name: Beacon of Immortality
text: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

name: Remove Soul
text: When your enemies are denied soldiers, they are denied victory.

name: Rootwater Commando
text: Rootwater merfolk are seldom seen these days, but elf corpses are as numerous as ever.

name: Rootwater Matriarch
text: In the harsh depths of Rootwater, the charms of surface dwellers are quite useless . . . except as lures.

name: Sea Monster
text: It's easy to believe the monster is a myth—until you feel three hundred thousand pounds of myth crashing down on your ship.

name: Sift
text: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

name: Sky Weaver
text: "Let my wisdom give you wings."

name: Benalish Knight
text:
"We called them 'armored lightning.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Snapping Drake
text: The irritable drakes are solitary nesters. Even brooding females barely contain the urge to attack their own young.

name: Spiketail Hatchling
text: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

name: Sunken Hope
text:
"I don't concern myself with my enemy's hopes. Hopes follow the tides. They will retreat soon enough."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Telepathy
text:
"The question isn't whether I can read minds. It's whether I have yet to find a mind worth reading."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Telling Time
text: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies collect jewels for theirs.

name: Tidings
text:
"Though the letter was many pages long, I could tell all I needed to know from one look at the messenger's face."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Time Stretch
text: There's lots of time like the present.

name: Traumatize
text:
"The educated mind is heavy with lore and knowledge. It's also the most likely to collapse under its own weight."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Cho-Manno, Revolutionary
text: "Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth. Our day has come at last."

name: Twincast
text: Imitation is the most dangerous form of flattery.

name: Twitch
text: Battles are won in nuance.

name: Unsummon
text: Tolarian apprentices learn to liberate Ætheric energy long before they are taught to bind it.

name: Vedalken Mastermind
text: The vedalken see other beings from a cold distance, as either experimental subjects or objects of study.

name: Wall of Air
text:
When no falcons fly, beware the sky.
—Femeref aphorism

name: Afflict
text: One rarely notices a heartbeat, save when it is stolen.

name: Agonizing Memories
text: In the aftermath of war, when the slaying is long done, the greatest miseries come home to roost.

name: Ascendant Evincar
text: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: A vertical scream pierces the night air and echoes doom through the clouds.

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now!"
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Bog Wraith
text: Knowing Takenuma Swamp to be dangerous, Hisata set wards to warn him of predators. He never imagined that his murderer would pass through them unhindered.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

name: Cruel Edict
text:
"Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Deathmark
text:
"I hope it's true that every snowflake is unique, because I never want to see one like this again. Now clean up that body."
—Thangbrand Gyrdsson, Kjeldoran patrol

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

name: Distress
text:
"They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. I like to break windows and take what's inside."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Doomed Necromancer
text: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

name: Dross Crocodile
text:
"As soon as it surfaced, we could all smell it. Its rancid breath reeked of half-digested carrion and its own rotting innards."
—Dafri, Auriok champion

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Demystify
text:
"Illusion is a crutch for those with no grounding in reality."
—Cho-Manno

name: Dusk Imp
text: Imps are just intelligent enough to have an understanding of cruelty.

name: Essence Drain
text:
"The elves are right: Death inevitably leads to life. But the truly powerful don't just experience this cycle. They control it."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Graveborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Hate Weaver
text: "Let my hate fuel your fury."

name: Hidden Horror
text: If the presence of evil were obvious, it wouldn't be nearly as dangerous.

name: Field Marshal
text: He is the only one who sees the patterns in the overlapping maps and conflicting reports.

name: Highway Robber
text: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

name: Hypnotic Specter
text: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.

name: Knight of Dusk
text: "Challenge me with your strongest. I will paint my sword with their blood."

name: Looming Shade
text: Its form never rests, propelled by some undetectable gale from beyond the gloom.

name: Lord of the Undead
text: "Do not weep at your defeat, my dear. In death, you will serve a greater purpose—mine."

name: Mass of Ghouls
text:
"An army has filled the valley, but it's not like any army I've ever seen. There are no tents, no fires, no horses . . . just a sea of bodies, writhing and moaning, as if a pestilent village were sent to invade us."
—Onean scout

name: Megrim
text:
"Pain is both a tool and a craft. Like any tool, it must be sharpened. Like any craft, it must be practiced."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

name: Midnight Ritual
text: Bury old friends deeply, lest they return bearing worms.

name: Mind Rot
text:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

name: Ghost Warden
text:
"I thought of fate as an iron lattice, intricate but rigidly unchangeable. That was until some force bent fate's bars to spare my life."
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

name: Mortal Combat
text: The crowd roared, the fighters bled, and the dead piled high in the pits. Only the Cabal could win.

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: No Rest for the Wicked
text:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Plague Beetle
text: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

name: Rain of Tears
text:
"When mortals die, they have family, friends, compatriots to mourn them. When the land dies, all else dies with it, and there is no one left to weep."
—Jacinth, Skyshroud ranger

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Recover
text: As Barrin exhumed his daughter's body, he finally realized the full price of his faith in Urza.

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Severed Legion
text: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

name: Soul Feast
text:
"I smell the tang of a mortal's fresh blood. I hear it sliding wetly beneath its skin. My hunger cannot refuse the invitation."
—Yuri, Sengir vampire

name: Hail of Arrows
text:
"Do not let a single shaft loose until my word. And when I give that word, do not leave a single shaft in Eiganjo."
—General Takeno

name: Spineless Thug
text: What it lacks in backbone, it makes up for in cruelty.

name: Stronghold Discipline
text: In Urborg, the instigators of each new rebellion are soaked in the blood of the last.

name: Thrull Surgeon
text: "Just take a little off the top."

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Unholy Strength
text: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

name: Anaba Bodyguard
text:
"They who challenge a minotaur enjoy the taste of their own blood."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Beacon of Destruction
text: The Great Furnace's blessing is a spectacular sight, but the best view comes at a high cost.

name: Bloodfire Colossus
text: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

name: Bloodrock Cyclops
text:
"There are only fifty words in the cyclops language, and ten of them mean 'kill.'"
—Ertai

name: Bogardan Firefiend
text:
"The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Cryoclasm
text: The people of Terisiare had come to live on frozen fields as though on solid ground. Nothing reminded them of the difference more clearly than the rifts brought on by the Thaw.

name: Demolish
text:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

name: Dragon Roost
text: Dragons erupt from peaks of chaos and flow from rivers of molten rage.

name: Duct Crawler
text:
"Boss told us to try and train 'em. Trained it to attack—it ate Flugg. Trained it to run fast—it got away. Success!"
—Dlig, goblin spelunker

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: High Ground
text: In war, as in society, position is everything.

name: Fists of the Anvil
text: Gron's mind reeled with possibilities, most of which are best left unmentioned.

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Flowstone Slide
text:
"Like an avalanche. With teeth. That will chase you. Uphill."
—Flint Foot, viashino runner

name: Furnace of Rath
text: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Goblin Elite Infantry
text: They talk a good fight.

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

name: Goblin Lore
text: "Now listen closely, my young gob. There are many ways to eat pimple bugs, but I say the best way is all smashed together between two slug chips."

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Holy Day
text:
"Today there is feasting and peace across our land, but the war has not ended. Tuck away your bloodlust. You'll need it tomorrow."
—Karrim, Samite healer

name: Goblin Sky Raider
text: The goblin word for "flying" is more accurately translated as "falling slowly."

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lavaborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Manabarbs
text:
"I don't know why people say a double-edged sword is bad. It's a sword. With two edges."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Orcish Artillery
text:
"So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game."
—General Khurzog

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

name: Rage Weaver
text: "Let my passion spur your victory."

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Relentless Assault
text: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

name: Rock Badger
text:
"As it charged our keep, I mistook it for a bear. After it tore through our ramparts and half the guard, I wished it had been a bear after all."
—Ballista guard

name: Scoria Wurm
text: Late at night, ululations echo from deep under Shiv, as the wurms sing of times older than humanity.

name: Seismic Assault
text: Earth arms itself with fire.

name: Shatterstorm
text: From a marvel of magical mechanization to a smoking stack of scrap in one easy step.

name: Honor Guard
text: The strength of one. The courage of ten.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Shivan Hellkite
text: A dragon's scale can be carved into a mighty shield, provided you can procure a dragontooth to cut it.

name: Shunt
text: Aranghil held her fury in her heart, hard and bright as a ruby. With its razor edge, she rewrote the laws of battle.

name: Smash
text: Ravnica's laws protect not its citizens but its industry. Aging equipment is destroyed rather than restored, to bring more money into the factories' coffers.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

name: Icatian Priest
text: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow. Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

name: Stun
text:
"Fortunately, merfolk aren't used to opponents with feet."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sudden Impact
text:
"Some say it's better to think before you act. While those people are considering all the options, that's usually when I kill them."
—Dravus, lava mage

name: Threaten
text: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Viashino Runner
text:
"It moved this way, an' that way, an' then before I could stick it, it jumped over my head an' was gone."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Wall of Fire
text: The erupting flames work as both barrier and weapon.

name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
text: Upon the frozen tundra stand the Kjeldoran Royal Guard, pikes raised, with the king's oath upon their lips.

name: Aggressive Urge
text: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Creeping Mold
text: Mold crept over the walls and into every crevice until the gleaming white stone strained and burst.

name: Elven Riders
text: "Wirewood cannot hide great size. Only with speed and skill can we survive here."

name: Loxodon Mystic
text: Elder mystics take their vow of silence so seriously that they impose it on any who enter their presence.

name: Elvish Berserker
text: Their fury scatters enemies like a pile of dry leaves.

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Enormous Baloth
text: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

name: Femeref Archers
text:
"Bet you can't put it through the eye."
"Left or right?"

name: Gaea's Herald
text: "Gaea sings with the voice of nature rampant: a thousand howls, chitters, and cries, and none of them can be ignored."

name: Giant Spider
text:
"When I trained under Multani, he bade me sit for hours watching Yavimaya's spiders. From them I learned stealth, patience, and the best way to snare a wind drake."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Grizzly Bears
text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Loyal Sentry
text: "My cause is simple: To stop you, at any cost, from ever seeing the inside of this keep."

name: Hurricane
text:
"Don't envy the grandeur of drakes. Their impression of grace fades when the first gust sends them crashing into one another."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Joiner Adept
text: A talented apprentice makes all things. The master makes all things possible.

name: Karplusan Strider
text: The strider's long, loping gait is an adaptation that allows it to move quickly in deep snow.

name: Kavu Climber
text:
"There was a crack of branches, a rustle of leaves, then a tremendous roar. Our party had no chance as death descended from above."
—Taseen, elvish bard

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Llanowar Sentinel
text:
"The forest has as many eyes as leaves."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lure
text: Her true theft was to steal the soldiers away from their posts.

name: Might of Oaks
text: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

name: Might Weaver
text: "Let my strength harden your resolve."

name: Luminesce
text:
"The White Shield is not the burnished metal you lash to your forearm but the conviction that burns in your chest."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Natural Spring
text:
"Jewels cannot be eaten nor gold drunk. What civilization trades, nature simply provides."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Naturalize
text:
"Well, it also makes a very nice flower pot. . . ."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Pincher Beetles
text:
"No fair! Since when does a bug get ta munch on *me*?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Quirion Dryad
text:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

name: Recollect
text:
"The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
—Savra

name: Mobilization
text: Wars are won with strength, valor, and numbers—especially numbers.

name: Root Maze
text: Pause for the briefest of moments to consider the whorl of brambles, the tangled twist of bark, and the maze has already won.

name: Rootwalla
text: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

name: Rushwood Dryad
text: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

name: Scion of the Wild
text: It has a hundred thousand extinctions to avenge.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Skyshroud Ranger
text: Not even the elves truly know the Skyshroud Forest. The rangers are merely the best equipped to handle its uncertainty.

name: Spined Wurm
text: Its spines act like the teeth of a saw, scoring distinctive marks in the vegetation of its territory.

name: Stalking Tiger
text: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Nomad Mythmaker
text: On the wild steppes, history vanishes in the dust. Only the mythmakers remain to say what was, and is, and will be.

name: Sylvan Basilisk
text:
"We're not sure what one looks like, so to be safe, nobody look at anything until we're out of here."
—Parbold Drix, veteran explorer

name: Sylvan Scrying
text: One glimpse of an elf's home lasts her weeks away in the wild.

name: Tangle Spider
text: Only rumors have ever escaped its web.

name: Treetop Bracers
text: Gravity is truly what you make of it.

name: Upwelling
text: Freyalise promised a dawn that would never end, a day of limitless life. As many dread her promise as revere it.

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Viridian Shaman
text: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

name: Wall of Wood
text: Orcish lumberjacks spent the night sharpening their blades and resting for a day of labor. They awoke to find that the forest had been making its own preparations.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Chimeric Staff
text: The staff unraveled in a chaotic chorus of clanging, becoming an improbable beast of hissing blades.

name: Citanul Flute
text: Each note of the flute mimics the call of a different beast.

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."

name: Composite Golem
text: An artificer's experiment in cross-material engineering found its own purpose as an interpreter between cultures.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Doubling Cube
text: The cube's surface is pockmarked with jagged runes that seem to shift when unobserved.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Fountain of Youth
text: Some say the fountain's waters are the first rains that fell over Dominaria.

name: The Hive
text:
"Their buzzing makes my bones hum from a mile away."
—Galenti, treasure hunter

name: Howling Mine
text: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Juggernaut
text: Built with neither a way to steer nor a way to stop, the juggernauts were simply aimed at an enemy's best defenses and told to charge.

name: Kraken's Eye
text: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"Not by age but by capacity is wisdom gained."
—Titus Maccius Plautus, *Trinummus*

name: Ornithopter
text:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

name: Phyrexian Vault
text:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

name: Platinum Angel
text: In its heart lies the secret of immortality.

name: Reviving Dose
text: Samite healers never mix their pungent elixir with sweetener or tea. The threat of a second dose is enough to get most warriors back on their feet.

name: Rod of Ruin
text: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Spellbook
text:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Steel Golem
text:
"Once you create perfection, what else is there to make?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Righteousness
text: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Rule of Law
text: Appointed by the kha himself, members of the tribunal ensure all disputes are settled with the utmost fairness.

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Serra Angel
text: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

name: Angelic Chorus
text: The harmony of the glorious is a dirge to the wicked.

name: Skyhunter Patrol
text:
"We leonin have come to rule the plains by taking to the skies."
—Raksha Golden Cub

name: Skyhunter Prowler
text: As tireless as her mount, a skyhunter's vigil is measured in days.

name: Soul Warden
text:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

name: Spirit Weaver
text: "Let my hope be your shield."

name: Starlight Invoker
text: "The constellations form a tapestry of light that traces my people's broken history. Day and night, I feel their glittering presence calling me to weave the pattern whole."

name: Steadfast Guard
text: "Best leave your tongue in its yap-hole, Mercadian scum, for your silvered words and golden bribes do not sparkle so brightly outside your city."

name: Angelic Wall
text:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

name: Suntail Hawk
text: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

name: Tempest of Light
text: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may takes its course."

name: Treasure Hunter
text: "The treasures of the ancients belong in museums, not in the grubby hands of grave robbers."

name: True Believer
text: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

name: Tundra Wolves
text:
"I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains."
—Onean scout

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Wall of Swords
text: The air hummed with the scissoring sound of uncounted blades that hovered in front of the invaders as though wielded by a phalanx of unseen hands.

name: Warrior's Honor
text:
"The day will come when the righteous warrior faces a battle she cannot win. She will greet that day as she has any other."
—Asmira, holy avenger

name: Wild Griffin
text:
"I abandoned my dream of a squadron of griffin-riders when the cost proved too high. Three trainers were eaten for every griffin broken to the bridle."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Aura of Silence
text: Not all silences are easily broken.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Youthful Knight
text: Idealism fits him better than his armor.

name: Academy Researchers
text: They brandish their latest theories as warriors would wield weapons.

name: Air Elemental
text:
"The East Wind, an interloper in the dominions of Westerly Weather, is an impassive-faced tyrant with a sharp poniard held behind his back for a treacherous stab."
—Joseph Conrad, *The Mirror of the Sea*

name: Ambassador Laquatus
text: "Life is a game. The only thing that matters is whether you're a pawn or a player."

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: "Do not concern yourself with my origin, my race, or my ancestry. Seek my record in the pits, and then make your wager."

name: Aura Graft
text: "It's not really stealing. It's more like extended borrowing."

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Aven Windreader
text: "The tiniest ripple tells a story ten fathoms deep."

name: Boomerang
text: Early Jamuraan hunters devised a weapon that would return to its source. Tolarian Aethermancers developed a spell that skipped the weapon entirely.

name: Cephalid Constable
text: Cephalids don't police people. They police loyalties.

name: Cloud Elemental
text: The soratami surround their sky-castles with living clouds that serve as both sword and shield.

name: Cloud Sprite
text: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

name: Counsel of the Soratami
text: "Wisdom is not the counting of all the drops in a waterfall. Wisdom is learning why the water seeks the earth."

name: Crafty Pathmage
text:
Follow the pathmage
—Otarian expression meaning "escape quickly"

name: Deluge
text:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan

name: Ballista Squad
text: The perfect antidote for a tightly packed formation.

name: Denizen of the Deep
text: According to merfolk legend, a denizen of the deep swallows the horizon at the end of each day, bringing on the cold blanket of night.

name: Discombobulate
text:
"I said 'pick his brain,' not 'tear off his head.'"
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Dreamborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Nature? Fire? Bah! Both are chaotic and difficult to control. Ice is structured, latticed, light as a feather, massive as a glacier. In ice, there is power!"
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Fog Elemental
text:
"It's the perfect sentry. Those who should pass can go right through it."
—Teferi

name: Fugitive Wizard
text:
"The law has its place—as a footnote in my spellbook."
—Siyani, fugitive mage

name: Horseshoe Crab
text:
"Hmm . . . It looks kinda like a bug. Let's crack it open an' see if it tastes like one!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Hurkyl's Recall
text: Hurkyl's research at the College of Lat-Nam wasn't enough to stop the two brothers, but for centuries thereafter her spellcraft taught artificers restraint.

name: Lumengrid Warden
text: The wardens keep watch over an endless sea of progress.

name: Bandage
text: Life is measured in inches. To a healer, every one of those inches is precious.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Merfolk Looter
text:
It belongs to the merfolk now.
—Shipwreck prayer

name: Peek
text: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.

name: Persuasion
text: There's no telling what an accomplished mage might collect.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"There are as many pillows of illusion as flakes in a snow-storm. We wake from one dream into another dream."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Illusions"

name: Plagiarize
text: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

name: Puppeteer
text:
"That's the funny thing about free will. You don't feel any different without it."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Reminisce
text: Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges.

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

name: Frozen Shade
text:
"There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Nightmare
text: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Plague Rats
text:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text: "They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,/ Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;/ It had been strange, even in a dream,/ To have seen those dead men rise."/ —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Bone
text: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"About, about in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Dragon Whelp
text:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

name: Dwarven Demolition Team
text: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text:
"And topples round the dreary west
A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin King
text: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

name: Gray Ogre
text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Ironclaw Orcs
text: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Orcish Artillery
text: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

name: Roc of Kher Ridges
text: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Two-Headed Giant of Foriys
text: None know if this Giant is the result of aberrant magics, Siamese twins, or a mentalist's schizophrenia.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

name: Wall of Fire
text: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Elvish Archers
text: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Ironroot Treefolk
text: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Whenever the Llanowar Elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

name: Timber Wolves
text: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Wall of Brambles
text: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

name: Wall of Ice
text:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Wood
text: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

name: War Mammoth
text: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

name: Jade Statue
text:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—Song of the Artificer

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

name: Pearled Unicorn
text: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

name: Benalish Hero
text: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
text: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

name: Phantasmal Forces
text: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

name: Phantom Monster
text:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Anger of the Gods
text: Hazoret's disappointment at initiates who fail their final trials can manifest in terrible ways.

name: Backdraft Hellkite
text: Memories burn with the brightest flames.

name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
text: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

name: Dockside Extortionist
text: "It's just business."

name: Dreamshaper Shaman
text: Magic is the true artist's medium.

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Goblin Banneret
text: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.

name: Hero of the Games
text: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.

name: Hissing Iguanar
text: Viashino thrashes keep iguanars as hunting companions, giving them wounded captives as playthings.

name: Kruin Striker
text: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

name: Labyrinth Champion
text: "It used to be a lair. Now it's just a tunnel."

name: Lava Coil
text:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Living Lightning
text: Not all storms come from the sky.

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Pirate's Pillage
text: Goblins can carry their body weight in loot.

name: Sparkmage's Gambit
text:
"A touch of lightning, and anyone can be taught to dance."
—Tobin, sparkmage

name: Storm Fleet Pyromancer
text:
"She's quick and fearless, and she's never missed a shot. That almost makes up for all the scorch marks she leaves behind."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Titan's Strength
text: "One last push, and then my task is done."

name: Warrior's Oath
text: "I swear this before all gods old and new: I will fight to my last breath."

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Ambuscade
text: "Spent a lifetime learning from predators. Picked up a few tricks."

name: Annoyed Altisaur
text: It pairs a long neck with a short temper.

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

name: Bloom Tender
text: Beauty is a seed, waiting to blossom under her capable hands.

name: Brindle Shoat
text: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

name: Centaur Battlemaster
text:
"A herd is only as strong as its weakest. Our weakest just killed his third minotaur raider—today."
—Braulios of Pheres Band

name: Concordant Crossroads
text: The wolf closed in. But then a strange wind whispered through the leaves, and with a burst of speed, the deer surged forward out of reach.

name: Deadly Recluse
text: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Food Chain
text: Every predator is something else's prey.

name: Gnarlback Rhino
text:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Last Breath
text: He gasped in wonder even as his body crumbled away.

name: Green Sun's Zenith
text: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Impervious Greatwurm
text: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

name: Might of Old Krosa
text:
"Krosa the great. Krosa the enduring. Look to the forest, and it will share its bounty."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Leonin Arbiter
text: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

name: Summer Bloom
text: "All the treasures of this world are grown, not made."

name: Thrive
text: The most successful of Simic creations is cytoplasm, a living, symbiotic substance that feeds off genetic rhythms and strengthens its host in return.

name: Travel Preparations
text: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Webweaver Changeling
text: Eight legs carrying endless phobias.

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

name: Arjun, the Shifting Flame
text: He speaks directly into his supplicants' minds using fiery words that inflame their thoughts and incite their passions.

name: Ashen Rider
text: One offering to appease her on her arrival. Another to celebrate her departure.

name: Ashenmoor Liege
text: Cinders carry an ancestral grudge that makes them slow to trust and quick to retaliate.

name: Assassin's Trophy
text: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Bant Charm
text: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

name: Bear's Companion
text: "The Sultai came hunting for a bear hide. Now I have a belt of naga skin, and my friend has a full belly."

name: Blazing Hellhound
text: It tears the flesh from your bones and then swallows the ash with its fiery maw.

name: Boartusk Liege
text: The boar leads its rider to victory in battle, but it doesn't know how close it is to becoming the victory feast.

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Call to the Feast
text: By the law of church and crown, vampires feed only on the blood of the guilty—those declared heretics, rebels, or enemies of war.

name: Cartel Aristocrat
text: "Your life serves a higher purpose now: ensuring the continuation of my own."

name: Child of Alara
text: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.

name: Chronicler of Heroes
text: She paints pictures with words, though not all pictures show the truth.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Conclave Mentor
text: "I have faith in your potential."

name: Crackling Doom
text: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

name: Dauntless Escort
text: Elspeth's squires do not seek advancement. For them, no knightly glory could surpass the glory of serving their champion.

name: Doran, the Siege Tower
text: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

name: Dragonlord Dromoka
text: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.

name: Dragonlord Silumgar
text: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

name: Drogskol Reaver
text: Wracked and warped with anguish, it obsessively seeks out other souls to hoard within its eternal prison.
