name: Eyeblight's Ending
text:
"Those without beauty are Lorwyn's greatest tumor. The winnowers have an unpleasant duty, but a necessary one."
—Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Imperial Seal
text:
"Your presence at the palace this evening is required."
—Letter from Queen Marchesa

name: Divine Visitation
text: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

name: Liliana's Elite
text:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

name: Necrotic Ooze
text:
"To death all must go, and so in death lies ultimate power."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Oona's Prowler
text: Deep in Glen Elendra blossoms Oona, queen of the faeries, nourished by secrets and pollinated by stolen dreams.

name: Seekers' Squire
text: Dusk follows the light.

name: Severed Strands
text: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Skinrender
text:
"Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Strands of Undeath
text:
"Why limit yourself to mortal law when you can outlive those who enforce it?"
—Czaric, Orzhov prelate

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Unearth
text: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

name: Vampire Sovereign
text:
"Your service shall be rewarded."
—Queen Lian

name: Vampiric Rites
text: Scions of the Markov line take particular pleasure in the perversion of humans' holy rituals.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Boon Reflection
text: Twice brewed and twice blessed, the remedy restores both body and mind.

name: Ovalchase Daredevil
text: "Let me guess. You thought I was dead."

name: Painsmith
text: The Moriok see the artificer as a taskmaster, forcing lazy metal into more potent shapes.

name: Skirsdag High Priest
text: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Thoughtseize
text: "Any dream is a robust harvest. Still, I prefer the timeworn dreams, heavy with import, that haunt the obsessive mind."

name: Council's Judgment
text: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Wound Reflection
text: The greater the suffering, the sweeter the taste.

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Balduvian Rage
text:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Bloodshot Trainee
text: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

name: Brimstone Volley
text: Peace had failed. War had failed. There was only one option left.

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

name: Cragganwick Cremator
text: Each night that his bowl fills, a village mourns.

name: Dismantle
text:
"If only the living were so easily salvaged."
—Memnarch

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Galvanic Blast
text: Mirrodin has little weather, but it certainly has lightning.

name: Goblin Gaveleer
text:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Crusader of Odric
text: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

name: Heat Shimmer
text:
"Better to flare out than to gutter."
—Flamekin expression

name: Imperial Recruiter
text: A passionate recruiter will win a war before the first arrow flies.

name: Ion Storm
text: When enough artifacts lie too long in the same place, their magical radiation weakens reality, opening rifts of unpredictable destructive power.

name: Kazuul's Toll Collector
text: Travelers are advised to bring extra swords, preferably shiny ones.

name: Lightning Axe
text:
"A gargoyle's meat can be carved with an ordinary cleaver, but for its petrous hide . . ."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Mana Echoes
text: When the ground is saturated with mana, even the lightest footstep can bring it to the surface.

name: Orcish Vandal
text: Every ancient relic is a weapon if you throw it hard enough.

name: Rage Reflection
text: Make every blow count.

name: Ethersworn Canonist
text: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Ravenous Intruder
text:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League

name: Rolling Earthquake
text: An empire can take centuries to build but mere moments to destroy.

name: Salivating Gremlins
text: If an elf can dream it, a dwarf can build it, and a gremlin can eat it.

name: Skinbrand Goblin
text:
"These Gruul skin-runes—discern whether their patterns evoke streets, leylines, or both. You have four days."
—Niv-Mizzet, to his assistant

name: Trash for Treasure
text: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.

name: Tuktuk the Explorer
text: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Bloodbriar
text:
"There is a sourness here that I don't understand. When the land reaches out to me, I hesitate to reach back."
—Nissa Revane

name: Clear Shot
text:
"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Conclave Naturalists
text: "Your swords and wards have no power here."

name: Crop Rotation
text: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

name: Crushing Vines
text:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters. This dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

name: Death-Hood Cobra
text:
"Size alone does not guarantee survival."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Enlarge
text: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

name: Exploration
text:
"Only when we journey into the unknown can we find the impossible."
—Cyrul the Wanderer

name: Gelatinous Genesis
text: Even as the world was left cracked and gory by the marauding Eldrazi, new life began to drip from its wounds.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Greater Good
text:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

name: Heartbeat of Spring
text:
"It is true that we monks hold the key to paradise, but most don't understand that the paradise we guard is the one within."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Kozilek's Predator
text: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

name: Mana Reflection
text: The greatest wonders of nature are found in the smallest saplings straining toward the canopy.

name: Might of the Masses
text: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
text: "Shine bright, bolts tight."

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Vengevine
text: Leave but a shred of root and it will return, bursting with vigor.

name: Whisperer of the Wilds
text: She speaks only in whispers but can be heard over the fiercest storm.

name: Woodland Champion
text: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
text: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

name: Fulminator Mage
text: "Burn, suffer, and trouble me no more."

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Alabaster Mage
text:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
text: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Manamorphose
text:
"Master the chaotic forces of nature, and you shall master magic."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Leonin Abunas
text: Only leonin clerics who can survive the Razor Fields for one turning of the suns can stand in the Cave of Light.

name: Meddling Mage
text: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."

name: Rhys the Redeemed
text: Whole again in honor and horn.

name: Sen Triplets
text: They are the masters of your mind.

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Master Splicer
text: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

name: Swiftblade Vindicator
text: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Time Sieve
text:
"I pray that I am never considered useless or old."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Vexing Shusher
text: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

name: Weapons Trainer
text: "When I'm done training you, anything will be a deadly weapon."

name: Myrsmith
text: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

name: Accomplished Automaton
text: Was it just lonely, or was some form of evolution inevitable?

name: Adaptive Automaton
text: Such loyalty can only be made.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Open the Vaults
text: When the vaults are empty, everyone is rich.

name: Cogwork Assembler
text: Duplication is neither thievery nor flattery. It is efficiency.

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Coretapper
text: It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.

name: Culling Dais
text:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Darksteel Axe
text: Heavier than it looks, tricky to wield, guaranteed to last.

name: Darksteel Forge
text:
"It is as if this world has been expecting our blessings."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Eager Construct
text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"When I said I needed a hand, I didn't mean this."
—Gerrard Capashen

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Gleaming Barrier
text:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

name: Golem Artisan
text: Better living through metallurgy.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Iron Bully
text:
"Why would someone have built ... wait, never mind. Send it to the front lines!"
—Commander Grozdan

name: Iron League Steed
text: The Iron League prides itself on its metal-shaping techniques.

name: Jhoira's Familiar
text:
"You could say it was my pet project."
—Jhoira

name: Kuldotha Forgemaster
text: The goblins say it used to be larger, before it began to stoke the Great Furnace with pieces of itself.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Lux Cannon
text: There are few problems that can't be solved by putting a hole in the world.

name: Magnifying Glass
text: Knight-Inquisitors of Saint Raban delve deep into mysteries best left unexplored.

name: Remember the Fallen
text: When the Mirrans had fallen, Planeswalkers carried the burden of remembrance.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

name: Mesmeric Orb
text: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Mox Opal
text: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Revoke Existence
text:
"The time has come for us to throw off the chains of tyrannical gods and antiquated superstitions."
—Tikaia, disciple of Uremides

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Pyrite Spellbomb
text:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Spellskite
text:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Springleaf Drum
text: "The music is in the drum. I simply coax it out to be heard."

name: Sundering Titan
text:
"Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Surge Node
text: Without a foe to focus on, the machine priests had time to indulge in new sciences.

name: Sanctum Spirit
text:
"When history becomes too mournful, even good souls may choose to forget."
—Shalai, voice of Plenty

name: Throne of Geth
text: At the heart of Ish Sah, Geth stokes the dark fires of Phyrexia.

name: Tumble Magnet
text: Magnetic devices that keep massive golems and structures standing can also be used for the opposite purpose.

name: Welding Jar
text: The wires crawl over broken metal and heat themselves to melting, filling cracks quickly and efficiently.

name: Academy Ruins
text: Its secrets once wrought the greatest artifice ever known. Now crabs loot the rubble to decorate their shells.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Fire-Lit Thicket
text: Occupancy of the den changes from night to night as boggart gangs fight for control of a place they aren't willing to simply eat.

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Glimmervoid
text: An empty canvas holds infinite possibilities.

name: Stonehewer Giant
text: "No matter how strong, an unarmed fighter is no more than a fool."

name: Graven Cairns
text:
"Here did the Extinguisher steal the light from the world. Here will we sacrifice her to bring the Great Rekindling to our people."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Mystic Gate
text: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Sunken Ruins
text: Without the care of the tideshapers, the Lanes lie neglected. Some have flooded entire towns; others dried to cracked mud.

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Urza's Mine
text: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

name: Strength of Arms
text:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

name: Wooded Bastion
text: The elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood continually expand the palisade surrounding the sanctuary. They hope to one day enclose the entire forest within its walls.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: Avacyn lives on in the hearts and minds of Innistrad's people.

name: Council's Judgment
text: "Our ruling is final."

name: Brainstorm
text:
"In all my years of research, I have yet to accurately quantify that baffling mental process known as 'inspiration.'"
—Elmora, mage-analyst

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: "Oh, *that's* what that switch does!"

name: Tempered Steel
text:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

name: Force of Will
text: "Amateur."

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Thoughtseize
text: The mind is a fragile thing. Remove the smallest fragment, and the whole thing starts to fall apart.

name: Toxic Deluge
text: Armor dissolved into flesh. Flesh melted to bone. Bone fell away to nothing.

name: Blood Moon
text: Bathed in deep crimson, the land that once gave comfort and shelter now yielded nothing but hostility.

name: Goblin Guide
text: When the landmarks themselves get up and move, goblin intuition beats any map.

name: Sneak Attack
text: "Keep watch? Why? Nothing going to mess with us. We too big and scary."

name: Crop Rotation
text: "The end of my cycle draws near. Rise up, young sprouts, and take root in my place."

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Exploration
text: With every step she took, a new world unfolded before her.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: In all her years of vigil, her resolve has never faltered.

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Meddling Mage
text: "Some defy the laws of nature. I dare nature to defy me."

name: Expedition Map
text:
"Let's see. I've been here, here, here, here, and here. Where next?"
—Olenn, tireless traveler

name: Topple the Statue
text: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Mana Crypt
text: At first they thought the vault was empty. Then the walls began to glow.

name: Mox Opal
text: What crossed her mind defied Orthodoxy: could there be perfection beyond *compleation*?

name: Academy Ruins
text: The Tolarian Academy was home to some of the greatest discoveries in Dominaria's history—as well as its greatest tragedies.

name: Valor in Akros
text: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

name: Urza's Mine
text: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Angel of the Dawn
text: She sings for all those who have been silenced.

name: Apprentice Wizard
text: Aspiring wizards must demonstrate basic levels of willpower and mental discipline to even be considered for an apprenticeship.

name: Arcum Dagsson
text: "Artifice sundered the world. It shall not again wreak such sorrow."

name: Argivian Restoration
text:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
text: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Corridor Monitor
text: Castle Vantress has no locks on its doors, but interlopers rarely make it past the foyer.

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Esperzoa
text: The more metal it digests, the more its jelly will fetch on the alchemists' market.

name: Archangel of Thune
text: Even the wicked have nightmares.

name: Force of Will
text: "I alone determine my destiny."

name: Frogify
text: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.

name: Hinder
text:
"Do not react to force in kind. Turn it aside. Direct it to where it can do no harm."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: Metallic Rebuke
text:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

name: Auriok Salvagers
text: "Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps. Scraps are enough."

name: Parasitic Strix
text: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Relic Runner
text: Her knack for tampering with wards got her kicked out of the academy, but they also got her back in.

name: Reshape
text:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Riddlesmith
text: The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.

name: Rush of Knowledge
text:
"Limitless power is glorious until you gain limitless understanding."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Serra Sphinx
text: Sphinxes drink from the mystic meres of Serra's realm, where their keen eyes watch reflections of what is and what is yet to come.

name: Sift
text: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

name: Steel Sabotage
text:
"You are hopelessly obsolete, my brothers. Come and join the Great Work."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Lymph, the fluid essence of blinkmoths, is prized by wizards for the rush of intellect it provides.

name: Thought Reflection
text: Only when two oracles speak in unison is an omen accepted as truth.

name: Vedalken Infuser
text: "All plans begin as dreams. I intend to awaken them."

name: Ad Nauseam
text: When the task spilled over into undeath, he stopped calling it his life's work.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

name: Bone Picker
text: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Costly Plunder
text: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Death's Shadow
text: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.

name: Defiant Salvager
text: "I didn't survive that crash just so I could fall to the likes of you."

name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
text: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Disciple of the Vault
text: He stands in the shadow of his lord, Geth, drinking in the dark energies of the Vault.

name: Divest
text: Flittersprites collect unusually valuable things: coins of fallen empires, baby teeth, and memories of treasured names.

name: Doomed Necromancer
text: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Blade Splicer
text: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Drown in Sorrow
text:
"The sad truth is that the whip of Erebos is long enough to wrap around all our throats."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Glaze Fiend
text: Before the zealots of the Ethersworn came to power, Esper illusionists dreamed up creations to mimic a variety of substances.

name: Magus of the Abyss
text: He climbs a staircase of falling souls, fighting the continuous pull of the void.

name: Magus of the Will
text: "These eyes have shown me the flaws of flesh."

name: Morkrut Banshee
text:
"Let go your grudges, or risk wandering the bogs forever in a murderous rage."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

name: Frozen Shade
text:
"There are some qualities—some incorporate things,
That have a double life, which thus is made
A type of that twin entity which springs
From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"There was no trace
Of aught on that illumined face...."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Nightmare
text: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Plague Rats
text:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you...."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"About, about, in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Dwarven Demolition Team
text: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text:
"And topples round the dreary west,
A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text:
"From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!"
"Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin King
text: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar,
*The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Gray Ogre
text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Roc of Kher Ridges
text: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and spread gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

name: Wall of Fire
text: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Elvish Archers
text: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Ironroot Treefolk
text: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

name: Timber Wolves
text: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Wall of Ice
text:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs
Did send a dismal sheen:
Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—
The ice was all between."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Wood
text: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

name: War Mammoth
text: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

name: Jade Statue
text:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone...."
—Song of the Artificer

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text:
"Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort."
—*The Book of Tal*

name: Pearled Unicorn
text:
"'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!'
'Well, now that we *have* seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll, *Through the Looking-Glass*

name: Benalish Hero
text: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

name: Pearled Unicorn
text: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
text: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

name: Phantasmal Forces
text: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

name: Phantom Monster
text:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

name: Frozen Shade
text: "There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade." —Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

name: Hypnotic Specter
text: "...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..." —Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Nightmare
text: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Plague Rats
text: "Should you a Rat to madness tease Why ev'n a Rat may plague you. . ." —Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text: "They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,/ Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;/ It had been strange, even in a dream,/ To have seen those dead men rise."/ —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Bone
text: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text: "About, about in reel and rout The death-fires danced at night; The water, like a witch's oils, Burnt green, and blue and white." —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Atog
text: The bane of all artificers, the legendary Atogs devoured intricate tools to further their own twisted growth.

name: Dragon Whelp
text: "O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ." —Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

name: Dwarven Weaponsmith
text: "Work with zeal as hammers peal! Melt, anneal, and pound the steel!" —Old Dwarvish forge-chant

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text: "And topples round the dreary west A looming bastion fringed with fire." —Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin King
text: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

name: Gray Ogre
text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Orcish Artillery
text: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

name: Roc of Kher Ridges
text: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

name: Shatterstorm
text: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

name: Wall of Fire
text: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Crumble
text: The spirits of Argoth grant new life to those who repent the folly of enslaving their labors to devices.

name: Elvish Archers
text: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Ironroot Treefolk
text: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Whenever the Llanowar Elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

name: Timber Wolves
text: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Wall of Brambles
text: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

name: Wall of Ice
text:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs
Did send a dismal sheen:
Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—
The ice was all between."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Wood
text: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

name: War Mammoth
text: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

name: Aladdin's Ring
text:
"After these words the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's, saying: 'It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.'"
—The Arabian Nights, Junior Classics trans.

name: Dancing Scimitar
text: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

name: Dragon Engine
text: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Jandor's Saddlebags
text: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—*Song of the Artificer*

name: Onulet
text: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's Onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

name: Ornithopter
text: Many scholars believe that these creatures were the result of Urza's first attempt at mechanical life, perhaps created in his early days as an apprentice to Tocasia.

name: Rocket Launcher
text: What these devices lacked in subtlety, they made up in strength.

name: The Rack
text: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the Rack was once his most feared creation.

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

name: Pearled Unicorn
text: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless, flat plains of their homeland.

name: Benalish Hero
text: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
text: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Hurkyl's Recall
text: This spell, like many attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife Hurkyl.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

name: Phantasmal Forces
text: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

name: Phantom Monster
text:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Reconstruction
text: Tedious research made the Sages of the College of Lat-Nam adept in repairing broken artifacts.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

name: Toxicrene
text: It emits a stinking cloud composed of millions of nascent microscopic organisms, each possessing a fragment of predatory sentience.

name: Tyranid Invasion
text: By the time the Blood Angels descended from the heavens, Phodia was a city transformed. Miles of flesh-filled rivers fed into the central digestion pools and up into the hive fleet above.

name: Assault Intercessor
text: A foe without honour is a foe already beaten.

name: Blood for the Blood God!
text: Skulls for the Skull Throne.

name: Cybernetica Datasmith
text: "Engaging Protector protocol."

name: Deathleaper, Terror Weapon
text: Created to break will and bone with equal ferocity.

name: Deny the Witch
text: "This heresy cannot stand!"

name: Epistolary Librarian
text: "Bolters? Chainswords? All fine weapons, however I wield a far more dangerous power."

name: For the Emperor!
text: They all took up the cry, the missionaries, the pilgrims, the sisters of the Orders Militant. The forces of Chaos melted before the fire of their faith.

name: Exterminatus
text:
"Some may question your right to destroy ten billion people. Those who understand know that you have no right to let them live."
—Exterminatus Extremis

name: Gargoyle Flock
text: They dive screaming on defensive lines, sowing chaos before the main assault begins.

name: Helbrute
text:
"No. No! Not the sarcophagus . . . Khorne damn you, you disloyal curs. JUST KILL ME!"
—Kalos the Ravager

name: The Lost and the Damned
text: The gods of Chaos bestow gifts of mutations upon their champions. Too many of these gifts transform their bearer into mindless, writhing chaos spawn.

name: Grey Knight Paragon
text:
"Our will shall be our weapons, our faith shall be our armour."
—Canticle of Absolution

name: Primaris Chaplain
text: Every kill is a sacrament of the Emperor's glory.

name: Shadow in the Warp
text: The astropath collapsed, his empty eye sockets aglow. He spoke three words before falling lifeless to the ground: "They . . . are . . . coming!"

name: Sister Hospitaller
text:
"Ours is to honour the martyr, tend the fallen, defend the innocent, and walk always in the light."
—*The Hospitaller's Book of Hours*

name: Sister Repentia
text:
"I shall seek the Emperor's forgiveness in the darkest places of the night."
—Oath of the Penitent

name: Trygon Prime
text: The walls of the Necron tomb were unbreakable. The ground beneath it was not.

name: Tzaangor Shaman
text: Tzeentch's beastmen twist reality as they themselves are twisted.

name: Venomthrope
text:
"See that cloud that hangs around it? More than a minute in there and you'll be bleeding out of places you didn't even know you had."
—Captain Ascote

name: Winged Hive Tyrant
text: A hive tyrant's synaptic link is the primary conduit through which the Hive Mind enforces its dominance over a hive fleet's lesser creatures.

name: Space Marine Scout
text: Through blood and battle, scouts are forged from raw recruits into the Imperium's finest.

name: Cryptothrall
text: Bound to a cryptek, the cryptothrall exists for one reason: to defend its master to the death.

name: Thunderwolf Cavalry
text: The practice of tracking and training Thunderwolves is a sort of initiation ritual into the upper echelons of the Wolf Guard.

name: Sceptre of Eternal Glory
text: It burns with the very fire that doomed Szarekh's species, and channels it to devastate his foes.

name: Abaddon the Despoiler
text: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

name: Abaddon the Despoiler
text: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

name: Bastion Protector
text: "By this oath, I pledge to stand by thee, against traitor, beast, or fiend, for only in death does duty end."

name: Deploy to the Front
text:
"When the door drops, give them a taste of the Emperor's fire!"
—Commissar Yarrick

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text: "Now!"

name: Fell the Mighty
text: The battle began with an overwhelming wave of Tyranids and ended with Canoness Lucretia standing atop a huge pile of charred alien corpses.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: The Battle of Baal was the bloodiest and most costly in the entire noble history of the Sons of Sanguinius.

name: Martial Coup
text:
"It is their duty to fight and die so that Humanity might be preserved."
—Lord Commissar Barron Reed

name: Vexilus Praetor
text: There is no greater bulwark than the Praetors of the Adeptus Custodes, the bodyguards of the Emperor of Mankind.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"Hunger is no different from any other foe; defeat it in the Emperor's name, and save Humanity."
—Motto of the Agri-World Viridia IV

name: Aetherize
text: No berzerker charge can stand against the psychic might of the Hive Mind.

name: Brainstorm
text: The Changer of Ways often sends glimpses of possible futures to his most loyal acolytes, visions that would destroy lesser minds.

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text: "We've reached the xenos HQ. Transmitting coordinates now."

name: Beacon of Unrest
text:
"Rise and serve me once more."
—Trazyn the Infinite

name: Bile Blight
text:
"Hold your bitterness deep within, and there let it fester. Let it roil and squirm and churn, until you are filled with bile so poisonous that all you touch falls to ruin."
—Mortarion, Daemon Primarch

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Praise Nurgle! For the plague to have progressed so quickly, truly his blessing must be upon us!"
—Ku'gath Plaguefather

name: Darkness
text: By the physical laws of our universe, darkness is merely the absence of light. Necrons can harness the power of other dimensions, where darkness is tangible and moldable.

name: Defile
text:
"Agresto, bring up the rear . . . Agresto?"
—Sergeant Dremark Eigen, last words

name: Abaddon the Despoiler
text: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

name: Dread Return
text:
"Bolters, flamers, plasma—we hit the xenos with everything, and it just kept coming."
—Captain Uriel Ventris

name: Go for the Throat
text:
"Pray that night is upon us, for if this twilight is the work of the Necrons, we are all dead men."
—Address by Lieutenant Krakos prior to the Bloodmoon Massacres

name: Mutilate
text: "You mortals turn to dust in the blink of an eye. I only expedite your fate."

name: Blasphemous Act
text: In the roiling depths of the Eye of Terror, the bloodthirsty hordes of Chaos Marines plot the downfall of their loyalist brethren.

name: Chaos Warp
text:
"Tzeentch cares not what they were or what they become. Only that they change."
—Kairos Fateweaver

name: Reverberate
text:
"That which was, will be. That which will be, was."
—Kairos Fateweaver

name: Starstorm
text:
"They're beasts! What are they going to do, bomb us from orbit?"
—Platoon Commander Cyrus Jalili, Prandium Defence Auxilia

name: Warstorm Surge
text: Khorne's sole desire is to drown the galaxy in a tide of slaughter. To conquer and kill every living thing, until there is nothing left but spilled blood and shattered bone.

name: Genestealer Locus
text: Harrowing visions, paralyzing pain, and terrifying brain spasms await those who challenge the cult.

name: Cultivate
text: A single spore from a Tyranid Hive Ship can spell doom for a solar system.

name: Death's Presence
text: The Genestealer Cults rejoiced at the arrival of their gods . . . at first.

name: Explore
text: The Tyranids advance inexorably across the galaxy in their living Hive Ships, with one singular goal: to consume all.

name: Farseek
text: "Once we have claimed this planet, we will claim the stars."

name: Hardened Scales
text: As the fusillade of lasgun fire bounced harmlessly off the carnifex's carapace, the creature roared and advanced.

name: Harrow
text: With each defeat, the hive learns. With each victory, it grows.

name: Inspiring Call
text: The voice of a clamavus commands all who carry the genetic legacy of the Tyranids in their blood.

name: Overgrowth
text: Tyranids flourish in any climate, dominate any ecosystem, crush any resistance.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Upon impact with a planet's surface, a tyrannocyte's bloated belly bursts open, disgorging a horde of Tyranid invaders.

name: Bred for the Hunt
text:
"Looks like we've found the source. Torch it quick, before anything crawls out."
—Sergeant "Ripper" Jackson

name: Hull Breach
text: At the lash of the hive ship's feeder tentacles, the cruiser vented atmosphere, cargo, and crew members into the void.

name: Mortify
text:
"This sword has many names. You may call it 'Death.'"
—Kaldor Draigo, Supreme Grand Master of the Grey Knights

name: Utter End
text:
"Target eradicated. That which burns shall ever be blessed."
—Fusilave unit Tor-213

name: Arcane Signet
text: Countless xenos cults dwell unseen within the Imperium, lurking just beneath the surface.

name: Arcane Signet
text: All Necrons bear the mark of the Triarch, a brand upon their living-metal skin that binds them to their dynasty.

name: Arcane Signet
text: As part of their indoctrination and training, a psyker learns to focus their mental strength through a psycho-reactive staff.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Used carefully, material that has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: "This cogitator provides a strategic overview of the battlefield. By which I mean, of course, the entire planet."

name: Commander's Sphere
text: Within it rests the power of a sun, and none of the warmth.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: The arcane sphere that hovers near Magnus's staff imbues it with the power to transform enemies into mindless chaos spawn.

name: Cranial Plating
text: The flesh of the Necrontyr is a memory so distant as to be nearly mythical.

name: Endless Atlas
text:
"While we slept, our inferiors infested the worlds that belong to us. Now, we awaken once more."
—Szarekh, the Silent King

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The ancient Necron race has achieved this pinnacle of elegance through their relentless pursuit of utility."
—Tech-Priest Darvin, executed for heresy 1256998.M41

name: Lord of Change
text: The Lords of Change are Tzeentch's greatest servants. The most powerful of them wield fragments of his power over destiny.

name: Hedron Archive
text: The vaults of the Necron Dynasties contain all manner of esoteric artifacts, most forged long before many of the younger races even existed.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"Pain is an ally. Pain is a friend. Pain is truth."
—Sister Erynica N'botu, Order of the Valorous Heart

name: Mind Stone
text: During biotransference, the Necrontyr lost almost all individuality. What little remained was imprisoned within a living metal form.

name: Sculpting Steel
text: Necrodermis, the living metal from which all Necrons are made, is endlessly adaptive.

name: Skullclamp
text: Only the most pious and devoted Imperial servants are granted the posthumous honor of becoming servo-skulls.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"One day, the dark glory of the void will swallow the light of the stars once and for all!"
—Magus Lucea Kane

name: Sol Ring
text:
"As Horus once besieged the Sol System, we shall bring the rotting Imperium to its knees."
—Abaddon the Despoiler

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Of all the stars in the Galaxy, Sol is of the Emperor. Its heat is His might. Its light is His revelation."
—*Lectitio Divinitatus*

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Once, the C'tan sought to rule us. Now it is they who serve us, their shards powering our great machines."
—Szarekh, the Silent King

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"It is my cry that wakes you in the night, and my body that crouches in the shadow. I am Tzeentch and you are the puppet that dances to my tune."
—*The Book of Tzeentch*

name: Talisman of Dominance
text:
"As swift as a lash mamba, as sharp as a spineleaf, as stubborn as a wild grox."
—Colonel Pannet, in praise of the Catachan warrior

name: Talisman of Dominance
text:
"My Master is the Beginning and he is the End. He is the Master of Mortals, and the core of our Dead Hearts."
—*The Saga of Khorne*

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"We shall wage this war with undaunted faith and courage. We shall not take one step back."
—Lord Marshal Toshenko to the Vostroyan 16th

name: Talisman of Indulgence
text:
"Embrace your hunger, your lust, your desire. The universe is ours for the taking!"
—Sanctifer LeVay, Cult of the Sacred Union

name: Talisman of Progress
text:
"Any Cadian who can't field-strip their own lasgun by age ten was born on the wrong planet."
—Anonymous

name: Thought Vessel
text: Before the Great Sleep, the Necrons knew every corner of the galaxy, as only the ultimate conquerors could.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text:
"It's a lifeless ruin of some long-lost race. What is there to fear?"
—Commissar Gadholm

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: When Chaos makes a tool that isn't specifically for destroying things, it's usually for finding new things to destroy.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Anrakyr the Traveller awoke from his slumber with a singular goal: to rebuild a united Necron galaxy.

name: Worn Powerstone
text:
"Power comes in many shapes. But real power does the shaping."
—Abaddon the Despoiler

name: Arcane Sanctum
text: The Emperor is the greatest psyker in Human history. For thousands of years, he has sat immobile in a palace that spans a continent.

name: Ash Barrens
text: Deserts of industrial ash surround the hive cities, covering the surface of the planet with an unstable, corrosive skin.

name: Barren Moor
text: Millennia of constant warfare have left many planets with very little worth fighting over.

name: Choked Estuary
text: Centuries' worth of black iron lie beneath the soil of every Imperial world, their civilization built on never-ending strife.

name: Cinder Glade
text: All orbital bombardment did was till the soil.

name: Command Tower
text: In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, vast capillary towers funnel biomass to the Hive Ships waiting in orbit.

name: Command Tower
text: On the Planet of Sorcerers in the Eye of Terror lies the Tower of the Cyclops, the redoubt of Magnus the Red.

name: Command Tower
text:
"The war will be decided here, where the planet's defences are strongest."
—Marneus Calgar

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text: The squad plunged deep into Hive Pandorial, finding only the shambling corpses of those they came to avenge.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: The Chapter's honored dead are interred in the Hall of Heroes, where the mineral-rich water of the catacombs slowly fossilizes their bones, preserving them for all time.

name: Desert of the Glorified
text: On countless frontier worlds, below silica sand, blasted chalk, or bubbling marsh, slumbering Necrons wait.

name: Dismal Backwater
text: Armageddon has become a site of holy pilgrimage for the Orks: a planet where the fighting never stops.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"What are ramparts, what are steeples, what are our machines worth in the teeth of this ceaseless hunger?"
—Magos Varnak

name: Exotic Orchard
text: In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, sessile organisms take root in a planet's crust, converting its resources into biomass that can be extracted by the Hive Fleet.

name: Foreboding Ruins
text: When the Great Rift opened across the Galaxy, many Imperial worlds were lost to Chaos.

name: Anrakyr the Traveller
text: "Though it may take an eternity, I will see the myriad dynasties united once more."

name: Forgotten Cave
text: In the hearts of mortals, in the pages of ancient lore, in the deep, forgotten places of the universe . . . Chaos waits.

name: Frontier Bivouac
text: Disillusioned with the Imperium, the population of Chancer's Vale turned to other, hungrier powers for meaning.

name: Game Trail
text:
"It appears Old One Eye is on the hunt."
—Marneus Calgar

name: Polluted Mire
text: As the continent sank over the course of eons, the tomb complex slowly flooded. The sleeping Necrons, their stasis crypts corrupted, never awoke.

name: Port Town
text: The Imperium's most peaceful worlds serve only to arm and supply the others.

name: Prairie Stream
text: Stripped and blasted by millennia of war, every planet eventually looks the same.

name: Reliquary Tower
text:
"Let the others bicker over their little worlds and stars. I have an empire of knowledge, and it encompasses all others."
—Trazyn the Infinite

name: Rugged Highlands
text: Defence laser emplacements are usually located at high altitude, where the rarified air does little to impede their range of destructive efficacy.

name: Scoured Barrens
text: The weapons deployed to drive the Traitor Legions into the Eye of Terror were so destructive that some planets still have not recovered.
