text: It moved through the troops leaving no footprints, save on their souls.

name: Coercion
text:
A rhino's bargain
—Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"

name: Derelor
text:
"Strength it has, but at the cost of a continuous supply of energy. Such failure can bear only one result."
—Execution order of Endrek Sahr, master breeder

name: Dread of Night
text:
"These moonless, foreign skies keep me in thrall. Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, they never surrender, and they don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, they never surrender, and they don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Dry Spell
text:
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer."
—Autumn Willow

name: Enfeeblement
text:
"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it."
—Kaervek

name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
text: The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat.

name: Fallen Angel
text:
"Angels are simply extensions of truth upon the fabric of life—and there is far more dark than light."
—Baron Sengir

name: Fatal Blow
text:
"What is crueler? To let a wound of the heart fester, or to simply cut it out?"
—Crovax

name: Feast of the Unicorn
text:
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the baron knows of one."
—Autumn Willow

name: Feral Shadow
text: Not all shadows are cast by light—some are cast by darkness.

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Greed
text:
"There is no calamity greater than lavish desires. There is no greater guilt than discontentment. And there is no greater disaster than greed."
—Lao Tsu, *Tao Te Ching*, (trans. Chan)

name: Infernal Contract
text:
"But I signed nothing!"
—Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage

name: Daraja Griffin
text:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

name: Kjeldoran Dead
text:
"They shall drink sorrow's dregs. They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Leshrac's Rite
text:
"Bind me to thee, my soul to thine. I am your servant and your slave. Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Lost Soul
text: Her hand gently beckons, she whispers your name—but those who go with her are never the same.

name: Mind Warp
text: The hardest of wizards can have the softest of minds.

name: Mischievous Poltergeist
text:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Nightmare
text: As the poisoned land spreads, so does the nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Painful Memories
text:
"It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory."
—Jolrael

name: Perish
text:
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: D'Avenant Archer
text: Avenant's archers are also trained as poets, so that each arrow is guided by a fragment of verse.

name: Python
text:
"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?"
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Rag Man
text: "Aw, he's just a silly, dirty little man. What's to be afraid of?"

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Razortooth Rats
text:
"Men and rats both hunger: we for our playthings; they, for us."
—Crovax

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Strands of Night
text:
"I have seen the night torn into thin darkling strips and woven into shapes too bleak for dreams."
—Crovax

name: Stromgald Cabal
text: When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Zombie Master
text: He controlled the zombies even before his own death; now nothing can make them betray him.

name: Aether Flash
text:
"You can't get there from here. Well, you can—it just won't be fun."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Anaba Bodyguard
text:
"Not all minotaurs are tribal. Some are freelance."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Anaba Shaman
text:
"The shamans? Ha! They are craven cows not capable of true magic."
—Irini Sengir

name: Balduvian Barbarians
text:
"Barbarian raids were a concern to those living in the northwest provinces, but the skyknights never dealt with the problem in a systematic way. They thought of the Balduvians as an 'amusing model' of their forebears' culture."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Boil
text:
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Divine Transformation
text: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

name: Conquer
text:
"Why do we trade with those despicable elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Crimson Hellkite
text:
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Fervor
text:
"If your blood doesn't run hot, I will make it run in the sands!"
—Maraxus of Keld

name: Final Fortune
text:
Want all, lose all.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Suq'Ata trader

name: Fit of Rage
text:
"Anger is fleeting; remorse is eternal."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Flame Spirit
text:
"The spirit of the flame is the spirit of change."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Ekundu Griffin
text:
"My goat was a small price to pay for the chance to see the hunting griffin dive and seize it."
—Suq'Ata trader

name: Giant Strength
text:
"O! it is excellent / To have a giant's strength, but it is tyrannous / To use it like a giant."
—William Shakespeare,
*Measure for Measure*

name: Goblin Digging Team
text:
"From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!"
"Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

name: Goblin Elite Infantry
text: They talk a good fight.

name: Goblin Hero
text:
"When you're a goblin, you don't have to step forward to be a hero—everyone else just has to step back!"
—Biggum Flodrot, goblin veteran

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

name: Goblin Recruiter
text: "Next!"

name: Goblin Warrens
text:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires*, vol. IV

name: Hulking Cyclops
text: Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Inferno
text:
"Some have said there is no subtlety to destruction. You know what? They're dead."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Jokulhaups
text:
"The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Lightning Blast
text:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Mountain Goat
text: Only the heroic and the mad follow mountain goat trails.

name: Orcish Artillery
text: In a rare display of ingenuity, the orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Hi!ni!ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me! / Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return."
—Navajo war chant

name: Archangel
text:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Ethereal Champion
text:
"If I have learned anything as a wizard it is this: never fight your own battles."
—Waffa, sorcerer of Nyomba

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Reckless Embermage
text: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

name: Relentless Assault
text:
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

name: Sabretooth Tiger
text:
"I fear anything with teeth measured in handspans!"
—Norin the Wary

name: Shatterstorm
text: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

name: Shock
text:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

name: Spitting Drake
text: It prefers its meals cooked.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"There are times solid ground gives precious little comfort."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Talruum Minotaur
text:
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Tremor
text:
"Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?"
—Naimag, Femeref philosopher

name: Vertigo
text:
"I saw the wizard gesturing, but I didn't guess his plan until my aesthir cried out and went into a dive."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: Viashino Warrior
text:
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Wall of Fire
text:
"Struggle, and you will only fan the flames."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Call of the Wild
text: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

name: Cat Warriors
text: These stealthy felines have survived so many battles that some believe they must possess many lives.

name: Creeping Mold
text:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Dense Foliage
text:
"Big plants not only good for hidin', but full o' tasty bugs, too."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Early Harvest
text:
"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Elder Druid
text:
"Did clouds dance in his eyes,
did thorns play at his fingertips?"
—Shesul Fass, faerie bard

name: Elven Cache
text: Elves know where to harvest the best of the forest, for they planted it there themselves.

name: Elven Riders
text:
Sometimes it is better to be swift of foot than strong of swordarm.
—Elven proverb

name: Elvish Archers
text: "I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, 'Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!'"

name: Fallow Earth
text:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Familiar Ground
text:
"I'd rather fight on foreign soil. That way, if I lose I can blame it on the terrain."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Femeref Archers
text:
"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course; they have no faith to guide their darts."
—Nuru, Femeref archer

name: Heavy Ballista
text:
"Archers, ballistae—you can't even get near the island of Avenant."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Fyndhorn Brownie
text:
"I've been insulted by drunks in a hundred inns, but never as skillfully or annoyingly as by those blasted brownies."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Fyndhorn Elder
text:
"Do we know what we're doing? Yes—the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Giant Spider
text: It's not far into the trap, as the crow flies.

name: Gorilla Chieftain
text:
"In the soil of leadership sprout the seeds of immortality."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominaria's grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Hero's Resolve
text:
"Destiny, chance, fate, fortune—they're all just ways of claiming your successes without claiming your failures."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lure
text: When setting a snare, success depends not on the quality of the trap, but the quality of the bait.

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Nature's Resurgence
text:
Spring follows winter
—Elvish expression meaning "all things pass"

name: Panther Warriors
text: The dogs of war are nothing compared to the cats.

name: Pradesh Gypsies
text:
"A mysterious people indeed. Their origins are as secret as their traditions."
—Lord Magnus of Llanowar

name: Rampant Growth
text: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

name: Redwood Treefolk
text: The soldiers chopped and chopped, and still the great tree stood, frowning down at them.

name: River Boa
text:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Icatian Town
text: Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

name: Rowen
text:
"I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it."
—Asmira, holy avenger

name: Scaled Wurm
text:
"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Stalking Tiger
text: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

name: Summer Bloom
text: Summer sends its kiss with warmth and blooming life.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the basilisk's terrible power.

name: Trained Armodon
text: These are its last days. Better to grow broad and heavy. Better that the enemy is crushed beneath its carcass.

name: Infantry Veteran
text:
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

name: Uktabi Orangutan
text:
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Unseen Walker
text:
"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands."
—Kamau, "Proper Passage"

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Vitalize
text:
"After waking to the magic of Llanowar, no dreams can compare."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Waiting in the Weeds
text: The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.

name: Warthog
text:
"Too much work—it takes a long time to break them in, and more than a few recruits."
—Grebog, goblin swine-rider

name: Worldly Tutor
text:
"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Kismet
text:
"Make people wait for what they want, and you have power over them. This is as true for merchants and militia as it is for cooks and couples."
—Gwendlyn Di Corci

name: Wyluli Wolf
text:
"When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?"
—Maimun al-Wyluli, diary

name: Aladdin's Ring
text:
". . . The magician drew a ring off his finger . . . , saying: 'It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.'"
—*The Arabian Nights*,
Junior Classics trans.

name: Ankh of Mishra
text: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle: the strange structures did not house Mishra's malevolent creations but were themselves among his creations.

name: Ashnod's Altar
text: The Brothers' War scarred the land, but Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

name: Cursed Totem
text:
Pass me from soul to soul, / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls.
—Totem inscription (translated)

name: Dancing Scimitar
text: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
text:
Honorable in battle, generous in death.
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

name: Dragon Engine
text:
"How is it the legged engines seem so much more alive than their wheeled counterparts? Simply, they were born, not made."
—Mishra

name: Dragon Mask
text:
"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Fountain of Youth
text: The fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

name: The Hive
text: Mouths and wings beyond numbering, but a single mind to guide them.

name: Light of Day
text:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

name: Jalum Tome
text: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystic runes.

name: Lead Golem
text: Slow and heavy swings the club.

name: Meekstone
text: When the mighty sleep, the lowly prowl.

name: Ardent Militia
text: Some fight for honor and some for gold, but the militia fight for hearth and home.

name: Longbow Archer
text:
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Roya, Zhalfirin archer

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone . . . ."
—"Song of the Artificer"

name: Ornithopter
text:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

name: Patagia Golem
text: It scattered falcons like a lion hunting among jackals.

name: Pentagram of the Ages
text: A mirror, a shield, a promise, a great distance, and a kind word—five ways to avoid harm.

name: Phyrexian Vault
text:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

name: Mesa Falcon
text:
"The faith of Serra is borne on wings of hope."
—Gulsen, abbey matron

name: Skull Catapult
text:
"What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Snake Basket
text:
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Wand of Denial
text: You'll never miss what you never had.

name: Order of the Sacred Torch
text: A blazing light to drive out the shadows.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Pearl Dragon
text:
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Regal Unicorn
text: Unicorns don't care if you believe in them any more than you care if they believe in you.

name: Remedy
text:
"These things will protect you while I'm gone, remind you of my love for you."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Reprisal
text:
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Resistance Fighter
text:
"My soldiers fought without hesitation, died without doubt."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Serenity
text:
"Just think of me as the storm before the calm."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Serra's Blessing
text:
"I have seen your strength imbued in angels' wings, and I have felt your sorrow rain down on the ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Standing Troops
text: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sunweb
text:
"There is no sweeter music than the wails of a dying dragon."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Tundra Wolves
text: I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains.

name: Unyaro Griffin
text: The griffin's shadow gives courage to the righteous and dread to the idle.

name: Armored Pegasus
text: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

name: Venerable Monk
text: His presence brings not only a strong arm but also renewed hope.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Sharper than wind, lighter than air.

name: Warmth
text:
"Flame grows gentle with but a little distance."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Air Elemental
text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

name: Boomerang
text: A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

name: Browse
text:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Castle
text:
"Hang out our banners on the outward walls; / The cry is still, 'They come'; our castle's strength / Will laugh a siege to scorn."
—William Shakespeare, *Macbeth*

name: Chill
text:
"Temper, temper."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Daring Apprentice
text: In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.

name: Deflection
text:
Up and down,
over and through,
back around—
the joke's on you.

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Dream Cache
text:
Dreams' riches are easily spent.
—Suq'Ata adage

name: Fog Elemental
text:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Glacial Wall
text:
"Huge walls of ice block further travel. We can't believe they are natural."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Harmattan Efreet
text:
"One moment I was walking along the beach, and the next I was high in the air, staring into a hideous smiling face."
—Tarub, Suq'Ata sailor

name: Horned Turtle
text:
"So like men are they: a hardened shell with fragile flesh beneath."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Insight
text:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Inspiration
text:
"Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, wizard savant

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Are merfolk humans with fins, or are humans merfolk with feet?

name: Mystical Tutor
text:
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Phantom Warrior
text: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

name: Polymorph
text: "Ahh! Opposable digits!"

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Prosperity
text:
"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently."
—Kukemssa pirate

name: Psychic Transfer
text:
"The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning."
—Kaervek

name: Relearn
text:
"Barrin taught me that the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Remove Soul
text: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

name: Sage Owl
text: The owl asks but never answers.

name: Sea Monster
text: Water is life. Or perhaps it is just something to wash it down with.

name: Segovian Leviathan
text:
"Leviathan, too! Can you catch him with a fish-hook or run a line round his tongue?"
—*The Bible*, Job 41:1

name: Sibilant Spirit
text: She had expected death to roar, to thunder, to growl. She did not recognize it when it came hissing to her side.

name: Soldevi Sage
text:
"To hide the truth is more than folly—it is fatal."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its messenger.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Telepathic Spies
text: Most spies sneak into enemy camps. These spies sneak into enemy minds.

name: Telepathy
text: "Secrets? What secrets?"

name: Temporal Adept
text:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All of her classmates have disappeared."
—Tolarian renegade

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

name: Tolarian Winds
text:
Why not ask the winds?
—Tolarian expression meaning "Who knows?"

name: Treasure Trove
text: "Nope, there's nothing here either. You guys go on ahead, I'll catch up in a minute. . . . Whoo hoo!"

name: Vigilant Drake
text: It can stay aloft for weeks with little or no sleep.

name: Cloudchaser Eagle
text: Most eagles hunt small animals. The cloudchasers hunt magic.

name: Vizzerdrix
text: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

name: Wall of Air
text:
"Let the air itself protect you, for it is everywhere."
—Master wizard

name: Wall of Wonder
text: They wondered at the size of it. It wondered which to eat first.

name: Wind Dancer
text: The sky is her stage.

name: Wind Drake
text:
"But high she shoots through air and light,
Above all low delay,
Where nothing earthly bounds her flight,
Nor shadow dims her way."
—Thomas Moore,
"Oh that I had Wings"

name: Abyssal Horror
text:
"I dreamt of it once. Now I fear it dreams of me."
—Tolarian scholar

name: Abyssal Specter
text: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

name: Agonizing Memories
text:
"I think little of the foes I've slain. But I'm haunted by the friends I've sent to die."
—The Southern Paladin

name: Befoul
text: The bog's touch means death to all but the darkest of hearts.

name: Crossbow Infantry
text: Twang. You're dead.

name: Bereavement
text: Grief is a razor that slices the soul.

name: Blood Pet
text: No thrull has ever been burdened with a long life.

name: Bog Imp
text: Think of it as a butcher knife with wings.

name: Bog Wraith
text: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

name: Crypt Rats
text:
Beware anything born among the dead.
—Tolarian saying

name: Dakmor Lancer
text: The darkness of his shield reflects the inky blackness of his soul.

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Hence 'banishèd' is banished from the world, / And the world's exile is death."
—William Shakespeare,
*Romeo and Juliet*

name: Darkest Hour
text: The eclipse made it clear whose side the sky was on.

name: Dregs of Sorrow
text:
"We live for a thousand years. The death of even one brings untold sorrow."
—Elvish elder

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, they never surrender, and they don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral,
*Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Duress
text: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

name: Eastern Paladin
text:
"There is no worse enemy. His passion for death doesn't just border on insanity, it wallows in it."
—The Southern Paladin

name: Engineered Plague
text: A single germ can kill more soldiers than ten thousand blades.

name: Fallen Angel
text:
"Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."
—Fallen angel, to Serra

name: Fear
text: "Booga booga booga!"

name: Foul Imp
text: The villagers call it "winged stench."

name: Fugue
text:
"It's hard to keep our own troops from fleeing when he's like this. How can our foes possibly stand against him?"
—Field marshal for the Eastern Paladin

name: Giant Cockroach
text: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Eager Cadet
text: "Training? Seeing my crops burnt to cinders was all the 'training' I needed."

name: Greed
text: An advisor once asked the Western Paladin how much gold would be enough. "I have no need of fools who can imagine 'enough,'" he told the advisor's corpse.

name: Hollow Dogs
text: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

name: Howl from Beyond
text: Whether it howls for hunger or for joy, you're in trouble just the same.

name: Infernal Contract
text:
"East and West meet and angels cry.
Unholy power darkens the sky."
—"The Ballad of the Paladins"

name: Leshrac's Rite
text:
"Brackish water, dark and blind
Heed my will, to you I bind."
—Opening passage of Leshrac's Rite

name: Looming Shade
text: On darkness feeding, in nightmares breeding.

name: Megrim
text: Memories cut from the mind can cut right back.

name: Mind Rot
text: What wizards fear most is losing their minds.

name: Nausea
text: No fear. No sense. And soon, no lunch.

name: Elite Archers
text: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Nocturnal Raid
text: The Eastern Paladin doesn't attack at night for the tactical advantage. He does it for the sheer joy of fighting beneath the moon.

name: Oppression
text:
"Defeating an enemy is not nearly as satisfying as watching one suffer."
—The Western Paladin

name: Ostracize
text: "You won't be needing this."

name: Persecute
text: "I want every last one of these tree-hugging, earth-loving, pointy-eared weaklings out of here. Now!"

name: Plague Beetle
text: No one knows whether they were named for the diseases they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

name: Rag Man
text: He hunts what might have been.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Razortooth Rats
text: They'll chew through armor, flesh, and bone. They'll even chew through each other if they're hungry enough.

name: Reprocess
text: The battle's end is the meal's beginning.

name: Gerrard's Wisdom
text: A picture is worth a thousand swords.

name: Revenant
text: It eats death and drinks pain.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Serpent Warrior
text: They're the fiercest of all the Western Paladin's soldiers. They're also the most fiercely loyal—but that loyalty comes at a price.

name: Soul Feast
text: You are who you eat.

name: Spineless Thug
text: What it lacks in backbone, it makes up for in cruelty.

name: Strands of Night
text: When the strands call, only the dead answer.

name: Stronghold Assassin
text: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

name: Tainted Aether
text: Pockets of Æther can be so foul they melt flesh from bone.

name: Unholy Strength
text: "I don't *feel* any different."

name: Wall of Bone
text: A skeletal wall, strengthened by the souls of traitors, rings the city of the Eastern Paladin.

name: Glorious Anthem
text:
"North and South meet and angels sing.
Voices resound with a righteous ring."
—"The Ballad of the Paladins"

name: Western Paladin
text:
"Expect nothing but scorn, flattery, and lies. And never turn your back on him."
—The Northern Paladin

name: Yawgmoth's Edict
text: The warping of bodies and souls has become the heart of Yawgmoth's existence.

name: Aether Flash
text: As the foul beast appeared, arcane lightning crackled around it.

name: Balduvian Barbarians
text:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

name: Bedlam
text: The generals were dead. The battle plans were forgotten. It was everyone for themselves.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Bloodshot Cyclops
text: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

name: Boil
text:
"It is a slaughter, the death of a sea. Never speak of it again."
—The Lord of Atlantis

name: Crimson Hellkite
text: The hellkites are artists with flames, painting the world with fire.

name: Disorder
text:
"Fire hurts them almost as much as the chaos that follows. Almost."
—The Western Paladin

name: Fervor
text: The intensity of their glare was soon surpassed by the intensity of their attack.

name: Final Fortune
text: A reward is worthless if you aren't around to enjoy it.

name: Fire Elemental
text: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

name: Ghitu Fire-Eater
text: The Ghitu believe their race was born of fire, and it's an honor to return to it.

name: Goblin Chariot
text: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

name: Goblin Digging Team
text:
"Dig. Dig. Dig. Dig. Dig. Dig. Die!"
—Goblin chant

name: Goblin Elite Infantry
text:
We're *elite*. You're not.
—Infantry motto

name: Goblin Gardener
text: Years of attempts have brought the goblins no closer to growing a sausage tree.

name: Goblin Glider
text:
"What's got two arms, one wing, and no brains?"
—Ghitu riddle

name: Heavy Ballista
text:
"Soldiers wear down and enemies collapse—but the ballista never tires."
—Ballista captain

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

name: Goblin Raider
text: He's smart for a goblin. He can do *two* things: hit *and* run.

name: Goblin Spelunkers
text: Goblins prefer caves to just about anything else. Caves prefer just about anything else to goblins.

name: Goblin War Drums
text: The goblin idea of music is to hit something with a stick.

name: Granite Grip
text: "Let me introduce you to Rocky."

name: Hill Giant
text: Hill giants are mostly just big. Of course, that does count for a lot.

name: Impatience
text: "I'm going to count to three. Three."

name: Inferno
text:
"Some have said there is no subtlety to destruction. You know what? They're dead."
—Wandering mage

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Ardent Militia
text: Knights fight for honor and mercenaries fight for gold. The militia fights for hearth and home.

name: Lightning Blast
text:
"I'll climb down soon. Don't worry, it's just a thundersto—"
—Former elvish scout

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: Ogres learn how to smash stuff even before they learn how to walk.

name: Orcish Artillery
text:
"Ready . . . aim . . . fire!"
"Ow!"

name: Pillage
text:
"Burn their homes. Salt their lands. Nothing survives."
—The Western Paladin

name: Pygmy Pyrosaur
text:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

name: Honor Guard
text: The strength of one. The courage of ten.

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Reckless Embermage
text: Those who play with fire are bound to get burned.

name: Reflexes
text:
"Be as fast as lightning, and you will be just as deadly."
—Combat trainer

name: Relentless Assault
text: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

name: Sabretooth Tiger
text: "Here, kitty kitty. Here, kitty kitty. Aaaaugh!"

name: Seismic Assault
text: Earth arms itself with fire.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Intrepid Hero
text: A fool knows no fear. A hero shows no fear.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"We were ready for an attack from the front, sides, or back—but the mage hit us from below."
—Veteran soldier

name: Storm Shaman
text: She speaks with the voice of the winds, and the earth trembles.

name: Sudden Impact
text: Caught red-handed.

name: Trained Orgg
text:
"That arm's for bashin'. That one's for smashin'. That one's for scratchin'. And that one . . . I don't know what that one's for."
—Orgg trainer

name: Tremor
text: Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Wall of Fire
text: The erupting flames work as both barrier and weapon.

name: Wildfire
text: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a *big* appetite.

name: Anaconda
text: You'll never find an anaconda in a swamp. It will always find you first.

name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
text:
Honorable in battle, generous in death.
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

name: Ancient Silverback
text: The Phyrexian killing machines couldn't have known the seriousness of their mistake in wounding the ape—they'd never seen it angry.

name: Blanchwood Armor
text:
"There's never been a dwarven smith who could match the marvels that Gaea herself forges."
—The Elvish Champion

name: Bull Hippo
text: The merfolk may rule the waters, but hippos have never had much respect for authority.

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Compost
text:
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout.
—Yavimaya saying

name: Creeping Mold
text: Mold crept over the walls and into every crevice until the gleaming white stone strained and burst.

name: Early Harvest
text: "Give it a week and it will feed an army."

name: Elder Druid
text: "I may seem wise to you, but I'm merely a sapling among mighty oaks."

name: Elvish Archers
text: The archers have a reputation for attacking without warning. They claim that the first arrow *is* the warning.

name: Knight Errant
text: Knights are quick to pledge their loyalty and even quicker to charge into battle.

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

name: Elvish Lyrist
text: To an elf, magic and music are the same.

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Familiar Ground
text: More than any other battlefield, the forest gives the advantage to those who know it best.

name: Femeref Archers
text:
"Bet you can't put it through the eye."
"Left or right?"

name: Fyndhorn Elder
text: "It is useful to be able to speak to the trees. But it is truly wondrous to be able to listen to them."

name: Gang of Elk
text:
"I felt the ground shake, so I hid in my tent until the earthquake passed. It passed all right, and it left hoofprints."
—Femeref explorer

name: Giant Spider
text:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

name: Knighthood
text: Kings don't make knights. Actions do.

name: Gorilla Chieftain
text: A gorilla chief must always be prepared to defend his crown. This leads to some pretty tough apes.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: They've got claws as long as your arm. And they're grouchy. Really, really grouchy.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Llanowar covers a million square miles, yet nobody enters the forest without the elves knowing it.

name: Lone Wolf
text: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

name: Lure
text:
"When the forest wants something, no mortal mind can resist her."
—Maro

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Might of Oaks
text: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

name: Monstrous Growth
text: Get in touch with your inner monster.

name: Nature's Resurgence
text:
"The dead whisper to the living. If you listen, you will learn."
—Maro

name: Longbow Archer
text: Some say they have the blood of hawks running through their veins.

name: Nature's Revolt
text: The land rises up to defend against those who would spoil its beauty.

name: Pride of Lions
text: There's only one thing worse than a hungry lion—many hungry lions.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: Redwood Treefolk
text:
And would you strip the bark from a treefolk?
—Elvish expression meaning "Are you crazy?"

name: Regeneration
text:
"Why should death always have the last word?"
—Llanowar druid

name: Rowen
text: Those who understand the forest are free to harvest its bounty.

name: Scavenger Folk
text: "One piece? Now there's a hundred!"

name: Seeker of Skybreak
text: Seekers spend their lives protecting a home they rarely visit.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Where dryads dance, seeds sprout and flowers bloom.

name: Master Healer
text: Her heart holds the pain of every soldier she's ever healed.

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"I wouldn't stand in front of that wurm, son. 'Course, I wouldn't stand behind it neither. In fact, standing anywhere near that wurm's not much of a plan. Running, now *that's* a plan!"
—Wandering mage

name: Squall
text:
"May the winds blow till they have wakened death. . . ."
—William Shakespeare,
*Othello*

name: Thorn Elemental
text: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

name: Thoughtleech
text:
"Their thoughts flow through my mind, and I am healed."
—Fyndhorn elder

name: Trained Armodon
text: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

name: Treefolk Seedlings
text:
Even the grandest forest begins with a single seedling.
—Llanowar saying

name: Untamed Wilds
text: No forest is so remote that the elves don't know its secrets.

name: Northern Paladin
text:
"How smooth his face, how sure his thoughts. I look forward to breaking his mighty will."
—The Eastern Paladin

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Each spell has its own song, and the enchantress knows the dance for each.

name: Vernal Bloom
text: Spring breathes the magic of new life.

name: Wild Growth
text: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

name: Wing Snare
text: The elves long ago mastered the art of hunting with nets. They call it "fishing the sky."

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Aladdin's Ring
text: Some say Aladdin's third wish was for this ring.

name: Beast of Burden
text: The heavier the load, the harder it works.

name: Caltrops
text: The Eastern Paladin knew how highly his southern rival valued horses, so he gleefully prepared a suitable welcome.

name: Pacifism
text: Without warriors there can be no war.

name: Crystal Rod
text: Polished by a thousand waves.

name: Dingus Egg
text: Legend has it that the world was hatched from a dingus egg.

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text: Bridges usually get you from one place to another. This one just gets you.

name: Feroz's Ban
text: Feroz is gone, but what remains is his final gift to his people: the right to be left alone.

name: Flying Carpet
text: "Wheeeeeeeeeeeeeee!"

name: Grafted Skullcap
text: "Every day, I fight for my life and win. Every night, I fight to remember my name and lose."

name: Grapeshot Catapult
text: The Southern Paladin taught the airborne vermin to fear the storm that rains upward.

name: Blessed Reversal
text:
"A battle's outcome is never certain."
—The Southern Paladin

name: Pariah
text: A valiant knight's life has no meaning without honor.

name: Howling Mine
text: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

name: Iron Star
text: Forged by a thousand flames.

name: Ivory Cup
text: Blessed by a thousand prayers.

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Jandor's Saddlebags
text:
Your heart's desire is found within.
—Saddlebag inscription

name: Jayemdae Tome
text:
"Knowledge is power."
—Sir Francis Bacon,
*Meditationes Sacrae*

name: Meekstone
text: The bigger they are, the stronger its pull.

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Purify
text:
"We have no need for these trinkets. We need only the strength of our swords and the virtue of our hearts."
—The Northern Paladin

name: Patagia Golem
text: Its wings were only designed to be ornamental, but it learned to use them on its own.

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

name: Pit Trap
text:
Never forget your feet
—Elvish expression meaning "watch your step"

name: Rod of Ruin
text: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

name: Sisay's Ring
text: "I'm not one for pretty things," said Sisay. "Unless they're pretty useful as well."

name: Spellbook
text: Knowledge knows no bounds.

name: Static Orb
text: The warriors fought against the paralyzing waves until even their thoughts froze in place.

name: Razorfoot Griffin
text: Like a meteor, it strikes from above without warning. Unlike a meteor, it then carries you off and eats you.

name: Throne of Bone
text: Tainted by a thousand fears.

name: Wall of Spears
text:
"A stick is your friend. A pointed stick is your good friend. An army of pointed sticks is your best friend."
—Onean sergeant

name: Wooden Sphere
text: Strengthened by a thousand limbs.

name: Reprisal
text: "Fear this no more!"

name: Reverse Damage
text: "Weapons usually bring death. Today, mine will bring life."

name: Rolling Stones
text:
"We spent three weeks trying to knock that wall down. Now it's knocking us down."
—Onean sergeant

name: Sacred Ground
text: The land will never betray those who gave their lives for it.

name: Sacred Nectar
text:
"For he on honey-dew hath fed,
And drunk the milk of Paradise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"Kubla Khan"

name: Samite Healer
text: Why does a Samite heal? You might as well ask why a bird flies.

name: Sanctimony
text: "The peasants labor for my profit. I approve."

name: Breath of Life
text:
"Nothing can stop the power of life—not even death."
—Onean cleric

name: Seasoned Marshal
text: He reads the battlefield like a map, always seeking the shortest route to victory.

name: Serra Advocate
text: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

name: Serra Angel
text: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

name: Serra's Embrace
text:
"With one breath, the newborn angel took to the air . . . and the world sighed."
—*The Book of Serra*

name: Shield Wall
text:
"If not for the wizard, we'd all be dead now. 'Course, it was him that started all this in the first place."
—Onean veteran

name: Skyshroud Falcon
text: The earliest mystics believed that the falcon slit the sky to let the light break through.

name: Southern Paladin
text:
"How can anyone fight so much yet enjoy it so little?"
—The Western Paladin

name: Spirit Link
text: The noble paladins draw strength from the courage of others.

name: Standing Troops
text: They fight so closely together a mouse couldn't slip past their guard.

name: Starlight
text:
"Even in the darkest night
Stars and angels still shine bright."
—Onean children's rhyme

name: Castle
text:
". . . Our castle's strength
Will laugh a siege to scorn."
—William Shakespeare,
*Macbeth*

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"The key to winning any fight is simply staying alive."
—The Southern Paladin

name: Sunweb
text: Sometimes the wings of fallen dragons refuse to give up the sky.

name: Sustainer of the Realm
text: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

name: Venerable Monk
text: "I rely not so much on the wisdom of age as on the overconfidence of youth."

name: Vengeance
text:
"It is the duty of the strong to oppose any who threaten the weak."
—The Southern Paladin

name: Wall of Swords
text: Sharper than wind, lighter than air.

name: Worship
text:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

name: Air Elemental
text: Where psycho meets cyclone.

name: Ancestral Memories
text:
"It's a poor sort of memory that only works backwards."
—Lewis Carroll,
*Through the Looking Glass*

name: Arcane Laboratory
text:
Too many wizards spoil the spell, but too many spells spoil the wizard.
—Sign on entry to arcane lab

name: Archivist
text: "Knowledge is a feast for the mind. Savor every swallow."

name: Baleful Stare
text: He can drown you in his eyes.

name: Benthic Behemoth
text: The sea has many secrets, but some are too big to be kept.

name: Boomerang
text:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser,
*The Faerie Queene*

name: Confiscate
text:
"The surface world contains nothing I cannot take."
—The Lord of Atlantis

name: Coral Merfolk
text: The coral merfolk delight in wrestling with their foes, skinning them alive on the razor-sharp edges of their reef.

name: Daring Apprentice
text: "I've seen my master do this a hundred times. How hard can it be?"

name: Deflection
text:
"You've thrown your net at the wrong fish."
—The Lord of Atlantis

name: Delusions of Mediocrity
text: When nothing but second best will do.

name: Equilibrium
text:
Seek balance in all things—as long as the scales are weighted in your favor.
—Vodalian saying

name: Evacuation
text:
"How many people can you save in that thing?"
"All of them," replied the mage with a smile.

name: Fighting Drake
text: Scholars in their ivory towers call them "sharks of the sky." Scholars on the road don't call them at all.

name: Fleeting Image
text:
"It was as if we fought a shadow."
—Onean soldier

name: Force Spike
text: "I don't *think* so."

name: Giant Octopus
text: The only thing that flows faster than water is fear.

name: Glacial Wall
text:
Like arguing with ice
—Vodalian expression meaning "wasting your time"

name: Hibernation
text: The deep sleep of winter is not always restful.

name: Horned Turtle
text: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

name: Levitation
text: "We'll be easy targets if we remain on the ground. Let's take the fight to them."

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mana Breach
text: The mana that binds the world together can also tear it apart.

name: Mana Short
text:
"Remove their power, and their will to fight will follow."
—Tolarian wizard

name: Mawcor
text: Neither head holds a brain—that's located somewhere in the chest—but four eyes aim much better than two.

name: Memory Lapse
text: "Eri phar phesta . . . um, phistor . . . er, phistara . . ."

name: Merfolk Looter
text: When you sink a lot of ships, it's easy to find sunken treasure.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text:
"The paladins would be wise not to forget about the Pearl Trident. The merfolk warriors have turned the tide of more than one human war . . . and I have no doubt they shall do so again."
—Onean scholar

name: Opportunity
text:
Little things like morals shouldn't hinder one's ambition.
—Pirate creed

name: Opposition
text: Exhausting a wizard can be exhausting work.

name: Phantom Warrior
text: It can pass through solid matter—but that doesn't mean it's harmless.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: He wastes his amazing talents on proving how amazing he really is.

name: Sea Monster
text: "Abandon ship!"

name: Sleight of Hand
text: "Most people believe magic is only a trick. Why change their minds?"

name: Angel of Mercy
text: A song of life soars over fields of blood.

name: Shifting Sky
text:
Master the sky and you rule everything beneath it.
—Metathran saying

name: Sneaky Homunculus
text: Keep watch only for the giants and you'll be eaten by the ants.

name: Spiketail Hatchling
text: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Telepathy
text: "Secrets? What secrets?"

name: Temporal Adept
text:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All of her classmates have disappeared."
—Tolarian renegade

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

name: Tidal Kraken
text: To merfolk, pirates are a nuisance. To pirates, merfolk are a threat. To the kraken, they're both appetizers.

name: Trade Routes
text: The wise, the righteous, the mighty—the merchant feeds them all.

name: Treasure Trove
text:
"Wealth means power; the power to subdue, to crush, to exploit, the power to enslave, to outrage, to degrade."
—Emma Goldman, "Anarchism"

name: Wall of Air
text:
When no falcons fly, beware the sky.
—Femeref aphorism

name: Wind Drake
text:
"But high she shoots through air and light,
Above all low delay,
Where nothing earthly bounds her flight,
Nor shadow dims her way."
—Thomas Moore, "Oh that I had Wings"

name: Wrath of Marit Lage
text:
"Marit Lage lies frozen in a glacier's heart. Still her dreams take form in our world, stealing the heat from our souls."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Abyssal Specter
text: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

name: Ambition's Cost
text: "Knowledge demands sacrifice."

name: Bog Imp
text: Think of it as a butcher knife with wings.

name: Bog Wraith
text: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

name: Carrion Wall
text: A wall built from the bodies of the enemy will never lack building material in times of war.

name: Coercion
text: "Human tenderness is simply weakness in a pretty package."

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Ha, banishment? Be merciful, say 'death,'
For exile hath more terror in his look,
Much more than death."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Death Pit Offering
text:
"Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Death Pits of Rath
text:
"Neither could I forget what I had read of these pits—that the *sudden* extinction of life formed no part of their most horrible plan."
—Edgar Allan Poe,
"The Pit and the Pendulum"

name: Deathgazer
text: Your entire life passes before its eyes.

name: Deepwood Ghoul
text: They feed on the living to stay undead.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, they never surrender, and they don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Dusk Imp
text: It despises humans and squirrels and beasts and dwarves and cephalids . . . well, it despises just about everything.

name: Eastern Paladin
text:
"There is no worse enemy. His passion for death doesn't just border on insanity, it wallows in it."
—Southern paladin

name: Execute
text:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Fear
text:
"The horror! The horror!"
—Joseph Conrad, *Heart of Darkness*

name: Giant Cockroach
text: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

name: Gluttonous Zombie
text: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Larceny
text:
Opportunity makes the thief.
—Roman proverb

name: Looming Shade
text: On darkness feeding, in nightmares breeding.

name: Lord of the Undead
text: "I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"

name: Maggot Carrier
text:
"We do not suddenly fall on death, but advance towards it by slight degrees; we die every day."
—Seneca, *Epistles*, trans. Gummere

name: Megrim
text: Memories cut from the mind can cut right back.

name: Mind Rot
text: What wizards fear most is losing their minds.

name: Mind Slash
text: "I can't think with all that screaming."

name: Mind Sludge
text: When you get into the swamp, the swamp gets into you.

name: Murderous Betrayal
text: Which hurts more: a sword in the gut or a dagger in the back?

name: Nausea
text: No fear. No sense. And soon, no lunch.

name: Crossbow Infantry
text:
"He can split a marshfly in two from halfway across the range."
—Onean sergeant

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Persecute
text:
"Of all the tyrannies on humane kind
The worst is that which persecutes the mind."
—John Dryden,
"The Hind and the Panther"

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Plague Beetle
text: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

name: Plague Wind
text:
"The second wind of ascension is Reaver, slaying the unworthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Primeval Shambler
text: His mind, like his body, is made up of the swamp's flotsam.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to the rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Serpent Warrior
text: A hiss before dying.

name: Sever Soul
text:
"The mortal world is a grove of sweet fruit, and I am ready to harvest it."
—Fallen angel

name: Severed Legion
text: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

name: Slay
text: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

name: Soul Feast
text: You are who you eat.

name: Spineless Thug
text: What it lacks in backbone, it makes up for in cruelty.

name: Swarm of Rats
text:
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Unholy Strength
text: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

name: Diving Griffin
text:
To outrace the griffin
—Kipamu expression meaning "to do the impossible"

name: Vicious Hunger
text: Only the most ravenous soul feeds on the health of the weak.

name: Warped Devotion
text:
"The spirit of the devout is easily crushed by the loss of hope."
—Fallen angel

name: Western Paladin
text:
"Expect nothing but scorn, flattery, and lies. And never turn your back on him."
—Northern paladin

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Anaba Shaman
text: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

name: Balduvian Barbarians
text:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Bloodshot Cyclops
text: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

name: Elite Archers
text: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

name: Boil
text: "When every reef is bared and every wave is dust—only then shall I rest."

name: Canyon Wildcat
text: In the warrior kingdom of Keld, the cats used in the hunt are prized for their tracking sense and ability to climb walls.

name: Cinder Wall
text:
"The smell of roasted flesh hung over the valley for hours."
—Onean sergeant

name: Demolish
text:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

name: Dwarven Demolition Team
text: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

name: Enrage
text: "You wouldn't like me when I'm angry."

name: Flashfires
text: Dry grass is tinder before the spark.

name: Furnace of Rath
text: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

name: Goblin Chariot
text: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

name: Goblin Glider
text:
"What's got two arms, one wing, and no brains?"
—Ghitu riddle

name: Elite Javelineer
text: "Precision is frequently more valuable than force."

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

name: Goblin Raider
text: He's smart for a goblin. He can do *two* things: hit *and* run.

name: Hill Giant
text: Bent on a quest for blood, a giant can storm through a fort's wall as if it were nothing more than a picket fence.

name: Hulking Cyclops
text: Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.

name: Inferno
text:
"Some have said there is no subtlety to destruction. You know what? They're dead."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lesser Gargadon
text:
"In some cultures, elephants are ridden by those in power. I don't think a mere elephant would even be noticed in Keld."
—Onean sergeant

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: Each victory adds a new verse.

name: Lightning Blast
text:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Mogg Sentry
text: Tortured with magic by their masters, the moggs are enflamed by the smell of sorcery.

name: Obliterate
text:
"The enemy has been destroyed, sir. So have the forest, the city, your palace, your dog . . ."
—Keldon soldier

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: Ogres learn how to smash stuff even before they learn how to walk.

name: Orcish Artillery
text:
"So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game."
—General Khurzog

name: Orcish Spy
text:
"You idiot! Never let the spies mingle with the orcish regulars after completing a mission. Now we'll never get them to fight!"
—General Khurzog

name: Panic Attack
text: Sometimes everyone decides to go for help at the same time.

name: Glory Seeker
text: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Reflexes
text:
"Be as fast as lightning, and you will be just as deadly."
—Combat trainer

name: Relentless Assault
text: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

name: Ridgeline Rager
text: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

name: Rukh Egg
text: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

name: Sabretooth Tiger
text: To a sabretooth, all men are mice.

name: Searing Wind
text:
"The first wind of ascension is Forger, burning away impurity."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Seismic Assault
text: Earth arms itself with fire.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Shock
text:
"I love lightning! It's my best invention since the rock."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

name: Shock Troops
text: War is a conflict that determines not who is right—but who is left.

name: Sizzle
text:
"Of course you should fight fire with fire. You should fight *everything* with fire."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Sudden Impact
text: Most people know better. Goblins only know bigger.

name: Tremor
text: Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?

name: Holy Day
text:
"The day of Spirits; my soul's calm retreat / Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "The Night"

name: Viashino Sandstalker
text:
"Some believe sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The ground itself lends its strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Blanchwood Armor
text:
"There's never been a dwarven smith who could match the marvels that Gaea herself forges."
—Elvish champion

name: Call of the Wild
text: From a whisper to a roar, the call is heard by all and refused by none.

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Choke
text:
"One day we shall walk where once was water."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Collective Unconscious
text: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Creeping Mold
text: Mold crept over the walls and into every crevice until the gleaming white stone strained and burst.

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

name: Elvish Lyrist
text: Each pluck of the strings breaks the hold of the unnatural on the world.

name: Elvish Pioneer
text: "Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Elvish Scrapper
text: "The stories tell of a distant time when machines overran the forests, destroying everything that lived. That time will not come again."

name: Emperor Crocodile
text: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

name: Fecundity
text: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

name: Fertile Ground
text:
"The love of nature . . . is a furious, burning, physical greed. . . ."
—Mary Webb, *The House in Dormer Forest*

name: Foratog
text: Five hundred years to grow—barely a minute to eat.

name: Honor Guard
text:
"It is not a choice I make, to have this guard. It is the choice of my people, and my duty to them."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Fyndhorn Elder
text: "It is useful to be able to speak to the trees. But it is truly wondrous to be able to listen to them."

name: Gaea's Herald
text: The elves' battle cries cut paths through the Æther, guiding those who would stand in Gaea's defense.

name: Giant Badger
text: Disturb a sleeping badger and the snapping of your bones will awaken the countryside.

name: Giant Spider
text:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominaria's grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Horned Troll
text: Sword hilts jut from some trolls' bodies where wounds healed so fast that the weapons were trapped inside.

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Intrepid Hero
text: A fool knows no fear. A hero shows no fear.

name: Living Terrain
text: Some warriors walk the earth. Others are born of it.

name: Llanowar Behemoth
text:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lone Wolf
text: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

name: Lure
text:
"When the forest wants something, no mortal mind can resist her."
—Maro

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Might of Oaks
text: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

name: Monstrous Growth
text: Get in touch with your inner monster.

name: Moss Monster
text: After the battle, an eerie silence gripped the forest. The losers' remains were lightly dusted with green.

name: Nantuko Disciple
text:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Natural Affinity
text: As long as the dryads are a part of the forest, the forest is a part of the army.

name: Ivory Mask
text: Made from its wearer's hopes, the mask ensures that those hopes will be fulfilled.

name: Naturalize
text:
"One touch of nature makes the whole world kin."
—William Shakespeare,
*Troilus and Cressida*

name: Norwood Ranger
text: The song of the forest is in perfect harmony. If a single note is out of place, the elves will find its source.

name: Plow Under
text:
To renew the land, plow the land.
To destroy the land, do nothing.
—Druids' saying

name: Primeval Force
text: It has germinated in the earth for thousands of years. Finally it wakes to the battle's call.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

name: Regeneration
text:
"Why should death always have the last word?"
—Llanowar druid

name: Revive
text: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

name: Rushwood Dryad
text: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"I wouldn't stand in front of that wurm, son. 'Course, I wouldn't stand behind it neither. In fact, standing anywhere near that wurm's not much of a plan. Running, now *that's* a plan!"
—Wandering mage

name: Thorn Elemental
text: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

name: Trained Armodon
text: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text:
"Graceful? Yes. Beautiful? Absolutely. Harmless? Definitely not."
—Fyndhorn elder

name: Vernal Bloom
text: The sun breaks, the beasts stir, and the forest awakens to stand against its enemies.

name: Vine Trellis
text: Nature twists knots stronger than any rope.

name: Wing Snare
text:
"We are the hands of the great trees, reaching out to ensnare what threatens their branches."
—Elvish hunter

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Master Decoy
text: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Aladdin's Ring
text:
"A good lamp will light your way. A good ring will clear it."
—Nervan, royal jeweler

name: Beast of Burden
text: The heavier the load, the harder it works.

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

name: Crystal Rod
text: Polished by a thousand waves.

name: Defense Grid
text:
"A good deal of tyranny goes by the name of protection."
—Crystal Eastman, "Equality or Protection"

name: Dingus Egg
text: Legend has it that the world was hatched from a dingus egg.

name: Disrupting Scepter
text: "True power is controlling not only the hearts of your subjects, but their minds as well."

name: Distorting Lens
text:
"The Eye altering alters all."
—William Blake, "The Mental Traveller"

name: Ardent Militia
text: Knights fight for honor and mercenaries fight for gold. The militia fights for hearth and home.

name: Master Healer
text: Her heart holds the pain of every soldier she's ever healed.

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"Why build a bridge that needs to be guarded?"
—Elvish champion

name: Flying Carpet
text: Woven from strands of griffin mane and pegasus tail.

name: Fodder Cannon
text: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

name: Howling Mine
text: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

name: Iron Star
text: Forged by a thousand flames.

name: Ivory Cup
text: Blessed by a thousand prayers.

name: Jayemdae Tome
text:
"Knowledge is power."
—Sir Francis Bacon, *Meditationes Sacrae*

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Patagia Golem
text: Its wings were only designed to be ornamental, but it learned to use them on its own.

name: Noble Purpose
text: Fighting for the right reason is itself a source of strength.

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

name: Planar Portal
text: These devices have been known to pull entire worlds through the Æther.

name: Rod of Ruin
text: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

name: Skull of Orm
text: Though lifeless, the skull still possessed a strange power over the flow of magic.

name: Spellbook
text: Knowledge knows no bounds.

name: Star Compass
text: It doesn't point north. It points home.

name: Throne of Bone
text: Tainted by a thousand fears.

name: Urza's Armor
text: Urza protected his body well, but neglected his soul.

name: Oracle's Attendants
text: The future isn't sacred, but its speaker is.

name: Wall of Spears
text:
"A stick is your friend. A pointed stick is your good friend. An army of pointed sticks is your best friend."
—Onean sergeant

name: Wooden Sphere
text: Strengthened by a thousand limbs.

name: Coastal Tower
text: A beacon in the night, a dream in the fog.

name: Elfhame Palace
text: The elfhames are the closest thing to "civilization" the elves allow themselves.

name: Salt Marsh
text:
Only death breeds in stagnant water.
—Urborg saying

name: Shivan Oasis
text: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

name: Urborg Volcano
text: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Peach Garden Oath
text:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood. . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

name: Rain of Blades
text: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

name: Redeem
text:
"Let me redeem my brothers both from death."
—William Shakespeare, *Titus Andronicus*

name: Rolling Stones
text:
"Trust me—the walls have more than just ears."
—Orcish spy

name: Sacred Ground
text: The land will never betray those who gave their lives for it.

name: Sacred Nectar
text:
"Over the silver mountains,
Where spring the nectar fountains,
There will I kiss
The bowl of bliss;
And drink my everlasting fill. . . ."
—Sir Walter Raleigh, "The Pilgrimage"

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Sanctimony
text: "The peasants labor for my profit. I approve."

name: Savannah Lions
text:
Even the brave are scared by a lion three times: first by its tracks, again by its roar, and one last time face to face.
—Somali proverb

name: Seasoned Marshal
text: She reads the battlefield like a map, always seeking the shortest route to victory.

name: Serra Angel
text: When she flies above the good, they consider themselves blessed. When she flies above the wicked, they consider themselves dead.

name: Solidarity
text:
"We must all hang together, or assuredly we shall all hang separately."
—Benjamin Franklin

name: Spirit Link
text: "I am bound to all my children. I share in their joys, I rage at their injuries."

name: Standing Troops
text: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

name: Staunch Defenders
text: The key to winning any fight is simply staying alive.

name: Suntail Hawk
text: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

name: Sunweb
text: Sometimes the wings of fallen dragons refuse to give up the sky.

name: Sword Dancer
text: Most soldiers think of the sword as a weapon. In the hands of Zho monks, swords are also the strongest of shields.

name: Tundra Wolves
text:
"I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains."
—Onean scout

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Sharper than wind, lighter than air.

name: Worship
text:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Aven Flock
text: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

name: Archivist
text:
"Words—so innocent and powerless are they, as standing in a dictionary; how potent for good and evil they become to one who knows how to combine them!"
—Nathaniel Hawthorne

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Balance of Power
text:
"To empty your mind is to fill your grave."
—Lat-Nam teaching

name: Boomerang
