text:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser, *The Faerie Queene*

name: Bribery
text: In Mercadia City, loyalties extend only as far as your purse can stretch.

name: Catalog
text:
Though those who study are as many as the hairs on an ox, those who succeed are as rare as unicorns' horns.
—Chinese proverb

name: Coastal Hornclaw
text: Jamuraan farmers fear three things above all else: droughts, floods, and hornclaws.

name: Coastal Piracy
text: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Confiscate
text:
"It is better to take what does not belong to you than to let it lie around neglected."
—Mark Twain, *More Maxims of Mark*

name: Blessed Reversal
text: Even an enemy is a valuable resource.

name: Coral Eel
text: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

name: Cowardice
Curiosity
text: "You know that secret? The one that wakes you up at night in a cold sweat? The one you think no one else in the world knows? Well, guess what."

name: Daring Apprentice
text: "I've seen my master do this a hundred times. How hard can it be?"

name: Deflection
text: The golden rule of revenge: Do unto others what they tried to do unto you.

name: Dehydration
text:
"Cry to the sun and watch as even your tears forsake you."
—Acolyte of Marit Lage

name: Evacuation
text: Which is more unsettling: the roar of battle or the silence that follows?

name: Fighting Drake
text: Scholars in their ivory towers call them "sharks of the sky." Scholars on the road don't call them at all.

name: Flash Counter
text: "So much for that bright idea!"

name: Fleeting Image
text:
"Beware lest you lose the substance by grasping at the shadow."
—Aesop, *Fables*, trans. Jacobs

name: Blinding Angel
text: "Their eyes will shrivel and blacken before faith's true light."

name: Fugitive Wizard
text: The College of Lat-Nam is often forced to expel students whose experiments grow too risky or too cruel.

name: Hibernation
text: The deep sleep of winter is not always restful.

name: Horned Turtle
text: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

name: Index
text: "Let's see . . . Mercadia, mercenary, merfolk . . . you know, I really need a better filing system."

name: Inspiration
text: Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success.

name: Intruder Alarm
text: One footstep among many is silent. One footstep alone is deafening.

name: Invisibility
text: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Chastise
text:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

name: Merchant of Secrets
text: To scrape out a living in Aphetto, wizards are reduced to selling rumors, lies, forgeries, or—if they get desperate enough—the truth.

name: Merchant Scroll
text: Lat-Nam wizards trade knowledge on scrolls made of magic so they can better guard against thieves and spies.

name: Phantom Warrior
text: It can pass through solid matter—but that doesn't mean it's harmless.

name: Puppeteer
text: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

name: Rewind
text: "Let's go over this one more time. . . ."

name: Sage of Lat-Nam
text: Within each device is a spark of its creator's soul. Within each sage is a lamp that awaits that spark.

name: Sea Monster
text: It's easy to believe the monster is a myth—until you feel three hundred thousand pounds of myth crashing down on your ship.

name: Eager Cadet
text: "Training? Seeing my crops burnt to cinders was all the 'training' I needed."

name: Vengeance
text: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

name: Giant Octopus
text:
"Before my eyes was a horrible monster, worthy to figure in the legends of the marvellous. . . . Its eight arms, or rather feet, fixed to its head . . . were twice as long as its body, and were twisted like the furies' hair."
—Jules Verne, *Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea*, trans. Lewis

name: Sea Eagle
text: Where air meets water, fish meets talon.

name: Vizzerdrix
text: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

name: Vizzerdrix
text: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

name: Enormous Baloth
text: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

name: Silverback Ape
text: It does not wear a crown or sit on a throne of gold, but those who have witnessed its power hail it nonetheless.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Telepathy
text: "Secrets? What secrets?"

name: Temporal Adept
text:
"If yesterday was two days ago tomorrow, will the day after tomorrow be today or yesterday?"
—Temporal Manipulation 101 final exam, Tolarian Academy

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

name: Thought Courier
text: "There's an assortment to satisfy all your needs: deep, fleeting, dirty, pure, scientific, philosophical, after, and even fore. For a price."

name: Tidal Kraken
text: To merfolk, pirates are a nuisance. To pirates, merfolk are a threat. To the kraken, they're both appetizers.

name: Tidings
text:
"Though the letter was many pages long, I could tell all I needed to know from one look at the messenger's face."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Time Ebb
text: Like the tide, time both ebbs and flows.

name: Trade Routes
text: The wise, the righteous, the mighty—the merchant feeds them all.

name: Traumatize
text: You won't know what you're missing.

name: Treasure Trove
text:
"Wealth means power; the power to subdue, to crush, to exploit, the power to enslave, to outrage, to degrade."
—Emma Goldman, "Anarchism"

name: Wanderguard Sentry
text: It allows those with dangerous weapons to pass. But not those with dangerous thoughts.

name: Wind Drake
text:
"But high she shoots through air and light,
Above all low delay,
Where nothing earthly bounds her flight,
Nor shadow dims her way."
—Thomas Moore, "Oh that I had Wings"

name: Withering Gaze
text: "Nature cares not for the knowledge to be gained from its study. Better to bleed it dry, lest its potential be wasted on lizards and leaves."

name: Blackmail
text: In addition to killing peasants, punishing subordinates, and raising an army of nightmares, Braids somehow found time for her favorite hobby: petty extortion.

name: Bog Imp
text: Think of it as a butcher knife with wings.

name: Bog Wraith
text: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

name: Coercion
text: "Of all I that I have lost, I miss my mind the most."

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

name: Crossbow Infantry
text:
"He can split a marshfly in two from halfway across the range."
—Onean sergeant

name: Cruel Edict
text:
"No mockeries now for them; no prayers nor bells, / Nor any voice of mourning save the choirs,— / The shrill, demented choirs of wailing shells."
—Wilfred Owen, "Anthem for Doomed Youth"

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Ha, banishment? Be merciful, say 'death,'
For exile hath more terror in his look,
Much more than death."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Death Pits of Rath
text:
"Neither could I forget what I had read of these pits—that the *sudden* extinction of life formed no part of their most horrible plan."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Pit and the Pendulum"

name: Deathgazer
text: Your entire life passes before its eyes.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Enfeeblement
text:
"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it."
—Kaervek

name: Execute
text:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Fear
text:
"Don't fear the darkness. Fear what it hides."
—Remin, venerable monk

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Final Punishment
text: The pain of a lifetime—every scrape, illness, and bruise—condensed into a single moment.

name: Foul Imp
text: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

name: Giant Cockroach
text: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

name: Gluttonous Zombie
text: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Highway Robber
text: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

name: Hollow Dogs
text: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

name: Foot Soldiers
text: Infantry deployment is the art of putting your troops in the wrong place at the right time.

name: Looming Shade
text: On darkness feeding, in nightmares breeding.

name: Lord of the Undead
text: "I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"

name: Megrim
text:
"You can run from your pain, but you will tire before it does."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Mind Rot
text:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

name: Mindslicer
text: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Persecute
text:
"Of all the tyrannies on humane kind
The worst is that which persecutes the mind."
—John Dryden,
"The Hind and the Panther"

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Plague Beetle
text: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

name: Plague Wind
text:
"The second wind of ascension is Reaver, slaying the unworthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to the rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Razortooth Rats
text:
"Men and rats both hunger: we for our playthings; they, for us."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: Each victory adds a new verse.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Serpent Warrior
text: They are incubated by swamp gases and cut their teeth on zombie flesh. Serpent warriors are not to be trifled with.

name: Slay
text: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

name: Soul Feast
text: You are who you eat.

name: Spineless Thug
text: What it lacks in backbone, it makes up for in cruelty.

name: Swarm of Rats
text:
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Unholy Strength
text: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

name: Glory Seeker
text: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Anaba Shaman
text: Just try taking *this* bull by the horns.

name: Anarchist
text: Those who will not follow are doomed to lead.

name: Balduvian Barbarians
text:
"From the snowy slopes of Kaelor,
To the canyons of Bandu,
We drink and fight and feast and die
As we were born to do."
—Balduvian tavern song

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Bloodfire Colossus
text: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

name: Boiling Seas
text: What burns the land, boils the seas.

name: Demolish
text:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

name: Holy Day
text:
"The day of Spirits; my soul's calm retreat / Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "The Night"

name: Enrage
text: The barbarians call it "touching the soul of the dragon."

name: Flame Wave
text:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Flashfires
text: Dry grass is tinder before the spark.

name: Flowstone Crusher
text:
"What's better than smashing things with a rock? A rock that gets up and smashes things for you."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

name: Flowstone Shambler
text: Flowstone troops are notoriously difficult to keep in formation.

name: Flowstone Slide
text: It may look like soil, but its nature is malice.

name: Furnace of Rath
text: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: They patched the holes, loaded their sharpest rocks, spanked their children one last time, and lurched off into the sunset.

name: Holy Strength
text: Such power protects the body with the strength of the soul.

name: Goblin Brigand
text: Like a loaded cannon—point and shoot.

name: Goblin Chariot
text: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

name: Goblin Mountaineer
text: The only thing worse than a goblin is a goblin that knows his way around.

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Goblin Sky Raider
text: The goblin word for "flying" is more accurately translated as "falling slowly."

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Kird Ape
text: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Honor Guard
text: The strength of one. The courage of ten.

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Mogg Sentry
text: Nothing makes a mogg madder than having to wake up.

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

name: Orcish Artillery
text:
"So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game."
—General Khurzog

name: Panic Attack
text: Sometimes everyone decides to go for help at the same time.

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "This scar? From a zombie's teeth. This scar? From a barbarian's axe. That scar? I don't talk about that one."

name: Relentless Assault
text: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

name: Rogue Kavu
text: Every litter of kavu yields one cub that refuses to hunt with the pack.

name: Rukh Egg
text: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

name: Seething Song
text:
"The purest ore is produced from the hottest furnace, and the brightest thunder-bolt is elicited from the darkest storm."
—Charles Colton

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Inspirit
text:
"The hour of your redemption is here. . . . Rally to me. . . . rise and strike. Strike at every favorable opportunity. For your homes and hearths, strike!"
—General Douglas MacArthur, to the people of the Philippines

name: Shock
text:
"Once I saw a goblin shouting at a thunderstorm. He lost the argument pretty quickly."
—Wandering mage

name: Sudden Impact
text:
"Some say it's better to think before you act. While those people are considering all the options, that's usually when I kill them."
—Dravus, lava mage

name: Threaten
text: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

name: Thundermare
text: Its hooves strike lightning and the thunder follows quickly after.

name: Viashino Sandstalker
text:
"Some believe sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Whip Sergeant
text: Keldon soldiers learn to move faster than the whip.

name: Wildfire
text: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a *big* appetite.

name: Anaconda
text: If you're smaller than the anaconda, it considers you food. If you're larger than the anaconda, it considers you a lot of food.

name: Ivory Mask
text: Made from its wearer's hopes, the mask ensures that those hopes will be fulfilled.

name: Biorhythm
text:
"I have seen life's purpose, and now it is my own."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Creeping Mold
text: Mold crept over the walls and into every crevice until the gleaming white stone strained and burst.

name: Early Harvest
text:
"Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty:
Vines with clust'ring bunches growing;
Plants with goodly burden bowing."
—William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

name: Elvish Bard
text: Helplessly drawn in, the bard's enemies quickly find there's more than song to be found.

name: Elvish Berserker
text: Their fury scatters enemies like a pile of dry leaves.

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Kami of Old Stone
text:
"There was a wall here. Now it is dust. A tower rose here. Now it is fallen. An army fought here. Now it is dead. A spirit was here. It is all that remains."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Elvish Warrior
text: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

name: Emperor Crocodile
text: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

name: Giant Spider
text:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

name: Greater Good
text:
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death."
—Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominaria's grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Groundskeeper
text: "Soldiers speak of defending the soil, but they care only for their nations. I care nothing for their nations and everything for the soil."

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Kavu Climber
text:
"There was a crack of branches, a rustle of leaves, then a tremendous roar. Our party had no chance as death descended from above."
—Taseen, elvish bard

name: Leonin Skyhunter
text: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

name: King Cheetah
text:
If you find yourself and a friend being chased by a king cheetah, you have but one chance: Trip your friend.
—Suq'Ata wisdom

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Llanowar Behemoth
text:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Might of Oaks
text: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

name: Natural Affinity
text: As long as the dryads are a part of the forest, the forest is a part of the army.

name: Natural Spring
text: The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.

name: Naturalize
text:
"Well, it also makes a very nice flower pot. . . ."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Needle Storm
text: The rain is driven like nails.

name: Marble Titan
text: It entered the temple with all the pomp and decorum of a rock hitting a goblin's skull.

name: Norwood Ranger
text: The song of the forest is in perfect harmony. If a single note is out of place, the elves will find its source.

name: Order of the Sacred Bell
text: "My brother, it may now be time to ring the bell and put out the call for aid."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: River Bear
text: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

name: Rootwalla
text: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

name: Scaled Wurm
text: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.

name: Master Decoy
text: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Silklash Spider
text: The only thing that flies over the Krosan Forest is the wind.

name: Summer Bloom
text: Summer sends its kiss with warmth and blooming life.

name: Trained Armodon
text: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

name: Tree Monkey
text: The vines and branches of the jungle canopy are all the wings it needs.

name: Treetop Bracers
text: Gravity is truly what you make of it.

name: Utopia Tree
text: The fruit of this fabled tree takes on the flavor of whatever food you love most.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text:
"Graceful? Yes. Beautiful? Absolutely. Harmless? Definitely not."
—Fyndhorn elder

name: Master Healer
text: Behind his eyes is the pain of every soldier his hands have healed.

name: Viridian Shaman
text: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

name: Weird Harvest
text: Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Zodiac Monkey
text: It lives mainly on fruit, leaves, and the occasional nose.

name: Aladdin's Ring
text:
"A good lamp will light your way. A good ring will clear it."
—Nervan, royal jeweler

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Beast of Burden
text: Though it was built as an instrument of labor, it wasn't long before it became an instrument of war.

name: Mending Hands
text:
"I can staunch their blood, mend their flesh, and knit their bones. But I cannot restore their hope."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."

name: Dancing Scimitar
text: A blade that has never known sheath, a hilt that has never known hand.

name: Defense Grid
text: It lights up the sky, beckoning enemies only to repel them.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Disrupting Scepter
text: "True power is controlling not only the hearts of your subjects, but their minds as well."

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Howling Mine
text: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Oracle's Attendants
text: They follow the prophecy to each new prophet, guarding the future from the present.

name: Jade Statue
text:
"The paradox of jade statues is that their victims never really expect attack, but they are never completely surprised either."
—Kabel, Tolarian archivist

name: Jester's Cap
text:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Kraken's Eye
text: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Ornithopter
text:
"It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

name: Rod of Ruin
text: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

name: Slate of Ancestry
text: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

name: Spellbook
text:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Tanglebloom
text: The bloom contains no seeds. It's meant only to nourish the forest's inhabitants.

name: Thran Golem
text: As a beaver's teeth grow unchecked without regular use, so does the golem's armor grow without regular battles.

name: Ur-Golem's Eye
text: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

name: Peace of Mind
text:
"What can a peasant get for free that an emperor can never buy?"
—Dal riddle

name: Reverse Damage
text:
"My enemy's hatred is his weakness. My enemy's anger is my strength."
—Remin, venerable monk

name: Righteousness
text: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

name: Sacred Ground
text: The knight knelt and prayed, first for the sanctity of his land and second for the strength to repel its invaders.

name: Sacred Nectar
text:
"Over the silver mountains,
Where spring the nectar fountains,
There will I kiss
The bowl of bliss;
And drink my everlasting fill. . . ."
—Sir Walter Raleigh, "The Pilgrimage"

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Aven Flock
text: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
Even the brave are scared by a lion three times: first by its tracks, again by its roar, and one last time face to face.
—Somali proverb

name: Seasoned Marshal
text:
"We are not interested in the possibilities of defeat."
—Queen Victoria

name: Serra Angel
text: When she flies above the good, they consider themselves blessed. When she flies above the wicked, they consider themselves dead.

name: Serra's Blessing
text: "Rise, and I will show you how to run without flagging, fight without raging, and fly without wings."

name: Soul Warden
text:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

name: Suntail Hawk
text: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

name: Ballista Squad
text: The perfect antidote for a tightly packed formation.

name: Tempest of Light
text: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Veteran Cavalier
text:
Spirit is the sword and experience the sharpening stone.
—Arabian proverb

name: Warrior's Honor
text:
"No person was ever honored for what he received. Honor has been the reward for what he gave."
—Calvin Coolidge

name: Worship
text:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

name: Zealous Inquisitor
text: Wine and balm for the confessions of the repentant. Razors and irons for the confessions of the unrepentant.

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Annex
text: You should see how small the map is.

name: Blessed Orator
text:
"He spoke with the tongue of Angels; we fought with the strength of lions."
—Handel, infantry soldier

name: Archivist
text:
"Sit down and read. Educate yourself for the coming conflicts."
—Mary Harris "Mother" Jones

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Aven Windreader
text: "The tiniest ripple tells a story ten fathoms deep."

name: Azure Drake
text:
Little dreamt could seem so cruel
As waiting for the wings outspread,
The jagged teeth, the burning eyes,
And dagger-claws that clench to nerves.

name: Baleful Stare
text: "Though there is little to be learned from your dust and stones, I shall wring them dry nevertheless."

name: Battle of Wits
text: The wizard who reads a thousand books is powerful. The wizard who memorizes a thousand books is insane.

name: Boomerang
text:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser, *The Faerie Queene*

name: Counsel of the Soratami
text: "Wisdom is not the counting of all the drops in a waterfall. Wisdom is learning why the water seeks the earth."

name: Blinding Angel
text: "Their eyes will shrivel and blacken before faith's true light."

name: Cowardice
Crafty Pathmage
text:
Follow the pathmage
—Otarian expression meaning "escape quickly"

name: Daring Apprentice
text: In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.

name: Dream Prowler
text:
"To think that some find sleep a restful state."
—Volrath

name: Evacuation
text: Which is more unsettling: the roar of battle or the silence that follows?

name: Exhaustion
text: Tired doesn't even begin to cover it.

name: Fleeting Image
text:
"Beware lest you lose the substance by grasping at the shadow."
—Aesop, *Fables*, trans. Jacobs

name: Blinking Spirit
text:
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Fugitive Wizard
text: The College of Lat-Nam is often forced to expel students whose experiments grow too risky or too cruel.

name: Horned Turtle
text: It doesn't like having visitors . . . unless it's having them for lunch.

name: Imaginary Pet
text: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

name: Levitation
text: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat when he had to get the others back down.

name: Lumengrid Warden
text: His peers derive knowledge from ancient tomes locked within dark spires. He finds knowledge within the solitude of a lifetime spent watching the Quicksilver Sea.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"There are as many pillows of illusion as flakes in a snow-storm. We wake from one dream into another dream."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Illusions"

name: Plagiarize
text: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

name: Chastise
text:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

name: Puppeteer
text: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

name: Reminisce
text: Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges.

name: Remove Soul
text: When your enemies are denied soldiers, they are denied victory.

name: Rewind
text: "Let's go over this one more time. . . ."

name: Sea Monster
text: It's easy to believe the monster is a myth—until you feel three hundred thousand pounds of myth crashing down on your ship.

name: Sea's Claim
text:
"Who's the crazy one now!?"
—Torgle, mountaintop boatmaker

name: Sift
text: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

name: Sleight of Hand
text:
"Gambling with mages never is."
—Remin, venerable monk

name: Eager Cadet
text: "Training? Seeing my crops burnt to cinders was all the 'training' I needed."

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"I wouldn't stand in front of that wurm, son. 'Course, I wouldn't stand behind it neither. In fact, standing anywhere near that wurm's not much of a plan. Running, now *that's* a plan!"
—Wandering mage

name: Vengeance
text: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

name: Coral Eel
text: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

name: Giant Octopus
text:
"Before my eyes was a horrible monster, worthy to figure in the legends of the marvellous. . . . Its eight arms, or rather feet, fixed to its head . . . were twice as long as its body, and were twisted like the furies' hair."
—Jules Verne, *Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea*, trans. Lewis

name: Index
text: "Let's see . . . Mercadia, mercenary, merfolk . . . you know, I really need a better filing system."

name: Vizzerdrix
text: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

name: Vizzerdrix
text: A bored wizard once created a vizzerdrix out of a bunny and a piranha. He never made *that* mistake again.

name: Goblin Raider
text: He's smart for a goblin. He can do two things: hit *and* run.

name: Enormous Baloth
text: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

name: Act of Heroism
text:
"On every plane, there are those who run toward danger."
—Gideon Jura

name: Dauntless Cathar
text: "The harder they try to extinguish my faith, the brighter it burns in the darkness."

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text:
"Behold blessed perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Plague Wind
text:
"The second wind of ascension is Reaver, slaying the unworthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Ratcatcher
text: An ogre's poisonous stench is like fine Kashkaval cheese to the noses lowest to the ground.

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Returned Phalanx
text: They lived in different nations and fought in different eras, but as the Returned, they link arms as one.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Undead Gladiator
text: The Cabal loves encores.

name: Unearth
text: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

name: Vampire Lacerator
text: The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"On dark nights you can still see the light of the Vess girl's lantern out in the Caligo, seeking her lost brother. Those who follow are doomed to join her endless search."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Disenchant
text:
"The tools of evil are mere things. And like all things, they cannot last forever."
—*Song of All*, canto 881

name: Balduvian Horde
text:
"We earn no medals and fight for no titles. Blood is proof of our victory."
—Lovisa Coldeyes

name: Ball Lightning
text: The most frightening storms are those not woven by nature's hand.

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Chandra's Outrage
text: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

name: Cinder Storm
text: Any pyromancer can summon fire with a thought. The trick is putting it out.

name: Crimson Mage
text:
"We wield the fires of rage. War is our blood and destruction our birthright."
—Crimson creed

name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
text: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.

name: Enthralling Victor
text: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Goblin War Drums
text: Their eardrums may have given out, but the rest of them never will.

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Imperial Recruiter
text: A passionate recruiter will win a war before the first arrow flies.

name: Jackal Pup
text: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

name: Kindle
text: Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Pillage
text:
"The embers of our homes still smolder, and already the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation. What they have started, we will finish."
—Lovisa Coldeyes

name: Pyre Hound
text: Its growl is the crackling and popping of a wildfire untamed.

name: Red Elemental Blast
text: Nothing restrains a burning passion.

name: Simian Spirit Guide
text:
"It's rarely worth questioning where the mana comes from. Just be grateful."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Skeletonize
text: Fire burns away both flesh and freedom.

name: Geist of the Moors
text:
"The battle is won. There's work to be done. / The Blessed Sleep must wait. / A fiend is about. It stalks the devout. / I'll save them from my fate."
—"The Good Geist's Vow"

name: Soulbright Flamekin
text: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

name: Spikeshot Goblin
text:
"Proximity discouraged. Do not approach."
—Vulshok field guide

name: Thresher Lizard
text: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

name: Trumpet Blast
text: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack. They need signals to tell them when to stop.

name: Uncaged Fury
text:
"It's right to fear those that you keep locked away."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Echoing Courage
text: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

name: Elvish Piper
text:
"From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more."
—Elvish teaching

name: Ember Weaver
text:
"Each night, the sun unravels and blows away. Each day, the spiders set a new one in the sky."
—Sunseeder myth

name: Griffin Protector
text: The drums of war stir the hearts of all who fight for righteousness.

name: Epic Confrontation
text: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Only the most effective tactics stand the test of time."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Kavu Climber
text:
The kavu might be above you
—Llanowar expression meaning "keep an open mind"

name: Kavu Predator
text: In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.

name: Krosan Colossus
text: When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.

name: Living Wish
text: The best wishes include the will to tame their consequences.

name: Lull
text: The clamor of war ceased as both armies stood and marveled at the beauty of Gaea's work.

name: Nettle Sentinel
text: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Stampede Driver
text: "The thunder of hooves is music to my ears."

name: Knight of the Skyward Eye
text: The Order of the Skyward Eye does the bidding of an evil force, unwittingly stirring fear and mistrust across Bant in accordance with his plans.

name: Timberpack Wolf
text:
"The need for the pack is bred in their bones. Their true strength will not show itself for any other purpose."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Tree of Redemption
text: The executioner's tree in Thraben Cathedral holds the power to absolve more than the souls of the hanged.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Woolly Loxodon
text: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

name: Baloth Null
text:
"Humans use pigs to hunt for mushrooms, don't they? It's like that."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

name: Blightning
text: While the smell of burning flesh is common in Grixis, the odor of smoldering brain matter is a rare treat.

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Brion Stoutarm
text: Boggarts and disturbing bits of boggarts flew through the air with alarming and untidy regularity.

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Conflux
text: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

name: Eladamri's Call
text: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Mystic Snake
text: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

name: Nicol Bolas
text: Dominaria's most ancient evil.

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Pernicious Deed
text: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

name: Pillory of the Sleepless
text: Which is worse—the sleep which never ends or that which never comes?

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Loyal Sentry
text: His watch ends only when he does.

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Assembly-Worker
text: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"When I said I needed a hand, I didn't mean this."
—Gerrard Capashen

name: Perilous Myr
text: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Sai of the Shinobi
text: The passing of the sai presages the end of the old clan and the ascent of the new.

name: Self-Assembler
text: It sees itself in all of its creations.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Sundering Titan
text:
"Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Lunarch Mantle
text:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

name: Haunted Fengraf
text: A ghoulcaller's playground.

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
text:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

name: Pendelhaven
text: The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.

name: Quicksand
text: Not all deaths are etched with mythic meaning and iconic glory.

name: Rishadan Port
text: Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
text: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Path of Peace
text: As Hedrax stepped into oblivion, he welcomed the unwavering silence.

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: "Many must die for the one who should not have perished."

name: Promise of Bunrei
text: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

name: Renewed Faith
text: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

name: Rest in Peace
text: Some corpses the Golgari cannot claim. Some souls the Orzhov cannot shackle.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

text: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

name: Urbis Protector
text:
"Guilds be damned. We can fend for ourselves."
—Vennick of the Gateless

name: Valor in Akros
text: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

text:
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."
—Takara, to Eladamri

text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

text: Nothing escapes a sharp mind.

text:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Coralhelm Guide
text:
"She knows every step of this coastline, both above and below the surface, and she has hideouts all along the way. She will get you there."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Curiosity
text: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

name: Cursecatcher
text: "Of all the things that can be stolen, opportunity is the most valuable."

name: Exclude
text:
"Terrifying, but thankfully temporary."
—Teferi

name: Flash
text: No tactic transforms a battle like a well-timed carnivore.

name: Freed from the Real
text: When a strong mind moves, form and energy shift to heed it.

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Ghost Ship
text: Going down with the ship is just the beginning.

name: Horseshoe Crab
text: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
text: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Murder of Crows
text: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
text: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Phantasmal Bear
text:
"You know it to be false, but when its claws find you, what you know won't matter much at all."
—Pol Jamaar, illusionist

name: Cloudshift
text:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

name: Retraction Helix
text: Where the geometries of the world collapse, a master of the aether can harvest power beyond comprehending.

name: Sift
text:
"Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Twisted Image
text:
"True strength is in the mind, for the body is too malleable a form."
—Politus, vedalken emisar

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

text: The spite of the Cabal turns meadow into mire.

text: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

name: Disfigure
text: "Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."

text: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

text:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

text: Their skills are extensive, and their appetite for battle just as vast.

name: Laquatus's Champion

—Queen Marchesa

—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

text: Subtlety is not a necessary part of sabotage.

—Pia Nalaar

—Rishkar, Peema renegade

text:

text: "I do not need to pierce your heart to still its beating."

text: "There is no greater coward than one who believes in nothing."

text:
"The Consulate sought to crush us. Let's give them a taste of their own medicine."
—Venkat Dasai, renegade commander

name: Cogwork Assembler
text: Duplication is neither thievery nor flattery. It is efficiency.

name: Consulate Dreadnought
text:
"It's like they planted another Bastion right in the middle of the harbor."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

name: Consulate Turret
text:
"Our watchtowers are well positioned. Why don't we arm them?"
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

name: Crackdown Construct
text:
"All buildings are subject to search. Resistance will be punished."
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

name: Deadeye Harpooner
text: "It seems there's even better hunting down here."

name: Filigree Crawler
text:
"The most harmonious designs are based on relationships found in nature."
—Venand Kapur, the Gearherder

name: Foundry Assembler
text:
"They never tire, they never complain, and they never ask questions. Build more."
—Ivash, Consulate inventor

name: Gonti's Aether Heart
text: Despite the magic that sustains Gonti's life, the crime lord is often described as heartless.

name: Hope of Ghirapur
text: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

name: Implement of Combustion
text: A dream of fire lies coiled inside, waiting for its glorious awakening.

name: Implement of Examination
text: A tool to see the unseen.

name: Implement of Improvement
text: A mystery in metal.

name: Decommission
text: "A key weakness in the design is its vulnerability to repeated, forceful blows."

name: Inspiring Statuary
text: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

name: Irontread Crusher
text: "We've been through a lot together."

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Merchant's Dockhand
text:
"If you can build it, we can move it."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

name: Night Market Guard
text:
"One head watches for Consulate enforcers. The other watches for renegade thieves."
—Crime Lord Gonti

name: Ornithopter
text:
"You want to know what we are fighting for? Look at the wonder in that child's eyes."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Pacification Array
text: The Consulate had access to thousands of innovative devices displayed at the Inventors' Fair. A few small changes transformed some of them from marvels of ingenuity to instruments of oppression.

name: Paradox Engine
text:
"One look at this glorious item convinced me that Kaladesh deserved my full attention. Sure enough, my time here has yielded exquisite fruit."
—Tezzeret

name: Deft Dismissal
text:
"With spy thopters all around, how can the consuls be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Peacewalker Colossus
text:
"Peace? Its sole purpose is fear."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Planar Bridge
text:
"It is finished. Now the real work can begin."
—Tezzeret

name: Prizefighter Construct
text: The Scrappers, an underground group with a passion for automaton brawls, had renegade leanings even before the Consulate's crackdown. It didn't take long for them to lend their best brawlers to the conflict.

name: Renegade Map
text: "We have safe houses in every zone, but you'll never find one without this."

name: Reservoir Walker
text: Renegade supply lines are, by necessity, mobile and difficult to disrupt.

name: Servo Schematic
text: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.

name: Universal Solvent
text:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

name: Untethered Express
text: Rules and rails are made to be broken.

name: Exquisite Archangel
text: A living invention born of a grand design.

name: Verdant Automaton
text:
"A perfect fusion of nature and artifice."
—Irsi, Kujar gardener

name: Watchful Automaton
text:
"Before we can destroy our enemies, we must find them. We must peer into every wretched hovel and every teeming market."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

name: Welder Automaton
text: Most of the constructs the renegades used against the Consulate weren't originally intended for combat. But some didn't require much modification.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Inspiring Roar
text:
"This is about more than aether or inventions. Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!"
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Ajani's Comrade
text: "I will go where the lion-man leads."

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

name: Felidar Guardian
text: The loyalty of a felidar is hard won but worth the effort.

name: Tezzeret's Betrayal
text:
"You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion."
—Tezzeret

name: Pendulum of Patterns
text: Its elaborate designs reveal secrets of aether's flow.

name: Tezzeret's Simulacrum
text: Tezzeret's command of living metal has nothing to do with intricate gearcraft or aether supplies.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text: Aether currents in the sky mirror water currents below, including the deadly rapids.

name: Aeronaut Admiral
text: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

name: Ghirapur Osprey
text: Many airship captains keep pets that share their love of the sky.

name: Restoration Specialist
text: Dwarves' tools are priceless heirlooms handed down through generations.

name: Solemn Recruit
text: "I can no longer sit in my workshop and ignore the events outside. My hammers strike for the people of Ghirapur."

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Sram's Expertise
text: "It's important to always have the right tool for the job. This one is for picking my teeth."

name: Thopter Arrest
text: The Consulate's eyes—unblinking, unsleeping—are everywhere.

name: Aethertide Whale
text:
"To survive up here, I've learned when to use my harpoon and when to just enjoy the view."
—Kadhu, skywhaler

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

name: Baral's Expertise
text: "Get out of my way."

name: Bastion Inventor
text: "This armor transcends the limitations of mere flesh and bone."

name: Disallow
text:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

name: Dispersal Technician
text: As renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire, Consulate blockades failed one by one.

name: Efficient Construction
text: For some of Ghirapur's aerowrights, building thopters is a byproduct of larger construction efforts.

name: Hinterland Drake
text:
"As a kid, I dreamed of flying on those wild drakes. They inspired me to build wings of my own."
—Nadja Cloudtoucher, aerowright

name: Ice Over
text:
"Slow the Consulate with whatever you've got!"
—Jasi Ganin, master siphoner

name: Illusionist's Stratagem
text:
"When everything hangs on a single moment, be sure you choose the right moment."
—Jace Beleren

name: Leave in the Dust
text: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

name: Mechanized Production
text:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

name: Metallic Rebuke
text:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

name: Aethergeode Miner
text: Gremlins in the wild feed on nodules of pure aether, which are also prized by miners.

name: Negate
text:
"It is fascinating to see how the people of this plane replicate magical techniques without a natural gift. Also frustrating."
—Jace Beleren

name: Quicksmith Spy
text: "Let's just broaden its surveillance lens."

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Salvage Scuttler
text: A hermit crab goes through many shells in its lifetime, and not all are natural in origin.

name: Shielded Aether Thief
text: Conflict breeds opportunity.

name: Shipwreck Moray
text: Shipwrecks do wonders for the local fauna, providing both shelter and aether.

name: Skyship Plunderer
text: Escapes should always be daring.

name: Take into Custody
text: "You can tell me what I want to know, or you can talk to the Chief of Compliance. Why don't you make it easy on yourself?"

name: Trophy Mage
text: "The tools of the past will help us forge the future."

name: Airdrop Aeronauts
text: "Supplies inbound. Keep that pressure on."

name: Wind-Kin Raiders
text: Small aeronaut societies like the Wind-Kin had little to lose by siding with the renegades, and much to gain.

name: Alley Strangler
text: "You never know what day might be your last."

name: Battle at the Bridge
text:
"This is bigger than you. All of you."
—Tezzeret

name: Cruel Finality
text: Bitter the bite of a demon's steel, and deep the abyss it opens.

name: Daring Demolition
text: Living so close to death gives the aetherborn an unusual perspective on risk.

name: Defiant Salvager
text: "I didn't survive that crash just so I could fall to the likes of you."

name: Fen Hauler
text:
"Success is found where others fear to look."
—Ara, renegade smuggler

name: Foundry Hornet
text: Its buzzing is easily mistaken for the hum of a thopter's wings.

name: Alley Evasion
text: "Sure, you know the law. But I know the streets."

name: Fourth Bridge Prowler
text: Renegades run the gamut from lofty sages to petty thieves.

name: Gifted Aetherborn
text: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

name: Gonti's Machinations
text: "I am confident that all our enterprises can benefit from this little revolution."

name: Ironclad Revolutionary
text: As the rebellion spread, renegade ingenuity outpaced the Consulate's greatest fears.

name: Night Market Aeronaut
text: "Death might come tomorrow, but today—today I am alive."

name: Perilous Predicament
text: Comrades in life. Comrades in death.

name: Renegade's Getaway
text: You can't fight what you can't find.

name: Audacious Infiltrator
text: "This little critter can turn all of you to scrap in under thirty seconds! Come on, who wants to be the first to go? Try and stop me!"

name: Resourceful Return
text: When the salvage team brought in the shattered gearhulk, a wave of excitement swept through the renegade foundry.

name: Secret Salvage
text: There is no shortage of illegal salvage in Ghirapur, nor of those who are willing to profit from it.

name: Vengeful Rebel
text: Some aetherborn joined the rebellion for profit, others for the sake of their freedom, still others for revenge.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Yahenni's Expertise
text: "The Consulate pushed me to my limit, darling, and this is the result."

name: Chandra's Revolution
text: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.

name: Destructive Tampering
text:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

name: Embraal Gear-Smasher
text: "A well-made wrench is a versatile, indispensable tool."

name: Bastion Enforcer
text: Headquartered at the Bastion of the Honorable, the Consulate's enforcers are charged with the impossible task of keeping the peace.

name: Enraged Giant
text: When fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, the aether weapons and swooping airships angered the normally placid creatures.

name: Freejam Regent
text: The dragons perching in Freejam's towers symbolize the zone's fierce independence.

name: Frontline Rebel
text: "Will you be strong and stand with me?"

name: Hungry Flames
text: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

name: Invigorated Rampage
text: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
text: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

name: Kari Zev's Expertise
text: "I was made for this!"

name: Lathnu Sailback
text: Travelers to Lathnu, high on the Devra Cliffs, need not fear the political strife of Ghirapur . . . but they have other dangers to worry about.

name: Call for Unity
text: The "leaking spire" stands for liberation from Consulate control.

name: Lightning Runner
text: "Catch me if you can."

name: Pia's Revolution
text: Pia's passion was directed at the big picture—at making real, lasting change.

name: Precise Strike
text: "Hit where it hurts, and always hit first."

name: Quicksmith Rebel
text: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

name: Ravenous Intruder
text:
"I've made some fine acquisitions of late, so I'm planning to make commensurate improvements to my security systems. I have a consultant coming tomorrow."
—Kurna Majan, Luminary League

name: Reckless Racer
text: Illegal street races turned out to be perfect practice for avoiding Consulate patrols.

name: Release the Gremlins
text:
"Being an inventor means knowing how to use the tools at hand to make something great—or to bring it down."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Shock
text: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

name: Siege Modification
text: Perfect for getting through to the consuls.

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Piper of the Swarm
text: "If it has ears, it will dance to my tune."

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Apex of Power
text:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Commune with Lava
text: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
text: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

name: Demanding Dragon
text: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Gratuitous Violence
text: What was supposed to be a quiet time in town turned into an adventure of its own.

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Valiant Endeavor
text: "Only victory shall stop our charge!"

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Rile
text: The enormous can still be at the mercy of the small.

name: Shivan Hellkite
text: A dragon's scale can be carved into a mighty shield, provided you can procure a dragontooth to cut it.

name: Arcane Endeavor
text: Late at night, when dreams touch a studious mind, bouts of inspiration strike.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Terror of Mount Velus
text: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Colossal Majesty
text:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

name: Greater Good
text:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Stay close, and their wrathful flames will not harm you."
—Galea

name: Nature's Lore
text: Druidcraft is a simple invocation to spirits of nature, promising a glimpse of nature's secrets.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara

name: Netherese Puzzle-Ward
text: Each configuration reveals a potential future.

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Wild Growth
text: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

name: Ashen Rider
text: One offering to appease her on her arrival. Another to celebrate her departure.

name: Atarka, World Render
text:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Bant Charm
text: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

name: Bedevil
text:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Obsessive Stitcher
text: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Vanish into Memory
text: Out of sight, into mind.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Winged Boots
text: Get carried away.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Colossus Hammer
text: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."

name: Commander's Sphere
text: "The heavens augur weal . . . for me. Woe for you."

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text: One who wears magical *boots of striding and springing* can jump astounding distances.

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Underdark flooding has swallowed ancient drow burial chambers, which are now haunted . . . and infested with oozes.

name: Esper Panorama
text: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Grave Endeavor
text: Not alive, not dead, but definitely furious.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Plant life in the valley changes for the worse as runoff from dwarven forges contaminates the water.

name: Nimbus Maze
text: To find its center is to find one's own.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Hellish Rebuke
text: "Then we burn together!"

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Legend says a mighty angel appears to pilgrims in need who reach this lofty height.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: The ancient magic of sun elves keeps these lands in an eternal summer.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Zhalfirin Void
text:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

name: Fiendlash
text: A fiery scourge for both flesh and soul.

name: Maddening Hex
text: Much more painful than mere regret.

name: Reckless Endeavor
text: Which burns more fiercely? Your ambition, or the flame?

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."
