name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Bag of Tricks
text: From fuzzy to ferocious in an instant.

name: Druid of Purification
text: "Return to the earth and the wind."

name: Wild Endeavor
text: The wilds consume, but they also create.

name: Dragonborn Champion
text: "I was raised on the stories of my ancestors, and I want to write my own pages in the tales."

name: Extract Brain
text: No thought is as succulent as a secret.

name: Hurl Through Hell
text: No one returns unchanged.

name: Fey Steed
text: Ride into legend.

name: Ride the Avalanche
text: The mountain will build your cairn of snow and ice and stone.

name: Bucknard's Everfull Purse
text: As long as it's never left empty, this magic pouch produces coins every dawn.

name: Holy Avenger
text: Divine light forged in steel.

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Angelic Gift
text: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

name: Ronom Unicorn
text: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Curator of Mysteries
text: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

name: Curse of Verbosity
text: Idle chatter beckons many an attentive ear.

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Murder of Crows
text: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Riverwise Augur
text: "Time flows as the rivers do, toward an unknown sea. The wise know to look downstream."

name: Serum Visions
text: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

name: Doomed Necromancer
text: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

name: +2 Mace
text: The weight of this magic weapon falls heavy on the wicked.

name: Delver's Torch
text: "Not all of us have darkvision, okay?"

name: Eyes of the Beholder
text: In the end, there was nothing beautiful to be seen.

name: Fates' Reversal
text: A doom denied—or, perhaps, delayed.

name: Feign Death
text: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

name: Grim Bounty
text: Freed from the need to pay tribute to the dragon, the villages gladly paid the dragon-slayers instead.

name: Grim Wanderer
text: There is a stillness that walks with him, the quiet that follows great tragedy, when even the mourners are too exhausted to weep.

name: Hired Hexblade
text: "I'll take care of it. You just be sure to hold up your end of the deal."

name: Devoted Paladin
text: "I swore a sacred oath to protect the weak and punish those who threaten them. As long as I draw breath, I will protect you."

name: Hoard Robber
text: "And to think, a year ago I was picking pockets in Waterdeep."

name: Power Word Kill
text: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
text: Erigan cried out in pain as a hideous weakness settled into his bones.

name: Sepulcher Ghoul
text: Ghouls devour the dead and any living creatures unwary enough to fall into their grasp.

name: Divine Smite
text: "When darkness closes in around us, my blade will light our path."

name: Skullport Merchant
text: "Buy something or get out."

name: Vampire Spawn
text: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

name: Wight
text: Wights want the world to resound with echoes of their own cruel hatred.

name: Yuan-Ti Fang-Blade
text: "The air is sweet with the taste of your fear."

name: Zombie Ogre
text:
"On the plus side, Throg no longer thinks he's clever."
—Xanathar

name: Armory Veteran
text: "This one is for goblins, this one is for owlbears, this one is for toast, this one is for . . ."

name: Boots of Speed
text: Click your heels and become the wind.

name: Brazen Dwarf
text: "My grandmother saved the life of a brass dragon, and in return she was given a glimpse of the fire in its heart—a glimpse she passed down to me."

name: Burning Hands
text: A simple fire spell that grows in intensity along with its caster.

name: Critical Hit
text: "How do you kill what's already dead? *That's* how."

name: Dwarfhold Champion
text: Courage is neither a shield nor an axe, but the will to wield both in defense of the innocent.

name: Goblin Javelineer
text: Hate gets you only so far. A pointy stick can close the rest of the distance.

name: Hobgoblin Bandit Lord
text: In a hobgoblin's view of the world, the weak owe tribute and fealty to the strong.

name: Hobgoblin Captain
text: Hobgoblins do not fear death, for those who fall in battle have gained glory eternal.

name: Hulking Bugbear
text: Bugbears move with surprising speed for their size and bulk, a fact that has led to the demise of many unwary adventurers.

name: Flumph
text: Flumphs siphon thoughts and energy from evil aberrations, and are often eager to share the dark knowledge they obtain with friendly adventurers.

name: Improvised Weaponry
text: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

name: Inferno of the Star Mounts
text: The ancient dragon Imvaernarhro has earned his fiery nickname.

name: Jaded Sell-Sword
text: "Today? That'll cost you extra."

name: Kick in the Door
text:
"We tried your way. Now we do it my way!"
—Jym, barbarian of Baldur's Gate

name: Magic Missile
text: A tried-and-true favorite of many wizards, whatever their school.

name: Meteor Swarm
text: Sometimes one fireball isn't enough.

name: Price of Loyalty
text: "Most folks got mayhem in their hearts. Just gotta know their price."

name: Gloom Stalker
text: "I'll make sure you never mistake a roper for a stalagmite again."

name: Red Dragon
text: Red dragons consider the world and every creature in it as theirs to command.

name: Rust Monster
text:
"They don't seem scary, but then you're suddenly standing there in your underclothes without a weapon. Then everything looks like a threat."
—Jarro, battle master

name: Unexpected Windfall
text: Fortune favors the fortunate.

name: Valor Singer
text: "There is only one way forward: into legend."

name: Wish
text:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

name: Xorn
text: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.

name: You Come to the Gnoll Camp
text:
"Easy now, everyone. I'll take care of this."
—Nadaar

name: You See a Pair of Goblins
text:
"I have the shot. Shall I take it?"
—Varis, Silverymoon ranger

name: Zalto, Fire Giant Duke
text: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

name: Bulette
text: Capable of moving swiftly through even tightly-packed earth and leaping surprising distances above ground, bulettes are difficult to escape once they've caught scent of prey.

name: Bull's Strength
text: As the iron bars of the portcullis parted like reeds, the defenders of the keep suddenly felt much less secure.

name: Choose Your Weapon
text:
"Move it, Varis, or I'll pick one for you!"
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

name: Circle of Dreams Druid
text: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.

name: Circle of the Moon Druid
text: Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of nature who haunt the deepest parts of the wilderness.

name: Compelled Duel
text: "You might be four times my size, but I will not be ignored!"

name: Dire Wolf Prowler
text: Large as horses, dire wolves must hunt often to satisfy their ravenous hunger. A mere human does little more than blunt their appetite.

name: Elturgard Ranger
text: Since the fall of Elturel, they've walked the Sword Coast from Tethyr to Icewind Dale, eyes always on their prey.

name: Gnoll Hunter
text: Yipping and cackling, the hunters tore through the village, leaving nothing but snapped bones and burning homes in their wake.

name: Green Dragon
text: Green dragons take special pleasure in corrupting the good-hearted.

name: Hill Giant Herdgorger
text: A shepherd's crook is useful for cleaning bits of wool out of the teeth.

name: Inspiring Bard
text: "Wake up, my friends! There are deeds to be done and treasures to be won!"

name: Half-Elf Monk
text: This fight was over the moment you picked up that clumsy cleaver of a sword.

name: Long Rest
text: A job well done means a rest well earned.

name: Lurking Roper
text: "You see, stalac-*tites* grow down from the ceiling, while stalag-*mites* reach—AAHHHHHHHHH—"

name: Neverwinter Dryad
text: Its life force entwined with its tree, a dryad is an elusive and solitary being that wishes only to be left alone.

name: Old Gnawbone
text: The ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar is often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.

name: Owlbear
text: Many people believe a misguided wizard created the first owlbear, but others insist that these creatures have always dwelled in the Feywild.

name: Plummet
text: The dragon's noxious breath withered the forest. The whistle of a hundred arrows filled the air. The ground roiled as if shaken by an earthquake. The tyrant fell from the sky.

name: Arborea Pegasus
text: The noble steeds of the elven gods can sometimes be persuaded to allow mere mortals on their backs.

name: Purple Worm
text: Underground civilizations maintain magical barriers around their settlements to deter these monsters.

name: Ranger's Longbow
text: With the right weapon, a fearsome beholder is nothing more than a big floating bullseye.

name: Scaled Herbalist
text: "I could help you, or I could eat you for lunch. I haven't decided yet."

name: Spoils of the Hunt
text: "Every coin helps rebuild the town they destroyed."

name: The Tarrasque
text: When it rises, nations fall.

name: Underdark Basilisk
text:
"See how the statues all have chunks bitten out of them? We're dealing with a basilisk, or I'm a froghemoth."
—Larissa Kyriln, learned warlock

name: Wandering Troubadour
text: "There's a new ballad waiting to be born around every corner."

name: Adult Gold Dragon
text: Gold dragons are the greatest of the metallic dragons in size, power, and wisdom, and often take it upon themselves to safeguard mortal communities from evils that might threaten them.

name: Bruenor Battlehammer
text: "Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!"

name: Keen-Eared Sentry
text: "You're not the first to underestimate me."

name: Farideh, Devil's Chosen
text: "A pact is a tool, not a damnation."

name: Gretchen Titchwillow
text: "Plant what you wish to see grow. Listen for the stories you want to hear told."

name: Hama Pashar, Ruin Seeker
text: "Someone took the time to carve these inscriptions. The least we can do is care enough to read them."

name: Loyal Warhound
text: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.

name: Tiamat
text: "My children will rule over all!"

name: Trelasarra, Moon Dancer
text: "Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth. We all may find beauty and light, if we have the courage to seek them."

name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
text: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"

name: Bag of Holding
text: Leave no treasure behind.

name: Dungeon Map
text: "Wait, is that a secret door? I can't tell for sure . . . there's some blood in the way."

name: Eye of Vecna
text: "I see all things as they truly are! I see . . . decay in all flesh, and betrayal in every heart."

name: Greataxe
text: "If you're so mighty, scaled one, then why are you dead?"

name: Iron Golem
text: Once an iron golem is set to a task, it won't turn aside until that task is complete or it has been destroyed.

name: Leather Armor
text: Lightweight, flexible, and protective.

name: Monk of the Open Hand
text: His mind is a tranquil meadow, his fists a raging storm.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Parts of Faerûn still churn with the magic of arrogant Netherese archmages long dead.

name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
text: Selûne guides her devotees with majestic wisdom and grace.

name: Treasure Vault
text: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

name: Plains
text: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations ... but what has been hunting them?

name: Plains
text: Seeking to learn why the ancestors have fallen silent, you've made your way to their ancient cairns.

name: Plains
text: Searching for a vanished caravan that was bound for Silverymoon, you've come to a bank of mysterious fog.

name: Plains
text: Venturing beneath the desert sands, you've discovered an alien power pulsing with inconceivable energy.

name: Island
text: In crystal-studded waters far below the surface, you've discovered an incubating egg of mysterious origin.

name: Island
text: After careful study, you've determined that the giant ruins served to track the movement of the planets ... and they will soon align once more.

name: Island
text: As your ship clears the edge of Waterdeep harbor, you notice pirate sails on the horizon. What has made them so bold?

name: Island
text: Alarmed by the news you brought, the storm giant king of the Maelstrom has called his kin to council.

name: Swamp
text: As a plague ravages the world above, you've made your way into the Underdark in search of a fungal panacea.

name: Swamp
text: Your search for a stolen artifact has brought you to the edge of the Mere of Dead Men.

name: Swamp
text: As you trudge through the sewers of Baldur's Gate it dawns on you: where are all the rats?

name: Swamp
text: You expected to meet hostile drow in this ancient ruin . . . but they fled long ago. What darkness could have driven them out?

name: Mountain
text: You meant to simply rest in Hundelstone, but the miners have told you stories of whispers in the dark below.

name: Mountain
text: Your path lies across the Spine of the World, where every cave hides some new danger.

name: Mountain
text: You've ventured deep into the heart of the mountain to determine what can calm its quaking rage.

name: Mountain
text: As you make camp near the ancient ruin, you hear the sound of drums echoing in halls where no dwarf has lived in generations.

name: Forest
text: As the sun reaches its zenith on the day of the solstice, a castle shimmers into view on the hilltop, just as the ancient text predicted.

name: Forest
text: As you venture deeper under the boughs of Neverwinter Wood, arrows in a tree trunk suggest you might not be welcome.

name: Oswald Fiddlebender
text: "Can't see this airship crashing in the near future. Sturdy as a rock."

name: Forest
text: As monsters from the Underdark rampage across the world above, you've delved deep underground to determine what has driven them upward.

name: Forest
text: Before the elf queen will aid you, you must find a way to cure the strange rot afflicting the roots of the ancient trees.

name: Blink Dog
text: Blink dogs protect the wild places of the world, driving away evil influences.

name: Planar Ally
text: Her light touches every corner and her wings brush either wall, leaving no place for evil to lurk.

name: Portable Hole
text: "They fall for it every time."

name: Potion of Healing
text: Magic can knit the body back together, but the courage to fight on comes only from within.

name: Priest of Ancient Lore
text: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."

name: Rally Maneuver
text: "Don't give up! You are steel and fire, and victory is yours to seize."

name: Ranger's Hawk
text: Swift eyes to scout the way ahead.

name: Steadfast Paladin
text: "When I made my oath to Moradin, I left selfishness and cowardice behind. Every battle, I make that commitment anew."

name: Teleportation Circle
text:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

name: Veteran Dungeoneer
text: Her tales of glory light a fire in the souls of the next generation of adventurers.

name: White Dragon
text: White dragons are unparalleled hunters, keenly focused on slaughtering their enemies.

name: You're Ambushed on the Road
text: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

name: Air-Cult Elemental
text: Elemental Evil distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.

name: Bar the Gate
text: "This path is closed to you!"

name: Celestial Unicorn
text: When all hope fails, its light remains.

name: Clever Conjurer
text: "I'm always happy to lend a hand!"

name: Displacer Beast
text: The only place you can be sure it's not is wherever it appears to be.

name: Feywild Trickster
text: Unlike most warlocks, those who make pacts with archfey are drawn to pranks and whimsy moreso than death and darkness.

name: Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar
text: "You studied hard. How delicious!"

name: Guild Thief
text: She puts some coin in the Guild's pocket and sends a message at the same time.

name: Mind Flayer
text: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."

name: Mordenkainen's Polymorph
text: "Your purpose may change along with your shape, but you will serve regardless."

name: Pixie Guide
text: Pixies are well known as pranksters, but some delight in more helpful magic.

name: Rimeshield Frost Giant
text: Frost giants carry the trophies of their greatest victories into battle, fashioned into armor of strength and savage beauty.

name: Secret Door
text: The way opened before him, and the dust of centuries stirred in the air.

name: Shocking Grasp
text: "Metal armor? A poor choice."

name: Shortcut Seeker
text: "Ah, the old 'trap door under a rug' trick. This is almost too easy."

name: Silver Raven
text: Wings take flight on whispered wind.

name: Soulknife Spy
text: "My psychic blade cuts the mind and severs thoughts. Even if you survive, you'll never remember I was here."

name: Split the Party
text: Don't.

name: Sudden Insight
text: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things gave Voltusk an inexplicable flash of understanding that he spent the rest of his life trying to repeat.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
text: The raging behir reared back, opened its terrible maw . . . and collapsed in a fit of horrifying giggles.

name: Trickster's Talisman
text: "Lady Luck, smile on me!"

name: True Polymorph
text: Maybe a little *too* convincing.

name: You Find the Villains' Lair
text: "Give me just a moment! I almost have it."

name: You See a Guard Approach
text: "Looks like we've got company."

name: Yuan-Ti Malison
text: Silent. Slithering. Sinister.

name: Black Dragon
text: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.

name: Check for Traps
text: "Relax. I'm a professional."

name: Clattering Skeletons
text: Those who die in the dungeon become its guardians.

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Death-Priest of Myrkul
text: "The Reaper bids you rise!"

name: Demogorgon's Clutches
text: The good will be corrupted, the kind will be devoured, and all will be dragged into the bottomless Abyss.

name: Devour Intellect
text:
"I'll know what you know soon enough."
—Nihiloor, Xanathar Guild spymaster

name: Drider
text: Though their forms embody Lolth's image, driders are those unfortunate drow who have failed the Spider Queen.

name: Dungeon Crawler
text:
"I think of it as giving them another chance to achieve their potential."
—Nestus Wrasse, necromancer

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: As the blaze raced towards her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

name: Miasmic Mummy
text: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

name: Nest of Scarabs
text:
"They are small, but they always want more. Learn from them."
—Bontu, god of ambition

name: Painful Lesson
text:
"You wish to remember this lesson? I will write it down for you."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Ruthless Sniper
text: "You may feel a slight sting."

name: Scarab Feast
text:
"The face of mediocrity is wrapped in anointed linen. Aspire to a better end."
—Epnokep, vizier of Bontu

name: Shadow of the Grave
text:
"Death has seeped into every part of this plane. I can feel it on my skin and taste it like sand in my mouth."
—Nissa Revane

name: Splendid Agony
text:
"Wherever you are in the city, you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that."
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

name: Djeru's Resolve
text: "When I wish to be strong, I train. When I wish to be wise, I study. When I wish to rest, I start again."

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Trespasser's Curse
text: Even in the relative safety of the city, there are places best left undisturbed.

name: Unburden
text:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition

name: Wander in Death
text: Forever restless. Forever growing in number.

name: Wasteland Scorpion
text: All but the gods fear the scorpion's sting.

name: Ahn-Crop Crasher
text:
"Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back."
—Anep, vizier of Hazoret

name: Blazing Volley
text: The arrows fell like fiery rain, and for a moment, the sky itself seemed to burn.

name: Fan Bearer
text: Rest sometimes requires the right prompting.

name: Bloodlust Inciter
text: "To victory! To glory! To eternity!"

name: Bloodrage Brawler
text: To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.

name: Brute Strength
text: "Oketra had our crop build an obelisk to prove the power of working together. But I am stronger without the weak."

name: By Force
text:
"Dissent? Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Cartouche of Zeal
text: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.

name: Consuming Fervor
text: Headlong is the only way to pass through the gate to the afterlife.

name: Desert Cerodon
text: The endless expanse of desert surrounding Naktamun sometimes yields threats that the gods themselves must answer.

name: Electrify
text: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."

name: Forsake the Worldly
text: "Why cling to these trappings? They are but tools and affectations. True wealth can be possessed only in the afterlife."

name: Emberhorn Minotaur
text: "My stride will break only against the twin points of Hazoret's spear."

name: Flameblade Adept
text:
"Allow zealous flames to light your path and the glory you seek will be revealed."
—Hazoret, god of zeal

name: Fling
text: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

name: Glorybringer
text: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

name: Harsh Mentor
text: "Fight through it."

name: Hazoret's Favor
text: Hazoret's gift is bestowed only once.

name: Hyena Pack
text: With carrion a rarity in the Broken Lands, the hyenas that stalk the deserts hunt in packs.

name: Limits of Solidarity
text:
"When the time comes, only one of you will be honored by my spear."
—Hazoret, god of zeal

name: Magma Spray
text:
"Ashes can't be embalmed."
—Neheb, initiate of Ahn crop

name: Manticore of the Gauntlet
text: In the training ground known as the Gauntlet, initiates are pushed to practice more destructive techniques.

name: Minotaur Sureshot
text: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

name: Nef-Crop Entangler
text: "If you do not feel the thrill of battle, alive like a flame, you will never triumph."

name: Nimble-Blade Khenra
text:
"In the Hour of Glory, the gods and the untested will prove their worth before the God-Pharaoh."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Pathmaker Initiate
text: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

name: Pursue Glory
text:
"Combat is a form of worship, the clash of steel a solemn prayer."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop

name: Sweltering Suns
text: The Hekma may repel storms and monsters, but nothing holds back the heat of the suns.

name: Thresher Lizard
text: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

name: Tormenting Voice
text: "You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."

name: Trial of Zeal
text: "Eternal glory awaits you, my child."

name: Trueheart Twins
text: Shoulder to shoulder until blade must turn against blade.

name: Violent Impact
text: Initiates in the heat of combat must be able to adapt to changing conditions.

name: Warfire Javelineer
text: Minotaurs favor magic that manifests as weapons wrapped in flame.

name: Benefaction of Rhonas
text: It falls to the gods to help all become worthy of the afterlife.

name: Bitterblade Warrior
text: "The vizier of poisons teaches an unconventional kind of strength."

name: Champion of Rhonas
text: The only way to finish the Trial of Strength is with a basilisk scale in hand.

name: Glory-Bound Initiate
text:
"Fly as an arrow through the trials, and never waver in your course."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

name: Colossapede
text:
"If it is bigger, you must be faster. If it is stronger, you must be sharper. Anything less, and you will never seize a place in our God-Pharaoh's perfect afterlife."
—Rhonas, god of strength

name: Crocodile of the Crossing
text:
"Everything in the trial has teeth. You will overcome them, or you will feed them."
—Rhonas, god of strength

name: Dissenter's Deliverance
text:
"When all doubts have melted away, the worthy will meet the Hour of Eternity and earn a place at the God-Pharaoh's side."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Exemplar of Strength
text: "No one is born worthy."

name: Giant Spider
text: The Broken Lands are littered with the remnants of civilizations long dead and infested by terrors very much alive.

name: Greater Sandwurm
text: A sandwurm can lie in wait beneath the sands for years until the slightest tremor alerts it to the presence of prey.

name: Hapatra's Mark
text:
"If you fear poisons, it is because you are ignorant of them."
—Hapatra, vizier of poisons

name: Gust Walker
text: "I'm never unarmed."

name: Harvest Season
text: A true reflection of nature: death fostering life.

name: Haze of Pollen
text: Few can overcome an assault of such aggressive serenity.

name: Honored Hydra
text: Even gods have pets.

name: Hooded Brawler
text: Nagas wielding twin daggers excel at the fighting technique known as the Bite of Rhonas.

name: Initiate's Companion
text:
"I'd like to say that it's our pet, but the reverse may be closer to the truth."
—Ixor, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Manglehorn
text:
"Rely too much on your weapons and watch your dreams shatter in your hands."
—Rhonas, god of strength

name: Naga Vitalist
text: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."

name: Oashra Cultivator
text: "Like fruits in the field, we will be harvested when the season is right."

name: Ornery Kudu
text: Debate rages among the viziers whether comparing the kudu's horns to the God-Pharaoh's is blasphemy or reverence.

name: Pouncing Cheetah
text: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.

name: Impeccable Timing
text: To a trained warrior, there is scarcely a more potent weapon than patience.

name: Prowling Serpopard
text: The viziers serving Rhonas, the god of strength, maintain the menagerie of animals employed during his trial.

name: Quarry Hauler
text: They labor beside the anointed, constructing the vast monuments of Naktamun.

name: Sandwurm Convergence
text: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

name: Scaled Behemoth
text: Surviving an encounter with it is proof enough that an initiate is ready for the Trial of Strength.

name: Shed Weakness
text: To prepare for the Trial of Strength, nagas shed their old skin—and with it their scars, their doubts, and their fears.

name: Sixth Sense
text: Instinct yields the truest insight.

name: Spidery Grasp
text: There are no safe paths through the Trial of Strength.

name: Stinging Shot
text: Initiates must train to resist the natural toxins they use as weapons.

name: In Oketra's Name
text:
"A single grain of sand is insignificant, but a sandstorm can reduce pyramids to dust. Stand with your crop. Become the storm."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

name: Synchronized Strike
text: Khenra are almost always born as twins. Their instinctual connection lends itself well to their preferred fighting style.

name: Trial of Strength
text: "Instincts to guide. Strength to overcome."

name: Watchful Naga
text: The forked tongue of the naga is sensitive to drifting scent trails from the past, present, and sometimes even the future.

name: Ahn-Crop Champion
text: "The Second Sun nears its destination! Let it light the way to ours!"

name: Enigma Drake
text: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets known only to Kefnet himself. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

name: Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons
text: Her subtle smile is suffused with venom.

name: Anointed Procession
text:
"The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them."
—Gideon Jura

name: Mighty Leap
text: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

name: Honored Crop-Captain
text: Her words inspire action. Her actions inspire victory.

name: Khenra Charioteer
text:
"We do not swerve."
—Tah-crop charioteer motto

name: Merciless Javelineer
text: "My mind is the calm in the midst of the storm, and my javelin the lightning."

name: Samut, Voice of Dissent
text: "I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying. The afterlife will have to wait."

name: Shadowstorm Vizier
text: She can coil a breeze like a string around her finger—or twist it into a noose.

name: Wayward Servant
text: If one of the anointed fails to serve with perfect obedience, the desert is always ready to receive it.

name: Weaver of Currents
text: "Your waters sustain the living and carry the dead. Mighty Luxa, let your power flow through me!"

name: Bontu's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Embalmer's Tools
text:
"They might be dead, but these mummies are masters of their trade."
—Jace Beleren

name: Hazoret's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

name: Protection of the Hekma
text: Part of the acolytes' training is to walk along the Hekma, staring out at the ravenous horrors kept at bay by the God-Pharaoh's barrier.

name: Honed Khopesh
text: Blades and bravery go hand in hand.

name: Kefnet's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall cultivate a nimble mind to perceive the glorious wonders that await them."
—Monument inscription

name: Luxa River Shrine
text: Without the God-Pharaoh, there would be no Luxa. Without the Luxa, there would be no life.

name: Oketra's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
text: Five gods, one purpose.

name: Rhonas's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall hone a strong body to endure the boundless energies of the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
text:
"When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation. Then the Hour of Glory, the Hour of Promise, and finally the Hour of Eternity."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Watchers of the Dead
text: They are tasked with protecting the entrance to the embalming chambers.

name: Regal Caracal
text: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

name: Cascading Cataracts
text:
"The power that flows here cannot be denied. But where is the source?"
—Nissa Revane

name: Cradle of the Accursed
text: Many such monuments dot the wasteland known as Ifnir.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma? Beyond the reach of the gods? Beyond the horns on the horizon?"
—Samut, initiate of Tah crop

name: Painted Bluffs
text: Centuries of scouring sands have carved and polished the rocky terrain of the Shefet.

name: Sunscorched Desert
text: The only relief in sight is a mirage.

name: Renewed Faith
text: "To see gods among the people, part of their daily lives . . . It's inspiring."

name: Rhet-Crop Spearmaster
text: "In the afterlife, I'll have no need of sleep. And until then, I have no time for it!"

name: Companion of the Trials
text:
"The fiercest loyalties are earned in battle."
—Gideon Jura

name: Graceful Cat
text: Though they are held in high regard as symbols of the god Oketra, cats often lack her sense of solidarity.

name: Stone Quarry
text: Entire valleys have been formed by mummies laboring to find veins of lazotep.

name: Desiccated Naga
text:
"The nature of this plane makes it almost too easy for me to command the dead."
—Liliana Vess

name: Tattered Mummy
text: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city crave only to spread their curse.

name: Foul Orchard
text: On Amonkhet, death is an ever-present part of life.

name: Seraph of the Suns
text:
"Angels? My feelings remain unchanged."
—Liliana Vess

name: Cinder Barrens
text: A mudflow swallowed the lowlands years ago. All that remains are a bottomless mire and an endless rain of ash.

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Highland Lake
text: With the fate of Innistrad uncertain, some seek solace in remote areas.

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text: Aether currents in the sky mirror water currents below, including the deadly rapids.

name: Timber Gorge
text: Tazeem's embrace is harsh, but for those that call it home, nothing else will do.

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Sparring Mummy
text: Aspiring to earn their place in the afterlife, acolytes train every day against those who fell short of that glory.

name: Supply Caravan
text:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

name: Those Who Serve
text:
"The dead perform all the work here—farming, building, teaching, even embalming their fellow mummies. The living need do nothing but train. What system could be more perfect?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Time to Reflect
text:
"Occasionally, there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Trial of Solidarity
text: "You will succeed as one or fail as many."

name: Vizier of Remedies
text: "You'll need all your strength for the trials to come."

name: Winged Shepherd
text:
"When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma, for its protection will be needed no longer."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Ancient Crab
text: The banks of the Luxa River attract all manner of predator but only the most resilient of prey.

name: Angler Drake
text: From the time they are hatchlings, river drakes are taught to pull the largest prey from the Luxa.

name: Cancel
text: "Let me try one of Kefnet's puzzles. This one was too easy."

name: Cartouche of Knowledge
text: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

name: Censor
text:
"Why so many questions?"
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Compelling Argument
text:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

name: Cryptic Serpent
text: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

name: Curator of Mysteries
text: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

name: Aven Mindcensor
text: "The only question we need to ask is how best to fulfill the will of the God-Pharaoh."

name: Decision Paralysis
text:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

name: Drake Haven
text:
"If you want to truly test your survival skills, walk the Obelisk Path when the drakes are feeding."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Essence Scatter
text: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.

name: Floodwaters
text:
"It usually appears placid, but don't be fooled. The Luxa River is a snake, and it can swallow you whole."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

name: Galestrike
text: Strong wings make strong winds.

name: Hekma Sentinels
text: "The God-Pharaoh created the Hekma to protect us from the horrors beyond and to surround us in his love."

name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
text: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

name: Illusory Wrappings
text:
"No amount of strength can help you overcome my trial. You must be ready to forgo your body and favor your mind."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

name: Binding Mummy
text: What the gods decree, the mummies enforce.

name: Lay Claim
text: Initiates need worry only about the trials. Everything else is in the hands of the gods.

name: Naga Oracle
text: "All questions will be answered during the Hour of Revelation."

name: New Perspectives
text: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

name: Open into Wonder
text: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: River Serpent
text: Though the Luxa River brings life to Naktamun, it's not without dangers.

name: Sacred Excavation
text: The anointed work the mines without pause, their cartouches instilling them with tireless purpose.

name: Scribe of the Mindful
text:
"The best answers solve more than one riddle."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

name: Seeker of Insight
text: The Trial of Knowledge challenges and broadens the minds of initiates.

name: Shimmerscale Drake
text: They are drawn by the brilliant blue glint of the mineral lazotep from the mines below.

name: Slither Blade
text: Some naga initiates move as silently the suns' reflections on the water.

name: Tah-Crop Skirmisher
text: Initiates live and train with their crop, the unit that begins the trials together.

name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
text: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

name: Winds of Rebuke
text: "I have foreseen that you will not pass my trial."

name: Zenith Seeker
text: Only from the sky can one fully understand the horrors of the wastes and the wonder of the Hekma's protection.

name: Baleful Ammit
text:
"Not all in our crop deserve the afterlife. We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

name: Blighted Bat
text: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

name: Bone Picker
text: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

name: Cruel Reality
text: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

name: Cursed Minotaur
text:
"Look! That is why we must never waver. That is what awaits us if we fail."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Dune Beetle
text: The scouring sands of Shefet polish its carapace, and the ranks of the cursed fill its belly.

name: Compulsory Rest
text: The pain of death is nothing compared to the pain of failure.

name: Faith of the Devoted
text:
"The more I see of this place, the less I want to."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Festering Mummy
text: As its parched flesh withers away, its malignant hunger grows.

name: Final Reward
text: Those who earn a glorious death are given the highest honor. They are carried on funeral barges through the gate to the afterlife.

name: Gravedigger
text: In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.

name: Grim Strider
text:
"As a child I saw something walking in the distance, far beyond the Hekma—shadow-dark, and taller than the gods. Even now, it passes through my dreams."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop

name: Horror of the Broken Lands
text: It feeds on dry bones in the sand and desperate pleas in the wind.

name: Lay Bare the Heart
text:
"True intentions lie not in the head but in the heart."
—Bontu, god of ambition

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Akrasan Squire
text: Bant's armies are primarily composed of members of the Mortar caste, loyal commoners who haven't yet earned a sigil.

name: Ethersworn Canonist
text: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: Dragon lords of Jund rule by edicts of flame.

name: Goblin Assault
text: A goblin raid is a delicate gambit—a blend of stealth, precision, and screaming death.

name: Goblin Mountaineer
text: Goblin lairs sit high in Jund's mountains. This gives the goblins easy access to the sacrificial peaks above and lets them build up a head of steam before attacking prey down below.

name: Hissing Iguanar
text: Viashino thrashes keep iguanars as hunting companions, giving them wounded captives as playthings.

name: Incurable Ogre
text: Each mutation causes the incurables to look vastly different from one another. They are left with only one thing in common: their insatiable lust for the slaughter.

name: Jund Battlemage
text: "Of your blood I will make my mead, an offering to the thirsty jungle."

name: Lightning Talons
text:
"This is going to hurt a lot, but on the bright side, you'll be dead soon."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

name: Magma Spray
text:
"Jund is a wounded world. Beware its searing blood spilling out onto the surface."
—Rakka Mar

name: Predator Dragon
text: Dragons make for spiteful gods.

name: Excommunicate
text: Rebels and other malcontents forced into the ritual awake lost in Topa's vast savannahs. Those who find their way back return humble and repentant.

name: Ridge Rannet
text:
"Only those with the strength to seize their destiny deserve to have one."
—Nacatl scratchforms

name: Rockslide Elemental
text: On Jund, even the landscape is a deadly hunter. Volcanoes, tar pits, and rock slides seem to prey upon the living.

name: Skeletonize
text: Fire burns away both flesh and freedom.

name: Soul's Fire
text: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

name: Thunder-Thrash Elder
text: Viashino thrashes are led by elders who have survived countless challenges.

name: Viashino Skeleton
text: Underneath the Dregscape lay the remains of creatures long extinct from Grixis.

name: Vicious Shadows
text:
"Thrashes of the ancient past still linger in spirit and shadow, desperate to sink their claws into our souls."
—Rakka Mar

name: Guardians of Akrasa
text:
"Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe."
—Elspeth

name: Volcanic Submersion
text: A dragon's death is almost as feared as its life. Old, dying dragons throw themselves into volcanoes, causing massive upheaval and widespread disaster.

name: Where Ancients Tread
text:
"Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Algae Gharial
text: It lurks just under the surface, using the algae-choked tar pits of Jund as both home and hunting blind.

name: Behemoth's Herald
text: "Mine is an insatiable god, with appetites as magnificent as the jungle itself."

name: Cavern Thoctar
text: Natives of Naya know better than to loiter near the mouth of a cave. Two glowing red eyes and the stench of foul breath are all the warning you're likely to get.

name: Court Archers
text: The Sun-Dappled Court of Valeron stands secure behind a wall of steel-tipped arrows.

name: Cylian Elf
text: From her sunsail tent high above the forest floor, an elf harkener can hear the footfalls of a single creature through the cacophony of Naya's jungle sounds.

name: Druid of the Anima
text: Although the Anima herself remains at the Sacellum, her druids roam Naya, collecting mana bonds with every location in the world.

name: Drumhunter
text: "I feel the vine-rhythm as my friends drive the beast to me. I will not miss my mark."

name: Gustrider Exuberant
text: "The elves claim the canopy. The nacatl claim the mountains. I suppose you think we ought to stay on the jungle floor?"

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Godtoucher
text: "Gargantuans die not in moments but in moons. There is still time to aid this noble ancient."

name: Jungle Weaver
text: Weavers' webs wall off swaths of territory more effectively than any portcullis made of iron.

name: Keeper of Progenitus
text: He watches over the valley where Progenitus sleeps, culling signs from its steaming breaths.

name: Lush Growth
text: Naya's bounty spills over upon itself. Each leaf and flower struggles against the next with thrashing thorns, acidic pollen, and strangling roots.

name: Mighty Emergence
text: Why settle for mere enormity?

name: Manaplasm
text: Urak froze when he heard it. That was his first mistake. He turned and cast a dramatic ward spell. That was his last.

name: Mosstodon
text: Whether gargantuans are the manifested will of Progenitus or simply the result of overabundant resources is moot when a herd of them is thundering at you.

name: Invincible Hymn
text: Bantians believe those who are born into the highest caste and live a life of discipline and virtue can ascend to become angels.

name: Naturalize
text: The idols of old are rich in minerals and magic. They are torn apart when nature aims to eat well.

name: Naya Battlemage
text: "I have trained in all three schools of magic."

name: Ooze Garden
text: Jund has little necromancy. Instead, the flesh of its dead gives rise to algal fiends.

name: Rhox Charger
text: "Momentum is a great ally."

name: Sacellum Godspeaker
text: Her connection to the gargantuans puts her in line to become Anima, a sacred but daunting duty.

name: Soul's Might
text: An avatar he sculpts of instinct and force.

name: Knight of the Skyward Eye
text: The Order of the Skyward Eye does the bidding of an evil force, unwittingly stirring fear and mistrust across Bant in accordance with his plans.

name: Spearbreaker Behemoth
text: Few Nayans dare hunt the gargantuans. They're regarded not as animals but as forces of nature, like landslides or typhoons.

name: Topan Ascetic
text: Monks from Topa wander all of Bant, encouraging the Unbeholden to find their place in society through honorable combat.

name: Wild Nacatl
text: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Bant Charm
text: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

name: Blightning
text: While the smell of burning flesh is common in Grixis, the odor of smoldering brain matter is a rare treat.

name: Blood Cultist
text: "To immortality."

name: Branching Bolt
text:
"Lightning lives in everything, in living flesh and growing things. It must be set free."
—Rakka Mar

name: Brilliant Ultimatum
text: Revealing the truth only deepened Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.

name: Knight of the White Orchid
text: Both guide and guard on open plain.

name: Broodmate Dragon
text: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter—and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

name: Bull Cerodon
text: It holds motionless vigil, watching Naya in silence through the screen of the whitecover. When it senses anything amiss, it launches forward with the uncanny sound of torn fog.

name: Carrion Thrash
text: Viashino hunt in gangs called thrashes. Not all thrashes hunt the freshest game.

name: Clarion Ultimatum
text: Be worthy of a single blessing, and many more will follow.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Deft Duelist
text: Some Serul Cove rogues traffic in stolen sigils, which fetch a high price from those who would rather pay for honor than earn it.

name: Empyrial Archangel
text: Her wings are the prayers of the devoted; her sword, the despair of the vile.

name: Esper Charm
text:
"Thoughts are commodities. Someone will pay a good price for them. Even ones as simplistic as yours . . ."
—Ennor, mentalist

name: Goblin Deathraiders
text: Every once in a while, when they aren't getting incinerated in lava, crushed under rock slides, or devoured by dragons, goblins experience moments of unmitigated glory in battle.

name: Knight-Captain of Eos
text: The strength of Bant's caste system is the unfailing loyalty of its meekest members.

name: Godsire
text:
"Lay sacrifice to the godsire that it may spare us, but save some for his progeny who also will hunger."
—Syeena, elvish godtoucher

name: Grixis Charm
text:
"So many choices. Shall I choose loathing, hate, or malice today?"
—Eliza of the Keep

name: Hellkite Overlord
text:
"The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization—just hunger, heat, and need."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Hindering Light
text: Centuries of careful practice have elevated the casting of protective spells to an art form. What little offensive magic remains on Bant stands little chance of breaching them.

name: Jhessian Infiltrator
text: The Jhessian navy makes successful raids on Valeron's coastal towns thanks to their spies planted during peacetime.

name: Jund Charm
text: Jund pulses with raw energy, waiting for shamans to shape it into useful form.

name: Kederekt Creeper
text: Bloated with venom, it crawls Grixis looking for victims to ooze onto.

name: Kiss of the Amesha
text: Once a year, Akrasa holds a joust that draws knights and their leotaus from every nation on Bant. The prize is an Akrasan sigil, but the true reward is the angel's kiss.

name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
text: Each of his twenty-two braids is bound with bone and leather from a foe.

name: Mayael the Anima
text: The sacred Anima's eyes are blind to all but the grandest truths.

name: Marble Chalice
text: The cup was a gift from the sphinx Tameron, who hoped that those who drank from it would live long enough to decrypt the sphinxes' wisdom.

name: Naya Charm
text: Deep in nature's core lies a potential unsullied by greed or civilization.

name: Necrogenesis
text:
"Those may be the squirms of one life ending or of another beginning. Either way, I'd leave it alone."
—Rakka Mar

name: Prince of Thralls
text: "There are none alive that I cannot crush. There are none dead that I do not command."

name: Punish Ignorance
text:
"Amateurish. Nearsighted. A waste of my time and everyone else's."
—Indra, nullmage of Vectis

name: Qasali Ambusher
text: The surprise of a battle cry can be as deadly as a blade.

name: Rafiq of the Many
text: Many sigils, one purpose.

name: Rakeclaw Gargantuan
text: Naya teems with gargantuans, titanic monsters to whom both nature and civilization defer.

name: Realm Razer
text: The behemoth roared, and the world was blasted free of empires and tyrants.

name: Rhox War Monk
text: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

name: Rip-Clan Crasher
text: If you breathe, she will fight you. If you breathe fire, she must fight you.

name: Metallurgeon
text: "By the time I got there, the heart had stopped. Fortunately, I was able to replace it with something better."

name: Sangrite Surge
text: Some believe the spiky crystal called sangrite is concentrated dragon's breath. Others think it's crystallized life energy. The clans care only about the power it unleashes when crushed.

name: Sedris, the Traitor King
text: He bids his minions rise from their graves to their knees.

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Sigil Blessing
text: "For unwavering commitment and unflinching strength, the Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil. Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty."

name: Sphinx Sovereign
text: "What rises without legs, whispers without a voice, bites without teeth, and dies without having life?"

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Steward of Valeron
text: Knight-stewards guard the Sun-Dappled Court, a grove of immense, sculptured olive trees that represent Valeron's twelve noble families.

name: Stoic Angel
text: Even the most battle-hardened soldiers pause in her presence for a moment of introspection.

name: Angel's Herald
text: Rigorous faith and belief are rewarded on occasion, and richly so.

name: Oblivion Ring
text: A circle of light and a word of confinement.

name: Swerve
text:
"We can't beat the necromancers in numbers or raw power. We must beat them with ingenuity and timing."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Thoughtcutter Agent
text: Agents of the Architects of Will mark their victims as a reminder that their secrets are secret no longer.

name: Tidehollow Strix
text: The scullers beneath Esper keep strixes as trained pets, and set them loose when a fare refuses to pay.

name: Titanic Ultimatum
text:
"Retribution is best delivered by claws and rage, with both magnified."
—Ajani

name: Tower Gargoyle
text:
"Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance."
—Tezzeret

name: Violent Ultimatum
text:
"Words are a waste of time. Destruction is a language everyone understands."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Waveskimmer Aven
text: The greatest gift you can give a sea aven is solitude.

name: Windwright Mage
text: She knows the names and secrets of each of Esper's twenty-three winds.

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Ranger of Eos
text: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

name: Lich's Mirror
text: It shows not what you are but what you were.

name: Minion Reflector
text: To crack a mirror is to provide an opening for the reflection to escape.

name: Obelisk of Bant
text: Whether incorporated into the structure of castles or admired as lone symbols, the obelisks stand for Bant's values of loyalty, honor, and truth.

name: Obelisk of Esper
text: It is a monument as austere, unyielding, and inscrutable as Esper itself.

name: Obelisk of Grixis
text: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

name: Obelisk of Jund
text: Volcanic ash-winds batter it, climbing vines overwhelm it, dragonfire roasts it, and yet it still stands as a testament to a forgotten world.

name: Obelisk of Naya
text: Centuries have passed since the plane shattered, yet the obelisks of each shard faithfully serve their long-forgotten purpose.

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Esper Panorama
text: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

name: Grixis Panorama
text: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

name: Jund Panorama
text: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Naya Panorama
text: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Rockcaster Platoon
text:
"Aven bandits can be sly. You've got to fill the sky with boulders—and then seek cover immediately."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Scourglass
text:
"Soon I will sleep, eyes closing to a world tarnished with flesh, and then wake to a polished vision."
—Sharuum

name: Sigiled Paladin
text: Each sigil marks the recognition of a great deed and signifies a duty owed to the one who granted it.

name: Soul's Grace
text: An avatar he sculpts of fellowship and light.

name: Sunseed Nurturer
text: Sunseeders quest for areas of open sky. They train plowbeasts to beat back the dense jungle long enough to cultivate a crop.

name: Angelic Benediction
text:
"Even in single combat, I am never alone."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Welkin Guide
text:
"Those talons really dig into your skin, but it's better than being dropped."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Yoked Plowbeast
text:
"It is sacrilege to confine a gargantuan to the grinding of straight lines. I will pray that it remembers who is the master of this land."
—Syeena, elvish godtoucher

name: Call to Heel
text: On Bant, a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty. The one who bears it may be called to fulfill that charge at any moment.

name: Cancel
text: "What you are attempting is not against the law. It is, however, extremely foolish."

name: Cathartic Adept
text: "Forget. Only then will there be space for hope between the pain and fear."

name: Cloudheath Drake
text: A permanent storm rages over the plain of Cloudheath, and drakes ride its currents—two reminders that some elements of Esper will not be controlled.

name: Coma Veil
text: Etherium does not know sleep. Only magic can teach it the resting state of cold steel.

name: Courier's Capsule
text: In ages past, Esper couriers bore messages written on ornate scrolls. The medium has grown more sophisticated, but the principle remains the same.

name: Covenant of Minds
text: Before signing anything on Grixis, always read the fine print.

name: Dawnray Archer
text: Their shots are fired most often as signals—or at those who didn't get the message.

name: Angelsong
text: Clash of sword and cry of beast fall mute when angels sound the call to prayer.

name: Esper Battlemage
text: She can heal the flesh, or exploit its many weaknesses.

name: Etherium Astrolabe
text:
"Speculation is foolish when the tools of certainty are available."
—Cinna, vedalken consul

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Filigree Sages
text: "We of the Sanctum Arcanum have pondered every word on every page of the Filigree Texts. If you can't say the same, don't bother speaking."

name: Gather Specimens
text:
"It's free to do whatever it wants. I've merely told it what that is."
—Xorin, Architect of Will

name: Jhessian Lookout
text: She stands ready, always watchful, knowing that weeks of peace and serenity can be overturned by a single distant sail.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Bant Battlemage
text: "A night attack will be easy. We'll make an air raid over the Akrasan border. Just get me some flint to light the war torches."

name: Memory Erosion
text:
"The Filigree Texts do not compel you to act in accordance with their precepts. They only specify the consequences should you fail."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Mindlock Orb
text: Rogue mechanists once rummaged through the wastes of the Tidehollow, constructing unauthorized golems to threaten the hegemony of the sphinxes. The orbs put a stop to that.

name: Outrider of Jhess
text: The island nation of Jhess is under constant siege from Valeron on the mainland. Riders traverse the coastline, always on the lookout for sails or aven.

name: Protomatter Powder
text:
"There is no such thing as scrap metal. All such material can be repaired with the proper bonding agent."
—Quennus, metallurgeon

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Spell Snip
text:
"Magic cast through a hand of flesh is just as weak as the flesh itself."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Sphinx's Herald
text: He calls a riddle through the gaps of cloven clouds, hoping for an answer.

name: Steelclad Serpent
text:
"From the highest towers to the deepest sea, all life must be touched by etherium."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Tortoise Formation
text: At sea, the Jhessian fleet strikes swiftly and decisively. On land, facing the elite cavalry of Valeron, its marines must rely on more cautious strategies.

name: Vectis Silencers
text: Even on Esper, there are those who eschew the use of magic in favor of simpler methods.

name: Ad Nauseam
text: When the task spilled over into undeath, he stopped calling it his life's work.

name: Archdemon of Unx
text: The necropolis at Unx was once a living city, its streets untrodden by death.

name: Banewasp Affliction
text: The consuming undeath of Grixis terrifies the survivors of Vithia, but its fauna is just as fearsome.

name: Blister Beetle
text: Warriors of the Rip Clan wear their beetle-acid scars proudly, even modifying clothing and armor to better display the trophy.

name: Bone Splinters
text: Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy. For now, they must harvest vis from the living to fuel their dark magics.

name: Cunning Lethemancer
text: "Give me your memories, and you will have release from the suffering they bring you."

name: Cradle of Vitality
text: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Deathgreeter
text: "The bones of allies grant wisdom. The bones of enemies grant strength. The bones of dragons grant life eternal."

name: Demon's Herald
text: "May these deaths be the first of many."

name: Dreg Reaver
text:
"On our thirty-fourth day of digging, we unearthed a chamber that contained the intact remains of several species long extinct from Grixis. One in particular should make a fine siege engine . . . ."
—Last notes of Shungus Nod, fleshcrafter

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Glaze Fiend
text: Before the zealots of the Ethersworn came to power, Esper illusionists dreamed up creations to mimic a variety of substances.

name: Grixis Battlemage
text: Vitals of Grixis who eschew undeath must scrape and scratch to retain their mortality. The result is a breed of inventive mages.

name: Dispeller's Capsule
text:
"I find its symmetry pleasing. It rids our world of offensive refuse while disposing of itself."
—Dolomarus, Proctor of the Clean

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Onyx Goblet
text: The goblet was a gift from the sphinx Gorael, who hoped humans and vedalken would eventually destroy each other to acquire it, leaving all of Esper to her own kind.

name: Puppet Conjurer
text: He scowls at his imperfect creation, then crushes it to scrap. He salvages the etherium and begins anew.

name: Scavenger Drake
text: Dragons consider drakes to be mockeries of their perfection, destroying them on sight.

name: Shadowfeed
text:
"The future is a snake, devouring your life backwards through time. And when you die, believe me, it doesn't stop feeding."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

name: Shore Snapper
text: Kathari, the sickly aven of Grixis, have learned that the corpses by the shoreline are more trap than treat.

name: Skeletal Kathari
text: Undeath doesn't end the kathari's search for carrion; it only removes one corpse from the Dregscape.

name: Bloodpyre Elemental
text: Elementals born of Jund are as cruel and unstable as the plane itself.

name: Bloodthorn Taunter
text: Naya's celebrants stoke the gargantuans into a rage, loosing a tide of muscle with the precision of an arrow.

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Dragon's Herald
text: The penultimate step of the ritual involves bathing in a delicious glaze.

name: Exuberant Firestoker
text: The artistry of Etlan's firedancers is more spectacular when behemoths join in.

name: Taste of Paradise
text:
"Any who drink of Freyalise's bounty drink the mead of rebirth."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Taste of Paradise
text:
"There is, in each of us, the potential to heal and the gift of renewed life."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Undergrowth
text:
"It is the work of sorcery. Burn it!"
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Undergrowth
text:
"The art of war is turning obstacle to advantage."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Yavimaya Ancients
text:
"The Ancients teach us that if we can but last, we shall prevail."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Yavimaya Ancients
text:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Yavimaya Ants
text:
"Few natural forces are as devastating as hunger."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Energy Arc
text:
"Relent, and you may transcend your situation."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Martyrdom
text:
"Martyrs are cheaper than mercenaries, and a far better investment."
—General Varchild

name: Martyrdom
text:
"The only true immortality is in dying for a cause."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Nature's Blessing
text:
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Aesthir Glider
text:
"Sacrilege! A noble ally in life, made nothing more than a glorified kite in death!"
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Aesthir Glider
text:
"A fine example of the rewards of artifice: a thoroughly obedient steed with wings of Soldevi steel."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Ashnod's Cylix
text: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

name: Floodwater Dam
text: Viscerid dams may be of living creatures as well as bones and mud.

name: Noble Steeds
text:
"Only an animal born in the wild has sufficient heart to be a true Knight's steed."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Noble Steeds
text:
"They are fighters as fine as any Knight they carry."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Mishra's Groundbreaker
text: The very ground yielded to Mishra's wishes.

name: Mystic Compass
text:
"And *I* say north is where I *want* it to be!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Phyrexian War Beast
text:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Phyrexian War Beast
text:
"Knowing its origins, how could they have thought they could control it?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Shield Sphere
text:
"My Soldiers know that they need never fear for their protection."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Reinforcements
text:
"We aided the Balduvians once before. They need but ask and we shall do so again."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Reinforcements
text:
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."
—General Varchild

name: Sol Grail
text:
"Look deep into the Grail, and see there what you desire most."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Soldevi Digger
text:
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Soldevi Sentry
text:
"A dreadful invention. What ease is there under the watchful eye of cold steel?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Sentry
text:
"Our newfound security enables us to turn more of our attentions to the wonders that lie deep within the soil."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Soldevi Steam Beast
text:
"Dagsson saw the steam as life-giving—until his followers felt its scalding touch."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Steam Beast
text:
"Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Urza's Engine
text:
"Humans and machines working together can be fearsome indeed!"
—Arcum Dagsson

name: Whirling Catapult
text:
"Direct confrontation never was to the Orcs' taste."
—General Varchild

name: Reprisal
text:
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Reprisal
text:
"Kjeldor's borders are secure, and its citizens are prepared to take up arms in defense of their families."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: School of the Unseen
text: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.

name: Royal Herbalist
text:
"Just as an Herbalist heals a wound, so must we heal the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Royal Herbalist
text:
"It's not so easy anymore. Nothing grows in Kjeldor but seaweed."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Seasoned Tactician
text:
"The benefits of peace far outweigh the pride of Generals."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Sustaining Spirit
text:
"Faith is our greatest protector."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Carrier Pigeons
text:
"Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"
—General Varchild, in a missive to King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Carrier Pigeons
text:
"It's true I ask no fealty of the flocks—but surely we are more than mere beasts."
—King Darien of Kjeldor, in a missive to General Varchild

name: Unlikely Alliance
text:
"Strange alliances are alliances still, and provide the same protection."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Wild Aesthir
text:
"High in the Karplusans, death is swift and razor-clawed."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Wild Aesthir
text:
"What Barbarian secrets do they spy from their lofty perch?"
—General Varchild

name: Awesome Presence
text: "At the core of all power is raw passion." —Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Awesome Presence
text:
"I shape my weapons from the fears of my enemies."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Benthic Explorers
text: The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare. The Explorers found their ancient enemies spawning everywhere.

name: Benthic Explorers
text: Distant Atlantis charged these Explorers with the task of venturing into unknown waters to track the despised Viscerids.

name: Browse
text:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: False Demise
text:
"Far too many of our missing 'dead' seem to be turning up in Varchild's ranks!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: False Demise
text:
"Fool! Never believe they're dead until you see the body!"
—General Varchild

name: Errand of Duty
text:
"Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Errand of Duty
text:
"May they speed to their task, for the Skyknights alone cannot hold Kjeldor safe."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
text:
"Lat-Nam has bequeathed us its secrets. With them we shall attain true enlightenment."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
text:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Soldevi Heretic
text:
"In the arms of tragedy, there is little comfort in being right."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Heretic
text:
"It cannot be! Soldev crushed, and my machines to blame?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Soldevi Sage
text:
"To hide the truth is more than folly—it is fatal."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Sage
text:
"Our underground archives grow daily, as our excavators and sages alike dig to uncover hidden wonders."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Storm Crow
text:
"It tells you that the worst is coming. Do you listen?"
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Storm Crow
text:
"Watch for it! Right on its tailfeathers will be a storm from your nightmares."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Inheritance
text:
"More than lessons may be gained from the past."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Viscerid Armor
text: A fallen Viscerid's only tribute is to be worn by a comrade.

name: Viscerid Armor
text: One Viscerid's death is often another's gain.

name: Viscerid Drone
text: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .

name: Casting of Bones
text:
"Whether whole or not, still we serve Lim-Dûl's wishes."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Casting of Bones
text:
"Only a necromancer would create such a foul form of divination."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Fatal Lore
text:
"All knowledge has its price."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Feast or Famine
text:
"We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Feast or Famine
text:
"The living cannot understand the benefits of death."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Fevered Strength
text:
"The burst of strength brought on by this plague should not be mistaken for a sign of renewed health."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

name: Fevered Strength
text:
"The fever clouds the mind as it energizes the body. Both will pass in time."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
text:
"The Guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
text:
"Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Misinformation
text:
"When you cannot rely on your sources, trust your own senses. When you cannot trust those, you must follow your instincts."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Phyrexian Boon
text:
"Phyrexia's touch is painful to all but the blackest of hearts."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Phyrexian Boon
text:
"Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Ritual of the Machine
text:
"Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Juniper Order Advocate
text:
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Soldevi Adnate
text:
"People love to follow fools; they don't feel so alone then."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Adnate
text:
"An idiot cannot hear sense, even when a thousand people speak it."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Stench of Decay
text:
"Disa is dead, and I am left. I shall allow no others to succumb to this pestilence."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

name: Stench of Decay
text:
"My lord, there is only so much I can do. This plague infests Krov worse than any other city."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Agent of Stromgald
text:
"The Order of Stromgald spreads its poisonous lies from within Varchild's troops, and still she sees only visions of conquest."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Agent of Stromgald
text:
"The 'fabled' Order of Stromgald is cast to the four winds, lost for all time. I, for one, give them no thought."
—General Varchild

name: Balduvian Horde
text:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Balduvian War-Makers
text:
"Those mewling Barbarians will cower before my righteous steel!"
—General Varchild

name: Balduvian War-Makers
text:
"We send our best to battle, but every man, woman, and child will stand against Varchild's butchers."
