—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Burnout
text:
"GOTCHA!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Enslaved Scout
text:
"Her soldiers' hatred for the Goblins is tempered only by their need for what the Goblins alone hold: knowledge of their mountain home."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Enslaved Scout
text:
"Even the basest creatures may serve a purpose. Still, their lives need be only as long as the paths we tread."
—General Varchild

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Each generation teaches the next that artifice is the enemy of natural order."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Gorilla War Cry
text:
"The only 'art' these beasts possess is the art of noise!"
—Jaya Ballard

name: Gorilla War Cry
text:
"Theirs is the art of blood."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Omen of Fire
text:
"Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!"
—General Varchild

name: Pillage
text:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Pyrokinesis
text:
"Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Kjeldoran Escort
text:
"We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Kjeldoran Escort
text:
"The first caravan has passed safely through the Karplusan Mountains without incident, forging a trade route to Balduvia. Kjeld himself would never have believed it!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Soldier of Fortune
text:
"Loyalty to coin alone is loyalty nonetheless."
—General Varchild

name: Storm Shaman
text:
"Let the lightning be your warning, and the thunder your battle cry."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Storm Shaman
text:
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!"
—Lovisa Coldeyes,
Balduvian Chieftain

name: Varchild's Crusader
text:
"We could have peace, but Varchild would rather have the maps of the new Kjeldor drawn in Balduvian blood."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Varchild's Crusader
text:
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!"
—General Varchild

name: Varchild's War-Riders
text:
"What tries to crush our spirit only strengthens our resolve."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Veteran's Voice
text:
"Good soldiers rely first upon their training, then upon their instincts."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Veteran's Voice
text:
"Teach by example. If your students do not survive, they were not worth the lesson."
—General Varchild

name: Deadly Insect
text:
"Beautiful, indeed—but one sting could fell a Giant in a heartbeat."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Deadly Insect
text:
"There is no time for pain when this beast leaves its terrible sting."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Elvish Ranger
text:
"No one may fault an Elvish Ranger's heart, but the simplest frailty may fell even the proudest warrior."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Elvish Ranger
text:
"How can any Human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Elvish Spirit Guide
text:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Fyndhorn Druid
text:
"All struggles ultimately require sacrifice. It's just that some sacrifices are dearer than others."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Fyndhorn Druid
text:
"Honor those who honor Fyndhorn above themselves."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

name: Gorilla Berserkers
text:
"Their fury is their greatest weapon."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Gorilla Berserkers
text:
"Beneath serenity may lie a hidden rage."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

name: Gorilla Chieftain
text:
"Oh, no—not *you* again?!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Gorilla Chieftain
text:
"In the soil of leadership sprout the seeds of immortality."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Hail Storm
text:
"If they can't take the hail, they'd better stay home."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

name: Kaysa
text: Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

name: Angelfire Crusader
text: Nothing burns hotter than the fires of holy rage.

name: Gaea's Skyfolk
text: The grace of the forest and the spirit of the sea.

name: Gerrard's Verdict
text: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

name: Goblin Trenches
text: The ground rose and formed into thousands of tiny warriors. This fight was far from over.

name: Jungle Barrier
text: A massive pull of mana caused all of Dominaria to pause—Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

name: Llanowar Dead
text: Just as leaves fall from the branches of a living tree, so too do the dead leave the elfhame.

name: Martyrs' Tomb
text:
Honor the brave who fought,
Honor the dead who fell,
Honor the world they saved.
—Memorial inscription

name: Mystic Snake
text: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

name: Overgrown Estate
text: The decay of Crovax's ancestral home matched the state of his soul.

name: Pernicious Deed
text: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

name: Powerstone Minefield
text:
"We have fought this far and lost too much. We will not turn back."
—Grizzlegom

name: Putrid Warrior
text: "I do not like it," said Grizzlegom, "but I will take every soldier I can get."

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Razorfin Hunter
text: No one knew if they'd been lurking under the sea all along, or if they'd been created by the Phyrexian overlay.

name: Soul Link
text: They danced like puppets to a tune only Yawgmoth could hear.

name: Temporal Spring
text: One splash of the spring's water knocks you clear into last week.

name: Vindicate
text:
"Don't mourn for me. This is my destiny."
—Gerrard

name: Helionaut
text: Hope kept the defenders aloft, but only courage kept them in the fight.

name: Dragon Arch
text: In their hunger for the arch's power, mages often forget that it only makes dragons easier to summon. It doesn't make them easier to control.

name: Shield of Duty and Reason
text: The duty: to defend. The reason: to survive.

name: Spectral Lynx
text: A shadowy version of its corporeal cousin, this lynx hunts souls, not meals.

name: Standard Bearer
text: The standard was a rallying point for the army and a target for the enemy.

name: Ceta Disciple
text: "The sea holds all that you need. You simply must know how to ask for it."

name: Coastal Drake
text: When the kavu emerged from their ancient nests, food chains long dormant became vibrant again.

name: Evasive Action
text: Effective use of terrain is a lesson good commanders learn quickly.

name: Ice Cave
text: Even the oppressive cold of the cave could not temper Eladamri's ire.

name: Index
text: "Let's see . . . Mercadia, mercenary, merfolk . . . you know, I really need a better filing system."

name: Jaded Response
text:
"Calm down everyone; it's nothing we haven't seen before."
—Sisay

name: Jilt
text:
"You're not my Hanna!"
—Gerrard, to Yawgmoth

name: Living Airship
text: The ship has a crew of three: the pilot, the gunner, and the ship itself.

name: Reef Shaman
text: With one gesture, she can render a thousand years of navigational charts obsolete.

name: Coalition Honor Guard
text: Giving little thought to their own defense, they carried the flag that united their army.

name: Shimmering Mirage
text:
"Oh, is *that* all you need? Why didn't you just say so?"
—Reef shaman

name: Unnatural Selection
text: What nature makes, magic can modify.

name: Vodalian Mystic
text:
"Sometimes when I look at the ocean, I could swear it changes colors."
—Sisay

name: Whirlpool Rider
text: Where the wind meets the water, change is inevitable.

name: Dead Ringers
text: "Beautiful, isn't it?" crowed Crovax. "They fought together. Now they will die together."

name: Foul Presence
text: The Phyrexians have one word that means both "evolution" and "pain."

name: Dega Disciple
text: "There is no true equity of power. There is only more and less."

name: Mournful Zombie
text: Treated with a powerful mix of herbs and potions, its wrappings have a remarkable preservative effect, even for the living.

name: Necra Disciple
text: "The darkness merely hides the light."

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: An audience of one with the malice of thousands.

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Planar Despair
text: All of Dominaria recoiled as Yawgmoth and his retainers arrived.

name: Quagmire Druid
text: As the druids had devoted their lives to preserving Dominaria, so did they devote their deaths.

name: Urborg Uprising
text: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

name: Zombie Boa
text: It doesn't need to feed, but still it hungers.

name: Bloodfire Colossus
text: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

name: Bloodfire Dwarf
text: For them, the only honorable death is one that leaves a crater.

name: Bloodfire Kavu
text: Heart of fire, blood of lava, teeth of stone.

name: Dwarven Patrol
text: Dwarves never worry about who watches their backs.

name: Raka Disciple
text: "The strong can also be subtle."

name: Smash
text:
"They're ugly, and they're in my way."
—Tahngarth

name: Diversionary Tactics
text: "It's the oldest trick in the book," said Guff. "And I ought to know—I wrote it."

name: Tundra Kavu
text: A cross between a jaguar and an armadillo.

name: Ana Disciple
text: "The blessings of Gaea alone are no longer enough."

name: Bog Gnarr
text: Not all of Dominaria's defenders were nourished by the light.

name: Glade Gnarr
text: Long thought merely a legend, the appearance of the gnarr was seen by the defenders as a sign of good luck.

name: Divine Light
text:
"Phyrexia is an unforgiving place, and I am an angry lord in an unforgiving mood."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Kavu Mauler
text: To the kavu, all Phyrexians are merely crunchy snacks.

name: Lay of the Land
text: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

name: Penumbra Bobcat
text: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

name: Penumbra Kavu
text:
"These kavu are so stubborn they even refuse to die."
—Tahngarth

name: Savage Gorilla
text: These omnivorous gorillas have no qualms about a diet composed of equal parts fruit and Phyrexians.

name: Symbiotic Deployment
text:
"You know your orders. I know your hearts. Now the stronghold will know defeat."
—Eladamri

name: Tranquil Path
text: Freyalise bought the planeswalkers the time they needed by clearing a path through the misshapen hell of Phyrexia.

name: Urborg Elf
text: The elves of Urborg are as deadly and capricious as the swamp itself.

name: Captain's Maneuver
text: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

name: Consume Strength
text: As Multani's troops invaded Urborg, the decay of the swamp became a feast for the living.

name: Death Grasp
text: Yawgmoth's greatest joy came from watching one hero defeat another.

name: Ebony Treefolk
text: Its roots are equally happy to drink the water of a clear stream or the oily blood of a Phyrexian warrior.

name: Fervent Charge
text: Crovax was nearly buried beneath the weight of his opponents.

name: Flowstone Charger
text: A mane of flowstone and a mien of fury.

name: Stun Sniper
text: The tips of her bolts are blunt, but her aim is deadly sharp.

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Nulltread Gargantuan
text: It crushes all underfoot, yet leaves no trace of its passage—no trampled debris, no flattened souls, not even a hoofprint.

name: Sages of the Anima
text: Godtrackers found new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.

name: Vedalken Heretic
text: "Etherium clouded my eyes, clogged my ears, desensitized my skin. Now that I can feel, I can begin to learn."

name: Winged Coatl
text: The nacatl called this new species "vetli," their word for poison arrows.

name: Esper Sojourners
text: The wilder the frontier, the greater the need for a controlling hand.

name: Etherwrought Page
text: An unbound page is a riddle, free of cover and of context, a favorite token of the hegemon.

name: Sen Triplets
text: They are the masters of your mind.

name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
text: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

name: Drastic Revelation
text: Every disaster holds mystery, for lack of a sane witness.

name: Thraximundar
text: His name means "he who paints the earth red."

name: Dragon Appeasement
text:
"Look there—they carry that one upon a sedan chair. It must be their leader. Wait . . . Oh! Perhaps not."
—Kaeda, aven scout

name: Lavalanche
text: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

name: Madrush Cyclops
text: Death comes in the blink of an eye.

name: Gloryscale Viashino
text:
"This is a new world and a new war. We need warriors who know chaos and how to combat it."
—Lisha of the Azure

name: Naya Sojourners
text: The elves had entered a land like an open grave—an act of fortitude or folly?

name: Retaliator Griffin
text: For every eye, an eye. For every tooth, a tooth. Griffins are nothing if not fair.

name: Uril, the Miststalker
text: It strides through the whitecover, mists in which even gargantuans can hide.

name: Bant Sojourners
text: "We must spread Bant's light before we are shadowed over."

name: Flurry of Wings
text: "We are born soldiers. The call to battle is a homecoming."

name: Jenara, Asura of War
text: Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

name: Wargate
text: Bant mages still call to the heavens for aid, but angels are not the only ones who answer.

name: Esper Stormblade
text: Stormcallers came to appreciate the novelty of Jund's volcanic updrafts.

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Sewn-Eye Drake
text:
"Too wary to charge, too prudent to serve. Not anymore."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Giant Ambush Beetle
text: It waits with absolute stillness. One might think it a statue if it weren't occasionally seen chewing on its victims.

name: Jund Hackblade
text: The knights were halfway through their precombat rites before they realized the foul brute meant to start without them.

name: Sangrite Backlash
text:
"Sangrite is the dragon's beating heart. Little wonder, then, that so many fools' chests burst trying to contain it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Talon Trooper
text: "The volcanic winds make a maze of the skies of Jund. If we mean to invade, we must first learn their invisible paths."

name: Marisi's Twinclaws
text:
"Looks like we're completely outnumbered."
"Lucky for us. I thought we'd be bored."

name: Bant Sureblade
text: Soldiers who fought through Grixis learned to hit first, recite the prayer of Asha later.

name: Messenger Falcons
text: So many aven had died scouting the distant fronts that the knight-captains recruited Nayan falcons as couriers.

name: Unbender Tine
text: Creations made in madness may contain great power. The path to that power is as labyrinthine as the creator's mind.

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Architects of Will
text: This secret society of mages manipulates the beliefs and opinions of others.

name: Brainbite
text: An Esper mage will leave a hole in your memory with surgical precision. A Grixis mage sees no reason to be so kind.

name: Aven Mimeomancer
text: "If the skies are our only refuge, I will see all of us take wing."

name: Etherium Abomination
text: It was given life by the etherium of a hundred slain Esperites.

name: Illusory Demon
text: In the Maelstrom, a trick of the light can feast on human flesh.

name: Mind Funeral
text:
"The soul is only as eternal as I say it is."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Nemesis of Reason
text: Words describing it fail. Pages relating it shrivel. Tales recounting it end.

name: Soul Manipulation
text:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Ethercaste Knight
text: "We coat ourselves in steel every day. What is etherium but the next logical step?"

name: Soulquake
text: The Maelstrom sent a wave of raw mana through the battlefield, carrying off the fighting and fallen alike.

name: Time Sieve
text:
"I pray that I am never considered useless or old."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Vedalken Ghoul
text: For four nights following Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients were found slain, the etherium ripped from their bodies.

name: Breath of Malfegor
text: The blood of the demons quickened as their master rose over the battlefield. The blood of the angels also quickened: here was the chance to finally end the war started millennia ago.

name: Defiler of Souls
text:
"Stray not into sin, lest you face the doorman of an insatiable tomb."
—Prayer of Asha

name: Demonspine Whip
text: Using a spine to break a slave's back appeals to the Grixis sense of irony.

name: Ethersworn Shieldmage
text: "See, children of metal? Already your bodies are rejecting harm. Continue on our path, and perfection will be yours."

name: Monstrous Carabid
text: What happens when a plane of predators collides with four planes of prey?

name: Sanity Gnawers
text: The last thought to go through their victim's mind is the one they tear out through the scalp.

name: Singe-Mind Ogre
text: Even the balmgivers of Bant couldn't heal the incurables, but sharing their torment helped.

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Blitz Hellion
text: Alarans commemorated its appearances with new holidays bearing names like the Great Cataclysm and the Fall of Ilson Gate.

name: Colossal Might
text:
"Never corner a barbarian. You become the path of least resistance."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Deadshot Minotaur
text: "May the earth rise up to meet you."

name: Godtracker of Jund
text: "The behemoths are content to graze like cattle, while dragons rage and conquer. I know which example I'll follow."

name: Gorger Wurm
text: In war-torn Alara, sometimes a wurm's gullet is the safest place to be.

name: Mage Slayer
text:
"When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do."
—Kresh the Bloodbraided

name: Predatory Advantage
text: Those who forget their past are doomed to be eaten by it.

name: Rhox Brute
text:
"In this new world, I have seen the once-devout rhoxes take up arms with the savages of Jund. I would be offended, but I see the wisdom in their choice."
—Gernan, Dawnray archer

name: Filigree Angel
text: "I craved enlightenment, and Crucius's etherium opened my eyes. I would share my sight with you, but first you must believe."

name: Spellbreaker Behemoth
text:
"Some think its immunity to countermagic evolved because of the constant mage attacks on Naya. I think it just ate a bunch of wizards."
—Broka, drumhunter

name: Vithian Renegades
text: "Here is the proof that what has been done may yet be undone. The hope we thought dead will be gloriously reborn."

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

name: Dauntless Escort
text: Elspeth's squires do not seek advancement. For them, no knightly glory could surpass the glory of serving their champion.

name: Enlisted Wurm
text: A match for any army—even its own.

name: Grizzled Leotau
text:
"There is no glory in a death of age, as even the leotau know. As winter steals into their coats, they seek the deadliest lands, that they may die as they lived."
—Aarsil the Blessed

name: Knight of New Alara
text: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

name: Knotvine Paladin
text:
"He is part of a new breed of guardian, one who embraces the best of both his world and ours."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Leonin Armorguard
text: Well suited are the nacatl to a coat of steel and forge-tempered claws.

name: Mycoid Shepherd
text: As pure mana flooded across the shards, it brought a sense of unity even to Jund's vicious food chain.

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Reborn Hope
text:
"In darkness is kindled the fiercest hope."
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Sigil Captain
text: "One sigil awarded for valor, the other awarded for surviving Hellkite's Pass."

name: Sigil of the Nayan Gods
text: As the elves learned the hymns of angels, the knights learned the roars of titans.

name: Sigiled Behemoth
text:
"Do not mistake a behemoth's assistance for subservience."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Meddling Mage
text: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."

name: Identity Crisis
text:
"To join our ranks, one must be pure. To be pure, one must be blessed by etherium. To be blessed, one must forget oneself."
—Ethersworn prayer

name: Tainted Sigil
text: Sigils corrupted by outsiders do not lose their power, only their purity.

name: Vectis Dominator
text:
"I appreciate the artistry of the telemins, but the creatures of the other worlds provide a much more dramatic performance."
—Ennor, mentalist

name: Zealous Persecution
text:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

name: Cloven Casting
text: "Let us flee to the deep jungle. Our city is no longer safe—and I suspect neither is the fallback retreat."

name: Double Negative
text: They feared each other for their differences but were absolutely terrified at their similarities.

name: Magefire Wings
text: Giving a thing wings does not take away its fear of flight—or its fear of fire, for that matter.

name: Skyclaw Thrash
text: Their newfound wings shined elegantly and functioned partially.

name: Offering to Asha
text:
"His body belongs to Bant now. His soul? I honestly don't know. I expect it belongs to the angels."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Spellbound Dragon
text: A king in Jund, a serf in Esper.

name: Lord of Extinction
text: The forlorn cries of the dead combine to make its laugh.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Morbid Bloom
text:
"From the damned I make my garden."
—Jorshu of Clan Nel Toth

name: Putrid Leech
text: It reacted to Naya's overabundant food supply by growing additional mouths.

name: Cerodon Yearling
text: The unit of measurement used to chart a cerodon's growth is "persons consumed."

name: Fight to the Death
text: When a battlefield falls silent, it's rarely due to a cease-fire.

name: Glory of Warfare
text: "Their hopes dashed on our shields! Their victory slashed by our swords!"

name: Intimidation Bolt
text: For hours afterward, all they could see was the grisly silhouette of their master, screaming.

name: Leonin Abunas
text: Only leonin clerics who can survive the Razor Fields for one turning of the suns can stand in the Cave of Light.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: A vertical scream pierces the night air and echoes doom through the clouds.

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Juggernaut
text: Built with neither a way to steer nor a way to stop, the juggernauts were simply aimed at an enemy's best defenses and told to charge.

name: Bog Witch
text: The world is the body. The mana is the blood. The witch is the surgeon.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Lodestone Golem
text:
"Somehow it warps the Æther. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Memnarch
text: In the blur between metal and flesh, Memnarch found madness.

name: Obelisk of Esper
text: It is a monument as austere, unyielding, and inscrutable as Esper itself.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Skullcage
text: Only a focused mind can survive it.

name: Sorcerer's Strongbox
text: Simun the Quiet filled the chest with his most precious thoughts. But in a fit of paranoia, he locked up the memory of where he hid the key.

name: Synod Centurion
text:
"We order them to stand, they stand. We order them to wait, they wait. We order them to die, they die."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Incremental Blight
text: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

name: Infectious Horror
text: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Metallurgeon
text: "By the time I got there, the heart had stopped. Fortunately, I was able to replace it with something better."

name: Makeshift Mannequin
text:
"This vulgar mimicry will end now."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text: Though you may see the same bones, you'll never see the same skeleton twice.

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Battering Craghorn
text: Their skeletons can be found all over Skirk Ridge, tangled in each other's horns.

name: Chandra's Outrage
text:
"Her mind is an incredible mix of emotion and power. Even if I could grasp it, I couldn't hold it for long."
—Jace Beleren, on Chandra Nalaar

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: Dragon lords of Jund rule by edicts of flame.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Inferno Trap
text: "Do you smell something burning?"

name: Seething Song
text: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Volcanic Fallout
text:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
text: "My mind has changed. My strength has not."

name: Leaf Gilder
text: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
text: "My mind is the spread of the canopy. My heart is the embrace of the roots. I am deathless Llanowar, its fury and its peace."

name: Plummet
text: "You are the grandest of all," said the archdruid to the trees. They became so proud of bark and branch that they suffered no creature to fly overhead or perch upon a bough.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: Wall of Roots
text: Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Yavimaya Dryad
text: The parched earth still shielded those few souls with the heart to call it home.

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Architects of Will
text: This secret society of mages manipulates the beliefs and opinions of others.

name: Avatar of Discord
text: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

name: Branching Bolt
text:
"Lightning lives in everything, in living flesh and growing things. It must be set free."
—Rakka Mar

name: Colossal Might
text:
"Never corner a barbarian. You become the path of least resistance."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Heroes' Reunion
text:
"You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?"
—Eladamri, to Gerrard

name: Kaervek the Merciless
text:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

name: Magister Sphinx
text: "These benighted worlds are thick with ignorance. I will educate them. They will listen, or they will die."

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Unbender Tine
text: Creations made in madness may contain great power. The path to that power is as labyrinthine as the creator's mind.

name: Unmake
text: A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.

name: War Elephant
text: "When elephants fight it is the grass that suffers." —Kikuyu Proverb

name: War Elephant
text: "When elephants fight it is the grass that suffers." —Kikuyu Proverb

name: Fishliver Oil
text: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

name: Fishliver Oil
text: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

name: Flying Men
text: Saffiyah clapped her hands and twenty flying men appeared at her side, each well trained in the art of combat.

name: Army of Allah
text: On the day of victory no one is tired. —Arab proverb

name: Juzám Djinn
text: "Expect my visit when the darkness comes. The night I think is best for hiding all." —Ouallada

name: Army of Allah
text: On the day of victory no one is tired. —Arab proverb

name: Camel
text: Everyone knew Walid was a pious man, for he had been blessed with many sons, many jewels, and a great many Camels.

name: Stone-Throwing Devils
text: Sometimes those with the most sin cast the first stones.

name: Stone-Throwing Devils
text: Sometimes those with the most sin cast the first stones.

name: Ali Baba
text: "When he reached the entrance of the cavern, he pronounced the words, 'Open, Sesame!'" —*The Arabian Nights*, Junior Classics trans.

name: Bird Maiden
text:
"Four things that never meet do here unite
To shed my blood and to ravage my heart,
A radiant brow and tresses that beguile
And rosy cheeks and a glittering smile." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

name: Bird Maiden
text: "Four things that never meet do here unite To shed my blood and to ravage my heart, A radiant brow and tresses that beguile And rosy cheeks and a glittering smile." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

name: Sandstorm
text: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

name: Wyluli Wolf
text: "When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?" —Maimun al-Wyluli, *Diary*

name: Wyluli Wolf
text: "When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?" —Maimun al-Wyluli, *Diary*

name: Aladdin's Ring
text: "After these words the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's, saying: 'It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.'" —*The Arabian Nights*, Junior Classics trans.

name: King Suleiman
text:
"We made tempestuous winds obedient to Solomon . . . And many of the devils We also made obedient to him."
—The Qur'an, 21:81

name: Dancing Scimitar
text: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

name: Jandor's Saddlebags
text: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

name: Moorish Cavalry
text: Members of the elite Moorish Cavalry are very particular about their mounts, choosing only those whose bloodlines have been pure for generations.

name: Island of Wak-Wak
text: The Isle of Wak-Wak, home to a tribe of winged folk, is named for a peculiar fruit that grows there. The fruit looks like a woman's head, and when ripe speaks the word "Wak."

name: Moorish Cavalry
text: Members of the elite Moorish Cavalry are very particular about their mounts, choosing only those whose bloodlines have been pure for generations.

name: Piety
text: "Whoever obeys God and His Prophet, fears God and does his duty to Him, will surely find success." —The Qur'an, 24:52

name: Piety
text: "Whoever obeys God and His Prophet, fears God and does his duty to Him, will surely find success." —The Qur'an, 24:52

name: Repentant Blacksmith
text: "For my confession they burned me with fire And found that I was for endurance made." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Pegasus Charger
text:
"The clouds came alive and dove to the earth! Hooves flashed among the dark army, who fled before the spectacle of fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 211

name: Sacred Mesa
text:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Warrior's Honor
text:
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Armored Pegasus
text: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

name: Black Knight
text: "Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight."

name: Feast of the Unicorn
text:
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the baron knows of one."
—Autumn Willow

name: Ihsan's Shade
text:
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

name: Benalish Knight
text:
"We called them 'armored lightning.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text:
"From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!"
"Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin Digging Team
text:
"From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!"
"Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

name: Goblin Grenade
text:
"I don't suppose we could teach them to throw the cursed things?"
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Goblin Hero
text:
"When you're a goblin, you don't have to step forward to be a hero—everyone else just has to step back!"
—Biggum Flodrot, goblin veteran

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

name: Goblin Offensive
text: They certainly are.

name: Goblin Recruiter
text: "Next!"

name: Goblin Snowman
text:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Combat Medic
text:
"Without Combat Medics, Icatia would probably not have withstood the forces of chaos as long as it did."
—*Sarpadian Empires*, vol. VI

name: Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"Can they *do* that?"
—Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words

name: Goblin Warrens
text:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires*, vol. IV

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Mogg Raider
text: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Hi! ni! ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me! / Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return."
—Navajo war chant

name: Raging Goblin
text: Charging alone takes uncommong daring or uncommon stupidity. Or both.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh
'n da hurt'll disappear."
—Troll chant

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

name: Canopy Spider
text:
"We know our place in the cycle of life—and it is not as flies."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Carnivorous Plant
text:
"It had a mouth like that of a great beast, and gnashed its teeth as it strained to reach us. I am thankful it possessed no means of locomotion."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the giant spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Gorilla Chieftain
text:
"Oh, no—not *you* again?!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Hurricane
text:
"The raging winds . . . , settling on the sea, the surges sweep, / Raise liquid mountains, and disclose the deep."
—Virgil, *Aeneid*, Book I, trans. Dryden

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Freewind Falcon
text:
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

name: Overrun
text:
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him."
—Tahngarth of the Weatherlight

name: Scavenger Folk
text: String, weapons, wax or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

name: Spectral Bears
text:
"I hear there are bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest."
—Grulsen, abbey matron

name: Woolly Spider
text:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a Spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Lady Orca
text:
"I do not remember what he said to her. I remember her fiery eyes, fixed upon him for an instant. I remember a flash, and the hot breath of sudden flames made me turn away. When I looked again, Angus was gone."
—A wayfarer, on meeting Lady Orca

name: Ranger en-Vec
text:
"The path of least resistance will seldom lead you beyond your doorstep."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Aesthir Glider
text:
"A fine example of the rewards of artifice: a thoroughly obedient steed with wings of Soldevi steel."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Jalum Tome
text: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystic runes.

name: Strip Mine
text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

name: Infantry Veteran
text:
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

name: Order of the White Shield
text: A shield of light admits no shadow.

name: Argivian Archaeologist
text: Fascinated by the lore of ancient struggles, the Archaeologist searches incessantly for remnants of an earlier, more powerful era.

name: Hurkyl's Recall
text: This spell, attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife Hurkyl.

name: Reconstruction
text: Tedious research made the Sages of the College of Lat-Nam adept in repairing broken artifacts.

name: Artifact Possession
text: Any black mage could coax a Thraxodemon to inhabit a magical device.

name: Gate to Phyrexia
text: "The warm rain of grease on my face immediately made it clear I had entered Phyrexia." —Jarsyl, *Diary*

name: Haunting Wind
text: These devices lured so many spirits that sometimes entire battlefields would become haunted at once.

name: Argivian Blacksmith
text: Through years of study and training, the Blacksmiths of Argive became adept at reassembling the mangled remains of the strange, mechanical creatures abounding in their native land.

name: Artifact Blast
text: The first line of defense against Urza and Mishra, the Artifact Blast achieved widespread fame until an unlucky mage discovered it was useless on the devices the brothers had already created.

name: Shatterstorm
text: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

name: Argothian Pixies
text: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers, the Pixies of Argoth bent their magic to more practical ends.

name: Argothian Treefolk
text: Haunting cries we hear in our dreams As the forest dies, a death from machines.

name: Citanul Druid
text: Driven mad by the fall of Argoth, the Citanul Druids found peace only in battle.

name: Crumble
text: The spirits of Argoth grant new life to those who repent the folly of enslaving their labors to devices.

name: Gaea's Avenger
text: After the destruction of Argoth, Gaea was willing to instill a portion of her own powers into some of her more vengeful followers.

name: Powerleech
text: The Forest of Argoth has developed a resistance to mechanical intrusion.

name: Amulet of Kroog
text: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog. As a sign of friendship, Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets; afterwards, thousands journeyed to Kroog in hope of healing, greatly adding to the city's glory.

name: Ashnod's Battle Gear
text: This horrid invention clearly illustrates why Mishra's lieutenant was feared as much by her troops as by her foes.

name: Ashnod's Transmogrant
text: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

name: Battering Ram
text: By the time Mishra was defeated, no mage was foolish enough to rely heavily on walls.

name: Candelabra of Tawnos
text: Tawnos learned quickly from Urza that utter simplicity often led to wondrous, yet subtle utility.

name: Clay Statue
text: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

name: Colossus of Sardia
text: From the Sardian mountains wakes ancient doom: Warrior born from a rocky womb.

name: Cursed Rack
text: Ashnod invented several torture techniques that could make victims even miles away beg for mercy as if the End had come.

name: Dragon Engine
text: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

name: Damping Field
text: Eventually, mages learned to harness the power of natural damping fields and use it for their own ends.

name: Feldon's Cane
text: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

name: Golgothian Sylex
text: From their earliest educations, the brothers had known that no human contrivance could stand against the true masters of Dominia.

name: Grapeshot Catapult
text: For years scholars debated whether these were Urza's or Mishra's creations. Recent research suggests they were invented by the brothers' original master, Tocasia, and that both used these devices.

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Jalum Tome
text: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystical runes.

name: Mightstone
text: While exploring the sacred cave of Koilos with his brother Mishra and their master Tocasia, Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

name: Millstone
text: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

name: Obelisk of Undoing
text: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

name: Onulet
text: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's Onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

name: Ornithopter
text: Many scholars believe that these creatures were the result of Urza's first attempt at mechanical life, perhaps created in his early days as an apprentice to Tocasia.

name: Rakalite
text: Urza was the first to understand that the war would not be lost for lack of power, but for lack of troops.

name: Rocket Launcher
text: What these devices lacked in subtlety, they made up in strength.

name: Shapeshifter
text:
Born like a Phoenix from the Flame, But neither Bulk nor Shape the same.
—Jonathan Swift, "Vanbrug's House"

name: Staff of Zegon
text: Though Mishra was impressed by the staves Ashnod had created for Zegon's defense, he understood they only hinted at her full potential.

name: Su-Chi
text: Flawed copies of relics from the Thran Empire, the Su-Chi were inherently unstable but provided useful knowledge for Tocasia's students.

name: Tablet of Epityr
text: Originally considered the work of Urza, this tablet was created by forgers seeking to imitate Urza's masterpieces.

name: Tawnos's Weaponry
text: When Urza's war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

name: The Rack
text: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the Rack was once his most feared creation.

name: Triskelion
text: A brainchild of Tawnos, the Triskelion proved its versatility and usefulness in many of the later battles between the brothers.

name: Urza's Avenger
text: Unable to settle on just one design, Urza decided to create one versatile being.

name: Urza's Chalice
text: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

name: Wall of Spears
text: Even the most conservative generals revised their tactics after the Battle of Sarinth, during which a handful of peasant-pikemen held off a trio of rampaging Craw Wurms.

name: Weakstone
text: During the brothers' childhood, Tocasia took them to explore the sacred cave of Koilos. There, in the Hall of Tagsin, Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

name: Yotian Soldier
text: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again, even while laying siege to a city far from their homes.

name: Drafna's Restoration
text: Drafna, founder of the College of Lat-Nam, could create a working model from even the smallest remnants of a newly unearthed artifact.

name: Mishra's Workshop
text: Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia, Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose. Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.

name: Strip Mine
text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
