text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Angel of Glory's Rise
text: "Justice isn't done until undeath is undone."

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Essence Harvest
text: Captain Lewenheart uncovered evidence of a demon cult among the clergy. The Skirsdag never gave him a chance to prove his case.

name: Exquisite Blood
text: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

name: Ghoulflesh
text: The body dies in stages. First the skin, then the muscle. The brain is last, much to the victim's dismay.

name: Gloom Surgeon
text: He roams the streets of Havengul seeking the sick and delirious so that he may cure them of their lives.

name: Grave Exchange
text:
"It's a cold, dark journey either way."
—Eruth of Lambholt

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Homicidal Seclusion
text:
"Damned crows and their endless squawking . . . blocks out the voices in my head . . ."
—Hermit of Hanne Hall

name: Human Frailty
text:
"I have seen a hundred mortal families rise and fall. I shall outlast a thousand more."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Cathedral Sanctifier
text: "Evil will soon be vanquished. What Innistrad most needs now is healing."

name: Hunted Ghoul
text: Even after Hanweir was saved, Gisa's lost ghouls would shamble through, still following the twisted orders of their imprisoned master.

name: Killing Wave
text:
"I come looking for demons and I find a plane full of angels. I hate angels."
—Liliana Vess

name: Maalfeld Twins
text:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Gisa the Mad

name: Marrow Bats
text:
"No matter how far we push into Stensia, undeath will always remain in these lands."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Mental Agony
text: "His mind is feeble. Feed him to the bats."

name: Necrobite
text: An undead snake doesn't bite in self-defense. It hungers as any zombie, never sated.

name: Polluted Dead
text: After the zombie attack, crops withered on the vine, and the thriving village became a ghost town almost overnight.

name: Renegade Demon
text:
"Have you ever cornered a wounded vampire? That's a walk in the cathedral garden in comparison."
—Tristen, Cathar Marshal

name: Searchlight Geist
text: It rises with the fall of darkness, seeking souls to extinguish.

name: Cloudshift
text:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

name: Soulcage Fiend
text: Vowing to free the souls of her children, Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

name: Triumph of Cruelty
text:
"I've seen corpses prettier than you, beastmage."
—Liliana Vess

name: Undead Executioner
text: Heartless killer in life, brainless killer in death.

name: Unhallowed Pact
text: Agreements with demons seldom end at the grave.

name: Aggravate
text:
"Barbarians! They burned my favorite chair! We'll kill them all!"
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Archwing Dragon
text: Swifter than an angel, crueler than a demon, and relentless as a ghoul.

name: Banners Raised
text: After the destruction of the Helvault, fearful mobs soon became fearless battalions.

name: Battle Hymn
text:
"A church is just wood and walls. A congregation is the faithful praising the angels."
—Kolman, elder of Gatstaf

name: Commander's Authority
text: "Wear her symbol with honor, a sign of faith upheld and honest deeds bravely done."

name: Dangerous Wager
text:
"C'mon friend, take a turn tossing the knucklebones. What've you got to lose?"
—Tobias, trader of Erdwal

name: Demolish
text:
"To truly defeat a skaberen, you must destroy not the monster but the lab."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Dual Casting
text: Hours after the Helvault opened, his powers returned twice as strong as before.

name: Fervent Cathar
text: "I'll put my sword down only to die. And I don't plan on doing that today."

name: Gang of Devils
text:
"Well, how could I know they'd explode?"
—Gregel, township militia

name: Guise of Fire
text:
"Fire will eventually destroy a zombie, but a fiery zombie destroys a lot of other things first."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Havengul Vampire
text: "That slowly decreasing pulse—that's the beat I waltz to."

name: Cursebreak
text: No longer the village pariah. No longer taunted and shamed. Sigrun was finally free.

name: Kessig Malcontents
text: Discontent is a powerful weapon in the hands of a mob.

name: Kruin Striker
text: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

name: Lightning Prowess
text: "Undead flesh is dry and papery. A single spark and 'poof.' No more ghoul."

name: Mad Prophet
text: "There's no heron in the moon! It's a shrew, a five-legged shrew, with a voice like whispering thunder!"

name: Malicious Intent
text: As peace returned to Thraben, some cathars made the mistake of letting down their guard.

name: Malignus
text: It descended on Estwald like a sudden storm. Moments later, only ashes and agony remained.

name: Pillar of Flame
text: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

name: Defang
text: Once vampires are disarmed, they're given wooden swords and forced to assist in the training of Midnight Duelists.

name: Raging Poltergeist
text: Some tried cremating their dead to stop the ghoulcallers. But the dead returned, furious about their fate.

name: Reforge the Soul
text: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

name: Riot Ringleader
text: "So the vampires like hot blood, do they? Let's see how they handle ours."

name: Rite of Ruin
text: Skirsdag cultists refused to quietly accept Avacyn's ascendancy.

name: Rush of Blood
text: Sometimes it's not for sustenance or to feed the dependence. Sometimes it's just to feel again.

name: Scalding Devil
text: Demons massacre. Devils annoy.

name: Somberwald Vigilante
text: He has nothing left but his resentment.

name: Thatcher Revolt
text: The dark times left the peasantry ready to fight with whatever weapons were at hand.

name: Thunderbolt
text:
"My next aerial design will use less metal."
—Hadaken, alchemist of Nephalia

name: Defy Death
text: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers. "A fitting end," she murmured as she raised her sword.

name: Uncanny Speed
text:
"To survive, we must embrace the savagery we knew in our race's infancy."
—Edgar Markov

name: Vexing Devil
text: It's not any fun until someone loses an eye.

name: Vigilante Justice
text: It begins as a whisper and ends with the red roar of fire.

name: Borderland Ranger
text: "There's only one route from Kessig into Stensia. Unless you come with me."

name: Devout Chaplain
text: "By Avacyn's decree, we shall cleanse these relics of their demonic past."

name: Bower Passage
text: In the darkest hours, some denied Avacyn. Now the Kessig wilds are their only haven.

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

name: Eaten by Spiders
text: After sampling many victims, the spider developed a preference for the undead and their accoutrements.

name: Flowering Lumberknot
text:
"It used to eat us trappers. Now it follows us around like some kind of hound dog."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Gloomwidow
text: The abandoned towns on the moors didn't stay empty for long.

name: Grounded
text:
"We've tracked Ludevic's monster across four provinces. When it lands, make sure it stays put."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig, to Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Joint Assault
text:
"By my power, werewolves shall become the wolfir, our allies in combat against darkness."
—Avacyn's Cursemute Decree

name: Lair Delve
text: "The fiends have fled. Well, good riddance. Nothing I like more than an empty lair."

name: Natural End
text: The haunted blade shattered, and the geist drifted gratefully to the Blessed Sleep.

name: Nettle Swine
text:
"I killed one and found bricks and bones in its belly. It had eaten a whole cottage, thatch and all."
—Paulin, Somberwald trapper

name: Primal Surge
text: With Avacyn's return, the flow of life became a tidal wave.

name: Emancipation Angel
text: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

name: Rain of Thorns
text: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

name: Snare the Skies
text: A hunter's precision and a durkvine's strength are a potent combination.

name: Somberwald Sage
text: "You can face any danger when all of nature is on your side."

name: Soul of the Harvest
text: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

name: Terrifying Presence
text: Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.

name: Timberland Guide
text: "Can you build a fire? Track a deer? Identify killer trees? Then you'll never survive Kessig without me."

name: Triumph of Ferocity
text:
"Rid me of this curse, witch, or die with me."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Angel of Jubilation
text: "Though Innistrad is not cleansed of evil, we finally have cause to rejoice."

name: Ulvenwald Tracker
text: "Peace will come to Innistrad, but only after all abominations have been dealt with, one by one."

name: Vorstclaw
text:
"Where'd the werewolves go? Maybe *that* got hungry."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Wandering Wolf
text: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

name: Wild Defiance
text:
"When civilization reaches out its greedy hand, take it off at the wrist."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Wildwood Geist
text: The geists that dwell in the deep forests of Kessig are as untamable as the woods themselves.

name: Wolfir Avenger
text: Released from a dark curse and bound to a higher calling.

name: Yew Spirit
text:
"I wonder what dwelled in the primordial forests before humans existed."
—Elder Rimheit

name: Farbog Explorer
text: "I'd slog through a thousand swamps to help one soul find rest."

name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
text: Great devotion yields great reward.

name: Angel's Tomb
text:
"Faith can quicken the stones themselves with life."
—Writings of Mikaeus

name: Angelic Armaments
text: Forged in dark hours from the flame that would not die.

name: Bladed Bracers
text: Forged from the rubble of the Helvault.

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Haunted Guardian
text:
"Drain the victim's blood, sell the corpse, and use the soul on guard duty. No muss, no fuss, no problems."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Narstad Scrapper
text:
"Finally, the principles of corpse animation applied to bloodless materials!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Otherworld Atlas
text:
"Any fool can open it. But it takes a genius to decipher the blank pages."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Scroll of Avacyn
text: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

name: Scroll of Griselbrand
text: Words no eyes should see, telling of things no sane mind could fathom.

name: Tormentor's Trident
text: To a demon there is no such thing as restraint.

name: Vanguard's Shield
text: Wars are not fought on a single front.

name: Alchemist's Refuge
text: Persecuted alchemists fled deep into Kessig's wilds, seeking solitude to continue their ghoulish craft.

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text: Its courtyards are lit during every hour of the day so that night may never fall within its walls.

name: Goldnight Redeemer
text: The Host sings of Avacyn's return without a single verse about its own suffering.

name: Holy Justiciar
text: Her eyes see through the rotting flesh and glimpse a soul in agony, begging for the Blessed Sleep.

name: Leap of Faith
text: The finest maneuvers take place in three dimensions.

name: Midnight Duelist
text: Avacyn's return did not rid him of his desire for revenge.

name: Midvast Protector
text: "I cultivated my faith in Avacyn despite meager returns. Now my faith is repaid."

name: Moonlight Geist
text: Wails and whispers are the only weapons she has left.

name: Angel's Mercy
text: "I understand your fears. I pity your doubts. I absolve you of both."

name: Moorland Inquisitor
text: Inquisitors are taught scripture, philosophy, and the fine art of sharpening an axe.

name: Righteous Blow
text:
"Monsters will no longer find safety under the mists of Morkrut!"
—Bruna, Light of Alabaster

name: Seraph of Dawn
text: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

name: Thraben Valiant
text: "Once more into Devil's Breach, soldiers. I want another devil tail for my collection."

name: Angelic Wall
text:
"The air stirred as if fanned by angels' wings, and the enemy was turned aside."
—Tales of Ikarov the Voyager

name: Voice of the Provinces
text: Her horn is heard across Innistrad, lifting the hearts of the righteous.

name: Zealous Strike
text: "Cower, fiend. The night is yours no longer."

name: Alchemist's Apprentice
text: Side effects may include foul odors, scalding steam, and spontaneous nonexistence.

name: Amass the Components
text: "I knew I'd find a use for all that newt spittle!"

name: Arcane Melee
text: Debates between wizards are never purely academic.

name: Captain of the Mists
text: "I am no mere ship's captain. The north wind is my accomplice. The tide is my first mate."

name: Crippling Chill
text: One breath of the geist turns veins to rivers of ice and freezes hearts midbeat.

name: Devastation Tide
text: It's hard to argue with a force made of divine will.

name: Dreadwaters
text: Stray into the Morkrut and it may rise to claim you.

name: Archangel
text: The sky rang with the cries of armored seraphs, and the darkness made a tactical retreat.

name: Favorable Winds
text: Long thought to be extinct, flocks of gryffs reappeared with Avacyn's return.

name: Fettergeist
text: The choices of the living will tether them in death.

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Geist Snatch
text: Angels and demons aren't the only ones listening to your prayers.

name: Ghostform
text: "There's no such thing as 'impenetrable.'"

name: Ghostly Flicker
text: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

name: Ghostly Touch
text: "Geists wish to make themselves known. I'm merely the vessel for their efforts."

name: Gryff Vanguard
text:
"Ghouls smashed the door, but I heard the call of the gryffs and knew we were saved."
—Ekka, shopkeeper of Hanweir

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Havengul Skaab
text: An abomination so violent that the other fiends tremble at the sight of it.

name: Into the Void
text:
"The cathars have their swords, the inquisitors their axes. I prefer the 'diplomatic' approach."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Latch Seeker
text: It seeks a tomb that will hold it, a coffin that will give it rest.

name: Lunar Mystic
text:
"I'm pleased this world has learned the moon affects more than the tides."
—Tamiyo, the Moon Sage

name: Mass Appeal
text: "We have emerged triumphant from the darkness. Let our hard-won wisdom guide us to prosperity."

name: Mist Raven
text:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

name: Misthollow Griffin
text: For some creatures, existing is only a whim.

name: Nephalia Smuggler
text: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

name: Outwit
text: The student asks how a spell is begun. The master ponders what ends it.

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Rotcrown Ghoul
text:
"Don't look into its eyes. It's thinking things no dead thing should think."
—Captain Eberhart

name: Scrapskin Drake
text:
"The cathars killed my skaabs down below. Let's see how high their swords can reach."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Second Guess
text:
"I see where you're going with that. I don't like it."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Spirit Away
text: The fear of slipping from the geist's tenuous grip overwhelmed Tolo's joy at his first flight.

name: Builder's Blessing
text:
"Mix the mortar with holy wards, or blood will run in the streets."
—Vadvar, Thraben stonewright

name: Temporal Mastery
text: Time is a marvelous plaything.

name: Appetite for Brains
text: Just as with a peach, the first bite is always the juiciest.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Bloodflow Connoisseur
text:
"Death not for survival but for vanity and pleasure? This is the decadence I sought to curb."
—Sorin Markov

name: Bone Splinters
text:
"Which do you deserve, the heft of a femur or the graceful sharpness of a forearm? Decisions, decisions . . ."
—Gisa the Mad

name: Butcher Ghoul
text: Without a mind, it doesn't fear death. Without a soul, it doesn't mind killing.

name: Call to Serve
text: Grace is a gift, never a reward.

name: Corpse Traders
text: Those without breath can't complain.

name: Crypt Creeper
text:
"I guess what they say is true. What doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Or at least stranger."
—Captain Eberhart

name: Dark Impostor
text: "Ah, this is a nice life. I can see why you were so desperate to keep it."

name: Death Wind
text: Leukin stared at the smoldering angel feathers. "Run!" he screamed to his patrol. "We don't stand a chance!"

name: Demonic Rising
text: Which is the greater folly, summoning the demon or expecting gratitude from it?

name: Demonic Taskmaster
text: Subservience to greater power is the only law in the pit.

name: Descent into Madness
text: The stairs lead down in both directions.

name: Dread Slaver
text: Half a brain rules the mindless.

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Raptor Companion
text: A raptor will follow any order as long as that order is "hunt," "kill," or "go for the guts."

name: Rebuke
text:
"No one chooses to be stitched together into a skaab. If it could speak, it would beg for its own destruction."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Royal Trooper
text: "Loyalty guides me. Pride compels me. Anger sustains me. And the pay isn't bad."

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
text:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

name: Silverchase Fox
text:
"Be careful in your hunt. The clever little creature can steal your wards and lead you right into the werewolf's den."
—Britta, midwife of Gatstaf

name: Solemn Offering
text:
"You will be reimbursed for your donation."
"The reimbursement is spiritual."
—Temple signs

name: Sparring Mummy
text: Aspiring to earn their place in the afterlife, acolytes train every day against those who fell short of that glory.

name: Steppe Glider
text: It glides over the landscape. It also happens to be one.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Take Up Arms
text:
"Many scales make the skin of a dragon."
—Abzan wisdom

name: Tandem Tactics
text: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

name: Benthic Giant
text:
"Some fates you can see coming for you, plain as day, and there's nothing you can do about them."
—Callaphe the mariner

name: Call to Heel
text: On Bant, a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty. The one who bears it may be called to fulfill that charge at any moment.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Coralhelm Guide
text:
"She knows every step of this coastline, both above and below the surface, and she has hideouts all along the way. She will get you there."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Frost Lynx
text: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

name: Impulse
text: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

name: Kitesail Corsair
text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Kraken Hatchling
text: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

name: Negate
text:
"It is fascinating to see how the people of this plane replicate magical techniques without a natural gift. Also frustrating."
—Jace Beleren

name: Nimbus of the Isles
text: The people of the Sevick Isles have a unique understanding of the term "ominous clouds."

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Peregrine Drake
text:
"Always a welcome sight breaking through the clouds."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"The construction of a defense is not accomplished by adding bricks."
—Jace Beleren

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Sower of Temptation
text: One glamer leads him far from home. The next washes away his memory that home was ever anywhere but at her side.

name: Spell Snare
text: With practice, the measurement of magic can lead to its mastery.

name: Switcheroo
text: Say hello to your new friend.

name: Tidespout Tyrant
text: The stadium tests more than just fighting skill. For example, swimming ability.

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Watercourser
text:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

name: Assassin's Strike
text: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Daggerdrome Imp
text: One of the many reasons why open-air markets close at dusk.

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Eyeblight Assassin
text: "Boggart blood disgusts me almost as much as the foul creatures themselves."

name: Hand of Silumgar
text: Silumgar trains those whom he favors in his magic, granting them the ability to spread his disdain across the land.

name: Last Gasp
text: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.

name: Liturgy of Blood
text:
"You harbor such vast potential. It would be such a shame to let you die of old age."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Morbid Curiosity
text: "Every creation carries a piece of its creators. Their knowledge, their dreams, their soul. That is the best part."

name: Nirkana Revenant
text: Hate is an everlasting wellspring from which it is eternally sustained.

name: Noxious Dragon
text: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

name: Nyxathid
text: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.

name: Painful Lesson
text:
"You wish to remember this lesson? I will write it down for you."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Prakhata Club Security
text: It's rare that the Prakhata Club closes its doors. It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal. What are the odds the two would occur on the same day?

name: Rotfeaster Maggot
text: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

name: Screeching Buzzard
text:
"A shrill creature that delights in the misery of others—what's not to love?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Shambling Ghoul
text: Once he gets up and going, he will forever shamble on.

name: Slum Reaper
text: It's sent into unguilded districts by the Orzhov to collect the souls of those no one will miss.

name: Swarm of Bloodflies
text: In the Gudul delta, bloodfly bites are indistinguishable from spear wounds.

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Tenacious Dead
text: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved far easier than getting them to lie back down.

name: Bathe in Dragonfire
text: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

name: Battle Rampart
text:
"I will build no sanctuaries. The safety you seek can be won only by the sword."
—Yannash, outpost builder

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Blood Feud
text: Succession is a matter of blood, and by blood it is often decided.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Ember Beast
text: The only livestock that will survive for long in the Smelting District, ember beasts serve many functions—none of them willingly.

name: Enthralling Victor
text: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

name: Expedite
text: "I run, and thunder follows."

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Goblin Razerunners
text: Finding an unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

name: Lightning Talons
text:
"The victim was either clawed to death or struck by lightning. Possibly both."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Magmatic Force
text: It's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness.

name: Pathmaker Initiate
text: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

name: Reckless Reveler
text:
"The gods of Theros are born of the expectations and beliefs of mortals. If I have found godhood, what does that say about their true desires?"
—Xenagos, god of revels

name: Shock
text: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

name: Thunder Strike
text: Lightning reflexes, thunderous might.

name: Trumpet Blast
text:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: War's Toll
text: Razia, archangel of war, demands total commitment.

name: Wrap in Flames
text:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Aim High
text:
"A slayer gets by on wits and reflexes."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Charging Rhino
text: The knights of Troinir Keep took the rhino as their emblem due to its intense focus when charging down a perceived threat—a trait they discovered on a hunting excursion.

name: Cowl Prowler
text: Consulate guards who pursue fleeing renegades into the Cowl often become lost—occasionally permanently—in the city's wildest greenbelt.

name: Daggerback Basilisk
text:
"Petrifying gaze, deadly fangs, knifelike dorsal spines, venomous saliva . . . Am I missing anything? . . . Toxic bones? Seriously?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

name: Proud Mentor
text: "Get ready, son."

name: Giant Growth
text:
"The prohibition of unnecessary tossing of the citizenry by giants shall also extend to spontaneous giants."
—Isperia's Edict, provision VII.789.2

name: Greater Good
text:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Karametra's Favor
text: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

name: Kraul Warrior
text: The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.

name: Lead by Example
text: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

name: Magus of the Candelabra
text:
"What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"
—Teferi, to Jhoira

name: Plated Crusher
text:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

name: Primal Huntbeast
text:
"To the unskilled, it appears as blurred patches of distorted light. Few have seen its true form."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this, your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Return to the Earth
text:
"Dragons are feared for their breath and their bite, but it is their wings that make them unconquerable. Bring them to earth, and they die like any other beast."
—Kassur, Sultai hunter

name: Saddleback Lagac
text:
"A good lagac will carry you through thick and thin. A bad one ... well, it's a tasty dinner."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Skyshroud Claim
text: The forest's constant struggle is to keep the spreading flowstone at bay.

name: Wandering Wolf
text: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Centaur Healer
text: Instructors at the Kasarna training grounds are capable healers in case their students fail to grasp the subtleties of combat.

name: Dinrova Horror
text:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Evil Twin
text: You can always tell the evil one by the dagger he's sticking in you.

name: Gwafa Hazid, Profiteer
text: "Everyone has a price."

name: Jelenn Sphinx
text: Few among the Azorius have ever spoken with the sphinxes, but all have felt their influence.

name: Kiss of the Amesha
text: Once a year, Akrasa holds a joust that draws knights and their leotaus from every nation on Bant. The prize is an Akrasan sigil, but the true reward is the angel's kiss.

name: Relentless Hunter
text: "I swore to take one head for each member of my family they killed. My task is nowhere near its end."

name: Rhox Brute
text:
"In this new world, I have seen the once-devout rhoxes take up arms with the savages of Jund. I would be offended, but I see the wisdom in their choice."
—Gernan, Dawnray archer

name: Riptide Crab
text: It sleeps with its claws open.

name: Arena Rector
text: "I see something special in you—a bright ember that yearns to dance among the stars."

name: Urborg Drake
text: Relentless as the sea, remorseless as death.

name: Consulate Skygate
text: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.

name: Culling Dais
text:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Eager Construct
text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Genesis Chamber
text:
"As the experimental population grows, so does the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium."
—Memnarch

name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
text: Blessed by the gods. Coveted by mortals. Beholden to neither.

name: Hexplate Golem
text:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Millennial Gargoyle
text:
"You've got to keep your wits about you on the roofs. Not all stones are compliant handholds."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

name: Aurora Champion
text: Many combatants at Valor's Reach wield glowing weapons to distract their enemies and delight the crowd.

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Night Market Guard
text:
"One head watches for Consulate enforcers. The other watches for renegade thieves."
—Crime Lord Gonti

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Pierce Strider
text:
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Seer's Lantern
text: A light to bring hope in dark times.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Stone Golem
text: The sculptor, like most artists, put his heart and soul into his work. But the newly awakened golem decided it wanted its creator's other, more tangible parts.

name: Tyrant's Machine
text:
"Though tempered differently, all wills can be broken."
—Inquisitor Kyrik

name: Yotian Soldier
text: Poets dream the verses of otherworldly stories. Artificers dream the blueprints of otherplanar artifacts.

name: Bring Down
text:
"Big, wicked, and not too smart. Poor thing never stood a chance against us, dear."
—Regna, to Krav

name: Jubilant Mascot
text: The competition is but one aspect of the spectacle.

name: Play of the Game
text: The most sensational plays send everyone home breathless.

name: Regna's Sanction
text:
"Show them the light, my love."
—Krav, the Unredeemed

name: Skystreamer
text: Victories at Valor's Reach are broadcast via griffins in the sky above.

name: Fumble
text: A moment of distraction, a lifetime of regret.

name: Game Plan
text: Plan for victory, or prepare for defeat.

name: Huddle Up
text: "Are you sure this is going to work?" asked Will. "No," said Rowan. "But if it does, it's going to be spectacular."

name: Out of Bounds
text: The wardens watch for illegal tactics and protect spectators from the occasional rogue fireball.

name: Saltwater Stalwart
text: Every attack is a test of your defenses. Every hit marks the map of your defeat.

name: Soaring Show-Off
text: Some spectators love an underdog, but others are just as happy to support a proven winner.

name: Spellseeker
text: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

name: Spellweaver Duo
text: Synchronized spellweaving is a difficult but rewarding skill to master.

name: Zndrsplt's Judgment
text: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun, but she still knows the penalties better than anyone else.

name: Bloodborn Scoundrels
text: The ring plays host to some combatants that the spectators love to hate.

name: Fan Favorite
text: "Pathetic! I've heard more noise in a monastery. Let me hear you, Valor's Reach!"

name: Gang Up
text:
"Well, who do we have here, Gorm?"
"No one, Virtus. No one at all."

name: Mindblade Render
text: "There will be no secrets between us... like it or not."

name: Sickle Dancer
text: "I lead, destruction follows."

name: Stunning Reversal
text: The line between victory and defeat can be as slim as a razor's edge.

name: Thrasher Brute
text: Some competitors fight for glory or money. Some just like hitting people.

name: Thrilling Encore
text: "Welcome to the winning team."

name: Virtus's Maneuver
text: Brutality had never been so exquisite.

name: Azra Bladeseeker
text: "Never get too attached to a weapon. You must allow a better one to find its way to you."

name: Bonus Round
text: When the twin-spell bonus round begins, the crowd rises to its feet in anticipation of incredible combinations.

name: Bull-Rush Bruiser
text: There will always be a spot at Valor's Reach for headlong violence.

name: Cheering Fanatic
text: "Punch 'em, kick 'em, bite 'em, beat 'em! Burn 'em all and we'll defeat 'em!"

name: Magma Hellion
text: The stadium is well-stocked with hazards to force the action if combatants show too much caution.

name: Stadium Vendors
text: "Potions! Mana potions, health potions, energy potions—get your potions here!"

name: Bramble Sovereign
text: "Within this grove, you belong to me."

name: Charging Binox
text: Arena beasts are bred for flashiness and foul temper. An extra head addresses both requirements.

name: Combo Attack
text: Success at Valor's Reach requires not only individual skill but also the ability to merge that skill with a partner's.

name: Decorated Champion
text: The oddsmakers hate him because every fight is a foregone conclusion. The crowd loves him for exactly the same reason.

name: Jungle Wayfinder
text: She is adept at navigating the stadium's ever-changing landscape.

name: Azra Oddsmaker
text: "I never give odds on my own fights. Unless, of course, you want to bet *against* me . . ."

name: Last One Standing
text: Some train all their lives for a shot at the title. Some just get really, really lucky.

name: Rushblade Commander
text: "I like a quick victory. More time to celebrate."

name: Sentinel Tower
text: The built-in obstacles force competitors to think three moves ahead.

name: Victory Chimes
text: The favored noisemaker of goblins ever since the wardens cracked down on explosives.

name: Bountiful Promenade
text: No pilgrimage to Valor's Reach is complete without a stroll through its celebrated shopping district.

name: Luxury Suite
text: The view is rivaled only by the decadence of the decor.

name: Morphic Pool
text: Ancient magic reshapes the stage into a variety of landscapes.

name: Sea of Clouds
text: Skybridges from across Kylem converge at the grand stadium of Valor's Reach.

name: Spire Garden
text: From thrilling combat to unparalleled vistas, Valor's Reach has it all.

name: Angel of Retribution
text: Bitter vengeance never glowed so bright nor sang so sweet.

name: Angelic Chorus
text: The harmony of the glorious is a dirge to the wicked.

name: Battle Mastery
text:
"There is elegance in all the Ojutai do—even their killing."
—Kirada, Silumgar enforcer

name: Champion of Arashin
text: "The blood of Dromoka and the blood of my veins are the same."

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Lightwalker
text:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Long Road Home
text: The person who finishes a journey is rarely the same as the one who starts it.

name: Loyal Pegasus
text:
"Even if I should die in the saddle, she will not let me fall to the ground."
—Hypatia of the Winged Horse

name: Mangara of Corondor
text: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

name: Midnight Guard
text:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Bane of Bala Ged
text: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage, its lush jungles and cascading rivers reduced to dust.

name: Kozilek's Channeler
text:
"In the dark places of our world, something horrible is growing. I fear our foes may be more numerous than we had imagined."
—Nissa Revane

name: Swarm Surge
text: The Eldrazi rampaged across Zendikar in a tide of chittering, heaving flesh.

name: Transgress the Mind
text:
"Fear of the unknown can be a wonderfully innocent thing, relatively speaking."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Bloodbond Vampire
text:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Bone Splinters
text: Vastly outnumbered, the Zendikari found creative ways to even the odds.

name: Carrier Thrall
text:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Defiant Bloodlord
text:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Demon's Grasp
text:
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
text: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

name: Oblivion Sower
text: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

name: Dutiful Return
text: When Malakir's surgeons failed, its death-shamans took over.

name: Hagra Sharpshooter
text: "It's hard to find their weak points, but I very much enjoy the discovery process."

name: Kalastria Healer
text: "Time and again, I have demonstrated my skills as a healer. Why, then, are you so ill at ease?"

name: Kalastria Nightwatch
text:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Malakir Familiar
text:
"They are deadly, and they are loyal. We can spare them a little blood."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

name: Nirkana Assassin
text: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

name: Ruin Processor
text: The Eldrazi continue to sweep through the wastes, compounding destruction that already seemed absolute.

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Vampiric Rites
text: For vampires, blood carries more than life. Memories long eroded from the minds of bloodchiefs can be reclaimed from the veins of their sired kin.

name: Voracious Null
text:
"These days, there's no shortage of food for the nulls of Guul Draz."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Barrage Tyrant
text: Terrible fury. Excellent aim.

name: Kozilek's Sentinel
text: It moves through the tunnels as slowly and surely as the shifting stones.

name: Scour from Existence
text:
"Our people and our very lands disappear as if they never were. We no longer fight for glory, or honor. We battle now for the right to exist."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Molten Nursery
text:
"Some detours just aren't worth it."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Processor Assault
text: Ulamog's processors trail behind him, converting ruined matter into furious energy.

name: Touch of the Void
text: Some wounds never heal.

name: Turn Against
text: "No, don't! Nal, it's me—"

name: Vestige of Emrakul
text: Emrakul has not been seen in months. Though her brood's numbers have dwindled in her absence, each drone is still a deadly threat.

name: Titan's Presence
text: Dust and memory are all that remain in Ulamog's wake.

name: Belligerent Whiptail
text:
"Whiptails can sense a traveler's footsteps from a great distance. Measuring that distance has been . . . difficult."
—Jalun, Affa sentry

name: Chasm Guide
text: With a single act of bravery, she went from expendable to indispensable.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Firemantle Mage
text: "Come on, you twisted things! Don't you want to get acquainted?"

name: Goblin War Paint
text:
"The Eldrazi may not be intimidated, but if it boosts the goblins' confidence, I see no reason to discourage it."
—Jalun, Affa sentry

name: Lavastep Raider
text: Goblins were first to see the potential of hedrons in the fight against the Eldrazi, for the magical stones came ready-made with pointy bits.

name: Makindi Sliderunner
text: After a battle, it breaks the hillsides into manageable pieces to prepare for next time.

name: Ondu Champion
text:
"Put a minotaur at the head of an army and suddenly all the soldiers act like they have horns."
—Gideon Jura

name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
text: A force as voracious as time itself.

name: Outnumber
text: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

name: Radiant Flames
text: The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.

name: Reckless Cohort
text: "You have a family. Mine died at Sea Gate. You go to yours, and I'll go to mine."

name: Rolling Thunder
text:
"Zendikar is always angry, though I've never seen that anger so precisely directed."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Shatterskull Recruit
text: Saved from certain death by the kor, he considers himself bound to them by an unbreakable blood oath.

name: Stonefury
text: Akoum can make any intruder look small.

name: Sure Strike
text: To survive imminent doom, it sometimes takes a foolhardy soul who acts first and fears later.

name: Tunneling Geopede
text: As Ulamog's brood reduces the earth to dust, geopedes burst from their tunnels in search of solid ground.

name: Valakut Invoker
text:
"As long as we have walked this world, we have known it as a harsh and unforgiving place."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Valakut Predator
text:
"Whatever volcanoes dream of, it seems like they always wake up grumpy."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Volcanic Upheaval
text: Like a living organism, Zendikar rids itself of infection, and it does so abruptly and ruthlessly.

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Blisterpod
text: A blisterpod's corpse is a scion's cradle.

name: Brood Monitor
text: The tenderness of a mother. The pity of a mantis.

name: Call the Scions
text: Ulamog's progeny swarm the land, draining Zendikar's mana to feed the titan's insatiable hunger.

name: Eyeless Watcher
text: Every Eldrazi in Ulamog's lineage is an extension of the titan's will.

name: Unnatural Aggression
text: The battle served as a grim reminder of what a final victory for the Eldrazi would mean.

name: Void Attendant
text: The Eldrazi don't merely extinguish life—they supplant it.

name: Void Winnower
text:
"Have you ever seen a world fall to its knees? Watch, and learn."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Beastcaller Savant
text: "They come because I call. They stay because I listen."

name: Broodhunter Wurm
text: The native creatures of Zendikar have adapted to live under rocks and crawl through underbrush in order to avoid the most voracious predators. The Eldrazi have yet to make such adjustments.

name: Giant Mantis
text:
"I always thought the great insects of Tazeem were frightening until I saw the Eldrazi. Now I welcome the sight of mantises perched in the treetops."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

name: Infuse with the Elements
text:
"Zendikar has given us the weapons to wage war on the appropriate scale."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

name: Jaddi Offshoot
text: On Murasa, even the trees grow trees.

name: Lifespring Druid
text: "The land is not dead, merely sick. I will nurse it back to health."

name: Murasa Ranger
text: "If you're not prepared to fight, you'd best be prepared to die."

name: Natural Connection
text: "Zendikar will not surrender, and neither can we."

name: Angel of Renewal
text: "No more fear. No more failure. No more death. No more!"

name: Nissa's Renewal
text: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

name: Oran-Rief Invoker
text:
"The world was not hostile to us—we were beneath its notice, and presented no danger."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Plated Crusher
text:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

name: Plummet
text: The elf's blade carved deep into the Eldrazi drone's fleshy lattices. Without a sound, the drone lost equilibrium and tumbled from the sky.

name: Reclaiming Vines
text:
"This world tires of its long occupation."
—Nissa Revane

name: Rot Shambler
text:
"If I die, feed me to a shambler. At least that way I'll be doing some good."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

name: Scythe Leopard
text: Eldrazi are not the leopard's preferred prey, but they are better than no prey at all.

name: Seek the Wilds
text: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

name: Angelic Gift
text: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

name: Snapping Gnarlid
text: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

name: Swell of Growth
text:
"Nissa is not the only one with a deep connection to Zendikar's primal elements."
—Kiora

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Tajuru Beastmaster
text: "My mount needs neither reins nor bridle. We both share a common purpose."

name: Tajuru Stalwart
text: "In its time of hardship, all of Zendikar cries out in pain. Are you listening?"

name: Tajuru Warcaller
text: Her rallying cry reaches far beyond the Tajuru elves, inspiring all those who hear it.

name: Territorial Baloth
text: It knows nothing of Eldrazi or Planeswalkers, just that there are new intruders in its territory.

name: Woodland Wanderer
text:
"The elements understand better than anyone that actions speak louder than words."
—Gideon Jura

name: Cliffside Lookout
text: Though losses run high among the scouts of the Stone Havens, they never flinch from their duty.

name: Dust Stalker
text: The only traces it leaves are silent gusts and prodigious amounts of wreckage.

name: Forerunner of Slaughter
text:
"While we delay, they're on the move. They will not wait as we bicker. We are losing this war by moments as our goal slips beyond our reach."
—Gideon Jura

name: Herald of Kozilek
text:
"Some Eldrazi, their purpose is obvious: suck the life out of the land, birth new Eldrazi. Others aren't so obvious, and those are the ones that make me really nervous."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Sire of Stagnation
text: As the great scourge passed by, Zendikar shivered, then lay silent.

name: Angelic Captain
text: As the soldiers beneath her raised their voices, the angel spread her wings, their span seeming to cover the sky.

name: Courier Griffin
text:
"Sea Gate has fallen. Survivors are on the move. Will send another griffin when we find refuge. Stay hidden. Stay safe."
—Message from Tars Olan, kor world-gift

name: Drana's Emissary
text: "The taste of freedom is sweeter than blood."

name: Grove Rumbler
text:
"The land will not wait for the enemy to arrive."
—Nissa Revane

name: Grovetender Druids
text: "The seedlings scream for us to loose them upon the Eldrazi, and we shall oblige."

name: March from the Tomb
text: They came from all walks of life, from every part of Zendikar, and they returned with one unifying cause.

name: Noyan Dar, Roil Shaper
text: After many years as a lullmage, Noyan Dar turned his talents from allaying Zendikar's fury to the considerably easier task of rousing it.

name: Resolute Blademaster
text: "Great steel is born in the hottest forges. Great soldiers are born in war."

name: Skyrider Elf
text: "It may be unconventional, but I'll take any steady mount in a storm."

name: Aligned Hedron Network
text: The last hedron slotted into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.

name: Hedron Archive
text: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned.""And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Pathway Arrows
text: Also called "pathway stones," hedron shards can immobilize Eldrazi on contact.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: Each time it is sent to find a safe haven, it takes longer to return.

name: Slab Hammer
text: Neither subtle nor pretty.

name: Blighted Cataract
text: Once, water ran here. Now only dust and ash fall from the clifftops.

name: Blighted Fen
text:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Blighted Gorge
text: The land is dying, but it will not go peacefully.

name: Blighted Steppe
text:
"When a limb is gangrenous, you cut it off. This is no different."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The Eldrazi may be ruthless, but Zendikar is relentless.

name: Expedition Envoy
text: The unofficial motto of every expedition house is "ready for anything," a phrase whose significance has been amplified since the emergence of the Eldrazi.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods
text: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Spawning Bed
text: Young Eldrazi crawl forth from the dust, compelled by a greater will.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Felidar Cub
text: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

name: Felidar Sovereign
text: It surveys the withering landscape, waiting for a victory only it can see.

name: Fortified Rampart
text: The refuge's defenses allow new recruits to see lesser Eldrazi up close, steeling their stomachs for what's to come.

name: Ghostly Sentinel
text: Mystics of the Stone Havens call upon the spirits of fallen heroes to defend the refuges.

name: Breaker of Armies
text:
"There are some who have lost everyone and everything. They actively seek out the Eldrazi, eager for the smallest measure of vengeance."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Gideon's Reproach
text:
"Suddenly, Gideon was there with us, clearing the way so that we could escape."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Hero of Goma Fada
text: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!"
—Gideon Jura

name: Kitesail Scout
text: "The wind in one's hair, the sun on one's back, the joy of open skies . . . the next generation of kor must know this kind of peace."

name: Kor Bladewhirl
text: The high-pitched whirl of a hook is the only battle cry she needs.

name: Kor Castigator
text:
"He told us not to worry, and he walked into the cavern. The swirling mass of Eldrazi parted to admit him, then closed in his wake."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Kor Entanglers
text: "We came into this world together. We fight for this world together. We'll leave this world together."

name: Lantern Scout
text: Hedron lanterns fend off more than just the darkness.

name: Lithomancer's Focus
text:
"Even in the hands of amateurs, Nahiri's hedrons can harm the Eldrazi."
—Ugin

name: Makindi Patrol
text: Working with his noble mount, he notices every form on the horizon, every scent in the air, every tremor in the earth.

name: Ondu Greathorn
text:
"May your horns get lodged in an Eldrazi's bony face, ornery brute!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Roil's Retribution
text:
"We can use their hunger to lead them into danger. If we're already prey, we may as well be bait!"
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Serene Steward
text: "I can give you strength, but you'll have to bring your own courage."

name: Shadow Glider
text: A few bands of kor sought refuge from the Eldrazi in Zendikar's vast cave networks, relying on their ability to survive in harsh vertical landscapes.

name: Smite the Monstrous
text: After watching the kor in battle, Gideon understood the difference between working together and working as one.

name: Deathless Behemoth
text:
"Over and over it rose. Over and over we fell."
—Ganda, Goma Fada deserter

name: Stone Haven Medic
text: "These days, soldiers never stick around long enough for a proper healing. They just want me to knit them up so they can hurry back to the fight."

name: Tandem Tactics
text: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

name: Unified Front
text: The kor's pride in their independence has given way to a strong sense of community that embraces all of Zendikar.

name: Cryptic Cruiser
text:
"The seas are no less imperiled than the dry lands. This fight is mine as much as it is yours."
—Kiora, to Gideon Jura

name: Horribly Awry
text:
"We are nothing but dust to them—our bodies, our actions, even our words."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Desolation Twin
text:
"With precise coordination and enough blood spilled, one can be driven off, even brought down. But two . . . that's a lot of blood."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Incubator Drone
text: The touch of an Eldrazi brings life and death in turn.

name: Mist Intruder
text: The wastes spread as quickly as the wind.

name: Murk Strider
text: If you can see it, it's too late.

name: Oracle of Dust
text: Whatever it is searching for, it will stop at nothing to find it.

name: Tide Drifter
text: It didn't do much, but the residents of Sea Gate gave it a wide berth all the same.

name: Anticipate
text: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

name: Eldrazi Devastator
text:
"No matter how big your champion, theirs is bigger. No matter how great your numbers, theirs are greater. No matter how voracious your appetite, they are hungrier. That is why the Eldrazi will win."
—Kalitas, thrall of Ulamog

name: Brilliant Spectrum
text: There are more sights on Zendikar than the eyes can see.

name: Cloud Manta
text: When Emeria's worshippers learned that she was no more than a twisted memory of Emrakul, they abandoned their temples to the god. The deserted shrines now serve as breeding grounds for the mantas.

name: Coralhelm Guide
text:
"She knows every step of this coastline, both above and below the surface, and she has hideouts all along the way. She will get you there."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Dampening Pulse
text:
"Quiet now, you dreadful vermin."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem roilmage

name: Dispel
text:
"I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis. Ugin's arguments were . . . unconvincing."
—Jace Beleren

name: Exert Influence
text: "I can't control its mind—I'm not even sure it has one. But I can dominate its will."

name: Halimar Tidecaller
text: "Quiet the waves? Why would I want to do that?"

name: Endless One
text: It embodies all possible meanings of the word "infinite."

name: Roilmage's Trick
text: Weather on Zendikar is unpredictable—unless you're the one telling it what to do.

name: Tightening Coils
text: Having gone to the trouble of stealing a bident from a god on another world, Kiora was eager to test its capabilities.

name: Ugin's Insight
text:
"You speak to me of the threat of Ulamog. But do not forget: they came as three."
—Ugin, to Jace Beleren

name: Wave-Wing Elemental
text:
"Do you see? All of Tazeem strains at its tether."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem roilmage

name: Gruesome Slaughter
text: Though Gideon arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre, he still had enough time to lead its survivors to relative safety.

name: Complete Disregard
text:
"We returned to the field and found poor Len, every detail of his final moment perfectly cast in that awful dust."
—Javad Nasrin, outrider captain

name: Culling Drone
text: Silence rules Bala Ged, broken only by the skittering of Eldrazi.

name: Grip of Desolation
text: As the hand closed, there was first terror, then numbness, and finally nothingness.

name: Mind Raker
text: It consumes any dreams of victory.

name: Silent Skimmer
text:
"I watched it pass at a distance. When I looked back to my companions, Najet was dead."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Legion Extruder
text: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

name: Molten Duplication
text: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

name: Ancient Cornucopia
text:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

name: Sandstorm Salvager
text: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."

name: Loot, the Key to Everything
text: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

name: Pest Control
text:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

name: Torpor Orb
text:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."

name: Legion Extruder
text: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

name: Molten Duplication
text: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

name: Ancient Cornucopia
text:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

name: Sandstorm Salvager
text: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

name: Loot, the Key to Everything
text: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

text:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

name: Torpor Orb
text:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

text: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."

name: Legion Extruder
text: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

name: Molten Duplication
text: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

name: Ancient Cornucopia
text:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

name: Sandstorm Salvager
text: Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.

name: Loot, the Key to Everything
text: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

name: Pest Control
text:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

name: Torpor Orb
text:
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you."
—Fomori inscription

name: Banishing Light
text:
"If you cannot find light in the darkness, create it."
—Aural, high cleric

name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
text: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

name: Moonstone Harbinger
text: Moonstone weapons drink in the last light of dusk to give their wielders an edge in combat.

name: Ravine Raider
text: The path to the Cliff of Heroes is rife with bandits, expertly camouflaged in the dense flora of Valley.

name: Ruthless Negotiation
text: "Next time you come this way, do us both a favor and have something worth stealing, yeah?"

name: Savor
text: Edibility is in the eye of the beholder.

name: Driftgloom Coyote
text: "The fog is descending like a starving beast. I believe our expedition ends here."

name: Scales of Shale
text: Like shedding, but backwards.

name: Sinister Monolith
text: Blood and brine make a strong mortar.

name: Stargaze
text:
"Some batfolk dedicate their lives to seeing the world beyond them."
—Warion, scholar of the Cosmos

name: Starlit Soothsayer
text: "The Lunar Paean is upon us. Let us turn to our ancestors for guidance, and look to our children for hope."

name: Valley Rotcaller
text:
We all share one life and one death.
—Rotcaller saying

name: Wick's Patrol
text:
"What a hideous creature! And the worm's no looker either."
—Grumble, rival marshstalker

name: Agate Assault
text: "Only an amateur crushes their enemies with a *cold* rock."

name: Alania's Pathmaker
text: "The frogfolk should worry less that the sky is falling and worry more about where it's landing."

name: Brambleguard Captain
text: "We sought adventure and found calamity. Forward, so we may meet both with courage!"

name: Brazen Collector
text: Risks taken to retrieve a prize only increase its value.

name: Byway Barterer
text: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

name: Feather of Flight
text: As he grasped the glowing feather, the lizard's heart soared, and the rest of him quickly followed.

name: Conduct Electricity
text: "Give me a lightning rod, something I can use as a channel!" Ral called above the mayhem. Nodding, Finneas drew a copperleaf arrow from his emptying quiver and shot.

name: Flamecache Gecko
text: Wood holds a flame for only so long before it crumbles into ash. But stone can burn forever.

name: Frilled Sparkshooter
text: Its frills keep it steady, making its aim impeccable.

name: Harnesser of Storms
text: She feeds and powers her entire village.

name: Kindlespark Duo
text: "We burn like fire!" cackled the lizard. "And strike like lightning!" the otter thundered.

name: Might of the Meek
text:
"Fear is unavoidable. You can run from it with your tail between your legs, or charge it head on with sword in hand. I prefer the latter."
—Rho, veteran hero

name: Playful Shove
text: The boisterous pat on the back was painful, but not nearly as painful as the joke that inspired it.

name: Quaketusk Boar
text:
"Calamity Beasts are running through Valley, leaving death and destruction in their wake. I have a plan to stop them."
—Glarb, ruler of Fountainport

name: Rabid Gnaw
text: Unbeknownst to the hosts, the foraged seeds they served at dinner had been touched by a Calamity Beast. The results were ... disturbing.

name: Raccoon Rallier
text: "I used to play for family only until I realized I could inspire an entire party with a single note."

name: Harvestrite Host
text: "Many paws grew this feast, and many paws should share it!"

name: Roughshod Duo
text: "En garde, you inadequate excuse for a foe!" challenged the mouse. "Raaahrgh grrrr raaaargh!" agreed the raccoon.

name: Steampath Charger
text: Hot-footed and cold-blooded.

name: Stormsplitter
text: "We'll cover more ground if I split up."

name: Take Out the Trash
text: Disgusting. Revolting. Effective.

name: Teapot Slinger
text: "For the last time it's *porcelain*, not stoneware, you ignorant fool!"

name: Valley Flamecaller
text:
"Well, that's another night of research spoiled."
—Claire, batfolk astrologer

name: Hop to It
text:
"Finding a hidden patch of glowberries is almost as joyful as eating them. Almost."
—Ms. Bumbleflower

name: War Squeak
text: Dangers sharper than thorns can hide among flowers.

name: Whiskerquill Scribe
text:
"Unneeded words are like dandelion seeds—cast adrift at the slightest whiff of scrutiny, only to find purchase and thrive where you least expect."
—Myrtle, Valley scribe

name: Bakersbane Duo
text: "I'll take the crust!" chittered the squirrel. "And I'll take the filling!" drooled the raccoon.

name: Bark-Knuckle Boxer
text:
May your bark be worse than your bite.
—Raccoonfolk war blessing

name: Brambleguard Veteran
text: "Why should the birdfolk get the best view?"

name: Curious Forager
text: The bones of Calamity Beasts are sometimes buried in caches where their power can grow quietly.

name: Intrepid Rabbit
text: "I'll light the way, but we must walk it together."

name: Druid of the Spade
text: The druid brought the best out of the soil and, in turn, the best out of the fluffle.

name: For the Common Good
text: Despite their differences, every creature and culture of Valley stood in unison against the threat.

name: Galewind Moose
text:
"Something has stirred the Calamity Beasts, and they are wreaking havoc. Anyone who wishes to help, come forth! Whether it's with your swords in the fight or your shovels in the field, join me!"
—Mabel, heir to Cragflame

name: Hazardroot Herbalist
text: Just because it's natural doesn't mean it's healthy.

name: Heaped Harvest
text: One can travel all of Valley and never eat the same meal twice.

name: High Stride
text:
"It takes a moment to find your stride, but once you do, you'll feel like a giant!"
—Brisco, river guide

name: Keen-Eyed Curator
text: "Now this one's a real collector's item. They say Lily Emberseed herself drank from this mug when she was still Lily of Valley."

name: Overprotect
text:
"Blor's defenses are impervious!"
—Blor the Impervious

name: Polliwallop
text: "We'll see who croaks first!"

name: Jolly Gerbils
text: "With all the chaos going around, we thought it might be the perfect time to take a break and have a nice picnic. Would you like to join us?"

name: Stickytongue Sentinel
text: Victory doesn't have to be close for him to taste it.

name: Stocking the Pantry
text:
Sorting the seeds from the nuts
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning
"dwelling on unnecessary details"

name: Sunshower Druid
text: Apprentice augurs begin their studies by predicting where the rain will fall. Even those who don't succeed derive great joy from the process.

name: Three Tree Rootweaver
text: "It's easy to find your way around the Root Maze if you know what to look, listen, smell, feel, and taste for."

name: Three Tree Scribe
text: "The tree wants to give me a warning. I just need to help it communicate."

name: Lifecreed Duo
text: "Why are you eating upside down?" asked the bird. "Why are you eating upside up?" replied the bat.

name: Treeguard Duo
text: "You shall not pass me," croaked the frog. "Nor me," growled the rabbit.

name: Treetop Sentries
text: They don't waste arrows on warning shots.

name: Valley Mightcaller
text: "There is no path to the Root Maze's center. Bard, sing a song while I create one."

name: Wear Down
text: The birdfolk guards flitted angrily. "Seriously, Timbles? Again?!"

name: Alania, Divergent Storm
text: "Why would I chase the storm? Does a cloud chase the rain? Does the sun chase the light?"

name: Burrowguard Mentor
text: "On your paws! I've been fighting in these fields for more seasons than you've had hot dinners!"

name: Cindering Cutthroat
text: "We don't 'play' with fire. It is strictly business."

name: Mabel's Mettle
text: "You stole a child from its nest," Mabel accused. "The only calamity I see here is you."

name: Corpseberry Cultivator
text: A rare fruit grows from the corpses of Calamity Beasts, with nectar the flavor of strength and skin as fragile as life.

name: Dreamdew Entrancer
text: "Your dreams are too precious to leave to chance."

name: Fireglass Mentor
text: "Nothing focuses the mind quite like a flame."

name: Head of the Homestead
text:
"Interrupting a rabbitfolk dinner is a most grievous offense. If you must do so, bring gifts for the little ones, or bring a shield."
—*Giddy's Guide to Valley*

name: Hugs, Grisly Guardian
text: Most of his scars tell tales. A few tell jokes.

name: Mouse Trapper
text: "I'm not here to hurt you, but I will stop you from hurting others."

name: Junkblade Bruiser
text: Each scrap shed from her battle-axe is more likely to end up stored permanently in an enemy's skull.

name: Lilysplash Mentor
text: "Splashy entrances are my specialty. And they can be yours too. Try again!"

name: Mind Drill Assailant
text: "If only you kept your secrets somewhere more secure than your delicate little skull."

name: Moonrise Cleric
text: "The sunrisers have entrusted me with their life force. I intend to repay them bountifully."

name: Plumecreed Mentor
text: "Any fledgling can flap their wings. But a true windscout must soar!"

name: Pond Prophet
text: "The rainfall brings us news of the world around us. I've learned a lot, but most of all I've learned that it's very exciting out there!"

name: Seedglaive Mentor
text: "Your riposte is good, yes. But how's your footwork?"

name: Seedpod Squire
text:
"If you think he's loud now, wait until he starts the battle song."
—Clement, pessimistic adventurer

name: Starseer Mentor
text: "Each star is given a name befitting its grandeur. This one is called Aurax, the Night-Eater. That one is called Blinky."

name: Stormcatch Mentor
text: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

name: Tempest Angler
text: "Castin' lines or castin' spells, ain't no one better than me."

name: Tidecaller Mentor
text: "The same tides that bring us knowledge can sweep us away."

name: Vinereap Mentor
text: "In youth, we reap. In death, we sow."

name: Wandertale Mentor
text: "You've all grown so much since I passed through this burrow last! Let's see, where to begin this story?"

name: Barkform Harvester
text: The farmers hide when it runs out of potatoes to harvest.

name: Bumbleflower's Sharepot
text: "I may have overestimated the portions."

name: Fountainport Bell
text: Fountainport's town crier once saved the townsfolk from predation by a rottenmouth viper with only their bell.

name: Heirloom Epic
text: "The beasts feared fire, and little else. Lily of Valley raised Cragflame and..."

name: Patchwork Banner
text: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.

name: Short Bow
text: Take heart. Take aim. Take them down.

name: Pileated Provisioner
text: Aerial supporters train for years to make sure the weapons they drop land in the hands of mice and not on their heads.

name: Three Tree Mascot
text:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—*Valley Gazetteer*, four-acorn review

name: Fabled Passage
text: Beyond Valley lies danger—and promise.

name: Rabbit Response
text: You never fight just one rabbitfolk. They bring the strength of their burrow to battle with them.

name: Uncharted Haven
text:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout

name: Repel Calamity
text: The living seasons come to grow, to burn, to wither, and to freeze. As natural as it is for the Calamity Beasts to live, it is just as natural for them to die.

name: Dawn's Truce
text: "I have a child I want to return to as well," whispered Mabel.

name: Jackdaw Savior
text:
Be the calm in the storm.
—Birdfolk saying

name: Starfall Invocation
text: The boundaries of Valley are heavily defended. Especially at night.

name: Valley Questcaller
text:
"Heroes grew as steadily as crops, and nourished our spirits."
—*Wake of the Beasts*

name: Brave-Kin Duo
text: "Did you bring everything you need for the journey?" the rabbit asked. "Of course I did! I brought you, my dear pine cone," the mouse replied.

name: Seasoned Warrenguard
text: Never underestimate what a rabbit can do with a root vegetable and some moxie.

name: Dour Port-Mage
text:
"Rations were tightly controlled."
—*Wake of the Beasts*

name: Mockingbird
text: "Don't worry, your secrets are safe with me!" the birdfolk called back in the ratfolk's own voice.

name: Shrike Force
text:
"I've trained every one of them in aerial maneuvers, talon strikes, and dive precision. They are the top of my class, and they may surpass me one day."
—Quickwing, master flyer

name: Valley Rotcaller
text: "Fighting the snake is to fight starvation itself. Strikes synchronize with hunger pangs."

name: Manifold Mouse
text: "Oh? Do I need to repeat myself?"

name: Stormsplitter
text:
"There was a bold young otterfolk / Who sailed for parts unknown, / Ignored the words her elders spoke, / And crewed the ship alone."
—*Songs from Upstream*

name: Sonar Strike
text: Valley's midnight clerics channel the life force of other animals into blinding strikes and searing shrieks.

name: Valley Flamecaller
text:
"The same heat with which we forge weapons may also forge friendships."
—Emberheart Forge inscription

name: For the Common Good
text:
"Here's to good food, good friends, and a good life, together in our Valley."
—Lily Emberseed

name: Mistbreath Elder
text:
Where you are is temporary. What you do is forever.
—Frogfolk saying

name: Scrapshooter
text: When the woodlands are your armory, you can afford to travel light.

name: Tender Wildguide
text:
"The community banded together to revitalize the scorched earth."
—*Wake of the Beasts*

name: Valley Mightcaller
text:
"Creatures of all kinds united to patrol the outskirts."
—*Wake of the Beasts*

name: Alania, Divergent Storm
text: While the storm raged, the sage took the lightning and wove a thunderous tapestry.

name: Finneas, Ace Archer
text: "Yeah. I'm that good."

name: Starfall Invocation
text: Nothing lurks in the purity of the moon's light.

name: Thistledown Players
text:
"In hand, a sword to slay the frightful beast; in heart, these words to soothe our frightened kin."
—*Lily and the Ember Seed*

name: Valley Questcaller
