text: No battle is fought, or won, alone.

name: Byway Barterer
text: "This trinket has saved my hide more times than I can count. I couldn't possibly let it go for less than say . . . four acorns."

name: Dreamdew Entrancer
text: "Your dreams are too precious to leave to chance."

name: Fabled Passage
text: Beyond Valley lies danger—and promise.

name: Warren Elder
text: "There is strength in numbers, yes. More importantly, there is joy."

name: Shoreline Looter
text: A water skimmer's ability to sense danger in the slightest ripple makes them a prized companion for Long River trawlers.

name: Serra Redeemer
text: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Wax-Wane Witness
text: Batfolk clerics consider the cycle of light and darkness as a sacred allegory of life and death.

name: Thieving Otter
text:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

name: Flame Lash
text: "This is just my warm-up."

name: Colossification
text:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten *were* related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

name: Rabid Bite
text: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Brightblade Stoat
text: Brightblades are trained to constantly mind the sun's position, adjusting the angle of their dagger to maximize glare.

name: Bellowing Crier
text: Glarb's court can always be found repeating his disastrous visions, even when they're unwelcome.

name: Calamitous Tide
text: Zoraline turned her attention to the shore. Helga and Ral's conversation quickly faded from her mind as she watched the gigantic wave approach.

name: Daring Waverider
text: "Look what I found!"

name: Dazzling Denial
text: Maintaining brilliant plumage isn't just a statement. It's a tactic.

name: Dire Downdraft
text: Quickwing's elite flyers were more than capable of navigating ordinary storms, but Dragonhawk's storms were anything but ordinary.

name: Dour Port-Mage
text: "Find your mooring and stop clogging the shipping lanes!"

name: Knightfisher
text: His keen eyes can see the glint of scales far below the river's surface.

name: Lightshell Duo
text: "Lightning and snail as one!" cried the rat. "It's so beautiful!" the otter gasped in awe.

name: Mockingbird
text: "Laughing at you? No, no, I'm laughing *as* you!"

name: Nightwhorl Hermit
text: He etches his secrets onto the shimmering shells of mussels, saving them to share with the Great Snail.

name: Pearl of Wisdom
text: Otterfolk divers compete to bring up the biggest, purest pearls they can find. Storing elemental magic in them is a bonus.

name: Plumecreed Escort
text: "I defend Valley and its beauty. What better weapon to wield than beauty itself?"

name: Run Away Together
text: Nobody bothered to look for Libo and Pulla, because everyone knew they didn't want to be found.

name: Shore Up
text: "Is that all you've got? Put some mussel into it!"

name: Carrot Cake
text:
"Secret ingredient? What do you think?"
—Ms. Bumbleflower

name: Shoreline Looter
text: A water skimmer's ability to sense danger in the slightest ripple makes them a prized companion for Long River trawlers.

name: Skyskipper Duo
text: "I don't know how to swim!" said the bird. "That's okay! I don't know how to fly!" laughed the frog.

name: Splash Portal
text:
"Don't ask me how it works. If I stopped long enough to question it, I'd lose my legs."
—Lorb, frogfolk wizard

name: Sugar Coat
text: Some jokes have the punchline baked in.

name: Thought Shucker
text: Many rats have found their minds while lost in the mud-slicked gyre of a snail shell.

name: Waterspout Warden
text: The escape route of many a birdfolk thief has been less surefire than they'd thought.

name: Agate-Blade Assassin
text: Some lizardfolk wield the precious agate and yearn for fire. Others wield it and thirst for blood.

name: Bonebind Orator
text: A great actor can breathe new life into old material.

name: Bonecache Overseer
text: "Bring me my harvest."

name: Daggerfang Duo
text: "Should we act now or later?" the rat asked. "Both," whispered the squirrel.

name: Diresight
text: There is a fine line between predicting the future and causing it.

name: Early Winter
text: The climate changed and the world suffered.

name: Feed the Cycle
text:
Sleeping beneath the sumac
—Squirrelfolk expression meaning "death"

name: Fell
text: When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

name: Glidedive Duo
text:
"Catch the thermal!" called the bat.
"What's a thermal?!" cried the lizard.

name: Hazel's Nocturne
text: On stormy autumn days, the leaves in the trees chitter and whisper.

name: Murmuration
text: Once the crow birdfolk realized augurs were using the shapes of their murmurations for divination, they decided to have some fun with it.

name: Cut a Deal
text: The beauty of Valley is born from the differences between animalfolk, not despite them.

name: Generous Gift
text: The appearance of large beasts from faraway lands remains a debate between animalfolk communities.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The same muscles used to swing a sword can be used to feed a burrow.

name: Chart a Course
text:
"Let's go somewhere no calamity can follow."
—Otho Darkclaw, reformed river pirate

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"From the day we are born, we do our best to survive. We fight. We run. We fear. But we cannot protect ourselves from change."
—Ark, lizardfolk blacksmith

name: Blasphemous Act
text: In the early days of Valley, desperate animalfolk harnessed the power of Calamity Beasts in ways that destroyed more than defended.

name: Chaos Warp
text:
"Has anyone seen Fli-fli? Is he still out with those frogfolk wizards?"
—Illa, otterfolk scout

name: Warstorm Surge
text: No fortification, however high, can protect those who provoke the ire of the molefolk.

name: Farseek
text: For most animalfolk, Valley is a paradise. But among some adventurers, the promise of "somewhere else" is just as captivating.

name: Steelburr Champion
text: "The secret to victory is simple. Don't lose."

name: Harmonize
text: You don't need to know the words to sing along.

name: Rites of Flourishing
text: To practice synergy, many frogfolk elementalists find joy in cleansing rivers and ponds together.

name: Second Harvest
text: Not every problem is a calamity. Some things just need time to grow.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: The storm of mana thundered and crackled with unlimited possibility. It would be beautiful, if it weren't so deadly.

name: Arcane Signet
text: The dark nights of Valley hold no horrors for batfolk clerics and warriors.

name: Boros Signet
text: Carved high into stone, the signet requires all to look up at it—whether with fear or admiration.

name: Sol Ring
text: Water surges in a mysterious crater created eons ago, revered by batfolk as a nexus for the cosmos.

name: Command Tower
text: Deep in the forests of Valley, there is an ancient batfolk tower with mysterious runes etched into its structure.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"When you can't find your way home, find home where you can."
—Rho, veteran hero

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Baird, Steward of Argive
text: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

name: Blade Splicer
text: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Loran of the Third Path
text: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

name: Luminous Broodmoth
text: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Path to Exile
text: Her resentment vanished as strange, unknown lands opened up before her.

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Riot Control
text:
"Ravnicans need order. If they don't have it, we shall bring it to them."
—Isperia

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Storm of Souls
text: Devotion does not end with death.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Bident of Thassa
text: Only Kiora would dare steal the weapon of a god. Only Kiora could have succeeded.

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

name: Perplexing Test
text: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Rowdy Research
text:
"Stolen treasures can be reclaimed, but stolen knowledge is yours forever."
—Alela

name: Sphinx of Enlightenment
text: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."

name: Stolen by the Fae
text: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Triskaidekaphile
text: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

name: Nested Shambler
text: Home is where the heart was.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Plumb the Forbidden
text: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Abrade
text:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Berserkers' Onslaught
text:
"Atarka's people starve while she feasts upon the bounty of their hunts. They must conquer ever more lands just for the sake of their own subsistence."
—Arel, Unseen Whisperer

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Devilish Valet
text: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Gratuitous Violence
text: Only the Cabal could make a fight to the death more deadly.

name: Hazel of the Rootbloom
text: "May all your caches be full."

name: Swarmyard Massacre
text:
"Life and death are a cycle, and it is I who keeps it spinning."
—Decai, squirrelfolk rotmaster

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Bootleggers' Stash
text: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—Saga of the Wisdom Seeker

name: Chatterstorm
text:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: End-Raze Forerunners
text:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

name: Explore
text: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Once revered, then hunted, and now beyond memory.

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Greater Good
text:
"There's wisdom to be gained in death—whether it be one's own or someone else's."
—Jarad, Golgari Lich-Lord

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Llanowar Loamspeaker
text: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Spore Frog
text: A progenitor of tadpoles and allergies in equal measure.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

name: Squirrel Sovereign
text: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

name: Tear Asunder
text: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

name: Unnatural Growth
text: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

name: Grumgully, the Generous
text: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
text: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Poison-Tip Archer
text: "One more step and you're mine."

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Ravenous Squirrel
text:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Windgrace's Judgment
text: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Not born of nature, but deeply connected to it nonetheless.

name: Circuit Mender
text: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Ghirapur Orrery
text: This detailed model allows the edificers to examine the city from every angle.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Haywire Mite
text:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Helm of the Host
text: Forged out of flowstone for the queen of Vesuva.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Brushland
text:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Copperline Gorge
text: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Stability and volatility churn together, creating beauty and danger both.

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Haunted Mire
text: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Jungle Hollow
text: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Razorverge Thicket
text: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Seachrome Coast
text: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunscorched Divide
text: Majesty rising above the arid sweep of land, a bulwark horizon against the mundane, a divide cleaving inspiration from stagnation.

name: Thickest in the Thicket
text: No pain, no fame.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Trailtracker Scout
text: It takes great courage—and great curiosity—to tail calamity.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Viridescent Bog
text: Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.

name: Wooded Ridgeline
text: The power of long-forgotten empires still pulses in the earth of Dominaria, giving rise to strange, mana-rich pockets of growth.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Flubs, the Fool
text: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.

name: Jacked Rabbit
text: "Squash. What it is and what it does."

name: Murmuration
text: Once the crow birdfolk realized augurs were using the shapes of their murmurations for divination, they decided to have some fun with it.

name: Steelburr Champion
text: "The secret to victory is simple. Don't lose."

name: Swarmyard Massacre
text:
"Life and death are a cycle, and it is I who keeps it spinning."
—Decai, squirrelfolk rotmaster

name: Thickest in the Thicket
text: No pain, no fame.

name: Trailtracker Scout
text: It takes great courage—and great curiosity—to tail calamity.

name: Marrow-Gnawer
text: They don't follow orders. They follow him.

name: Ant Queen
text:
"She only makes the trek through Valley when she's hungry. I fear it's not just our crops she enjoys."
—Lop, rabbitfolk farmer

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"How lovely! An ambassador from outside Valley arrived today in Three Tree City. Animalfolk from all over have come to welcome them."
—Ms. Bumbleflower

name: Squirrel Mob
text: "You're already surrounded."

name: Baleful Strix
text: It came from beyond Valley. Not a calamity like the Great Maha, and not animalfolk. It was something new.

name: Jacked Rabbit
text: "Squash. What it is and what it does."

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
text: "Invite your friends! Invite your family! Invite some strangers! Tonight we feast!"

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
text: He calls forth his flock from dancing zephyrs and swirling clouds.

name: Excoriate
text: The demon had flown past the reach of Erebos's whip but not the point of the sun god's spear.

name: Kragma Butcher
text: Minotaurs go into battle hungry. The first sight of their enemies' blood sends them into a flesh-eating rage.

name: Lightning Volley
text: "We are the motes of rain that join to make the thundercloud. The power of the storm god surges through us!"

name: Pinnacle of Rage
text: Mount Sulano erupted not in magma but in anger.

name: Reckless Reveler
text:
"The gods of Theros are born of the expectations and beliefs of mortals. If I have found godhood, what does that say about their true desires?"
—Xenagos, god of revels

name: Rise to the Challenge
text: Plidius wagered that Arissa couldn't kill a chimera with her javelins alone. She proved him wrong in a way everyone could see for days to come.

name: Satyr Firedancer
text: His heart, the coal; his eye, the spark; his hand, the whirling flame.

name: Scouring Sands
text: When Purphoros cleans the ashes from his forge, entire cities vanish.

name: Searing Blood
text: Purphoros's blessing: sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane. Always ablaze.

name: Stormcaller of Keranos
text: A prayer answered by Keranos is clear for all to witness.

name: Archetype of Endurance
text: Despite its fearsome stature, it is as elusive as a shadow, circling round to stalk those who presume to hunt it.

name: Aspect of Hydra
text: "Even alone I outnumber you."

name: Charging Badger
text:
"If the hierarchies of nature were determined by ferocity alone, the badger would be lord of the beasts."
—Anthousa of Setessa

name: Culling Mark
text: Hunt without Nylea's leave and you may find yourself the next quarry.

name: Graverobber Spider
text: Cloaks woven from its webs are durable and waterproof but said to bring on nightmares.

name: Hero of Leina Tower
text: "You cannot achieve greatness if its seed has not already been planted in your heart."

name: Hunter's Prowess
text: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

name: Karametra's Favor
text: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

name: Mischief and Mayhem
text:
"The false god Xenagos treats the whole world as his rollick site. If his whims are left unchecked, Theros will be reduced to rubble and ashes."
—Elspeth

name: Mortal's Resolve
text: The Fates tried to cut her string but found the thread had turned to iron.

name: Glimpse the Sun God
text: Better to be beneath Heliod's notice than beneath his heel.

name: Pheres-Band Raiders
text: "Who can deny the call to battle when it sings in our blood?"

name: Pheres-Band Tromper
text: Trompers are the most feared warriors of the Pheres Band. Anger is their lifeblood. It sustains them and gives them purpose.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Setessan Oathsworn
text: "Setessa is not the city of my birth, but it is the place I fight for, and the place I'm willing to die for. Does that not make it my home?"

name: Setessan Starbreaker
text: "Who says you cannot touch the stars?"

name: God-Favored General
text: Someone had to be first to attack, but he was not alone for long.

name: Snake of the Golden Grove
text: Some fruits are best left ungathered.

name: Swordwise Centaur
text:
The girl who would become the Champion of the Sun hacked furiously at the practice dummy. At last she stopped, breathing heavily, and looked up at her instructor. "So much anger," said the centaur. "I will teach you the ways of war, child. But first you must make peace with yourself."
—*The Theriad*

name: Unravel the Aether
text: Thaumaturges of Theros have learned to weave their magic into the world around them, but it can be pulled apart strand by strand.

name: Great Hart
text:
The great hart stood like a statue, its hide painted gold by the dawn. The Champion laid down her weapons and stepped forward within an arm's length of the beast. The hart, sacred to Heliod and bathed in the god's own light, bowed to the Champion, marking her as the Chosen of the Sun God.
—*The Theriad*

name: Kiora's Follower
text: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

name: Reap What Is Sown
text: The strength of the people comes from the land. And the bounty of the land comes from Karametra.

name: Gorgon's Head
text:
"You slew the gorgon? Show me."
—King Igalus, last words

name: Griffin Dreamfinder
text: Some griffins are able to pluck mystic auras from the Æther that are hidden from other mortals.

name: Pillar of War
text: Just because a temple has no guards doesn't mean it's undefended.

name: Siren Song Lyre
text: A siren once tried to steal it out of jealousy but was caught by the song of its strings.

name: Springleaf Drum
text: "The music is in the drum. I simply coax it out to be heard."

name: Hero of Iroas
text: "My left has felled a cyclops. My right has slain a giant. I bring both to every fight."

name: Hold at Bay
text: It was Daeron's bravery that brought him to Odunos. But it was the magic of Meletis that brought him home.

name: Loyal Pegasus
text:
"Even if I should die in the saddle, she will not let me fall to the ground."
—Hypatia of the Winged Horse

name: Akroan Phalanx
text: Shields up, spears out, heels set, hearts firm.

name: Mortal's Ardor
text:
"Such deeds should be common fare for such as us."
—Anax, king of Akros

name: Nyxborn Shieldmate
text: In Meletis, the walls have ears. In Akros, they have blades.

name: Oreskos Sun Guide
text: "Let the humans have their pantheon. We need no gods to thrive. Even a mortal such as I can capture a part of the sun's power."

name: Plea for Guidance
text: On Theros, the dove is a symbol not of peace but of discovery. Quick wings herald the arrival of a revelation.

name: Revoke Existence
text:
"There will come a time when the gods will look at mortals and shudder."
—Uremides the philosopher

name: Silent Sentinel
text: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

name: Spirit of the Labyrinth
text: Students at the Dekatia Academy learn that being sent to study with her is a lesson in itself.

name: Sunbond
text:
"I was not chosen for my faith in the gods. Sometimes the gods must put their faith in us."
—Elspeth

name: Vanguard of Brimaz
text: "The humans and their gods never blessed me. Only the pride deserves my allegiance."

name: Akroan Skyguard
text: "Trust me. When you have earned a god's favor, you'll know."

name: Aerie Worshippers
text: They can conjure stars from a clear sky.

name: Archetype of Imagination
text:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

name: Crypsis
text: Tritons borrow the camouflage of their oceanic prey to become predators on land.

name: Deepwater Hypnotist
text:
"Watch the waves too long, and you may never look away."
—Meletian proverb

name: Divination
text: "Ask of Keranos that you may understand the stars that mark your destiny. Implore Erebos that you may accept the fate thus divulged."

name: Evanescent Intellect
text: The mind is a vessel that may be emptied like any other.

name: Archetype of Courage
text:
"It has been my experience that soldiers most fervently follow generals who lead by example."
—Elspeth

name: Floodtide Serpent
text:
"Pray to Thassa for *what*? A bigger monster to eat it? A wave that can wash it away? What then?"
—Lindos, merchant of Meletis

name: Kraken of the Straits
text: Thassa felt no need to punish the sailors for their folly in crossing the straits. The kraken would do it for her.

name: Nullify
text:
"Those who incur Thassa's anger will be swallowed whole by her waves, or torn asunder by her bident."
—Thrasios, triton hero

name: Nyxborn Triton
text:
"He is Thassa's. I could not sway him."
—Kiora

name: Retraction Helix
text: Where the geometries of the world collapse, a master of the Æther can harvest power beyond comprehending.

name: Sphinx's Disciple
text: Few dare to brave the Dakra Isles. Those who return are forever changed.

name: Sudden Storm
text: No matter how big and strong you are, the sea is bigger and stronger.

name: Thassa's Rebuff
text: To resist Thassa is to deny the rising tide.

name: Vortex Elemental
text: The sea is always hungry.

name: Whelming Wave
text:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

name: Archetype of Finality
text: She sees mortals not as they wish to be, but as what they will become.

name: Ashiok's Adept
text:
"Every nightmare is a caged bird that yearns to be set free."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

name: Dawn to Dusk
text: "The numbers of Nyxborn among us have swelled. Is this a sign of the gods' favor, or does it portend something else?"

name: Asphyxiate
text:
"Some poisons enter through the blood. Some are ingested. Some are inhaled. All ways through which mortals draw strength are paths for poison."
—Agathe, priest of Pharika

name: Bile Blight
text: Not an arrow loosed, javelin thrown, nor sword raised. None were needed.

name: Black Oak of Odunos
text: Phenax promised the newly dead souls they would be spared from Erebos. In this, he did not lie.

name: Claim of Erebos
text: Priests of Erebos give an occasional reminder to mortals who have forgotten their mortality.

name: Drown in Sorrow
text:
"The sad truth is that the whip of Erebos is long enough to wrap around all our throats."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Eye Gouge
text: One chance. One throw. One perfect hit.

name: Fate Unraveler
text:
"Never forget that the life you've built can be undone by a single loose thread."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Felhide Brawler
text: Burial rites among the Felhide minotaurs involve devouring those who fell in battle, to remove their shame from memory and to fuel the survivors' revenge.

name: Forlorn Pseudamma
text:
"More children taken. This is an evil we will track without mercy."
—Anthousa of Setessa

name: Forsaken Drifters
text: It is a terrible thing when the path of the Returned leads them back to the Underworld.

name: Gild
text: Merchants of the Underworld trade in coins of clay. Gold serves another purpose.

name: Marshmist Titan
text: A favorite of Erebos, for it has sent many to the Underworld.

name: Necrobite
text: A servant of Pharika must know countless balms that heal and soothe—and countless more that do the opposite.

name: Nyxborn Eidolon
text: A body Returned, a soul still lost.

name: Elite Skirmisher
text: Some adopted the tactics of the leonin to combat the ferocity of the minotaurs.

name: Pain Seer
text: Every twitching nerve and pulsing vein carries a message, discernible with the right tools.

name: Servant of Tymaret
text: Life is most precious to those who have already lost it.

name: Weight of the Underworld
text: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

name: Akroan Conscriptor
text: "The time to serve is now."

name: Archetype of Aggression
text:
"Did Purphoros bless Maikal because of his rage? Or did Maikal's rage blossom after he'd been blessed? Only the gods know."
—Eocles, oracle of Purphoros

name: Bolt of Keranos
text: The breakthroughs granted by Keranos, god of epiphany, can be surprisingly literal.

name: Ephara's Radiance
text:
"Civilization is the sum of Ephara's gifts."
—Olexa of the Twelve

name: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass
text:
The Champion armed herself to face the cyclops, heedless of her companions' despair. "How will you defeat it with only one spear?" asked young Althemone. The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."
—*The Theriad*

name: Epiphany Storm
text: In Meletis, certain oracles are trained to be divine lightning rods, receiving countless visions in an instant.

name: Fall of the Hammer
text: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

name: Fearsome Temper
text: Purphoros is god of creation and destruction, which makes him the most creatively destructive god in the pantheon.

name: Forgestoker Dragon
text: The Akroans fashion their helms to honor the dragons, not to protect against them, as that would be of little help.

name: Impetuous Sunchaser
text: "I will soar higher than the walls of Akros! Higher than the clouds! Higher than Heliod himself!"

name: Day of Destiny
text:
"Rise like the sun, stand like the mountain, charge like the lion, die as a hero."
—General Takeno

name: Kami of False Hope
text:
"Across the rift of battle, a bridge of gossamer. And for one moment, it holds."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: First Volley
text:
"We searched their bodies for signs of the blades that had killed them, but found nothing more than scorched flesh."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

name: Flames of the Blood Hand
text: Many ogres extracted blood oaths from the oni they summoned. Others simply extracted blood.

name: Frost Ogre
text: Mountain ogres allowed blizzards to sheathe them in ice, both to reinforce their armor and to hide their pungent musk from potential prey.

name: Frostling
text: Its bite will take off more than a toe.

name: Goblin Cohort
text: Akki shells provided good protection when downhill charging became headlong tumbling.

name: Heartless Hidetsugu
text: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

name: In the Web of War
text:
"In desperation, Konda sent warriors to parley with the ogre-magi. No one knows whether they were slaughtered at Shinka or if they even reached its bloodstained walls."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Ire of Kaminari
text:
"Thunder broke the brittle silence over the Araba. A surge of raw energy lifted the soldier's body into the air and briefly, in the heart of the flash, he saw the face of a god."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Kami of Tattered Shoji
text: It remembered all the shadows lantern-cast upon its paper wings, and sometimes those silhouettes played across its shape again, acting out silent tragedies.

name: Ishi-Ishi, Akki Crackshot
text:
"Here fell Ishi-Ishi, King of the Flaming Pebbles, Scourge of the Mountain Kami, Lover of Goats. May his shell never burn."
—Cave inscription

name: Mannichi, the Fevered Dream
text:
"Early in his reign, Konda fell ill. His head burned with fever, and he saw visions of his future. In them, he saw a spirit-child, and, in that child's eyes, a way to make his empire last forever."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Ogre Recluse
text:
"Those ogres who did not embrace oni worship were cast out, cursed, and forced into hermitage, waiting for the day the oni would come for them."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Shinka Gatekeeper
text:
"Understanding is not a virtue of the ogre. Do not seek to reason your way into Shinka Keep."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Child of Thorns
text:
"The soratami scoff at the perils of Jukai, calling the forest an 'unruly garden.' Perhaps we should send them a rose such as this."
—Dokai, Weaver of Life

name: Enshrined Memories
text:
"The race is run in the mind before the first step is taken."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Gnarled Mass
text:
"On the fifty-seventh day of the Battle of Silk, the bell again tolled in hopes of summoning mortal aid. This time, a new breed of kami rose to answer its call."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Isao, Enlightened Bushi
text:
"I do not care if he claims no allegiance in this war. Find him, Takeno."
—Lord Konda

name: Kentaro, the Smiling Cat
text: "The bonds of bushido will draw the dishonored back someday, and I will be there waiting."

name: Lifegift
text:
"Walk the world and you'll find your soul; search your soul and you'll discover the world."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Lifespinner
text:
"The husk splits like a madman's smile And mystery steps forth."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Loam Dweller
text:
"You know its mood by the plants that spring up around it. When it is placid, fields of lilies flow in its wake; when it is angry, every stem has a thorn."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

name: Kitsune Palliator
text: "Who am I to judge who is deserving and who is not? That is a question for lords, not healers."

name: Scaled Hulk
text:
"Say, what rhymes with 'run for your lives'?"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

name: Unchecked Growth
text:
"That energy was once granted to growing things. Now the kami keep it for themselves, releasing it in sudden floods that overwhelm flesh and foliage alike."
—Sakiko, Mother of Summer

name: Uproot
text:
"We arrived at the battlefield too late. *Again*. Another error on your part, and you will have to answer to me personally."
—General Takeno, letter to the imperial mapmaker

name: Mending Hands
text:
"I can staunch their blood, mend their flesh, and knit their bones. But I cannot restore their hope."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

name: Mirror Gallery
text: Only in mirrors do heroes find their equal.

name: Orb of Dreams
text:
"Behind the eyelids, a flickering flame. Beneath the dream, a flickering sorrow. Can peace find you in this sleep When all the world is tossed by war?"
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Ornate Kanzashi
text: Masako was privy to a great many of Konda's deepest secrets, and her hair was always perfect.

name: Shuko
text:
"One scratch on a wall meant safe passage, two that the target had already been raided, and three warned of a trap."
—*Weaponry of Kamigawa*

name: That Which Was Taken
text:
"This god held prisoner in human hands has put all humanity in the hands of angry gods."
—Masako the Humorless

name: Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai
text: Listen at its walls and you will hear the whispers of gods.

name: Oyobi, Who Split the Heavens
text: Her angry call split the sky. From that rift descended her champions.

name: Empty-Shrine Kannushi
text: "Crease the folds, bend the paper, turn the spirits, shield the soul."

name: Split-Tail Miko
text: "I wish there were no use for those with my talents. I wish that I could walk Kamigawa forgotten and unneeded, with no war wounds to heal and no broken bones to mend."

name: Takeno's Cavalry
text: At night he perfected his aim, shooting spiderwebs by starlight.

name: Tallowisp
text: Isolated on its little candlewick, the kami never heard of the crime that drove its comrades to war.

name: Terashi's Grasp
text:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Terashi's Verdict
text: It was as though the sky opened its eyes and found what it saw displeasing.

name: Ward of Piety
text: Reluctant to strike at the kami directly, some kitsune trained in more passive fighting techniques.

name: Yomiji, Who Bars the Way
text:
"As I died, I rejoiced. I would see my family again. But then I woke up back on the battlefield. Back in Kamigawa. Back in hell."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

name: Floodbringer
text: "Such a small thing, a drop of water . . . And yet enough of them together can flood a field, cleanse a mire, or choke a forest."

name: Heed the Mists
text: "Once, I looked to the mists for wisdom. Now I wish only for understanding."

name: Jetting Glasskite
text: The bolt struck with a flash and there was a terrible sound, as of glass shattering, but the creature was unharmed.

name: Kaijin of the Vanishing Touch
text: When it's finished, all that's left of you is a ripple on a still pond.

name: Final Judgment
text:
"The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
text: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

name: Minamo Sightbender
text: Woven from threads of the spirit world, the mistcloak rendered its wearer invisible, but quickly fell to tatters.

name: Minamo's Meddling
text: Like storm water through the segments of bamboo, the spell followed the links of magic. Then it destroyed them.

name: Phantom Wings
text: Many kami could fly, which put some warriors at a distinct disadvantage. The mages of Minamo took it upon themselves to correct that imbalance.

name: Reduce to Dreams
text:
"This world is a dream. We cling to our toys like children, but sooner or later we must learn to live without them."
—Sensei Hisoka

name: Ribbons of the Reikai
text:
"If wisdom is a river, then we cup our hands, reach in, and drink from it in sips. The kami, however, are like fish, swimming, breathing, surrounded in its presence."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Shimmering Glasskite
text: A child's whisper could crack its shell, but not even an oni's scream could penetrate it.

name: Stream of Consciousness
text:
"All things return to their beginnings. The waters that spill across the Kamitaki Falls flow to sea, only to be returned to her as the rain that joins the mighty river."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Teardrop Kami
text:
"Do not fall into the trap of thinking you understand the kami. Cannot a drop of water be dew on the meadow, a glacier's thaw, or the tear of a child?"
—Sensei Hisoka

name: Threads of Disloyalty
text:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Toils of Night and Day
text:
"The war sent Kamigawa into turmoil. Here it was spring and there winter. For some, time stood still, while for others, moments flashed past like minnows in a pond."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Heart of Light
text:
"There is a shining in the mortal heart that even the kami cannot reach."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Bile Urchin
text:
"The two youths argued and tempers flared. One youth opened his mouth to utter a vile curse, but what he spat out instead was a kami of poison and filth."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Hero's Demise
text:
"What will it say on our graves, Lord Konda? Will it say we led our world to conquer immortal forces or that we were crushed by our own arrogance? At each defeat, I wonder."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

name: Kyoki, Sanity's Eclipse
text:
"Kyoki, Eater of Minds, Corrupter of Thoughts, Bringer of Madness, Lord of Fear. Return, by our blood, and walk again."
—Ogre chant

name: Mark of the Oni
text:
"As more oni walked Kamigawa, more darkness infested its inhabitants' souls."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Nezumi Shadow-Watcher
text:
"The Okiba Gang! Night-cursed thieves and assassins! I've had enough of their meddling! Triple the guard!"
—Marrow-Gnawer

name: Ogre Marauder
text: Once freed, the oni demanded more and more sacrifices to appease them. The ogres happily obliged.

name: Psychic Spear
text:
"The wizards of Takenuma Swamp faced the horrors of humanity every day. It's no wonder they fared so well against the kami."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Scourge of Numai
text:
"Where a once-proud human city stood, only the ruins of Numai remain, deep amid rotting bamboo and plagued by oni."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Stir the Grave
text:
"Your lungs may not draw breath, but while your hands can grip a sword, you will be useful to me."
—Nighteyes, nezumi necromancer

name: Takenuma Bleeder
text: "I prefer to weave my magic through oni blood, but yours will do in a pinch."

name: Three Tragedies
text:
"As the kami passed over the village of Mita, the inhabitants relived their three most grievous tragedies. Some cried. Some raged. Some were driven to madness. But the next morning, none possessed the will to fight."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Indebted Samurai
text: "Forgive me, Saburo. I could not save you. But your blade will not rest in my hand."

name: Yukora, the Prisoner
text: It took ninety-nine monks to weave the spell that trapped Yukora. Upon the death of the ninety-nine, the spell was broken, and the demon returned to the mortal world seeking vengeance for its imprisonment.

name: Akki Blizzard-Herder
text:
"It remains unclear whether the akki shamans could in fact create storms or simply predicted them."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Akki Raider
text: Akki were very territorial, attacking and destroying any settlements that came too close to their mountain homes. The more successful their raids, the bolder they became.

name: Ashen Monstrosity
text: There was a dull thunder at the vanguard, then shocked cries in the midst of the column. Moments later, Takada, last of the rearguard, faced the kami alone.

name: Crack the Earth
text:
"As the war progressed, the destruction the kami caused became more widespread and less predictable."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Broken Fall
text:
"I think I used up all my good luck and all my bad luck in the same fall."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Cackling Fiend
text: Its windpipe is only the first to amplify its maddening laughter.

name: Catastrophe
text: Radiant's eyes flashed. "Go, then," the angel spat at Serra, "and leave this world to those who truly care."

name: Crazed Skirge
text: They are Phyrexia's couriers; the messages they carry are inscribed on their slick hides.

name: Curfew
text: ". . . But I'm not tired!"

name: Dirtcowl Wurm
text: Few of Rath's rivers follow a steady course, so many new channels are carved for them.

name: Advance Scout
text:
"The soldier's path is worn smooth by the tread of many feet—all in one direction, none returning."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Disenchant
text:
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Disruptive Student
text:
"Teferi is a problem student. Always late for class. No appreciation for constructive use of time."
—Barrin, progress report

name: Elvish Lyrist
Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Fecundity
text: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

name: Fire Ants
text: Visitors to Shiv fear the dragons, the goblins, or the viashino. Natives fear the ants.

name: Flood
text:
"A dash of cool water does wonders to clear a cluttered battlefield."
—Vibekke Ragnild, *Witches and War*

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Gorilla Warrior
text: They were formidable even before they learned the use of weapons.

name: Heat Ray
text: It's not known whether the Thran built the device to forge their wonders or to defend them.

name: Infantry Veteran
text:
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Lightning Elemental
text: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Mana Leak
text:
"The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy."
—Volrath

name: Maniacal Rage
text: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

name: Manta Riders
text:
"Water is firmament to the finned."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Master Decoy
text:
"A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Nekrataal
text:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My Betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

name: Opportunity
text:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Pincher Beetles
text:
"No fair! Since when does a bug get ta munch on *me*?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Plated Rootwalla
text:
" . . . And the third little boar built his house out of rootwalla plates . . . ."
—Skyshroud children's story

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Ray of Command
text: "Heel."

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: River Boa
text:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Argothian Elder
text:
Sharpen your ears
—Elvish expression meaning "grow wiser"

name: Rolling Thunder
text: "Such rage," thought Vhati, gazing up at the thunderhead from the *Predator*. "It is Greven's mind manifest."

name: Sadistic Glee
text:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sanctum Custodian
text: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

name: Sanctum Guardian
text: "Protect our mother in her womb."

name: Sandstorm
text: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

name: Scaled Wurm
text:
"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Seasoned Marshal
text: There are only two rules of tactics: never be without a plan, and never rely on it.

name: Seeker of Skybreak
text:
"We shun them not for their dream but for their refusal to let such a noble dream die a noble death."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Armored Pegasus
text:
"I always charge a little extra to take on a pegasus. They fly like eagles, kick like mules, and hide like hermits."
—Tahli *en*-Dal, bounty hunter

name: Sewer Rats
text:
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Shower of Sparks
text: The viashino had learned how to operate the rig through trial and error—mostly error.

name: Skyshroud Elite
text:
"Civilization is a conspiracy to disguise the mutilation of nature."
—Skyshroud elite creed

name: Soltari Foot Soldier
text:
"Children of the Ruins, raised to be warriors, know that life begins when another speaks their names."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

name: Songstitcher
text: The true names of birds are songs woven into their souls.

name: Soul Warden
text:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

name: Azure Drake
text:
Little dreamt could seem so cruel
As waiting for the wings outspread,
The jagged teeth, the burning eyes,
And dagger-claws that clench to nerves.

name: Steam Blast
text: The viashino knew of the cracked pipes but deliberately left them unmended to bolster the rig's defenses.

name: Subversion
text: Kerrick's corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.

name: Sun Clasp
text:
"And darkness shall be cast from me
For my soul resides in the Sun."
—Femeref dirge

name: Symbiosis
text: Although the elves of Argoth always considered them a nuisance, the pixies made fine allies during the war against the machines.

name: Blinking Spirit
text:
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Trumpeting Armodon
text: These are its last days. But it will not go quietly.

name: Unnerve
text:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh
'n da hurt'll disappear."
—Troll chant

name: Wall of Heat
text: At a distance, we mistook the sound for a waterfall . . . .

name: Wildfire Emissary
text:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, vizier of Amiqat

name: Wind Drake
text:
"No bird soars too high, if he soars with his own wings."
—William Blake,
*The Marriage of Heaven and Hell*

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Vedalken Humiliator
text: "And who will stop me? You?"

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Bedevil
text:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
text: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text:
"Our secrets lie in the desert beyond the Hekma. But finding them will not be your challenge; living with the knowledge will be."
—Samut, to Basri

name: Vindicate
text:
"Show them the same mercy they showed to Kroog."
—Gyvan, thopter pilot

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Etched Champion
text: Its predecessors were etched with the wisdom of ancients; its own etchings bear warnings of a future fraught with war.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Liquimetal Torque
text:
"Weaponized jewelry has a long and respected history."
—Ervos Trax

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mirrorworks
text: The faces of Geth's corpse-dredgers are disturbingly similar.

name: Kayla's Music Box
text: Kayla wondered if Urza's repair of the music box was a display of affection, or just of skill.

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Servo Schematic
text: The Consulate prizes innovation when it is dependable and replicable.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Machine God's Effigy
text: Gix ensured his most loyal followers were the first to taste Phyrexian perfection.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Nobody knew what the relic did, only that it was growing louder.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Ancient Den
text:
"Halcyon, the floating capital of the Thran. The once shining city in the clouds now lies ruined on the desert floor."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text: It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Drossforge Bridge
text: The path to ruin is forged in pain.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Goldmire Bridge
text: The path to glory is forged in ambition.

name: Great Furnace
text:
"Molten blood runs through the ruins of the forge city of Phoenon, a still-beating heart whose body rotted centuries ago."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Mistvault Bridge
text: The path to knowledge is forged in hunger.

name: Thopter Shop
text: Rushed repairs once sent a thopter back to combat with a mechanic's still-warm lunch in the gunner's seat.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Razortide Bridge
text: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: River of Tears
text:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

name: Seat of the Synod
text:
"Full of immense beauty and power, the falls at Orleason inspired the empire's greatest dreamers."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

name: Silverbluff Bridge
text: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Remote but always watching, the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Vault of Whispers
text:
"Koilos, the Thran prison-city, built to house their outcasts and dissidents. It was here that Phyrexia's influence first festered."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Rootpath Purifier
text: "Holiness is not found in a druid's words, or even the rituals of Titania's court. It is found here, in the mud, where Gaea bares her soul, unshackled by ceremony."

name: Urza's Workshop
text: Urza eventually came to understand Tocasia's lessons on clarity of purpose. Perfection became his goal, and all other matters fell away in its pursuit.

name: Digsite Engineer
text: "Dig over there, you bolthead!"

name: Indomitable Archangel
text:
"Every sword drawn to defend is an angelic blade, guided to justice by an angelic hand."
—Auriok proverb

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Tempered Steel
text:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
text: Urza poured his love, his grief, and his hatred into the Sylex, and the Multiverse shook.

name: Bident of Thassa
text: Only Kiora would dare steal the weapon of a god. Only Kiora could have succeeded.

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
text: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Filigree Attendant
text:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dextrous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: Mnemonic Sphere
text:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

name: Terisiare's Devastation
text: In the end, the war had no winner.

name: One with the Machine
text:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
text: "Impress me."

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Aeronaut Cavalry
text:
"The ground is where wars are waged, but the air is where they are won."
—Harbin, vanguard aviator

name: Kayla's Reconstruction
text: Anyone can destroy a continent. Few have the vision to rebuild one.

name: Gixian Skullflayer
text: "With every culling, we bring this world closer to *compleation*."

name: Gnawing Vermin
text:
"Everyone warns about the sand and the food, but the rats are worse than both put together!"
—Sanwell, letter to his family

name: Go for the Throat
text: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

name: Gruesome Realization
text: Mishra was gone—all that remained was a machine wearing his face.

name: Kill-Zone Acrobat
text: Her circus training proved surprisingly valuable on the battlefield.

name: Misery's Shadow
text: In the ruins of Kroog, only anguish thrived.

name: Moment of Defiance
text: "Well? What are you waiting for? Let's not keep the buzzards waiting."

name: No One Left Behind
text: Dying for the cause is overrated.

name: Lay Down Arms
text: She'll swing a blade all her life, but never again for war.

name: Overwhelming Remorse
text: Tocasia's face haunted his vision. The explosion still rung in his ears. Mishra kept running and never once looked back.

name: Painful Quandary
text: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

name: Powerstone Fracture
text:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

name: Thran Vigil
text: Glacian built his automatons to last, and last they did, beyond even the Thran themselves.

name: Thraxodemon
text: Urza and Mishra weren't the only denizens of Terisiare to covet the powerstones' energy.

name: Trench Stalker
text: It can hear a panicked heartbeat from a thousand paces away.

name: Clay Revenant
text: Tawnos built his clay statues for durability, not knowing they'd keep fighting long after the war.

name: Loran of the Third Path
text: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

name: Goring Warplow
text: Built to crush walls and wills in equal measure.

name: Transmogrant Altar
text:
"The human body—like any other machine—can be stripped for parts."
—Ashnod

name: Transmogrant's Crown
text: Fallaji soldiers hated seeing loved ones' faces among the transmogrants. Ashnod devised a solution.

name: Arms Race
text: "You want it good, fast, or cheap? You can't have all three."

name: Bitter Reunion
text: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

name: Brotherhood's End
text: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.

name: Conscripted Infantry
text: "Funny," remarked Laga to his squad. "Mishra's lackeys wear luxurious silks in their gilded palaces, while we toil in the trenches eating stale bread."

name: Loran, Disciple of History
text: Urza and Mishra may have been Tocasia's most famous students, but Loran was the true heir to her legacy.

name: Excavation Explosion
text: Urza's engineers could take weeks to dig out a powerstone. The goblins weren't so painstaking.

name: The Fall of Kroog
text: As retaliation for the Warlord's ambush at the peace summit, Mishra leveled Yotia's capital city.

name: Fallaji Chaindancer
text: She was eager to show the invading Yotians how she earned her nickname, "The Sandstorm of Tomakul."

name: Giant Cindermaw
text:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

name: Goblin Blast-Runner
text: Most goblins can light a fuse and run, but only the cleverest remember to drop the bomb.

name: Mechanized Warfare
text: First the automatons reinforced depleted squads. Then they replaced them entirely.

name: Loran's Escape
text: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run. Hope ran with her.

name: Mishra, Excavation Prodigy
text: While Urza read books, Mishra learned to read the desert itself.

name: Mishra's Domination
text: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.

name: Mishra's Onslaught
text:
"Hah. Urza has underestimated my strength yet again."
—Mishra

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: She focused her mind on the volcano's fury, and hers erupted in kind.

name: Obliterating Bolt
text: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

name: Penregon Strongbull
text: His child-lifting act was second only to his cauldron-punting routine.

name: Pyrrhic Blast
text: Only the quartermaster wept for their loss.

name: Raze to the Ground
text: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.

name: Mass Production
text:
"I need an army, not a masterpiece. Accelerate output, whatever it takes."
—Urza, notes to his engineers

name: Roc Hunter
text: "Never track the roc itself with your eyes, for it will swoop with the sun at its back and blind you. Instead, track its shadow and, when it's almost upon you, heave your javelin upward with all your might."

name: Sardian Cliffstomper
text: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.

name: Tyrant of Kher Ridges
text: In war, dragons don't see sides, just side dishes.

name: Unleash Shell
text: The new cannon's destructive power more than made up for its unpredictable blast radius.

name: Whirling Strike
text:
"I will trust desert steel in Fallaji hands over a soulless machine any day."
—Hajar, Mishra's bodyguard

name: Blitz Automaton
text: While Urza's machines favored defense, Mishra built his to end the war quickly.

name: Meticulous Excavation
text: "Remember, students, if it's glowing, humming, or whirring, don't touch it!"

name: Alloy Animist
text: "This metal belonged to Argoth before it was ripped from the ground. Now it belongs to Argoth again."

name: Argothian Opportunist
text: "Nature adapts. So should we."

name: Argothian Sprite
text:
"Make the exhaust vents smaller next time!"
—Urza, notes to his engineers

name: Audacity
text: Bravery outlives the brave.

name: Awaken the Woods
text:
"We expected the Argothians to stand their ground. We didn't expect the ground itself to stand."
—Myrel, Shield of Argive

name: Blanchwood Armor
text: Some armor is forged, some is forested.

name: Burrowing Razormaw
text:
"That's odd. I don't remember seeing plans to dig a trench near here."
—Lognell, Argivian scout

name: Citanul Stalwart
text: The endless grind of the Brothers' War had fouled Terisiare's land and blackened its skies. Argoth's defenders were determined to protect their isle from the same fate.

name: Epic Confrontation
text:
"You've let yourself grow old, and your light is dimming. Shall we talk one last time, or must I slay you now?"
—Mishra, to Urza

name: Fade from History
text: After a long hibernation, Argoth began slowly recovering from the ravages of war.

name: Fallaji Excavation
text: Few relics excited Fallaji archaeologists more than Thran powerstones, which they called "eyes of the Old Ones."

name: Fauna Shaman
text: "I call on both predators and protectors, for now is a season of war."

name: Fog of War
text: So thick was the fog on Argoth's shores that the brothers' forces passed within shouting distance of each other without realizing it.

name: Gaea's Courser
text: "Even the leaves oppose your being here. What hope have you against nature's might?"

name: Gaea's Gift
