text: When it came to fighting an army of trees, even Mishra's best generals were stumped.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Imagine being scared of pixies. Just smoosh them under your boot!"
—Kerish, Urzan mechanist

name: Gnarlroot Pallbearer
text: The flames of war consumed most of Argoth's treefolk. Vengeance consumed the rest.

name: Hoarding Recluse
text: To the spiders of Argoth, thopters were just bigger, crunchier flies.

name: Perimeter Patrol
text: The Fallaji quickly learned that the Kher Ridges held too many caves and valleys to be surveyed from the air alone.

name: Sarinth Steelseeker
text: "This metal junk is ugly, but it's got its uses."

name: Phalanx Vanguard
text: The cool, sleek automatons beside her mirrored her own iron resolve.

name: Shoot Down
text: Gwenna stayed her hand only once, to save young Harbin's life—a mistake she would never repeat.

name: Tawnos's Tinkering
text: While his master tried to surpass nature, Tawnos aimed to capture its beauty.

name: Tomakul Honor Guard
text: In the Great Desert, one law is enforced over all others: water belongs to all.

name: Wasteful Harvest
text: Once the brothers discovered the pristine island of Argoth, the war came down to who could plunder it faster.

name: Boulderbranch Golem
text:
"Artifice is not the only form of creation."
—Titania

name: Cradle Clearcutter
text: A thousand years of growth, harvested in minutes.

name: Haywire Mite
text:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Powerstone Engineer
text: "Well there's your problem—resonance leak lowering output by thirty percent. I can patch that up."

name: Rust Goliath
text:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant

name: Battery Bearer
text: She always leads the charge.

name: Deathbloom Ritualist
text: Each fallen friend was a seed of regret, eager to blossom again in Gaea's name.

name: Evangel of Synthesis
text: "Forge the future in metal and oil!"

name: Prison Sentence
text: War prisoners were ineffective political pawns, as neither brother cared enough to trade for them.

name: Fallaji Vanguard
text: "The Burnished Banner will show the Warlord that the Suwwardi Marches belong to the Fallaji!"

name: Hajar, Loyal Bodyguard
text: "I've stood by Mishra's side from the beginning. I will not abandon him now."

name: Harbin, Vanguard Aviator
text: "Yotia is my birthright, father. Let me fight for it."

name: Hero of the Dunes
text: History forgot her name but not her victories.

name: Legions to Ashes
text:
"For the love of the seven brass gods, it's a city of academics! How are they doing this?"
—Sharaman, Urzan lieutenant

name: Recommission
text: "Put your backs into it! If we don't lay claim to it, the Fallaji will!"

name: Sarinth Greatwurm
text: It felt the rumblings of war and uncoiled itself from the depths of the world.

name: Tawnos, the Toymaker
text: "Don't thank me. Thank nature for its wondrous designs!"

name: Third Path Iconoclast
text: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
text: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

name: Yotian Dissident
text: "I joined this war to protect my homeland, not to destroy someone else's."

name: Yotian Tactician
text: "Time for the Iron Alliance to remind the qadir's army how inhospitable the Sword Marches can be."

name: Recruitment Officer
text: "Every name on this list is already a hero! Will you add your own to it?"

name: Aeronaut's Wings
text: Volunteers rarely questioned why the airborne battalion always seemed to be recruiting.

name: Argivian Avenger
text: Unable to settle on just one versatile being, Urza decided to create myriad adaptable machines.

name: Energy Refractor
text:
"Raw energy contains infinite possibility."
—Urza

name: Goblin Firebomb
text:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Mine Worker
text: Following his hunger for knowledge and power from the past, Urza starved Dominaria's future.

name: Repair and Recharge
text:
"Throw the bodies out. They'll just weigh down the frame."
—Rolf, Argivian mechanic

name: Portal to Phyrexia
text: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

name: Power Plant Worker
text: Mechanical workers toiled away, tirelessly fueling the impossible.

name: Reconstructed Thopter
text: From above, the brothers noticed strange glyphs etched into the desert sand.

name: The Stasis Coffin
text: Tawnos built it to be absolutely impermeable to any force inside. Luckily it worked for any force outside as well.

name: Steel Exemplar
text: Reports differed on whether the figure was an automaton or a mage, mostly because few who saw it survived.

name: Stone Retrieval Unit
text: Automatons could be rebuilt. Powerstones could not.

name: Siege Veteran
text: "Steady, recruit. We fight in the light of justice. We cast no shadow."

name: Supply Drop
text: New armaments, fresh provisions, and best of all, dry socks.

name: Swiftgear Drake
text: Inspired by fishing raptors, Tawnos designed the drake's talons to seize prey with overwhelming speed and precision.

name: Symmetry Matrix
text:
"Achieving perfection is simple. Watch, I'll do it twice."
—Mishra

name: Tower Worker
text: Even Urza's most mundane creations shared his obsession with perfection.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Brushland
text:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Soul Partition
text: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"There's a certain beauty in destruction. Some will consider this war a masterpiece."
—Ashnod

name: Hall of Tagsin
text: The Thran's machines were not dead after all, merely dormant . . . and waiting.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Tocasia's Dig Site
text: Sent by their noble parents to toughen up and learn something of the world's past, Urza and Mishra instead uncovered Terisiare's future.

name: Underground River
text:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Survivor of Korlis
text: At first, the merchant state of Korlis saw no need to involve itself in the conflict between Yotia and the Fallaji. Mishra's dragon engines changed that.

name: Rescue Retriever
text: It brings the two things weary soldiers need most: medicine and morale.

name: Thopter Architect
text: "She'll only fly once. Make it count!"

name: Mishra, Tamer of Mak Fawa
text:
"With the Brotherhood of Gix whispering in his ear, Mishra's drive to prove himself was slowly twisted into an insatiable hunger for power."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
text:
"At heart, Urza was an inventor, not a warlord. Over time, the burdens of leadership left him as cold and calculating as his mechanical creations."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Ambush Paratrooper
text: "It would be folly to fight a dragon engine head-on. Let's hit it from above."

name: Tocasia's Welcome
text: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

name: Union of the Third Path
text: Terisia City at last opened its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the endless war.

name: Warlord's Elite
text: "The Warlord thinks we've gone soft, does he? The Fist of Progress will prove him wrong!"

name: Yotian Medic
text:
"Go, save as many as you can! The city walls may be rubble, but Kroog will live on in its people."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog

name: Platoon Dispenser
text:
"Hear that thud-clank, thud-clank? We're saved."
—Ani, Urzan soldier

name: Lay Down Arms
text: She'll swing a blade all her life, but never again for war.

name: Flow of Knowledge
text:
"Focus your mind. Do you hold a piece of the ocean or a thousand drops of rain?"
—Hurkyl

name: Corrupt
text: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."

name: Sardian Cliffstomper
text: When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors for aid.

name: Blanchwood Armor
text: Some armor is forged, some is forested.

name: Calamity's Wake
text: The sylex's blast had razed the land, leaving behind only snow and sorrow. Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.

name: Air Marshal
text: "Today our blades remember Kroog! May the seven brass gods be with us!"

name: Curate
text: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to... No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."

name: Desynchronize
text: Before Kaya could pull Teferi's spirit back, the overloaded temporal anchor failed, and he was set adrift in the currents of time.

name: Drafna, Founder of Lat-Nam
text: Alongside his wife, Hurkyl, Drafna built a legacy of scholarship that endured for millennia.

name: Flow of Knowledge
text:
"Focus your mind. Do you hold a piece of the ocean or a thousand drops of rain?"
—Hurkyl

name: Deadly Riposte
text:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

name: Forging the Anchor
text: The metal turned and blossomed with Saheeli's will, each filigreed twist bringing the temporal anchor closer to completion.

name: Involuntary Cooldown
text:
"Back to the ivory towers! This won't hold for long!"
—Vayor, Third Path cryomancer

name: Keeper of the Cadence
text: "What you call magic, I call the power of memory."

name: Lat-Nam Adept
text: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."

name: Machine Over Matter
text: The Warlord decreed that only someone who could move the statue would be strong enough to marry the princess. So Urza moved it.

name: Disenchant
text: "One down, several thousand more to go."

name: Retrieval Agent
text: The humming tome burned his leather glove, nearly taking his hand along with it. Then a strange power coursed through him.

name: Scatter Ray
text: Mishra's army demanded the secrets of the Third Path. Hurkyl's followers graciously showed them.

name: Skystrike Officer
text: "Landing zone is clear. Activate and deploy!"

name: Splitting the Powerstone
text: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.

name: Stern Lesson
text:
"The brothers are brilliant, but their quarreling will be the death of me."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Take Flight
text: Though neither brother cared to admit it, flying the ancient thopter was their last happy moment together.

name: Third Path Savant
text: As Mishra's army bore down on Terisia City, Corlo felt his focus, his patience, and his willpower twine together. With a deep breath, he plucked answers from the air.

name: Thopter Mechanic
text: "You want me to install a seat belt? Please. You're lucky to get a seat!"

name: Great Desert Prospector
text: "Hello, beautiful."

name: Urza's Rebuff
text:
"As usual, my brother's maneuvers are brash and impulsive."
—Urza

name: Wing Commando
text: "The welds are weaker at the top."

name: In the Trenches
text: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."

name: Ashnod's Intervention
text: "Listen, Duck. Gix is everywhere, playing every side. Mishra won't listen . . . but perhaps Urza will."

name: Battlefield Butcher
text: "Any more giant metal monsters want to try their luck? I'm just getting warmed up!"

name: Carrion Locust
text: No honor. No glory. No leftovers.

name: Corrupt
text: "Most wise, most thoughtful, most powerful qadir," said the Gixian, "we offer whatever help we may give in your illustrious name."

name: Diabolic Intent
text: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

name: Disciples of Gix
text: "Machines feel no fear, no sorrow, no hunger—only glorious purpose, true and pure."

name: Disfigure
text: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

name: Dreams of Steel and Oil
text: Mishra's nightmares of Phyrexia rang with screams of agony and groans of twisted metal. The sounds stayed with him long after he awoke.

name: Emergency Weld
text: Scurrying repair bots quietly turned the tide of many battles, patching damaged automatons back into fighting form.

name: Fateful Handoff
text:
"Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

name: Gix's Caress
text: "Show me all the delicious misery you've sown."

name: Gixian Infiltrator
text: "Terisia City's fall is inevitable. My master's plan runs as sure and steady as the oil in my veins."

name: Gixian Puppeteer
text: To some, desecration. To Gix, decoration.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Ornithopter
text:
"Without Urza's ingenuity, the wings would never have borne weight. Without Mishra's courage, we would never have known the machine's true potential. I hope this persuades them to work together more."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Perilous Vault
text:
"As the years passed, Urza turned his focus from the Thran to worlds beyond his own, seeking any spell or technology that might break the Phyrexian scourge."
—*Urza: From Prodigy to Planeswalker*

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text:
"These skittering creatures were created to hunt the one true threat to Phyrexia: dissent."
—Venser, journal

name: Platinum Angel
text:
"Serra built angels from the spirits of fallen warriors, but I believe a more mundane power source might suffice."
—Karn

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"A rakalite core paired with a powerstone matrix has significantly increased the healing effects of my original amulet design."
—Urza, research notes

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"Perhaps drawing the impossible monster will lessen the burden my memory must bear."
—Jarsyl, diary

name: Quicksilver Amulet
text:
"If powerstones are energy stored in material form, could we store matter as energy in the same way?"
—Rayne, research notes

name: Runechanter's Pike
text:
"Harmonic resonance infusions amplify the natural abilities of the song mages of Sumifa."
—Drafna, research notes

name: Sculpting Steel
text:
"Based on his early work with primal clay, Tawnos refined the rare metals in the earth into self-assembling strands."
—*After the War*

name: Self-Assembler
text:
"Test 37: Sentience module is still too strong. It's adding ears again."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer

name: Semblance Anvil
text:
"The forges consumed all and still screamed for more."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Sigil of Valor
text:
"This war will be over quickly, so we can afford to make the medals out of gold."
—Dispatch from the Merchant Council of Korlis

name: Springleaf Drum
text:
"It is neither the species of leaf nor the thickness of branch that creates music. Gaea's song is already in the drum."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Cloud Key
text: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

name: Sundering Titan
text:
"Give the schematic to the younger brother. Tell him that it will surely keep Argoth's resources out of Urza's hands."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"Test 12: Boots now protect wearer from all hazards except blisters. Need to source better insoles."
—Development log of Willa, Yotian artificer

name: Thorn of Amethyst
text:
"The geode must be mined in moonlight and broken open by a silver hammer."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

name: Unwinding Clock
text:
"Heat from the rotating mechanism is captured and converted into energy, allowing it to operate in perpetuity."
—*Rusko's Compendium of Clockwork*

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text:
"A wish can be controlled. Dreams are far more chaotic, and ungoverned by rationale."
—*Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II*

name: Defense Grid
text: It lights up the sky, beckoning enemies only to repel them.

name: Door to Nothingness
text: Only a monster could create such a door. Only a fool would open it.

name: Elsewhere Flask
text: One night Oona bottled the sky. The next night she aligned the stars and released it.

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

name: Aetherflux Reservoir
text: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.

name: Howling Mine
text: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Inspiring Statuary
text: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Journeyer's Kite
text:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Keening Stone
text: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

name: Key to the City
text: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

name: Liquimetal Coating
text:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Lodestone Golem
text:
"Somehow it warps the Æther. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Altar of Dementia
text:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

name: Mesmeric Orb
text: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

name: Millstone
text: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Mox Amber
text: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

name: Ornithopter
text: Once a year, the skies over Paliano fill with the flying machines of those who hope to be taken on as pupils by the artificer Muzzio.

name: Perilous Vault
text: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.

name: Ashnod's Altar
text:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Quicksilver Amulet
text: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

name: Runechanter's Pike
text: As sharp as its bearer's words of faith.

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Self-Assembler
text: It sees itself in all of its creations.

name: Semblance Anvil
text: Forged from what it forges.

name: Sigil of Valor
text: With each honor he earns, Gideon paves the path to his redemption.

name: Springleaf Drum
text: "The music is in the drum. I simply coax it out to be heard."

name: Sundering Titan
text:
"Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Thorn of Amethyst
text: Mined from a cave in the Dark Meanders, it shines brightest when no one is looking.

name: Unwinding Clock
text:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Aetherflux Reservoir
text:
"These estimates are conservative. Its true capacity may be far, far greater."
—Research notes, signature illegible

name: Altar of Dementia
text:
"My dreams have brought more visions from our master: an altar, exquisite and perfect. We must build it at once."
—Writings of Artonac, priest of Gix

name: Ashnod's Altar
text:
"Blood fluting needs to be deeper. Additional hooks needed for nerve rigging. Surface stippling could be coarser."
—Ashnod, design notes

name: Blackblade Reforged
text:
"Tempered in the blood of ten thousand sacrifices? Superstitious drivel."
—Mishra, note to his researchers

name: Bone Saw
text: In a world where death is always violent, cruel weapons are as common as rocks.

name: Bone Saw
text:
"When metal instruments are scarce, a saw constructed from the subject's femur will suffice for a craniectomy."
—Ashnod, research notes

name: Burnished Hart
text:
"The natural world has already solved our problems. Our challenge is to replicate the elegance of its solutions."
—Tawnos

name: Chromatic Lantern
text:
"Feldon's latest discovery appears to draw upon the same 'memories of the land' my wife studied. How I wish she could see it."
—Writings of Drafna

name: Cloud Key
text:
"A key only unlocks a door. Its wielder must choose whether to cross the threshold."
—*Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II*

name: Defense Grid
text:
"Properly installed, each powerstone emits a targeted electromagnetic field that halts momentum as sure as stone."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

name: Door to Nothingness
text:
"I have re-created a Thran portal at last! Before I inform Lord Urza, I'll test it myself."
—Oryan, Urzan artificer, final research note

name: Elsewhere Flask
text:
"My husband is clever enough to bottle the sky, and foolish enough to ignore its beauty."
—Queen Kayla bin-Kroog

name: Foundry Inspector
text:
"Delicate resonance detectors could scan the assembly lines for metallic impurities, loose bolts, and freak occurrences of sentience."
—Tawnos, proposal for overseer prototype

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The lotus is a potent but ephemeral source of power. To preserve its potency, lacquer carefully with a conductive coating."
—*Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II*

name: Howling Mine
text:
"The Sardian dwarves have let superstition override common sense. There's plenty of ore left in the mountain, and we mustn't let it go to waste."
—Last dispatch of Bolgon, Argivian surveyor

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Should a single drop take hold, the oil begins to consume organic tissue and will multiply until it overwhelms the host."
—Yawgmoth, collected writings

name: Inspiring Statuary
text:
"In the early days, Urza's wondrous automatons were seen as symbols of hope and courage."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Ivory Tower
text:
"Ringed by white stone, Terisia was a city of scholarship and knowledge, where magic promised a brighter future to a world devoured by artifice."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Jalum Tome
text:
"These glyphs describe a Thran device capable of controlling a machine army, but the dimensions make no sense. It's nearly the size of the Null Moon."
—Urza, diary

name: Journeyer's Kite
text:
"Measure the angles carefully. Note the gauge of the paper. By your sixth birthday, I expect a flying prototype."
—Tawnos, letter to Harbin

name: Keening Stone
text:
"The new prototype utilizing a rotational axis is marvelously effective: it makes me want to tear my own ears off."
—Ashnod, to her assistants

name: Key to the City
text:
"Presented to the Chief Artificer in recognition of his unparalleled service to Yotia."
—Rusted plaque

name: Liquimetal Coating
text:
"We've had a breakthrough on the fifth iteration. The subject's skin was entirely replaced within an hour, and he survived a full day after that!"
—Ashnod, to Mishra

name: Lodestone Golem
text:
"Progress update: the problem of the slagheap blocking the entrance seems to have solved itself."
—Mine supervisor's report

name: Mesmeric Orb
text:
"I now believe the strange orb was some kind of Thran security device. Supporting this theory, I can no longer recall where I found it."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Millstone
text:
"In the lean months, communities lived off a bitterwheat berry so tough that its flour contained more millstone than grain."
—*On the Early History of Keld*

name: Mind's Eye
text:
"I sit and I think of Lat-Nam, of the azure waves white with froth, suspended over the shore. I see the energy there and I call it here."
—Hurkyl, meditation notes

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"The secrets of my great-uncle's heirloom lie in the world where it was forged: the grease-stained wastes of Phyrexia."
—Jarsyl, diary

name: Mox Amber
text:
"A crystallized moment in time from the Mending Era, first discovered during the Ice Age. A temporal conundrum, even to the great scholar himself."
—*The Discoveries of Feldon*

name: Air Elemental
text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

name: Impulse
text:
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."
—Teferi

name: Killer Whale
text: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Snapping Drake
text: Drakes claim to be dragons—until the dragons show up.

name: Tolarian Winds
text: Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.

name: Vigilant Drake
text: Awake and awing in the blink of an eye.

name: Wayward Soul
text:
"no home no heart no hope"
—Stronghold graffito

name: Bone Harvest
text:
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once."
—Kaervek

name: Blizzard Elemental
text: Students who had seen Rayne argue with Urza were certain she had summoned it to make him seem warmer by comparison.

name: Coercion
text:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

name: Death Stroke
text: For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home, As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

name: Diabolic Edict
text: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

name: Fallen Angel
text:
"Angels are simply extensions of truth upon the fabric of life—and there is far more dark than light."
—Baron Sengir

name: Feral Shadow
text:
"The nightstalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."
—Kaervek

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Hollow Dogs
text: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter
Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Skittering Horror
text:
"This monstrosity will do—for now."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: Skittering Skirge
text: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

name: Tar Pit Warrior
text:
"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep."
—Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"

name: Bloodrock Cyclops
text:
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

name: Hulking Cyclops
text: Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.

name: Cloud Djinn
text:
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lowland Giant
text: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Shock
text:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

name: Sonic Burst
text: Music scythes the savage beast.

name: Talruum Minotaur
text:
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Thunderbolt
text:
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Cloud Elemental
text:
"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Viashino Warrior
text:
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins."
—Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert

name: Crash of Rhinos
text:
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way.
—Femeref adage

name: Crashing Boars
text: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

name: Deadly Insect
text: With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Plated Spider
text: Most spiders wait patiently for their prey to arrive. Most spiders aren't forty feet tall.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

name: Scaled Wurm
text:
"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Shambling Strider
text: Freyalise forbid that any stranger should wander into the striders' territory.

name: Woolly Spider
text:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Yavimaya Wurm
text: When the gorilla playfully grabbed the wurm's tail, the wurm doubled back and playfully ate the gorilla's head.

name: Diabolic Vision
text:
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Segmented Wurm
text:
"If only we could so easily leave behind those parts of ourselves that pain us."
—Crovax

name: Fog Elemental
text:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gaseous Form
text:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Giant Crab
text: During the giant crabs' mating season, Skyshroud nights are filled with the clatter of their skirmishes.

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Blood Rites
text: In war, the best leaders are open to all tactics.

name: Capricious Efreet
text: "You wish for great destruction? It is done, my master."

name: Curse of Chaos
text:
"Let them cry for mercy. The only one who can hear them is me."
—Siglind the Conqueror

name: Fissure Vent
text:
"Something down there has an appetite for what we're standing on. Let's hope it doesn't want seconds."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Furnace Celebration
text: Nothing impresses goblins more than something that's bound to kill them.

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Magus of the Arena
text: The magus still hears the roar of the crowds. They're gone, but the will to compete remains.

name: Mass Mutiny
text:
"What say you, my most trusted advisors? . . . Advisors?"
—Edra, merfolk sovereign

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Stalking Vengeance
text: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Sudden Demise
text: In the Skyfang Mountains, one misstep can mean the end of an entire clan.

name: Terra Ravager
text: It lives in the mountaintops, feeds at the mountains' feet, and kills anything it finds on the path between.

name: Tooth and Claw
text:
"You deify nature as female—kind and gentle—yet you cringe at what is natural."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: War Cadence
text: The rhythm isn't a call to arms, but a signal that the goblins have made a new enemy.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Where Ancients Tread
text:
"Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Widespread Panic
text:
"How thin is the veneer of civilization! A modest measure of panic will wash it off completely."
—Guard Erdrud of An Karras

name: Wild Ricochet
text:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

name: Witch Hunt
text: The accusations spread like hungry flames.

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Bane of Progress
text: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

name: Brooding Saurian
text:
"I have been trapped in the lizard's lair for days. It seems to regard me as its child and will not let me leave."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Curse of Predation
text:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Drumhunter
text: "I feel the vine-rhythm as my friends drive the beast to me. I will not miss my mark."

name: Elvish Skysweeper
text: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Fecundity
text: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Jade Mage
text:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Krosan Warchief
text: It turns prey into predator.

name: Mold Shambler
text: When civilization encroaches on nature, Zendikar encroaches back.

name: Night Soil
text: Some said killing the thallids only encouraged them.

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Rain of Thorns
text: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Reincarnation
text:
"You cannot imagine what eyes you may look through tomorrow."
—Aerona, elder druid

name: Restore
text:
"See, the land itself raises an altar to the ascendancy of nature."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Silklash Spider
text: By the time the spider comes to slurp up its dinner, its victims have been partially dissolved by acidic silk.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Slice in Twain
text:
"The hypocrisy of these elves is thicker than steel—destroying 'unnatural metal' with their own enchanted swords."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Spawning Grounds
text: It's the only water source in miles of desert, but the local tribes avoid it at all costs.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

name: Boros Charm
text:
"Practice compassion and mercy. But know when they must end."
—Aurelia

name: Charnelhoard Wurm
text: Jund's dragons hoard only sangrite crystals. Its wurms aren't so picky.

name: Crosis's Charm
text: A pretty bauble of persecution.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Death Grasp
text: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

name: Deepfire Elemental
text:
"There are deep, deep places in this world that have long burned hot with little regard for the whitening of the earth's thin skin."
—Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper

name: Dromar's Charm
text:
"Wisdom can be summed up in two rules: Control what you can. Eliminate what you cannot."
—Dromar, the Banisher

name: Fiery Justice
text: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate, they tried a more internal approach to depose the pretender king.

name: Filigree Angel
text: "I craved enlightenment, and Crucius's etherium opened my eyes. I would share my sight with you, but first you must believe."

name: Razor Hippogriff
text: She incubates her eggs in gold and mana.

name: Fires of Yavimaya
text: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

name: Gahiji, Honored One
text: He can stir the gentlest spirit to wild ferocity.

name: Grixis Charm
text:
"So many choices. Shall I choose loathing, hate, or malice today?"
—Eliza of the Keep

name: Hull Breach
text: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

name: Jund Charm
text: Jund pulses with raw energy, waiting for shamans to shape it into useful form.

name: Leafdrake Roost
text:
"The best experiments are those whose successes replicate themselves."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Mayael the Anima
text: The sacred Anima's eyes are blind to all but the grandest truths.

name: Aerie Mystics
text: They are cautious with their body language and facial expressions. Any stray movement could betray the positions of the troops they protect and cost many lives.

name: Serene Master
text:
"A great warrior studies many different disciplines and takes the best from each."
—Gideon Jura

name: Naya Charm
text: Deep in nature's core lies a potential unsullied by greed or civilization.

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
text: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Nivix Guildmage
text: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

name: Rakeclaw Gargantuan
text: Naya teems with gargantuans, titanic monsters to whom both nature and civilization defer.

name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
text: "Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."

name: Rubinia Soulsinger
text: "Take up the quill, and feel your future flow into the runes."

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Scarland Thrinax
text:
"There is only one way of life in Jund: feed on the weak until you are cut down by something stronger."
—Jorshu of Clan Nel Toth

name: Serra Avatar
text: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
text: The orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives in the Karplusan Mountains, gathering his dead army, intent on revenge.

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Skyward Eye Prophets
text: They lament the doom that is coming to Bant without realizing the part their own leaders have played in it.

name: Soul Manipulation
text:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Spellbreaker Behemoth
text:
"Some think its immunity to countermagic evolved because of the constant mage attacks on Naya. I think it just ate a bunch of wizards."
—Broka, drumhunter

name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
text: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Thraximundar
text: His name means "he who paints the earth red."

name: Tidehollow Strix
text: The scullers beneath Esper keep strixes as trained pets, and set them loose when a fare refuses to pay.

name: Tower Gargoyle
text:
"Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance."
—Tezzeret

name: Winged Coatl
text: The nacatl called this new species "vetli," their word for poison arrows.

name: Augury Adept
text: Moonstones grant limited foresight but unlimited advantages.

name: Divinity of Pride
text:
"She spoke of mystery and portent, of such unfathomable things that my mind screamed for pity."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Spiteful Visions
text: Knowledge brings the sting of disillusionment, but the pain teaches perspective.

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Azorius Keyrune
text:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

name: Carnage Altar
text:
"In these bloodstains I will find the fingerprints of our oppressors."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Crawlspace
text: Lord Rondor arrived for battle with sixty war elephants, ten catapults, and two hundred of his finest archers. Then he saw the battlefield . . .

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Mirari
text:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Unexpectedly Absent
text: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

name: Obelisk of Esper
text: It is a monument as austere, unyielding, and inscrutable as Esper itself.

name: Obelisk of Grixis
text: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

name: Obelisk of Jund
text: Volcanic ash-winds batter it, climbing vines overwhelm it, dragonfire roasts it, and yet it still stands as a testament to a forgotten world.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Wall of Reverence
text: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

name: Temple Bell
text: Enlightenment is not gained by striking the bell or hearing its toll. It's found in the silence that follows.

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
text: Paradoxically, to tilt the massive jug for a sip, you'd need the energy of the giant's tonic.

name: Thunderstaff
text: Jort the Thunder-Mad spent his life perfecting a way to harness the power of the heavens.

name: Tower of Fortunes
text: The ur-golem etchings begin by celebrating Mirrodin's creator, a golem of almost limitless power. They end by cursing its protector, a being called Memnarch.

name: Viseling
text: "This may hurt a lot."

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

name: Esper Panorama
text: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Arcane Melee
text: Debates between wizards are never purely academic.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Grixis Panorama
text: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Homeward Path
text:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Jund Panorama
text: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Kher Keep
text:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

name: Naya Panorama
text: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Borrowing 100,000 Arrows
text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

name: Urza's Factory
text:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Brilliant Plan
text: At Red Cliffs, Kongming and Zhou Yu each wrote his plan for defeating Wei on the palm of his hand. They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

name: Control Magic
text:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

name: Curse of Inertia
text:
"As long as I pull the strings, you will dance."
—Tezzeret

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Diviner Spirit
text: Sentience is its natural habitat.

name: Djinn of Infinite Deceits
text: The winds of change have a mind of their own.

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Jace's Archivist
text: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

name: Archangel
text: The sky rang with the cries of armored seraphs, and the darkness made a tactical retreat.

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"I'd build an entire fortress of them if I could."
—Mzali, Lighthouse archmage

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Order of Succession
text: "Long live . . . me."

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Prosperity
text:
"True riches are found in the mazes of the mind."
—Tamiyo, the Moon Sage

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Skyscribing
text:
"All clouds should be so organized."
—Isperia

name: Strategic Planning
text: "Plans evolved within the tent decide a victory 1,000 *li* away."

name: Azorius Herald
text:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

name: Thornwind Faeries
text: Guarding the ship is the Thornwinds' first concern. Getting along with the locals ranks fourth or fifth at best.

name: Tidal Force
text:
"Do not speak the name of the sea, for if it should hear you and rise up, no fortress in the world could hide you."
—Gimara of Halimar

name: Vision Skeins
text: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

name: Wash Out
text:
"It's not the darkness I fear but dull and numbing shades of gray."
—Sydri, galvanic genius

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Annihilate
text:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Cradle of Vitality
text: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.

name: Baleful Force
text:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

name: Disciple of Griselbrand
text: The demon Griselbrand dared to stand against Avacyn, earning him the loathing of thousands and the admiration of a few.

name: Endless Cockroaches
text: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

name: Famine
text:
"Better to starve to death than be bored to death."
—Liliana Vess

name: Greed
text: What is a sliver of one's soul compared to unimaginable wealth?

name: Curse of the Forsaken
text:
"Purge the damned, for they have no place among the righteous!"
—Seeta of Thraben

name: Hooded Horror
text: Insidious fear can be the undoing of the greatest of armies.

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Marrow Bats
text:
"No matter how far we push into Stensia, undeath will always remain in these lands."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Nightscape Familiar
text: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

name: Ophiomancer
text:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Phyrexian Delver
text: Because the dead have no will to resist.

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Quagmire Druid
text: As the druids had devoted their lives to preserving Dominaria, so did they devote their deaths.

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Stronghold Assassin
text: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Angel of the Dire Hour
text: She arrived like a meteorite, and the enemy fell in a shock wave of holy vengeance.

name: Call to Mind
text:
"It's hard to say which is more satisfying: the search for that missing piece or fitting that piece into place."
—Evo Ragus

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Distorting Wake
text: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Hoverguard Sweepers
text: They only appear in emergencies, and emergencies never last long.

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
text: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

name: Breaching Leviathan
text: These waters remain uncharted, but not for lack of trying.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Rush of Knowledge
text:
"Limitless power is glorious until you gain limitless understanding."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Sphinx of Magosi
text: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Turn to Frog
text: "Ribbit."

name: Abyssal Persecutor
text: His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.

name: Aether Snap
text:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

name: Annihilate
text:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Black Sun's Zenith
text:
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Bloodgift Demon
text: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Dulcet Sirens
text: What are the orders of a king or the demands of a creed next to such melodies?

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
text: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Dregs of Sorrow
text: Crovax gazed on the dead, and for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Magus of the Coffers
text: All that remains of the Cabal are the echoes in its deepest vault. Yet those who hear the echoes feel a power undiminished by the dust of ages.

name: Morkrut Banshee
text:
"Let go your grudges, or risk wandering the bogs forever in a murderous rage."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Mutilate
text:
"It's only torture if you're strong enough to survive. Otherwise, it's a simple, gruesome death. I'm happy either way."
—Liliana Vess

name: Nantuko Shade
text: In life, the nantuko study nature by revering it. In death, they study nature by disemboweling it.

name: Nekrataal
text: His victims don't have time to feel despair.

name: Pestilence Demon
text: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Reaper from the Abyss
text: "Avacyn has deserted you. I welcome your devotion in her stead."

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Skirsdag High Priest
text: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Victimize
text: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground. "It is defective. We must scrap it."

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Goblin Welder
text: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Stormsurge Kraken
text: Most see krakens as wantonly violent, failing to notice their meticulous attention to detail when dismantling a vessel.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Tuktuk the Explorer
text: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

name: Whipflare
text: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

name: Word of Seizing
text: "Obey!"

name: Collective Unconscious
text: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

name: Desert Twister
text: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

name: Drove of Elves
text: "The light of beauty protects our journeys through darkness."

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Skysweeper
text: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Essence Warden
text:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
text: The infamous Ezuri commands the highest bounty the vedalken have ever placed upon an outlaw.

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Fresh Meat
text: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

name: Grim Flowering
text:
"Nothing in nature goes to waste, not even the rotting corpse of a good-for-nothing, blood-sucking vampire."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Angelic Field Marshal
text: Her presence on the battlefield can transform an unruly mob into a disciplined army.

name: Hunting Triad
text: "Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

name: Immaculate Magistrate
text: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Praetor's Counsel
text: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Primordial Sage
text: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Silklash Spider
text: By the time the spider comes to slurp up its dinner, its victims have been partially dissolved by acidic silk.

name: Soul of the Harvest
text: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Sylvan Safekeeper
text:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Flesh Carver
text: "Just a taste?"

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

name: Titania's Chosen
text:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Whirlwind
text: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Junk Diver
text: Garbage in, treasure out.

name: Liquimetal Coating
text:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Malicious Affliction
text:
"Such an affliction appears to seek out the pure."
—Byro, plague doctor

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Predator, Flagship
text:
"The scourge of Skyshroud is airborne once more."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Ur-Golem's Eye
text: Ur-golems once dominated the plane. Even now, they maintain a deep connection to it.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Gargoyle Castle
text: Most knew of the tower's wizard and gargoyle. Few realized which was guardian and which was master.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Spoils of Blood
text:
"There are always leftovers."
—Derecht, flesh carver

name: Haunted Fengraf
text: A ghoulcaller's playground.

name: Phyrexia's Core
text:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Incite Rebellion
text: Nothing breaks the monotony like a good old-fashioned riot.

name: Scrap Mastery
text: "Where a lesser mind sees junk, I see infinite potential."

name: Tyrant's Familiar
text: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

name: Warmonger Hellkite
text: Its wings beat to the howls of war and fan the fires of rage.

name: Creeperhulk
text:
"I saw the devastation when the juggernauts crashed the walls of An Karras. Then I got to thinking."
—Janji, sylvan druid

name: Grave Sifter
text: It claws at the earth in a vain attempt to reclaim what it once was.

name: Lifeblood Hydra
text: Pharika has written her secrets on its bones so that only the worthy may discover them.

name: Siege Behemoth
text:
"Hold the line, hold the li—"
—General Srok, last words

name: Song of the Dryads
text: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text: If you hear it, it's too late.

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Wolfcaller's Howl
text:
"Knowledge is a stain that only instinct and ferocity can cleanse."
—Drarg, wolfcaller

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Crown of Doom
text: Every head it rests upon winds up severed.

name: Loreseeker's Stone
text: Mages come from far and wide to bathe in its wisdom.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Deploy to the Front
text:
"We will descend upon you like a plague of locusts to purge you from our lands!"
—Hirov, commander of the Thousand Swords

name: Adarkar Valkyrie
text: She doesn't escort the dead to the afterlife, but instead raises them to fight and die again.

name: Armistice
text:
We all must profit for peace to last.
—Mercadian saying

name: Brave the Elements
text:
"Trust me, your lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

name: Kor Sanctifiers
text: "Why keep such trinkets? They only add weight to your travels."

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Midnight Haunting
text: The path back to the world of the living is murky and bewildering. A geist may not even realize that it's terrifying its own loved ones.

name: Mobilization
text: Wars are won with strength, valor, and numbers—especially numbers.

name: Oblation
text: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

name: Requiem Angel
text: When angels despair, what hope can remain for mortals?

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Serra Avatar
text: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
text:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"The dead have it easy. They suffer no more. If breaking their rest helps the living, so be it."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: True Conviction
text: Dozens of spells known only to the Auriok elders were lost, but the next generation, galvanized by war, devised even more potent magic.

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Azure Mage
text:
"We draw our power from the infinite ocean of the mind, where all manner of things can be conceived."
—Azure creed

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Bastion Protector
text: "As long as I stand, so will your cause."

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Gigantoplasm
text:
"I appreciate things that exceed expectations."
—Mizzix

name: Thought Reflection
text: Knowledge fills the mind of a fool and opens the mind of the sage.

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Ambition's Cost
text: The waters of wisdom are as dust in the mouth of one who thirsts for power.

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

name: Blood Bairn
text: The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Fate Unraveler
text:
"Never forget that the life you've built can be undone by a single loose thread."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Gild
text: Merchants of the Underworld trade in coins of clay. Gold serves another purpose.

name: Grave Peril
text:
"Sometimes the grave does not wait for death before relishing its feast of flesh and bones."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Seal of Doom
text:
"A basilisk's gaze is effective, but disposing of physical remains is a tiresome task. It's far more discreet to dissolve one's victim entirely."
—Szadek

name: Underworld Connections
