text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Borderland Behemoth
text: Giants share nothing but their fury.

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
text: When the moon rises and the bloodlust takes hold, nothing matters but the kill.

name: Desperate Ravings
text: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

name: Synthetic Destiny
text: To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.

name: Dragon Mage
text: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fall of the Hammer
text: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Hammerfist Giant
text:
"Oh sure, they buy a lot of ale, but I always find myself needing to rebuild after the giants have paid a visit."
—Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

name: Hunted Dragon
text: The knights see a mighty quarry. The dragon sees breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Magma Giant
text: Its open mouth is a furnace blast that blisters the skin. Its smoking fists are meteors that split the earth.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Stinkdrinker Daredevil
text: Boggarts constantly strive to outdo each other with the things they bring back to the warren, each hoping the exploit will become as well-known as those of Auntie Grub.

name: Sunrise Sovereign
text: A hundred generations has he mentored, a hundred armies has he crushed beneath his feet, yet only a hundred words has he ever spoken, each more revered than a hundred books.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Thundercloud Shaman
text: He cares not for the disasters his storm brings as long as his path ahead is clear.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Word of Seizing
text: "Obey!"

name: Bane of Progress
text: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

name: Daxos's Torment
text: The terrors of the Underworld travel alongside those who return to the mortal realm.

name: Desert Twister
text: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

name: Kessig Cagebreakers
text: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Loaming Shaman
text: His work determines who is remembered and who feeds the worms.

name: Mulch
text: The land knows no difference between the graves of commoners and nobles.

name: Ohran Viper
text: The ohran viper is not cold-blooded. Its veins course with the same antigelid venom used to kill its prey.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Viridian Shaman
text: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

name: Scourge of Nel Toth
text:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

name: Viridian Zealot
text: "I will fight only the way nature intended—and nature intended us to win."

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Death Grasp
text: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

name: Thief of Blood
text: Her hunger will not be denied.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Lotleth Troll
text: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

name: Mystic Snake
text: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Steam Augury
text: Keranos is a fickle god, delivering punishment as readily as prophecy.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Underworld Coinsmith
text: Coins of the Underworld are shaped from clay funerary masks.

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Biomantic Mastery
text:
"Look beyond, to the vascular awareness that all life is a map to greater knowledge."
—Momir Vig, *Biomancy*, vol. I

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Snakeform
text: Losing his possessions distressed him, but the lack of limbs was strangely liberating.

name: Wistful Selkie
text: Selkies call to a sea they never swam, in a tongue they never spoke, with a song they never learned.

name: Boros Cluestone
text:
"In case of fire, treachery, citywide riot, political upheaval, or worldwide societal collapse, break glass."
—Cluestone inscription

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Coldsteel Heart
text: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Crystal Chimes
text: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Eldrazi Monument
text:
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Orzhov Cluestone
text: A symbol of power and wealth, the only commodities that matter to the Orzhov.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, chancellor of the Tolarian Academy

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Ancient Amphitheater
text: The arbiter Galanda Feudkiller judges Lorwyn's squabbles from a lofty perspective.

name: Meteor Blast
text:
"Behold astronomy's contribution to war."
—Fennor Rhyl, starcaller

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
text:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Pathbreaker Ibex
text:
"My skills are wasted here."
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Arjun, the Shifting Flame
text: He speaks directly into his supplicants' minds using fiery words that inflame their thoughts and incite their passions.

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
text: "Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."

name: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage
text: "Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs."

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Seal of the Guildpact
text:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Arbiter of Knollridge
text: Though giants are mortal, they live so long and on such a grand scale that many small folk don't believe they ever truly die.

name: Aura of Silence
text: Not all silences are easily broken.

name: Celestial Ancient
text:
"We thought the clouds had moved from the night sky. Then the night sky moved, and the horizon grew wings."
—Josuri

name: Dawn to Dusk
text: "The numbers of Nyxborn among us have swelled. Is this a sign of the gods' favor, or does it portend something else?"

name: Dawnglare Invoker
text:
"What we knew as Emeria, Ula, and Cosi were not divine beings at all, but a cruel trick, and a grave error."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Dictate of Heliod
text:
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?"
—Polyxene the Doubter

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Kor Sanctifiers
text: "Why keep such trinkets? They only add weight to your travels."

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

name: Monk Idealist
text: "Belief is the strongest mortar."

name: Open the Vaults
text: When the vaults are empty, everyone is rich.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Silent Sentinel
text: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Victory's Herald
text: The corruption stirred the heavens above, awaking a shining champion.

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Blatant Thievery
text: "I'll leave subtlety to the rich."

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

name: Blustersquall
text: Weather is more predictable than the Izzet.

name: Aethersnatch
text: "You were saying?"

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Dominate
text:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Jace's Archivist
text: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Vedalken Engineer
text: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Festercreep
text: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Languish
text: Life is such a fragile thing.

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Dragon Mage
text: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Curtains' Call
text:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Reforge the Soul
text: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Stalking Vengeance
text: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Trash for Treasure
text: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.

name: Magus of the Will
text: "These eyes have shown me the flaws of flesh."

name: Whipflare
text: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Burgeoning
text: The first vine shows the others where to grow.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Parting Thoughts
text:
"To spend your life seeking, only to find regret upon achieving . . . this is the most delicious irony of all."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Lurking Predators
text: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

name: Quirion Explorer
text:
Fight with a friend at your back, steel in your hands, and magic in your veins.
—Quirion creed

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rites of Flourishing
text: "Dance, and bring forth the coil! It is an umbilical to Gaea herself, fattening us with the earth's rich bounty."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Sylvok Explorer
text: Any creature on a druid's shoulder is his family, any land under his feet his home.

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text: If you hear it, it's too late.

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Wild Beastmaster
text: "When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."

name: Ankle Shanker
text: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

name: Artifact Mutation
text:
"From shards and splinters I call forth my living horde."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Frenzied Fugue
text: Forever after, she lived in fear of the madness reclaiming her.

name: Aura Mutation
text:
"Life can be found in all things, even things unnatural."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Bred for the Hunt
text: Some see the world as a place of infinite wonder and knowledge. Some see it as an infinite dinner plate.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Goblin Spymaster
text:
"Infiltrate and infuriate!"
—Goblin Espionage League motto

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Crackling Doom
text: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

name: Dauntless Escort
text: Elspeth's squires do not seek advancement. For them, no knightly glory could surpass the glory of serving their champion.

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Duneblast
text: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Filigree Angel
text: "I craved enlightenment, and Crucius's etherium opened my eyes. I would share my sight with you, but first you must believe."

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text:
"Greed, rage, and bloodlust all lead to death at the hands of those who keep their heads."
—Sergeant Eyra

name: Runehorn Hellkite
text: Inscribed with runes that predate the dragon, its horns possess their own ancient magic.

name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

name: Gwafa Hazid, Profiteer
text: "Everyone has a price."

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Horizon Chimera
text:
"Do not try to make sense of the chimera. Impossibility is its habitat."
—Kydele, prophet of Kruphix

name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
text: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Lavalanche
text: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

name: Master Biomancer
text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Nath of the Gilt-Leaf
text: A savage hunter with a prince's bearing.

name: Necrogenesis
text:
"Those may be the squirms of one life ending or of another beginning. Either way, I'd leave it alone."
—Rakka Mar

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Evolutionary Escalation
text: Survival is a constant competition from which both sides can benefit.

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Spellheart Chimera
text: Thaumaturges remain silent around chimeras, lest their words conjure even stranger beasts.

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Primeval Protector
text: The earth shook in support of their cause, offering a champion of its own.

name: Wilderness Elemental
text:
"Don't be so quick to reclaim the thawing lands. They might have acquired a taste for freedom."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Zhur-Taa Druid
text: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

name: Everlasting Torment
text: When night fell, the plane itself was scarred.

name: Mirrorweave
text:
"Those who are different are untrustworthy, unpredictable. Put your safety in the hands of your own kind."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Spitting Image
text: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Blinkmoth Urn
text: The vedalken embed such urns in their living artifact creations.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Stonehoof Chieftain
text: The pounding of his followers' hearts matched the beat of his hooves, and their voices echoed his bellows.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Empyrial Plate
text: A body clad in steel reflects a warrior's resolve.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Howling Mine
text: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Keening Stone
text: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

name: Akiri, Line-Slinger
text: Her bold movements are anchored in the careful precision of each rope.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira, sylvok outcast

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Temple Bell
text: Enlightenment is not gained by striking the bell or hearing its toll. It's found in the silence that follows.

name: Venser's Journal
text: A Planeswalker's chronicle spans worlds and civilizations, each page a lifetime.

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Homeward Path
text:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
text: "Through me, the Great Teacher's voice will rattle this world."

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus
text:
"It lives . . . IT LIVES!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix
text: She bears the greatest burden of all: that of knowing.

name: Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis
text: "Look what we fought for. Look what we built together."

name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
text: "How does one become a self-taught genius? Naturally, it requires brains."

name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
text: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

name: Sublime Exhalation
text: Exhale, and let the winds carry your soul for all eternity.

name: Armory Automaton
text: With no flesh to tire or resolve to falter, the machines soon became the Academy's preferred trainers.

name: Boompile
text:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Blazing Archon
text:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

name: Blind Obedience
text: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

name: Coastal Breach
text: The sea filled the villagers' nets until the day it cast its own.

name: Brave the Sands
text: Enduring the most desolate and dangerous conditions, Abzan sentries unfailingly guard the stronghold gates.

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Dispeller's Capsule
text:
"I find its symmetry pleasing. It rids our world of offensive refuse while disposing of itself."
—Dolomarus, Proctor of the Clean

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Hushwing Gryff
text: An overwhelming sense of calm accompanies the gryffs that wheel above the roofs of Gavony.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Oblation
text: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

name: Open the Vaults
text: When the vaults are empty, everyone is rich.

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Reverse the Sands
text: Worse than the years of aging was the burden of memory. The young monk lost his youth and gained a vicarious lifetime of hardship and woe.

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Sphere of Safety
text: The Rakdos believe that all are eager to join their revels, even when told otherwise.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Wave of Reckoning
text: We shall suffer turmoil equal to that which we have wrought, whether in this life or the next.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Chief Engineer
text: An eye for detail, a mind for numbers, a soul of clockwork.

name: Devastation Tide
text: It's hard to argue with a force made of divine will.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Grip of Phyresis
text:
"Even your blade knows who will triumph here."
—Atraxa, Praetors' Voice

name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
text: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Read the Runes
text: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

name: Swan Song
text:
"The most enlightened mages create beauty from violence."
—Medomai the Ageless

name: Alms Collector
text: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

name: Galecaster Colossus
text: Ground bones, broken glass, and splintered shipwrecks make up the sands of his shores.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Crux of Fate
text: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

name: Damnable Pact
text:
"Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Dark Impostor
text: "Ah, this is a nice life. I can see why you were so desperate to keep it."

name: Kindred Discovery
text: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
text: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Magus of the Abyss
text: He climbs a staircase of falling souls, fighting the continuous pull of the void.

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Magus of the Mind
text: "I'll show you what you truly desire."

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Underworld Connections
text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Bloodline Necromancer
text: "The veil of death hides little from our kind."

name: Rakish Heir
text: "If you're not having fun, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Tyrant's Familiar
text: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Crushing Vines
text:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Boneyard Scourge
text: Death arrives on tattered wings and stolen bones.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Hunter's Prowess
text: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

name: Jedit Ojanen of Efrava
text: The cat warriors recognized this Jedit's face, but not his fierce loyalty to Efrava.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Rain of Thorns
text: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Soul's Majesty
text: An avatar he sculpts of wisdom and strength.

name: Temur Sabertooth
text: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

name: Curse of Disturbance
text: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

name: Atarka, World Render
text:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

name: Broodmate Dragon
text: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter—and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

name: Crackling Doom
text: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

name: Crosis's Charm
text: A pretty bauble of persecution.

name: Dromoka, the Eternal
text:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Havengul Lich
text: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

name: Izzet Chronarch
text: He ensures not only whether but also when and where the lightning strikes twice.

name: Memory Plunder
text:
"Vengeance is the echo of the victim's own crime."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Mercurial Chemister
text: What some see as "distracted" is really "fathoming the unfathomable."

name: Mirari's Wake
text: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Nin, the Pain Artist
text: "Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."

name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
text: He has no patience for minds that do not inspire him or explode by trying.

name: Nivix Guildmage
text: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

name: Ojutai, Soul of Winter
text:
"When I battled Ojutai, I realized my learning had only begun."
—Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: New Blood
text:
"Now isn't that better?"
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
text: "I am the blood of the ur-dragon, coursing through all dragonkind."

name: Silumgar, the Drifting Death
text:
"No machinations, no puppet strings, no plots. Just pure, sweeping death."
—Tasigur, the Golden Fang

name: Spellbound Dragon
text: A king in Jund, a serf in Esper.

name: Stromkirk Captain
text:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Balan, Wandering Knight
text: "What weapon will you bear against one who's mastered them all?"

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Vindictive Lich
text: Heart, mind, soul—weapons all.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Fist of Suns
text:
"It is all in my grasp. Every petty dream, every grand scheme, every soul, every fear. It all flows through me and from me."
—Memnarch

name: Grappling Hook
text: Part tool, part weapon, part of the kor.

name: Hedron Archive
text: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned.""And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Hero's Blade
text: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira, sylvok outcast

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Bloodsworn Steward
text: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat ... if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Crimson Honor Guard
text: The finest soldiers aren't worth a whit without a set of hands to lead them and a set of eyes to guide them.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Cinder Barrens
text: A mudflow swallowed the lowlands years ago. All that remains are a bottomless mire and an endless rain of ash.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Elfhame Palace
text: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Grixis Panorama
text: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Kindred Charge
text: For goblins, quantity is quality.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Maze-runners who pass through the Rakdos gate leave behind their scruples and a significant amount of skin.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: The Selesnya welcome all to help them heal the city's wounds. The price, however, is devotion to the guild and a selfless belief in Trostani.

name: Stone Quarry
text: In Gavony, headstones come only from quarries that have been blessed by chaplains.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Despite the chaos of the Roil and the devastation of the Eldrazi, Zendikar is a world of breathtaking beauty.

name: Urborg Volcano
text: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

name: Curse of Vitality
text: Good health beckons many a vigorous follower.

name: Curse of Bounty
text: Flavorful aromas beckon many a salivating maw.

name: Qasali Slingers
text: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

name: Traverse the Outlands
text: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

name: Fractured Identity
text: Self-reflection is not without its perils.

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Fortunate Few
text: "... Is it over?"

name: Licia, Sanguine Tribune
text: "I give my blood, my life, all I have in exchange for victory."

name: Mathas, Fiend Seeker
text: "All will know of your crimes."

name: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami
text: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
text: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

name: Blind Obedience
text: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Divine Reckoning
text: Survival of the purest.

name: Scalelord Reckoner
text: The justice of dragons demands more than just an eye for an eye.

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

name: Leonin Arbiter
text: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

name: Leonin Shikari
text: Her instinct is as sharp as her blade.

name: Raksha Golden Cub
text: Some believe that Raksha, youngest of the kha, is the reincarnation of Dakan, the first and mightiest of leonin leaders.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Rout
text:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Spirit of the Hearth
text: Thieves know that a snarl in the night means, "Rob another house."

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Sunspear Shikari
text: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Body Double
text: "I am who I pretend to be."

name: Clone Legion
text: Their lust for battle was so great that they didn't care their enemies wore their own faces.

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Merchant of Secrets
text: To scrape out a living in Aphetto, wizards are reduced to selling rumors, lies, forgeries, or—if they get desperate enough—the truth.

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Curse of Verbosity
text: Idle chatter beckons many an attentive ear.

name: Polymorphist's Jest
text:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Serendib Sorcerer
text: "Even a dragon is humble as a kitten if it thinks itself a slave."

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
text: "So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar."

name: Apprentice Necromancer
text: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Loyal Drake
text:
"Doves and pigeons are too subtle. When I send a message, I want it to have some teeth."
—Aeschel, royal diplomat

name: Saheeli's Artistry
text: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Telling Time
text: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

name: Tidings
text:
"Though the letter was many pages long, I could tell all I needed to know from one look at the messenger's face."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Treasure Hunt
text:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Whitewater Naiads
text: Stand against the crash of the river's rapids and you will know the power of the naiads.

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Moonlight Bargain
text: At every fifth full moon, the Moon Market convenes to peddle Ravnica's most forbidden wares.

name: Phyrexian Delver
text: Because the dead have no will to resist.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: He marks his territory with fire and wrath, etching the mountainside with his charring breath.

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Aura Gnarlid
text: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

name: Vedalken Humiliator
text: "And who will stop me? You?"

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Dawn's Reflection
text: Only Sylvok magic could truly capture the perfection of a Mirrodin sunrise.

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Enchantress's Presence
text: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

name: Epic Proportions
text: From mite to mighty.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Fertile Ground
text: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Ground Seal
text:
"Let all we have buried be buried forever."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Herald of the Pantheon
text: The distinction of bearing the gods' banner is nothing compared to the glory of being closer to Nyx.

name: Hydra Omnivore
text:
"We should learn from the hydra. It never plays favorites; it devours everyone equally."
—Thrass, elder druid

name: Kruphix's Insight
text: The horizon is tantalizing in both its uncertainty and its potential.

name: Moldgraf Monstrosity
text: The border between life and death is as thin as a layer of topsoil.

name: Overgrowth
text:
"Let the forest spread! From salt, stone, and fen, let the new trees rise."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Loyal Subordinate
text: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Scute Mob
text:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Spawning Grounds
text: It's the only water source in miles of desert, but the local tribes avoid it at all costs.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Wild Growth
text: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Bant Charm
text: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

name: Charnelhoard Wurm
text: Jund's dragons hoard only sangrite crystals. Its wurms aren't so picky.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Elderwood Scion
text: The Sunbriar druids believe that every life begins in its heart and ends under its hooves.

name: Skull Storm
text: A rapid and catastrophic decline.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: High Priest of Penance
text: "All I require is faith, loyalty, obedience, trust, and complete and utter devotion."

name: Lavalanche
text: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Unflinching Courage
text: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Zendikar Incarnate
text:
"Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath. That is why Nissa is the last of the animists."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Blinkmoth Urn
text: The vedalken embed such urns in their living artifact creations.

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Empyrial Storm
text: An inspiring and glorious ascent.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Crystal Ball
text: It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Magnifying Glass
text: Knight-Inquisitors of Saint Raban delve deep into mysteries best left unexplored.

name: Enchanter's Bane
text: Those who fail to respect power will soon be consumed by it.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mirrorworks
text: The faces of Geth's corpse-dredgers are disturbingly similar.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Scuttling Doom Engine
text: A masterwork of spite, inspired by madness.

name: Seer's Lantern
text: A light to bring hope in dark times.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Unwinding Clock
text:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Foundry of the Consuls
text: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Haunted Fengraf
text: A ghoulcaller's playground.

name: Highland Lake
text:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Jund Panorama
text: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Treasure Nabber
text: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Despite the chaos of the Roil and the devastation of the Eldrazi, Zendikar is a world of breathtaking beauty.

name: Crash of Rhino Beetles
text:
"When the herd moves, so should you."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Warped Landscape
text: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Myth Unbound
text: There are precious few names that echo throughout the Multiverse.

name: Nylea's Colossus
text:
"Those who seek my protection shall receive it."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

name: Ravenous Slime
text: Death eventually wiggles toward us all.

name: Turntimber Sower
text: "Zendikar's wounds can be healed."

name: Whiptongue Hydra
text:
"Where'd all the birds go?"
—Kaldrin, jungle sightseer

name: Tawnos, Urza's Apprentice
text: "My master believes anything is achievable."

name: Thantis, the Warweaver
text: She spins a web few can resist. Its sweet aroma sparks chaos in every heart.

name: Tuvasa the Sunlit
text: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

name: Windgrace's Judgment
text: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
text: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Forge of Heroes
text: History is not delicately woven. It is hammered with fire.

name: Adarkar Valkyrie
text: She doesn't escort the dead to the afterlife, but instead raises them to fight and die again.

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: "Many must die for the one who should not have perished."

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Echo Storm
text: An organized and methodical reproduction.

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Serra Avatar
text: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Silent Sentinel
text: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

name: Unquestioned Authority
text: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Estrid's Invocation
text: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Archetype of Imagination
text:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Devastation Tide
text: It's hard to argue with a force made of divine will.

name: Dictate of Kruphix
text: "Knowledge is cruel. It will break your heart and test your allegiances. Are you certain you want this curse?"

name: Dream Cache
text:
Dreams' riches are easily spent.
—Suq'Ata adage

name: Ever-Watching Threshold
text:
"You think they know we're here?"
—Orlo, goblin raider

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Cliffside Rescuer
text: "Keep going! I'll buy you time!"

name: Mass Diminish
text: Transformed from brute to cute.

name: Asylum Visitor
text: "The ravings of the mad are laced with eldritch knowledge."

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

name: Sudden Substitution
text: "Bow before the might of—wait, what?"

name: Doomed Necromancer
text: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

name: Faith of the Devoted
text:
"The more I see of this place, the less I want to."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "We all want to know what's going on in someone else's head. I simply open it up and look."

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Murderous Compulsion
text: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Alchemist's Greeting
text:
"Impressive."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Burning Vengeance
text: Mist is the geists' sorrow. Wind is their pain. Fire is their vengeance.

name: Desperate Ravings
text: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

name: Devil's Play
text: A devil's hands are never idle.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Rolling Temblor
text: When demons open a path to your front door, it's time to move.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Colossal Majesty
text:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight
