name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Druid's Deliverance
text: "Selesnya's roots reach deep into the Worldsoul, and we will not be moved."

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Fresh Meat
text: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Giant Adephage
text:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Momentous Fall
text: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

name: Overwhelming Stampede
text:
"I trust the instincts of any beast over the advice of any human who presumes to be an expert in the art of war."
—Rinshel, elf insurgent

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Second Harvest
text:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Slice in Twain
text: The magic of the River Heralds is so great that even a single shaman can fend off a pirate landing party.

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Mire in Misery
text: Misery loves company.

name: Emmara Tandris
text: When Selesnya needed a champion, Emmara put the ranks of her guild before herself—making her the perfect choice.

name: Growing Ranks
text:
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness."
—Trostani

name: Pristine Skywise
text: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Commander's Insignia
text: At the general's triumphant return, renewed strength surged through the soldiers' ranks.

name: Sagu Mauler
text: The Sagu Jungle's thick undergrowth conceals even the largest predators—if they wish to remain hidden.

name: Secret Plans
text: Rakshasa trade in secrets, amassing wealth from their careful revelation.

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Sundering Growth
text:
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade."
—Trostani

name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
text: There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage
text: "Preachers of freedom forget that conformity can be beautiful."

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Azorius Locket
text:
"Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency."
—Dovin Baan

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Izzet Locket
text:
"Remember to discharge your locket every seven hours. Unless you prefer the spontaneous aether overload, of course."
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

name: Key to the City
text: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Rakdos Locket
text:
"This trinket will gain you admittance to some painfully exclusive gatherings."
—Exava, blood witch

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Backdraft Hellkite
text: Memories burn with the brightest flames.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Cinder Barrens
text:
"I do as I choose with what is mine. And it is all mine."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Dockside Extortionist
text: "A small price to keep such pretty things safe!"

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Foul Orchard
text: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

name: Gargoyle Castle
text: Most knew of the tower's wizard and gargoyle. Few realized which was guardian and which was master.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska

name: Ghired's Belligerence
text:
"Harmony is no longer an option."
—Ghired, Conclave exile

name: Highland Lake
text:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Hate Mirage
text: A trick of the light, though momentary, can still be deadly.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Naya Panorama
text: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Maze-runners who pass through the Rakdos gate leave behind their scruples and a significant amount of skin.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rix Maadi, Dungeon Palace
text: Even miles away, if you put your ear to the sewer vents, you can hear the screams and the tempestuous laughter.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods
text: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

name: Stone Quarry
text: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Skyfire Phoenix
text: Its fury sets the clouds alight.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Tectonic Hellion
text: Hellions measure their meals in mountains.

name: Doomed Artisan
text: "Remember me not as I am, but as I should have been."

name: Wildfire Devils
text: Devils sow grief and harvest glee.

name: Apex Altisaur
text: It brings belligerence to new heights.

name: Full Flowering
text: A swirl of light, a whisper through the leaves, and all at once the forest came to life.

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Selesnya Eulogist
text: "Let the example of the fallen inspire us all to greater courage."

name: Voice of Many
text: His words echo every roar, screech, and howl of the wilds.

name: Anje Falkenrath
text: "We all hide a little madness behind our sophistication, do we not?"

name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
text: Gerrard's final act ensured his legacy would never die.

name: Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer
text: "The only constant in life is the unknown."

name: Marisi, Breaker of the Coil
text: "Cast off the law! Awaken your rage!"

name: Pramikon, Sky Rampart
text: Its colors entrance aggressors, directing their violence.

name: Sevinne, the Chronoclasm
text: "The best moments are worth reliving."

name: Aeon Engine
text:
"Paradox? Eh, we'll worry about that yesterday."
—Edorin, the Timesmith

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Empowered Autogenerator
text: Magic, unlike physics, has no unbreakable laws.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Scaretiller
text: Fields of battle turn to fields of grain.

name: Scroll of Fate
text:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

name: Sanctum of Eternity
text: Come and rest here, beyond the constraints of space and time.

name: Song of the Worldsoul
text: "Mat'Selesnya sings out, and life flourishes in answer."

name: Desolation Twin
text:
"With precise coordination and enough blood spilled, one can be driven off, even brought down. But two . . . that's a lot of blood."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Divine Reckoning
text: Survival of the purest.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Purify the Grave
text: Some priests speak in whispers of the Helvault, a silver prison of unpurged evils.

name: Ray of Distortion
text: "Now your staff is as twisted as your soul."

name: Roc Egg
text: A thin shell lies between the roc and a world of bite-sized treats.

name: Rootborn Defenses
text: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Trostani's Judgment
text:
"Some cannot be saved as they are, but all can serve the Worldsoul."
—Trostani

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Chemister's Insight
text: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

name: Clever Impersonator
text:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Fervent Denial
text: "I prefer a reality in which you are not."

name: Jace's Sanctum
text:
"For all our lofty talk of keeping watch, we had no idea what we were getting into."
—Jace Beleren

name: Leadership Vacuum
text:
"While they scramble to fill the sudden vacancy at the top, we strike."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

name: Oona's Grace
text: Oona grants her favored subjects a dream from her own guarded heart.

name: Runic Repetition
text: "What some call obsession, I call the quest for perfection."

name: Secrets of the Dead
text:
"The veil between the living and the dead is so very thin that the whispers of the ancients can finally be heard."
—Amalric of Midvast Hall

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Spirit Cairn
text: The most beautiful souls shine even in death.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Thraben Doomsayer
text: "Swarms of the unhallowed claw at Thraben's gates! Do you still deny the end approaches?"

name: Unexpectedly Absent
text: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Chemister's Insight
text: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

name: Curator of Mysteries
text: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

name: Kelsien, the Plague
text: "Aim for an eye. Better they never see you."

name: Drake Haven
text:
"If you want to truly test your survival skills, walk the Obelisk Path when the drakes are feeding."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
text: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Lunar Mystic
text:
"I'm pleased this world has learned the moon affects more than the tides."
—Tamiyo, the Moon Sage

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: New Perspectives
text: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Swarm Intelligence
text: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
text: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

name: Windfall
text: "Rich" is a relative term.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Xathrid Necromancer
text: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Captivating Crew
text: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

name: Commune with Lava
text: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Lightning Rift
text:
"Jealous of storms, Vadrok took lightning from the sky and buried it deep under the earth. It still rumbles there, longing to escape."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Shared Animosity
text:
"It is the nature of souls that they burn more brightly together than apart."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Tectonic Reformation
text: Alone in the charred desolation of her kingdom, she regretted many things—most of all not acting sooner.

name: Titan of Eternal Fire
text: There is no gift more precious or more perilous than fire.

name: Vigilante Justice
text: It begins as a whisper and ends with the red roar of fire.

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Crop Rotation
text: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Natural Connection
text: "Zendikar will not surrender, and neither can we."

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Slice in Twain
text: The magic of the River Heralds is so great that even a single shaman can fend off a pirate landing party.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Vorapede
text:
"If you think you've killed one, guess again."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Wilderness Reclamation
text:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

name: Artifact Mutation
text:
"From shards and splinters I call forth my living horde."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Crackling Doom
text: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

name: Deathsprout
text:
"They say nothing lasts forever. I say everything lasts forever, just not in the form you may be accustomed to."
—Vraska

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Duneblast
text: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
text: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

name: Avenging Huntbonder
text: "I teach the cubs how to kill the two-legs quickly, and why it's best for the pride."

name: Mercurial Chemister
text: What some see as "distracted" is really "fathoming the unfathomable."

name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
text: As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Call the Coppercoats
text: When the alarm crystals flash, Drannith's finest answer the call.

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Villainous Wealth
text: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

name: Wydwen, the Biting Gale
text: In a world of bright, cloudless skies, she is the dark storm on the horizon.

name: Abandoned Sarcophagus
text: Although long since dead, the banished dissenters finally took their vengeance.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fluctuator
text:
"It generates power by harnessing the nature of possibility itself."
"But will it work?"
". . . Possibly."

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Silent Arbiter
text: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Flawless Maneuver
text:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Gavony Township
text:
"The protective wards of the church have weakened, and no one can tell us why. It's time to look to our own defenses."
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Hostile Desert
text: Amonkhet's desiccated land thirsts for blood.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

name: Crystalline Resonance
text:
"As a boulder diverts a stream, the crystals bend life around them."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Decoy Gambit
text:
"We'll distract them. The rest of you, get out of here!"
—Alux, Skysail defender

name: Fierce Guardianship
text:
"Hunt somewhere else. This is your only warning."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Tidal Barracuda
text: It lurks in the spaces between moments.

name: Deadly Rollick
text: Otrimi was disappointed at how quickly its new friend got tired and stopped playing.

name: Dredge the Mire
text: Fortunately, the reanimation spell just missed the long-dead colony of dung scorpions.

name: Netherborn Altar
text: It is spoken of only in whispers, visited only by the desperate.

name: Species Specialist
text: "I don't have anything against Snapdax. I'm just more of a dog person."

name: Titan Hunter
text: "Monster or human, my rate's the same."

name: Deflecting Swat
text: Archmage attacks are little more than annoyances to Kalamax.

name: Frontier Warmonger
text: She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

name: Curious Herd
text:
"If you don't break camp as you leave, you'll return to find it broken for you."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

name: Glademuse
text:
"Rage can be heard throughout the world, but wisdom comes at a whisper."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Obscuring Haze
text: Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

name: Bonder's Ornament
text:
"Found families deserve a family crest too."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Gavi, Nest Warden
text: A mother's love transcends species.

name: Nesting Grounds
text: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

name: Aerial Responder
text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: "Many must die for the one who should not have perished."

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Bounty Agent
text: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."

name: Jirina Kudro
text: "Strength is what keeps us alive. Compassion is what keeps us human."

name: Cavalry Pegasus
text:
"It is hope, hooved and winged."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Citywide Bust
text:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Dearly Departed
text:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Descend upon the Sinful
text: Above the cries, a phrase rang out: "You will all be saved."

name: Devout Chaplain
text: "By Avacyn's decree, we shall cleanse these relics of their demonic past."

name: Kalamax, the Stormsire
text: Its mood changes with the weather, and vice versa.

name: Magus of the Disk
text: Studying the journals of the necromage Nevinyrral leaves disciples gripped with the urge to exercise his draconian judgment.

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Solemn Recruit
text: "I can no longer sit in my workshop and ignore the events outside. My hammers strike for the people of Ghirapur."

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Rout
text:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Tragic Arrogance
text: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Aetherspouts
text:
"Don't worry, there's plenty for everyone."
—Vickon, Eleventh Company battlemage

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Crafty Cutpurse
text: Possession is eleven-tenths of the pirate code.

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Serum Visions
text: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

name: Swarm Intelligence
text: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
text: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Curse of Disturbance
text: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

name: Damnable Pact
text:
"Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Defiant Bloodlord
text:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Greed
text: What is a sliver of one's soul compared to unimaginable wealth?

name: Necropolis Regent
text: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

name: Digsite Engineer
text: "Dig over there, you bolthead!"

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Silversmote Ghoul
text: Being trapped between two forms of unlife is a fate worse than mere death.

name: Suffer the Past
text: Ulamog's tentacles, their touch like burning ice, rummaged through his soul and stung his memories one by one.

name: Taste of Death
text:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least. Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Apex of Power
text:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Excavation Technique
text: "Stand back. This part gets messy."

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Erratic Cyclops
text:
"The League accepts no responsibility for former members and the damage they may cause."
—Maree, Izzet chamberlain

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Quicksmith Genius
text: Quicksmiths are eager to jump from one project to the next, relying on flashes of inspiration rather than careful research.

name: Seething Song
text: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

name: Wildfire Devils
text: Devils sow grief and harvest glee.

name: Ageless Entity
text: Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Monologue Tax
text:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Nissa's Renewal
text: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
text:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Debtors' Knell
text: One moment, conscious only of a sense of repose. The next moment, hearing the trudge of his own footsteps. He sighed and squinted into the glare ahead.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
text: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

name: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage
text: "Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs."

name: Leyline Prowler
text: It feeds on the dark energies that course through the deep world—and on any other creature lured by the leyline's pull.

name: Master Biomancer
text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Primal Empathy
text: "From this day forward, we confront this world together, lifting each other up."

name: Sapling of Colfenor
text: Her plans may yet bear fruit.

name: Spitting Image
text: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

name: Commander's Insight
text: No amount of solitary studying can replace a master's tutelage.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Alhammarret's Archive
text: It contains the totality of Alhammarret's notes, theories, and ponderings.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Boros Locket
text:
"We pass these along to our fellow soldiers to recognize deeds of valor. It won't stay with you for long."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Key to the City
text: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Paradise Plume
text: A last wisp of paradise in a fallen world.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Pyromancer's Goggles
text:
"I hope to meet Jaya Ballard someday. I think we'd get along."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
text: Paradoxically, to tilt the massive jug for a sip, you'd need the energy of the giant's tonic.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Venser's Journal
text: A Planeswalker's chronicle spans worlds and civilizations, each page a lifetime.

name: Victory Chimes
text: The favored noisemaker of goblins ever since the wardens cracked down on explosives.

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Blighted Cataract
text: Once, water ran here. Now only dust and ash fall from the clifftops.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Perplexing Test
text: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
text:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
text:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

name: Phyrexia's Core
text:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text: Its courtyards are lit during every hour of the day so that night may never fall within its walls.

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Sly Instigator
text: "Me? I'm just an innocent bystander!"

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Spawning Kraken
text:
"I never imagined I'd lay eyes on a creature that makes Gyruda look small and harmless!"
—Lukka

name: Theoretical Duplication
text:
"You made it asymmetrical just to annoy me, didn't you?"
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean

name: Blight Mound
text: Pests feed on carrion, mud, and one another.

name: Bold Plagiarist
text: "I know a good idea when I see one."

name: Essence Pulse
text:
"There is nothing so invigorating and stubbornly belligerent as the pure energy of life."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

name: Incarnation Technique
text: "Draw out your fear, but don't let it control you. You're in charge now."

name: Marshland Bloodcaster
text: Blood magic is more artery than science.

name: Stinging Study
text: Silverquill first-years welcome discomfort in the classroom, knowing it will prepare them for the years ahead.

name: Veinwitch Coven
text: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

name: Inferno Project
text: Art born from such raw emotion often takes on a life of its own.

name: Blossoming Bogbeast
text:
As subtle as a bogbeast
—Witherbloom expression meaning
"crude and clumsy"

name: Guardian Augmenter
text: After years of research, he finally unlocked the formula for a perfect punch.

name: Pest Infestation
text: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

name: Sequence Engine
text:
"Reality, when broken down, is just math."
—Deekah, professor of fractal theory

name: Trudge Garden
text:
"Sure, trudges smell like soggy death, but the mushrooms on their backs are the tastiest delicacy in Sedgemoor!"
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

name: Inkshield
text: Silverquill's elite know how to offer a scathing rebuttal without uttering a word.

name: Oversimplify
text:
"A fine example of addition by subtraction."
—Deekah, professor of fractal theory

name: Reinterpret
text:
"With just a little added flair, your work could be truly spectacular. Let me show you."
—Nassari, Prismari dean

name: Revival Experiment
text: What goes into the vivipods never quite matches what comes out.

name: Wake the Past
text:
"Belong in a museum? I think we should let relics belong wherever they please!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

name: Tempting Contract
text:
"Don't think of it as debt. Think of it as an investment in yourself."
—Diriga, demon bursar

name: Witch's Clinic
text: Students from other colleges are invited to visit Witherbloom's medical facilities. Not many do.

name: Desolation Twin
text:
"With precise coordination and enough blood spilled, one can be driven off, even brought down. But two . . . that's a lot of blood."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Dispeller's Capsule
text:
"I find its symmetry pleasing. It rids our world of offensive refuse while disposing of itself."
—Dolomarus, Proctor of the Clean

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

name: Hunted Lammasu
text: The lammasu ruled the velds before the city grew. Now they roam Ravnica's skies, but their ancient enemies have not forgotten them.

name: Oblation
text: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
text: From the Roil emerged a ravenous primordial being of pure mana.

name: Bane of Progress
text: Urza's forces tore across Argoth, and Argoth responded in kind.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"The land echoes our intentions, and the kami echo the land. We must strive to live in harmony with the world even when it seems to rise against us."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Worldly Tutor
text:
"A single chord brings them to heel. A whole song, and they dance."
—Yisan, the wanderer bard

name: Sol Ring
text: Deep within the heart of the forest, a new sun flared to life.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Absolute power is the only true authority. Anything less is a lie told by the weak."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text:
"Come now, dear brother. If you wanted rules, you should have called it a *game*, not a *war*."
—Gisa, to Geralf

name: Ophiomancer
text: Her writhing, boneless movements are unsettling to humans, but hypnotic to her serpent brood.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A whisper of authority rises over a cacophony of grinding machines.

name: Reanimate
text:
"Death is a small price to pay for immortality."
—Baron Sengir

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"I am greater than rain and nourishment. I am glistening oil and perfection."
—Yawgmoth

name: Sol Ring
text: Deep within the forsaken cavern, a new shadow emerged to devour the light.

name: Command Tower
text:
"It's a bit much, I know, but it reminds my visitors who really holds the power here."
—Davriel Cane

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

name: Wandering Ones
text:
"I saw them once, when I was a child. They led me to my parents' arms when I was lost. Why have they abandoned me now? Why won't they take me home again?"
—Unnamed beggar

name: Ashen-Skin Zubera
text: When the Honden of Night's Reach began to crumble, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to haunt mortal dreams.

name: Befoul
text:
"When the rampaging kami at Reito had crushed the opposing militia, swarms of minor kami swept over the battlefield to consume all that remained."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Cursed Ronin
text: "You are fortunate, my enemy. You have paid the price but once. I never stop paying."

name: Dance of Shadows
text: "Only one man survived, barely sane. He got out two words before collapsing: shadows' shadows."

name: Deathcurse Ogre
text: After their worship of oni began, only a few of Kamigawa's ogres remained in the bitter cold of the Tendo Peaks. Most were drawn to the darkness of Takenuma.

name: Distress
text:
"Today I asked Master Dosan what the ogre mages did with the humans they sacrificed. He gave me a hard look and said to think no more on the matter."
—Meditation journal of young budoka

name: Gutwrencher Oni
text:
"Blood drips. Blood sings. Blood devours all and only blood remains."
—Ogre chant

name: Honden of Night's Reach
text: To the sorrow of all, its dark reach grasped and crushed those who guarded its silent vigil.

name: Horobi, Death's Wail
text:
"From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami. And thereafter at every battle came Horobi, Death's Wail."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Iname, Death Aspect
text: Iname revels in sadistic glee at the crushing of souls, but soon mourns the lives so cruelly cut short. So the cycle begins anew.

name: Kami of the Waning Moon
text:
"For a moment, Reito's defenders regrouped. Then wailing kami reappeared to send them scattering like flocks of frightened birds."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Kiku, Night's Flower
text:
"A wanderer has told me of an assassin in the Takenuma Swamp who uses her dark arts to animate her enemies' shadows against them. A wild tale, but it explains much."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Marrow-Gnawer
text: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

name: Midnight Covenant
text:
"Not all mortals fought the kami. The ogres revered the oni, while some humans made pacts based upon empty promises."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Nezumi Bone-Reader
text: Four generations ago, old Split-Tail stole a bundle of scrolls from the Minamo School. Soon after, the first nezumi shamans were born.

name: Nezumi Cutthroat
text:
"These nezumi, they disgust me. The things they will do for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

name: Hold the Line
text: "Forgive me, Master Kami, but in the interest of my people I must halt your advance."

name: Nezumi Ronin
text:
"Some nezumi became as skilled in the samurai arts as the humans and kitsune. Yet no lord would have them, so they sold their swords to the highest bidder."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Night of Souls' Betrayal
text:
"How can we wage war against ourselves? What happens when the kami of our very souls rise against us? I answer simply: We cannot. We die. There can be no victory in this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

name: Numai Outcast
text:
"Beware the blade of dishonor. It kills more silently than war, more quickly than age."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Painwracker Oni
text:
"Blood flows. Blood calls. Blood devours all and only blood remains."
—Ogre chant

name: Pull Under
text:
"Although nowhere on Kamigawa was safe during the war, the Takenuma Swamp was the most horrifying. The rotting bamboo itself rebelled against its mortal inhabitants, pulling them into unmarked graves."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Rag Dealer
text:
"After General Takeno found the Oathkeeper amidst the bamboo marshes, more scavengers braved the swamp's nezumi, oni, and kami in hopes of glory."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Honden of Cleansing Fire
text: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.

name: Rend Flesh
text:
"The Reito Massacre was a testament to the kami's unstoppable power. The human defenders might as well have been moths battling a forest fire."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Rend Spirit
text:
"The battle at Ganzan Pass was a testament to human endurance. The untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami, leaving more than their share of slain foes in their wake."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
text:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Swallowing Plague
text:
"We are recalling all forces from the Takenuma Swamp. We lose men daily to kami attacks, and it seems our defeats only encourage them further."
—General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda

name: Villainous Ogre
text:
"The war saw the ogres emerge from their caves, reeking of blood, with the power of oni in their veins."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Waking Nightmare
text:
"Once each year, the oni and other evil spirits paraded through villages to disturb mortals' sleep. During the war, this parade became a nightly event."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Horizon Seed
text: In peaceful times, these beings escorted the honored kami to their new shrines. In the Kami War, they became the medics of an unstoppable army.

name: Wicked Akuba
text: The sound of children weeping is a song that fills its heart with joy.

name: Akki Avalanchers
text: Among Godo's hordes, "beware of falling rocks" came to mean "akki live nearby."

name: Akki Coalflinger
text: No matter where you find them, goblins love rocks.

name: Akki Rockspeaker
text: The lava-proof shells of akki evolved over centuries, as akki pranks almost always got seriously out of hand.

name: Akki Underminer
text:
"Deep inside the Sokenzan Mountains, a band of akki discovered a cache of ancient items of power. Their ensuing spree of destruction became known as 'The Three Days of Fun.'"
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Battle-Mad Ronin
text: "I fought fiercely, bravely, and without mercy. Had I not struck down my captain in the heat of battle, I might have become a hero instead of an outcast."

name: Ben-Ben, Akki Hermit
text: Some akki thought of Ben-Ben as a kami of trickery in disguise. They hunted for him in the maze of warrens, often falling prey to his traps.

name: Blind with Anger
text:
"I can post only the most honorable and strong-willed samurai to defend your stronghold. I have seen what can happen to lesser men."
—General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda

name: Blood Rites
text:
"The threat of the kami was made worse by the blood rituals of the ogres, who freed terrifying oni to wander Kamigawa unhindered."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Crushing Pain
text: It is said that the mere touch of a kami is like embracing the sun itself.

name: Earthshaker
text: It scaled the Sokenzan Mountains in search of Kumano's secret. The mountain shook for two days, and the kami never returned.

name: Ember-Fist Zubera
text: When the Honden of Infinite Rage shattered, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to sow mortal destruction.

name: Indomitable Will
text:
"None of you are yet samurai. Defend your homes with honor, die for your cause, and perhaps then you will be worthy of the word."
—General Takeno

name: Hanabi Blast
text: The most powerful of akki fire spells were developed at the cost of blood, toil, tears, sweat, and usually a nose or two.

name: Hearth Kami
text:
"Every treachery, great or small, begets a spirit that rages at the injustice. Given the opportunity, each will return that treachery to its owner tenfold."
—Sensei Hisoka

name: Honden of Infinite Rage
text: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.

name: Kami of Fire's Roar
text:
"I can hear the shamans chanting in the hills. They say their magic will protect us from the kami, that our gold has bought our safety. But no one sleeps soundly tonight."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Reito

name: Kumano's Pupils
text:
"Long before he reluctantly joined the war, stories spread of Kumano's followers winning victories against the kami."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Lava Spike
text: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

name: Mana Seism
text:
"It is the nature of humanity not to worry about tomorrow, especially when there's a good chance they won't live to see the end of today."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Innocence Kami
text: Her voice was light, her substance music.

name: Ore Gorger
text:
"We've stumbled upon a network of caves not on our maps. We can only hope it is safe to spend the night."
—Lost Battalion, message to General Takeno

name: Pain Kami
text:
"All kami are our enemies now, A very tough lesson to learn. But it's one that's taken quickly, When you feel what it's like to burn!"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

name: Ronin Houndmaster
text: Some samurai fell so far out of grace that only dogs would keep them company.

name: Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked
text: Their dominion over dark and destructive forces twisted the oni into beings of pure malevolence.

name: Sideswipe
text: Hisoka's wizards struggled for years to master the art of redirection that came so naturally to the shamans of Ganzan Pass.

name: Sokenzan Bruiser
text:
"We camped near the Sokenzan Mountains. Though I know its inhabitants are sparse, I hear cries coming from the highest peaks every night, as if the mountains themselves bellow for vengeance."
—Lost Battalion, message to General Takeno

name: Soul of Magma
text:
"In every other mind, the battle was lost. General Takeno alone was not touched by despair. Drawing his blade, he was attack and rallying cry in one."
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
text: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the men. The kami are coming."

name: Stone Rain
text:
"The kami struck with gouts of fire, showers of rock, and the combined rage of the spirit world. Only Eiganjo Castle remained standing, glistening untouched in the sun."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Uncontrollable Anger
text: To an akki warrior, gravity is the direction of the nearest unsmashed face.

name: Unearthly Blizzard
text:
"We are trapped. The mountains and blinding kami storms have made us hopelessly lost. We are starving. In the name of all things sacred, please, send help . . . ."
—Lost Battalion, final message to General Takeno

name: Unnatural Speed
text:
"How can we hope to match the speed of lightning? The fury of storms? The power of mountains? The answer is simple. We cannot. I advise against this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

name: Kabuto Moth
text:
"Many great warriors died in the first days of the war, as the spirits of their weaponry turned against them with terrifying rage."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
text:
"He can cause a lot of pain and do it with no fuss. That's all good, but I just wish he didn't do it to us!"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
text:
"Each night as Master Dosan prays to the kami, the hate he receives in return withers his body a little more. Though the kami are slowly killing him, still he continues his prayers."
—Meditation journal of a young budoka

name: Dripping-Tongue Zubera
text: When the Honden of Life's Web was destroyed, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to ensure mortal defeat.

name: Feast of Worms
text:
"The dust beneath our feet was once part of a mighty civilization. Shall we too provide the path for a future generation?"
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Gale Force
text: Everything the kami had done, they did with more force. Gentle breezes became typhoons, rolling rivers turned to crushing rapids, and gentle growth became overnight masses of thorns and vines.

name: Kami of Ancient Law
text:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

name: Glimpse of Nature
text: Dosan sat in repose for many hours. He made no motion, no sound at all. And as he sat, nature revealed itself to him.

name: Hana Kami
text: It grew in lands lit by pride and watered by tears.

name: Heartbeat of Spring
text:
"It is true that we monks hold the key to paradise, but most don't understand that the paradise we guard is the one within."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Honden of Life's Web
text: To the sorrow of all, its web became a net that strangled those who helped weave it.

name: Humble Budoka
text: Each time wanderers entered the forest seeking enlightenment, Dosan was there, waiting for them to arrive.

name: Iname, Life Aspect
text: Iname rejoices in the dawn of a new life, but soon becomes jealous of the simple joys denied him by his station. So the cycle begins anew.

name: Joyous Respite
text:
"I have been gifted by the kami with long life. So far, they have not seen fit to withdraw their gift. There may yet be a way to stop the killing without more blood, human or kami, being spilled."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Jukai Messenger
text: Dosan's monks, deep in spiritual thought, could walk through the thickest of forests without leaving a mark, even the leaves beneath their feet unaffected by their passing.

name: Kami of the Hunt
text:
"Don't worry, Jiro. The kami would never attack us this close to home . . . . Jiro?"
—Hoto, temple guardian, last words

name: Kami of Old Stone
text:
"There was a wall here. Now it is dust. A tower rose here. Now it is fallen. An army fought here. Now it is dead. A spirit was here. It is all that remains."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Kashi-Tribe Warriors
text: The orochi and the monks had always had an unspoken agreement: live and let live. But when the kami began raging, some warrior youths began questioning that agreement.

name: Kodama of the North Tree
text:
"The monks of the North Tree rarely saw their kodama until the Kami War, when it woke like a slumbering, angry bear."
—"Poem of the Five Trees"

name: Kodama of the South Tree
text:
"The monks of the South Tree had always reveled beneath their kodama's friendly gaze. During the Kami War, this gaze became fierce and full of hate."
—"Poem of the Five Trees"

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Lure
text: Jukai Forest was known for its secrets, which drew in many wayfarers and wizards. But it was those same secrets that kept most of those seekers from ever being heard from again.

name: Moss Kami
text: Kami manifest in the form of whatever they embody in the physical plane. Some tower in the shape of moss or bark, while others take forms beyond mortal imagining.

name: Kami of the Painted Road
text: In ancient times, precepts of kami law were inscribed onto bridges as a gesture of respect. During the war, humans regarded them as warnings of where not to travel.

name: Nature's Will
text:
"Without the kami to speak to nature on our behalf, we must beg help from nature directly."
—Seshiro the Anointed

name: Order of the Sacred Bell
text: "Our bodies are weak compared to those of the kami, our knowledge limited, and our magic poor. Yet we draw breath. That alone is reason to hope."

name: Orochi Leafcaller
text: "Only orochi hatched from eggs 'touched by the kami' may become shamans. These days, there are fewer and fewer new shamans being born."

name: Orochi Ranger
text:
"The young come to me, confused. They have been taught to respect the kami, and now they must fight them? I do not know what to say."
—Sachi, to her father

name: Orochi Sustainer
text: "Nothing is the same anymore. The forests are not as lush, the waters not as pure, the air not as clear. Without the kami to direct and sustain the forces of nature, it's only a matter of time before we feel their neglect."

name: Sachi, Daughter of Seshiro
text: "The warriors deal in poison and fangs. We shamans remember why our ancestors crawled with their bellies to the earth."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Seshiro the Anointed
text: His family was the first to reach out to the human monks. He soon knew as many koans as he did blade strikes.

name: Soilshaper
text: It spoke with the voice of nature, but its words were curses spat upon humankind.

name: Strength of Cedars
text:
"No sooner had the beast collapsed under the blows of Takeno's sword than the earth rippled and the creature rose again to face him."
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

name: Time of Need
text:
"When the kumo attacked the monks' sacred shrine, a mournful toll for help echoed through the forest. Thus began the Battle of Silk, which would last six years."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Kitsune Blademaster
text: Those kitsune trained in the blade preferred to fight with a blade-catching jitte in the off hand, buying them just enough time to deliver the first deadly cut.

name: Hair-Strung Koto
text:
"The Kami War drove many members of Konda's court insane. As their spiritual world turned against them, so too did their minds turn from reality."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Honor-Worn Shaku
text: Before being presented to its lord, each shaku is blessed by every hero of every region within that lord's domain.

name: Imi Statue
text:
"Just looking at it fills me with dread . . . . Yet since it arrived, I've done little else. My blades have dulled and my business has failed, and still I cannot look away."
—Keisaku, master swordmaker

name: Jade Idol
text: Before the Kami War, the shishi were symbolic guardians, protecting the shrines where they stood. But after the kami turned on the material world, shishi began pouncing from their perches to attack would-be supplicants.

name: Journeyer's Kite
text:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Kitsune Diviner
text: She who once led prayers honoring the kami adapted to use her influence to stay them.

name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
text: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

name: Nine-Ringed Bo
text:
"We received an anonymous letter suggesting that Kumano holds a secret to defeating the kami, but he is nowhere to be found."
—General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda

name: No-Dachi
text: Not keen-edged enough for cutting armor, the no-dachi slew by folding its victim rapidly and violently under the weight of its impact.

name: Reito Lantern
text: Lanterns carved from the mystic stones of the Reito Mines were said to light the way of lost souls.

name: Eiganjo Castle
text: Since the war began, the castle's walls mark the only place on Kamigawa where no kami has ever set foot.

name: Minamo, School at Water's Edge
text: Its students graduate the school and enter history.

name: Okina, Temple to the Grandfathers
text: If a land can be said to have a heart, Okina is the heart of Kamigawa.

name: Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep
text: The glow from within looks inviting, but woe awaits whomever finds out who stokes the fire or what simmers in the pot.

name: Shizo, Death's Storehouse
text: Centuries ago, Shizo was a verdant field of wildflowers. After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

name: Untaidake, the Cloud Keeper
text: Untaidake is the needle that weaves the fabric of creation.

name: Kitsune Riftwalker
text: The wake of his passage shoved aside the influence of the kami.

name: Cage of Hands
text:
"Our own actions built the prisons that now hold us. Our hands reached too far and tried to hold too much."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Lantern Kami
text:
"Snuffing the light of a lantern without saying a small prayer is bad luck. Though its flame can only singe, its soul can repeatedly visit misery on one's house."
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Masako the Humorless
text: Konda's servants dared not neglect their duties for a moment under Masako's icy gaze, knowing that what she saw, Lord Konda would hear.

name: Mothrider Samurai
text: When the night blossoms open, the wings of Eiganjo take flight.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Quiet Purity
text:
"When the Kami of Utter Silence passes, walls lose their secrets. Scrolls lose their lessons. Tapestries lose their beauty. Where there was meaning, there is only stillness."
—Sensei Hisoka

name: Call to Glory
text:
"General Takeno glared at us as if we were the enemy. 'The day is not over yet,' he shouted, 'and unless you have a nezumi's heart, you *will* stand and fight!'"
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

name: Reciprocate
text:
"Just as the noble soul calls virtue to itself, the evil soul summons harm."
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Reverse the Sands
text: Worse than the years of aging was the burden of memory. The young monk lost his youth and gained a vicarious lifetime of hardship and woe.

name: Samurai Enforcers
text: From the moment they swore their oaths, they belonged to their lord, sword and soul.

name: Silent-Chant Zubera
text: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

name: Terashi's Cry
text:
"The sun kami is terrible to behold. When its temper flares, best seek shade and pray for forgiveness."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Vassal's Duty
text: "My life is yours, my lord. There is no greater service than to yield it for your safety."

name: Vigilance
text:
"Put a spear in a peasant's hands, and you have an expendable troop. Put a purpose in his heart, and you win a warrior."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

name: Aura of Dominion
text:
"Lies and deceit do yield results, but legitimate authority is the ultimate form of control."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Counsel of the Soratami
text: "Wisdom is not the counting of all the drops in a waterfall. Wisdom is learning why the water seeks the earth."

name: Cut the Tethers
text:
"You cannot bar the path of gods. You can only divert their journey for a while."
—Sensei Hisoka

name: Eerie Procession
text:
"Though in years past speculation was not encouraged about the strange ways of kami, now we must understand their motivations, if such is even possible to the mortal mind."
—Lady Azami

name: Eye of Nowhere
text:
"Once we prayed to the kaijin for safe voyage. Now we only pray that we can escape their gaze."
—Hayato, master sailor

name: Cleanfall
text: During the war, the rites of purification were still effective, but the kami, not the kitsune, chose what to cleanse.

name: Field of Reality
text:
"The scholars of the Minamo School understood the veil between their world and that of the kami. Moreover, they knew how to exploit it."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Floating-Dream Zubera
text: When the Honden of Seeing Winds was forgotten, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to uncover mortal secrets.

name: Graceful Adept
text:
"When you have mastered my lessons, it will seem as though the whole of the world has opened up to your mind and nothing is beyond your grasp."
—Lady Azami

name: Guardian of Solitude
text:
"It seemed an easy thing, to step into the nothingness, to fall, to die. But then, for an instant, I saw it, eyes filled with endless sorrow, and I turned back to face my pain."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Hinder
text:
"Do not react to force in kind. Turn it aside. Direct it to where it can do no harm."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

name: Hisoka, Minamo Sensei
text: "By all rights we should have perished in the Kami War. Our perseverence is a tribute to mortal ingenuity. And perhaps a few forgotten secrets found in the nick of time."

name: Hisoka's Defiance
text: "With every passing day, the kami shape our world to suit their will. I, for one, would not see them succeed."

name: Honden of Seeing Winds
text: To the sorrow of all, its winds found sin in the hearts of those who once learned from its wisdom.

name: Devoted Retainer
text: Deep within Eiganjo Castle lay the Palace of Infinite Halls, a seemingly endless network of corridors once guarded by a seemingly endless legion of samurai.

name: Kami of Twisted Reflection
text: Its form reflected humanity as it stood during the Kami War: disjointed, confused, and incomplete.

name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
