text: He loved his cities in the clouds. When he traveled to the lands below, he brought many reminders of his home.

name: Part the Veil
text: At the waterfall, the border between the humanoid and the spirit worlds was weakest. The kami moved across it with ease and at will.

name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
text: "Virtue is an inner light that can prevail in every soul."

name: Reach Through Mists
text:
"Know one part of the name, obsession begins. Know two parts, paranoia sets in. Know three parts, madness descends. Know all, and only the kami know what will become of you."
—Lady Azami

name: River Kaijin
text:
"Since the war began, fishermen don't sing to the kaijin to ask for full nets. They guard the shore with thrice-blessed spears, saving the nets for their wives to pack their belongings and leave."
—Hayato, master sailor

name: Sire of the Storm
text: This storm blows gales through the dreams of men.

name: Soratami Cloudskater
text: "You hide your actions from eyes on the ground, but nothing escapes the clouds."

name: Soratami Mirror-Mage
text: "The clouds obey my whims, and you'll obey theirs."

name: Ethereal Haze
text:
"Imagine a dove flying through smoke. Does the dove injure the smoke? Does the smoke impede the dove?"
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Soratami Savant
text: "To prevent, one must first predict."

name: Soratami Seer
text: Their mirrors show two worlds: that which is and that which should be.

name: Squelch
text: Oku-Doku had gone through all the motions: the same akki cursewords, the same ingredients with their horrid stink, the same rude gestures. Yet not a person died.

name: Teller of Tales
text: Words never uttered by mortals flowed incessantly from its many mouths.

name: Thoughtbind
text:
"As the rest of the mortal world waged war, Lady Azami and her students invaded tomes of knowledge. Their search yielded spells critical in the fight."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: The Unspeakable
text: It is madness that drives men to seek forbidden knowledge, and madness has given it form.

name: Horn of Deafening
text: "A blast, an echo . . . then silence."

name: Jalum Tome
text: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystic runes.

name: Living Armor
text: Though it affords excellent protection, few don this armor. The process is uncomfortable and not easily reversed.

name: Obelisk of Undoing
text: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

name: Rakalite
text: Urza was the first to understand that the war would not be lost for lack of power, but for lack of troops.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

name: Repentant Blacksmith
text:
"For my confession they burned me with fire
And found that I was for endurance made."
—*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction required immense resources.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: War Elephant
text:
"When elephants fight it is the grass that suffers."
—Kikuyu proverb

name: Azure Drake
text: The Azure Drake would be more powerful were it not so easily distracted.

name: Boomerang
text: "O! call back yesterday, bid time return." —William Shakespeare, *King Richard the Second*

name: Fishliver Oil
text: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

name: Flash Flood
text: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.

name: Remove Soul
text: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

name: Wall of Vapor
text:
"Walls of a castle are made out of stone,/ Walls of a house out of bricks or of wood./ My walls are made out of magic alone,/ Stronger than any that ever have stood."
—Chrysoberyl Earthsdaughter, *Incantations*

name: Wall of Wonder
text: So confusing is the Wall's appearance that few of its victims even see it move.

name: Banshee
text: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

name: Bog Rats
text: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

name: Hell's Caretaker
text: You might leave here, Chenndra, should another take your place . . . .

name: Shimian Night Stalker
text:
"When churchyards yawn and hell itself breathes out/ Contagion to this world."
—William Shakespeare, *Hamlet*

name: The Fallen
text: Magic often masters those who cannot master it.

name: Blood of the Martyr
text: The willow knows what the storm does not: that the power to endure harm outlives the power to inflict it.

name: Transmutation
text:
"You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!"
—Randall Jarrell, *The Woman at the Washington Zoo*

name: Beasts of Bogardan
text: Bogardan is a land as volatile as the creatures who live there.

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Goblin Digging Team
text: "From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!" "Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

name: Goblin Shrine
text:
"I knew it weren't no ordinary pile of—you know."
—Norin the Wary

name: Mountain Yeti
text: The Yeti's single greatest asset is its unnerving ability to blend in with its surroundings.

name: Wall of Heat
text: At a distance, we mistook the sound for a waterfall . . . .

name: Wall of Opposition
text: Like so many obstacles in life, the Wall of Opposition is but an illusion, held fast by the focus and belief of the one who creates it.

name: Argothian Pixies
text: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers, the Pixies of Argoth bent their magic to more practical ends.

name: Cat Warriors
text: These stealthy felines have survived so many battles that some believe they must possess many lives.

name: Divine Offering
text: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact. The fight was getting ugly.

name: Craw Giant
text: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

name: Emerald Dragonfly
text: "Flittering, wheeling, / darting in to strike, and then / gone just as you blink." —"Dragonfly Haiku," poet unknown

name: Revelation
text: "Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek." —Ecclesiasticus 3:19

name: Scavenger Folk
text: String, weapons, wax, or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

name: Indestructible Aura
text: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.

name: Dakkon Blackblade
text:
"My power is as vast as the plains; my strength is that of mountains. Each wave that crashes upon the shore thunders like blood in my veins."
—Dakkon Blackblade, *Memoirs*

name: Marhault Elsdragon
text: Marhault Elsdragon follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

name: Ivory Guardians
text: The elite guard of the Mesa High Priests, the Ivory Guardians were created to protect the innocent and faithful.

name: Sivitri Scarzam
text: Even the brave have cause to tremble at the sight of Sivitri Scarzam. Who else has tamed Scarzam's Dragon?

name: Tobias Andrion
text: Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, Tobias Andrion is the military right arm of the empire and the figurehead of its freedom.

name: Keepers of the Faith
text: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."

name: Xira Arien
text: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

name: Ashnod's Transmogrant
text: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

name: Barl's Cage
text: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

name: Feldon's Cane
text: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

name: Fountain of Youth
text: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

name: Beckoning Will-o'-Wisp
text: Follow the light at your own risk.

name: Tymora's Invoker
text: "May Lady Luck smile upon you some other day, pal."

name: Winter Eladrin
text: "If you want a warm welcome, you'll have to seek it elsewhere."

name: Young Blue Dragon
text: "I see the far side of tomorrow and the lost memories of queens. What do you wish to learn?"

name: Agent of the Iron Throne
text: You give your clients what they want at a fair price. What happens after that is none of your concern.

name: Agent of the Shadow Thieves
text: Your skill, dexterity, and moral flexibility make you a valuable asset to your guild.

name: Ambition's Cost
text: "Of course it can be yours. Anything is possible, for the right price. Speaking of which . . ."

name: Armor of Shadows
text:
"What's softer than silk, stronger than steel, and quieter than thought?"
—Warlock riddle

name: Arms of Hadar
text: Burning slowly into annihilation, the elder evil Hadar grants fearsome powers to warlocks willing to help satiate its dark hunger.

name: Astarion's Thirst
text:
"Stop bleeding. It's distracting."
—Astarion, the Decadent

name: Atrocious Experiment
text: There is no line Jon Irenicus would not cross to regain his lost immortality.

name: Blood Money
text: For the patriar class, wealth is in the blood.

name: Bonecaller Cleric
text: The bell's unearthly chime slips into the ears of the dead, waking them rudely from their eternal slumber.

name: Call to the Void
text: Bhaal's mortal children carried within them a darkness that, left unchecked, would devour them all.

name: Cast Down
text:
"We simply cannot tolerate a petty thief among the servants. I'm afraid I'll have to let you go."
—Rog, steward of House Rillyn

name: Chain Devil
text: To these fiends, there's no symphony more beautiful than the melodies of rattling chains and ripping flesh.

name: Cloudkill
text: As the acrid fumes drifted through the Lower City, even the vermin ceased to stir.

name: Criminal Past
text: You've never cared much for laws or authority, especially when they get in your way.

name: Cultist of the Absolute
text: You embrace power at any cost, and if it consumes you, so be it.

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Eldritch Pact
text: The Night Serpent tasted the warlock's ambition and savored the dark hunger in her soul.

name: Crystal Dragon
text:
"Wait, it was just guarding a bunch of eggs! Where is the treasure?"
—Xalcorin the bard

name: Guildsworn Prowler
text: "Of course it's part of my plan. Who do you think started the bar fight?"

name: Mold Folk
text:
"Corpses of those slain by russet mold grow new moldies. Not the legacy most of us aspire to."
—Elminster

name: Murder
text:
"Pave your path to the throne with yet another body if you must, Sarevok. It will make your stolen godhood no less false."
—Gorion, wise mentor

name: Myrkul's Invoker
text: "Your death will make a fine tribute for the Lord of Bones."

name: Nefarious Imp
text: It listens to all of their plans and plots creative ways to turn them to ruin.

name: Cut a Deal
text:
"It's a win-win arrangement. I just happen to win the most."
—Duke Thalamra Vanthampur

name: Passageway Seer
text: "I'm certain there's a shortcut here . . ."

name: Scion of Halaster
text: Most see the Mad Mage as a deranged menace, but you recognize the genius behind his paranoia.

name: Shadowheart, Dark Justiciar
text: "Shar's will shall be done. As sure as night will fall."

name: Skullport Merchant
text: "Buy something or move along."

name: Stirge
text:
"I will never complain about mosquitos again."
—Imoen

name: Summon Undead
text: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.

name: Topaz Dragon
text: What its gaze doesn't wither, its breath surely will.

name: Underdark Explorer
text: "Keep your fancy magic. All I need is a hook and a sturdy length of rope."

name: Vrock
text:
"Don't try to bribe them. They'll take your gold *and* your liver."
—Volo's field notes

name: Zhentarim Bandit
text:
"The Zhentarim are ruthless, unscrupulous, and dishonest. But I must admit, they are effective."
—Commander Liara Portyr

name: Amethyst Dragon
text:
"At least it's a beautiful way to die."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

name: Bhaal's Invoker
text: "The Lord of Murder has freed me from the shackles of mortal laws and gifted me with fire to carry out his will."

name: Breath Weapon
text: "In the name of Tempus, Lord of Battles, you will die honorably in righteous fire."

name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
text: The essence of a red dragon burns within, always ready to rise with wrath.

name: Coronation of Chaos
text: When Sarevok's deception was unmasked, the cheering crowd erupted into an outraged mob.

name: Far Traveler
text: You have traveled to many places, over mountains and across seas, but a new journey always calls.

name: Dragon Cultist
text: You know that mighty dracoliches will one day rule over this world. For you, that day can't come soon enough.

name: Earth Tremor
text:
"Every cave-in is Moradin telling you to leave the earth where it is."
—Halgar, dwarven recluse

name: Elturel Survivors
text: They fought with the desperate courage of those who have nothing left to lose.

name: Fang Dragon
text:
"Watch out for its teeth, tail, claws, wings, back, and front."
—Olga, cavalier

name: Fireball
text: The orchard soon reeked of sulfur, smoke, and scorched bugbear, with just a hint of peach.

name: Guild Artisan
text: Your discerning eye for value makes you nearly impossible to swindle.

name: Flaming Fist
text: You carry the security of Baldur's Gate on your shoulders, and you welcome the weight of responsibility.

name: Ingenious Artillerist
text: "Sure, you can help me calibrate the aiming mechanism. Stand over there."

name: Inspired Tinkering
text: "What do you mean 'Does it work?' What an insulting question."

name: Lightning Bolt
text:
"Hasn't she heard of knocking?!"
—Snerd, Flaming Fist guard

name: Livaan, Cultist of Tiamat
text: Her hunger for power consumes what the fire cannot.

name: Nemesis Phoenix
text: A flame as bright and merciless as the sun.

name: Flaming Fist Officer
text: "Get the remaining citizens to safety! These miscreants have an appointment with my spear."

name: Pack Attack
text: Kobold tactics rarely account for little things like diplomacy, mercy, or surrender.

name: Patron of the Arts
text: "It's okay. My mother owns the museum."

name: Popular Entertainer
text: The last thing anyone would describe you as is shy. You love the spotlight, and it loves you back.

name: Reckless Barbarian
text: The best defense is not even knowing what the word "defense" means.

name: Stirring Bard
text: At the first sign of danger, she breaks out the power chords.

name: Storm King's Thunder
text:
"I alone am worthy to decide where lighting strikes."
—Hekaton, storm giant king

name: Street Urchin
text: Your harsh upbringing on the streets of the city left you crafty, resilient, and wise beyond your years.

name: Taunting Kobold
text: Pozo's heart was full of courage, right up until it was full of elven steel.

name: Githzerai Monk
text: The githzerai dwell in the heart of Limbo, shaping the chaos of that plane with their powerful psionic abilities.

name: Tavern Brawler
text: The only thing you love more than a good drink is a good fight. Luckily, one usually follows the other.

name: Warehouse Thief
text: Wealthy patriars make up the vast majority of both his victims and his customers.

name: Wrathful Red Dragon
text: "We'll put it all back! The gems, the gold, the chalice that would've looked great on my mantle; we'll put everythi—"

name: Goliath Paladin
text: "Why do you cower in the darkness, little gnolls? If you would challenge me, step into the light."

name: Young Red Dragon
text: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

name: Acolyte of Bahamut
text: You were on a wayward path until Bahamut showed you that power and kindness can unite beneath the same banner.

name: Ambitious Dragonborn
text: The raging green dragon left destruction—and at least one admirer—in its wake.

name: Avenging Hunter
text: "I will remember my friends. But you? You won't be remembered at all."

name: Band Together
text: "Boo, let's see how this miscreant handles a furry missile of justice!"

name: Barroom Brawl
text: "I'll see your three dragons and raise you two fists!"

name: Bramble Sovereign
text: Life runs wild amid the tangled branches.

name: Carefree Swinemaster
text: "C'mon, Boodigan, let's go see what kind of treasure this place has!"

name: Greatsword of Tyr
text: In the light of its gleaming blade, the faithful shine and the wicked cower.

name: Cloakwood Hermit
text: You've always preferred the company of animals to people.

name: Cloakwood Swarmkeeper
text: When he's threatened, the forest buzzes and the air hums with dragonfly wings.

name: Colossal Badger
text: Rip through enough dirt and you'll eventually find something edible.

name: Draconic Muralists
text: "We must never allow the deeds of our great ancestors to be forgotten."

name: Dread Linnorm
text: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

name: Druidic Ritual
text: Bone, root, and seed—the past, the present, and future in one handful of earth.

name: Emerald Dragon
text: Emerald dragons hate prying eyes, and they have a host of ways to deter them.

name: Ettercap
text:
"Filthy, sticky, vile, noxious—and I haven't even started describing the webs."
—Erinis, gloom stalker

name: Explore the Underdark
text:
"Careful near those pretty glowing plants. What do you think they feed on?"
—Talin, Underdark guide

name: Hardy Outlander
text: You're a born explorer, happiest forging your way through the untamed wilds.

name: Jaheira, Friend of the Forest
text: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."

name: Lurking Green Dragon
text:
"Territorial. Scary. No further notes."
—Volo's field notes

name: Master Chef
text: You never thought "rations" was an appropriate term for the feasts you prepare for your party.

name: Monster Manual
text: The detail really makes the monsters jump off the page.

name: Myconid Spore Tender
text: Myconid colonies grow and expand at an aggressive rate, but they are friendly and peaceful unless provoked.

name: Nature's Lore
text: Druidcraft is a simple invocation to spirits of nature, promising a glimpse of nature's secrets.

name: Owlbear Shepherd
text: When your pack is nowhere to be found, you form a new one.

name: Poison the Blade
text: "Breath of basilisk, sting of scorpion, or medusa's tears? All may be distilled, for a price."

name: Raised by Giants
text: Your parents taught you that strength can be nurtured and honed, no matter one's size.

name: Saddle of the Cavalier
text:
". . . and I will need an equally righteous but slightly smaller saddle for my space hamster companion."
—Minsc, beloved ranger

name: Scaled Nurturer
text: "Life always starts small. Only time will tell what heights it may reach."

name: Silvanus's Invoker
text: "Arise, friend, and seize the horizon in the name of the Oak Father."

name: Split the Spoils
text: "That half is yours. These halves are mine."

name: Traverse the Outlands
text:
"By the time you've seen it all, all have already changed."
—Wandering treant, name unknown

name: Undercellar Myconid
text: Water, barley, yeast, darkness—the tavern cellar had everything a growing mold could need.

name: Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
text: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

name: Cadira, Caller of the Small
text: She roams the border between wilderness and civilization, protecting those who need it most.

name: Icewind Stalwart
text: "Get behind my shield!"

name: Commander Liara Portyr
text: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

name: The Council of Four
text: Ambition has a price in Baldur's Gate, and it is paid to the Council.

name: Gorion, Wise Mentor
text: "You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."

name: Inspiring Leader
text: Your family needed a farmer, so you tilled. Your town needed a fighter, so you trained. When your people needed a leader, you knew what you had to do.

name: Korlessa, Scale Singer
text: "Would you like a song of wing-wind and fire, or one of gentle heartbeats atop a golden hoard?"

name: Lozhan, Dragons' Legacy
text: She channels myth and memory into waves of deadly arcane force.

name: Mahadi, Emporium Master
text: "Welcome to the Wandering Emporium. Feel free to browse the bazaar. We have everything a lost soul could want, need, or afford."

name: Oji, the Exquisite Blade
text: They walk the Path of Kensei with perfect balance.

name: Thrakkus the Butcher
text: Somehow, he never seems to run out of fresh meat.

name: Arcane Encyclopedia
text: A quill from the First Reader at Candlekeep, the spectacles of the Most Holy Servant of Gond, a woven bookmark from the Caleph Arcane of Calimport: readers always leave something of themselves behind.

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"To feel no constraint but the four points of a compass, to tread a path that only you can find . . . these are the flavors of power I've learned to savor."
—Keon, horizon walker

name: Bag of Holding
text: Leave no treasure behind.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: Some patriars pay massive sums for exotic pets that can give their posh, predictable lives an edge of danger.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Not born of nature, but deeply connected to it nonetheless.

name: Charcoal Diamond
text: Every facet a portent of Kelemvor's inevitable judgment.

name: Chardalyn Dragon
text: First discovered in ancient Netheril, chardalyn stones absorb and hold magical energy, enabling constructs to be infused with fearsome power and unnatural malice.

name: Cloak of the Bat
text:
"How about the power of silent flight? Does that suit your needs, cutthroat?"
—Rivalen Blackhand, proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries

name: Clockwork Fox
text:
"It might just be my greatest invention yet: A lovable pet that *decreases* the need for chores!"
—Jan Jansen

name: Decanter of Endless Water
text:
"Now, remember: Under no circumstances should you utter the word 'geyser' in the same room as—oh, blast it!"
—Bindlehaim, Upper City merchant

name: Dire Mimic
text: Sometimes the closet *is* the monster.

name: Drillworks Mole
text: The Flaming Fist soldiers prepared to face a bulette, or worse, but the cause of the rumblings turned out to be much more benign and bizarre.

name: Fire Diamond
text: Every facet aglow like iron in Moradin's mighty forge.

name: Manifold Key
text:
"Finally! It was worth the price to never have to fiddle with lockpicks ever again."
—Davvry Mineshadow, thief

name: Marble Diamond
text: Every facet a benediction of Lathander's light.

name: Marching Duodrone
text: "One-two! One-two! One-two! One-two!"

name: Meteor Golem
text: The strongest golems are forged from meteoric iron that has been tempered in the heat of an elemental plane.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"I don't study it because I want answers; I study it because there is beauty in pursuing the unknown."
—Misvaad, Candlekeep librarian

name: Mirror of Life Trapping
text: Quenton barely had a second to admire his exquisite handsomeness before reality collapsed around him.

name: Moss Diamond
text: Every facet a promise of Chauntea's bounty.

name: Navigation Orb
text: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.

name: Nimblewright Schematic
text:
"While it is certainly a unique touch, Jan, does the mustache really need to be there?"
—High Artificer Andar Beech

name: Patriar's Seal
text: Only a fool ignores a letter bearing the official mark of a patriar family.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: Charting the Spine of the World is best left to the disposable.

name: Prized Statue
text: To the cultists, the sacred idol was priceless. To the adventurers, it was worth about two sturdy mules and a barrel of ale.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: To understand Baldur's Gate, one must first understand how wealth and commerce shape every facet of life.

name: Rug of Smothering
text:
"No, not an accessory to murder—I'm looking for an accessory *for* murder."
—Nadja, Flaming Fist investigator

name: Sky Diamond
text: Every facet a window into Oghma's divine insight.

name: Stonespeaker Crystal
text: It whispers words spoken centuries ago, coaxing wisdom from the ghosts of civilizations past.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text: One who wears magical *boots of striding and springing* can jump astounding distances.

name: Universal Solvent
text: A few drops could dissolve the webs of Lolth herself.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

name: Baldur's Gate
text:
"Of course I know what 'eponymous' means! It's a little horse."
—Krizz, gate guard

name: Basilisk Gate
text: The eastern passage into the city is filled with reminders that the patriars are literally looking down on you.

name: Black Dragon Gate
text: An imposing visage that looms over all who would rise above their station.

name: Bountiful Promenade
text: Servants tend the gardens meticulously, ensuring that Upper City residents aren't bothered by the messier parts of nature.

name: Citadel Gate
text: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.

name: Cliffgate
text: A partition between the hopeless living and the restless dead.

name: Command Tower
text: Durlag's Tower is filled with enough treasure to last a lifetime, and enough traps to drastically shorten that lifetime.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: There is an immense diversity of life in the Underdark, almost all of which can kill you.

name: Luxury Suite
text: In opulent chambers behind closed doors, dynasties are made and broken with but a few murmured words.

name: Manor Gate
text: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.

name: Morphic Pool
text: No one really knows how deep the waters go beneath Undercity, nor what amorphous horrors lurk within.

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Gale stared into the pool and saw a stranger. The similarities were uncanny, but it was not him.

name: Sea Gate
text: An efficient route from a smuggler's ship to a patriar's manor.

name: Sea of Clouds
text: A shoreless sea extends to every horizon, sharing its beauty only with those who can fly high enough to see it.

name: Spire Garden
text: The village's name was long forgotten, its crumbling ruins a monument to the fragility of civilization.

name: Rescuer Chwinga
text: Fortunately for lost travelers, chwingas' curiosity often gets the better of their shyness.

name: Archivist of Oghma
text: "Knowledge is the greatest tool of the mortal mind, outweighing anything made by mortal hands. Before anything else can exist, the idea must exist."

name: Roving Harper
text: The Harpers value peaceful coexistence, historical preservation, and harmony with nature, and each day they spread their ideals a little farther.

name: Sculpted Sunburst
text: A searing light that spares only the chosen.

name: Slaughter the Strong
text: It was a big day for the gravediggers at Cliffside Cemetery.

name: Steadfast Unicorn
text: Only the good-hearted may set foot in a unicorn's domain.

name: Stoneskin
text: "Ooh, nice shot! I almost felt that one."

name: Plains
text: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has even surprisingly uneventful.

name: Plains
text: Lady Bormul claims an owlbear has been trampling her fields, but there's something unnatural about the tracks it left behind.

name: Plains
text: After spending all day trying to track down a rare tome, you're about to give up when you hear your name whispered from a dark alley.

name: Plains
text: You arrive at Baldur's Gate with instructions to head straight to the heart of the rumor mill: the bakery.

name: Island
text: As you sail past the imposing Seatower of Balduran, you realize that breaking your friend out of that prison will be much harder than you thought.

name: Island
text: As you gaze down upon Wyrm's Crossing, you hear distant cries of alarm, and you notice that all traffic on the bridge has come to a halt.

name: Island
text: You're about to disembark to find the harbormaster when you spot a merfolk darting underneath your ship.

name: Island
text: The ship's captain promised she'd get you safely to the Netherese ruin, but *she* is the one who just washed overboard.

name: Swamp
text: Now that you've clearly hit the "marsh" part of Lizard Marsh, you begin to worry about the "lizard" part.

name: Swamp
text: The sudden sinkhole was surprising enough, but nothing could have prepared you for the ancient city that was hidden underneath.

name: Swamp
text: The old wizard's experiments destroyed the castle centuries ago. So why does some of the rubble look recent?

name: Swamp
text: At the mouth of the sewer pipe, you realize it's massive enough that even a giant could walk through without stooping. That gives you an idea . . .

name: Mountain
text: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.

name: Mountain
text: Lord Jannath sent you to secure the mine from gnoll raiders, but so far you haven't seen any gnolls . . . or, for that matter, any miners.

name: Mountain
text: Rumor holds that powerful artifacts and untold wealth are hidden away in Ramazith's Tower, and today you plan to find out for yourself.

name: Mountain
text: As you pause mid-climb to catch your breath, you'd swear you can hear a heartbeat pulsing deep within the mountain.

name: Forest
text: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?

name: Forest
text: The lights in the cavern glow and fade, glow and fade in a rhythm that must have a deeper meaning, if only you can figure it out.

name: Forest
text: You continue to mutter and complain as you trip over yet another gnarled root. From behind the nearest tree trunk, something mutters back.

name: Forest
text: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.

name: Far Traveler
text: You have traveled to many places, over mountains and across seas, but a new journey always calls.

name: Flaming Fist
text: You carry the security of Baldur's Gate on your shoulders, and you welcome the weight of responsibility.

name: Inspiring Leader
text: Your family needed a farmer, so you tilled. Your town needed a fighter, so you trained. When your people needed a leader, you knew what you had to do.

name: Veteran Soldier
text: You've always been happiest fighting for a cause you believe in alongside loyal comrades.

name: Veteran Soldier
text: You've always been happiest fighting for a cause you believe in alongside loyal comrades.

name: Candlekeep Sage
text: You love the smell of dusty tomes, the flicker of candles during late-night reading, and the old texts that bring to life the scholars who have come before.

name: Dungeon Delver
text: You're driven not by a lust for gold or baubles, but by the thrill of danger and the excitement of the unknown.

name: Feywild Visitor
text: Fey energy clings to you, a shimmering reminder of your otherworldly travels.

name: Renari, Merchant of Marvels
text: "Sure, you can get one elsewhere ... if you want a knockoff that'll break the first time you use it."

name: Shameless Charlatan
text: You see your next disguise in every stranger's smile.

name: Sword Coast Sailor
text: You were born at sea, and your legs are steadiest when the waves are rowdiest.

name: Agent of the Iron Throne
text: You give your clients what they want at a fair price. What happens after that is none of your concern.

name: Agent of the Shadow Thieves
text: Your skill, dexterity, and moral flexibility make you a valuable asset to your guild.

name: Criminal Past
text: You've never cared much for laws or authority, especially when they get in your way.

name: Cultist of the Absolute
text: You embrace power at any cost, and if it consumes you, so be it.

name: Scion of Halaster
text: Most see the Mad Mage as a deranged menace, but you recognize the genius behind his paranoia.

name: Shadowheart, Dark Justiciar
text: "Shar's will shall be done. As sure as night will fall."

name: Ascend from Avernus
text: Smoke clogged the streets and rubble littered the ground, but sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

name: Dragon Cultist
text: You know that mighty dracoliches will one day rule over this world. For you, that day can't come soon enough.

name: Guild Artisan
text: Your discerning eye for value makes you nearly impossible to swindle.

name: Livaan, Cultist of Tiamat
text: Her hunger for power consumes what the fire cannot.

name: Popular Entertainer
text: The last thing anyone would describe you as is shy. You love the spotlight, and it loves you back.

name: Street Urchin
text: Your harsh upbringing on the streets of the city left you crafty, resilient, and wise beyond your years.

name: Tavern Brawler
text: The only thing you love more than a good drink is a good fight. Luckily, one usually follows the other.

name: Acolyte of Bahamut
text: You were on a wayward path until Bahamut showed you that power and kindness can unite beneath the same banner.

name: Cloakwood Hermit
text: You've always preferred the company of animals to people.

name: Hardy Outlander
text: You're a born explorer, happiest forging your way through the untamed wilds.

name: Jaheira, Friend of the Forest
text: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."

name: Master Chef
text: You never thought "rations" was an appropriate term for the feasts you prepare for your party.

name: Your Temple Is Under Attack
text: "You trespass on sacred ground, monster. Leave while you still can."

name: Raised by Giants
text: Your parents taught you that strength can be nurtured and honed, no matter one's size.

name: Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
text: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

name: Cadira, Caller of the Small
text: She roams the border between wilderness and civilization, protecting those who need it most.

name: Commander Liara Portyr
text: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

name: You're Confronted by Robbers
text: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.

name: The Council of Four
text: Ambition has a price in Baldur's Gate, and it is paid to the Council.

name: Gorion, Wise Mentor
text: "You are safest in Candlekeep, Abdel, but I cannot keep you from the world forever."

name: Korlessa, Scale Singer
text: "Would you like a song of wing-wind and fire, or one of gentle heartbeats atop a golden hoard?"

name: Lozhan, Dragons' Legacy
text: She channels myth and memory into waves of deadly arcane force.

name: Aarakocra Sneak
text: "Shhh! I think I hear goblins. And I definitely smell them."

name: Mahadi, Emporium Master
text: "Welcome to the Wandering Emporium. Feel free to browse the bazaar. We have everything a lost soul could want, need, or afford."

name: Oji, the Exquisite Blade
text: They walk the Path of Kensei with perfect balance.

name: Thrakkus the Butcher
text: Somehow, he never seems to run out of fresh meat.

name: Bane's Contingency
text: "My whims dictate the fate of nations. Your pitiful mortal magic is no more significant than a gnat buzzing in my ear."

name: Blur
text: "It's as much a trick of the mind as it is a trick of the eye."

name: Candlekeep Inspiration
text: Tales of heroes past galvanize the heroes of the future.

name: Astral Confrontation
text: "After voyaging all the way through the Astral Sea with my life hanging by a silver thread, fighting the mind flayer was the easy part."

name: Candlekeep Sage
text: You love the smell of dusty tomes, the flicker of candles during late-night reading, and the old texts that bring to life the scholars who have come before.

name: Displacer Kitten
text:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

name: Draconic Lore
text: The wyrmling studied the ancient carvings and dreamed of a day when her own exploits would be immortalized in stone.

name: Faldorn, Dread Wolf Herald
text: "Cities are a blight on the beauty of nature."

name: Dragonborn Looter
text: Erdur never thought of it as stealing. Treasure simply didn't deserve to be stuck underground where no one could admire it.

name: Folk Hero
text: Tales of your great deeds follow you no matter how far you travel from your hometown.

name: Clan Crafter
text: Trained by a dwarven master, you see the potential in every scrap of metal.

name: Passionate Archaeologist
text: You can't remember a time when you didn't feel the pull of forgotten stories and buried secrets.

name: Dream Fracture
text: In her dream, Lola gazed into a mirror. Her familiar features warped, her jaw stretching wider and wider until it cracked and her reflection pulled her into its gaping maw.

name: Stick Together
text: Every veteran adventurer will tell you to stick with your party, because the ones who split up aren't around to give advice.

name: Dungeon Delver
text: You're driven not by a lust for gold or baubles, but by the thrill of danger and the excitement of the unknown.

name: Elminster's Simulacrum
text:
"Why simply sit back and applaud the good ideas of others when I can improve upon them?"
—Elminster

name: Feywild Caretaker
text: "Hello, my fluttering friends! Isn't it a beautiful day?"

name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
text: "Virtue is an inner light that can prevail in every soul."

name: Irregular Cohort
text: Where fickle form meets lasting loyalty.

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Mage's Attendant
text: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.

name: Bane's Invoker
text: "The Lord of Darkness elevates only those who serve."

name: Feywild Visitor
text: Fey energy clings to you, a shimmering reminder of your otherworldly travels.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Order of Whiteclay
text: Made from the clay of burial mounds, the face paint of the priests is a sign of their respect for those whose rest they interrupt.

name: Priest of Ancient Lore
text: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."

name: Rumor Gatherer
text: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Solemn Recruit
text: "I can no longer sit in my workshop and ignore the events outside. My hammers strike for the people of Ghirapur."

name: Font of Magic
text: Warnis had always felt a glimmer of potential within herself, flickering just out of reach. That night, as the cultists attacked, it became a torrent of power that was hers to command.

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Angler Turtle
text: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Curse of Verbosity
text: Idle chatter beckons many an attentive ear.

name: Dissipation Field
text:
"Strike me once, shame on you. Strike me twice . . . Well, let's just see if you can."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Forgotten Creation
text:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Fractured Sanity
text: The body grows stronger under stress. The mind does not.

name: Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar
text: "You studied hard. How delicious!"

name: Keiga, the Tide Star
text: The pull of the tide star holds eternal sway.

name: Mind Flayer
text: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Sludge Monster
text: Tracking it isn't the hard part.

name: Sly Instigator
text: "Me? I'm just an innocent bystander!"

name: Bloodsoaked Champion
text: "Death is merely another foe the Mardu will overcome."

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Calculating Lich
text: "We share a common enemy. Does that not make us friends?"

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Crippling Fear
text: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

name: Curtains' Call
text:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Dire Fleet Ravager
text: His fists fume with the decay of death, each strike a plague on the hearts of his enemies.

name: Gray Harbor Merfolk
text: Harbormasters tend to forget that security shouldn't stop at the surface.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "We all want to know what's going on in someone else's head. I simply open it up and look."

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Illithid Harvester
text: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

name: Malakir Blood-Priest
text: "From your veins to mine."

name: Mindblade Render
text: "There will be no secrets between us... like it or not."

name: Nighthawk Scavenger
text: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Avatar of Slaughter
text:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

name: Irenicus's Vile Duplication
text:
"You will serve me better in this form."
—Jon Irenicus

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Bonecrusher Giant
text: Not every tale ends in glory.

name: Brash Taunter
text: "You hit like a kobold!"

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Demon Bolt
text:
"Burn them from the sky."
—Varragoth

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
text: "Courage is the only shield I need."

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Geode Rager
text: Its crystalline core refracts light into chaos.

name: Goblin Spymaster
text:
"Infiltrate and infuriate!"
—Goblin Espionage League motto

name: Jeska's Will
text:
"Gather your strength. Prepare yourself."
—Jeska, to Radha

name: Kenku Artificer
text: Though her words may be unoriginal, her creations are anything but.

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Ryusei, the Falling Star
text: The course of the falling star always ends in ruin.

name: Kindred Discovery
text: A family that welcomes birds of all feathers.

name: Thunder Dragon
text: Sometimes primitive cultures attributed natural phenomena to monsters. Sometimes they were right.

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Warmonger Hellkite
text: Its wings beat to the howls of war and fan the fires of rage.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: End-Raze Forerunners
text:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Lovestruck Beast
text: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

name: Modify Memory
text: Percival's clothes itched and his dinner was unpleasantly wriggly, but the kobold looked like he was having the time of his life.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Sandwurm Convergence
text: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Escape to the Wilds
text: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Grumgully, the Generous
text: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

name: High Priest of Penance
text: "All I require is faith, loyalty, obedience, trust, and complete and utter devotion."

name: Memory Plunder
text:
"Vengeance is the echo of the victim's own crime."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Nemesis of Reason
text: Words describing it fail. Pages relating it shrivel. Tales recounting it end.

name: Sprite Dragon
text: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Dimir Keyrune
text: A key that slips through every lock.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Nimbleclaw Adept
text: "Don't worry, I can reach it."

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Mindcrank
text:
"Let go of your memories and be reborn."
—Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Spellskite
text:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Pseudodragon Familiar
text: Pseudodragons are favored companions of wizards, prized for their cunning and curiosity.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Castle Locthwain
text: Without Locthwain's persistence, the realm would stagnate and die.

name: Castle Vantress
text: Without Vantress's knowledge, the realm would lose itself in darkness.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Underdark flooding has swallowed ancient drow burial chambers, which are now haunted . . . and infested with oozes.

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Highland Forest
text:
"Tread carefully! The last time I walked this path, half the snowdrifts were, in fact, sleeping trolls. I've never run so fast in my life!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

name: Renari, Merchant of Marvels
text: "Sure, you can get one elsewhere . . . if you want a knockoff that'll break the first time you use it."

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Plant life in the valley changes for the worse as runoff from dwarven forges contaminates the water.

name: Mutavault
text: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

name: Nephalia Drownyard
text:
"Some see a coastal disaster. I see a fully-stocked seagraf."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Prismari Campus
text: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
text: It offers the power to shape worlds and the elegance to do so with style.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: River of Tears
text:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Snowfield Sinkhole
text:
"Young Vitima bellowed to the Cosmos, daring the gods to punish her hubris! Well, she got their attention, as you can see."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Run Away Together
text: True love means always knowing what's on the other's mind.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Faldorn, Dread Wolf Herald
text: "Cities are a blight on the beauty of nature."

name: Shameless Charlatan
text: You see your next disguise in every stranger's smile.

name: Sword Coast Sailor
text: You were born at sea, and your legs are steadiest when the waves are rowdiest.

name: Snow Day
text:
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed."
—Prismari dormitory notice

name: Stunt Double
text: No duelist is without equal in Paliano.

name: Thunder Drake
text: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

name: Turn to Frog
text: "Ribbit."

name: Basilica Screecher
text: A screech in the night is all it takes for Orzhov debtors to clutch at their coin purses.

name: Corpse Churn
text: "How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses..."

name: Daggerclaw Imp
text: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Deal Gone Bad
text:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Gurmag Swiftwing
text:
"Anything a falcon can do, a bat can do in pitch darkness."
—Urdnan the Wanderer

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Masked Blackguard
text: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.

name: Mausoleum Turnkey
text: When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.

name: Orzhov Racketeers
text: "Looks like you need protection."

name: Rakdos Trumpeter
text:
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos."
—Lazav

name: Ribbons of Night
text:
"My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar."
—Aszala of House Dimir

name: Roofstalker Wight
text: No heartbeat to hear, no greed to bribe, no fear of death.

name: Syndicate Enforcer
text: Even the darkest corners of Ravnica still lie in the shadow of the Church.

name: Tithebearer Giant
text:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

name: Venomous Hierophant
text: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"

name: Vindictive Vampire
text: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

name: Chainwhip Cyclops
text:
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind."
—Urgdar, cyclops philosopher

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Cosmotronic Wave
text: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."

name: Dagger Caster
text: "Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."

name: Deputized Protester
text: Butcher's training, warrior's heart.

name: Fire Urchin
text: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.

name: Firefist Striker
text: The flaming fist of Boros holds the promise of both protection and destruction in its grasp.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Goblin Wizardry
text: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

name: Gravel-Hide Goblin
text:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade

name: Havoc Jester
text: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

name: Krenko's Command
text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Living Lightning
text: Not all storms come from the sky.

name: Ornery Goblin
text: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

name: Reduce to Ashes
text:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

name: Ripscale Predator
text: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

name: Spellgorger Weird
text: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

name: Stormblood Berserker
text: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

name: Towering Thunderfist
text:
"Nothing ruins a party like one of those big killjoys bursting through the door and setting all the guests free."
—Ruba, Rakdos cultist

name: Turret Ogre
text: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.

name: Utvara Scalper
text: He wages war wherever the wind carries him.

name: Wojek Bodyguard
text: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

name: Affectionate Indrik
text: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

name: Band Together
text: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

name: Battlefront Krushok
text: Krushoks clear debris from fertile fields, fallow fields, and battlefields.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Challenger Troll
text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

name: Colossal Majesty
text:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

name: Duskshell Crawler
text: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

name: Enraged Ceratok
text: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"

name: Fungal Rebirth
text:
"We're all food for something in the end."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Giant Adephage
text:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Gift of Strength
text:
"When the sky screams, when the ground groans, the End-Raze will soon begin."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Kraul Warrior
text: The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.

name: Kronch Wrangler
text: Looking over two city blocks of destruction, he could only cackle with pride.

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Sauroform Hybrid
text:
"Within each of us, the potential for great power waits to be released."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

name: Steeple Creeper
text:
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources."
—Vannifar

name: Territorial Boar
text:
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger."
—Yeva, Nature's Herald

name: Transluminant
text: "Forget yourself. Forget your city. Forget your homes, your families, the debts and obligations that hold you to this world."

name: Vines of the Recluse
text: "The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Wildwood Patrol
text: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

name: Yeva's Forcemage
text: "Nature can't be stopped. It rips and tears at Ravnica's tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun."

name: Curse of Chains
text: The giant's real punishment was the fleeting moment when he was allowed to stand before being dragged down to his knees again.

name: Firemane Avenger
text: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

name: Footlight Fiend
text:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

name: Fresh-Faced Recruit
text:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic

name: Frostburn Weird
text: Many chemisters are oblivious to the innumerable machinations of their guild, instead focusing obsessively on creating the perfect weird.

name: Hydroid Krasis
text: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Master Biomancer
text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

name: Pit Fight
text:
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Pitiless Gorgon
text: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."

name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
text: "If there were such a thing as a soul, I think it would be behind the gallbladder but above the kidneys."

name: Rakdos, the Showstopper
text: "Entertain me."

name: Snakeform
text: Losing his possessions distressed him, but the lack of limbs was strangely liberating.

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Turn to Mist
text:
"Did you expect me to dodge? How quaint."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Underrealm Lich
text: "You've strayed, overworlder."

name: Vernadi Shieldmate
text: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."

name: Vizkopa Vampire
text: Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them. The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

name: Whisper Agent
text: He has a job to finish, and it's you.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Afterlife Insurance
text: As far as the Orzhov Syndicate is concerned, it is the height of irresponsibility not to have a plan for your own ghost.

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Boros Guildgate
text:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Boros Strike-Captain
text: "Keep up with me, comrades, or I cannot guarantee you a fair share of the fracas."

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Covetous Elegy
text: Wealthier than ever thanks to exorbitant interest on wartime loans, the Orzhov only grew hungrier for more.

name: Ecstatic Electromancer
text: Her theories are grounded. Her experiments are not.

name: Furious Spinesplitter
text: The Gruul believe the best way to protect Ravnica's wilderness is to destroy civilization and all who defend it.

name: Ordruun Mentor
text: The recruits had a lot to learn. Luckily, she had a lot to teach.

name: Portal Manipulator
text: "The next punch you throw hits the back of your own head."

name: Sludge Titan
text: A hideous, living residue of countless corpses dissolving anonymously in the scummy depths.

name: Stampede Surfer
text: "This little piggy goes to war!"

name: Suppressor Skyguard
text: "Attention, brawlers! You are in violation of Senate statute 2309.76-22. Halt your melee before you incur further charges."

name: Tribune of Rot
text: "I bestow upon you a great honor—your flesh alone will nourish a new generation of saprolings."

name: Undercover Butler
text: Dress for the job you want them to think you have.

name: Vernal Sovereign
text: It is spring incarnate, its gentle warmth chasing away the last of winter's bite.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

name: Azorius Arrester
text: "You have the right to remain silent. Mostly because I tire of your excuses."

name: Azorius Justiciar
text: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

name: Council's Judgment
text: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

name: Deadly Riposte
text:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Enforcer Griffin
text:
"A company of infantry is trapped behind the lines. We need to strike hard and fast to free them, or the casualties will be horrific. Send the griffins."
—Tajic

name: Finale of Glory
text: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.

name: Glorifier of Dusk
text: "The blood of the enemy is a sacrament. The strength it gives is proof that our cause is just."

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Law-Rune Enforcer
text:
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity."
—Dovin Baan

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Oust
text:
"'Invincible' is just a word."
—Gideon Jura

name: Parhelion Patrol
text: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."

name: Rally to Battle
text: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.

name: Roc Charger
text: Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.

name: Rootborn Defenses
text: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

name: Seller of Songbirds
text:
"Lady Wren is the one merchant in Keyhole Downs who isn't running a scam."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Sunhome Stalwart
text: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

name: Syndic of Tithes
text:
"Entrance is free. Donations are required."
—Notice outside Vizkopa Bank

name: Syndicate Messenger
text:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia

name: Tandem Tactics
text: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

name: Trusted Pegasus
text: "Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.

name: Twilight Panther
text: A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.

name: Urbis Protector
text:
"I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement. I'm sure this comes as no surprise to you."
—Teysa, to Lazav

name: War Screecher
text: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

name: Chemister's Insight
text: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

name: Cloudkin Seer
text: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Erratic Visionary
text: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"

name: Jeering Homunculus
text: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

name: Leapfrog
text:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Passwall Adept
text: "My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Rescuer Sphinx
text: "Now, little fighter, show me you deserved this second chance."

name: Roaming Ghostlight
text: Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.

name: Sage's Row Savant
text: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

name: Skitter Eel
text:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Slip Out the Back
text: "I was never here."

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Vela the Night-Clad
text: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Dragonlair Spider
text: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Goblin Welder
text: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Hammerfist Giant
text:
"Oh sure, they buy a lot of ale, but I always find myself needing to rebuild after the giants have paid a visit."
—Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Hunted Dragon
text: The knights see a mighty quarry. The dragon sees breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Incite Rebellion
text: Nothing breaks the monotony like a good old-fashioned riot.

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Magma Giant
text: Its open mouth is a furnace blast that blisters the skin. Its smoking fists are meteors that split the earth.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Meteor Blast
text:
"Behold astronomy's contribution to war."
—Fennor Rhyl, starcaller

name: Scrap Mastery
text: "Where a lesser mind sees junk, I see infinite potential."

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Stinkdrinker Daredevil
text: Boggarts constantly strive to outdo each other with the things they bring back to the warren, each hoping the exploit will become as well-known as those of Auntie Grub.

name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
text: "Through me, the Great Teacher's voice will rattle this world."

name: Sunrise Sovereign
text: A hundred generations has he mentored, a hundred armies has he crushed beneath his feet, yet only a hundred words has he ever spoken, each more revered than a hundred books.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Thundercloud Shaman
text: He cares not for the disasters his storm brings as long as his path ahead is clear.

name: Tuktuk the Explorer
text: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

name: Tyrant's Familiar
text: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

name: Warmonger Hellkite
text: Its wings beat to the howls of war and fan the fires of rage.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Whipflare
text: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

name: Word of Seizing
text: "Obey!"

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Troll Ascetic
text: It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Bred for the Hunt
