text: Some see the world as a place of infinite wonder and knowledge. Some see it as an infinite dinner plate.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Desecrator Hag
text: Loose earth is not a burial but an appetizer.

name: Duneblast
text: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Master Biomancer
text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

name: Mirrorweave
text:
"Those who are different are untrustworthy, unpredictable. Put your safety in the hands of your own kind."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Spitting Image
text: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Arbiter of Knollridge
text: Though giants are mortal, they live so long and on such a grand scale that many small folk don't believe they ever truly die.

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Boros Cluestone
text:
"In case of fire, treachery, citywide riot, political upheaval, or worldwide societal collapse, break glass."
—Cluestone inscription

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Coldsteel Heart
text: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Brave the Sands
text: Enduring the most desolate and dangerous conditions, Abzan sentries unfailingly guard the stronghold gates.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Junk Diver
text: Garbage in, treasure out.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Liquimetal Coating
text:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Loreseeker's Stone
text: Mages come from far and wide to bathe in its wisdom.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Damia, Sage of Stone
text: Ask your query and be on your way. Just don't look her in the eye.

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, chancellor of the Tolarian Academy

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Ancient Amphitheater
text: The arbiter Galanda Feudkiller judges Lorwyn's squabbles from a lofty perspective.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Dawnglare Invoker
text:
"What we knew as Emeria, Ula, and Cosi were not divine beings at all, but a cruel trick, and a grave error."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Phyrexia's Core
text:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Sublime Exhalation
text: Exhale, and let the winds carry your soul for all eternity.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Victory's Herald
text: The corruption stirred the heavens above, awaking a shining champion.

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Dreamborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Grip of Phyresis
text:
"Even your blade knows who will triumph here."
—Atraxa, Praetors' Voice

name: Memory Erosion
text:
"The Filigree Texts do not compel you to act in accordance with their precepts. They only specify the consequences should you fail."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Riddlekeeper
text: Fools surrender their sanity to his riddles. Even greater fools try to solve them.

name: Slipstream Eel
text: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Festercreep
text: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Gravedigger
text: Only a thin layer of dirt separates civilization from an undead apocalypse.

name: Languish
text: Life is such a fragile thing.

name: Mortivore
text: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Unnerve
text:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Borderland Behemoth
text: Giants share nothing but their fury.

name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
text: When the moon rises and the bloodlust takes hold, nothing matters but the kill.

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fall of the Hammer
text: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Aerie Mystics
text: They are cautious with their body language and facial expressions. Any stray movement could betray the positions of the troops they protect and cost many lives.

name: Desert Twister
text: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

name: Drove of Elves
text: "The light of beauty protects our journeys through darkness."

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Skysweeper
text: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Essence Warden
text:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
text: The infamous Ezuri commands the highest bounty the vedalken have ever placed upon an outlaw.

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Fresh Meat
text: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

name: Grave Sifter
text: It claws at the earth in a vain attempt to reclaim what it once was.

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Grim Flowering
text:
"Nothing in nature goes to waste, not even the rotting corpse of a good-for-nothing, blood-sucking vampire."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Hunting Triad
text: "Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

name: Immaculate Magistrate
text: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Kessig Cagebreakers
text: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Lifeblood Hydra
text: Pharika has written her secrets on its bones so that only the worthy may discover them.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Mulch
text: The land knows no difference between the graves of commoners and nobles.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Pathbreaker Ibex
text:
"My skills are wasted here."
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Praetor's Counsel
text: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Primordial Sage
text: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Restore
text:
"See, the land itself raises an altar to the ascendancy of nature."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Siege Behemoth
text:
"Hold the line, hold the li—"
—General Srok, last words

name: Silklash Spider
text: By the time the spider comes to slurp up its dinner, its victims have been partially dissolved by acidic silk.

name: Song of the Dryads
text: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

name: Soul of the Harvest
text: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Sylvan Safekeeper
text:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text: If you hear it, it's too late.

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

name: Titania's Chosen
text:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Viridian Zealot
text: "I will fight only the way nature intended—and nature intended us to win."

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Whirlwind
text: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

name: Wolfcaller's Howl
text:
"Knowledge is a stain that only instinct and ferocity can cleanse."
—Drarg, wolfcaller

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
text: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Leafdrake Roost
text:
"The best experiments are those whose successes replicate themselves."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Lotleth Troll
text: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Mortify
text: The eyes let flow with tears, then blood, then the very soul—the whole wrung inside out, dripping down into the blackened puddle of the past.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
text: "Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."

name: Rubinia Soulsinger
text: "Take up the quill, and feel your future flow into the runes."

name: Skyward Eye Prophets
text: They lament the doom that is coming to Bant without realizing the part their own leaders have played in it.

name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
text:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Winged Coatl
text: The nacatl called this new species "vetli," their word for poison arrows.

name: Wrecking Ball
text: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Azorius Keyrune
text:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Eldrazi Monument
text:
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Serra Angel
text: Perfect justice in service of a perfect will.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Loreseeker's Stone
text: Mages come from far and wide to bathe in its wisdom.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Predator, Flagship
text:
"The scourge of Skyshroud is airborne once more."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Shattered Angel
text: She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
text: Paradoxically, to tilt the massive jug for a sip, you'd need the energy of the giant's tonic.

name: Thunderstaff
text: Jort the Thunder-Mad spent his life perfecting a way to harness the power of the heavens.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Gargoyle Castle
text: Most knew of the tower's wizard and gargoyle. Few realized which was guardian and which was master.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Haunted Fengraf
text: A ghoulcaller's playground.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Unexpectedly Absent
text: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

name: Borrowing 100,000 Arrows
text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

name: Control Magic
text:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

name: Curse of Inertia
text:
"As long as I pull the strings, you will dance."
—Tezzeret

name: Diviner Spirit
text: Sentience is its natural habitat.

name: Djinn of Infinite Deceits
text: The winds of change have a mind of their own.

name: Thornwind Faeries
text: Guarding the ship is the Thornwinds' first concern. Getting along with the locals ranks fourth or fifth at best.

name: Wash Out
text:
"It's not the darkness I fear but dull and numbing shades of gray."
—Sydri, galvanic genius

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Ambition's Cost
text: The waters of wisdom are as dust in the mouth of one who thirsts for power.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

name: Blood Bairn
text: The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Dread Cacodemon
text: Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Bathe in Light
text: "Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Razorjaw Oni
text: It gnashed its teeth, and the battlefield filled with the screech of blade striking blade.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Scourge of Nel Toth
text:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Thief of Blood
text: Her hunger will not be denied.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Avatar of Slaughter
text:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

name: Cleansing Beam
text:
"Justice is toothless without punishment. Righteousness cannot succeed without the suffering of the guilty."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Curse of the Forsaken
text:
"Purge the damned, for they have no place among the righteous!"
—Seeta of Thraben

name: Death by Dragons
text: Suddenly, Eldo felt very alone.

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Oni of Wild Places
text: The oni leapt easily from peak to peak, toying with its victims, its voice a purr from the rumbling depths of nightmare.

name: Stranglehold
text: The correct answer to a barbarian's riddle is to choke on your cleverness and die.

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"Ruhan would never agree to such terms."
—Ruhan of the Fomori

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Bane of Progress
text: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

name: Collective Unconscious
text: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

name: Creeperhulk
text:
"I saw the devastation when the juggernauts crashed the walls of An Karras. Then I got to thinking."
—Janji, sylvan druid

name: Curse of Predation
text:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Celestial Force
text:
"Wishing upon only one star seems like a failure of imagination."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Unnerve
text:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

name: Vow of Malice
text:
"I grant you blades—on the condition that they are not pointed at me."
—Damia, Sage of Stone

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Avatar of Slaughter
text:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Cleansing Beam
text:
"Justice is toothless without punishment. Righteousness cannot succeed without the suffering of the guilty."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Death by Dragons
text: Suddenly, Eldo felt very alone.

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Goblin Cadets
text: "If you kids don't stop that racket, I'm turning this expedition around *right now!*"

name: Insurrection
text:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Magmatic Force
text:
"Granted, it's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness. So what would you call *two* of them?"
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: False Prophet
text: "You lived for Serra's love. Will you not die for it?"

name: Oni of Wild Places
text: The oni leapt easily from peak to peak, toying with its victims, its voice a purr from the rumbling depths of nightmare.

name: Ruination
text:
"We have built a wall upon sand. The wall will vanish. The sand will remain."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Stranglehold
text: The correct answer to a barbarian's riddle is to choke on your cleverness and die.

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"Ruhan would never agree to such terms."
—Ruhan of the Fomori

name: Wild Ricochet
text: "I knew that trick long before your great-grandmother's great-grandmother was born."

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Bestial Menace
text:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Fists of Ironwood
text: Saprolings add the three and the four to the "one-two punch."

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Hydra Omnivore
text:
"We should learn from the hydra. It never plays favorites; it devours everyone equally."
—Thrass, elder druid

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Magus of the Vineyard
text: Battered and beaten by years of salt and claw, he never ceased to walk, and to seed. Only now, in this time of rebirth, do his seeds take root.

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Spawnwrithe
text: Its victims feel only an itchy, wriggling feeling just under their skin. By then, it's far too late.

name: Squallmonger
text: "Squall, gale, hurricane—it's all a matter of size . . . and price."

name: Symbiotic Wurm
text: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Troll Ascetic
text: It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Aura Shards
text: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
text: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Chorus of the Conclave
text: "We are many, yet one. We are separate in body, yet speak with a single voice. Join us in our chorus."

name: Martyr's Bond
text:
"Our lives are connected by divine law. The truth of this will be made evident in time."
—Zedruu the Greathearted

name: Colossal Might
text:
"Never corner a barbarian. You become the path of least resistance."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Damia, Sage of Stone
text: Ask your query and be on your way. Just don't look her in the eye.

name: Desecrator Hag
text: Loose earth is not a burial but an appetizer.

name: Dominus of Fealty
text:
"Nothing is truly your own. It is his, whether you know it or not."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Monk Realist
text: "We plant the seeds of doubt to harvest the crop of wisdom."

name: Hull Breach
text: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

name: Izzet Chronarch
text: He ensures not only whether but also when and where the lightning strikes twice.

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Mortify
text: The eyes let flow with tears, then blood, then the very soul—the whole wrung inside out, dripping down into the blackened puddle of the past.

name: Necrogenesis
text:
"Those may be the squirms of one life ending or of another beginning. Either way, I'd leave it alone."
—Rakka Mar

name: Nin, the Pain Artist
text: "Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."

name: Nucklavee
text: It loathes all tastes but two: spells and flesh.

name: Plumeveil
text:
"It was vast, a great sheet of soaring wings, and equally silent. It caught us unawares and blocked our view of the kithkin stronghold."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Oblation
text: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

name: Ruhan of the Fomori
text: Unfettered by allegiance, driven by war.

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

name: Selesnya Evangel
text: "The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."

name: Sigil Captain
text: "One sigil awarded for valor, the other awarded for surviving Hellkite's Pass."

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
text:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Wrecking Ball
text: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

name: Acorn Catapult
text: The Kalonian word for "ammunition" is the same as the word for "bait."

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Howling Mine
text: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Homeward Path
text:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

name: Serra Angel
text: Perfect justice in service of a perfect will.

name: Shattered Angel
text: She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

name: Spurnmage Advocate
text: "Our unity humbles our foes."

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Dreamborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Gomazoa
text: To explorers, "point man" is a polite way of saying "gomazoa fodder."

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Memory Erosion
text:
"The Filigree Texts do not compel you to act in accordance with their precepts. They only specify the consequences should you fail."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Murmurs from Beyond
text: Like pools of fog that hid treacherous rocks from sailors' eyes, so too were the hands of the kami.

name: Perilous Research
text: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned that no amount of death could deter the stream of thieves and desperate scholars.

name: Propaganda
text:
"You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."
—Volrath, to Karn

name: Ray of Command
text: "Heel."

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Riddlekeeper
text: Fools surrender their sanity to his riddles. Even greater fools try to solve them.

name: Arbiter of Knollridge
text: Though giants are mortal, they live so long and on such a grand scale that many small folk don't believe they ever truly die.

name: Slipstream Eel
text: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

name: Vedalken Plotter
text: "Fair? At what point in our negotiations did you convince yourself my goal was to be fair?"

name: Vision Skeins
text: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Attrition
text:
"I will trade life for life with the insurgents. Our resources, unlike theirs, are limitless."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Dread Cacodemon
text: Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Footbottom Feast
text: The scent of rot and vinegar fills the marsh, inviting boggarts from every warren to reunite and feast.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Gravedigger
text: Only a thin layer of dirt separates civilization from an undead apocalypse.

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: Mortivore
text: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

name: Bathe in Light
text: "Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Razorjaw Oni
text: It gnashed its teeth, and the battlefield filled with the screech of blade striking blade.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: The Prismatic Piper
text: It is everything and nothing.

name: Alms Collector
text: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
text: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Mobilized District
text: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

name: Mystic Gate
text: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Sea Gate Wreckage
text: Once a center for knowledge, Sea Gate now serves as a reminder of what was lost.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
text: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods
text: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Remote but always watching, the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Loyal Drake
text:
"Doves and pigeons are too subtle. When I send a message, I want it to have some teeth."
—Aeschel, royal diplomat

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
text:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Urza's Mine
text: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Murder of Crows
text: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text: "Live an exemplary life. Die a worthy death. Rise in eternal glory."

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: *Strixhaven Star* food critic Aspen Van Gnoot's coverage of the fight would go on to win a student journalism award for outstanding war reporting.

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
text: "Impress me."

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

name: Personal Tutor
text: Lomelda had spent four semesters on the waitlist for Kasmina's Advanced Polymorphological Theory seminar. She was determined not to miss a word.

name: Resculpt
text: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Shipwreck Dowser
text: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

name: Spellseeker
text: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

name: Stormsurge Kraken
text: Most see krakens as wantonly violent, failing to notice their meticulous attention to detail when dismantling a vessel.

name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
text: Even in their mountain fortresses, the Akroans have learned not to anger Thassa.

name: Angelic Field Marshal
text: Her presence on the battlefield can transform an unruly mob into a disciplined army.

name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
text: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

name: Windcaller Aven
text: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

name: Windrider Wizard
text: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."

name: Witching Well
text: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
text: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Carrier Thrall
text:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Curtains' Call
text:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Deadly Rollick
text: Otrimi was disappointed at how quickly its new friend got tired and stopped playing.

name: Demon's Disciple
text: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.

name: Baird, Steward of Argive
text: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Beware the generosity of demons.

name: Dread Drone
text: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Drown in Sorrow
text:
"The sad truth is that the whip of Erebos is long enough to wrap around all our throats."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder
text: Creator of life, bringer of death.

name: Exsanguinate
text: "I didn't say I would help you find your way home. I said I would help you finish your adventure."

name: Extinguish All Hope
text: Phenax, god of deception, offered the soldiers protection from every poison on Theros. He saw no need to mention that Pharika's poisons were drawn from Nyx.

name: Feast of Succession
text:
"Beware the eager host."
—Eligeth, crossroads augur

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Balan, Wandering Knight
text: "What weapon will you bear against one who's mastered them all?"

name: Final Parting
text:
"Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."
—Liliana Vess

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

name: Grave Pact
text: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

name: Heartless Act
text:
"It's them or us."
—General Kudro

name: Imp's Mischief
text:
"Do the innocent pay for the crimes of the guilty? Of course they do. That's the fate of the weak."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Battle Screech
text: All sounds harmonize with the Worldsoul.

name: Legion Vanguard
text: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

name: Lotleth Giant
text:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Loyal Subordinate
text: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Priest of the Blood Rite
text: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
text: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Serrated Scorpion
text: Each scorpion's venom is unique, thwarting sanctuary healers' attempts to develop an antidote.

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Thorn of the Black Rose
text: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of persuasion.

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Vindictive Lich
text: Heart, mind, soul—weapons all.

name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
text: "Look how they beg for the knife! The Demonlord has trained them well."

name: Witch's Cauldron
text: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.

name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
text: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Avatar of Slaughter
text:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

name: Balefire Dragon
text: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

name: Blood Aspirant
text: It's a small step from revel to bloodbath.

name: Captain Ripley Vance
text: The Spitfire Bastion bristles with cannons claimed from every ship she's conquered.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Champion of the Flame
text: Grand Warlord Radha's challengers are always defeated, but she rewards the most passionate with the Flame of Keld. After that, they burn for her.

name: Crimson Fleet Commodore
text:
"Kindly steer your fleet clear of the waters west of Scrub Isle. It would be a shame to incinerate such exquisite maritime craftsmanship."
—Commodore Axurik, to Admiral Yelise

name: Cyclops Electromancer
text: Every storm has an eye.

name: Deflecting Swat
text: Archmage attacks are little more than annoyances to Kalamax.

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Fiendlash
text: A fiery scourge for both flesh and soul.

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Frontier Warmonger
text: She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

name: Furious Rise
text: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Fencing Ace
text: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

name: Havoc Jester
text: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

name: Heartless Hidetsugu
text: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

name: Insurrection
text:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Living Lightning
text: Not all storms come from the sky.

name: Flawless Maneuver
text:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Makeshift Munitions
text: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Rakka Mar
text:
"The finest pawns are those with pawns of their own."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Gavony Silversmith
text: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

name: Ravaging Blaze
text: In time, not even the fire monks could keep up with Chandra.

name: Rorix Bladewing
text: In an attempt to restore pride to Shiv and to forge an undying legacy, Rorix traveled far to compete for glory in Otaria's Grand Coliseum.

name: Slice and Dice
text: Tahngarth relished the chance to bloody his blades on those who had ravaged his home.

name: Spikeshot Goblin
text: The path of a goblin shaman is a journey through a thousand ways of hurting people.

name: Spitebellows
text: Its emotions run high. You should just run.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

name: Star of Extinction
text:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Treasure Nabber
text: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
text: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Abundant Harvest
text: "Gaea knows what you need. Do you?"

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Broken Wings
text: Getting airborne with a kitesail is easy. It's everything afterward that takes focus, skill, and luck.

name: Courage in Crisis
text: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."

name: Crash of Rhino Beetles
text:
"When the herd moves, so should you."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

name: Deadly Recluse
text: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Entourage of Trest
text:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Slaughter the weak ones. They are unworthy of the gift of *compleation.*"

name: Finale of Devastation
text: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.

name: Fungal Plots
text: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ilysian Caryatid
text: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

name: Jade Mage
text: "Loneliness is a symptom of civilization."

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Kozilek's Predator
text: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

name: Lifeblood Hydra
text: Pharika has written her secrets on its bones so that only the worthy may discover them.

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
text: "My mind is the spread of the canopy. My heart is the embrace of the roots. I am deathless Llanowar, its fury and its peace."

name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
text: Wherever Yanggu goes, Mowu follows—sometimes at his side, sometimes obscuring him from view entirely.

name: Nemata, Grove Guardian
text:
"Anyone who believes the elder dragons are the only ancient powers of this world has spent too much time listening to the elder dragons."
—Multani

name: Obscuring Haze
text: Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
text: It gathers against the coming storm.

name: Oviya Pashiri, Sage Lifecrafter
text: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."

name: Predatory Rampage
text:
"It is the fate of the weak to fall."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ram Through
text:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Rot Shambler
text:
"If I die, feed me to a shambler. At least that way I'll be doing some good."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

name: Sakiko, Mother of Summer
text: "My heart beats with the rhythm of the forest."

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Skyshroud Claim
text: "Flowstone spreads, but new life spreads faster."

name: Skysnare Spider
text: The only thing more ill-tempered than a griffin in a web is the spider that must subdue it.

name: Snakeskin Veil
text: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

name: Song of the Dryads
text: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

name: Stonehoof Chieftain
text: The soldiers were hopelessly outmatched, having brought only swords, ballistas, fire, spellcraft, and several large cannons to the battle.

name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
text: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Keleth, Sunmane Familiar
text: She chooses her riders carefully and bears them to glory in battle after battle.

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

name: Akiri, Fearless Voyager
text: "No angel bars our ascent. Emeria waits above!"

name: Experiment Kraj
text:
"Of course it will grow beyond control—it was designed to choose its own evolution."
—Momir Vig

name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
text: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "We must rebuild Taj-Nar. Not for Raksha, not for the Vanished Ones, but for those who still remain."

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
text: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
text: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
text: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Rafiq of the Many
text: Many sigils, one purpose.

name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
text: The orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives in the Karplusan Mountains, gathering his dead army, intent on revenge.

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
text: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Teysa Karlov
text: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

name: Knighted Myr
text:
"This one fights like a leonin!"
—Jor Kadeen

name: Tuya Bearclaw
text: "Send in your cavalry! Diaglu loves horsemeat."

name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
text: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

name: Zilortha, Strength Incarnate
text:
"Many thought they knew its weakness. They are dead."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Ashnod's Altar
text:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

name: Bonder's Ornament
text:
"Found families deserve a family crest too."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Boompile
text:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Firemind Vessel
text: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

name: Haunted Cloak
text: Bear the weight of so many spirits and you'll surrender civility and restraint to savagery and instinct.

name: Loyal Retainers
text: Because sometimes the greatest enemy is paperwork.

name: Hero's Blade
text: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Inspiring Statuary
text: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

name: Jeweled Lotus
text:
"I've seen my share of baubles, minister. Whatever ostentatious bit of glitter you have there won't convince me to ... Oh my."
—Emperor Ayrelion

name: Letter of Acceptance
