text: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Meteor Golem
text: Herala sighed as the creature pulled itself from the smoldering pit, the ground boiling beneath its still-glowing feet. She had just plowed that field.

name: Pathrazer of Ulamog
text: No thought but hunger. No strategy but destruction.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: A capable mage can tune its focus, refracting mana through each disk in turn to cast any spell they desire.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: To understand Ravnica, one must first understand how each guild contributes to its stability.

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Staunch Throneguard
text:
"Brago in his arrogance let the throne's defenses fall dormant. Our new queen is not so incautious."
—Livio, Oathsworn Sentinel

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Vial of Dragonfire
text:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Rejuvenating Springs
text: When they're done pummeling each other, the fighters relax companionably in the springs, warming their sore muscles.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Spectator Seating
text: The loudest and most heartfelt cheers come from the cheap seats.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Ministrant of Obligation
text: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Training Center
text: Between matches, combatants practice to stay in peak mental and physical form.

name: Undergrowth Stadium
text: To get to Valor's Reach, competitors must first make a name for themselves in the smaller arenas.

name: Vault of Champions
text: Where victors are commemorated and moments of glory immortalized.

name: Myrsmith
text: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
text: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
text: A force as voracious as time itself.

name: Alms Collector
text: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

name: Angelic Field Marshal
text: Her presence on the battlefield can transform an unruly mob into a disciplined army.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Balan, Wandering Knight
text: "What weapon will you bear against one who's mastered them all?"

name: Flawless Maneuver
text:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Loyal Retainers
text: Because sometimes the greatest enemy is paperwork.

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Smothering Tithe
text:
"I await your donation."
—Dasha, Orzhov priest

name: Steelshaper's Gift
text: Some blades seek their own wielders.

name: Sublime Exhalation
text: Exhale, and let the winds carry your soul for all eternity.

name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
text:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Wrath of God
text: Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Palace Sentinels
text:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
text: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

name: Bribery
text: "It seems your ticket is in order after all, ma'am."

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Fierce Guardianship
text:
"Hunt somewhere else. This is your only warning."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
text: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

name: Personal Tutor
text: Lomelda had spent four semesters on the waitlist for Kasmina's Advanced Polymorphological Theory seminar. She was determined not to miss a word.

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Spellseeker
text: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

name: Stormsurge Kraken
text: Most see krakens as wantonly violent, failing to notice their meticulous attention to detail when dismantling a vessel.

name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
text: A force as voracious as time itself.

name: Pianna, Nomad Captain
text: Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

name: Curtains' Call
text:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Deadly Rollick
text: Otrimi was disappointed at how quickly its new friend got tired and stopped playing.

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Beware the generosity of demons.

name: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder
text: Creator of life, bringer of death.

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

name: Grave Pact
text: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

name: Imp's Mischief
text:
"Do the innocent pay for the crimes of the guilty? Of course they do. That's the fate of the weak."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
text: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Vindictive Lich
text: Heart, mind, soul—weapons all.

name: Avatar of Slaughter
text:
"Diplomacy has solved nothing. Only bloodspill can end this now. Call forth the warbringer."
—Basandra, Battle Seraph

name: Balefire Dragon
text: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

name: Deflecting Swat
text: Archmage attacks are little more than annoyances to Kalamax.

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Heartless Hidetsugu
text: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

name: Insurrection
text:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Star of Extinction
text:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

name: Treasure Nabber
text: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

text: "Slaughter the weak ones. They are unworthy of the gift of *compleation.*"

name: Sunspear Shikari
text: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides. The fight for survival reunited them.

name: Undergrowth Stadium
text: To get to Valor's Reach, competitors must first make a name for themselves in the smaller arenas.

name: Vault of Champions
text: Where victors are commemorated and moments of glory immortalized.

name: All That Glitters
text: Anyone who says love is the greatest gift of all has never received a ruby the size of their face.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text:
"Dissent will become perfection."
—Elesh Norn

name: Generous Gift
text:
"Served cold? Nonsense! The best way to serve revenge is with an elephant of nervous disposition! Everyone knows that."
—Avenir the Petty

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "I've heard enough from you, heretic."

name: Path to Exile
text: Attacking a kami is considered bad luck, so seasoned mages have developed techniques to usher them back to the spirit realm without violence.

name: Puresteel Paladin
text: His heart is pure. His world is not.

name: Return to Dust
text:
"What's the big deal? All things will eventually cease to be, this one's just getting a head start."
—Edorin, the Timesmith

name: Steelshaper's Gift
text: A good blacksmith will craft the weapon you ask for. A master will craft the weapon you dream of.

name: Supply Runners
text: Good dogs stay by your side until the end. Great dogs leave to bring back aid.

name: Counterspell
text: "Nice spell you got there. Be a shame if something happened to it."

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Does this choice really seem so simple, syr knight?"

name: Frantic Search
text: One half-written novel, a year's worth of lecture notes, and several grocery lists later, Shiori began to wonder if she'd hacked the wrong terminal.

name: Dread Return
text: The luckiest acolytes were those who didn't survive long enough to see the archfiend's return.

name: Exsanguinate
text: "A small sip here and a small sip there, and all of a sudden I need a new dance partner."

name: Grave Pact
text: As the ritual neared its climax, the exultant cultists waited with bated breath, unaware of the looming consequences of the scroll's translation error.

name: Swift Response
text:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain

name: Kindred Dominance
text: "Today will end with a feast," gloated the dragon. And what a feast it was.

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Keep looking up and you'll miss what's right in front of your face.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "If they didn't want me to steal this, they should've used more than seven layers of shatterproof antimagus glass."

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Linear time? You may as well believe in triangular gravity!"

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: "First you summon the lightning, then you make it dance."

name: Treasure Nabber
text:
"Opposable thumbs, opposable toes, prehensile tails, boundary issues . . . no treasure is safe from a goblin."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Vandalblast
text:
"I hope the review board was paying attention, because my thesis would be hard to do twice."
—Spyracus, Prismari mage-student

name: Arachnogenesis
text: "Captain, is now a good time to mention I'm allergic to spiders?"

name: Elvish Mystic
text: "Just as new shoots rise from winter's slumber, so too will my people rise to greatness once again."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The trees keep our history better than any digital device."
—Satsuki, the Living Lore

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Ohran Frostfang
text:
"Nonsense! Everyone knows that snakes are sluggish and docile when cold!"
—Bodrick the Overconfident, last words

name: Arcane Signet
text: Matic had only taken the ring to appease his grandmother when she'd pressed it insistently into his palm. As the rats scurried away from its light, he understood her urgency.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: Those who crave power for selfish ends find that it always floats just beyond their fingertips, forever maddeningly out of reach.

name: Fellwar Stone
text: Nothing shatters a peaceful life like newfound riches.

name: Thran Dynamo
text:
"The 'pinnacle' of advancement is a concept that exists only in the narrow minds of those with no ambition."
—Yawgmoth

name: Command Tower
text:
"I'm not sure who's in charge around here, but I'm pretty sure I know where to go to find out."
—Corliss the Wanderer

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Rejuvenating Springs
text:
"This garden is where my grandmother had her first breakthrough on biomodular logarithmic theory!"
—Zimone, Quandrix mage-student

name: Reliquary Tower
text: At a certain point, the only thing a wizard wants for is time. And after that, nothing.

name: Spectator Seating
text:
"It's almost as exciting as watching a great battle from the Blood Age in person!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

name: Training Center
text:
"Sometimes you just need to be inspired by a massive explosion or a color that didn't exist five seconds ago."
—Rootha, Prismari mage-student

name: Undergrowth Stadium
text:
"Witherbloom always has the home-field advantage."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

name: Vault of Champions
text:
"Sure, true self-worth has to come from within, but trophies are nice too."
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "Leadership is both a blessing and a burden. Every day I strive to prove myself a worthy steward to those who follow me."

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text: "The body has limits. The mind does not."

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "I am the bridge between sea and sky. Wind and waves alike rise at my whim."

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text: "Live an exemplary life. Die a worthy death. Rise in eternal glory."

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "If you travel only to reach a destination, you will miss the point of the journey."

name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
text:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
text: As wild and untamed as the Roil from which it was born.

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
text: "A life is meaningless until put to use."

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
text: Living proof that friendship and loyalty transcend language.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "As Yavimaya yearns to grow beyond its boundaries, so must we spend our lives seeking new horizons."

name: Teysa Karlov
text: "Life and death are two sides of the same coin."

name: Wanderer's Strike
text:
"Precise, clean cuts. No one saw anything. Again. Tag the report with my code and file it."
—Lavinia

name: Flawless Maneuver
text: "I've survived a century's worth of assassination attempts, but this might be the most pathetic of them all."

name: Smothering Tithe
text: All that glitters is yours.

name: Fierce Guardianship
text: "Mindless violence withers in the face of a master's skill."

name: Deadly Rollick
text: "Anyone can make their audience beg for an encore . . . I prefer mine to beg for mercy!"

name: Demonic Tutor
text: "Is the knowledge really forbidden because it is dangerous to you? Or perhaps because it is dangerous to those who seek to control you?"

name: Balefire Dragon
text: An unwelcome light on a dark and foggy night.

name: Deflecting Swat
text: "Come to slay the dragon for the good of the kingdom? How terribly predictable."

name: Insurrection
text:
"Why should our fates be decided by pompous decrees from an empty throne? Fight with me and seize the reins of your own destiny!"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers

name: Ainok Bond-Kin
text: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

name: Wrath of God
text: Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.

name: Finale of Devastation
text: With a roar, the forest came alive.

name: Obscuring Haze
text: "Be calm, wise spirit. You are in a world that is not your own, but I am not your enemy."

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Model? I'm insulted. It's by all reasonable metrics a fully functional planetary system, scaled down for easier study."
—Urza, to Tawnos

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Narci, Fable Singer
text: "All stories eventually come to an end."

name: Abstruse Archaic
text: Unburdened from mortality, archaics wander the Vastlands seeking knowledge only they can comprehend.

name: Calamity of the Titans
text: To the Zendikari, an apocalypse. To the Eldrazi, a day like any other.

name: Rise of the Eldrazi
text: And still the titans were not sated.

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Ondu Spiritdancer
text: "We travel to know the land—its sacred spirit, its perils and blessings."

name: Regal Sliver
text:
"It is possible that some queens are not born queens, but evolve into that form over time."
—Rukarumel, field notes

name: Taunting Sliver
text:
"The way it shakes its hood is astonishingly irritating."
—Neena, outland scout

name: Capricious Sliver
text: They hunt on pure instinct, driven by the will of the hive mind with no time wasted on independent thought.

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

name: Hatchery Sliver
text: A single survivor can repopulate a devastated hive within a week.

name: Darksteel Monolith
text: Mirrodin's heart beats with Phyrexian oil.

name: Body Double
text: "I am who I pretend to be."

name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
text: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

name: Bribery
text: "It seems your ticket is in order after all, ma'am."

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Bane of Bala Ged
text: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage, its lush jungles and cascading rivers reduced to dust.

name: Endless One
text: It embodies all possible meanings of the word "infinite."

name: It That Betrays
text: All will be harvested.

name: Oblivion Sower
text: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

name: Spatial Contortion
text:
"For those without the Planeswalker spark, the merest touch of the Blind Eternities can kill."
—Ugin

name: Counterspell
text: The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.

name: Titan's Presence
text: Dust and memory are all that remain in Ulamog's wake.

name: Bonescythe Sliver
text:
"It seems docile enough. Perhaps we could train it to reap the grain—it would be the easiest harvest season of our lives!"
—Georgina, farmer, now deceased

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Constricting Sliver
text: Newborn slivers will sometimes wrap themselves playfully around a human's finger. They grow out of the "playful" part.

name: Deploy the Gatewatch
text: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

name: Grasp of Fate
text: Few escape the Underworld. Fewer still escape fate.

name: Harsh Mercy
text:
"There is no greater burden than choosing who to save."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: "Scholars seek to understand the way the world is. I wish to shape the world into what it should be."

name: Cryptic Serpent
text: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

name: Oath of Gideon
text: "For justice and peace, I will keep watch."

name: Omen of the Sun
text: "My time will come, when every soul will bask in my glory and obey my law."

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Sentinel Sliver
text:
"Nine hells! How does something with no eyes see so far?"
—Max, Benalish scout

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Sinew Sliver
text: As the muscle cords of the creature twitched, Hanna saw an unsettling unanimity in the others' rippling flesh. She didn't know what it meant, but she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
text: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Diffusion Sliver
text: Its call disrupts the delicate balance of the inner ear, disorienting intruders without direct confrontation.

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Flux Channeler
text: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Galerider Sliver
text:
"I wish we'd never visited that accursed hive. Even here, surrounded by nothing but clouds, I swear I can still hear the horrible clicking, slithering sounds."
—Monihan, aerial surveyor

name: Oath of Jace
text: "For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch."

name: Shifting Sliver
text: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

name: Synapse Sliver
text:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Windfall
text: "Rich" is a relative term.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Winged Sliver
text:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Clot Sliver
text:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Crippling Fear
text: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

name: Crypt Sliver
text:
"Someone's been tampering with the graves again. But what kind of grave robber uses a pickax?"
—Morgan, cemetery groundskeeper

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Mindwrack Harpy
text: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros... and they thoroughly deserve it.

name: Deranged Assistant
text: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

name: Syphon Sliver
text: The hive knows no fear or mercy, only hunger.

name: Blade Sliver
text:
"A great many dangerous creatures call this region home. They all avoid the slivers."
—Foothill guide

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Blur Sliver
text: Traveling across the desert alone, you might assume you'd see them coming, but that would be your third mistake.

name: Bonesplitter Sliver
text: As the time streams grew more and more unstable, Dominaria's creatures struggled to adapt. The intense pressures led to many dead ends but also to lethal new forms that appeared as suddenly as the ashen rains.

name: Cleaving Sliver
text: When it wriggled closer to a thrum of slivers, their talons hardened and glinted in the sun. One took a playful swipe at a tree trunk, and its new blade cut clean through.

name: Hollowhead Sliver
text:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Repeated Reverberation
text: It's in the nature of fire to grow.

name: Efficient Construction
text: For some of Ghirapur's aerowrights, building thopters is a byproduct of larger construction efforts.

name: Spiteful Sliver
text:
"The key to safely studying any sliver is to find out what provokes it, then absolutely never do that."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Striking Sliver
text: There is no such thing as surprising a sliver.

name: Two-Headed Sliver
text: When a species becomes so dominant that no other can compete, evolution gets creative.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Brood Sliver
text: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
text:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Enchantress's Presence
text: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Font of Fertility
text: Drink deep, and know the path to the heart of the wilds.

name: Gemhide Sliver
text: Squee had been disemboweled many times before, but never by something so stunningly beautiful.

name: Greater Tanuki
text: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

name: Herald of the Pantheon
text: The distinction of bearing the gods' banner is nothing compared to the glory of being closer to Nyx.

name: All That Glitters
text: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Manaweft Sliver
text: Their pearlescent scales are highly sought after by those who lack the instincts for self-preservation.

name: Megantic Sliver
text: Slivers will swiftly adapt to fill any evolutionary niche, even if that niche is "earthshaking apex predator."

name: Might Sliver
text:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Omen of the Hunt
text: "My time will come, when no road will divide the endless verdure of the trees."

name: Quick Sliver
text: The directors of the Riptide Project wanted instant results on the sliver experiments. They got their wish.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Slimefoot, I know I said I wanted to grow our repository of knowledge, but this isn't what I had in mind."

name: Sanctum Weaver
text: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

name: Sandwurm Convergence
text: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

name: Setessan Champion
text: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Venom Sliver
text: The venom softens tissue and liquefies internal organs, allowing the slivers to feed freely without wasting time chewing.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text:
"Graceful? Yes. Beautiful? Absolutely. Harmless? Definitely not."
—Fyndhorn elder

name: Cloudshredder Sliver
text: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Firewake Sliver
text:
"When establishing a new hive in hostile territory, slivers abandon all sense of individual self-preservation to ensure the queen's survival."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Harmonic Sliver
text:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Hibernation Sliver
text: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

name: Jukai Naturalist
text: He had heard rumors of the cities—the constant noise, the stagnant air, the tainted water—and he had no wish to learn if they were true.

name: Lavabelly Sliver
text: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Oath of Teferi
text: "For the lost and forgotten, I will keep watch."

name: Satyr Enchanter
text: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."

name: Sliver Hivelord
text:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
text: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Fierce Guardianship
text:
"Hunt somewhere else. This is your only warning."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Crashing Drawbridge
text:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Filigree Attendant
text:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dextrous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

name: Forsaken Monument
text:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Honor-Worn Shaku
text: Before being presented to its lord, each shaku is blessed by every hero of every region within that lord's domain.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mirage Mirror
text: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
text: Nevinyrral's final act of spite was to make sure all of his magic was destroyed along with him.

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Perilous Vault
text: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.

name: Scaretiller
text: Fields of battle turn to fields of grain.

name: Silent Arbiter
text: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

name: Stonecoil Serpent
text: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Ghostly Flicker
text: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Goliath Sphinx
text: He makes his home on the tallest mountain in Sejiri, where the vista is as endless as his patience.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Forge of Heroes
text: History is not delicately woven. It is hammered with fire.

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: The Prismatic Piper
text: It is everything and nothing.

name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
text: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

name: Spontaneous Mutation
text: When the body turns, the mind soon follows.

name: Strategic Planning
text:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

name: Trove Tracker
text: The best treasures are the least shared.

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Wrong Turn
text: Its bewildered bellow was met with a stern "shh."

name: Bitter Revelation
text:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

name: Bladebrand
text:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith, the Scourge Diva

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Corpse Churn
text:
"The distraction of your life has ended. Now your service begins."
—Kalitas, thrall of Ulamog

name: Court of Ambition
text: Watch your step.

name: Crow of Dark Tidings
text:
"Well, this can't be a good sign."
—Old Rutstein

name: Cuombajj Witches
text: All things are connected: light to dark, age to youth, blood to blood.

name: Defiant Salvager
text: "I didn't survive that crash just so I could fall to the likes of you."

name: Demonic Lore
text:
"The greatest works of literature leave the reader forever altered."
—Nevinyrral, Urborg tyrant

name: Dhund Operative
text: Baral's spies always have the latest technology.

name: Elvish Doomsayer
text: "From a tiny doubt, the greatest fears grow and flourish. May the weeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Eyeblight Assassin
text: "Boggart blood disgusts me almost as much as the foul creatures themselves."

name: Eyeblight Cullers
text:
"As long as eyeblights exist, the hunt will never end."
—Miara, Thorn of the Glade

name: Eyeblight Massacre
text:
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"
—Nissa Revane, to Dwynen

name: Falthis, Shadowcat Familiar
text: She sticks to her chosen master closer than their own shadow.

name: Feast of Succession
text:
"Beware the eager host."
—Eligeth, crossroads augur

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Ghastly Demise
text:
"Anyone can snap her fingers and yank a soul. I prefer to kill creatively."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
text: "Perfection is elusive. Let us try again."

name: Maalfeld Twins
text:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Gisa the Mad

name: Miara, Thorn of the Glade
text: "Approach from downwind. Tread with care. Aim for the heart."

name: Murder
text:
"No matter how busy my schedule gets, I always try to take time for that personal touch."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

name: Necrotic Hex
text:
"You foolish knights pound your breastplates and vow to fight until your last breath. As if that's when it ends."
—Tormod, the Desecrator

name: Nightshade Harvester
text: "Anywhere the moonlight touches—that's my garden."

name: Noxious Dragon
text: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

name: Null Caller
text: Zendikar's defenders include both healers and vampires. One way or another, the fallen will return to the fight.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Pride of the Perfect
text: Like moonglove's flowers, the greatest beauty often masks the greatest dangers.

name: Profane Transfusion
text:
"Those that fall short of perfection can still contribute to the Great Work."
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

name: Revenant
text:
"Not again."
—Hans

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Captain's Call
text:
"Who among you has the courage to face certain death? Who will heed my call?"
—Rayel Vanger, Firstblade of Thune

name: Spark Harvest
text: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Thorn of the Black Rose
text: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of persuasion.

name: Tormod, the Desecrator
text: "Life is but the precursor to a long and successful death."

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Vow of Torment
text:
"Peace is a privilege you haven't earned."
—Tevesh Szat

name: Court of Grace
text: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

name: Alena, Kessig Trapper
text: "Halana and I have a bond that'll never be broken."

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Brazen Freebooter
text: Finders, keepers.

name: Burning Anger
text: "With rage as your forge, your hammer can smite anything."

name: Champion of the Flame
text: Grand Warlord Radha's challengers are always defeated, but she rewards the most passionate with the Flame of Keld. After that, they burn for her.

name: Coercive Recruiter
text: "Choose, vampire: our hat on your head, or no hat, no head."

name: Court Street Denizen
text: "The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."

name: Court of Ire
text: Hold your tongue, lest you burn it.

name: Crimson Fleet Commodore
text:
"Kindly steer your fleet clear of the waters west of Scrub Isle. It would be a shame to incinerate such exquisite maritime craftsmanship."
—Commodore Axurik, to Admiral Yelise

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Emberwilde Captain
text: "You are bold, challenger, but flammable."

name: Explosion of Riches
text: "You've got how much gold there?"

name: Fiery Cannonade
text: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

name: Dispeller's Capsule
text:
"I find its symmetry pleasing. It rids our world of offensive refuse while disposing of itself."
—Dolomarus, Proctor of the Clean

name: Frenzied Saddlebrute
text: The drumbeats of the horde echo in every heart.

name: Furnace Celebration
text: Nothing impresses goblins more than something that's bound to kill them.

name: Goblin Trailblazer
text:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

name: Hellkite Courser
text: The charge was heralded not by horns, but by the dragon's echoing roar.

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Jeska's Will
text:
"Gather your strength. Prepare yourself."
—Jeska, to Radha

name: Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar
text: Kediss loves molten metal, searing flames, and head scratches.

name: Krark, the Thumbless
text: "Double or nothing."

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Lightning-Rig Crew
text: A pirate ship in battle is a storm of activity.

name: Makeshift Munitions
text: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

name: Port Razer
text: "Smash and grab, loot and burn, then it is the next town's turn!"

name: Renegade Tactics
text: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

name: Ripscale Predator
text: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

name: Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh
text: Strength is relative.

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: To a goblin, value is based on the four S's: shiny, stabby, smelly, and super smelly.

name: Skyraker Giant
text: She will not be content until hers is the highest head in the sky.

name: Soul's Fire
text: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

name: Soulfire Eruption
text: Forsake flesh. Choose fire.

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Stonefury
text: Akoum can make any intruder look small.

name: Valakut Invoker
text:
"As long as we have walked this world, we have known it as a harsh and unforgiving place."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Welding Sparks
text:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Wild Celebrants
text: "You can tell something's really valuable by the sound it makes when you slam your staff into it."

name: Ambush Viper
text:
"Living creatures seldom impress me. But I like this one."
—Uta Falkenrath

name: Ancient Animus
text: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

name: Annoyed Altisaur
text: It pairs a long neck with a short temper.

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Biowaste Blob
text:
"The Simic will be fined for contaminating the waterways. In the meantime, seize that blob!"
—Arrester Polgar

name: First Response
text:
"There's never a good time for a disaster or an attack. That's why we're here."
—Oren, militia captain

name: Court of Bounty
text: To grow is to triumph.

name: Crushing Vines
text:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters. This dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

name: Dawnglade Regent
text:
"Every creature in the glade paused and stared. Overcome, I bowed to the beast."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Entourage of Trest
text:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

name: Inspiring Roar
text:
"This is about more than aether or inventions. Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!"
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood
text: "Something mighty stirs in the forest. Can't you feel it?"

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Immaculate Magistrate
text: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Lifecrafter's Gift
text: The best engineers recognize when a problem has already been solved.

name: Magus of the Order
text: "Life for life. The cost is always the same."

name: Molder Beast
text:
"A trail of scrap metal can lead it into an ambush. But take care not to overfeed it."
—Adaran, Tangle hunter

name: Monstrous Onslaught
text:
"Regards from Peema."
—Rishkar

name: Numa, Joraga Chieftain
text: His blade carves a path for his people. His words guide them along it.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Reshape the Earth
text:
"The land is not dead, merely dormant. It will awaken if you know how to ask."
—Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood

name: Iona's Judgment
text: Beneath the gaze of angels, only the righteous may stand without fear.

name: Scaled Behemoth
text: Surviving an encounter with it is proof enough that an initiate is ready for the Trial of Strength.

name: Scrounging Bandar
text: "It was right here a second ago . . ."

name: Sentinel Spider
text:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Sifter Wurm
text:
"Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now. Look elsewhere for refuge."
—Arnun, vizier of the menagerie

name: Silverback Shaman
text: The apes of Yavimaya draw strength from the spirits of their ancestors.

name: Soul's Might
text: An avatar he sculpts of instinct and force.

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Strength of the Pack
text: The pack that ambushes, eviscerates, and devours together stays together.

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Abomination of Llanowar
text: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.

name: Amareth, the Lustrous
text: "Come closer, dear, and let me see that bauble. I've got a match for it somewhere..."

name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
text: "Life ... is not ... a race."

name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
text: "Nature is a dance. Master it, and the world can keep no secrets from you."

name: Belbe, Corrupted Observer
text: "Those who wish to become evincar must first cast off the shackles of compassion."

name: Captain Vargus Wrath
text: "To be a successful cutthroat, you have to truly enjoy the work."

name: Colfenor, the Last Yew
text: "To reach my age, you must know when to bend with the winds and when to stand tall."

name: Ghen, Arcanum Weaver
text: "Any apprentice with a spellbook and two sticks can churn out a fireball. This is different. This is art."

name: Gor Muldrak, Amphinologist
text: "The day of reckoning is coming. Knowledge of the amphin may be our only refuge."

name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
text: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

name: Hans Eriksson
text: "Nothing could ruin such a fine day, Saffi."

name: Keleth, Sunmane Familiar
text: She chooses her riders carefully and bears them to glory in battle after battle.

name: Jared Carthalion, True Heir
text: "I'm here for what's mine."

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
text: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

name: Kangee, Sky Warden
text: "Let their horrors and machines come. We will meet them blow for blow."

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
text: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
text: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

name: Nymris, Oona's Trickster
text: Mischief is its own reward.

name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
text: "I'm bored with now."

name: Reyav, Master Smith
text: "There's always room for improvement."

name: Thalisse, Reverent Medium
text: She hears every voice from the swirling, whispering mist and swears to tell their stories.

name: Tuya Bearclaw
text: "Send in your cavalry! Diaglu loves horsemeat."

name: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash
text: The gifts of Jund never come without a price.

name: Amorphous Axe
text: A weapon forged for every hand.

name: Angelic Armaments
text: Forged in dark hours from the flame that would not die.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Armory of Iroas
text: Each weapon is as unique as the champion who carried it to battle.

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Bladegriff Prototype
text: The new model has improved aerodynamics but introduced a few glitches in the targeting system.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Charcoal Diamond
text: The essence of night to harden the soul.

name: Commander's Plate
text: Not all beautiful things are fragile.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Filigree Familiar
text:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Fire Diamond
text: The essence of flame to stoke the spirit.

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Golem Artisan
text: Better living through metallurgy.

name: Haunted Cloak
text: Bear the weight of so many spirits and you'll surrender civility and restraint to savagery and instinct.

name: Horizon Stone
text: Kruphix once dreamed that he traveled beyond the edge of the world to an unfamiliar land. Curious, he picked up a rock, and awoke to find it had followed him from the dream into reality.

name: Howling Golem
text: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Jeweled Lotus
text:
"I've seen my share of baubles, minister. Whatever ostentatious bit of glitter you have there won't convince me to ... Oh my."
—Emperor Ayrelion

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Loreseeker's Stone
text: Mages come from far and wide to bathe in its wisdom.

name: Lumengrid Gargoyle
text:
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Maelstrom Colossus
text:
"Nothing of the Maelstrom is quiet or easy."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Marble Diamond
text: The essence of sunlight to brighten the way.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Moss Diamond
text: The essence of life to heal the world.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
text: Nevinyrral's final act of spite was to make sure all of his magic was destroyed along with him.

name: Pennon Blade
text: Draped with the pennon of a fallen outpost, the sword came to symbolize the peoples of Zendikar becoming one.

name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
text: The Consulate keeps watch at each of the eleven bridges to ensure that the market remains a haven for commerce, not for con artists.

name: Perilous Myr
text: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Rings of Brighthearth
text:
"Without flame, there would be no iron tools, no cooked meals, no purge of old growth to make room for new."
—Brighthearth creed

name: Seer's Lantern
text: A light to bring hope in dark times.

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Open the Armory
text: "Once Avacyn returned, I hoped I'd never need these things again. I didn't think I'd be dusting them off to use against angels."

name: Sisay's Ring
text:
"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sky Diamond
text: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Staunch Throneguard
text:
"Brago in his arrogance let the throne's defenses fall dormant. Our new queen is not so incautious."
—Livio, Oathsworn Sentinel

name: Sunset Pyramid
text: Decades to build. Hours to demolish.

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Universal Solvent
text:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

name: Workshop Assistant
text: Sometimes the smallest things make the biggest difference.

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Rejuvenating Springs
text: When they're done pummeling each other, the fighters relax companionably in the springs, warming their sore muscles.

name: Spectator Seating
text: The loudest and most heartfelt cheers come from the cheap seats.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Training Center
text: Between matches, combatants practice to stay in peak mental and physical form.

name: Undergrowth Stadium
text: To get to Valor's Reach, competitors must first make a name for themselves in the smaller arenas.

name: Palace Sentinels
text:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Vault of Champions
text: Where victors are commemorated and moments of glory immortalized.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Wyleth, Soul of Steel
text: "Two things a warrior needs: a strong sword and a strong will."

name: Timely Ward
text: Behind every general who leads from the front is a nervous mage with a spell at the ready.

name: Blazing Sunsteel
text: Wyleth emerged from the crater unscathed with the sun's fury trapped in his hands.

name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
text:
"To sail through those waters is to offer oneself as tribute."
—Captain Hoyrik

name: Stumpsquall Hydra
text: In preparation to grow new heads, a hydra may rid itself of older ones.

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Patron of the Valiant
text: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Disenchant
text: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Ironclad Slayer
text: The best weapon is the one at hand.

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: On Serra's Wings
text:
"The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."
—*Song of All*, canto 524

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Sigarda's Aid
text: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Unquestioned Authority
text: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

name: Promise of Tomorrow
text: Death can wait.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
text: He loved his cities in the clouds. When he traveled to the lands below, he brought many reminders of his home.

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Whelming Wave
text:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Expedite
text: "I run, and thunder follows."

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
text: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

name: Volcanic Fallout
text:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Wild Ricochet
text:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

name: Rebbec, Architect of Ascension
text:
"She sees beyond technology to what it enables."
—Glacian, powerstone engineer

name: Word of Seizing
text: "Obey!"

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
text: "My mind is the spread of the canopy. My heart is the embrace of the roots. I am deathless Llanowar, its fury and its peace."

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
text:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Seraph of Dawn
text: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Seraphic Greatsword
text: Light as a feather. Sharp as an angel's wrath.

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Spitting Image
text: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
text: "Nothing is too broken to mend."

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Bonesplitter
text:
"It puts an end to what ails you."
—Jeorg, Valla battlemaster

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Skywhaler's Shot
text: In the moment of truth, it is as though time stands still, and the whale waits, suspended in the sky.

name: Brass Squire
text:
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Haunted Cloak
text: Bear the weight of so many spirits and you'll surrender civility and restraint to savagery and instinct.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Mask of Avacyn
text: It hides the face and protects the soul.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Slash the Ranks
text: The generals each surveyed their devastated forces. Then, slowly, they turned to each other and raised their swords.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Slaughter the Strong
text:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

name: Encroaching Wastes
text: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Slith Ascendant
text: Instinctively drawn to the light of its "mother-sun," each slith follows that sun's path around Mirrodin.

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text: Its courtyards are lit during every hour of the day so that night may never fall within its walls.

name: Stone Quarry
text: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Squad Captain
text: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

name: Akiri, Line-Slinger
text: Her bold movements are anchored in the careful precision of each rope.

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

name: Triumphant Reckoning
text: In a flash of light and a burst of aether, despair turned to hope and defeat turned to victory.

name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
text: "Through me, the Great Teacher's voice will rattle this world."

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus
text:
"It lives . . . IT LIVES!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix
text: She bears the greatest burden of all: that of knowing.

name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
text: "How does one become a self-taught genius? Naturally, it requires brains."

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
text: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Trusty Packbeast
text:
"Margaret has traveled with me to the end of the world and back."
—Hewen Frit, merchant

name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
text: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: The Prismatic Piper
text: It is everything and nothing.

name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
text: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

name: Keleth, Sunmane Familiar
text: She chooses her riders carefully and bears them to glory in battle after battle.

name: Rebbec, Architect of Ascension
text:
"She sees beyond technology to what it enables."
—Glacian, powerstone engineer

name: Eligeth, Crossroads Augur
text: "There's no better place to divine the future than at a nexus of branching presents."

name: Glacian, Powerstone Engineer
text:
"His energy is as boundless as the powerstones'."
—Rebbec, architect of ascension

name: Falthis, Shadowcat Familiar
text: She sticks to her chosen master closer than their own shadow.

name: Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
text: "Perfection is elusive. Let us try again."

name: Miara, Thorn of the Glade
text: "Approach from downwind. Tread with care. Aim for the heart."

name: Tormod, the Desecrator
text: "Life is but the precursor to a long and successful death."

name: Alena, Kessig Trapper
text: "Halana and I have a bond that'll never be broken."

name: Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar
text: Kediss loves molten metal, searing flames, and head scratches.

name: Krark, the Thumbless
text: "Double or nothing."

name: Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh
text: Strength is relative.

name: Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood
text: "Something mighty stirs in the forest. Can't you feel it?"

name: Azure Fleet Admiral
text:
"Your concern for my safety is touching, but as long as your gunners remain reliably erratic, I see no reason to change course."
—Admiral Yelise, to Commodore Axurik

name: Numa, Joraga Chieftain
text: His blade carves a path for his people. His words guide them along it.

name: Abomination of Llanowar
text: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.

name: Amareth, the Lustrous
text: "Come closer, dear, and let me see that bauble. I've got a match for it somewhere..."

name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
text: "Life ... is not ... a race."

name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
text: "Nature is a dance. Master it, and the world can keep no secrets from you."

name: Belbe, Corrupted Observer
text: "Those who wish to become evincar must first cast off the shackles of compassion."

name: Captain Vargus Wrath
text: "To be a successful cutthroat, you have to truly enjoy the work."

name: Colfenor, the Last Yew
text: "To reach my age, you must know when to bend with the winds and when to stand tall."

name: Ghen, Arcanum Weaver
text: "Any apprentice with a spellbook and two sticks can churn out a fireball. This is different. This is art."

name: Gor Muldrak, Amphinologist
text: "The day of reckoning is coming. Knowledge of the amphin may be our only refuge."

name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
text: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

name: Hans Eriksson
text: "Nothing could ruin such a fine day, Saffi."

name: Angel of the Dawn
text: She sings for all those who have been silenced.

name: Jared Carthalion, True Heir
text: "I'm here for what's mine."

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
text: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

name: Kangee, Sky Warden
text: "Let their horrors and machines come. We will meet them blow for blow."

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
text: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
text: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

name: Nymris, Oona's Trickster
text: Mischief is its own reward.

name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
text: "I'm bored with now."

name: Flood of Recollection
text: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

name: Reyav, Master Smith
text: "There's always room for improvement."

name: Thalisse, Reverent Medium
text: She hears every voice from the swirling, whispering mist and swears to tell their stories.

name: Tuya Bearclaw
text: "Send in your cavalry! Diaglu loves horsemeat."

name: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash
text: The gifts of Jund never come without a price.

name: Confiscate
text:
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit."
—Barrin, progress report

name: Court of Cunning
text: A throne built on wisdom cannot be toppled.

name: Daring Saboteur
text: "They'll never see me coming."

name: Deranged Assistant
text: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

name: Eligeth, Crossroads Augur
text: "There's no better place to divine the future than at a nexus of branching presents."

name: Angelic Gift
text: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

name: Galestrike
text: Strong wings make strong winds.

name: Glacian, Powerstone Engineer
text:
"His energy is as boundless as the powerstones'."
—Rebbec, architect of ascension

name: Mana Confluence
text:
"Ravnica is not its buildings or markets, or even its guilds. Ravnica is its people. As long as we're here, we can rebuild the rest."
—Teysa Karlov

name: Hullbreacher
text: "I don't need a map to find riches."

name: Kitesail Corsair
