text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Laboratory Drudge
text:
"Many hands make light work."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Anointer of Valor
text: Light streaked down from the heavens, and a voice whispered in the soldier's ear: "You shall not fall today."

name: Mana Drain
text: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

name: Merchant Raiders
text: "Tell you what, you keep the rope."

name: Mnemonic Deluge
text: Past, present, and future surged through the wizard's mind, bringing a flood of possibilities.

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Prosperous Pirates
text: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

name: Prying Eyes
text: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."

name: Run Away Together
text:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

name: Sailor of Means
text: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

name: Scholar of Stars
text: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."

name: Scholar of the Ages
text: "I study the past to find hope for the future."

name: Scrapdiver Serpent
text: Smart artificers clean up after themselves.

name: Siren Stormtamer
text: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

name: Skaab Goliath
text: Three heads are better than one.

name: Sphinx of the Second Sun
text: He watches in silence as the shadows shift, bringing Amonkhet ever nearer to the Hour of Revelation.

name: Windborne Charge
text: The merfolk call the sky goddess Emeria. The kor call her Kamsa. The two races agree on little except that she offers many blessings to the faithful.

name: Zealous Strike
text: "Cower, fiend. The night is yours no longer."

name: Bonds of Quicksilver
text: The sea's reach extends beyond its shores.

name: Caller of Gales
text: "Some merfolk choose to rest their fins in the water. I believe wisdom exists not only where we were born but where we were told not to go."

name: Cloaked Siren
text:
"That is not the voice of the wind singing on the stones."
—Callaphe the mariner

name: Covenant of Minds
text: Before signing anything on Grixis, always read the fine print.

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Followed Footsteps
text: Æther can turn a footprint into a blueprint.

name: Into the Void
text:
"The cathars have their swords, the inquisitors their axes. I prefer the 'diplomatic' approach."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
text:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Merfolk Skyscout
text: "Emeria is a pleasant lie, a figment to hide Emrakul's hideous face. I can only hope to uncover a truth that lies deeper still."

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"I'd build an entire fortress of them if I could."
—Mzali, Lighthouse archmage

name: Negate
text:
"You cannot be an Ojutai monk. They prize wisdom and skill, and you have neither."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Weight Advantage
text: When immovable object turns to unstoppable force, it's best to just get out of the way.

name: Show and Tell
text: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

name: Sphinx of Magosi
text: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

name: Vaporkin
text:
"Mists are carefree. They drift where they will, unencumbered by rocks and river beds."
—Thrasios, triton hero

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Blood-Toll Harpy
text: When harpies demand a toll to cross through their territory, consider yourself lucky if they permit payment in coin.

name: Ballot Broker
text:
"Merchants and politicians differ only in name."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Death Wind
text: Leukin stared at the smoldering angel feathers. "Run!" he screamed to his patrol. "We don't stand a chance!"

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Farbog Boneflinger
text:
"Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!"
—Gisa, to Geralf

name: Festergloom
text: The death of a scout can be as informative as a safe return.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

name: Mausoleum Turnkey
text: When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

name: Public Execution
text: Though the executioner did not speak, the villagers got the message.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Shambling Goblin
text:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

name: Stromkirk Patrol
text: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

name: Unnerve
text:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

name: Burn Away
text:
"Your corruption will burn, serpent, until there is nothing left to defile."
—Asmala, bloodfire mystic

name: Burning Wish
text: She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Ember Beast
text: The only livestock that will survive for long in the Smelting District, ember beasts serve many functions—none of them willingly.

name: Flame Slash
text: After millennia asleep, the Eldrazi had forgotten about Zendikar's fiery temper and dislike of strangers.

name: Gang of Devils
text:
"Well, how could I know they'd explode?"
—Gregel, township militia

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "The enemy is getting too close! Quick! Inflate the toad!"

name: Goblin Tunneler
text: "The best way over the mountain is through."

name: Gratuitous Violence
text: Only the Cabal could make a fight to the death more deadly.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
text: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Ogre Sentry
text:
"You have to appreciate the genius of it. Why bother building defenses when you can just fill the pass with angry ogres?"
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Trumpet Blast
text:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Twin Bolt
text: Kolaghan archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They utilize their dragonlord's lightning to strike their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur Forest

name: Brushstrider
text: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

name: Burgeoning
text: The first vine shows the others where to grow.

name: Copperhorn Scout
text: Fangren spur may sound louder, but Viridian resurgents claim that the horn of the vorrac creates a truer, more inspiring note.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Fade into Antiquity
text:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Irresistible Prey
text: The baloth's instincts boiled, its muscles pulled taut, and its razor-spines bristled, as it turned to face—a runt meepling.

name: Lace with Moonglove
text:
"Which is more filled with poison: the flower of the moonglove or the minds of elves?"
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

name: Lay of the Land
text: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

name: Manaplasm
text: Urak froze when he heard it. That was his first mistake. He turned and cast a dramatic ward spell. That was his last.

name: Nessian Asp
text: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.

name: Netcaster Spider
text: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Palace Sentinels
text:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Plummet
text: The elf's blade carved deep into the Eldrazi drone's fleshy lattices. Without a sound, the drone lost equilibrium and tumbled from the sky.

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Ravenous Leucrocota
text: Hunger makes a leucrocota dangerous. A full belly makes it angry and dangerous.

name: Strength in Numbers
text:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Voyaging Satyr
text: "None can own the land's bounty. The gods made this world for all to share its riches. And I'm not just saying that because you caught me stealing your fruit."

name: Akroan Hoplite
text: "Fair fight? How could it be a fair fight? We're Akroans. They're not."

name: Ascended Lawmage
text: A lawmage's runic script is an act of governance given form: legislation written directly onto the air itself.

name: Carnage Gladiator
text: Not the foulest or bloodiest act at Rix Maadi by a stretch.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Dragonlair Spider
text: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

name: Gruul War Chant
text:
"We are the heart of the wild, the fire in its eyes, and the howl in its throat. Come, join the battle to which you were born."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Pharika's Mender
text: "The direst venom becomes a panacea under Pharika's guidance. I bring it to the worthy, clinging at the edge of the abyss."

name: Bronze Sable
text:
The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra, cutting down scores among hundreds. She would have been overcome if not for the aid of the temple guardians whom Karametra awakened.
—*The Theriad*

name: Hedron Matrix
text: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi, forming superstructures that radiated overwhelming magic.

name: Protector of the Crown
text: "I gladly offer my weapon and my life to the glory of my sovereign."

name: Hexplate Golem
text:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Horn of Greed
text:
"Rath grows, and I am nourished."
—Volrath

name: Kitesail
text: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

name: Opaline Unicorn
text: Purphoros once loved Nylea, the god of the hunt. His passion inspired his most astounding works of art.

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Dread Statuary
text: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Recruiter of the Guard
text: Before a cause can have supporters, it has to have a voice.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Shimmering Grotto
text: Untold riches await those who forsake the bustling world to search the secret, silent places.

name: Sanctum Prelate
text: "These halls are sacred. You *will* be silent."

name: Throne Warden
text: "Rulers come and go, but my allegiance belongs to the throne."

name: Wings of the Guard
text: Within the city walls, Adriana's falcons hunt vermin of all kinds.

name: Canal Courier
text: The most effective roadways in Paliano aren't roads at all.

name: Expropriate
text: Few things are more valuable than time or money—and Leovold has plenty of both.

name: Illusion of Choice
text:
"Please vote with a clear head and vigilant heart, knowing each voice is meaningful regardless of the outcome."
—Ottavio d'Oro, Electoral Committee Speaker of Paliano

name: Jeering Homunculus
text: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

name: Keeper of Keys
text: For the right price, he'll unlock your path to the throne.

name: Stunt Double
text: No duelist is without equal in Paliano.

name: Capital Punishment
text:
"I did offer them a choice . . ."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Custodi Lich
text:
"Keeping order is a task too important to relinquish in death."
—Abrado, Custodi priest

name: Garrulous Sycophant
text:
"Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Marchesa's Decree
text:
"Those who seize power must have the means to hold it."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Regicide
text: "You're done!"

name: Thorn of the Black Rose
text: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of bureaucracy.

name: Besmirch
text: The whitest robes stain best.

name: Crown-Hunter Hireling
text: While most in Paliano seek fame through favor, he'll settle for infamy through blood.

name: Deputized Protester
text: Butcher's training, warrior's heart.

name: Goblin Racketeer
text: "It, uh, fell off a cart?"

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Subterranean Tremors
text: The market is now closed.

name: Domesticated Hydra
text: "Sit. Fetch. Devastate."

name: Entourage of Trest
text:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

name: Menagerie Liberator
text: "The wild are neither your thralls nor your amusement."

name: Orchard Elemental
text: Fruits for friends, fists for foes.

name: Hymn of the Wilds
text: Many attempt to speak with nature. Selvala speaks less, and nature answers more.

name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
text: "My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper."

name: Knights of the Black Rose
text: "Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!"

name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
text: "I'm sure we can come to an arrangement."

name: Spy Kit
text: Imitation is the sincerest form of treachery.

name: Throne of the High City
text: A shining symbol of Paliano's true ruler—ambition.

name: Affa Guard Hound
text: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

name: Disenchant
text:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Faith's Reward
text:
"I thought the wind was ushering me to my final destination, but it lifted me to my feet and I fought on."
—Idrus, war priest of Thune

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Hail of Arrows
text:
"Do not let a single shaft loose until my word. And when I give that word, do not leave a single shaft in Eiganjo."
—General Takeno

name: Hallowed Burial
text:
"I'd rather hear the screams of battle than the quiet that follows."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Hollowhenge Spirit
text: Some spirits mourn. Others terrorize.

name: Kill Shot
text: Mardu archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They never miss their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.

name: Pariah
text: "It is *not* sad," Radiant chided the lesser angel. "It is right. Every society must have its outcasts."

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Reviving Dose
text: Samite healers never mix their pungent elixir with sweetener or tea. The threat of a second dose is enough to get most warriors back on their feet.

name: Spirit of the Hearth
text: Thieves know that a snarl in the night means, "Rob another house."

name: Wild Griffin
text: Farmers typically keep their flocks at thirteen sheep—one to distract the griffins while they take the other twelve to market.

name: Advantageous Proclamation
text: "The beneficent council deems you worthy of favor. They hope this doesn't provoke envy from your peers."

name: Jetting Glasskite
text: The bolt struck with a flash, and there was a terrible sound, as of glass shattering, but the creature was unharmed.

name: Minamo Scrollkeeper
text: The scrollkeepers never stepped an inch away from the doors of the Great Library, not even when the ogres and their oni masters swept through Minamo.

name: Plated Seastrider
text: The Neurok buried entangling cables just under the Quicksilver Sea. One seastrider harvest can provide an army's worth of armor and shields.

name: Reckless Scholar
text: "Any good prospector must sift the gold from the sand."

name: Stasis Cell
text: The Simic created the cells to preserve their experiments. The Azorius put the cells to use on the guilty.

name: Stifle
text:
"Superior force meets woefully inadequate object. What paradox were you expecting?"
—Azguri, archmage of Evos Isle

name: Sentinel Dispatch
text:
"Unusual. Security also worth stealing."
—Dack Fayden

name: Turn the Tide
text:
"Let their mindless armies come and face the might of genius."
—Varil, Neurok partisan

name: Wind Dancer
text: "Take my hand and dance to the music of the winds."

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Ill-Gotten Gains
text: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

name: Infectious Horror
text: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

name: Liliana's Specter
text:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

name: Magus of the Mirror
text: "Behold! The image of the enemy and all that she has. Trust your envy, and take it."

name: Morkrut Banshee
text:
"Let go your grudges, or risk wandering the bogs forever in a murderous rage."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Skeletal Scrying
text: His family was a small price to pay for the dark gifts that called to him.

name: Smallpox
text: Take away a few things, and a rebellion may ensue. Take away everything, and the oppression will be accepted as fate.

name: Stronghold Discipline
text: In Urborg, the instigators of each new rebellion are soaked in the blood of the last.

name: Syphon Soul
text: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred. Then she lost herself again in the joy of her victims' suffering.

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Typhoid Rats
text: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

name: Unhallowed Pact
text: Agreements with demons seldom end at the grave.

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Wakedancer
text: Hers is an ancient form of necromancy, steeped in shamanic trance and ritual that few skaberen or ghoulcallers comprehend.

name: Zombie Goliath
text:
"Removing the encumbrance of useless brain tissue grants several advantages: a slight increase in mobility, a response of revulsion and horror from the enemy, and, in the case of large specimens, room for passengers."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Barbed Shocker
text: Fervid shamans willingly submit to shockers in hopes of glimpsing the fortunes of the future.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Brago's Representative
text: On Fiora, no matter is settled until King Brago offers an opinion.

name: Cinder Wall
text:
"The smell of roasted flesh hung over the valley for hours."
—Onean sergeant

name: Flaring Flame-Kin
text: A flame-kin is always formidable, but feeding its fire with a sorcerous gift grants it the power to devastate armies.

name: Flowstone Blade
text:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn

name: Heartless Hidetsugu
text: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

name: Heckling Fiends
text: Their language may be a cacophonous agglomeration of chittering snorts and mad barking, but the message they send is all too clear.

name: Lizard Warrior
text: Don't let its appearance frighten you. Let its claws and teeth do that.

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Orcish Cannonade
text:
"Crispy! Scarback! Load another volcano-ball."
—Stumphobbler Thuj, orcish captain

name: Pitchburn Devils
text: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

name: Power of Fire
text: The cinders believe their flame was stolen by one they call the Extinguisher. All who now wield fire draw their desperate wrath.

name: Torch Fiend
text: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

name: Trumpet Blast
text: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack. They need signals to tell them when to stop.

name: Vent Sentinel
text:
"Zendikar fortifies itself against the Great Threat, making sentries of sky, sea, and stone."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Volcanic Fallout
text:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Wrap in Flames
text:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Charging Rhino
text:
"Is it wrong to go straight for what you want? Sneaking is for cats and goblins."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Council's Judgment
text: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

name: Copperhorn Scout
text: Fangren spur may sound louder, but Viridian resurgents claim that the horn of the vorrac creates a truer, more inspiring note.

name: Echoing Courage
text: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

name: Elephant Guide
text: Nature's strength outlives the strong.

name: Exploration
text:
"Only when we journey into the unknown can we find the impossible."
—Cyrul the Wanderer

name: Hunger of the Howlpack
text:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Hydra Omnivore
text:
"We should learn from the hydra. It never plays favorites; it devours everyone equally."
—Thrass, elder druid

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Provoke
text:
"Never start a fight you can't finish."
—Padril, council guardian

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Respite
text: "If they board us we're finished," warned Orim. Crovax nodded. "And if they don't . . . what then?"

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Scaled Wurm
text: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.

name: Sporecap Spider
text:
"They don't move much, but then again, if you get caught in its web, it has all the time in the world to get to you."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

name: Wrap in Vigor
text: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
text: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Dimir Doppelganger
text: "Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Fires of Yavimaya
text: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

name: Rousing of Souls
text: "We remember. We rise."

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Pernicious Deed
text: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

name: Sky Spirit
text:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Spontaneous Combustion
text: "Heat of battle" is usually a metaphor.

name: Altar of Dementia
text:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

name: Backup Plan
text: "In the market for an alternative, friend?"

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Reito Lantern
text: Lanterns carved from the mystic stones of the Reito Mines were said to light the way of lost souls.

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Silent Arbiter
text: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Vedalken Orrery
text: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

name: Warmonger's Chariot
text: The best defense is a good offense.

name: Quicksand
text: Not all deaths are etched with mythic meaning and iconic glory.

name: Marchesa's Emissary
text: "The Black Rose doesn't tolerate weeds."

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?

name: Marchesa's Infiltrator
text: "Secrets, like coins, are easy to steal."

name: Grudge Keeper
text: "Your defiance is noted."

name: Enraged Revolutionary
text: When every right is voted away, only rage remains.

name: Grenzo's Cutthroat
text: "Their guards are soft, ready to welcome a sharp dagger."

name: Treasonous Ogre
text:
"Everything comes with a price. Especially revolution."
—Grenzo, dungeon warden

name: Predator's Howl
text:
"And Muzzio says my arguments have no teeth."
—Selvala, ranger of the Lowlands

name: Selvala's Charge
text: Selvala's arrival never goes unnoticed.

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Flamewright
text: Those who can't conspire, create.

name: Marchesa's Smuggler
text: "Watch your head . . . and your back."

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Cogwork Librarian
text: Why wait for answers?

name: Cogwork Spy
text: Paliano's creations provide ample opportunities to plot the downfall of a neighbor.

name: Lore Seeker
text: Each volume contains wonders.

name: Whispergear Sneak
text: Spy for today. Plan for tomorrow.

name: Ajani's Sunstriker
text: "Ajani goes where he is needed most and in his name we keep his lands safe."

name: Courier Hawk
text: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica. Soon the service became one of their most profitable businesses.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Kor Chant
text: Sacred rites repurposed to fight an ancient threat.

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Pillarfield Ox
text:
"May starving fleas birth a thousand generations on your stubborn hide, cow!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Pride Guardian
text: "Any hotheaded cub can raise a sword in anger."

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Rout
text:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Silverchase Fox
text:
"Be careful in your hunt. The clever little creature can steal your wards and lead you right into the werewolf's den."
—Britta, midwife of Gatstaf

name: Soulcatcher
text: "Their spirits walk the winds and fill my soul."

name: Stave Off
text:
"Just a moment of perfect grace and sanctity is enough."
—Kal Lior, leonin elder

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Unquestioned Authority
text: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

name: Valor Made Real
text: "As my father taught, 'Training will raise your shield to the blow, but courage fills the gaps the shield leaves open.'"

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Wakestone Gargoyle
text: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

name: Aether Tradewinds
text:
"The wind smells of misfortune. Check your knots."
—Anitan, Ondu cleric

name: Air Servant
text:
"Wind is forceful, yet ephemeral. It can knock a dragon out of the sky, yet pass through the smallest crack unhindered."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Breakthrough
text: The ideas came flooding in so fast that they couldn't all be contained.

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Dream Fracture
text:
"Creation is a paradox. It hatches from its opposite."
—Olka, Mistmeadow witch

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Favorable Winds
text: Long thought to be extinct, flocks of gryffs reappeared with Avacyn's return.

name: Grixis Illusionist
text: "It's simple, really. If they can't find us, they can't kill us."

name: Aerie Mystics
text: They are cautious with their body language and facial expressions. Any stray movement could betray the positions of the troops they protect and cost many lives.

name: Mark of Asylum
text: A paragon of honor, Galo Aher fell to a blast of fire. The Order of the White Orchid was so saddened that they forged a new sigil in his likeness.

name: Charnelhoard Wurm
text: Jund's dragons hoard only sangrite crystals. Its wurms aren't so picky.

name: Child of Alara
text: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.

name: Conflux
text: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

name: Countersquall
text: Each of the twenty-three winds of Esper is named and chronicled, and every possible interaction with the flow of magic is exhaustively detailed.

name: Elder Mastery
text: Taste his power, hunger for his command.

name: Esper Cormorants
text:
"The smiths of this land must be mad to reach so far and so high for another creature to decorate."
—Cagen Vargan, Jhessian sea scout

name: Exploding Borders
text: Reuniting a world is not a gentle process.

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Giltspire Avenger
text: "To trespass so far from home is to ask for a lonesome grave."

name: Goblin Outlander
text: Egbol stared in wonder at Naya's landscape. So much to eat. So much to steal.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Gwafa Hazid, Profiteer
text: "Everyone has a price."

name: Hellkite Hatchling
text: A killing machine from birth.

name: Jhessian Balmgiver
text: "You have two choices: heed my advice now or need my healing later."

name: Knight of the Reliquary
text:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

name: Knotvine Mystic
text: The elves of Naya were the last to acknowledge the massive shift of mana in their world.

name: Maelstrom Archangel
text: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

name: Magister Sphinx
text: "These benighted worlds are thick with ignorance. I will educate them. They will listen, or they will die."

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Meglonoth
text: When the shards merged, Mayael found herself the general of Naya's mightiest army.

name: Nacatl Outlander
text: Survival in the wilds of Naya left Tiyan well equipped to win the civilized battles of Bant.

name: Mirror-Sigil Sergeant
text: "If I had many lives, I would give them all for Bant."

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Rhox Bodyguard
text: An enlightened soul caged in a body made for battle.

name: Scarland Thrinax
text:
"There is only one way of life in Jund: feed on the weak until you are cut down by something stronger."
—Jorshu of Clan Nel Toth

name: Skyward Eye Prophets
text: They lament the doom that is coming to Bant without realizing the part their own leaders have played in it.

name: Sludge Strider
text: Underneath the cities of Esper are cycles of life unseen by those who feed them.

name: Suicidal Charge
text:
"They think they're winning. But they're just lining up to be dinner."
—Rakka Mar

name: Vagrant Plowbeasts
text: Plowbeasts of Naya escaped their harnesses in droves, content to snack on the conveniently cultivated fields of Eos and Valeron.

name: Nacatl Hunt-Pride
text: "We must hunt and kill the dragon before it can return to raze our ancient city."

name: Valeron Outlander
text: After years of honing her philosophy in debate with stubborn rhoxes, Niella was ready to convert any heathen.

name: Vectis Agents
text: With their life energy suppressed under their etherium enhancements, thieves from Esper found it surprisingly easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.

name: Vedalken Outlander
text: The Seekers of Carmot searched across the unknown lands for the mystical red stone that could reforge Esper in ethereal perfection.

name: Zombie Outlander
text: The ripe smell of life drifted into Grixis. The dead caught the scent and with reckless hunger followed it back into Jund.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Bone Saw
text: In a world where death is always violent, cruel weapons are as common as rocks.

name: Font of Mythos
text: Those who drink from Malfegor's cup are tainted with hunger and stained with lies.

name: Kaleidostone
text: Once broken, who knows what worlds might grow from its shards?

name: Mana Cylix
text: Those who dismiss the cylix as an ordinary wooden bowl are blind to the true measure of its worth.

name: Manaforce Mace
text: As the shards merged, relics once thought mundane regained forgotten powers.

name: Paragon of the Amesha
text: "Let my lance sing with the voices of angels and the heathen cower before my shield, for I will teach this land the meaning of honor."

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Reliquary Tower
text: When the aven scouts located the tower in Esper, the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a righteous crusade to recover their lost treasures.

name: Unstable Frontier
text: The goblins went to sleep in Jund and awoke in Grixis. They'd never seen a zombie before. They would never see one again.

name: Rhox Meditant
text: The weight of her conviction balances on the harmony of her soul.

name: Scepter of Dominance
text:
"Whether or not you will bow to me is not open to debate. The question is, will I ever let you rise?"
—Fridius, telemin master

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Valiant Guard
text: As the outsiders invaded Bant, soldiers who once saw sigils as the highest marks of glory began to see the scars of battle as tokens of equal worth.

name: Asha's Favor
text: As his new wings lifted him high above Bant, Taric felt his earthly aspirations transform into heavenly resolve.

name: Wall of Reverence
text: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

name: Constricting Tendrils
text: Priests of Bant protect their temples with traps more elaborate than any mosaic floor.

name: Controlled Instincts
text: Togk Manytooth struggled helplessly as the kathari circled above him. For a warrior, immobilization is a fate worse than death.

name: Cumber Stone
text:
"The stone is more potent than ever. The flesh that creeps into our land will become even more slovenly and weak."
—Niclavs, archmage of Esper

name: Esperzoa
text: The more metal it digests, the more its jelly will fetch on the alchemists' market.

name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
text: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

name: Frontline Sage
text: The battle was won in the commander's head before the first weapon was drawn.

name: Grixis Illusionist
text: "It's simple, really. If they can't find us, they can't kill us."

name: Aven Squire
text: When the meek charge into battle, courage becomes infectious.

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: Parasitic Strix
text: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

name: Scepter of Insight
text:
"The road to truth has many branches, and so must the cane with which I walk it."
—Voln the Elder

name: Scornful Aether-Lich
text:
"With no flesh, there is no pain, no hesitation, no emotion of any kind. He is crafted perfection."
—Tezzeret

name: Unsummon
text:
"Send it back to its own strange world so we can avoid another inglorious combat with these wicked beings."
—Captain Valek of Jhess

name: View from Above
text: "This air feels so heavy and thick. There are no winds to speak of. I fear the knowledge that comes from a place like this."

name: Worldly Counsel
text: Every horizon hides a new possibility.

name: Aven Trailblazer
text:
"The bird wore the form of a man, bereft of filigree. Why do the Texts not speak of it?"
—Belator of Esper

name: Corrupted Roots
text: The bones of Jund's dead resurfaced in Naya, poisoning the jungle and killing the sunseeders' crops.

name: Drag Down
text: The barbarians of Jund believe the bottomless tar pits extend forever into other, darker worlds.

name: Dreadwing
text: Dreadwings spring from lofty perches to surprise kathari in midflight. They smother their prey and then consume it as they glide gently toward the ground.

name: Fleshformer
text: Necromancers who discovered the new sources of mana were quick to dream up new nightmares with them.

name: Infectious Horror
text: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

name: Kederekt Parasite
text: When the smell of passing thoughts piques its hunger, its maw becomes primed with acid and a taste for brains.

name: Nyxathid
text: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.

name: Celestial Purge
text:
"This new chaos confounds us. We must fling it into our winds, our storms. These we can control."
—Bezzit Plar, Esper stormcaller

name: Salvage Slasher
text: Esper artificers never imagined that one day their scraps would be pressed against their soft and fragile throats.

name: Scepter of Fugue
text: One goes to Tidehollow either to forget or to be forgotten. Either way, the scullers will oblige.

name: Sedraxis Alchemist
text: The problem with a liquid that can dissolve anything is finding something to carry it in.

name: Voices from the Void
text: As Grixis collided with the rest of Alara, the worlds began to hear the hateful whispers of the forgotten dead.

name: Wretched Banquet
text:
"The meek inherit nothing."
—Sedris, the Traitor King

name: Yoke of the Damned
text: The demon's yoke is part leash, part noose.

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Bloodhall Ooze
text: A drop of blood spilled from the first dragon.

name: Court Homunculus
text: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.

name: Canyon Minotaur
text: On Jund, the deep canyons were the best places to hide. When the goblins wandered into Naya, they found that was not so true.

name: Dark Temper
text: When you've got the temperament of a dragon, every argument is one you'll win.

name: Dragonsoul Knight
text: The farther he roamed from Jund and its dragons, the more he felt their essence in himself.

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Goblin Razerunners
text: Finding themselves in a new and unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

name: Ignite Disorder
text: "Bant is a world imprisoned by polished stone and tyrannical rule. It yearns to strike back against those who restrain it."

name: Kranioceros
text:
"A surly beast, the kranioceros will raise its defenses at the smallest threat. Stay out of sight and downwind, or you'll disrupt its natural migrations."
—Ebrel, godtoucher mentor

name: Maniacal Rage
text: The spikes of sangrite made the goblin stronger, but they didn't make him any smarter.

name: Molten Frame
text: The metal filigree in his body glowed red-hot, and his flesh soon followed.

name: Darklit Gargoyle
text: It shines in the darkness of its master's ambitions.

name: Quenchable Fire
text: You'd better know how to pray for rain.

name: Rakka Mar
text:
"The finest pawns are those with pawns of their own."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Toxic Iguanar
text: There are no "weak" creatures on Jund. Even the smallest can strike a deadly blow.

name: Viashino Slaughtermaster
text: "I'll fight two at once, and then lick their guts from my blades."

name: Volcanic Fallout
text:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Wandering Goblins
text: Tired of waiting for a dragon to eat them, some hardy goblins struck out to become meals for the unknown.

name: Beacon Behemoth
text: When its smoky plumes light Naya's sky, every creature from the smallest pip fawn to the largest rannet heeds the warning.

name: Cliffrunner Behemoth
text: It's revered for its power, celebrated for its grace, and feared for the avalanches triggered by its thunderous feet.

name: Cylian Sunsinger
text: "The sun shines bright upon the strong."

name: Ember Weaver
text:
"Each night, the sun unravels and blows away. Each day, the spiders set a new one in the sky."
—Sunseeder myth

name: Filigree Fracture
text: The sphinx tyrannized Bant until a rhox mage tested the hardiness of her shiny parts.

name: Gluttonous Slime
text: On Jund, everything eventually ends up in something else's stomach.

name: Matca Rioters
text: When outsiders interrupted the matca championship, things got ugly.

name: Might of Alara
text: The combined strength of all five planes spawned creations none had seen before.

name: Nacatl Savage
text:
"Blades dull and armor dents. Marisi taught us that instinct is the only thing a true warrior needs."
—Ajani

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Paleoloth
text:
"Gods do not sleep soundly in the earth's embrace."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Sacellum Archers
text: "Our arrows are aimed not at the sacred behemoths but at those who dare to dream of such a trophy."

name: Lapse of Certainty
text: Without a connection of mind and body, magic is just an idea stuck in the head, a word on the tip of a tongue.

name: Scattershot Archer
text: To train her elves for war, Mayael would drop a sackful of acorns from the tree canopy. Each archer tried to split as many as possible before the acorns hit the forest floor below.

name: Shard Convergence
text: Alara is broken no more.

name: Soul's Majesty
text: An avatar he sculpts of wisdom and strength.

name: Spore Burst
text: Seeds from Jund don't drift gently on the wind. They get up and stampede.

name: Sylvan Bounty
text: Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.

name: Tukatongue Thallid
text: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

name: Wild Leotau
text:
"Leotau that were born wild make the best mounts. It's like riding a thunderstorm."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Font of Fertility
text: Drink deep, and know the path to the heart of the wilds.

name: Prophet of Kruphix
text: "Time is fluid as a dance, and truth as fleeting."

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

name: Seeker of the Way
text: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dromoka, the Eternal
text:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Siege Rhino
text: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Adarkar Valkyrie
text: She doesn't escort the dead to the afterlife, but instead raises them to fight and die again.

name: Kjeldoran Gargoyle
text: The gargoyles were taken from the walls of flooded Kjeldoran cities and brought upland to guard the outposts of New Argive.

name: Thermopod
text: Slicking the ice with its heated underside, the thermopod skates at great speed to overtake its prey.

name: Boreal Centaur
text: Those who used reindeer as beasts of burden knew to avoid the centaurs, who raged at the enslavement of their spirit-kin.

name: Boreal Druid
text: Some creatures are bound to the cold by Rimewind magic. Others seek it out, adapted by two thousand years of the Ice. The Boreal, where Heidar's frigid sway is strongest, is home to both.

name: Brooding Saurian
text:
"I have been trapped in the lizard's lair for days. It seems to regard me as its child and will not let me leave."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

name: Bull Aurochs
text: The aurochs herd is content to graze—until the bull provides the dissenting urge to charge.

name: Frostweb Spider
text: Its white webs glitter, mimicking the frost on the tree's branches.

name: Into the North
text:
"Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter. Go forth and reclaim them for Yavimaya."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Karplusan Strider
text: The strider's long, loping gait is an adaptation that allows it to move quickly in deep snow.

name: Martyr of Spores
text: "Weep not for me. I will rise with the spring's new growth."

name: Mystic Melting
text: The sun-hot glow radiated from the druids, leaving scattered metal in steaming pools as it passed.

name: Ohran Viper
text: The ohran viper is not cold-blooded. Its veins course with the same antigelid venom used to kill its prey.

name: Panglacial Wurm
text:
"Step lightly and we might be able to use it as a bridge."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Kjeldoran Outrider
text: "I listen to people. He sniffs the wind. And we both sense something big coming. Something very big."

name: Simian Brawler
text:
"It's odd to see the apes rip down trees to arm themselves in defense of their forests."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Sound the Call
text:
"If you call the wolves, ensure you have a worthy hunt, or you may become the hunted."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Steam Spitter
text: Its belly produces a boiling-hot fluid it can spit as a weapon or spin slowly enough to freeze into a defensive web.

name: Deepfire Elemental
text:
"There are deep, deep places in this world that have long burned hot with little regard for the whitening of the earth's thin skin."
—Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper

name: Diamond Faerie
text:
"That such delicate creatures could become so powerful in the embrace of winter is yet more proof that I am right."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Kjeldoran War Cry
text: King Darien's breath crystallized and fell to the frozen battlefield, but its command carried true to all soldiers of New Argive.

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
text: Karplusan legend told of an orc so cruel that he burned his own followers in rage—yet so revered that they rose from their pyres to serve him.

name: Tamanoa
text: When Freyalise spoke the World Spell, the tamanoa rose to bring a new morning to Terisiare.

name: Vanish into Memory
text: Out of sight, into mind.

name: Wilderness Elemental
text:
"Don't be so quick to reclaim the thawing lands. They might have acquired a taste for freedom."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Coldsteel Heart
text: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Phyrexian Ironfoot
text: It took the Rimewind cultists days to realize they had successfully activated the creature—it just wasn't interested in moving.

name: Luminesce
text:
"The White Shield is not the burnished metal you lash to your forearm but the conviction that burns in your chest."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Phyrexian Snowcrusher
text: Its plow wasn't designed for snow, but to carve a path through shrieking armies.

name: Phyrexian Soulgorger
text: The Phyrexian minds that constructed it did not live past its awakening.

name: Arctic Flats
text:
"A realm once green now ruled by Frost,
Where flesh and field both pay its cost.
Those dearly loved, forever lost . . ."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Boreal Shelf
text:
"Who will stay the Tyrant's hand,
As ice and woe both grip our land?
The helpless feel his frozen brand."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Frost Marsh
text:
"Now caged in Winter's bitter chill,
Our people cry, their voices shrill—
Eternal cold breaks down their will."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Highland Weald
text:
"Our noble land, enslaved by Rime,
Is it our fate to freeze through time?
If this be true, oh wicked crime."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Martyr of Sands
text: "Only in our vulnerability is there true power, and that power is life itself."

name: Tresserhorn Sinks
text:
"Our land oppressed by silent Cold,
We weary wretches, young and old,
Pray that Springtime loose his hold."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Ronom Unicorn
text: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

name: Squall Drifter
text:
"The scouts claim the cold has malice, and a mind. I begin to believe them. Impassable drifts seem to appear before us at every turn."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

name: Sun's Bounty
text: "Heidar has forced the sun into hiding, but it has not forgotten us."

name: Boreal Griffin
text:
"More than snow falls from the Boreal skies."
—Arkin Egilsson, skycaptain

name: Swift Maneuver
text: Darien's call to Yavimaya would have fallen red to the snow had it not been for the agility of the aesthir.

name: White Shield Crusader
text: "Honor your steed and it will carry you to great deeds—and bring you home to tell of them."

name: Adarkar Windform
text: Terisiare has only two kinds of weather: cold and weird.

name: Arcum Dagsson
text: "Artifice sundered the world. It shall not again wreak such sorrow."

name: Balduvian Frostwaker
text: "Whether frozen or fertile, the land is our ally. It awaits the call to battle."

name: Drelnoch
text: Adarkar's blank wastes make the mind wander—and stray thoughts are quickly caught and devoured.

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Nature? Fire? Bah! Both are chaotic and difficult to control. Ice is structured, latticed, light as a feather, massive as a glacier. In ice, there is power!"
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Frost Raptor
text: The Rimewind wizards strove to perpetuate a magical winter. Their unnatural snows birthed unnatural beasts.

name: Frozen Solid
text:
"Guard, fetch me a mallet."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Heidar, Rimewind Master
text: "The umber stain of the Thaw will be bleached away. Once again the world will be sharp, white, perfect!"

name: Krovikan Mist
text: Plague-induced dreams became real as they swirled above Krov, mingling with the magical residue of the World Spell.

name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
text:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Martyr of Frost
text:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Perilous Research
text: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned that no amount of death could deter the stream of thieves and desperate scholars.

name: Rimewind Cryomancer
text: "The Thaw brings flooding, disease, and death. We will do all in our power to bring frigid peace back to the world."

name: Rimewind Taskmage
text: "Find solace in the sun? Burning, blinding, laying secrets bare? No, solace is found under the blanket of cold."

name: Ronom Serpent
text: With the spread of Rimewind's sorcerous winter, snow dwellers reclaimed their places atop the food chain.

name: Rune Snag
text:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Field Marshal
text: The Knights of Stromgald struck Darien's Roost from two sides. They would have caught Kjeldor in a pincer attack were it not for Darien's tacticians.

name: Chill to the Bone
text:
"Thick hides and layered armor won't help when I freeze you from the inside out."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Chilling Shade
text: Rimewind necromancers caught travelers in mystical blizzards then trapped their spirits in the mist of their final frozen breaths.

name: Deathmark
text:
"I hope it's true that every snowflake is unique, because I never want to see one like this again. Now clean up that body."
—Thangbrand Gyrdsson, Kjeldoran patrol

name: Disciple of Tevesh Szat
text: "You pray to Freyalise, but she cannot hear your pleas. It is Tevesh Szat who will claim your soul."

name: Feast of Flesh
text:
"Starving an army that feeds on its enemies is a sound strategy."
—Garza Zol, plague queen

name: Gristle Grinner
text:
"There it was, clawing the ice as it chittered and clicked its teeth. We fled in horror before it unearthed its grisly meal."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

name: Gutless Ghoul
text:
"Make sure those wretches feed only upon the plagued. The blood of the healthy is reserved for me alone."
—Garza Zol, plague queen

name: Krovikan Scoundrel
text: The few surviving humans of Krov would have welcomed the return of winter and its sterilizing cold. They often peered northward, hoping that the snow's edge had reached their infested city-tomb.

name: Martyr of Bones
text: Puppeteered by Heidar's icy hand, they were sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army.

name: Rime Transfusion
text: The unfortunates so transformed hungered not for flesh, but for warmth.

name: Rimebound Dead
text:
"Tresserhorn is ours now. Dredge the lake and bring me all the bones you find. We'll build you a new army, the likes of which Terisiare has never seen."
—Heidar, Rimewind master, to Haakon

name: Stromgald Crusader
text: "The White-Shielders think their code justifies their actions. In truth it only binds their hands."

name: Tresserhorn Skyknight
text: Kjeldorans who fled battle were exiled to the wastes. Those who strayed near Tresserhorn were pressed into service in Haakon's army.

name: Zombie Musher
text: The World Spell thawed their icy graves, promising rest in soft, quiet earth at last. But Heidar called them to duty for a twisted cause.

name: Balduvian Rage
text:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

name: Braid of Fire
text: "To a trained mind, the cold is but a momentary distraction."

name: Cryoclasm
text: The people of Terisiare had come to live on frozen fields as though on solid ground. Nothing reminded them of the difference more clearly than the rifts brought on by the Thaw.

name: Goblin Furrier
text: Clambering up and over the powdery slope, the goblin chanced upon a small furry thing. There they regarded each other: the goblin and his new pair of earmuffs.

name: Goblin Rimerunner
text: Rimerunners set off avalanches to immobilize foes as well as to create more challenging slopes.

name: Greater Stone Spirit
text: Having charted their way up the difficult face, the two mountaineers had to contend with the mountain's decision to stand up.

name: Icefall
text: As the Thaw met Terisiare, mountains shed their icy skins, crushing homes and hopes alike.

name: Karplusan Wolverine
text:
"They're not easily trained. Fortunately, they already know how to kill."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Lightning Serpent
text: Ice exploded into steam in its wake, hissing like a thousand serpents hailing their blazing master.

name: Lovisa Coldeyes
text: "I lead my horde to the northwest. I won't return until the ice wizards fall and their fiendish contraptions are crushed!"

name: Martyr of Ashes
text: She turns ash into flame and burns enemies to ash.

name: Ohran Yeti
text: When a snowdrift shows you its eyes, it's already too late.

name: Orcish Bloodpainter
text: Blood calls to blood.

name: Rite of Flame
text: Deep beneath the ice, beneath the soil and the rock, Dominaria's fire still burned hot.

name: Skred
text:
"This close to Rimewind Keep, no avalanche is nature's doing."
—Ukoten, centaur chieftain

name: Snow Devil
text:
"Give me wings to fly and speed to strike. In return, the glory I earn shall be yours."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian shaman

name: Zuran Spellcaster
text:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent, cautious as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Drift of the Dead
text:
"Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Reinforcements
text:
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."
—General Varchild

name: Kjeldoran Dead
text:
"They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Legions of Lim-Dûl
text:
"I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter,
leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Disenchant
text:
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

name: Aurochs
text: One aurochs may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.

name: Browse
text:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Woolly Mammoths
text:
"Mammoths may be good to ride on, but they're certainly bad to fall off of!"
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Giant Trap Door Spider
text:
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Wings of Aesthir
text:
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit."
—Arnjlot Olasson, sky mage

name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
text:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Skull Catapult
text:
"Let any who doubt the evil of using the ancient devices look at this infernal machine. What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Kjeldoran Elite Guard
text: The winged helms of the guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

name: Whalebone Glider
text:
"It's no ornithopter, but then I'm no Urza."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Viscerid Drone
text: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .

name: Casting of Bones
text:
"Only a necromancer would create such a foul form of divination."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"The so-called barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter,
leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Binding Grasp
text:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Essence Flare
text: Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Mistfolk
text:
"Although my official log will state there is no evidence pointing to the existence of the mistfolk, my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Deadly Insect
text:
"There is no time for pain when this beast leaves its terrible sting."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order advocate

name: Cathar Commando
text: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

name: Ecstatic Awakener
text: "Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny. I beg you, release the strength within me!"

name: Foul Play
text: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

name: Ghoulish Procession
text: It was a family reunion to die for.

name: Heirloom Mirror
text: "Speak my name thrice, and be rewarded."

name: Hobbling Zombie
text:
"I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
text: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"

name: Cathar's Call
text: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

name: Mask of Griselbrand
text: The legacy of evil lives on.

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Morkrut Behemoth
text:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: No Way Out
text: In the maze-like passages of the Erdwal, a wrong turn can be fatal.

name: Novice Occultist
text: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.

name: Olivia's Midnight Ambush
text: "And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding."

name: Rotten Reunion
text: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.

name: Shady Traveler
text: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

name: Siege Zombie
text: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.

name: Slaughter Specialist
text: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.

name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
text: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

name: Vampire Interloper
text: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory. Their agents arrive from the sky to collect the ceremonial bowls in eerie silence.

name: Vengeful Strangler
text: As the flames consumed the killer, his eyes remained fixed on the executioner's face, his hands twitching like angry spiders.

name: Abandon the Post
text: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

name: Ardent Elementalist
text: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.

name: Burn the Accursed
text: Nothing remained but a few drifting embers and the smell of smoldering hair.

name: Cathartic Pyre
text: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

name: Curse of Shaken Faith
text: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

name: Falkenrath Perforator
text: "Lady Anje sends her regards. I'll carve the rest of her message into your skin."

name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
text: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

name: Famished Foragers
text: Furious to find the workshop empty, the starving vampires flew into a frenzy.

name: Fangblade Brigand
text: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

name: Clarion Cathars
text: The sound of the trumpet is both warning and comfort: it tells of approaching danger but also reminds the village folk that someone is there to stand against it.

name: Festival Crasher
text: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

name: Flame Channeler
text: At the edge of night, on the cusp of winter, the allure of fire grows ever stronger.

name: Harvesttide Infiltrator
text: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.

name: Immolation
text: Nothing is funnier to a devil than setting someone—anyone—on fire.

name: Lambholt Harrier
text:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch

name: Lunar Frenzy
text: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.

name: Moonrager's Slash
text: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

name: Mounted Dreadknight
text: Markov vampires cultivate an image of such decadent elegance that it can be easy to forget they can field a deadly fighting force.

name: Neonate's Rush
text:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Obsessive Astronomer
text: "Sleep? I can sleep when I'm dead!"

name: Pack's Betrayal
text: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

name: Play with Fire
text: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

name: Raze the Effigy
text: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.

name: Duelcraft Trainer
text: "It's all in the follow-through."

name: Stolen Vitality
text: "There's nothing like a good meal to really lift the spirit."

name: Tavern Ruffian
text: She dispatched every challenger with a sickening snap of bone.

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Village Watch
text: "You have my word. You'll see no wolf attacks while we're around!"

name: Voldaren Ambusher
text: "Gotcha."

name: Voldaren Stinger
text: A duel to first blood means something very different when a vampire is involved.

name: Bird Admirer
text: She won't rest until she's collected specimens of every bird on Innistrad.

name: Bounding Wolf
text: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.

name: Brood Weaver
text: Travelers in the Somberwald scan the ground for werewolves and other threats, unaware of what lurks above.

name: Candlelit Cavalry
text: "On this night, the dark will fear us."

name: Clear Shot
text: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

name: Contortionist Troupe
text: "Welcome to the greatest show in Kessig!"

name: Fateful Absence
text: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

name: Dawnhart Rejuvenator
text: "Wherever there is life, there is power for one who knows the old ways."

name: Defend the Celestus
text: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

name: Dryad's Revival
text: "Pleased to meet you, Seven."

name: Eccentric Farmer
text: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."

name: Harvesttide Sentry
text: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.

name: Hound Tamer
text: "You and me, we're not built for captivity."

name: Might of the Old Ways
text: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

name: Flare of Faith
text: "I fell to my knees. I called out to Sigarda. And then I saw my tormentors blaze with blessed sunlight."

name: Outland Liberator
text: "Just hold still. I'll help you."

name: Pestilent Wolf
text: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

name: Plummet
text:
"A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Shadowbeast Sighting
text:
"Werewolves leave tracks. Vampires leave wrung-out corpses. This is something else."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Snarling Wolf
text:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

name: Timberland Guide
text: Hiring an experienced wilderness guide isn't cheap, but it costs less than a search party. Or a funeral.

name: Tireless Hauler
text: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.

name: Tovolar's Huntmaster
text: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

name: Unnatural Growth
text: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

name: Willow Geist
text: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

name: Angelfire Ignition
text: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."

name: Gavony Silversmith
text: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

name: Bladestitched Skaab
text: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

name: Can't Stay Away
text: Death is no impediment to dinner.

name: Croaking Counterpart
text: Frog is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Dawnhart Wardens
text: "The balance of day and night is shattered. We must find the Moonsilver Key."

name: Gavony Trapper
text: The elite cathars of the Parish-Blades train in all manner of techniques designed to delay and frustrate the beasts that hunt the crossways.

name: Faithful Mending
text: "What has been looted can be restored. The church lives on within us."

name: Fleshtaker
text: A soulless husk of endless hunger.

name: Galvanic Iteration
text: Better potent than predictable.

name: Grizzly Ghoul
text: The hunters spent the evening celebrating their kill and the rest of the night running from it.

name: Join the Dance
text: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."

name: Hedgewitch's Mask
text: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.

name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
text: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

name: Kessig Naturalist
text: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."

name: Rite of Harmony
text: Nature bends to the witches' call.

name: Rite of Oblivion
text: Revenge is a circle without end.

name: Sacred Fire
text:
"Do not confuse justice with mercy."
—Odric, Order of Saint Traft

name: Homestead Courage
text: "C'mon, fiend. I'll carve you up like a Harvesttide ham."

name: Sunrise Cavalier
text: "Like us, the morning fights for survival."

name: Crossroads Candleguide
text: Do the candleguides' heads turn to follow you as you pass, or is it merely a trick of the flickering light?

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
text: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.

name: Moonsilver Key
text: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

name: Mystic Skull
text: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.

name: Pithing Needle
text: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

name: Silver Bolt
text:
"When a werewolf charges, you'll only have time for one shot. Best make it count."
—Captain Eberheart

name: Stuffed Bear
text: It takes a taxidermist of unusual skill to cleanly stuff and mount a beast without severing its primal, predatory drive.

name: Loyal Gryff
text: Silverstreak had lost her rider, but not her instinct to help humankind.

name: Deserted Beach
text: Drownyard floods and unnatural frost made the once peaceful boardwalk deceptively treacherous.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Haunted Ridge
text: Swirling eddies of ash hide crumbling cliffs, treacherous drops, and the slavering maws of unknown evils.

name: Overgrown Farmland
text: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

name: Rockfall Vale
text: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

name: Shipwreck Marsh
text: The bones of doomed ships jut out from the muck while the bones of their sailors molder below.

name: Adamant Will
text: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

name: Angelic Quartermaster
text: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."

name: Lunarch Veteran
text: "Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us."

name: Arm the Cathars
text: Faith is a cathar's greatest weapon, but a sword of blessed silver is a close second.

name: By Invitation Only
text: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

name: Dawnhart Geist
