text: "Our bodies may lie slain, but perhaps we can still complete the ritual. I'd rather not spend my afterlife in this wretched eternal night."

name: Distracting Geist
text: "I never did enjoy studying."

name: Drogskol Infantry
text: He swore to protect the Moorlands. A little thing like death was no excuse to break his oath.

name: Estwald Shieldbasher
text: The door to her home survived the fires of the Malignus. Now it's her greatest weapon.

name: Mourning Patrol
text: "It's creepy out here, isn't it, boy? I always feel like someone's watching us."

name: Fierce Retribution
text: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."

name: Gryff Rider
text:
"Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight. She'll do the rest."
—Anders, cathar drillmaster

name: Kindly Ancestor
text: "You look cold, dearie."

name: Odric's Outrider
text: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

name: Militia Rallier
text: "We can wait like helpless children for a hero, or we can gather our courage and *be* the heroes. Who's with me?"

name: Nebelgast Beguiler
text: A moment of distraction, an hour off course.

name: Ollenbock Escort
text: "Stay in the light. I don't know what lurks in those shadows, and I'd like to keep it that way."

name: Panicked Bystander
text: "Help! There's been a horrible murder!"

name: Parish-Blade Trainee
text: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.

name: Piercing Light
text:
"Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Resistance Squad
text:
"It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Beloved Beggar
text: Charity is rare on Innistrad, but kindness is always repaid.

name: Ritual Guardian
text: "By ancient magics, by angels' grace, we will survive this night."

name: Sanctify
text:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Sigarda's Summons
text: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed."

name: Traveling Minister
text: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

name: Twinblade Geist
text: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

name: Unholy Officiant
text:
"Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?"
—Sorin Markov

name: Ritual of Hope
text: "Tonight, we can be anything."

name: Vampire Slayer
text: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed. When she brought one down herself, she realized she had found her calling.

name: Welcoming Vampire
text: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

name: Alchemist's Retrieval
text: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

name: Biolume Egg
text: Serpents leave their eggs in the cold and inky depths...

name: Chill of the Grave
text: Frozen is frozen, whether it's with cold, terror, or both.

name: Cobbled Lancer
text:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager

name: Search Party Captain
text: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

name: Consuming Tide
text: Nephalia's tides obey an unforgiving moon.

name: Cruel Witness
text:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Diver Skaab
text: It doesn't need to breathe, but the suit does help keep the parts together.

name: Geistlight Snare
text: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

name: Geralf, Visionary Stitcher
text: "Do you like it, Sister? Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own."

name: Gutter Skulker
text: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.

name: Inspired Idea
text: Stitching is an ever-evolving field, with each new advancement reaching a new height of horror.

name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector
text: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."

name: Lantern Bearer
text: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .

name: Mischievous Catgeist
text:
"I never get any knitting done, but I don't entirely mind."
—Lorn, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Necroduality
text:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes

name: Sigardian Savior
text: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."

name: Repository Skaab
text: Created to capture the spark of genius for later use.

name: Scattered Thoughts
text: Stitchers delegate the most important tasks to assistants with a good eye for detail.

name: Selhoff Entomber
text: It knows one fundamental truth: bodies belong in graves.

name: Serpentine Ambush
text: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

name: Skywarp Skaab
text:
"If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher."
—Barton, stitcher

name: Steelclad Spirit
text: Some geists imitate the lives they left behind. Others follow the dreams they never realized.

name: Stormchaser Drake
text:
"Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Soul-Guide Gryff
text: It conducts the souls of the righteous to their blessed rest and the spirits of the evil to justice.

name: Syncopate
text: "Fool! Can't you see the tide has turned against you?"

name: Syphon Essence
text: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with *viscus vitae*, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.

name: Thirst for Discovery
text:
"This is your only warning, alchemist. The secrets of the sea are not yours to behold. Lord Krothuss will not be so merciful next time."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Wanderlight Spirit
text: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.

name: Wash Away
text:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

name: Whispering Wizard
text: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.

name: Winged Portent
text:
"No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think."
—York, Kessig tracker

name: Wretched Throng
text:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

name: Aim for the Head
text:
"Works every time."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Sungold Barrage
text: Heida allowed herself a moment of satisfaction as she watched the beast fall, then turned to seek another foe. It would be a long, long night.

name: Bleed Dry
text:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Catapult Fodder
text: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.

name: Concealing Curtains
text: Specifics were kept secret, but word quickly spread that the show was a must-see.

name: Courier Bat
text: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

name: Demonic Bargain
text:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

name: Desperate Farmer
text: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.

name: Diregraf Scavenger
text: It can barely feel the sword anymore.

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

name: Dreadfeast Demon
text: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.

name: Dying to Serve
text:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Edgar's Awakening
text: "Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day."

name: Gift of Fangs
text:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Grisly Ritual
text:
"You can always tell who's new from the screaming."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

name: Headless Rider
text: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

name: Innocent Traveler
text: "Aren't you going to invite me in?"

name: Mindleech Ghoul
text:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Thraben Exorcism
text: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

name: Parasitic Grasp
text: Some wicked souls linger only to consume the warmth of life.

name: Path of Peril
text: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

name: Persistent Specimen
text:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, stitcher's assistant

name: Pointed Discussion
text: Small talk is a dying art.

name: Ragged Recluse
text: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
text: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

name: Skulking Killer
text: Olivia set a few villagers loose in the hedge maze as part of the evening's "entertainment."

name: Bereaved Survivor
text: "With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to. Alone, I wept for a sister who would never return."

name: Unruly Mob
text: "We survived the Travails! Killer angels! Horrors from beyond the moon! Now some big werewolves think they can scare us? Let 'em try."

name: Undying Malice
text: Few take kindly to being put in their place, especially if their place is the grave.

name: Unhallowed Phalanx
text:
"In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore."
—Kerren of the Mausoleum Guards

name: Vampire's Kiss
text: Young vampires gorge themselves at every meal, but their elders have learned to savor the smallest bite.

name: Wedding Security
text: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.

name: Abrade
text: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

name: Alluring Suitor
text: "May I have this dance?"

name: Ancestral Anger
text: "One vampire for every family member I've lost."

name: Vanquish the Horde
text: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.

name: Ballista Watcher
text: "Careful, this thing's dangerous. Wouldn't want anyone getting hurt."

name: Blood Hypnotist
text: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

name: Change of Fortune
text:
"We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

name: Baithook Angler
text: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

name: Daybreak Combatants
text: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

name: Dominating Vampire
text: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

name: End the Festivities
text: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

name: Fearful Villager
text: When Harold ran from the wolves, the others called him a coward.

name: Flame-Blessed Bolt
text:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Frenzied Devils
text:
"Devils need no reason to stir up chaos. The chaos itself is their reward."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer

name: Honeymoon Hearse
text: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.

name: Hungry Ridgewolf
text: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.

name: Component Collector
text: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."

name: Into the Night
text:
"When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Kessig Flamebreather
text: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.

name: Kessig Wolfrider
text: "It's a perfect partnership. My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch."

name: Lightning Wolf
text: These thick-furred wolves have adapted to Stensia's storms, channeling their energy into bursts of supernatural speed.

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Pyre Spawn
text: Memories of the Harvesttide tragedy festered until they grew into an incarnate rage that set the world ablaze.

name: Reckless Impulse
text: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

name: Rending Flame
text:
"It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Runebound Wolf
text: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.

name: Stensia Uprising
text: "Vampires have done nothing but take from us. Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!"

name: Sure Strike
text: Before the officiant even had a chance to ask if anyone objected to the Voldaren-Markov union, Arlinn made her opinion known.

name: Vampires' Vengeance
text: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

name: Voldaren Epicure
text: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Voltaic Visionary
text: She spent many years trying to harness chaos.

name: Weary Prisoner
text: "Your guard attacked me. He got what was coming to him."

name: Apprentice Sharpshooter
text: Innistrad's best archers are trained by the Quiver of Kessig, an order of cathars who specialize in ranged combat.

name: Cartographer's Survey
text: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.

name: Curse of Surveillance
text: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves."
—Wrenn

name: Dawnhart Disciple
text: "Our coven finds strength in nature and purpose in serving our communities."

name: Dig Up
text: Things buried on Innistrad rarely seem to stay that way.

name: Dormant Grove
text: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

name: Flourishing Hunter
text:
"I would welcome her into my pack with honor."
—Arlinn Kord

name: Delver of Secrets
text: "If my hypothesis is correct . . ."

name: Hookhand Mariner
text: The local gossips swore Nesmith lost his hands in a fight with a werewolf.

name: Infestation Expert
text: There's only so many times she can take being asked . . .

name: Laid to Rest
text:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch

name: Massive Might
text:
"Run! It's coming for us! Eventually!"
—Yaster, Havengul shopkeeper

name: Moldgraf Millipede
text: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

name: Mulch
text:
"Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing."
—Halana, to Alena

name: Oakshade Stalker
text: He blends seamlessly into the forest, waiting silently for his prey.

name: Devious Cover-Up
text: Widow Weber's new scarecrow seemed to attract more crows than it scared off.

name: Packsong Pup
text: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

name: Reclusive Taxidermist
text: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.

name: Retrieve
text: The roots preserved the armor for a hundred years, safeguarding it for a traveler in need.

name: Rural Recruit
text: The Dawnhart survivors welcome recruits of all shapes and sizes.

name: Sheltering Boughs
text:
"We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?"
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

name: Snarling Wolf
text:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

name: Splendid Reclamation
text:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn

name: Spore Crawler
text:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

name: Dissipate
text:
"Morning light, morning light,
Chase away the fears of night."
—Gavony children's rhyme

name: Sporeback Wolf
text: The mushrooms growing in the wolves' fur possess curative properties incredible enough to tempt many alchemists into risking their lives to track one down.

name: Toxic Scorpion
text:
"You want that venom? Collect it yourself! I'm not losing another pair of dragonhide gloves."
—Old Rutstein

name: Ulvenwald Oddity
text:
"Obviously it's dangerous, but I've never seen anything like it. This could be an entirely new species! I say we follow it."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Weaver of Blossoms
text: Living in harmony with nature . . .

name: Witch's Web
text: Ever since the ritual, Ryla didn't have an appetite at the dinner table, but her long walks in the forest always seemed to satiate her hunger.

name: Wolf Strike
text: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.

name: Wolfkin Outcast
text: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

name: Ancient Lumberknot
text: The soft creak of trees in the wind is not always cause for comfort.

name: Blessed Defiance
text: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"

name: Drownyard Amalgam
text: When human corpses are in short supply, stitchers get creative.

name: Child of the Pack
text: Her face shines with youthful innocence.

name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
text: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."

name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
text: "Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly."

name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
text: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

name: Markov Purifier
text: The ceremonial "incense" was a concoction of Edgar's own design, a precise blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.

name: Markov Waltzer
text: "I'll lead."

name: Fading Hope
text: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

name: Olivia, Crimson Bride
text: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

name: Blood Servitor
text:
"Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Falcon Abomination
text: The foulest of fowl.

name: Boarded Window
text:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Foreboding Statue
text: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.

name: Honored Heirloom
text: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

name: Wedding Invitation
text: RSVP at your own risk.

name: Deathcap Glade
text: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.

name: Dreamroot Cascade
text: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.

name: Firmament Sage
text: The cause remained unclear, but the fact was undeniable: nights were lengthening faster than in any autumn past.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Shattered Sanctum
text: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

name: Stormcarved Coast
text: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

name: Sundown Pass
text: Riders chase the fading light recklessly through the mountains, desperate for one last glimpse of day.

name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
text: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

name: Flip the Switch
text:
"Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway."
—Barton, stitcher

name: Galedrifter
text:
"If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie."
—Geor, Havengul fisher

name: Geistwave
text: Necro-alchemists gained popular support during the Travails, when geist-fueled weapons helped defend towns against mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

name: Grafted Identity
text: Autonomy is only skin deep.

name: Larder Zombie
text: The cathars arrived at the abandoned lab to find many of the unfinished projects gnawing on one another.

name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
text: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

name: Borrowed Time
text: Teferi stepped calmly into the fray. Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

name: Locked in the Cemetery
text: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

name: Mysterious Tome
text: The villagers pored through the old storybook, hoping that one of the tales within might hold some clue to saving the fading sun.

name: Ominous Roost
text:
"One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse. I don't know what this is, but it can't be good."
—Verna, priest of Sigarda

name: Organ Hoarder
text: The stitcher died years ago, but her dutiful assistant still keeps the laboratory well stocked.

name: Overwhelmed Archivist
text: "Bah! As if I had time to preserve everything."

name: Patrician Geist
text: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

name: Phantom Carriage
text: Passage to the abyss is free, but the return trip will cost you.

name: Revenge of the Drowned
text: A heavy net doesn't always mean a good catch.

name: Secrets of the Key
text: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

name: Shipwreck Sifters
text: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

name: Skaab Wrangler
text: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

name: Sludge Monster
text: Tracking it isn't the hard part.

name: Stormrider Spirit
text: The weary travelers mistook the flickering lights for a candleguide pointing the way to Harvesttide. Their relief turned to terror as lightning lit the sky.

name: Candlegrove Witch
text: "Like a thousand candles fighting back the darkness, we are strongest when we stand together."

name: Triskaidekaphile
text: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

name: Unblinking Observer
text:
"Day 77: The homunculus within the crystal continues to mimic my every movement. I wonder what they are writing?"
—Laboratory notes of Yzlkpk

name: Vivisection
text: Though their work is widely reviled, stitchers see themselves as being on the cutting edge of science.

name: Arrogant Outlaw
text: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

name: Baneblade Scoundrel
text: "I was a mere cutpurse until I learned the going rate for fresh corpses."

name: Bat Whisperer
text: "My little winged friends tell me which of these townsfolk are worth tasting for myself."

name: Bladebrand
text: Skirsdag cultists believe that the right poison "purifies" a tainted soul before it makes its way to Ormendahl.

name: Blood Pact
text: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult. They simply turned their worship to the next demon to emerge from the shadows bearing offers of power.

name: Bloodline Culling
text: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."

name: Bloodtithe Collector
text: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

name: Champion of the Perished
text: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

name: Defenestrate
text: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

name: Dreadhound
text: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

name: Duress
text: The Voldaren torture pits are so expansive that prisoners have a nasty tendency to be forgotten for years.

name: Eaten Alive
text:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Mogg Fanatic
text:
"As if his chest had been a mortar, he burst his hot heart's shell upon it."
—Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*

name: Mind Stone
text:
"Except our own thoughts, there is nothing absolutely in our power."
—Rene Descartes, *Discourse on Method*

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Cenn's Tactician
text: "A well-trained force brings peace... which brings more time for training!"

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer-both are attractive to thieves.

name: Boggart Ram-Gang
text:
"We're going to need a bigger gate."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
text: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Marisi's Twinclaws
text:
"Looks like we're completely outnumbered."
"Lucky for us. I thought we'd be bored."

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Naya Sojourners
text: The elves had entered a land like an open grave-an act of fortitude or folly?

name: Mind Control
text:
"Why fight the body when you can dominate the mind that rules it?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Kor Duelist
text: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Leatherback Baloth
text: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

name: Boomerang
text:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser, *The Faerie Queene*

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Pathrazer of Ulamog
text: No thought but hunger. No strategy but destruction.

name: Curse of Wizardry
text:
"We must all push through the pain to heal our world."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Plots That Span Centuries
text: "I don't expect you to understand the myriad ways in which you're about to die."

name: Perhaps You've Met My Cohort
text: "I'm calling in a favor from an old friend. Once you're all dead, I'll consider the matter settled."

name: Drench the Soil in Their Blood
text: "Are they dead yet? No? Then my previous order stands."

name: Plague Stinger
text: It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Golem's Heart
text: The heart of a golem gives life to more than just the iron husk around it.

name: Memnite
text: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

name: Skinrender
text:
"Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Master's Call
text: The need to obey was inscribed on every plate in their bodies.

name: Plague Myr
text: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

name: Signal Pest
text: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Yixlid Jailer
text: He holds the keys to a tombful of incarcerated secrets.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Vault Skirge
text: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Circle of Flame
text:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Whenever the Llanowar elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Stonewood Invoker
text: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

name: Voice of the Woods
text: The ritual of making draws upon the elves' memories and pasts. And elves have long memories and ancient pasts.

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Wirewood Herald
text: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

name: Wirewood Symbiote
text: It drinks fatigue.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Elvish Promenade
text: The faultless and immaculate castes form the lower tiers of elvish society, with the exquisite caste above them. At the pinnacle is the perfect, a consummate blend of aristocrat and predator.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Moonglove Extract
text: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

name: Slate of Ancestry
text: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

name: Elvish Eulogist
text: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

name: Akki Coalflinger
text: No matter where you find them, goblins love rocks.

name: Clickslither
text: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

name: Emberwilde Augur
text: Legends say a djinn gave the goblins a gift they could never hope to master.

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Goblin Cohort
text: Akki shells provided good protection when downhill charging became headlong tumbling.

name: Goblin Matron
text: There's always room for one more.

name: Goblin Sledder
text: "Let's play 'sled.' Here's how it works: you're the sled."

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
text: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Reckless One
text: "Release chaos with me!"

name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
text: "I order you to volunteer."

name: Elvish Warrior
text: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

name: Skirk Fire Marshal
text: He's boss because he's smart enough to get out of the way.

name: Skirk Prospector
text:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Skirk Shaman
text: In a shaman's grimy hands, a concoction of dried Skirk Ridge herbs can become the face of panic.

name: Tar Pitcher
text:
"Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms. At the same time, her warren decided to share with her a sensory greeting of hot tar . . . ."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Boggart Shenanigans
text: Boggarts revel in discovering new sensations, from the texture of an otter pellet to the squeak of a dying warren mate.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

name: Tarfire
text:
"After Auntie brushed the soot from her eyes, she discovered something wonderful: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Heedless One
text: "Channel your vitality through me."

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Waterspout Djinn
text:
"Fly us higher, out of its storm."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Spire Golem
text: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Martyr of Frost
text:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Counterspell
text: The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Gush
text: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

name: Flamekin Brawler
text: When he hits people, they stay hit.

name: Fireslinger
text:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Soulbright Flamekin
text: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

name: Pyre Charger
text: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Oxidda Golem
text: The longer it patrols the smoldering crags of the Oxidda Chain, the more it adopts their fiery temper.

name: Firebolt
text: Reach out and torch someone.

name: Seal of Fire
text: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

name: Incinerate
text: "Who said there are no assurances in life? I assure you this is going to hurt."

name: Flame Javelin
text: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Serra Angel
text: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

name: Luminous Angel
text: "The spread of evil's destruction shall always be matched by the rise of the noble fallen."

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Angelsong
text: Clash of sword and cry of beast fall mute when angels sound the call to prayer.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Pacifism
text: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

name: Serra's Boon
text:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

name: Angelic Benediction
text:
"Even in single combat, I am never alone."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Icatian Priest
text: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow. Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

name: Serra's Embrace
text: The touch of Serra's angels bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Lord of the Pit
text: "My summoning begins your debt, planeswalker."

name: Abyssal Gatekeeper
text:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Foul Imp
text: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

name: Daggerclaw Imp
text: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

name: Dusk Imp
text: Imps are just intelligent enough to have an understanding of cruelty.

name: Overeager Apprentice
text: Slow and steady may not always win the race, but at least it doesn't end up splattered on the walls.

name: Soot Imp
text:
"If one gets in your chimney, you're going to need a long wick and a barrel of bangstuff to get it out."
—Hob Heddil

name: Demon's Jester
text: They knock 'em dead, with or without the punch line.

name: Souldrinker
text: Don't drink and thrive.

name: Charging Paladin
text: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

name: Abyssal Specter
text: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

name: Cackling Imp
text: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Unholy Strength
text: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

name: Cruel Edict
text:
"Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Liliana learned the secrets she sought, but at a price that was etched on her fate.

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Ha, banishment? Be merciful, say 'death,'
For exile hath more terror in his look,
Much more than death."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Breeding Pit
text: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Corrupt
text: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Serra Advocate
text: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

name: Sustainer of the Realm
text: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text: An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot.

name: Plated Slagwurm
text: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Lignify
text: Bulgo paused, puzzled. What was that rustling sound, and why did he feel so stiff? And how could his *feet* be so thirsty?

name: Nature's Lore
text: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

name: Elephant Guide
text: Nature's strength outlives the strong.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Windstorm
text:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Deathgreeter
text: "The bones of allies grant wisdom. The bones of enemies grant strength. The bones of dragons grant life eternal."

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—*Nevinyrral, Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Vine Trellis
text: Nature twists knots stronger than any rope.

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Wall of Bone
text:
"Graveyards are sacrilege! A waste of perfectly good bones."
—Keren-Dur, necromancer lord

name: Faerie Macabre
text: The line between dream and death is gauzy and fragile. She leads those too near it from one side to the other.

name: Howling Banshee
text: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

name: Keening Banshee
text: Her cold wail echoes in the alleys and under-eaves, finding the unfortunate and turning their blood to ice.

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Vicious Hunger
text: Only the most ravenous soul feeds on the health of the weak.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Snuff Out
text: "The bigger they are, the faster they rot."

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Mutilate
text: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Corrupt
text: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

name: Wirewood Savage
text:
"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Stampeding Wildebeests
text: The most violent and destructive storms in Femeref occur on cloudless days.

name: Phyrexian Negator
text: They exist to cease.

name: Phyrexian Debaser
text:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Defiler
text:
"The third stage of the illness: muscle aches and persistent cough."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Voltaic Key
text: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Phyrexian Vault
text:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

name: Puppet Strings
text: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Slay
text: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

name: Hideous End
text: Death is a generous author, always willing to grant a stirring final chapter.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: An audience of one with the malice of thousands.

name: Phyrexian Battleflies
text: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Nomadic Elf
text: "I've journeyed across Dominaria. Phyrexians are everywhere. Plague is everywhere. There's no place left to hide."

name: Phyrexian Denouncer
text:
"The first stage of the illness: rash and nausea."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Charging Troll
text: They stop for nothing, not even the end of a battle.

name: Evasive Action
text: Effective use of terrain is a lesson good commanders learn quickly.

name: Tribal Flames
text:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Fertile Ground
text: As Phyrexians descended, Multani paused to reflect on the beauty that might never be seen again.

name: Gerrard's Command
text: "Unless you like the idea of becoming some goblin's lunch, get up and move!"

name: Narrow Escape
text: He could find no strength left to budge, no power left to fight, no will left to live. Luckily, they could find him.

name: Exotic Curse
text:
Fouler than a necromancer's kiss.
—Jamuraan expression

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Armadillo Cloak
text: "Don't laugh. It works."

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Power Armor
text:
"Great peril demands formidable weaponry."
—Urza

name: Allied Strategies
text: Each commander looked at the others and wondered who would be first to break the alliance.

name: Elfhame Palace
text: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

name: Shivan Oasis
text: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

name: Priest of Gix
text:
"Gix doesn't want a people to rule but puppets to entertain his madness."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

name: Phyrexian Broodlings
text: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

name: Sanguine Guard
text:
"Father of Machines! Your filigree gaze carves us, and the scars dance upon our grateful flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Burrenton Bombardier
text: The flasks provide ballast, a means of steering, and—with a little luck—a way to deliver ward-spells to cohorts below.

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Kemba's Skyguard
text:
"We're now to dispense aid to any Mirran we see battling anything . . . 'strange.' Regent's orders."
—Ranya, skyhunter captain

name: Seasoned Marshal
text: There are only two rules of tactics: never be without a plan, and never rely on it.

name: Catapult Master
text: "There's no 'I' in 'team,' but there's a 'we' in 'weapon.'"

name: Conclave Equenaut
text: Equenauts are the seeds of the Conclave, scattered on the four winds, searching for new places to take root.

name: Elite Vanguard
text: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Raise the Alarm
text: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

name: Razor Barrier
text: "We protect our homelands. Why should they not protect us?"

name: Crusade
text:
"Finally, I understand. Home isn't where you rest. It's what you fight for."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Abolish
text: As war raged on, the young mages became more direct in their tactics, often at great cost.

name: Goldmeadow Harrier
text:
"It's a proven fact that sling-stones from the dawn side of the riverbank sail the farthest and truest."
—Deagan, cenn of Burrenton

name: Saltblast
text: Dominaria erodes with each passing gust.

name: Swell of Courage
text: "Tideshaping is more than creating a few new puddles."

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Any fool can pick up a sword and charge into battle. To emerge alive at the end, that is a gift that comes from leadership and experience."

name: Arcbound Worker
text: The parts are as strong as the whole.

name: Steel Wall
text:
"We sculpt the land into what we need—homes, armament, fortresses of war. Our strength comes not only from knowing, but from *commanding* the terrain."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Silver Myr
text: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Assembly-Worker
text: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

name: Serrated Biskelion
text:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Esperzoa
text: The more metal it digests, the more its jelly will fetch on the alchemists' market.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Loyal Sentry
text: "My cause is simple: To stop you, at any cost, from ever seeing the inside of this keep."

name: Frogmite
text: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

name: Juggernaut
text: The mighty city of An Karras, with its rich history, built over thousands of years, fell in three hours.

name: Synod Centurion
text:
"We order them to stand, they stand. We order them to wait, they wait. We order them to die, they die."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Triskelion
text:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

name: Qumulox
text: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

name: Mosquito Guard
text: His aim is as sure as a mosquito's sting, but with none of the warning.

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Trip Noose
text: A taut slipknot trigger is the only thing standing between you and standing.

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Moonglove Extract
text: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

name: Argivian Restoration
text:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Glory Seeker
text: "There's no contract to sign, no oath to swear. The enlistment procedure is to unsheathe your sword and point it at the enemy."

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Kor Skyfisher
text: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

name: Temple Acolyte
text: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

name: Knotvine Paladin
text:
"He is part of a new breed of guardian, one who embraces the best of both his world and ours."
—Mayael the Anima

name: Steward of Valeron
text: Knight-stewards guard the Sun-Dappled Court, a grove of immense, sculptured olive trees that represent Valeron's twelve noble families.

name: Zhalfirin Commander
text:
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Knight Exemplar
text: "If you think you are brave enough to walk the path of honor, follow me into the dragon's den."

name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
text: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
text: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

name: Alaborn Cavalier
text:
"Course he ran! *I* wouldn't want to stare down that barrel, either!"
—Alaborn soldier

name: Skyhunter Patrol
text:
"We leonin have come to rule the plains by taking to the skies."
—Raksha Golden Cub

name: Plover Knights
text: The knights are a major attraction at every Lammastide festival. Teams of riders perform daring feats of flight to the delight of all below.

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Harm's Way
text: Even when fate is already written, there's always time to change the names.

name: Reciprocate
text:
"Just as the noble soul calls virtue to itself, the evil soul summons harm."
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Edge of Autumn
text: "At harvest are seeds of next year sown."

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Reprisal
text: "Fear this no more!"

name: Test of Faith
text: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

name: Heroes' Reunion
text:
"You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?"
—Eladamri, to Gerrard

name: Lionheart Maverick
text: "Your signet is no symbol of power. It marks only your need for numbers to aid you. What do you do, guild-rat, now that you face my blade alone?"

name: Sigil Blessing
text: "For unwavering commitment and unflinching strength, the Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil. Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty."

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"Tusks to splinter skulls. Steel to shatter scale."
—Warhammer inscription

name: Spidersilk Armor
text: It hardly weighs anything, but it takes all day to remove.

name: Cinder Wall
text:
"The smell of roasted flesh hung over the valley for hours."
—Onean sergeant

name: Skirk Prospector
text:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Knight of Meadowgrain
text: "By tradition, we don't speak for two days after battle. If our deeds won't speak for themselves, what else could be said?"

name: Bloodmark Mentor
text: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

name: Fire-Belly Changeling
text:
"My ears say it hisses. My fingers say it burns."
—Auntie Wort

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Henge Guardian
text: Like so many Thran relics, the wurm engine kept operating long after its creators were gone.

name: Bogardan Rager
text: In the erupting heart of Bogardan, it's hard to tell hurtling volcanic rocks from pouncing volcanic beasts.

name: Knight of the White Orchid
text: Both guide and guard on open plain.

name: Shivan Hellkite
text: A dragon's scale can be carved into a mighty shield, provided you can procure a dragontooth to cut it.

name: Thunder Dragon
text: Sometimes primitive cultures attributed natural phenomena to monsters. Sometimes they were right.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

name: Captive Flame
text: "Kills and cooks your food in one easy stroke."

name: Ghostfire
text: Only those gifted with the eye of Ugin, the spirit dragon, can see his fiery breath.

name: Leonin Skyhunter
text: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

name: Seething Song
text: If your flesh can withstand the flame, the spirit of the dragon will burn within your soul.

name: Seismic Strike
text:
"Life up here is simple. Adapt to the ways of the mountains and they will reward you. Fight them and they will end you."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

name: Claws of Valakut
text: "Swords may sunder. Shields may fail. My will is stronger than steel, and my flesh and bone far more deadly."

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Jaws of Stone
text: When giants find their mountain homes infested, they have a whole range of solutions.

name: Silver Knight
text: "Hammer out your doubts as you forge your weapon. To slay a dragon, your resolve must be stronger than your steel."

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Loxodon Hierarch
text: "I have lived long, and I remember how this city once was. If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it."

name: Spitemare
text:
"I knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom. Any attempt to leash or exploit it failed, and at terrible cost."
—Ashling

name: Marisi's Twinclaws
text:
"Looks like we're completely outnumbered."
"Lucky for us. I thought we'd be bored."

name: Ageless Entity
text: Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.

name: Pride of Lions
text: There's only one thing worse than a hungry lion—many hungry lions.

name: Kird Ape
text: Apes can be gentle, contemplative beasts—but context is everything.

name: Nacatl Hunt-Pride
text: "We must hunt and kill the dragon before it can return to raze our ancient city."

name: Ajani's Mantra
text:
"He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence."
—Zaliki of Naya

name: Lightning Helix
text:
"Rage is not the answer. Rage followed by fitting vengeance is the answer."
—Ajani

name: Recumbent Bliss
text: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

name: Searing Meditation
text:
"When I meditate I see the world as it should be. All that does not fit, I remove."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Behemoth Sledge
text:
"May this grant you all the strength of the behemoths and none of their serenity."
—Ajani

name: Naya Charm
text: Deep in nature's core lies a potential unsullied by greed or civilization.

name: Essence Warden
text:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Sylvan Bounty
text: Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.

name: Titanic Ultimatum
text:
"Retribution is best delivered by claws and rage, with both magnified."
—Ajani

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Wild Nacatl
text: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

name: Surveilling Sprite
text: Their natural curiosity, combined with a knack for trespassing, makes sprites excellent spies.

name: Nightscape Familiar
text: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

name: Slavering Nulls
text: Having lost their minds, they now want yours.

name: Morgue Toad
text:
"The toads of Urborg aren't fast, powerful, or pleasant, but they have their uses."
—Ertai

name: Hellfire Mongrel
text: There is no fondness between the hound and its master. There is only a common appreciation of the hunt.

name: Dimir Cutpurse
text: Other guilds demand tolls from those who travel their territories, but not House Dimir. It takes its share secretly, one coin purse at a time.

name: Loam Lion
text: In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

name: Steamcore Weird
text: Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.

name: Moroii
text:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

name: Ogre Savant
text: He's an oxymoron.

name: Vapor Snag
text:
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Countersquall
text:
"The essence of every world, every spell, and every thought is power. Nothing else matters, because nothing else exists."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Canyon Wildcat
text: "Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.

name: Obelisk of Grixis
text: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

name: Recoil
text: Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.

name: Undermine
text: "Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"

name: Grixis Charm
text:
"So many choices. Shall I choose loathing, hate, or malice today?"
—Eliza of the Keep

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Elder Mastery
text: Taste his power, hunger for his command.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Jade Mage
text:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Sky Spirit
text:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Clone
text: The shapeshifter mimics with a twin's esteem and a mirror's cruelty.

name: Primal Plasma
text: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

name: Cache Raiders
text: What the current doesn't take, they do.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Jedit's Dragoons
text: After Efrava was destroyed, the cat warriors scattered across Dominaria. Those who followed Jedit's example were strong enough to survive the ravages of apocalypse.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Sigil of Sleep
text: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

name: Revoke Existence
text:
"No half measures, no regrets. We'll tell no stories of this day. It will be as if it never existed at all."
—Ganedor, loxodon mystic

name: Angelic Shield
text:
"If only an angel's wings could shelter us all."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Safe Passage
text: With one flap of her wings, the angel beat back the fires of war.

name: Vanish into Memory
text: Out of sight, into mind.

name: Overrule
text: With one commanding word, the spell was put down and a fine collected for its casting.

name: Plated Geopede
text: It prefers a cooked meal, so it will eat you now and lava-bask later.

name: Pygmy Pyrosaur
text:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Fiery Hellhound
text:
"I had hoped to instill in it the loyalty of a guard dog, but with fire's power comes its unpredictability."
—Maggath, Sardian elementalist

name: Minamo Sightbender
text: Woven from threads of the spirit world, the mistcloak rendered its wearer invisible, but quickly fell to tatters.

name: Vulshok Sorcerer
text: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Cosi's Ravager
text:
"Cosi has many followers. Even the volcano finds a way to do his bidding."
—Zakken, Enclave cleric

name: Vulshok Berserker
text: He experiences every emotion with passion and repays every slight with vengeance.

name: Bloodfire Kavu
text: Heart of fire, blood of lava, teeth of stone.

name: Stone Giant
text: A typical day for a giant. A momentous event for a goat.

name: Geyser Glider
text:
"Quit pontificating, mage. The last thing we want to do is give it more hot air."
—Tala Vertan, Makindi shieldmate

name: Lithophage
text: It's viciously territorial, destroying every creature on the mountain it has chosen to consume.

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Earth Servant
text:
"Fire. Air. Water. These elements spread, filling in the spaces they are not. But earth is implacable like a sullen child."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Greater Stone Spirit
text: Having charted their way up the difficult face, the two mountaineers had to contend with the mountain's decision to stand up.

name: Bloodfire Colossus
text: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Journeyer's Kite
text:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Scroll Thief
text: I've learned how to disable wards, pick locks, and decode the Agaran language—all before even reading the scroll!

name: Seismic Strike
text:
"Life up here is simple. Adapt to the ways of the mountains and they will reward you. Fight them and they will end you."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

name: Spire Barrage
text: Goblin lessons include the 2,071 tips for survival. Frek only remembered 2,070.

name: Jaws of Stone
text: When giants find their mountain homes infested, they have a whole range of solutions.

name: Neurok Invisimancer
text: "They won't see your shadow or hear your breath, but they will feel your blade."

name: Slith Strider
text: A slith's form and function are determined by the color of the sun under which it's born.

name: Galvanoth
text: It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.

name: Izzet Chronarch
text: He ensures not only whether but also when and where the lightning strikes twice.

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Force Spike
text: "I don't *think* so."

name: Magma Spray
text:
"Jund is a wounded world. Beware its searing blood spilling out onto the surface."
—Rakka Mar

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Call to Heel
text: On Bant, a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty. The one who bears it may be called to fulfill that charge at any moment.

name: Train of Thought
text: "But then . . . oh, but . . . which means . . . which would lead to . . . exactly!"

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Reminisce
text: Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges.

name: Thunderheads
text: The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.

name: Dissipate
text:
"This abomination never belonged in our world. I'm merely setting it free."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Overwhelming Intellect
text: "My brain hurts."

name: Sphinx-Bone Wand
text: Its host's final curse lies captured within.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Invoke the Firemind
text: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
text: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Devouring books is only the beginning. The librarian's next.

name: Gelectrode
text:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Boneyard Wurm
text: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.

name: Putrid Leech
text: It reacted to Naya's overabundant food supply by growing additional mouths.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Greater Mossdog
text: Man's best fungus.

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Sadistic Hypnotist
text: "Victory in the pits is almost as rewarding as the methods I use to achieve it."

name: Golgari Rotwurm
text: Like corpse-worms through a carapace, rotwurms slide through the hollowed bones of the undercity.

name: Doomgape
text: It eats and eats until the juiciest morsel it can find is itself.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Ghoul's Feast
text: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."

name: Yoke of the Damned
text: The demon's yoke is part leash, part noose.

name: Steamcore Weird
text: Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.

name: Golgari Germination
text: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Feast or Famine
text:
"The living cannot understand the benefits of death."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Vigor Mortis
text: After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.

name: Grim Flowering
text:
"Nothing in nature goes to waste, not even the rotting corpse of a good-for-nothing, blood-sucking vampire."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Twilight's Call
text:
Twilight falls. We rise.
—Necropolis inscription

name: Ogre Savant
text: He's an oxymoron.

name: Bloodrage Vampire
text: The most genteel facades hide the most abominable desires.

name: Mausoleum Guard
text: "Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."

name: Phantom General
text: After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Decompose
text:
"Sheesh! How am I supposed to make a decent living around here?"
—Cabal grave robber

name: Sorin's Thirst
text: "All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."

name: Zealous Persecution
text:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Unmake
text: A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Vampire Lacerator
text: The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.

name: Death Grasp
text: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Wall of Omens
