text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Scorched Rusalka
text: Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Ashmouth Hound
text: Its fiery paws make it easy to track, which is very useful when you want to go in exactly the opposite direction.

name: Coal Stoker
text:
"The day is mine! I sent three such creatures against my foe, then watched as my magefire popped her soldiers like overripe spleenfruits."
—Dobruk the Unstable, pyromancer

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Lavaborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Mad Prophet
text: "There's no heron in the moon! It's a shrew, a five-legged shrew, with a voice like whispering thunder!"

name: Hellrider
text:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Skirsdag Cultist
text: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

name: Gang of Devils
text:
"Well, how could I know they'd explode?"
—Gregel, township militia

name: Bump in the Night
text: It's not just the wind. It's not all in your head. And it's *definitely* something to worry about.

name: Blazing Salvo
text: Barbarians equate courage with the ability to endure pain.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Duskhunter Bat
text: The swamps go silent at its approach, but it still hears the heartbeat of the prey within.

name: Flame Slash
text: After millennia asleep, the Eldrazi had forgotten about Zendikar's fiery temper and dislike of strangers.

name: Geistflame
text: Innistrad pyromancers find their best raw materials in the fury of the dead.

name: Pyroclasm
text: Chaos does not choose its enemies.

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Strangling Soot
text:
"What good is your blade without your breath?"
—Greht, Gathan warlord

name: Browbeat
text:
"Pained defiance or shameful surrender—every reaction is a pleasant surprise."
—Tibalt

name: Breaking Point
text: "Enough!"

name: Blightning
text: In the spirit of inquiry, Tibalt applied a battery of agony spells. They yielded nothing on the vampire's whereabouts, but the screams were reward enough.

name: Flame Javelin
text: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

name: Devil's Play
text: A devil's hands are never idle.

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Freewind Equenaut
text: Confront her, and feel the hooves of her steed. Ignore her, and feel the sting of her arrow.

name: Anax and Cymede
text: Akros's greatest heroes are also its royalty.

name: Armory Guard
text: The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."

name: Gustcloak Sentinel
text: Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.

name: Dawnstrike Paladin
text: She crushes darkness beneath her charger's hooves.

name: Nobilis of War
text:
"A great siege is a banquet to him; a long and terrible battle, the most exquisite delicacy."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Daily Regimen
text: What self-indulgence tears down, discipline builds up again.

name: Pay No Heed
text: "My course is before me. There is nothing behind me."

name: Somberwald Vigilante
text: He has nothing left but his resentment.

name: Righteousness
text: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

name: Bonds of Faith
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Battle Mastery
text:
"Boom! Boom! Boots the size of oxcarts, then an axe like a falling sun. Elves scattered. Trees scattered. Even the hills ran for the hills!"
—*Clachan Tales*

name: Smite the Monstrous
text: Though the old holy wards and roadside shrines have begun to fail, faith in Avacyn still holds true power.

name: Miraculous Recovery
text: "I am the rock of the polis. Death only strengthens me."

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Cavalry Pegasus
text:
"It is hope, hooved and winged."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"Wood is wasted in the dirt."
—Orcish proverb

name: Deadly Recluse
text: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

name: Kavu Predator
text: In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.

name: Satyr Hedonist
text: "Any festival you can walk away from wasn't worth attending in the first place."

name: Zhur-Taa Druid
text: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Troll Ascetic
text: It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.

name: Crowned Ceratok
text: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Ghor-Clan Savage
text: The snap of sinew. The crunch of bone. A cry for mercy. These are the music of the Gruul.

name: Deus of Calamity
text:
"He bears the marks of ages upon his skin, memories of dreams long dead and best left buried."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Conquering Manticore
text: It speaks no commands but is always obeyed.

name: Thraben Valiant
text: "Once more into Devil's Breach, soldiers. I want another devil tail for my collection."

name: Skarrgan Skybreaker
text:
"The sky isn't falling—it's being thrown at us!"
—Otak, Tin Street shopkeep

name: Shower of Sparks
text: The viashino had learned how to operate the rig through trial and error—mostly error.

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Regrowth
text: While the root remains, the tree yet lives.

name: Terrifying Presence
text: Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.

name: Destructive Revelry
text:
"Stoke a fire hot enough and you'll never run out of things to burn."
—Xenagos, the Reveler

name: Dragon Blood
text: A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Stun Sniper
text: The tips of her bolts are blunt, but her aim is deadly sharp.

name: Fires of Yavimaya
text: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
text:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Stealer of Secrets
text: The Dimir would hire her, if only they knew where she lived. The Azorius would condemn her, if only they knew her name.

name: Aether Adept
text: "The universe is my instrument, and the song I play upon it is one you are forbidden to hear."

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Phantasmal Dragon
text: Its hunger and ire are no less for being wrought of lies and mist.

name: Body Double
text: "I am who I pretend to be."

name: Leyline Phantom
text:
"Is the maze itself a phantom? Or is one as real as the other? Perhaps I am as mad as the dragon."
—Jace Beleren, journal

name: Chronomaton
text: On the third night, the villagers destroyed their clocks. The sounds of whirring gears and chiming metal held only dread for them.

name: Thought Scour
text:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Agoraphobia
text: "Everyone in this city is choosing sides. I choose inside."

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"To sculpt a mind is to see every memory and thought as an individual piece that can be rearranged—or removed."
—Jace Beleren

name: Remand
text: For the Azorius, the law can be a physical shield against chaos and anarchy.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Griptide
text:
"Beware the seagrafs just off the shore. These waters are filled with hungry geists looking for an easy meal."
—Captain Eberhart

name: Ray of Command
text: "Heel."

name: Jace's Phantasm
text: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

name: Control Magic
text:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

name: Summoner's Bane
text:
"I don't need to have the perfect plan. My foe just has to have an imperfect one."
—Jace Beleren

name: Jace's Ingenuity
text: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

name: Future Sight
text:
"Is the inevitable any less miraculous?"
—Veldka, wandering sage

name: Dread Statuary
text: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

name: Phantasmal Bear
text:
"You know it to be false, but when its claws find you, what you know won't matter much at all."
—Pol Jamaar, illusionist

name: Pulse Tracker
text:
"You can't think your way out of this, Jace. Thought implies life, and life requires a pulse—music to a hunter's ears."
—Vraska

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Gatecreeper Vine
text: Every inch of Ravnica is home to something.

name: River Boa
text:
"Sheath your swords! Cudgels only. I see a new pair of waterproof trek boots slithering away."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Vinelasher Kudzu
text: It grows to hate you.

name: Putrid Leech
text:
"The Golgari would say that life comes from death and death comes from life. But sometimes, death comes from the dead."
—Vraska

name: Sadistic Augermage
text: "Don't worry. I know the drill."

name: Slate Street Ruffian
text:
"Merciless to the point of psychosis. Let's give him a job."
—Zelinas, Orzhov recruiter

name: Spawnwrithe
text: Its victims feel only an itchy, wriggling feeling just under their skin. By then, it's far too late.

name: Stonefare Crocodile
text: The Izzet's plans to exploit the undercity ran into a few stubborn obstacles.

name: Ohran Viper
text: The ohran viper is not cold-blooded. Its veins course with the same antigelid venom used to kill its prey.

name: Corpse Traders
text: Those without breath can't complain.

name: Festerhide Boar
text:
"Bury your dead deep. The boars are hungriest while the corpse is still warm."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Crosstown Courier
text: Information travels quickly through Ravnica's network of messengers and thought agents.

name: Mold Shambler
text: When civilization encroaches on nature, Zendikar encroaches back.

name: Highway Robber
text: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

name: Nekrataal
text:
"You can't protect them all, Jace."
—Vraska

name: Drooling Groodion
text:
"The Golgari expand, yes, but I refuse to call their tainted creations 'growth.'"
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Dream Stalker
text: What happens when it is the dream that wakes and the sleeper that fades into memory?

name: Treasured Find
text: Gorgons crave beautiful things: gems, exquisite amulets, the alabaster corpses of the petrified dead . . .

name: Last Kiss
text:
"Romanticize it, glamorize it, call it what you will. To me, it will always be carnal, bloody murder."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Underworld Connections
text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Consume Strength
text:
"You are correct. This is going to hurt."
—Vraska

name: Grisly Spectacle
text:
"Watch people flock to a murder scene. Then tell me we're not all a little sick in the head."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Krovikan Mist
text:
"It's as strong as you believe it is, and it's very convincing."
—Jace Beleren

name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
text: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Ogre Battledriver
text: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

name: Flame-Kin Zealot
text: Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.

name: Oni of Wild Places
text: The oni leapt easily from peak to peak, toying with its victims, its voice a purr from the rumbling depths of nightmare.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Reckless Abandon
text: The climax of a warlord's career is always death.

name: Shock
text:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

name: Bone Splinters
text: Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy. For now, they must harvest vis from the living to fuel their dark magics.

name: Arc Trail
text:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

name: Krenko's Command
text: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dauntless Onslaught
text:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Orcish Cannonade
text:
"Crispy! Scarback! Load another volcano-ball."
—Stumphobbler Thuj, orcish captain

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Swords, to me! We must engage their line to protect our archers and mages. Let no one fail this task!"

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Leonin Snarecaster
text: Formerly oppressed by the polis of Meletis, leonin occasionally "mistake" their old enemies for game.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: "Do not concern yourself with my origin, my race, or my ancestry. Seek my record in the pits, and then make your wager."

name: Faerie Impostor
text: Many Tin Street shops display a sign on the door: "No cloaks allowed."

name: Coral Trickster
text: They wait in darkened depths, laughing eagerly.

name: Sparkmage Apprentice
text: Sparkmages are performance artists of sorts, but pain is the price of admission.

name: Lone Missionary
text: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Master Decoy
text: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Hussar Patrol
text:
"You think no one is watching, you think you're smart enough to escape, and most foolish of all, you think no one cares."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Lightning Angel
text: Sudden vengeance, echoing fury.

name: Faerie Invaders
text: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

name: Goblin Deathraiders
text: Every once in a while, when they aren't getting incinerated in lava, crushed under rock slides, or devoured by dragons, goblins experience moments of unmitigated glory in battle.

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Swift Justice
text:
"Having conviction is more important than being righteous."
—Aurelia

name: Impulse
text: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Hold the Line
text: "Forgive me, Master Kami, but in the interest of my people I must halt your advance."

name: Inferno Trap
text: "Do you smell something burning?"

name: Steam Augury
text: Keranos is a fickle god, delivering punishment as readily as prophecy.

name: Hellraiser Goblin
text: Don't let him lead the soldiers, but by all means let him lead the way.

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Gustcloak Harrier
text: Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.

name: Gustcloak Savior
text:
"Our death-arrows flew in high arcs towards the aven. And then . . . nothing."
—Coliseum guard

name: Gustcloak Sentinel
text: Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.

name: Gustcloak Skirmisher
text: They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

name: Kinsbaile Skirmisher
text: "If a boggart even dares breathe near one of my kin, I'll know. And I'll not be happy."

name: Kor Skyfisher
text: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

name: Loxodon Partisan
text:
"On every plane I've encountered loxodons, I've found stalwart and loyal friends."
—Elspeth

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Mortal's Ardor
text:
"Such deeds should be common fare for such as us."
—Anax, king of Akros

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Mother of Runes
text: She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.

name: Precinct Captain
text: "In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Soul Parry
text:
"I was called to this world of steel, and it will be my steel that answers."
—Elspeth

name: Standing Troops
text:
"Bant sentries were called the Angel Line. They never faltered, and they were ready to die defending their position."
—Elspeth

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Veteran Armorsmith
text: "Courage is a proud and gleaming shield. It does not bend or hide from sight. To fight with courage, we must forge in steel."

name: Veteran Swordsmith
text: "Truth is a straight, keen edge. There are no soft angles or rounded edges. To fight for truth, we must forge in steel."

name: Accumulated Knowledge
text:
"Learn not only from the failures of the past, but also from its triumphs."
—Isperia

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Celestial Flare
text:
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Surrakar Banisher
text: Surrakar grab things they *don't* want.

name: Whelming Wave
text:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

name: Explore
text:
"I will never run out of new oceans to explore or new sea-dwellers to embrace as my own."
—Kiora

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Nessian Asp
text: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.

name: Netcaster Spider
text: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

name: Court Street Denizen
text: "The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."

name: Coiling Oracle
text:
"Nature was slowly heading in the right direction, but we know how to achieve faster results."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Kiora's Follower
text: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Nimbus Swimmer
text: The Simic soon discovered that the sky offered as few constraints on size as the sea.

name: Plasm Capture
text:
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Dauntless Onslaught
text:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Dictate of Heliod
text:
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?"
—Polyxene the Doubter

name: Daggerback Basilisk
text:
"Petrifying gaze, deadly fangs, knifelike dorsal spines, venomous saliva . . . Am I missing anything? . . . Toxic bones? Seriously?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Frontier Guide
text: "The elders say Zendikar has no safe, peaceful places. How would they know? They've never looked."

name: Graypelt Hunter
text: He'll cleave wood and bone alike to carve a path for his allies.

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Groundswell
text: "This world will not be tamed."

name: Harrow
text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

name: Joraga Bard
text: Adventuring bards recite *Chanter's Epics*, never-ending tales that keep their comrades' minds alert to danger.

name: Ondu Giant
text: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

name: Affa Guard Hound
text: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

name: Scute Mob
text:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Territorial Baloth
text: Its territory is defined by wherever it is at the moment.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Stonework Puma
text:
"We suffer uneasy ground, unstable alliances, and unpredictable magic. Something you can truly trust is worth more than a chest of gold."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Oblivion Sower
text: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

name: It That Betrays
text: Your pleas for death shall go unheard.

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Bloodrite Invoker
text:
"The brood lineages unfolded across the world, each patterned after one of three progenitors, each a study in mindless consumption."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Consume the Meek
text:
"Others ask why the Eldrazi destroy. I ask why they preserve."
—Ganda, Goma Fada deserter

name: Induce Despair
text: All the angel saw was her doom.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Smother
text:
"Before I hire new recruits, I test how long they can hold their breath. You'd be surprised how often it comes up."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Emrakul's Hatcher
text: Wordlessly it leads its abhorrent brood.

name: Makindi Griffin
text: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, the griffins were forced to seek new territory lest their aeries be crushed between the massive stone monoliths.

name: Forked Bolt
text:
"Play no favorites. Everybody dies."
—Sparkmage saying

name: Hellion Eruption
text: Just when you thought you'd be safe, in the middle of an open field with no Eldrazi around for miles.

name: Magmaw
text:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

name: Torch Slinger
text: Once thrown, twice burned.

name: Forerunner of Slaughter
text:
"While we delay, they're on the move. They will not wait as we bicker. We are losing this war by moments as our goal slips beyond our reach."
—Gideon Jura

name: Mind Stone
text: What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Oust
text:
"'Invincible' is just a word."
—Gideon Jura

name: Repel the Darkness
text: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

name: Emancipation Angel
text: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

name: Gather the Townsfolk
text: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

name: Goldnight Redeemer
text: The Host sings of Avacyn's return without a single verse about its own suffering.

name: Moorland Inquisitor
text: Inquisitors are taught scripture, philosophy, and the fine art of sharpening an axe.

name: Rebuke
text:
"No one chooses to be stitched together into a skaab. If it could speak, it would beg for its own destruction."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Slayer of the Wicked
text: You don't want to see his trophy room.

name: Bonds of Faith
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

name: Thraben Heretic
text: "Let them decry me for burning the dead. I'm not giving those ghoulcallers any more fuel for their madness."

name: Village Bell-Ringer
text: "Priests, hunters, slayers—to arms! The enemy approaches!"

name: Voice of the Provinces
text: Her horn is heard across Innistrad, lifting the hearts of the righteous.

name: Captain of the Mists
text: "I am no mere ship's captain. The north wind is my accomplice. The tide is my first mate."

name: Gryff Vanguard
text:
"Ghouls smashed the door, but I heard the call of the gryffs and knew we were saved."
—Ekka, shopkeeper of Hanweir

name: Mist Raven
text:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

name: Nephalia Smuggler
text: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

name: Pore Over the Pages
text: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

name: Cathedral Sanctifier
text: "Evil will soon be vanquished. What Innistrad most needs now is healing."

name: Tower Geist
text: Jenrik's tower is served by those who once sought to enter it uninvited.

name: Butcher's Cleaver
text: Outside the safety of Thraben, there is little distinction between tool and weapon.

name: Sharpened Pitchfork
text: Not everyone can have a sword of blessed silver. Not everyone needs one, either.

name: Champion of the Parish
text: "I stand for every cobbler, tanner, and fool in this town—and they stand for me."

name: Compelling Deterrence
text: "So much for neighborly hospitality!"

name: Havengul Runebinder
text: "So many corpses, so little time."

name: Makeshift Mauler
text:
"It always amazes me what perfectly good things people throw away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Scrapskin Drake
text:
"The cathars killed my skaabs down below. Let's see how high their swords can reach."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Screeching Skaab
text: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

name: Stitched Drake
text:
"The best skaabs are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Chapel Geist
text: Death has bound it with chains of past regrets. Forever it searches for atonement, each kindness removing a single link.

name: Abattoir Ghoul
text: Death took his humanity but not his skill with the knife.

name: Appetite for Brains
text: Just as with a peach, the first bite is always the juiciest.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

name: Butcher Ghoul
text: Without a mind, it doesn't fear death. Without a soul, it doesn't mind killing.

name: Diregraf Ghoul
text:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Dread Return
text: The will to return can overpower the will to survive.

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Ghoulraiser
text:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Dearly Departed
text:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Human Frailty
text:
"I have seen a hundred mortal families rise and fall. I shall outlast a thousand more."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Tribute to Hunger
text: Marella was delighted. The ball had attracted so many suitors for her daughter, including that handsome stranger. She wondered where the two were now . . . .

name: Victim of Night
text:
"Do not touch a drop. Not yet. I want to watch this so-called slayer's last crisis of faith."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Diregraf Captain
text: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

name: Cobbled Wings
text: For the necro-alchemist, any puzzle can be solved with intelligence and harvested body parts.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Eerie Interlude
text: The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.

name: Elder Cathar
text: "My greatest hope is that you will surpass me in every way, consigning my name to some forgotten corner of history."

name: Gilt-Leaf Seer
text: Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories. The act only deepened their insight.

name: Jaddi Lifestrider
text: Nature's arms encircle all who are willing to draw close.

name: Natural Connection
text: "Zendikar will not surrender, and neither can we."

name: Nissa's Chosen
text: Once, Nissa selected worthy fighters to defend the Joraga. Now, she gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.

name: Oakgnarl Warrior
text: "Roam as you will, your roots remain in the strong earth of your Rising."

name: Oran-Rief Invoker
text:
"The world was not hostile to us—we were beneath its notice, and presented no danger."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Saddleback Lagac
text:
"A good lagac will carry you through thick and thin. A bad one . . . well, it's a tasty dinner."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Scythe Leopard
text: Eldrazi are not the leopard's preferred prey, but they are better than no prey at all.

name: Seek the Horizon
text:
"The horizon is the perpetual ideal, the constant promise of hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Vines of the Recluse
text: "The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."

name: Wood Elves
text: Through the waves of Eldrazi attacks, the Murasan jungles seemed to regrow as soon as they were destroyed.

name: Woodborn Behemoth
text: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Bala Ged Scorpion
text: Fast and lethal, with a penchant for the weak and infirm.

name: Citanul Woodreaders
text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

name: Blistergrub
text:
"Avoid anything that scuttles, scrabbles, or shambles."
—Opar, veteran guide

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Carrier Thrall
text:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Demon's Grasp
text:
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Despoiler of Souls
text: Rats and vultures devour. It desecrates.

name: Disfigure
text: "Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."

name: Doom Blade
text:
"One little word was all it took. The world shook as I said it. The doom of Zendikar was here at last."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Foul Imp
text: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Giant Scorpion
text: Its sting hurts, but death is strangely painless.

name: Grim Discovery
text: Few among the living understand just how much of their world is shaped by the ruins of the dead.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Mire's Toll
text: As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.

name: Pestilence Demon
text: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

name: Priest of the Blood Rite
text: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

name: Renegade Demon
text: Confront it at your own peril, for it will confront you for its own amusement.

name: Smallpox
text: Take away a few things, and a rebellion may ensue. Take away everything, and the oppression will be accepted as fate.

name: Squelching Leeches
text: Setting foot in their muck is an open invitation.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Unhallowed Pact
text: Agreements with demons seldom end at the grave.

name: Crop Rotation
text: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Snap
text: It doesn't matter if the mind or body cracks first. They both have to go.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: The Unspeakable
text: The rumors are horrifying; the truth is worse.

name: Empty the Warrens
text: It's never just *one* goblin.

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Beacon of Tomorrows
text: To look into its light is to meet the gaze of history.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Jori En, Ruin Diver
text: "Some relic hunters have given up exploring and gone to fight the Eldrazi. But I know our work is more important than ever. The secrets we uncover could lead to the world's salvation."

name: Spellheart Chimera
text: Thaumaturges remain silent around chimeras, lest their words conjure even stranger beasts.

name: Nucklavee
text: It loathes all tastes but two: spells and flesh.

name: Lovisa Coldeyes
text: "A massacre? It is a mercy we grant them. This way they won't freeze to death."

name: Beacon of Destruction
text: The Great Furnace's blessing is a spectacular sight, but the best view comes at a high cost.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Firebolt
text: "There's more where that came from!"

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Kruin Striker
text: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
text: He does not tolerate intruders.

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Cloudcrown Oak
text:
"Clever folk build their homes near cloudcrowns. If a hawk or even just a faerie tries to swoop in, it'll get swatted from here to Cloverdell."
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Talara's Battalion
text: The safewright Talara protects a delicate woodland waterfall. She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Run home, cur. I've already taken your master's head. Don't make me thrash you with it."

name: Relentless Hunter
text: "I swore to take one head for each member of my family they killed. My task is nowhere near its end."

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Guttural Response
text: A savage cry with the power to shatter minds.

name: Rubblebelt Raiders
text:
"This city will perish, and the Gruul will cheer as the boar-god crushes the last bricks into dust."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Coat of Arms
text: A banner for bonds of blood or belief.

name: Quicken
text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Reach Through Mists
text:
"Know one part of the name, obsession begins. Know two parts, paranoia sets in. Know three parts, madness descends. Know all, and only the kami know what will become of you."
—Lady Azami

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "Be like the sea: flow around that which is unmovable; for everything else, crash into it unrelentingly."

name: Merrow Reejerey
text: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Rootwater Hunter
text:
"Bitter water, vicious wave;
Shadow-cold shallows, root-made maze.
Home's angry embrace."
—*Rootwater Saga*

name: Scroll Thief
text: Kapsho merfolk have infiltrated fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari in their relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

name: Aquitect's Will
text:
"You may want to hold your breath."
—Kellyg, merrow aquitect

name: Tidal Warrior
text: The tide of battle favors those who can swim.

name: Tidal Wave
text:
"The floor of the sea is paved with the shattered remnants of vessels that navigated its surface unwelcomed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

name: Wake Thrasher
text: Anyone who thinks merrows have more brains than brawn has never been run over by one.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Blighted Cataract
text: Once, water ran here. Now only dust and ash fall from the clifftops.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Warren Instigator
text: There is always a rabble to be roused.

name: Battle Squadron
text: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Brute Strength
text: It's not the size of the rock. It's how badly you want to lift it.

name: Cleaver Riot
text: Measure once, cut twice.

name: Ember Hauler
text: Flurk's crude goblin language didn't differentiate between "I *bring* the flame" and "I *am* the flame."

name: Foundry Street Denizen
text: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Ghostfire
text: Only those gifted with the eye of Ugin, the spirit dragon, can see his fiery breath.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "It's time for the 'Smash, Smash' song!"

name: Goblin Diplomats
text: When you need to convey that special kind of message.

name: Goblin Grenade
text: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.

name: Goblin Razerunners
text: Finding themselves in a new and unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

name: Goblin Tunneler
text: "The best way over the mountain is through."

name: Engulf the Shore
text:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Goblin Wardriver
text:
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy."
—Qerk of the Secret Warren

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Krenko's Command
text: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

name: Tarfire
text:
"After Auntie brushed the soot from her eyes, she discovered something wonderful: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Brittle Effigy
text:
"In my early experiments in phylactery, I found that fragile forms have their uses."
—Rocati, Duke of Martyne

name: Blighted Gorge
text: The land is dying, but it will not go peacefully.

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"What you attempt to pull from the aether, I can spread onto the wind."
—Jace Beleren

name: Master of the Pearl Trident
text: "Let the land dwellers know the coast is no longer the border between our realms. A new age of empire has begun."

name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
text: Great hero or grand betrayer? The truth of Ezuri's legacy is clouded by the fog of legend.

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Kujar Seedsculptor
text: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

name: Leaf Gilder
text: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

name: Naturalize
text: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
text: "This is our land. We will not allow eyeblights to poison its beauty."

name: Nature's Way
text: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

name: Regal Force
text: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.

name: Sylvan Advocate
text: "The land gives of itself. Its abundance provides, even in times of chaos."

name: Talara's Battalion
text: The safewright Talara protects a delicate woodland waterfall. She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

name: Viridian Shaman
text: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
text: "I can call an army to my side in the blink of an eye. Best not blink."

name: Dwynen's Elite
text: Call one, call them all.

name: Artificer's Epiphany
text: The artificers of Kaladesh strive ceaselessly for perfection, progress, and the ultimate expression of elegance.

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Riddlesmith
text: The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.

name: Trophy Mage
text: "The tools of the past will help us forge the future."

name: Barrage Ogre
text: The elves had devised countless strategies to combat Memnarch's war machines, but they had no idea what to do when one was *thrown* at them.

name: Ghirapur Gearcrafter
text: The metal must be pure. The hand must be steady. The product must be perfect.

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: From trinket to trauma.

name: Welding Sparks
text:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

name: Reclusive Artificer
text: It's not wise to disturb an artist at work.

name: Darksteel Plate
text:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Filigree Familiar
text:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Neurok Replica
text: All the curiosity of the Neurok with only a trace of their duplicity.

name: Elvish Branchbender
text: "How do the vinebred feel? Fah! We do not ask the puppet how it feels when the puppeteer bids it dance."

name: Pyrite Spellbomb
text:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Scuttling Doom Engine
text: A masterwork of spite, inspired by madness.

name: Voyager Staff
text: Voyager staffs are sought by those hoping to find an escape from the sprawling glut of Ravnica.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Foundry of the Consuls
text: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Phyrexia's Core
text:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Vanguard
text: "Our lives are woven together like the trees' branches over our heads, forming a canopy that protects us all."

name: Ezuri's Archers
text: Eyes and arrows trained ever skyward.

name: Air Response Unit
text: Wherever the racers go, help follows.

name: Collision Course
text:
"These gators are driving like idiots!"
—Redshift

name: Quag Feast
text: Speedbrood racers are gregarious while not racing, but everyone must eat.

name: Ripclaw Wrangler
text: By the time Shantanu heard the Endriders chanting "The claw!" he was already in its grasp.

name: Risen Necroregent
text: In life, she commanded the respect of her army. In death, she demands it.

name: Risky Shortcut
text:
"Don't think of it as cheating, think of it as track they forgot to lay out for us."
—Rido, Endrider

name: Shefet Archfiend
text: It yields only to the gods themselves.

name: The Speed Demon
text: Caution is for those who falter.

name: Spin Out
text:
"Good sportsmanship wins the crowd. Bad sportsmanship wins the race."
—Winter

name: Streaking Oilgorger
text:
"They feed on OIL? Where were they during the Phyrexian Invasion?!"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Syphon Fuel
text: After years of hunger, the oil-thirsting vampires of Gastal finally had their fill.

name: Wickerfolk Indomitable
text: Some horrors are created. Others are the recognition of a possibility that has always existed.

name: Daring Mechanic
text: "Just a few more bolts—SHARK ON YOUR RIGHT—and we should be good to go."

name: Wretched Doll
text:
"Lot of folks on Duskmourn are more scared of dying than what comes after. Oh, how wrong they are."
—Winter

name: Adrenaline Jockey
text: "Either I win or we both lose. Take your pick."

name: Count on Luck
text: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

name: Crash and Burn
text: Redshift told his team to destroy the competition. They were thrilled to discover he meant it literally.

name: Dynamite Diver
text:
"Launch the explosives! No, you idiot, not like that!"
—Redshift, Rocketeer chief

name: Endrider Catalyzer
text: Endrider magic was developed on a world that was constantly on the move—the higher the velocity, the stronger the magic.

name: Fuel the Flames
text:
"Our world died, but we survived. Funny how it's the opposite for you."
—Rido, Endrider

name: Full Throttle
text:
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Gastal Blockbuster
text: "Consider me an accident no longer waiting to happen."

name: Gallant Strike
text: The ghost shrieked as Terrin's blade sank deep. Perhaps a second death would teach it not to mess with his dog.

name: Greasewrench Goblin
text: Killswitch finally had the right wrench for the job. Now she needed to remember what the job was.

name: Lightning Strike
text:
"No, it's not quite as simple as 'point and boom,' but if you must summarize."
—Daretti

name: Marauding Mako
text: "What a bunch of junk. I'll take the lot."

name: Pedal to the Metal
text: In lieu of brakes, the Rocketeers installed a second accelerator pedal.

name: Prowcatcher Specialist
text: "Don't you know it's dangerous to go faster than us?"

name: Reckless Velocitaur
text: Repairs are tomorrow's problems.

name: Road Rage
text: Endriders learned the rules of the road on Gastal, which meant they didn't learn any rules at all.

name: Skycrash
text: Under moonfall conditions, there's nothing you can do but drive and hope for the best.

name: Thunderhead Gunner
text:
"Fire the cannon, mates, fire it quick!
The sea's full of chum and we want our pick!"
—Keelhauler shanty

name: Tyrox, Saurid Tyrant
text: The Avishkari delegation considered their treaties with the Saurid Autocracy settled, but that was a crucial misunderstanding. To the Autocracy, diplomacy is a matter of power, not paper; testing the Grand Prix's defenses is merely their way of making a counteroffer.

name: Afterburner Expert
text: Speedbump has miraculously survived ninety-nine rocket crashes, and he's aiming for an even hundred.

name: Beastrider Vanguard
text: "She knows what I'm thinking before I do. That is what true partnership means."

name: Bestow Greatness
text:
Exercise kindness, for nothing remains small forever.
—Alacrian proverb

name: Broken Wings
text: An early lead puts a target on your back.

name: Defend the Rider
text: Lagorin would not lose another.

name: Guidelight Synergist
text: "Declarative: A unit is only as strong as its network."

name: Earthrumbler
text: The Brood aspires to become speed itself.

name: Elvish Refueler
text: "Anyone running low?"

name: Fang Guardian
text: Though the Fang Druids desired peace, the Grand Prix's interference threatened to awaken old dangers on Muraganda.

name: Hazard of the Dunes
text:
"It's aggravating that nature can build better hazards than I ever could."
—Termin, track designer

name: Jibbirik Omnivore
text: "Roadkill" takes on an entirely different meaning when the beast you crash into is more likely to kill *you*.

name: March of the World Ooze
text:
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Interface Ace
text: To the Guidelight Voyagers, a vehicle is just another hardware upgrade.

name: Molt Tender
text: The Speedbrood regards molting as a selfless act worthy of the highest of honors. It allows one to be born anew for the good of the brood.

name: Ooze Patrol
text: As it digested the demonic roadster, it too learned the thrill of speed.

name: Plow Through
text: Like most goblins, Rocketeers value nothing more than a good old-fashioned near-death experience.

name: Pothole Mole
text:
"Someone please call pest control. Again."
—Termin, track designer

name: Regal Imperiosaur
text: Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.

name: Stampeding Scurryfoot
text: All creatures great and small contribute to the stampede.

name: Terrian, World Tyrant
text: The Fang Druids call it the World Tyrant, for it has consumed entire ecosystems that it keeps suspended in its core. To look upon it is to see the world as it was eons ago.

name: Apocalypse Runner
text:
"Don't avoid the wreck. Survive it."
—Far Fortune

name: Lightshield Parry
text: The Quickbeasts' diet of aether makes them capable of astonishing maneuvers.

name: Brightglass Gearhulk
text: "A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."

name: Broadside Barrage
text: "Let's show 'em how the Keelhaulers say hello!"

name: Broodheart Engine
text: The only honor greater than piloting a Speedbrood vehicle is becoming one yourself.

name: Cloudspire Skycycle
text: For Team Cloudspire, the track is merely a suggestion.

name: Debris Beetle
text: Many brought weapons to the race. This crew built theirs as they went.

name: Dune Drifter
text: It was easy for them to replace lost crew members once they reached home turf.

name: Explosive Getaway
text: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
text: Let the past die so the future might live.

name: Lotusguard Disciple
text:
"No one dies under my watch."
—Sektem, Lotusguard veteran

name: Kolodin, Triumph Caster
text: "Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."

name: Oildeep Gearhulk
text: Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.

name: Pyrewood Gearhulk
text: A mighty memorial to a fallen savior.

name: Veteran Beastrider
text: "Your enemies will underestimate you, but you must never underestimate yourself."

name: Voyage Home
text: "Observation: At current rate of travel, eventual rediscovery of home is a mathematical inevitability. Firm imperative: Let's go."

name: Aetherjacket
text: The Sting Strike model saved thousands of lives during the Invasion and quickly became a bestseller for Shadowblayde Craftworks.

name: Camera Launcher
text: Vnwxt's contract demanded at least one dedicated camera on him at all times.

name: Marketback Walker
text: Many of the inventions built to fight the Phyrexians have since been repurposed for civilian use.

name: Monument to Endurance
text: Loss is not the end of the journey.

name: Radiant Lotus
text: After devastation, hope bloomed.

name: Scrap Compactor
text: From the screaming of Duskmourn's possessed metal came the happy cries of freed souls.

name: Starting Column
text: Ten teams. Ten dreams. One winner.

name: Ticket Tortoise
text: "ADMIT ONE. ENJOY THE RACE."

name: Walking Sarcophagus
text: The warrior rose in a very different world from the one he'd left behind.

name: Wreck Remover
text:
"Don't get too cocky. We're all junk to the cleanup crew."
—Far Fortune

name: Amonkhet Raceway
text: Stage 2: The sands and waters of Amonkhet.

name: Avishkar Raceway
text: Stage 1: The winding streets of Ghirapur.

name: Ride's End
text: Their race ended much the same way it began, walking through a sandstorm on a world that ended long ago.

name: Bleachbone Verge
text:
"Despite being older than nearly every living thing here, Loot is still just a kid. That doesn't change what we need from him."
—Jace

name: Bloodfell Caves
text: To the Endriders, racing is worship. Their prayers rise on the howls of straining engines. Explosions punctuate their chorus of shouts, forming a hymn of glory to the open road and all roads to come.

name: Blossoming Sands
text: The Alacrian Quickbeasts desire not only to win, but to forge new alliances against the unknown threats of this interconnected Multiverse.

name: Dismal Backwater
text: The doomed souls of the Speed Demons race in uneasy unity, each one hoping to escape their own fate.

name: Jungle Hollow
text: When asked, the Speedbrood never put their motives into words; they simply say that velocity is their way of life. Only by becoming speed itself can one truly understand their reason for racing.

name: Muraganda Raceway
text: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

name: Night Market
text: The Indigo Revolution changed more about Avishkar than just its name. Even Gonti's infamous night markets had gone legitimate.

name: Roadside Assistance
text: No road has to be traveled alone.

name: Riverpyre Verge
text:
"While Loot's ability to predict Omenpaths is extraordinary, I'm more impressed by his unrelenting curiosity."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Rugged Highlands
text: The Goblin Rocketeers want nothing more than to push the limits of kinetic energy and see if their machines can go the farthest, fastest, first.

name: Scoured Barrens
text: For the Champions of Amonkhet, the stakes go beyond victory. They race to show the Multiverse that their home is not a dead plane to be mourned, but a living world just beginning to awaken.

name: Sunbillow Verge
text:
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Swiftwater Cliffs
text: The Keelhaulers channel their prey drive into thrilling, cutthroat pursuits. Glory is all the sweeter when it's won at the expense of others.

name: Thornwood Falls
text: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all. Now the citizens of Avishkar cheer for the Aether Rangers as they try to bring victory and glory to their new nation.

name: Tranquil Cove
text: The Guidelight Voyagers seek only a means to return home, hoping to one day discover a way back among the many worlds they race across.

name: Wastewood Verge
text:
"I'm worried about Loot. He has great power but lacks the experience to know what dangers await him."
—Vraska

name: Salvation Engine
text:
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Willowrush Verge
text:
"If nothing else, that Loot is one brave little rat."
—Winter

name: Wind-Scarred Crag
text: Team Cloudspire burns with the pride and passion typical of competitors on Kylem. As the reigning champions of the Ghirapur Grand Prix, they have no intention of losing their title.

name: Skyseer's Chariot
text: "It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."

name: Spectacular Pileup
text: The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.

name: Air Response Unit
text: When the worst happens, rely on the best.

name: Broadcast Rambler
text: Get the shot. Every time.

name: Detention Chariot
text: Captivate the competition.

name: Skyseer's Chariot
text: Get carried away.

name: Spotcycle Scouter
text: Hard light. Hard attitude.

name: Hulldrifter
text: This car is what dreams are made of.

name: Midnight Mangler
text: Don't buy the rest. Possess the best!

name: Possession Engine
text: Take it for a spin. That's not a request.

name: Rangers' Refueler
text: Style that never runs on fumes.

name: Thopter Fabricator
text: Take flight on the wings of true innovation.

name: Cryptcaller Chariot
text: Go where only death dares follow.

name: The Last Ride
text: Leave a nightmare in your wake.

name: Ripclaw Wrangler
text: Seize the day . . . and anything else that happens to catch your eye.

name: Sundial, Dawn Tyrant
text:
"We follow as it walks at the head of the ever-breaking day. Is it leading the dawn, or does it march to some forgotten celestial order? It does not answer our questions, so faith must sustain us."
—Chakshi, Dawnchaser pilgrim

name: Burner Rocket
text: A ride worth dying for. Or in.

name: Clamorous Ironclad
text: Cut through the air like a corsair!

name: Earthrumbler
text: It practically drives itself!

name: Lumbering Worldwagon
text: Go everywhere. See everything.

name: Apocalypse Runner
text: Don't let the end of days stand in your way.

name: Boosted Sloop
text: Take a bite out of life.

name: Cloudspire Skycycle
text: The road is where you take it.

name: Debris Beetle
text: Get things rolling ... and never stop.

name: Dune Drifter
text: Vintage is back, and it's hunting you.

name: Haunted Hellride
text: A car you'd sell your soul for.

name: Rangers' Aetherhive
text: Thopters conditionally included.

name: Lifecraft Engine
text: Choose your own destiny.

name: Tune Up
text:
"For most people? The odds would be insurmountable," Daretti said.
"But we're not most people," Pia replied.

name: Skybox Ferry
text: Some say they want to see the world. We say why stop at just one?

name: Guardian Sunmare
text: It'll satisfy your need for steed!

name: Mindspring Merfolk
text: "Suck my seaweed!"

name: Bloodghast
text: "This baby runs on unleaded O negative."

name: Gas Guzzler
text: License plate: G4S BR34TH.

name: The Speed Demon
text: "You've got the dream machine. I've got the nightmare mach-ightmare."

name: Unswerving Sloth
text: "To victory . . . eventually!"

name: Burnout Bashtronaut
text: "Anybody looking for a torque dork?"

name: Draconautics Engineer
text: "Gentlegoblins, start your dragons!"

name: Agonasaur Rex
text: The one and only velocity raptor.

name: Webstrike Elite
text: "I'm the wretch who can fletch!"

name: Fearless Swashbuckler
text: "Party on the poop deck!"

name: Voyager Glidecar
text: "Exclamatory: Hang on to something."

name: Voyager Quickwelder
text: The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home. They considered every last unit essential, down to the glitchiest grunt.

name: Mu Yanling, Wind Rider
text: The search for her lost mentor continued.

name: March of the World Ooze
text:
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Bounce Off
text:
Control lost is adventure gained.
—Keelhauler proverb

name: Caelorna, Coral Tyrant
text: For centuries, she grew in her benthic home, safe from Muraganda's moonfalls, feeding on the raw leylines that run below the water. When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.

name: Diversion Unit
text: "Declarative: Goodbye."

name: Flood the Engine
text: There had been a time when the Endriders would've killed for water.

name: Amonkhet Raceway
text: Stage 2: The sands and waters of Amonkhet.

name: Avishkar Raceway
text: Stage 1: The winding streets of Ghirapur.

name: Muraganda Raceway
text: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

name: Gearseeker Serpent
text: The biggest collector of vehicles on Avishkar is also the largest.

name: Salvation Engine
text:
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Skyseer's Chariot
text: "It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."

name: Spectacular Pileup
text: The first four crashes were accidental. Then the Endriders joined the fun.

name: Voyager Glidecar
text: "Exclamatory: Hang on to something."

name: Mindspring Merfolk
text: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.

name: Mu Yanling, Wind Rider
text: The search for her lost mentor continued.

name: Possession Engine
text: "Here's a tip: If your ride needs souls for fuel, make sure to always keep one handy."

name: Repurposing Bay
text: By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.

name: Thopter Fabricator
text: Every camera had a backup, and every backup had a backup, and every backup's backup had a backup, too.

name: Unstoppable Plan
text: Jace knew that if he just had time to explain his plan, he would find support. Unfortunately, time was in short supply.

name: Vnwxt, Verbose Host
text: "Racers! Start! Your! Engiiiiiines!"

name: Bloodghast
text: Summoning it is easy. Controlling it is another matter.

name: Cryptcaller Chariot
text:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

name: Gas Guzzler
text: Gastal's vampires took fuel from the dead.

name: Guidelight Optimizer
text: "Analysis: Systems operating at 125% efficiency. Stress within expected tolerances. Exclamatory: Punch it."

name: The Last Ride
text: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.

name: Quag Feast
text: Speedbrood racers are gregarious while not racing, but everyone must eat.

name: The Speed Demon
text: Caution is for those who falter.

name: Count on Luck
text: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

name: Howler's Heavy
text: "It takes a thick skin to ride among the Keelhaulers."

name: Full Throttle
text:
"You wanted a fight. Now you've got two."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Afterburner Expert
text: Speedbump has miraculously survived ninety-nine rocket crashes, and he's aiming for an even hundred.

name: March of the World Ooze
text:
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Regal Imperiosaur
text: Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.

name: Brightglass Gearhulk
text: "A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."

name: Debris Beetle
text: Many brought weapons to the race. This crew built theirs as they went.

name: Explosive Getaway
text: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

name: Keen Buccaneer
text: "The secret to good piratin' is being ready for anything. That, and havin' eight arms."

name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
text: Let the past die so the future might live.

name: Kolodin, Triumph Caster
text: "Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."

name: Oildeep Gearhulk
text: Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.

name: Pyrewood Gearhulk
text: A mighty memorial to a fallen savior.

name: Memory Guardian
text: For the Guidelight Voyagers, there is no such thing as junk.

name: Marketback Walker
text: Many of the inventions built to fight the Phyrexians have since been repurposed for civilian use.

name: Monument to Endurance
text: Loss is not the end of the journey.

name: Midnight Mangler
text:
"Is someone asleep at the wheel, or are the wheels driving themselves?!"
—Vnwxt, Grand Prix host

name: Radiant Lotus
text: After devastation, hope bloomed.

name: Bleachbone Verge
text:
"Despite being older than nearly every living thing here, Loot is still just a kid. That doesn't change what we need from him."
—Jace

name: Muraganda Raceway
text: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

name: Riverpyre Verge
text:
"While Loot's ability to predict Omenpaths is extraordinary, I'm more impressed by his unrelenting curiosity."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Sunbillow Verge
text:
"Loot is free to go where he wants, so let's make sure the kid gets there in one piece."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Wastewood Verge
text:
"I'm worried about Loot. He has great power but lacks the experience to know what dangers await him."
—Vraska

name: Willowrush Verge
text:
"If nothing else, that Loot is one brave little rat."
—Winter

name: Mindspring Merfolk
text: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.

name: Skyseer's Chariot
text: Get carried away.

name: Mu Yanling, Wind Rider
text: The search for her lost mentor continued.

name: Possession Engine
text: Take it for a spin. That's not a request.

name: Thopter Fabricator
text: Take flight on the wings of true innovation.

name: Cryptcaller Chariot
text: Go where only death dares follow.

name: The Last Ride
text: Leave a nightmare in your wake.

name: Lumbering Worldwagon
text: Go everywhere. See everything.

name: Nimble Thopterist
text: The Aether Rangers repurposed thopters once used for Consulate surveillance so they could scout the track.

name: Debris Beetle
text: Get things rolling ... and never stop.

name: Lifecraft Engine
text: Choose your own destiny.

name: Guardian Sunmare
text: It'll satisfy your need for steed!

name: Mindspring Merfolk
text: "Suck my seaweed!"

name: Bloodghast
text: "This baby runs on unleaded O negative."

name: Gas Guzzler
text: License plate: G4S BR34TH.

name: The Speed Demon
text: "You've got the dream machine. I've got the nightmare mach-ightmare."

name: Burnout Bashtronaut
text: "Anybody looking for a torque dork?"

name: Possession Engine
text: "Here's a tip: If your ride needs souls for fuel, make sure to always keep one handy."

name: Draconautics Engineer
text: "Gentlegoblins, start your dragons!"

name: Agonasaur Rex
text: The one and only velocity raptor.

name: Webstrike Elite
text: "I'm the wretch who can fletch!"

name: Fearless Swashbuckler
text: "Party on the poop deck!"

name: Repurposing Bay
text: By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.

name: Roadside Blowout
text:
"In cases of extreme emergency, just wing it."
—Rocketeer safety manual, full text

name: Broadcast Rambler
text: To keep up with the Grand Prix, reporters trained just as hard as the racers themselves.

name: Scrounging Skyray
text: "Oi, you ain't gonna believe what these kelpheads just threw away!"

name: Skystreak Engineer
text: Garima was delighted to finally test out her design. The amazing views were a bonus.

name: Spectral Interference
text: "So many fears. Let's make them all come true."

name: Spell Pierce
text: The druid's aim was dead on. But their choice of target was dead wrong.

name: Spikeshell Harrier
text: "Target acquired. Resolution: Imminent impact."

name: Stock Up
text: "We are now accepting over eleven different interplanar currencies, including polished moonfall!"

name: Thopter Fabricator
text: Every camera had a backup, and every backup had a backup, and every backup's backup had a backup, too.

name: Trade the Helm
text: "This looks like a winning vehicle. But you lot ain't a winning team."

name: Transit Mage
text: "Remember: You can take the wheel if you want, but *I* choose the music."

name: Trip Up
text: "That net was made to hold skywhales. Good luck getting to the next checkpoint!"

name: Unstoppable Plan
text: Jace knew that if he just had time to explain his plan, he would find support. Unfortunately, time was in short supply.

name: Vnwxt, Verbose Host
text: "Racers! Start! Your! Engiiiiiines!"

name: Ancient Vendetta
text:
"Make peace with your end, for not even your legacy will remain."
—Zahur

name: Back on Track
text: At the Tombs Before Time, the living of Amonkhet made vital alliances with the honored dead.

name: Bloodghast
text: Summoning it is easy. Controlling it is another matter.

name: Chitin Gravestalker
text: The Speedbrood doesn't differentiate between salvage and carrion.

name: Canyon Vaulter
text: Some seek thrills in watching the show. Some seek thrills in being the show.

name: Cryptcaller Chariot
text:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

name: Deathless Pilot
text: Amonkhet champions become markedly more reckless after dying.

name: Engine Rat
text: In a land of undeath, permanent pest control solutions are few and far between.

name: Gas Guzzler
text: Gastal's vampires took fuel from the dead.

name: Gastal Raider
text: Win or lose, she will sate her hunger.

name: Grim Javelineer
text: Kheti lost everything to the Eternals and the Phyrexians. What she gained was an intimate knowledge of death in its myriad forms.

name: Cloudspire Captain
text: Cloudspire's might comes from its unparalleled coordination.

name: Hellish Sideswipe
text: Might makes right-of-way.

name: Intimidation Tactics
text:
"This is still a negotiation. We haven't broken anything... yet."
—Far Fortune

name: Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant
text: Galadak's Scar is full of craters which are home to terrifying predators of immense size and savagery. Yet even among such company, Kalakscion—and her insatiable hunger—eclipses them all.

name: The Last Ride
text: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.

name: Locust Spray
text:
"Captain, the cowards are throwing *bugs* at us!"
—Sphyr, Keelhauler lookout

name: Maximum Overdrive
text: Compared to the Fuel Wars on Gastal, this Grand Prix is a thrilling vacation.

name: Pactdoll Terror
text:
"And you're telling me this was designed for *children*?"
—Sita Varma

name: Wake the Reflections
text:
"You see a bird, an oak, a packbeast. I see the potential for an army."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

name: Scab-Clan Giant
text: For the Gruul, bone-crushing rage is the first priority. Accuracy comes in a distant ninetieth.

name: Showstopper
text: The audience quickly realized a few things: it wasn't a magic trick, there wasn't candy in there, and they'd need new clothes.

name: Sin Collector
text: "That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."

name: Sire of Insanity
text: Its victims become mindless lunatics. Conveniently, that's the first step in joining the Cult of Rakdos.
