name: Species Gorger
text:
"We raised eelhawks to control the squidflies, then waspcrabs to prey on the eelhawks. Now what do we do with all these waspcrabs?"
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Spike Jester
text: For the Rakdos, "suicidal charge" and "good showmanship" are one and the same.

name: Tajic, Blade of the Legion
text: "I run the maze alone, but I fight with the full might of the Legion."

name: Unflinching Courage
text: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

name: Viashino Firstblade
text:
"All that steel doesn't make them slower. It makes them bolder."
—Tajic, Blade of the Legion

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Warleader's Helix
text:
"There is no time to remedy our enemies' ignorance. Blast it out of them."
—Aurelia

name: Warped Physique
text: The Gruul seek unbounded strength. The Dimir deliver cruel irony.

name: Woodlot Crawler
text:
"We learned something from the Simic. Unfortunately for them."
—Nefara, Dimir agent

name: Zhur-Taa Ancient
text: Many Ravnicans think of nature as orderly groves and elf-tended rot farms. They haven't seen the Gruul wilds.

name: Zhur-Taa Druid
text: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

name: Maze Glider
text: The pattern of the Implicit Maze extends in more than two dimensions.

name: Azorius Cluestone
text: Its three sides represent the Sova, judges and arbitrators; the Jelenn, scribes and elocutors; and the Lyev, lawmages and enforcers.

name: Boros Cluestone
text:
"In case of fire, treachery, citywide riot, political upheaval, or worldwide societal collapse, break glass."
—Cluestone inscription

name: Dimir Cluestone
text: It waits in the chill of the undercity, holding nameless secrets for those who dare to touch it.

name: Golgari Cluestone
text: Golgari mold collects whispers, intelligence that is later harvested by Jarad and his high chancellors.

name: Mindstatic
text:
"It's always satisfying to stymie the best efforts of a rival, but the reactions of the Gruul are particularly amusing."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

name: Gruul Cluestone
text: Forgotten under rocks and vines, Gruul symbols mark the sites of primitive rituals where shamans once chanted to the wild.

name: Izzet Cluestone
text: It holds within it an unsolvable riddle. A creative answer yields an invitation to the guild.

name: Orzhov Cluestone
text: A symbol of power and wealth, the only commodities that matter to the Orzhov.

name: Rakdos Cluestone
text:
"Burn. Bleed. Enjoy."
—Cluestone inscription

name: Selesnya Cluestone
text:
"Break it if you must. The loss of one relic is nothing next to the value of enriching us all."
—Suniel the Woodwise

name: Simic Cluestone
text: Simic symbols are among the most intricate and fragile, yet few vandalize them for fear of the strange lifeforms that might be released.

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.

name: Murmuring Phantasm
text:
"The most insidious thing in the world is nonsense that sounds just plausible enough to listen to."
—Lazav

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: The scarred rubble around the gate is testament to past meetings of the Clans, summits that inevitably devolved into brawls.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Beyond lies the culmination of all Izzet projects, a grand experiment led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet himself.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Maze-runners who pass through the Rakdos gate leave behind their scruples and a significant amount of skin.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: The Selesnya welcome all to help them heal the city's wounds. The price, however, is devotion to the guild and a selfless belief in Trostani.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Simic biomancers don't concern themselves with guarding a gate. Their ever-present creations are enough to ward off trespassers.

name: Opal Lake Gatekeepers
text: Sentries guard Ravnica's landmarks and outlying districts, unaware of these places' import to the maze.

name: Uncovered Clues
text: The Implicit Maze winds through Ravnica, connecting arcane landmarks of all ten guilds.

name: Haazda Snare Squad
text: They've been probation officers, army grunts, bounty hunters—anything to make their district safer.

name: Wind Drake
text: Air currents whip through the city corridors, creating wind tunnels that accelerate urban drakes toward their prey.

name: Bane Alley Blackguard
text: "I'm in the field of procurement, and business is good. The guilds want all kinds of maps and relics these days, though what they want them for I'm not quite sure."

name: Blood Scrivener
text: Make sure you bleed the fine print.

name: Crypt Incursion
text: The Golgari maze-runner Varolz hungers to prove his fortitude in battle, and his trail of victims feeds other hungers.

name: Fatal Fumes
text: Travelers in the undercity dread the horrors and assassins of the Dimir, but nearly as many die from more mundane hazards.

name: Hired Torturer
text: "Follow your passion, I always say. Might as well get paid to do what you love."

name: Rakdos Drake
text: Rakdos rioters paint their faces to resemble the drakes' bloodied muzzles.

name: Sinister Possession
text:
"You caught something on a cold night's stroll? No, I'd say something caught you."
—Mezim Magrah, civic healer

name: Lyev Decree
text: The Azorius have so many codes and statutes that you're always in violation of one of them.

name: Ubul Sar Gatekeepers
text: There are many gates into the undercity, but few ways out.

name: Awe for the Guilds
text: When the guilds cooperate, the guildless celebrate their peaceful society. When the guilds clash, the guildless just try to keep out of the way.

name: Clear a Path
text: "Why do guards always look surprised when we bash them?" asked Ruric. "I think they expect a bribe," said Thar.

name: Maze Rusher
text:
"The maze seems to fight us at every turn, resisting our efforts to solve it."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Punish the Enemy
text:
"When justice descends, the servant will burn with the master."
—Aurelia

name: Riot Piker
text: He doesn't care whether he's rioting about trade rights or just having a drunken brawl. He wakes up every morning eager to smash some heads.

name: Rubblebelt Maaka
text:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Maze Sentinel
text: The route has been known for millennia, but only by those with no means to tell it.

name: Kraul Warrior
text: The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.

name: Maze Behemoth
text: It returned to the leylines as quickly as it had appeared, leaving only broken bodies to mark its passage.

name: Mending Touch
text:
"The gift of life must be freely given. Anything less would diminish us all."
—Arin, Selesnya healer

name: Mutant's Prey
text: Every street corner is a hunting ground, every citizen potential prey.

name: Phytoburst
text: Phytohydras are banned as houseplants in many residential spires. If left unfed, they find their own exit—usually at the cost of extensive property damage.

name: Saruli Gatekeepers
text: In Ravnica's wilder districts, nature still stirs, and its protectors still mind their posts.

name: Skylasher
text:
"It preys on those who would spy on our lands, so we never prey on it."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Renounce the Guilds
text:
"Scores will die in the name of peace. That is what you call compromise?"
—Gideon Jura, to Aurelia

name: Advent of the Wurm
text: The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.

name: Armored Wolf-Rider
text: Wolf-riders of Selesnya apprentice from a young age. Each rider raises a wolf pup from birth to serve as a mount, hoping that one day the two will share the honor of guarding the Great Concourse.

name: Ascended Lawmage
text: A lawmage's runic script is an act of governance given form: legislation written directly onto the air itself.

name: Beetleform Mage
text:
"When the Simic say to take command of your life, we don't mean just your career."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Blast of Genius
text: Ral Zarek's brainstorms bring actual thunder and lightning.

name: Blaze Commando
text: A true Boros commando only calls for reinforcements so they can clean up the mess.

name: Boros Battleshaper
text: Leaders shape the minds of their allies. It takes a master to shape the minds of enemies.

name: Bred for the Hunt
text: Some see the world as a place of infinite wonder and knowledge. Some see it as an infinite dinner plate.

name: Riot Control
text:
"Ravnicans need order. If they don't have it, we shall bring it to them."
—Isperia

name: Bronzebeak Moa
text: They fight for their home with more loyalty than any conscript.

name: Carnage Gladiator
text: Not the foulest or bloodiest act at Rix Maadi by a stretch.

name: Debt to the Deathless
text: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

name: Deputy of Acquittals
text: "Everyone deserves a day in court."

name: Drown in Filth
text: The rot farmer's first rite of passage is to craft a pair of work stilts.

name: Emmara Tandris
text: When Selesnya needed a champion, Emmara put the ranks of her guild before herself—making her the perfect choice.

name: Feral Animist
text: "Channeling the rage of the beast is the easy part. Explaining why you woke up with no memory in a pile of mangled lawmages—that's trickier."

name: Fluxcharger
text: One part mizzium, two parts elemental energy, eleven parts danger.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Gleam of Battle
text: Every soldier returns from battle changed: by hardship, by blood, by a glimpse of glory.

name: Goblin Test Pilot
text:
"All pilots and prototypes destroyed. Extensive collateral damage inflicted. Conclusion: flawless design."
—*Manual of Melek*

name: Gruul War Chant
text:
"We are the heart of the wild, the fire in its eyes, and the howl in its throat. Come, join the battle to which you were born."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Haunter of Nightveil
text: The Dimir employ the spirits of Ravnica's ancient, nameless dead, guiding their malevolence toward selected victims.

name: Jelenn Sphinx
text: Few among the Azorius have ever spoken with the sphinxes, but all have felt their influence.

name: Korozda Gorgon
text: "Welcome to my collection."

name: Steeple Roc
text:
"Sometimes it forgets to loosen its grip before taking flight. I lost my roof that way."
—Ecaban, Boros scout

name: Maw of the Obzedat
text: The devout sacrifice themselves to it hoping for escape from their debts to the guild, but many end up owing in the afterlife.

name: Morgue Burst
text:
"Let him in. He's on the list."
—Olrich, Rakdos club owner

name: Obzedat's Aid
text:
"The Obzedat have revived you with purpose. Don't squander their blessing."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Sunspire Gatekeepers
text: "You will pass with respect, or you will not pass at all."

name: Pilfered Plans
text: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the chances of the other guilds.

name: Plasm Capture
text:
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Render Silent
text: "We have confiscated your spells as evidence. Once we conclude our investigation, you may petition to have them returned."

name: Restore the Peace
text:
"You can always count on the Azorius to ruin a party."
—Massacre Girl

name: Guardian of the Guildpact
text: The magic of the Guildpact gives aegis to the spirits pressed into its service. Upon entering the afterlife, they find new focus and are charged with defending the Guildpact against those who would see it broken.

name: Assault Zeppelid
text:
"Show them to Razia and then to the Azorius sky marshals. We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj."
—Momir Vig

name: Azorius Aethermage
text: In her single metasphere are bound the records of every Ætheric transaction since the time of Azor.

name: Azorius First-Wing
text: With a steady diet of lawbreakers, Azorius griffins inevitably develop a resistance to the contraband magic that taints much of their prey.

name: Azorius Ploy
text: Azorius military tactics, like their legal tactics, capitalize on delay and nullification.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Cytoshape
text:
"Though highly effective at reshaping flesh, these specially bred cytoplasts leave the subject reeking of omnibian mucus."
—Simic research notes

name: Dread Slag
text: A thousand phobias sopped from the city and wrung from Rix Maadi as one.

name: Haazda Exonerator
text: "This aura threatens the sanctity of your soul. Wrenching it free won't be easy on either of us. If you're ready, we'll begin."

name: Experiment Kraj
text:
"Of course it will grow beyond control—it was designed to choose its own evolution."
—Momir Vig

name: Gobhobbler Rats
text: Lyzolda's pet rats eat better than the average citizen. In fact, they can usually be found eating the average citizen.

name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
text: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

name: Hellhole Rats
text:
"I must speak with Momir Vig about creating a water-spouting watchdog."
—Mathvan, Prahv scrollwarden

name: Jagged Poppet
text: Few puppets are so willing.

name: Leafdrake Roost
text:
"The best experiments are those whose successes replicate themselves."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Lyzolda, the Blood Witch
text: Sacrificial rites take place before an audience of cheering cultists, each begging to be the next on stage.

name: Omnibian
text:
"This creature has hyperevolved chameleonic abilities. It no longer mimics its surroundings, instead forcing them to take on its form."
—Simic research notes

name: Haazda Shield Mate
text: The Haazda shield is broad, protecting both the free and the guilded.

name: Overrule
text: With one commanding word, the spell was put down and a fine collected for its casting.

name: Pain Magnification
text: The Rakdos make sure their victims remember their pain—or at least give up a little bit of their sanity in order to forget.

name: Rain of Gore
text:
"Stay indoors, away from what seeps over the thresholds. This is the Demon's work, and only ill can come of it."
—Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

name: Rakdos Augermage
text: "Great minds bleed alike."

name: Rakdos Ickspitter
text:
"Our thrulls dissolve from the inside out in a matter of days. Shoddy work, but they're a scream while they last."
—Uzric, Rakdos guildmage

name: Mistral Charger
text: Some sky steeds break from the thundering herd to ride free on the open winds.

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Swift Silence
text:
"This world may not know peace, but in my presence you *will* know quiet."
—Augustin IV

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Twinstrike
text: They're dying left and right.

name: Vigean Hydropon
text: Fruits of magic, roots in science.

name: Voidslime
text:
"It is technically an ooze, but its lifespan measures only seconds. In that short time, its appetite for magic is extraordinary."
—Simic research notes

name: Wrecking Ball
text: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

name: Avatar of Discord
text: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

name: Biomantic Mastery
text:
"Look beyond, to the vascular awareness that all life is a map to greater knowledge."
—Momir Vig, *Biomancy*, vol. I

name: Minister of Impediments
text: When it takes forever to learn all the rules, no time is left for breaking them.

name: Riot Spikes
text: Most auramancers would have let the spikes hover just above the skin. Having the spikes rip through the skin from beneath was a touch added by Rakdos himself.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Proper Burial
text: Properly honored dead gain the peace of the grave and freedom from the call of the Ghost Quarter.

name: Bronze Bombshell
text:
"Ooh, shiny! Let's pull off the chain and take her with us."
—Ukl, Gruul raider, last words

name: Evolution Vat
text: The vats are self-contained worlds, bubbling and churning with unnatural speed, boiling down eons of change into moments.

name: Magewright's Stone
text: The stones hark back to an age before civilization, when the living earth blessed all who trod its untamed wilds.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Skullmead Cauldron
text: Once tasted, the flavor of skullmead lingers in the throat, a secret brand of guilt for those who partake in forbidden pleasures.

name: Transguild Courier
text: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

name: Soulsworn Jury
text: In death, as in life, they protect the Grand Arbiter from exposure to contrary points of view.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
text:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

name: Pillar of the Paruns
text: Built on the very ground where the Ten signed the Guildpact, the tower is a monument to the past and a reminder of who holds power in the present.

name: Prahv, Spires of Order
text: Prahv, where much work is done to make sure nothing is accomplished.

name: Rix Maadi, Dungeon Palace
text: Even miles away, if you put your ear to the sewer vents, you can hear the screams and the tempestuous laughter.

name: Stoic Ephemera
text: "Life is fleeting, and so is death. Only the oath is eternal."

name: Azorius Herald
text:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

name: Valor Made Real
text: "As my father taught, 'Training will raise your shield to the blow, but courage fills the gaps the shield leaves open.'"

name: Wakestone Gargoyle
text: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

name: Ocular Halo
text: While the soldier dreams, the eyes stand watch.

name: Psychic Possession
text: "You will do the thinking for the both of us!"

name: Spell Snare
text: Every culture has its unlucky numbers. In a city where you're either alone, in a crowd, or being stabbed in the back, two is the worst number of all.

name: Tidespout Tyrant
text: He unmakes the world in his own image.

name: Vision Skeins
text: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

name: Bond of Agony
text: The Rakdos are unique in designing torture equipment they can operate while "suffering" alongside their victims.

name: Brain Pry
text: To the Rakdos, the fun is in the shakedown. The loot is usually discarded.

name: Blessing of the Nephilim
text: "Before the first stone was laid or the first elf-child born, the power of the nephilim was gathering. Let that power be spread by my hands."

name: Delirium Skeins
text: There came a rush, a sudden fire in the mind. Then the two saw only the sooty fog of madness, heard only the crackling of their last thoughts burning away.

name: Demon's Jester
text: They knock 'em dead, with or without the punch line.

name: Drekavac
text: Like a vulture's scalp, the face of a drekavac is oily and hairless. The filth and disease of its carrion diet slip off its blood-slick skin.

name: Enemy of the Guildpact
text: Guilds often exterminate those who saw or knew too much. Some vindictive souls retain their knowledge, using it in the afterlife to crush the guilded and the vile bargain that gives them power.

name: Macabre Waltz
text:
"All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy."
—Savra

name: Nettling Curse
text:
"I call them 'Poke' and 'Prod.'"
—Chagrach, Rakdos cursemage

name: Nightcreep
text:
"Please tell me I'm hallucinating. I'd rather be crazy than here."
—Gorev Hadszak, Wojek investigator

name: Brace for Impact
text: Flesh can be tempered by spellcraft and forged ever stronger by the hammers of foes.

name: Nihilistic Glee
text: "All ends in obliteration—love in hatred, life in death, and light in empty darkness."

name: Ragamuffyn
text: They cut the stitches and give her sips of her brew. Then they sew her up again, and she's back to stirring.

name: Ratcatcher
text: An ogre's poisonous stench is like fine Kashkaval cheese to the noses lowest to the ground.

name: Seal of Doom
text:
"A basilisk's gaze is effective, but disposing of physical remains is a tiresome task. It's far more discrete to dissolve one's victim entirely."
—Szadek

name: Slaughterhouse Bouncer
text: A Rakdos party is a flop if anyone lives to talk about it.

name: Unliving Psychopath
text:
"The victim bears the marks of the 'Ktozok Impaler'. . . but he was executed years ago!"
—Gorev Hadszak, Wojek investigator

name: Vesper Ghoul
text:
"Nature's exceptions remind us not to think in absolutes. Just as the orchid blossoms on blackened stone, so does the gift of mana occasionally manifest in the undead."
—Bougrat, druid of the Cult of Yore

name: Wit's End
text:
"Some images are so powerful that one glance burns them into your mind forever. Come, let us gaze on nothingness."
—Szadek

name: Cackling Flames
text:
"I like a little entertainment with my dinner."
—Rakdos

name: Carom
text: Her enemy's strength is her own.

name: Flame-Kin War Scout
text:
"The forward flame-kin are popping. We have incoming!"
—Svar, Boros signaler

name: Flaring Flame-Kin
text: A flame-kin is always formidable, but feeding its fire with a sorcerous gift grants it the power to devastate armies.

name: Gnat Alley Creeper
text: Despite its diminutive name, Gnat Alley is the longest street in Ravnica. Mile after twisting mile, it threads its way among the broader, safer thoroughfares like a parasite.

name: Ignorant Bliss
text:
"A quick step beyond oblivion lies a place so full of thoughts that it leaves no room for your own."
—Quyzl, chronarch prodigy

name: Kill-Suit Cultist
text: Dressed to kill.

name: Kindle the Carnage
text: "Start knockin' heads, boys, and don't stop 'til the ragamuffyn sings!"

name: Ogre Gatecrasher
text: A popular game among ogres is to see how many revolutions a head can make before it pops off.

name: Psychotic Fury
text:
"Rage, my servants. Our ancient power is renewed in blood."
—Rakdos

name: Celestial Ancient
text:
"We thought the clouds had moved from the night sky. Then the night sky moved, and the horizon grew wings."
—Josuri

name: Seal of Fire
text:
"If it breathes, it will burn."
—Rakdos pyromancers' creed

name: Stalking Vengeance
text: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

name: Taste for Mayhem
text: The taste of blood breaks down what little self-control the Rakdos possess.

name: Utvara Scalper
text: He wages war wherever the wind carries him.

name: War's Toll
text: Razia, archangel of war, demands total commitment.

name: Weight of Spires
text:
"Finally, a good use for an Azorius courthouse."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Whiptail Moloch
text:
"It wags its tail when it's happy. It wags its tail when it's angry. Nope, there's no good time to be around a whiptail."
—Rugar, Leaguehall Infirmary patient

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice *now*!"
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Flash Foliage
text:
"This undemanding vegetation takes root in a mote of dust but grows incredibly quickly."
—Simic research notes

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

name: Loaming Shaman
text: His work determines who is remembered and who feeds the worms.

name: Might of the Nephilim
text:
"Send a runner to Tin Street, and tell 'em the delivery has been . . . uh . . . held up."
—Bonmod, caravan rear guard

name: Freewind Equenaut
text: Confront her, and feel the hooves of her steed. Ignore her, and feel the sting of her arrow.

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Simic Initiate
text: Simic initiates begin their training as experimental subjects. Failures are flushed to the undersewers.

name: Simic Ragworm
text:
"Infused with autochthon blood for size and hellion cells for speed, the ragworm is perfect for clearing the undergardens of both rats and vagrants."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Sprouting Phytohydra
text: A hydra tender's problem isn't having enough defenses but enough pots.

name: Stomp and Howl
text:
"Mizzium may be impervious to fire, but obviously certain other things can . . . modify its form."
—Ivos Koba, indrik handler

name: Street Savvy
text: "It takes more than swift feet and dark shadows to slip by me unnoticed."

name: Thrive
text: The most successful of Simic creations is cytoplasm, a living, symbiotic substance that feeds off genetic rhythms and strengthens its host in return.

name: Archangel's Light
text:
"This is the light of Avacyn. Even in her absence she offers us hope."
—Radulf, priest of Avacyn

name: Hollowhenge Spirit
text: Some spirits mourn. Others terrorize.

name: Nearheath Stalker
text: "Do not speak of this to the elders. They look unfavorably upon my indulgences."

name: Russet Wolves
text:
"The wolves of our valley are bred to detest the scent of ghouls. For centuries they have kept our estates clear of such carrion."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Scorch the Fields
text:
"Your fields will turn as black as a ghoul's tongue and fire shall be your only harvest."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Shattered Perception
text:
"You must shatter the fetters of the past. Only then can you truly act."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Torch Fiend
text: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

name: Wrack with Madness
text: The skathul, spirits consumed by revenge, fester and seethe while looking for weak minds to assault.

name: Briarpack Alpha
text:
"The wolves turned on us and a chill swept over me. The pack had a new leader."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Crushing Vines
text:
"Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage. I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide."
—Garruk Wildspeaker, to Liliana Vess

name: Dawntreader Elk
text: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

name: Deranged Outcast
text: Cast out by his village, he now takes grim offense at refugees who seek shelter in his forest.

name: Favor of the Woods
text: Feeling abandoned by Avacyn, some Kessigers turned to the pagan rituals of their ancestors.

name: Ghoultree
text: It uproots entire fengrafs to add to its twisted frame.

name: Gravetiller Wurm
text: As the creatures of the night closed in on humanity, Innistrad's primeval forces stirred, as though waking to watch the slaughter.

name: Grim Flowering
text:
"Nothing in nature goes to waste, not even the rotting corpse of a good-for-nothing, blood-sucking vampire."
—Halana of Ulvenwald

name: Hollowhenge Beast
text: In a world of monsters, it's the stuff of nightmares.

name: Hunger of the Howlpack
text:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Kessig Recluse
text: Its silk is highly prized, but then again, so is your life.

name: Lambholt Elder
text:
"Be wary of the seemingly gentle souls. The weak here were slaughtered long ago."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Scorned Villager
text: "My village's fear drove me into the wild . . ."

name: Somberwald Dryad
text: The Somberwald is her domain, and she has yet to hear an acceptable excuse for trespassing.

name: Strangleroot Geist
text: Geists of the hanged often haunt the tree on which they died.

name: Ulvenwald Bear
text:
Out chasing bears
—Kessig expression meaning "died in the woods"

name: Loyal Cathar
text:
"I trust myself to do my duty, even unto death. It's what comes after that I'm afraid of."
—Constable Visil, to Thalia

name: Village Survivors
text: As their villages fell to werewolves, fleeing refugees discovered they too had remarkable survival instincts.

name: Vorapede
text:
"If you think you've killed one, guess again."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Wild Hunger
text: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions. The snake was filled only with Otto.

name: Young Wolf
text: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

name: Diregraf Captain
text: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

name: Drogskol Captain
text: Dead or alive, true leaders can inspire an entire army.

name: Drogskol Reaver
text: Wracked and warped with anguish, it obsessively seeks out other souls to hoard within its eternal prison.

name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
text: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

name: Havengul Lich
text: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

name: Midnight Guard
text:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Stromkirk Captain
text:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Chalice of Life
text: The sweet taste of hope's promise.

name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade
text: Those who grasp its hilt soon hear the demon's call.

name: Grafdigger's Cage
text:
"If you wind up in one of mine, you can be sure as silver it will be your last."
—Grafdigger Wulmer

name: Niblis of the Mist
text:
"Not even a roaring fire could thaw the chill it put in my heart."
—Vonn, geist-trapper

name: Wolfhunter's Quiver
text:
"Steel in the heart, silver in the bow."
—Wolfhunter's creed

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Our world is vast, but Thraben is its heart. The cathedral must stand even if the hinterlands are lost."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Haunted Fengraf
text: A ghoulcaller's playground.

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: Niblis of the Urn
text:
"I never had the nerve to open that bottle. I'll bet you're wishing right now you hadn't been so curious yourself."
—Old Rutstein

name: Ray of Revelation
text:
"May angels carry him into the Blessed Sleep with dreams of sunlit days and moonless nights."
—Tomb inscription of Saint Raban

name: Requiem Angel
text: When angels despair, what hope can remain for mortals?

name: Sanctuary Cat
text: Cats prowl the corridors of Avacyn's churches in search of devils or signs of their mischief.

name: Bar the Door
text:
"It may not look like much, but it's a good old door with strong wards. It'll hold."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Silverclaw Griffin
text: It patrols the grafs for miles around Thraben, ensuring that the unhallowed do not wake for long.

name: Skillful Lunge
text:
"Valor is a currency of the living that serves us well."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

name: Thraben Doomsayer
text: "Swarms of the unhallowed claw at Thraben's gates! Do you still deny the end approaches?"

name: Thraben Heretic
text: "Let them decry me for burning the dead. I'm not giving those ghoulcallers any more fuel for their madness."

name: Artful Dodge
text: Those who know the alleys and sewers of the Erdwal can disappear like smoke.

name: Beguiler of Wills
text: "Come, let me free you of the tyranny of thought."

name: Bone to Ash
text:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Chant of the Skifsang
text: The skifsang, seafarers of Nephalia, craft spells like other sailors craft nets—making them strong enough to snare even the deadliest catch.

name: Chill of Foreboding
text: "Wait . . . did you fellows hear something?"

name: Counterlash
text: "Pathetic. Let me show you how it's done."

name: Divination
text: Even the House of Galan, who takes the most scholarly approach to the mystic traditions, has resorted to exploring more primitive methods in Avacyn's absence.

name: Griptide
text:
"Beware the seagrafs just off the shore. These waters are filled with hungry geists looking for an easy meal."
—Captain Eberhart

name: Havengul Runebinder
text: "So many corpses, so little time."

name: Burden of Guilt
text:
"Grab an axe and defend the gate! Your despair is an extravagance we can ill afford."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Headless Skaab
text: A head is a needless encumbrance when muscle is all that's required.

name: Nephalia Seakite
text:
"Keep one eye on the cliff road or you may fall to your death. Keep one eye on the sky or your death may fall on you."
—Manfried Ulmach, Elgaud Master-at-Arms

name: Niblis of the Breath
text:
"Why do the dead remain among us? Where is Flight Alabaster to lead them home? Where is Avacyn?"
—Eruth of Lambholt

name: Saving Grasp
text: Nothing's more valuable than perfect timing.

name: Screeching Skaab
text: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

name: Secrets of the Dead
text:
"The veil between the living and the dead is so very thin that the whispers of the ancients can finally be heard."
—Amalric of Midvast Hall

name: Shriekgeist
text: Wounds of the flesh are easy to heal. Wounds of the mind may never be undone.

name: Curse of Exhaustion
text:
"I do believe your heresy will prove more difficult now that you have more pressing concerns."
—Bishop Argust

name: Thought Scour
text:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Tower Geist
text: Jenrik's tower is served by those who once sought to enter it uninvited.

name: Black Cat
text: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

name: Chosen of Markov
text: "I have been found worthy by this great house . . ."

name: Curse of Thirst
text:
"May you drink until you drown but never be sated."
—Odila, witch of Morkrut

name: Deadly Allure
text: What could be more irresistible than death?

name: Death's Caress
text: The faint smell of cloves, the rustling of the wind, and a paralyzing descent into an airless, fathomless tomb.

name: Elgaud Inquisitor
text: "It will take more than steel alone to purge this world of evil."

name: Falkenrath Torturer
text: "There was a time when our cages rang with wailing. Now only a handful of these whimpering fools remain."

name: Farbog Boneflinger
text:
"Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!"
—Gisa, to Geralf

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Gravepurge
text:
"The Blessed Sleep? Ha! Wake up my lovelies, there's work to be done!"
—Gisa, ghoulcaller of Gavony

name: Harrowing Journey
text:
"There are always fools who attempt to traverse Kruin Pass before sundown and every time they wind up in a race for their lives."
—Old Rutstein

name: Highborn Ghoul
text:
"All the dead sleep lightly here, no matter how refined their beds may be."
—Grafdigger Wulmer

name: Ravenous Demon
text: His twisted words entice the weak.

name: Reap the Seagraf
text: The wreck hung on the jagged reef, each night disgorging more of its gruesome cargo.

name: Sightless Ghoul
text: It blindly marches on Thraben's gates, guided by its master's direful will.

name: Skirsdag Flayer
text: Certain initiates into the Skirsdag cult take a vow of blindness, pledging obedience to none but demonkind.

name: Spiteful Shadows
text:
"Let us remind these human cattle why they fear the shadows of this world."
—Aldreg, Skirsdag cultist

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Undying Evil
text:
"Is it true the evil that people do follows them into death? Let's find out."
—Liliana Vess

name: Vengeful Vampire
text: He wields the full power of wrath unfettered by the sympathies of a soul.

name: Wakedancer
text: Hers is an ancient form of necromancy, steeped in shamanic trance and ritual that few skaberen or ghoulcallers comprehend.

name: Gather the Townsfolk
text: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

name: Zombie Apocalypse
text:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Afflicted Deserter
text: The rising of the first full moon eliminated any doubt as to the horrible truth lurking within.

name: Alpha Brawl
text: Being an alpha means proving it every full moon.

name: Blood Feud
text: Succession is a matter of blood, and by blood it is often decided.

name: Burning Oil
text: Every now and then, a devil's prank can give you a good idea.

name: Curse of Bloodletting
text: It is the demon's mark, an infernal claim on the flesh of the guilty.

name: Erdwal Ripper
text: Savage vampires lurk in the Erdwal's network of passageways where prey is plentiful and easy to catch.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fires of Undeath
text: "I drink of those who are worthy of my palate. The rest I burn."

name: Gavony Ironwright
text: "I wish my work could shelter everyone, yet I pray we are never so few that it does."

name: Fling
text: Masters of the sword know the blade is not the only weapon at their disposal.

name: Forge Devil
text: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

name: Heckling Fiends
text: Their language may be a cacophonous agglomeration of chittering snorts and mad barking, but the message they send is all too clear.

name: Hellrider
text:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Hinterland Hermit
text: He tried to live far from those he could hurt . . .

name: Markov Blademaster
text: "Mortals practice swordplay for a few decades at best. How can they ever attain the exquisite mastery that eternity has to offer?"

name: Markov Warlord
text: "What use is a stake or holy symbol in the hands of a coward?"

name: Mondronen Shaman
text: "Tovolar, my master. Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak."

name: Moonveil Dragon
text:
"Their hearts beat, their lungs draw breath, and they have one true form. I count them as allies of the living."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Abyssal Specter
text:
"Open the gates, and bid them enter."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Balduvian Horde
text:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Goblin Mutant
text: If only it had three brains, too.

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Jokulhaups
text:
"I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster. The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Lava Burst
text:
"Overkill? This isn't a game of kick-the-ouphe!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Orcish Cannoneers
text:
"It's a thankless job, and you'll probably die in an explosion. But the pay is pretty good."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Pillage
text:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Leaves more room for the big ones to fight in, you know."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Shatter
text:
"Let the past be the past. Do not call up that which you cannot put down. Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Storm Shaman
text:
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!"
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Storm Shaman
text:
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!"
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Balduvian Bears
text:
"They're a hardy bunch, but I'd still bet that they just slept through the worst of the cold times."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Folk of the Pines
text:
"Our friends of the forest take many forms, yet all serve the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text:
"Living side by side with the Elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Hurricane
text:
"This was quite possibly the least pleasant occurrence on the entire expedition."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Woolly Spider
text:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a Spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Yavimaya Ancients
text:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Yavimaya Ancients
text:
"The Ancients teach us that if we can but last, we shall prevail."
—Kaysa,
elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Giant Trap Door Spider
text:
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Icy Manipulator
text:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Icy Manipulator
text:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Phyrexian War Beast
text:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Phyrexian War Beast
text:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Walking Wall
text:
"The fortress is not what it seems."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Foul Familiar
text:
"Serve me, and live forever."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
text:
"The Guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending."
—Chaeska, keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
text:
"Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Hero of Precinct One
text: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
text: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
text: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
text: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Iridian Maelstrom
text: A thousand years ago, Phyrexia poisoned Serra's Realm and engineered its collapse. On shimmering waves generations in the making, the angels finally took their revenge.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
text: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

name: Radiant Flames
text: The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Two-Headed Hellkite
text: Eons ago, the ur-dragon roared. Its descendants still carry the echo across the Multiverse.

name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
text: "Life ... is not ... a race."

name: Arvad the Cursed
text: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Bedevil
text:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Duneblast
text: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Kaya's Wrath
text: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

name: Knight of New Alara
text: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

name: Lavalanche
text: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

name: Maelstrom Archangel
text: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

name: Mortify
text:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

name: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami
text: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

name: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth
text: Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Surrak Dragonclaw
text: Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.

name: Tajic, Blade of the Legion
text: "I run the maze alone, but I fight with the full might of the Legion."

name: Terminate
text: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Bontu's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Hazoret's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Honor-Worn Shaku
text: Before being presented to its lord, each shaku is blessed by every hero of every region within that lord's domain.

name: Oketra's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: The Peregrine Dynamo
text: Jhoira stumbled upon an ally, not just a good source of spare parts.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Sword of the Chosen
text: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

name: Transguild Courier
text: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cascading Cataracts
text:
"The rushing water is as the God-Pharaoh. It encompasses all. It nurtures all."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text: It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.

name: Crystal Quarry
text:
"How tragic that greed eclipses beauty."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
text:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

name: Mobilized District
text: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

name: Robaran Mercenaries
text: "We learned from the best. And the worst. Pretty much whoever was available."

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Shivan Gorge
text: Both forge and pyre.

name: Shizo, Death's Storehouse
text: Centuries ago, Shizo was a verdant field of wildflowers. After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Jenson Carthalion, Druid Exile
text: He was born with the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid, tying his fate to the druids of the Juniper Order.

name: The Ever-Changing 'Dane
text: He could be anyone, anywhere, but he'll never again be "half" of anything.

name: General Marhault Elsdragon
text: Driven by rage, directed by his emperor's claw.

name: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven
text: "I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."

name: Ramses, Assassin Lord
text: "Why butcher an army when you can slash a single throat for the same result?"

name: Tobias, Doomed Conqueror
text: Tobias spent decades tormenting pirates on the open sea and decades more dancing lifelessly beneath it.

name: Zeriam, Golden Wind
text:
"For their courage, the griffins were granted domain over all the desert skies."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: The Ever-Changing 'Dane
text: He could be anyone, anywhere, but he'll never again be "half" of anything.

name: General Marhault Elsdragon
text: Driven by rage, directed by his emperor's claw.

name: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven
text: "I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."

name: Ramses, Assassin Lord
text: "Why butcher an army when you can slash a single throat for the same result?"

name: Tobias, Doomed Conqueror
text: Tobias spent decades tormenting pirates on the open sea and decades more dancing lifelessly beneath it.

name: Mana Cannons
text:
"I hate the smell of charred Phyrexian, but it sure beats the alternative!"
—Jaya

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

name: Day of Destiny
text:
"If you wish to die as a hero, you must first live as one."
—General Takeno

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Improvised Armor
text: "I don't care if it's covered in rust, blood, or enemy insignias. If it'll stop an arrow, I'll take it."

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Twisted Experiment
text: After six days in the hands of the Gixians, what remained was utterly unrecognizable as the person it once was.

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Urborg Uprising
text: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

name: Wretched Anurid
text: The only prince inside this frog is the one it ate.

name: Kjeldoran Gargoyle
text: The gargoyles were taken from the walls of flooded Kjeldoran cities and brought upland to guard the outposts of New Argive.

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Coal Stoker
text:
"The day is mine! I sent three such creatures against my foe, then watched as my magefire popped her soldiers like overripe spleenfruits."
—Dobruk the Unstable, pyromancer

name: Deadapult
text:
"Nothing ruins your day like a blazing zombie."
—Tahngarth

name: Ember Beast
text:
Spot one ember beast, attack.
Spot a second, best fall back.
—Dwarven saying

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Lieutenant Kirtar
text:
"His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same."
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gamble
text: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

name: Gempalm Incinerator
text: "I've got this under control! Probably!"

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Goblin Medics
text: Dorik was unshakably confident, having learned medicine from the finest butcher shops in Yotia.

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Last Chance
text: "I only had time to read half the spell, but I'm pretty sure this will work!"

name: Lightning Rift
text: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: "You are not alone. You never were."

name: Macetail Hystrodon
text: The goblins tracked the hystrodon with much stealth and cunning. Then they were eaten with much pain and yelling.

name: Overmaster
text: "My, what a pretty little trick. At least you'll die with style."

name: Pashalik Mons
text: The thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Ridgetop Raptor
text:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Skirk Prospector
text: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

name: Slice and Dice
text: Tahngarth relished the chance to bloody his blades on those who had ravaged his home.

name: Sneak Attack
text: "Nothin' beat surprise—'cept rock."

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

name: Spark Spray
text: "You see this rock-grinder? One step closer and it'll be a face-grinder!"

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Subterranean Scout
text: When things get ugly above ground, goblins resort to alternate routes of passage.

name: Suq'Ata Lancer
text:
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor

name: Undying Rage
text: Radha was born in Skyshroud, but her temper is undeniably Keldon.

name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
text: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

name: Arboria
text: As the world steeled itself for the New Phyrexian invasion, the heart of the Pinelands awoke, and a new maro-sorcerer strode forth to join the fight.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Sages whisper of an undiscovered natural paradise, a tropical island unspoiled by war.

name: Break Asunder
text: "No good will come of this."

name: Crop Rotation
text: "Hmm ... maybe lotuses this year."

name: Elvish Spirit Guide
text:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Exploration
text: The first explorers found Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth—towering forests grown over rich veins of ore.

name: Mystic Zealot
text: Nomad youths aspire to one of two roles in the tribe: priest or warrior. Their secret dream is to become both.

name: Fa'adiyah Seer
text: She nurtures each flower from seed to blossom, and in return, they whisper secrets only she can hear.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: The giant spider's silk naturally resists gravity, almost weaving itself as it blankets the forest canopy.

name: Invigorating Boon
text:
"Bright spores coalesced in empty air. Seedlings burst through barren soil. Genesis had arrived."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
text: "My mind has changed. My strength has not."

name: Lull
text: Tayil stood and breathed in the scent of wet earth. For a moment, he was home in his father's village, the battle but a distant dream.

name: Nomad Decoy
text: If you can take something from a nomad, it's probably bait.

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Nut Collector
text: "I'll call you Reginald, and you're Mimi, and you're Tank, and you're Bobo..."

name: Penumbra Bobcat
text: "It was just a trick of the light," Dalis muttered to himself. "I've been patrolling alone too long. Got to stop jumping at shadows."

name: Sandstorm
text: Ravaged by decades of war, the land struck back with primal, blinding fury.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

name: Stonewood Invoker
text: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

name: Symbiotic Beast
text:
"I'll take the patrol through the hunting grounds. You take the caves. Give me an angry apex predator over those little creepy-crawlies any day."
—Oranes, Yavimaya hunter

name: Werebear
text: He exercises his right to bear arms.

name: Wild Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Worldly Tutor
text: "All of us, from the tiny leaf-mite to the towering baloth, are vital threads in the weave of life."

name: Absorb
text: "Your presumption is your downfall."

name: Decimate
text: Tormented by her own existence, Karona turned her wrath on the world that had birthed her.

name: Dralnu's Crusade
text:
"Don't you agree that mogg intellects are improved by zombification?"
—Lord Dralnu

name: Pacifism
text: Without warriors there can be no war.

name: Gerrard's Verdict
text: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

name: Hunting Grounds
text:
"Don't be silly. Panthers don't hunt in packs!"
—Jego, disgraced archdruid

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Step aside, weakling, or I'll swat you like the bug you are."

name: Recoil
text: Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.

name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
text:
"All the power of a maro-sorcerer, all the mindless fury of a pitlord. He is a perfect servant."
—Geyadrone Dihada

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
text: "Nothing is too broken to mend."

name: Xira Arien
text: Her wits are sharp, but her blades are sharper.

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Crawlspace
text: "Not so scary when you can't squeeze through the air ducts, are you?"

name: Cryptic Gateway
text: Its lock changes to fit each key.

name: Damping Sphere
text: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

name: Remedy
text: "Take this. I know it's bitter, but it will ease the fever and get you back on your feet."

name: Dragon Blood
text: Fire in the blood, fire in the belly.

name: Dragon Engine
text: From a distance, dormant dragon engines can be mistaken for harmless statues. By the time you get close enough to spot the scorch marks, it's too late.

name: Helm of Awakening
text:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Jalum Tome
text: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

name: Jester's Cap
text: The crowd laughed heartily at the fool's performance, until his hat laughed back.

name: Juggernaut
text:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

name: Legacy Weapon
text: In a single blinding flash, Yawgmoth was obliterated, and Urza could finally rest.

name: Renewed Faith
text: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

name: Millikin
text: "Another failure," grumbled the toymaker. She slammed the door with such gusto that she failed to notice the eyes watching her.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Ornithopter
text:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

name: Thran Golem
text: Even after thousands of years, the wondrous creations of the Thran guarded the lost empire's secrets with single-minded devotion.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Triskelion
text:
"What's got three legs and three heads and wants to kill us? That's not a riddle!"
—Jayeen, Fallaji scout

name: Umbilicus
text: It was the explorers' only tether to reality.

name: Urza's Blueprints
text: From concept to paper to reality.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."
—Urza, to Tawnos

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Wall of Junk
text: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Serra Avatar
text: Though Serra is long dead, her legacy of grace and kindness will live on forever.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Divine Sacrament
text: "My wings shall be your shield. My sword shall be your vengeance."

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"Organization is often undervalued but rarely unjustified."
—Frasio, royal archivist

name: Glory
text:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Lieutenant Kirtar
text:
"His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same."
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: "You are not alone. You never were."

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

name: Renewed Faith
text: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Serra Avatar
text: Though Serra is long dead, her legacy of grace and kindness will live on forever.

name: Spirit Link
text: "We are all inextricably linked, souls woven in tapestry."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Test of Endurance
text: Most wars are won not by those with the best tactics or truest cause but simply by the ones left standing.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Spectral Lynx
text: A shadowy version of its corporeal cousin, this lynx hunts souls, not meals.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Denizen of the Deep
text: According to merfolk legend, a denizen of the deep swallows the horizon at the end of each day, bringing on the cold blanket of night.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Slimefoot, I know I said I wanted to grow our repository of knowledge, but this isn't what I had in mind."

name: Force of Will
text: "Your artillery will burn itself out before I allow my focus to waver."

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: High Tide
text:
"Close the walls! Retract the docks! The homarids are coming!"
—Benson, Argivian sentry

name: Impulse
text:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

name: Mystical Tutor
text: The student searches the world for meaning. The master finds worlds of meaning in the search.

name: Spirit Link
text: "We are all inextricably linked, souls woven in tapestry."

name: Opposition
text: Exhausting a wizard can be exhausting work.

name: Ovinize
text: The crocodile's failed attack left it feeling both hungry and sheepish.

name: Peregrine Drake
text:
"Always a welcome sight breaking through the clouds."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Stroke of Genius
text: "Every thought is a star illuminating the darkness. Inspiration comes from finding the constellations that link them."

name: Time Stretch
text:
"I swear, I just wanted a few extra hours to do my homework!"
—Petra, novice chronomancer

name: Turnabout
text: The best cure for a big ego is a little failure.

name: Cleric of the Forward Order
text: War after war, a healer's enemy is always the same—death itself.

name: Sun Clasp
text:
"Open when darkness threatens."
—Amulet inscription

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Mindslicer
text: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

name: Nantuko Shade
text: In life, the nantuko study nature by revering it. In death, they study nature by disemboweling it.

name: Necrosavant
text: To the novice necromancers, it looked exactly like a regular human grave.

name: No Mercy
text:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

name: Oversold Cemetery
text: It was a profitable scheme, at least until the dead began to object.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Test of Endurance
text: Most wars are won not by those with the best tactics or truest cause but simply by the ones left standing.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gamble
text: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

name: Gempalm Incinerator
text: "I've got this under control! Probably!"

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Last Chance
text: "I only had time to read half the spell, but I'm pretty sure this will work!"

name: Overmaster
text: "My, what a pretty little trick. At least you'll die with style."

name: Pashalik Mons
text: The thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Sneak Attack
text: "Nothin' beat surprise—'cept rock."

name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
text: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

name: Arboria
text: As the world steeled itself for the New Phyrexian invasion, the heart of the Pinelands awoke, and a new maro-sorcerer strode forth to join the fight.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Sages whisper of an undiscovered natural paradise, a tropical island unspoiled by war.

name: Elvish Spirit Guide
text:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Exploration
text: The first explorers found Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth—towering forests grown over rich veins of ore.

name: Fa'adiyah Seer
text: She nurtures each flower from seed to blossom, and in return, they whisper secrets only she can hear.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Invigorating Boon
text:
"Bright spores coalesced in empty air. Seedlings burst through barren soil. Genesis had arrived."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
text: "My mind has changed. My strength has not."

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Nut Collector
text: "I'll call you Reginald, and you're Mimi, and you're Tank, and you're Bobo..."

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Wild Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Worldly Tutor
text: "All of us, from the tiny leaf-mite to the towering baloth, are vital threads in the weave of life."

name: Absorb
text: "Your presumption is your downfall."

name: Decimate
text: Tormented by her own existence, Karona turned her wrath on the world that had birthed her.

name: Dralnu's Crusade
text:
"Don't you agree that mogg intellects are improved by zombification?"
—Lord Dralnu

name: Gerrard's Verdict
text: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.
