name: Hunting Grounds
text:
"Don't be silly. Panthers don't hunt in packs!"
—Jego, disgraced archdruid

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Step aside, weakling, or I'll swat you like the bug you are."

name: Recoil
text: Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.

name: Sol'kanar the Swamp King
text:
"All the power of a maro-sorcerer, all the mindless fury of a pitlord. He is a perfect servant."
—Geyadrone Dihada

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
text: "Nothing is too broken to mend."

name: Xira Arien
text: Her wits are sharp, but her blades are sharper.

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Crawlspace
text: "Not so scary when you can't squeeze through the air ducts, are you?"

name: Cryptic Gateway
text: Its lock changes to fit each key.

name: Damping Sphere
text: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

name: Helm of Awakening
text:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Aquamoeba
text: Some tides need no moon.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Jester's Cap
text: The crowd laughed heartily at the fool's performance, until his hat laughed back.

name: Juggernaut
text:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

name: Legacy Weapon
text: In a single blinding flash, Yawgmoth was obliterated, and Urza could finally rest.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Ornithopter
text:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

name: Thran Golem
text: Even after thousands of years, the wondrous creations of the Thran guarded the lost empire's secrets with single-minded devotion.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Triskelion
text:
"What's got three legs and three heads and wants to kill us? That's not a riddle!"
—Jayeen, Fallaji scout

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Umbilicus
text: It was the explorers' only tether to reality.

name: Urza's Blueprints
text: From concept to paper to reality.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."
—Urza, to Tawnos

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text: Wisdom is a precious heirloom to be passed down faithfully from each generation to the next.

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: An angel among angels, she carries the hopes of the world skyward.

name: Test of Endurance
text: "I could do this all day."

name: Windborn Muse
text: A single glimpse was enough to compel Captain Velkarne to lay down his sword and take up the poet's quill.

name: Wrath of God
text: Each side prayed for the gods to smite the other. In the end, all their prayers were answered.

name: Denizen of the Deep
text:
"Don't be silly, Grandfather. If the tides were caused by some monster drinking the ocean, wouldn't more ships go missing?"
—Leda, Vodalian youth

name: Force of Will
text: "Weren't you ever taught that it's rude to interrupt?"

name: High Tide
text:
"May Svyelun's waves drown your memory."
—Traditional merfolk curse

name: Mystical Tutor
text: Wisdom is a well that never runs dry. It offers the most to those with the deepest thirst for knowledge.

name: Time Stretch
text: There's lots of time like the present.

name: Chainer's Edict
text: "You forfeited any right to mercy the moment you challenged me."

name: Entomb
text:
"Oh, don't worry about that one. I'm saving him for later."
—Liliana Vess

name: No Mercy
text:
"Leave no survivors. Let the other worlds see what befalls those who attempt to resist the might of Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

name: Oversold Cemetery
text:
"Of course we can squeeze in a few more! It's not like corpses need personal space."
—Orson, cemetery baron

name: Street Wraith
text: Most of the spirits that haunt Urborg were once ordinary people, even children, twisted beyond recognition by the swamp's corrupted mana.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: Wisdom is a throne, a seat of power that only the strong are worthy to occupy.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"If you look past the giant claws, nasty teeth, and horrible breath, they're actually kind of cute."
—Shanna Sisay

name: Gamble
text: "What's the worst that could happen?"

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Pyromancers are cowards who look no further than the flickering flame on the surface. I alone have the courage to dig to the true power that roils beneath."

name: Last Chance
text: No reinforcements. Nowhere to retreat. Nothing to lose.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "You with the red shirt! You're up next."

name: Arboria
text:
"I have never before felt so unwelcome in a forest."
—Jolrael

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Its brilliant plumage painted streaks of color across a sky long darkened by war.

name: Confiscate
text:
"The surface world contains nothing I cannot take."
—The Lord of Atlantis

name: Nut Collector
text: "Come, come, my hungry little friends! There's plenty for everyone."

name: Worldly Tutor
text: Wisdom is a seed. Nurtured with patience and care, it will bear new fruit each season.

name: Absorb
text: "It's a shame to see such potential wasted on petty evil. Let's correct that, shall we?"

name: Decimate
text:
"There is no sweeter sound than the deafening thunder of utter destruction."
—Kamahl, Pit Fighter

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Keep coming, weaklings! I'm just getting warmed up."

name: Helm of Awakening
text: Perhaps things would have ended differently had its first gasping breath not been lost in the susurrus of shifting sands.

name: Jester's Cap
text:
"They say the last owner cut out his own tongue, laughing the whole time. Superstitious drivel, but amusing, isn't it?"
—Hilde the Collector, last known words

name: Legacy Weapon
text: Whether lives or precious artifacts, no price was too high to stop the Phyrexian invasion.

name: Triskelion
text: Optimally designed for agility, mobility, and lethality.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"In my dark moments, I think Urza may have been more of a father to his creations than he ever was to his own son."
—Tawnos

name: Maze of Ith
text:
"Let the interlopers scurry like trapped rats until they exhaust themselves. They are no threat to us."
—Ith, High Arcanist

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Denizen of the Deep
text: According to merfolk legend, a denizen of the deep swallows the horizon at the end of each day, bringing on the cold blanket of night.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Slimefoot, I know I said I wanted to grow our repository of knowledge, but this isn't what I had in mind."

name: Floodgate
text:
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"
—Makht, goblin casualty

name: Divine Sacrament
text: "My wings shall be your shield. My sword shall be your vengeance."

name: Force of Will
text: "Your artillery will burn itself out before I allow my focus to waver."

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Glintwing Invoker
text: The Mirari flares in his mind.

name: Hermetic Study
text: "At last! I have discovered a way to weaponize one of Tolaria's most abundant resources: horseshoe crabs."

name: High Tide
text:
"Close the walls! Retract the docks! The homarids are coming!"
—Benson, Argivian sentry

name: Horseshoe Crab
text: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

name: Impulse
text:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"Organization is often undervalued but rarely unjustified."
—Frasio, royal archivist

name: Mystical Tutor
text: The student searches the world for meaning. The master finds worlds of meaning in the search.

name: Opposition
text: Exhausting a wizard can be exhausting work.

name: Ovinize
text: The crocodile's failed attack left it feeling both hungry and sheepish.

name: Peregrine Drake
text:
"Always a welcome sight breaking through the clouds."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Snap
text: Good riddance.

name: Stroke of Genius
text: "Every thought is a star illuminating the darkness. Inspiration comes from finding the constellations that link them."

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Rayne once made several unkind comparisons between the bird's naked opportunism and Urza's.

name: Time Stretch
text:
"I swear, I just wanted a few extra hours to do my homework!"
—Petra, novice chronomancer

name: Glory
text:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Turnabout
text: The best cure for a big ego is a little failure.

name: Cackling Fiend
text: Its windpipe is only the first to amplify its maddening laughter.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
text: The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat.

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Flesh Reaver
text: Though the reaver is horrifyingly effective, its dorsal vents spit a highly corrosive cloud of filth.

name: Goblin Turncoat
text: Modo was great at making friends . . . into shields.

name: Howl from Beyond
text: Whether it howls for hunger or for joy, you're in trouble just the same.

name: Hyalopterous Lemure
text:
"I was wrong! Not harmless at all!"
—Norin the Wary

name: Mindslicer
text: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

name: Nantuko Shade
text: In life, the nantuko study nature by revering it. In death, they study nature by disemboweling it.

name: Necrosavant
text: To the novice necromancers, it looked exactly like a regular human grave.

name: No Mercy
text:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

name: Oversold Cemetery
text: It was a profitable scheme, at least until the dead began to object.

name: Phyrexian Debaser
text:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Charismatic Vanguard
text: "This battlefield is an anvil, my mace a forging hammer . . . and you, Phyrexian scum, are the scrap metal that's about to be reshaped as I see fit."

name: Phyrexian Vivisector
text: Before he was the Father of Machines, Yawgmoth was a twisted Thran physician, and his legacy of medical atrocities lives on in New Phyrexia.

name: Pilfer
text: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

name: Sengir Connoisseur
text: "We cannot afford to let the Phyrexians win. They taste terrible."

name: Shadow Prophecy
text: "Lord Windgrace, grant me wisdom."

name: Shadow-Rite Priest
text: Backstabbing is common within demonic cults. So are front- and side-stabbing.

name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
text: "Gix failed. I shall not."

name: Splatter Goblin
text:
"For some, perfection is but a single moment when form and purpose converge."
—Rona

name: Citizen's Arrest
text: "What lurks behind the faces of those you think you can trust?"

name: Tattered Apparition
text:
"Ah yes, I remember that one. I turned him inside out and cast his soul into an endless nightmare a few centuries ago."
—Braids

name: Toxic Abomination
text: Deep in the forgotten reaches of Urborg, ancient Phyrexian monstrosities shamble endlessly, putrid ichor leaking from their rusted forms.

name: Writhing Necromass
text:
"We sent three of our best legions! You're telling me no one came back?"
—Tori D'Avenant

name: Coalition Warbrute
text: Anger is his greatest weapon, and he sharpens it daily.

name: Electrostatic Infantry
text:
"That's not exactly what I had in mind when I said 'charge,' but I like your enthusiasm!"
—Balmor, battlemage captain

name: Fires of Victory
text: The drums and horns were expected, but the goblin dance was a pleasant surprise.

name: Flowstone Infusion
text: The rumor that contact with flowstone would reveal Phyrexian sleeper agents was spread mostly by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

name: Flowstone Kavu
text: The kavu adjusted easily to the Rathi overlay, incorporating the invasive flowstone into their own adaptable forms.

name: Furious Bellow
text: Minotaurs sometimes pretend to be lost in a battle rage, leading their opponents to underestimate their cleverness.

name: Goblin Picker
text: Countless generations of Shivan goblins have worked on the Mana Rig, giving them an unparalleled eye for useful relics.

name: Clockwork Drawbridge
text: Argivia's clockwork fortifications are the stuff of legend, reminding all on Dominaria that ingenuity has saved them before and can do so again.

name: Hurler Cyclops
text:
"It's my fault, really. I told him to throw anything he could find at the enemy."
—Throppel, auxiliary commander

name: Hurloon Battle Hymn
text: The magical echoes of the Hurloon mountain range greatly increase the potency of spells based on song or speech.

name: Jaya's Firenado
text:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Lightning Strike
text: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians. "What?" said the pyromancer serenely. "I told you I'd learned some new tricks."

name: Meria's Outrider
text: Arrows fashioned from the living wood of Yavimaya carry all of the forest's rage in their fire-hardened points.

name: Molten Monstrosity
text: The cold snap killed off most of the heat-loving hellions . . . leaving only the strongest alive to breed.

name: Shivan Devastator
text: There were many reasons why Shiv was not high on Sheoldred's list of places to conquer: big, fiery reasons.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"The most delicious ingredients are often the most dangerous to obtain."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Twinferno
text:
"More fire?" Jaya asked.
"More fire," Jodah agreed.

name: Warhost's Frenzy
text: Keldons may be outnumbered, but they are never outmatched.

name: Barkweave Crusher
text:
"Phyrexia may be ancient, but Gaea is eternal."
—Queen Allenal of Ruadach

name: Bite Down
text:
"Yavimaya takes care of herself; the kavu are evidence of this. What does your Coalition offer that the forest cannot provide?"
—Jenson Carthalion

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Serra guides our shots true. Also, I just tuned the cannons."
—Tiana

name: Deathbloom Gardener
text: "I can provide the Coalition with poisons that will break down Phyrexian machinery as easily as they stop the heart."

name: Elfhame Wurm
text: The wurms consume everything in their path, so the elves make sure that their path goes through as many Phyrexians as possible.

name: Elvish Hydromancer
text: "Water remembers every living thing that it has ever been a part of. We need only bring that recollection to the surface."

name: Gaea's Might
text:
"Why fight over the lumber in a tree's trunk when its branches have room for all?"
—Multani

name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
text: "The seedling you save today may be the sheltering boughs of generations to come."

name: Destroy Evil
text: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

name: Llanowar Loamspeaker
text: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.

name: Llanowar Stalker
text: If you spot one elf in Llanowar, it's likely there's another with a knife at your back.

name: Magnigoth Sentry
text: When one of Yavimaya's enormous magnigoth trees awakens into a treefolk, it is a towering presence of physical strength and ancient wisdom.

name: Mossbeard Ancient
text: Older than the mountains, the dragons, and the wars of humans and machines.

name: Nishoba Brawler
text: Though native to cold climates, the nishoba have adapted to more temperate environments since the Ice Age ended.

name: Snarespinner
text: In the rich jungles of Yavimaya, bright colors are the perfect camouflage.

name: Griffin Protector
text: Griffin flocks still patrol the skies above the Zhalfirin void, as though they are waiting for their old home to reappear.

name: Strength of the Coalition
text:
"Root and wing, claw and sword; this will be a memorable stand, indeed."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

name: Sunbathing Rootwalla
text: A rootwalla's prey includes anything or anyone that wanders into view.

name: Tear Asunder
text: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

name: Territorial Maro
text: The Coalition was more than just treaties and alliances: it was the soul of a world rising up against the invading tide.

name: Yavimaya Iconoclast
text: Steel weapons hold a forbidden allure to some of the younger Yavimayans.

name: Yavimaya Sojourner
text: To the long-lived treefolk, the Phyrexians invading again after only three centuries was as though they never left.

name: Aron, Benalia's Ruin
text:
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone."
—Danitha

name: Baird, Argivian Recruiter
text: "Fear doesn't make you a coward; giving in to it does. Now take up your sword and fight!"

name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
text: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
text: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

name: Heroic Charge
text: "For Keld! For Benalia! For Dominaria!"

name: Garna, Bloodfist of Keld
text: "Let's see who gets more kills, Radha."

name: Meria, Scholar of Antiquity
text: "Why fear artifice? Is it not also of this world?"

name: Join Forces
text:
"Okay—you take the sixteen ragers and the hulk on the right. I'll take the ten defilers and the plaguelord on the left. Ready?"
—Danitha, to Radha

name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
text: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
text: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."

name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
text: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."

name: Shanna, Purifying Blade
text: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life. Now it was time to forge her own.

name: Juniper Order Rootweaver
text: "What Phyrexia takes, the grace of Freyalise shall replenish."

name: Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight
text: "The sky is my birthright. I dare you to try and take it from me."

name: Zar Ojanen, Scion of Efrava
text: "I carry my home in my heart."

name: Automatic Librarian
text: Enforcing absolute quiet with extreme prejudice since 3285 AR.

name: Knight of Dawn's Light
text: "Phyrexians destroyed my village, but they cannot break my hope."

name: Hero's Heirloom
text:
"A blade is just a tool. Its power comes from the hand that wields it."
—Danitha

name: Jodah's Codex
text:
"If you remember nothing else of our world's history, remember this: Phyrexians can be defeated."
—Jodah

name: Meteorite
text:
"Material at dig site 165-beta confirmed to be of Null Moon origin. Immediate excavation assistance requested."
—Tolarian field dispatch

name: Relic of Legends
text:
"If the worst parts of history can repeat themselves, it stands to reason that the best parts can as well."
—Teferi

name: Salvaged Manaworker
text:
"When weapons of war are repurposed for peaceful ends, you know society has advanced."
—Jodah

name: Shield-Wall Sentinel
text: "Unit alpha-6 locking into position!"

name: Timeless Lotus
text: Urza exploited nature to power his war machines; in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.

name: Vanquisher's Axe
text: When a Keldon takes a trophy from an enemy, it's usually something they can use to kill more enemies.

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Contaminated Aquifer
text: The caves stretch farther than anyone knows, and the terrible legacy of Yawgmoth lurks in every shadow.

name: Geothermal Bog
text: There are still a few places where the natural dangers outweigh even those posed by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

name: Haunted Mire
text: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

name: Idyllic Beachfront
text: In the tradition of the original Tolarian Academy, every Tolarian campus is built near a body of water.

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Molten Tributary
text: Though dangerous, Shiv teems with both life and mana, making it a tempting destination for ambitious mages.

name: Radiant Grove
text: Yavimaya's inhabitants are dedicated to protecting its unspoiled jungle from the scourge of artifice.

name: Sacred Peaks
text: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

name: Sunlit Marsh
text: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

name: Tangled Islet
text: Many of Terisiare's islands are merely extensions of the root system of the Yavimaya magnigoth forests.

name: Mesa Cavalier
text: In the fight to defeat Phyrexia, the courage of Benalish knights is matched only by that of their pegasus steeds.

name: Wooded Ridgeline
text: The power of long-forgotten empires still pulses in the earth of Dominaria, giving rise to strange, mana-rich pockets of growth.

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Prayer of Binding
text: When a Phyrexian agent cannot be killed, they must be contained.

name: Serra Redeemer
text: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

name: Cosmic Epiphany
text:
"All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality. Every answer we seek is out there, hidden only by the limits of our minds."
—Jodah

name: Ragefire Hellkite
text:
"Well, the good news is that sound wasn't the volcano erupting . . ."
—George, Coalition scout

name: Briar Hydra
text: Flora and fauna alike rose to Yavimaya's defense.

name: Resolute Reinforcements
text: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

name: Runic Shot
text: "Target acquired."

name: Samite Herbalist
text: "Spiritual wholeness is not something you can give to yourself: it is attained only through the divine blessing of healing another."

name: Shalai's Acolyte
text: Armed by Multani, she protected the forest from above.

name: Take Up the Shield
text: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

name: Temporary Lockdown
text: "Any one of us could be compromised," said Karn. "No one leaves until we know who can be trusted."

name: Valiant Veteran
text: "Let them come. We will show them that Argivian steel is stronger than any Phyrexian metal."

name: Academy Loremaster
text: As a young student, she dusted the shelves of Tolaria's great library. Now, she writes the books that line them.

name: Academy Wall
text: Once the Society of Mishra took control, the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam became a haven for dark research.

name: Resolute Reinforcements
text: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

name: Micromancer
text: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

name: Cut Down
text:
"There can be no mercy, no half measures. When facing Phyrexians, it's kill swiftly or die."
—Jodah

name: Lightning Strike
text: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians. "What?" said the pyromancer serenely. "I told you I'd learned some new tricks."

name: Nishoba Brawler
text: Though native to cold climates, the nishoba have adapted to more temperate environments since the Ice Age ended.

name: Coral Colony
text: The seafloor is strewn with the wreckage of Vodalia's would-be conquerors.

name: Ertai's Scorn
text: "You're not so special, Karn. Anything that has been assembled can be disassembled."

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"Phyrexians pollute everything they touch, so the solution is simple: don't let them touch anything."
—Teferi

name: Argivian Phalanx
text: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

name: Haughty Djinn
text: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

name: Haunting Figment
text: Some bad dreams stay with you forever.

name: Impulse
text:
"I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser."
—Teferi

name: Joint Exploration
text: The Tolarians had the maps, but only the Yavimayans knew how to read them.

name: Micromancer
text: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

name: Negate
text:
"It's frustrating, isn't it, to be so weak and ineffectual? Don't worry, you'll be *compleat* soon enough."
—Rona

name: Artillery Blast
text: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.

name: Phyrexian Espionage
text:
"Even if they're hunting for sleeper agents, who looks twice at a bird?"
—Rona

name: Shore Up
text: Homarid shells are adapted to the crushing pressure of the deepest depths; on land, their sturdiness seems supernatural.

name: Silver Scrutiny
text: Karn's creation allowed him to monitor events across Dominaria—and everything he saw worried him.

name: Soaring Drake
text: The already spectacular views from the towers of the College at Lat-Nam are sometimes enhanced by glimpses of drakes diving into the ocean to devour small sharks.

name: Talas Lookout
text:
"The Talas pirates are motivated by money, so we paid them twice what they could steal from us to spy for us instead."
—Jhoira

name: Tidepool Turtle
text: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.

name: Benalish Faithbonder
text: "A single light can hold back endless darkness."

name: Timely Interference
text: Students fled with their research as Tolaria fell to the Phyrexians.

name: Tolarian Geyser
text: "If they don't drown, perhaps they'll rust."

name: Tolarian Terror
text: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
text:
"There hasn't been an original thought on Vesuva in centuries."
—Emmest, Tolarian chronicler

name: Vodalian Hexcatcher
text: "You're just one more pollutant to be removed from the sea."

name: Volshe Tideturner
text: Ships suspected of carrying Sheoldred's agents have a tendency to drift far off course as they sail through the Voda Sea.

name: Aggressive Sabotage
text: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."

name: Benalish Sleeper
text: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.

name: Battle-Rage Blessing
text:
"Since when is it cheating to give one side an unfair advantage?"
—Braids

name: Battlefly Swarm
text: Having encountered the bitter Phyrexian battleflies before, Squee knew not to bother eating them—or at least to stop after the fifth.

name: Blight Pile
text:
"Keep your distance. It may be broken, but it's far from benign."
—Stenn

name: Bone Splinters
text:
"Steel may be more durable, but nothing channels the spite of the unjustly dead like bone."
—Braids

name: Choking Miasma
text: The Phyrexians were as surprised as anyone to discover they still needed to breathe.

name: Cult Conscript
text: His eternal rest turned out to be more of a quick nap.

name: Cut Down
text:
"There can be no mercy, no half measures. When facing Phyrexians, it's kill swiftly or die."
—Jodah

name: Captain's Call
text:
"Argivia's walls may run on powerstones, but its real power comes from its people."
—King Darien XLVIII

name: Drag to the Bottom
text: Windgrace's gladehunters hibernate in the quagmires of Urborg until the scent of Phyrexian technology awakens their hunger.

name: Extinguish the Light
text: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

name: Gibbering Barricade
text:
"Who needs stone walls when you can hide behind an impenetrable barrier of screaming nightmares?"
—Braids

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

name: Charge
text:
"Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."
—Danitha Capashen

name: Rat Colony
text: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

name: Settle the Score
text:
"You bound me with a contract only your death could end—and you thought me the fool?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Soul Salvage
text: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

name: Thallid Omnivore
text: Thelon of Havenwood created thallids as a food source in times of darkness. Thallids did the same with saprolings.

name: Thallid Soothsayer
text: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

name: Urgoros, the Empty One
text: As the phantom flies overhead, the city of Vhelnish screams in silence.

name: D'Avenant Trapper
text:
"Go swiftly, clever arrow, and teach
The philosophy of stillness."
—D'Avenant verse

name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
text: "Look how they beg for the knife! The Demonlord has trained them well."

name: Windgrace Acolyte
text: Acolytes of the lost Lord Windgrace fight to keep Urborg relics out of Cabal hands.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
text: Centuries ago, a mad god offered a simple trade.

name: Bloodstone Goblin
text: The stone whispers tales of darkness and fire. She replies, "Tell me more."

name: Champion of the Flame
text: Grand Warlord Radha's challengers are always defeated, but she rewards the most passionate with the Flame of Keld. After that, they burn for her.

name: Fervent Strike
text:
"The flame paints a bright wheel on the sky, then shifts into a stabbing spark. The enemy falls; the smoke of victory rises."
—"Legends of the Firedancer"

name: Fiery Intervention
text: Burning something is easy. Choosing a target can be more difficult.

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Fire Elemental
text:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Firefist Adept
text: The versatile "fiery gauntlet" is among the first spells young Ghitu mages learn.

name: Frenzied Rage
text:
"The heat in our hearts sometimes rises to the surface."
—Valduk, keeper of the Flame

name: Ghitu Chronicler
text: "What fire forged, fire remembers."

name: Ghitu Journeymage
text: The Ghitu of Shiv are as fierce and uncompromising as their volcanic home.

name: Ghitu Lavarunner
text: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

name: Goblin Chainwhirler
text: "The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!"

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Not since the days of Pashalik Mons have the Rundvelt goblins been so united or effective.

name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
text: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

name: Keldon Raider
text: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

name: Keldon Warcaller
text:
"The Mountain gave the Flame to Kradak to light the furnaces of his people's hearts. The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord."
—"The Flame of Keld"

name: Orcish Vandal
text: Every ancient relic is a weapon if you throw it hard enough.

name: Radiating Lightning
text: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

name: Rampaging Cyclops
text: Keldon warriors take advantage of the cyclops's inability to focus on more than one thing at a time.

name: Dauntless Bodyguard
text: The Benalish aristocracy is hereditary, but the loyalty of its subjects is earned.

name: Run Amok
text: Keld faced an apocalypse to fulfill a dire prophecy. Now Keldons have nothing left to believe in except themselves.

name: Seismic Shift
text:
"Shiv is a restless land. It heaves ash, bleeds lava, and scabs over in black obsidian."
—*The First Eruption*

name: Shivan Fire
text: Sometimes Shivan dragons toy with their food. Other times they just cook it.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Skirk Prospector
text: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

name: Skizzik
text: It skitters across Shiv, each tendril hitting the ground with a sharp snap.

name: Squee, the Immortal
text: "You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."

name: Two-Headed Giant
text: He watches the pass in both directions, and all must pay his toll.

name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
text: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

name: Dub
text: "Rise, knight of New Benalia."

name: Warcry Phoenix
text: War begins with one red ember.

name: Warlord's Fury
text:
"The old ways were for a winter world. We do what's best for us, not for the past. We are Keldons!"
—Grand Warlord Radha

name: Wizard's Lightning
text:
"The study of magic began when the first mage taught herself to throw lightning."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Adventurous Impulse
text: Every odyssey begins with a single step.

name: Ancient Animus
text: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

name: Arbor Armament
text:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

name: Baloth Gorger
text: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

name: Broken Bond
text: "I can't bear to see another plane broken before I make my own home whole. I'm sorry, but my watch is over."

name: Corrosive Ooze
text: Nothing tastes finer to an ooze than a priceless family heirloom.

name: Elfhame Druid
text: The bond between Llanowar elves and their kavu empowers both.

name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
text:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Fungal Plots
text: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

name: Gaea's Protector
text: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

name: Kamahl's Druidic Vow
text: Centuries ago, a barbarian laid his rage to rest.

name: Krosan Druid
text: "Druids endure disaster as seeds endure winter. Now Krosa blooms once more."

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Llanowar Envoy
text:
"Cherish this world in honor of the martyrs who saved it. We too must be prepared to give our lives."
—*The Mending of Dominaria*

name: Llanowar Scout
text: Llanowar elfhames occupy different heights within the great forest. Elves of the Loridalh and Kelfae hames can see neither earth nor sky.

name: Mammoth Spider
text: Most spiders of Llanowar disdain elvish alliances. No elf has as many beautiful eyes or as many strong arms.

name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
text: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

name: Nature's Spiral
text:
"As Argoth's last defenders fell to Urza's juggernauts, Titania said, 'Nature cannot be destroyed, only changed.'"
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Pierce the Sky
text: Llanowar elves conceal their ballistae in the upper canopy of the forest, ready to clear the skies of any intruder.

name: Primordial Wurm
text:
"You can hear its tail thrashing from a mile away. Keep in mind that its jaws may already be half a mile closer."
—Jenson Carthalion, Yavimaya exile

name: Saproling Migration
text: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

name: Spore Swarm
text: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

name: Sporecrown Thallid
text:
"The identifying ornamental growths of alpha thallids may be hereditary, or catalyzed by some chemical signal."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Steel Leaf Champion
text: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

name: Sylvan Awakening
text:
"Yavimaya is aware, but not always awake. You will know the difference when you see it."
—Karn

name: Territorial Allosaurus
text: A living remnant of the Ice Age.

name: Thorn Elemental
text: The first law of Yavimaya is that guests may kill only to survive. As fires aren't needed in the warm weather, cutting trees for wood means death.

name: Verdant Force
text: The bower shuddered. The stillness broke. The scurf shifted, and a being emerged from the flowers and ferns.

name: Yavimaya Sapherd
text:
"When their community grows cluttered, thallids begin a traditional bobbing dance, then trek out in all directions."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Gideon's Reproach
text: On Amonkhet, Gideon lost both his sural and his faith in himself. But he can still throw a punch, and he still knows a bad guy when he sees one.

name: Adeliz, the Cinder Wind
text: The passionate intensity of the Ghitu tempered by the cool insight of Tolarian training.

name: Arvad the Cursed
text: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

name: Grand Warlord Radha
text: "The future is my gift to Keld."

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
text: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
text:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Adamant Will
text: The shield took a year to craft, a month to enchant, and a decade to master—all for one glorious moment.

name: Healing Grace
text:
"Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

name: Oath of Teferi
text: "For the lost and forgotten, I will keep watch."

name: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth
text: Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.

name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
text: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
text: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
text: "Nothing is too broken to mend."

name: Aesthir Glider
text: An ancient device recovered from a thawing glacier high in the Karplusan mountains.

name: Amaranthine Wall
text: Neither its appearance nor its temperature varies as the years pass, an eternal testament to the forces that shaped Dominaria.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Bloodtallow Candle
text:
"Bring me an angel feather, and I will give you one death in return. There can be no turning back once the candle is lit."
—Whisper, blood liturgist

name: Damping Sphere
text: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

name: Guardians of Koilos
text: Archaeologists depend on automatons inspired by their previous discoveries at Koilos to guard the excavations.

name: Helm of the Host
text: Forged out of flowstone for the queen of Vesuva.

name: Howling Golem
text: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: Ice may thaw, but malice never does.

name: Invoke the Divine
text:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—*Song of All*, canto 1008

name: Jhoira's Familiar
text:
"You could say it was my pet project."
—Jhoira

name: Juggernaut
text:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

name: Mishra's Self-Replicator
text: It has witnessed history's most significant events, one incarnation after another.

name: Mox Amber
text: A moment in time made tangible, it has the power to realize epic visions.

name: Navigator's Compass
text: The *Weatherlight* can no longer planeshift, but it can traverse Dominaria with ease.

name: Pardic Wanderer
text:
"To the head of Archaeological Findings: The excavation schedule at dig site 93-beta must be revised. Part of the site has walked off."
—Tolarian field dispatch

name: Powerstone Shard
text:
"Light passing through a powerstone is refracted by eternity and colored by planar energy. I wonder how the world appeared through Urza's eyes?"
—Teferi

name: Shield of the Realm
text: Benalish glazeplate is stained with salts from the Rift Era and enchanted to deflect blows.

name: Short Sword
text:
"Sometimes the only difference between a martyr and a hero is a sword."
—Captain Sisay, *Memoirs*

name: Knight of Grace
text: A light to pierce the shadows.

name: Skittering Surveyor
text: Like a cross between a spider and a spyglass, but friendlier.

name: Sparring Construct
text: The trainers were a gift of gratitude from the wizards of Tolaria West to the knights of New Benalia for their aid during the Talas Incursion.

name: Thran Temporal Gateway
text: The portal opens not to the past, but from it. Those who step through discover an unimaginable future.

name: Urza's Tome
text:
"Truly understanding even one volume can be a life's work."
—Naru Meha, master wizard

name: Voltaic Servant
text: A missing piece in search of a puzzle.

name: Cabal Stronghold
text: The seat of Belzenlok's power, the Stronghold serves as the gathering place for the Cabal as their dark influence spreads from Urborg.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Knight of New Benalia
text: The mage-smiths of New Benalia have perfected the art of blending fine steel and enchanted glass into weapons that are both beautiful and deadly. Only elite knights are entrusted with these martial works of art.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as the Cabal encroaches.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Zhalfirin Void
text:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
text: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: "You are not alone. You never were."

name: Mesa Unicorn
text: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

name: Temporal Machinations
text: The Cabal soldier blinked and found day had become night, he had a face full of thistle seeds, and the old man was nowhere to be seen.

name: Niambi, Faithful Healer
text: "My father will be happy to see you."

name: Teferi's Sentinel
text:
"Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir. My homeland is gone, but its protectors remain."
—Teferi

name: Meandering River
text:
"Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds. Aren't you ready to do the same?"
—Jhoira, to Teferi

name: Karplusan Hound
text:
"Don't worry, they don't bite. They much prefer setting people on fire."
—Jaya Ballard, to Chandra

name: Pyromantic Pilgrim
text: "From the volcanoes of Shiv to the Balduvian steppes, I have sought a worthy teacher. At last, I have found one."

name: Timber Gorge
text: Glaciers, torrential floods, and temporal disturbances came and went. The mountains yet stood, unchanged.

name: On Serra's Wings
text:
"The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."
—*Song of All*, canto 524

name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
text: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

name: Pegasus Courser
text: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

name: Aven Sentry
text: "My flock flew from a distant continent ruined by cataclysm and war. Benalia gave us shelter to end our exodus."

name: Sanctum Spirit
text:
"When history becomes too mournful, even good souls may choose to forget."
—Shalai, voice of Plenty

name: Seal Away
text: An ancient nemesis rendered harmless long ago.

name: Sergeant-at-Arms
text: Knights get the glory. Soldiers get things done.

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Serra Disciple
text: Theologians now believe the Ancestor was another divine form of Serra.

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Tragic Poet
text: "In a healing world I write—I, who will never be healed. Let my last gift be one of memory: from a thousand lost thoughts, choose one, and remember my name."

name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
text: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

name: Baird, Steward of Argive
text: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

name: Academy Journeymage
text: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

name: Arcane Flight
text: The Tolarian Academies are known for their magical research, powerful sorcerers, and accidental destruction of ecosystems.

name: Befuddle
text:
"The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still. I learned that from Radha."
—Jhoira

name: Cold-Water Snapper
text: For generations, the inhabitants of Orvada have hungered for turtle soup. For generations, the turtles have frustrated their ambitions.

name: Benalish Honor Guard
text:
"The true measure of all heroes is not what they achieve, but who they inspire."
—*Triumph of Gerrard*

name: Deep Freeze
text: For cryomancers, studying the Ice Age isn't just an academic exercise.

name: Diligent Excavator
text: Archaeologists don't just dig in the dirt. They excavate time, scraping off the years grain by grain.

name: Divination
text:
"Half of your studies will be learning the laws of magic. The other half will be bending them."
—Naru Meha, master wizard

name: Homarid Explorer
text:
"Homarids spread northward from Sarpadia as the climate cooled, raiding coastal settlements for supplies."
—*Time of Ice*

name: In Bolas's Clutches
text:
"Your contract is in default. You belong to me now. Serve, or die."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Karn's Temporal Sundering
text: Centuries ago, a quest to harness time became a spiral into chaos.

name: Merfolk Trickster
text: Saved from destruction by one planeswalker's sacrifice, the Eliterate colony forswore the taking of life.

name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
text: "Perfect. Now do it again."

name: Benalish Marshal
text:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—*History of Benalia*

name: Opt
text: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

name: Relic Runner
text: Her knack for tampering with wards got her kicked out of the academy, but they also got her back in.

name: Rescue
text: With just a few seconds to escape, Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

name: Sage of Lat-Nam
text: Though it was laid to waste by the brothers, many schools of magic trace their origins to the College of Lat-Nam, including the first Tolarian Academy.

name: Syncopate
text: The fire spell stuttered and broke. Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

name: Tempest Djinn
text: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Blessed Light
text: Enchanted by mage-smiths and blessed by priests, Benalish windows let in light and cast out darkness.

name: Tolarian Scholar
text: The Tolarian Academies embrace a tradition of study and research while discouraging the kinds of experiments that ruined the original island of Tolaria.

name: Unwind
text:
"A problem is only a problem if you don't have the tools to correct it."
—Jhoira

name: Vodalian Arcanist
text: The Vodalian Empire tends to be insular. The scholarly Volshe caste are the exception, using education as an antidote to xenophobia.

name: Weight of Memory
text: In lives that have stretched for centuries, there are bound to be a few awkward silences.

name: Wizard's Retort
text:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
text: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

name: Blessing of Belzenlok
text:
"My heart is not mine, it is Belzenlok's. All hearts are his, and all blood."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

name: Cabal Evangel
text: "All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . ."

name: Cabal Paladin
text:
"The Demonlord has ruled every age. Every ruin, myth, and nightmare proves his power."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

name: Board the Weatherlight
text: A new gathering for a new age.

name: Caligo Skin-Witch
text: "Take their faces. The lips of these unbelievers may yet honor the Demonlord."

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Dark Bargain
text: "I have pustules of the great Ratadrabik, very cheap. No? Surely you'll want a tincture of Nevinyrral's pulverized remains. Genuine!"

name: Deathbloom Thallid
text:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

name: Demonic Vigor
text: In the Cabal, death is just another mark of devotion.

name: Divest
text: Flittersprites collect unusually valuable things: coins of fallen empires, baby teeth, and memories of treasured names.

name: Dread Shade
text:
"The forest surrounding the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass, a vast bog stalked by horrors too terrible to name."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Drudge Sentinel
text: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.

name: Call the Cavalry
text: Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.

name: Eviscerate
text:
"Fear the dark if you must, but don't mistake sunlight for safety."
—Josu Vess

name: Feral Abomination
text:
"Urborg used to be lovely—scenic volcanoes, respectable lich lords. Since the Cabal came with their nightmares and thrulls, it's all gone to the worms."
—Mister Lostspoons, Skulltown gossip

name: Final Parting
text:
"Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."
—Liliana Vess

name: Fungal Infection
text: To thallids, the whole world is just a pile of mulch to grow saprolings in.

name: Knight of Malice
text: A shadow to swallow the light.

name: Lingering Phantom
text:
"True power never dies, but lies awake, waiting for its name to be spoken."
—*The Eldest Reborn*

name: Air Elemental
text:
"The East Wind, an interloper in the dominions of Westerly Weather, is an impassive-faced tyrant with a sharp poniard held behind his back for a treacherous stab."
—Joseph Conrad, *The Mirror of the Sea*

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mind Control
text:
"Why fight the body when you can dominate the mind that rules it?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"The construction of a defense is not accomplished by adding bricks."
—Jace Beleren

name: Snapping Drake
text: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies collect jewels for theirs.

name: Unsummon
text: Mages routinely summon creatures from the Æther. It's only fair that they occasionally throw one back.

name: Abyssal Specter
text: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

name: Ascendant Evincar
text: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

name: Boomerang
text: Early Jamuraan hunters devised a weapon that would return to its source. Tolarian Æthermancers developed a spell that skipped the weapon entirely.

name: Crowd of Cinders
text: They envy the life-giving heat so much that they tear it from those who still possess it.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Dusk Imp
text: Imps are just intelligent enough to have an understanding of cruelty.

name: Essence Drain
text:
"The elves are right: Death inevitably leads to life. But the truly powerful don't just experience this cycle. They control it."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Eyeblight's Ending
text:
"Those without beauty are Lorwyn's greatest tumor. The winnowers have an unpleasant duty, but a necessary one."
—Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana

name: Megrim
text:
"It's a vicious circle. Stress breeds pain. Pain breeds stress. It's simply beautiful, wouldn't you agree?"
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Mind Rot
text:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

name: Mind Shatter
text: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

name: Moonglove Winnower
text: Winnowers live to eliminate eyeblights, creatures the elves deem too ugly to exist.

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Severed Legion
text: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Unholy Strength
text:
"Born under the moon, the second child will stumble on temptation and seek power in the dark places of the heart."
—Codex of the Constellari

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Cloud Sprite
text: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

name: Bloodmark Mentor
text: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

name: Cinder Pyromancer
text: "If the whole world burns, I'll never grow cold."

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Enrage
text: The barbarians call it "touching the soul of the dragon."

name: Furnace of Rath
text: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Goblin Sky Raider
text: The goblin word for "flying" is more accurately translated as "falling slowly."

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

name: Rage Reflection
text: Vengeance is a dish best served twice.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Shock
text:
"Once I saw a goblin shouting at a thunderstorm. He lost the argument pretty quickly."
—Wandering mage

name: Blanchwood Armor
text:
"Before armor, there was bark. Before blades, there were thorns."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Drove of Elves
text: "The light of beauty protects our journeys through darkness."

name: Elven Riders
text: "Wirewood cannot hide great size. Only with speed and skill can we survive here."

name: Deluge
text:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

name: Elvish Eulogist
text: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

name: Elvish Promenade
text: The faultless and immaculate castes form the lower tiers of elvish society, with the exquisite caste above them. At the pinnacle is the perfect, a consummate blend of aristocrat and predator.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Elvish Warrior
text: As graceful as a deer leaping a stream and as deadly as the wolf waiting in ambush on the other side, elvish warriors are the eyes of the forest as well as its unsheathed claws.

name: Gaea's Herald
text: "Gaea sings with the voice of nature rampant: a thousand howls, chitters, and cries, and none of them can be ignored."

name: Giant Spider
text: The giant spider's silk naturally resists gravity, almost weaving itself as it blankets the forest canopy.

name: Greenweaver Druid
text: The other tribes call them fanatics, but none deny that the Mul Daya elves have an iron-strong bond to some force greater than themselves.

name: Howl of the Night Pack
text: The murderous horrors of Raven's Run are legendary, but even that haunted place goes quiet when the night wolves howl.

name: Denizen of the Deep
text: According to merfolk legend, a denizen of the deep swallows the horizon at the end of each day, bringing on the cold blanket of night.

name: Immaculate Magistrate
text: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Natural Spring
text:
"Jewels cannot be eaten nor gold drunk. What civilization trades, nature simply provides."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Naturalize
text: If you want to destroy something lifeless, make it live.

name: Nature's Spiral
text: Like nature, the fern spirals back on itself, eternally seeking its own center.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Essence Scatter
text: Some wizards compete not to summon the most interesting creatures, but to create the most interesting aftereffects when a summons goes awry.

name: Runeclaw Bear
text: Bears aren't always as strong and as mean as you imagine. Some are even stronger and meaner.

name: Spined Wurm
text: Its spines act like the teeth of a saw, scoring distinctive marks in the vegetation of its territory.

name: Trained Armodon
text: Armodons are trained to step on things. Enemy things.

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Wall of Wood
text: Orcish lumberjacks spent the night sharpening their blades and resting for a day of labor. They awoke to find that the forest had been making its own preparations.

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Coat of Arms
text: A banner for bonds of blood or belief.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Kraken's Eye
text: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

name: Wall of Spears
text:
"A stick is your friend. A pointed stick is your good friend. An army of pointed sticks is your best friend."
—Onean sergeant

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

name: Nicol Bolas
text: Dominaria's most ancient evil.

name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
text: As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Thunder Dragon
text: Sometimes primitive cultures attributed natural phenomena to monsters. Sometimes they were right.

name: Bogardan Hellkite
text: Cleansing the world, one breath at a time.

name: Dragon Whelp
text: Dragon whelps face few threats besides their own enthusiasm.

name: Dragonstorm
text: Dragons come not in packs or in herds but in storms.

name: Ebon Dragon
text:
"The dragon wing of night o'erspreads the earth."
—*Troilus and Cressida*, William Shakespeare

name: Hellkite Overlord
text:
"The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization—just hunger, heat, and need."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
text: The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.

name: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist
text: "I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name. No matter their visage, I serve."

name: Rhet-Tomb Mystic
text: "Kefnet may be gone, but the thirst for wisdom never dies."

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Lightning Runner
text: "Catch me if you can."

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Reckless Fireweaver
text: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

name: Aetherwind Basker
text: Its frill inspired the design of efficient aether collectors.

name: Architect of the Untamed
text: Next to her designs, life seems like a pale imitation.

name: Attune with Aether
text: "I've never seen a world where aether weaves through every aspect of nature."

name: Bootleggers' Stash
text: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Peema Aether-Seer
text: "The Great Conduit connects us all."

name: Servant of the Conduit
text: "Creation without connection to nature is just manufacture."

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Lazotep Chancellor
text:
"Cease all psychic attacks pending intel on enemy countermeasures."
—Dimir communiqué

name: Rogue Refiner
text: "It's natural, it's all around us, and it's there for the taking. Just try and tell me what I'm doing is wrong."

name: Wayward Servant
text: If one of the anointed fails to serve with perfect obedience, the desert is always ready to receive it.

name: Whirler Virtuoso
text: The first tentative flaps are like a song to his soul.

name: Bontu's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

name: Decoction Module
text: Progress leads to inspiration.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker
text: "Zendikar still seems so far off, but Chandra is my home."

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma? Beyond the reach of the gods? Beyond the horns on the horizon?"
—Samut, initiate of Tah crop

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Not every church is a place of faith.

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

name: Aetherflux Conduit
text: As Kaladesh became Avishkar, aether finally started flowing freely to all.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Slagwoods Bridge
text: The path to action is forged in confidence.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Tanglepool Bridge
text: The path to change is forged in insight.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

name: Treasure Vault
text: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Stridehangar Automaton
text:
"Avishkar greets the Multiverse with an open hand, but do not assume we are defenseless."
—Pia Nalaar

name: On Wings of Gold
text: The edge of Naktamun was once protected by Kefnet. The honored mummies who patrol it now do so in his image.

name: Priest of the Crossing
text:
"Each cataclysm only strengthens our resolve."
—Pytamun, Nef-tomb priest

name: Wizened Mentor
text: It wasn't that his students were better; it was that his students had made *him* better.

name: Prophet of the Scarab
text: "Heed the Scarab's call, or be crushed upon their return!"

name: Rhet-Tomb Mystic
text: "Kefnet may be gone, but the thirst for wisdom never dies."

name: Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker
text: "Zendikar still seems so far off, but Chandra is my home."

name: Aetherflux Conduit
text: As Kaladesh became Avishkar, aether finally started flowing freely to all.

name: Stridehangar Automaton
text:
"Avishkar greets the Multiverse with an open hand, but do not assume we are defenseless."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "I do not wish for a return of the old gods, nor to recapture the glory of the past. I only wish to see my people thrive. That is enough."

name: Reality Shift
text: Forget the expected. Embrace the unpredictable.

name: Temmet, Naktamun's Will
text: Each time he glimpsed oblivion, he learned another lesson.

name: Corpse Augur
text: "Hail the Fly, the Wasp, the Scarab, the Locust, and the Scorpion!"

name: Cryptbreaker
text: The Chitin Court lurks, awaiting its chance to reclaim Amonkhet from the living.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death wanders on Amonkhet, though as of late it has begun to advance with purpose.

name: Gravecrawler
text: A curse barely remembered, a vengeance not yet complete.

name: Midnight Reaper
text:
"We would be fools to trust the histories given to us by the Trespasser. We must seek the truth of our world, whatever the cost."
—Etha, vizier of invocations

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"Look, I don't know what happened. And I really wish I did, so I could do it again!"
—Tailpipe, Rocketeer

name: Chaos Warp
text: Tools developed for infiltrating or sabotaging rival teams became new fields of research in their own right.

name: Druid of Purification
text: "Innovation was meant to end our wars, but it has only brought new conflicts. We must return to our roots."

name: On Wings of Gold
text: The edge of Naktamun was once protected by Kefnet. The honored mummies who patrol it now do so in his image.

name: Corpse Knight
text: All trace of his kingdom had been worn away by the desert sand, but still he kept vigil over the dunes of his home.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Dozens of empires lie dead and buried in the Broken Lands. But on Amonkhet, dead does not mean gone.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Avishkar's power comes from its joyful innovation, in the marvels that people can build when they work together for the common good.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: The Omenpaths didn't just open portals to other worlds. It opened the eyes of many inventors who had been thinking too small.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: The Consulate may be gone, but a savvy street artist still needs to evade disgruntled property owners.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Our third sun approaches. Naktamun will remember its masters."
—Varina, monarch of the Broken Lands

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Nissa asked if the light of foreign suns could affect the flora of Avishkar through Omenpaths. I built a device to capture such light for further testing."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Academy Ruins
text:
"It's often said that an idea can never be killed. How I wish that were true."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Command Tower
text:
"The Wandering teaches us that life is not a binary existence. The body decays, but the mind persists. There must be a reason."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Priest of the Crossing
text:
"Each cataclysm only strengthens our resolve."
—Pytamun, Nef-tomb priest

name: Command Tower
text:
"You think I sit in this seat because of luck? Because of providence? I hold this seat because I alone am fit to fill it."
—Gonti

name: Binding Mummy
text: What the gods decree, the mummies enforce.

name: Aethertide Whale
text:
"To survive up here, I've learned when to use my harpoon and when to just enjoy the view."
—Kadhu, skywhaler

name: Confiscation Coup
text: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

name: Disallow
text:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

name: Forgotten Creation
text:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Glimmer of Genius
text: Creators live for that moment of inspiration: precious, profound, perfect.

name: Wizened Mentor
text: It wasn't that his students were better; it was that his students had made *him* better.

name: One with the Machine
text:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Prophet of the Scarab
text: "Heed the Scarab's call, or be crushed upon their return!"

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Holy Light
text: "Bathed in hallowed light, the infidels looked upon the impurities of their souls and despaired." —*The Book of Tal*

name: Dark Sphere
text:
"I was struck senseless for a moment, but revived when the strange curiosity I carried fell to the ground, screaming like a dying animal."
—Barl, Lord Ith

name: Diabolic Machine
text: "The bolts of our ballistae smashed into the monstrous thing, but our hopes died in our chests as its gears continued turning." —Sevti Mukul, *The Fall of Alsoor*

name: Fellwar Stone
