text: "What do you have that I cannot obtain?" —Mairsil, called the Pretender

name: Fountain of Youth
text: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

name: Living Armor
text: Though it affords excellent protection, few don this armor. The process is uncomfortable and not easily reversed.

name: Scarecrow
text: There was more malice in its button eyes than should have been possible in something that had never known life.

name: Skull of Orm
text: Though lifeless, the Skull still possessed a strange power over the flow of magic.

name: Knights of Thorn
text: "With a great cry, the Goblin host broke and ran as the first wave of Knights penetrated its ranks." —Tivadar of Thorn, *History of the Goblin Wars*

name: Stone Calendar
text: The Pretender Mairsil ordered a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

name: Martyr's Cry
text:
"It is only fitting that one such as I should die in pursuit of knowledge."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Miracle Worker
text:
"Those blessed hands could bring surcease to even the most tainted soul."
—Sister Betje, *Miracles of the Saints*

name: Morale
text: "After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan." —Tivadar of Thorn, *History of the Goblin Wars*

name: Pikemen
text: "As the cavalry bore down, we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet. 'Don't lift your pikes 'til I give the word,' I said." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Squire
text:
"Of twenty yeer of age he was, I gesse.
Of his stature he was of even lengthe,
And wonderly deliver, and greete of strengthe."
—Geoffrey Chaucer, *The Canterbury Tales*

name: Blood of the Martyr
text: The willow knows what the storm does not: that the power to endure harm outlives the power to inflict it.

name: Amnesia
text: "When one has witnessed the unspeakable, 'tis sometimes better to forget." —Vervamon the Elder

name: Drowned
text: We asked Captain Soll what became of the Serafina, but all he said was, "Ships that go down shouldn't come back up."

name: Flood
text: "A dash of cool water does wonders to clear a cluttered battlefield." —Vibekke Ragnild, *Witches and War*

name: Ghost Ship
text: "That phantom prow split the storm as lightning cast its long shadow on the battlefield below." —Mireille Gaetane, *The Valeriad*

name: Brainwash
text: "They're not your friends; they despise you. I'm the only one you can count on. Trust me."

name: Ashes to Ashes
text: "All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first." —Maeveen O'Donagh, Memoirs of a Soldier

name: Banshee
text: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

name: Bog Imp
text: On guard for larger dangers, we underestimated the power and speed of the Imp's muck-crusted claws.

name: Bog Rats
text: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

name: Curse Artifact
text: Voska feared the artifact had come too easily.

name: Eater of the Dead
text: Even the putrid muscles of the dead can provide strength to those loathsome enough to consume them.

name: Grave Robbers
text:
"If you don't have your health, you don't have anything."
—Proverb

name: Inquisition
text: Many of those entrusted to Primata Delphine's care tended to express themselves with screams.

name: Marsh Gas
text:
"Comes right outta th' ground. If ya can smell it, it's too late."
—Keevy Bogsbury

name: Murk Dwellers
text: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

name: Dust to Dust
text: Tervish never noticed that the amulet had vanished. It had disappeared not only from his possession, but from his memory as well.

name: Rag Man
text: "Aw, he's just a silly, dirty little man. What's to be afraid of?"

name: The Fallen
text: Magic often masters those who cannot master it.

name: Uncle Istvan
text: Solitude drove the old hermit insane. Now he only keeps company with those he can catch.

name: Word of Binding
text: "That was the worst experience of my days, standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Worms of the Earth
text: The ground collapsed, leaving nothing but the great Worms' mucous residues.

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Brothers of Fire
text: Fire is never a gentle master.

name: Exorcist
text: Though they often bore little greater charm than the demons they battled, exorcists were always welcome in Scarwood.

name: Fissure
text: "Must not all things at the last be swallowed up in death?" —Plato

name: Goblin Caves
text: The stench of countless generations of unspeakable activities was enough to loosen both our footing and our stomachs.

name: Goblin Digging Team
text: "From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!" "Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

name: Goblin Hero
text: They attacked in an orgy of rage and madness, but only one seemed as focused on killing us as on the sheer joy of battle.

name: Goblin Shrine
text: "I knew it weren't no ordinary pile of—you know." —Norin the Wary

name: Inferno
text: "Any scrap of compassion that still existed in my soul was permanently snuffed out when they cast me out into the flames." —Mairsil, called the Pretender

name: Orc General
text: "Your army must fear you more than the enemy. Only then will you triumph." —Malga Phlegmtooth

name: Sisters of the Flame
text: We are many wicks sharing a common tallow; we feed the skies with the ashes of our prey.

name: Carnivorous Plant
text: "It had a mouth like that of a great beast, and gnashed its teeth as it strained to reach us. I am thankful it possessed no means of locomotion." —Vervamon the Elder

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text: "They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred. Let them be cast out." —Ailheen, Speaker of the Council

name: Hidden Path
text:
"Where moments before we were lost beyond hope, the strange, floating lights showed us the way and restored our morale."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Land Leeches
text: "The standard cure for leeches requires the application of burning embers. Alternative methods must be devised should an ember of sufficient size prove more harmful than the leech." —Vervamon the Elder

name: Festival
text: Only after the townsfolk had drawn us into their merry celebration did we discover that their holiday rituals held a deeper purpose.

name: Lurker
text:
"Each night we felt it watching us from the darkness beyond our fire. We only had one pack horse left."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Marsh Viper
text: "All we had left were their black and bloated bodies." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Niall Silvain
text: This is his domain, and while you remain here you must value all life as you value your own.

name: People of the Woods
text:
"Their rain of arrows left only myself alive, cowering within a tree hollow. They did not even come out to loot the bodies."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Savaen Elves
text: "Purity of magic can only come from purity of the land. How can a meal nourish if the ingredients are spoiled?" —Sidaine of Savaen

name: Scavenger Folk
text: String, weapons, wax, or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

name: Venom
text: "I told him it was just a flesh wound, a wee scratch, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Whippoorwill
text: If the Whippoorwill remains silent, the soul has not reached its reward.

name: Marsh Goblins
text: Even the other Goblin races shun the Marsh Goblins, thanks to certain unwholesome customs they practice.

name: Scarwood Goblins
text: Larger and more cunning than most Goblins, Scarwood Goblins are thankfully found only in isolated pockets.

name: Dark Heart of the Wood
text: Even the Goblins shun this haunted place, where the tree limbs twist in agony and the ground seems to scuttle under your feet.

name: Barl's Cage
text: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

name: Bone Flute
text: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

name: Coal Golem
text: "Three such creatures stood burning at the crest of the hill. Only seconds later, the Fireball struck our front line." —Lydia, Countess Brellis

name: Monologue Tax
text:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

name: Ondu Spiritdancer
text: "We travel to know the land—its sacred spirit, its perils and blessings."

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Sphere of Safety
text: The Rakdos believe that all are eager to join their revels, even when told otherwise.

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Timely Ward
text: Behind every general who leads from the front is a nervous mage with a spell at the ready.

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Soaring Lightbringer
text: Hope arrives on silent wings.

name: Archetype of Imagination
text:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Extravagant Replication
text: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"

name: Mirrormade
text:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper

name: Thirst for Meaning
text: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Blood Artist
text:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Fate Unraveler
text:
"Never forget that the life you've built can be undone by a single loose thread."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Kederekt Parasite
text: When the smell of passing thoughts piques its hunger, its maw becomes primed with acid and a taste for brains.

name: Mask of Griselbrand
text: The legacy of evil lives on.

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Zimone's Hypothesis
text: "There exists a theoretical infinity between the discrete atoms of reality. I'm simply appropriating that infinity as storage space."

name: Nightshade Harvester
text: "Anywhere the moonlight touches—that's my garden."

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Ancient Cellarspawn
text: Where it treads, plants wither. Where it breathes, poison spreads.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Brash Taunter
text: "Why don't you come a little closer and say that again, you spineless spit-licker!"

name: Enchanter's Bane
text: Those who fail to respect power will soon be consumed by it.

name: Harsh Mentor
text: "Fight through it."

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Rampaging Ferocidon
text: All raptors are aggressive, but ferocidons seem to enjoy their prey's pain.

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Deathcap Cultivator
text: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Slaughter the weak ones. They are unworthy of the gift of *compleation.*"

name: Giant Adephage
text:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Deluge of Doom
text:
"I told you there were no razorkin down that passage. I never said it was *safe*."
—Winter

name: Gnarlwood Dryad
text: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.

name: Greater Tanuki
text: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Hydra Omnivore
text:
"We should learn from the hydra. It never plays favorites; it devours everyone equally."
—Thrass, elder druid

name: Moldgraf Millipede
text: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

name: Mulch
text:
"Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing."
—Halana, to Alena

name: Overwhelming Stampede
text:
"I trust the instincts of any beast over the advice of any human who presumes to be an expert in the art of war."
—Rinshel, elf insurgent

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Sandwurm Convergence
text: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Scute Swarm
text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Skola Grovedancer
text: "From the ashes of last night's revel, I bring the dawn of new growth."

name: Into the Pit
text: Duskmourn never yields its secrets without exacting a brutal price.

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text:
"Odd. I didn't see any lightning . . . ."
—Herreth, poacher, last words

name: Wilderness Reclamation
text:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
text:
"To sail through those waters is to offer oneself as tribute."
—Captain Hoyrik

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Eureka Moment
text: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Inkshield
text: Silverquill's elite know how to offer a scathing rebuttal without uttering a word.

name: Kaervek the Merciless
text:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

name: Life Insurance
text: All the money in the world won't buy back a pulse.

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Oversimplify
text:
"A fine example of addition by subtraction."
—Deekah, professor of fractal theory

name: Spiteful Visions
text: Knowledge brings the sting of disillusionment, but the pain teaches perspective.

name: Stormfist Crusader
text:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Sadistic Shell Game
text: "Shame about your friends. Wanna see what's inside yours?"

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Brainstone
text: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Haywire Mite
text:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Mind Stone
text:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Scroll of Fate
text:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Barbflare Gremlin
text:
"You think burning the pie to a crisp was bad? You should see what it did to the chef!"
—Meg, supply runner

name: Ash Barrens
text:
"You should have granted us an audience. Instead, you now reign over a kingdom of ruins."
—Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker

name: Blackcleave Cliffs
text: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.

name: Castle Vantress
text: Without Vantress's knowledge, the realm would lose itself in darkness.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Darkmoss Bridge
text: The path to power is forged in ruthlessness.

name: Gleeful Arsonist
text: "Let the world burn!"

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Dryad Arbor
text:
"Touch no tree, break no branch, and speak only the question you wish answered."
—Von Yomm, elder druid, to her initiates

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Geothermal Bog
text: There are still a few places where the natural dangers outweigh even those posed by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

name: Graven Cairns
text: Shamans of Kar-Sengir claim that their sun sets because it can no longer bear the gaze of those pain-carved cliffs.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
text: The stronghold of Theros's light.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: In places where the sea meets the trees, it's easy to forget the darkness that rules most of Innistrad.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Obscura Storefront
text: In volatile times, a sense of certainty is in high demand.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Quandrix Campus
text: Mage-students who see beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Shivan Gorge
text: Both forge and pyre.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

name: Tangled Islet
text: Many of Terisiare's islands are merely extensions of the root system of the Yavimaya magnigoth forests.

name: Demolisher Spawn
text: It rips through the Hauntwoods like a chainsaw, leaving a crushed and bloody trail behind.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Thornwood Falls
text: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Tree of Tales
text: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Underground River
text:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Vault of Whispers
text: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Viridescent Bog
text: Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.

name: Witch's Clinic
text: Students from other colleges are invited to visit Witherbloom's medical facilities. Not many do.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Behold the Power of Destruction
text: "I must break the world before I can remake it in my image."

name: Choose Your Champion
text: "I am nothing if not fair. I've chosen my champion. Now you must choose yours."

name: Choose Your Demise
text: "There is no way out—only a choice of final agonies."

name: I Am Duskmourn
text: "I am infinite. All that you behold, even the stars above, are my domain."

name: I Am Never Alone
text: "This is but a pale shadow of my true form. Cower before it, and despair."

name: I Am Untouchable
text: "The least of my minions is more than a match for you."

name: Kneel Before My Legions
text: "You wish to beg for mercy? Save your breath for screaming."

name: Mine Is the Only Truth
text: "Your gods are hollow lies, your prayers nothing but effluvia befouling my air."

name: My Crushing Masterstroke
text: "Do you see the faces of those you once loved among my legion? You will join them soon."

name: My Laughter Echoes
text: "I await you around every corner, smiling and holding a razor."

name: My Tendrils Run Deep
text: "There is no path here that does not end with me."

name: My Will Is Irresistible
text: "Your former friends have already sworn themselves to me. Wouldn't you like to join them?"

name: My Wings Enfold All
text: "This House is mine, and all within it are my playthings."

name: No Secret Is Hidden from Me
text: "I will sink my teeth into the depths of your mind and devour all that is precious to you."

name: Shriekwood Devourer
text: With every soul it consumes, its roots stretch farther and reach for more victims.

name: Only I Know What Awaits
text: "I will multiply your fears until your body melts in on itself and you drown in the tears of your own terrified mind."

name: Plots That Span Centuries
text: "Awaken, cowards! Long have I been preparing for this moment, and you *will* witness my next ascension."

name: Power Without Equal
text: "With what sorry scraps of power do you think to oppose me?"

name: A Premonition of Your Demise
text: "I will unravel you piece by piece."

name: Reality Is Mine to Control
text: "I will make you a monster to haunt your own dreams."

name: Rot Like the Scum You Are
text: "Defy me, and you will dissolve inch by screaming inch."

name: Running Is Useless
text: "Yes, flee from me, prey! Flee from your inevitable fate until your feeble mortal body collapses. I will drink my fill of your fear."

name: Time Bends to My Will
text: "I can stretch a single moment of agony into centuries."

name: When Will You Learn?
text: "Do you not grow tired of your futility? I know I do."

name: You Are Unworthy of Mercy
text: "When you die alone, know that it was I who took everything from you."

name: You Live Only Because I Will It
text: "Do not fear death. Fear me."

name: You Will Know True Suffering
text: "Know that the pain you feel now is but an infinitesimal fraction of the agony I will soon inflict upon you."

name: Your Mistake Is My Triumph
text: "Know, as you perish, that all it took was a single misstep for you to fall into my clutches."

name: Your Nightmares Are Delicious
text: "I will craft exquisite tortures from the roiling depths of your terrified mind."

name: Your Own Face Mocks You
text: "Cower before your true selves."

name: Your Plans Mean Nothing
text: "You will crawl through the ashes of your own grand ambitions before I grant you the mercy of death."

name: Crypt Ghast
text: The soul of a murderer from the old world, steeped for centuries in rot and malevolence.

name: Damn
text: As their bodies crumbled to ash, the cultists' terrible smiles only grew wider.

name: Exhume
text: Those who try to rob a grave claimed by a necromancer rarely make the same mistake twice.

name: Redress Fate
text: "I can't go with you into the House, but I can give you one chance to reverse your doom. Make it count."

name: Soaring Lightbringer
text: Hope arrives on silent wings.

name: Zimone's Hypothesis
text: "There exists a theoretical infinity between the discrete atoms of reality. I'm simply appropriating that infinity as storage space."

name: Ancient Cellarspawn
text: Where it treads, plants wither. Where it breathes, poison spreads.

name: Deluge of Doom
text:
"I told you there were no razorkin down that passage. I never said it was safe."
—Winter

name: Into the Pit
text: Duskmourn never yields its secrets without exacting a brutal price.

name: Sadistic Shell Game
text: "Shame about your friends. Wanna see what's inside yours?"

name: Barbflare Gremlin
text:
"You think burning the pie to a crisp was bad? You should see what it did to the chef!"
—Meg, supply runner

name: Gleeful Arsonist
text: "Let the world burn!"

name: Demolisher Spawn
text: It rips through the Hauntwoods like a chainsaw, leaving a crushed and bloody trail behind.

name: Shriekwood Devourer
text: With every soul it consumes, its roots stretch farther and reach for more victims.

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: To weary wanderers, trapped and lost amid Duskmourn's labyrinthine halls, her gifts are a welcome respite from meals of boiled ear-fungus, crickets, and the Floodpits' bizarre aquatic creatures.

name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
text: "Sometimes, we must make our own path through the darkness."

name: Cackling Counterpart
text: Irene's screams of denial harmonized with its terrible laughter.

name: Ponder
text: "When you learn to read the tides of fate, it's easy to catch the outcomes you desire."

name: Telling Time
text: Time moves strangely in Duskmourn. The terrors of the past snap at the heels of an unknowable future, while the torments of the present stretch into infinity.

name: Blood Pact
text: Valgavoth's devotees write his scriptures upon their flesh so they never forget the secrets he whispers to them.

name: Blood Seeker
text: He hopes each greedy gulp will be the one that makes him feel warm again.

name: Feed the Swarm
text: The spineworms' venom contains a powerful anesthetic, allowing victims to watch in peace as their bodies are stripped to the bone.

name: Night's Whisper
text: "They were all laughing at you after you left, you know. How will you make them pay?"

name: Beast Within
text: Beasties tend to be shy, kind to humans, and absolutely ruthless toward Valgavoth's monstrous spawn.

name: Citanul Hierophants
text: "All who inhabit these woods are part of our ritual, whether they realize it or not."

name: Moldgraf Monstrosity
text: It swallows its catches whole and keeps them in its belly—alive, immobilized, and dissolving slowly.

name: Bedevil
text: Whenever Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing courses through the House like a malevolent wave, spawning new horrors and inciting its inhabitants to frenzy.

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Great power requires great sacrifice. But it need not be my own."

name: Deathreap Ritual
text: There is no atrocity Valgavoth's devotees would not commit for the promise of freedom from fear.

name: Diabolic Vision
text: The demon was long dead, but it still whispered of forbidden truths and exquisite deaths.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Hidden within the infinite, protean rooms of the House are strange pockets of power that only the bravest dare access.

name: Redress Fate
text: "I can't go with you into the House, but I can give you one chance to reverse your doom. Make it count."

name: Putrefy
text: Julie thought getting trapped in a doll was the worst fate imaginable. She was wrong.

name: Utter End
text: For a razorkin, painless dissolution is a far worse fate than agonizing death.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Sometimes safety is a place. Sometimes it's a person. Sometimes it's a tangible reminder that even in darkness, hope persists.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: When you spend most of your time running for your life, it pays to invest in quality footwear.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"I'm not saying I'm sure it's a trap. I'm just saying it wasn't there yesterday and I'm pretty sure I heard it whisper my name. If you're so curious, you touch it."
—Angus, survivor scout

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: Survivors hungry for knowledge sometimes find, to their surprise, that knowledge is hungry for survivors.

name: Command Tower
text:
"It's me and Gribble's special fort. None of the bad things can get us in there."
—Toby

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Acrobatic Cheerleader
text: "I used to cheat death every day in practice. This is nothing."

name: Fear of Immobility
text: As it slunk toward her, Nina told her legs to run, but they stayed rooted and rigid. She screamed—but no sound left her lips.

name: Give In to Violence
text:
"Come. Strip yourself of flesh and fear. Hunt for me. *Entertain* me."
—The Lord of Pain

name: Grievous Wound
text: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

name: Leyline of the Void
text: Cracks in the facade of the House lead not to escape but to oblivion.

name: Live or Die
text:
"I grant them the illusion of hope so that their despair grows ever sweeter."
—Valgavoth

name: Miasma Demon
text: "Hush, little ants. I can rid you of your troubles with a breath. All I ask in return is a drop of blood... and a promise."

name: Fear of Surveillance
text: Its unblinking gaze sees every flaw, every shame, every humiliating moment you wish you could forget.

name: Murder
text: Razorkin have only one hobby.

name: Popular Egotist
text: "I know you'd want me to live, bestie!"

name: Friendly Ghost
text: In life, Marcus had been a devoted guide of new arrivals. Death simply made it easier to get around.

name: Valgavoth's Faithful
text:
"That's the one good thing about these cultists: sometimes they do your work for you."
—Winter

name: Winter's Intervention
text: "Can we trust him?" Niko whispered as they eyed the stranger. "I don't know," the Wanderer replied, "but he's a lot friendlier than the creature that was chasing us."

name: Withering Torment
text: Each spindrell is the lingering consciousness of a survivor consumed by cellarspawn—a ragged, drifting remnant pulsing with constant psychic agony.

name: Bedhead Beastie
text: It had heard monsters were supposed to hide under beds, and it did its best.

name: Betrayer's Bargain
text:
"This is my way out. You'll have to find your own."
—Winter, to Niko

name: Boilerbilges Ripper
text: "Go ahead, meat. Run."

name: Clockwork Percussionist
text: Dance to its beat, or it will dance on your grave.

name: Diversion Specialist
text: "Hey! Fang-faces! Over here!"

name: Fear of Being Hunted
text: It makes no effort to hide itself, savoring its prey's rising panic as the sound of its clacking skull grows closer and closer.

name: Grab the Prize
text: Unfortunately, the keyhole turned out to be located in an even larger, scarier clown mouth.

name: Hand That Feeds
text: In the darkness, Lana reached for Shay's hand and squeezed it for comfort. Then she heard Shay call to her from the next room.

name: Glimmer Seeker
text: "Well, hello there. Want to come exploring?"

name: Impossible Inferno
text: No living being, survivor or monster, is exempt from Valgavoth's wrath.

name: Most Valuable Slayer
text: Torain had never lost a match in his life, and he didn't plan to start now.

name: Norin, Swift Survivalist
text: "I don't know what it was! Why would I stick around to find out?"

name: Piggy Bank
text: "Remember when you smashed me for a little pocket money?"

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"In my younger days, I would meticulously catalog all the terrors I encountered. These days, I mostly just kill them with fire."
—Rip, spawn hunter

name: Ragged Playmate
text: "You tried to throw me away, Henry. I don't like that at all."

name: Rampaging Soulrager
text: The souls of those who perished before Valgavoth's Ascension exist now only as fractured echoes of who they once were.

name: Razorkin Hordecaller
text: "Know your place, pets! First blood is mine!"

name: Razorkin Needlehead
text: "Stitch your eyes, stitch your skin, stitch your mouth into a grin."

name: Ripchain Razorkin
text: "Listen to that tasty squelch. Good hit, good hit! Come here now, little meatbag!"

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: Kaito ran. Illusion or no, the fire felt hot enough to kill.

name: Screaming Nemesis
text: She sees the faces of those who wronged her in everyone she encounters.

name: Trial of Agony
text: All it took to shatter their lifelong bond was a scrap of hope.

name: Hardened Escort
text: "It's not magic. I read the writing on the House's walls. I listen to its sighs. I smell the changes in its air. It tells me where danger lies."

name: Turn Inside Out
text: "Scared, are you? Need a hug?"

name: Untimely Malfunction
text: "No! This worked perfectly in the lab!"

name: Vengeful Possession
text: As the ghost clawed its way into her skin, Sarissa forgot that the rage tearing through her heart wasn't her own.

name: Vicious Clown
text: "Surprise! Aaahahahahah! You should see the look on your face. Here, let's peel it off so you can!"

name: Violent Urge
text: Rage can be a potent antidote to fear.

name: Waltz of Rage
text: The melody was all in her head, but she'd always preferred to dance alone.

name: Anthropede
text: The touch of its many hands is almost gentle, at first. But then the grip tightens, and the mandibles dig in.

name: Bashful Beastie
text: No one knows what hides beneath the beasties' masks.

name: Jump Scare
text: "Boo!"

name: Cathartic Parting
text: "We got more than most people do. We got the chance to say goodbye."

name: Cautious Survivor
text: She came back alone, with her recorder broken and its footage scrambled. Whatever she had experienced, she never spoke of again.

name: Coordinated Clobbering
text: Zimone's theory was that the fractalization of atmospheric aether would increase kinetic energy. Tyvar's theory was that if you hit cultists in the face really hard, they would fall down. They were both right.

name: Cryptid Inspector
text: "Please be dead, please be dead, please be dead."

name: Defiant Survivor
text: "The dark should be scared of me!"

name: Fear of Exposure
text: A mouth like that can never keep secrets.

name: Flesh Burrower
text: Symptoms of a burrower bite include fevers, chills, gangrene, subcutaneous writhing, a growing urge to eat the flesh of the living, and if you're lucky, death.

name: Frantic Strength
text: With his friends dead and his weapons broken, Taros seized the only thing he could to defend himself.

name: Grasping Longneck
text:
"We ran, but it was all around us—like a writhing, flailing forest of rubbery limbs and stabbing talons."
—Survivor's journal

name: Horrid Vigor
text:
"We set it on fire. It lived. We cut off its head. It lived. We fell to it, one by one. It lives."
—Sunrise, survivor sentry

name: Insidious Fungus
text: Wherever it grows, wood rots, walls turn gray, and flesh becomes fertilizer.

name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
text: She's got a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and jaws that can pulverize a cellarspawn with a single snap.

name: Leyline of Mutation
text: Life thrives in the Hauntwoods, but it follows its own laws, unbound from the natural order.

name: Manifest Dread
text:
"That's why I never travel without a flamethrower."
—Rip, spawn hunter

name: Lionheart Glimmer
text: The survivors would no longer be picked off one by one. It was their turn to hunt.

name: Overgrown Zealot
text: Even as the roots twisted painfully into his flesh, he sang out in joy, for he could feel himself becoming one with the woods.

name: Patchwork Beastie
text: It doesn't know it isn't real.

name: Slavering Branchsnapper
text:
"Hey, look! It made us a nice big path through the hedge maze!"
—Zimone

name: Cult Healer
text: "Oh, we don't *need* to operate. I've just always wanted to try it."

name: Tyvar, the Pummeler
text: "They just keep coming and coming—perfect for my morning workout!"

name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
text: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

name: Wary Watchdog
text: Valgavoth harbors a special loathing for dogs, whose mere presence provides a powerful antidote to the fear he craves.

name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
text: Every night, Cori threw the unsettling doll away. Every morning, it was back on the shelf, its eyes following her every move.

name: Optimistic Scavenger
text: "A void rod? Perfect! Now I'll be able to get the glitch reader working again."

name: Drag to the Roots
text:
"Valgavoth commands us to feed the trees. Let our blood be their mulch, our flesh their soil."
—Victor, Valgavoth's seneschal

name: Fear of Infinity
text: There are some nightmares so terrible, you're never truly rid of them.

name: Gremlin Tamer
text: "Do they cause trouble? Sure. But if you're nice to them, the trouble happens to other folks."

name: Inquisitive Glimmer
text: Glimmers are physical manifestations of survivors' hope and courage. Their presence is one of the few things that can protect from Valgavoth's malevolent influence.

name: Intruding Soulrager
text: The souls of those who perished outside the House persist as fractured echoes, driven to share their misery with the living.

name: Orphans of the Wheat
text: Their only family is each other, and their only toys are those who wander too far into the fields.

name: Midnight Mayhem
text:
"They might look funny, but when all those teeth sink into your flesh, you won't be laughing."
—Winter

name: Oblivious Bookworm
text: "Huh, the detector won't stop beeping. Must be on the fritz again."

name: Peer Past the Veil
text: Those who glimpse the House's true nature firsthand are cursed to never again look away.

name: Shrewd Storyteller
text: All his tales are cautionary.

name: Shroudstomper
text:
"At least the razorkin are happy when they kill you. The walkers don't even notice."
—Angus, survivor scout

name: Undead Sprinter
text: Farley had always been the fastest on the track team. But no one was cheering anymore.

name: Wildfire Wickerfolk
text:
"Isn't fire supposed to *kill* those things?"
—Tyvar

name: Patched Plaything
text: When it ripped, its owner attempted to fix it. Something went... wrong.

name: Attack-in-the-Box
text: Pop goes the evil.

name: Bear Trap
text: Every time its teeth tasted blood, its hunger grew, until one day it was no longer a trap but a hunter.

name: Friendly Teddy
text: Best friends are great to share secrets with—like where the matches are, or how to find a human heart.

name: Glimmerlight
text: Hope and reliable lighting are in short supply in the House. Glimmers provide both.

name: Possessed Goat
text: When their would-be sacrifice wandered back to their encampment, the survivors breathed a sigh of relief, assuming the demon had departed.

name: Keys to the House
text: If you find them, they wanted to be found.

name: Malevolent Chandelier
text:
"If you see a light moving toward you in the darkness, don't assume it's coming to help."
—Winter

name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
text: In a moment of bloodthirsty whimsy, a razorkin once picked up a ventriloquist's puppet and used it to terrorize a survivor. Now it hunts on its own, with no one pulling its strings.

name: Abandoned Campground
text: They say every inhabitant vanished in a single night, leaving their belongings untouched but curiously covered in moths.

name: Blazemire Verge
text: Here, the Balemurk spits and boils, the oppressive darkness pierced by scorching spears of fire.

name: Bleeding Woods
text: They say if someone lies down to sleep beneath the trees, in the morning nothing will remain but a few scattered bones and a bed of blood-red lilies.

name: Etched Cornfield
text: They say those who lose their way in the fields gradually wither and grow brittle, until at last they put down roots and anchor into the soil as a whispering stalk.

name: Floodfarm Verge
text: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

name: Gloomlake Verge
text: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

name: Hushwood Verge
text: Here, the Hauntwoods churn like a viper's nest, as monstrous creatures prowl hungrily toward the ghostly light.

name: Lakeside Shack
text: They say that if you stay in the cabin until the mists reach it, something will slither from the water and knock at the door.

name: Murky Sewer
text: They say dripping, hungry things writhe beyond the edge of the light, waiting to drag the unwary into the darkness.

name: Neglected Manor
text: They say every family who resided there met a grisly end, and once in a while you'll hear their screams echoing through the moldering halls.

name: Peculiar Lighthouse
text: They say its beckoning beacon leads not to safe harbor but into the arms of the drowned.

name: Raucous Carnival
text: They say that those who enter the amusement park never come back, and their disembodied laughter joins the others on the wind.

name: Razortrap Gorge
text: They say the blades wait to bite through your skin until you've climbed too far to turn back, leaving you to cling with blood-slick hands until gravity takes you.

name: Strangled Cemetery
text: They say that with each new moon, the buried dead rise and dance from dusk to dawn, and witnesses to the revelry must join them for eternity.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: The House's geography constantly warps and twists, fields melting into floorboards and walls opening into hungry maws.

name: Savior of the Small
text: "You're safe, kiddo! For at least the next ten minutes. That's about all I can promise."

name: Thornspire Verge
text: Here, the Boilerbilges twitch like a trapped animal, peaks straining against the grasping roots and vines.

name: Valgavoth's Lair
text: It is the one chamber whose location never changes, the rotten, rancorous heart of Duskmourn itself.

name: Seized from Slumber
text: Tyson tried to scream for help, but his lungs simply unraveled.

name: Optimistic Scavenger
text: "A void rod? Perfect! Now I'll be able to get the glitch reader working again."

name: Shardmage's Rescue
text: With a flick of their wrist, Niko shattered the wickerfolk and whisked Nashi to safety.

name: Entity Tracker
text: "The readings are off the charts! Whatever it is, it's close."

name: Come Back Wrong
text:
"See?! That's why you always burn the bodies."
—Rip, spawn hunter

name: Clockwork Percussionist
text: Dance to its beat, or it will dance on your grave.

name: Norin, Swift Survivalist
text: "I don't know what it was! Why would I stick around to find out?"

name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
text: She's got a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and jaws that can pulverize a cellarspawn with a single snap.

name: Oblivious Bookworm
text: "Huh, the detector won't stop beeping. Must be on the fritz again."

name: Split Up
text:
"Whatever happens, we need to stick togeth—AAAAGGGHHH!"
—Recovered tape fragment

name: Unwanted Remake
text:
"not dead just gone
IT WILL COME BACK"
—Note scrawled on a scrap of paper

name: Come Back Wrong
text:
"Rachel, it's me! I've . . . I've brought you back. We can finally be together. R-Rachel? Rach—"
—Recovered tape fragment

name: Shepherding Spirits
text: "This way, Melinda. A hundred years haven't improved your sense of direction."

name: Withering Torment
text:
"DO NOT OPEN. Not a door."
—Bloodstained note

name: Split Up
text:
"Don't be a wimp. We'll cover more ground this way."
—Rian, former survivor

name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
text:
"Where do they keep coming [unintelligble screaming]"
—Recorded tape fragment

name: Blazemire Verge
text: Here, the Balemurk spits and boils, the oppressive darkness pierced by scorching spears of fire.

name: Splitskin Doll
text: Those who mock its ragged surface and seeping eyes have a curious tendency to go missing.

name: Floodfarm Verge
text: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

name: Gloomlake Verge
text: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

name: Hushwood Verge
text: Here, the Hauntwoods churn like a viper's nest, as monstrous creatures prowl hungrily toward the ghostly light.

name: Thornspire Verge
text: Here, the Boilerbilges twitch like a trapped animal, peaks straining against the grasping roots and vines.

name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
text: "Sure, I'm pretty small, but Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared."

name: Trapped in the Screen
text: Maggie had always wanted to be on television.

name: Grievous Wound
text: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

name: Leyline of the Void
text: Cracks in the facade of the House lead not to escape but to oblivion.

name: Unsettling Twins
text: "Come play with us."

name: Leyline of Mutation
text: Life thrives in the Hauntwoods, but it follows its own laws, unbound from the natural order.

name: Shardmage's Rescue
text: With a flick of their wrist, Niko shattered the wickerfolk and whisked Nashi to safety.

name: Clammy Prowler
text: Sometimes, survivors in the Floodpits hear their own drowning voices crying out for help. Only the ones who flee immediately live to speak of it.

name: Creeping Peeper
text:
"Be on your guard. Valgavoth has eyes everywhere. And I don't mean that figuratively."
—Winter

name: Daggermaw Megalodon
text: Valgavoth's evil aura turned the shark from an apex predator into an inescapable terror of the deeps.

name: Don't Make a Sound
text: Jace kept his mouth shut, but he couldn't shake the feeling that the strange creatures could hear the screaming in his mind.

name: Emerge from the Cocoon
text: Within the silken shroud, all doubts are cleansed, and all desires are united with Valgavoth.

name: Duskmourn's Domination
text: All who enter the House hear Valgavoth's whispers, worming through their consciousness until they can no longer resist his influence.

name: Enter the Enigma
text: Though she was used to stepping into the unknown, something about this strange doorway made the Wanderer shiver as she crossed the threshold.

name: Entity Tracker
text: "The readings are off the charts! Whatever it is, it's close."

name: Erratic Apparition
text:
"What's got you all bent out of shape?"
—Joseph, comedian, last words

name: Fear of Failed Tests
text:
"W-wait! What do you mean this quiz determines half our grade?"
—Zimone, muttering in her sleep

name: Fear of Falling
text: It had been months since Jakob had started falling but only a few weeks since he'd run out of breath to scream.

name: Fear of Isolation
text: On the second day after he'd been separated from his friends, Tino worried they'd be panicking at his absence. By the fourth, he was certain they'd never cared for him at all.

name: Get Out
text: Kaito's blade brought the light of another plane into Duskmourn, and with it, a brief chance to escape.

name: Ghostly Keybearer
text: Once charged with watching over every room in the original Vendrell house, it doggedly surveys the endless, ever-expanding labyrinth.

name: Glimmerburst
text: At first Sasha felt silly fending off the cellarspawn hordes with the essence of her childhood pet hamster. But it sure beat dying alone in the dark.

name: The Mindskinner
text: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

name: Paranormal Analyst
text: "If I've done this right, it should immobilize all spirits in the area. If I've done this wrong... you know what, let's just hope I did it right."

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Clad in the light of conviction and hope, Linette strode forth to face Duskmourn's terrors without fear.

name: Piranha Fly
text: They thirst for blood like mosquitoes do. They just have a less dainty way of accessing it.

name: Scrabbling Skullcrab
text: With sandy beaches in short supply, Duskmourn's crabs have adapted to burrow into everything from carpet to flesh.

name: Stalked Researcher
text: "Just a shadow. It's only a shadow. Please let it be a shadow."

name: Tunnel Surveyor
text: Though he needed to know what lay beyond the intersection, Harp couldn't suppress a shiver of disquiet as his glimmer disappeared into the darkness ahead.

name: Exorcise
text:
"Strictly speaking, you can't kill what's already dead, but trapping and disintegrating it is pretty close."
—Garden, survivor technologist

name: Vanish from Sight
text: The Wanderer flung out her hand, but too late—Kaito had vanished into the House's maw.

name: Appendage Amalgam
text: It moves with the speed of a spider but none of its skittering grace, scuttling to the sound of mucus-covered fingers.

name: Balemurk Leech
text: Adapted to feed on dead flesh, it's not averse to making its own when no corpses are available.

name: Cackling Slasher
text: Every death was funnier than the last, until his howling laughter drowned out his victims' screams.

name: Come Back Wrong
text:
"See?! That's why you always burn the bodies."
—Rip, spawn hunter

name: Commune with Evil
text: Elsa swelled with euphoria and power as she stepped over her friends' corpses. She should have bargained with a demon a lot sooner.

name: Cracked Skull
text: Ears ringing and head throbbing, all Tarvin could do was wait to see what would finish the job.

name: Cynical Loner
text: "Thanks, but no thanks. I'm done with hope."

name: Dashing Bloodsucker
text: "There are worse things here than vampires."

name: Demonic Counsel
text: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

name: Doomsday Excruciator
text: "All stars grow dark. All worlds come to an end."

name: Fanatic of the Harrowing
text: "Valgavoth wants our pain, our terror! We cannot join him unless we suffer!"

name: Fear of Lost Teeth
text: As it drew closer, Sam felt her own teeth wriggle in their sockets, as if they wanted to leap out and join the thing.

name: Fear of the Dark
text: The first thing it kills is the light.

name: Final Vengeance
text: The cries of survivor and cellarspawn mingled in a single, terrible roar as they plunged into the fathomless depths.

name: Auriok Glaivemaster
text: "Give me a bit of steel and I'll deliver it into the hearts of my enemies."

name: Pteron Ghost
text: Defending to the death isn't always enough.

name: Arcbound Worker
text: The parts are as strong as the whole.

name: Auriok Siege Sled
text: Everything in its path is either pushed aside or ground under.

name: Coretapper
text: It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.

name: Pulse of the Fields
text: Before religion or civilization, there was order.

name: Darksteel Forge
text:
"Did it have this shape upon Mirrodin's creation, or did some inconceivable force shape the unshapable?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Darksteel Gargoyle
text: The ultimate treasure is one that guards itself.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Drill-Skimmer
text: In close proximity, their magnetic energies merge and form a field of protection.

name: Dross Golem
text: The longer it skulks through the corrosive gases of Mephidross, the more it adopts their thirst for death.

name: Purge
text: For the first and last time, the horrific creature experienced terror.

name: Eater of Days
text: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

name: Genesis Chamber
text:
"As the experimental population grows, so do the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium."
—Memnarch

name: Geth's Grimoire
text: The book shrieks horribly until its cover is opened, granting the spirit inside a moment's rest from the painful stirrings of the book's contents.

name: Juggernaut
text: The goblins built it far larger than the cave opening, but to their glee, it smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new exit.

name: Kraken's Eye
text: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

name: Memnarch
text: In the blur between metal and flesh, Memnarch found madness.

name: Ritual of Restoration
text: Leonin raising ceremonies take place at the white sun's dawn, the rebirth of artifacts mirroring the birth of a new day.

name: Myr Landshaper
text: One thing the myr can't do is enjoy the scenery.

name: Myr Moonvessel
text: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind: dependability, controllability, and disposability.

name: Oxidda Golem
text: The longer it patrols the smoldering crags of the Oxidda Chain, the more it adopts their fiery temper.

name: Razor Golem
text: The longer it stands among the deadly blades of the Razor Fields, the more it adopts their harsh exterior.

name: Soulscour
text:
"I have seen the end of times, a future in which all our kind are torn from this world."
—Ushanti, leonin shaman

name: Spincrusher
text: It rolls with the punches.

name: Spire Golem
text: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

name: Steelshaper Apprentice
text: Theirs is a craft brought about by necessity, now raised to the level of art.

name: Tangle Golem
text: The longer it weaves through the twisted vines of the Tangle, the more it adopts their hidden strength.

name: Ur-Golem's Eye
text: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

name: Voltaic Construct
text: The undead may outlast the living, but those who have never lived outlast them both.

name: Wand of the Elements
text: It gives legs to the earth and wings to the sky.

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Wirefly Hive
text:
"The lifespan of a wirefly can be precisely described as 'short.'"
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

name: Test of Faith
text: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

name: Turn the Tables
text: "Your arrogance is my best weapon."

name: Carry Away
text: Stealing goblin weapons would be easier if the goblins were smart enough to let go.

name: Echoing Calm
text: A single light unleashes a hail of cleansing.

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Hoverguard Observer
text: It could be made to run silently, but its low hum reminds the Neurok that they are always watched.

name: Last Word
text: "Someday, someone will best me. But it won't be today, and it won't be you."

name: Machinate
text: As long as there are questions to be asked, the vedalken will ask them.

name: Magnetic Flux
text: After the researcher's astonishing success, his assistants spent six hours finding a way to return the specimens safely to the ground.

name: Neurok Prodigy
text: "Why should I be bound by rules when I can see so far beyond them?"

name: Pulse of the Grid
text: Before labs or lectures, there was insight.

name: Reshape
text:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Retract
text:
"Secrets are meant to remain secret."
—Memnarch

name: Synod Artificer
text: Memnarch shared a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service. It is a debt he intends to collect.

name: Vedalken Engineer
text: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

name: Vex
text:
"The druids would be better off if they spent more time in the lab and less time watching trees grow."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Aether Snap
text:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

name: Burden of Greed
text:
"The one who dies with the most toys is still dead."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Chittering Rats
text: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

name: Hallow
text: "Bend with the storm, then reply in kind."

name: Death Cloud
text: The swarm's million wings stir the foulest of breezes.

name: Echoing Decay
text: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.

name: Essence Drain
text: Mephidross claims all life within it. What cannot be twisted is absorbed.

name: Grimclaw Bats
text: Even on a world of metal, there are those who thirst for blood.

name: Hunger of the Nim
text: Their pain is so great, they can't help but share it with others.

name: Mephitic Ooze
text: In Mephidross, refuse doesn't last long—it's all scavenged, reanimated, or consumed.

name: Murderous Spoils
text: Scavengers are always the first to pay their respects.

name: Nim Abomination
text: It is one of the oldest nim, steeped so long in the Dross that it has lost all vestiges of humanity.

name: Leonin Battlemage
text: The strongest of the pride are measured not by the steel in their hands but by the steel in their souls.

name: Pulse of the Dross
text: Before tyrants or torturers, there was evil.

name: Scavenging Scarab
text: The beetles feed not on the flesh of corpses but on the metal, grinding out the iron and steel to add to their own bulky shells.

name: Screams from Within
text: There's no escaping an enemy that lives inside your head.

name: Scrounge
text: When leonin settlers abandon their homes to the nim, items of value are often left behind.

name: Barbed Lightning
text: Every creature on Mirrodin is a lightning rod.

name: Crazed Goblin
text: Because fighting is easier than figuring out what else to do.

name: Dismantle
text:
"If only the living were so easily salvaged."
—Memnarch

name: Drooling Ogre
text:
"Is it the stomping kind or the munching kind?"
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

name: Echoing Ruin
text: A single misstep unleashes an avalanche of ruin.

name: Leonin Shikari
text: Her instinct is as sharp as her blade.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Flamebreak
text:
"Now I'm thirsty."
—Korva, Vulshok battlemaster

name: Goblin Archaeologist
text: Always easily impressed, Durg was about to be blown away.

name: Inflame
text: A Vulshok weapon strikes with the fire of the forge that made it.

name: Krark-Clan Stoker
text: Fallen enemies are fed to the scavengers. Fallen friends are thrown into the Great Furnace, their souls returned to the Great Mother.

name: Pulse of the Forge
text: Before wars or weapons, there was anger.

name: Shunt
text: "You might want to work on your aim."

name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Loxodon Mystic
text: As the nim storm across the plains, a lone priest stands in their path. At his silent gesture, the battle line breaks, and the tide turns.

name: Unforge
text: Compared to the fire of the forge, the strength of steel is nothing.

name: Vulshok War Boar
text: It must eat its weight in metal daily, or its furnacelike belly will consume itself for lack of fuel.

name: Ageless Entity
text: Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.

name: Echoing Courage
text: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

name: Fangren Firstborn
text: In the Tangle, bad is often followed by worse.

name: Nourish
text: Gelfruit grows abundantly wherever Sylvok druids live, as if the Tangle knows that humans are not as hardy as the beasts or as nimble as the elves.

name: Oxidize
text:
"Ashes to ashes, rust to rust."
—Viridian shaman

name: Metal Fatigue
text: The Auriok have fought the metal hordes for so long now that knowing how to cripple them has become an instinct.

name: Pulse of the Tangle
text: Before predators or prey, there was life.

name: Rebuking Ceremony
text: From the Radix at the hub of the Tangle all the way out to the Edges of Forgetting, a Viridian elf's life is built around the temporary.

name: Roaring Slagwurm
text: Wurms compete for nesting grounds near the Radix. The young who hatch closest have the best chance for survival.

name: Stand Together
text: Strange times make for strange allies.

name: Tangle Spider
text: They're considered good luck by the elves they don't eat.

name: Tanglewalker
text: In bringing life to Mirrodin, Memnarch was more successful than he knew—for Mirrodin began to take on a life of its own.

name: Tel-Jilad Outrider
text: "When the levelers come again, we shall be ready for them."

name: Tel-Jilad Wolf
text: Thanks to the wolves, Tel-Jilad is the one area of Mirrodin the myr don't see often.

name: Viridian Acolyte
text: "We have no sun to guide our dead, so I tend the prismatic flames of the spirit fires that show the souls their way. When I die, I hope there is one left to guide my spirit home."

name: Viridian Zealot
text: "I will fight only the way nature intended—and nature intended us to win."

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Arcane Spyglass
text: It breaches not physical distances but temporal ones.

name: Arcbound Bruiser
text: Break in case of emergency.

name: Scion of Ugin
text: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron. As Ugin lay dormant, his spectral guardians kept vigil.

name: Dragon Hunter
text: "Dromoka has taught me the secrets of her kind, that I might use them in her service."

name: Flatten
text: Like their dragonlord, the Kolaghan take no trophies. They find true fulfillment only in the battle itself, in clash of steel and thunder of hooves.

name: Foul Renewal
text: The cycle of life and death is rarely pretty.

name: Foul-Tongue Shriek
text: Foul-Tongue shamans draw their powers from a dark twisting of the Draconic language.

name: Gravepurge
text:
"Lord Silumgar has given you a second chance to please him."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Hand of Silumgar
text: Silumgar trains those whom he favors in his magic, granting them the ability to spread his disdain across the land.

name: Kolaghan Skirmisher
text: Kolaghan's army rushes from kill to kill, desperate to avoid the dragon's wrath.

name: Marang River Skeleton
text: The gurgling of the Marang conceals both footsteps and screams.

name: Marsh Hulk
text: Now vengeance is his sole purpose.

name: Dragon's Eye Sentry
text: Even the humblest guard of Ojutai's strongholds ponders the puzzles of the Great Teacher's lessons.

name: Mind Rot
text:
"The Ojutai are my favorite victims. They have so much knowledge to lose."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

name: Minister of Pain
text: Draconic words need not be shouted. A whisper will suffice.

name: Qarsi Sadist
text: Dying for the greater good still hurts.

name: Rakshasa Gravecaller
text: Debts to rakshasa linger beyond death.

name: Self-Inflicted Wound
text:
"Worse than watching the cruelest deed is watching it done by your own hand."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

name: Shambling Goblin
text:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

name: Sibsig Icebreakers
text:
"I almost envy them. They can't get frostbite."
—Kirada, Silumgar enforcer

name: Dromoka Captain
text: "We fight not out of fear, but for honor."

name: Silumgar Butcher
text: Silumgar takes pride in the diversity of his sibsig.

name: Ukud Cobra
text:
"The Silumgar hide behind the deadly wildlife of their swamps. They'd rather scheme in their jungle palaces than face us."
—Khibat, Kolaghan warrior

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"The realization that one is dying is far more terrifying than death itself."
—Sidisi, Silumgar vizier

name: Virulent Plague
text:
"This pestilence robs us of glorious death in battle. We starve to death with full bellies and drown trying to slake our unnatural thirst."
—Kerai Hatesinger, Kolaghan warrior

name: Wandering Tombshell
text: The crumbling temples on the tortoise's back are monuments to the decadence of the ancient Sultai. Though it harkens back to the era of the khans, Silumgar allows it to walk his territory as a warning to those who would oppose him.

name: Dromoka Dunecaster
text: "The dragonlords rule the tempests of the skies. Here in the wastes, the storms are mine to command."

name: Berserkers' Onslaught
text:
"Atarka's people starve while she feasts upon the bounty of their hunts. They must conquer ever more lands just for the sake of their own subsistence."
—Arel, Unseen Whisperer

name: Commune with Lava
text: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

name: Descent of the Dragons
text: Dragons emerge from tempests fully formed and terribly hungry.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Hardened Berserker
text:
"Just let him loose and follow the charge."
—Yikaro, Atarka warrior

name: Dromoka Warrior
text: Dromoka has regard for the humans who serve under her. In return for her protection, they obey with steadfast loyalty, acting as weapons for her and her scalelords against the other clans.

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

name: Kindled Fury
text:
"It is most honorable to use every part of the animals we kill . . . especially if we use them to annihilate our enemies."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Kolaghan Aspirant
text: She answers the call of the Crave, the desire for battle sated only by bloodshed.

name: Lose Calm
text: A lifetime of discipline forsaken in a moment of rage.

name: Magmatic Chasm
text:
"Our shamans assert their mastery over the land, thwarting the lesser clans' attempts to stand in the way of our dragonlord."
—Allek, Atarka hunter

name: Qal Sisma Behemoth
text:
"It hunts grand game for Atarka, and when the time comes, it will become a mighty feast."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Echoes of the Kin Tree
text: Even after Anafenza was executed, many secretly maintained their beliefs in the old ways.

name: Rending Volley
text: The sky offers few hiding places.

name: Roast
text:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman

name: Sarkhan's Rage
text: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

name: Sarkhan's Triumph
text: Sarkhan gazed on the world around him, the dragons sweeping through its skies, and joy kindled like a fire in his soul.

name: Screamreach Brawler
text: "My dragonlord's lightning will dance upon your bones!"

name: Seismic Rupture
text: The shaman opened the earth beneath their feet, trapping the survivors within the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour at her leisure.

name: Stormcrag Elemental
text: The storms of Tarkir awaken more than dragons.

name: Enduring Victory
text:
"My dragonlord is immortal. Most dragons are not."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Summit Prowler
text:
"Do you not hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? Their meat is as tender as a bear's and their blood as warming as fire. They are prey that will please Atarka."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Tail Slash
text:
"Kneel before a dragon and you will be spared when it turns to leave."
—Yikaro, Atarka warrior

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Tormenting Voice
text: A mocking laughter echoed in Ugin's mind. How many centuries had he slumbered, stricken, while Nicol Bolas moved unchallenged among the planes?

name: Twin Bolt
text: Kolaghan archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They utilize their dragonlord's lightning to strike their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.

name: Vandalize
text:
"As we have learned from Kolaghan, to ruin is to rule."
—Shensu, Kolaghan rider

name: Volcanic Rush
text:
"The bravest warriors take the shortest path to victory, whatever that path may be."
—Sakta, Atarka hunter

name: Fate Forgotten
text: When Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, it changed Tarkir's future. The Sultai no longer exist, having been supplanted by the dragonlord Silumgar and his clan.

name: Ainok Artillerist
text:
"In the Tarkir I once knew, the Abzan revered their ancestor trees. Now, as Dromoka, they cut their finest groves to make weapons."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Atarka Beastbreaker
text: He scorns the heavy winter garb of lesser warriors, trusting his anger to keep him warm.

name: Avatar of the Resolute
text: It exemplifies the ideals of the Dromoka: strength, unity, and honor.

name: Circle of Elders
text: They whisper of an ancient hero who saved the dragons of their world.

name: Collected Company
text: Many can stand where one would fall.

name: Colossodon Yearling
text: The colossodon's hard outer shell stops many predators, but with a gentle flip from a dragon, it quickly becomes a meal in a bowl.

name: Conifer Strider
text: Atarka's presence thaws the glaciers of Qal Sisma, forcing its elementals to migrate or adapt.

name: Dragon-Scarred Bear
text: Bears are a delicacy for the Atarka. The few that remain are the toughest of their species.

name: Dromoka's Gift
text: The simplest gift from a dragon can be a revered accolade for a human warrior.

name: Epic Confrontation
text: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Despite the flames and devastation of the dragons, Tarkir continued to thrive.

name: Lurking Arynx
text: Once it has your scent, it will hunt you from the Gurmag Swamp to Ayagor.

name: Naturalize
text: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

name: Pinion Feast
text:
"Even paradise is not without tragedies."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Press the Advantage
text:
"Show your enemies as much mercy as they would show you."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Revealing Wind
text:
"The sands obscure the vision of others, but clarify ours."
—Faiso, Dromoka commander

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

name: Graceblade Artisan
text:
"Can you catch a snowflake on the edge of your blade? Her sword has snagged an entire blizzard."
—Zogye, Ojutai mystic

name: Sandsteppe Scavenger
text: "Sad what passes for a dragon among the Silumgar."

name: Segmented Krotiq
text: The list of things a krotiq eats is as long as the krotiq itself.

name: Shape the Sands
text:
"Dragons in flight seldom expect company."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Sheltered Aerie
text: Dromoka's scalelords patrol the skies over Arashin, offering her people safety from the harsh world.

name: Sight of the Scalelords
text:
"The Silumgar creep around our borders and infiltrate our aeries. We must remain ever watchful."
—Golran, Dromoka captain

name: Stampeding Elk Herd
text: The Atarka use them not just for food, but also to clear away snow, trees, and enemy forces.

name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
text: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

name: Tread Upon
text:
"Boasting impenetrable defenses only draws the most tenacious of attackers."
—Yikaro, Atarka warrior

name: Arashin Sovereign
text: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

name: Boltwing Marauder
text: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.

name: Cunning Breezedancer
text:
"That which is beautiful in form can also be deadly."
—Ishai, Ojutai dragonspeaker

name: Dragonlord Dromoka
text: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.

name: Herald of Dromoka
text: The trumpeters of Arashin are ever alert in their watch over the Great Aerie.

name: Dragonlord Silumgar
text: Silumgar never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Harbinger of the Hunt
text: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

name: Pristine Skywise
text: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

name: Ruthless Deathfang
text:
"Bring forth the dead, their skull-grins and rattle-bones. We will feast upon their wailing ghosts."
—Silumgar, translated from Draconic

name: Ancestral Statue
text: The mage awakened the statue in hopes of learning the lost lore of her clan, but the statue was interested only in war.

name: Atarka Monument
text: Atarka is worshipped and fed by her subjects at Ayagor, the Dragon's Bowl.

name: Custodian of the Trove
text: Silumgar delights in repurposing the treasures of other clans to serve his own ravenous greed.

name: Dragonloft Idol
text: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

name: Dromoka Monument
text: Dromoka rules her clan from the Great Aerie atop Arashin, the central city of the Shifting Wastes.

name: Lightwalker
text:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Keeper of the Lens
text:
"It sees all, but it reveals what it sees only to a chosen few."
—Taigam, Ojutai master

name: Kolaghan Monument
text: Kolaghan has no lasting home, but her disciples leave relics to mark her conquests.

name: Ojutai Monument
text: Ojutai spends time at all his strongholds, but he most favors Cori Stronghold for his meditation.

name: Silumgar Monument
text: Silumgar dominates his clan from a fortress on the Marang River, where he rests upon piles of treasure.

name: Spidersilk Net
text: "Dragons are our betters, but we will fight them if our dragonlord orders it."

name: Tapestry of the Ages
text:
"Abzan, Jeskai, Sultai, Mardu, Temur—names lost to history, yet worthy of further study."
—Narset

name: Vial of Dragonfire
text: Designed by an ancient artificer, the vials are strong enough to hold the very breath of a dragon—until it's needed.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Misthoof Kirin
text: It heralded Sarkhan's return to Tarkir's present.

name: Pacifism
text:
"If I fight, I might step on a butterfly. That would be sad."
—Krowg of Qal Sisma

name: Arashin Foremost
text: "I would gladly give my life if it would inspire my clan to victory."

name: Radiant Purge
