text: The Shifting Wastes are Dromoka's domain. She will not tolerate intruders.

name: Resupply
text:
"If the scalelords are the brains of Dromoka's army, the supply caravans are its beating heart."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

name: Sandcrafter Mage
text: With heat, sand can form a delicate work of art; with pressure, an impenetrable bulwark.

name: Sandstorm Charger
text:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Scale Blessing
text:
"Your bravery honors us all."
—Dromoka, translated from Draconic

name: Secure the Wastes
text:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Silkwrap
text: Better scarves than scars.

name: Strongarm Monk
text:
"His companions are wise to follow him, for his foes dare not stand in his way."
—Zhiada, Dirgur protector

name: Student of Ojutai
text: "Human enlightenment is a firefly that sparks in the night. Dragon enlightenment is a beacon that disperses all darkness."

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Surge of Righteousness
text: Though she stood alone, she struck with the force of an army.

name: Territorial Roc
text:
"Such lesser creatures must be purged from the sky. What use do they have but to help channel the lightning of our mighty dragonlord?"
—Gvar Barzeel, Kolaghan warrior

name: Ancient Carp
text:
"Why eat now what could one day grow into a feast?"
—Ojutai, translated from Draconic

name: Anticipate
text: "When I have meditated on all outcomes, my opponent has no recourse."

name: Clone Legion
text: Their lust for battle was so great that they didn't care their enemies wore their own faces.

name: Contradict
text: Those who question Ojutai may not like the answers they receive.

name: Dance of the Skywise
text: The Ojutai believe in the Great Wheel: those who best serve the dragonlord are destined to be reborn as dragons.

name: Elusive Spellfist
text:
"Learn to see an obstacle from a new perspective. Underneath, for example."
—Chanyi, Ojutai monk

name: Glint
text: Rakshasa waste no opportunity to display their wealth and power, even in the midst of a sorcerous duel.

name: Gudul Lurker
text: The small are mostly ignored by dragons.

name: Aven Tactician
text: The aven are admired, for they are able to fly with the dragons.

name: Learn from the Past
text:
"I've been told my whole life that the great Ojutai holds all knowledge, but I wonder what our forebears knew."
—Narset

name: Mirror Mockery
text: Who you are constantly runs toward who you will be.

name: Mystic Meditation
text:
"Still the mind and quiet the heart. Only then will you hear the Multiverse's great truths."
—Narset

name: Negate
text:
"You cannot be an Ojutai monk. They prize wisdom and skill, and you have neither."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Ojutai Interceptor
text: "Though I may soar, I could never fly as high as the dragons."

name: Palace Familiar
text:
"The most profound secrets lie in the darkest places of the world. It can be prudent to make use of another set of eyes."
—Sidisi, Silumgar vizier

name: Battle Mastery
text:
"There is elegance in all the Ojutai do—even their killing."
—Kirada, Silumgar enforcer

name: Reduce in Stature
text: A dragon learns humility only in the moments before its death.

name: Sidisi's Faithful
text: "I tire of your prattle, and your face."

name: Skywise Teachings
text: Ojutai's words must be translated from Draconic before his students can benefit from their wisdom.

name: Updraft Elemental
text:
"It slips through the smallest cracks in the mountain, emerging whole and unfettered. There is nowhere it cannot go, for what can hold back the air itself?"
—Chanyi, Ojutai monk

name: Youthful Scholar
text:
"Too dumb, and you end up a sibsig. Too smart, and you end up a meal. Mediocrity is the key to a long life."
—Mogai, Silumgar noble

name: Zephyr Scribe
text:
"Ojutai's rule has allowed Tarkir's monks to learn from the truly enlightened."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Blood-Chin Fanatic
text: "We are as brutal as our dragonlord. We strike like wild lightning and feast on human flesh."

name: Blood-Chin Rager
text: Kolaghan blades rarely stay clean for long.

name: Champion of Arashin
text: "The blood of Dromoka and the blood of my veins are the same."

name: Butcher's Glee
text: The Crave made Kneecleaver think she was bigger than the dragon.

name: Coat with Venom
text:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Corpseweft
text: Sidisi hated to limit her options.

name: Damnable Pact
text:
"Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Deadly Wanderings
text:
"Seclusion is only an option for the strong."
—Sorin Markov

name: Death Wind
text:
"I am a dragonslayer for Lord Silumgar. There is no dragon save him whom I fear."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Defeat
text:
"Wars are decided one life at a time."
—Gvar Barzeel, Kolaghan warrior

name: Duress
text: Sarkhan was eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he saw how lowly his old foe had become.

name: Dutiful Attendant
text: The dragon who eats the last head in the basket is entitled to the servant's.

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Serra Angel
text: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

name: Luminous Angel
text: "The spread of evil's destruction shall always be matched by the rise of the noble fallen."

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Angelsong
text: Clash of sword and cry of beast fall mute when angels sound the call to prayer.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Pacifism
text: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

name: Serra's Boon
text:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

name: Angelic Benediction
text:
"Even in single combat, I am never alone."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Icatian Priest
text: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow. Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

name: Serra's Embrace
text: The touch of Serra's angels bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Lord of the Pit
text: "My summoning begins your debt, Planeswalker."

name: Abyssal Gatekeeper
text:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Foul Imp
text: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

name: Daggerclaw Imp
text: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

name: Dusk Imp
text: Imps are just intelligent enough to have an understanding of cruelty.

name: Overeager Apprentice
text: Slow and steady may not always win the race, but at least it doesn't end up splattered on the walls.

name: Soot Imp
text:
"If one gets in your chimney, you're going to need a long wick and a barrel of bangstuff to get it out."
—Hob Heddil

name: Demon's Jester
text: They knock 'em dead, with or without the punch line.

name: Souldrinker
text: Don't drink and thrive.

name: Charging Paladin
text: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

name: Abyssal Specter
text: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

name: Cackling Imp
text: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Unholy Strength
text: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

name: Cruel Edict
text:
"Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Liliana learned the secrets she sought, but at a price that was etched on her fate.

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Ha, banishment? Be merciful, say 'death,'
For exile hath more terror in his look,
Much more than death."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Breeding Pit
text: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Corrupt
text: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Serra Advocate
text: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

name: Sustainer of the Realm
text: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
text: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

name: Grasp of the Hieromancer
text:
"There is power in abandon, but far more in control."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Precinct Captain
text: "In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."

name: Relief Captain
text: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

name: Aerial Responder
text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
text:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Youthful Knight
text: Idealism fits him better than his armor.

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Vision Skeins
text: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

name: Anointer of Champions
text: "Arise. You have been anointed by the light. Go forth and fight without fear, for you shall be victorious."

name: Windrider Eel
text:
"The best spot to hook one is right behind the gills."
—Rana Cloudwake, kor skyfisher

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: "Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Chandra's Outrage
text: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Excoriate
text: The demon had flown past the reach of Erebos's whip but not the point of the sun god's spear.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Stormblood Berserker
text: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

name: Sudden Demise
text: In the Skyfang Mountains, one misstep can mean the end of an entire clan.

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Hunter's Prowess
text: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Press the Advantage
text:
"Show your enemies as much mercy as they would show you."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Scute Mob
text:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Vines of the Recluse
text: "The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."

name: Woodborn Behemoth
text: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Dreadbore
text: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Obelisk of Grixis
text: Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Grixis Panorama
text: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

name: Beacon of Immortality
text: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "We are not an empire, and I am not a queen. But I speak with the shout of the rivers and the whisper of the clinging mist."

name: Threads of Disloyalty
text:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Time Warp
text: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

name: Unsummon
text: Not to be. That is the answer.

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Bloodbond Vampire
text:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Coat with Venom
text:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Necropolis Regent
text: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

name: Vampire Interloper
text: He listens to every heartbeat, deciding which one of hundreds he will stop.

name: Vampire Noble
text:
"No emergency is so dire that it cannot be dealt with elegantly."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Mass Mutiny
text: "You too, Squib?"

name: Rush of Adrenaline
text: Scarecrows only go so far in sending the message to stay away.

name: Shared Animosity
text:
"It is the nature of souls that they burn more brightly together than apart."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"Ruhan would never agree to such terms."
—Ruhan of the Fomori

name: Borderland Ranger
text: "There's only one route from Kessig into Stensia. Unless you come with me."

name: Hunter's Prowess
text: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

name: Prey Upon
text: Nature exists in balance: river and jungle, sky and sea, predator and prey.

name: Soul of the Harvest
text: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Jungle Barrier
text: Within silent clearings guarded by living palisades, the natural world guards its most precious secrets.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Zealous Persecution
text: "Rejoice! Your vile blood will help fulfill our righteous cause."

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Quicksilver Amulet
text: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text: It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects: the creative sun, the sustaining sun, and the destructive sun.

name: Veteran's Reflexes
text: "Assume everything wants to kill you. At the very least, assume everything wants what's in your pack."

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Blatant Thievery
text: Centuries of association with the Sun Empire have taught the dinosaurs that shiny things are important.

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Siege Rhino
text: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

name: Rally the Ancestors
text:
"The family is a tree, and in times of need, every branch can be a weapon."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Ensoul Artifact
text: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Searing Blood
text: Purphoros's blessing: sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane. Always ablaze.

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Fertile Ground
text: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

name: Flourishing Defenses
text: Many horrors take the bait of brave elf volunteers walking alone, only to fall to the blades of rescuers lurking nearby.

name: Foundation Breaker
text: The castle finally got vengeance for enduring years of royally bad taste.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Assassin's Trophy
text:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

name: Sinister Gnarlbark
text: It is accompanied by the agonized squeals of faeries caught in its sap.

name: Everlasting Torment
text: When night fell, the plane itself was scarred.

name: Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons
text: Her subtle smile is suffused with venom.

name: Horde of Notions
text: Even the oldest treefolk was but an acorn when Lorwyn's first mysteries were born.

name: Kulrath Knight
text: Mounted cinders circle the blasted peak at Kulrath, hunting the Extinguisher.

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Risen Reef
text:
"No, not 'washed' ashore. It *walked* ashore."
—Shafring Hulm, beachcomber

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Vernal Sovereign
text: It is spring incarnate, its gentle warmth chasing away the last of winter's bite.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Grim Poppet
text: Beware a scarecrow bearing gifts—especially sloshing vessels of acid.

name: Timeless Lotus
text: Urza exploited nature to power his war machines; in time, nature exploited his war machines to renew itself.

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text: With a warm fire and a fresh catch, Temur hunters find respite in even the coldest climates.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Nesting Grounds
text: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

name: Opulent Palace
text:
"The people must know that the former seat of their oppression is cleansed. Throw open Qarsi's gates and let them see for themselves."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Riveteers Overlook
text: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text:
"The most important part of a stronghold isn't its armaments or its walls. It's the reason people have to defend it."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar captain

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

name: Springleaf Parade
text:
"Come into the light, strange one. All are welcome to bask in Eirdu's glow."
—Kithkin rite-leader

name: Dread Tiller
text:
"I told you not to build it with blighted wood."
—Lysh, kithkin wickersmith

name: Rain-Slicked Copse
text: A forest that never thirsts always flourishes.

name: Sodden Verdure
text: Lorwyn contains many such places: not bustling, not frenetic, but teeming with life in their own, quiet way.

name: Aberrant Return
text: Shadowmoor is rife with wild magic—powerful but as volatile as the plane itself.

name: Eventide's Shadow
text: Ajani's heart went out to those changed by the aurora's tides. Having selfhood ripped away was still a painfully familiar feeling.

name: Sinister Gnarlbark
text: It is accompanied by the agonized squeals of faeries caught in its sap.

name: Springleaf Parade
text:
"Come into the light, strange one. All are welcome to bask in Eirdu's glow."
—Kithkin rite-leader

name: The Reaper, King No More
text: Harrowed but still harrowing.

name: Dread Tiller
text:
"I told you not to build it with blighted wood."
—Lysh, kithkin wickersmith

name: Rain-Slicked Copse
text: A forest that never thirsts always flourishes.

name: Sodden Verdure
text: Lorwyn contains many such places: not bustling, not frenetic, but teeming with life in their own, quiet way.

name: Distant Melody
text: In far-off Shadowmoor, her kin lifted their heads to a refrain they could not hear.

name: Blowfly Infestation
text: Blowflies only infest corpses, but if none are available, they have no trouble making some.

name: Hoarder's Greed
text: No one asked the springjack what it wanted.

name: Necroskitter
text: A swarm ever grows in its wake.

name: Tree of Perdition
text: A haunted husk of bark, its cursed whispers linger on the wind.

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: "You, toadlet! Bring me a goblet of your bog's finest fire-slug slime!"

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Faeries trade trinkets for tales, growing their knowledge and his collection.

name: Fire Covenant
text: "No matter our differences, one thing we agree on: It ends in fire."

name: Arcane Signet
text: Eirdu's adherents invoke its blessings with jingling bells and dancing feet. Where there is joy, there is the warmth of the sun.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Isilu's adherents invoke its blessings with contemplation at sites marked by standing stones. Where there is quiet, there is the moon's inspiration.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Meadowlarks sing in sun-touched skies
And breezes kiss where Eirdu lies."
—Verselet of Lorwyn

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Wanderers creep 'neath dark moonrise
And wildness seethes where Isilu lies."
—Verselet of Shadowmoor

name: Command Tower
text:
"The Path of Flame is a flamekin's most personal journey. You must walk it for yourself, but you'll never walk alone."
—Zasharua, Brighthearth mentor

name: Command Tower
text: The boggarts' construction methods were chaotic and reckless, but the resulting tower became the envy of Rotbog warren.

name: Festering Thicket
text: Life is nothing more than decay postponed.

name: Vernal Fen
text: Shadowmoor contains many such places: not evil, not malevolent, but pulsing with something bitter and eldritch.

name: Shatter the Sky
text: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.

name: Aberrant Return
text: Shadowmoor is rife with wild magic—powerful but as volatile as the plane itself.

name: Black Sun's Zenith
text:
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Carnifex Demon
text: Every contagion has a host.

name: Dusk Urchins
text: They spawn from shadow, wreaking chaos until shadow claims them again.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Incremental Blight
text: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
text: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

name: Eventide's Shadow
text: Ajani's heart went out to those changed by the aurora's tides. Having selfhood ripped away was still a painfully familiar feeling.

name: Midnight Banshee
text: Many have heard the beginning of its low, sustained shriek but few the end.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Persist
text: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

name: Skinrender
text:
"Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Soul Snuffers
text: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Cathartic Pyre
text: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Smokebraider
text: "Be silent and listen to your inner fire. Only then can you walk the Path of Flame."

name: Bane of Progress
text: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

name: Changeling Wayfinder
text: No map. No complaints.

name: Clachan Festival
text: Unmatched in their harmony, the troupe took home the festival's trophy with a stirring rendition of "Dundoolin Downs."

name: Dose of Dawnglow
text: A lifetime of mischief gave way to a moment of tenderness.

name: Dream Seizer
text: "Every fae has their preference. Mine are the dreams most bitter and pungent."

name: Gloom Ripper
text: "I will not rest until I have excised the rot from this land."

name: Gnarlbark Elm
text: It greedily drinks boggart curses and returns their pain in kind.

name: Graveshifter
text:
We'll see a changeling at their funeral
—Kithkin saying meaning "they won't be forgotten"

name: Gutsplitter Gang
text: Known for being as ferocious in challenging each other for the first swing as they are against the enemy.

name: Iron-Shield Elf
text: Flamekin metalcraft saves many an elvish life but mortally wounds their pride.

name: Moonglove Extractor
text: Concentrating moonglove flowers into deadly moonglow poison is a revered but fleeting position for Lorwyn elves.

name: Crib Swap
text: Elsewhere in Lorwyn, nestled in a faerie ring, the coos of a small giant turned to cries.

name: Mornsong Aria
text: Maralen is more forgiving than Oona was, but her rule is no less absolute.

name: Nameless Inversion
text: Eclipsed realms are the spaces between Lorwyn's stability and Shadowmoor's chaos—raw and undefined boundaries where the plane naturally corrects imbalances in power and influence.

name: Nightmare Sower
text: The fae giggled and the nightmare took root.

name: Perfect Intimidation
text: Morcant's voice was as sweet as honey and as dangerous as moonglove.

name: Retched Wretch
text: "Told ya I taste terrible!"

name: Scarblade Scout
text:
"Areas of the Gilt-Leaf that carry scars of the Invasion are too unsightly for travel. They are to be marked and avoided."
—High Perfect's decree

name: Scarblade's Malice
text: The poison on their blades is nothing compared to the poison in their hearts.

name: Curious Colossus
text: Kithkin respect giants, but not usually from such close range.

name: Shimmercreep
text: It lurks near the borders, harvesting loose threads of wild magic where the planes meet.

name: Unbury
text: A well-aged boggart body is steeped in magics richer than any fae glamer.

name: Boldwyr Aggressor
text: During the Invasion, Clan Boldwyr's defense of their dolmens was legendary. Now they're more territorial than ever.

name: Boneclub Berserker
text: Bolstered by the cheers of his warren, Trugg was ready to make his appearance in Auntie Grub's tales.

name: Boulder Dash
text: It was the first year the downhill event had been included in the Frogtosser Games. It would also be the last.

name: Brambleback Brute
text: Her tangled cape grew with every village razed.

name: Burning Curiosity
text: Cinders are drawn to any heat, at any cost.

name: Cinder Strike
text: "If I am to gutter out, at least you will burn."

name: Elder Auntie
text: "Did nephew spit up again? Oh, good! Auntie needed to make a new batch of potions for the merrow market."

name: Enraged Flamecaster
text: He recognized the weapons of his brother who'd gone missing in elven lands. The heat of his grief could be felt for miles.

name: Explosive Prodigy
text:
"Intense flame, but malleable. The braiders can help you harness that heat."
—Senbrand, soulstoke mentor

name: Feed the Flames
text: Fire is always hungry and never picky.

name: Flame-Chain Mauler
text: In the fires below Mount Kulrath, artisans shape weapons designed to draw heat and extinguish life.

name: Flamebraider
text: "You seek guidance on your Path. Then let me provide it: What greater flame is there than the sun?"

name: Encumbered Reejerey
text: A merrow's value to their school is heavily determined by the wealth they're able to bring back.

name: Flamekin Gildweaver
text: Few flamekin have the patience necessary to weave goldenglow moth silk. Those who do are highly revered, and highly rewarded.

name: Giantfall
text: Bump went the giant. Gone went the hamlet.

name: Goatnap
text: Jealous of his sister's cloudgoat, the giant went to find the next best thing.

name: Gristle Glutton
text: "Crunch and crack! Gnaw and snap! Be the snacker or be the snack!"

name: Hexing Squelcher
text: "Finally, a place where the ingredients are as potent as my magics!"

name: Impolite Entrance
text: "We smelled you kith-twits makin' porridge in here! We love porridge! Give us your porridge!"

name: Kulrath Zealot
text: The Path of Flame brought him power at the terrible cost of his own identity.

name: Lasting Tarfire
text: What began as a rivalry between two petty marauders ended in a field soaked in tar, soot, and flame.

name: Evershrike's Gift
text: Their first encounter was luck. Their bond was fate.

name: Lavaleaper
text: Flamekin believe it knows the slopes of Mount Kulrath even better than they do.

name: Meek Attack
text: "Charge! Aim for the cuticles!"

name: Reckless Ransacking
text: Most thieves are silent and swift, leaving no trace of their crime. Noggles take a different approach.

name: Scuzzback Scrounger
text: The only metal polish he uses is blood.

name: Sear
text: Everything becomes kindling at the right temperature.

name: Sizzling Changeling
text: Burrenton's forges call to it, and it arrives whenever they need to be relit.

name: Sourbread Auntie
text: "C'mere you little urchins. Auntie's trying a new recipe, and I need some tasters."

name: Squawkroaster
text: As Sanar watched the tangle of chirps and flames run by, his eyes lit up. "I want one," he whispered.

name: Sting-Slinger
text: "The first step is to wuzzle the buzzers."

name: Tweeze
text: "Oh, come on, don't be stingy! You've got so many!"

name: Warren Torchmaster
text: Auntie Soot's raids begin when her torch is dipped in the oil atop her head and end when the flame burns out.

name: Assert Perfection
text: Some elves still cling to the old ways of treating outsiders.

name: Bloom Tender
text: Heart calmed by the beauty of the blossom, the dawnhand wondered who was actually protecting whom.

name: Blossoming Defense
text: To survive Shadowmoor's wilds, safewrights must carry an unassailable seed of beauty within their heart.

name: Bristlebane Outrider
text: Memories of oil and blood haunt her rides. She patrols kithkin lands driven by the fear of losing another doun.

name: Gallant Fowlknight
text: The thoughtweft amplifies any small bud of courage, turning fear to resolve and daring to heroics.

name: Chomping Changeling
text: The knight was irritated when her rations went missing and truly baffled when her weapons started disappearing too.

name: Crossroads Watcher
text: "Voices in the deep wood, and none of them familiar. Let's take a look, Squeakwing."

name: Dawn's Light Archer
text: "Archery is beauty in action. Your stance, your draw, your aim, and your release. All must be a single harmonious motion."

name: Dundoolin Weaver
text: Stitching a mind back into the thoughtweft takes time, artistry, and the faith of an entire clachan.

name: Formidable Speaker
text: Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, World Champion XXIX

name: Great Forest Druid
text: "Forget the elves, that meddling faerie queen, and those greasy machines. If you ask me, it's the generous who should be remembered."

name: Luminollusk
text: Its trail of wild magic attracts boggart aunties searching for the rarest ingredients in Shadowmoor.

name: Goldmeadow Nomad
text: "During my time on the road, the emptiness I felt after severing myself from the thoughtweft has faded with every story heard and every tale spread."

name: Lys Alana Informant
text: While they are no longer the dominant power on Lorwyn, elves still revel in looking down on others.

name: Midnight Tilling
text: The kithkin farmer awoke to find the crop ruined and a trail of rootprints leading into the forest.

name: Mistmeadow Council
text: "You've been hiding something. Everyone can tell."

name: Moon-Vigil Adherents
text: Adherents of the moon seek to lay claim over the entire plane and bring it under Isilu's domain.

name: Prismabasher
text: Driven by an unknown hunger, it charges from aurora to aurora leaving trails of wild magic in its wake.

name: Keep Out
text: "We don't want your kind round here."

name: Safewright Cavalry
text: They had survived battles and foes together. For the elf, there was no greater beauty than her cervin steed.

name: Spry and Mighty
text: No matter their size, strength, or demeanor, the brave stand side by side.

name: Surly Farrier
text: "I don't care what the others say. Luck left us during the Invasion. The only thing we can trust now is our own grit."

name: Tend the Sprigs
text: Newgrowns need love, attention, and fertilizer.

name: Thoughtweft Charge
text: United in mind, soul, and muscle.

name: Kinbinding
text: Kithkin are bound through the thoughtweft—mind to mind and heart to heart.

name: Unforgiving Aim
text: "I tend to my field of view like a garden. Occasionally, it needs weeding."

name: Vinebred Brawler
text: Once looked down upon, vinebreeders proved invaluable during the Phyrexian Invasion and soon became exquisite in the eyes of elves.

name: Virulent Emissary
text: "I could use a knife, but I'd miss that tremble under my fingers as the poison takes hold."

name: Wildvine Pummeler
text: Stinging roots of wild magic woke the giant in a very foul mood.

name: Abigale, Eloquent First-Year
text: The right poem lifts more than spirits.

name: Boggart Cursecrafter
text: "This bone is a good bone. Very angry. I can make lots of pain with this one."

name: Chaos Spewer
text: Only the most powerful boggart cursecrafters seek out veins of wild magic to fuel their vile hexes.

name: Chitinous Graspling
text: It had observed the twinkling object from afar, then found a form to sate its curiosity.

name: Deepchannel Duelist
text: "Bargain with ruthless cunning, and when all else fails, make sure you fight with the same."

name: Doran, Besieged by Time
text: "Each year that passes rots you with scars. Shelter your heart, for the world is cruel."

name: Dream Harvest
text: Faeries swarm to snoring boggarts like vultures to rotting meat.

name: Feisty Spikeling
text: As the changeling found its form, the innocent mischief in its gaze was replaced with daring ferocity.

name: Flaring Cinder
text: "Am I losing myself or realizing my true nature?"

name: Gangly Stompling
text: Having manifested in the grotto at diminutive size, it now reveled in the reverberations of its own heavy footfalls.

name: Glister Bairn
text: "We'll leave this one here and that one there. Then wait and see who comes to share."

name: Hovel Hurler
text: Giants love two things: sleeping, and getting rid of things that wake them up.

name: Kirol, Attentive First-Year
text: Kirol hated being a pawn in Morcant's game. If dawnglove was as potent as she suggested, it should be preserved, not used to tip the balance of power.

name: Lluwen, Imperfect Naturalist
text: "I know I belong somewhere—just not here."

name: Merrow Skyswimmer
text: "Only fools believe us bound to water."

name: Mischievous Sneakling
text: The changeling felt that the most important part of making new friends was the element of surprise.

name: Morcant's Loyalist
text:
"Despite recent alliances, we must never forget the ideals of perfection which define us."
—High Perfect's decree

name: Noggle Robber
text: Noggles have no concept of money, but they do have a high affinity for "shiny."

name: Prideful Feastling
text: Changelings are friendly by nature, but some forms carry ancestral memories of carnage and hunger.

name: Raiding Schemes
text:
"Keep enemies close . . . and elves closer."
—A tale of Auntie Wort

name: Liminal Hold
text: A reliquary is needed to pass through the eclipse safely. Without it, two warring selves will calcify into one.

name: Stoic Grove-Guide
text: Safewrights stationed within the Creakwood do not fear Shadowmoor's encroaching dark. They embrace it.

name: Tam, Mindful First-Year
text: "What are the odds? And what would you like them to be?"

name: Thoughtweft Lieutenant
text: He draws the threads of the thoughtweft tighter, turning it from cloth to armor.

name: Twinflame Travelers
text:
"Imagine the power of a flamekin and a rimekin united. Fervent passion confined by introspective insight. They would challenge every tale, rewrite every story."
—Ashling

name: Meanders Guide
text: In the silence of the Dark Meanders, she thought only of those still lost.

name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
text: She spoils the book before you read it.

name: Wary Farmer
text: "The only 'farmhands' I need are my own."

name: Chronicle of Victory
text:
"For those we lost, that they may forever live."
—Tapestry inscription

name: Firdoch Core
text: As Isilu drifted past in a swirl of shadow and moonlight, the strange, half-buried stones began to wake.

name: Foraging Wickermaw
text: It feeds on beauty others have left behind.

name: Mirrormind Crown
text: Forged in Velis Vel, swiped by a clever merrow, and sold to a curious kithkin.

name: Puca's Eye
text:
"I swear it watches me as I walk by."
—Toch, Ballynock sage

name: Moonlit Lamenter
text: Isilu's adherents mourn the dead, purging grief through keening rituals.

name: Springleaf Drum
text: To attain the preferred timbre for merrow shanties, the kelp leaf must be moistened with fresh water and struck with a fluid wrist.

name: Blood Crypt
text: The boggart was playfully prodding a critter when the skies darkened, then he gobbled it down with glee.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"I don't think we're going to make it back in time for Introduction to Prophecy."
—Tam, Strixhaven first-year

name: Hallowed Fountain
text: The merrow was vending her wares when the skies darkened, then she sharply raised her prices.

name: Overgrown Tomb
text: The elf was disgusted by the bramble before him when the skies darkened, then he stepped closer to observe the wild beauty.

name: Steam Vents
text: The flamekin was drawn toward warm laughter when the skies darkened, then she turned back to the lonely peak.

name: Temple Garden
text: The kithkin was admiring the flowers when the skies darkened, then they ripped up the roots for the next season.

name: Personify
text:
"I found myself wishing I could run away and start anew. That's when I saw those yellow eyes."
—Yenn, kithkin nomad

name: Protective Response
text: With no connection to the thoughtweft, kithkin nomads rely on guts, instinct, and each other.

name: Adept Watershaper
text:
"Once, a young merrow thought herself rather ordinary, but the river knew her name . . ."
—*Riverstone Tales*

name: Curious Colossus
text:
"She stepped and they screamed, the poor little mites, for they'd never seen a more frightening sight."
—*The Bigs and the Littles*

name: Adept Watershaper
text: "If even the simplest land-dweller can divert the river with no more than a shovel, just imagine what I can do."

name: Mirrorform
text:
"Quiet is beyond the night
Changeling, take my form tonight
Prove my life was not for naught
Changeling, see I'm not forgot."
—*Poems for Kith and Kin*

name: Reluctant Dounguard
text: Keeping others out of the doun is the only thing that motivates some to step outside their walls.

name: Meek Attack
text:
"Curiosity pulled at Auntie, she had to know. How many pokes do you need to take a toe?"
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Bloom Tender
text:
"Every day she tended the flowers, for the fey promised that upon the thousandth bloom, her lover would live once more."
—*The Fae's Cruel Prank*

name: Mutable Explorer
text:
"It had been to warrens and kithkin taverns, but found a home in the hidden cavern."
*—The Changeling's Search*

name: Riverguard's Reflexes
text:
"If you hire a riverguard for protection, go in with your best offer. They won't consider anything less."
—Cenna, ferry pilot

name: Boggart Cursecrafter
text:
"A boggart bone to say goodbye, a kithkin bone to make 'em cry."
—*A Boggartling's First Book of Curses*

name: Deepchannel Duelist
text:
"He flourished his blade, and the Wanderwine flourished, too. To this day, he's still felt in every current."
—*The Legend of Flynn*

name: Shore Lurker
text: "The Dark Meanders contain nothing but refuse and the trinkets other merrow have left behind. I'm on the hunt for something new."

name: Morcant's Loyalist
text:
"Bow to mother, get in bed / Rest your flawless hornèd head / Dream of wetting blades with red / And wake to fill our foes with dread"
—Lullaby for perfect or better children

name: Thoughtweft Lieutenant
text:
" ... And so, we raise our swords when the time is right, for many swords make a single might!"
—*The Tale of the Hero of Kinsbaile*

name: Twinflame Travelers
text:
"Look to the sky and you can still see them together, searching for their perfect home."
—*Two Starfalls and Other Tales*

name: Hallowed Fountain
text:
"I like to bask and watch its beauty—a reminder that we can't control the currents, but can know how to swim across them."
—Sygg

name: Steam Vents
text:
"Consider water and fire. Enemies at first, but they join to make relaxing steam."
—Ashling

name: Blood Crypt
text:
"Remember, my little foragers, only bring me back finger bones. No toes!"
—Auntie Grub

name: Overgrown Tomb
text:
"Our ascension is rooted in our grief, but we must not express such an unsightly emotion."
—Trystan

name: Temple Garden
text:
"I planted these flowers as a wee lass. Oh how they've grown big and strong!"
—Brigid

name: Harmonized Crescendo
text: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

name: Spiral into Solitude
text: Paranoia can drive kithkin to isolate themselves. Then their neighbors begin to whisper, and their fears become true.

name: Mornsong Aria
text: Maralen is more forgiving than Oona was, but her rule is no less absolute.

name: Formidable Speaker
text: Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, World Champion XXIX

name: Abigale, Eloquent First-Year
text: The right poem lifts more than spirits.

name: Sun-Dappled Celebrant
text: Eirdu's adherents celebrate the sun on cold days and create warmth through spirited dances and revelry.

name: Dream Harvest
text: Faeries swarm to snoring boggarts like vultures to rotting meat.

name: Kirol, Attentive First-Year
text: Kirol hated being a pawn in Morcant's game. If dawnglove was as potent as she suggested, it should be preserved, not used to tip the balance of power.

name: Lluwen, Imperfect Naturalist
text: "I know I belong somewhere—just not here."

name: Raiding Schemes
text:
"Keep enemies close . . . and elves closer."
—A tale of Auntie Wort

name: Thoughtweft Imbuer
text: "Wear this, and you shall carry the might of the clachan with you."

name: Tam, Mindful First-Year
text: "What are the odds? And what would you like them to be?"

name: Mirrormind Crown
text: Forged in Velis Vel, swiped by a clever merrow, and sold to a curious kithkin.

name: Timid Shieldbearer
text: Fear is especially potent through the thoughtweft. A lone kithkin's panic can motivate a doun.

name: Tributary Vaulter
text: "Other species may spread across the land all they like, but the riverways and the skies above them will always be ours."

name: Kinbinding
text: Kithkin are bound through the thoughtweft—mind to mind and heart to heart.

name: Harmonized Crescendo
text: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

name: Wanderbrine Preacher
text: "Truly, I am sustained by the faith of my congregation."

text: Merrow nets snare struggling prey and panicking foe alike.

text: He wished for isolation, and Shadowmoor replied.

text: "It's hardly even a prank in Velis Vel. It's just the way things work here."

text: Adherents of the sun implore others to bask in Eirdu's light and expel darkness from the plane.

name: Glamermite
text: "And watch, my queen, he'll do as I please!"

name: Glen Elendra Guardian
text: "The home of the fae must be protected."

name: Glen Elendra's Answer
text:
"This is *my* domain, and *I* am its Queen."
—Maralen, fae ascendant

name: Gravelgill Scoundrel
text: "Cut the line and take the catch. Then find a little kith to snatch."

name: Harmonized Crescendo
text: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

text: You can't catch what you can't perceive.

name: Kulrath Mystic
text: "The difference between passion and anger is nothing more than who is in control."

text: If you stare long enough at your reflection, your reflection starts staring back.

name: Bark of Doran
text: A shield that makes the world tremble.

name: Pestered Wellguard
text: In silence, she cursed a thousand times the fact she'd been stationed near fae lands.

name: Rimekin Recluse
text: Rimekin were once flamekin who turned their heat inward following the horrors of the Invasion. They burn cold, choosing isolation as the path to preserve their flames.

name: Run Away Together
text: "You don't need to steal my dreams, my love. They are already yours."

name: Shinestriker
text: Its spines are highly prized among faeries for use as lances, but they're almost impossible to harvest.

name: Silvergill Peddler
text: "I should let you know, Longlake Clachan was very interested in that one, but I'm willing to entertain a better offer."

name: Spell Snare
text: Shadowmoor merrow swindle and steal not only for profit but for spite.

name: Stratosoarer
text: Wise travelers take advantage of the wind that always blows in its wake.

name: Summit Sentinel
text: No visitors make the ascent of Mount Tanufel without catching the eye of its rimekin guardians.

name: Swat Away
text: Some beings shouldn't be toyed with.

name: Tanufel Rimespeaker
text: "A single snowflake can trigger an avalanche. A single insight can do the same."

name: Temporal Cleansing
text: Careless fae become lost in dreamstuff too sweet.

name: Thirst for Identity
text: Within each rimekin rages an ongoing struggle for self-discovery and purpose.

name: Unexpected Assistance
text: In one breath, Abigale's mind turned from panic to poetry.

name: Wanderwine Distracter
text: Merrow glamers have disarmed many a foe when a shield has failed.

name: Wild Unraveling
text: As wild magic ripped into his arm, the path that was once so clear became shadowed by his own fear.

name: Auntie's Sentence
text: "Stop whining, elf. The rest of us can see that it's *perfectly* fair, heh!"

name: Bile-Vial Boggart
text: It took years to finesse his potion of necroskitter slime and bogslither teeth. Finally, *he* would prank the fae.

name: Bitterbloom Bearer
text: Petals burst in evening hours with flitting things so fickle and sour.

name: Blight Rot
text: The scratch became a sore, the sore became a wound, the wound became an infection, and the infection became a funeral.

name: Blighted Blackthorn
text: It bears a forbidden fruit.

name: Boggart Prankster
text:
"Fetch my bow! And an umbrella!"
—Edren, kithkin farmer

name: Bogslither's Embrace
text: Shadow creatures are untamable forces of nature—chaotic and hungry.

name: Creakwood Safewright
text: "I will endure grasping vine and prickling bramble to preserve even one flower."

name: Darkness Descends
text: Isilu's presence turned day to night, fellowship to suspicion, and neighbors against one another.

name: Deafening Silence
text:
"They have forsaken their vows. The edict of the Circle demands their voices be silenced."
—Syr Tasdale, knight of Ardenvale

name: Piper of the Swarm
text: "If it has ears, it will dance to my tune."

name: Reave Soul
text:
"Into amethyst, I pour
Envy's shadow, sorrow's gleam.
Lure the one whose scorn I bore
That I may hear one final scream."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Revenge of Ravens
text: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again. Her familiars quickly granted his request.

name: Smitten Swordmaster
text: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

name: Specter's Shriek
text:
"Imagine having your skeleton extracted through your ear, one bone at a time."
—Corliss the Wanderer

name: Tempting Witch
text:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Wicked Guardian
text: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors."

name: Faerie Guidemother
text: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

name: Witch's Vengeance
text: The hex swept through the village, its citizens falling one by one.

name: Barge In
text: The giant had heard of locks, but he had yet to discover a door he couldn't open.

name: Bloodhaze Wolverine
text:
"Build a moat. If we're lucky, it can't swim."
—Syr Branigan, knight of Ardenvale

name: Blow Your House Down
text:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch

name: Bonecrusher Giant
text: Not every tale ends in glory.

name: Burning-Yard Trainer
text: "For every scar I've received, I've given ten back."

name: Claim the Firstborn
text:
"The deal was struck and the favor had been done. And so, under the cover of night, the debt was paid."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Crystal Slipper
text:
"After the death of her mother, Cassia found that things that appear fragile can be very strong indeed."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Flutterfox
text:
"The white fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Embereth Paladin
text: "The king would die for the realm. I would not hesitate to do the same for him."

name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
text: "Courage is the only shield I need."

name: Ferocity of the Wilds
text: Knights who excel in tournaments sometimes underestimate threats beyond the realm.

name: Fervent Champion
text: 2018 World Champion Javier Domínguez

name: Fires of Invention
text: "Just tell us how many you want and get out of the way."

name: Fling
text: Giants believe that tossing redcaps at knights is the best way to deal with both.

name: Irencrag Feat
text: The greatest challenge isn't the stifling heat but the crushing weight of those who failed before.

name: Irencrag Pyromancer
text: "Fear of fire is a sensible instinct. If I were you, I'd be terrified."

name: Joust
text:
"Life is a tournament that rewards the bold."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

name: Fortifying Provisions
text: "To the king, to the Circle, and to the realm! And to not dying."

name: Mad Ratter
text: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

name: Merchant of the Vale
text: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

name: Ogre Errant
text: Knights kept returning from Ogre's Pass wearing nothing but bruises, so they decided to just pretend it was on their side.

name: Raging Redcap
text: Many tales of redcap terror begin with two simple things: bloodlust and stolen steel.

name: Redcap Melee
text: At first, Syr Fenwick scoffed when he saw his opponents for the final match.

name: Redcap Raiders
text:
"I admire their courage as much as I despise their savagery."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

name: Giant Killer
text: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

name: Searing Barrage
text: It emerged from the coldest depths of Lochmere only to face the fires of Irencrag.

name: Seven Dwarves
text:
"The gleam of rubies and my brothers and sisters by my side . . . what more could I want?"
—Brognold the Third

name: Skullknocker Ogre
text: The ogre crashed through the massive door. The winged folios scattered like frightened birds.

name: Slaying Fire
text: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.

name: Syr Carah, the Bold
text: "Duty and honor are reasons enough, but beating you will also be a pleasure."

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
text: A dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.

name: Weaselback Redcap
text:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

name: Glass Casket
text: Fate will decide whether it's a bed or a tomb.

name: Curious Pair
text: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

name: Edgewall Innkeeper
text: "Warmth. Safety. A fully-stocked larder. You'll find nothing like Edgewall Keep in the wilds, I promise you that!"

name: Fell the Pheasant
text:
"A keen eye and steady hand are essential for defeating most foes, including hunger."
—Syr Grenphire, knight of Garenbrig

name: Fierce Witchstalker
text: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

name: Flaxen Intruder
text: The middle blade was just right.

name: Garenbrig Carver
text: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

name: Garenbrig Squire
text:
"Find him a weapon as big as his dreams."
—Yorvo, lord of Garenbrig

name: Giant Opportunity
text: They look tasty, but best to plant them.

name: Insatiable Appetite
text: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.

name: Keeper of Fables
text:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Lovestruck Beast
text: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

name: Maraleaf Rider
text: They both hunger for battle.

name: Oakhame Adversary
text: The elves remember every secret path from the days when they ruled the realm.

name: Harmonious Archon
text: First among equals.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Rosethorn Acolyte
text: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

name: Sporecap Spider
text: After years of taunts and aerial assaults from Rankle's minions, the witches of Maraleaf Forest acquired new familiars.

name: Syr Faren, the Hengehammer
text: "Words are pointless. It's what you do with your hammer that counts."

name: Tall as a Beanstalk
text: He realized a bit late that he was supposed to *plant* the magic beans.

name: Hushbringer
text: "Let's begin this conversation again, and this time you will only listen."

name: Tuinvale Treefolk
text: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

name: Wildwood Tracker
text: "This one was wearing shoes made of glass. She'll be no ordinary prey."

name: Wolf's Quarry
text:
"The monster was gaining on them. Twice it had found them. There was only one place left to hide."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Doom Foretold
text: In the end, death usually has its way.

name: Escape to the Wilds
text: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

name: Knight of the Keep
text: "What good is loyalty to the crown if we are not also in service to those less fortunate? I fight for all of us."

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

name: Grumgully, the Generous
text: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

name: Improbable Alliance
text:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

name: Inspiring Veteran
text: "I fight for my daughter, who may not set foot on a battlefield for many years. Remember who you fight for."

name: Maraleaf Pixie
text: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.

name: All That Glitters
text: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
text: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

name: Savvy Hunter
text: None of the other villagers dare venture into the wilds, so she feeds the whole hamlet herself.

name: Steelclaw Lance
text:
"A traditional lance is fine for the Burning Yard, but in the wilds you need a nastier bite."
—Kenver, Embereth weaponsmith

name: Stormfist Crusader
text:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Wandermare
text:
"A good steed will carry you home. A great steed will carry you to glory."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

name: Deathless Knight
text:
"Headed to the wilds? Beware the dead riders who serve the Shadow Queen."
—Scalan, Edgewall innkeeper

name: Elite Headhunter
text: Nothing remains of his foes but the gripping story of their downfall.

name: Fireborn Knight
text: He endured the white-hot blaze of the Circle and the sweltering heat of the Irencrag, and he emerged victorious.

name: Loch Dragon
text: Despite its ferocity, its favor can be won with a gift of something it's never seen before.

name: Rampart Smasher
text:
"He has strength and courage—just way, way too much of both."
—Syr Faren, the Hengehammer

name: Resolute Rider
text: "Respect the wilds? Certainly. Fear them? No."

name: Thunderous Snapper
text: While humans hear only a deafening roar, the fae hear music of breathtaking beauty.

text: Some are annoyed by the constant ticking as they clean the cobbles, but to the castle custodians, there's no sweeter sound.

name: Crashing Drawbridge
text:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Gingerbrute

name: Mysterious Pathlighter
text: For good or ill, most fae can't resist meddling in the adventures of any knight they meet.

name: Henge Walker
text: Everything that inhabits Garenbrig is affected by the wild magic flowing through the Great Henge.

name: Inquisitive Puppet
text:
"The strings were gone, but he still felt the pull of invisible forces tugging at his mind."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

text:
"Don't let it fool you. Many of us got our first scars from Syr Nobody."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

name: Locthwain Gargoyle
text:
"As the traitor hurried across the courtyard, its eyes snapped open. It was time to pay the queen a visit."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

text: Syr Branigan always remembered to kiss his good luck charm, having lost his foot to wolverines the last time he forgot.

name: Prophet of the Peak
text: It frequently predicts imminent death by devouring.

name: Roving Keep
text:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Scalding Cauldron
text: "It's a witch's trick, this cauldron full of pain. I wouldn't dump it on any but the wicked."

name: Outflank
text:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Shambling Suit
text:
"The young squire gripped her sword as the clanking stranger emerged. It was no knight that had come to challenge her."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Signpost Scarecrow
text:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer

name: Sorcerer's Broom
text:
"Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies. The fae king smiled."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

text:
"Though long forgotten, the wheel continued to turn, spinning fate from a dusty attic."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

text: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.

name: Witch's Oven
text: The wafting smells are both scrumptious and suspicious.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Prized Griffin
text:
"I wrote these tales with a quill made from a griffin's feather. And the winning of that feather is quite a tale itself."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

text: Without Garenbrig's strength, the realm would succumb to the wilds.

name: Castle Locthwain
text: Without Locthwain's persistence, the realm would stagnate and die.

text: Every hero's journey starts somewhere.

text:
"If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it."
—Queen Linden of Ardenvale

text: Tempered by fire and united in virtue, the knights of Ardenvale fight with a single, unbreakable will.

text: The keen-eyed guardians of Ardenvale are ever on alert.

text: "This sword is Sunrise. The other is Dawn. They mark the beginning of my days but the end of yours."

name: Silverflame Squire
text: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

name: Oko's Accomplices
text: They function as everything from assassins to jesters in the name of their fae king.

name: Bramblefort Fink
text: No matter the cruelty of Oko's jokes, he's always guaranteed the sycophant's laughter.

name: Oko's Hospitality
text:
"My advisors recommend I let them eat you."
—Oko

name: Faerie Formation
text: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: Workshop Elders
text:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
text: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

name: Taste of Death
text:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least. Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Embereth Skyblazer
text: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"

name: Steelbane Hydra
text: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.

name: Thorn Mammoth
text: It will come to the defense of all wild things, from the shivering wren to the towering giant.

name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
text: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

name: Knights' Charge
text:
"By hoof, wing, or paw. For the realm!"
—Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
text: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

name: Trapped in the Tower
text: "At least up here I have some peace and quiet."

name: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
text: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: True Love's Kiss
text:
"Be careful, dear. Some people deserve their curses."
—Marawen, barrow witch

name: Venerable Knight
text: "May this blade guide you on your great journey, as it did me on mine."

name: Worthy Knight
text: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

name: Fervent Champion
text: 2018 World Champion Javier Dominguez

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"In the wilds, your true training will begin."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

name: Animating Faerie
text: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

name: Piper of the Swarm
text: "If it has ears, it will dance to my tune."

name: Slaying Fire
text: The purest virtue burns brighter than the sun and hotter than dragonfire.

text:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

name: Inspiring Veteran
text: "I fight for my daughter, who may not set foot on a battlefield for many years. Remember who you fight for."

name: Ardenvale Paladin
text: "Even when hope is but a small flame fighting the night, I will serve the absent king."

name: Corridor Monitor
text: Castle Vantress has no locks on its doors, but interlopers rarely make it past the foyer.

name: Didn't Say Please
text: "If you're in our home, we expect you to mind your manners."

name: Faerie Vandal
text: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

name: Frogify
text: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.

name: Gadwick, the Wizened
text: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.

name: Ardenvale Tactician
text: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

name: Into the Story
text: The boundary between real and imaginary is as thin as the page, and just as easily torn.

name: Merfolk Secretkeeper
text: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

name: Mirrormade
text:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper

name: Mistford River Turtle
text: The fae raised the turtle from a tiny hatchling. They taught it whom to ferry—and whom to drown.

name: Moonlit Scavengers
text: They comb the shallows of Lochmere for relics of a bygone era. And if they happen upon a lone traveler, all the better.

name: Mystical Dispute
text: "Poor, lost mage. Your feet are on land, yet you're in over your head, aren't you?"

name: Opt
text:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Bartered Cow
text: At the market, no one heeded Hilda's frantic mooing. The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.

name: Run Away Together
text:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

name: Sage of the Falls
text: Ask a merfolk even a simple question and the answer is a journey far beyond the known.

name: So Tiny
text: His sword sounded like a silver chime on the glass jar, and the sprite laughed with delight.

name: Steelgaze Griffin
text:
"If we didn't guard our secrets, they wouldn't remain secrets for long."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Stolen by the Fae
text: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

name: Tome Raider
text: "Humans are so forgetful. Every page I steal becomes a secret they can't remember."

name: Beloved Princess
text: Sometimes a gentle slipper can travel where an armored boot's been denied.

name: Unexplained Vision
text: Rowan and Will exchanged a baffled glance. Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?

name: Vantress Paladin
text: "Someone knows where the king is. They can't expect to keep it a secret from us."

name: Wishful Merfolk
text: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

name: Witching Well
text: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
text: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

name: Bake into a Pie
text: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

name: Barrow Witches
text:
"Taste the sweetness, breath for breath. Keep the balance, death for death."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Belle of the Brawl
text: Locthwain knights take pride in being the last ones standing in a fight or on a dance floor.

name: Blacklance Paragon
text: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

name: Bog Naughty
text:
"The faerie plucked an acorn off the ground. One knight's quest was about to come to a bitter end."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Cauldron Familiar
text: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

name: Epic Downfall
text: The dragon had a lot of things going through his mind that day. He didn't expect a sword to be one of them.

name: Eye Collector
text: "Lord Rankle will see you now—all he asks is a small token of tribute."

name: Festive Funeral
text:
"Even as we mourn the last, we look to the next with joy. Hopefully, my new suitor will bring the Cauldron home."
—Ayara, First of Locthwain

name: Forever Young
text: Those who say you only live once have never been touched by the Cauldron of Eternity.

name: Lash of Thorns
text:
"Another angry mob? When will they learn to leave me be?"
—Terryn, Edgewall outcast

name: Locthwain Paladin
text: "I will find the king if I have to ride from summer to winter and back again."

name: Lost Legion
text: Even death cannot diminish the persistence of the knights of Locthwain.

name: Malevolent Noble
text: He has slain a dozen witches, luring each with a promise of fresh children's bones.

name: Memory Theft
text: In the wilds, the ravens steal far more than baubles.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Plague Witch
text: "I can ail what cures you."

name: Prowling Pangolin
text: "Wait, are *we* the decoys?"

name: Sengir Autocrat
text: "The penalty for idleness is death. The penalty for disputing the penalty is death."

name: Sinkhole
text: High walls, a sturdy keep, a strong garrison . . . they made no difference. In a matter of moments, the city was lost.

name: Skulking Ghost
text:
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow guildmage

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Urborg Uprising
text: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Visara the Dreadful
text: "My eyes are my strongest feature."

name: Wake of Vultures
text:
"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'"
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

name: Wakedancer
text: Hers is an ancient form of necromancy, steeped in shamanic trance and ritual that few skaberen or ghoulcallers comprehend.

name: Battle Squadron
