text: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Burning Vengeance
text: Mist is the geists' sorrow. Wind is their pain. Fire is their vengeance.

name: Carbonize
text:
"There's no coming back from that."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Desperate Ravings
text: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fervent Cathar
text: "I'll put my sword down only to die. And I don't plan on doing that today."

name: Honden of Cleansing Fire
text: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.

name: Firebolt
text: "There's more where that came from!"

name: Flame Jab
text:
"Fire's out. Should be safe now."
—Gnarltrunk

name: Gamble
text: "What's the worst that can happen?"

name: Honden of Infinite Rage
text: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.

name: Kird Ape
text: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Humble
text: Through failure we learn our finest lessons in humility.

name: Orcish Oriflamme
text: The orcs' banner sends a clear message: "Stand against us and meet the same fate as the goblins."

name: Price of Progress
text: Enthusiasm can be tempered in the furnace of the earth.

name: Pyroblast
text: Water can be crushing, but it is predictable. Fire is always dynamic, its rage absolute and all-consuming.

name: Rorix Bladewing
text: In an attempt to restore pride to Shiv and to forge an undying legacy, Rorix traveled far to compete for glory in Otaria's Grand Coliseum.

name: Seismic Stomp
text:
"It is not in me to tread lightly."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Tooth and Claw
text:
"Don't spend long examining signs of its passage. That you find them at all means it's still close at hand."
—Varra, Warden of the East Road

name: Wildfire Emissary
text:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, vizier of Amiqat

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Ancestral Mask
text: "I pass to you all we have ever been. Go forth and become all we never could."

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Commune with the Gods
text: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.

name: Elvish Vanguard
text: "Our lives are woven together like the trees' branches over our heads, forming a canopy that protects us all."

name: Emperor Crocodile
text: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

name: Flinthoof Boar
text: Through the smoke and flames it hunts, sniffing out the panicked and confused.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Green Sun's Zenith
text: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Heritage Druid
text:
"Study the great spirits of our age and those of the past. Prune secrets from the branching traceries of our lineage."
—Twila, Gilt-Leaf archdruid

name: Honden of Life's Web
text: To the sorrow of all, its web became a net that strangled those who helped weave it.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Natural Order
text: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

name: Nimble Mongoose
text: One thread connected all the travelers' stories: the ferocity of the mongoose.

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Regal Force
text: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.

name: Seal of Strength
text: When does majestic become ominous?

name: Sentinel Spider
text:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
text: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: "Scholars seek to understand the way the world is. I wish to shape the world into what it should be."

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: "If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."

name: Werebear
text: To become is to understand.

name: Wirewood Symbiote
text:
"Let the wild in. Channel its strength."
—Freyalise

name: Xantid Swarm
text: When they land on you, all you can think about is tearing them off.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

name: Armadillo Cloak
text: "Don't laugh. It works."

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Mistral Charger
text: Some sky steeds break from the thundering herd to ride free on the open winds.

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Flame-Kin Zealot
text: Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.

name: Glare of Subdual
text: The righteous light of Selesnya is channeled through the devout, striking out to blind the nonbelievers.

name: Goblin Trenches
text:
"Even if we dislodge them, I fear these lands will never again yield crops."
—Kimmick, vanguard knight

name: Shaman of the Pack
text: To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.

name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
text: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

name: Thunderclap Wyvern
text: Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Monk Idealist
text: "Belief is the strongest mortar."

name: Vindicate
text:
"I have seen entire civilizations rise and fall. You mortals are but dust to me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Zealous Persecution
text:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Giant Solifuge
text:
"If you'd ever met one, you wouldn't ask me to justify the extra provisions for additional security."
—Lorref, caravan master

name: Ashnod's Altar
text:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

name: Mother of Runes
text: She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.

name: Emmessi Tome
text: It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Millikin
text: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Winter Orb
text:
"How could anyone survive this? There is some force at work that stifles even the will to go on."
—Naromin, veteran explorer

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Rally the Peasants
text:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"Find the dens of evil and flood them with light."
—Hulo, the Penitent Wanderer

name: Second Thoughts
text: It suddenly dawned on Jorin that farming was quite a noble profession.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Shelter
text: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

name: Ballynock Cohort
text: A kithkin's worst enemy is solitude.

name: Soulcatcher
text: "Their spirits walk the winds and fill my soul."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Unexpectedly Absent
text: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: War Priest of Thune
text: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

name: Welkin Guide
text:
"Those talons really dig into your skin, but it's better than being dropped."
—Rafiq of the Many

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Benevolent Bodyguard
text: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Control Magic
text: If you don't have the best toys, find the one who does.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Force of Will
text: "I alone determine my destiny."

name: Future Sight
text:
"Is the inevitable any less miraculous?"
—Veldka, wandering sage

name: Gaseous Form
text:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Giant Tortoise
text: In the coastal states of Jhess and Valeron, "tortoise" is a synonym for "stubborn."

name: Glacial Wall
text:
"There is no confusion as to the boundary of the archmage's territory."
—Ippin, master cartographer

name: Honden of Seeing Winds
text: To the sorrow of all, its winds found sin in the hearts of those who once learned from its wisdom.

name: Hydroblast
text: Fire can be savage, but it is fickle. Water is always true, its flow steady and world-shaping.

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Jetting Glasskite
text: The bolt struck with a flash, and there was a terrible sound, as of glass shattering, but the creature was unharmed.

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Coalition Honor Guard
text: Giving little thought to their own defense, they carried the flag that united their army.

name: Memory Lapse
text: What a lonely agony, the memory of memories lost.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Mystical Tutor
text: The student searches the world for meaning. The master finds worlds of meaning in the search.

name: Oona's Grace
text: Oona grants her favored subjects a dream from her own guarded heart.

name: Peregrine Drake
text:
"Always a welcome sight breaking through the clouds."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Phantom Monster
text: Is it an amalgamation of faded memories or the projection of a half-remembered dream? Neither answer offers any comfort.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: "You can't learn to enjoy life's amusements in the pages of books. You must seek them out in earnest."

name: Quiet Speculation
text:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

name: Screeching Skaab
text: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
text: "Virtue is an inner light that can prevail in every soul."

name: Serendib Efreet
text: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

name: Silent Departure
text: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

name: Sprite Noble
text: "By thorn and by stone, we will fight to see the day when beauty returns to this world."

name: Stupefying Touch
text: "A warrior without wit is simply meat."

name: Tidal Wave
text:
"The floor of the sea is paved with the shattered remnants of vessels that navigated its surface unwelcomed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Annihilate
text:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Elite Vanguard
text: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

name: Blightsoil Druid
text: "See the beauty in death: the clean white bones lying in the fertile soil and the brightly colored moonglove sprouting from the fell earth."

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Braids, Cabal Minion
text: "Home is where you can find a decent graveyard and strangers can disappear without awkward questions."

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Deadbridge Shaman
text: Ending her life won't end the infestation.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Entomb
text:
"I'll return once you've ripened."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Eyeblight's Ending
text:
"Those without beauty are Lorwyn's greatest tumor. The winnowers have an unpleasant duty, but a necessary one."
—Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"Organization is often undervalued but rarely unjustified."
—Frasio, royal archivist

name: Havoc Demon
text: A cry of pain as it enters this world. A chorus of screams as it leaves.

name: Honden of Night's Reach
text: To the sorrow of all, its dark reach grasped and crushed those who guarded its silent vigil.

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Lys Alana Scarblade
text: In beauty-obsessed Lys Alana, one cut of her blade means the difference between a high society feast and raking through the dungheap for scraps.

name: Malicious Affliction
text:
"Such an affliction appears to seek out the pure."
—Byro, plague doctor

name: Nausea
text: "Was it something I said?"

name: Nekrataal
text: His victims don't have time to feel despair.

name: Olivia's Dragoon
text: Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.

name: Prying Questions
text: What remained of the Lunarch Inquisition found new ways to extract confessions.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Don't get too comfortable in there."
—Liliana Vess

name: Ruthless Disposal
text:
"Do try to pull your weight, Geralf. I feel like I'm doing everything."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Skirsdag Supplicant
text:
"I can no longer stand by as these Skirsdag infiltrators rot the church from within. Even the Lunarch Council is compromised. What a fool I've been."
—Odric

name: Stromkirk Condemned
text:
"Blood from the vein is the finest vintage to accompany a feast of the mind."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Succumb to Temptation
text: "Restraint is for the meek."

name: Thraben Foulbloods
text: The famed hunting hounds of House Cecani continue to prove the quality of their pedigree.

name: Tree of Perdition
text: There will be no absolution.

name: Vampire Cutthroat
text: Not all monsters have tentacles.

name: Wailing Ghoul
text:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Weirded Vampire
text:
"Emrakul makes apparent those whom she has favored."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Whispers of Emrakul
text: Your thoughts are no longer your own.

name: Alchemist's Greeting
text:
"Impressive."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Assembled Alphas
text: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

name: Blood Mist
text: "Some claim that rage is a cloud that obscures thought and vision. But I can assure you—I've never seen with greater clarity."

name: Bold Impaler
text: Burning with hatred for Nahiri, the Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor with a collective fury not seen in centuries.

name: Brazen Wolves
text: With fewer patrols about, Kessig's roads have become prime hunting grounds.

name: Conduit of Storms
text: It strikes with the fury of a tempest.

name: Deranged Whelp
text:
"When you confront a wolf scorned by its pack, extra caution is the order of the day."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

name: Falkenrath Reaver
text:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

name: Furyblade Vampire
text: "Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."

name: Galvanic Bombardment
text: Geist-powered devices have no shortage of fuel.

name: Hanweir Garrison
text: "We're ready for anything!"

name: Harmless Offering
text: "Such an adorable face!"

name: Incendiary Flow
text:
"What's your plan?" Gideon asked.
"Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

name: Insatiable Gorgers
text:
"Drink deeply, for there is no tomorrow!"
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Make Mischief
text: A tidy desk is as good as an invitation.

name: Nahiri's Wrath
text: "You brought this upon yourself, Sorin!"

name: Otherworldly Outburst
text: A tiny crack is enough to open the mind to Emrakul.

name: Prophetic Ravings
text: "Keep your herons and shrews! You will find nothing in the moon, for the moon is a lie! It has told me so!"

name: Shreds of Sanity
text: A few gnawing thoughts can eat at the mind until nothing else remains.

name: Smoldering Werewolf
text:
"Never thought I'd see the day I'd be wishing to see just a plain old werewolf."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

name: Spreading Flames
text:
"Hang on. I'm just tidying up."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Stensia Banquet
text:
"We can't win a war on an empty stomach, can we?"
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Stensia Innkeeper
text: "The perils of the road, you say? Don't worry. You won't have to face those again."

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Weaver of Lightning
text: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

name: Bruna, the Fading Light
text: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

name: Backwoods Survivalists
text: Paranoia has driven some Kessig communities to hunt down anything—and anyone—that travels through their woods.

name: Bloodbriar
text:
"There is a sourness here that I don't understand. When the land reaches out to me, I hesitate to reach back."
—Nissa Revane

name: Clear Shot
text:
"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

name: Crossroads Consecrator
text: "May the steel of your blade match the steel in your soul."

name: Emrakul's Evangel
text:
"In times like these, be particularly wary of those who claim they can save your soul."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Emrakul's Influence
text: Hordes of Eldrazi and cultists swarmed over Thraben's defenses, and the members of the Gatewatch found themselves overrun.

name: Gnarlwood Dryad
text: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Hamlet Captain
text: "Bloodsuckers, howlers, monsters from the beyond . . . it doesn't much matter. I won't have to face them alone."

name: Kessig Prowler
text: In the wake of Emrakul, some werewolves' human forms were lost forever.

name: Noose Constrictor
text:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

name: Permeating Mass
text: Woodland geists concluded that Emrakul would be unable to warp the denizens of the forest if the geists got there first.

name: Prey Upon
text: The Somberwald has become a hunting ground for the Dronepack, the group of werewolves that have succumbed to the flesh-twisting power of Emrakul.

name: Primal Druid
text: "The power of the woods is only ever borrowed."

name: Shrill Howler
text:
"A werewolf's howl is terrifying, to be sure. But this . . . this was a chilling sound I somehow felt. I fear what will reply to it."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Somberwald Stag
text: Despite the reemergence of werewolves and the proliferation of Eldrazi, elk numbers in the Somberwald have remained steady.

name: Spirit of the Hunt
text: The bonds of the pack transcend time and death.

name: Splendid Reclamation
text:
"No matter how much a plane has suffered, there is a way to restore it."
—Nissa Revane

name: Springsage Ritual
text:
"Every evil destroyed is a strike against the enemy."
—Erold, Gatstaf springsage

name: Swift Spinner
text: Its web is woven so tightly that not even geists can avoid capture.

name: Tangleclaw Werewolf
text:
"What has long, flesh-rending claws and enormous, bone-crushing teeth?"
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Ulvenwald Captive
text:
"Even on a plane as dark as this one, nature will organize a defense against the unnatural."
—Nissa Revane

name: Ulvenwald Observer
text:
"I tell you, the trees were closing in! It's by the grace of the Heron alone that I made it out of the Ulvenwald!"
—Ricton, traveling merchant

name: Waxing Moon
text:
"Show them what it means to be the source of nightmares!"
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha

name: Woodcutter's Grit
text: The magic used by Kessigers is known for its practical applications.

name: Courageous Outrider
text: One silvery blast signaled that she wouldn't be arriving at Thraben alone.

name: Woodland Patrol
text: Each had seen friends and family taken by the corruption, so each carried an axe at the other's request.

name: Campaign of Vengeance
text:
"There is no saving this world, not anymore. But we shall be its bloody vengeance."
—Sorin Markov

name: Gisa and Geralf
text:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

name: Heron's Grace Champion
text: Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.

name: Mercurial Geists
text:
"Procedural misstep: provocation of geists for the purpose of yielding more energy can compromise containment units. Next action: clean up mess."
—Laboratory notes

name: Ride Down
text: The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads of cultists and horrors, opening the way for the villagers to flee Thraben.

name: Dawn Gryff
text: After facing so many horrors, the survivors of Videns parish couldn't comprehend the hope that the gryff represented.

name: Cathar's Shield
text:
"A leader can inspire courage, but it is the smiths and healers who truly keep hope alive."
—Thalia, heretic cathar

name: Cultist's Staff
text: The head of the staff doubles as a brand to anoint the newly inducted.

name: Field Creeper
text: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

name: Geist-Fueled Scarecrow
text:
"It'll keep the crows away. Works on neighbors too."
—Old Rutstein

name: Lupine Prototype
text:
"Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known. Can such genius be taught?"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Slayer's Cleaver
text:
"Don't stop chopping until the pieces stop wiggling."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

name: Deploy the Gatewatch
text: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

name: Thirsting Axe
text: Sometimes the weapon wields the bearer.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Nephalia Academy
text:
"May knowledge be our sanctuary."
—Yora, academy researcher

name: Drogskol Shieldmate
text: "I will join you so that you will not yet join me."

name: Faithbearer Paladin
text:
"I've seen cathars riding to battle without a hint of fear. Perhaps that is its own sort of madness."
—Esler, Havengul mercenary

name: Fiend Binder
text: She had not believed any shred of humanity remained in these writhing monsters until the twisted form of her partner appeared before her.

name: Geist of the Lonely Vigil
text: The flicker of candlelight and the echo of hymns told the villagers that the monastery wasn't truly abandoned.

name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
text: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

name: Give No Ground
text: "Get behind me!"

name: Guardian of Pilgrims
text: Immune to the physical warping caused by Emrakul, geists proved to be some of humanity's most important allies.

name: Ironclad Slayer
text: The best weapon is the one at hand.

name: Ironwright's Cleansing
text: "Impurities must be pounded out."

name: Lone Rider
text:
"Horse and rider are often of one mind."
—Ulda, Gavony Rider

name: Long Road Home
text: The person who finishes a journey is rarely the same as the one who starts it.

name: Lunarch Mantle
text:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

name: Peace of Mind
text: Not all minds touched by the Eldrazi turn to raging psychosis. Some simply withdraw from this world into memories of a better one.

name: Providence
text: There is power in prayer, regardless of who is listening.

name: Repel the Abominable
text:
"Fight for a better future, even if you may not live to see it."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Sigarda's Aid
text: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

name: Sigardian Priest
text: Many whose faith was destroyed by Avacyn turned to the only angel who remained true to humanity.

name: Spectral Reserves
text:
"My predecessors taught me of duty and commitment. It seems they have more to teach."
—Wendin, veteran cathar

name: Steadfast Cathar
text:
"The most resolute soldiers will press forward in the face of overwhelming odds."
—Gideon Jura

name: Subjugator Angel
text: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
text: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

name: Thalia's Lancers
text: "Let the points of our lances lead the way."

name: Thraben Standard Bearer
text: The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

name: Advanced Stitchwing
text:
"Improvement is a consequence of practice."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Coax from the Blind Eternities
text: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

name: Contingency Plan
text:
"Improvisation is for those who failed to prepare."
—Jace Beleren

name: Convolute
text:
"There's no sense arguing with insanity."
—Levana, Midnight Duelist

name: Displace
text: "I'll see you soon, Subjects 25 and 26. I've got a good feeling this time!"

name: Docent of Perfection
text: The time had come for him to share his findings.

name: Drag Under
text: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

name: Enlightened Maniac
text: "At last! Proof that it's not all in my head!"

name: Exultant Cultist
text: Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."

name: Emrakul, the Promised End
text: An enigma as vexing as life itself.

name: Fortune's Favor
text: Uncertainty has its own allure.

name: Geist of the Archives
text: After reading the final words, it turns back to the first page and begins again.

name: Grizzled Angler
text: "There's no question that these waters are treacherous, but if there's one thing I've learned in all my years of sailing . . ."

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Ingenious Skaab
text: Heads and shoulders above the rest.

name: Laboratory Brute
text: It keeps intruders out and experiments in.

name: Lunar Force
text: "Moonlight offers sublime warmth that brings me a comfort sunlight cannot provide."

name: Eternal Scourge
text:
"It has latched onto this place like an infestation. All efforts at eradication have proved futile."
—Yeter, Trostad villager

name: Mind's Dilation
text: Infinite wisdom cannot be contained within a single mind.

name: Scour the Laboratory
text: "The answer's in here somewhere!"

name: Summary Dismissal
text: "Let's start fresh, shall we?"

name: Take Inventory
text: A place for everything, and everything in its place.

name: Tattered Haunter
text: When the Nebelgast recedes, there are often stragglers.

name: Turn Aside
text:
"There are tides beyond those in the sea that are driven by Innistrad's silver moon. If you learn their patterns, you can channel them in fascinating ways."
—Tamiyo

name: Unsubstantiate
text:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

name: Boon of Emrakul
text: All around Emrakul, life re-formed in her image.

name: Cemetery Recruitment
text: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

name: Certain Death
text: Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.

name: Dark Salvation
text: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.

name: Dusk Feaster
text: The Voldaren lands remained well protected when Olivia's army marched from Lurenbraum Fortress.

name: Gavony Unhallowed
text:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Liliana's Elite
text:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

name: Markov Crusader
text: The surviving members of the Markov bloodline drove through a crush of horrors to reclaim their ancestral home.

name: Murder
text: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

name: Oath of Liliana
text: "I'll keep watch. Happy now?"

name: Evendo Brushrazer
text: "Progress always has a price."

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Pest Infestation
text: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Roiling Regrowth
text:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Skyshroud Claim
text: "Flowstone spreads, but new life spreads faster."

name: Splendid Reclamation
text:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn

name: Tear Asunder
text: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

name: Enthusiastic Mechanaut
text: "Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.

name: Escape to the Wilds
text: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
text: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
text: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

name: Planetary Annihilation
text:
"The better you understand how a planet is made, the better you understand how one is unmade."
—Ulix, Eumidian terrademolitionist

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
text: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Rakdos Charm
text:
"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

name: Wake the Past
text:
"Belong in a museum? I think we should let relics belong wherever they please!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

name: Windgrace's Judgment
text: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

name: Worldsoul's Rage
text: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

name: Coretapper
text: It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.

name: Empowered Autogenerator
text: Magic, unlike physics, has no unbreakable laws.

name: Lux Cannon
text: There are few problems that can't be solved by putting a hole in the world.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Horizon Explorer
text: Every world is a new garden.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Cabaretti Courtyard
text: So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Escape Tunnel
text: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Maestros Theater
text: Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.

name: The Mycosynth Gardens
text: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.

name: Moxite Refinery
text: Within moxite lies the ability for a ship's drive to pierce the Chaos Wall. Without it, the Edge becomes much smaller.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: Through sun and storm, across steppe and swamp, Storm Crane Monastery flies wherever aid is needed.

name: Razortide Bridge
text: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

name: Riveteers Overlook
text: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Rustvale Bridge
text: The path to strength is forged in stability.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Solar Array
text: Sothera collapses, but its light is not yet gone.

name: Silverbluff Bridge
text: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Surge Conductor
text: A conductor for an electric symphony.

name: Viridescent Bog
text: Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.

name: Eumidian Hatchery
text: Eumidians do their work knowing that only future generations will see it finished.

name: Festering Thicket
text: Evendo's microbial life swiftly adapted to metabolize the leaking star fuel, devouring it like any other nourishment.

name: Glittering Massif
text: Iridescent debris and chromatic chemical fires litter Kavaron with the beauty of destruction.

name: Radiant Summit
text:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Vernal Fen
text:
"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Insight Engine
text: With each iteration, the database grows closer to original thought.

name: Kilo, Apogee Mind
text: Both sculptor and sculpted.

name: Evendo Brushrazer
text: "Progress always has a price."

name: Planetary Annihilation
text:
"The better you understand how a planet is made, the better you understand how one is unmade."
—Ulix, Eumidian terrademolitionist

name: Horizon Explorer
text: Every world is a new garden.

name: Moxite Refinery
text: Within moxite lies the ability for a ship's drive to pierce the Chaos Wall. Without it, the Edge becomes much smaller.

name: Solar Array
text: Sothera collapses, but its light is not yet gone.

name: Surge Conductor
text: A conductor for an electric symphony.

name: Eumidian Hatchery
text: Eumidians do their work knowing that only future generations will see it finished.

name: Festering Thicket
text: Evendo's microbial life swiftly adapted to metabolize the leaking star fuel, devouring it like any other nourishment.

name: Glittering Massif
text: Iridescent debris and chromatic chemical fires litter Kavaron with the beauty of destruction.

name: Radiant Summit
text:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Vernal Fen
text:
"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The divine light of the Palatinate could be so cold. As she laid down her sword, she felt the sun's warmth in a different way.

name: Swan Song
text: In the end, the dying Illvoi clung to neither secrecy nor protocol. She cloudsculpted wings that she might live on in a spark of creativity.

name: Tezzeret's Gambit
text: Despite all the differences between the Edge and the Multiverse, people still spoke the language of greed.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Tezzeret grinned as he realized Mm'menon was right: he had much to learn.

name: Chaos Warp
text: The importance of using updated Pinnacle codebooks is a lesson learned only once.

name: Farseek
text: Eumidians live to change and be changed, ever increasing the complexity of the Edge. Each new world is a new perspective.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "Regrowth is as inevitable as the tragedy that necessitates it."

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"An ordered Sothera is a peaceful Sothera. Join the Strategic Corps today and proudly turn the gears of progress!"
—Pinnacle recruitment ad

name: Cloud Key
text: The advent of cloudsculpting ended the use of mechanical locks in Illvoi society.

name: Pentad Prism
text: Like the Astelli, born of consumed stars.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"All creation in a single point, the point of all creation in all."
—Sunstar loop-mantra

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"Sunstar hypocrites speak of peace but march to war. Only we sing truth."
—Xu-Ifit, osteoharmonist

name: Command Tower
text:
"Thus, the shattered half of the planet was named Kavaron That Is, and the capital was moved to Kavaron Before."
*—The Tragedy of Emperor Kavarus III*

name: Insight Engine
text: With each iteration, the database grows closer to original thought.

name: Fabled Passage
text: For many children, the wonder of their first warp is a lifelong inspiration.

name: Mountain Valley
text: The ice that grips Evendo hides a world coveted by both the Eumidians and the Καν.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: On the border of the Chaos Wall that separates the Edge from the Blind Eternities, creation itself still churns.

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Fumigate
text:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Organic Extinction
text:
"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Universal Surveillance
text: Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Night's Whisper
text: "They were all laughing at you after you left, you know. How will you make them pay?"

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Hammer of Purphoros
text: All the world is Purphoros's anvil.

name: Aftermath Analyst
text: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like...a lot more?"

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Groundskeeper
text: "While the church thinks in terms of legacies, others think in terms of eternities."

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Loamcrafter Faun
text: "Give me just a moment. I need to grow us a new bridge."

name: Dawnstrike Vanguard
text: "Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!"

name: Faller's Faithful
text:
"Death is a trick of the light. Snuff it out and discover immortality."
—Plummet Record 170.312

name: Gravblade Heavy
text: It's difficult to dodge a weapon that commands gravity itself.

name: Gravkill
text:
"Sing! When the Faller reaches the end of his journey, all things will arrive at the Zero Point. What is unending will persist through to the new creation and be ordered accordingly."
—*The Theorem Unending and Final,* Antiphon 6

name: Gravpack Monoist
text: Her food stores will run out before her fuel, leaving only her mechan gravpack to carry her remains to the Next Eternity.

name: Hullcarver
text:
"Sunstar thinking is too linear. While they fight head-on, we hit them everywhere else."
—Alpharael, Stonechosen

name: Hymn of the Faller
text: "Does truth lie in the void between stanzas?"

name: Insatiable Skittermaw
text:
"Redd's gone. And the chittering—it won't stop!"
—Decrypted log 3.88

name: Lightless Evangel
text: "You have been given great purpose. Your matter will feed the singularity."

name: Dockworker Drone
text: Eternity columns are the trade hubs of every solar system.

name: Monoist Circuit-Feeder
text: It does to ships what the Monoist faith does to stars.

name: Monoist Sentry
text: Monoists fight a war of attrition, knowing their victory is inevitable so long as they stay true to their faith.

name: Sunset Saboteur
text: "Lightsick fools. All suns eventually set."

name: Swarm Culler
text: The swarm lacked a natural predator, so the Eumidians became one.

name: Dual-Sun Adepts
text:
"You fight beside me as brilliantly as the dawn. I have nothing more to teach you."
—Master Iridiss

name: Temporal Intervention
text: It will not end any other way than this.

name: Tragic Trajectory
text:
"Rejoice, and know all will join you soon."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: Umbral Collar Zealot
text: "All things will fall to the Zero Point. By accepting this truth, my path is known and my fate is certain."

name: Virus Beetle
text: The Eumidian biotechs were delighted when a mutated malware gene devastated their systems. They'd encourage the trait, so long as future clutches could be contained.

name: Voidforged Titan
text: The voidforged lack the formal programming of other mechan. Instead, they are engineered to move in accordance with the hymn of the Immortal Faller.

name: Vote Out
text: Democracy is not always just.

name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
text: "They will call you a monster, but I call you worthy."

name: Zero Point Ballad
text:
"Beyond the supervoid, existence collapses into a singular point. We are all dead. We all live."
—Xu-Ifit, osteoharmonist

name: Bombard
text:
"Go back to your little war, sun-stooge! This here is *our* operation!"
—Kunthaar, Kav mine operator

name: Dual-Sun Technique
text:
"Haste begets blunder. Be patient, Aora. As the sun rises, you will yet earn your second blade."
—Master Iridiss

name: Cut Propulsion
text: When fighting Kav, always expect each action to have an unequal and opposite overreaction.

name: Devastating Onslaught
text:
"Adapt to this, you bug-eyed planet-squatters!"
—Admiral Scargruf, Kavaron Memorial Navy

name: Drill Too Deep
text: The rapacious appetite that ended their world became the only means by which the Kav could lift their civilization from it.

name: Frontline War-Rager
text: The Kav have more than ideology or profit on the line. They fight for a home.

name: Full Bore
text: The mining gear that crumbled their planet could also deal terrible damage to flesh.

name: Invasive Maneuvers
text:
"It saves a lot on ammunition. No, I'm not kidding."
—Captain Mayav, Kavaron Memorial Navy

name: Kavaron Harrier
text: Once the security for a moxite mine, now a ghost in a hollowed-out cavern.

name: Emergency Eject
text: "This is your captain speaking. Our eternity drive has ruptured. Light be with you all."

name: Kavaron Skywarden
text: Scavengers looking to steal from Kav mining sites rarely make that mistake again.

name: Kavaron Turbodrone
text:
"Safe? Buddy, the whole planet is falling apart, we don't have time for safe."
—Dorgan, Kav roboticist

name: Lithobraking
text:
A Kav landing
—Sotheran expression meaning "a bad time"

name: Melded Moxite
text: Only the most skilled matter shapers can imbue moxite with other raw energies, but the rewards are well worth the dangers.

name: Memorial Team Leader
text: Recover the treasures in Kavaron's memorial vaults—by any means necessary.

name: Memorial Vault
text: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.

name: Molecular Modifier
text: "Let's show those bugs our own style of splicin'."

name: Nebula Dragon
text: Legend says the first Regent Maximum was herself a dragon. She illuminated the void and gifted the Celestial Palatinate lightforging.

name: Orbital Plunge
text: The Kav pilot gleefully ignored his lander's collision warning.

name: Oreplate Pangolin
text: It wasn't the most efficient design, but the miners refused to part with "Ol' Pangy."

name: Pain for All
text: The agony that consumed him also gave him clarity of purpose.

name: Plasma Bolt
text: Excess energy from the moxite core is focused into a destructive ray of plasma.

name: Red Tiger Mechan
text: While the Kavaron tiger has been extinct for centuries, its renowned ferocity endures.

name: Remnant Elemental
text: Even until Exodus Day, those in power on Kavaron refused to acknowledge that the planet was trying to tell them something.

name: Rig for War
text: "We build our beamcutters to mince bedrock. Should slice a Eumidian hull with no issues."

name: Ruinous Rampage
text: Kav battle rhetoric teaches that there are no malfunctions on the battlefield, just equipment that need to be utilized differently.

name: Rust Harvester
text: It scrounges Kavaron's wasteland, unaware that its home can no longer support its purpose.

name: Exosuit Savior
text: "An Astelli once saved me just like this. I aspire to live up to their example every day."

name: Slagdrill Scrapper
text:
"Who cares if it rips the asteroid apart? We got what we needed."
—Viya, Kav moxite baron

name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
text: "We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."

name: Terminal Velocity
text: A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.

name: Terrapact Intimidator
text: "Your land, or my blades."

name: Territorial Bruntar
text: Some creatures have adapted to thrive in the unstable chaos of Kavaron That Is.

name: Vaultguard Trooper
text:
"Give everything and advance!"
—Kav naval motto

name: Weapons Manufacturing
text:
"Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation."
—General Tekvu, Kavaron Memorial Navy

name: Flight-Deck Coordinator
text: The hidden might of the Sunstar Free Company is its technical staff.

name: Zookeeper Mechan
text: Infinite Guideline's "Fauna from Sothera" exhibit proved popular. Unfortunately, the biological zookeepers kept getting eaten.

name: Biosynthic Burst
text:
Maybe in your next evolution.
—Eumidian insult

name: Blooming Stinger
text: Death never smelled so sweet.

name: Close Encounter
text: Many mistake terrasymbiotic philosophy as pacifism. They are rarely wrong twice.

name: Diplomatic Relations
text:
"We will not yield until the Eumidians relinquish our Kavaron Tomorrow."
—Official Kav diplomatic statement

name: Edge Rover
text: Charting the Edge, one scan at a time.

name: Focus Fire
text:
"We are the arrows of Sunsolde's Quiver."
—*Declaration of Fleet Purpose*, Axiom 2

name: Eumidian Terrabotanist
text:
To plant the seeds of the other is to cultivate the self.
—Eumidian aphorism

name: Eusocial Engineering
text: A harmonious production for a better world.

name: Frenzied Baloth
text: Not all species on Evendo welcomed the thawing of the ice.

name: Fungal Colossus
text: When falling shards of Kavaron shattered the icy shell of Evendo, the Eumidian seed pods were far from the only form of life awakened from slumber.

name: Galactic Wayfarer
text: Most say the Edge cannot be measured, but some will spend their lives trying anyway.

name: Gene Pollinator
text: Eumidians have engineered a device or species to manage every stage of terrasymbiosis.

name: Harmonious Grovestrider
text: Beyond the borders of Pinnacle space, alien worlds of untold wonder await.

name: Hemosymbic Mite
text: By stimulating violent behavior in its host, the mite scavenges the remains of prey much too large for it to hunt on its own.

name: Icecave Crasher
text: As warmth crept across Evendo, many long-dormant species grew bolder.

name: Icetill Explorer
text: "Come! Join me in the sun!"

name: Intrepid Tenderfoot
text: Narix felt their molt coming. Before taking a new form, they had to find what Evendo required of them.

name: Lashwhip Predator
text:
"Oh, look at the size of those petals! That one's eaten well this season."
—Bez, Pinnacle nature surveyor

name: Meltstrider Eulogist
text: There are no failures in terrasymbiosis, only lessons learned.

name: Meltstrider's Gear
text: Meltstriders are the bleeding edge of Evendo's frontier thaw.

name: Hardlight Containment
text:
"I have forgotten sleep in their prison."
—Korelaa, prison escapee

name: Ouroboroid
text:
"I've found a strange vine in the ice. Thawing for further analysis."
—Meltstrider log, final entry

name: Pull Through the Weft
text: "That which should not have happened is undone, and a new pattern takes its place."

name: Sami's Curiosity
text: Tannuk's gut warned of danger, but Sami forged ahead without heed.

name: Seedship Agrarian
text: Knowledge isn't found, but grown.

name: Seedship Impact
text: A new brood finds its home on the doorstep of another's.

name: Shattered Wings
text: The Eumidians sought to keep Evendo a gentle world—at any cost.

name: Skystinger
text: Eumidian thermal wands protect their new home as well as thaw it.

name: Tapestry Warden
text: Drix never leave their worlds defenseless.

name: Honor
text: "With this mantle, you carry the duty to spread light, liberty, and the grace of Taman IV to the stars."

name: Terrasymbiosis
text: For Eumidians, terraforming and evolution are one and the same. They grow as their planet grows, in lockstep coexistence.

name: Thawbringer
text: "We are as ice," their mentor once told them, "Destined to shed our rigid form and nourish the grounds with our melting."

name: Alpharael, Dreaming Acolyte
text: "I am worthy of the Faller's blessing. I can prove it."

name: Biomechan Engineer
text: "Life is a pattern, not a material."

name: Biotech Specialist
text: "Modify these alleles and try again."

name: Cosmogoyf
text:
>Alert: COSMOGOYF
>Recommended Action: RUN
—PSS *Erix* shipboard computer, final transmission

name: Genemorph Imago
text: "We can all be more than we are. Let me help."

name: Haliya, Ascendant Cadet
text: "By the eternal and everflowing light, I swear myself to this cause."

name: Honored Knight-Captain
text: "Hope can never fade so long as there's a hand to carry my sword when I fall."

name: Mm'menon, Uthros Exile
text:
"What crime did you commit that makes *me* your best option?"
—Tezzeret

name: Mutinous Massacre
text: Kavaron's degradation poisoned many hearts, which the Monoists were happy to exploit.

name: Sami, Ship's Engineer
text: Whenever Sami was down on their luck, they returned to an old comfort: the clinks and clanks of tinkering.

name: Sami, Wildcat Captain
text: "The hard way it is."

name: Seedship Broodtender
text: "Inspiration blossoms from fertile rot."

name: Singularity Rupture
text:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: Space-Time Anomaly
text: The howling winds could hardly be heard over the maddening thoughts of the godcore.

name: Knight Luminary
text: "I thank you that I do not shine alone."

name: Station Monitor
text: "Keeping tabs on a whole station is too much for just one."

name: Syr Vondam, the Lucent
text: A new dawn, burning away the darkness.

name: Tannuk, Memorial Ensign
text: Serving in the Memorial Navy was nothing like the posters made it out to be.

name: All-Fates Scroll
text: For navigating that which was, is, and will be.

name: Bygone Colossus
text: The Edge is littered with the vestiges of civilizations annihilated by the Eldrazi.

name: Chrome Companion
text: Liberation Station's morale greatly improved after Rover took up residence.

name: Dauntless Scrapbot
text: The wastelands of yesterday's colonies will pave the road to tomorrow's.

name: Lightstall Inquisitor
text: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

name: The Endstone
text: The future is set. The present remains uncertain.

name: Nutrient Block
text:
"What flavor do you want, Sami? Bland, dense, or vanilla?"
—Tannuk

name: Thaumaton Torpedo
text: A miniature star, replicating the mana-aether reactions in a sun's core.

name: Thrumming Hivepool
text:
"I'll never escape this rock, but I fear they will."
—Decrypted log 4.11

name: Virulent Silencer
text: Nano-infectant: A category-Phi substance, capable of infecting both organics and artificials. Weaponizing it is a war crime.

name: Breeding Pool
text:
"Log 1.4.778: Granove, a tropical moon teeming with endemic biota. A must see for any aspiring astrobiologist!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

name: Godless Shrine
text:
"Log 1.7.618: Starshadow, a relic of a culture lost to calamity. Its people were eradicated in a single day—but by what?"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

name: Sacred Foundry
text:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

name: Secluded Starforge
text: The heat of a sun condensed into a forge.

name: Stomping Ground
text:
"Log 2.5.325: A newborn moon, Aqqat still churns with the fires of creation. I'm eager to see what it will become!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

name: Luxknight Breacher
text:
"Only when a vessel is emptied of shallow ego may the depths of light flow in to fill it."
—Seraphus Chek, Sunstar poet

name: Watery Grave
text:
"Log 2.9.089: Lammuat, the cemetery moon of salvage and secrets. Could be profitable for those brave enough to plumb its recesses."
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

name: Haliya, Guided by Light
text: Beyond the edge of faith lies eternal hope.

name: Radiant Strike
text:
"The light does not ask permission to cut through the darkness."
—Mentor Ultimate, to Regent Maximum Taman IV

name: Starwinder
text: Those lucky enough to survive leave with greater perspective of their own importance.

name: Alpharael, Stonechosen
text: Beyond the the edge of devotion lies eternal ambition.

name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
text: "Tear away the rotten flesh of 'reality' and behold the pristine bones of Truth."

name: Possibility Technician
text: In desperate times, Kavaron's greatest minds strive to elevate their civilization.

name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
text: Beyond the edge of doubt lies eternal loyalty.

name: Mightform Harmonizer
text: "Some things are bigger than one's self."

name: All-Fates Stalker
text: "You again?"

name: Sami, Wildcat Captain
text: Beyond the edge of desperation lies eternal ingenuity.

name: Beyond the Quiet
text: At the end of all things, will you find redemption or rebirth?

name: Cosmogrand Zenith
text: "Perfection lies beyond ego. Only through service can you become complete."

name: Starwinder
text: Droplets from its breaching splash newborn stars across the void.

name: Devastating Onslaught
text: Life, in all its explosive emotion, is never shorter than when used as a weapon.

name: Nova Hellkite
text: Flickering through the space between chaos and weft, it glimpses cosmic truths.

name: Rust Harvester
text: It recycled malaise into exuberance.

name: Weapons Manufacturing
text: A welcoming farewell to new neighbors.

name: Terrasymbiosis
text: Advancement is found in the collision of chaos and order.

name: Cosmogoyf
text: To exist and be subject to its hunger are one and the same.

name: Mutinous Massacre
text: There is no blade sharper than betrayal.

name: Space-Time Anomaly
text: More worlds have been forgotten than any living being could know.

name: Secluded Starforge
text: Those who grasp for power might one day find it.

name: Hardlight Containment
text:
"I have forgotten sleep in their prison."
—Korelaa, prison escapee

name: Lightstall Inquisitor
text: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

name: Emissary Escort
text: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.

name: Moonlit Meditation
text:
"All is the hand that weaves the Fabric of Being. The Fabric of Being is All."
—*Drix Codex*, line 1

name: Scout for Survivors
text:
"We've received transmission! They're alive—just barely."
—Sunstar Free Company Mission Control

name: Sunset Saboteur
text: "Lightsick fools. All suns eventually set."

name: Zero Point Ballad
text:
"Beyond the supervoid, existence collapses into a singular point. We are all dead. We all live."
—Xu-Ifit, osteoharmonist

name: Memorial Vault
text: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.

name: Pain for All
text: The agony that consumed him also gave him clarity of purpose.

name: Terminal Velocity
text: A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.

name: Seam Rip
text: Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.

name: Frenzied Baloth
text: Not all species on Evendo welcomed the thawing of the ice.

name: Ouroboroid
text:
"I've found a strange vine in the ice. Thawing for further analysis."
—Meltstrider log, final entry

name: Biotech Specialist
text: "Modify these alleles and try again."

name: Singularity Rupture
text:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: The Endstone
text: The future is set. The present remains uncertain.

name: Thrumming Hivepool
text:
"I'll never escape this rock, but I fear they will."
—Decrypted log 4.11

name: Starfighter Pilot
text: "Brightstar-1 to FlightComm: Scopes are clear. The stars are yours."

name: Starport Security
text: "You are a suspect in an ongoing investigation. Do not resist apprehension."

name: Umbral Collar Zealot
text: "All things will fall to the Zero Point. By accepting this truth, my path is known and my fate is certain."

name: Pull Through the Weft
text: "That which should not have happened is undone, and a new pattern takes its place."

name: Singularity Rupture
text:
"Rejoice! For within sekhar, the final sacrifice, you will find passage to the Next Eternity."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: Emissary Escort
text: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.

name: Sunstar Lightsmith
text: She forges blades of incandescence and quenches them in pitch darkness.

name: Weftblade Enhancer
text: His people watched the Eldrazi rise and the Fomori fall. Never will they watch again.

name: Zealous Display
text: The Sunstar Free Company is not swayed by profit. Sunstar is their faith, the prism through which they cast light across Sothera.

name: Annul
text: "Your ship and crew have been contaminated by the great destroyers. We cannot risk their spread. Prepare for unraveling."

name: Atomic Microsizer
text: When packing for a stealth mission, it's important to fold your dimensions tightly.

name: Cerebral Download
text: All Uthros networks are routed through an ancient relic called a memory vessel, which converts data into thought.

name: Cloudsculpt Technician
text: A cloudsculptor at work is like a carefully balanced weather system, and just as dangerous to interfere with.

name: Auxiliary Boosters
text: An intelligent jetpack for those who find themselves lost in space.

name: Codecracker Hound
text: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

name: Cryogen Relic
text: Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.

name: Cryoshatter
text: Illvoi are masters of the deep freeze, though conditions must be perfect to avoid going to pieces.

name: Desculpting Blast
text: "Your atoms will serve my ambitions in a much more useful form."

name: Divert Disaster
text: Illvoi hope for the best outcomes but engineer for the worst.

name: Emissary Escort
text: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.

name: Gigastorm Titan
text: The shadow of the godcore falls over Uthros, and the world erupts with storms.

name: Illvoi Galeblade
text: Uthros guards have such rapid reflexes that it has led to rumors of experimental precognition.

name: Illvoi Infiltrator
text: Cloudkill agents slip in and out like a breeze.

name: Banishing Light
text: "Stygian demon! You are sentenced to ten cycles of illumination. May the light scour the shadow from your soul."

name: Illvoi Operative
text: The Uthros Combine's first question for any scientific breakthrough is always: "How can this be used to keep our next breakthrough secret?"

name: Lost in Space
text: Every so often, the Edge reminds you that there's always more to discover.

name: Mechan Assembler
text: Every iteration brings it closer to understanding its own creation.

name: Mechan Navigator
text: Illvoi temper their curiosity with caution, deploying mechan pilots before they risk mortal scientists.

name: Mechan Shieldmate
text:
"Do not mistake a preference for peace for an inability to fight."
—Yvin, Pinnacle envoy

name: Mental Modulation
text: Illvoi nervous systems are decentralized. Even as one part runs calculations, another might contemplate the depths of Uthros.

name: Moonlit Meditation
text:
"All is the hand that weaves the Fabric of Being. The Fabric of Being is All."
—*Drix Codex*, line 1

name: Beyond the Quiet
text: As the supervoid's photon collar washed over them, time stopped. Their souls would experience the grandeur of their demise for eternity.

name: Nanoform Sentinel
text: Cloudsculpting naturally led the Illvoi to other methods of reshaping matter.

name: Scour for Scrap
text: The Illvoi hunt for stellar fragments that predate even the Fomori.

name: Selfcraft Mechan
text: Sometimes the best parts are already in use.

name: Brightspear Zealot
text: "My purpose is my spear. My spear is my life. My life is for the Regent Maximum."

name: Steelswarm Operator
text: It harnesses energy from the brutal, mana-rich storms found deep within Uthros.

name: Unravel
text: Drix weftwalking requires neither eternity columns nor Pinnacle codebooks. But the art is ancient, and each passing is a leap of faith.

name: Uthros Psionicist
text:
"Log entry cycle 33,507: Tenuous perception of psionic activity emanating from Uthros's core. Nature: Nonlinguistic, fragmentary. Content: Isolation, apoplexy. It wants free."
—Uthros Combine research notes

name: Alpharael, Stonechosen
text: "All things end. I'd rather embrace that truth than the fantasy of eternal light."

name: Beamsaw Prospector
text: The Kav had learned their lesson about mining too deep. Zern Miffles had not.

name: Cosmogrand Zenith
text: Cosmogrands of the Celestial Palatinate always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.

name: Blade of the Swarm
text: The Eumidians sought the secret of weftwalking in Drix DNA. Though they failed, their attempts yielded other gains.

name: Comet Crawler
text:
"Found the stranded crew in an icy labyrinth. Well, what's left of them."
—Decrypted log 2.23

name: Dark Endurance
text: One last chance. Make it count.

name: Decode Transmissions
text: "You would kill the Faller—our messiah—and call *us* monsters?"

name: Depressurize
text: The Sunstar faith teaches of Perfect Void—of emptying oneself so that the light may fill the hollow. But in the void of death, its teachings bring little comfort.

name: Dubious Delicacy
text: It's an acquired taste.

name: Embrace Oblivion
text: "Join me in the Next Eternity."

name: Archon of Justice
text: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

name: Light from Within
text:
"Muscle does not make one strong. It only masks the soul's light. True strength lies in purity of purpose."
—Donal Alloway, cenn of Kinscaer

name: Crag Puca
text:
"Be happy when you see a puca shaped like mischief. It's far better than one shaped like death."
—Dindun of Kulrath Mine

name: Dominus of Fealty
text:
"Nothing is truly your own. It is his, whether you know it or not."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Inside Out
text: Seyden's temperament didn't take well to the puca's magic. Nor did his face.

name: Mirror Sheen
text: Even treefolk witches steer clear of the unpredictable woods near Glen Elendra. Spells refract off the glamer-polished trees and the eyes of lurking pucas.

name: Noggle Bandit
text: Noggles believe that they were the first race ever to walk Shadowmoor. They don't "steal." They just take back what's rightfully theirs.

name: Noggle Bridgebreaker
text: "It's always funny till someone gets hurt. Then it's hilarious."

name: Noggle Ransacker
text: Noggles live purely by what they can scavenge. There is not a single thing a noggle eats, wears, or uses that did not once belong to another.

name: Loyal Gyrfalcon
text: It's tethered not to keep it from fleeing but to keep it from eating everything in sight.

name: Nucklavee
text: It loathes all tastes but two: spells and flesh.

name: Riverfall Mimic
text: Mimics don't hide their natural form well, but their disguises work well enough on boggarts.

name: Stream Hopper
text: Like many who dwell in Shadowmoor now, he was robbed of his better half by the Aurora.

name: Unnerving Assault
text: The scales of battle rarely balance.

name: Canker Abomination
text: Once the hideous disease takes hold, it spreads through both bark and mind.

name: Cankerous Thirst
text: Nothing warms the bark on a chilly day like a draught of elf.

name: Deity of Scars
text:
"His skin cuts swords."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Desecrator Hag
text: Loose earth is not a burial but an appetizer.

name: Patrol Signaler
text: Many a keen-eared bogle has run afoul of a clever and silently orchestrated kithkin ambush.

name: Doomgape
text: It eats and eats until the juiciest morsel it can find is itself.

name: Drain the Well
text: Trows have learned that it's not wise to eat cinders without a bucket or two of water nearby.

name: Odious Trow
text: Trows are the vile trolls that lurk in the bogs of Shadowmoor. They reappear each night to frighten the living and gnaw the dead.

name: Quillspike
text: While it's true that a quillspike does heal the sick, it's just because it finds them tastier that way.

name: Sapling of Colfenor
text: Her plans may yet bear fruit.

name: Stalker Hag
text: Her hunt is silent until a bone snaps or flesh tears. Her victims never know to scream.

name: Recumbent Bliss
text: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

name: Woodlurker Mimic
text: A mimic's disguise fools its victims just long enough to draw them within range of its venomous tentacles.

name: Battlegate Mimic
text: Mimics don't need perfect disguises. They need only the perfect victims: the naive, the young, or the poor of sight.

name: Double Cleave
text: "When in doubt, kill 'em twice."

name: Duergar Assailant
text: Some duergars dismiss the world above as a fable. They react violently when their comfortable illusions are dispelled.

name: Duergar Mine-Captain
text: Duergars are prodigious workers with long memories. Some still fulfill intricately detailed orders given decades, if not centuries, before.

name: Spirit of the Hearth
text: Thieves know that a snarl in the night means, "Rob another house."

name: Fire at Will
text: "Make these shots count. The more foes we drop now, the fewer we'll have trying to kill us later."

name: Hearthfire Hobgoblin
text: Hobgoblins are best left alone. They sharpen their farm implements far more than is necessary for their work in the fields.

name: Hobgoblin Dragoon
text: The faeries snickered at first. A common hob in Oona's skies? But his lance ended their mockery, and now the sound of a cicada's wings brings a shudder to the faerie heart.

name: Nobilis of War
text:
"A great siege is a banquet to him; a long and terrible battle, the most exquisite delicacy."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Rise of the Hobgoblins
text: A river even the merrow dare not cross.

name: Spitemare
text:
"I knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom. Any attempt to leash or exploit it failed, and at terrible cost."
—Ashling

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Springjack Shepherd
text: "Better for a doun to lose its cenn than its springjacks."

name: Fable of Wolf and Owl
text: The forest grew fangs. The sky spread its wings.

name: Favor of the Overbeing
text: Enlightenment is the mundane seen from the vantage point of the divine.

name: Gilder Bairn
text: Do the glowing trinkets show it the way home, or do they set a twisted path for someone else to follow?

name: Groundling Pouncer
text: Endry was determined to teach his groundlings a few winged-faerie tricks.

name: Overbeing of Myth
text:
"She walks among us unseen, learning from our imperfections."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Shorecrasher Mimic
text: The Aurora replaced the changelings' innocence with malice and their curiosity with hunger.

name: Suture Spirit
text: Is her need to heal born out of compassion or penance?

name: Slippery Bogle
text: Bogles are very tasty if you can get the skin off. It's getting a blade on them that's the problem.

name: Snakeform
text: Losing his possessions distressed him, but the lack of limbs was strangely liberating.

name: Spitting Image
text: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

name: Trapjaw Kelpie
text: Travelers in these waters leave a bit of themselves behind.

name: Wistful Selkie
text: Selkies call to a sea they never swam, in a tongue they never spoke, with a song they never learned.

name: Antler Skulkin
text: Every skull has a tale to tell, and a skulkin is many dire tales cobbled together.

name: Fang Skulkin
text:
"Everything falls apart. But living things fall apart in the most fascinating ways."
—Mowagh the Gwyllion

name: Hoof Skulkin
text: It hunts with the memory of a long lost herd.

name: Banishing Knack
text: Suddenly he realized that everything was connected by invisible strings, strings that could be pulled—or cut.

name: Jawbone Skulkin
text:
"Ah, skull of shrew—a very potent substance. In powdered form, it gives thrice the zing of noggle hoof pulp."
—Boghald, Barrenton medic

name: Leering Emblem
text: The banner was not a symbol of victory, but a herald of the carnage to come.

name: Scarecrone
text: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

name: Shell Skulkin
text: Skulkins confer strange benefits on unsuspecting patrons.

name: Ward of Bones
text: Mages dare not attempt magic in its grotesque presence.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Cache Raiders
text: What the current doesn't take, they do.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Dream Fracture
text:
"Creation is a paradox. It hatches from its opposite."
—Olka, Mistmeadow witch

name: Ballynock Trapper
text: No matter how large or small, fierce or fleeting, the kithkin have a trap for it.

name: Dream Thief
text: Awylla's salvaged dreams would finally be put to good use.

name: Idle Thoughts
text: Inspiration strikes the uncluttered mind.

name: Indigo Faerie
text: "You should see your face right now."

name: Inundate
text: "For years, the landfolk have emptied their refuse into the waters. It's time to return the favor."

name: Merrow Levitator
text: He fancies himself a master thief, claiming to "steal the ground" from his victims.

name: Oona's Grace
text: Oona grants her favored subjects a dream from her own guarded heart.

name: Razorfin Abolisher
text: Once you have been marked by the merrow, you are not long for their waters.

name: Cenn's Enlistment
text: The more the scarier.

name: Talonrend
text: Change is a denizen of Shadowmoor as much as ouphes and noggles are.

name: Wake Thrasher
text: Anyone who thinks merrows have more brains than brawn has never been run over by one.

name: Wilderness Hypnotist
text:
