"I felt as if I were moving in brackish water, as if I were drowning, even though I knew I stood on dry land."
—Dindun of Kulrath Mine

name: Ashling, the Extinguisher
text: The Aurora had transformed her into a relentless force of destruction.

name: Creakwood Ghoul
text: Some eat the living. Some eat the dead. It eats the past.

name: Crumbling Ashes
text:
"I was there to watch my brothers' quenching. I drew the slightest warmth from their dying rage."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Lingering Tormentor
text: The bogeyman doesn't disappear when you close your eyes.

name: Merrow Bonegnawer
text: Banished to the Dark Meanders for hideous crimes, some merrows find a taste for the darkness . . . and the dead.

name: Raven's Crime
text: It plucks away memories like choice bits of carrion.

name: Smoldering Butcher
text: A cinder's axe bears no marks from parrying a foe's blade.

name: Soot Imp
text:
"If one gets in your chimney, you're going to need a long wick and a barrel of bangstuff to get it out."
—Hob Heddil

name: Soul Reap
text: Their thoughtweft carried Darial's last thoughts back to his doun. They sorely wished it had not.

name: Soul Snuffers
text: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

name: Syphon Life
text: Leeches never tire of feeding.

name: Talara's Bane
text:
"Your thoughts betray you."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Umbra Stalker
text: Don't venture into the darkness, lest it decide not to let you leave.

name: Chaotic Backlash
text: The concept of thoughtweft fascinates the Nighthearth cult. Imagine, bringing agony to an entire people by torturing just one.

name: Endure
text: The Aurora had lessened the kithkins' kindness, deepened their paranoia, and dulled their sense of pain.

name: Cinder Pyromancer
text: "If the whole world burns, I'll never grow cold."

name: Duergar Cave-Guard
text: Duergars who grow too large to live in the tunnels are sent topside to defend the entrances from intruders.

name: Fiery Bombardment
text: It kills two beasts with one thrown.

name: Flame Jab
text:
"Fire's out. Should be safe now."
—Gnarltrunk

name: Hatchet Bully
text: "It's not much for eating, but I think we can find somethin' to do with it."

name: Hateflayer
text: It has no safe side.

name: Hotheaded Giant
text: As he races the moon each night, he draws a glowing equator across the world.

name: Outrage Shaman
text: A boggart's mind is a tinderbox of volatile thoughts, hungry for a spark.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Puncture Blast
text: Gnarltrunk didn't remember having quite that many knotholes.

name: Stigma Lasher
text: The Extinguisher's curse lasted long after her departure.

name: Unwilling Recruit
text: Frorn didn't want to be kept, but he didn't want to be thrown back either.

name: Bloom Tender
text: Beauty is a seed, waiting to blossom under her capable hands.

name: Duskdale Wurm
text:
"Last time, it tore up the Wilt-Leaf, turned Mistmeadow into a mudhole, and made the river jump its banks. On the bright side, we were eating venison for weeks."
—Donal Alloway, cenn of Kinscaer

name: Marshdrinker Giant
text: When giants rise from their long slumbers, they rarely remember how fragile the waking world can be.

name: Hallowed Burial
text:
"I'd rather hear the screams of battle than the quiet that follows."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Monstrify
text: Gackt came to regret keeping his pet toads on his head.

name: Nettle Sentinel
text: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

name: Phosphorescent Feast
text: The boggarts gorged themselves until their bellies glowed.

name: Primalcrux
text: When nature is backed into a corner, just like its children, it lashes out.

name: Regal Force
text: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.

name: Savage Conception
text: Some beasts are born not of a mother, but of magic.

name: Swirling Spriggan
text: After its encounter with the spriggan, the patrol was red with anger, green with envy, white with fear, and painfully black and blue.

name: Talara's Battalion
text: The safewright Talara protects a delicate woodland waterfall. She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

name: Tilling Treefolk
text: He digs his roots into barren ground, searching for old seeds that never had the chance to sprout.

name: Twinblade Slasher
text: Righteous anger hones a humble soul.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Beckon Apparition
text: When a graveyard is full, the gwyllions rattle the tombs and unleash the spirits into the sky.

name: Bloodied Ghost
text:
"Only a knife left for a fortnight in the hollow of a ghastbark tree can inflict a wound so grave."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Divinity of Pride
text:
"She spoke of mystery and portent, of such unfathomable things that my mind screamed for pity."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Edge of the Divinity
text: The divinity's patronage confers both wicked grace and graceful wickedness.

name: Kithkin Zealot
text: The more his flock fears, the more power he wields.

name: Harvest Gwyllion
text: She speaks only in vile epithets, spitting out curses and obscenities that harm others just by the hearing.

name: Nightsky Mimic
text: A mimic need only touch a being to learn its shape, but touching usually leads to mauling and messily eating.

name: Nip Gwyllion
text: Once your life and all your worldly possessions have been surrendered to her, a gwyllion can be surprisingly civilized.

name: Pyrrhic Revival
text: They found themselves alive again, still bearing their mortal wounds.

name: Unmake
text: A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Stonewood Invoker
text: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

name: Voice of the Woods
text: The ritual of making draws upon the elves' memories and pasts. And elves have long memories and ancient pasts.

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Wirewood Herald
text: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

name: Wirewood Symbiote
text: It drinks fatigue.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Elvish Promenade
text: The faultless and immaculate castes form the lower tiers of elvish society, with the exquisite caste above them. At the pinnacle is the perfect, a consummate blend of aristocrat and predator.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Moonglove Extract
text: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

name: Slate of Ancestry
text: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

name: Elvish Eulogist
text: "No matter how adept our artistic skill, our effigies can never hope to capture the vibrant beauty of a living elf. Perhaps that is truly why we mourn."

name: Akki Coalflinger
text: No matter where you find them, goblins love rocks.

name: Clickslither
text: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

name: Emberwilde Augur
text: Legends say a djinn gave the goblins a gift they could never hope to master.

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Goblin Cohort
text: Akki shells provided good protection when downhill charging became headlong tumbling.

name: Goblin Matron
text: There's always room for one more.

name: Goblin Sledder
text: "Let's play 'sled.' Here's how it works: you're the sled."

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
text: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Reckless One
text: "Release chaos with me!"

name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
text: "I order you to volunteer."

name: Elvish Warrior
text: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

name: Skirk Fire Marshal
text: He's boss because he's smart enough to get out of the way.

name: Skirk Prospector
text:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Skirk Shaman
text: In a shaman's grimy hands, a concoction of dried Skirk Ridge herbs can become the face of panic.

name: Tar Pitcher
text:
"Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms. At the same time, her warren decided to share with her a sensory greeting of hot tar . . . ."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Boggart Shenanigans
text: Boggarts revel in discovering new sensations, from the texture of an otter pellet to the squeak of a dying warren mate.

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

name: Tarfire
text:
"After Auntie brushed the soot from her eyes, she discovered something wonderful: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Heedless One
text: "Channel your vitality through me."

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Seismic Assault
text: The flowstone seemed for a moment to assume Greven's rage—it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

name: Sonic Burst
text: Music scythes the savage beast.

name: Spellshock
text: A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.

name: Bequeathal
text:
"On my death, I give you this treasure: the knowledge that life is hard, yet too soon past."
—Dal funeral rite

name: Cartographer
text: How do you map a world when the land moves beneath your feet?

name: Crashing Boars
text: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

name: Elven Palisade
text:
"Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Elvish Berserker
text: Their fury scatters enemies like a pile of dry leaves.

name: Jackalope Herd
text: There's little more demeaning than getting your butt kicked by a bunch of bunnies.

name: Plated Rootwalla
text:
" . . . And the third little boar built his house out of rootwalla plates . . . ."
—Skyshroud children's story

name: Predatory Hunger
text: Hunger growls, never purrs.

name: Pygmy Troll
text: "Who you callin' 'shorty'?"

name: Rabid Wolverines
text: Is there any other kind?

name: Paladin en-Vec
text: "Our belief shall be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart."

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: Resuscitate
text:
"It is the art of convincing someone to live."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Rootwater Alligator
text: Subduing and skinning an alligator is the first rite of maturity adolescent merfolk must pass.

name: Skyshroud Elite
text:
"Civilization is a conspiracy to disguise the mutilation of nature."
—Skyshroud elite creed

name: Song of Serenity
text: Heartwood brings peace in great symphonies where dryads conduct the trees through every note.

name: Peace of Mind
text:
Three are the paths of the soul:
One out—roam across the plain,
One back—dwell with tribe and tent,
One in—turn an enemy's hate.

name: Wood Elves
text: Secure in the embrace of wood, they want no part of Eladamri's war.

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

name: Erratic Portal
text: "In Barrin's name!" cried Lyna as Hanna's sword passed through her, "Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!"

name: Medicine Bag
text:
"My medicine bag and I have treated countless wounds and illnesses. But never have I seen so many made so sick for so long. We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again."
—Orim, journal

name: Memory Crystal
text: Hues of recollection flicker like facets of a gem.

name: Null Brooch
text:
Give away everything so others have nothing.
—Brooch inscription

name: Skyshaper
text:
"It'll get us to the portal, but I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Spellbook
text:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Sphere of Resistance
text: A sphere pushes equally in all directions.

name: City of Traitors
text:
"While we fought, the *il* surrendered."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Reconnaissance
text: War favors the informed.

name: Shackles
text: Shackles of gold are still shackles.

name: Shield Mate
text: They bear weightier burdens than the shields they carry.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Soul Warden
text:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

name: Standing Troops
text: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

name: Treasure Hunter
text:
"What separates junk from treasure is imagination."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Zealots en-Dal
text:
"Great chains shall free our warriors."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Aether Tide
text: The tide of magic brought them here. Now it would take them home.

name: Cunning
text:
". . . Dry-walkers die
We feed on sweet flesh . . . ."
—*Rootwater Saga*

name: Curiosity
text: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

name: Cataclysm
text: The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

name: Ephemeron
text: From nothing came teeth.

name: Equilibrium
text: In Rath, there are only so many souls to go around.

name: Ertai, Wizard Adept
text:
"Was that *it*?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Fade Away
text:
"Consider the fable of the greedy herder. As her flock grew, so did her weariness; she slept, and the sheep wandered off."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Killer Whale
text: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

name: Mana Breach
text: The wizard had it all—until she tried to use it.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

name: Charging Paladin
text: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

name: Mind Over Matter
text:
Lyna turned to the figure beside her. "They're gone. What now?"
"As ever," said Urza, "we wait."

name: Mirozel
text: The mirozels are the only stars in Rath's opaque skies.

name: Robe of Mirrors
text: "Does this make me look fat?"

name: Rootwater Mystic
text:
"Read the roots tell the tale
Future forms in waving weeds
Higher than truth is hope."
—*Rootwater Saga*

name: School of Piranha
text: Some schools aren't worth getting into.

name: Scrivener
text:
"History is a potent weapon."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Thalakos Drifters
text: They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.

name: Theft of Dreams
text:
"Volrath stole everything there was of me."
—Takara

name: Convalescence
text: Selenia had hurt Mirri terribly, but injuries of the flesh could be treated. The wounds she had torn in Crovax's soul would never close.

name: Treasure Trove
text: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents over sleeping children.

name: Wayward Soul
text:
"no home no heart no hope"
—Stronghold graffito

name: Whiptongue Frog
text: Their favorite food? Wind dancers.

name: Carnophage
text: Eating is all it knows.

name: Cat Burglar
text: The *il*-Kor no longer roam the open plains, but they are still hunters.

name: Culling the Weak
text:
"The blood of the weak shall be the ink with which we scribe great Yawgmoth's glorious name."
—Stronghold architect, journal

name: Cursed Flesh
text: A farewell to arms . . . and feet . . . and legs . . . .

name: Dauthi Cutthroat
text: In their twisted logic, to empty the shadow world is to escape it.

name: Dauthi Jackal
text:
"All Dauthi are jackals, regardless of breed."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Exalted Dragon
text: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

name: Death's Duet
text: Life has always been a dance. It is only fitting that death sing the tune.

name: Fugue
text: "My ship . . . ," Sisay mumbled. "Intact," Gerrard reassured her, "which is more than I can say for you, my friend." Sisay laughed despite the pain.

name: Grollub
text: Mogglings caught in a misdeed often blame the grollub. Even though the creature is usually innocent, no taskmaster can resist an excuse to beat it.

name: Hatred
text:
"I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry. And still you will not have suffered enough."
—Greven *il*-Vec, to Gerrard

name: Nausea
text: Any mogg will tell you there's nothing more nauseating than the smell of cute.

name: Necrologia
text:
"My enemies' death yields threefold benefit: removal, reuse, and research."
—Volrath

name: High Ground
text: In war, as in society, position is everything.

name: Plaguebearer
text: Its respiration is your expiration.

name: Recurring Nightmare
text:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax

name: Scare Tactics
text:
"Fear rules those weak enough to accept it."
—Greven *il*-Vec

name: Thrull Surgeon
text: "Just take a little off the top."

name: Vampire Hounds
text: The hounds' barks are a horrifying chorus of screams, moans, and whispers.

name: Anarchist
text: "I'll take that. You won't need it when the revolution comes."

name: Cinder Crawler
text: The crawler doesn't care what gets in its way. It pushes everything into the boiling muck and waits for the meal to cook.

name: Dizzying Gaze
text:
"When I cut down my angel I only started my fall."
—Crovax

name: Fighting Chance
text: A stroke of luck can smite an army.

name: Furnace Brood
text: Furnace air crackles with magmatic cackles.

name: Mage il-Vec
text: Living below a flowstone foundry produces a disproportionate number of fire mages among the *il*.

name: Maniacal Rage
text: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

name: Monstrous Hound
text: "Stay."

name: Kor Chant
text: The true treasure no thief can touch.

name: Ogre Shaman
text: Ogre shamans must be bright enough to learn their invocations and dim enough to use them.

name: Onslaught
text: The last thing to go through the mogg's mind was its teeth.

name: Pandemonium
text:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Price of Progress
text: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

name: Raging Goblin
text: Volrath has bred them to fear only him. Are they charging into battle, or merely fleeing his wrath?

name: Ravenous Baboons
text: Build something and the baboons will tear it down. Leave the pieces lying and they will scatter them.

name: Reckless Ogre
text: There is no such thing as a regiment of ogres.

name: Sabertooth Wyvern
text: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

name: Carnophage
text:
"And in their blind and unattaining state their miserable lives have sunk so low that they must envy every other fate."
—Dante, *Inferno*, trans. Ciardi

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"Peace hath her victories
No less renownd than war."
—John Milton,
"To the Lord General Cromwell"

name: Ophidian
text:
"I will ... tell thee more than thou hast wit to ask."
—Christopher Marlowe, *Doctor Faustus*

name: Jackal Pup
text:
"Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war."
—William Shakespeare, *Julius Caesar*

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately."
—Henry David Thoreau, *Walden*

name: Soltari Priest
text:
"Fire is the test of gold; adversity, of strong men."
—Seneca, "On Providence," trans. Basore

name: Mogg Fanatic
text:
"As if his chest had been a mortar, he burst his hot heart's shell upon it."
—Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*

name: White Knight
text:
"When good men die their goodness does not perish, / But lives though they are gone."
—Euripides,
*Termenidae*, trans. Morgan

name: Black Knight
text:
"The chill, to him who breathed it, drew / Down with his blood, till all his heart was cold."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, *Idyls of the King*

name: Wall of Blossoms
text:
"Everything in Nature contains all the powers of Nature."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson,
"Compensation"

name: Fireslinger
text:
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Bottle Gnomes
text:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Sparksmith
text: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

name: Scragnoth
text: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

name: Smother
text:
"I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Whipcorder
text: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Silver Knight
text: Otaria's last defense against the wave of chaos threatening to engulf it.

name: Krosan Warchief
text: It turns prey into predator.

name: Lightning Rift
text: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Accumulated Knowledge
text:
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."
—Takara, to Eladamri

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Duress
text:
"We decide who is worthy of our works."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Counterspell
text:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Kird Ape
text: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text:
"They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred. Let them be cast out."
—Ailheen, Speaker of the Council

name: Arrogant Wurm
text: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

name: Armadillo Cloak
text:
"Don't laugh. It works."
—Yavimaya ranger

name: Terminate
text: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Chainer's Edict
text: The pits have their own form of mercy.

name: Astral Slide
text:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

name: Firebolt
text: Reach out and torch someone.

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun-and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Gerrard's Verdict
text: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Engineered Plague
text:
"The admixture of bitterwort in the viral brew has produced most favorable results."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: To the Krark Clan, every artifact has a trigger and a barrel.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Eternal Witness
text: Gaea needs no book to record every act.

name: Pendelhaven
text: The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.

name: Resurrection
text:
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more."
—War blessing of Serra

name: Wall of Roots
text: Root systems in Mwonvuli twist through currents of mana rather than soil.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Raissa transformed herself into a vessel for the Watchword Codex, allowing the arcane lore to flow through her body.

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Merrow Reejerey
text: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Wild Nacatl
text: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Leylines branch out from its foundation like roots from a tree. These draw mana from every region and welcome all living things into its verdant chambers.

name: Cloudpost
text:
"He watches from above. He watches from below. He watches from within."
—Inscription on Tel-Jilad, the Tree of Tales

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Rhox War Monk
text: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

name: Jace's Ingenuity
text: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Glistener Elf
text: "Beg me for life, and I will fill you with the glory of Phyrexian perfection."

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Pillar of Flame
text: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

name: Gitaxian Probe
text:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance

name: Despise
text:
"Truth is always a weapon in your enemies' hands."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Sin Collector
text: "That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Rakdos Cackler
text: Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.

name: Dimir Charm
text:
"Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to."
—Lazav

name: Warleader's Helix
text:
"There is no time to remedy our enemies' ignorance. Blast it out of them."
—Aurelia

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Encroaching Wastes
text: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

name: Dissolve
text: "You thought only the gods could stop you?"

name: Magma Spray
text: A stone hurled at an enemy is deadlier in liquid form.

name: Bile Blight
text: Not an arrow loosed, javelin thrown, nor sword raised. None were needed.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Ultimate Price
text: "He's paid his price. Now you pay mine."

name: Roast
text: The wave of lava seared cloth from skin, skin from flesh, and flesh from bone.

name: Anticipate
text: "You thought I wouldn't see that coming?"

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Hordeling Outburst
text: Kolaghan goblins rush into battle to satisfy their desire for violence as well as their desire not to be eaten.

name: Abzan Beastmaster
text: His beasts move the great siege towers of the Abzan across the endless sands.

name: Frost Walker
text:
"As the clans carved out their territories, we saw allies where the Mardu saw only obstacles."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Call the Bloodline
text: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

name: Clash of Wills
text:
"The mind of an Eldrazi is a puzzle that can never be solved. The trick is to make sure a piece goes missing."
—Jace Beleren

name: Smash to Smithereens
text:
"All these old relics have one thing in common. Every last one of them is made of smithereens."
—Zada of Slab Haven

name: Blighted Fen
text:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Inspiration comes in all shapes and sizes.

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Spatial Contortion
text:
"For those without the Planeswalker spark, the merest touch of the Blind Eternities can kill."
—Ugin

name: Flaying Tendrils
text: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

name: Noose Constrictor
text:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

name: Fortune's Favor
text: Uncertainty has its own allure.

name: Incendiary Flow
text: "What's your plan?" Gideon asked. "Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

name: Servo Exhibition
text: Impressing a judge is one thing. Delighting a child is another.

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Renegade Rallier
text: "This fight belongs to us all."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Always Watching
text:
"We pray to Avacyn on high.
On snow-white wings fearless you fly.
Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives.
May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Graveborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Headless Rider
text: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Lord of the Undead
text: "Do not weep at your defeat, my dear. In death, you will serve a greater purpose—mine."

name: Marchesa's Decree
text:
"Those who seize power must have the means to hold it."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Mutilate
text: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

name: Necrotic Hex
text:
"You foolish knights pound your breastplates and vow to fight until your last breath. As if that's when it ends."
—Tormod, the Desecrator

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Noxious Ghoul
text: Plague and death wrapped in one convenient package.

name: Open the Graves
text: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Soulless One
text: "Surrender your soul to me."

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text:
"Even swamps need sustenance. We will give it to them, and in turn, they will sustain us."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Undead Warchief
text: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

name: Vengeful Dead
text: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Withering Torment
text: Each spindrell is the lingering consciousness of a survivor consumed by cellarspawn—a ragged, drifting remnant pulsing with constant psychic agony.

name: Abrade
text:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Bitter Reunion
text: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Breath Weapon
text:
"My brother Thaedus's calculations were flawed. While correcting his work, I found that a dragon's fire breath can actually cover an area of—"
—Charred journal of Sophia the Cleverer

name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
text: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"Look, I don't know what happened. And I really wish I did, so I could do it again!"
—Tailpipe, Rocketeer

name: Chandra's Ignition
text: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

name: Count on Luck
text: "With your help, Loot, we're going to make a hell of an entrance," said Chandra. In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Angelic Field Marshal
text: Her presence on the battlefield can transform an unruly mob into a disciplined army.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Firespitter Whelp
text: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

name: Angelic Sleuth
text: Some crime scenes' secrets can only be discerned from an angel's-eye view.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Nogi, Draco-Zealot
text: "Glory to the Burning Ones! May their mighty fangs devour all foes!"

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Shivan Devastator
text: There were many reasons why Shiv was not high on Sheoldred's list of places to conquer: big, fiery reasons.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Terror of Mount Velus
text: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Tyrant's Familiar
text: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Bishop of Wings
text: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Bite Down
text:
"All the fancy spells and diabolical machines in the Multiverse are nothing compared to a good chomp."
—Vivien Reid

name: Carnage Tyrant
text: Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.

name: Challenger Troll
text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

name: Colossal Majesty
text:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

name: Curious Altisaur
text: After long days of squeezing through cramped tunnels, the Sun Empire's dinosaurs were overjoyed to stretch their necks and survey the wonders of the Core.

name: Dungrove Elder
text: All the trees of the forest are his army, and every leaf his shield.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Slaughter the weak ones. They are unworthy of the gift of *compleation*."

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Gigantosaurus
text:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Court of Grace
text: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

name: Hulking Raptor
text:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli

name: Ilysian Caryatid
text: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: "This forest is your birthright. From now until your final breath, you and Llanowar are bound. Keep each other safe."

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Monstrous Onslaught
text:
"Regards from Peema."
—Rishkar

name: Overwhelming Stampede
text:
"I trust the instincts of any beast over the advice of any human who presumes to be an expert in the art of war."
—Rinshel, elf insurgent

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Cut a Deal
text: The beauty of Valley is born from the differences between animalfolk, not despite them.

name: Pugnacious Hammerskull
text:
"I don't know whether it hates the mycoids or just loves breaking things. I say we leave it be."
—Samin, Oltec scout

name: Ram Through
text:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

name: Regal Imperiosaur
text: Initially frustrated by Muraganda's inconsistent biodiversity, Avishkari researchers made a breakthrough after mapping the plane's aetheric index—the wide variety of fauna was the result of raw magic, not evolution.

name: Ripjaw Raptor
text: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Day of Judgment
text: Clerics on both sides prayed for divine intervention to end the war. The gods didn't play favorites.

name: Steel Leaf Champion
text: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

name: Surrak and Goreclaw
text: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
text: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

name: Tamiyo's Safekeeping
text: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

name: Terrian, World Tyrant
text: The Fang Druids call it the World Tyrant, for it has consumed entire ecosystems that it keeps suspended in its core. To look upon it is to see the world as it was eons ago.

name: Thickest in the Thicket
text: No pain, no fame.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian

name: Unnatural Growth
text: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
text:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Dazzling Angel
text: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

name: Whiptongue Hydra
text: Its greatest asset is neither its sticky tongues nor keen eyes, but patience.

name: Whisperer of the Wilds
text: She speaks only in whispers but can be heard over the fiercest storm.

name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
text: "I can call an army to my side in the blink of an eye. Best not blink."

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: Some patriars pay massive sums for exotic pets that can give their posh, predictable lives an edge of danger.

name: Bontu's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Charcoal Diamond
text: The essence of night to harden the soul.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Defy Death
text: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers. "A fitting end," she murmured as she raised her sword.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Darksteel Juggernaut
text: One part unstoppable force, one part immovable object.

name: Dragonstorm Globe
text: Jeskai scholars fashioned devices to forecast the behavior of the dragonstorms.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Fire Diamond
text: The essence of flame to stoke the spirit.

name: Forsaken Monument
text:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Destroy Evil
text: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

name: Hazoret's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Infernal Idol
text:
"The courier's death was regrettable, but then again, she was warned not to touch it."
—Lord Xander

name: Marble Diamond
text: The essence of sunlight to brighten the way.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
text: Nevinyrral's final act of spite was to make sure all of his magic was destroyed along with him.

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Patchwork Banner
text: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.

name: Exemplar of Light
text: "I will not rest until you know peace."

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Rhonas's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall hone a strong body to endure the boundless energies of the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Scrawling Crawler
text: It spreads the machine gospel of New Phyrexia, its task incomplete until all surrender to perfection.

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Silver Myr
text: The myr are like quicksilver: malleable in function and adaptable in form.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Spire Golem
text: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

name: Exorcise
text:
"Strictly speaking, you can't kill what's already dead, but trapping and disintegrating it is pretty close."
—Garden, survivor technologist

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Castle Locthwain
text: Without Locthwain's persistence, the realm would stagnate and die.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Fateful Absence
text: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Foundry of the Consuls
text: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Witch's Clinic
text: Students from other colleges are invited to visit Witherbloom's medical facilities. Not many do.

name: Grasp of Fate
text: Few escape the Underworld. Fewer still escape fate.

name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
text: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Invoke the Divine
text: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: "You are not alone. You never were."

name: Giada, Font of Hope
text: "This city is my home. I will make it a place to be proud of."

name: Metropolis Reformer
text: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Search the Premises
text:
"To halt these lurid practices, Geralf must be found and made an example of."
—Inquisitor Delmund

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

name: Segovian Angel
text: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

name: Seraph of the Sword
text: "Only when my sword lies idle shall I rejoice."

name: Serra Avenger
text:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All,* canto 904

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: Some artisans spend their entire lives in pursuit of that one perfect creation.

name: Speaker of the Heavens
text: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

name: Starnheim Aspirant
text: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Thraben Watcher
text:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."

name: Vanguard Seraph
text: She guides expedition parties through the perilous floating ruins of Zendikar's ancient empires.

name: Wojek Investigator
text: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know . . ."

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: Under the cold light of Innistrad's moon, with singsong rhymes and haunting whistles, Gisa delights in raising the dead to do her bidding.

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: Memory Guardian
text: For the Guidelight Voyagers, there is no such thing as junk.

name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
text: A queen with no peer whose brood spans the sky.

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
text: "Impress me."

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Research Thief
text: The Futurists eagerly supplement their research with their rivals' closely guarded secrets.

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: Tamiyo's Logbook
text:
"We are opening a new chapter in the one true story of Phyrexia. Someone must record it for posterity."
—Tamiyo

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Tezzeret grinned as he realized Mm'menon was right: he had much to learn.

name: Thopter Fabricator
text: Every camera had a backup, and every backup had a backup, and every backup's backup had a backup, too.

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text:
"I have yet to discover a story that predates her. She may be as old as Ixalan itself."
—Huatli, warrior poet

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Vedalken Archmage
text:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
text: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: It has no respect for the deeds of martyrs, reducing their legacy to a mouthful of flesh.

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Cemetery Recruitment
text: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

name: Champion of the Perished
text: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

name: Consuming Corruption
text: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
text: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

name: Eternal Taskmaster
text: Sometimes she considered how much easier it would have been to stay dead.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Sire of Seven Deaths
text: Born of the infinite void between realities, the Eldrazi have one goal: to consume.

name: Beast-Kin Ranger
text: "We smelled you coming from a mile away, outsider."

name: Elfsworn Giant
text: He upheld his vow to the elves by watching their woods and blazing their trails.

name: Elvish Regrower
text: "There you are, little friends! You've been sleeping for a long time, but it's time to wake up now."

name: Felling Blow
text: "You are not welcome in Skemfar."

name: Needletooth Pack
text:
"Nature's greatest predators sometimes come in small packages. A lot of small packages."
—Vivien Reid

name: Preposterous Proportions
text: Their acorn hunt was unsuccessful, but they did find the wizard's experimental potion cache.

name: Exemplar of Light
text: "I will not rest until you know peace."

name: Quakestrider Ceratops
text:
"For the first time in all my travels, I've encountered a creature I can only describe as an apex herbivore."
—Vivien Reid

name: Treetop Snarespinner
text: The griffins think they rule the sky, but the spiders know better.

name: Anthem of Champions
text: Setessa is protected by four warrior factions, each named for an animal. United, they can repel any threat to their polis.

name: Ashroot Animist
text: "We will burn down the old growth of civilization and nurture what sprouts from the ashes."

name: Dreadwing Scavenger
text: It scours battlefields for corpses, consuming flesh and souls alike.

name: Elenda, Saint of Dusk
text: "You have learned nothing in my absence."

name: Felidar Savior
text: Cut and bruised from his climb to the summit, Zahr wept with relief when he saw the felidar's horns appear.

name: Koma, World-Eater
text: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
text: Ravnica's sharpest mind and its biggest ego.

name: Perforating Artist
text: The first three rows of the audience are marketed as the "slash zone."

name: Wardens of the Cycle
text: "The wheel turns, and what meets its end begins again."

name: Zimone, Paradox Sculptor
text: "Extraplanar geometry isn't so hard once you get used to thinking in twelve dimensions."

name: Leyline Axe
text: It awaits a worthy wielder.

name: Fleeting Flight
text: On that fateful day, Sir Brilbury's fear of heights was outmatched by his sense of duty.

name: Quick-Draw Katana
text:
"Draw swiftly, strike cleanly, and sheathe before the ground tastes blood."
—Munetsugu Takeno, *Way of the Samurai*

name: Ravenous Amulet
text: Each of its owners' final moments is remembered within the roiling stone.

name: Scrawling Crawler
text: It spreads the machine gospel of New Phyrexia, its task incomplete until all surrender to perfection.

name: Soulstone Sanctuary
text: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Authority of the Consuls
text: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

name: Cathar Commando
text: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

name: Guarded Heir
text: The fate of the kingdom is tied to her own. Until she's old enough to rule, her vassals will not leave her side.

name: Day of Judgment
text: Clerics on both sides prayed for divine intervention to end the war. The gods didn't play favorites.

name: Giada, Font of Hope
text: Now she is New Capenna's greatest hope.

name: Healer's Hawk
text: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

name: Make Your Move
text:
"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
—Teysa

name: Mischievous Pup
text: As far as the dog was concerned, anything that fit in its mouth was a toy.

name: Resolute Reinforcements
text: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Stroke of Midnight
text:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—*Tale of the Masked Maiden*

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

name: Hare Apparent
text: Most families have trees. His has an entire forest.

name: Aegis Turtle
text: On Ikoria, even the gentlest creatures are constantly evolving, outpacing tooth and claw with mighty natural armor.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Brineborn Cutthroat
text: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"The greatest victory is a battle unfought."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

name: Extravagant Replication
text: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Micromancer
text: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

name: Mocking Sprite
text: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"

name: Helpful Hunter
text:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: "I think you'll find my terms quite agreeable, if you know what's good for you."

name: Omniscience
text:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

name: Run Away Together
text:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

name: Self-Reflection
text: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Tolarian Terror
text: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

name: Bake into a Pie
text: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
text: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

name: Burglar Rat
text:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

name: Diregraf Ghoul
text:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Eaten Alive
text:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

name: Exsanguinate
text: "I didn't say I would help you find your way home. I said I would help you finish your adventure."

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

name: Macabre Waltz
text: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

name: Marauding Blight-Priest
text: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

name: Painful Quandary
text: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

name: Inspiring Paladin
text: As the line faltered, the thunder of hoofbeats heralded desperately needed aid.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

name: Pilfer
text: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"If none of the bones are original, is it even the same skele—aaagh!"
—Mort the Philosopher, last words

name: Rise of the Dark Realms
text:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
text: Unlike Innistrad's more ostentatious vampire families, Stromkirk vampires take pride in silence and subterfuge.

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Axgard Cavalry
text:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

name: Joust Through
text: "Allow me to offer a counterpoint."

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Brazen Scourge
text: Driven by an insatiable hunger, gremlins never cease feeding. They can destroy a lifetime of work in just a few moments.

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Fanatical Firebrand
text:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Firebrand Archer
text: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

name: Firespitter Whelp
text: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Arahbo, the First Fang
text: It's said all cats in the Multiverse trace their lineage back to him, from the meekest kitten to the mightiest lion.

name: Luminous Rebuke
text: The monstrous bird swooped in for the kill, only to be met by a concentrated blast of pure, searing moonlight.

name: Goblin Surprise
text: "Hey, your door's broken!"

name: Heartfire Immolator
text: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
text: Once a mortal ogre, Hidetsugu devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text: "Threats? Extortion? Good sir, you have me all wrong. I am a legitimate businessman; my colleagues and I are simply here to conduct legitimate business."

name: Seismic Rupture
text: The raiding party advanced on the lone figure, confident they had her cornered and helpless. Then she raised her hands, and the ground opened with a fiery roar.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Slagstorm
text:
"As long as we have the will to fight, we are never without weapons."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Spitfire Lagac
text:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Sure Strike
text: "Everyone has a weak spot."

name: Prideful Parent
text: One day, the future king will protect a pride of his own. For now, he defends his family from the terror of the swishy tail.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

name: Affectionate Indrik
text: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

name: Bite Down
text:
"All the fancy spells and diabolical machines in the Multiverse are nothing compared to a good chomp."
—Vivien Reid

name: Blanchwood Armor
text: Some armor is forged, some is forested.

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Serra guides our shots true. Also, I just tuned the cannons."
—Tiana

name: Dwynen's Elite
text: Call one, call them all.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Raise the Past
text: At Strixhaven University, learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Inspiring Call
text: "They said we were weak, did they? Let's show them what happens when we fight as one!"

name: Llanowar Elves
text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

name: Mild-Mannered Librarian
text: She had always believed in the transformative powers of great literature.

name: Nessian Hornbeetle
text:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

name: Skyknight Squire
text: Before Pashin could become the greatest skyknight in the kingdom, he'd have to survive his first flight.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Snakeskin Veil
text: Most travelers panic when they stumble upon the skin of a giant rattlewurm. Landry saw it as a gift.

name: Wary Thespian
text: Giorgio paced the stage anxiously. This was their final rehearsal, but there were still so many mistakes!

name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
text: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

name: Empyrean Eagle
text: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

name: Squad Rallier
text: Between the call of the bugler and the shrill squawk of her mount, not a soul slept through morning muster.

name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
text: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

name: Heroic Reinforcements
text: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Ruby, Daring Tracker
text: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Thousand-Year Storm
text: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

name: Adventuring Gear
text: An explorer's essentials in a wild world.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Campus Guide
text: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"

name: Gleaming Barrier
text:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Valkyrie's Call
text: "Welcome, worthy one."

name: Vanguard Seraph
text: She guides expedition parties through the perilous floating ruins of Zendikar's ancient empires.

name: Arcane Epiphany
text: For years, the tome pulsed with forgotten spells and secrets, hungry for a mind strong enough to read it.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Arahbo, the First Fang
text: The rumble of his roar is a call to the hunt.

name: Crystal Barricade
text: Ikoria's crystals glow in the presence of monsters, making them valuable as both defensive fortifications and warning beacons.

name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
text: "Have patience, brave one. Just as the sun returns each morning, I will be there to drive back the terrors of night."

name: Armasaur Guide
text: The armasaur was skittish about the lanterns, until it noticed the captivating dance of its shadow along the walls.

name: Archmage of Runes
text: He's so intent on his study that others think him frozen in place.

name: Raise the Past
text: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.

name: Skyknight Squire
text:
"Fly high. Fly true. Fly free."
—Skyknight's oath

name: Valkyrie's Call
text: Every warrior on Kaldheim aspires to a death so noble.

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Helle soared joyfully through the icy dawn. After hearing one thousand tales of her ancestors, she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

name: Archmage of Runes
text: The giants of Kaldheim have over two hundred runes for "squish."

name: High Fae Trickster
text: "You humans think even slower than you move. You don't realize you've already lost."

name: Homunculus Horde
text:
"To whoever left their homunculus experiment unattended: you will not be penalized if you come forward and tell us how to make it stop."
—Laboratory notice

name: Bigfin Bouncer
text: "You know how to swim, don't ya, chum?"

name: Lunar Insight
text:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher
