name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: "I sincerely regret that your place of business burned itself down after you declined our protection."

name: Omniscience
text:
"Knowing everything reveals not answers, but in fact their profound absence."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Refute
text: "What arrives uninvited, overstays its welcome, and is blown away with a single breath?"

name: Think Twice
text: "Hmm... I'm of two minds about this."

name: Abyssal Harvester

text: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."

text: Querana held the bridge for hours, her blade a shining blur that cleaved through rags and rotten flesh. But the horde kept coming.

text: She preys on Thraben's elites, known for their sophisticated taste.

text: Curiosity stopped keeping score.

text: The empire expanded hungrily, every bloody conquest seeding the ground with the corpses of all who resisted. One moonless night, the corpses rose to take back what was theirs.

name: Vengeful Bloodwitch
text: "Using blood to shed more blood— tell me that's not inspired!"

name: Zul Ashur, Lich Lord

name: Abrade
text: Selis entered the storm brimming with confidence. Her courage crumbled almost as fast as her shield.

name: Electroduplicate
text:
"What's a more fitting shape for a storm than a dragon?"
—Niv-Mizzet

text: The two heads occasionally disagree on trivial matters like who to eat first.

—Uriah the Smug, last words

text: "All matter returns to nature, in time. I just speed up the process a bit."

text: "Our home may have no walls, but it is far from undefended."

name: Ashroot Animist
text: "The land is my steed, and I am its champion!"

text: Sharp enough to carve a swath through history.

text:
"We will sow perfection into the soft flesh of the Multiverse."
—Argent Etchings, plate 38, passage 8

text:
"Start with small, careful steps. I've had customers accidentally jog themselves halfway across the continent in these things."
—Norris, arcane cobbler

name: Soulstone Sanctuary
text: Explorers mistakenly focused on the hands, not what they could be grasping towards.

name: Elementalist Adept
text: "Mana is all around us, ready to take shape. We need only reach out and guide it."

name: Arahbo, the First Fang
text: The rumble of his roar is a call to the hunt.

name: Crystal Barricade
text: Ikoria's crystals glow in the presence of monsters, making them valuable as both defensive fortifications and warning beacons.

name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
text: "Have patience, brave one. Just as the sun returns each morning, I will be there to drive back the terrors of night."

name: Raise the Past
text: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.

name: Erudite Wizard
text: "Pretty baubles and gilded palaces may appeal to the egotist, but true wealth comes only through knowledge."

name: Skyknight Squire
text:
"Fly high. Fly true. Fly free."
—Skyknight's oath

name: Valkyrie's Call
text: Every warrior on Kaldheim aspires to a death so noble.

name: Archmage of Runes
text: The giants of Kaldheim have over two hundred runes for "squish."

name: High Fae Trickster
text: "You humans think even slower than you move. You don't realize you've already lost."

name: Homunculus Horde
text:
"To whoever left their homunculus experiment unattended: you will not be penalized if you come forward and tell us how to make it stop."
—Laboratory notice

name: Lunar Insight
text:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher

name: Omniscience
text:
"Knowing everything reveals not answers, but in fact their profound absence."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

text:
"A face full of pollen? That's probably the nicest thing a faerie will ever give you!"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

text: When seeking spiritual enlightenment, best to go directly to the source.

text: It's said all cats in the Multiverse trace their lineage back to him, from the meekest kitten to the mightiest lion.

name: Crystal Barricade
text:
"Good as new!"
—Krek, daysquad captain

text: "I will not rest until you know peace."

text: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

text: At Strixhaven University, learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

text: Before Pashin could become the greatest skyknight in the kingdom, he'd have to survive his first flight.

name: Valkyrie's Call
text: "Welcome, worthy one."

name: Archmage of Runes
text: He's so intent on his study that others think him frozen in place.

text: To the High Fae, spells that take a human years to master come as easily as breathing.

—Liliana Vess

text: "The night sky is generous with its secrets. We need only learn its language."

name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
text: "This town swims with such exquisite blood. I will take every drop for my own."

text: "You've been a marvelous servant. Consider this your final assignment."

text: Her master gathered the bones to resurrect her, only to find her purring on the altar.

name: Electroduplicate
text: The dragon roared and the storm thundered back.

text: All at once, a quiet world was seized by wings, claws, fangs, and fire.

name: Searslicer Goblin
text: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

name: Twinflame Tyrant
text:
"Job only paid enough for one head. I'm out."
—Peren, veteran mercenary

name: Mischievous Mystic
text: "Don't worry about where they're taking me. The more pressing question is, why aren't they taking you?"

name: Preposterous Proportions
text: Their acorn hunt was unsuccessful, but they did find the wizard's experimental potion cache.

name: Anthem of Champions
text: Setessa is protected by four warrior factions, each named for an animal. United, they can repel any threat to their polis.

name: Ashroot Animist
text: "We will burn down the old growth of civilization and nurture what sprouts from the ashes."

name: Elenda, Saint of Dusk
text: "You have learned nothing in my absence."

name: Refute
text: "I said *no*!"

name: Koma, World-Eater
text: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
text: Ravnica's sharpest mind and its biggest ego.

name: Zimone, Paradox Sculptor
text: "Extraplanar geometry isn't so hard once you get used to thinking in twelve dimensions."

name: Leyline Axe
text: It awaits a worthy wielder.

name: Scrawling Crawler
text: It spreads the machine gospel of New Phyrexia, its task incomplete until all surrender to perfection.

name: Soulstone Sanctuary
text: By tradition, travelers touched the pillar for good luck. One day, it decided to travel as well.

name: Adamant Will
text: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

name: Ancestor Dragon
text: From emperors to paupers, every citizen of Shenmeng pays reverence to the mighty ancestor dragons.

name: Rune-Sealed Wall
text:
"If the giant, repelling wards aren't enough to keep out nosy visitors, the huge wall should help."
—Kastigan, reclusive runecaster

name: Angelic Edict
text: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

name: Bishop's Soldier
text: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

name: Deadly Riposte
text:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

name: Elspeth's Smite
text: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

name: Herald of Faith
text: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

name: Ingenious Leonin
text: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

name: Inspiring Overseer
text: The angels were determined to show a city run by demons that there was a better path.

name: Leonin Skyhunter
text: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

name: Leonin Vanguard
text: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

name: Skyship Buccaneer
text:
"It's a pirate's nature to be free of law. Gravity is no exception."
—Kari Zev, skyship captain

name: Moment of Triumph
text: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

name: Pacifism
text:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

name: Prayer of Binding
text:
"We do not make martyrs of villains. We leave them and their vile ideologies to be forgotten."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

name: Burrog Befuddler
text: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.

name: Cancel
text: "I decide what stands in my way."

name: Corsair Captain
text: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

name: Exclusion Mage
text: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

name: Into the Roil
text: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

name: Kitesail Corsair
text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Mystic Archaeologist
text: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

name: Opt
text: Teferi had once wielded the power—and hubris—of a god. To fix his mistakes, he would risk everything.

name: Quick Study
text: At first, Johann was annoyed that the library had decided to reorganize itself. But he had to admit that storing the cookbooks in the cauldron made a certain kind of sense.

name: Storm Fleet Spy
text: "They're searching in the same direction we are. And for the same thing, I'll wager."

name: Bloodtithe Collector
text: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

name: Cemetery Recruitment
text: To a necromancer as powerful as Liliana Vess, a graveyard is as good as a garrison of soldiers awaiting her command.

name: Strix Lookout
text: Wise. Watchful. Fashionable.

name: Deadly Plot
text:
"Open grave available, only one previous tenant."
—Sign on cemetery gate

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Highborn Vampire
text: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

name: Maalfeld Twins
text:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Moment of Craving
text: The vampires of the Dusk Legion undertake Blood Fasts to strengthen their wills, but not all can control their hunger.

name: Offer Immortality
text: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Suspicious Shambler
text: It was the perfect disguise—at least until its stomach started moaning.

name: Undying Malice
text: Lazlo was going to find the jerks who stabbed him in the back and stab them in their fronts.

name: Untamed Hunger
text:
"Mindlessness is not weakness. When we are lost to hunger we are unstoppable."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

text: As his ship passed the waterlogged wrecks, Markos realized he wasn't the first person to try sailing out of the Underworld.

text: He hovers silently above the city, scouting for when the ripest necks pass through the darkest alleys.

name: Vampire Neonate
text: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

name: Vampire Spawn
text: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: A few moments of her rattle's infuriating clattering is enough to provoke even lifelong pacifists into a howling, violent rage.

text: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

text: Gnorl and Vurg knew all too well how much dragons liked to eat goblins, but they had a dream that could not be dampened: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dropkick Bomber
text: "I've always enjoyed kicking stuff, so this was an ideal career opportunity."

name: Fire Elemental
text:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Goblin Oriflamme
text:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Abyssal Harvester
text:
"Till the soil, spare no soul. / Neath the darkness, nightmares grow."
—Children's nursery rhyme

name: Goblin Smuggler
text: "No one here but us empty barrels!"

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Kindled Fury
text: "Fiends! Cowards! Your days of slaughtering innocents are done. It's time to face a real warrior!"

name: Raging Redcap
text: Many tales of redcap terror begin with two simple things: bloodlust and stolen steel.

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

name: Seize the Spoils
text: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

name: Skyraker Giant
text: She will not be content until hers is the highest head in the sky.

name: Swab Goblin
text: Though small, goblins can hold their own in a fight. Foolhardy confidence goes a long way.

name: Terror of Mount Velus
text: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

name: Volley Veteran
text: They didn't fire in unison, nor in the same direction. Most didn't even use arrows. Somehow it worked perfectly.

name: Aggressive Mammoth
text:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

name: Bear Cub
text:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"Our state-of-the-art laboratories have been stripped of bothersome safety measures."
—Radula, Simic biomancer

name: Druid of the Cowl
text: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

name: Joraga Invocation
text:
"A single tree does not a forest make. We are stronger when we stand together."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

name: Magnigoth Sentry
text: When one of Yavimaya's enormous magnigoth trees awakens into a treefolk, it is a towering presence of physical strength and ancient wisdom.

name: Tajuru Pathwarden
text: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Goblin Firebomb
text:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Uncharted Haven
text:
"There are lands beyond Valley. Wild, calamity-scarred, and beautiful."
—Farfeather, birdfolk scout

name: Archway Angel
text: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.

name: Ballyrush Banneret
text: Only wool from the side of the springjack turned most often to the sun can be woven into kithkin battle standards. Jackherds record every movement of their woolly-jacks until shearing.

name: Crusader of Odric
text: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

name: Blasphemous Edict
text:
"A demonic pact is all fun and games until the bill comes due."
—Liliana Vess

name: Dawnwing Marshal
text: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

name: Devout Decree
text:
"It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

name: Disenchant
text: Even millennia later, some war machines from the devastating Brothers' War continue to function. Thankfully, the weapons meant to destroy them still work too.

name: Felidar Cub
text: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

name: Fumigate
text:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Knight of Grace
text: A light to pierce the shadows.

name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
text: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Regal Caracal
text: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
text: "This town swims with such exquisite blood. I will take every drop for my own."

name: Release the Dogs
text: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
text: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Chart a Course
text: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

name: Dictate of Kruphix
text: The god Kruphix was born when mortals first looked to the horizon and wondered what lay beyond.

name: Dive Down
text: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

name: Finale of Revelation
text: "Brother, your fate has always been bound to mine. Now we have reached the place where they shall both end."

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Fog Bank
text: The battalion thought they could escape the fog by marching in a straight line. Three days later, they began to suspect it was following them.

name: Gateway Sneak
text: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."

name: River's Rebuke
text: The waters that give the River Herald merfolk their name are sacred to their culture; they do not abide invaders to sail upon them.

name: Shipwreck Dowser
text: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

name: Tempest Djinn
text: "Oh, yes, many have come to take my power for their own. They will tell you all about their exploits when you meet them on the sea floor."

name: Unsummon
text: Tolarian apprentices learn to liberate aetheric energy long before they are taught to bind it.

name: Claws Out
text:
"I'm sure we can spare a little of today's catch for a hungry friend. Or two. Or five. Or . . . seven . . ."
—Lars, fisherman

name: Voracious Greatshark
text: There is no boat big enough.

name: Deathmark
text:
"I hope it's true that every snowflake is unique, because I never want to see one like this again. Now clean up that body."
—Thangbrand Gyrdsson, Kjeldoran patrol

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Duress
text:
"Give of yourself, for *compleation* awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

name: Kalastria Highborn
text: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

name: Knight of Malice
text: A shadow to swallow the light.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: High-Society Hunter
text: "You've been a marvelous servant. Consider this your final assignment."

name: Pulse Tracker
text:
"You can't think your way out of this, Jace. Thought implies life, and life requires a pulse—music to a hunter's ears."
—Vraska

name: Sanguine Indulgence
text:
"Drink from the vein? How provincial."
—Lord Duchorvin

name: Tribute to Hunger
text:
"Secluded park. Dual puncture wounds. I told you these aren't random murders. Get the stakes ready."
—Rem Karolus, monster slayer

name: Vampiric Rites
text: Scions of the Markov line take particular pleasure in the perversion of humans' holy rituals.

name: Vile Entomber
text: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

name: Bolt Bend
text:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

name: Hungry Ghoul
text: All at once, the warden realized the string of mysterious escapes was an entirely different problem.

name: Crash Through
text:
"We have to get out of the city, Djeru. All of us! Gather as many as you can."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Dragon Mage
text:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Ghitu Lavarunner
text: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

name: Giant Cindermaw
text:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

name: Harmless Offering
text: "Such an adorable face!"

name: Obliterating Bolt
text: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

name: Infernal Vessel
text: "Rise, my liege! Rise, and blanket the world in eternal night!"

name: Ravenous Giant
text: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

name: Stromkirk Noble
text: "A responsible king walks among his subjects."

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Viashino Pyromancer
text: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."

name: Circuitous Route
text:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
text: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

name: Gnarlback Rhino
text:
"The bad news is the siege wall is gone. The good news is I've got ideas for a new battering ram."
—Sergeant Ginnick

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Infestation Sage
text: "I control the swarm. If you strike me down, there will be nothing left to hold back their hunger."

name: Mold Adder
text: The more you struggle against its coils, the tighter they get.

name: Primal Might
text: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
text: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Deadly Brew
text: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

name: Dryad Militant
text: "Once, my guild welcomed outsiders. Too many preyed on our generosity, mistaking it for weakness. No more."

name: Enigma Drake
text: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

name: Garna, Bloodfist of Keld
text: Keldons live for the fervor of battle, as eager to receive scars as they are to give them.

name: Nine-Lives Familiar
text: Her master gathered the bones to resurrect her, only to find her purring on the altar.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Mortify
text: The queen sent her champion to defeat the necromancer threat. His helmet was returned the next day, warped and stained with blood.

name: Teach by Example
text:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Revenge of the Rats
text:
"The cats are behaving oddly today. Almost like they're all scared of something."
—Entry in a heavily chewed journal

name: Diamond Mare
text: When it passes, rainbows follow.

name: Feldon's Cane
text: Feldon bartered the second of these canes from a Yumok fisherman who had been using it as a boat tiller.

name: Pyromancer's Goggles
text: Chandra treasures her mentor's goggles, not for their magical properties, but for the memory of the woman who taught her to truly harness the power of fire.

name: Sanguine Syphoner
text: As life returned to the bogs of Bala Ged, the vampires returned to feed upon it.

name: Three Tree Mascot
text:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—*Valley Gazetteer*, four-acorn review

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Crawling Barrens
text: Zendikar is restless.

name: Cryptic Caves
text: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Seeker's Folly
text: While searching the foreboding woods for his favorite helmet, Syr Verlor lost his second-favorite helmet.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Crystal Barricade
text:
"Good as new!"
—Krek, daysquad captain

name: Soul-Shackled Zombie
text: The ritual successfully rebound her soul to her body, but not quite in the way she'd planned.

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Confiscate
text: "But I brought enough for the whole class!"

name: Stab
text: Elgin's final mistake was assuming an intruder would come through the door, and not up the sheer, smooth, six-story wall.

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Gratuitous Violence
text: What was supposed to be a quiet time in town turned into an adventure of its own.

name: Guttersnipe
text:
"I'm not sure we can outlast them, Captain. Their ammunition appears to be lava, Captain."
—Stubert, pirate gunner

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Unflinching Courage
text: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

name: Adaptive Automaton
text: Such loyalty can only be made.

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Gilded Lotus
text: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text:
"You will perish. But first, you will entertain me."
—Sheoldred, praetor of New Phyrexia

name: Solemn Simulacrum
text: It has outlasted its creator, their kingdom, and even the castle walls, but still it stands watch.

name: Tragic Banshee
text: She attended her own burial service, eager for company.

name: Hinterland Sanctifier
text: "You can learn a lot about a place just by asking the land how it's doing."

name: Crusader of Odric
text: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

name: Dazzling Angel
text: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

name: Healer's Hawk
text: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

name: Herald of Faith
text: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

name: Inspiring Overseer
text: The angels were determined to show a city run by demons that there was a better path.

name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
text: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

name: Vampire Gourmand
text: "He asked me if I wanted to come in for a bite to eat. Who am I to turn down a stranger's kindness?"

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Icewind Elemental
text: It surveys its domain on wings of ice, bringing misfortune to all who dare trespass.

name: Kitesail Corsair
text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Mocking Sprite
text: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"

name: Rune-Sealed Wall
text:
"If the giant, repelling wards aren't enough to keep out nosy visitors, the huge wall should help."
—Kastigan, reclusive runecaster

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Strix Lookout
text: Wise. Watchful. Fashionable.

name: Tempest Djinn
text: "Oh, yes, many have come to take my power for their own. They will tell you all about their exploits when you meet them on the sea floor."

name: Vampire Soulcaller
text: "Don't worry, little friends. We will not be hungry much longer."

name: Unsummon
text: Tolarian apprentices learn to liberate aetheric energy long before they are taught to bind it.

name: Bloodtithe Collector
text: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Kalastria Highborn
text: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

name: Pulse Tracker
text:
"You can't think your way out of this, Jace. Thought implies life, and life requires a pulse—music to a hunter's ears."
—Vraska

name: Vampire Interloper
text: He hovers silently above the city, scouting for when the ripest necks pass through the darkest alleys.

name: Vampire Soulcaller
text: "Don't worry, little friends. We will not be hungry much longer."

name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
text: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

name: Vengeful Bloodwitch
text: "You thought I was unarmed? Poor fool—your veins are my arsenal."

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Firespitter Whelp
text: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Primal Might
text: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
text: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

name: Diamond Mare
text: When it passes, rainbows follow.

name: Cryptic Caves
text: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

name: Battlesong Berserker
text: The thud of her axe striking armor and flesh gives rhythm to her song of bloody victory.

name: Boltwave
text:
"Taming a storm is like taming a wild beast; once you understand its wants and needs, you can direct it any way you like."
—Ral Zarek

name: Dauntless Veteran
text: "Courage is not the absence of fear. Courage is choosing to face your fear, spit in its face, and refuse to let it hold you back."

name: Bulk Up
text: Norf would win the arm-wrestling contest this year, at any cost.

name: Courageous Goblin
text: "Yeah! What he said!"

name: Crackling Cyclops
text: What he lacks in depth perception, he makes up for in charged potential.

name: Dragon Trainer
text: "I was hardly a month old when he hatched. We grew up together. Even shared a crib!"

name: Electroduplicate
text: The dragon roared and the storm thundered back.

name: Fiery Annihilation
text:
"Fireproof or your money back!"
—Jornald's Arms and Armor (out of business)

name: Goblin Boarders
text:
"SPLIT THE SKULLS AND SPLIT THE SPOILS!"
—Breeches, munitions master

name: Goblin Negotiation
text: Either you pay for Krenko's "protection" or you pay to replace your stall. Either way, you pay.

name: Gorehorn Raider
text: Anyone fast enough to dodge her horns and parry her cutlass just gets kicked overboard.

name: Dazzling Angel
text: Her wings ripple with impossible colors—a sign that a miracle is on the way.

name: Incinerating Blast
text: Most pyromancers could never summon the sheer heat necessary to melt solid rock, but most pyromancers aren't Chandra Nalaar.

name: Rite of the Dragoncaller
text: All at once, a quiet world was seized by wings, claws, fangs, and fire.

name: Searslicer Goblin
text: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

name: Slumbering Cerberus
text: The plan seemed to be going perfectly, until Mino realized the third head was no longer snoring.

name: Sower of Chaos
text: After a few minutes in the cathar's attire, Vizrik started getting all kinds of new ideas.

name: Strongbox Raider
text: "Tonight, we feast!"

name: Twinflame Tyrant
text:
"Job only paid enough for one head. I'm out."
—Peren, veteran mercenary

name: Ambush Wolf
text: It lies perfectly still and silent for hours, concealed in the undergrowth, until its prey draws close enough to strike.

name: Apothecary Stomper
text: A walking clinic with a trumpet to sound its arrival.

name: Icatian Phalanx
text: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the Phalanxes fought on, standing solidly against the onrushing raiders. Disciplined and dedicated, they held their ranks to the end, even in the face of tremendous losses.

name: Icatian Priest
text:
"May you be strong and valiant, to defeat the enemies of the pure."
—"Leitbur's Prayer"

name: Icatian Scout
text:
"Because the Orc hordes attacked along the entire border, Scouts were essential to Icatia's defense."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Icatian Scout
text:
"Let it be known that Ailis Connaut acted with honor and bravery in the defense of the town of Montford, risking her life to scout the enemy's position . . . ."
—Proclamation granting knighthood

name: Icatian Scout
text:
"Of course I'm not a spy! The enemy has spies. I am a Scout."
—Ailis Connaut

name: Icatian Scout
text:
"Scouting is the art of balancing the need to go undiscovered with the need to get all the information you can. It's only by Leitbur's good grace that I'm still alive today."
—Ailis Connaut, *Diary*

name: Icatian Skirmishers
text: Skirmishers engaged raiders before they could reach the towns. Although these units typically suffered huge losses, they never lacked volunteers.

name: Icatian Town
text: Icatia's once peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from Orcs and Goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

name: Order of Leitbur
text: Followers of Tourach regarded all other religions equally: with open contempt. Not so the followers of Leitbur, who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Order of Leitbur
text:
"The powers of the corrupt will fade before the fury of the pure."
—Bethan Leitbur, "The Way"

name: Order of Leitbur
text:
"Trained to battle the followers of Tourach, the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with Orcish and Goblin raiders."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: High Tide
text:
"When the very tides turn against you, it's time to consider retirement."
—General Khurzog

name: High Tide
text:
"May Svyelun and her tides favor you."
—Traditional Merfolk blessing

name: High Tide
text:
"By the time their enemies noticed the sea's changing mood, the Vodalians had often shifted formation and were ready to attack."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Combat Medic
text:
"Although Icatia's Combat Medics borrowed much of their knowledge from other societies, their skills were their own."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Combat Medic
text:
"We'd no sooner knock 'em back on their heels than that accursed sawbones would show up and patch 'em back together again."
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Combat Medic
text:
"Without Combat Medics, Icatia would probably not have withstood the forces of chaos as long as it did."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Combat Medic
text:
"Time enough to become a Medic once you're hurt too badly to fight. For now, Icatia needs your strength more than your compassion."
—Lydia Wynforth, Mayor of Trokair

name: Homarid Shaman
text:
"The ground grew swampy; hooves and claws sank into the marshy earth. Snarls of rage and bleats of despair echoed through the trees as the waters grew higher and higher."
—Kyliki of Havenwood, "Havenwood Remembered"

name: River Merfolk
text:
"Dwelling in icy mountain streams near Goblin and Orcish foes, the River Merfolk were known for their stoicism."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Svyelunite Priest
text:
"Early Vodalians worshipped Svyelun, goddess of the Pearl Moon. Later she became a more abstract figure."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Vodalian Knights
text: Fear the Knight leaping from the water into the air, weapon ready.

name: Vodalian Mage
text:
"Vodalian Mages are remarkable. Their merchants bring them arcane lore and devices from across the seas."
—Lydia Wynforth, Mayor of Trokair

name: Vodalian Mage
text:
"Come back, cowards! Everyone knows Merfolk can't wield magic!"
—Pashadar Dirf, Goblin Flotilla Commander, last words

name: Vodalian Mage
text: Vodalian Mages were invaluable in magical combat. Unfortunately, the Homarids raided with strength, numbers, and very little magic.

name: Vodalian Soldiers
text:
"Vodalian Soldiers had some unique advantages. Often they would ride into battle on war machines rumored to have come from the far northern oceans."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Vodalian Soldiers
text:
"You think you know everything there is to know about battle? You know Orc droppings! Underwater combat is three dimensional. Those thrice-damned Vodalians don't attack in ranks; they attack in schools."
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Vodalian Soldiers
text:
"Stalwart Soldiers, you stand against the Homarids for Vodalia and for honor. Your homeland cries out for protection, and the moment has come. Now let your valor shine, and sound the cry to battle. Victory to Vodalia!"
—Marshall Volnikov

name: Vodalian Soldiers
text:
"The cooling climate introduced a new threat to Vodalia: the Homarids. Once a minor nuisance, they thrived in the changing environment. Their ceaseless attacks strained Vodalia's defenses to their limit, eventually overwhelming the empire."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Armor Thrull
text:
"The worst thing about being a mercenary for the Ebon Hand is having to wear a dead Thrull."
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Armor Thrull
text:
"They gave their lives to strengthen the Order's armies, until they declined this honor in favor of joining the Thrull Rebellion."
—Jherana Rure, Counter-Insurgency Commander

name: Armor Thrull
text:
"Except for a bare spot at the base of their skulls, Armor Thrulls bear interlocking plates and spikes with the strength of steel. Their design is almost artistic."
—Endrek Sahr, "Thrulls"

name: Armor Thrull
text: Occasionally, an ally balked at wearing a dead Thrull as armor. The priests' whips, however, were usually enough to encourage a more practical outlook.

name: Basal Thrull
text:
Initially bred for sacrifice, the Thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results.
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Basal Thrull
text:
Although my later designs were much more sophisticated, Basal Thrulls were no less a success."
—Endrek Sahr, "Thrulls"

name: Basal Thrull
text:
"To create the first Thrulls, I only introduced alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy; Tourach's principles remained unchanged."
—Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

name: Basal Thrull
text:
"Above all, a well crafted Thrull should be hideous—blasted of countenance and twisted of limb—to inspire fear and revulsion."
—Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

name: Breeding Pit
text: The Thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Derelor
text:
"Strength it has, but at the cost of a continuous supply of energy. Such failure can bear only one result."
—From the execution order for Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

name: Hymn to Tourach
text:
"The eerie, wailing Hymn caused insanity even in hardened warriors."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Hymn to Tourach
text:
"Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: Members of the Order often played the Hymn on instruments made from their victims' bones.

name: Initiates of the Ebon Hand
text:
"We are no longer Nature's children, but her masters . . . ."
—Oath of the Ebon Hand

name: Initiates of the Ebon Hand
text: Ebon leaders soon realized that non-human races often had special talents that could be exploited.

name: Initiates of the Ebon Hand
text:
"Many Initiates sacrificed a hand to become full members of the Order."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Farrel's Zealot
text: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

name: Farrel's Zealot
text: Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

name: Farrel's Zealot
text: Farrel, a former priest, believed Icatia was far too complacent toward the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Farrelite Priest
text: Although their methods were often brutal, Farrel's followers believed in the preservation of justice and virtue.

name: Necrite
text: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counter-insurgency.

name: Necrite
text:
"Ever see a wall drop dead of fright, kid? It ain't pretty."
—Cpl. Dobbs

name: Necrite
text: Was it the sight, smell, or aura of the Necrite that killed so effectively?

name: Order of the Ebon Hand
text: A true follower of Tourach took pride in achievement to the exclusion of other concerns.

name: Order of the Ebon Hand
text:
"There are intriguing similarities between the Order and Icatia's Leitbur religion, suggesting the two had a common origin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Order of the Ebon Hand
text: Dedicated to the principles of Tourach, members of the Order of the Ebon Hand demonstrated their devotion with grisly rituals.

name: Thrull Champion
text:
"Those idiots should never have bred Thrulls for combat!"
—Jherana Rure

name: Thrull Retainer
text:
"Until the Rebellion, Thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Thrull Wizard
text:
"In crafting intelligent Thrulls to assist in sacrifices, Sahr inadvertantly set the stage for the Thrull Rebellion."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Brassclaw Orcs
text:
"The Brassclaws delighted in lightning raids on Icatian and Dwarven towns; an unprepared enemy is easier to defeat."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Brassclaw Orcs
text:
"Brassclaws were typical Orcs—quick to laud their own prowess in battle, quick to jeer at their opponents, and quicker still to run away when things started to look slightly dangerous."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Brassclaw Orcs
text:
"A whole skin is worth a thousand victories."
—Orcish Veteran of the Battle of Montford

name: Brassclaw Orcs
text:
"The large brass claws worn by some Sarpadian Orc tribes were among the least feared weapons ever known."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Hand of Justice
text:
"The Hand of Justice will come to cleanse the world if we are true."
—Oliver Farrel

name: Dwarven Armorer
text:
"The few remaining pieces from this period suggest the Dwarves eventually made weapons and armor out of everything, even children's toys."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Dwarven Catapult
text:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, Dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Dwarven Lieutenant
text:
"Dwarven officers were tireless in battle, moving up and down the lines to rally their troops and boost morale."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Dwarven Soldier
text:
"Let no one say we did not fight until the last . . . ."
—Headstone fragment from a mass grave found in the Crimson Peaks

name: Dwarven Soldier
text: There is a legend among present-day Dwarves that the Dwarves of Sarpadia will one day return to defend Dwarvenkind against a deadly peril.

name: Dwarven Soldier
text:
"Although the Dwarves staunchly defended their walled city-states against the Orcs, their civilization was the first to fall, and its name was sadly lost."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Goblin Chirurgeon
text: The Chirurgeons patched up their fallen comrades with a gruesome mix of twisted limbs and mangled flesh.

name: Goblin Chirurgeon
text:
"I asked one of my aides how they do it, but all he'd say was, 'Trust me, Mayor, you don't want to know.'"
—Lydia Wynforth, Mayor of Trokair

name: Goblin Chirurgeon
text:
"Perhaps Goblins are good for something after all."
—Attributed to General Khurzog

name: Goblin Flotilla
text: Exceptionally poor sailors, Goblins usually arrived at their destination retching and in no condition to fight.

name: Goblin Grenade
text:
"According to accepted theory, the Grenade held some kind of flammable mixture and was carried to its target by a hapless Goblin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Goblin Grenade
text:
"I don't suppose we could teach them to *throw* the cursed things?"
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Goblin Grenade
text:
"Without their massive numbers, the Goblins could never have launched such a successful offensive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Goblin War Drums
text:
"The Goblins' dreaded War Drums struck terror into the hearts of even their bravest foes."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Goblin War Drums
text:
"Defending the outer trenches, we strained our eyes in the darkness. All we could hear was the Drums' terrible pounding. Dobbs, on my right, broke first. Soon we were all heading for the walls."
—Corporal Peter Douglas, courtmartial testimony

name: Goblin War Drums
text: The War Drums enabled Goblin and Orcish armies to crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities.

name: Goblin War Drums
text: When creating a new War Drum, Goblin designers sought out the highest quality skulls. Serra Angel skulls were most highly prized, although most acknowledged that the skull of the exotic Sea Serpent made for a richer tone.

name: Goblin Warrens
text:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Orcish Captain
text: There's a chance to win every battle.

name: Orcish Spy
text:
"Yeah, they're ugly, they desert in droves, and their personal habits are enough to make you sick. But I'll say this for Orcs: they make great spies."
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Orcish Spy
text:
"Orcish armies often employed the smaller, swifter, and less intelligent Goblins as spies."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Orcish Spy
text:
"You idiot! Never let the spies mingle with the Orcish regulars after completing a mission. Now we'll never get them to fight!"
—General Khurzog

name: Orcish Veteran
text: Orcs are not exactly known for their valor—although most Orcs have seen countless battles, only a handful have actually fought in them.

name: Orcish Veteran
text:
"Orcs often greeted promotions to Icatian battle with anguished wails and pleas for mercy."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Orcish Veteran
text: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

name: Orcish Veteran
text: Although models of courage for Orcs, the Veterans quickly learned to fear the swift justice of their Icatian enemies.

name: Orgg
text: It's bigger than it thinks.

name: Elven Fortress
text: Many Elven Fortresses weren't built by masons and carpenters, but created from the living forest itself.

name: Elven Fortress
text:
"The size of the obvious Fortress walls often misled foes. Actually, the Elves enchanted the forest itself to provide the first line of defense with tangling vines and stinging thorns."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Elven Fortress
text:
"Thallids are not ordinary enemies of flesh and bone and reason. They attack with no thought for our strength or of their own losses. I fear our Fortresses shall be overwhelmed."
—Kyliki of Havenwood

name: Elven Fortress
text:
"Burn it down, you say? Now *there's* a stupid idea. What do you suppose will become of those overhanging branches, hmm? And then what do you suppose will become of us?"
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Elvish Hunter
text:
"Elves often tipped their arrows with a drug that caused a deep but harmless sleep."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Elvish Hunter
text:
"As the climate cooled, many Elves turned to Thallid farming for food, while the Hunters honed their skills on what little game remained."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Elvish Hunter
text: The Elves never had a standing army; when battle came, they pressed Hunters, Scouts, and Farmers into a surprisingly effective militia.

name: Elvish Scout
text: Even one whose ears were closely tuned to the sounds of Havenwood could miss hearing a Scout move past.

name: Elvish Scout
text:
"Even for Elves, they were stealthy little twerps. They'd taken our measure before we'd even seen them."
—Marshall Volnikov

name: Elvish Scout
text: Although the Elves of Havenwood lived in isolated villages, their swift communications allowed them to act as a single community.

name: Feral Thallid
text:
"Born and bred of fungus, Thallids were nearly impossible to kill."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Fungal Bloom
text:
"Thallids could absorb energy from the forest itself. Even Elves were at a disadvantage in fighting them."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Night Soil
text: Some said killing the Thallids only encouraged them.

name: Night Soil
text: The Elves gathered huge piles of rot to grow fungus. Out of imitation or forethought, the Thallids did the same.

name: Night Soil
text:
"There were often more Thallids after a battle than before."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Thelonite Druid
text:
"The magic at the heart of all living things can bear awe-inspiring fruit."
—Kolevi of Havenwood, Elder Druid

name: Thelonite Monk
text:
"As the climate worsened, some Thelonites turned to fertilizing with fresh blood in an attempt to keep Havenwood alive and growing."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Icatian Infantry
text: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

name: Icatian Infantry
text: Although they had long been concerned about the Order of the Ebon Hand, the Icatians faced an even greater threat from Goblin and Orcish raiders.

name: Icatian Infantry
text:
"Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall. Its faithful soldiers defended their cities to the very end."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Icatian Infantry
text:
"Never Surrender"
—Motto carved into a fragment of an Icatian wall

name: Thorn Thallid
text:
"The danger in cultivating massive plants caught the Elves by surprise."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Thorn Thallid
text:
"The cooling climate forced the Elves to experiment with new food sources."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Thorn Thallid
text:
"I don't know which is worse, getting hit with those darts or having to watch them grow back."
—Orcish Soldier

name: Thorn Thallid
text:
"Scholars still debate whether the Thallids were truly sentient."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Aeolipile
text:
"Although fragile, the Aeolipile could be quite destructive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Balm of Restoration
text:
"Not all armies enjoyed the services of a medic. For them, Balm of Restoration was that much more valuable."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Conch Horn
text: Even the most skilled of modern mages only partially understand the Conch Horn's awesome powers.

name: Delif's Cone
text:
"Where is it written that beasts must cause pain?"
—Delif, *Ponderings*

name: Draconian Cylix
text:
"There is no gain without sacrifice."
—Icatian proverb

name: Elven Lyre
text: Scholars are uncertain whether it was the actual sound or some other magical property of the Elven Lyre that transformed its player.

name: Implements of Sacrifice
text: Relics of the Order of the Ebon Hand, the bowl and dagger bespeak the hideous cruelty of its rituals.

name: Ring of Renewal
text: To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.

name: Icatian Lieutenant
text: To become an officer, an Icatian Soldier had to pass a series of tests. These evaluated not only fighting and leadership skills, but also integrity, honor, and moral strength.

name: Spirit Shield
text: At times, survival must outweigh all other considerations.

name: Zelyon Sword
text: No sheath shall hold what finds its home in flesh.

name: Rainbow Vale
text: In the feudal days of Icatia, finding the Rainbow Vale was often the goal of Knights' quests.

name: Wrecking Ball Arm
text: "I don't care what it is! I'm gonna bust him up!"

name: Chocobo Knights
text: Only a select few can become Chocobo Knights. You have to be a skilled rider or achieve some combat merit to become one.

name: Protection Magic
text: "Armor of light, halt physical might!"

name: Summoner's Sending
text: The sending takes them to the Farplane, where they may rest in peace.

name: Espers to Magicite
text: "Come to me, my magicite pretty . . . come, and help me build the Magitek Empire of Kefka!"

name: Rejoin the Fight
text: "I have to fight... to protect the people I love, and to make the world a safe place for new lives!"

name: Chocobo Knights
text: Only a select few can become Chocobo Knights. You have to be a skilled rider or achieve some combat merit to become one.

name: Snort
text:
"He's not so great with words, but his strength'll blow you away!"
—Ultros

name: Lifestream's Blessing
text:
"We came to tell you our memories. Come, planet! Show us your answer!"
—Cloud Strife

name: Sphere Grid
text: To activate nodes, you must use spheres.

name: Wrecking Ball Arm
text: "I don't care what it is! I'm gonna bust him up!"

name: Alisaie Leveilleur
text: "No matter what happens, we have to survive. Together."

name: Cid, Freeflier Pilot
text: "I'm Cid—that's who the hell I am! Now just let me handle it!"

name: Cid, Freeflier Pilot
text: "I'm Cid—that's who the hell I am! Now just let me handle it!"

name: Cyan, Vengeful Samurai
text: "There will be no mercy for thee!"

name: Elena, Turk Recruit
text: "Looks like talking alone won't cut it. You're going to have to feel some pain!"

name: General Leo Cristophe
text: "You're a human being before you're a soldier."

name: Lord Jyscal Guado
text: "Listen to me very carefully, for I shall tell you the truth about my son, Seymour."

name: Alphinaud Leveilleur
text: "We alone can accomplish little, but joined by others, we may yet build a bonfire to carry us heavensward."

name: Hermes, Overseer of Elpis
text: "For us, there may be no higher purpose than to live for our world, but what of the other living beings out there?"

name: Hraesvelgr of the First Brood
text: "Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."

name: Lulu, Stern Guardian
text: "If you want everything, you'll end up with nothing."

name: O'aka, Traveling Merchant
text: "Say, lad, you wouldn't have a bit o' gil to lend?"

name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
text: "Hey, I've got just the thing!"

name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
text: Recent rumors speak of an impostor that shows up and masquerades as Siegfried himself.

name: Cait Sith, Fortune Teller
text: "I'm friend to one and all, thanks to my crystal ball!"

name: Gau, Feral Youth
text: "Uwao! Aooh! I'm Gau! Your friend! Frieeend!!!"

name: Yuffie, Materia Hunter
text: "I know you want my help because I'm so good!"

name: Bugenhagen, Wise Elder
text: "I've been thinking if there was anything we could do to help a planet already in misery..."

name: Cyan, Vengeful Samurai
text: "There will be no mercy for thee!"

name: Tromell, Seymour's Butler
text: "The Guado take care of Guado affairs."

name: Aerith, Last Ancient
text: "Right here, right now, I need to know I did everything I could."

name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
text: "Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"

name: Banon, the Returners' Leader
text: "You are this world's last ray of light... our final hope."

name: Elena, Turk Recruit
text: "Looks like talking alone won't cut it. You're going to have to feel some pain!"

name: Red XIII, Proud Warrior
text: "I am Nanaki, Watcher of Cosmo Canyon... and son of Seto!"

name: Shelinda, Yevon Acolyte
text: "Truly, I know nothing of the ways of fighting, but I do know some white magic."

name: General Leo Cristophe
text: "You're a human being before you're a soldier."

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: "Hey! Say something, why don't you!"

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: "... It's beautiful, isn't it?"

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: "Hey spike-head. What'd you wanna see fireworks with me for?"

name: Lord Jyscal Guado
text: "Listen to me very carefully, for I shall tell you the truth about my son, Seymour."

name: Authority of the Consuls
text:
"He must be guilty of something or other, or he wouldn't have attempted to flee the Empire."
—Yotsuyu goe Brutus

name: Bastion Protector
text: "Squad A will set up here and search for suspects. B will establish a perimeter—roadblocks included. Contain the situation!"

name: Cleansing Nova
text:
"We called this calamity the 'Flood of Light.' Everything it touched was leeched of life and vigor, leaving naught behind but a luminous wasteland."
—Moren, Crystarium Librarian

name: Cut a Deal
text:
"A strong Eorzea will ever have need of a strong Ul'dah."
—Nanamo Ul Namo

name: Damning Verdict
text: "Yevon is embodied by eternal, unchanging continuity, summoner. Those who question these truths—they are traitors!"

name: Protection Magic
text: "Armor of light, halt physical might!"

name: Destroy Evil
text:
"So it is you, after all, who will send me. But even after I am gone, Spira's sorrow will prevail."
—Seymour, to Yuna

name: Dispatch
text:
"I'll take the chopper! The bikes are all yours, Cloud!"
—Barret Wallace

name: Farewell
text: "Stay with me until the end. Please."

name: Final Judgment
text:
"Let this be a lesson to all those who would walk the path of sin—the wicked shall not inherit this world!"
—Vauthry

name: Lingering Souls
text: "Strange as it may seem, the longer I linger here, the less the matter of my epitaph concerns me."

name: Luminous Broodmoth
text:
"Don't bother going after all of them. Cut the ones that matter, and run!"
—Auron

name: Palace Jailer
text: "I think we all know who really deserves to be locked up in here..."

name: Path to Exile
text:
"This is your story. It all begins here."
—Auron

name: Promise of Loyalty
text:
"Listen to my story. This may be our last chance."
—Tidus

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: "Ok, I'm going to just go ahead and say it..."

name: Sun Titan
text: Wrexsoul is formed of the countless souls lost during the conflict one thousand years past...

name: Sunscorch Regent
text: The guardian wyrm, Evrae. The great sacred beast—protector of Bevelle.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The refreshing caress of the wind, the soothing whisper of the waves... how liberating!"

name: Unfinished Business
text: "If you're gonna pick a fight with the Turks, you'd better be prepared to leave in a body bag."

name: Vanquish the Horde
text:
"Sir! A mass of high-density energy is heading towards Midgar!"
—Shinra operator

name: Archmage Emeritus
text:
"If you are ever to become a capable astrologian, you must believe in the path laid out before you, and in your power to read it, follow it, and ultimately control it."
—Leveva Heavensreader

name: Inexorable Tide
text:
"When Sin attacked Zanarkand that day, I woke up in Spira."
—Tidus

name: Into the Story
text: "Hear... feel... think..."

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text:
"All right, I'll work!"
—Tidus

name: Propaganda
text:
"Barring a few exceptions, we have detained all those with allegiance to the Scions. The Rising Stones is also under our control."
—Crystal Brave Soldier

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text: He knew there was no way back home, back to Zanarkand.

name: Rite of Replication
text: "Eorzea is mine by right!"

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: Ancient monsters that had long been sealed away were released when the world was ripped apart.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: The legacy of Gaius van Baelsar is a towering monument to imperial tyranny.

name: Crux of Fate
text: "Thou art weak, Hraesvelgr—a slithering wyrm who fawneth on the vermin who should rightly be his prey."

name: Exsanguinate
text:
"As the fight wore on, blood began to soak through his armor, spreading to every ilm of his body. But when it began to rise and envelop him as a mist, I realized it wasn't blood, but something dark and twisted..."
—Ishgardian Citizen

name: Morbid Opportunist
text:
"Great people here! You can trust everything they say!"
—Zozo resident

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"My love... you made me so happy. Thank you..."
—Elayne Garamonde

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "We're gonna go into the castle through a secret cave that nobody else knows about!"

name: Reanimate
text:
"The world is about to learn... the meaning of... fear..."
—Emperor Geshtahl

name: Rise of the Dark Realms
text:
"You can't destroy everything! People will always have dreams!"
—Terra Branford

name: Snuff Out
text: "Look, Avere! All these people have come to make you a gift of their souls!"

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: All those wounded by the necromancer's zombie stick are doomed to a fate of eternal undeath!

name: Syphon Mind
text:
"'Tis now all but certain that the towers were conceived to facilitate the summoning of primals by those imprisoned within."
—Urianger Augurelt

name: Anger
text:
"Relm's inside!"
—Strago Magus

name: Summoner's Sending
text: The sending takes them to the Farplane, where they may rest in peace.

name: Big Score
text: "Look, I finally found it... The legendary treasure that can undo death itself."

name: Chaos Warp
text:
"I'm getting less human..."
—Vincent Valentine

name: Furious Rise
text: "You guys are worthless, but my proud creation is a sure thing!"

name: Vandalblast
text: "Danger's part of the job. Don't worry about me."

name: Bane of Progress
text: Sin always returns for its spawn.

name: Cultivate
text: "They say you can't grow grass and flowers in Midgar. But for some reason, the flowers have no trouble blooming here."

name: Duskshell Crawler
text:
"Hah! That one looks slow," scoffed Tidus.
"It's also tough. Let me handle this," replied Auron.

name: Farseek
text:
"I am on a journey, studying the history of our world, Spira, seeking its stories and secrets."
—Maechen, scholar

name: Forgotten Ancient
text:
"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living."
—Auron

name: Generous Patron
text:
"Look at the crowd, folks!"
—Blitzball announcer

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"When it starts, I won't be myself any more. I won't be able to hold myself back."
—Jecht

name: Harmonize
text:
"Only the Ancients, only Aerith can save us from Meteor."
—Cloud Strife

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Hahahahaha!"

name: Nature's Lore
text:
"The spirits that return to the planet, merge with one another and roam the planet. They roam, converge, and divide, becoming a swell, called the lifestream."
—Bugenhagen

name: Rampant Growth
text:
"It is up to the planet to decide. What is best for the planet. What is bad for the planet. All that is bad will disappear."
—Bugenhagen

name: Three Visits
text:
"If I give up now, I could do anything I wanted to, and yet . . . even if I was with you, I could never forget."
—Yuna

name: Baleful Strix
text: Skatenes are mind-quickened owls, granted sentience via powerful magicks much in the same way toads are transformed into poroggos.

name: Bedevil
text: On that day... the world was changed forever...

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: A crudely reinforced baseball bat. Designed to beat the living tar out of anything and everything.

name: Bred for the Hunt
text:
"Think you will win? You not forget who took your horn! Never forget!"
—Biran Ronso

name: Crackling Doom
text: "No hard feelings, now... I'm just going to use this power you've unleashed to put you to sleep..."

name: Decimate
text:
"Progress requires sacrifice. Learn to live with it."
—President Shinra

name: Endless Detour
text:
"I'm scared of lightning! Let's rest, please? Pretty please?"
—Rikku

name: Legions to Ashes
text:
"Ha-ha! I'm raring to go! Can't be leaving everything up to you whippersnappers!"
—Strago Magus

name: Mortify
text:
"Espers... Who'd have dreamed they were that powerful..."
—Imperial soldier

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text: "This little hamlet has too much 'boring' and not enough 'burning'... Torch everything!"

name: Vindicate
text: "Remember... remember us... remember... that we once lived..."

name: Void Rend
text:
"I expect some voidsent are more intelligent than others. Perhaps these ones simply do not understand our words."
—Y'shtola Rhul

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"Lord Kefka's treasure . . . Return the treasure . . ."
—Kefka's cultists

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"To put it simply, the knowledge of the Ancients is sealed within each orb. That knowledge not only connects us to the planet... it allows us to tap into her power."
—Sephiroth

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"I'm a blitzball player. Star player of the Zanarkand Abes!"
—Tidus

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"I preside over the forces of stasis, tranquility, peace. I will weave this selfsame power into the crystal, granting thee mastery over matter, to give form to the formless."
—Hydaelyn

name: Armory Automaton
text:
"They don't call those things sweepers for nothing. They can wipe out a whole squad in seconds."
—Jessie, Avalanche rebel

name: Colossus Hammer
text: "Sorry to keep you waiting. It's me! I'll handle the rest!"

name: Commander's Sphere
text:
"Have you ever heard of something called a Growth Egg? Have you? Hmmm? It was buried in a tomb to the west a looong, long time ago!"
—Kohlingen resident

name: Darksteel Plate
text: "A Shinra uniform... I was so proud when I first put it on."

name: Inspiring Statuary
text:
"Man thinks very highly of himself."
—Barret Wallace

name: Key to the City
text:
"Oh dear... We're really in trouble this time..."
—The Impresario, opera house manager

name: Lightning Greaves
text:
"Gotta step it up!"
—Tifa Lockhart

name: Meteor Golem
text: A mechanical monster equipped with a massive arsenal of weapons and attacks, including its signature Wave Cannon.

name: Millikin
text: A machine that dazes and confuses its enemies with bewildering signals.

name: Mind Stone
text: A relic that greatly enhances the magical power of its wielder.

name: Relic of Legends
text:
"A smile better suits a hero."
—Haurchefant Greystone

name: Skullclamp
text:
"My mother's name is Jenova... 'The Jenova Project'... is this just a coincidence?"
—Sephiroth

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Magicite is an esper's power in its purest form. When an esper dies, magicite is all that's left behind..."
—Ramuh

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Naturally formed materia. And look at the size of it. Astounding. For the mako energy to condense into something like this, it must have taken an eternity."
—Sephiroth

name: Sol Ring
text:
"Memories are nice, but that's all they are."
—Rikku

name: Sol Ring
text: It is said that aetheryte is the solid manifestation of the planet's lifeblood, aether, and that by touching it, the aether which makes up our bodies resonates with that contained in the crystal.

name: Hermes, Overseer of Elpis
text: "For us, there may be no higher purpose than to live for our world, but what of the other living beings out there?"

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"You can gain all kinds of abilities by equipping relics."
—South Figaro merchant

name: Sword of the Animist
text: "Don't fight here! You'll ruin the flowers!"

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"He's alive... Locke's alive!"
—Celes Chere

name: Talisman of Dominance
text:
"The Ascian used me, as he used so many others-all to further the restoration of his wretched god."
—Gaius Baelsar

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text: "A red mage's spells belong to two distinct schools, rooted as they are in the ancient disciplines of black and white magic."

name: Talisman of Indulgence
text: "Hee-hee-hee! You're not getting away from me!"

name: Talisman of Progress
text:
"Master Louisoix... I understand now... the choice you made... In death... there is life..."
—Moenbryda Wilfsunnwyn

name: Thought Vessel
text: Initiating... Performing diagnostics... Diagnostics complete. To proceed, please agree to the terms and conditions of use.

name: Hraesvelgr of the First Brood
text: "Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text:
"The gate to tomorrow is not the light of heaven, but the darkness of the depths of the earth."
—Vincent Valentine

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: "Treasure, treasure!"

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"None of us were prepared for the spectacle that awaited us when we first stepped into the tower. To be surrounded by the marvels of a lost age took our breath away."
—Ironworks datalog 2.5

name: Ash Barrens
text: There's a legend that tells of an ancient battle between the esper Odin and a powerful magus... It took place in the great hall of a castle.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"Welcome to the new world order."
—Rufus Shinra

name: Bonders' Enclave
text:
"With things the way they are now, how 'bout raising a chocobo?"
—Chocobo Bill

name: Brushland
text:
"When Sin is defeated here, the Calm will visit Spira once more. That's why this place is now known as the Calm Lands."
—Scholar Maechen

name: Canopy Vista
text:
"This here's Mideel. It's a quiet little hot springs town. Just the perfect place for old folks like us to live out our lives."
—Mideel resident

name: Choked Estuary
text:
"The imperials have not gained any ground since our last battle, but neither have we."
—Ala Mhigan resistance fighter

name: Lulu, Stern Guardian
text: "If you want everything, you'll end up with nothing."

name: Cinder Glade
text:
"After we lost the war, we got peace, but with that, we lost something else. Now look at Wutai..."
—Yuffie Kisaragi

name: Clifftop Retreat
text:
"Our mission is to survey a run-down reactor."
—Sephiroth

name: Command Tower
text: To dizzying heights it rises, the gleaming spire, its tip threatening to pierce the blinding canopy. There it will all begin anew. Between Dark and Light, the pure and the corrupt—the one true struggle.

name: Contaminated Aquifer
text:
"With Gunnhildr's Blades and the Warrior of Light leading the charge, it is only a matter of time before Castrum Lacus Litore is ours."
—Bajsaljen Ulgasch

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Thought to have been built by the Nymian civilization, which thrived in the area some fifteen centuries ago, the palace appears to have been dedicated to their patron deity, Oschon, the Wanderer.

name: Desolate Mire
text:
"To the south of here lies the Veldt. 'Tis a wild and dangerous land, inhabited by all manner of ferocious beasts..."
-—Cyan Garamonde

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: Eight dragons seal away its awesome might; the might of the one called "Crusader." And when the eight shall fall, the one again shall rise.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text:
"The maze that surrounds the base of the tower is known as the 'Labyrinth of the Ancients.'"
—G'raha Tia

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Both the Crusaders and the Al Bhed truly wish peace for Spira. This Operation Miʼhen was born from that wish they share."
—Seymour Guado

name: O'aka, Traveling Merchant
text: "Say, lad, you wouldn't have a bit o' gil to lend?"

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"We have been expecting you, Lady Yuna. Welcome to Guadosalam."
—Tromell, Seymour's butler

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Nowhere... to... run... Nowhere... to... hide... No escape... for... you..."
-—Ghosts on the Phantom Train

name: Fire-Lit Thicket
text:
"Welcome to Wall Market, the pleasure capital of Midgar that's got everything for everybody!"
—Wall Market barker

name: Flooded Grove
text:
"This is what spheres are made of. It absorbs and preserves people's memories."
—Auron

name: Foreboding Ruins
text:
"They were storing an awful lot of flame rods in there..."
—Thamasa elder

name: Fortified Village
text:
"We've been fighting Shinra on this battlefield for a long time. We've settled in for a long war."
—Fort Condor villager

name: Furycalm Snarl
text:
"It sure helped having Cid here. I had no idea he could drive a train..."
—Red XIII

name: Game Trail
text: Many attractions await you here at the Gold Saucer. You will be moved and excited, thrilled and terrified!

name: Geothermal Bog
text:
"Legend has it that the Phoenix turned itself to stone ages ago... It seems the story was true."
—Locke Cole

name: Glacial Fortress
text: For as long as their nation has warred with Dravania, there have been Ishgardians who instead chose to ally themselves with the dragons. Shiva is said to have been among the first, hence why the heretics revere her as a saint.

name: Graven Cairns
text:
"At times we were friendly rivals, and at times we were simply friends. We'd always talk about our dreams... Like which of us would be first to sail beyond the sky to the stars."
—Setzer Gabbiani

name: High Market
text:
"Pretty impressive that a kid like me can run a business, don't ya think? You should buy something to encourage me!"
—Nikeah boy

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"The entire river glows, like a sea of stars."
—Lulu

name: Idyllic Beachfront
text:
"This is where I was born. I started blitz when I was five. I joined the Aurochs at thirteen... ten years ago. Ten years... and we never won a game."
—Wakka

name: Isolated Chapel
text: This is the Sealed Gate... Beyond there is the esper world.

name: Jungle Shrine
text:
"This is... the Temple of the Ancients. I know... I feel it. The knowledge of the know Ancients..."
—Aerith Gainsborough

name: Mossfire Valley
text:
"Look at this rusted rocket. I was supposed to be the first man in space with this. Everyday, it tilts a little bit more."
-—Cid Highwind

name: Nesting Grounds
text: A butterfly will lead the way to secret things.

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"The Empire is snuffing out Returners wherever it finds them. We must find a way to strike back before it's too late..."
—Returner soldier

name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
text: "Hey, I've got just the thing!"

name: Overflowing Basin
text:
"They say that clouds of pyreflies gather here when night falls."
—Yuna

name: Port Town
text:
"The excitement here has reached a fever pitch as the opening ceremony gets under way!"
—Blitzball announcer

name: Prairie Stream
text:
"Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. This will be the last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with."
—Eureka expedition ferryman

name: Radiant Grove
text:
"You're not really going to see the dead, more like your memories of them. They take on the form of the dead person—an illusion, nothing else."
—Rikku

name: Rogue's Passage
text:
"Make your way out of town through the mines! I'll try to buy you some time."
-—Old man from Narshe

name: Rootbound Crag
text:
"Did Sephiroth... do this?"
—Cloud Strife

name: Rugged Prairie
text:
"Corel sure has gone to pot. It used to be a famous coal mining town! Νοw, it's nothing but a miserable pit! Me, my bulldozer... everything's out of work."
—Corel resident

name: Sacred Peaks
text:
"So this is the power of the Warring Triad! With this and my magicite... the world will be mine to command!"
—Emperor Gestahl

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: "The Burn"—once a verdant region teeming with flora and fauna, repeated summonings saw it bled of aether and reduced to a barren desert.

name: Seaside Citadel
text:
"I lived in the city of Bevelle until ten years ago. It's the biggest city in Spira! The main temple of Yevon is there."
—Yuna

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text:
"The time has come for us to claim our rightful dominion over the world!"
—Emperor Gestahl
