name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: Reports of bloody carnage have reached the Crystarium, and the guard has deployed in force in answer to Holminster's plea for aid.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text:
"Deep within the Sea of Clouds, beyond treacherous winds and swirling rock, lies a land like no other. Isles-—nay, pristine jewels—clustered about a massive floating crystal."
—Diadem mission commander

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text:
"Today the No. 1 Reactor was bombed. The terrorist group Avalanche has claimed responsibility for the bombing."
—President Shinra

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: In order to reach the Sealed Gate and enter the land of the espers, one must brave a volcanic dungeon, fraught with vile monsters.

name: Spire of Industry
text:
"A shining monument to corporate greed. One of these days I'm gonna tear it down and burn the rubble."
—Barret Wallace

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: The legendary treasure sleeps where the mountains form a star.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text:
"Thinking of crossing the marshes? Hmm, then it'll probably be safer for you to get a chocobo."
—Chocobo Bill

name: Sunken Hollow
text: Haunting the depths of what is now Loch Seld, Skalla's silent walls lure adventurers into the salt-laden waters with the promise of mysteries unsolved and treasures unclaimed.

name: Espers to Magicite
text: "Come to me, my magicite pretty . . . come, and help me build the Magitek Empire of Kefka!"

name: Sunken Ruins
text:
"Look closely. Emet-Selch has not simply reclaimed these ruins he has layered the semblance of an entire city upon them."
—Y'shtola Rhul

name: Sunlit Marsh
text:
"Ah, our guests have arrived!"
-—Aenc Thon, Lord of the Lingering Gaze

name: Sunpetal Grove
text:
"I wish I could live in a place like this. Peaceful... living with a smile on my face every day."
—Yuna

name: Sunscorched Divide
text:
"You there! We're about to storm the castle. The two of you will join the assault squad. Get moving!"
-—Imperial soldier

name: Tangled Islet
text:
"Are you heading for Kilika Temple? Then just follow this trail. There are poisonous fiends in the forest. Be on your guard!"
-—Crusader captain

name: Temple of Enlightenment
text:
"First down the Moonflow to the Guado city of Guadosalam... then we cross the Thunder Plains to the temple of Macalania."
—Lulu

name: Temple of Mystery
text: Remiem Temple. Once a great religious center in the Calm Lands, lost after the battle with Sin.

name: Temple of Plenty
text: Kilika Temple is the temple of fire. Even the Cloister of Trials is engulfed in flames. Those who disobey the precepts and enter unsanctioned may forfeit their lives.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"It is better for you to die in hope than to live in despair. Let me be your liberator."
—Lady Yunalesca

name: Underground River
text: For years, it was not known how the pirates were able to raid areas so far from the coast, until a local shepherd sighted a band of painted ruffians entering the Sastasha Seagrot...

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text:
"Come, summoner. I will bestow you with my power: the Dark Aeon, Anima."
—Seymour's mother

name: Wooded Ridgeline
text: "Monsters instinctively target weaker prey," said Cloud. "Hmm... you'd better watch out then," Aerith teased.

name: Fated Clash
text:
"I'll show you who's the better man!"
—Seifer Almasy

name: Judgment of Alexander
text:
"Your powers even transcend Bahamut's... Alexander, I've been waiting for you."
—Kuja

name: Amarant Coral
text: "I'm not here to help. I just want it to be fair."

name: Search for Dagger
text: "Dagger is more important to me than anything else."

name: Flash Photography
text: "Gimme a pose I'll never forget!"

name: Lulu, Stern Guardian
text: "No matter how dark the night, morning always comes."

name: Rikku, Resourceful Guardian
text: "Rikku-approved item coming up!"

name: Snapcaster Mage
text: Nym's scholars defended their tiny nation with spell-weaving faeries.

name: Yuffie, Materia Hunter
text: "I have orders to infiltrate Shinra headquarters and steal their ultimate materia."

name: Aerith, Last Ancient
text: "The flowers they ... they have something important to tell us."

name: Birds of Paradise
text: It is rumored that wild breeds of the species— including those which have retained the capacity for flight—still thrive throughout forests nestled in the vastly unexplored valleys of Abalathia's Spine.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Kefka's practically a god now, sitting up in that tower of his with the power of the Warring Triad at his command..."
—Albrook citizen

name: Command Tower
text:
"Thanks to the miracle of mako energy, our lives are richer and better than ever before. Mako keeps our lights on at night, and made Midgar into the city that never sleeps."
—Shinra guide

name: Command Tower
text:
"The city lights go out one by one. The stars fade then the horizon glows, almost like it's on fire. It's really... pretty. I know you'd like it."
—Tidus

name: Rejoin the Fight
text: "I have to fight... to protect the people I love, and to make the world a safe place for new lives!"

name: Siegfried, Famed Swordsman
text: Recent rumors speak of an impostor that shows up and masquerades as Siegfried himself.

name: Cait Sith, Fortune Teller
text: "I'm friend to one and all, thanks to my crystal ball!"

name: Gau, Feral Youth
text: "Uwao! Aooh! I'm Gau! Your friend! Frieeend!!!"

name: Bugenhagen, Wise Elder
text: "I've been thinking if there was anything we could do to help a planet already in misery..."

name: Sphere Grid
text: To activate nodes, you must use spheres.

name: Aerith, Last Ancient
text: "Right here, right now, I need to know I did everything I could."

name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
text: "Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"

name: Banon, the Returners' Leader
text: "You are this world's last ray of light... our final hope."

name: Shelinda, Yevon Acolyte
text: "Truly, I know nothing of the ways of fighting, but I do know some white magic."

name: Fight On!
text: "Just hang in there! Someday we'll look back at these hard times and laugh."

name: Hecteyes
text:
"Once, the monsters of Hell poured forth into the world. They entered using a path known as the Jade Passage."
—Hilda, Princess of Fynn

name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian
text: "Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?"

name: Overkill
text:
"Hey why don't ya try out that sword I gave you!"
—Wakka

name: Poison the Waters
text: "Hee-hee... Nothing beats the sweet music of hundreds of voices screaming in unison! Uwee-hee-hee!"

name: Qutrub Forayer
text: They willfully attain an undead existence to serve their foul mistresses for eternity.

name: Resentful Revelation
text: "The Jenova Project resulted in my conception."

name: Sephiroth's Intervention
text: "Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud."

name: Shambling Cie'th
text: Cie'th are damned to wander the world unliving and undying, until their corrupted flesh at last can move no more.

name: Shinra Reinforcements
text: "End of the line, punk!"

name: Coeurl
text: A lean and limber predator whose whiskers acquire charge from naturally-occurring electric particles in the atmosphere.

name: Summon: Primal Odin
text: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

name: Tonberry
text: Fearful monsters that creep ever forward, knives poised with deadly intent.

name: Undercity Dire Rat
text:
"I finally worked out how to get the door on the left side open! I hope there's somethin' in there besides rats..."
—Kytes, street urchin

name: Barret Wallace
text: "You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"

name: Choco-Comet
text: The other colorations of chocobo tend to be quite violent, giving rise to the saying: "Yellow, best for riding; aught else, best be hiding."

name: The Fire Crystal
text: "Warriors of Light...Only you can restore hope to the world, for yours is the light that can balance out the darkness..."

name: Freya Crescent
text: "We live not to forget our past, but to learn from it!"

name: The Crystal's Chosen
text: Within the light, the will of the crystal surged through them. They decided to accept their destiny. And so began a journey to dispel the darkness and return light to the world ...

name: Haste Magic
text: "Double time."

name: Hill Gigas
text:
"This place is dangerous! Be careful!"
—Zozo resident

name: Item Shopkeep
text: "What can I do for you?"

name: Light of Judgment
text:
"I was there... I saw when Kefka used his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz, far to the east."
—Tzen resident

name: Mysidian Elder
text: "Perhaps this is a test and you must prove yourself worthy."

name: Opera Love Song
text: "O my hero, my beloved, shall we still be made to part?"

name: Prompto Argentum
text: "Look out world, here we come!"

name: Delivery Moogle
text: "A new letter has arrived just for you, kupo!"

name: Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo
text: "Come, then! Who will be next to die on my steel!?"

name: Sabotender
text: These strange, ambulatory cacti are commonly found in the Altepa Desert of the Kuzotz Region, and little regarding their way of life is known to science.

name: Self-Destruct
text:
"Hah! If I'd just left you in the lurch, I'd look like a jerk for all of history!"
—Gilgamesh

name: Sorceress's Schemes
text: "The price for your meddling is death beyond death."

name: Summon: Brynhildr
text: A name in blood, a pact of flame.

name: Summon: Esper Ramuh
text: "I am Ramuh—the esper."

name: Summon: G.F. Cerberus
text: "Pretty confident. Let's see how you do."

name: Summon: G.F. Ifrit
text: "Hm! Not bad for a human."

name: Suplex
text: "The time has come to put my training to use!"

name: Unexpected Request
text: "I shall hereby do my best to kidnap you!"

name: Zell Dincht
text: "My weapons are these fists of mine!"

name: Airship Crash
text:
"Just our luck to crash in this forest... it's gonna get interesting..."
—Baku, Tantalus leader

name: Balamb T-Rexaur
text:
"Sometimes it's better to run!"
—Quistis Trepe

name: Bartz and Boko
text: "Call me Bartz. Me and my chocobo just go wherever the trail leads us..."

name: Blitzball Shot
text:
"Everyone seems to be calling for Wakka, folks!"
—Blitzball announcer

name: Cactuar
text: A cactus with legs that loves to run hither and thither. Watch out for its thorns!

name: Chocobo Racetrack
text:
"No matter how you make your bet, you win some and you lose some. It all comes down to skill and luck."
—Racing expert

name: Dwarven Castle Guard
text: "'Lali-ho' is the dwarven greeting!"

name: Commune with Beavers
text: "Guy speak beaver."

name: Diamond Weapon
text: A tutelary creature said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.

name: Galuf's Final Act
text: "I'll destroy you Exdeath... even if it means I have to take you into the afterlife myself!"

name: Gigantoad
text: The gigantoad is known to venture outside of its comfort zone during downpours—much to the surprise of unsuspecting hikers.

name: Goobbue Gardener
text: The parasitic moss that grows in the folds of the goobbue's back is highly valued as an ingredient in various potions and medicines.

name: Gran Pulse Ochu
text: A mysterious beast that has grown large on its journey across Gran Pulse. Its children, known as microchus, accompany the ochu in combat against adventurers.

name: Fate of the Sun-Cryst
text:
"You would have me destroy the Empire? Is this my duty? Is this what you want?"
—Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca

name: Jumbo Cactuar
text: Some Cactuars live long lives and grow huge. This Jumbo Cactuar is one of them.

name: Loporrit Scout
text: "I've come to realize that it's important to put down the book every now and then, and experience some adventures for myself."

name: Prishe's Wanderings
text: "There's only one reason. They smell an adventure! C'mon! We've got no time to lose!"

name: Quina, Qu Gourmet
text: "World only have two things: Things you can eat and things you no can eat."

name: Reach the Horizon
text:
"Guess this is goodbye, City of Mako."
—Tifa Lockhart

name: A Realm Reborn
text: "The Seventh Astral Era is come!"

name: Ride the Shoopuf
text: "Ride ze shoopuf? All aboards!"

name: Rydia's Return
text:
"Are you okay? You should be able to move now."
—Rydia, Summoner of Mist

name: Sazh Katzroy
text: "Chocobo, we just can't catch a break, can we?"

name: Sazh's Chocobo
text: The chick has no name, as voicing the true identity of the animal might trigger ripples of destiny across Cocoon and cause a hurricane in Eden. Either that, or Sazh just hasn't thought of one yet.

name: Summon: Fat Chocobo
text: A pleasingly plump summon.

name: Summon: Fenrir
text: "Who dares summon me from the darkness?"

name: Tifa Lockhart
text: "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."

name: Torgal, A Fine Hound
text:
"Thank you, Torgal. For never giving up."
—Clive Rosfield

name: Town Greeter
text: "This is Cornelia, the city of dreams."

name: Black Waltz No. 3
text: "You fool. Do I look like some lowly black mage soldier?"

name: Cloud of Darkness
text: "We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"

name: Gaelicat
text:
"That's the ticket! Now, let's get moving to North Mountain!"
—Galuf Baldesion

name: Exdeath, Void Warlock
text: "Mwa-hahahaha! Witness what befalls those who stand against me!"

name: Garland, Knight of Cornelia
text: "I, Garland, will knock you all down!"

name: Garnet, Princess of Alexandria
text: "Someday I will be queen, but I will always be myself."

name: Giott, King of the Dwarves
text: "We will fight along with you for the planet, our home!"

name: Gladiolus Amicitia
text: "Guard the king with our lives—that's the way it's always been."

name: Hope Estheim
text: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."

name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant
text: "In ashen grip, let ember glow, to kindle flames anew."

name: Judge Magister Gabranth
text: "I slew your king. I slew your country. Do these deeds not demand vengeance?"

name: Kuja, Genome Sorcerer
text: "Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past..."

name: Lightning, Army of One
text: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."

name: Locke Cole
text: "As long as there are people who need to be protected, I'll keep on fighting!"

name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
text: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

name: Rufus Shinra
text: "I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man."

name: Serah Farron
text: "Our own private heaven."

name: Shantotto, Tactician Magician
text: "Ohohoho! I might be the harshest mistress in all of Vana'diel. But I may yet forgive you, if at my feet you kneel."

name: Tidus, Blitzball Star
text: "Every blitzer knows: when you got the ball, you gotta score!"

name: Magitek Infantry
text: These cybersoldiers were specifically engineered to excel in combat, and serve as the powerhouse of the imperial infantry.

name: Aettir and Priwen
text:
"The pinnacle o' perfection, forged from blood, sweat, an' tears!"
—Gerolt Blackthorne

name: Elixir
text: Fully recovers HP and MP.

name: Excalibur II
text: The ultimate sword, used by a legendary king. It was forged in another world.

name: Genji Glove
text: "I must say, I quite enjoy these tussles."

name: Instant Ramen
text: "It's not about finding the single best ingredient. It's about crafting that perfect blend of meat, egg, and shrimp. That harmony of flavors is key."

name: Minwu, White Mage
text: "I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded."

name: Iron Giant
text: The iron giant is both hostile and powerful, using a giant blade to fell its foes. The mere mention of its name strikes fear in the hearts of drivers who know how perilous the roads are at night.

name: Lion Heart
text: "Lions are known for their great strength and pride."

name: Lunatic Pandora
text:
"Inside the Lunatic Pandora is this thing called a Crystal Pillar. It calls monsters from the Moon."
—Zell Dincht

name: Magic Pot
text: "Gimme elixir!"

name: PuPu UFO
text: "Thank you!"

name: Relentless X-ATM092
text:
"Let's get the hell out of here!"
—Zell Dincht

name: Ring of the Lucii
text:
"Kings of Lucis... come to me!"
—Noctis Lucis Caelum

name: Moogles' Valor
text:
"Thanks, moogles! We're in your debt!"
—Locke Cole

name: World Map
text: And so their quest began.

name: Adventurer's Inn
text:
"Welcome! We have rooms for 200 gil a night. Would you like to stay and rest your body and mind?"
—Innkeep

name: Baron, Airship Kingdom
text: The advent of the airship marked the realization of Baron's dreams, but also the birth of its militarism.

name: Capital City
text: A city built upon the Isles of Ark that straddle the continents of Storm and Ash.

name: Crossroads Village
text:
"You've got to destroy the Dreadnought!"
—Bafsk resident

name: Eden, Seat of the Sanctum
text: This city, Cocoon's capital, shares its name with its fal'Cie patron.

name: Gohn, Town of Ruin
text:
"They say that beyond the dunes is the Town of Ruin, but no one can even enter the desert to find out, let alone cross it."
—Cid Previa

name: The Gold Saucer
text: After relaxing at Costa del Sol, stop by the Gold Saucer. It's a rich and exciting place to play!

name: Gongaga, Reactor Town
text:
"The Shinra people told us that everyone would be happy once the reactor was built. But all it brought us was sadness..."
—Gongaga villager

name: Guadosalam, Farplane Gateway
text:
"We Guado protect the Farplane so the dead can rest in peace."
—Guadosalam citizen

name: Insomnia, Crown City
text:
"I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind," said King Regis.
"Don't know about you, but I'm ready as I'll ever be," replied Noctis.

name: Ishgard, the Holy See
text: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury.

name: Jidoor, Aristocratic Capital
text:
"You're the spitting image of Maria!"
—Jidoor resident

name: Lindblum, Industrial Regency
text: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.

name: Midgar, City of Mako
text: A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

name: Rabanastre, Royal City
text: The town proper of Rabanastre is divided into four sections by the cardinal directions of the compass. The east and west are merchant districts, the streets lined with shops and stalls of every description.

name: Sharlayan, Nation of Scholars
text:
"The Sharlayans were the keepers of wisdom both old and new. Their mastery over magic and aether was unsurpassed, and even the Garleans knew to fear them."
—Minfilia Warde

name: Starting Town
text: When darkness veils the world, four Warriors of Light shall come.

name: Phoenix Down
text: A feather with the power to revive those who have exhausted their strength.

name: Treno, Dark City
text:
"There aren't many nobles living here. The nights are long. It's a great place for thieves."
—Marcus, Tantalus thief

name: Vector, Imperial Capital
text:
"If we allow the Empire to continue expanding its Magitek arsenal... history's greatest mistake will be repeated."
—Banon, Leader of the Returners

name: Windurst, Federation Center
text: The first Star Sibyl gained the powers of the stars and moon at Full Moon Fountain. She found the stars of hope from within the darkness, and led Windurst to glory.

name: Zanarkand, Ancient Metropolis
text: A city dead for a thousand years. The end of Yuna's journey.

name: Adelbert Steiner
text: "Chivalry requires a knight to look after his comrades-in-arms. I will not abandon you!"

name: Sidequest: Catch a Fish
text: "I am Noctis, Prince of Lucis and King of Fishing!"

name: Ishgard, the Holy See
text: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury.

name: Jidoor, Aristocratic Capital
text:
"You're the spitting image of Maria!"
—Jidoor resident

name: Lindblum, Industrial Regency
text: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.

name: Midgar, City of Mako
text: A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

name: Zanarkand, Ancient Metropolis
text: A city dead for a thousand years. The end of Yuna's journey.

name: Slash of Light
text: The endless struggle that raged over two thousand years had ended, and peace prevailed once more.

name: Lightning, Army of One
text: "Moment of truth, Hero."

name: Snow Villiers
text: "All I can do is go forward. Keep fighting and surviving, until I find the answers I need."

name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
text: "How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"

name: Summon: Choco/Mog
text: "Wark? Kupo!"

name: Summon: Choco/Mog
text: "Wark? Kupo!"

name: Summon: Shiva
text: "Let us summon a sea in a new dream world."

name: Summon: Primal Odin
text: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

name: Summon: Brynhildr
text: A name in blood, a pact of flame.

name: Summon: Esper Ramuh
text: "I am Ramuh— the esper."

name: Summon: G.F. Cerberus
text: "Pretty confident. Let's see how you do."

name: Summon: G.F. Ifrit
text: "Hm! Not bad for a human."

name: Summon: Fat Chocobo
text: A pleasingly plump summon.

name: Summon: Fenrir
text: "Who dares summon me from the darkness?"

name: Ultima
text:
"Such devastation ... this was not my intention!"
—Gaius van Baelsar

name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant
text: "Let the flames burn within you! No... let them burn without!"

name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn
text: "Show me your strength of will!"

name: Weapons Vendor
text: "Man in your line of work needs weapons, no? Why not try that one on for size?"

name: White Auracite
text: "She gave her life that we might defeat the Ascians. Her sacrifice must not be in vain."

name: Adelbert Steiner
text: "Chivalry requires a knight to look after his comrades-in-arms. I will not abandon you!"

name: Ashe, Princess of Dalmasca
text: "I am simply myself. No more and no less. And I want only to be free."

name: Beatrix, Loyal General
text: "I commend your courage, but I will show you no mercy."

name: The Wind Crystal
text: "I give unto you the last of my light, and with it, the last hope of a fading world."

name: Minwu, White Mage
text: "I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded."

name: Rosa, Resolute White Mage
text: "I have no regrets for becoming a white mage and fighting alongside a brave knight."

name: Snow Villiers
text: "All I can do is go forward. Keep fighting and surviving, until I find the answers I need."

name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
text: "How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"

name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn
text: "Show me your strength of will!"

name: Edgar, King of Figaro
text: "Sabin...let's settle this with the toss of a coin."

name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
text: "I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."

name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant
text: "I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."

name: Matoya, Archon Elder
text: "Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today..."

name: You're Not Alone
text:
"You've always protected us. But you still don't understand that we looked out for you, too!"
—Dagger

name: Quistis Trepe
text: "It's not like everyone can get by on their own, you know?"

name: Ultimecia, Temporal Threat
text:
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate."
—Edea Kramer

name: Y'shtola Rhul
text: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

name: Cecil, Dark Knight
text: "I suppose this is my fate as a dark knight. Soon, I won't even feel remorse for my actions."

name: Fang, Fearless l'Cie
text: "If I don't figure out our Focus soon... Vanille's gonna be a Cieʼth. I'll tear down the sky if it'll save her."

name: Jecht, Reluctant Guardian
text: "Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?"

name: Seymour Flux
text: "Your hope ends here. And your meaningless existence with it."

name: Barret Wallace
text: "You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"

name: Freya Crescent
text: "We live not to forget our past, but to learn from it!"

name: Lightning, Security Sergeant
text: "I had to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning."

name: Prompto Argentum
text: "Look out world, here we come!"

name: Queen Brahne
text: "Oh? Are you defying me as well?"

name: Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo
text: "Come, then! Who will be next to die on my steel!?"

name: Zell Dincht
text: "My weapons are these fists of mine!"

name: Bartz and Boko
text: "Call me Bartz. Me and my chocobo just go wherever the trail leads us..."

name: Diamond Weapon
text: A tutelary creature said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.

name: Quina, Qu Gourmet
text: "World only have two things: Things you can eat and things you no can eat."

name: Sazh Katzroy
text: "Chocobo, we just can't catch a break, can we?"

name: Tifa Lockhart
text: "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."

name: Torgal, A Fine Hound
text:
"Thank you, Torgal. For never giving up."
—Clive Rosfield

name: Absolute Virtue
text: "These memories generate sssuffering... these thoughtsss... bring remorssse..."

name: Black Waltz No. 3
text: "You fool. Do I look like some lowly black mage soldier?"

name: Combat Tutorial
text:
"Clueless, aren't you? Good thing I'm here."
—Lulu

name: Cloud of Darkness
text: "We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"

name: Cloud, Planet's Champion
text: "It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"

name: Exdeath, Void Warlock
text: "Mwa-hahahaha! Witness what befalls those who stand against me!"

name: Garland, Knight of Cornelia
text: "I, Garland, will knock you all down!"

name: Garnet, Princess of Alexandria
text: "Someday I will be queen, but I will always be myself."

name: Giott, King of the Dwarves
text: "We will fight along with you for the planet, our home!"

name: Gladiolus Amicitia
text: "Guard the king with our lives—that's the way it's always been."

name: Dragoon's Wyvern
text:
"I heard that to become a dragoon, you had to make a pact with a living wyvern. However, thanks to the dragonslayers, there aren't that many dragons left."
—Ceraulian, San d'Oria citizen

name: Hope Estheim
text: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."

name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant
text: "In ashen grip, let ember glow, to kindle flames anew."

name: Judge Magister Gabranth
text: "I slew your king. I slew your country. Do these deeds not demand vengeance?"

name: Kuja, Genome Sorcerer
text: "Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past..."

name: Lightning, Army of One
text: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."

name: Locke Cole
text: "As long as there are people who need to be protected, I'll keep on fighting!"

name: Dreams of Laguna
text: "Don't go back on your word. C'mon, go wave to her."

name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
text: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

name: Rufus Shinra
text: "I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man."

name: Sephiroth, Planet's Heir
text: "This is the end... for all of you."

name: Serah Farron
text: "Our own private heaven."

name: Shantotto, Tactician Magician
text: "Ohohoho! I might be the harshest mistress in all of Vana'diel. But I may yet forgive you, if at my feet you kneel."

name: Edgar, King of Figaro
text: "Sabin...let's settle this with the toss of a coin."

name: Tidus, Blitzball Star
text: "Every blitzer knows: when you got the ball, you gotta score!"

name: Ultimecia, Time Sorceress
text: "Your vain krusade ends here, SeeDs."

name: Xande, Dark Mage
text: "But your struggle was all for naught. Don't you see how close the darkness has drawn?"

name: Yuna, Hope of Spira
text: "I will stand my ground and be strong."

name: Ether
text: Restores 20 MP.

name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
text: "I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."

name: Cloud, Planet's Champion
text: "It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"

name: Sephiroth, Planet's Heir
text: "This is the end... for all of you."

name: Beatrix, Loyal General
text: "I commend your courage, but I will show you no mercy."

name: Ultimecia, Temporal Threat
text:
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate."
—Edea Kramer

name: Deadly Embrace
text: "Come, little lamb... to the slaughter with you!"

name: Seymour Flux
text: "Your hope ends here. And your meaningless existence with it."

name: Judgment Bolt
text: "I'm here to even the odds. Any objections?"

name: Xande, Dark Mage
text: "But your struggle was all for naught. Don't you see how close the darkness has drawn?"

name: Ultima Weapon
text: "This will be the end of it."

name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
text: "Traveling the world has taught me how little I know!"

name: A Realm Reborn
text:
"A new day now begins in Eorzea."
—Raubahn Aldynn

name: Tifa Lockhart
text: "Words aren't the only way to tell someone how you feel."

name: Il Mheg Pixie
text: "Well now, aren't you just brimming with life? I'd love to suck up all that aether like nectar from a flower!"

name: Yuna, Hope of Spira
text: "I will stand my ground and be strong."

name: Y'shtola Rhul
text: "Sleep well, and may the shadows keep you."

name: Phoenix Down
text: A feather with the power to revive those who have exhausted their strength.

name: White Auracite
text: "She gave her life that we might defeat the Ascians. Her sacrifice must not be in vain."

name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant
text: "I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."

name: Barret Wallace
text: "You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"

name: Louisoix's Sacrifice
text:
"Thank you... for everything... Pray take your rest, Grandfather... You deserve it."
—Alisaie Leveilleur

name: Magic Damper
text: "You're gonna wish you hadn't."

name: Matoya, Archon Elder
text: "Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today..."

name: Qiqirn Merchant
text: Small Beastmen that live alongside humans in the Aht Urhgan Empire. Their ancestors were nomads in the north, and their unique culture and customs can be seen even now.

name: Quistis Trepe
text: "It's not like everyone can get by on their own, you know?"

name: Relm's Sketching
text: In her pictures she captures everything: forests, water, light . . . the very essence of the things she paints.

name: Rook Turret
text:
"'Tis unfortunate that many Ishgardians cannot appreciate the practicality of my work."
—Stephanivien de Haillenarte

name: Ashe, Princess of Dalmasca
text: "I am simply myself. No more and no less. And I want only to be free."

name: Sahagin
text: "Pshhh... Shhhilence, shhhorewalker! Try to eshhhcape, and I'll shhhlice gills into your neck!"

name: Scorpion Sentinel
text:
"Barret, be careful! Attack while its tail's up, it's gonna counterattack with its laser."
—Cloud Strife

name: Sidequest: Card Collection
text: The glory of the tourney awaits!

name: Stolen Uniform
text: "It's a little tight, but the price was right!"

name: Summon: Shiva
text: "Let us summon a sea in a new dream world."

name: Auron's Inspiration
text:
"Now is the time to choose! Now is the time to shape your stories! Your fate is in your hands!"
—Auron

name: Syncopate
text: "Your eyes, they burn with resolve . . . beautiful."

name: Travel the Overworld
text:
"My dad always wanted me to go out and travel the world. But it also feels like ... like the wind is calling me."
—Bartz Klauser

name: The Water Crystal
text:
"Crystal of water, may you regain your light."
—Aria Benett

name: Y'shtola Rhul
text: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

name: Ahriman
text: "The Wrath of Dark has nearly reached its zenith! No one can stop it! Least of all you!"

name: Al Bhed Salvagers
text: "We found the airship! The records were right."

name: Cecil, Dark Knight
text: "I suppose this is my fate as a dark knight. Soon, I won't even feel remorse for my actions."

name: Cornered by Black Mages
text:
"Kuja called them black mages, dark spawn of the mist."
—The Soulcage

name: Dark Confidant
text: "Fare you well, Bringer of Light."

name: Evil Reawakened
text: "Galuf. It's good to see you again . . . Mwa-hahahahaha!"

name: Fang, Fearless l'Cie
text: "If I don't figure out our Focus soon... Vanille's gonna be a Cieʼth. I'll tear down the sky if it'll save her."

name: River Boa
text:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Longbow Archer
text:
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Roya, Zhalfirin archer

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Mind Warp
text: The hardest of wizards can have the softest of minds.

name: Shock
text:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

name: Graft Surgeon
text: When medical supplies are limited, her own cuttings will suffice.

name: Flourishing Grapple
text: Lorehold believed in learning from history. Hexhaven made sure that history was brief.

name: Gardenize
text:
Starting sprouts
—Vigorbloom term for their first graft

name: Greenhouse Propagator
text: Vigorbloom's unique graft technique requires the tender nurturing of seedlings to root seamlessly into the body and facilitate healing.

name: Hexhaven Invigorator
text:
"Behold ideal symbiosis."
—Kwia Vigorbloom

name: Hunter's Axe
text: One wielder a fierce steward of the wilds, the other a cruel bringer of death.

name: Guiding Hydra
text: It hands direction to straying minds.

name: Omnipresence
text: Her choice made, Tam called upon the one being who could fix what Jace had done.

name: Restore with Empathy
text: Garruk looked at the young, scared boy from Vryn. "I have also begun anew," he rumbled.

name: Simulacrum Shaper
text: It was solemn work, repurposing flesh as fertile soil.

name: Something Worth Saving
text: "Jace cut out all the best pieces of himself. If we find them, perhaps they can help save him."

name: Sureshot Sower
text: Her specialized arrows turn targets to compost before they even hit the ground.

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't adapt, dies. And what dies feeds the tarmogoyf.

name: Tethermage's Advantage
text: Konstrari students harness leyline energy to animate their constructs. The more determined the tethermage, the more effective the puppetbeast.

name: Verdant Kraken
text: It specializes in natural disorder.

name: Vinelasher Adept
text: Some battlevine cultivars can grasp flesh as easily as they can climb walls.

name: Wrecking Gecko
text:
"Corridors 17-24 are now open for extra credit training. Come prepared."
—Campus announcement

name: Blessed Ghoul
text: He had failed his final exam, but his professor had kindly offered a way to make up the work.

name: Bloombrute
text:
"Proper medical assistance is hard to find. I suggest you grow your own."
—Karalgin, professor of phytomancy

name: Charge the Sanctum
text: Deep in their hearts, the team believed what was left of Jace could still be reasoned with.

name: Clash of Elements
text: "More fire? Is that your solution to everything?" one Chandra asked. "Works pretty well, doesn't it?" the other replied.

name: Desperate Futurescribe
text: As realities merged, the futures she could read dwindled.

name: Kindred Judgment
text: In the end, the light shone, the land flourished, and the dead and vile were washed away.

name: Entrust the Spark
text: "A spark is power and freedom. Use it better than I did," Jace's voice echoed to Tam.

name: Frostbite Pyromental
text: It's a contradiction in burns.

name: Loyal Tutor
text: "We swore to keep watch," Ajani growled through gritted teeth, "and that includes against our own."

name: Solarium Sentry
text: "I've seen hay fever hit harder than that!"

name: Solitary Cell
text: Denied all tools of necromancy, Liliana endured her least favorite feeling: boredom.

name: Memory Trap
text: The Theorist used his own memories to trap the parts of Jace that objected to his plans, and to ensnare the friends who wished to stop him.

name: Stinging Vitriol
text:
"Confidence is relative. Bolster yours by breaking theirs."
—Ingris Stingerquill

name: Tam's Resistance
text: Tam had offered to help and Vraska believed her.

name: Tenured Tethermage
text: "Today, you will be learning material repurposing and adaptation. This will be on the test."

name: Twinned Vision
text: "She will rage and burn until her fuel is expended. It's almost sad to see me like this."

name: Twisted Fates
text: "Josu's ashes choke you even now. You failed, while I will have our brother live forever," said one Liliana to the other.

name: Predictive Preparations
text: Fatehold battlemages believe the best way to win a duel is to first study the outcome.

name: Vindictive Triumph
text: As much as Liliana never wanted to see her opaline double again, she had always been loath to prematurely discard a useful tool.

name: Warrior's Blades
text: Whetted against grief. Wielded with vengeance.

name: Afterthought Sentry
text: An eyeless guard of stone watches a forgotten annex of memory, granite feathers rustling in breezes no one thinks to remember.

name: Archive Arbiter
text: It ensures students leave the Folioplex with the correct notes, theories, and ponderings.

name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
text: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

name: The Echoverse Fulcrum
text: The tower transformed to fulfill its true purpose: as a catalyst to merge the old Multiverse with the new.

name: Prophesied End
text: Upon death, an oracle of Arcavios returns to the very source of their world. Jace followed Jadzi's mind to witness two planes becoming one.

name: Eye of Jace
text: All cadets wore the Eye. None discussed how it followed their every move.

name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
text: Late at night it searches for students congregating where they shouldn't be.

name: Living Library
text:
"Too many lives have been cut short, too many of their futures untold. I can rewrite them. I can give them a voice."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

name: Medic's Kitesail
text: An apothecary on wings.

name: Murmuring Volume
text: Its pages surrender no words until the book has first read its prospective reader.

name: Dedicated Commons
text:
"Our mobile greenhouse will never be deprived of energy again. It will always align itself to the sun's path."
—Vigorbloom and Konstrari joint project

name: Deserted Beach
text: Jace remembered the island. The useless original, the inner refuge. He remembered how twice he found the strength to rebuild himself from nothing.

name: Fatehold Annex
text: Battlemages of Fatehold, the school of future history, sift through infinite potentials to write the future they desire.

name: Formidable Commons
text:
"The wood of the theater is shaped to capture reverberations, and the resulting sound is deafening!"
—Konstrari and Stingerquill joint project

name: Hall of Echoes
text: The tunnels below Hexhaven murmur with ripples of first breaths.

name: Refute Destiny
text: Quandrix believed in finding the equations of the natural world. Hexhaven disrupted the pattern of existence.

name: Haunted Ridge
text: Jace remembered the mage-rings. The first time he touched another's mind. He remembered how powerful his own could be if he were willing to find his limits.

name: Hexhaven Dueling Arena
text: Those who survive are stronger for it.

name: Innovative Commons
text:
"Proud to announce we've invented a *voice-activated* void portal! No gestures needed!"
—Stingerquill and Theorix joint project

name: Konstrari Annex
text: Battlemages of Konstrari, the school of constructive arts, pour their hearts into their craft in defense of Hexhaven.

name: Meticulous Commons
text:
"We present a new way to calculate predictions based upon the *absence* of data."
—Fatehold and Theorix joint project

name: Overgrown Farmland
text: Jace remembered the shadows. The inscrutable puzzle, the prisoner in the moon. He remembered how victory could be achieved by choosing not to play.

name: Rockfall Vale
text: Jace remembered the gate. The dying world, the wanderers who stayed to fight. He remembered how even the most impossible problems had practical solutions.

name: Roiling Canopy
text: Jace left slices of his personality trapped in his strongest memories.

name: Room of Refuge
text: Any shelter from the Theorist's gaze was a welcome one.

name: Shipwreck Marsh
text: Jace remembered the ship. The captain who saw him through. He remembered how losing a part of himself had only made him stronger.

name: Repurposed Enforcer
text: A face half remembered, a form fit to serve.

name: Stingerquill Annex
text: Battlemages of Stingerquill, the school of painful words, sharpen their tongues to cut down the unworthy.

name: Theorix Annex
text: Battlemages of Theorix, the school of esoteric mathematics, reshape reality itself to their whim.

name: Transformative Commons
text:
"We've developed seeds that see their own future and self-select for the good of the species."
—Vigorbloom and Fatehold joint project

name: Vigorbloom Annex
text: Battlemages of Vigorbloom, the school of invasive healing, tend to the health of Hexhaven, no matter the cost.

name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
text: "Benalia stands for hope and light. I pledge my blade to any that fall under its banner."

name: Gideon's Memorial
text: Inscribed are the words "I will keep watch."

name: Koth of the Homestead
text: "Malach, tell your mother the steelfruit harvest is abundant this cycle!"

name: Academic Ascent
text: The Theorist takes notice of innovative battlemages.

name: Return to the Light Realms
text:
"For every living person there are generations of souls reaching out to be remembered."
—Liliana the Faultless

name: Liliana the Faultless
text: "All mistakes can be fixed. Even you."

name: Lyra, Archangel of Dawn
text: She is the radiant sun that shatters darkness.

name: Rescue Girl, First Responder
text:
"The Helpful Hero! The Daring Darling of the Tenth District!"
—*Ravnica Gazette* headline

name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
text: "A creative mind is a dangerous thing."

name: Thalia, the Survivor
text: "In Sigarda's name, I will ensure your peaceful rest."

name: Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage
text: "Many wield the law as a cudgel. I prefer to use it as a shield."

name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
text: The Emperor spared no comfort for the friend who had so diligently awaited her return.

name: Shatterwing Pegasus
text: Winged with the shards of shattered star arches, it circles above the Eradia. A rare glimmer of hope for students caught in the perilous wasteland that surrounds Jace's tower.

name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
text: "Emperor Tamiyo rules with truth, respect, and passion. She has more than earned my loyalty."

name: Arni, Humble Scribe
text: "If you have a tale worthy of telling, I would hear it, friend."

name: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost
text: Fblthp had *definitely* made a wrong turn.

name: Geist of Saint Thalia
text: "Be at peace, child. The horrors will not claim you this night."

name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
text: "Kefnet always told me to apply my knowledge. I merely chose to apply it in usurping him."

name: Lyra, Tolarian Archangel
text: Knowledge is radiance.

name: Proft, Consulting Detective
text: When the crime is violent, call the Boros. When it's legalistic, call the Azorius. When it's complex, call him.

name: Ruric Thar, Biomagus
text: The Simic Combine's two brightest minds.

name: Surgical Precision
text: Vigorbloom battlemages love dueling. Opportunities to hurt sow opportunities to heal.

name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
text: Everything in her wake stills, then stops.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "You can't always be perfect. Sometimes your escape has to be just good enough."

name: Traxos, Academy Guardian
text:
"Tolaria has stood for a thousand years. You're looking at why."
—Lyra, Tolarian headmaster

name: Yargle, Goliath of Otaria
text:
"Why sure I remember Yar-Kul! Man had the most refined palate in all Otaria. I still have some of his cookbooks. Shame he went and trespassed in Krosan forest . . . There ain't a single soul who comes outta those woods unchanged."
—Mister Foundforks, culinarian

name: Danitha, Spear of Agony
text: "To know the Cabal is to know despair. None can stand against its legions."

name: Gallia, Tragic Host
text: The party never ends, but the guests will never arrive.

name: Unflinching Hortimancer
text: Battlefield medicine is as much about timing as it is healing. A perfect remedy is worthless if it comes too late.

name: Gideon the Oathless
text: "The man who was Kytheon Iora, hero of the people, was lost long ago. I serve no one now."

name: Liliana the Repentant
text: "My mistakes are *mine* to fix."

name: Loot, the Anomaly
text: Loot's value is absolute in any Multiverse, so Jace kept him locked away and hidden.

name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
text: With her village destroyed, Mabel turned to the Calamity Beasts to bring down King Glarb.

name: Massacre Girl, Most Wanted
text: Ravnica's most feared—and most adored—serial killer.

name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
text: If the crime is violent, it's the Rakdos. If it's covert, it's the Dimir. If it's intricate, it's him.

name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
text: "I once witnessed the power of a diamondstorm. I had to make that power my own."

name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
text: No score is too small, no coin purse too big.

name: Your Fate Ends Here
text: "The future looms large over the present, and you're blocking my view."

name: Winter, Tormented Loner
text: He had no one left to betray but himself.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text:
"I look forward to the day when my biggest concern is the ravenous, spectral, overgrown, croaking, hulking, foulmouthed abomination that turns up every now and again just to vex us."
—Field notes of Aryel, knight of Windgrace

name: Arni, Renowned Champion
text: There is no man with more bravado in all Bretagard, yet he has never exaggerated a single detail.

name: Gallia, the Merrymaker
text: All of Theros is her dance floor.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Alone
text: His best friend was gone. Someone had to pay.

name: Kiora of Fire and Ashes
text: "If you can't stand the heat, get out of my way."

name: Koth, the Geomancer
text: "My home was lost a long time ago. But maybe we can forge something new."

name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
text: "I had to make a choice: save my people from Benalia, or save the land from my people. In the end, it was no choice at all."

name: Pia, Determined Rebuilder
text: "We've kept one foot in the past for too long. Now we walk into a better future!"

name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
text: Samut doesn't pretend to know the best path, but she does know that Amonkhet will only thrive if its people keep moving forward.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer
text: "Every exit is covered. You can't run."

name: Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage
text: "Laws are made to be broken. This includes physics and thermodynamics."

name: Winter, Team Player
text: "Everyone stick together. Follow my lead!"

name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
text: Innistrad's moonlit nights belong to his pack and his pack alone.

name: Fblthp, Knows the Way
text: Fblthp had always loved to travel.

name: Cruel Calculations
text:
"There is no curve. Either you succeeded, or you did not. Either way, this will be informative."
—Uldaros Theorix

name: Ghalta the Unstoppable
text: The apex of nature's ferocity.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone
text: "I traveled with Mowu as a Planeswalker. Now I do so through Omenpaths. Neither of us are complaining about the longer walk."

name: Loot, the Nexus
text:
"Within Loot's mind were the blueprints I needed to complete this new Multiverse. He gave me hope. Tell him that, Vraska."
—Jace

name: Marwyn, the Preserver
text: "We are Llanowar's children, but also its protectors. Our destinies are one."

name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
text: "Perhaps one day I will learn how to break the hold the Consulate has over Chandra and Kiran."

name: Ruric Thar, Magecrusher
text: "Can't cast spells with a broken mouth!"

name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
text: Titanbones found he received the greatest gifts in the littlest things.

name: Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray
text: His cunning leadership of Towashi's dogs earned him the nickname "The Stray Emperor."

name: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord
text: "Our family was born in blood, and through blood it will endure."

name: Hapatra, the Desert Fang
text: "Your people stand strong, Rhonas. Rest easy, you have prepared us well."

name: Karn, Gilded Guardian
text: Karn forged the empty world of Mirrodin and filled it with peaceful creations.

name: Kiora of Salt and Sand
text: "The sea ends where I say it does."

name: Mabel, Valley Hero
text: Mabel had learned that mother, adventurer, and protector were not all that far apart.

name: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar
text: "Life isn't worth living without freedom of expression."

name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
text: "Paths to peace are carved in flesh and stone. This is how we reform what has failed before."

name: Vraska, the Cutting Glare
text: "No one can remake me. Not Bolas, not Phyrexia, and not you, Jace."

name: Karn, Argent Defender
text: "I owe the Multiverse a debt I fear I can never repay. That remedy begins now, with a first step away from the past and toward the future I wish to see."

name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
text: Its orders, ancient. Its advance, ponderous. Its threat, undeniable.

name: Divining Duelist
text: "I predicted your quips yesterday, Stingerquill. They weren't clever then either."

name: Teyo, Lightshield Expert
text: A hard-earned confidence reinforced his shield. He would not falter.

name: Thalia, the Survivor
text: "Every day, another threat. And every day, I will meet it."

name: Geist of Saint Thalia
text: "Each night, a restless terror. And each night, I will soothe it."

name: Icy Reception
text: "Keep them distracted," instructed the Theorist. Chandra's doppelganger smiled, and a chill went through the air.

name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
text: "I have slowed the suns themselves. Do you truly think your pulse will fare any better?"

name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
text: His heart had become as hard and sharp as the diamonds he wielded.

name: Winter, Tormented Loner
text: "There is no exit. No end. Not for me."

name: Infinite Coursework
text: Theorem dreams soon became nightmares.

name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
text: "Llanowar is both a forest and a people. Forests are replaceable. People are not."

name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
text: "Sometimes the answer is to keep moving—the sunrise at your back, the perilous expanse before you."

name: Winter, Team Player
text: "I'm not looking for a way out of Duskmourn unless I can bring every other survivor along with me."

name: Marwyn, the Preserver
text: "Our prosperity comes from a forest that has always provided. We belong to Llanowar as much as it belongs to us."

name: Karn, Gilded Guardian
text: A world without blemishes, a soul without anguish.

name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
text: "Your scars are fault lines. I will shatter them, and you."

name: Vraska, the Cutting Glare
text: "I'm proud of my scars. They're who I am."

name: Karn, Argent Defender
text: A life without rest, a soul heavy with regret.

name: Mindseeker Oculus
text:
"No need to sneak around. Beleren knows we're here."
—Garruk, to Vraska

name: Perfected Theory
text: In the Meditation Realm, Jace had seen himself reflected in a Multiverse complete in every detail. Now he only had to make it real.

name: Precise Redaction
text: Silverquill believed the word was the mightiest weapon. Hexhaven got the last one.

name: Protege's Awakening
text:
"Am I a person?" she asked.
Jace smiled. "Yes. Your name is Tamira. But who you are is up to you."

name: Campus Crier
text: He speaks what the futurescribes have written.

name: Loyal Tutor
text: "We swore to keep watch," Ajani growled through gritted teeth, "and that includes against our own."

name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
text: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

name: Undulating Witness
text: Twisting in the wind like a strange banner, it keeps watch over the horizon and tower alike.

name: Unsummon
text:
"The Multiverse is a work in progress. There will need to be revisions."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

name: Enlightened Confidant
text: Greatness is earned, not bought.

name: Break Under Pressure
text:
"Please, do take it personally."
—Ingris Stingerquill

name: Cast Away Doubt
text: Every part of Jace's mind that objected to his plan had been cut away. The Theorist was all that remained.

name: Dark Matter Manipulator
text: Theorix has the most instances, by far, of posthumously awarded extra credit.

name: Darklight Phoenix
text: Some eclipses never exit totality.

name: Extended Absence
text:
"On the bright side, the corpus inversion spell performed as expected."
—Zim, Theorix mage

name: Extrapolate the Impossible
text: Jace believed that if he could successfully merge the two Multiverses, he would remove the suffering of so many.

name: Last Gasp
text:
"Poor cadet didn't even make it to the chorus."
—Miskatel, Stingerquill voxmancer

name: Multiply by Zero
text: Existence can be categorically denied. You just need the right variables.

name: Overwrite the Multiverse
text: "Suffering ends at my will."

name: Rampart Hunter
text: The Eradia surrounding Hexhaven is rife with mage hunters drawn to the powerful magic emanating from the school's tower.

name: Rank Rat
text: The scrabbling of claws across stone was a symphony to Liliana's ears as she ordered the swarm against her sickeningly nice twin.

name: Rise of the Deathbringer
text: "I am the curse."

name: Screeching Soulbreaker
text: She weaves brutal insults into hypnotizing melodies, enthralling her victims to stay and listen.

name: Silence the Echo
text: The Vraska who had never known pain could not comprehend the unyielding will of the Vraska who had known too much.

name: Solve for Disappointment
text: The Theorist has no interest in failures.

name: Terminal Criticism
text: Prismari believed art was in the eye of the beholder. Hexhaven was a harsh critic.

name: Theoretical Necromancer
text: "Mortality is just one more parameter to define and defy."

name: Flickering Hound
text: It roams the halls for truant students, who suddenly find themselves back in class.

name: Ajani's Anguish
text: The memory trap tormented Ajani. "Time's up, brother," said Jazal's voice inside his head. "Your vengeance, or your friends. What will it be?"

name: Artifist Acumen
text:
"It's important to emphasize core principles, but to win duels you must extrapolate your designs to work in a variety of formats."
—*Advanced Tethering*

name: Awaken the Inferno
text: Nothing burns like betrayal.

name: Blazing Crescendo
text:
"I learned this little trick from Koth."
—Chandra

name: Chandra's Emberling
text: When Chandra needed to summon a chaotic distraction, only one form came to mind.

name: Command the Stage
text: Stingerquill admits only the fiercest hearts.

name: Craterclaw Colossus
text: Some puppetbeasts are monstrous machines. Others, works of art. The best are both.

name: Curse-Marred Demon
text: He had gambled and accepted the pact, ignorant of what he stood to lose.

name: Generous Revival
text: "Right as rain!" the saccharine double taunted.

name: Draconic Visitor
text:
"What is that?! A firebreathing sphinx?"
—Derenk, Hexhaven cadet

name: Eardrum Rattler
text: She puts the harm in harmony.

name: Essence Burn
text: Witherbloom believed in life and death's intricate balance. Hexhaven was drawn to their unpredictable power.

name: Face Yourself
text:
"I only wish you could see the necessity of this. Your counterparts all have."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

name: Fulminous Forte
text: A solo so violent even the echoes can deafen the unprepared.

name: Heartstring Puller
text: "Come on cadet, I'll show you the ropes!"

name: Master of Barbs
text: The question isn't *if* he'll make his students cry. Only when.

name: Germinate Recruits
text:
"Bring me the underperformers. I will make them flourish."
—Kwia Vigorbloom

name: Skilled Battlecarver
text: Konstrari frontline mages are adept at turning implements of craft into instruments of war.

name: Tether Technician
text: Konstrari cadets are Hexhaven's front line against any threat, be it Eradian abominations or extradimensional academies.

name: Violent Echoes
text: Two Multiverses. Only one future.

name: Wrath of the Bloodmane
text: "I can see the weakness in your soul. Let me cut it out of you!"

name: Arcane Amphisbaena
text: Its tongues can taste loyalty—or deceit.

name: Bestial Incursion
text:
"Petition the dean for additional seeds. Gaz and Dak got into the medical supplies. Again."
—Divik, Vigorbloom cadet

name: Budding Insurgent
text: "If we're going to fix things, we should start here. Why does no one question the Theorist?"

name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
text: Devourer of the Obzedat, tithe-drinker, and necroparun eternal.

name: Memnarch, the Warden
text: In the gleam between metal and suns, Memnarch found meaning.

name: Turbulent Crater
text:
"The Theorist swears this Multiverse will be free of suffering, but part of me wonders if he just plans on hiding it better."
—Tam, field notes

name: Turbulent Shore
text:
"I knew this Multiverse to be superior when I had never experienced the other. Now that I have, I am . . . less certain."
—Tam, field notes

name: Turbulent Wetlands
text:
"There is a deep sadness here . . . one I had not thought possible in this reality. Is it my understanding that's flawed or the Theorist's?"
—Tam, field notes

name: Tamiyo, Upriser Crowned
text: She seized the throne to protect her family first, Kamigawa second.

name: Darksteel Angel
text: An alloy of curiosity and hope; the caretaker of a gleaming plane of possibility.

name: Memnarch, the Warden
text: In the gleam between metal and suns, Memnarch found meaning.

name: Turbulent Crater
text:
"The Theorist swears this Multiverse will be free of suffering, but part of me wonders if he just plans on hiding it better."
—Tam, field notes

name: Turbulent Shore
text:
"I knew this Multiverse to be superior when I had never experienced the other. Now that I have, I am . . . less certain."
—Tam, field notes

name: Turbulent Wetlands
text:
"There is a deep sadness here . . . one I had not thought possible in this reality. Is it my understanding that's flawed or the Theorist's?"
—-Tam, field notes

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"Everything is in progress . . . just like us. May we always know exactly who we are."
—Jace, to Tam

name: Sol Ring
text: Jace could see the sunlight in his Multiverse, but somewhere along the way, he lost the feel of its warmth.

name: Command Tower
text: The pinnacle of Jace's hope for a better, different Multiverse.

name: Reflecting Pool
text:
"Jace's world is like a warped mirror. Like some part of him strains against what the Theorist is creating."
—Vraska

name: Flawless Maneuver
text:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Grand Crescendo
text: The roar of applause drowned out the melee raging in the lobby.

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
text: Unconnected to the land, it hungers.

name: Secure the Wastes
text:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Serra's Emissary
text: Where swords fail, faith transcends.

name: Stroke of Midnight
text:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—*Tale of the Masked Maiden*

name: Sunfall
text:
"Let the light scour away your imperfect flesh."
—Heliod

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Brainstorm
text: "I have a plan. Actually, I have three."

name: Brainsurge
text: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Occult Epiphany
text: In a single unending moment, a hundred lifetimes of knowledge coursed through his unraveling mind.

name: Synthetic Destiny
text: To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.

name: Archon of Cruelty
text: Malice spreads on wings of tyranny.

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Whirlwind of Thought
text: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
text:
"She binds them to do naught but worship her. It is no salvation she grants, but servitude."
—Geist of Saint Thalia

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Fabled Passage
text: Beyond Valley lies danger—and promise.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Mystic Gate
text: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Radiant Summit
text:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

name: Sunken Ruins
text: Without the care of the tideshapers, the Lanes lie neglected. Some have flooded entire towns; others dried to cracked mud.

name: Underground River
text:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
text: Unconnected to the land, it hungers.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
text:
"She binds them to do naught but worship her. It is no salvation she grants, but servitude."
—Geist of Saint Thalia

name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
text: Devourer of the Obzedat, tithe-drinker, and necroparun eternal.

name: Tamiyo, Upriser Crowned
text: She seized the throne to protect her family first, Kamigawa second.

name: Darksteel Angel
text: An alloy of curiosity and hope; the caretaker of a gleaming plane of possibility.

name: Dragon Bell Monk
text: He has spent years training his eyes and ears to detect the subtle signs of a dragon's approach.

name: Friendly Fire
text:
"Never tell goblins to 'fire at will.'"
—Urut Barzeel, Mardu hordechief

name: Gore Swine
text:
"The Mardu are like the gore swine. We are wild, hunt in packs, and rarely clean the blood from our blades."
—Vallash, Mardu warrior

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Hungering Yeti
text: No clan is as adept at saying "go away" as the Temur.

name: Lightning Shrieker
text: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.

name: Mardu Scout
text: The Mardu all enjoy war, but only the goblins make a game of it.

name: Dragonscale General
text: "Dragons seek war. I bring it to them."

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Take inspiration from your enemies, and make their strengths your own."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

name: Shockmaw Dragon
text: Dragons of the Kolaghan brood are always on the move. They are the driving force behind the Mardu's nomadic way of life.

name: Smoldering Efreet
text: The efreet are drawn to the Kaisham Wanderers, a loosely organized Jeskai school where trickery is employed to challenge the status quo and upend the belief systems of others.

name: Wild Slash
text: Never mistake deception for cleverness.

name: Abzan Beastmaster
text: His beasts move the great siege towers of the Abzan across the endless sands.

name: Abzan Kin-Guard
text: "The Mardu rush headlong toward extinction. We ensure the longevity of our clan by protecting our territory, not rampaging through it."

name: Ambush Krotiq
text: The Abzan merchants soon discovered why this route was clear of dragons.

name: Archers of Qarsi
text:
"We think of the naga as creeping cutthroats, slitherers in the swamps. But they are equally at home in the trees."
—Goton, Qal Sisma shaman

name: Battlefront Krushok
text: Krushoks clear debris from fertile fields, fallow fields, and battlefields.

name: Cached Defenses
text: The glittering scales in the Abzan vaults represent mighty deeds of the past and protection for generations to come.

name: Destructor Dragon
text: After countless attacks on the Salt Road where it passes through the frozen tundra, the Abzan began to refer to the area as Atarka territory rather than Temur lands.

name: Feral Krushok
text: In a stunning act of diplomacy, Yasova Dragonclaw ceded a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai. Her clan protested until they saw she had given the Sultai the breeding grounds of the krushoks. They hadn't realized she had a sense of humor.

name: Great-Horn Krushok
text: Perfectly suited for life in the Shifting Wastes, the krushok is well protected by its horn, its hide, and its temper.

name: Frontier Mastodon
text: Each bronze disk on its harness is an offering from a young Temur hunter, a sign of respect to the spirits of the wild.

name: Fruit of the First Tree
text: "I will be the ancestor my descendants call upon for aid. On that day I will take up my sword for my family once more."

name: Hunt the Weak
text: Dragons scorn the weak, even among their own kind.

name: Return to the Earth
text:
"Dragons are feared for their breath and their bite, but it is their wings that make them unconquerable. Bring them to earth, and they die like any other beast."
—Kassur, Sultai hunter

name: Ruthless Instincts
text: A single battle affects countless others.

name: Sandsteppe Mastodon
text: A mastodon's path always leads to an oasis.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Sudden Reclamation
text:
"There is no secret buried so deep that we will never find it."
—Kurtar, Sultai necromancer

name: Honor's Reward
text: It seldom rains in Abzan lands. When it does, the khan marks the occasion by honoring the families of the fallen.

name: Temur Sabertooth
text: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

name: Whisperer of the Wilds
text: She speaks only in whispers but can be heard over the fiercest storm.

name: Wildcall
text: A howl on the wind hides many dangers.

name: Atarka, World Render
text:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Cunning Strike
text:
"The opponent who blocks the path, becomes the path."
—Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest

name: Dromoka, the Eternal
text:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Ethereal Ambush
text: The energies of the Temur lands are readily unleashed upon intruders.

name: Grim Contest
text: The invader hoped he could survive the beast's jaws and emerge through its rotting skin.

name: Harsh Sustenance
text: The Shifting Wastes provide refuge to those who know where to look for it.

name: Ojutai, Soul of Winter
text:
"When I battled Ojutai, I realized my learning had only begun."
—Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest

name: Silumgar, the Drifting Death
text:
"No machinations, no puppet strings, no plots. Just pure, sweeping death."
—Tasigur, the Golden Fang

name: War Flare
text:
"No sun or fire can warm my blood quite like a war flare."
—Urut Barzeel, Mardu hordechief

name: Goblin Boom Keg
text: Dragonfire spawned many imitations. Some were more dramatic than others.

name: Hero's Blade
text: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

name: Hewed Stone Retainers
text:
"Their origins are shrouded in mystery. I believe they are the protectors of the lost secrets of our world."
—Jilaya, Temur whisperer

name: Pilgrim of the Fires
text: The most skilled Jeskai artisans can craft imposing golems with such precision that they will last an eternity—the time believed necessary to master the Fires of the Jeskai Way.

name: Ugin's Construct
text: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin, but he gleaned the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.

name: Lotus-Eye Mystics
text: Every action has a foreseen purpose.

name: Mardu Woe-Reaper
text: "Those who died in battle deserve their rest."

name: Abzan Advantage
text:
"To survive, you must seize every opportunity."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Monastery Mentor
text: "Speak little. Do much."

name: Pressure Point
text: By studying dragon anatomy, Jeskai monks have learned how to locate clusters of nerves that will incapacitate even the mightiest dragons.

name: Rally the Ancestors
text:
"The family is a tree, and in times of need, every branch can be a weapon."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Sandblast
text: In the Shifting Wastes, more are killed by sand than by steel.

name: Soul Summons
text: Ugin's magic reaches beyond the dragons. The clans have adapted it for war.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Wandering Champion
text: "Learn from your enemies, but do not tolerate them."

name: Wardscale Dragon
text: Dromoka's brood emerge from the dragon tempests covered with tough scales that protect them from most clan weapons and magic.

name: Enhanced Awareness
text:
"Study the topography of your enemies, and you will have a map to victory."
—Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest

name: Frost Walker
text:
"As the clans carved out their territories, we saw allies where the Mardu saw only obstacles."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Jeskai Sage
text: "The one who conquers the mind is greater than the one who conquers the world."

name: Lotus Path Djinn
text: "The lotus takes root where body and mind intersect. It blooms when body and mind become one."

name: Abzan Skycaptain
text: "A tempest is coming. Turn your faces toward the wind!"

name: Marang River Prowler
text: The currents of the Marang wash away both tracks and blood.

name: Mindscour Dragon
text:
"The bells may one day ring as an anthem of our own end."
—Kyu, Sage-Eye mystic

name: Mistfire Adept
text: "The quieter the skies, the calmer the mind."

name: Neutralizing Blast
text: "To defeat your enemies, you must remove their ability to make war against you."

name: Rakshasa's Disdain
text: "Every failure, every death only makes my strength greater."

name: Refocus
text: "Before you can open your third eye, you must prove you can open the first two."

name: Arashin Cleric
text: "We'll have time to put out the fires when those trapped within the ruins are safe."

name: Shifting Loyalties
text:
"Show the enemy the true path, and the spirit will yearn to follow it."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Sultai Skullkeeper
text: A skullkeeper is the first to arrive after the palace archers strike down intruders, probing their brains for choice bits of knowledge.

name: Supplant Form
text:
"Ice can be shaped to any form, even the whisper of a memory."
—Mytha, Temur shaman

name: Temporal Trespass
text: Few truly live in the moment.

name: Whisk Away
text: The maneuvers of the Abzan formation intrigued Ojutai in both their complexity and their futility.

name: Will of the Naga
text: The charm of a naga is undeniable.

name: Aven Skirmisher
text: "We do not hide from the dragons that pretend to rule the skies. If we did, the dragons would become our rulers, and our way of life would be lost."

name: Alesha's Vanguard
text: Boundaries drawn on maps or marked with stone have no meaning for the Mardu.

name: Ancestral Vengeance
text: The defenses of the Abzan extend well beyond the walls of their fortresses.

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: "Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"

name: Battle Brawler
text: Every time he returns from battle unscathed, he feels a tinge of disappointment.

name: Crux of Fate
text: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

name: Dark Deal
text: The first khans of the Sultai relied on the magic of the rakshasa to ensure the survival of the clan.

name: Diplomacy of the Wastes
text:
"Our emissaries are gifted negotiators."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

name: Douse in Gloom
text: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.

name: Fearsome Awakening
text: On Tarkir, dragons emerge from enormous tempests, phenomena tied to Ugin's very presence on the plane.

name: Grave Strength
text: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

name: Gurmag Angler
text: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

name: Merciless Executioner
text: He enjoys his work, for he sees only the worst Abzan criminals: those who betray their own kin.

name: Noxious Dragon
text: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

name: Orc Sureshot
text: "Words have yet to halt an arrow."

name: Qarsi High Priest
text: "Hear me, nameless, and obey."

name: Reach of Shadows
text:
"Is it better to be a fool or a coward? Fools may get things done occasionally, but cowards live longer."
—Ghelesh Shadowmane, rakshasa mage

name: Sibsig Host
text:
"They were your friends, your family, your clan. They want only to welcome you."
—Tasigur, the Golden Fang

name: Sultai Emissary
text: To the Sultai, Ugin's power was just one more resource to be exploited.

name: Tasigur's Cruelty
text: The cruelest tortures leave no mark upon the flesh.

name: Typhoid Rats
text: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

name: Daghatar the Adamant
text: "Our victories will protect a thousand generations."

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Arcbond
text:
"If you must die today, make your death worthy of legend."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

name: Bathe in Dragonfire
text: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

name: Bloodfire Enforcers
text: Bloodfire practitioners train to focus their rage, building it deep inside themselves until they are ready to release it as a devastating attack.

name: Break Through the Line
text:
"If the Mardu were more in tune with their beasts, they would not scare so easily."
—Jilaya, Temur whisperer

name: Collateral Damage
text: It is much easier to create fire than to contain it.

name: Defiant Ogre
text: "I have no clan, but I still have purpose."

name: Dragonrage
text:
"Dragons in the skies of Tarkir—for the first time, it feels like my home."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Fierce Invocation
text: Anger can empower those who embrace it.

name: Magus of the Moon
text: Tidal forces of the blood moon wrench and buckle the land, drawing monoliths of stone and soil toward the flaming orb.

name: Rift Elemental
text:
"It's difficult to heal a rift after it begins wandering about on its own."
—Teferi

name: Scourge of Kher Ridges
text: Doom casts its own flickering shadow.

name: Bloodshot Trainee
text: "Hrrngh! Someday I'm going to hurl this . . . er . . . roll this . . . hrrngh . . . nudge this boulder right down a cliff."

name: Emblem of the Warmind
text:
"It takes but one spark to ignite a parched forest. Our hearts, I fear, are too dry for this new visitor."
—Elek Longbeard

name: Flowstone Embrace
text:
"The seventh symbol, the Mark of Stone, stores the power of ancient Rath."
—*Tome of Elemental Mastery*

name: Ghostfire
text: Only those gifted with the eye of Ugin, the spirit dragon, can see his fiery breath.

name: Grinning Ignus
text:
"Take care what you offer the ignus. Food, perhaps. Coins. But nothing flammable!"
—Stovic, village eccentric

name: Magus of the Moat
text: "The spirits of the mythic ones ever circle their beloved keep, forbidding entry to all who come with the heavy tread of hate."

name: Steamflogger Boss
text:
"Whip the Xs! Pinch the Os!
What we're building, no one knows!"

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Tarox Bladewing
