text: Despising his siblings as insults to his line, he finds and devours each in turn.

name: Force of Savagery
text:
"Life cannot be created and then abandoned. It must be nurtured and fed so that it may express its ripened might."
—Freyalise

name: Heartwood Storyteller
text: His roots reach deep, nurtured not by soil and rain, but by millennia of experience.

name: Llanowar Augur
text: "I am irrelevant. The future I hold in my hands is everything."

name: Magus of the Vineyard
text: Battered and beaten by years of salt and claw, he never ceased to walk, and to seed. Only now, in this time of rebirth, do his seeds take root.

name: Quiet Disrepair
text:
"Artifice has always stood upon nature's shoulders. Let us watch nature take a turn."
—Freyalise

name: Riftsweeper
text: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

name: Rites of Flourishing
text: "Dance, and bring forth the coil! It is an umbilical to Gaea herself, fattening us with the earth's rich bounty."

name: Wrap in Vigor
text: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

name: Centaur Omenreader
text: The wisdom of the omenreaders is legendary. Creatures travel for miles through icy peril to seek their counsel.

name: Edge of Autumn
text: "At harvest are seeds of next year sown."

name: Imperiosaur
text:
"An ancient, powerful force has overtaken the valley. I sympathize for its former inhabitants, but I rejoice for the land itself."
—Olanti, Muraganda druid

name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
text: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

name: Phosphorescent Feast
text:
"Mushroom Queen sits among her spores, Enjoying life and avoiding chores."
—Ibblian pixie ditty

name: Samite Censer-Bearer
text: Samite alchemists extracted aromatic traces of healing minerals from the residue of the receding salt dunes.

name: Spellwild Ouphe
text:
"You'd think that their big glowing eyes would be almost hypnotic to look at. In fact, it's the other way around—they are entranced by nearly everything they see."
—Balecki, Spellwild druid

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Glittering Wish
text: She wished for gold, but not for the strength to carry it.

name: Sliver Legion
text: Hidden within the clicking, chittering swarm is a unique mind, still young, but growing more aware as time passes.

name: Akroma's Memorial
text:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

name: Scout's Warning
text: "There is no tactic I enjoy more than ambushing the ambushers."

name: Cloud Key
text: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

name: Sliversmith
text: After centuries of labor, its creations outnumber those they were to mimic.

name: Veilstone Amulet
text: Sometimes it's ostentatious to go unseen.

name: Dryad Arbor
text:
"Touch no tree, break no branch, and speak only the question you wish answered."
—Von Yomm, elder druid, to her initiates

name: Graven Cairns
text: Shamans of Kar-Sengir claim that their sun sets because it can no longer bear the gaze of those pain-carved cliffs.

name: Grove of the Burnwillows
text: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

name: Horizon Canopy
text: The great leaves are resilient underfoot. Heavy steps do not bruise them, but release a sweet and spicy scent.

name: Nimbus Maze
text: To find its center is to find one's own.

name: River of Tears
text:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Augur il-Vec
text: "If it would end this exile, my life is yours."

name: Bound in Silence
text: A fight put off forever is already won.

name: Lucent Liminid
text: It is a herald of the sun goddess, projected from the hallowed glass whenever her light passes through.

name: Lumithread Field
text: Having conquered the Bastion of Suns, the Ota took its light for their own.

name: Lymph Sliver
text: Its skin remains in a flowing, liquid state that keeps its body coated with potent restorative lymph.

name: Mistmeadow Skulk
text: Doyo suspected the boggarts of brewing a plot against his crop, so he scythed away his grain to clear the sightlines.

name: Patrician's Scorn
text: Lady Farisa's contempt of tawdry kitsch grew even more infamous after her death.

name: Barren Glory
text:
"The only perfect world is an empty world, with no one to sin or wage war."
—Tarran, magus of the disk

name: Ramosian Revivalist
text: The Ramosian tradition is alive, but its namesake has long since been forgotten.

name: Aven Augur
text: "I have seen the future. It does not include you."

name: Foresee
text: Wind time's watch, and watch time unwind.

name: Magus of the Future
text: Those gifted with the sight have one eye in the present and the other in the future.

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

name: Venser's Diffusion
text: "Each reality is but the dream of another, and each sleeper a god unknowing."

name: Arcanum Wings
text: Nobles don wings to reach the sky villas of their peers, exchanging them for more fashionable attire upon arrival.

name: Bonded Fetch
text: A well-made homunculus grooms the mind of its master, pruning the thoughts that lead to madness. Few loredelvers survive the study of the infinite without one.

name: Narcomoeba
text: It was created by the Iquati as a living memory—one that objects to being forgotten.

name: Nix
text:
"There is no shortcut to work done true and well. The Creators learned this to their sorrow, the first time they made the world."
—Githri the Prisoner

name: Sarcomite Myr
text:
"A horrible sight, yes, but the sounds . . . Its twanging tendons and grinding gears are almost musical."
—Brudiclad, Telchor engineer

name: Second Wind
text: Vindr stormchasers believe that the same ancient forces that move the winds can also move mortal minds and hearts.

name: Even the Odds
text:
"They who fall singing the battle hymn of Benalia go not unavenged."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish commander

name: Whip-Spine Drake
text:
"I swear the clouds were created just so the drakes would have a place to lurk."
—Kasharri, skyknight

name: Augur of Skulls
text: Within each empty skull, it seeks ways to preserve its own failing undeath.

name: Cutthroat il-Dal
text: Her blades slashed across the noble's shadow. He scoffed, then fell over dead.

name: Grave Peril
text:
"Sometimes the grave does not wait for death before relishing its feast of flesh and bones."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Lost Hours
text:
"Your thoughts do not interest me nearly as much as the absence thereof."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Gift of Granite
text: The blessing adds both protection to the recipient and weightlessness to the stone.

name: Magus of the Abyss
text: He climbs a staircase of falling souls, fighting the continuous pull of the void.

name: Minions' Murmurs
text:
"They are quick to offer advice, those whose mistakes doomed them to undeath. How can I not listen to the wisdom of failure?"
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Pooling Venom
text: The land can only hold so much poison before it begins to bite back.

name: Slaughter Pact
text: Death is only the beginning of the end.

name: Stronghold Rats
text: In the stronghold's dungeons, the shadows hide in the vermin.

name: Frenzy Sliver
text: The Arturan conjurers took the strange, alien fossil and patterned their own twisted creations in its image.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Witch's Mist
text:
"Hear us, Overmother. Let the strong thrive under your gelatinous hand, and let the weak writhe under your serrated heel."
—Prayer of the devoted

name: Yixlid Jailer
text: "I have an eternity to know the souls who are bound here, to behold their every facet. But moments from now they will be gagged and masked, and they shall be known by none other."

name: Char-Rumbler
text: Elementals flourished as Dominaria healed and new forms of life adapted to the land's reinfusion with mana.

name: Emberwilde Augur
text: Legends say a djinn gave the goblins a gift they could never hope to master.

name: Ball Lightning
text:
"Life, struck sharp on death, Makes awful lightning."
—Elizabeth Barrett Browning,
"Aurora Leigh"

name: Tradewind Rider
text:
"'Tis a shame, in such a tempest, to have but one anchor."
—Laurence Sterne, *Tristram Shandy*

name: Armageddon
text:
"'O miserable of happy! Is this the end
Of this new glorious world... ?'"
—John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

name: Time Warp
text:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Phyrexian Negator
text: They exist to cease.

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Exalted Angel
text:
"She is a theme of honor and renown, . . . Whose present courage may beat down our foes."
—William Shakespeare, *Troilus and Cressida*

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Meddling Mage
text: Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.

name: Pernicious Deed
text:
"The tyrannous and bloody deed is done,
The most arch deed of piteous massacre
That ever yet this land was guilty of."
—William Shakespeare, *Richard III*

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Cunning Wish
text: The foolish wish for that which they desire. The cunning wish for that which they require.

name: Vindicate
text: Some convictions are so strong that the world must break to accommodate them.

name: Natural Order
text: ...but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Bitterblossom
text: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Goblin Welder
text: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

name: Angelic Guardian
text: "No single arrow can pierce an entire flock."

name: Angler Turtle
text: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

name: Vengeant Vampire
text: "Those who stood in my path now lay behind me."

name: Immortal Phoenix
text: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Um...oh...what was I saying?"
—Reveka, wizard savant

name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
text: There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.

name: Devouring Light
text: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Scatter the Seeds
text: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

name: Advent of the Wurm
text: The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.

name: Armada Wurm
text: No one in the Conclave acts alone.

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Dimir Charm
text:
"Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to."
—Lazav

name: Centaur Healer
text: Instructors at the Kasarna training grounds are capable healers in case their students fail to grasp the subtleties of combat.

name: Dryad Militant
text: "We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost."

name: Glare of Subdual
text: The righteous light of Selesnya is channeled through the devout, striking out to blind the nonbelievers.

name: Growing Ranks
text:
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness."
—Trostani

name: Loxodon Hierarch
text: "I have lived long, and I remember how this city once was. If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it."

name: Privileged Position
text:
"We in the Conclave have a saying: 'When you hold a shield, lend your shield.' The strong must never forget what they owe to the weak."
— Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Selesnya Evangel
text: "The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."

name: Dimir Doppelganger
text: "Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."

name: Sundering Growth
text:
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade."
—Trostani

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Dinrova Horror
text:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
text:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

name: Moroii
text:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

name: Warped Physique
text: The Gruul seek unbounded strength. The Dimir deliver cruel irony.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Thunderheads
text: The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.

name: Char
text: Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.

name: Syncopate
text: "Patience, mage. Killing you now would be too easy."

name: Goblin Rally
text: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Cerebral Vortex
text: Izzet brains and Izzet boilers: contents under pressure.

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Gelectrode
text:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Telling Time
text: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

name: Invoke the Firemind
text: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

name: Nivix Guildmage
text: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

name: Stitch in Time
text: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

name: Tibor and Lumia
text: Tracing the horizon in a dance of wind and fire.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Last Gasp
text: "Allow me a moment to catch your breath."

name: Slum Reaper
text: The outskirts of Golgari territory are guarded by more than just walls.

name: Vigor Mortis
text: After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.

name: Deadbridge Goliath
text: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Drown in Filth
text: The rot farmer's first rite of passage is to craft a pair of work stilts.

name: Gaze of Granite
text: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Lotleth Troll
text: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
text: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

name: Ribbons of Night
text:
"My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar."
—Aszala of House Dimir

name: Treasured Find
text: Gorgons crave beautiful things: gems, exquisite amulets, the alabaster corpses of the petrified dead . . .

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Boros Elite
text:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

name: Daring Skyjek
text: "The hard part isn't landing in the saddle. The hard part is leaping before you see it."

name: Bomber Corps
text: "Subtlety is for lawmages and spies."

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Agrus Kos, Wojek Veteran
text: Lieutenant Kos has never met a group of recruits he could not inspire or a mob he could not quell.

name: Boros Reckoner
text:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Boros Swiftblade
text: When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.

name: Brightflame
text:
"Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way."
—Razia

name: Firemane Avenger
text: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Martial Glory
text:
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day."
—Gideon Jura, to Aurelia

name: Razia, Boros Archangel
text: Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.

name: Spark Trooper
text: Izzet-designed conductors atop Sunhome charge empty sets of armor that give form to the fluctuating elementals.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
text: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

name: Zhur-Taa Druid
text: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

name: Zhur-Taa Swine
text: Gurley was the first to domesticate one, though his widow didn't take much solace in that accomplishment.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Miming Slime
text:
"We paid the Simic very well for this capability, but we should quickly recoup our expenses in saved wages."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Vinelasher Kudzu
text: It grows to hate you.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Experiment Kraj
text:
"Of course it will grow beyond control—it was designed to choose its own evolution."
—Momir Vig

name: Dramatic Rescue
text:
"I never thought I'd be so glad to see two tons of beak and claws bearing down on me at the speed of an arrow."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Nimbus Swimmer
text: The Simic soon discovered that the sky offered as few constraints on size as the sea.

name: Omnibian
text:
"This creature has hyperevolved chameleonic abilities. It no longer mimics its surroundings, instead forcing them to take on its form."
—Simic research notes

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Voidslime
text:
"It is technically an ooze, but its life span measures only seconds. In that short time, its appetite for magic is extraordinary."
—Simic research notes

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Render Silent
text: "We have confiscated your spells as evidence. Once we conclude our investigation, you may petition to have them returned."

name: Azorius Herald
text:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

name: Skymark Roc
text:
"Try not to look guilty. Or delicious."
—Thorpe, street urchin

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Azorius Keyrune
text:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Teysa, Orzhov Scion
text: "Spend your life betraying me if you wish. I'll simply take it up with your ghost."

name: Azorius Justiciar
text: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

name: Martyred Rusalka
text: Rakdos cultists hanged her for sport in the township square. Her ghost now stands vigil at what has become known as the Tree of Weeping.

name: Keening Banshee
text: Her cold wail echoes in the alleys and under-eaves, finding the unfortunate and turning their blood to ice.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia

name: Debtors' Knell
text: One moment, conscious only of a sense of repose. The next moment, hearing the trudge of his own footsteps. He sighed and squinted into the glare ahead.

name: Stoic Ephemera
text: "Life is fleeting, and so is death. Only the oath is eternal."

name: Pillory of the Sleepless
text: Which is worse—the sleep which never ends or that which never comes?

name: Sin Collector
text: "That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
text: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

name: Cackling Flames
text:
"I like a little entertainment with my dinner."
—Rakdos

name: Splatter Thug
text: The mask isn't meant to hide his identity. It's meant to keep the viscera out of his eyes.

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Hover Barrier
text: As whispers and rumors increased, so did the demand for fail-safe barriers.

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Avatar of Discord
text: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

name: Carnival Hellsteed
text: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

name: Dreadbore
text: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

name: Jagged Poppet
text: Few puppets are so willing.

name: Lyzolda, the Blood Witch
text: Sacrificial rites take place before an audience of cheering cultists, each begging to be the next on stage.

name: Rakdos Cackler
text: Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.

name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
text: "If there were such a thing as a soul, I think it would be behind the gallbladder but above the kidneys."

name: Rakdos's Return
text: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

name: Riot Spikes
text: Most auramancers would have let the spikes hover just above the skin. Having the spikes rip through the skin from beneath was a touch added by Rakdos himself.

name: Wrecking Ball
text: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

name: Rakdos Keyrune
text: The Rakdos use it for everything you can think of and plenty more than that.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Wasteland Viper
text:
"The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society."
—Teysa Karlov

name: Wurmweaver Coil
text: Some use magic to spy through walls. Others use it to crush them.

name: Borborygmos
text:
"It's easy to see why those Gruul dirtbags follow him—the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'"
—Teysa Karlov

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Burning-Tree Shaman
text: Gruul shamans are bent on punishing the civilized. Any act more complex than rubbing sticks together or eating with utensils is met with the stinging burn of their magic.

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Giant Solifuge
text:
"We respect all lifeforms, but this one we respect from a distance."
—Mandor, Selesnya ranger

name: Gruul Charm
text:
"Not Gruul? Then die!"
—Borborygmos

name: Pit Fight
text:
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Rubblebelt Raiders
text:
"This city will perish, and the Gruul will cheer as the boar-god crushes the last bricks into dust."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Rumbling Slum
text: The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slum districts and banish them to the wastes. The Gruul adopt them and send them back to the city for vengeance.

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Scab-Clan Mauler
text: They inflict pain to forget their own and break foes to feel whole.

name: Highcliff Felidar
text: Once the felidar has marked you as prey, there's no point in running.

name: Patron of the Valiant
text: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

name: Relief Captain
text: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

name: Take Vengeance
text: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

name: Topan Freeblade
text: "My scars are my sigils. I will wear them with pride long after you're gone."

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Aven Wind Mage
text: "My skill sharpens with each beat of my wings."

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Cryptic Serpent
text: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

name: Decision Paralysis
text:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

name: Sphinx of Enlightenment
text: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."

name: Dramatic Reversal
text:
"Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Engulf the Shore
text:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Galestrike
text: Strong wings make strong winds.

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: River's Rebuke
text: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

name: Salvager of Secrets
text: The greatest treasure of the deep is an echo from above.

name: Carrion Screecher
text: The banished have come home to roost.

name: Gavony Unhallowed
text:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Calculating Lich
text: "We share a common enemy. Does that not make us friends?"

name: Grasp of Darkness
text:
"I welcome the use of even the foulest magic if it will rid us of the monstrosities that plague our world."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Tattered Mummy
text: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city crave only to spread their curse.

name: Brute Strength
text: It's not the size of the rock. It's how badly you want to lift it.

name: Destructive Tampering
text:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Fiendish Duo
text: Half the size, double the mayhem.

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Lightning Strike
text: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Voldaren Duelist
text: "I have yet to find my equal."

name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
text: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

name: Crested Herdcaller
text:
"Our survival, like theirs, depends on our ability to work together."
—Huatli, to Tishana

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Grazing Whiptail
text: Often found browsing on the upper canopies of Ixalan's jungles, whiptails are known to absently bat away anything foolish enough to interrupt their meal.

name: Ranging Raptors
text: They cover their territory like a tide of teeth and claws.

name: Earthshaker Giant
text: "Come, my wild children. Let's give the interlopers a woodland welcome."

name: Ripjaw Raptor
text: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

name: Spidery Grasp
text:
"Nobody's seen the Lady of Videns for years. Poor dear, no companions at all in that old castle."
—Yonda of Gavony

name: Thunderherd Migration
text: The herds follow as new growth arises.

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Howling Golem
text: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

name: Fiend Binder
text: She had not believed any shred of humanity remained in these writhing monsters until the twisted form of her partner appeared before her.

name: Kytheon's Irregulars
text: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

name: Mighty Leap
text: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

name: Zamriel, Seraph of Steel
text: Armored in courage and armed with searing light, her legion stands unflinching against the forces of darkness.

name: Forbidding Spirit
text: "You will respect the dead."

name: Joraga Visionary
text: "If you only follow where the paths lead, you merely go where others have gone before you."

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Rabid Bite
text: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.

name: Ram Through
text:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

name: Regrowth
text: While the root remains, the tree yet lives.

name: Taunting Elf
text: The safety of the village depends on the beast thinking with its stomach.

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Wirewood Pride
text: "Though you may leave this haven we have found, may our strength never leave you."

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Colossus Hammer
text: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."

name: Greatsword
text: The only blow that matters is the killing blow.

name: Howling Golem
text: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

name: Kitesail Apprentice
text: Carving lines through the sky, kite sailors map trails for the pilgrims below to follow.

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Trusty Machete
text:
"Until this expedition is done, that blade is your guardian, your liberator, and your best friend all rolled into one."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Kor Duelist
text: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

name: Kor Outfitter
text: "We take only what we need to survive. Believe me, you will need this."

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Strength of Arms
text:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Maeve, Insidious Singer
text: Her haunting tune drowns out the percussion of snapping masts.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Angler Drake
text: From the time they are hatchlings, river drakes are taught to pull the largest prey from the Luxa.

name: Angler Turtle
text: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

name: Brineborn Cutthroat
text: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Vogar, Necropolis Tyrant
text: A despot in life. A monster in death.

name: Impulse
text: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

name: Jeering Homunculus
text: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Precognitive Perception
text: "To control the present we must master the future."

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Run Away Together
text:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Nogi, Draco-Zealot
text: "Glory to the Burning Ones! May their mighty fangs devour all foes!"

name: Talrand's Invocation
text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Bloodsoaked Altar
text: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.

name: Bushmeat Poacher
text: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

name: Demon of Loathing
text: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

name: Doom Blade
text:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Dusk Legion Zealot
text: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

name: Imaryll, Elfhame Elite
text: The elvish kingdoms of Llanowar are united in their distrust of outsiders.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Gavony Unhallowed
text:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Gifted Aetherborn
text: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

name: Gravewaker
text: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Maalfeld Twins
text:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Priest of the Blood Rite
text: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions."
—Shaile, Silverquill dean

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
text: "You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."

name: Village Rites
text: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed totems of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.

name: Vow of Torment
text:
"Peace is a privilege you haven't earned."
—Tevesh Szat

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Ancient Hellkite
text: When a dragon attacks, there are no bystanders.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Dragon Mage
text: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: He marks his territory with fire and wrath, etching the mountainside with his charring breath.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Goblin Motivator
text: Small words stoke large flames.

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Knollspine Dragon
text: It woke to find a vast world in need of a master.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Seize the Spoils
text: "Grab what you want and burn the rest. Leave nothing behind."

name: Shivan Dragon
text:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—Saga of the Wisdom Seeker

name: Dwynen's Elite
text: Call one, call them all.

name: Elven Ambush
text:
"No elf can match a Tuskeri in combat. Why not charge?"
—Knorjolvin, Tuskeri raider

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

name: Elvish Skysweeper
text: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: End-Raze Forerunners
text:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

name: Immaculate Magistrate
text: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

name: Call the Cavalry
text: Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.

name: Everdawn Champion
text:
"Undefeated in battle, she is the shining future our empire deserves."
—Huatli

name: Fan Bearer
text: Rest sometimes requires the right prompting.

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!"
—Gideon Jura

name: Inspiring Captain
text: "Our enemies will soon discover that we are not as meek as they had believed."

name: Mesa Unicorn
text: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Subjugator Angel
text: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

name: Advanced Stitchwing
text:
"Improvement is a consequence of practice."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Favorable Winds
text:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

name: Hydrolash
text:
"I don't need your mage-rings or your mana equations. I call, and the sea answers."
—Keyta, rebel hydromancer

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Soulblade Djinn
text: He grants endless wishes, as long as you always wish for a blade.

name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
text: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

name: Bone Splinters
text: Vastly outnumbered, the Zendikari found creative ways to even the odds.

name: Cruel Revival
text: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Gruesome Fate
text:
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?"
—Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock

name: Languish
text: Life is such a fragile thing.

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Tattered Mummy
text: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city crave only to spread their curse.

name: Thallid Soothsayer
text: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Bombard
text:
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Captivating Crew
text: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Rolling Thunder
text:
"Zendikar is always angry, though I've never seen that anger so precisely directed."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Seismic Elemental
text:
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!"
—Sergeant Ryda

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Tormenting Voice
text: "You are undeserving of the afterlife. You will never feel the God-Pharaoh's embrace."

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Jungle Delver
text: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Nissa's Revelation
text: The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Seek the Wilds
text: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Eager Construct
text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Filigree Familiar
text:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Howling Golem
text: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

name: Manalith
text:
"Though the afterlife, the city, and even the God-Pharaoh himself were one great deception, the ideals championed by the gods remain true."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: Each time it is sent to find a safe haven, it takes longer to return.

name: Snare Thopter
text:
"I did not think I would understand the cold filigree creatures of this world, but they too are governed by the laws of nature."
—Nissa Revane

name: Welder Automaton
text: Most of the constructs the renegades used against the Consulate weren't originally intended for combat. But some didn't require much modification.

name: Always Watching
text:
"We pray to Avacyn on high.
On snow-white wings fearless you fly.
Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives.
May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

name: Benalish Marshal
text:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—*History of Benalia*

name: Bright Reprisal
text: Vampires know blood and the systems that carry it. And they know exactly where to strike to set it free.

name: Leyline of the Meek
text: Where strength and humility converge.

name: Agent of Masks
text: "You say that I am two-faced? Enough with the flattery. We have business to conduct."

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia

name: Borborygmos
text:
"It's easy to see why those Gruul dirtbags follow him—the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'"
—Teysa

name: Burning-Tree Shaman
text: Gruul shamans are bent on punishing the civilized. Any act more complex than rubbing sticks together or eating with utensils is met with the stinging burn of their magic.

name: Castigate
text:
"We have no need for military might. We wield two of the sharpest swords ever forged: Faith in our left hand, Wealth in our right."
—Vuliev of the Ghost Council

name: Cerebral Vortex
text: Izzet brains and Izzet boilers: contents under pressure.

name: Conjurer's Ban
text: Orzhov faithful file past to have their minds purged of "impure" desires. There, the guiltwardens eliminate any thoughts of hope or self-sufficiency.

name: Culling Sun
text:
"Who truly runs this city? Look to the sky on hallowed days, and see whose sigil is stamped clearly onto the heavens."
—Vuliev of the Ghost Council

name: Lionheart Maverick
text: "Your signet is no symbol of power. It marks only your need for numbers to aid you. What do you do, guild-rat, now that you face my blade alone?"

name: Dune-Brood Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it spawned nameless thousands to herald its arrival.

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Feral Animist
text: He chanted over a pot of boiling blood and honey. His brain buzzed like a nest of hornets, and his muscles rippled with the might of the bear.

name: Gelectrode
text:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

name: Goblin Flectomancer
text: Rerouting magic through a goblin's brain is the surest way to throw it wildly off course.

name: Ink-Treader Nephilim
text: When it awoke, the mirrors of the world reflected only darkness.

name: Invoke the Firemind
text: To those in tune with the Firemind, there is no difference between knowledge and flame.

name: Izzet Chronarch
text: He ensures not only whether but also when and where the lightning strikes twice.

name: Martyred Rusalka
text: Rakdos cultists hanged her for sport in the township square. Her ghost now stands vigil at what has become known as the Tree of Weeping.

name: Killer Instinct
text: "Take the bridge, men! Victory! Victory is ou— Retreat! RETREAT!"

name: Mortify
text: The eyes let flow with tears, then blood, then the very soul—the whole wrung inside out, dripping down into the blackened puddle of the past.

name: Pillory of the Sleepless
text: Which is worse—the sleep which never ends or that which never comes?

name: Rumbling Slum
text: The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slum districts and banish them to the wastes. The Gruul adopt them and send them back to the city for vengeance.

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Scab-Clan Mauler
text: They inflict pain to forget their own and break foes to feel whole.

name: Schismotivate
text:
"I ran the experiment through the brain of a schizophrenic lab-goblin. My burners' flames fell asleep while the beakers jumped about and shattered. Success!"
—Myznar, Izzet psychomancer

name: Order of the Stars
text: As stoic as the marble halls, as unblinking as the stars upon their shields.

name: Skarrgan Skybreaker
text:
"The sky isn't falling—it's being thrown at us!"
—Otak, Tin Street shopkeep

name: Souls of the Faultless
text:
"More horrible than their empty forms are their noble eyes. I dare not strike."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Stitch in Time
text: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

name: Streetbreaker Wurm
text: The Orzhov run a construction unit whose only business is rebuilding the wreckage left in the wake of wurms. When business is slow, they pay Golgari carnomancers to lure the wurms to the surface.

name: Tibor and Lumia
text: Tracing the horizon in a dance of wind and fire.

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Witch-Maw Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it shattered the hillsides to make way for its passage.

name: Wreak Havoc
text:
"Crush them!"
—Borborygmos

name: Shadow Lance
text: Shadow lances are crafted from harvested souls. The more wicked the sinner, the keener the blade.

name: Yore-Tiller Nephilim
text: When it awoke, the worms of the earth hissed in a chorus of beckoning.

name: Debtors' Knell
text: One moment, conscious only of a sense of repose. The next moment, hearing the trudge of his own footsteps. He sighed and squinted into the glare ahead.

name: Giant Solifuge
text:
"We respect all lifeforms, but this one we respect from a distance."
—Mandor, Selesnya ranger

name: Mourning Thrull
text: During their ascent to spirithood, patriarchs of Orzhova shed both flesh and emotion. This earthly slag is collected and formed into thrulls.

name: Petrahydrox
text: It departs through the streets' fissures with a sound like gravel pouring into a pond.

name: Wild Cantor
text: They are the voice of the wild, crying out with nature's fury and bringing forth its primeval might.

name: Shadow Lance
text: Shadow lances are crafted from harvested souls. The more wicked the sinner, the keener the blade.

name: Shrieking Grotesque
text: Orzhov mage-sculptors bring their stone to life before they carve it. The shrieking begins as soon as the mouths are formed.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Gruul War Plow
text:
"Steering apparatus?! What for? Rip it out, sharpen it, and lash it to the front!"
—Ktank, Gruul plowmaster

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Mizzium Transreliquat
text:
"What is it? Um . . . what do you *want* it to be?"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Sinstriker's Will
text: "Steel rusts. Arrows break. But righteousness is always strong, always sharp."

name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
text: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

name: Orzhova, the Church of Deals
text: Unlike most churches, at Orzhova it's best to pray before you arrive.

name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
text:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Skyrider Trainee
text: "Of course I plan on going up. Kang here is the most trusted 'fin on the squad. Afraid? Me? No, I'm just . . . waiting for the right wind conditions."

name: Spelltithe Enforcer
text: His assistants calculate the amount of the tribute. He measures out the punishment for delinquency.

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: To Arms!
text:
"The call came, spell-borne through mortar and stone to the ear of every soldier. The call came, and the advantage was ours."
—Lodusz, captain of the watch

name: Withstand
text:
"Defense is as much a part of war as offense, the shield as important a tool as the sword."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Aetherplasm
text: Its fickle form holds hints of a thousand former identities.

name: Crystal Seer
text: "Surprise is a useless, untidy emotion—the plaything of goblins and fools."

name: Drowned Rusalka
text: Lurking below the current, she thirsts until others come to drink.

name: Frazzle
text: The chant was interrupted, the components cooked, and Zok worried that it was his brain he smelled smoking.

name: Hatching Plans
text: So wondrous to behold, so delicate and finely crafted—and yet, such a pleasure to smash.

name: Infiltrator's Magemark
text:
"In secrecy is strength. None can oppose one who cannot be found."
—Szadek

name: Leyline of Singularity
text: Where renown and solitude converge.

name: Quicken
text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Runeboggle
text:
"Ever try to count hyperactive schoolchildren while someone shouts random numbers in your ear? It's like that."
—Geetra, frustrated mage

name: Sky Swallower
text: Would you trade the world for such a pet?

name: Steamcore Weird
text: Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.

name: Stratozeppelid
text: The "Days of Darkness" mark the stratozeppelids' annual migration, when for five days they blot out the sun and trumpet their passing.

name: Thunderheads
text: The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.

name: Thunderheads
text: The clouds grew thick, and then the grew teeth.

name: Torch Drake
text:
"Drakes? Bah! Things that breathe don't interest me. It breathes *fire*, you say? Well, that's a different story!"
—Zataz, Izzet clockwork artificer

name: Train of Thought
text: "But then . . . oh, but . . . which means . . . which would lead to . . . exactly!"

name: Droning Bureaucrats
text: " . . . and you must also apply for an application license, file documents 136(iv) and 22-C and -D in triplicate, pay all requisite fees, request a . . ."

name: Vedalken Plotter
text: "Fair? At what point in our negotiations did you convince yourself my goal was to be fair?"

name: Abyssal Nocturnus
text:
"I fear to keep an open mind, for there are those who would use it as a door to my soul."
—Voka Schlak, Mauzam Asylum inmate, diary

name: Caustic Rain
text:
"Looking out the great windows of Vitu-Ghazi at the foundry stacks belching their smoke to the sky, I wonder when the sky will take its vengeance."
—Heruj, Selesnya initiate

name: Cremate
text: Cremation of the dead is not a religious ritual in Ravnica. It's a business designed to keep the Golgari from growing in numbers.

name: Cryptwailing
text:
"Piece the tragic notes together and is it not a melody?"
—Teysa

name: Daggerclaw Imp
text: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

name: Douse in Gloom
text: Orzhov prisoners are steeped in a blackened brew that robs their souls of strength. Patriarchs drink that brew to extend their own lives.

name: Ghost Warden
text:
"I thought of fate as an iron lattice, intricate but rigidly unchangeable. That was until some force bent fate's bars to spare my life."
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

name: Hissing Miasma
text: All that remains when the fog finishes are neat piles of polished bones, like acid-etched glass. Orzhov servants collect them to make altar chimes.

name: Leyline of the Void
text: Where treachery and oblivion converge.

name: Ostiary Thrull
text: Orzhov churches don't pass the plate for collection. They charge for admission.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Poisonbelly Ogre
text: Some claim it's a failed Simic experiment, others say a Golgari creation. Both guilds deny all responsibility, while secretly studying its strange virulence.

name: Restless Bones
text:
"We mourn our dead. We shroud our dead. We bury our dead. Too often, it seems, we must kill our dead again."
—Grazda, veteran armorer

name: Revenant Patriarch
text: "The Golgari raise the bodies of their dead to serve. We raise the spirits of our dead to lead."

name: Ghostway
text:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Sanguine Praetor
text:
"Our fealty to guilds dooms us. The old gods shall resurface. Our skins will wave upon the guild-masts over emptied streets, and our bones will clatter in the wind."
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

name: Smogsteed Rider
text:
"An entire order of mages who draw their power from Ravnica's smog? Yet another indicator of our world's decay."
—Dravash, dowsing shaman

name: Bloodscale Prowler
text: It tracks its victims by the scent of their breath, preferring to dine on those who recently ate well.

name: Fencer's Magemark
text:
"The first blow is the most important. It often negates the need for a second."
—Agrus Kos

name: Ghor-Clan Bloodscale
text: At mealtimes, the Gruul customarily omit such niceties as using forks or killing the entrée.

name: Hypervolt Grasp
text: Zap on. Zap off.

name: Leyline of Lightning
text: Where storm and spellcraft converge.

name: Ogre Savant
text: He's an oxymoron.

name: Parallectric Feedback
text: "You can't have so many people living so close together, all practicing so much magic, and not expect some feedback."

name: Scorched Rusalka
text: Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.

name: Tin Street Hooligan
text: "Rauck-Chauv's like a holiday! Only it isn't on the calendars, and instead of dancing you knock people flat, and instead of giving gifts you break stuff."

name: Guardian's Magemark
text: The soldier moved with fluid poise, his awareness extending far beyond five senses.

name: Crash Landing
text:
"The other guilds think they're untouchable. It's time we brought them back down to earth."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Dryad Sophisticate
text: From Tin Street to the Outcast Mansions, she walks unbidden and unbound, her graceful silence never shaken by the riot of city life around her.

name: Earth Surge
text:
"Some gardeners sing to plants. I tell them stories—stories of how they once ruled the world, of the mortals who destroyed their kind, and of revenge."
—Bougrat, druid of the Cult of Yore

name: Gatherer of Graces
text: "Garb is for common folk. I prefer to wear insight and zeal, ambition and flame."

name: Ghor-Clan Savage
text: The snap of sinew. The crunch of bone. A cry for mercy. These are the music of the Gruul.

name: Gristleback
text: Loyal in battle, hearty in stew.

name: Gruul Nodorog
text:
Petting the nodorog
—Gruul expression meaning "making a really big mistake"

name: Gruul Scrapper
text: The Gruul aren't satisfied with just smashing things. They continue smashing other things with the things they just smashed.

name: Harrier Griffin
text: Moon Market merchants sell a bottled scent to cutpurses and other criminals. Those doused in the liquid become "griffin bait."

name: Leyline of Lifeforce
text: Where sovereignty and flesh converge.

name: Predatory Focus
text: Instinct blood-tinted his world until he could see only one thing clearly: his prey.

name: Primeval Light
text:
"Look to the old tomes, those bound in hides and written in yarberry ink. They hold the spells that can free us of the clutter of modern magecraft."
—Dravash, dowsing shaman

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Silhana Starfletcher
text: In light he finds both gift and weapon.

name: Starved Rusalka
text:
"No more wretched fate is there than to waste away. If you are slain, your ghost may at least avenge itself upon your killer. But what release is there for one slain by Time?"
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Wurmweaver Coil
text: Some use magic to spy through walls. Others use it to crush them.

name: Blade Instructor
text: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."

name: Divine Visitation
text: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

name: Fearless Halberdier
text: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."

name: Fire Urchin
text: Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.

name: Goblin Banneret
text: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.

name: Goblin Locksmith
text:
"He's got more finesse than most goblins. He smashes windows with his fist rather than his forehead."
—Arrester Polgar

name: Hellkite Whelp
text:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

name: Inescapable Blaze
text:
"The Izzet are blamed for every little disaster, which is unfair because we only cause most of them."
—Mizzix of the Izmagnus

name: Lava Coil
text:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer

name: Flight of Equenauts
text: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."

name: Maniacal Rage
text:
"They tell us the wilds are ours, then they brick them over. They can lie to our faces but not to our fists."
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Ornery Goblin
text: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

name: Rubblebelt Boar
text: Some Gruul druids believe that boars are spawn of the great Ilharg, the mighty Raze-Boar who will one day rise and level the city.

name: Smelt-Ward Minotaur
text:
"Don't arrest him—enlist him!"
—Commander Yaszen

name: Street Riot
text:
"They said obey and you'll be happy. They said you'll be safe. But we're not safe. We're not happy. And we will not obey."
—Domri Rade

name: Sure Strike
text: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."

name: Torch Courier
text: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.

name: Gird for Battle
text:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

name: Wojek Bodyguard
text: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

name: Affectionate Indrik
text: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Bounty of Might
text:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia

name: Circuitous Route
text:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"The Dimir may look all they want. We never grow tired of swatting their bugs."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Devkarin Dissident
text: "This is Mileva, in the Tenth. We've got an elf in the plaza with a chip on her shoulder. Actually, it's more of a morningstar."

name: District Guide
text: "The route is direct but challenging. Incidentally, how are you with heights?"

name: Generous Stray
text: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.

name: Haazda Marshal
text: Ravnica's convoluted power structure often boils down to who can muster the most swords on a given block.

name: Golgari Raiders
text: What the Golgari can't claim through patient undercity expansion, they seize in brazen topside sorties.

name: Grappling Sundew
text: Some rooftop gardens attract bees; others capture dragons.

name: Hitchclaw Recluse
text: Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.

name: Ironshell Beetle
text:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

name: Kraul Foragers
text:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying

name: Might of the Masses
text:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

name: Pack's Favor
text: Selesnya grows its ranks in more ways than one.

name: Healer's Hawk
text: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

name: Portcullis Vine
text: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

name: Prey Upon
text:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

name: Siege Wurm
text: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.

name: Urban Utopia
text: Ravnica's diversity produces blossoms of opinion in a rich soil of perspectives.

name: Vivid Revival
text: Golgari crops bloom in strange soils, touched only by long-traveled light.

name: Wary Okapi
text:
"Be like the grazers of the Saruli. Keep your herd close, and stay alert for encroaching danger."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

name: Hunted Witness
text: He ferried weapons, spells, exotic animals—but his most dangerous cargo was the truth.

name: Wild Ceratok
text: Once part of a wealthy merchant's private zoo, the herd roams feral throughout the Tenth, where it will remain until the guilds can agree to relocate, cull, or befriend it.

name: Artful Takedown
text: Dimir assassinations are choreographed like dance routines. Each challenge is anticipated and countered with graceful ease.

name: Assassin's Trophy
text: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

name: Beamsplitter Mage
text: The Izzet love replicating results.

name: Boros Challenger
text: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."

name: Camaraderie
text:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Centaur Peacemaker
text: "Please accept this offering. I sincerely hope to leave my mace at my side."

name: Chance for Glory
text: "It is not your time. The Legion still needs your blade."

name: Inspiring Unicorn
text: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

name: Conclave Cavalier
text: "Just as leaves fall and the tree blooms again, one day I will fall and the Conclave will endure."

name: Darkblade Agent
text: "I've seen your house, and you've been a lovely, if unwitting, host. But at last it's time for farewells."

name: Deafening Clarion
text:
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?"
"You'll know."

name: Dimir Spybug
text: Just assume every conversation is on record.

name: Disinformation Campaign
text:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

name: Emmara, Soul of the Accord
text: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."

name: Erstwhile Trooper
text:
"The Erstwhile—rotten of body and outmoded in dress, but unfailing in loyalty."
—Vraska

name: Intrusive Packbeast
text: Good at carrying things. Really good at knocking them down.

name: Garrison Sergeant
text: In the Legion, no flagpole is merely decorative, and every ceremonial sword bears an edge.

name: Glowspore Shaman
text: From death she grows living grandeur.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text:
"Result 752: Rapid mass redistribution.
"Result 753: Calamitous reverse synthesis.
"Result 754: Acute disarrayment."
—Izzet research notes

name: Golgari Findbroker
text: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."

name: Hammer Dropper
text: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.

name: Hypothesizzle
text:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

name: Ionize
text: "Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."

name: Ledev Guardian
text: "I've raised her since she was a pup, and she's raised me since I was a recruit."

name: Join Shields
text: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."

name: Justice Strike
text:
"Those who show no mercy to the weak deserve no mercy from the strong."
—Firemane Kavrova

name: March of the Multitudes
text: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

name: Nightveil Predator
text:
"Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?"
—Tajic, to Aurelia

name: Notion Rain
text: City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.

name: Ochran Assassin
text: "The dagger is just the distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."

name: Rhizome Lurcher
text:
"The dead gain new purpose here. What is strange in the eyes of other guilds is harmonious in ours."
—Devesh, Golgari shaman

name: Rosemane Centaur
text: "I long for peaceful times, when I may tend to my garden instead of our borders."

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text: Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.

name: Sonic Assault
text: He heard stars and saw thunder.

name: Bounty Agent
text: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."

name: Swathcutter Giant
text:
"Now do you understand what we meant when we said *disperse*?"
—Eksari, Boros patrol leader

name: Swiftblade Vindicator
text: A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.

name: Thought Erasure
text: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."

name: Thousand-Year Storm
text: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

name: Luminous Bonds
text:
"Article 5.8.2. Ensure proper restraint of any and all arms, legs, claws, jaws, tails, tentacles, and tendrils as appropriate."
—*Azorius Arrester Procedure*, Appendix B

name: Undercity Uprising
text:
"Now it's your turn to hide."
—Vraska

name: Underrealm Lich
text: "You've strayed, overworlder."

name: Unmoored Ego
text: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"Something's causing electrospheric disruption in the blazekite's spire-vanes. Find the cause, and tell them to keep it up!"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Fresh-Faced Recruit
text:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic

name: Piston-Fist Cyclops
text: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.

name: Pitiless Gorgon
text: "The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."

name: Vernadi Shieldmate
text: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."

name: Parhelion Patrol
text: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."

name: Whisper Agent
text: He has a job to finish, and it's you.

name: Righteous Blow
text:
"The Golgari believe they should be given what they deserve. On this we agree."
—Tajic

name: Boros Locket
text:
"We pass these along to our fellow soldiers to recognize deeds of valor. It won't stay with you for long."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Dimir Locket
text:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

name: Gatekeeper Gargoyle
text: Each night it visits a different guildgate around the city, digging its talons into fresh stone.

name: Golgari Locket
text:
"Wear it at all times. It will guide our reanimators to your corpse."
—Mazirek, kraul death priest

name: Izzet Locket
text:
"Remember to discharge your locket every seven hours. Unless you prefer the spontaneous aether overload, of course."
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

name: Rampaging Monument
text: "Be advised: suspect is nine stories tall, marble hair, answers to Saint Gusztav."

name: Roc Charger
text: Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.

name: Selesnya Locket
text:
"Think of the locket as a seed you bear, spreading life from Vitu-Ghazi across all of Ravnica."
