—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Silent Dart
text: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"

name: Wand of Vertebrae
text: Made by the mad for the work of the wicked.

name: Boros Guildgate
text:
"The more trust breaks down, the more we must throw open the front gates."
—Aurelia

name: Boros Guildgate
text:
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection."
—Tajic

name: Dimir Guildgate
text:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav

name: Dimir Guildgate
text:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata

name: Gateway Plaza
text: The Chamber of the Guildpact stands as a reminder that even the bitterest struggles can end in cooperation.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska

name: Golgari Guildgate
text:
"Jarad was a friend to the Devkarin. Now we slink through neglected tunnels, befriending those who crawl them."
—Izoni

name: Skyline Scout
text: "Sometimes an angel passes by and gives me a little nod, like, 'You're a daring one!' That always makes my day."

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text:
"Yesterday I didn't recognize my own guild. Today I see why. And for tomorrow I must be prepared."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Overgrown Tomb
text: Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.

name: Sacred Foundry
text:
"You will not be trained here. You will be forged."
—Commander Yaszen

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text:
"Everyone who crosses that threshold is our most cherished friend. Everyone who crosses it again is our bitterest enemy."
—Trostani

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text:
"We leave our gardens open, so all may know wonder, but guarded, so all may know peace."
—Emmara

name: Steam Vents
text:
"A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

name: Temple Garden
text:
"Where the roots reach, there the temple rises."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Watery Grave
text: Few believe Duskmantle exists. Fewer find it. None live to bear witness.

name: Sunhome Stalwart
text: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

name: Precision Bolt
text: Ral had wielded lightning all his life but had never harnessed the power of an entire guild.

name: Sworn Companions
text:
"The trouble with youths these days is that, in outright defiance of their elders, they refuse to be bought."
—Karlov of the Ghost Council

name: Kraul Raider
text: The kraul once skulked in the outskirts of Golgari society, but with Vraska's rise, they became valued forces of the Swarm.

name: Attendant of Vraska
text: When the Erstwhile were unearthed from their tombs, they became a ready-made army for Vraska.

name: Impervious Greatwurm
text: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

name: Take Heart
text: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

name: Tenth District Guard
text: "The Tenth has always been my home. This city is constantly embroiled in one crisis or another, but I'm determined to protect my piece."

name: Candlelight Vigil
text: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the Conclave can.

name: Chemister's Insight
text: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

name: Citywatch Sphinx
text: All those who trade in questions must answer to the Dimir.

name: Devious Cover-Up
text: First, dispose of the evidence. Then dispose of your knowledge of its disposal.

name: Dimir Informant
text: The letters arrive, all sealed and read.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "Laws apply only to those who lack the vision to see past them."

name: Drowned Secrets
text: Beneath Ravnica's streets runs a layer of tunnels, then caverns and waterways, then terrors and nightmares.

name: Citywide Bust
text:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Enhanced Surveillance
text:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

name: Guild Summit
text: In a climate of suspicion, Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

name: Leapfrog
text:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Muse Drake
text: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.

name: Narcomoeba
text:
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?"
—Ravnican riddle

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Omnispell Adept
text: She memorized every arcane text in the Ismeri Library by the time she was sixteen. Now she quizzes sphinxes in her spare time.

name: Collar the Culprit
text:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Passwall Adept
text: "My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."

name: Quasiduplicate
text: "My greatest creation—me!"

name: Radical Idea
text: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.

name: Selective Snare
text:
"How thoughtful of the Legion to train its soldiers to fit our spell's specifications."
—Nefara, Dimir agent

name: Sinister Sabotage
text:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

name: Unexplained Disappearance
text: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.

name: Vedalken Mesmerist
text: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."

name: Wall of Mist
text: Fog haunts the streets, rendering the familiar as otherworldly, changing neighbors into shadows, and muffling cries for help.

name: Wishcoin Crab
text:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks

name: Barrier of Bones
text: The Dimir rarely make statements, but when they do, the message is clear.

name: Bartizan Bats
text:
"Bats are welcome to eat thousands of my pets. I have multitudes more that will ultimately eat the bats."
—Izoni

name: Burglar Rat
text:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

name: Child of Night
text: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

name: Dead Weight
text: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.

name: Doom Whisperer
text: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.

name: Crush Contraband
text: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

name: Douser of Lights
text: The party of Rakdos revelers cackled and capered as the thing approached. It hissed, and they jabbed their torches at it, giggling when it recoiled. Then, one by one, the torches went out—and the screaming began.

name: Gruesome Menagerie
text:
"Variety is also the spice of death."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Hired Poisoner
text: "They don't even feel the cut. I'm ordering a drink in a nearby tavern before anyone notices something's wrong."

name: Kraul Swarm
text: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.

name: Lotleth Giant
text:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Mephitic Vapors
text: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Necrotic Wound
text: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

name: Dawn of Hope
text:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

name: Never Happened
text: Dimir assassins have the precision to slay a single memory.

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Ritual of Soot
text: Only the patrol's armor was found, so tainted with the acrid smell of sudden death that it could never be worn again.

name: Severed Strands
text: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

name: Spinal Centipede
text: The Golgari adorn themselves with the exoskeletons of iridescent insects. It's only fair the insects do likewise.

name: Undercity Necrolisk
text: In its territory, living is an affront.

name: Veiled Shade
text:
"I sang songs of sorrow for my lost love. Imagine my horror when, one night, they were answered."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Vicious Rumors
text:
"The alliances were already frayed. All we do is find the loose threads and pluck."
—Lazav

name: Demotion
text: There's no greater honor than joining your chosen guild, and no greater shame than failing it.

name: Whispering Snitch
text: "Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"

name: Arclight Phoenix
text: Some storms never blow over.

name: Barging Sergeant
text: "Don't stop till your horns come out their back."

name: Book Devourer
text: "Not my first edition of *The Advokist and the Urchin*!"

name: Command the Storm
text: In the wake of Niv-Mizzet's disappearance, Ral found himself leading the guild. He had dreamed of this day, but couldn't help feeling like a pawn in someone else's game.

name: Cosmotronic Wave
text: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."

name: Electrostatic Field
text:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

name: Erratic Cyclops
text:
"The League accepts no responsibility for former members and the damage they may cause."
—Maree, Izzet chamberlain

name: Experimental Frenzy
text: Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.

name: Moon-Eating Dog
text: The most nimble of creatures, it chases the most sacred luminence.

name: Stormcloud Spirit
text: The spirits of all the rivers and oceans came together as an unstoppable force, unleashing their fury as lightning and thunder.

name: Ancestor Dragon
text: It is said that Yinglong gave birth to the qilin and the phoenix, and after them, all the hairy and winged beings in the world. Thus it is known as the Ancestor Dragon.

name: Cloak of Mists
text: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

name: Qilin's Blessing
text:
"Interesting . . . This mortal being seems to have been blessed with Qilin's essence."
—Mu Yanling's journal

name: Drown in Shapelessness
text: "From the swallows, I learned how to ride the winds to anywhere, and from my tears, I mastered how to harness the water."

name: Dragon's Presence
text:
"The Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds, amid shattering mountains and sundering earth."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Brilliant Plan
text: A heaven-sent vision is like a lantern to guide the way.

name: Meandering River
text: Clouds and mists cover the lake as though it were a dreamland. When the wind rises, the mists disperse, opening great vistas of rippling reeds.

name: Colorful Feiyi Sparrow
text: These nimble sparrows, not often seen, delight in tricking the pangolins that wander the forest.

name: Leopard-Spotted Jiao
text: This strange beast has the hide of a leopard, the howl of a dog, and the horns of an ox.

name: Feiyi Snake
text: Two bodies, twice the malice.

name: Sacred White Deer
text: The pale deer are believed to have lived a thousand years, the pure white five hundred more. Those who seek them would gladly wander the wilds forever for the merest glimpse of these sacred beings.

name: Reckless Pangolin
text:
"A pangolin's power grows with its speed. Strike when you have the chance!"
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Giant Spider
text: The welcoming appearance of the Arrow Bamboo Forest masks its deathly hostility.

name: Ferocious Zheng
text: Known for their glowing horn and stone-rattling roar, zheng are the fiercest predators in the forest. Few survived before Jiang Yanggu came.

name: Fire-Omen Crane
text: If you can see it clearly, you're already on fire.

name: Purple-Crystal Crab
text: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

name: Screeching Phoenix
text: Its wings are a heavenly inferno that sets the world ablaze.

name: Earthshaking Si
text:
"For reasons unknown to me, herds in the Arrow Bamboo Forest have become more and more agitated."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Hardened-Scale Armor
text: A pangolin's scales are resistant to all sorts of damage and weaponry. Desire for them threatens to drive the pangolin to extinction.

name: Breath of Fire
text: Fire leads to more fire.

name: Aggressive Instinct
text:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Confidence from Strength
text:
"Prepare for battle!"
—Jiang Yanggu

name: Journey for the Elixir
text: "As my hands touched it, I realized that I had not found it—it had been leading me here."

name: Cleansing Screech
text: "Crackle" and "pop" are the most wondrous sounds.

name: Timber Gorge
text: Near the Western Seas lies Mount Zhaoyao—a forest of stones that reaches the clouds, a bountiful land of wondrous treasures and strange animals.

name: Vivid Flying Fish
text: The rainbow seen above the Great Lake of Cloud Dream just after the rain is nothing but the vivid-colored flying fishes' ritual dance.

name: Welkin Tern
text: It stops flying only as its life comes to an end.

name: Heavenly Qilin
text: It strides through the universe as though stepping on the stars, crossing freely between the celestial and earthly worlds.

name: Armored Whirl Turtle
text: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.

name: Nine-Tail White Fox
text: It has waited a millennium just for you, and for a millennium will it watch over your descendants.

name: Earth-Origin Yak
text: Deep in the Northern Mountains, the yaks linger silently, channeling the powers of the earth.

name: Aerial Maneuver
text:
"When you put all of yourself into an attack, without fear or hesitation, in that instant you may attain greatness."
—Predak, Gateless freemage

name: Debtor's Pulpit
text:
"You may not be able to pay. But you can still kneel."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Massive Raid
text:
"The Boros lack vision. Give them a convenient scapegoat and they'll be blind to the true threats."
—Lazav

name: Mugging
text: Scream: muffled. Pockets: emptied. Neck function: never the same again.

name: Ripscale Predator
text: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

name: Scorchwalker
text:
"Borborygmos's elemental launched an assault, but the Izzet wards held and experiments continue."
—Skyknight report on the Rubblebelt

name: Skinbrand Goblin
text:
"These Gruul skin-runes—discern whether their patterns evoke streets, leylines, or both. You have four days."
—Niv-Mizzet, to his assistant

name: Skullcrack
text: The lawmage's argument was clever and well reasoned, but Blunk's response proved irrefutable.

name: Structural Collapse
text: The Gruul holiday of Rauck-Chauv always ends the same way.

name: Tin Street Market
text:
"Sometimes I stroll along Tin Street and watch citizens busy with their daily lives. It reminds me why I do my job."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Towering Thunderfist
text:
"Nothing ruins a party like one of those big killjoys bursting through the door and setting all the guests free."
—Ruba, Rakdos cultist

name: Dutiful Thrull
text:
"They are useful, but there's little satisfaction in supplication that throws itself under your heel."
—Jozica, Orzhov enforcer

name: Viashino Shanktail
text: The Slizt Clan's battle cry is an impressive display of fury, defiance, and spit.

name: Warmind Infantry
text: Before Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, the two guilds had collaborated on the Warmind Initiative in pursuit of the ultimate soldier.

name: Wrecking Ogre
text: If no opponent can be found, ogres of the Bolrac Clan will often pick fights with buildings.

name: Adaptive Snapjaw
text:
"Eh, needs more toad."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Alpha Authority
text: Even the bitterest enemies of the Burning-Tree Clan respect the strength of Borborygmos's rule.

name: Burst of Strength
text:
"Our fight is not about territory or revenge. It is about freedom, plain and simple."
—Ruric Thar, Ghor-Clan chieftain

name: Crowned Ceratok
text: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

name: Disciple of the Old Ways
text: "Selesnya thinks nature is a pretty plaything. True nature would rip their faces off and wear their skins as trophies."

name: Forced Adaptation
text:
"We're planting the seeds of change. Sometimes, we plant them in people."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Giant Adephage
text:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Greenside Watcher
text: "The Izzet may incite war, but my duty is here. I will not abandon the wild."

name: Hindervines
text:
"Woodlands and laws. Both grow faster than the Azorius's ability to manage them."
—Suniel the Woodwise

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Miming Slime
text:
"We paid the Simic very well for this capability, but we should quickly recoup our expenses in saved wages."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Naturalize
text:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

name: Predator's Rapport
text:
"Other guilds say the Gruul are savages, no better than the beasts we live with. I say we've found friends who won't stab us in the back."
—Domri Rade

name: Rust Scarab
text:
"Behold nature's answer to the problem of society."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Scab-Clan Charger
text: "The only roads I wish to see are those beaten flat by wild hooves."

name: Serene Remembrance
text: While Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched, Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past.

name: Skarrg Goliath
text:
"They bind us with their laws. We free ourselves with nature's fist."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Slaughterhorn
text: The Orzhov clergy would never cross its path, but sending thrull couriers to do so is cheap and entertaining.

name: Spire Tracer
text: Cartographers on Ravnica chart not just the horizontal, but also the vertical.

name: Tower Defense
text:
"The drakes are practice. We may one day need to bring down a sky swallower, or maybe even Rakdos himself."
—Korun Nar, Rubblebelt hunter

name: Wasteland Viper
text:
"The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Wildwood Rebirth
text: In Ravnica, there are maladies far more difficult to treat than death.

name: Alms Beast
text: Alms-coins are only redeemable at Orzhov businesses.

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Biovisionary
text: He tired of his fellow researchers and their useless prattling, so he decided to make a network of scholars with whom he could carry a conversation.

name: Boros Charm
text:
"Practice compassion and mercy. But know when they must end."
—Aurelia

name: Guildscorn Ward
text:
"The Gateless have risen. The Ten shall fall."
—Ninth District graffiti

name: Cartel Aristocrat
text: "Your life serves a higher purpose now: ensuring the continuation of my own."

name: Dimir Charm
text:
"Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to."
—Lazav

name: Dinrova Horror
text:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

name: Drakewing Krasis
text: Cautious not to repeat Vig's mistakes, the Simic fuse life essences using magic alone. Each result is called a krasis.

name: Hold the Gates
text: "We grew up on these streets. We know them better than any Boros grunt from Zelzo."

name: Executioner's Swing
text: "The contract specified an appendage for a missed payment. Read the fine print: the head is an appendage."

name: Firemane Avenger
text: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.

name: Fortress Cyclops
text:
"They think they tamed him, but he will always be a wild titan, a force of nature."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Frenzied Tilling
text:
"Izzet contraptions pollute our lands. Burn them down, kill the makers, cleanse the earth."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Ground Assault
text:
"Taking down a dragon is easy. All you need is enough space to get in a good swing."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Gruul Charm
text:
"Not Gruul? Then die!"
—Borborygmos

name: Holy Mantle
text:
"The guilds promise to provide safety. I prefer to make my own."
—Briska, Ninth District freemage

name: Gruul Ragebeast
text:
"If the other guilds want a war, they should know we've been ready the whole time."
—Ruric Thar, Ghor-Clan chieftain

name: High Priest of Penance
text: "All I require is faith, loyalty, obedience, trust, and complete and utter devotion."

name: Hydroform
text:
"While the sea may be our home, the sky is our destiny."
—Prime Speaker Zegana

name: Kingpin's Pet
text:
"Debt and death sound so similar, and thrulls are so hard of hearing. Mistakes are inevitable."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Martial Glory
text:
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day."
—Gideon Jura, to Aurelia

name: Master Biomancer
text: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

name: Merciless Eviction
text:
"I once saw the Obzedat moved to action. Since that day, I've been thankful that they're mainly lazy, and dead."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

name: Mortus Strider
text: Dimir's best agents hide from death itself.

name: Knight of Obligation
text: He can calculate interest to six decimal places even in the midst of a deadly duel.

name: Mystic Genesis
text:
"The Simic can grow anything out of a puddle of sludge. I just hope they never join forces with the Golgari."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Nimbus Swimmer
text: The Simic soon discovered that the sky offered as few constraints on size as the sea.

name: Ordruun Veteran
text: "My father was Gruul, but I chose the precision of the legion over the fury of the pack."

name: Primal Visitation
text: Gruul shamans believe all sentient beings have the soul of savagery inside them, an animal form clawing to escape.

name: Psychic Strike
text: Until more information could be gleaned about Niv-Mizzet's intentions, Lazav took every opportunity to stall his experiments.

name: Knight Watch
text:
"We lost respect after the battle for Barbu Rooftop. Send the troops to mingle respectfully with the citizens."
—Commander Yaszen of Boros

name: Purge the Profane
text: The Orzhov hear the plans of the other guilds through the guilty thoughts of the disloyal.

name: Ruination Wurm
text: When the architects of Ravnica claim a structure will stand against a wurm, they never mention for how long.

name: Signal the Clans
text: Gruul clanfolk obey few rules, but all feel bound to answer the call of the horn.

name: Simic Charm
text:
"We measure our progress in heartbeats."
—Prime Speaker Zegana

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text: Millennium Platform, once a monument to peace, was quickly seized by the skyknights for its strategic aerial location.

name: Spark Trooper
text: Izzet-designed conductors atop Sunhome charge empty sets of armor that give form to the fluctuating elementals.

name: Angelic Edict
text: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Wojek Halberdiers
text: Tired of Boros interference, the Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins, hoping their corpses would weigh down the halberds.

name: Murder Investigation
text: "Every death has a web of consequences. Our job is to find the spider."

name: Zhur-Taa Swine
text: Gurley was the first to domesticate one, though his widow didn't take much solace in that accomplishment.

name: Arrows of Justice
text: Archers from the Horizon Military Academy hone their skills by targeting pickpockets blocks away.

name: Beckon Apparition
text: The foyer is littered with the coins it demands but can no longer hold.

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Bioshift
text:
"It's all right if you change your mind. There's always a chance we can rearrange parts later."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

name: Boros Reckoner
text:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Coerced Confession
text:
"Ask the right questions in the right way and truth is inevitable."
—Lazav

name: Deathcult Rogue
text:
"The hussars can't catch him, and he evades our traps with ease. I fear he walks unseen even in the halls of New Prahv."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Gift of Orzhova
text:
"Remember by whose gift you ascend."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Nav Squad Commandos
text: Funded by the Azorius to keep current maps of the undercity, the Boros nav squads survey even the most unsavory areas.

name: Immortal Servitude
text:
"The fine print of countless contracts has ensured we are never defenseless."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Merfolk of the Depths
text: When giant sinkholes opened across Ravnica, they revealed buried oceans and the merfolk, once thought to be extinct.

name: Pit Fight
text:
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Rubblebelt Raiders
text:
"This city will perish, and the Gruul will cheer as the boar-god crushes the last bricks into dust."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Shattering Blow
text:
"Aurelia seems too eager to solve her problems by delivering them to oblivion."
—Prime Speaker Zegana

name: Armored Transport
text:
"If only our jails were as secure."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Dimir Keyrune
text: A key that slips through every lock.

name: Righteous Charge
text: "In the name of peace, moderation, and decency—wipe them all out!"

name: Gruul Keyrune
text: As perilous and unpredictable as the wilds themselves.

name: Illusionist's Bracers
text: It's easy to believe you're a god when you're twice as powerful as everyone else.

name: Millennial Gargoyle
text:
"You've got to keep your wits about you on the roofs. Not all stones are compliant handholds."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

name: Orzhov Keyrune
text: You only need to wield it once to appreciate the power of control.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: To understand Ravnica, one must first understand how each guild contributes to its stability.

name: Razortip Whip
text:
"It no longer surprises me what shows up in our raid of a Rakdos revue."
—Janik Bara, Wojek captain

name: Riot Gear
text: Any meeting between guilds requires proper equipment.

name: Skyblinder Staff
text: "If bats are the only thing between me and a mountain of Orzhov coins, then I'm about to be a very rich thief."

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Shielded Passage
text: Izzet delved into the depths of Ravnica's past, and Selesnya followed without fear.

name: Breeding Pool
text: Uncharted depths. Unbounded hopes. Unfathomable mysteries.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

name: Godless Shrine
text: Judgment without hope.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Sacred Foundry
text: Burning fervor and fearsome skill create a lethal beauty terrible to behold.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Stomping Ground
text:
"Roots, ruins, and room to fight. All the comforts of home."
—Domri Rade

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Watery Grave
text:
"I fear that as we scurry after phantoms, the Dimir pull nine puppet strings."
—Ral Zarek

name: Smite
text:
"Sure, today of all days, he asked to borrow my boots!"
—Darijo, Ivy Street ruffian

name: Syndic of Tithes
text:
"Entrance is free. Donations are required."
—Notice outside Vizkopa Bank

name: Urbis Protector
text:
"I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement. I'm sure this comes as no surprise to you."
—Teysa, to Lazav

name: Zarichi Tiger
text:
"The taming and consecration of these creatures is evidence of our faith."
—Resimir, Zarichi Temple priest

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Angelic Skirmisher
text: "A keen mind wields an army as a deft hand wields a sword."

name: Agoraphobia
text: "Everyone in this city is choosing sides. I choose inside."

name: Enter the Infinite
text:
"Don't just have an idea—have all of them."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Frilled Oculus
text:
"Understand the Simic? That's about as easy as winning a staring contest with a homunculus."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Gridlock
text:
"One tiny peg pulled from a single wagon wheel, and an entire district grinds to a halt."
—Lazav

name: Incursion Specialist
text: "Work for the Dimir again? That depends. Tell me more about this maze."

name: Keymaster Rogue
text: "This one opens the grate outside Zelzo Base. This one is for Ismeri Library. This one is for an invisible door . . . No, I've said too much."

name: Assault Griffin
text:
"The Simic offer a prize to any biomancer who can breed a krasis to match a griffin in the air. It's never been claimed."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Leyline Phantom
text:
"Is the maze itself a phantom? Or is one as real as the other? Perhaps I am as mad as the dragon."
—Jace Beleren, journal

name: Metropolis Sprite
text: "Well, if that goblin didn't want his tongue pierced, he shouldn't have stuck it out at me."

name: Mindeye Drake
text: They can map both the cityscape and the minds of its architects.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Realmwright
text: There is not a single inch of Ravnica that hasn't been altered at one point or another to fit someone's whims.

name: Sage's Row Denizen
text: "I offer you wisdom untainted by false loyalty, learning free of any guild's agenda."

name: Sapphire Drake
text: Sapphire drakes can communicate over great distances, their calls resonating in the gems fixed in their skulls.

name: Scatter Arc
text: "Should your chosen emissary be able to fluctuate triharmonic pentodes, however unlikely, I shall shunt excess negavolt radicals."

name: Basilica Guards
text: "None may pass . . . for free."

name: Skygames
text: Both Boros and Azorius scout the games in hopes of recruiting the finest athletes.

name: Spell Rupture
text:
"Like water, mana will drain from an inferior vessel."
—Jalan Tosk, Simic forcemage

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Way of the Thief
text: A true shortcut isn't a way other people don't know; it's a way other people can't go.

name: Basilica Screecher
text: A screech in the night is all it takes for Orzhov debtors to clutch at their coin purses.

name: Contaminated Ground
text:
"No one cares about pollution until they can see it."
—Gurras, Golgari rot farmer

name: Blind Obedience
text: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

name: Corpse Blockade
text: There are laws against it, but the dead have no one to complain to and the living are too frightened to investigate.

name: Death's Approach
text:
"It's cold in the grave, and the dead crave your warmth. Who are you to deny them?"
—Strava, Dimir mage

name: Devour Flesh
text: His twisted mind concluded that if he was what he ate, and he wanted to stay human, . . .

name: Dying Wish
text: "I wish I could rewrite my every deed and kill you with my first breath instead of my last."

name: Gateway Shade
text: Tireless and merciless, shades are harnessed as spies by the Dimir.

name: Grisly Spectacle
text:
"Watch people flock to a murder scene. Then tell me we're not all a little sick in the head."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Gutter Skulk
text: Upon finding his warehouse infested, Gaven didn't know whether to get an exterminator or an exorcist.

name: Horror of the Dim
text:
"Lesser minds can scarcely imagine such a marriage of necromancy and mind magic."
—Strava, Dimir mage

name: Illness in the Ranks
text:
"Selesnya denied us tribute. Let's show them the error of their ways."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Boros Elite
text:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

name: Killing Glare
text: A casual glance into a dark corner may be your last.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Slate Street Ruffian
text:
"Merciless to the point of psychosis. Let's give him a job."
—Zelinas, Orzhov recruiter

name: Smog Elemental
text:
"The skies used to be my refuge, a place of peace away from the chaos below. Now, with every flight, death seems to follow me like a shadow."
—Writings of Cica, Skyjek scout

name: Court Street Denizen
text: "The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."

name: Syndicate Enforcer
text: Even the darkest corners of Ravnica still lie in the shadow of the Church.

name: Thrull Parasite
text: The hunger of a vampire and the subtlety of a tax collector.

name: Undercity Informer
text: "Scandal and slander are never welcome news. That's why I'm never the messenger."

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Act of Treason
text: Each day uncertainty and rumors spread, and each night attendance at the Juri Revue increases.

name: Bomber Corps
text: "Subtlety is for lawmages and spies."

name: Cinder Elemental
text:
"The old gods awoke and sent fingers of fire to see what was left of the old ways under the endless city."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

name: Crackling Perimeter
text: As the path he sought came into focus, Niv-Mizzet took steps to prevent others from approaching it.

name: Ember Beast
text: The only livestock that will survive for long in the Smelting District, ember beasts serve many functions—none of them willingly.

name: Daring Skyjek
text: "The hard part isn't landing in the saddle. The hard part is leaping before you see it."

name: Firefist Striker
text: The flaming fist of Boros holds the promise of both protection and destruction in its grasp.

name: Foundry Street Denizen
text: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

name: Furious Resistance
text:
"At least the Gateless rebels have ideals. Rakdos just mocks, defiles, and kills all we hold dear."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Hellraiser Goblin
text: Don't let him lead the soldiers, but by all means let him lead the way.

name: Homing Lightning
text:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

name: Madcap Skills
text: The larger the crowd, the harder it is for them to run away.

name: Mark for Death
text: Everyone roots for the little guy, but nobody bets on him.

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text: An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot.

name: Plated Slagwurm
text: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Lignify
text: Bulgo paused, puzzled. What was that rustling sound, and why did he feel so stiff? And how could his *feet* be so thirsty?

name: Nature's Lore
text: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

name: Elephant Guide
text: Nature's strength outlives the strong.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Windstorm
text:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Deathgreeter
text: "The bones of allies grant wisdom. The bones of enemies grant strength. The bones of dragons grant life eternal."

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Nothing is sacred to rats. Everything is simply another meal.

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Vine Trellis
text: Nature twists knots stronger than any rope.

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Wall of Bone
text:
"Graveyards are sacrilege! A waste of perfectly good bones."
—Keren-Dur, necromancer lord

name: Faerie Macabre
text: The line between dream and death is gauzy and fragile. She leads those too near it from one side to the other.

name: Howling Banshee
text: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

name: Keening Banshee
text: Her cold wail echoes in the alleys and under-eaves, finding the unfortunate and turning their blood to ice.

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Vicious Hunger
text: Only the most ravenous soul feeds on the health of the weak.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Snuff Out
text: "The bigger they are, the faster they rot."

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Mutilate
text: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Corrupt
text: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

name: Wirewood Savage
text:
"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Stampeding Wildebeests
text: The most violent and destructive storms in Femeref occur on cloudless days.

name: Metallic Sliver
text: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

name: Quick Sliver
text: The directors of the Riptide Project wanted instant results on the sliver experiments. They got their wish.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Hibernation Sliver
text: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

name: Acidic Sliver
text: The first sliver burst against the cave wall, and others piled in behind to deepen the new tunnel.

name: Spined Sliver
text:
"Slivers are evil and slivers are sly; And if you get eaten, then no one will cry."
—Mogg children's rhyme

name: Victual Sliver
text: "We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen. "Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole."

name: Armor Sliver
text:
Hanna: "We must learn how they protect each other."
Mirri: "After they're done trying to kill us, all right?"

name: Spectral Sliver
text:
"Sure, I've seen agents of the Cabal here and there. Well, not here, and certainly not in any of the sliver labs. Oh dear, I've said too much."
—Apprentice researcher

name: Barbed Sliver
text: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Fungus Sliver
text:
"When a sliver of this breed enters the hive, the others claw each other in frenzied fits, thereby ensuring their rapid growth."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Brood Sliver
text: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

name: Might Sliver
text:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Sliver Overlord
text: The end of evolution.

name: Fury Sliver
text:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

name: Heartstone
text:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Aphetto Dredging
text: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

name: Winged Sliver
text:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Clot Sliver
text:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Frenzy Sliver
text: The Arturan conjurers took the strange, alien fossil and patterned their own twisted creations in its image.

name: Heart Sliver
text: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

name: Gemhide Sliver
text:
"The land is weary. Even Skyshroud is depleted. We must find another source of mana—one that is growing despite our withering world."
—Freyalise

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Defile
text: The only shortcut in a bog is to the bottom.

name: Plague Engineer
text:
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Magmatic Sinkhole
text: Opening like the maw of a hellion, the earth swallowed the traveler whole.

name: Shenanigans
text: Pricey baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
text: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Force of Vigor
text: The vines overgrew the construct, snapping gears and soaking up aether.

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Weather the Storm
text: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

name: Lavabelly Sliver
text: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
text: The stronghold of Theros's light.

name: King of the Pride
text:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Prismatic Vista
text: There is beauty in the uncertainty of potential.

name: Faerie Seer
text: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

name: Strike It Rich
text: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.

name: Unholy Heat
text: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

name: Esper Sentinel
text: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

name: Hard Evidence
text: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
text: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
text: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Fauna Shaman
text: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Ornithopter
text: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
text: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

name: Treasure Hunt
text:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Hypnotic Specter
text: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Waste Not
text: Designed by the Magic community

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "Cast out by my tribe, I am a pariah trapped in this mammal's carcass. Only my true kin hear my cries."

name: Ancestral Mask
text: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

name: Knight of the Reliquary
text:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Vault Skirge
text: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Stifle
text:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Fiery Islet
text: Where water is the canvas and lava the paint.

name: Sunbaked Canyon
text: Since the river ran dry, travelers wander where fish once swam.

name: Silent Clearing
text: The expedition's end began the marsh's story.

name: Waterlogged Grove
text: The trees pull water from deep underground, filling the forest for miles.

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Echoing Decay
text: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.

name: Unearth
text: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

name: Plains
text: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has even surprisingly uneventful.

name: Plains
text: Lady Bormul claims an owlbear has been trampling her fields, but there's something unnatural about the tracks it left behind.

name: Plains
text: After spending all day trying to track down a rare tome, you're about to give up when you hear your name whispered from a dark alley.

name: Plains
text: You arrive at Baldur's Gate with instructions to head straight to the heart of the rumor mill: the bakery.

name: Island
text: As you sail past the imposing Seatower of Balduran, you realize that breaking your friend out of that prison will be much harder than you thought.

name: Island
text: As you gaze down upon Wyrm's Crossing, you hear distant cries of alarm, and you notice that all traffic on the bridge has come to a halt.

name: Island
text: You're about to disembark to find the harbormaster when you spot a merfolk darting underneath your ship.

name: Island
text: The ship's captain promised she'd get you safely to the Netherese ruin, but *she* is the one who just washed overboard.

name: Swamp
text: Now that you've clearly hit the "marsh" part of Lizard Marsh, you begin to worry about the "lizard" part.

name: Swamp
text: The sudden sinkhole was surprising enough, but nothing could have prepared you for the ancient city that was hidden underneath.

name: Swamp
text: The old wizard's experiments destroyed the castle centuries ago. So why does some of the rubble look recent?

name: Swamp
text: At the mouth of the sewer pipe, you realize it's massive enough that even a giant could walk through without stooping. That gives you an idea . . .

name: Mountain
text: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.

name: Mountain
text: Lord Jannath sent you to secure the mine from gnoll raiders, but so far you haven't seen any gnolls . . . or, for that matter, any miners.

name: Mountain
text: Rumor holds that powerful artifacts and untold wealth are hidden away in Ramazith's Tower, and today you plan to find out for yourself.

name: Mountain
text: As you pause mid-climb to catch your breath, you'd swear you can hear a heartbeat pulsing deep within the mountain.

name: Forest
text: You know that hiexel bark produces a lot of smoke when burned, but why would Rilsa Rael need so much of it?

name: Forest
text: The lights in the cavern glow and fade, glow and fade in a rhythm that must have a deeper meaning, if only you can figure it out.

name: Forest
text: You continue to mutter and complain as you trip over yet another gnarled root. From behind the nearest tree trunk, something mutters back.

name: Forest
text: You're on your way home when you spot the gates of a strange city . . . one that isn't on the map and wasn't here when you traveled this path four days ago.

name: Voracious Greatshark
text: There is no boat big enough.

name: Fruitcake Elemental
text: Experiments intended to create the perfect holiday emissary resulted in a substance harder than darksteel and a fraction as merry.

name: Season's Beatings
text: Arriving home, he suddenly longed for the bloodsoaked battlefields behind him.

name: Abbey Gargoyles
text:
"Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: Willow Priestess
text:
"Those of faith are those of strength."
—Autumn Willow

name: Apocalypse Chime
text:
"One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Clockwork Gnomes
text:
"Until I came to the Floating Isle, I never had to oil the servants."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Didgeridoo
text:
"Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Ebony Rhino
text:
"That Rhino would fetch us a tidy sum, Joven. Perhaps it's time to make it ours."
—Chandler

name: Feroz's Ban
text:
"Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost."
—Daria

name: Joven's Tools
text:
"If that thief Joven ever shows his head around here again, make sure he leaves without it."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Roterothopter
text:
"The Roterothopter is as insidious as it is ingenious. It is one of the few creations of our school that I take no pride in."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Mesa Falcon
text:
"The faith of Serra is borne on wings of hope."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: Mesa Falcon
text:
"Pretty Falcon, friend to Soraya. Will you send her my greetings?"
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: An-Havva Township
text: Folk of good heart will always find a home.

name: Aysen Abbey
text: Serra's gift to her people: a symbol of faith and hope.

name: Castle Sengir
text: Where hope has no champion, evil rules all.

name: Koskun Keep
text: Treachery and anarchy make poor partners.

name: Wizards' School
text: The legacy of Feroz lives on.

name: Rashka the Slayer
text:
"Rarely be the prey so haughty as to hunt the hunter."
—Baron Sengir

name: Samite Alchemist
text:
"Powders and potions are nothing compared to faith."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

name: Samite Alchemist
text:
"The wisest of Aysen dwell not in the Abbey, but in the laboratory."
—Taysir

name: Serra Aviary
text:
"Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."
—Taysir

name: Serra Paladin
text:
"Would that I could be a Paladin again, but the dead hold no place among their ranks."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Soraya the Falconer
text:
"Soraya speaks with the hunters of the air, as do all of her family line."
—Autumn Willow

name: Truce
text:
"The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Aether Storm
text:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

name: Baki's Curse
text:
"Those who fling spells too quickly should have reason to regret it."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Chain Stasis
text:
"Here we go again."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

name: Dark Maze
text:
"The path of faith is fortunately fraught with failure."
—Irini Sengir

name: Dark Maze
text:
"Stray not into the path of darkness, or be lost forever."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Jinx
text:
"What wizards upset, the land soon rights."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: Abbey Matron
text:
"The Matrons are kindly souls, but don't ask one for an ale."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

name: Abbey Matron
text:
"The Matrons still say Serra is coming back. I bet she never even existed."
—Murat, Death Speaker

name: Labyrinth Minotaur
text:
"I doubt any Labyrinth Minotaurs still live—but then again, we Minotaurs are stubborn beings."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Labyrinth Minotaur
text:
"Legend says they got a treasure cave, but it don't say where to find it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Oh, I had a conscience once. But alas, I seem to have forgotten where I put it."
—Chandler

name: Merchant Scroll
text:
"There's no trade without trust."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Mystic Decree
text:
"Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers. Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."
—Irini Sengir

name: Narwhal
text:
"Who needs a spear? Ya break off the horn, and ya stab the fish with it. Easy!"
—Kakra, Sea Troll

name: Reef Pirates
text:
"Corpses for crew don't sit well with me. Zeki and his dead ship had best keep their distance."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: Reef Pirates
text:
"Zeki sails with a dead crew not out of villainy, but pragmatism."
—Baron Sengir

name: Reveka, Wizard Savant
text:
"It's nice to see a sister Dwarf in a position of such power, but why'd it have to be one of those seafaring muleheads?"
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

name: Sea Sprite
text:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

name: Sea Troll
text:
"I've seen those Trolls devour a drowning sailor faster than his lungs could fill with water."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Aysen Bureaucrats
text:
"I would say that our Bureaucrats are no better than vipers—but I shouldn't insult the vipers."
—Murat, Death Speaker

name: Aysen Bureaucrats
text:
"All the tortures of my vault of horrors pale in comparison to dealing with those petty Bureaucrats."
—Baron Sengir

name: Aysen Crusader
text:
"A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make."
—Irini Sengir

name: Wall of Kelp
text:
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Baron Sengir
text:
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Black Carriage
text:
"The Baron's drivers are also driven."
—Chandler

name: Cemetery Gate
text:
"It keeps some out, yes. It also keeps others in!"
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Cemetery Gate
text:
"Just the place for a picnic."
—Murat, Death Speaker

name: Dry Spell
text:
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer."
—Autumn Willow

name: Dry Spell
text:
"My soul thirsts for Serra's salvation, as does my body for life's breath."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Feast of the Unicorn
text:
"Some delicacies are not to be savored, save by the callous."
—Baron Sengir

name: Feast of the Unicorn
text:
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the Baron knows of one."
—Autumn Willow

name: Funeral March
text:
"This party is such fun—but it's a shame to mourn just one."
—Irini Sengir

name: Aysen Highway
text:
"Tread the roads of righteousness, Murat, lest you lose your way and be consumed."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

name: Grandmother Sengir
text:
"Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear Grandmother."
—Baron Sengir

name: Greater Werewolf
text:
"The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."
—Taysir

name: Headstone
text:
"Your headstone is the last page in the book of your life."
—Murat, Death Speaker

name: Ihsan's Shade
text:
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

name: Irini Sengir
text:
"That cruel being brings shame to all her fellow Dwarves and misery to all the land. She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

name: Sengir Autocrat
text:
"A thankless job, and a death sentence besides."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Sengir Bats
text:
"They are the eyes of the Baron, and they know your fears."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Sengir Bats
text:
"In the face of every one I see the Baron."
—Daria

name: Torture
text:
"It helps you pass the time until you die."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Torture
text:
"Oh, they scream, right enough, and plead, too—but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Beast Walkers
text:
"The Beast Walkers do a great service to Aysen. As humans or as beasts, their heart is yet to Serra true."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

name: Veldrane of Sengir
text:
"Poor, foolish Veldrane. He goes wherever the Baron wills him. One day, he'll go to die."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

name: Aliban's Tower
text:
"Those who hide in hollow towers would do well to remember the rain."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

name: Aliban's Tower
text:
"The people of Aysen built their roads with stones from these wonders. Aliban would be pleased with their ingenuity."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Ambush
text:
"Don't these goons have anything better to do?"
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: Ambush Party
text:
"Call it a cost of doing business. The best way to protect against thieves is to hire better thieves."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Ambush Party
text:
"The roads to Koskun Keep are mostly safe these days. Mostly."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: An-Zerrin Ruins
text:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

name: Anaba Ancestor
text:
"The Ancestors are the wisdom of the tribe and the soul of the Homelands. I am eternally in their debt."
—Taysir

name: Anaba Bodyguard
text:
"Not all Minotaurs are tribal. Some are freelance."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Anaba Bodyguard
text:
"Not someone to pick a fight with, unless you're fond of pain."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

name: Anaba Shaman
text:
"The Shamans? Ha! They are mere craven cows not capable of true magic."
—Irini Sengir

name: Anaba Shaman
text:
"Few master the powers of the earth as well as do the Shamans of the Minotaurs."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

name: Anaba Spirit Crafter
text:
"The Spirit Crafters sing of all our people. They sing of those lost, of those found, and of those who are yet to be."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Chandler
text:
"Never brag about the latest wonder you've created, students. Chandler might be listening."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

name: Death Speakers
text:
"Such innocent little birds. They sing a sweet song, sitting on their fragile branch."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Dwarven Pony
text:
"I hear Halina's got a pony that can count to six—and likes to eat meat."
—Chandler

name: Dwarven Sea Clan
text:
"No dwarf alive can best one of my crew dead."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Dwarven Trader
text:
"Their definition of 'fair profit' is certainly novel."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

name: Dwarven Trader
text:
"They wouldn't sell their own families—at least, not for cheap."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

name: Eron the Relentless
text:
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

name: Evaporate
text:
"The body is a temple with a foundation of sand."
—Autumn Willow

name: Joven
text:
"Joven, you're almost as good a thief as I. But Eron hates you even more."
—Chandler

name: Hazduhr the Abbot
text:
"Soon, Serra will return and choose the Abbot's successor, else we are lost."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: An-Havva Constable
text:
"Joskun and the other Constables serve with passion, if not with grace."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

name: An-Havva Inn
text:
"The Inn was ever a steady source of good cheer and kindness. Greatly do I miss it, now that I am gone."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Autumn Willow
text:
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Carapace
text:
"The tougher to crack, the sweeter the snack."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

name: Carapace
text:
"Now, *that's* a fashion statement."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

name: Daughter of Autumn
text:
"Those who say that Serra is dead have never met the Autumn Willow's daughters. They are as kind and as generous as Serra would wish us to be."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: Faerie Noble
text:
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, *there's* some straight talkers."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: Folk of An-Havva
text:
"This town's only for good folk. The rest can go to the city."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: Folk of An-Havva
text:
"There are those who accept being told what to do, what to think, and what to say. Then there are the Folk of An-Havva."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

name: Hungry Mist
text:
"All things must eat, after all. Even the air can hunger."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: Hungry Mist
text:
"If the air must feed, let it take the self-righteous."
—Murat, Death Speaker

name: Leeches
text:
"Where our potions and powders fail, perhaps nature will succeed."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

name: Leaping Lizard
text:
"I never question the Autumn Willow about her motives, not even when she turns people into Lizards. It's her way."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

name: Primal Order
text:
"It's strange, but I can feel it when the land is corrupted. I understand why the Autumn Willow is so protective."
—Daria

name: Root Spider
text:
"They're not half as fierce if they don't see you coming."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

name: Roots
text:
"That which nourishes can also bind."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: Shrink
text:
"The smallest beast can yet have the greatest heart."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: Shrink
text:
"Do not fear adversity. Let your courage be your strength."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Spectral Bears
text:
"I hear there are Bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: Willow Faerie
text:
"The Autumn Willow cannot be everywhere at once—that's what her grandchildren are for."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

name: Willow Faerie
text:
"Swift as the wind and harder to catch—that's the Faeries for you."
—Daria

name: Long-Bodied Grey Dog
text: Beorn's dogs took bowls and platters and knives and wooden spoons and quickly laid them on the trestle tables.

name: Dwarven Shortsword
text: Dwarves lived long lives if not felled in battle, and they forged their blades to last even longer.

name: Goblin-town Flunkies
text: Goblins made no beautiful things, but they made many clever ones.

name: Gundabad Opportunist
text: Goblins had a simple approach to ownership: whatever you could hold onto was yours.

name: Iron Hills Stalwart
text: Their fires caught the attention of huge bats flapping and whirring round their ears.

name: Misty Mountains Raider
text: The Wargs and the Goblins often helped one another in wicked deeds.

name: Óin the Brave
text: When the heart of a Dwarf is wakened by gold, he grows suddenly bold and fierce.

name: Pinecone Strike
text: The pinecones burst on the ground in the middle of the circle of wolves and went off in colored sparks and smoke.

name: Ragged Short Spear
text: Spears served Goblins better than swords or bows—they were quick to make and quiet to use.

name: Smaug, the Great Calamity
text: "My armor is like tenfold shields, my teeth are swords, my wings a hurricane, and my breath death!"

name: Eagle of the Great Shelf
text: The Goblins hated the Eagles and feared them, but could not reach their lofty seats or drive them from the mountains.

name: Smaug the Magnificent
text: "You think you will get a fair share? If you get off alive, you will be lucky."

name: Smaug's Fury
text: The Dwarves had barely time to fly back to the tunnel when Smaug came hurtling from the north, licking the mountainsides with flame, beating his great wings with a noise like a roaring wind.

name: Snowslope Hunter
text: Goblins did not usually venture very far from their mountains except to go on raids or hunt for food.

name: Stone-Giant of High Pass
text: The stone-giants were out and were hurling rocks at one another for a game.

name: Thorin, Mountain-king
text: "To me! O my kinsfolk!"

name: Attercop
text: Soon there came the sound of "Lazy Lob" and "Attercop" from among the trees away on the right. That upset the spiders greatly.

name: Beorn, Reluctant Host
text: He never invited people into his house if he could help it. Now he had got fifteen strangers sitting in his porch!

name: Cantankerous Keepers
text: The guards were decidedly less than pleased, upon waking, to find their prisoners escaped.

name: Dancing from Dark to Dawn
text:
"There must have been a regular bears' meeting outside here last night."
—Gandalf

name: Galion, Elvenking's Butler
text:
"Here's the old villain with his head on a jug! He's been having a little feast all to himself!"
—Elven guard

name: Gigantic Big Bear
text: Wargs and Goblins had few predators in the foothills of the Misty Mountains, but they did have some.

name: Guardian of the Halls
text: The Wood-Elves were not wicked folk. If they had a fault, it was distrust of strangers. Though their magic was strong, even in those days they were wary.

name: Little Bear
text: Even the littlest bears joined in important bear meetings and moonlit dances.

name: Mirkwood Pathmaker
text: In the wide world, the Wood-Elves lingered in the twilight of the sun and moon but loved best the stars. They wandered in the great forests that grew tall in lands that were now lost.

name: Esgaroth Garrison
text: "I suggest we go to Lake-town," said Bilbo. "What else is there?"

name: Nasty Little Rabbit
text: Beorn's fences kept out Goblins and unwanted intruders, not hungry rabbits.

name: The Notary Hobbits
text: Since Bilbo was presumed dead, his belongings were auctioned by three of the town's best lawyers: Messrs. Grubb, Grubb, and Burrowes.

name: Old Fat Spider
text:
"Old Tomnoddy can't spy me!"
—Bilbo

name: Ordinary Bear
text:
"I should say there were little bears, large bears, ordinary bears, and gigantic big bears, all dancing outside from dark to nearly dawn."
—Gandalf

name: Quarrel
text: The shoving and name-calling was all in good fun, and Bilbo began to finally view the Dwarves as companions instead of strangers.

name: Radagast of Rhosgobel
text:
"Perhaps you have heard of my good cousin Radagast who lives near the southern borders of Mirkwood?" Gandalf asked.
"Yes," said Beorn, "not a bad fellow as Wizards go, I believe."

name: Through the Forest Gate
text:
"Well, here is Mirkwood—the greatest of the forests of the northern world. I hope you like the look of it."
—Gandalf

name: Troll Negotiations
text: Suddenly they were fighting like dogs, and calling one another all sorts of perfectly true and applicable names in very loud voices.

name: Wargling
text: From infancy, Warg pups were taught to hunt and harry and to fear and hate the presence of Humans.

name: Wilderland Scrounger
text: Wargs had little trouble devouring and digesting the most putrid of carcasses.

name: Wood Elves
text: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

name: Bard the Bowman
text: No one had dared to face the Dragon for many an age; nor would they have dared now, if it hadn't been for the grim-voiced Bard urging them on.

name: Bolg's Company
text: Tidings they had gathered in secret ways; and in all the mountains there was a forging and an arming.

name: Gleaming Splendor
text: Bilbo had heard tell and sing of Dragon-hoards before, but the splendor, the lust, the glory of such treasure had never yet come home to him.

name: The Chief Warg
text: Even magic rings were not much use against wolves—especially against the evil packs that lived near Goblin-infested mountains.

name: Chief Warg's Company
text: Seldom did Wargs venture near the dwellings of Humans, preferring instead to hunt and den over the Edge of the Wild.

name: Duskwatch Hunter
text: Packs of evil wolves lived under the shadow of the Goblin-infested mountains, over the Edge of the Wild on the borders of the unknown.

name: Dwalin, Weaponmaster
text: The Company had lost a great deal, but they had killed the Great Goblin and many others besides. All in all, they had the best of it.

name: Eagle's Rescue
text: "Don't pinch! You need not be frightened like a rabbit. What is finer than flying?"

name: Fearsome Goblin Pair
text: Out jumped the Goblins: big Goblins, small Goblins, great ugly-looking Goblins, lots of Goblins!

name: Large Bear
text:
"I followed these bear tracks as far as the Carrock. There they disappeared into the river, but the water was too deep and strong beyond the rock for me to cross."
—Gandalf

name: Iron Hills Blacksmith
text: Dáin heard Thorin's urgent plea and ordered his smiths to fetch their strongest axes and mattocks.

name: Mirkwood Nurturer
text:
"Merry be the greenwood, while the world is yet young! And merry be all your folk!"
—Gandalf

name: Nori, Teller of Tales
text:
"If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world."
—Thorin

name: Patient Instructor
text: Lake-town was much diminished from its old grandeur, but still the Long Lake provided for all their needs.

name: Thranduil, the Elvenking
text: In a great hall with pillars hewn out of the living stone sat the Elvenking on a chair of carven wood.

name: Thranduil's Company
text: They escaped at times to ride or run over open lands by moonlight or starlight.

name: Glamdring, Foe-hammer
text: Suddenly a sword flashed in its own light.

name: Key to the Side-Door
text:
"I forgot to mention that with the map went a key, a small and curious key."
—Gandalf, to Thorin

name: My Precious
text: "It won't see us, will it, my precious?"

name: Thrór's Map
text: "Stand by the grey stone when the thrush knocks," read Elrond, "and the setting sun with the last light of Durin's Day will shine upon the keyhole."

name: Lake-town Lookout
text: "Look! The lights again! Last night the watchmen saw them start and fade from midnight until dawn. Something is happening up there."

name: Well-Worn Spatula
text: "Put on a few eggs, there's a good fellow!" -Gandalf, to Bilbo

name: Elven Passage
text: Filled with the twinkling lights, laughter, and songs of the Elves.

name: Elvenking's Halls
text: Elf-guards sang as they marched along the twisting, crossing, and echoing paths.

name: Goblin-town
text: The passages were crossed and tangled in all directions, and it was most horribly stuffy.

name: Hobbit Hole
text: In a hole in the ground there lived a Hobbit . . .

name: Iron Hills
text: The hills provided quality iron, allowing Dáin's folk to clad themselves in hauberks of steel mail and hoses of fine metal mesh.

name: Lake-town
text: The Elves spoke of a strange town built right on the surface of the Long Lake, under the shadow of the Dragon-mountain.

name: Mirkwood
text:
"Stick to the forest-track, keep your spirits up, and hope for the best."
—Gandalf

name: Plains
text:
Roads go ever ever on
Under cloud and under star,
Yet feet that wandering have gone
Turn at last to home afar.

name: Lake-town Toymaker
text: In the great days of old, when Dale in the North was rich and prosperous, Lake-town flourished.

name: Island
text:
The streams shall run in gladness,
The lakes shall shine and burn,
And sorrow fail and sadness
At the Mountain-king's return!

name: Swamp
text:
The wind went on from west to east;
All movement in the forest ceased,
But shrill and harsh across the marsh
Its whistling voices were released.

name: Mountain
text:
Far over the misty mountains cold
To dungeons deep and caverns old
We must away, ere break of day,
To seek the pale enchanted gold.

name: Forest
text:
Sigh no more Pine, till the wind of the morn!
Fall Moon! Dark be the land!
Hush! Hush! Oak, Ash, and Thorn!
Hushed be all water, till dawn is at hand!

name: Old Thrush
text:
"We may not understand him, but that old bird understands us, I am sure."
—Balin

name: Magnificent End
text: The flames were near him. His companions were leaving him. He bent his bow for the last time.

name: Moment of Glory
text: "I am Bard, slayer of the Dragon!"

name: Ori, Keeper of Songs
text: The music began all at once, so sudden and sweet that Bilbo forgot everything else.

name: The Queen of Dale
text: Dale may grow to reclaim its former glory and splendor, as in the days before the Dragon came.

name: Settle the Wreckage
text: There was a hiss, a gushing whirl, and then silence. And that was the end of Smaug and Esgaroth.

name: Stone by Sunlight
text: "Dawn take you all, and be stone to you!"

name: Thorin's Last Stand
text: "I go now to the halls of waiting to sit beside my fathers, until the world is renewed."

name: Settle the Wreckage
text: There was a hiss, a gushing whirl, and then silence. And that was the end of Smaug and Esgaroth.

name: Riddles in the Dark
text:
"What have I got in my pocket?"
—Bilbo

name: Uncover the Moon-Letters
text: Elrond took the map and gazed long at it, and he shook his head, until he saw what the moon revealed.

name: Inside Information
text: "Old fool!" Bilbo thought. "Why, there is a large patch in the hollow of his left breast as bare as a snail out of its shell!"

name: The Sackville-Bagginses
text: It took more than Bilbo showing up alive to convince some that he was not, in fact, "presumed dead."

name: Troop of Ponies
text: The sun had only just turned west when they started on the path to Mirkwood, and till evening it lay golden on the land about them.

name: Velvetwing Butterflies
text: Bilbo's eyes were nearly blinded by the light. He could only hold on and blink at the sight of them.

name: Supper for Spiders
text: The spiders laughed. "You were quite right," they said, "the meat's alive and kicking!"

name: Getaway Barrel
text:
"I do hope I put the lids on tight enough!"
—Bilbo

name: Stone-Giant of High Pass
text: The stone-giants were out and were hurling rocks at one another for a game.

name: Cantankerous Keepers
text: The guards were decidedly less than pleased, upon waking, to find their prisoners escaped.

name: Gigantic Big Bear
text: Wargs and Goblins had few predators in the foothills of the Misty Mountains, but they did have some.
