name: Radagast of Rhosgobel
text:
"Perhaps you have heard of my good cousin Radagast who lives near the southern borders of Mirkwood?" Gandalf asked.
"Yes," said Beorn, "not a bad fellow as Wizards go, I believe."

name: Vow to Erebor
text:
"We shall soon, before the break of day, start on our long journey—a journey from which some of us, or perhaps all of us, may never return."
—Thorin

name: Through the Forest Gate
text:
"Well, here is Mirkwood—the greatest of the forests of the northern world. I hope you like the look of it."
—Gandalf

name: Dwalin, Weaponmaster
text: The Company had lost a great deal, but they had killed the Great Goblin and many others besides. All in all, they had the best of it.

name: Bilbo, Thief in the Night
text: "I am an honest burglar, more or less."

name: Bilbo Baggins, Burglar
text:
"Now it is the burglar's turn. You must go on and find out if all is perfectly safe and canny."
—Thorin

name: Confusticate and Bebother
text: "Confusticate and bebother these Dwarves! Why don't they come and lend a hand?"

name: Elven Raft-Steerer
text:
"Float beyond the world of trees
Out into the whispering breeze."

name: Elvenking's Harper
text:
"Hundreds of torches and many fires must have been lit suddenly and by magic. And hark to the singing and the harps!"
—Kíli

name: Enchanted River's Grasp
text: And fast asleep Bombur remained in spite of all they could do.

name: Belladonna Took
text: Once in a while, members of the Took clan would go and have adventures.

name: Fateful Discovery
text: Bilbo could hear nothing, see nothing, and feel nothing except the stone floor . . . until his hand met what would be the real turning point in his career.

name: Gandalf, Wandering Wizard
text: "May the wind under your wings bear you where the sun sails and the moon walks."

name: Lakeshore Apothecary
text: After Smaug fell, Bard took the lead with the hard task of governing and protecting the people. Most would have perished in the winter that now hurried if help had not been to hand.

name: Long Lake Nuisance
text: Thrushes carried news between towns and villages. Herons, however, brought nothing more than disruption.

name: The Lord of the Eagles
text: The ancient Eagles of the northern mountains were proud, strong, and noble-hearted—the greatest of all birds.

name: Mirkwood Meditator
text: Elves always knew what was going on among the peoples of the land—as quick as water flows, or quicker.

name: Plunder the Trollshaws
text: The swords caught their eyes particularly, because of their beautiful scabbards and jeweled hilts.

name: Ravenhill Flock
text:
"They live many a year, and their memories are long, and they hand on their wisdom to their children. I knew many among the ravens of the rocks when I was a Dwarf-lad."
—Balin

name: Riddles in the Dark
text:
"What have I got in my pocket?"
—Bilbo

name: Sound the Trumpets
text: The warning trumpets were suddenly sounded, and echoed along the rocky shores. So it was that the Dragon did not find them quite unprepared.

name: Thranduil's Decree
text: "I have a right to know what brings you here, and if you will not tell me now, I will keep you all in prison until you have learned sense and manners!"

name: Uncover the Moon-Letters
text: Elrond took the map and gazed long at it, and he shook his head, until he saw what the moon revealed.

name: Uneasy Partings
text: The winds were cold, leaves were falling fast, and three large boats left Lake-town, laden with rowers, Dwarves, a Hobbit, and hope.

name: Bofur, Reliable Guardian
text: Bofur and Bombur were left behind to guard the ponies and such stores as they had.

name: Bilbo's Deadly Slice
text: Before the spider knew what was happening, it felt Bilbo's sting and rolled off the branch, dead.

name: Crude Bent Blade
text: Clever and cruel, Goblins were particularly good at making instruments of torture and destruction.

name: Desolation Prowler
text: Not even the ravens knew of their coming until they arrived in the broken lands which divided the Lonely Mountain from the hills behind.

name: Dreaded Bat-Cloud
text: Beneath the thunder another blackness whirled forward, so dense that no light could be seen between their wings.

name: Front Porch Sentries
text: It was deep, deep dark, such as only Goblins that have taken to living in the heart of the mountain can see through.

name: Gathering of Darkness
text:
"Alas! Bolg of the North is coming!"
—Gandalf

name: Gnashing of Teeth
text: The rage of the wolves was terrible to see, and the commotion they made filled all the forest.

name: Gollum, Silent Slinker
text: He rowed about quietly on the lake. Never a ripple did he make, not he.

name: Gollum the Abandoned
text: "Where iss it? Losst it is, my precious!"

name: Great Fierce Bee
text:
"If one were to sting me, I should swell up as big again as I am!"
—Bilbo

name: Head of the Hunt
text: The Wargs planned to come by night upon the villages nearest the mountains. If their plan had been carried out, there would have been none left there next day.

name: Inside Information
text: "Old fool!" Bilbo thought. "Why, there is a large patch in the hollow of his left breast as bare as a snail out of its shell!"

name: Nighthowl Pursuer
text: "What shall we do?" cried Bilbo. "Escaping Goblins to be caught by wolves!"

name: Rage into the Valley
text: The Goblin army poured in, driving wildly between the arms of the Mountain, seeking for the foe.

name: Ravening Warg
text: Goblins and wolves returned to the assault and soon forced their foes into a great ring, hemmed on all sides.

name: Reverent Howl
text: The grey chief spoke in their dreadful language, and every now and then all the Wargs in the circle would answer together.

name: The Sackville-Bagginses
text: It took more than Bilbo showing up alive to convince some that he was not, in fact, "presumed dead."

name: Stir Up Trouble
text:
"I will prepare something particularly uncomfortable for you, Thorin Oakenshield!"
—The Great Goblin

name: Stony-Voiced Goblins
text: With the Goblins pinching and laughing at them unmercifully, Bilbo wished again and again for his nice bright Hobbit hole. Not for the last time.

name: Supper for Spiders
text: The spiders laughed. "You were quite right," they said, "the meat's alive and kicking!"

name: Bombur, Gentle Dreamer
text: Bombur was always trying to recapture the beautiful dreams he had in the forest.

name: Bothersome Noisemaker
text: The Goblins began to sing, or croak, keeping time with the flap of their flat feet on the stone.

name: Dwarven Provisioner
text: They had brought with them a great store of supplies—for the Dwarves could carry very heavy burdens, and bore huge packs in addition to their weapons.

name: Desert Were-Worm
text:
Fight wild Were-worms in the Last Desert
—Expression meaning "an impossible task"

name: Desolation of Smaug
text: At the twanging of the bows and the shrilling of the trumpets, the Dragon's wrath blazed to its height, till he was blind and mad with it.

name: Dori, Bearer of Friends
text: "I can't be always carrying burglars on my back, down tunnels and up trees! What do you think I am? A porter?"

name: Dwarven Mauler
text: There rose from across the valley a deep-throated roar. With cries of "Moria!" and "Dáin, Dáin!" the Dwarves of the Iron Hills plunged in.

name: Gandalf, Spark Starter
text: Gandalf thought of most things; and though he could not do everything, he could do a great deal for friends in a tight corner.

name: Getaway Barrel
text:
"I do hope I put the lids on tight enough!"
—Bilbo

name: Bard, Heir of Girion
text: With strength of arms, Bard demonstrated the might once possessed by the old lords of Dale.

name: Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning
text: His hatred for Dwarves smoldered for years after they killed his father Azog. When they killed the Great Goblin, the embers became a blaze.

name: Dáin of the Ancient Halls
text: In haste Dáin had come to his kinsman's aid, and in fury he now defended him.

name: Great Goblin, Foul-Hearted
text: "Slash them! Beat them! Bite them! Gnash them!"

name: Thranduil the Strategist
text: Even before Bard sent for aid, the Elvenking knew of Smaug's death and had already made plans to march.

name: Dawn of a New Age
text: "Yes, I am coming," said Frodo. "The Ring-bearers should go together."

name: Flowering of the White Tree
text: While the Tree grew and blossomed, Queen Arwen sang a song of Valinor.

name: The Gaffer
text:
"'Live and learn!' as my gaffer used to say. Though he was thinking of gardening, not of roosting like a bird, nor of trying to walk like a spider."
—Sam

name: Galadriel's Dismissal
text: "The love of the Elves for their land and their works is deeper than the deeps of the Sea. Yet they will cast all away rather than submit to Sauron—for they *know* him now."

name: Banishing Light
text: Before all went Aragorn with the Flame of the West—Andúril, like a new fire kindled, Narsil reforged as deadly as of old. And upon his brow was the Star of Elendil.

name: Dúnedain Blade
text: The sword glinted in the westering sun.

name: Errand-Rider of Gondor
text: "Gondor is in great need. Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed, lest Gondor fall at last."

name: Esquire of the King
text:
"Where now the horse and the rider?
Where is the horn that was blowing?
Where is the helm and the hauberk,
and the bright hair flowing?"
—Lament for the Rohirrim

name: Fiend Hunter
text:
"What roads would any dare to tread if the Dúnedain were all gone into the grave?"
—Aragorn

name: Fog on the Barrow-Downs
text:
"Cold be hand and heart and bone,
and cold be sleep under stone:
never more to wake on stony bed,
never, till the Sun fails and the Moon is dead."

name: Landroval, Horizon Witness
text: He passed over Udûn and Gorgoroth and saw all the land in ruin and tumult beneath him, and before him Mount Doom blazing.

name: Reprieve
text: All of them, the ponies as well, grew refreshed and strong in a few days at the Last Homely House.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: In a twinkling the table was laid. There was hot soup, cold meats, a blackberry tart, new loaves, slabs of butter, and half a ripe cheese: good plain food, as good as the Shire could show.

name: Soldier of the Grey Host
text: The Dead awaken; for the hour is come for the oathbreakers.

name: Westfold Rider
text:
"The Orcs were greater in number than we counted on. Great Orcs, who also bore the White Hand of Isengard."
—Éomer

name: Captain of Umbar
text:
"There is a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin, manned by the Corsairs of Umbar in the South. They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor."
—Beregond

name: Colossal Whale
text:
"And in the night from Otherworld beyond the Sea there strong and free a storm arose . . ."
—*Song of Eärendil*

name: Grey Havens Navigator
text: It was an old tradition that beyond the Shire stood the Grey Havens, from which at times elven-ships set sail, never to return.

name: Hithlain Knots
text:
"If you will try to run away you must be tied; but we don't wish to hurt you."
—Sam

name: Ithilien Kingfisher
text: After their reunion, the Hobbits spent many days in Ithilien. The stream that flowed from the falls of Henneth Annûn could be heard in the night as it rushed down through its rocky gate.

name: Knights of Dol Amroth
text: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate.

name: Lórien Revealed
text:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lórien and be glad!"
—Haldir

name: Raise the Palisade
text: Hood and cloak were gone; they were in shining armor, and red light leapt from their eyes. In the gloom the great Dwarf gleamed like gold in a dying fire.

name: Nimrodel Watcher
text:
"But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies."
—Haldir

name: Pelargir Survivor
text: "The Corsairs are upon us! Back to the walls! Back to the City before all are overwhelmed!"

name: Stern Scolding
text: "Fool of a Took! This is a serious journey, not a Hobbit walking-party. Throw yourself in next time, and then you will be no further nuisance. Now be quiet!"

name: Willow-Wind
text: Frodo's voice was blown away by the willow-wind and drowned in a clamor of leaves.

name: Bitter Downfall
text:
"I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid."
—Boromir

name: Haunt of the Dead Marshes
text:
"You should not look in when the candles are lit."
—Gollum

name: Languish
text: It seemed to the tenders of the sick that on the Halfling and on the Lady of Rohan this malady lay heavily. Soon they began to fall down into the darkness, and as the sun turned west, a grey shadow crept over their faces.

name: Merciless Executioner
text: "Curse the Isengarders! Uglúk u bagronk sha pushdug Saruman-glob búbhosh skai!"

name: Night's Whisper
text: Frodo was hardly less terrified than his companions; he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.

name: Shadow of the Enemy
text: As Frodo put on the Ring, Sauron was suddenly aware of the magnitude of his own folly. His wrath blazed in consuming flame, but his fear rose like black smoke.

name: Troll of Khazad-dûm
text:
"A great cave-troll, I think. There is no hope of escape that way."
—Gandalf

name: Battle-Scarred Goblin
text:
"An Orc shot Balin from behind a stone. We slew the Orc, but many more came."
—*Book of Mazarbul*

name: Fire of Orthanc
text: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.

name: Goblin Cratermaker
text:
"But the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc."
—Aragorn

name: Goblin Fireleaper
text:
"Let us hope that fire now lies between us and pursuit. Come! There is no time to lose."
—Gandalf

name: Guttersnipe
text:
"I have looked on Moria, and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful."
—Gimli

name: Improvised Club
text:
"'For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins,
'I'll eat thee too and gnaw thy shins.'"
—Sam

name: Inferno Titan
text:
"I daresay there's more truth in some of them stories than you reckon."
—Sam

name: Olog-hai Crusher
text: Trolls were abroad, no longer dull-witted, but cunning and armed with dreadful weapons.

name: Smite the Deathless
text: "No living man am I!"

name: Celeborn the Wise
text: His eyes were keen as lances in starlight, and yet profound, the wells of deep memory.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text:
"I sang of leaves, of leaves of gold, and leaves of gold there grew:
Of wind I sang, a wind there came and in the branches blew."

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

name: Elvish Visionary
text:
"Do not think that only by singing amid the trees, nor even by the slender arrows of Elven-bows, is this land of Lothlórien maintained and defended against its Enemy."
—Galadriel

name: Galadhrim Guide
text: "I shall lead you well, and the paths are smooth and straight."

name: Lothlórien Lookout
text:
"That was the custom of the Elves of Lórien, to dwell in the trees. Therefore they were called Galadhrim, the Tree-people."
—Legolas

name: Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin
text: To the air he had returned, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text:
All that is gold does not glitter,
Not all those who wander are lost;
The old that is strong does not wither,
Deep roots are not reached by the frost.

name: Rogue's Passage
text:
"I'm leaving; for somewhere where I can finish my book, perhaps. I have thought of a nice ending for it: 'And he lived happily ever after to the end of his days.'"
—Bilbo

name: Call Forth the Tempest
text: All was well, until one day they met a thunderstorm—more than a thunderstorm, a thunder-battle.

name: Arwen, Weaver of Hope
text:
"Here is the heart of Elvendom on earth, and here my heart dwells ever."
—Aragorn

name: Delighted Halfling
text: Bilbo's return was quite unexpected, met with confusion and worry but also wonder and awe.

name: Elven Chorus
text: Elvish singing was not a thing to miss, in June under the stars.

name: Last March of the Ents
text:
"If we stayed and did nothing, doom would find us anyway. That is why we are marching now."
—Treebeard

name: Aragorn and Arwen, Wed
text: At Midsummer in the year of the Fall of Sauron, Aragorn took the hand of Arwen Undómiel, and they were wedded in the city of the Kings.

name: Flame of Anor
text: "The dark fire will not avail you, flame of Udûn."

name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
text:
"The ruffians are on top—gathering, robbing, bullying, and running or ruining things as they like, in his name."
—Frodo

name: Sauron, the Lidless Eye
text: "Great Kings take what is their right."

name: Andúril, Narsil Reforged
text: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths.

name: Bilbo's Ring
text: He goes on living, never looking a day older.

name: Relic of Sauron
text:
"Always after a defeat and a respite, the Shadow takes another shape and grows again."
—Gandalf

name: Minas Tirith
text: It was the Guarded City, with walls so strong and old they seemed to have been carved out of the bones of the earth.

name: Rivendell
text: Many desired to see the house of Elrond, and breathe the air of that deep valley where the Fair Folk dwelt in peace.

name: The Shire
text: There in that pleasant corner of the world, the Hobbits plied their well-ordered business of living.

name: Dawn of a New Age

name: The Shire
text: There in that pleasant corner of the world, the Hobbits plied their well-ordered business of living.

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

name: Keep Watch
text: "I see their moral dilemmas. I see their raw courage. I see their self-sacrifice. I see our victory."

name: Double Cleave
text: "When in doubt, kill 'em twice."

name: Hearthfire Hobgoblin
text: Hobgoblins are best left alone. They sharpen their farm implements far more than is necessary for their work in the fields.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Copper Myr
text: The elves thought of the myr as minor threats, just as the myr thought of the elves.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Darksteel Forge
text:
"Did it have this shape upon Mirrodin's creation, or did some inconceivable force shape the unshapable?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Door to Nothingness
text:
"All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality. You will die, and no one will mourn."
—Memnarch

name: Gold Myr
text: The leonin thought of the myr as omens, never imagining the sinister fate they foretold.

name: Iron Myr
text: The goblins didn't think of the myr at all, which allowed the myr to observe everywhere unhindered.

name: Leaden Myr
text: The Moriok saw the myr as fellow scavengers, never knowing just who the myr were scavenging for.

name: Lodestone Myr
text: When necessary, myr can override and control any artificial object, as can their creator.

name: Qumulox
text: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Nuisance Engine
text: All Auriok children know the tale, "Bolgri and the Long Day of Squashing."

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Silver Myr
text: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

name: Skeleton Shard
text: Metal permeates the marrow of every bone in Mephidross—except one.

name: Suntouched Myr
text: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

name: Wizard Replica
text: It responds with unnatural precision.

name: Sarcomite Myr
text:
"A horrible sight, yes, but the sounds . . . Its twanging tendons and grinding gears are almost musical."
—Brudiclad, Telchor engineer

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Shivan Oasis
text: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Lymph, the fluid essence of blinkmoths, is prized by wizards for the rush of intellect it provides.

name: Tree of Tales
text: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

name: Vault of Whispers
text: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

name: Vedalken Engineer
text: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

name: Ascendant Evincar
text: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: A vertical scream pierces the night air and echoes doom through the clouds.

name: Beseech the Queen
text: Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Cadaverous Knight
text:
Grieve for the soul in death dishonored.
—Shadow Guild saying

name: Cruel Revival
text: Few Cabal fighters fear death. They fear what follows it.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"If there is such a thing as too much power, I have not discovered it."
—Volrath

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax, ascendant evincar

name: Gravedigger
text: Oddly, no one questioned the Cabal's wisdom in hiring a zombie to work at the cemetery.

name: Kor Sanctifiers
text: "Why keep such trinkets? They only add weight to your travels."

name: Helldozer
text: Sometimes you go to hell, and sometimes hell comes to you.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Incremental Blight
text: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Nefashu
text: Where the nefashu pass, blood rolls like a silk carpet.

name: Noxious Ghoul
text: Plague and death wrapped in one convenient package.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Shepherd of Rot
text:
"My priests swore loyalty to the Cabal not until death, but beyond it."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Soulless One
text: "Surrender your soul to me."

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Syphon Soul
text: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred. Then she lost herself again in the joy of her victims' suffering.

name: Undead Warchief
text: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Bogardan Firefiend
text:
"The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Bogardan Rager
text: In the erupting heart of Bogardan, it's hard to tell hurtling volcanic rocks from pouncing volcanic beasts.

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Cinder Elemental
text: Their rage can grow to such proportions that they explode in a cloud of fire.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Furnace of Rath
text: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

name: Goblin Offensive
text: They certainly are.

name: Insurrection
text:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

name: Relentless Assault
text: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

name: Rockslide Elemental
text: On Jund, even the landscape is a deadly hunter. Volcanoes, tar pits, and rock slides seem to prey upon the living.

name: Rolling Thunder
text: "Such rage," thought Vhati, gazing up at the thunderhead from the *Predator*. "It is Greven's mind manifest."

name: Rorix Bladewing
text: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land. The rest seek any opportunity to restore the broken pride of their race.

name: Smokebraider
text: "Be silent and listen to your inner fire. Only then can you walk the Path of Flame."

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Beast Hunt
text:
"Surely we could tame something besides hurdas and pillarfield oxen!"
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Ivy Elemental
text: In the gardens of the centaurs, many travelers have mysteriously vanished while admiring the elaborate topiaries.

name: Living Hive
text: In its center is a single red ant, a queen that regulates the hive's movements.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Tribal Unity
text: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him, but he still believes in the power of muscle.

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Boros Swiftblade
text: When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.

name: Branching Bolt
text:
"Lightning lives in everything, in living flesh and growing things. It must be set free."
—Rakka Mar

name: Bull Cerodon
text: It holds motionless vigil, watching Naya in silence through the screen of the whitecover. When it senses anything amiss, it launches forward with the uncanny sound of torn fog.

name: Captain's Maneuver
text: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

name: Cerodon Yearling
text: The unit of measurement used to chart a cerodon's growth is "persons consumed."

name: Glory of Warfare
text: "Their hopes dashed on our shields! Their victory slashed by our swords!"

name: Hull Breach
text: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

name: Fabricate
text: "The secret to invention is to see something in your mind, then find where it hides in the world."

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Mage Slayer
text:
"When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do."
—Kresh the Bloodbraided

name: Razia, Boros Archangel
text: Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.

name: Rumbling Slum
text: The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slum districts and banish them to the wastes. The Gruul adopt them and send them back to the city for vengeance.

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

name: Sludge Strider
text: Underneath the cities of Esper are cycles of life unseen by those who feed them.

name: Battlegate Mimic
text: Mimics don't need perfect disguises. They need only the perfect victims: the naive, the young, or the poor of sight.

name: Act of Heroism
text:
"On every plane, there are those who run toward danger."
—Gideon Jura

name: Khenra Scrapper
text: "There is no tomorrow, so hold nothing back."

name: Kindled Fury
text: The minotaur stared at the Eternal bearing down on him—the embodiment of deadly skill he had aspired to become.

name: Magmaroth
text: Sand into glass and flesh into ash—such are the markers of its domain.

name: Manticore Eternal
text: While most Eternals were initiates who completed the trials, Bolas had plans for some of Amonkhet's other denizens.

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Open Fire
text: Some khenra archers fashion their arrows with a personal touch.

name: Puncturing Blow
text:
"Neither the false God-Pharaoh nor his bugs will decide our fate."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Sand Strangler
text: The bombardment of sand disorients, chokes, and ultimately tenderizes its prey.

name: Thorned Moloch
text: Those who fled the destruction of the city stumbled into the territory of their prickly neighbors.

name: Djeru's Renunciation
text:
"I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Ambuscade
text: "Spent a lifetime learning from predators. Picked up a few tricks."

name: Beneath the Sands
text: Though buried and muffled, nature's whisper still called to Nissa.

name: Bitterbow Sharpshooters
text:
"Remember, brother, the eyes are always vulnerable."
"I never forgot."

name: Devotee of Strength
text: When Rhonas fell, his followers stirred with newfound strength—a final gift from a god they thought indomitable.

name: Dune Diviner
text: The desert had once been a place of endless horror. It was now the last refuge as the city of Naktamun fell.

name: Feral Prowler
text: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

name: Frilled Sandwalla
text: It basks atop the rubble of Rhonas's monument, which still pulses with latent power.

name: Gift of Strength
text: "What greater testament can there be to Rhonas's lessons?"

name: Harrier Naga
text: She trusts that the potent poisons of her darts will reach the enemy before the enemy reaches her.

name: Hope Tender
text: Some refused to leave their shattered homes, vowing to rebuild at any cost.

name: Dutiful Servants
text: Buildings crumbled and monuments fell. The river bled and the sky wept tears of fire. All the while, servants silently continued their work, oblivious to it all.

name: Hour of Promise
text: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

name: Life Goes On
text:
"If you believe the God-Pharaoh tests you, charge with me to prove yourself. If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!"
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Nissa's Defeat
text:
"The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Oasis Ritualist
text: "It's only the end if we allow it."

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Quarry Beetle
text:
"The ruin of the past is the topsoil of the future."
—Sokar, former Nef-crop initiate

name: Rampaging Hippo
text:
"Respect is earned through deeds—or the capacity to bite someone in half."
—Sana, former Ahn-crop initiate

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Gideon's Defeat
text:
"Gideon, how easy it must be to play the protector when you think yourself untouchable. How wrong you are."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Rhonas's Last Stand
text: Rhonas continued to fight until his last breath and even beyond.

name: Rhonas's Stalwart
text: "Give me some room."

name: Sidewinder Naga
text:
"Those who embrace the harsh land rather than fight it find they have a powerful ally."
—Nissa Revane

name: Sifter Wurm
text:
"Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now. Look elsewhere for refuge."
—Arnun, vizier of the menagerie

name: Tenacious Hunter
text: The crocodiles of the Broken Lands, long used to feeding on undead flesh, eagerly flooded into Naktamun for a taste of something fresher.

name: Uncage the Menagerie
text: The destruction of Rhonas's monument released his collection upon the city.

name: God-Pharaoh's Faithful
text: "This is the final trial! Rejoice, for the God-Pharaoh soars among us!"

name: Resolute Survivors
text: "We are crops no longer. Reap elsewhere."

name: River Hoopoe
text:
"It's a cruel thing to give such a sad song to such a colorful creature."
—Sana, former Ahn-crop initiate

name: Unraveling Mummy
text:
"We are no longer in control."
—Elekh, vizier of embalming

name: Hour of Revelation
text: In the first moments, the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.

name: Abandoned Sarcophagus
text: Although long since dead, the banished dissenters finally took their vengeance.

name: Crook of Condemnation
text: The God-Pharaoh's angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches and the fortifying magic they provided.

name: Mummy Paramount
text:
"It appears some mummies have begun to observe a hierarchy all their own."
—Elekh, vizier of embalming

name: Graven Abomination
text: Ironically, the statues had been constructed as a warning.

name: Hollow One
text: The embodiment of yearning, forever drifting the deserts to find what had once made it whole.

name: Manalith
text:
"Though the afterlife, the city, and even the God-Pharaoh himself were one great deception, the ideals championed by the gods remain true."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Mirage Mirror
text: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

name: Sunset Pyramid
text: Decades to build. Hours to demolish.

name: Traveler's Amulet
text:
"Why wander in search of a new home when the path is laid out before you?"
—Pytamun, former Nef-crop initiate

name: Crypt of the Eternals
text: The dead entered as worthy. They exited as Eternals.

name: Oketra's Avenger
text: "Oketra's arrow is my spear, and her love my shield."

name: Dunes of the Dead
text: The Curse of Wandering permeated Amonkhet long before Nicol Bolas. He simply harnessed it.

name: Hostile Desert
text: Amonkhet's desiccated land thirsts for blood.

name: Oketra's Last Mercy
text: To the end, all Oketra did was for others.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Survivors' Encampment
text: "What will happen to us?" they asked. The vizier paused. "I think . . . I think that's up to us now."

name: Sandblast
text: The sands of Amonkhet can be as much a boon as a bane. It depends entirely on which way the wind blows.

name: Avid Reclaimer
text: "All can't be lost. Nissa has shown me that."

name: Brambleweft Behemoth
text: Life will find a way, or it will make one.

name: Woodland Stream
text:
"Bolas's power on this plane can't be absolute. Look around you."
—Nissa Revane

name: Wasp of the Bitter End
text: As the Second Sun glided into its final position in the sky, a chorus of wings sounded to herald the return of Nicol Bolas.

name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
text: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

name: Cinder Barrens
text:
"I do as I choose with what is mine. And it is all mine."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Solemnity
text: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

name: Solitary Camel
text: Deserts are inhospitable, not uninhabitable.

name: Steward of Solidarity
text: In the midst of disaster, heroic acts became almost ordinary, and ordinary warriors became heroes.

name: Vizier of the True
text: Outnumbered, but not outmatched.

name: Aerial Guide
text:
"Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

name: Aven Reedstalker
text: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."

name: Countervailing Winds
text: The Eternals had long since mastered every technique taught during the trials.

name: Cunning Survivor
text: Initiates who had been through the Trial of Knowledge learned to see everything as pieces of a larger puzzle.

name: Eternal of Harsh Truths
text:
"If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Fraying Sanity
text: Those wound tightest are first to unravel.

name: Hour of Eternity
text: To serve as an Eternal is the afterlife granted to the worthy.

name: Imaginary Threats
text: Liliana always knew Jace's illusions would come in handy.

name: Jace's Defeat
text:
"I had hoped for more from you, Jace. But I expected as much."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Kefnet's Last Word
text: In his final moments, Kefnet reached into the minds of those around him, desperate for logic within the consuming chaos.

name: Angel of the God-Pharaoh
text: The angels did not deceive. From the start, they were clear their allegiance was to the God-Pharaoh and to him alone.

name: Ominous Sphinx
text: The sphinxes began to speak only after the Second Sun aligned. They whispered dire warnings, though no one listened.

name: Proven Combatant
text: "It's not wise to keep glory waiting."

name: Seer of the Last Tomorrow
text: "The truth? It's been here all along. The Hours as we understood them are lies."

name: Spellweaver Eternal
text:
"They were once our brothers and sisters."
—Etha, former Rhet-crop initiate

name: Strategic Planning
text:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

name: Striped Riverwinder
text: The denizens of the Luxa River woke angry on the currents of blood.

name: Aven of Enduring Hope
text: "This storm will calm. We must believe that."

name: Swarm Intelligence
text: The Locust God's children were numberless, relentlessly eating away every trace of the city's protection.

name: Tragic Lesson
text: Though Kefnet's followers feverishly searched his last words for some final riddle, they found only the gurgles of a dying god.

name: Unsummon
text: Skills mastered by initiates are preserved within cartouches, so Eternals remain adept at their preferred combat styles.

name: Banewhip Punisher
text: "If I die, it will not be alone."

name: Crested Sunmare
text:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Bontu's Last Reckoning
text: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

name: Carrion Screecher
text: The banished have come home to roost.

name: Doomfall
text:
"This place has outlived its usefulness."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Grisly Survivor
text: No cartouches to earn. No afterlife to enter. Only the glory of a well-struck blow and the growing pile of felled enemies at her feet.

name: Hour of Glory
text: The gods of the trials also faced the opportunity to prove themselves worthy.

name: Khenra Eternal
text: For many years, servant mummies toiled in the mines to extract lazotep. The emergence of the Eternals revealed the sacred substance's true purpose.

name: Lethal Sting
text: Initiates once believed defeat was the worst fate possible—a sentiment they quickly abandoned.

name: Liliana's Defeat
text:
"All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Lurching Rotbeast
text: The dead that swept across Naktamun came in all shapes and sizes.

name: Dauntless Aven
text: In the chaos brought by the new gods, swift-winged aven served as pathfinders, leading the last of the people away from the ruins of Naktamun.

name: Marauding Boneslasher
text: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

name: Merciless Eternal
text:
"My work here is complete. The people have done everything required of them."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Moaning Wall
text: Before the monuments, before the first trials, before Naktamun itself, Bolas culled the plane of its adults in order to rebuild it for his own designs.

name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
text: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

name: Razaketh's Rite
text: "The blood ritual is complete. The end approaches."

name: Ruin Rat
text: From every shadow came the dull scratch of teeth on bones.

name: Scrounger of Souls
text: Yell for help, and that may answer.

name: Torment of Hailfire
text: "Your God-Pharaoh has returned."

name: Torment of Scarabs
text: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.

name: Torment of Venom
text: The Scorpion God's sting sends venom strong enough to poison blood, bone, and spirit.

name: Vile Manifestation
text: The glyphs writhed and twisted, spewing out dark, vengeful magic.

name: Wretched Camel
text: Perfectly adapted to cross the wastes in life, they bring the wastes with them in death.

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Blur of Blades
text: Samut battled her way through the hordes, shouting the names of those who'd died in her crop and those she hoped yet to save.

name: Burning-Fist Minotaur
text: "There is no afterlife. Not for me, and not for you. So think again before getting in my way."

name: Chandra's Defeat
text:
"Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Chaos Maw
text: The food chain doesn't end at sandwurms.

name: Crash Through
text:
"We have to get out of the city, Djeru. All of us! Gather as many as you can."
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Defiant Khenra
text: There were those who saw the death of the gods and the city's collapse as a final test of worth. Some believed it meant the God-Pharaoh had been killed. Only a few realized they had been deceived.

name: Disposal Mummy
text: Without the viziers to oversee their actions, some anointed went to extreme lengths to fulfill their directives.

name: Fervent Paincaster
text: "Everyone here is a honed fighter. We'll respond the only way we know how."

name: Firebrand Archer
text: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

name: Frontline Devastator
text: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

name: Gilded Cerodon
text: The plating of its horns is a token of honor from Hazoret, who favors creatures with great hearts.

name: Granitic Titan
text:
"That one's not mine. Run!"
—Nissa Revane

name: Hour of Devastation
text:
"Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Inferno Jet
text: "When the whole world is crazy, it's important to find something you can rely on."

name: Adarkar Unicorn
text:
"There is no nobler creature in all of Terisiare."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Snow Devil
text:
"Give me wings to fly and speed to strike. In return, the glory I earn shall be yours."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian Shaman

name: Soldevi Machinist
text:
"Perhaps this time the power of the artificers shall be used wisely."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Soul Barrier
text:
"There's more than one way to skin an Ouphe—or thwart a mage."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Thunder Wall
text:
"The Lemures had barely taken wing when the sky roared with thunder. The swarm of little beasts wavered, divided, and fell, crashing to the earth."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Updraft
text:
"The power of flight has but one equal in battle: surprise. Understanding how to use both is the key to victory."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

name: Wind Spirit
text:
"To visit the sky requires bravery, and thought, and little else. To master the sky requires the binding of *its* masters, and little else."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

name: Word of Undoing
text:
"It was in Urza's journals that I finally found the secret at the core of the summonings."
—Journal, author unknown

name: Wrath of Marit Lage
text: Dread Marit Lage lies dreaming, not dead.

name: Zuran Enchanter
text:
"We are Kjeldorans no more."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Zuran Spellcaster
text:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Abyssal Specter
text:
"Open the gates, and bid them enter."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Brine Shaman
text:
"The Shamans of Marit Lage do her bidding in secret, but they do it gladly."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Burnt Offering
text:
"My foes serve me twice: in dying, and in death."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Drift of the Dead
text:
"Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Fear
text:
"Even the bravest of warriors yet knows the dark clutch of fright upon his stalwart heart."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Flow of Maggots
text:
"The very earth seemed alive and made a sound like the writhing of the damned."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Foul Familiar
text:
"Serve me, and live forever."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Gaze of Pain
text: Remove the guardians to ensure your victory.

name: Gravebind
text: One foot in the grave, firmly planted.

name: Hoar Shade
text:
"The creature we fought in the western waste was doubly dangerous: mortally wounded, it rebounded and attacked again."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Howl from Beyond
text:
"From the mouths of my servants, my voice shall emerge to shake the souls of my foes."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Hyalopterous Lemure
text:
"The Lemures looked harmless, until they descended on my troops. Within moments, only bones remained."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Icequake
text:
"When the earth shakes, and their animals are swallowed up by the ground, perhaps they will think twice before attacking again."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Infernal Darkness
text:
"I thought the day had brought enough horrors for our ragged band, but the night was far worse."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Kjeldoran Dead
text:
"They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Knight of Stromgald
text:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Krovikan Elementalist
text:
"The Elementalists' talents could be useful if turned to other purposes."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Krovikan Fetish
text: Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.

name: Legions of Lim-Dûl
text:
"I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Leshrac's Rite
text:
"Bind me to thee, my soul to thine. I am your servant and your slave. I shall hunger for your word and thirst for your blessing. Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Lim-Dûl's Cohort
text:
"Join me in the place of power, you risen dead. Join me where the waters weep and the trees have no hearts."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Lim-Dûl's Hex
text:
"The weak shall fall. The strong shall remain."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Mind Ravel
text: An end to reason, an end to order. Forget all that has been.

name: Mind Whip
text:
"A mind in agony is a sparrow without wings."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Minion of Tevesh Szat
text:
"A minion given over to Tevesh Szat is a stronger minion gained."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Moor Fiend
text:
"Let them close the gates of Krov from dusk until dawn if they so choose. It matters not. My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Seizures
text:
"Sheathe your sword, warrior, lest ye fall on it when stricken."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Songs of the Damned
text: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

name: Spoils of Evil
text:
"Virtue has its rewards, as does its opposite."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Spoils of War
text:
"This is the fun part!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

name: Stromgald Cabal
text:
"Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Touch of Death
text:
"What was yours is mine. Your land, your people, and now your life."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Aggression
text: The star that burns twice as bright burns half as long.

name: Cold Snap
text: Who knows from whence the winter comes?

name: Anarchy
text:
"The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Avalanche
text:
"The pass was completely blocked by the avalanche; we're forced to turn back. Nevertheless, we've gone farther and seen more than any before us."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Balduvian Barbarians
text:
"Barbarian raids were a concern to those living in the northwest provinces, but the Skyknights never dealt with the problem in a systematic way. They thought of the Balduvians as an 'amusing model' of their forebears' culture."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Battle Frenzy
text:
"One day you, too, shall drink the blood of your foes. It is something to look forward to."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Bone Shaman
text:
Rattle me bones as I cross the floor
And the bones in your grave will rattle no more.

name: Brand of Ill Omen
text:
"Let those who bear the brand receive no shelter, no kindness, and no comfort from our people."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Cooperation
text:
"The Elves train our healers, and we keep the Orcs at bay. Most Elvish bargains aren't as fair."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Conquer
text:
"Why do we trade with those despicable Elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Curse of Marit Lage
text:
"Our world has not felt her thundering steps in lifetimes, but Marit Lage's presence is still with us."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Dwarven Armory
text:
"Few of us left, now. Confounded Yeti have opened all the vents. We'd best hide here with the weapons."
—Perena Deepcutter, Dwarven Armorer

name: Errantry
text:
"There is no shame in solitude. The lone Knight may succeed where a hundred founder."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Flame Spirit
text:
"The spirit of the flame is the spirit of change."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Flare
text:
"I strive for elegance and speed in my work."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Glacial Crevasses
text:
"We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled. I can't believe it was mere coincidence."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Goblin Mutant
text: If only it had three brains, too.

name: Death Ward
text:
"Sometimes, a soul is not ready to complete its journey to the next world."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Goblin Ski Patrol
text:
"AIIIEEEE!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

name: Goblin Snowman
text:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

name: Grizzled Wolverine
text:
"Before you release a Wolverine from the trap, make sure it's really dead."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Imposing Visage
text:
"I can't believe they expect me to fight with this rabble. A Goblin in a big mask sends 'em running for cover."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Jokulhaups
text:
"I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster. The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Karplusan Giant
text:
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of Giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Karplusan Yeti
text:
"What's that smell?"
—Perena Deepcutter, Dwarven Armorer

name: Lava Burst
text:
"Overkill? This isn't a game of Kick-the-Ouphe!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Arctic Foxes
text:
"Those Foxes are wily, swift, and ferocious. They are the warriors of the snows."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Disenchant
text:
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Melting
text:
"Who needs the sun when you've got me around?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Meteor Shower
text:
"Eenie, meenie, minie, moe . . . oh, why not all of them?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Mountain Goat
text:
"Folkore has it that to capture a Mountain Goat is a sign of divine blessing. I just know it's a sign that dinner is on the way."
—Klazina Jansdotter, Leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

name: Orcish Cannoneers
text:
"It's a thankless job, and you'll probably die in an explosion. But the pay is pretty good."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Orcish Farmer
text:
"Yes, the Farmers keep our soldiers fed. But why do they have to make every battlefield a pigpen?"
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Orcish Librarian
text: Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . .

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Panic
text:
"If you'd been there, you would've run from that deer, too!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Pyroblast
text:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Leaves more room for the big ones to fight in, you know."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Sabretooth Tiger
text:
"Daughter, it is now your turn to hunt the Tiger, and make a blanket of its fur."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Shatter
text:
"Let the past be the past. Do not call up that which you cannot put down. Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Stone Rain
text:
"May the forces that took Argoth beneath the waves never come among us again."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Stone Spirit
text:
"The spirit of the stone is the spirit of strength."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Stonehands
text:
"Trust in the power of stone. Stone is strong; stone shatters swords; stone breaks bones. Trust in stone."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Elvish Healer
text:
"The Kjeldorans keep the Orcs at bay and we train their healers. Most human bargains aren't as fair."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Tor Giant
text:
"What do you do then? Run. Run very fast. Don't stop until you see the camp—or a bigger Giant."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

name: Vertigo
text:
"I saw the wizard gesturing, but I didn't guess his plan until my Aesthir cried out and went into a dive."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Wall of Lava
text:
"Now *there's* something you don't see every day."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Word of Blasting
text:
"Walls? What walls?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Aurochs
text: One Auroch may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.

name: Balduvian Bears
text:
"They're a hardy bunch, but I'd still bet that they just slept through the worst of the cold times."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Brown Ouphe
text:
"Ouphes love trinkets and love to take them apart. I only wish they wouldn't do so with the magical ones."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Chub Toad
text:
Chub Toad, Chub Toad
At the door.
Run away quick
Or you'll run no more.
—Traditional children's rhyme

name: Enduring Renewal
text: That which lasts longest serves best.

name: Dire Wolves
text:
"It's amazing how scared a city kid can get at a dog. Now, of course, I'd cross Terisiare alone, and keep no watch if I had a pack of greys hanging on my flanks as I went."
—Oddveig Ulfsson, caravan scout

name: Earthlore
text:
"Even the ground is our friend."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Elder Druid
text:
"I am older than any Elder Druid before me, and still no child has been born with the Mark to take my place. When will the wheel turn?"
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Essence Filter
text:
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Fanatical Fever
text:
"Let go your fury, and hone your anger. Become the fist of Freyalise!"
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Folk of the Pines
text:
"Our friends of the forest take many forms, yet all serve the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Forgotten Lore
text: In ashes are the gems of history.

name: Foxfire
text:
"Only the foolish fear Foxfire."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Freyalise Supplicant
text:
"We have joined with the Druids of the Juniper Order. Our faith is one."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Fyndhorn Brownie
text:
"I've been insulted by drunks in a hundred inns, but never as skillfully or annoyingly as by those blasted Brownies."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Fyndhorn Elder
text:
"Do we know what we're doing? Yes—the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text:
"Living side by side with the Elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Fyndhorn Pollen
text:
"I breathed deeply, and suddenly I knew not who or where I was."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Gorilla Pack
text:
"We learned this at a dear price: once you cross the great river, get through the Yavimaya forest at top speed."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Hot Springs
text: Warmth is life; heat is peace.

name: Hurricane
text:
"This was quite possibly the least pleasant occurrence on the entire expedition."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Formation
text:
"I have been a warrior for over four hundred years, and yet each generation of Kjeldorans teaches me new tricks. There can be no better allies."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Johtull Wurm
text:
"To bring her down we must be on all sides at once—leave one avenue open and we'll all be dead."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Juniper Order Druid
text:
"The filthy towns of Kjeldor are no place for anyone to live. Fyndhorn is our home now."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Maddening Wind
text:
"It is Freyalise, walking on the world."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Nature's Lore
text:
"Fyndhorn is our home."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Pale Bears
text:
"Daughter, on the day you have killed your Pale Bear, then will I give you your true name."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Pygmy Allosaurus
text:
"I don't understand the appeal of keeping these things as pets, unless you want your children eaten."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Pyknite
text:
"Never cross a Pyknite, if you value your scalp."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Regeneration
text:
"Faith in Freyalise has given me the gift, not the curse, of unprecedented longevity."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Rime Dryad
text:
"The Dryads told us to stay, as no new horrors would come when it was so cold. Three of us left anyway. The rest believed their lies, and their skeletons weren't found until the thaw."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Ritual of Subdual
text:
"That which does not bend to the will of Freyalise shall surely break."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Scaled Wurm
text:
"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these Wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Shambling Strider
text: Freyalise forbid that any stranger should wander into the Striders' territory.

name: Stampede
text:
"We could see the horizon blacken with the great beasts, but it was too late. The icefield offered no immediate safety, but luckily most of us reached a crevasse in which we could take cover."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Tarpan
text:
"A good Tarpan will serve you, faithful and true. A bad one will kick you in the head."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Thermokarst
text:
"Finally we understand the lesson of our home: loss begets renewal."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

name: Thoughtleech
text:
"A resourceful mage has many sources of information. The best one is your foe."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Trailblazer
text:
"Our Elvish Hunter Taaveti led us swiftly along hidden paths through the dense forest. We caught the Orcs from behind, and completely by surprise."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Wall of Pine Needles
text: The power of the forest takes a hundred forms. Some are more surprising than others.

name: Wild Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Woolly Mammoths
text:
"Mammoths may be good to ride on, but they're certainly bad to fall off of!"
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Woolly Spider
text:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a Spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Yavimaya Gnats
text:
"It is our third day of travel on the Yavimaya River, and still these creatures plague us. Davin Lansson, our naturalist, has facetiously labeled them 'gnats,' and the name has stuck."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Centaur Archer
text:
"Centaurs will kill our Aesthir if they can; they've always been enemies. Destroy the horse-people on sight."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Diabolic Vision
text:
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Elemental Augury
text:
"It is the changing of perception that is important."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Essence Vortex
text: Masters who sacrifice for servants will receive the gift of loyalty.

name: Fiery Justice
text:
"The fire of justice burns like nothing else."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Hallowed Ground
text:
"On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Flooded Woodlands
text: Freyalise's tears bring life and renewal, though they also bring trouble.

name: Fumarole
text:
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills."
—Klazina Jansdotter, Leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

name: Ghostly Flame
text:
"Walk slowly when in the nether world, and seek that which calls."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Giant Trap Door Spider
text:
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Glaciers
text:
"Even the highest mountain can be ground to dust."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Hymn of Rebirth
text:
"There will come soft rains, and spring shall be amongst us, a welcome friend."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Kjeldoran Frostbeast
text:
"Two of my Warriors found that the creature was dangerous not only in combat, but also in simple proximity."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Monsoon
text:
"No one in her right mind would venture off the coast of Kjeldor during this season."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Mountain Titan
text:
"The Titans claimed to draw strength from the rocks, but I suspect them of some darker allegiance."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Arenson's Aura
text:
"I have my faith, and I have my prayers. But if push comes to shove, I've also got a little something extra."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Heal
text:
"Sometimes even the smallest boon can save a life."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Reclamation
text:
"We shall oppose Lim-Dûl and his forces by any means necessary, even if the very earth be torn asunder."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Skeleton Ship
text:
"The sea gives up her dead as easily as the soil."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Spectral Shield
text:
"What can be a stronger shield than concealment? Have you ever defeated an enemy you didn't know existed?"
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Storm Spirit
text:
"Come to us, with your lightning. Come to us, with your thunder. Serve us with your strength, and smite our foes with your power."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian Shaman

name: Stormbind
text:
"Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Wings of Aesthir
text:
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

name: Adarkar Sentinel
text:
"We encountered the Sentinels in the wastes, near no living thing. Their purpose was inscrutable."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Aegis of the Meek
text:
"With this marvel, even the weak have a fighting chance!"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Arcum's Sleigh
text:
"With the proper equipment and caution, one can travel anywhere."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Hipparion
text:
"Someone once said that Hipparions are to Warriors what Aesthir are to Skyknights. Don't believe it."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Baton of Morale
text:
"The Goblins would kill to get ahold of this one."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Celestial Sword
text:
"So great is its power, only the chosen can wield it and live."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Despotic Scepter
text:
"We were not meant to have such terrible things. They should be left where we found them, if not destroyed!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Fyndhorn Bow
text:
"With a bow like this, the hunting is always good."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

name: Icy Manipulator
text:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Jester's Cap
text:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Kelsinko Ranger
text:
"Rangers not trained by the Elves just aren't the same."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Pentagram of the Ages
text:
"Take this item, for instance. How would it destroy us, Relicbane?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Pit Trap
text:
"These traps are truly a symbol of great cruelty and sinister cunning."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Shield of the Ages
text:
"This shield is a true rarity: an artifact whose purpose is obvious."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Skull Catapult
text:
"Let any who doubt the evil of using the ancient devices look at this infernal machine. What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

name: Soldevi Golem
text: Slow and steady wins the race.

name: Soldevi Simulacrum
text: They look human— until they bleed.

name: Kjeldoran Elite Guard
text: The winged helms of the Guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

name: Staff of the Ages
text:
"We found this staff useful on our visit to this very commission. Would Relicbane prefer we had been slain by Lim-Dûl's horrors?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Sunstone
text:
"I dispute Relicbane's hysterical allegations, Commissioner, but it is true that these artifacts can be dangerous."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Vibrating Sphere
text:
"Unearthly and invisible fibers emanate from this sphere, entangling all who draw near."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Walking Wall
text:
"The fortress is not what it seems."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Wall of Shields
text:
"It's the pokey bits that hurt the most."
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

name: War Chariot
text:
"I wouldn't advise using it with a Woolly Mammoth, but it's quite appropriate for many other beasts."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Whalebone Glider
text:
"It's no Ornithopter, but then I'm no Urza."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Zuran Orb
text:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Kjeldoran Knight
text:
"Those who do not ride the wind on Aesthir still command loyalty and respect."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Kjeldoran Phalanx
text:
"There's nothing I like better than watching a street full of soldiers kicking down the doors of the guilty and the impure."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
text:
"Honorable in battle, generous in death."
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

name: Kjeldoran Skycaptain
text:
"If we do our duty and uphold our honor, Kjeldor shall stand for a thousand years."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Armor of Faith
text:
"Keep your chainmail, warrior. I have my own form of protection."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Kjeldoran Skyknight
text:
"My Aesthir is my most trusted ally. We fight as one and live as one, and we will die as one."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Kjeldoran Warrior
text:
"Give me a thousand such Warriors and I could change the world."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Lightning Blow
text:
"If you do it right, they'll never know what hit them."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Lost Order of Jarkeld
text:
"Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Mercenaries
text:
"Blasted amateurs! Doesn't the queen think we can fight well enough on our own?"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Order of the White Shield
text:
"Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Prismatic Ward
text:
"These, of all spells, must have common components I can isolate and use."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Rally
text:
"Stand your ground, troops! This shall be our finest hour!"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox, last words

name: Battle Cry
text:
"In the thick of battle, you must keep your wits about you. Yelling a lot helps, too."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Sacred Boon
text:
"Divine gifts are granted to those who are worthy."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Shield Bearer
text:
"You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a Skyknight."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Snow Hound
text:
"If you're starving, eat your horses, your dead, or yourself—but *never* eat your dog."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"The so-called Barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Warning
text:
"The folk of the Karplusan Mountains are impossible to ambush."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

name: Arnjlot's Ascent
text:
"The dreams of a child fulfilled:
the wind on my brow,
the air 'neath my feet."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

name: Balduvian Conjurer
text:
"The very lands of Balduvia are alive."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Binding Grasp
text:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter,
Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Breath of Dreams
text:
"Get up, blast you! They're attacking! Why are you all so slow?"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Clairvoyance
text:
"As we followed the ice wall, we had the distinct feeling of being watched. Many of the party wanted to turn back."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Counterspell
text:
"The duel was going badly for me, and Zur thought I was finished. He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Deflection
text:
Up and down,
over and through,
back around—
the joke's on you.

name: Enervate
text:
"Worlds turn in crucial moments of decision. Make your choice."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Errant Minion
text: Abandon not your faith when others abandon you.

name: Essence Flare
text: Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.

name: Blessed Wine
text:
"May the bounty of Kjeld enrich your days."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Force Void
text:
"My mind and spirit are one—a barrier not readily passed."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Glacial Wall
text:
"We are farther west than any could have imagined possible, but I still wish to press on. Unfortunately, huge walls of ice block further travel. We can't believe they are natural."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Hydroblast
text:
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Illusionary Forces
text:
"This school was founded in secret, operates in secret, and exists for the teaching of secrets. Those who would alter reality must first escape it."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Illusionary Presence
text:
"We could feel the Shaman's power, as surely as we felt the storm."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Illusionary Terrain
text:
"The drawing of maps is fruitless in the west near the ice walls; the very earth is formless."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Illusionary Wall
text:
"Let them see what is not there and feel what does not touch them. When they no longer trust their senses, that is the time to strike."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Blinking Spirit
text:
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

name: Infuse
text:
"The potential for change lies in all things. Know a thing's nature, know its possibilities, and know it anew."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Krovikan Sorcerer
text:
"These Sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Mesmeric Trance
text:
"Magic overused can freeze the mind. Creativity is more important than power."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Mistfolk
text:
"Although my official log will state there is no evidence pointing to the existence of the Mistfolk, my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Polar Kraken
text:
"It was big. Really, really, big. No, bigger than that. It was *big!*"
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Ray of Erasure
text:
"What is real can be unreal."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Reality Twist
text:
"Nothing is as it seems."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Sea Spirit
text:
"It rose above our heads, above the ship, and still higher yet. No foggy, ice-laden sea in the world could frighten me more."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Shyft
text:
"Capturing this specimen was not easy. Study it well, that you someday might be as versatile."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Sibilant Spirit
text:
"Relax. I'm sure it's just a snake hissing."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Silver Erne
text:
"I've seen a larger Erne knock a Giant to the ground and stay airborne. They move not with the wind, but as the wind."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Adaptive Shimmerer
text:
"You sure you want to see what emerges? You might not like it. It definitely won't like you."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Drannith Healer
text: "The glowstones shine and dinosaurs roar to the south. Business will be brisk tonight."

name: Suffocating Fumes
text:
"Yesterday it was flying tigers and crumbling bridges. Who knows what today will bring?"
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster

name: Unbreakable Bond
text:
From now until the crystals stop glowing
—Ketria oath meaning "forever"

name: Unexpected Fangs
text:
"With the frequent mutations, predator-prey relationships seem to change every moment. I already like it here."
—Vivien Reid

name: Unlikely Aid
text: "I appreciate you not letting me fall to my death in the acid bogs. Now, can you let me down?"

name: Whisper Squad
text: Ears can't hear them. Eyes see too many of them.

name: Zagoth Mamba
text:
"It's just a snake. A many-eyed snake with venom that turns your blood to smoke, but still, just a snake."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Blazing Volley
text:
"Don't ask me what to do if you miss. They're stingdrakes. Don't miss."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

name: Blisterspit Gremlin
text:
"Ah, we have a critic."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

name: Blitz of the Thunder-Raptor
text: The sound of Vadrok's gigantic wings is ominous. But the true terror is when they fall silent.

name: Drannith Magistrate
text: "Our sanctuaries must be beacons of reason and calm or else they will fall."

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.

name: Clash of Titans
text:
"Let the brutes fight. If they kill each other, we lose no more soldiers today."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

name: Drannith Stinger
text: The first line of defense, and the last person you want to anger.

name: Ferocious Tigorilla
text: From a certain perspective, it's an inspiring story of overcoming obstacles.

name: Fire Prophecy
text:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Flame Spill
text: Fragile, floating Skysail suddenly seemed like an appealingly safe place to live.

name: Forbidden Friendship
