text: The two looked at each other, and neither fled. "I see," the soldier murmured. "We're both just fighting for survival out here, aren't we?"

name: Frenzied Raptor
text:
"Though the road through Raugrin is lined with alarm crystals, some monsters seem to be adapting. We've had raptors feigning attacks on provision caravans, while others try to sneak through the lava curtain."
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster

name: Frillscare Mentor
text: Fortune favors the ferocious.

name: Go for Blood
text: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

name: Heightened Reflexes
text: Some crystals glow in the presence of monsters, forming a convenient warning system. Some monsters have learned to outrun the light.

name: Lava Serpent
text: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.

name: Prickly Marmoset
text:
"It's either terrified or extremely mad at us, definitely one of the two."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

name: Flourishing Fox
text:
"Day 1: These fox pups have really taken to me.
"Day 4: Big. So big. Need additional security."
—Jonald, mission naturalist, research notes

name: Pyroceratops
text: "I always thought wizards were supposed to have owls or one-eyed cats for familiars, but flaming dinosaurs work, too."

name: Raking Claws
text:
"How many claws does a monster have? Exactly one more than you've accounted for."
—Alux, Skysail defender

name: Reptilian Reflection
text: Danger often lurks in the allure of crystal shards.

name: Rooting Moloch
text: Their feeding habits leave them with gizzards full of tumbled gems.

name: Rumbling Rockslide
text:
"When monsters walk, the earth knows its place and yields."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Spelleater Wolverine
text:
"The monster that scares me the most isn't the biggest."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage

name: Tentative Connection
text: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.

name: Garrison Cat
text: After much arguing, the soldiers decided to keep it, on the grounds that it killed enough mice to count as an honorary monster slayer.

name: Weaponize the Monsters
text: Revenge is a path inevitably walked alone.

name: Adventurous Impulse
text: An adventure without a companion is hardly an adventure at all.

name: Almighty Brushwagg
text:
Laughed at the brushwagg
—Hunters' expression meaning "died unexpectedly"

name: Barrier Breach
text:
"They cast wards, thinking it will protect them, but the biggest monsters find a way through."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Bristling Boar
text:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

name: Charge of the Forever-Beast
text: The Zagoth wetlands are fertilized by centuries of Brokkos's former challengers.

name: Colossification
text:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten *were* related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

name: Essence Symbiote
text: The Ozolith's appearance spawned a new era of wild mutation on Ikoria. Some creatures hunted different prey, lived in new habitats, and thrived on mutation itself.

name: Helica Glider
text: It could subsist on seeds but its preferred fare is your face.

name: Excavation Mole
text: It makes molehills out of mountains.

name: Exuberant Wolfbear
text: Sometimes the *eludha* is a sacred harmony of souls. Sometimes the bonder grabs some fur and holds on tight.

name: Flycatcher Giraffid
text: Poachers use the harvested tongues to snare pests, plumb caves, and scale tall buildings.

name: Fully Grown
text:
"One day I woke up and knew I had nothing left to teach her. So now I ride on her shoulders and follow where she leads."
—Gustin, wildbonder

name: Greater Sandwurm
text: On Ikoria, sandwurms never lie dormant for too long. In some regions, "no activity" is the greatest sign of danger.

name: Honey Mammoth
text:
"And I thought *I* had a big sweet tooth."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

name: Hornbash Mentor
text: "We share the same nuanced opinion of hunters and military goons: smash them."

name: Humble Naturalist
text: "The key to bonding with monsters, no matter their size, is knowing where they like to be scratched."

name: Ivy Elemental
text: For safety reasons, the keeping of houseplants within Ikoria's sanctuaries is heavily discouraged.

name: Monstrous Step
text: Life is best taken one step at a time.

name: Mosscoat Goriak
text:
"Goriaks are as stubborn and hardy as I'd expect of a large herbivore in a wetland habitat. But I never expected them to have such beautiful voices!"
—Vivien Reid

name: Mythos of Brokkos
text:
"The most unexpected weapon that a monster can wield is kindness."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

name: Plummet
text: Scavengers follow in Skysail's shadow, feasting on the carcasses of monsters that attacked the floating city.

name: Imposing Vantasaur
text: Raugrin's coastline can be quite beautiful, as long as you avoid the volcanic dinosaurs, the sea dinosaurs, and the roaming beach dinosaurs.

name: Ram Through
text:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

name: Sudden Spinnerets
text:
"What's natural on Ikoria continues to delight me."
—Vivien Reid

name: Survivors' Bond
text: "And what did we learn? Never taunt a porcuparrot!"

name: Thwart the Enemy
text:
"Your prey is in my custody now. Withdraw."
—Vivien Reid

name: Wilt
text: Nothing returns from the nightmare nests of Indatha unscathed.

name: Back for More
text:
"How can you be sure you pierced its heart? Do you even know where its heart is?"
—Trundan, Indatha poacher

name: Keensight Mentor
text: Through the *eludha*, bonders share the powerful abilities of their chosen companions.

name: Channeled Force
text: Few monsters challenged Narset after they sensed her power.

name: Dire Tactics
text:
"I will preserve human life at all costs. I will stand alone against behemoths before I let them touch my city. I will hold the wall."
—Oath of the Coppercoats

name: Eerie Ultimatum
text:
"The ground under our feet is a record of every slight against the world, to be avenged at a time of its choosing."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Frondland Felidar
text:
"Fear not the behemoth heard from miles away. Fear the stalking felidar, which reveals itself only for the kill."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: General's Enforcer
text: More stubborn than Drannith's walls.

name: Genesis Ultimatum
text: No human eyes have ever witnessed the birth of an apex monster.

name: Lavabrink Venturer
text: "Take one wrong step out here and you're dead. I take only right steps."

name: Inspired Ultimatum
text:
"Inner peace is wonderful, and worth striving for. Outer peace is much less important."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage

name: Offspring's Revenge
text: All they found in the hunter's camp were tiny paw prints and a lot of blood.

name: Farfinder
text: "Take us home," she whispered, and the fox's eyes began to glow.

name: Primal Empathy
text: "From this day forward, we confront this world together, lifting each other up."

name: Rielle, the Everwise
text: "Being all-knowing is a matter of remembering which things it is crucial to forget."

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"Strike those abominations down. Let their names rot with their remains."
—General Kudro

name: Savai Thundermane
text: A crackling roar is the last sound many hunters hear.

name: Skull Prophet
text: "I study bone because that's where truth dwells. One monster knucklebone is wiser than all that damp meat in your head."

name: Skycat Sovereign
text: The bounty on its head is as old as Skysail, but no one has ever tried to collect.

name: Slitherwisp
text: Fear is its habitat, sanity its prey.

name: Luminous Broodmoth
text: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.

name: Song of Creation
text: She wept, not from perfect understanding, but from serene gratitude.

name: Sprite Dragon
text: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

name: Whirlwind of Thought
text: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

name: Zenith Flare
text:
"I defy this world to try our defenses now. Send pterons and skycats. Send Vadrok!"
—Janae, Coppercoat architect

name: Alert Heedbonder
text: Considering the zealous armies, vile poachers, and titanic monsters, it's always wise to keep one eye on the horizon.

name: Cunning Nightbonder
text: "We are each other's shadow, fleeting yet always present."

name: Jubilant Skybonder
text: She was born unable to walk. Through the *eludha*, she was able to fly.

name: Proud Wildbonder
text:
"You're little now, yes, but one day your footsteps will make mountains tremble."
—Gustin, wildbonder

name: Maned Serval
text:
"Don't search the ruins of Orn during the day. Nethroi's many eyes will spot you instantly. Don't go at night either. You'll be dinner for the servals. Maybe just don't go."
—Rasai, Indatha hunter

name: Sonorous Howlbonder
text: The call of the wild is rarely a solo.

name: Indatha Crystal
text: Crystals nestle in the roots of Indatha's helica trees as if being nurtured by their embrace.

name: Ketria Crystal
text: The dark of night never truly falls on Ketria, where abundant crystals bathe the land in their glow.

name: The Ozolith
text: As it twists, so does all life around it.

name: Raugrin Crystal
text: The vegetation in Raugrin is dull, but that only makes the towering crystal structures gleam brighter.

name: Savai Crystal
text: The same crystals that root deep enough to pierce Savai's catacombs also soar high enough to change its weather.

name: Sleeper Dart
text:
"Sleep now, you big brute."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Springjaw Trap
text:
"Stop trying to pierce the hide. Hit where it's softest: ankle, sole, hamstring."
—Master Hunter Chevill

name: Zagoth Crystal
text: From the fertile muck of Zagoth, everything—animal, botanical, and crystalline—grows with rugged beauty.

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"It's not hard to grasp that this land does not belong to us."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Indatha Triome
text:
"These lowlands were formed thousands of years ago by the behemoth Indath—its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

name: Pacifism
text:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

name: Ketria Triome
text: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.

name: Raugrin Triome
text: Raugrin meets the sea with jaws wide, its coast spiked with teeth of crystal and granite.

name: Savai Triome
text: Broad prairies feed the human sanctuary of Drannith and conceal a network of caverns where giant cats make their dens.

name: Zagoth Triome
text: Hunters in the primeval wetlands become fluent in reading the ripples to tell when to pursue and when to flee.

name: Patagia Tiger
text: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.

name: Perimeter Sergeant
text: "Get in there, soldier! I want a pelt on my wall before lunch!"

name: Zilortha, Strength Incarnate
text:
"Many thought they knew its weakness. They are dead."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Sanctuary Lockdown
text:
"Drannith gives no quarter to traitors."
—General Kudro

name: Savai Sabertooth
text: The giant tigers of Savai prefer to hunt at daybreak, when the crystals' warning glow is masked by the light of dawn.

name: Mysterious Egg
text:
"A good forage if you can find it, but eat it before you get back to sanctuary. The guards won't let you bring it through the gates."
—Dennae, Savai hunter

name: Snare Tactician
text:
"Our volleys don't aim to kill. Impair them and the ground will do the rest."
—Alux, Skysail defender

name: Spontaneous Flight
text: "Amazing! And I was only trying to teach her to sit!"

name: Stormwild Capridor
text: After a disastrous day of battle, Lavabrink's lightning mages were recalled.

name: Swallow Whole
text:
"World's better with one fewer poacher in it."
—Winota, heartbonder

name: Valiant Rescuer
text: The floating city of Skysail has two rules: don't leave your crewmates behind, and don't mess with the guardrails.

name: Colossification
text: "Talk later. Row now!"

name: Flourishing Fox
text:
"Day 1: These fox pups have really taken to me.
"Day 4: Big. So big. Need additional security."
—Jonald, mission naturalist, research notes

name: Heartless Act
text:
"It's them or us."
—General Kudro

name: Forbidden Friendship
text: The two looked at each other, and neither fled. "I see," the soldier murmured. "We're both just fighting for survival out here, aren't we?"

name: Sprite Dragon
text: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

name: Will of the All-Hunter
text:
"It's Snapdax. You'd have a better chance of breaching a wall with a slice of bread."
—Krek, daysquad captain

name: Aegis Turtle
text:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Blade Banish
text: The Wanderer walks many paths. Her blade travels only one.

name: Anticipate
text: Bonder and bonded move in unison, intuiting each other's next move.

name: Boon of the Wish-Giver
text:
"There is no law of nature that I have not seen Illuna break. Makes you wonder what is truly possible, does it not?"
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Convolute
text: "No, thank you."

name: Crystacean
text: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

name: Escape Protocol
text: Sanctuaries harnessed the glowstones' natural reaction to monsters to create a warning system.

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"I know the nightmares of Indatha seem scary, but when you break them down into their component parts, they're quite beautiful."
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

name: Checkpoint Officer
text: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.

name: Facet Reader
text: "Every flaw in the crystal represents a moment where our strategy might go wrong."

name: Frost Lynx
text: If you feel a strange chill within the temperate Quartzwood, look up.

name: Frostveil Ambush
text: Hunters' methods vary from simple and brutal to elaborate and brutal.

name: Glimmerbell
text:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

name: Gust of Wind
text: Skysail's strength was also its vulnerability.

name: Hampering Snare
text:
"I want it to look me in the eyes and know the face of the man who put it down."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Keep Safe
text: "Coppercoats think they understand duty and loyalty, but they can't begin to fathom the depths of my bond."

name: Neutralize
text: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

name: Coordinated Charge
text:
"Out here we're nothing but our training."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

name: Of One Mind
text:
"The *eludha* is total communication, total understanding. It makes regular human speech feel like garbled grunting."
—Winota, heartbonder

name: Phase Dolphin
text:
"You've never had to trust your breath to an inhuman creature who could crush you at its whim, and I truly feel sorry for you."
—Eagan, seabonder

name: Pollywog Symbiote
text: It always knew it was destined to be more than a frog.

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Startling Development
text: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.

name: Thieving Otter
text:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

name: Voracious Greatshark
text: There is no boat big enough.

name: Wingfold Pteron
text:
"Its weak spot is easily spotted, but only if it's swooping down on you."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

name: Wingspan Mentor
text: Their bond grew over time, as did the height of their jumps.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Blitz Leech
text:
"Fools wear armor against it as if the worst it could take is your blood."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Blood Curdle
text: Fear pierces the strongest armor.

name: Boot Nipper
text:
"I have a number of hyper-specific phobias and this somehow hits all of them."
—Aaru, Zagoth lumberjack

name: Bushmeat Poacher
text: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

name: Call of the Death-Dweller
text: The living fear Nethroi's whispers. The dead heed them.

name: Daysquad Marshal
text: "The night emboldens many monsters, but the mightiest will attack in broad daylight."

name: Corpse Churn
text: "How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses..."

name: Dark Bargain
text:
"The poacher's trade isn't monster parts. It's myth. People pay to be part of the fantasy."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Dead Weight
text:
"You're not my quarry, little one. I'm after whatever comes to investigate your cries."
—Kelsien, the Plague

name: Durable Coilbug
text:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

name: Duskfang Mentor
text: "What she sees, I see. What she tastes, I taste."

name: Easy Prey
text: The definition of "bite-sized treat" depends on who you ask.

name: Extinction Event
text:
"Nature is more merciless than any hunter I've ever known."
—Zai, nightsquad captain

name: Gloom Pangolin
text:
"They say it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet. It's only active during the darkest of Indatha nights, making verification highly challenging."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

name: Divine Arrow
text: Outside Drannith's walls, where collateral damage is of no concern, the Coppercoats are free to use more potent methods.

name: Grimdancer
text: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.

name: Heartless Act
text:
"It's them or us."
—General Kudro

name: Hunted Nightmare
text:
"The cruelest monsters inspire the greatest tales. The greatest tales inspire the cruelest hunters."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Lurking Deadeye
text: "There's no roar so mighty that it can't be silenced."

name: Memory Leak
text:
"By halves does youth depart. I remember halves of names, halves of years, halves of myself."
—Ogaro, wandering sage

name: Mutual Destruction
text: Hunter and hunted both died thinking they had outwitted the other.

name: Mythos of Nethroi
text:
"And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

name: Nightsquad Commando
text: "The big fella sounds hungry. Let's send him to bed without his supper."

name: Serrated Scorpion
text: Each scorpion's venom is unique, thwarting sanctuary healers' attempts to develop an antidote.

name: Scion of Ugin
text: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron. As Ugin lay dormant, his spectral guardians kept vigil.

name: Noxious Dragon
text: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Rakdos Drake
text: Rakdos rioters paint their faces to resemble the drakes' bloodied muzzles.

name: Reave Soul
text:
"I was not convinced you had a soul until I saw it for myself."
—Liliana Vess

name: Rotfeaster Maggot
text: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Thoughtseize
text: "Any dream is a robust harvest. Still, I prefer the timeworn dreams, heavy with import, that haunt the obsessive mind."

name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
text: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

name: Ulcerate
text:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Wrench Mind
text: What is the sound of one head snapping?

name: Anger of the Gods
text: There was no reason to pray. This was already an act of the gods.

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Benevolent Ancestor
text: Although the door is flimsy and the lock pathetically small, Josuri's family never fears the night outside.

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Blinding Mage
text: "I carry the light of truth. Do not pity those it blinds, for they never had eyes to see."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Heat Ray
text:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Magus of the Moon
text: Tidal forces of the blood moon wrench and buckle the land, drawing monoliths of stone and soil toward the flaming orb.

name: Mark of Mutiny
text: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
text: "We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

name: Pillar of Flame
text: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

name: Ryusei, the Falling Star
text: The course of the falling star always ends in ruin.

name: Splatter Thug
text: The mask isn't meant to hide his identity. It's meant to keep the viscera out of his eyes.

name: Disenchant
text:
"The tools of evil are mere things. And like all things, they cannot last forever."
—*Song of All*, canto 881

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Trumpet Blast
text:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Vent Sentinel
text:
"Zendikar fortifies itself against the Great Threat, making sentries of sky, sea, and stone."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Aerial Predation
text: In the towering trees of the Samok Stand and the predators that guard them, the might of the Ravnican wild has returned.

name: Carven Caryatid
text: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

name: Channel
text: To some mages, the meaning of life is less important than how much is left.

name: Crowned Ceratok
text: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

name: Curse of Predation
text:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Duskdale Wurm
text:
"Last time, it tore up the Wilt-Leaf, turned Mistmeadow into a mudhole, and made the river jump its banks. On the bright side, we were eating venison for weeks."
—Donal Alloway, cenn of Kinscaer

name: Enlarge
text: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

name: Greater Basilisk
text: Bone, stone . . . both taste the same to a hungry basilisk.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Hunt the Weak
text: Dragons scorn the weak, even among their own kind.

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Dragon Bell Monk
text: He has spent years training his eyes and ears to detect the subtle signs of a dragon's approach.

name: Ivy Elemental
text: In the gardens of the centaurs, many travelers have mysteriously vanished while admiring the elaborate topiaries.

name: Jaddi Offshoot
text: On Murasa, even the trees grow trees.

name: Jugan, the Rising Star
text: The light of the rising star empowers the champions of tomorrow.

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

name: Lure
text: It makes the insignificant conspicuous, the repulsive alluring, and the deadly irresistible.

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

name: Netcaster Spider
text: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Sultai Flayer
text: "You can have the body, necromancer. I just want the skin."

name: Timberland Guide
text: "Can you build a fire? Track a deer? Identify killer trees? Then you'll never survive Kessig without me."

name: Wall of Roots
text:
"Mana grows and changes like the roots of a plant. Like a plant, it must be nurtured."
—Nissa Revane

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Chronicler of Heroes
text: She paints pictures with words, though not all pictures show the truth.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Abzan Battle Priest
text: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
text:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Jungle Barrier
text: Within silent clearings guarded by living palisades, the natural world guards its most precious secrets.

name: Knight of the Reliquary
text:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Lightning Helix
text:
"Rage is not the answer. Rage followed by fitting vengeance is the answer."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Rosheen Meanderer
text: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Darksteel Axe
text: Heavier than it looks, tricky to wield, guaranteed to last.

name: Dragonloft Idol
text: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

name: Kolaghan Monument
text: Kolaghan has no lasting home, but her disciples leave relics to mark her conquests.

name: Manakin
text:
"Each night, the artificer tucked the little doll into a locked drawer. Each morning, she awoke to find it waiting beside her with some new bauble."
—"The Artificer's Apprentice"

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Guard Duty
text: "I was told these were standard issue. Do I look standard to you?"

name: Mindcrank
text:
"Let go of your memories and be reborn."
—Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Moonglove Extract
text: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Star Compass
text: It doesn't point north. It points home.

name: Guided Strike
text:
"May the Ancestor strengthen my hand and guide my blade."
—Nomad war prayer

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Graven Cairns
text: Shamans of Kar-Sengir claim that their sun sets because it can no longer bear the gaze of those pain-carved cliffs.

name: Grove of the Burnwillows
text: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Swords, to me! We must engage their line to protect our archers and mages. Let no one fail this task!"

name: Horizon Canopy
text: The day is born within its branches.

name: Nimbus Maze
text: To find its center is to find one's own.

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: River of Tears
text:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

name: Shimmering Grotto
text: Untold riches await those who forsake the bustling world to search the secret, silent places.

name: Iona's Judgment
text: Beneath the gaze of angels, only the righteous may stand without fear.

name: Seeker of the Way
text: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Serra Ascendant
text: Faith in Serra is its own reward.

name: Student of Ojutai
text: "Human enlightenment is a firefly that sparks in the night. Dragon enlightenment is a beacon that disperses all darkness."

name: Sustainer of the Realm
text: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Topan Freeblade
text: "My scars are my sigils. I will wear them with pride long after you're gone."

name: Yosei, the Morning Star
text: The caress of the morning star frees all from the clutch of darkness.

name: Ainok Bond-Kin
text: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Amass the Components
text: "I knew I'd find a use for all that newt spittle!"

name: Bewilder
text:
"Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken. Silly, yes, but exactly the thing we needed to break the stifling tension."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Cephalid Broker
text: Cephalids value the free exchange of ideas—except for the "free" part.

name: Condescend
text: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

name: Consecrated Sphinx
text: Blessed by the hands of Jin-Gitaxias.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Diminish
text: Everything seems a little less ferocious when it's running from a house cat.

name: Dissolve
text: "You thought only the gods could stop you?"

name: Doorkeeper
text: One piercing stare usually convinces thieves to go elsewhere.

name: Elusive Spellfist
text:
"Learn to see an obstacle from a new perspective. Underneath, for example."
—Chanyi, Ojutai monk

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Frost Lynx
text: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Illusory Angel
text:
"In a daze, I woke and looked upon the battlefield, where I could swear my dreams were laying waste to the enemy."
—Letter from a soldier

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Jace's Phantasm
text: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

name: Jhessian Thief
text: "Where's the fun in an escape if it's not at least a little daring?"

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

name: Keiga, the Tide Star
text: The pull of the tide star holds eternal sway.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mana Drain
text: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"It augments anamnesis. What is so confusing about that?"
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Phantom Monster
text: Is it an amalgamation of faded memories or the projection of a half-remembered dream? Neither answer offers any comfort.

name: Angelic Accord
text: As demons are drawn to suffering, angels are drawn to acts of benevolence.

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Riverwheel Aerialists
text: Adepts of the Riverwheel Stronghold can run through rain and never get wet; masters use the raindrops as stepping stones.

name: Shriekgeist
text: Wounds of the flesh are easy to heal. Wounds of the mind may never be undone.

name: Skywise Teachings
text: Ojutai's words must be translated from Draconic before his students can benefit from their wisdom.

name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
text: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

name: Thought Scour
text:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Windfall
text: "Rich" is a relative term.

name: Abyssal Persecutor
text: His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.

name: Bala Ged Scorpion
text: Fast and lethal, with a penchant for the weak and infirm.

name: Archangel of Thune
text: Even the wicked have nightmares.

name: Bladewing's Thrall
text: A shadow of life chasing a husk of glory.

name: Bogbrew Witch
text: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

name: Butcher's Glee
text: The Crave made Kneecleaver think she was bigger than the dragon.

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Dead Reveler
text: He's the unlife of the party.

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Auriok Champion
text: Mirrodin's deepest caverns conceal its brightest hopes.

name: Festering Newt
text: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

name: Grisly Spectacle
text:
"Watch people flock to a murder scene. Then tell me we're not all a little sick in the head."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Haunting Hymn
text: The hymn's melody has persisted since Tourach's time, but the words changed to invoke the phobias of each listener.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
text: The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.

name: Lord of the Pit
text: "My summoning begins your debt, Planeswalker."

name: Night of Souls' Betrayal
text:
"How can we wage war against ourselves? What happens when the kami of our very souls rise against us? I answer simply: We cannot. We die. There can be no victory in this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

name: Apothecary Geist
text: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

name: Deadly Allure
text: What could be more irresistible than death?

name: Demonic Taskmaster
text: Subservience to greater power is the only law in the pit.

name: Desperate Farmer
text: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.

name: Eaten Alive
text:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

name: Ecstatic Awakener
text: "Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny. I beg you, release the strength within me!"

name: Edgar's Awakening
text: "Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day."

name: Falkenrath Torturer
text: "There was a time when our cages rang with wailing. Now only a handful of these whimpering fools remain."

name: Ghoulish Procession
text: It was a family reunion to die for.

name: Gisa's Bidding
text: "Soft dirt makes for light work."

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Heartless Summoning
text:
"They won't be winning any beauty pageants, but they'll do the trick."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Indulgent Aristocrat
text: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Avacynian Priest
text: Moorlanders speak in awe of the priests' talent for arriving just in time to drive off the wicked things that prowl the ravished parish.

name: Killing Wave
text: "Try again in the next life, darling."

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Morkrut Banshee
text: Cover your ears and you may never hear her coming—both a blessing and a curse.

name: Murderous Compulsion
text: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

name: Olivia's Dragoon
text: Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Siege Zombie
text: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.

name: Skirsdag High Priest
text: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Tree of Perdition
text: There will be no absolution.

name: Village Rites
text: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

name: Abrade
text: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

name: Bruna, the Fading Light
text: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

name: Alchemist's Greeting
text:
"Impressive."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Ancestral Anger
text: "One vampire for every family member I've lost."

name: Blood Mist
text: "Some claim that rage is a cloud that obscures thought and vision. But I can assure you—I've never seen with greater clarity."

name: Burning Vengeance
text: Mist is the geists' sorrow. Wind is their pain. Fire is their vengeance.

name: Cathar Commando
text: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

name: Conduit of Storms
text: It strikes with the fury of a tempest.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Festival Crasher
text: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Furyblade Vampire
text: "Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."

name: Geier Reach Bandit
text: The cathars realized they had not tracked her—she had led them here.

name: Hanweir Garrison
text: "We're ready for anything!"

name: Hanweir Watchkeep
text: He scans for wolves, knowing there's one he can never anticipate.

name: Honeymoon Hearse
text: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.

name: Cathar's Call
text: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

name: Hungry Ridgewolf
text: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.

name: Kruin Outlaw
text: "Hold tight. I've got a surprise for them."

name: Lightning Axe
text: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

name: Mass Hysteria
text: Gavony was their stage, and the moon their spotlight.

name: Neonate's Rush
text:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Reforge the Soul
text: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

name: Runebound Wolf
text: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Smoldering Werewolf
text:
"Never thought I'd see the day I'd be wishing to see just a plain old werewolf."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Ulrich's Kindred
text:
"I am not its master. We are of the same pack."
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha

name: Uncaged Fury
text:
"It's right to fear those that you keep locked away."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Vexing Devil
text: It's not any fun until someone loses an eye.

name: Village Messenger
text: "I'm afraid it's bad news."

name: Crusader of Odric
text: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

name: Voldaren Ambusher
text: "Gotcha."

name: Voldaren Duelist
text: "I have yet to find my equal."

name: Voldaren Epicure
text: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Aim High
text:
"A slayer gets by on wits and reflexes."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Ambush Viper
text:
"Living creatures seldom impress me. But I like this one."
—Uta Falkenrath

name: Clear Shot
text: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

name: Cryptolith Rite

text: The spread of its hood eclipses all hope.

name: Kavu Monarch
text: Kavu emerged all across Dominaria, but the first and the strongest came from Yavimaya.

name: Divine Presence
text:
"Serra's light isn't easily extinguished."
—Reya Dawnbringer

name: Kavu Scout
text: The kavu evolved for centuries deep inside Dominaria, and some can draw from its strength.

name: Lightning Dart
text: Broken and punctured by dozens of Phyrexian portals, the angry sky began to spit lightning back at the world.

name: Loafing Giant
text: "Forget it. I'm not getting up today."

name: Maniacal Rage
text: "Remember me?" Tahngarth roared. "Now I'll repay you for my stay on Rath!"

name: Obliterate
text: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

name: Rage Weaver
text: "Let my passion spur your victory."

name: Rogue Kavu
text: "I know how this one feels," said Urza. "It's not like others of its kind and has been shunned for its differences."

name: Ruby Leech
text:
"Its gems didn't stop pulsating until they were completely removed."
—Tolarian research notes

name: Scarred Puma
text: It's not eager to lose the *other* eye.

name: Searing Rays
text:
"This is a battle of pawns, for the highest stakes imaginable."
—Urza

name: Shivan Harvest
text:
"The blood of your ancestors ran heavy on this soil. Now it's your turn to sacrifice for the glory of Shiv."
—Viashino heretic

name: Skittish Kavu
text: Fierce when roused, this breed of kavu is easily distracted by a strong voice or melodic tune.

name: Glimmering Angel
text:
"We turned to see where the blow came from and saw only a distant light."
—Capashen lord

name: Slimy Kavu
text: Its slime liquefies the ground as efficiently as its fangs shred prey.

name: Stun
text:
"They certainly are well protected. Too bad for them they're not well balanced."
—Sisay

name: Tectonic Instability
text:
"Think of the problems we'll face if you uproot entire continents," said Urza.
"I have," replied Teferi, "but the alternative is worse."

name: Tribal Flames
text:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Turf Wound
text:
"I can't imagine how anyone lives in Shiv, let alone why they choose to stay."
—Sisay

name: Viashino Grappler
text:
"They've returned for the mana rig, but it no longer belongs to them."
—Viashino bey

name: Global Ruin
text:
"The earth shook, the sky rained fire, and it seemed the world was ending."
—Benalish refugee

name: Zap
text: "All this time I thought Squee was useless," chuckled Sisay. "Who knew he'd be such a good shot?"

name: Aggressive Urge
text: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.

name: Bind
text:
"The battlefield is cluttered enough. Be still."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Blurred Mongoose
text:
"The mongoose blew out its candle and was asleep in bed before the room went dark."
—Llanowar fable

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Skyshroud hymn

name: Fertile Ground
text: As Phyrexians descended, Multani paused to reflect on the beauty that might never be seen again.

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Harsh Judgment
text:
"At least they remember me."
—Gerrard

name: Jade Leech
text:
"It took magic to extract one of the stones and five people to carry it."
—Tolarian research notes

name: Kavu Chameleon
text:
"They weren't part of my plan, but Gaea insisted."
—Urza

name: Kavu Climber
text: The appearance of the first kavu surprised Multani. As they continued to emerge, he no longer had any doubts about Yavimaya's ability to defend herself.

name: Kavu Lair
text: As a dark rain of Phyrexians fell from the sky, fountains of kavu erupted from the ground.

name: Llanowar Cavalry
text: For the first time, elves welcomed Benalish soldiers into the forest with something other than arrows.

name: Llanowar Vanguard
text: Llanowar rallied around Eladamri's banner and united in his name.

name: Might Weaver
text: "Let my strength harden your resolve."

name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
text: "The world calls and I answer."

name: Angel of Mercy
text:
"In times like these, people need to be reminded of compassion."
—Sisay

name: Holy Day
text:
"Will history remember this as the day demons arrived or the day saviors arrived?"
—Barrin

name: Nomadic Elf
text: "I've journeyed across Dominaria. Phyrexians are everywhere. Plague is everywhere. There's no place left to hide."

name: Pulse of Llanowar
text:
"Gaea's memory is eternal, and she exists in all things."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Quirion Sentinel
text: All elvenkind stood against Phyrexia. The Quirion nation deployed its most spiritual adepts, who wielded the power of their native soil.

name: Quirion Trailblazer
text: "All that matters is the path ahead."

name: Restock
text:
"We hid such stockpiles all over Rath. We should continue that practice here."
—Lin Sivvi

name: Saproling Infestation
text: "My army took centuries to gather," remarked Urza. "Yavimaya seems to conjure hers out of thin air."

name: Liberate
text:
"Not everyone gets a second chance."
—Hanna

name: Scouting Trek
text:
"I have chosen my path. Who will walk it with me?"
—Eladamri

name: Serpentine Kavu
text: Under Yavimaya's peaceful facade beat the hearts of many savage beasts.

name: Tangle
text: Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

name: Tranquility
text: The plagues robbed Dominaria of all but its dreams. Eladamri hoped dreams were enough.

name: Treefolk Healer
text: Protected by druids for untold centuries, the forest began to return the favor.

name: Utopia Tree
text: The fruit of this fabled tree takes on the flavor of whatever food you love most.

name: Obsidian Acolyte
text:
The truthful will stand in the gaze of death and escape unharmed.
—Obsidian acolyte creed

name: Wallop
text: In Yavimaya, flying low to join a battle can be a costly mistake.

name: Wandering Stream
text:
"Dominaria touches us all."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Whip Silk
text: Llanowar forges weapons of steel. Yavimaya grows her weapons within.

name: Absorb
text: "Your presumption is your downfall."

name: Angelic Shield
text:
"If only an angel's wings could shelter us all."
—Barrin

name: Armadillo Cloak
text:
"Don't laugh. It works."
—Yavimaya ranger

name: Artifact Mutation
text:
"From shards and splinters I call forth my living horde."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Aura Mutation
text:
"Life can be found in all things, even things unnatural."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Aura Shards
text: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

name: Backlash
text: Darigaaz decided his foe would be more useful as a weapon.

name: Barrin's Spite
text:
"Only vengeance matters now."
—Barrin

name: Captain Sisay
text: Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.

name: Charging Troll
text: They stop for nothing, not even the end of a battle.

name: Pledge of Loyalty
text: Urza convinced many Dominarians not only to set aside their differences, but to embrace them.

name: Coalition Victory
text:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

name: Dueling Grounds
text: "You think you can stop me?" hissed Tsabo. "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

name: Frenzied Tilling
text:
"Beneath her scars, Dominaria's beauty yet shines."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Galina's Knight
text: "Are they on our side?" asked Sisay. "If they kill Phyrexians they are," replied Gerrard.

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Heroes' Reunion
text:
"You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?"
—Eladamri, to Gerrard

name: Horned Cheetah
text: "I think she wants us to eat it," said Squee, staring at the oily carcass the cheetah had dragged to their fire.

name: Hunting Kavu
text: Dominarians gladly fought alongside kavu . . . until the kavu figured out some Dominarians were quite tasty.

name: Llanowar Knight
text: Her armor and steed were borrowed, but her courage was hers alone.

name: Meteor Storm
text: The storm wasn't an omen. It was the fulfillment of one.

name: Noble Panther
text: Unlike many hunters, these panthers have no need for camouflage. They're fast enough to catch any prey.

name: Ordered Migration
text: "Birds reach all parts of the world," said Barrin. "They will make excellent scouts."

name: Plague Spores
text:
"Breathe deep, Dominaria. Breathe deep and die."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Raging Kavu
text: It took Yavimaya a thousand years to breed them, but it took only seconds for them to prove their worth.

name: Reckless Assault
text:
"How will you fight an enemy that cares nothing for itself?"
—The Blind Seer

name: Recoil
text: Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.

name: Riptide Crab
text: It sleeps with its claws open.

name: Sabertooth Nishoba
text: They sneer at the terrestrial dangers found on peaks and shores, eager to prove themselves against new and even mightier foes.

name: Samite Archer
text: "I can preserve ten lives by taking one."

name: Shivan Zombie
text: Barbarians long for a glorious death in battle. Phyrexia was eager to grant that wish.

name: Simoon
text: Hot wind whipped up as if the weather itself wanted to fight Phyrexians.

name: Slinking Serpent
text: It winds its way through undergrowth as easily as it swims through shallows.

name: Teferi's Moat
text:
"Isolation is not the answer."
—Urza, to Teferi

name: Rampant Elephant
text: No matter how righteous the cause, it helps to bring along some muscle.

name: Tsabo Tavoc
text: "I might almost pity my enemies—if it wasn't so amusing to watch them die."

name: Undermine
text: "Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"

name: Urborg Drake
text: Relentless as the sea, remorseless as death.

name: Vicious Kavu
text: As battle raged in Shiv, a strange new ally appeared from below the ravaged ground.

name: Vile Consumption
text: The plague moved faster than an army and was far more deadly.

name: Vodalian Zombie
text:
"Every last one of you will become my servant. It's a shame you won't live to see the irony."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Voracious Cobra
text: There's no known antidote for the cobra's venom . . . or its appetite.

name: Wings of Hope
text: Urza knew Phyrexians would come through the air and sent his soldiers to greet them.

name: Razorfoot Griffin
text:
"Do griffins fight to defend their homes or purely for sport?"
—Sisay

name: Yavimaya Barbarian
text: Not all elves embrace the pastoral life. Some still roam the forest's edge, forever making war against their hated enemies.

name: Yavimaya Kavu
text: Kavu hunt prey in packs—one kavu hunts a pack of prey.

name: Alloy Golem
text:
"We turned old weapons into new warriors."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Bloodstone Cameo
text:
"The stone whispers to me of dragon's fire and darkness. I wish I'd never pried it from the figurehead of that sunken Keldon longship."
—Isel, master carver

name: Chromatic Sphere
text:
"Let insight and energy be your guides."
—The Blind Seer, to Gerrard

name: Restrain
text:
"Hanna would give up her own life before she'd abandon the *Weatherlight*."
—Sisay

name: Crosis's Attendant
text: "Crosis is the eye of the ur-dragon, piercing illusion and darkness."

name: Darigaaz's Attendant
text: "Darigaaz is the breath of the ur-dragon, burning away the burdens of mortality."

name: Drake-Skull Cameo
text:
"A strange skull was turned up by an Ephran farmer's plow. I traded a copper ring for the 'ox skull.' It resonates of the sea and danger."
—Isel, master carver

name: Dromar's Attendant
text: "Dromar is the wings of the ur-dragon, sweeping away all opposition."

name: Juntu Stakes
text:
"Those who can't survive are of no consequence."
—Tsabo Tavoc

name: Lotus Guardian
text: Lotus fields are too valuable to leave undefended.

name: Phyrexian Altar
text:
"Your life was meaningless, but your death will glorify Yawgmoth."
—Tsabo Tavoc

name: Phyrexian Lens
text:
"There's nothing I wouldn't give to achieve victory. Can you say the same?"
—Tsabo Tavoc, to Gerrard

name: Planar Portal
text: The sky split, and the air crackled and roiled. The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria had finally begun.

name: Power Armor
text:
"Great peril demands formidable weaponry."
—Urza

name: Reviving Dose
text: As healers battled each plague, they learned more about the next.

name: Rith's Attendant
text: "Rith is the claw of the ur-dragon, scattering seeds of devastation."

name: Seashell Cameo
text:
"Today a seashell fell from the empty sky here in Kinymu, a hundred leagues from the sea. I'm torn—shall I carve a woman or a bird?"
—Isel, master carver

name: Sparring Golem
text: "Part drill sergeant, part training dummy," thought Gerrard. "I hope it can stand up to a real war."

name: Tigereye Cameo
text:
"An elvish adventurer unearthed this stone in Jolrael's jungle. Now it's truly fit for display in one of her palaces."
—Isel, master carver

name: Treva's Attendant
text: "Treva is the voice of the ur-dragon, demanding cries of worship."

name: Troll-Horn Cameo
text:
"I found a troll-horn fragment in the wooded foothills of Hurloon, and it keeps growing larger. I wonder, is the horn recreating itself or the troll?"
—Isel, master carver

name: Urza's Filter
text: "It's a tool for aiding my other tools," explained Urza. "Now they'll work in harmony."

name: Rewards of Diversity
text:
"Everything is in place. Nothing can happen that isn't part of my plan."
—Urza

name: Coastal Tower
text: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

name: Elfhame Palace
text: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

name: Salt Marsh
text:
Only death breeds in stagnant water.
—Urborg saying

name: Shivan Oasis
text: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: A beacon of hope for a battered army.

name: Urborg Volcano
text: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

name: Shackles
text: "It could be worse," said Gerrard, looking around. "Well, maybe not."

name: Spirit of Resistance
text:
"Our victory must come from all of Dominaria, or it will not come."
—Urza

name: Spirit Weaver
text: "Let my hope be your shield."

name: Atalya, Samite Master
text: "Healing is a gift the divine ones have shared with us. It is a sacred trust."

name: Strength of Unity
text: All Dominarians agreed on one thing: they would not go down without a fight.

name: Teferi's Care
text:
"If I do nothing else, I will protect my people."
—Teferi

name: Wayfaring Giant
text: Its stature and stride increase with each step it takes.

name: Winnow
text:
"Strength in numbers? I think not."
—Gerrard

name: Blind Seer
text:
"I think he sees more than he lets on."
—Gerrard

name: Disrupt
text: Teferi wanted no part of Urza's battle plans, but both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.

name: Distorting Wake
text: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

name: Dream Thrush
text: Whether for good or ill, their arrival always means change.

name: Empress Galina
text: "Above the waves you may be mighty indeed, but down here you belong to me."

name: Essence Leak
text:
"We define the boundaries of reality; they don't define us."
—Teferi

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Mana Maze
text:
"Those who know only one path to victory can never hope to triumph."
—The Blind Seer

name: Benalish Heralds
text: The detailed dispatch could be summarized in four words: "Time is running out."

name: Metathran Zombie
text:
"Rise, metathran. You shall serve a nobler cause in death."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Opt
text: "We need alternatives, Hanna," yelled Gerrard. "Now!"

name: Rainbow Crow
text: Children claim no two feathers are exactly the same color, then eagerly gather them for proof.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Sapphire Leech
text:
"The subject's wings are clearly vestigial. We suspect the gems somehow keep it aloft."
—Tolarian research notes

name: Shimmering Wings
text:
"Wings are but fins for swimming the sky."
—Empress Galina

name: Shoreline Raider
text:
"This strange new beast makes for an excellent meal. Get me more."
—Empress Galina

name: Sky Weaver
text: "Let my wisdom give you wings."

name: Sway of Illusion
text:
"I suggest you take a closer look."
—Tidal visionary

name: Benalish Trapper
text: "I'm up here. You're down there. Now who's the lower life form?"

name: Tidal Visionary
text: Beneath the waves, things appear the way merfolk want them to.

name: Tower Drake
text: Young tower drakes quickly learn to maneuver among Benalia's many spires.

name: Vodalian Hypnotist
text: "Deceit is the heart of war."

name: Vodalian Merchant
text: Not choosing sides in a war can be dangerous—but lucrative.

name: Wash Out
text:
"Rest now. You've neither won nor lost, but this battle is over for you just the same."
—Teferi

name: Well-Laid Plans
text: "I knew this day would come," said Urza. Looking at the destruction, Barrin sighed, "You don't have to revel in it."

name: Blinding Light
text: An angel's sword impales only the body; her righteousness penetrates the soul.

name: Addle
text:
"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge."
—Urborg witch

name: Andradite Leech
text:
"Older specimens are completely encrusted with gems, which serve as both armor and weapons."
—Tolarian research notes

name: Annihilate
text:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Bog Initiate
text:
"Urborg's magic is strong. Did Urza send you to protect us or to protect against us?"
—Urborg witch, to Barrin

name: Cremate
text: Death's embrace need not be cold.

name: Crypt Angel
text: Once an angel, now an abomination.

name: Cursed Flesh
text: Misery, filth, disease—all things that bring suffering to the world—only make Phyrexians more dangerous.

name: Defiling Tears
text: Serra's living warriors looked on in horror. "Where is our Lady now?" they cried.

name: Abbey Griffin
text:
"The darkness crawls with vampires and ghouls, but we are not without allies."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Divine Reckoning
text: Survival of the purest.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Ghoulcaller's Chant
text:
"The living are born small and weak. The dead rise ready to serve. The choice is obvious."
—Gisa, ghoulcaller of Gavony

name: Ghoulraiser
text:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Gruesome Deformity
text: She wanted to inspire terror wherever she went. The demons happily granted her wish.

name: Heartless Summoning
text:
"They won't be winning any beauty pageants, but they'll do the trick."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Manor Skeleton
text: Lungs dried to parchment wheeze blasphemies within a cage of bleached bone.

name: Markov Patrician
text: Vampires of the Markov bloodline pride themselves on their exquisite taste in fashion, art, and "wine of the vein."

name: Maw of the Mire
text: As the chapel was dragged under, the bell in the tower rang until the murky depths forever silenced its toll.

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Morkrut Banshee
text:
"Let go your grudges, or risk wandering the bogs forever in a murderous rage."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Night Terrors
text: Innistrad is a place where dreams invade the mind and mere shadows exact a terrible toll.

name: Reaper from the Abyss
text: "Avacyn has deserted you. I welcome your devotion in her stead."

name: Rotting Fensnake
text: Its venom sacs are long gone, but its crushing strength is somehow greater than ever.

name: Screeching Bat
text: The bat has such clarity of hearing that simple sounds become symphonies.

name: Skeletal Grimace
text:
"And then I realized we all have skeletons on the inside. Why wait until the bodies are dead to control them?"
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Skirsdag High Priest
text: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

name: Stromkirk Patrol
text: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

name: Tribute to Hunger
text: Marella was delighted. The ball had attracted so many suitors for her daughter, including that handsome stranger. She wondered where the two were now . . . .

name: Elder Cathar
text: "My greatest hope is that you will surpass me in every way, consigning my name to some forgotten corner of history."

name: Typhoid Rats
text: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Vampire Interloper
text: He listens to every heartbeat, deciding which one of hundreds he will stop.

name: Victim of Night
text:
"Do not touch a drop. Not yet. I want to watch this so-called slayer's last crisis of faith."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Village Cannibals
text: Some have endured the horrors of Innistrad by becoming the worst monsters of all.

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Is it hopeless? When wave upon wave of our dead return as mindless flesh-eaters to claw upon Thraben's walls? We're too busy cutting them down to indulge ourselves in such philosophical foppery."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Ashmouth Hound
text: Its fiery paws make it easy to track, which is very useful when you want to go in exactly the opposite direction.

name: Balefire Dragon
text: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

name: Elite Inquisitor
text: "No matter how many I kill, there are always more to hunt. It makes me smile just to think about it."

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Bloodcrazed Neonate
text: While elder vampires select their meals with care, the newly sired frenzy at the first whiff.

name: Burning Vengeance
text: Mist is the geists' sorrow. Wind is their pain. Fire is their vengeance.

name: Crossway Vampire
text: "Do not flatter Fate. It did not guide you into my clutches tonight. That was all my doing."

name: Curse of Stalked Prey
text:
"Innocent thorns can fill the air with your bloodscent. Don't stray from the path."
—Elmut, crossway watcher

name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
text: When the moon rises and the bloodlust takes hold, nothing matters but the kill.

name: Curse of the Pierced Heart
text:
"May your veins weep, and may every vampire take notice."
—Stensian curse

name: Desperate Ravings
text: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

name: Feeling of Dread
text: People only say "I'm sure it was nothing" when they're sure it was something.

name: Devil's Play
text: A devil's hands are never idle.

name: Falkenrath Marauders
text: No slinking in the dark for them, no luring whispers. They claim their prey in the speed and glory of the hunt.

name: Feral Ridgewolf
text:
"The wolves no longer hunt just to feed. They kill for sport, or for some madness behind their eyes."
—Elmut, crossway watcher

name: Furor of the Bitten
text: Those who only believe themselves infected with lycanthropy can be as dangerous as those who really are.

name: Geistflame
text: Innistrad pyromancers find their best raw materials in the fury of the dead.

name: Hanweir Watchkeep
text: He scans for wolves, knowing there's one he can never anticipate.

name: Harvest Pyre
text: Corpses destroyed by fire form the most destructive geists.

name: Infernal Plunge
text: "Oh mighty Griselbrand, Scourge of the Heedless World, gladly I consume myself for thee!"

name: Into the Maw of Hell
text: Few entrances lead to where demons and devils lurk. Unfortunately, they occasionally open new ones.

name: Kessig Wolf
text:
"Don't be afraid when you hear the wolves howl. Be afraid when you don't hear them at all."
—Saint Trogen, the Slayer

name: Kruin Outlaw
text: "Hold tight. I've got a surprise for them."

name: Night Revelers
text: Vampires think of themselves as the indisputable nobility of Innistrad, able to do as they please. There are few who can prove them wrong.

name: Nightbird's Clutches
text: Shiny polished silver can ward off many creatures, but it attracts others.

name: Pitchburn Devils
text: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

name: Rage Thrower
text: "Some lament these haunted times, but I'm a geistflame-tank-half-full kind of person."

name: Rakish Heir
text: "If you're not having fun, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Reckless Waif
text: "Yes, I'm alone. No, I'm not worried."

name: Gallows Warden
text: The spirit cares nothing for the crimes or triumphs of the slain. It shelters all beneath its stormy cloak.

name: Riot Devils
text: Devils are demons' unearthly desires made flesh. Let loose on the world, they satisfy their mad craving for destruction in a whirlwind of chaos.

name: Rolling Temblor
text: When demons open a path to your front door, it's time to move.

name: Scourge of Geier Reach
text: Stensian villagers mourned the loss of human life. Thraben vampire slayers mourned the loss of living wood.

name: Skirsdag Cultist
text: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

name: Stromkirk Noble
text: "A responsible king walks among his subjects."

name: Tormented Pariah
text: "Hey lads, the moon's rising. All the better to watch him beg for mercy."

name: Traitorous Blood
text:
"I can make you dance to my tune like a puppet, your very blood eager to obey."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Vampiric Fury
text: Many peasants secretly admire vampires' glamour and elegance—until they witness a moment of pure bloodlust.

name: Village Ironsmith
text: Each night, he abandons the trappings of civilization.

name: Ambush Viper
text:
"Living creatures seldom impress me. But I like this one."
—Uta Falkenrath

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Boneyard Wurm
text: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.

name: Bramblecrush
text:
"Civilization is fertilizer."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Darkthicket Wolf
text: Werewolf slayers don't know for certain how werewolves are created. So they kill all the wolves, just to be safe.

name: Elder of Laurels
text: Hopes and prayers can carry the same force as swords and torches.

name: Essence of the Wild
text: Wander too far into the wild and it may take you for its own.

name: Festerhide Boar
text:
"Bury your dead deep. The boars are hungriest while the corpse is still warm."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Full Moon's Rise
text: Some lycanthropes wish they could abandon their weak human shapes and revel in the power of the wolf.

name: Gatstaf Shepherd
text:
"What is worse than a wolf in sheep's clothing?"
—Wolfhunter's riddle

name: Grave Bramble
text: Nature abhors a zombie.

name: Grizzled Outcasts
text: Seen as unsavory, the hunters were never allowed in town—until one night they vanished.

name: Hamlet Captain
text: "I would fear this fight, bloodsucker, were I alone."

name: Hollowhenge Scavenger
text: After werewolves slaughtered the citizenry of Hollowhenge, other creatures moved in.

name: Kessig Cagebreakers
text: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Kindercatch
text: In the forest villages of Kessig, parents feed their children wormwood and other bitter herbs, hoping to make them less palatable to things that roam the night.

name: Lumberknot
text: Animated by geists fused in its oak, it hungers for more life to add to its core.

name: Make a Wish
text: In Gavony wishing is taken as a sign of weakness, yet the wells usually brim with silver.

name: Mayor of Avabruck
text: He can deny his true nature for only so long.

name: Moldgraf Monstrosity
text: The border between life and death is as thin as a layer of topsoil.

name: Mulch
text: The land knows no difference between the graves of commoners and nobles.

name: Naturalize
text:
"Stone and thought fade into ruin. Only the wind in the leaves will endure."
—Tomb inscription

name: Orchard Spirit
text:
"Pick not the rotten fruit, but neither touch the best. Leave those as an offering for our unseen guests."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

name: Parallel Lives
text:
"There will come a time when the only prey left will be each other."
—Ulrich of Krallenhorde Pack

name: Angel of Flight Alabaster
text: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if it has seen her.

name: Mausoleum Guard
text: "Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Ranger's Guile
text: In the remote corners of Kessig, protection is found in secret powers unknown to the Church of Avacyn.

name: Somberwald Spider
text: Stensian vampires encourage spiders near their manors so they can rob the webs.

name: Spidery Grasp
text:
"Nobody's seen the Lady of Videns for years. Poor dear, no companions at all in that old castle."
—Yonda of Gavony

name: Travel Preparations
text: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

name: Tree of Redemption
text: The executioner's tree in Thraben Cathedral holds the power to absolve more than the souls of the hanged.

name: Ulvenwald Mystics
text: "With this ritual, we cast aside our fragile humanity . . ."

name: Villagers of Estwald
text: You can spot a werewolf-infested town by its lack of butcher shops.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Woodland Sleuth
text: "Whatever did this is near. Death reversion has not yet occurred. Be alert!"

name: Wreath of Geists
text: Before you travel the woods of Kessig, first get permission from those who died trying.

name: Evil Twin
text: You can always tell the evil one by the dagger he's sticking in you.

name: Butcher's Cleaver
text: Outside the safety of Thraben, there is little distinction between tool and weapon.

name: Cellar Door
text: As if anyone needed another reason to avoid dark, dank cellars.

name: Cobbled Wings
text: For the necro-alchemist, any puzzle can be solved with intelligence and harvested body parts.

name: Midnight Haunting
text: The path back to the world of the living is murky and bewildering. A geist may not even realize that it's terrifying its own loved ones.

name: Creepy Doll
text: A child's porcelain doll went missing one night, as did a pair of kitchen shears and the town magistrate.

name: Demonmail Hauberk
text: It comes off as easily as your own skin.

name: Geistcatcher's Rig
text: The rigs were outlawed except in Nephalia, where malign spirits are as plentiful as crazed inventors.

name: Ghoulcaller's Bell
text: The bell's chime heralds the rise of the unhallowed from the grave and the fall of their victims into the earth.

name: Graveyard Shovel
text: Thanks to Havengul's thriving illegal market for corpses, the shovel that interred a body during the day is usually the same one digging it out at night.

name: Manor Gargoyle
text: Nothing could break it but the fall.

name: Mask of Avacyn
text: It hides the face and protects the soul.

name: One-Eyed Scarecrow
text: Farmhands and priests mutter curses at the ragged thing; it unnerves more than just the crows.

name: Runechanter's Pike
text: As sharp as its bearer's words of faith.

name: Sharpened Pitchfork
text: Not everyone can have a sword of blessed silver. Not everyone needs one, either.

name: Silver-Inlaid Dagger
text: Magical etchings turned a whittler's tool into a wolfhunter's weapon.

name: Traveler's Amulet
text: The rider set off into the eerie mist, swaddled in armor and laden with amulets.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: Where cathars learn to fight not only demons and vampires, but ignorance as well.

name: Gavony Township
text:
"The protective wards of the church have weakened, and no one can tell us why. It's time to look to our own defenses."
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: In places where the sea meets the trees, it's easy to forget the darkness that rules most of Innistrad.

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Not every church is a place of faith.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Nephalia Drownyard
text:
"Some see a coastal disaster. I see a fully-stocked seagraf."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Shimmering Grotto
text:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Stensia Bloodhall
text: The revelry ends when the supply of fresh ingenues runs dry.

name: Sulfur Falls
