text: Skirsdag cultists meet behind a waterfall's curtain and plot with demonic forces.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

name: Nevermore
text: "By the law of Avacyn, the following thoughts, words, and deeds are henceforth disallowed."

name: Paraselene
text:
"Moonlight has a way of showing all things as they truly are—for better or for worse."
—Zilla of Lambholt

name: Purify the Grave
text: Some priests speak in whispers of the Helvault, a silver prison of unpurged evils.

name: Rally the Peasants
text:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

name: Rebuke
text:
"No one chooses to be stitched together into a skaab. If it could speak, it would beg for its own destruction."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Angelic Overseer
text: From mortal hope immortal power springs.

name: Selfless Cathar
text: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."

name: Silverchase Fox
text:
"Be careful in your hunt. The clever little creature can steal your wards and lead you right into the werewolf's den."
—Britta, midwife of Gatstaf

name: Slayer of the Wicked
text: You don't want to see his trophy room.

name: Smite the Monstrous
text: Though the old holy wards and roadside shrines have begun to fail, faith in Avacyn still holds true power.

name: Spare from Evil
text:
"As long as we can utter a prayer or lift a weapon, we have the power to fight back."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Spectral Rider
text: Never a word. Never a warning. Only the sound of hoofbeats along the crossways, and the screams of the avenged.

name: Stony Silence
text:
Let moss grow over gargoyles
—Gavony saying meaning "forget painful memories"

name: Thraben Purebloods
text:
"I've learned to trust my dogs' instincts. When they're calm, I'm calm. And when they get nervous, I get my crossbow."
—Hinrik of House Cecani

name: Thraben Sentry
text: "Looks like it's going to be a quiet night."

name: Unruly Mob
text:
"Who says werewolves are the only ones who can hunt as a pack?"
—Kolman, elder of Gatstaf

name: Avacynian Priest
text: Moorlanders speak in awe of the priests' talent for arriving just in time to drive off the wicked things that prowl the ravished parish.

name: Urgent Exorcism
text:
"To show geists pity is to prolong their agonies. Whether they know it or not, they seek the Blessed Sleep, and we are to give it to them."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Village Bell-Ringer
text: "Priests, hunters, slayers—to arms! The enemy approaches!"

name: Voiceless Spirit
text:
"I'd rather take on a neckbiter or moonhowler any day. Oh well, looks like I'm going to end up parrying with empty air half the night."
—Saint Trogen, the Slayer

name: Armored Skaab
text: Literally made for battle.

name: Back from the Brink
text: On Innistrad, death is just a career change.

name: Battleground Geist
text: Not content to nudge vases and chill drawing rooms, some geists muster spectral armies to claw at the hearts of the living.

name: Civilized Scholar
text: "Me, angry? Of course not. Thanks to my research, I'm above such petty emotions now."

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Curiosity
text: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

name: Bonds of Faith
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

name: Curse of the Bloody Tome
text: After seeing his life's work drip away, the mage decided it was a good time to go crazy.

name: Deranged Assistant
text: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

name: Dissipate
text:
"This abomination never belonged in our world. I'm merely setting it free."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Fortress Crab
text: Unbreakable and unappetizing, the crab grows uninterrupted, sometimes to the size of a cottage and beyond.

name: Frightful Delusion
text: Whether he actually exists is in question, but the terror she feels is excruciatingly real.

name: Hysterical Blindness
text:
"The panic is amusing, but the real fun comes when the spell passes and the villagers start looking for a scapegoat."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Champion of the Parish
text: "I stand for every cobbler, tanner, and fool in this town—and they stand for me."

name: Invisible Stalker
text: "All that concerns me is the vampires' sense of smell and those freezing Nephalian nights."

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Lantern Spirit
text: Bound to the square where she died, she calls out to those in danger—usually scaring them straight into the peril she warns of.

name: Lost in the Mist
text: The secrets she carried could have saved many lives, but they quietly drowned with her.

name: Makeshift Mauler
text:
"It always amazes me what perfectly good things people throw away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Moon Heron
text: The heron is the symbol of the archangel Avacyn. The fact that such spirits still fly gives the church hope that its founder may one day return.

name: Chapel Geist
text: Death has bound it with chains of past regrets. Forever it searches for atonement, each kindness removing a single link.

name: Murder of Crows
text: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

name: Rooftop Storm
text:
"Let those idiot priests tremble! A new era in unlife begins here and now. Oglor, raise the lightning vane!"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Runic Repetition
text: "What some call obsession, I call the quest for perfection."

name: Selhoff Occultist
text: "The mist whispers to those who know it to be more than a mundane fog."

name: Sensory Deprivation
text: They call it "stitcher's anesthesia," a spell to deaden the senses while the mad doctors begin their grisly work.

name: Silent Departure
text: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

name: Skaab Goliath
text:
"Three heads, six arms, and some armor grafts are better than . . . the normal numbers of those things."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Spectral Flight
text:
"The church looks down on binding spirits into armor, but now I can look down on them."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Cloistered Youth
text:
"I heard her talking in her sleep—pleading, shrieking, snarling. It was not my daughter's voice. That is not my daughter."
—Ekatrin, elder of Hanweir

name: Stitched Drake
text:
"The best skaab are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Stitcher's Apprentice
text: "Oglor create life, Oglor take it away. Oglor god! . . . until Master return."

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Abattoir Ghoul
text: Death took his humanity but not his skill with the knife.

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"The demons don't care if we mutter niceties and act out ceremonies. Just kill him."
—Bishop Volpaig, servant of Griselbrand

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Bloodgift Demon
text: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

name: Dearly Departed
text:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Bump in the Night
text: It's not just the wind. It's not all in your head. And it's *definitely* something to worry about.

name: Curse of Death's Hold
text: "May you and all your kin waste and wither until your clan is no more!"

name: Curse of Oblivion
text: The first step to peace is to learn how to forget.

name: Dead Weight
text: The crueler vampires' idea of free-range farming.

name: Diregraf Ghoul
text:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Disciple of Griselbrand
text: The demon Griselbrand dared to stand against Avacyn, earning him the loathing of thousands and the admiration of a few.

name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
text: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

name: Genesis
text:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Overwhelming Forces
text: By the year 208, Cao Cao commanded more than 1,000 experienced generals and a million infantry, cavalry, and naval troops.

name: Vindicate
text:
"I have seen entire civilizations rise and fall. You mortals are but dust to me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Show and Tell
text: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Greater Good
text:
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death."
—Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
text: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: |su,porkFst,GEyts,LecchuZFFGKMEDEauDut. |be,Gyyts,pFnenBePe,Qe,fyrshuZFGKDugSeDZnepyt.

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Rishadan Port
text: Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.

name: Ravages of War
text:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*,
trans. Feng and English

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Wasteland
text: The land was left depleted and empty, an unsettling taste of things to come.

name: Mana Drain
text:
"Power is wasted on the weak. They never keep it for long."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Imperial Seal
text: "If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: Gaddock Teeg
text: So great is his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

name: Homeward Path
text:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

name: Doran, the Siege Tower
text: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

name: Spellskite
text:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Pendelhaven
text: The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.

name: Merchant Scroll
text: A rare find, suitable for the most discerning collector.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: "I can tell you what you wish to know. But first, there is the matter of my fee."

name: Nin, the Pain Artist
text: "Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Teferi's Protection
text:
"Someday, when the world is safe again, my homeland will return."
—Teferi

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Food Chain
text: Every predator is something else's prey.

name: Mirri's Guile
text: Hanna was astounded. Mirri read every leaf and wisp of breeze like a book of ancient lore.

name: Sliver Legion
text: Hidden within the clicking, chittering swarm is a unique mind, still young, but growing more aware as time passes.

name: Mox Opal
text: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

name: Monastery Mentor
text: "The past does not determine our present."

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?

name: Arena Rector
text: Her call echoes across worlds, calling the loyal to battle.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text: The path offered by the academy is long and difficult, but those who brave it arrive at wisdom beyond compare.

name: Spellseeker
text: Not content with mere answers, she hunts for the truth.

name: Demonic Tutor
text: "Mama says it's my imagination, but I know you'd never lie to me."

name: Gamble
text: As she triggered yet another trap, Chira realized that what she thought was the goblin word for "easy" probably wasn't.

name: Sylvan Tutor
text: The whole of creation stood transfixed, silenced by the weight of anticipation.

name: Bear Cub
text:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

name: Grizzly Bears
text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

name: Kraken Hatchling
text: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

name: Task Force
text: Keeping the streets of the Sixth District safe, one escaped Simic mutant at a time.

name: Rhystic Study
text:
"I'll teach you the leyline paratrigonometrics, no problem. But you need to show me how to make that fiery swirly thing."
—Zimone, to Rootha

name: Tragic Lesson
text: Eventually, the school would resort to hiring a kraken to guard the more dangerous tomes in the Biblioplex.

name: Wizard Mentor
text: "I hope you took notes before it exploded."

name: Blood Artist
text: "No! It's all wrong! I need more. Bring me more!"

name: Feast of Blood
text:
"The best part of a wedding is the cutting of the cake, followed closely by the cutting of the cake decorator."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Festering Evil
text: Evil is never absent, only hidden.

name: Ghoul's Feast
text:
"Sumptuous, carefully fermented, and served with a silky ocular puree. You simply must try a bite."
—Varina, Lich Queen

name: Morkrut Banshee
text: She wails for those who have died, and for those who are about to.

name: Nezumi Bone-Reader
text: "The old ways still work, but a little tech support never hurts."

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"Even after death, a wealth of serviceable biomass remains."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text:
"Your sacrifice has been noted and deemed insufficient."
—Qal-Sha, priest of Norn

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"I can't bear to watch these things put themselves back together, Geralf. They remind me of the time you tried to cut your own hair: a tragic abomination!"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Renegade Demon
text: Trapped in Immersturm, it bloodies its blade not for ideals or territory or power, but simply to pass the time.

name: Swarm of Bloodflies
text: Despite the name, they'll happily devour the flesh too.

name: Wakedancer
text: Havengul wakes are widely regarded as great entertainment. If you're lucky, the guest of honor climbs out of the casket and joins in the festivities.

name: Aftershock
text: Deciding the house's ownership through a wizard duel had sounded like a brilliant idea at the time.

name: Fireslinger
text: The most successful entertainers on New Capenna feature an element of medium-to-extreme danger in their acts.

name: Flameblade Adept
text: The time for training was done. Only one final trial stood between Amin and his place among the honored dead.

name: Uktabi Orangutan
text: The hierarchy of the Uktabi Jungle hinges mostly on who can keep Prince Kibo entertained.

name: Spawning Pit
text: Nothing is wasted on New Phyrexia.

name: Acrobatic Maneuver
text: Renegades find ever more creative ways to work around the Consulate's aether regulations.

name: Aethershield Artificer
text: Most smiths shape metal, but some prefer more delicate materials.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
text:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Angel of Flight Alabaster
text: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if they have seen her.

name: Angelic Edict
text: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Anointer of Valor
text: Light streaked down from the heavens, and a voice whispered in the soldier's ear: "You shall not fall today."

name: Apothecary Geist
text: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

name: Merfolk Pupil
text: Maintaining a personal bubble is even more important when you have gills.

name: Archon of Justice
text: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

name: Attended Healer
text: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Basri's Acolyte
text: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

name: Benalish Honor Guard
text:
"The true measure of all heroes is not what they achieve, but who they inspire."
—*Triumph of Gerrard*

name: Blessed Defiance
text: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"

name: Blessed Spirits
text: Not all heroes die in armor.

name: Brightmare
text: A ray of hope in the darkest night.

name: Bring to Trial
text: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

name: Built to Last
text: Consulate-built automatons have a lifetime warranty.

name: Captivating Unicorn
text:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant

name: Caught in the Brights
text: While hunting aether, a gremlin may ignore other stimuli, including threats to its own life.

name: Combat Professor
text: "Before Yovus was cut down at Pranticle Peak, she performed which maneuver? Anyone? From the reading?"

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Dawn of Hope
text:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

name: Soul Read
text: It's easy to be two steps ahead when you can see their every thought.

name: Dawning Angel
text:
"As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Daybreak Chaplain
text: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

name: Daybreak Charger
text: It's often mistaken for the coming dawn as it gallops across the horizon.

name: Defy Death
text: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers. "A fitting end," she murmured as she raised her sword.

name: Devouring Light
text: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

name: Divine Arrow
text: Outside Drannith's walls, where collateral damage is of no concern, the Coppercoats are free to use more potent methods.

name: Divine Verdict
text: Giants and pit spawn attempted to topple the cathedral's pillars. The fine grit of their remains still swirls in the breeze outside.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Dreadful Apathy
text: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

name: Synchronized Eviction
text: "I told you this one would be a handful."

name: Favored of Iroas
text: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."

name: Felidar Cub
text: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

name: Forced Worship
text: Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.

name: Gallant Cavalry
text: "Our duty does not stop at our borders."

name: Gallows Warden
text: The spirit cares nothing for the crimes or triumphs of the slain. It shelters all beneath its stormy cloak.

name: Giant Ox
text:
"How strong is he? Well, I once lost control of the plow, and he carved a furrow right through my house! Didn't even slow down."
—Guldir, Beskir farmer

name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
text: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

name: Glory Bearers
text: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Hotshot Mechanic
text: "If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking."

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Impeccable Timing
text: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

name: Imperial Aerosaur
text: Its assistance is unnervingly similar to its hunting technique.

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Swords, to me! We must engage their line to protect our archers and mages. Let no one fail this task!"

name: Inspiring Cleric
text: "The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath."

name: Conductor of Cacophony
text:
Only an imitation of tortured shrieking
—or so the Rakdos claim.

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
text: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."

name: Justiciar's Portal
text: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.

name: Kami of Ancient Law
text:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

name: Kitsune Ace
text: "Oh, sorry—were we racing?"

name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
text: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

name: Law-Rune Enforcer
text:
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity."
—Dovin Baan

name: Leonin Snarecaster
text: Formerly oppressed by the polis of Meletis, leonin occasionally "mistake" their old enemies for game.

name: Leonin Warleader
text: When one leonin hunts, many more are surely nearby.

name: Creeping Bloodsucker
text:
"If a vampire were feeding on you every night, wouldn't you have bite marks? Stop wasting my time."
—Donya, village healer

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
text: "You are not alone. You never were."

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Mausoleum Guard
text: "Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."

name: Mesa Lynx
text: Its ferocity is tempered by patience, knowing it must wait for just the right moment to strike a killing blow.

name: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker
text:
"Watch over my father. Tell him I'm safe, but I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace."
—Michiko, letter to General Takeno

name: Midnight Guard
text:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Miraculous Recovery
text: "I am the rock of the polis. Death only strengthens me."

name: Moment of Triumph
text: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

name: Murder Investigation
text: "Every death has a web of consequences. Our job is to find the spider."

name: Deadly Plot
text:
"Open grave available, only one previous tenant."
—Sign on cemetery gate

name: Nightguard Patrol
text: "The Wojek defend the laws. We defend the people."

name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
text: The Consulate keeps watch at each of the eleven bridges to ensure that the market remains a haven for commerce, not for con artists.

name: Not Forgotten
text: Visit the dead, and they may return the favor.

name: Order of the Golden Cricket
text:
"Should you take it in mind to ride a springjack, remember: there are easier ways to fly, and harder ways to break your skull."
—Lann of Cloverdell

name: Phalanx Tactics
text: Every soldier has a place to stand and a role to play.

name: Pillardrop Rescuer
text: Gentle hands of stone whisk the careless from the crumbling ruins of Pillardrop.

name: Pious Wayfarer
text: Every footstep is a prayer, every road a temple.

name: Pouncing Lynx
text: "I don't understand. He's normally so well behaved!"

name: Prowling Felidar
text: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.

name: Disciple of Perdition
text: "Could you please spare some of your blood for my precious little tree?"

name: Rambunctious Mutt
text: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

name: Regal Caracal
text: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

name: Righteousness
text: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Savannah Sage
text: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Ossuary Rats
text: You know you've ventured too deep when the rats stop running and hold their ground.

name: Seller of Songbirds
text:
"Lady Wren is the one merchant in Keyhole Downs who isn't running a scam."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Serene Steward
text: "I can give you strength, but you'll have to bring your own courage."

name: Settle Beyond Reality
text: Two taken, two judged, one returned.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Skyhunter Patrol
text:
"We leonin have come to rule the plains by taking to the skies."
—Raksha Golden Cub

name: Skyhunter Prowler
text: As tireless as her mount, a skyhunter's vigil is measured in days.

name: Spirited Companion
text: It formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Stalwart Valkyrie
text: "Only the worthy may pass."

name: Starnheim Aspirant
text: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

name: Steppe Lynx
text: Nothing quickens the predator's blood like the unfamiliar scents of new hunting grounds and the mewling cries of new prey.

name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
text: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

name: Taranika, Akroan Veteran
text: "I like to think Kytheon keeps watch over all of us."

name: Tempered Veteran
text: "I've been carrying a sword since before you were born. I wouldn't give up my oath for all the peace and comfort in the world."

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Trained Caracal
text: Some Ravnicans consider carrying a sword to be beneath them, preferring instead a tooth-and-claw escort.

name: Transcendent Envoy
text:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Skullslither Worm
text: As larvae, they burrow into a host's brain to feed upon it, growing until they're large enough to burst free and seek out larger prey.

name: Unquestioned Authority
text:
"Only the Ancestor should be revered."
—Mystic heretic

name: Valkyrie Harbinger
text: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

name: Valor in Akros
text: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

name: Valorous Steed
text: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.

name: Weight of Conscience
text: Sometimes the weight of the world on your shoulders is a literal one.

name: Academy Journeymage
text: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

name: Aeronaut Tinkerer
text: "All tinkerers have their heads in the clouds. I don't intend to stop there."

name: Suspicious Shambler
text: It was the perfect disguise—at least until its stomach started moaning.

name: Artificer's Epiphany
text: The artificers of Kaladesh strive ceaselessly for perfection, progress, and the ultimate expression of elegance.

name: Aviation Pioneer
text: "They say perfection is unattainable, but they said that about flight too."

name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
text: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

name: Brineborn Cutthroat
text: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

name: Bury in Books
text: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

name: Termination Facilitator
text: "You sign. They die. Simple as that."

name: Chillerpillar
text: From its cocoon, a flurry takes flight.

name: Chilling Trap
text:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Condescend
text: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

name: Crippling Chill
text: In the silence of the ice, even dreams become still.

name: Cryptic Serpent
text: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Drag Under
text: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

name: Drownyard Explorers
text: "Angels and inquisitors terrorize villages, but no one seems to notice the stirring out at sea."

name: Elite Instructor
text: The greatest minds in Meletis study under the masters at the Dekatia, a renowned school of magic and philosophy.

name: Erdwal Illuminator
text:
"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

name: Eyekite
text:
"This one will need direction. After all, each of its eyes is larger than its brain."
—Cyla, Lord of the Aerie

name: Faerie Formation
text: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

name: Faerie Vandal
text: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

name: Fallowsage
text: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

name: Filigree Attendant
text:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dextrous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Floodhound
text: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.

name: Frostpeak Yeti
text: Some heroes line their coats with yeti fur. More yetis line their bellies with heroes.

name: Gearseeker Serpent
text: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

name: Gearsmith Prodigy
text: Young artificers on Kaladesh let their imaginations run wild.

name: Gigantoplasm
text:
"I appreciate things that exceed expectations."
—Mizzix

name: Glen Elendra Pranksters
text: Victims spirited through a faerie ring find themselves stranded miles away.

name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
text: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

name: Icebind Pillar
text:
"Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"
—Tibalt

name: Jace's Scrutiny
text: "Just a collage of images: cryptoliths, the sea, a tangle of shipwrecks."

name: Lay Claim
text: Initiates need worry only about the trials. Everything else is in the hands of the gods.

name: Leave in the Dust
text: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

name: Library Larcenist
text: "I specialize in missing manuscripts, pilfered poetry, and lifted letters."

name: Lookout's Dispersal
text: Her song plucks the strings of the storm, shifting wind and storm into a harmony that will carry her ship to safety.

name: Lumengrid Sentinel
text: The vedalken order their Neurok sentinels to watch over the shores of the Quicksilver Sea, as if they know of intruders yet to come.

name: Coalborn Entity
text: The blacksmith forgot to feed the forge, so the forge fed itself.

name: Mechanized Production
text:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "Be like the sea: flow around that which is unmovable; for everything else, crash into it unrelentingly."

name: Military Intelligence
text: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

name: Mistwalker
text:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

name: Moonfolk Puzzlemaker
text: "Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be."

name: Mystic Skyfish
text: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

name: Neutralize
text: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

name: Octoprophet
text: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

name: Daring Piracy
text: Sky pirates often leap randomly into the fray and assume there will be something to land on.

name: One With the Wind
text:
"River and sea, jungle and sky. Water flows freely between the two halves of the world. We are creatures of the water."
—Shaper Tuvasa

name: Oneirophage
text: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

name: Opt
text:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Perilous Voyage
text: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.

name: Pestermite
text: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

name: Pilfering Hawk
text:
"Well, at least it left us a mouse in exchange. Er . . . ugh . . . make that half a mouse."
—Binhald, Beskir veteran

name: River Sneak
text: No ripples, no splashes, no warning.

name: Goblin Researcher
text: Slonk was struck by lightning twenty-seven times before he got the idea. Another forty-three hits and he'd perfected it.

name: Sage of the Falls
text: Ask a merfolk even a simple question and the answer is a journey far beyond the known.

name: Sage's Row Savant
text: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

name: Saltwater Stalwart
text: Every attack is a test of your defenses. Every hit marks the map of your defeat.

name: Seafloor Oracle
text: Where the light falls dim and blue on broken ships, secrets lie unclaimed.

name: Sentinels of Glen Elendra
text: Some say the valley of Glen Elendra is mythical, and that rumors of its existence are nothing but a faerie prank. Others say it is the fae's most fiercely guarded secret.

name: Serum Visions
text: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

name: Shaper Apprentice
text: The River Heralds would wreck a thousand ships to keep intruders from finding the golden city.

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: So Tiny
text: His sword sounded like a silver chime on the glass jar, and the sprite laughed with delight.

name: Startling Development
text: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.

name: Steelgaze Griffin
text:
"If we didn't guard our secrets, they wouldn't remain secrets for long."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Stinging Lionfish
text: Starfish are its favorite prey.

name: Stolen by the Fae
text: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

name: Stonybrook Angler
text: "Water is in the air, the trees, and the earth. Understand its motion, speak its language, and the subtle currents that flow through all living things will fall under your command."

name: Storm Sculptor
text: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

name: Teferi's Protege
text: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.

name: Tolarian Kraken
text:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Tolarian Sentinel
text: "It is not just our people I try to rescue. It is our culture, and our hope that we can return to greatness."

name: Tome Anima
text: Sometimes knowledge takes on a life of its own.

name: Triton Shorestalker
text: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."

name: Undersea Invader
text:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

name: Vedalken Engineer
text: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

name: Wake Thrasher
text: Anyone who thinks merrows have more brains than brawn has never been run over by one.

name: Plundering Predator
text: You can gather a tidy fortune if you can avoid getting clobbered by falling treasure.

name: Watertrap Weaver
text: The river is a powerful friend.

name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
text: Tritons search for omens in its wake.

name: Weldfast Wingsmith
text: "Airships are too confining. If I'm in the sky, I want to feel the wind in my hair and taste the aether."

name: Alley Strangler
text: "You never know what day might be your last."

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Black Cat
text: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

name: Blight Keeper
text: It withers fruit and flesh alike.

name: Blood Price
text: Blood is the oldest currency.

name: Bloodbond Vampire
text:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
text: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Bone Picker
text: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

name: Burglar Rat
text:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

name: Cemetery Recruitment
text: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

name: Certain Death
text: Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.

name: Chittering Rats
text: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

name: Consign to the Pit
text: First your whole life flashes before your eyes. Then you have considerable time to reflect on every regret as you plummet.

name: Corpse Churn
text:
"The distraction of your life has ended. Now your service begins."
—Kalitas, thrall of Ulamog

name: Giant Ladybug
text: It's bad luck to step on one, but worse luck to have one step on you.

name: Crow of Dark Tidings
text:
"Well, this can't be a good sign."
—Old Rutstein

name: Cruel Sadist
text: Face of innocence. Hand of death.

name: Crypt Rats
text:
"Shoo, you little worm tails—go away! My corpses aren't your dinner!"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Dead Weight
text: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.

name: Death Wind
text:
"I am a dragonslayer for Lord Silumgar. There is no dragon save him whom I fear."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Deathbloom Thallid
text:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

name: Demon of Catastrophes
text: A pit yawned open, a column of oily smoke arose, and a towering form hissed, "I accept this offering."

name: Demonic Gifts
text: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

name: Demon's Disciple
text: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.

name: Demon's Grasp
text:
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Devouring Swarm
text: Their arrival is heralded by the deafening hum of ten thousand wings. Their departure is marked by the silence of the dead.

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Dread Presence
text: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.

name: Dread Rider
text:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder

name: Dread Slaver
text: Half a brain rules the mindless.

name: Dreadhound
text: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

name: Dune Beetle
text: The scouring sands of Shefet polish its carapace, and the ranks of the cursed fill its belly.

name: Durable Coilbug
text:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

name: Eaten Alive
text:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

name: Mild-Mannered Librarian
text: She had always believed in the transformative power of great literature.

name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
text: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Eviscerate
text:
"Fear the dark if you must, but don't mistake sunlight for safety."
—Josu Vess

name: Exsanguinate
text: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Fetid Imp
text: Many deaths are distasteful, but only a few are truly repugnant.

name: Fungal Infection
text: To thallids, the whole world is just a pile of mulch to grow saprolings in.

name: Gavony Unhallowed
text:
"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Ghoulraiser
text:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Gnawing Zombie
text: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

name: Primeval Herald
text: When they call, nature answers.

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
text: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

name: Kalastria Nightwatch
text:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Rampaging Growth
text: When they had the house checked for bugs, they didn't think big enough.

name: Karfell Kennel-Master
text: Trapped in a realm of dead flesh and scarce hunting, the ravenous wolves of Karfell follow the Dread Marn to warm game.

name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
text: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

name: Kraul Swarm
text: The hive has a long memory. It knows how every member ever died, and to whom it owes the grudge.

name: Liliana's Elite
text:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Liliana's Steward
text: Servants at Vess Manor are chosen for their strong work ethic and respectful demeanor. Being alive is not required.

name: Lurking Deadeye
text: "There's no roar so mighty that it can't be silenced."

name: Maalfeld Twins
text:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Marauding Blight-Priest
text: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

name: Marauding Boneslasher
text: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

name: Mire Blight
text:
"Is there anything in Guul Draz that *doesn't* suck the life out of you?"
—Tarsa, Sea Gate sell-sword

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Moment of Craving
text: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

name: Necromancer's Stockpile
text: The experiments decided to perform some research of their own.

name: Necrotic Wound
text: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

name: Nested Ghoul
text:
"The chest cavity is cleared of useless meat. I know just what to do with the space."
—Gyed, Vault Priest

name: Nirkana Assassin
text: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

name: Spectral Hunt-Caller
text: The nightsong begins with a lone howl, but soon swells to a deafening chorus.

name: Ob Nixilis's Cruelty
text: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis sought gratification in random acts of torment.

name: Ophiomancer
text:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Phyrexian Debaser
text:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Pit Keeper
text: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

name: Priest of the Blood Rite
text: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

name: Reaper from the Abyss
text: "Avacyn has deserted you. I welcome your devotion in her stead."

name: Reave Soul
text:
"I was not convinced you had a soul until I saw it for myself."
—Liliana Vess

name: Towering Gibbon
text: "Don't worry, folks. We're perfectly safe here. That's a banana processing plant."

name: Returned Reveler
text: The flesh is dead and the life forgotten, but old habits persist.

name: Revenant
text:
"Not again."
—Hans

name: Ruthless Disposal
text:
"Do try to pull your weight, Geralf. I feel like I'm doing everything."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
text:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Shambling Ghoul
text: Once he gets up and going, he will forever shamble on.

name: Skirsdag High Priest
text: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

name: Skirsdag Supplicant
text:
"I can no longer stand by as these Skirsdag infiltrators rot the church from within. Even the Lunarch Council is compromised. What a fool I've been."
—Odric

name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
text: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

name: Soulcage Fiend
text: Vowing to free the souls of her children, Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

name: Spark Reaper
text:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Strangling Spores
text: Imagine a thousand tiny mushrooms cropping up within your lungs.

name: Takenuma Bleeder
text: "I prefer to weave my magic through oni blood, but yours will do in a pinch."

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Dutiful Replicator
text:
"Careful. Leave it running for too long and it'll turn the whole building into angels."
—Tawnos

name: Typhoid Rats
text: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

name: Ulcerate
text:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Vampire Envoy
text: "Zendikar will fight until it has bled its last."

name: Vampiric Rites
text: For vampires, blood carries more than life. Memories long eroded from the minds of bloodchiefs can be reclaimed from the veins of their sired kin.

name: Vermin Gorger
text:
"Once, vampires ruled this world, commanding the fear and respect that befit our noble blood. Have we truly sunk so low?"
—Sorin Markov

name: Village Rites
text: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed totems of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.

name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
text: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

name: Wailing Ghoul
text:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Wicked Guardian
text: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors."

name: Infernal Idol
text:
"The courier's death was regrettable, but then again, she was warned not to touch it."
—Lord Xander

name: Witch's Cauldron
text: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

name: Act on Impulse
text: "You don't want to know what happens after I put on the goggles."

name: Arms Dealer
text:
"Guaranteed to leave your enemies sufficiently stabbed, bitten, cleaved, or exploded."
—Grezkrick's Emporium motto

name: Axgard Cavalry
text:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Barrage Ogre
text: The elves had devised countless strategies to combat Memnarch's war machines, but they had no idea what to do when one was *thrown* at them.

name: Battle Squadron
text: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Ingenious Leonin
text: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

name: Instruments of War
text: Perfect for keeping time at a battle or a ball.

name: Blisterspit Gremlin
text:
"Ah, we have a critic."
—Orthion, Lavabrink captain

name: Blood Aspirant
text: It's a small step from revel to bloodbath.

name: Bloodhaze Wolverine
text:
"Build a moat. If we're lucky, it can't swim."
—Syr Branigan, knight of Ardenvale

name: Bogardan Dragonheart
text: A hunger to soar must be sated.

name: Bolt Hound
text: Its spark is worse than its bite.

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Brazen Freebooter
text: Finders, keepers.

name: Brazen Wolves
text: With fewer patrols about, Kessig's roads have become prime hunting grounds.

name: Burn Bright
text:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Catalyst Elemental
text: As the hyperstormic generator crept past redline, a being emerged from the arc.

name: Chandra's Magmutt
text:
"Is it purebred? No, but it's pure fire."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Chandra's Pyreling
text:
"I think Chandra just wanted something to blame random scorch marks on."
—Jace Beleren

name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
text:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan

name: Chandra's Spitfire
text: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

name: Coalhauler Swine
text: Nothing stops industry in Ravnica—certainly not the safety of its workers.

name: Cyclops Electromancer
text: Every storm has an eye.

name: Dance with Devils
text: Devils sow chaos and reap panic.

name: Arrest
text: Getting caught was bad enough, but being rolled to the detention center was by far the worst part.

name: Destructive Tampering
text:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Electrify
text: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."

name: Fanatical Firebrand
text:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Fervent Strike
text:
"The flame paints a bright wheel on the sky, then shifts into a stabbing spark. The enemy falls; the smoke of victory rises."
—"Legends of the Firedancer"

name: Balan, Wandering Knight
text: "I'm feeling generous. I'll let you choose the blade that slays you."

name: Fiery Intervention
text: Burning something is easy. Choosing a target can be more difficult.

name: Firebolt
text: "There's more where that came from!"

name: Firecannon Blast
text: Goblins' fearlessness and diminutive size make them the perfect cannoneers.

name: Flame Lash
text: "This is just my warm-up."

name: Flames of the Firebrand
text:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
text: Theros's human philosophers were at a marked disadvantage due to their need to pause for things like food or sleep.

name: Go for Blood
text: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

name: Goblin Artillery
text: Most goblins get their turn firing the catapult, but few achieve the coveted title of Ammunition Holder.

name: Goblin Grenade
text: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.

name: Goblin Oriflamme
text:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Goblin Psychopath
text: He never wastes energy distinguishing between friend and foe.

name: Goblin Rally
text: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

name: Goblin Trailblazer
text:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Not since the days of Pashalik Mons have the Rundvelt goblins been so united or effective.

name: Goldhound
text: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.

name: Emancipation Angel
text: "I'll take it from here, soldier."

name: Grotag Night-Runner
text: Naturally inquisitive and adaptable, goblins can turn their small stature to their advantage as rogues.

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Hungry Flames
text: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
text: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

name: Immersturm Raider
text: The demons took no captives and claimed no spoils; they sought only to destroy.

name: Impending Doom
text: "Feast, for your next meal may be your last!"

name: Improvised Weaponry
text: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

name: Irencrag Pyromancer
text: "Fear of fire is a sensible instinct. If I were you, I'd be terrified."

name: Flicker of Fate
text: "Sure, I've got nine lives, but that doesn't mean I'm keen to waste one now."

name: Irreverent Revelers
text: To some satyrs, only blasphemy is sacred.

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
text: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

name: Keldon Raider
text: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Lava Serpent
text: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.

name: Lavastep Raider
text: Goblins were first to see the potential of hedrons in the fight against the Eldrazi, for the magical stones came ready-made with pointy bits.

name: Lightning Axe
text: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

name: King of the Pride
text: His kind were once hunted to near-extinction. Now, under his protection, they rule the savannah.

name: Mad Ratter
text: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
text: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

name: Markov Warlord
text: "What use is a stake or holy symbol in the hands of a coward?"

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Nest Robber
text:
"These sailors on our shores are like the dinosaurs that plunder eggs from nests. They live on the labors of others."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Outnumber
text: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

name: Pillar of Flame
text: May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion.

name: Prickly Marmoset
text:
"It's either terrified or extremely mad at us, definitely one of the two."
—Jonald, mission naturalist

name: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
text: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

name: Raking Claws
text:
"How many claws does a monster have? Exactly one more than you've accounted for."
—Alux, Skysail defender

name: Ravenous Giant
text: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

name: Raze the Effigy
text: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.

name: Reckless Fireweaver
text: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

name: Reptilian Reflection
text: Danger often lurks in the allure of crystal shards.

name: Ripscale Predator
text: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

name: Rooting Moloch
text: Their feeding habits leave them with gizzards full of tumbled gems.

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

name: Rush of Adrenaline
text: Scarecrows only go so far in sending the message to stay away.

name: Sarkhan's Rage
text: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Smoldering Efreet
text: The efreet are drawn to the Kaisham Wanderers, a loosely organized Jeskai school where trickery is employed to challenge the status quo and upend the belief systems of others.

name: Sokenzan Smelter
text: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.

name: Spark of Creativity
text:
"To invent is to rebel."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Sparkmage Apprentice
text: Sparkmages are performance artists of sorts, but pain is the price of admission.

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Spellgorger Weird
text: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

name: Spiteful Prankster
text: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Storm Fleet Pyromancer
text:
"She's quick and fearless, and she's never missed a shot. That almost makes up for all the scorch marks she leaves behind."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Subterranean Scout
text: When things get ugly above ground, goblins resort to alternate routes of passage.

name: Merrow Reejerey
text: ". . . that's when I reeled in a human about yay big."

name: Sudden Breakthrough
text: Rootha created constantly, passionately, in hopes of impressing her greatest critic: herself.

name: Swaggering Corsair
text: "I'm about to make you famous. From the golden city to High and Dry, they'll talk about how fast you died!"

name: Swift Kick
text: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Torch Courier
text: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Vault Robber
text: The dwarves believe works of art should be passed down the generations, not buried with the dead.

name: Viashino Pyromancer
text: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."

name: Volley Veteran
text: "Fill the sky with stuff!"

name: Mirror Image
text: "Do I really look like that? I'm . . . beautiful!"

name: War-Name Aspirant
text: No battle means more to a Mardu warrior than the one that earns her war name.

name: Warcry Phoenix
text: War begins with one red ember.

name: Weaselback Redcap
text:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

name: Welding Sparks
text:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Wildfire Elemental
text:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Adventurous Impulse
text: An adventure without a companion is hardly an adventure at all.

name: Preordain
text: In a Multiverse of endless possibilities, Aminatou decided to experience all of them.

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Band Together
text: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

name: Blisterpod
text: A blisterpod's corpse is a scion's cradle.

name: Bounding Wolf
text: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.

name: Briarpack Alpha
text:
"The wolves turned on us and a chill swept over me. The pack had a new leader."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Bristling Boar
text:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

name: Broken Bond
text: "I can't bear to see another plane broken before I make my own home whole. I'm sorry, but my watch is over."

name: Brood Monitor
text: The tenderness of a mother. The pity of a mantis.

name: Canopy Baloth
text:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Challenger Troll
text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

name: Spectral Sailor
text: "Permission to haunt aboard, cap'n?"

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Creeperhulk
text:
"I saw the devastation when the juggernauts crashed the walls of An Karras. Then I got to thinking."
—Janji, sylvan druid

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Deadbridge Goliath
text: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

name: Declare Dominance
text:
"If you think yourself a chief, then prove your might."
—Gar-Tun, Mistvalley silverback

name: Domesticated Hydra
text: "Sit. Fetch. Devastate."

name: Drowsing Tyrannodon
text: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.

name: Drudge Beetle
text: The Street Swarm is the labor class that drives the Golgari's endless cycle of life and death.

name: Duskshell Crawler
text: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

name: Dwynen's Elite
text: Call one, call them all.

name: Elderleaf Mentor
text: "Our ancestors grew complacent in their divinity, allowing their lessers to topple them. Never again."

name: Engulfing Slagwurm
text: Its teeth exist only for decoration.

name: Enlarge
text: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Ferocious Pup
text: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

name: Fierce Witchstalker
text: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

name: Flourishing Hunter
text:
"I would welcome her into my pack with honor."
—Arlinn Kord

name: Frontier Mastodon
text: Each bronze disk on its harness is an offering from a young Temur hunter, a sign of respect to the spirits of the wild.

name: Gaea's Protector
text: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

name: Ghirapur Guide
text: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Groundswell
text: "This world will not be tamed."

name: Diabolic Edict
text:
"Mere death brings no pleasure. Pleasure comes from watching fools scratch and claw to save their wretched lives from the inevitable."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Havenwood Wurm
text: Time rifts bring tunneling beasts of old into the hard, dry earth of the present. Most die there, trapped, but the mightiest burst through the surface.

name: Hooting Mandrills
text: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

name: Hunger of the Howlpack
text:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Hunter's Edge
text: The hunt ends. Lunch begins.

name: Ilysian Caryatid
text: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Iridescent Hornbeetle
text: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.

name: Ironshell Beetle
text:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

name: Feast on the Fallen
text: He only paused to catch his breath, not knowing that it would be his last.

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Kessig Cagebreakers
text: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

name: Kraul Foragers
text:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying

name: Kraul Warrior
text: The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.

name: Kujar Seedsculptor
text: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Mammoth Spider
text:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist

name: Master's Rebuke
text: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: "To die for a cause and continue to serve it is the truest mark of loyalty."

name: Might of the Masses
text:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

name: Moldgraf Millipede
text: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

name: Moonlight Hunt
text: Courage alone won't keep you alive.

name: Naga Vitalist
text: "The lands of the God-Pharaoh are suffused with his breath."

name: Nantuko Cultivator
text: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

name: Nessian Hornbeetle
text:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

name: Nightpack Ambusher
text: A strong leader means a growing pack.

name: Oashra Cultivator
text: "Like fruits in the field, we will be harvested when the season is right."

name: Ondu Giant
text: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

name: Oathsworn Vampire
text: "Neither time nor death could keep me from upholding our pact."

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Overgrowth
text:
"Let the forest spread! From salt, stone, and fen, let the new trees rise."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Packsong Pup
text: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Pestilent Wolf
text: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

name: Pounce
text: The drive to hunt and feed is raw instinct for dinosaurs. The trick is simply to channel it in the right direction.

name: Predator's Howl
text:
"And Muzzio says my arguments have no teeth."
—Selvala, ranger of the Lowlands

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Ogre Slumlord
text: "'Rat-infested' sounds so negative. I prefer 'rat-friendly.'"

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Prowling Serpopard
text: The viziers serving Rhonas, the god of strength, maintain the menagerie of animals employed during his trial.

name: Quarry Beetle
text:
"The ruin of the past is the topsoil of the future."
—Sokar, former Nef-crop initiate

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Reckless Amplimancer
text: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Relentless Pursuit
text: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "Looks like I need a new test subject. Any volunteers?"

name: Roots of Wisdom
text: Though imprisoned in Jaspera trees, the elvish gods known as the Einir still whisper through the ages.

name: Scale the Heights
text: "Ever onward, ever skyward."

name: Scrounging Bandar
text: "It was right here a second ago . . ."

name: Silverback Shaman
text: The apes of Yavimaya draw strength from the spirits of their ancestors.

name: Simian Brawler
text:
"It's odd to see the apes rip down trees to arm themselves in defense of their forests."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: "Let me give you a hand. He won't be needing it; he's left-handed. Also dead."

name: Snapping Gnarlid
text: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

name: Soul's Might
text: An avatar he sculpts of instinct and force.

name: Sporeback Wolf
text: The mushrooms growing in the wolves' fur possess curative properties incredible enough to tempt many alchemists into risking their lives to track one down.

name: Stalking Drone
text: As the Eldrazi adapted to the jungles of Zendikar, some took on the tactics of more familiar predators.

name: Titanic Brawl
text: Whoever wins, the neighborhood loses.

name: Unnatural Aggression
text: The battle served as a grim reminder of what a final victory for the Eldrazi would mean.

name: Wily Bandar
text: Part feline, part primate, all trouble.

name: Tragic Slip
text: She never would've guessed that her last word would be "Whoops!"

name: Wolf's Quarry
text:
"The monster was gaining on them. Twice it had found them. There was only one place left to hide."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Wolverine Riders
text: "We'll break their lines. The rest of you, follow!"

name: Woodborn Behemoth
text: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

name: Woodland Champion
text: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

name: Young Wolf
text: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

name: Zendikar's Roil
text:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

name: Titan's Presence
text: Dust and memory are all that remain in Ulamog's wake.

name: Tree of Perdition
text:
"Trees are to be venerated and protected . . . except that one."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

name: Warden of Geometries
text: The wastelands disorient even the most experienced scouts, making them easy prey for Kozilek's drones.

name: Adventuring Gear
text: An explorer's essentials in a wild world.

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Alchemist's Vial
text: A weapon best suited for those with good aim and steady hands.

name: Aradara Express
text: It glides around the city, a sublime combination of elegance and utility.

name: Assembly-Worker
text: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

name: Bag of Holding
text: There's no prepared like overprepared.

name: Campus Guide
text: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"

name: Cellar Door
text: As if anyone needed another reason to avoid dark, dank cellars.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Gront realized that his brilliant plan of being faster than Kork might still not be enough.

name: Circuit Mender
text: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

name: Cogwork Assembler
text: Duplication is neither thievery nor flattery. It is efficiency.

name: Dragon Blood
text: A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Gearsmith Guardian
text: Made in its creator's image, though slightly more clangy.

name: Gleaming Barrier
text:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

name: Dragon Mage
text: "I've forgotten more spells than you will ever know."

name: Golem Artisan
text: Better living through metallurgy.

name: Hammer of Ruin
text: By hammer forged, and by hammer undone.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Hero's Blade
text: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

name: Infiltration Lens
