text: Neurok spies carry devices that let them look a few moments into the future, giving them an almost insurmountable edge.

name: Iron Bully
text:
"Why would someone have built ... wait, never mind. Send it to the front lines!"
—Commander Grozdan

name: Drannith Stinger
text: "If you're going to run for cover, you should start now."

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Kitesail
text: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

name: Leonin Scimitar
text:
"Every scratch tells a story, and every notch has a name. Four generations have held this blade. You shall not disappoint them."
—Initiation of Laena, skyhunter

name: Locthwain Gargoyle
text:
"As the traitor hurried across the courtyard, its eyes snapped open. It was time to pay the queen a visit."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Manakin
text:
"Each night, the artificer tucked the little doll into a locked drawer. Each morning, she awoke to find it waiting beside her with some new bauble."
—"The Artificer's Apprentice"

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Phyrexian Ironfoot
text: It took the Rimewind cultists days to realize they had successfully activated the creature—it just wasn't interested in moving.

name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
text: "Wanna see a neat trick?"

name: Pierce Strider
text:
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Self-Assembler
text: It sees itself in all of its creations.

name: Shambling Suit
text:
"The young squire gripped her sword as the clanking stranger emerged. It was no knight that had come to challenge her."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Rapacious Dragon
text: It wasn't the first time the dragon's hoard had attracted a free lunch.

name: Tamiyo's Journal
text: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Universal Solvent
text:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

name: Vial of Dragonfire
text:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

name: Weapon Rack
text: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.

name: Whirlermaker
text:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Rigging Runner
text: "Prepare to be boarded! Or don't. I'm coming over either way."

name: Blighted Fen
text:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Spear Spewer
text:
"Okay, maybe the 962nd spear will be the one that gets 'em!"
—Kreech, ballista operator

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Shimmerdrift Vale
text: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Urza's Factory
text:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Urza's Mine
text: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Bow before the power of *science*!"

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

name: Warped Landscape
text: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: "Reality is always much duller and grayer than what your imagination can conjure."

name: Caustic Caterpillar
text:
"That was a Consulate spy thopter. Leave the caterpillar to its meal."
—Pia Nalaar, renegade inventor

name: Colossal Majesty
text: "Wow, it's even *bigger* than I thought! Awesome!"

name: Elvish Rejuvenator
text: "As long as its roots still reach the soil, I can heal it."

name: Ram Through
text: The castle's mages had devised effective counters to every form of siegecraft, but had no answers to gorilla warfare.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text:
"Count yourself lucky it only broke your kitesail. Get that close to the nest again and it'll be your face."
—Huatli

name: Coldsteel Heart
text: "There is as much power in winter's chill as in summer's warmth."

name: Magnifying Glass
text: Palmistry is much more effective when you read the fine print.

name: Peacewalker Colossus
text: One way to keep the peace is to make war look like a really bad idea.

name: Dawnwing Marshal
text: "Horizon to horizon, mountain to sea. Everything within is ours to protect."

name: Revoke Demise
text: "Arise, sister. Our journey has only just begun."

name: Raise the Alarm
text: The city of Drannith danced to the music of the siege. Four bells meant a breach of the north wall. A horn blast meant all hands to arms. Additional gongs and tones indicated fire, poison, air raids, and more.

name: Steadfast Unicorn
text: As the majestic creature pranced through the market, furious haggling calmed and arguments trailed off.

name: Tenacity
text:
"Deep in the ugliness of war, she appeared to remind us of the love for which we fight."
—Syr Agata of Ardenvale

name: Drag Under
text: One moment Dorica was meditating in her study, searching her mind for Thassa's guidance. Then, with a splash, she was underwater, face to face with a god.

name: Faerie Seer
text: "Such dull wishes these humans make! To grant them as wished would be a dismal affair. Perhaps with a twist . . ."

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: "Go on now, get up there and take a gander at what's beyond those hills for me."

name: Run Ashore
text: Sand to the eyes was against the rules. Unfortunately, there was no referee.

name: Scourge of the Undercity
text: Her hunger for blood is matched only by her hunger for vengeance.

name: Sudden Insight
text: He sought to peer beneath the surface of the moon. Instead, he peeled back the skin of reality itself.

name: Uncomfortable Chill
text:
"Tormented screams are like snowflakes: no two are quite the same."
—Pedor, ice witch

name: Bonecaller Cleric
text: "My blood was never my own. I carried it gladly for the Hungering One, and at last she arises to reclaim it."

name: Dark Bargain
text: Under Ormendahl's demonic influence, Bishop Jerren became the perfect agent of bloody blasphemy.

name: Dark Confidant
text: "Newly conjured demons arrive confused, angry, and unsure how to direct their cruelty. I offer a few fun suggestions."

name: Deadly Dispute
text: Fortune may favor the bold, but it also flattens the foolhardy.

name: Eaten Alive
text: Flesh untouched by plague was a rare delicacy for the hungry creatures in Guul Draz.

name: Eternal Taskmaster
text: Sometimes she considered how much easier it would have been to stay dead.

name: Grim Bounty
text: The Dusk Legion demanded a share of the gold. The pirates happily obliged.

name: Howling Banshee
text:
"No such thing as 'too quiet.' Quiet is good. Quiet means we don't end up dead in the mud, bleeding from our ears."
—Rem Karolus

name: Wriggling Grub
text: The professor of essence studies always relished the looks on the first-years' faces as their vivisections descended into chaos.

name: Killing Glare
text: "Now really, was that the expression you wanted preserved on your face forever?"

name: Priest of Gix
text: "Take my mind, so that it may serve the will of Phyrexia. Take my flesh, so I may become compleat."

name: Sangromancer
text: "Capenna needs some new blood. Preferably spilled by us."

name: Serpent Assassin
text:
"Patrol didn't find a single footprint, Captain. We should be safe to rest here."
—Lowell, army scout

name: Skymarch Bloodletter
text: "Looks like my Blood Fast is about to end early."

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The staff flared and rattled erratically, every twirl driving the wolf to greater heights of rage.

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Great goblin warlords lead vast hordes into battle from atop mighty siege-beasts. Lesser chiefs get a couple of squires and a big bug.

name: Dropkick Bomber
text: "I've always enjoyed kicking stuff, so this was an ideal career opportunity."

name: Blood Feud
text: No wedding between rival vampire dynasties is complete without a few attempted murders at the reception.

name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
text: Sages whisper that Lathliss still keeps the heart of the old dragon queen sealed within a jewel, its smoldering warmth an eternal reminder that no monarch is untouchable.

name: Destructive Digger
text: "Depending what's behind that boulder, we're either about to be very rich or very disintegrated."

name: Fathom Fleet Firebrand
text: As her pulse quickened, the snakes on her arms flared and writhed, eager to sink their fangs into the coming fray.

name: Goblin Fireslinger
text: The explorers didn't understand the lone sentry's jabbering, but they offered gold for passage. The counteroffer was a face full of molten rock.

name: Goblin Smuggler
text: "No one here but us empty barrels!"

name: Guttersnipe
text: "Your steel fails you, surface-dweller. Perhaps I will reforge the fragments into something less embarrassing."

name: Kiln Fiend
text: Born of fire yet not immune to it, the fiend lashes out in mindless rage, spurred by constant agony.

name: Firespitter Whelp
text: In subsequent terms, first-year students were prohibited from enrolling in Introduction to Dragonkeeping.

name: Krenko's Command
text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

name: Seize the Spoils
text: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

name: Volley Veteran
text: They didn't fire in unison, nor in the same direction. Most didn't even use arrows. Somehow it worked perfectly.

name: Zealous Conscripts
text: Only those who strike without a moment's hesitation may earn Hazoret's favor.

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"Our state-of-the-art laboratories have been stripped of bothersome safety measures."
—Radula, Simic biomancer

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "If you cling to the safety of the roots, you'll never climb high enough to see through the canopy."

name: Explore
text: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Once revered, then hunted, and now beyond memory.

name: Gift of the Gargantuan
text: To Alara's Wild Nacatl, the greatest blessing is to be spared by the behemoths.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: "This forest is your birthright. From now until your final breath, you and Llanowar are bound. Keep each other safe."

name: Undercellar Myconid
text:
"Granted, we were trying to make perfume, but I'd still say the experiment was a success!"
—George, underground alchemist

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: The beacon shone over the city, its lights a message to every traveler: whoever you are, you belong here.

name: Leonin Scimitar
text: "Our enemies may be more metal than flesh. Good reason to wield a blade that will cut either."

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text: Every evening a rainbow of industry illuminates the skies above Eiganjo.

name: Ash Barrens
text:
"You should have granted us an audience. Instead, you now reign over a kingdom of ruins."
—Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Akroan Skyguard
text: "Trust me. When you have earned a god's favor, you'll know."

name: Goblin Surprise
text: "Hey, your door's broken!"

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Angelic Edict
text: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

name: Angelic Gift
text: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

name: Archon of Falling Stars
text:
"The archon fell like a star from the sky, meeting the rising sun at the horizon's edge."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Argivian Phalanx
text: New Argive welcomed the kor people when they were displaced by the Rathi overlay. The kor repay that kindness with fierce loyalty.

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Hearts on Fire
text:
"With you by my side, I am unstoppable."
—Halana, to Alena

name: Basri's Acolyte
text: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

name: Basri's Solidarity
text:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket

name: Battlefield Promotion
text: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

name: Bishop's Soldier
text: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

name: Brightmare
text: A ray of hope in the darkest night.

name: Captivating Unicorn
text:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant

name: Celestial Enforcer
text: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

name: Chosen by Heliod
text:
"Training and studies aid a soldier in meager amounts. The gods do the rest."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

name: Daybreak Chaplain
text: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

name: Deadly Riposte
text:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

name: Defend the Campus
text: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

name: Defiant Strike
text: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

name: Desperate Lunge
text: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

name: Destroy Evil
text: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

name: Scholar of Combustion
text: "If the fire is silent, I'm technically not breaking the library rules!"

name: Divine Arrow
text: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: Dreadful Apathy
text: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

name: Elite Skirmisher
text: Some adopted the tactics of the leonin to combat the ferocity of the minotaurs.

name: Favored of Iroas
text: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."

name: Fencing Ace
text: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

name: Go Forth
text: Spark or no, Nissa would always be an explorer.

name: Flutterfox
text:
"The fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Gavony Silversmith
text: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

name: Gird for Battle
text:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

name: Glory Bearers
text: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

name: Golden-Tail Disciple
text: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

name: Herald of the Sun
text: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."

name: Impeccable Timing
text: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

name: Hungry Megasloth
text: It supplements its leafy diet with delicacies snatched from low-flying airships.

name: Indomitable Will
text:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

name: Ingenious Leonin
text: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Jubilant Mascot
text: The competition is but one aspect of the spectacle.

name: King of the Pride
text:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Leonin of the Lost Pride
text: Leonin band together in the Underworld, taking solace in their strength until, at last, both pride and self are forgotten.

name: Leonin Vanguard
text: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

name: Light the Way
text: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

name: Razorgrass Invoker
text: "Let the beauty of our land lull them so that they may stumble upon its hidden thorns."

name: Lightwalker
text:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Mesa Unicorn
text: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

name: Militant Inquisitor
text: "I am an instrument of the church wielded against Avacyn's enemies."

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Moment of Triumph
text: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

name: Saurian Symbiote
text: It's a living, self-contained ecosystem.

name: Nykthos Paragon
text: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.

name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
text: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

name: Outflank
text:
"With the drum of hooves and a flash of blades, the monster's terrifying roar changed to a cry of fear."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Pacifism
text: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

name: Paladin of the Bloodstained
text: Closely linked to the Church of Dusk, the paladins of the Bloodstained order are devout to the point of fanaticism.

name: Parhelion Patrol
text: "Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."

name: Patron of the Valiant
text: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

name: Rally of Wings
text: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

name: Recruitment Officer
text: "Every name on this list is already a hero! Will you add your own to it?"

name: Recumbent Bliss
text: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

name: Relief Captain
text: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

name: Repel the Darkness
text: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

name: Resistance Reunited
text: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.

name: Revitalize
text: Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.

name: Rhox Faithmender
text: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

name: Ronom Unicorn
text: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable.
—Benalish proverb

name: Slimy Piper
text: All throughout the glade, sprouts squelched happily along to the tune.

name: Search Party Captain
text: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Serra's Embrace
text: The touch of Serra's angels bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

name: Shield Mare
text: When it passes, order defeats chaos.

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
text:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

name: Speakeasy Server
text: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Squad Captain
text: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

name: Stalwart Valkyrie
text: "Only the worthy may pass."

name: Star Pupil
text: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."

name: Spined Tyrranax
text:
"Drive the beasts into the enemy ranks, then stay back and let them do the work."
—Koth

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Starnheim Courser
text: Every worthy warrior who arrives in Starnheim is gifted a mount befitting their heroism, a mighty pegasus raised and trained by the valkyries.

name: Steadfast Sentry
text: "Get up, slugabeds! We've got company, and they're not dressed for a party!"

name: Stone Haven Outfitter
text: The makers and menders are the first called to battle and the last to leave.

name: Sungrace Pegasus
text: The sacred feathers of the pegasus are said to have healing powers.

name: Sunhome Stalwart
text: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

name: Sunmane Pegasus
text: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

name: Sunspear Shikari
text: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides. The fight for survival reunited them.

name: Swift Response
text:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain

name: Woodland Liege
text: "Your human laws mean nothing here. Plead your case before the tribunal of the wilds."

name: Take Up the Shield
text: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

name: Tethmos High Priest
text: "Death is tyranny. Like all tyranny, it must be opposed."

name: Thopter Architect
text: "She'll only fly once. Make it count!"

name: Trusty Retriever
text: Wipe away the slobber and it's as good as new, give or take a few bite marks.

name: Wingsteed Rider
text: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.

name: Shardless Outlander
text: The Conflux proved that Alara's strength came from unity, not division.

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

name: Academy Journeymage
text: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

name: Aerial Guide
text:
"Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages."
—Neponem, vizier of Kefnet

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Augur of Bolas
text: "There is no future save the one my master wills."

name: Aven Reedstalker
text: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."

name: Azure Drake
text: More so than "storm" or "pirate," "drake" is the word a sailor least wants to hear.

name: Starnheim Memento
text: Made from a feather from Firja's wing, it marks a worthy hero with the blessing of the valkyries.

name: Breaching Hippocamp
text: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.

name: Brineborn Cutthroat
text: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

name: Bury in Books
text: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

name: Cartouche of Knowledge
text: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

name: Chilling Trap
text:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Choking Tethers
text: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.

name: Chrome Prowler
text: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.

name: Faithful Pikemaster
text: "I seek no fight with you, but neither will I stand aside."

name: Brigone, Soldier of Meletis
text: "Gods, guide my hand!"

name: Cloudkin Seer
text: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Cruel Witness
text:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Crystacean
text: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Draugr Thought-Thief
text: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.

name: Exclusion Mage
text: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

name: Expedition Diviner
text: Wizards' spells twist the fabric of reality to channel elemental energies, peer into the future, and even calm the Roil.

name: Expendable Lackey
text:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine

name: Experimental Aviator
text: "The little thopters seemed lonely up here, so I thought I'd join them."

name: Fading Hope
text: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

name: Faerie Vandal
text: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

name: Filigree Attendant
text:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

name: Frost Trickster
text: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

name: Gearseeker Serpent
text: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

name: Glimmerbell
text:
"Their paths aren't random, but they don't float with the wind. Could they be following surges in crystalline energy?"
—Naireh, Ketria elementalist

name: Gust of Wind
text: Skysail's strength was also its vulnerability.

name: Haunting Figment
text: Some bad dreams stay with you forever.

name: Kapsho Kitefins
text:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff

name: Krovikan Mist
text: Plague-induced dreams became real as they swirled above Krov, mingling with the magical residue of the World Spell.

name: Lat-Nam Adept
text: "Every book is a doorway to enlightenment. Curiosity is your key."

name: Locked in the Cemetery
text: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

name: Lord of the Unreal
text: "The dream does not end until I say so."

name: Majestic Metamorphosis
text: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

name: Malcator's Watcher
text: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.

name: Malfunction
text: "They don't make them like they used to."

name: Merfolk Pupil
text: Maintaining a personal bubble is even more important when you have gills.

name: Muse Drake
text: A composer wrote a symphony based on the drakes screeching outside her window. Reviews were mixed—except among the drakes.

name: Mystic Skyfish
text: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

name: Naiad of Hidden Coves
text:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Network Disruptor
text: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Oneirophage
text: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Opt
text: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

name: Organ Hoarder
text: The stitcher died years ago, but her dutiful assistant still keeps the laboratory well stocked.

name: Overflowing Insight
text: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

name: Pestermite
text: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

name: Phantasmal Form
text: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.

name: Phantom Ninja
text:
"Ninjas can run across water, pull ladders from pockets, kill with a kiss, and slip between bricks. Pack of lies, I say."
—Benden, teahouse gossip

name: Purple-Crystal Crab
text: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Remand
text: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

name: Cynette, Jelly Drover
text: "Once you build up an immunity to their deadly venom, they're really quite cuddly!"

name: Serpentine Ambush
text: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

name: Shipwreck Dowser
text: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

name: Shore Keeper
text: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

name: Shorecomber Crab
text: Though Captain Riptide's corpse was mostly recovered from the shipwreck, no one ever managed to find his favorite hat.

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Silent Departure
text: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

name: Sky-Eel School
text: They swim on tides few can see, away from a threat few yet understand.

name: Slimebind
text:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester

name: Soul Read
text: It's easy to be two steps ahead when you can see their every thought.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Sphinx of Enlightenment
text: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."

name: Sprite Noble
text: "By thorn and by stone, we will fight to see the day when beauty returns to this world."

name: Stinging Lionfish
text: Starfish are its favorite prey.

name: Stitched Drake
text:
"The best skaab are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Stolen by the Fae
text: Denizens of the wilds don't always seek to harm intruders. Sometimes they simply misplace them.

name: Plagon, Lord of the Beach
text: "No more lurking in the shallows. We ride!"

name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
text:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

name: Thopter Mechanic
text: "You want me to install a seat belt? Please. You're lucky to get a seat!"

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Tide Skimmer
text: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

name: Tidepool Turtle
text: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.

name: Tolarian Kraken
text:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Towering-Wave Mystic
text: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

name: Pol Jamaar, Illusionist
text: "'Real' is a more flexible concept than you might think."

name: Undersea Invader
text:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

name: Vexing Gull
text:
"May the skies be clear of gales and gulls."
—Meletian prayer

name: Voracious Greatshark
text: There is no boat big enough.

name: Waker of Waves
text: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
text: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Waterkin Shaman
text: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
text: Tritons search for omens in its wake.

name: Whirlwind Denial
text: "No, no, and . . . no."

name: Wind Strider
text: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

name: Windcaller Aven
text: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

name: Windreader Sphinx
text: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

name: Windstorm Drake
text: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

name: Winged Words
text: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

name: Witching Well
text: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

name: Yarok's Wavecrasher
text:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 2

name: Agonizing Syphon
text:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Generous Pup
text: They communicate via the universal language of treats.

name: Arrogant Outlaw
text: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

name: Audacious Thief
text: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Bleed Dry
text:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Blood Burglar
text:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

name: Bloodgift Demon
text: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
text: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

name: Bloodtithe Collector
text: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

name: Boneclad Necromancer
text: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."

name: Coat with Venom
text:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Contract Killing
text: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

name: Creeping Bloodsucker
text:
"If a vampire were feeding on you every night, wouldn't you have bite marks? Stop wasting my time."
—Donya, village healer

name: Crooked Custodian
text: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

name: Dark Supplicant
text: Cabal clerics serve two masters: their patriarch and their god.

name: Deal Gone Bad
text:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

name: Defenestrate
text: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

name: Devouring Swarm
text: Their arrival is heralded by the deafening hum of ten thousand wings. Their departure is marked by the silence of the dead.

name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
text: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

name: Diregraf Scavenger
text: It can barely feel the sword anymore.

name: Disfigure
text: With a snap of metal like a strike of lightning, the tide of war shifted in Mishra's favor.

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

name: Doomed Necromancer
text: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

name: Dreadhound
text: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

name: Dross Hopper
text: Bred in the vicious Mephidross, dross hoppers learned to eat quickly and escape faster.

name: Durable Coilbug
text:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

name: Elderfang Disciple
text: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."

name: Endless Cockroaches
text: There is nothing more repulsive than a cockroach—except a cockroach and all its friends.

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Expedition Skulker
text: Rogues bring an array of useful skills to the work of an adventuring party: stealth, agility, the ability to locate and disarm traps, and a subtle, deadly fighting style.

name: Exsanguinate
text: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

name: Extinguish the Light
text: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

name: Eye Collector
text: "Lord Rankle will see you now—all he asks is a small token of tribute."

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Foul Play
text: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

name: Fretwork Colony
text: The swarm leaves behind a flawless pattern that only occasionally threatens the structural integrity of the wood.

name: Gift of Fangs
text:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Gnawing Zombie
text: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

name: Go for the Throat
text: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

name: Grave Strength
text: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Koma's Faithful
text: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

name: Masked Blackguard
text: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.

name: Midnight Assassin
text: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Moment of Craving
text: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Morkrut Behemoth
text:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Morkrut Necropod
text:
"There's not enough salt in all of Nephalia to wither that thing."
—Ghoulcaller Enslow

name: Murder
text:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
"The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace."
—Nantuko teaching

name: Necropolis Regent
text: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

name: Cleon, Merry Champion
text: "Let us dance 'round the funeral pyres of our foes!"

name: Necrotic Wound
text: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Persistent Specimen
text:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, stitcher's assistant

name: Pharika's Chosen
text: The serpents' dens built into statues of Pharika serve not only to consecrate her temples, but as a hidden line of defense.

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

name: Powerstone Fracture
text:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
text: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
text: To cross swords with her is a shockingly bad idea.

name: Reaper from the Abyss
text: "Avacyn has deserted you. I welcome your devotion in her stead."

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Ruthless Knave
text: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

name: Sanctum Seeker
text: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

name: Scion of the Swarm
text: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

name: Severed Strands
text: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

name: Subtle Strike
text: Silence is an underrated hunting strategy.

name: Swarm of Bloodflies
text: Despite the name, they'll happily devour the flesh too.

name: Thirsting Bloodlord
text: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

name: Torment of Scarabs
text: Like a carpet unrolling for their god, the scarabs poured out from the necropolis.

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Typhoid Rats
text: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

name: Ukud Cobra
text:
"The Silumgar hide behind the deadly wildlife of their swamps. They'd rather scheme in their jungle palaces than face us."
—Khibat, Kolaghan warrior

name: Ulcerate
text:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

name: Hinterland Sanctifier
text: "You can learn a lot about a place just by asking the land how it's doing."

name: Undercity Scrounger
text: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
text: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

name: Vampire Scrivener
text: No one remains on her list for long.

name: Venomous Hierophant
text: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"

name: Vicious Conquistador
text:
"He is ambitious. Tireless. And utterly ruthless. Ideal for the frontier."
—Viceroy Elia Sotonores, report to the queen

name: Village Rites
text: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

name: Virus Beetle
text:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

name: Braulios of Pheres Band
text: "Your claim to this land is as tenuous as my tolerance of your presence on it."

name: Vraska's Finisher
text: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

name: Wailing Ghoul
text:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Wakedancer
text: Havengul wakes are widely regarded as great entertainment. If you're lucky, the guest of honor climbs out of the casket and joins in the festivities.

name: Akroan Crusader
text: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

name: Arena Athlete
text: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

name: Bathe in Dragonfire
text: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

name: Dionus, Elvish Archdruid
text: "My people are like the great magnigoth trees. We've seen ice, flood, invasions, and wars, yet our roots remain strong."

name: Blood Hypnotist
text: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

name: Bloodfire Expert
text: Some efreet abandon their homes in the volcanic Fire Rim to embrace the Jeskai Way and discipline their innate flames.

name: Bloodlust Inciter
text: "To victory! To glory! To eternity!"

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Brute Strength
text: "Oketra had our crop build an obelisk to prove the power of working together. But I am stronger without the weak."

name: Cartouche of Zeal
text: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.

name: Chandra's Spitfire
text: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Crimson Wisps
text: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

name: Cyclops Electromancer
text: Every storm has an eye.

name: Daybreak Combatants
text: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Shroofus Sproutsire
text: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

name: Emberhorn Minotaur
text: "My stride will break only against the twin points of Hazoret's spear."

name: Expedition Champion
text: Warriors are combat specialists who bring their deadly skills to bear against the many foes that adventurers face in the course of their journeys.

name: Fanatical Firebrand
text:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Fiendish Duo
text: Half the size, double the mayhem.

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Fire Prophecy
text:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise

name: Firebrand Archer
text: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

name: Fissure Wizard
text: He might call up a burst of lava or a raging hellion from Akoum's volcanic depths. Or he might just fall in.

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Flame-Blessed Bolt
text:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Flames of the Firebrand
text:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Fling
text: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

name: Furious Reprisal
text:
"Now that's the Chandra I've been waiting to see."
—Liliana Vess

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Goblin Researcher
text: Slonk was struck by lightning twenty-seven times before he got the idea. Another forty-three hits and he'd perfected it.

name: Goblin Trailblazer
text:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

name: Goma Fada Vanguard
text:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

name: Hellkite Whelp
text:
"They play by spitting fire at each other. Don't be offended if one gives you a love-scorch."
—Esfir, Rakdos dragon wrangler

name: Hero of the Games
text: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.

name: Incorrigible Youths
text:
"Ah, to be young again."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Infuriate
text:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

name: Insolent Neonate
text: "Manners are for mortals."

name: Invigorated Rampage
text: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

name: Jaya's Firenado
text:
"For all their supposed advances, the Phyrexians still aren't fireproof."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Keldon Raider
text: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

name: Kindled Fury
text: The minotaur stared at the Eternal bearing down on him—the embodiment of deadly skill he had aspired to become.

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "Save that one! She looks rich!"

name: Kruin Striker
text: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

name: Markov Blademaster
text: "Mortals practice swordplay for a few decades at best. How can they ever attain the exquisite mastery that eternity has to offer?"

name: Markov Warlord
text: "What use is a stake or holy symbol in the hands of a coward?"

name: Minotaur Sureshot
text: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Neonate's Rush
text:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Open Fire
text: Some khenra archers fashion their arrows with a personal touch.

name: Pathmaker Initiate
text: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

name: Pigment Storm
text: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.

name: Play with Fire
text: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

name: Pyrophobia
text:
"I hate this! I hate fire! I hate you for taking me on this route!"
—Norin the Wary

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Reckless Impulse
text: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I've beaten far better than you, in far greater numbers. So go ahead, draw your swords."

name: Renegade Tactics
text: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

name: Resistance Skywarden
text: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.

name: Roil Eruption
text:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Sarkhan's Rage
text: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

name: Satyr Hoplite
text: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."

name: Shock
text:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

name: Soul Sear
text: There was no witty retort, no confident boast to accompany the attack. There was only pain.

name: Delightful Discovery
text: "What do you think? New class pet?"

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Spellgorger Weird
text: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

name: Trial of Zeal
text: "Eternal glory awaits you, my child."

name: Trueheart Twins
text: Shoulder to shoulder until blade must turn against blade.

name: Uncaged Fury
text: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.

name: Unleash Fury
text: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

name: Unstoppable Ogre
text: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.

name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
text: "Good work, but I know you can do better. Try again."

name: Vampiric Fury
text: Many peasants secretly admire vampires' glamour and elegance—until they witness a moment of pure bloodlust.

name: Voldaren Ambusher
text: "Gotcha."

name: Voldaren Duelist
text: "I have yet to find my equal."

name: Voldaren Epicure
text: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Weaselback Redcap
text:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

name: Weaver of Lightning
text: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

name: Wildfire Elemental
text:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
text: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

name: Adventure Awaits
text: "Good, we're all here. Let's get started!"

name: Adventurous Impulse
text: Every odyssey begins with a single step.

name: Advocate of the Beast
text: "I am neither their drover nor their leader. To these majestic beasts, I am simply their herdmate and nothing more."

name: Aggressive Instinct
text:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Ainok Artillerist
text:
"In the Tarkir I once knew, the Abzan revered their ancestor trees. Now, as Dromoka, they cut their finest groves to make weapons."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Arbor Armament
text:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Do not mistake complexity for brilliance. It takes a master to perfect a simple design."

name: Armored Kincaller
text:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli

name: Audacity
text: Bravery outlives the brave.

name: Baloth Gorger
text: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Band Together
text: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

name: Big Play
text:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

name: Bite Down
text:
"Yavimaya takes care of herself; the kavu are evidence of this. What does your Coalition offer that the forest cannot provide?"
—Jenson Carthalion

name: Bond of Flourishing
text: "We agree that life should flourish. We disagree on the optimal number of limbs."

name: Bounty of Skemfar
text: Even war cannot dull Skemfar's beauty.

name: Syr Elenora, the Discerning
text: She rode forth from Vantress an emissary, a marshal, and a paragon of style.

name: Brushstrider
text: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

name: Byway Courier
text: A good courier travels fast and asks no questions.

name: Canopy Baloth
text:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Cherished Hatchling
text: Despite its appearance, it's anything but defenseless.

name: Clear Shot
text: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Deepwood Denizen
text: "You didn't come all this way just to bother me, did you? Say your piece and be gone."

name: Defend the Celestus
text: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
text: "I see no heroes upon this field. Only tinder awaiting my spark."

name: Drover of the Mighty
text: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

name: Drowsing Tyrannodon
text: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.

name: Druid of the Anima
text: Although the Anima herself remains at the Sacellum, her druids roam Naya, collecting mana bonds with every location in the world.

name: Duskshell Crawler
text: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

name: Dwynen's Elite
text:
"Come, my beautiful brothers and sisters. Let us hunt."
—Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf daen

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Fierce Witchstalker
text: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

name: For the Family
text: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.

name: Fungal Plots
text: Thallids nurture saprolings, entertain them, and eat them.

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: "To the void with you!"

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ghirapur Guide
text: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Only the most effective tactics stand the test of time."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Giant Opportunity
text: They look tasty, but best to plant them.

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Greenwood Sentinel
text: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

name: Groundswell
text: "This world will not be tamed."

name: Harrow
text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
text: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

name: High-Rise Sawjack
text: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

name: Hunter's Edge
text: The hunt ends. Lunch begins.

name: Insatiable Appetite
text: He ate them out of house and home and shed and barn and flock and herd.

name: Invigorating Surge
text: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Jungle Delver
text: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

name: Kazandu Nectarpot
text:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

name: Kazandu Stomper
text: Elves revere cycles of renewal, but they prefer cycles that don't involve their homes getting smashed.

name: Kujar Seedsculptor
text: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
text: "The seedling you save today may be the sheltering boughs of generations to come."

name: Llanowar Visionary
text: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

name: Maraleaf Rider
text: They both hunger for battle.

name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
text: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

name: Might of the Masses
text:
"There is nothing stronger than many hearts united for a single cause."
—Emmara

name: Moldgraf Millipede
text: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

name: Murasa Ranger
text: "If you're not prepared to fight, you'd best be prepared to die."

name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
text: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Overwhelm
text: The Conclave acts with a single will, expressed by countless warriors.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Predator's Strike
text: If you hear it coming, you're not its prey.

name: Gilded Scuttler
text: "ATTENTION BEACHGOERS: This is a litter-free zone. Violators will be pinched."

name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
text: "Sign or don't, it makes little difference to me. It is your fate that hangs in the balance."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Reckless Amplimancer
text: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Saproling Migration
text: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
text: "Oppose us and die a heretic. Join us and be blessed with immortality."

name: Skyclave Pick-Axe
text: For use on cliffs and other faces.

name: Snakeskin Veil
text: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

name: Snapping Gnarlid
text: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

name: Spore Crawler
text:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

name: Spore Swarm
text: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

name: Sporecrown Thallid
text:
"The identifying ornamental growths of alpha thallids may be hereditary, or catalyzed by some chemical signal."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Stony Strength
text: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"

name: Tajuru Pathwarden
text: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

name: Territorial Scythecat
text: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Tukatongue Thallid
text: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

name: Voice of the Woods
text: "Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."

name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
text: If she commands it, her subjects will burn the world to ash.

name: Woodland Champion
text: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

name: Enlisted Wurm
text: A match for any army—even its own.

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Cliffhaven Kitesail
text: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.

name: Eager Construct
text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Gingerbrute
text: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.

name: Maelstrom Colossus
text:
"Nothing of the Maelstrom is quiet or easy."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Patchwork Automaton
text: It dwells happily near the ever-burning forges of Sokenzan City, crafting small things of beauty from discarded scraps.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Relic Axe
text: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: She pulverizes each hedron and consumes the dust, absorbing the power within.

name: Universal Solvent
text:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

name: Whirlermaker
text:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The Eldrazi may be ruthless, but Zendikar is relentless.

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: Various cultures of Ixalan tell stories of the monsters of legend that ended up as gristle between Ghalta's teeth.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Vault of Whispers
text: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
text: In his sleep, he twitched and snarled, dreaming of glorious battle against the undead hordes.

name: Phantasmal Shieldback
text: It materialized in the mist, and the invading horde broke like waves against solid rock.

name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
text: "Soil and stone, hear my call! Branch and bone, yield your all!"

name: Banishing Light
text:
"The kami have declared that courtyard a no-fly zone."
—Light-Paws

name: Celestial Unicorn
text:
"The true champion of the sun shall arrive on swift hooves, bearing a light to pierce the bleakest darkness."
—Korinna, Meletian oracle

name: Dauntless Onslaught
text: Energized by a hearty lunch and a long nap in the afternoon sun, they were more than ready to take down any prey.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "Considering your statures, let's start with the upward slash."

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Gaea's Cradle
text:
"Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
text: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

name: Divine Arrow
text: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Emancipation Angel
text: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

name: Face of Divinity
text: Pure souls shine bright as daybreak.

name: Forced Worship
text: Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Gird for Battle
text:
"You won't need the sword drills, your shields, or my blessing. You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart."
—Aurelia

name: Healer's Hawk
text: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

name: Indomitable Will
text:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

name: Corsair Captain
text: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

name: Inspired Charge
text: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"

name: Inspiring Captain
text: "Time to show the foe our true mettle."

name: Inspiring Unicorn
text: There are two lives: the life you live before you see a unicorn, and the life you live after.

name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
text: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the guard. The kami are coming."

name: Knight of the Tusk
text: "Horse? Who needs a horse?"

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Lena, Selfless Champion
text: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

name: Lightwalker
text:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
text: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.

name: Long Road Home
text: The person who finishes a journey is rarely the same as the one who starts it.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Mesa Unicorn
text: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Pacifism
text: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

name: Patron of the Valiant
text: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Rhox Faithmender
text: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

name: Ronom Unicorn
text: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Sky Tether
text:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Take Heart
text: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

name: Tandem Tactics
text: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Voice of the Provinces
text: Her horn is heard across Innistrad, lifting the hearts of the righteous.

name: Aegis Turtle
text:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Battleground Geist
text: Not content to nudge vases and chill drawing rooms, some geists muster spectral armies to claw at the hearts of the living.

name: Befuddle
text: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

name: Chart a Course
text: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

name: Coastal Piracy
text: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

name: Cryptic Serpent
text: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

name: Curiosity
text: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

name: Erratic Visionary
text: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"

name: Essence Flux
text: A spirit is both fettered and free—bound in some ways to its previous existence, yet able to transcend much of the corporeal.

name: Exclude
text:
"Terrifying, but thankfully temporary."
—Teferi

name: Exclusion Mage
text: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
text: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

name: Kitesail Corsair
text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Leave in the Dust
text: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

name: Murmuring Phantasm
text:
"The most insidious thing in the world is nonsense that sounds just plausible enough to listen to."
—Lazav

name: Mystic Archaeologist
text: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

name: Narcolepsy
text:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Nocturnal Feeder
text: A living pulse is an irresistible temptation.

name: Octoprophet
text: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

name: Oneirophage
text: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Prosperous Pirates
text: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

name: Read the Runes
text: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Tinybones, Trinket Thief
text: Big distractions mean tiny nuisances can slip by unnoticed.

name: Rishadan Airship
text: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.

name: Sage's Row Savant
text: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

name: Sailor of Means
text: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Selhoff Occultist
text: "The mist whispers to those who know it to be more than a mundane fog."

name: Serendib Efreet
text: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Storm Sculptor
text: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

name: Witch of the Moors
text: Many hands for many evils.

name: Sweep Away
text: The Roil takes many forms. It also takes many victims.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Talrand's Invocation
text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."
