name: Thought Collapse
text:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav

name: Thought Scour
text:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Towering-Wave Mystic
text: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

name: Vedalken Archmage
text:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

name: Vedalken Entrancer
text: Their denial reaches far into your future.

name: Voyage's End
text: Philosophers say those lost at sea ascended to a more perfect realm. Sailors say they drowned.

name: Chained Brute
text: A momentary lapse is all it needs to break free.

name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
text: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Whelming Wave
text:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

name: Windreader Sphinx
text: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

name: Windstorm Drake
text: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

name: Winged Words
text: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

name: Wishful Merfolk
text: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

name: Wizard's Retort
text:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Agonizing Syphon
text:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

name: Brightmare
text: A ray of hope in the darkest night.

name: Immolating Gyre
text: "Nice army you had there."

name: Assassin's Strike
text: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

name: Bake into a Pie
text: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

name: Black Cat
text: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

name: Blighted Bat
text: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Blood Divination
text: Predicting the future is a messy business.

name: Blood Host
text: It would be ill-mannered to decline his invitation. It would be ill-advised to accept it.

name: Bloodbond Vampire
text:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Bloodhunter Bat
text: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

name: Bogbrew Witch
text: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

name: Bone Picker
text: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

name: Bone Splinters
text:
"Which do you deserve, the heft of a femur or the graceful sharpness of a forearm? Decisions, decisions . . ."
—Gisa the Mad

name: Burglar Rat
text:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Cauldron Familiar
text: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

name: Cemetery Recruitment
text: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

name: Child of Night
text: No guilds—that is her rule. The House vampires unnerve her. The Combine would dissect her, the Legion burn her, the Conclave "cure" her. The shadows are all the family she needs.

name: Corpse Hauler
text:
"He expects a reward, but the only piece of silver he'll get from me is my blade in his gut."
—Shelac, necromancer

name: Lightning Visionary
text: "The gods don't speak to mortals with gentle entreaties. They speak with thunder and fury."

name: Corpse Traders
text: Those without breath can't complain.

name: Crow of Dark Tidings
text:
"Well, this can't be a good sign."
—Old Rutstein

name: Death's Approach
text:
"It's cold in the grave, and the dead crave your warmth. Who are you to deny them?"
—Strava, Dimir mage

name: Douse in Gloom
text: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.

name: Drainpipe Vermin
text: When times are tough, the poor eat the rats. When times are tougher, the rats eat the poor.

name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
text: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

name: Dutiful Attendant
text: The dragon who eats the last head in the basket is entitled to the servant's.

name: Eternal Taskmaster
text:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

name: Living Lightning
text: Not all storms come from the sky.

name: Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Exquisite Blood
text: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Festering Newt
text: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

name: Funeral Rites
text: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
text: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

name: Ghoulraiser
text:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Gifted Aetherborn
text: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

name: Gravewaker
text: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

name: Gristle Grinner
text:
"There it was, clawing the ice as it chittered and clicked its teeth. We fled in horror before it unearthed its grisly meal."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Kalastria Nightwatch
text:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Languish
text: Life is such a fragile thing.

name: Last Gasp
text: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.

name: Launch Party
text: Life's too short to not do the things you love.

name: Lawless Broker
text: Kaladesh's illicit marketplaces are known as "night markets," but if you know who to ask, you can find what you're looking for at any time of the day.

name: Liliana's Elite
text:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

name: Macabre Waltz
text: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

name: Malakir Familiar
text:
"They are deadly, and they are loyal. We can spare them a little blood."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Mausoleum Turnkey
text: When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.

name: Miasmic Mummy
text: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Nightshade Stinger
text:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Nyxathid
text: Born of volcanic forces, it thrives on the absolute panic it inspires.

name: Spiteful Prankster
text: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Phyrexian Broodlings
text: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

name: Phyrexian Debaser
text:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

name: Rise of the Dark Realms
text:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Scourge of Nel Toth
text:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Settle the Score
text:
"You bound me with a contract only your death could end—and you thought me the fool?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Shambling Goblin
text:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

name: Slate Street Ruffian
text:
"Merciless to the point of psychosis. Let's give him a job."
—Zelinas, Orzhov recruiter

name: Soul Salvage
text: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

name: Swarm of Bloodflies
text: In the Gudul delta, bloodfly bites are indistinguishable from spear wounds.

name: Tempting Witch
text:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Tithebearer Giant
text:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

name: Vampire Neonate
text: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

name: Wailing Ghoul
text:
"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Act of Treason
text: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

name: Branching Evolution
text:
"Is it the water? The stars? Whatever it is, something incredible is happening here."
—Eris, zoologist, journal entry

name: Ashmouth Hound
text: Its fiery paws make it easy to track, which is very useful when you want to go in exactly the opposite direction.

name: Ball Lightning
text: The most frightening storms are those not woven by nature's hand.

name: Barrage of Expendables
text: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.

name: Bathe in Dragonfire
text: The scent of cooked flesh lingers in the charred landscape of Tarkir.

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Blindblast
text:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Bloodrage Brawler
text: To Hazoret, those who fight for her are her beloved children.

name: Bloodrock Cyclops
text:
"There are only fifty words in the cyclops language, and ten of them mean 'kill.'"
—Ertai

name: Bloodshot Trainee
text: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Borderland Minotaur
text:
"You have led us to triumph over the forces of Mogis!" said Brygus the Brave, clapping the Champion on the back. The Champion wiped the sweat and blood from her brow. "I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."
—*The Theriad*

name: Cinder Elemental
text:
"The old gods awoke and sent fingers of fire to see what was left of the old ways under the endless city."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

name: Collateral Damage
text: It is much easier to create fire than to contain it.

name: Dance with Devils
text: Devils sow chaos and reap panic.

name: Doublecast
text: First the insult, then the encore.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Towering Titan
text: "Knock, knock."

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Fanatical Firebrand
text:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Flame Lash
text: "This is just my warm-up."

name: Flames of the Firebrand
text:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
text: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lightning-Core Excavator
text:
"That's the third time this month it's exploded on site. Maybe we should switch to something a little less defective."
—Kerrin, archaeologist

name: Fling
text: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

name: Flurry of Horns
text: A minotaur does not distinguish between human, satyr, and triton. They are all meat.

name: Forge Devil
text: A bit of pain never hurts.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "It's time for the 'Smash, Smash' song!"

name: Goblin Commando
text: With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.

name: Goblin Instigator
text: "We can take 'em. You go first!"

name: Goblin Lore
text: "The coronation of King Numsgil, no . . . adventures of Tuktuk, no . . . the saga of Morpo the Bard, no! Where's *my* story?"

name: Goblin Rally
text: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Goblin Shortcutter
text: "I'm not running away! I'm figuring out the best routes."

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Heartfire
text: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

name: Hellrider
text:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Homing Lightning
text:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

name: Hungry Flames
text: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Lightning Axe
text: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Lightning Diadem
text: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"Oh, it's easy enough to kill, but I'm not going anywhere near it."
—Norin the Wary

name: Lightning Shrieker
text: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.

name: Magma Jet
text: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Makeshift Munitions
text: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

name: Minotaur Skullcleaver
text:
"Their only dreams are of full stomachs."
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Minotaur Sureshot
text: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

name: Molten Ravager
text:
"Only the foolhardy would venture into the Akoum Mountains without a lullmage to tame the raging rocks and living fires."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Mugging
text: Scream: muffled. Pockets: emptied. Neck function: never the same again.

name: Ornery Goblin
text: "Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."

name: Outnumber
text: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

name: Pillar of Flame
text: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

name: Pyroclastic Elemental
text:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Rageblood Shaman
text:
"I see a spark of pure rage. Soon that spark will spread from the depths of Kragma. Soon its fire will engulf the polis."
—Hira, street oracle

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Sarkhan's Rage
text: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

name: Seismic Elemental
text:
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!"
—Sergeant Ryda

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"Within each of you is the strength of a landslide."
—Kumano, to his pupils

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Tibalt's Rager
text:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

name: Torch Fiend
text: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

name: Volcanic Fallout
text:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

name: Volley Veteran
text: "Fill the sky with stuff!"

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Warfire Javelineer
text: Minotaurs favor magic that manifests as weapons wrapped in flame.

name: Weaver of Lightning
text: "Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Affectionate Indrik
text: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

name: Aggressive Urge
text: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Arbor Armament
text:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Awakener Druid
text: The druids of Mazar treat each seedcone with respect for the warrior it will become.

name: Brindle Shoat
text: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

name: Brushstrider
text: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

name: Carven Caryatid
text: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

name: Dawntreader Elk
text: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

name: Drover of the Mighty
text: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

name: Dwynen's Elite
text: Call one, call them all.

name: Elemental Uprising
text:
"My heart and Zendikar's beat as one. Together we will endure."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Enlarge
text: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Fa'adiyah Seer
text: "My visions don't show me home. They show me where home is yet to be found."

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Feral Invocation
text: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

name: Feral Prowler
text: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Release the Dogs
text: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

name: Ghirapur Guide
text: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

name: Grave Bramble
text: Nature abhors a zombie.

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Initiate's Companion
text:
"I'd like to say that it's our pet, but the reverse may be closer to the truth."
—Ixor, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Ironshell Beetle
text:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

name: Irresistible Prey
text: The baloth's instincts boiled, its muscles pulled taut, and its razor-spines bristled, as it turned to face—a runt meepling.

name: Keeper of Fables
text:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Leaf Gilder
text: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

name: Lifecrafter's Gift
text: The best engineers recognize when a problem has already been solved.

name: Lurking Predators
text: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

name: Momentous Fall
text: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

name: Nature's Way
text: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

name: Nessian Hornbeetle
text:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

name: Orazca Frillback
text: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Penumbra Bobcat
text: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

name: Pouncing Cheetah
text: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Primordial Sage
text: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Rumbling Baloth
text: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

name: Scrounging Bandar
text: "It was right here a second ago . . ."

name: Silhana Wayfinder
text: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

name: Somberwald Stag
text: Despite the reemergence of werewolves and the proliferation of Eldrazi, elk numbers in the Somberwald have remained steady.

name: Soul of the Harvest
text: It's there when a seed sprouts, when gourds ripen on the vines, and when the reapers cut the grains under the Harvest Moon.

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Sylvan Brushstrider
text: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Wall of Vines
text: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Woodborn Behemoth
text: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

name: Zendikar's Roil
text:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Dinrova Horror
text:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Ironroot Warlord
text:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

name: Maelstrom Archangel
text: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

name: Raging Regisaur
text: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Alloy Myr
text: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.

name: Ancestral Statue
text: The mage awakened the statue in hopes of learning the lost lore of her clan, but the statue was interested only in war.

name: Arcane Encyclopedia
text: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

name: Chromatic Sphere
text:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Dragonloft Idol
text: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Gargoyle Sentinel
text:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander

name: Gingerbrute
text: The unlabeled vial was not vanilla extract after all.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Jousting Dummy
text:
"Don't let it fool you. Many of us got our first scars from Syr Nobody."
—Syr Layne, knight of Embereth

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Mana Geode
text:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Marauder's Axe
text: A sharp axe solves most problems.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Perilous Myr
text: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Rogue's Gloves
text: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.

name: Roving Keep
text:
"It wandered slowly across the landscape, calling out in its lonely voice, but no other castles answered its cries."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Scarecrone
text: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

name: Scroll of Avacyn
text: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

name: Scuttlemutt
text: With five lenses on its "head," it sees the world in a range of colors beyond ordinary perception.

name: Signpost Scarecrow
text:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer

name: Skittering Surveyor
text: Like a cross between a spider and a spyglass, but friendlier.

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled *Camouflage and Its Practical Applications*.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Warmonger's Chariot
text: The best defense is a good offense.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Phyrexian Tower
text:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn

name: Steel-Plume Marshal
text: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

name: Stone Haven Pilgrim
text: The persistence to overcome obstacles is the most esteemed of kor virtues.

name: Supply Runners
text: Good dogs stay by your side until the end. Great dogs leave to bring back aid.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

name: Aegis of the Heavens
text: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

name: Trusty Retriever
text: Wipe away the slobber and it's as good as new, give or take a few bite marks.

name: Aerial Assault
text:
"Oh, you must be mistaken. Hawks are solitary hunters, you see."
—Bunder Diedreck, ornithologist

name: Affa Guard Hound
text: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Alabaster Mage
text:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Angel of the Dire Hour
text: She arrived like a meteorite, and the enemy fell in a shock wave of holy vengeance.

name: Angelic Edict
text: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearer.

name: Archon of Justice
text: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

name: Archaeomender
text: "Just as a broken relic can be mended, a shattered history can be made whole."

name: Archon of Redemption
text: Until Emeria is freed, he raises his sword in her name.

name: Battlefield Promotion
text: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

name: Blessed Spirits
text: Not all heroes die in armor.

name: Bulwark Giant
text:
"Where did *she* come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Cathar's Companion
text:
"Unwavering and loyal, they represent stability in uncertain times."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Celestial Mantle
text: Upon such armor, even a mountain would break.

name: Cloudshift
text:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

name: Cradle of Vitality
text: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.

name: Dauntless Onslaught
text:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Aegis of the Gods
text: Athreos cares little for the other gods' conflict with mortals. He is concerned only with safe passage for the dead.

name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
text: It is the soul of a philosopher who died of starvation contemplating the universe.

name: Knowledge and Power
text:
"Information is a powerful weapon."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Lightning Diadem
text: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."

name: Magma Spray
text: The ancient dragon Thraxes sleeps in Purphoros's sacred peak. When he stirs in dreams, so does the mountain.

name: Pensive Minotaur
text:
The Champion and her companions marched through the night, but the battle was over before they arrived. In the middle of the carnage sat a solitary minotaur, lost in what seemed to the Champion to be thought.
—*The Theriad*

name: Prophetic Flamespeaker
text: Fire to destroy. Fire to create.

name: Rollick of Abandon
text:
"Embrace every moment, for it could be your last."
—Xenagos, god of revels

name: Font of Vigor
text: Drink deep, and be restored.

name: Satyr Hoplite
text: "Xenagos has become what he once despised: a tyrant and an oppressor."

name: Sigiled Skink
text: The runes seem to come alive as it moves, rippling like slow flames across its scales.

name: Spawn of Thraxes
text: Sparks from Purphoros's forge fill the belly of every dragon.

name: Starfall
text:
"The most brilliant stars are not born of Nyx."
—Rhexenor, Akroan flamespeaker

name: Bassara Tower Archer
text: Setessan warriors of Bassara Tower are known for their guerrilla tactics and skill with the bow. Interlopers into the Nessian Wood do not get far.

name: Desecration Plague
text:
"The gods think of us as insects. Perhaps there is wisdom in that."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Dictate of Karametra
text: "I refuse to let the folly of mortals endanger the home I made for them."

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Font of Fertility
text: Drink deep, and know the path to the heart of the wilds.

name: Golden Hind
text:
"It is not yours to hunt, mortal. Be content with its beauty alone."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

name: Goldenhide Ox
text: The temptation to take the ox's golden hide is as irresistible as it is fatal.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Humbler of Mortals
text: The anger of the gods multiplied in Nyx, and the land awoke in dark echoes of their rage.

name: Kruphix's Insight
text: The horizon is tantalizing in both its uncertainty and its potential.

name: Harvestguard Alseids
text: Not all shields are forged of iron or bronze.

name: Market Festival
text: Commerce is always the basis for peace.

name: Nature's Panoply
text: Nature protects its own.

name: Oakheart Dryads
text:
"I do not know if the forest was different after they passed. But I know I was."
—Ianthe, Setessan hunter

name: Pheres-Band Thunderhoof
text: "Flesh and bone or star and shadow. It makes no difference to my club."

name: Pheres-Band Warchief
text: The renowned warchiefs of Pheres Band fight with the might of minotaurs and the sagacity of sphinxes.

name: Ravenous Leucrocota
text: Hunger makes a leucrocota dangerous. A full belly makes it angry and dangerous.

name: Renowned Weaver
text: "You think your weaving as beautiful as mine? Let me show you the true meaning of the craft."

name: Reviving Melody
text: "Listen to my song, and you need never forge a golden mask to return to me."

name: Satyr Grovedancer
text: "Some of my kin dance for themselves, without greater purpose. Nylea gives me purpose, and with it strength."

name: Lagonna-Band Trailblazer
text: Go forth with honor, return with glory.

name: Desperate Stand
text: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revived the tactics of Kytheon Iora's infamous irregulars.

name: Revel of the Fallen God
text:
"Xenagos has fallen, and the world grows dark without him. What can ever fill that darkness but our rage?"
—Guruthes, disciple of Xenagos

name: Underworld Coinsmith
text: Coins of the Underworld are shaped from clay funerary masks.

name: Armory of Iroas
text: From a distance the weapons look pristine, but in fact they are tarnished and dented, each as unique as the champion who carried it to battle.

name: Chariot of Victory
text: The greatest heroes are the first to stand, the first to take up arms, and the first to meet the enemy.

name: Leonin Iconoclast
text: "The stars belong in the night sky. This is our world, and we are our own masters."

name: Deserter's Quarters
text: In Akros, the penalty for running from battle is one night's stay in the Deserter's Quarters.

name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
text: Blessed by the gods. Coveted by mortals. Beholden to neither.

name: Hall of Triumph
text: Heroes act without thought of glory or reward. Accolades are a consequence, not a goal.

name: Mana Confluence
text: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.

name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
text: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
text:
After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos. She found that they were quick to take offense, not because they were thin-skinned, but because they were always eager for a fight.
—*The Theriad*

name: Reprisal
text:
"A tiny flame is enough to dispel the night."
—Elspeth

name: Skyspear Cavalry
text: Pray her spear reaches you first. Her griffin is less kind.

name: Stonewise Fortifier
text: Ephara taught some mortals to feel every vein in marble as though it flows with their own blood.

name: Supply-Line Cranes
text: They are trained from hatching to deliver aid where it is needed most.

name: Tethmos High Priest
text: "Death is tyranny. Like all tyranny, it must be opposed."

name: Akroan Mastiff
text: Even when many of the soldiers who guarded Akros were called away, its safety was never in doubt.

name: Cloaked Siren
text:
"That is not the voice of the wind singing on the stones."
—Callaphe the mariner

name: Countermand
text: The physical pain was nothing compared to the agony in his mind.

name: Dakra Mystic
text: Choices are rarely as simple as they seem.

name: Daring Thief
text: Honesty is the first casualty of war.

name: Dictate of Kruphix
text: "Knowledge is cruel. It will break your heart and test your allegiances. Are you certain you want this curse?"

name: Font of Fortunes
text: Drink deep, and your thoughts will flow freely.

name: Godhunter Octopus
text:
"I will match Thassa drop for drop and show a god what true power is."
—Kiora

name: Hubris
text:
"You wish to learn of Nyx? Very well."
—Phenax, god of deception

name: Pin to the Earth
text:
"Mortal strength, like mortal hope, is so easily crushed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

name: Pull from the Deep
text: Ideas, not stones, form the true foundation of Meletis.

name: Riptide Chimera
text:
"I want one."
—Kiora

name: Rise of Eagles
text: An offering to the sea brings an insight from the stars.

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Thassa's Devourer
text: When mortals claim there are places Thassa cannot reach, the sea god laughs.

name: Thassa's Ire
text: The sailor had never seen a god before. Now she had gazed upon Thassa. Shortly she would see Athreos, and then she would meet Erebos.

name: Triton Cavalry
text: The tritons broke the surface, and the Nyxborn broke ranks.

name: Triton Shorestalker
text: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."

name: War-Wing Siren
text: Once she sang sailors to their doom. Now she leads them to glory.

name: Whitewater Naiads
text: Stand against the crash of the river's rapids and you will know the power of the naiads.

name: Agent of Erebos
text: Erebos's minions hunt the Returned and warn those who consider the same folly.

name: Dawnbringer Charioteers
text: "Nyx may belong to the gods, but the skies of Theros are ours."

name: Aspect of Gorgon
text:
"My adopted children are loved no less."
—Pharika, god of affliction

name: Cast into Darkness
text: In desperation the soldier prayed to Phenax, begging for the power to cheat the gorgon's gaze.

name: Dictate of Erebos
text: "I take no pleasure in your suffering, but it is necessary. Once you accept your fate you'll find eternity more tolerable."

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Extinguish All Hope
text: Phenax offers the hope of life, while Pharika grants the solace of death. Between them stands Erebos, who promises nothing but eternity.

name: Feast of Dreams
text: "We gave the gods the power to war against us. It is time we took that power back."

name: Deicide
text:
"It is done."
—Elspeth

name: Felhide Petrifier
text: It's common practice among minotaurs to collect the heads of their victims as trophies. Sometimes the trophies prove more than ornamental.

name: Font of Return
text: Drink deep, and death will recoil from you.

name: Grim Guardian
text: Occasionally the living wander to the Rivers, but the wardens of Athreos ensure that only the dead pass.

name: Master of the Feast
text: Any pleasure, when taken to excess, becomes torment. It's a formula that demons have perfected.

name: Nightmarish End
text:
"To think some believe it peaceful to die in one's sleep."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

name: Nyx Infusion
text: A balm or a poison depending on how it is administered, and to whom.

name: Pharika's Chosen
text: The serpents' dens built into statues of Pharika serve not only to consecrate her temples, but as a hidden line of defense.

name: Returned Reveler
text: The flesh is dead and the life forgotten, but old habits persist.

name: Dictate of Heliod
text:
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?"
—Polyxene the Doubter

name: Ritual of the Returned
text: A mask forged to avenge a death forgotten.

name: Rotted Hulk
text:
The hulk rose from the sea and loomed over the Champion. Pinned beneath the twisting, rotted planks of wood was the body of Kaliaros, the helmsman of her former crew, and beside him the captain, Photine.
—*The Theriad*

name: Spiteful Blow
text:
"Only a fool takes Phenax at his word. What do you expect from a god born of lies and betrayal?"
—Verenes, priest of Iroas

name: Squelching Leeches
text: Leeches are sacred to followers of Pharika for drawing poison from a wound, but feared by everyone else for drawing blood from the flesh.

name: Thoughtrender Lamia
text: Some predators can sense fear in their prey, but the lamia is drawn to madness.

name: Tormented Thoughts
text:
"Not all nightmares can be escaped by waking."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

name: Worst Fears
text: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

name: Akroan Line Breaker
text: The enemies' shields are the first to shatter, and their battle line is never far behind.

name: Bearer of the Heavens
text: To hold the heavens from the earth is no curse, but a titanic responsibility.

name: Eagle of the Watch
text:
"Even from miles away, I could see our eagles circling. That's when I gave the command to pick up the pace. I knew we were needed at home."
—Kanlos, Akroan captain

name: Bladetusk Boar
text: Deathbellow Canyon is home to minotaurs and many other creatures that share a love for the taste of human flesh.

name: Cyclops of Eternal Fury
text:
"The anger that festers inside this one is contagious."
—Anthousa of Setessa

name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
text: Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.

name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
text: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.

name: Flurry of Horns
text: A minotaur does not distinguish between human, satyr, and triton. They are all meat.

name: Font of Ire
text: Drink deep, and find your vengeance fulfilled.

name: Forgeborn Oreads
text: Purphoros shaped the oreads out of stray coals from his forge.

name: Gluttonous Cyclops
text: The cyclops had learned to never eat a shepherd. Instead he gently flung the "pit" aside to grow a new flock.

name: Ancestor's Chosen
text: Empowered by generations of strength.

name: Funeral Pyre
text:
"Raze the body. Raise the soul."
—Mystic elder

name: Spellgorger Barbarian
text: The epidemic insanity had a lasting effect on certain barbarians—but no one noticed.

name: Swelter
text: No circle has a beginning, but many have foreseeable ends.

name: Swirling Sandstorm
text: As dust swept out, vultures swept in.

name: Anurid Barkripper
text: When it croaks, so do you.

name: Anurid Swarmsnapper
text: Anurids have the problem of airborne invaders licked.

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Glory
text:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Elephant Guide
text: Nature's strength outlives the strong.

name: Epic Struggle
text:
"If our foes will not listen to words, perhaps hooves and claws will make them take notice."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Erhnam Djinn
text: He provides a safe path to nowhere.

name: Exoskeletal Armor
text:
"We use only what we need—but in times of strife, our need becomes great."
—Centaur warrior

name: Folk Medicine
text: Sometimes the healers need healing.

name: Forcemage Advocate
text: "Our unity renews our strength."

name: Genesis
text:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Giant Warthog
text:
"When the Ancestor saw the cruelty her human children were capable of, Her fury shook the world. From this outburst sprang the warthogs."
—Nomad myth

name: Golden Wish
text: She wished for nobility, but not for a nation to honor it.

name: Harvester Druid
text: "In the end, the same soil lies atop the field, within the mountain, and under the sea."

name: Ironshell Beetle
text:
"Why waste time creating weapons? Nature provides us with all we need."
—Centaur warrior

name: Krosan Wayfarer
text:
"The Krosan Forest lives, and druids are its seeds."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Living Wish
text: He wished for growth, but not for a way to control it.

name: Nantuko Tracer
text:
Your past is a map to where you will go.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nullmage Advocate
text: "Our unity unmasks your deceit."

name: Guided Strike
text:
"May the Ancestor strengthen my hand and guide my blade."
—Nomad war prayer

name: Seedtime
text:
The hippo grows wings to fight the condor.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Serene Sunset
text: The armies paused, silent, as the warriors reflected on the sunsets of their youth.

name: Sudden Strength
text: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

name: Sylvan Safekeeper
text:
"How could someone so small cause so much trouble?"
—Nomad sentry

name: Thriss, Nantuko Primus
text: "When you live for others, you live for yourself."

name: Tunneler Wurm
text: If an anurid's lucky, it'll find a warm tunnel for bedtime. If a wurm's lucky, it'll find a warm anurid for breakfast.

name: Venomous Vines
text:
"True strength comes from within. The false promise of unnatural power only incurs Krosa's wrath."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Anurid Brushhopper
text: It's so tough it can frighten *itself* into hiding.

name: Hunting Grounds
text: In the heavy hush of Krosa, drawing on mana is like ringing a dinner bell.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

name: Lead Astray
text:
"Never underestimate our enemy's strength, brutality, . . . or stupidity."
—Commander Eesha

name: Nomad Mythmaker
text: Nomads weave tales thicker than tapestries.

name: Pulsemage Advocate
text: "Our unity revives our hopes."

name: Ray of Revelation
text: Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.

name: Shieldmage Advocate
text: "Our unity conquers all fears."

name: Silver Seraph
text: A symbol of hope for hopeless times.

name: Spirit Cairn
text: It marks the border between here and hereafter.

name: Spurnmage Advocate
text: "Our unity humbles our foes."

name: Suntail Hawk
text:
"Our forebears once flew like this—carefree, needing nothing but a warm nest and a full belly. Our intellect may be more burden than blessing."
—Commander Eesha

name: Test of Endurance
text:
"If we have learned nothing else, we have learned to survive."
—Mystic elder

name: Trained Pronghorn
text:
"The desert asked the Ancestor for children, and the antelope were born."
—Nomad myth

name: Unquestioned Authority
text:
"Only the Ancestor should be revered."
—Mystic heretic

name: Valor
text:
"The cracks widened, the shell crumbled, and Valor spread throughout the land."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Aven Fogbringer
text: "I cover the land with blankets and it sleeps."

name: Cephalid Constable
text: Cephalids don't police people. They police loyalties.

name: Cephalid Inkshrouder
text: Cephalids shrink from the harsh glare of scrutiny.

name: Cunning Wish
text: He wished for knowledge, but not for the will to apply it.

name: Defy Gravity
text: Magical or not, it's still a cloud.

name: Envelop
text:
"What you made will be unmade. What you learned will be unlearned. And when you're done, you will be undone."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Battlewise Aven
text: Experience is a good teacher, not a kind one.

name: Grip of Amnesia
text:
"Would you abandon your past to save your future?"
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Hapless Researcher
text: Scholars possess such lofty knowledge that it shouldn't be surprising when they fall.

name: Keep Watch
text: "I see their moral dilemmas. I see their raw courage. I see their self-sacrifice. I see our victory."

name: Laquatus's Disdain
text: "The first time was amusing, but now you're getting tiresome."

name: Mental Note
text: Some minds are more open than others.

name: Mirror Wall
text:
"Breaking it would be about four hundred years bad luck."
—Nomad sentry

name: Quiet Speculation
text:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

name: Benevolent Bodyguard
text: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

name: Telekinetic Bonds
text:
"Nature's been fired. The oceans are under new management."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Web of Inertia
text: Cephalids specialize in lose-lose situations.

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Wormfang Newt
text: Spawned by mages emulating the insane.

name: Border Patrol
text:
"We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more."
—Commander Eesha

name: Wormfang Turtle
text: Chainer's admirers keep his dreams alive.

name: Balthor the Defiled
text: He remembers enough of his life to weep for what he has lost.

name: Cabal Trainee
text:
"Ah, a faceshredder. Very rare. Nearly unstoppable. Good luck!"
—Cabal instructor

name: Death Wish
text: He wished for power, but not for the longevity to abuse it.

name: Earsplitting Rats
text: Rats come in one amount: too many.

name: Filth
text:
"As the portal closed, Filth oozed through. The stench of evil followed it in."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Grave Consequences
text:
"You call *that* a nightmare?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Cagemail
text:
"Power often costs too high a price."
—Commander Eesha

name: Morality Shift
text: The mind sings, though at times it sings a dirge.

name: Rats' Feast
text:
"That does it—I quit!"
—Cabal grave robber

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Arcane Teachings
text: Dwarves may teach at the speed of stone, but their results are solid.

name: Barbarian Bully
text: "Out of my way!"

name: Chastise
text:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

name: Book Burning
text: The wizard's spellbook was full of burning questions.

name: Breaking Point
text: "Enough!"

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Burning Wish
text: She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.

name: Dwarven Bloodboiler
text: His battle cry unleashes an avalanche of dwarves.

name: Dwarven Driller
text:
"Drill the planet, it's no trouble: Mining granite, making rubble."
—Dwarven drilling song

name: Dwarven Scorcher
text: Barbarians invented the blaze of glory. Dwarves perfected it.

name: Ember Shot
text: Dwarves bring poor coal to market, use good coal in their homes, and throw their best coal away.

name: Flaring Pain
text:
"I don't rub salt in wounds. I use sulfur."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Commander Eesha
text: "War glides on the simplest updrafts while peace struggles against hurricane winds. It is the way of the world. It must change."

name: Goretusk Firebeast
text: As a youth, Kamahl took one for a pet. His hair has yet to grow back.

name: Jeska, Warrior Adept
text: "My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge. Kamahl has a temper of fire. I have a temper of steel."

name: Liberated Dwarf
text: Freed from their chains, these dwarves are bound only by honor.

name: Waterspout Djinn
text:
"Fly us higher, out of its storm."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Spire Golem
text: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Martyr of Frost
text:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Counterspell
text: The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Gush
text: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

name: Flamekin Brawler
text: When he hits people, they stay hit.

name: Fireslinger
text:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Soulbright Flamekin
text: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

name: Pyre Charger
text: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Oxidda Golem
text: The longer it patrols the smoldering crags of the Oxidda Chain, the more it adopts their fiery temper.

name: Firebolt
text: Reach out and torch someone.

name: Seal of Fire
text: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

name: Incinerate
text: "Who said there are no assurances in life? I assure you this is going to hurt."

name: Flame Javelin
text: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Ruthless Winnower
text: "I count the usurpers with my dagger, one death blow at a time."

name: Marble Diamond
text: The essence of sunlight to brighten the way.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Sky Diamond
text: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Cryptic Caves
text: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

name: Serpent's Soul-Jar
text: The coils spiral like time itself, carrying spirits back around from death to reawakening.

name: Foul Orchard
text: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Bounty of Skemfar
text: Even war cannot dull Skemfar's beauty.

name: Crown of Skemfar
text: Lathril, queen of the ancient Einir, left a powerful legacy for her mortal descendants.

name: Wolverine Riders
text: "We'll break their lines. The rest of you, follow!"

name: Elderfang Venom
text: "The Cosmos Serpent favored us with his venom. As thanks, we sink fangs into those who dishonor the old ways."

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Eerie Interlude
text: The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Ghostly Flicker
text: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

name: Mist Raven
text:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Synthetic Destiny
text: To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.

name: Windfall
text: "Rich" is a relative term.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Eyeblight Cullers
text:
"As long as eyeblights exist, the hunt will never end."
—Miara, Thorn of the Glade

name: Eyeblight Massacre
text:
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"
—Nissa Revane, to Dwynen

name: Lys Alana Scarblade
text: In beauty-obsessed Lys Alana, one cut of her blade means the difference between a high society feast and raking through the dungheap for scraps.

name: Miara, Thorn of the Glade
text: "Approach from downwind. Tread with care. Aim for the heart."

name: Pride of the Perfect
text: Like moonglove's flowers, the greatest beauty often masks the greatest dangers.

name: Prowess of the Fair
text: An elvish duel is a thing of beauty: the warriors' grace, the crash of steel, then the artful spray of blood.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
text: "This is our land. We will not allow eyeblights to poison its beauty."

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Promenade
text: The faultless and immaculate castes form the lower tiers of elvish society, with the exquisite caste above them. At the pinnacle is the perfect, a consummate blend of aristocrat and predator.

name: End-Raze Forerunners
text:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Harvest Season
text: A true reflection of nature: death fostering life.

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Lys Alana Huntmaster
text: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air, and all who hear it feel its pull.

name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
text: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Nullmage Shepherd
text: The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting their scorn poles. The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.

name: Numa, Joraga Chieftain
text: His blade carves a path for his people. His words guide them along it.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Rhys the Exiled
text: Once a famed hunter and packmaster, now a renegade seeking his own path.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: "If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."

name: Voice of Many
text: His words echo every roar, screech, and howl of the wilds.

name: Voice of the Woods
text: "Ancient ones, I call on you, your wisdom and your power, your will to claim again all that is rightfully yours."

name: Wirewood Channeler
text: "Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Abomination of Llanowar
text: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Empyrean Eagle
text: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

name: Golgari Findbroker
text: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Pact of the Serpent
text: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"

name: Poison-Tip Archer
text: "One more step and you're mine."

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Shaman of the Pack
text: To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.

name: Soulherder
text: It watches over every absence.

name: Thunderclap Wyvern
text: Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.

name: Twinblade Assassins
text: Rumors swirl of a pair of deadly Golgari assassins known only as the Left and Right Hands of the Ochran.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Axgard Braggart
text: "Heavy? Ha! The Trollking of Mossrun was heavy, and I tossed him five miles!"

name: Doomskar Oracle
text: "Giants and monsters loom on the horizon, and the elves plan to murder our gods!"

name: Karfell Kennel-Master
text: Trapped in a realm of dead flesh and scarce hunting, the ravenous wolves of Karfell follow the Dread Marn to warm game.

name: Koma's Faithful
text: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

name: Poison the Cup
text: Dark schemes cut down what armies cannot.

name: Raise the Draugr
text: "King Narfi calls. We go to war!"

name: Skemfar Avenger
text: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.

name: Giant Ox
text:
"How strong is he? Well, I once lost control of the plow, and he carved a furrow right through my house! Didn't even slow down."
—Guldir, Beskir farmer

name: Tergrid, God of Fright
text: Fear is her one true companion.

name: Tergrid's Shadow
text: Tergrid, god of fright, never acknowledges her own shadow . . . or its murderous deeds.

name: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire
text: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

name: Vengeful Reaper
text: "Starnheim is closed to you, coward."

name: Village Rites
text: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed totems of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.

name: Weigh Down
text: The draugr often drown intruders. Years later, their corpses rise from the depths to join the ranks of the Dread Marn.

name: Withercrown
text:
"We'll see each other again soon."
—Egon, god of death

name: Arni Brokenbrow
text: "I headbutted a troll. And won."

name: Axgard Cavalry
text:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
text: "This is a tale to make all Kaldheim tremble..."

name: Breakneck Berserker
text: "Go for the knees! The last giant who tried to get past us got rolled back down the mountain in a dozen pieces."

name: Calamity Bearer
text: He'd ignite the World Tree itself if he could.

name: Cinderheart Giant
text: What fire giants lack in arcane prowess, they make up for with reckless, explosive rage.

name: Craven Hulk
text: Abandoned at birth, the giant was raised by goats. Ironically, it grew up to be the most cautious member of the herd.

name: Demon Bolt
text:
"Burn them from the sky."
—Varragoth

name: Gods' Hall Guardian
text: Not a single rat has been seen in Istfell since the gods moved in.

name: Dwarven Reinforcements
text: "Orders? We don't wait for orders!"

name: Fearless Liberator
text: "No one else had the spine for it, so I ran right between that giant's legs and hauled poor Valdir back to Axgard!"

name: Fearless Pup
text: "Awooo!"

name: Frenzied Raider
text: "Arrogant maggot. You won't be so proud when I rip out your tongue and drink from your skull!"

name: Frost Bite
text:
"Don't wander far—it's a bit nippy out there!"
—Leidurr, expedition leader

name: Goldmaw Champion
text: "That was nothing. I once took down a frost giant with a spoon!"

name: Hagi Mob
text: "Graarg!"

name: Immersturm Raider
text: The demons took no captives and claimed no spoils; they sought only to destroy.

name: Provoke the Trolls
text:
"I like burning and pillaging as much as anyone, but sometimes it's just easier to throw a rock and let the trolls do the work."
—Urik, Tuskeri raid leader

name: Reckless Crew
text: "Boat's burning! Row faster!"

name: Run Amok
text:
"A Tuskeri never shrinks from battle! Quite the opposite in fact."
—Arni Brokenbrow

name: Seize the Spoils
text: "Grab what you want and burn the rest. Leave nothing behind."

name: Shackles of Treachery
text: In that instant, Toralf felt only the power of the storm and the need to destroy.

name: Smashing Success
text:
"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"
—Magda, brazen outlaw

name: Squash
text: The troll had recently crushed a human in much the same way. Sadly, he expired too quickly to appreciate the irony.

name: Tundra Fumarole
text: The only thing that smells worse than troll is burnt troll.

name: Tuskeri Firewalker
text: "Toralf blessed me with fire. I am worthy of Starnheim!"

name: Vault Robber
text: The dwarves believe works of art should be passed down the generations, not buried with the dead.

name: Arachnoform
text: Deep within endless webs of clinging silk, the weaver awaits.

name: Invoke the Divine
text: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."

name: Blessing of Frost
text: A friend of Jorn is never cold.

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—*Saga of the Wisdom Seeker*

name: Elderleaf Mentor
text: "Our ancestors grew complacent in their divinity, allowing their lessers to topple them. Never again."

name: Esika, God of the Tree
text: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."

name: Iron Verdict
text: "You'll raid nothing but mist in Istfell."

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
text: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

name: Glittering Frost
text: At last, the storm's rage subsided, leaving silent, frozen beauty in its wake.

name: Gnottvold Recluse
text: Fed up with webs impeding travelers in other realms, Kolvori banished the giant spiders to Gnottvold, where their webs snare only the occasional rampaging troll.

name: Grizzled Outrider
text: "Sure, a horse might be faster. But I'd like to see a horse take the head clean off a troll in one swipe!"

name: Guardian Gladewalker
text: The raiders' only warning was a whisper floating through the mist: "Trespassers."

name: Horizon Seeker
text: "A five-day climb? Ha! I'll do it in two."

name: Icehide Troll
text: A troll's greatest weapon is its ability to emerge unexpectedly from the landscape.

name: Jaspera Sentinel
text: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.

name: Jorn, God of Winter
text: "Wherever snow falls, I am home."

name: Kaya's Onslaught
text: "Your trail ends here."

name: King Harald's Revenge
text: "We will destroy the pretenders and reclaim the divinity of the Einir."

name: Littjara Glade-Warden
text: In every tree, a restless spirit.

name: Mammoth Growth
text: Thus the longhall became a flathall.

name: Ravenous Lindwurm
text:
"I'm no coward, but I'd sooner tangle with a rampaging Torga troll than a hungry lindwurm!"
—Yegar, Beskir warrior

name: Rootless Yew
text:
"We are bound to wander this forest forever. Sometimes I think it wanders with us."
—Ogni, Kannah scout

name: Master Skald
text: "All my scars have stories to tell."

name: Roots of Wisdom
text: Though imprisoned in Jaspera trees, the elvish gods known as the Einir still whisper through the ages.

name: Sculptor of Winter
text: "I and my kin remember the old ways. The frost whispers to me in a language too ancient for the Skoti usurpers to comprehend."

name: Snakeskin Veil
text: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

name: Battershield Warrior
text: "I need no axe to best these weaklings."

name: Rally the Ranks
text: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single, devastating force.

name: Firja, Judge of Valor
text: She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.

name: Koll, the Forgemaster
text: Using tyrite from a fallen Cosmos monster, Koll forged a weapon to awe Halvar himself.

name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
text: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

name: Narfi, Betrayer King
text: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

name: Revitalize
text: Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.

name: Vega, the Watcher
text: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

name: Cosmos Elixir
text: The Skoti owe their immortality to the elixir, and the manner of its creation is their most closely guarded secret.

name: Funeral Longboat
text:
"Cast onto the windless water, he drifted until the sea turned to sky."
—*Saga of the Lost King*

name: Raven Wings
text:
"There are some places even our ships cannot travel. I would know their secrets too."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

name: Scorn Effigy
text: It remembers every wound it has seen or suffered—and nothing else.

name: Alpine Meadow
text:
"Here perished Rognar the Reckless after his hundred-day battle with the Ironmaw Dragon. We raised these stones to mark his resting place."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Arctic Treeline
text:
"When the Light of Starnheim shines here, every frost-edged needle glitters with the reflected glory of the Cosmos."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Barkchannel Pathway
text:
"Listen! The trees tell tales of their ancestors in the whisper-song of leaves."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

name: Blightstep Pathway
text:
"The waters smell oddly sweet, but do not be enticed. You don't want to meet what lurks below the surface."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior

name: Darkbore Pathway
text:
"Hush, and stay still. No matter how dreary the darkness, a light in the Skelle Mire is never a good sign."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder

name: Faceless Haven
text: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.

name: Glacial Floodplain
text:
"A cliff once rose from the surf here—until Bjora Dawn-Greeter declared that it was blocking her view and pulled it down bare-handed."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Hengegate Pathway
text:
"I cannot read these runes, yet somehow they seem like a warning. Have we passed unknowingly into a new realm?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator

name: Highland Forest
text:
"Tread carefully! The last time I walked this path, half the snowdrifts were, in fact, sleeping trolls. I've never run so fast in my life!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Ice Tunnel
text:
"The ice cracked underfoot; strange shapes swam beneath the surface. Who else has walked this blighted path?"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Rimewood Falls
text:
"For a fortnight, our warband lay still beneath the icy waters, breathing through reeds as we waited for the great bear to appear."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Shimmerdrift Vale
text: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

name: Snowfield Sinkhole
text:
