"Young Vitima bellowed to the Cosmos, daring the gods to punish her hubris! Well, she got their attention, as you can see."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Sulfurous Mire
text:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Volatile Fjord
text:
"I watched with my own eyes as Jari Eagle-Caller fell from these cliffs, only to be snatched from the air by a giant bird!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Woodland Chasm
text:
"Is this the grave of a god? A tunnel carved by the Cosmos Serpent? It matters not. It is no place for us."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Sigrid, God-Favored
text: Never alone, never afraid.

name: Battlefield Raptor
text: It wheeled upward, away from the shrieks and thunder. It reached the point where sky met smoke, and, with but a glance at the horizon, aimed itself and dove.

name: Stalwart Valkyrie
text: "Only the worthy may pass."

name: Starnheim Courser
text: Every worthy warrior who arrives in Starnheim is gifted a mount befitting their heroism, a mighty pegasus raised and trained by the valkyries.

name: Story Seeker
text: Dwarven skalds are the most renowned storytellers in all of Kaldheim. They travel across the realms, seeking out heroic deeds and chronicling them in epic sagas.

name: Usher of the Fallen
text: "I have led ten thousand through these mists and never lost the way."

name: Valor of the Worthy
text: "If I am to die, let it be a hero's death!"

name: Valkyrie Harbinger
text: Where she flies, the Light of Starnheim shines.

name: Cleaving Reaper
text: "I won't pollute my blade with your blood, demon. You'll die by your own axe!"

name: Surtland Flinger
text: Victory before camaraderie.

name: Canopy Tactician
text: "Death and life are two ends of the same spear."

name: Armed and Armored
text: The dwarves of Axgard seldom have reason to leave their impregnable underground kingdom—but when they do, they go in force.

name: Warhorn Blast
text: "Mead down! Swords up!"

name: Starnheim Aspirant
text: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

name: Warchanter Skald
text: "Who will be the hero of my tale?"

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

name: Giant's Grasp
text: "Behave and you'll be a fine pet. Bite me and you're ammunition."

name: Elderfang Ritualist
text: Her fingers stiffened as the shrouded corpse stirred. Her final, ragged breath was one of triumph. "Return, my chosen, and grant our people victory!"

name: Bearded Axe
text: Every dwarven artisan spends the first hundred years of their life forging a single weapon and infusing it with runic magic.

name: Fire Giant's Fury
text: So ended the feast, the hall, and the clan.

name: Wings of the Cosmos
text: The wolf's startled yelp changed quickly to a howl of elation as she soared over her envious packmates.

name: Elven Ambush
text:
"No elf can match a Tuskeri in combat. Why not charge?"
—Knorjolvin, Tuskeri raider

name: Gladewalker Ritualist
text: "We are all."

name: Rampage of the Valkyries
text: "This is a foul place. Cleanse it."

name: Beskir Shieldmate
text: "If we fall today, let us fall with honor, defending our realm from the horrors that would defile it. Forward, shieldmates! To Starnheim!"

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Usher of the Fallen
text: "I have led ten thousand through these mists and never lost the way."

name: Strategic Planning
text: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.

name: Poison the Cup
text: Dark schemes cut down what armies cannot.

name: Frost Bite
text:
"Don't wander far—it's a bit nippy out there!"
—Leidurr, expedition leader

name: Annul
text:
"Many giants have tried to crush me with their hammers. You'll never stop me with that little toy."
—Stigur of the Omenseekers

name: Augury Raven
text: Some ravens collect shiny baubles; others hoard omens and secrets.

name: Behold the Multiverse
text: Countless worlds unfolded before Niko, every one in need of heroes.

name: Bind the Monster
text: Sarulf's snarl of rage shook the World Tree.

name: Brinebarrow Intruder
text: Locked in the ice of Karfell, the treasures of ancient nobles await in ruins guarded by the dead.

name: Bound in Gold
text:
"Trespassers will be smelted."
—Axgard inscription

name: Cyclone Summoner
text: Frost giants study for centuries in isolation, honing their ability to harness elemental mayhem.

name: Depart the Realm
text: "My home calls to me, I must go."

name: Disdainful Stroke
text:
"The skald boasted that he could outsing the sea. Cosima heard him, and drowned his village with a single wave."
—*Longbeard Saga*

name: Draugr Thought-Thief
text: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.

name: Frost Augur
text: From the barest crack in the ice, she teases forth a swirling, living map of the Cosmos.

name: Frostpeak Yeti
text: Some heroes line their coats with yeti fur. More yetis line their bellies with heroes.

name: Clarion Spirit
text: To the living, the horn sounds faint and mournful, but to the spirits of Istfell, it is a thunderous call that must be obeyed.

name: Graven Lore
text: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

name: Icebind Pillar
text:
"Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"
—Tibalt

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
text: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

name: Karfell Harbinger
text: "This is a realm of the living. King Narfi's legion is coming to change that."

name: Littjara Kinseekers
text: Like calls to like, and none are forgotten.

name: Mists of Littjara
text: The Skelle raiders boasted that nothing could stop them, certainly not a bit of fog.

name: Mistwalker
text:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

name: Codespell Cleric
text: "Today we are not Beskir or Tuskeri. We must fight as one clan, shoulder to shoulder, to defend our rightful home!"

name: Pilfering Hawk
text:
"Well, at least it left us a mouse in exchange. Er . . . ugh . . . make that half a mouse."
—Binhald, Beskir veteran

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Run Ashore
text:
"Which one of you slug-brained milksops forgot to make an offering to Cosima?"
—Jolkur, navigator

name: Saw It Coming
text: "How predictable."

name: Strategic Planning
text: Alrund sees the future as a whorl of signs and symbols, omens interwoven in an intricate knotwork only he can decipher.

name: Undersea Invader
text:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

name: Divine Gambit
text: There are rules, and then there are gods.

name: Bloodsky Berserker
text: "Who's next?!"

name: Crippling Fear
text: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

name: Deathknell Berserker
text:
"Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again."
—*Longbeard Saga*

name: Demonic Gifts
text: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

name: Dogged Pursuit
text: Kaya had stalked countless horrific foes, but never one that killed with such callous precision and twisted creativity.

name: Draugr Recruiter
text: "You cannot stand against us, but when you fall, you will stand with us!"

name: Dread Rider
text:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder

name: Doomskar
text: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.

name: Duskwielder
text: "My shadow alone will slay you."

name: Egon, God of Death
text: Egon ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.

name: Elderfang Disciple
text: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."

name: Feed the Serpent
text: He spent the final moments of his existence tumbling down the length of the serpent's jaws, driven mad by the magnitude of the Cosmos.

name: Grim Draugr
text: She was a ragged shadow of her living form, but she had lost none of her deadly prowess.

name: Hailstorm Valkyrie
text: When the path to Starnheim was opened, vengeance rained down upon the enemies of Bretagard.

name: Infernal Pet
text:
"Here, my pet. Another little light for you to snuff out."
—Kzarakh, Immersturm gamekeeper

name: Acrobatic Maneuver
text: Renegades find ever more creative ways to work around the Consulate's aether regulations.

name: Subtle Strike
text: Renegades do some of their best work right under the Consulate's nose.

name: Syndicate Trafficker
text: "The price isn't negotiable, but I'm sure you'll agree it's fair."

name: Thriving Rats
text: In Ghirapur, even the lowliest residents live in lavish surroundings.

name: Tidy Conclusion
text: Aetherborn patrons use any means necessary to secure victory for their protégés.

name: Weaponcraft Enthusiast
text:
"No, I don't believe they have the proper permits for those, but I'm not going to be the one to ask."
—Caru, Consulate warden

name: Brazen Scourge
text: Driven by an insatiable hunger, gremlins never cease feeding. They can destroy a lifetime of work in just a few moments.

name: Built to Smash
text: Free from Consulate regulations, renegade-built automatons push performance to the limit.

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
text: "This one's for my mom, and this one's for me."

name: Demolish
text: Most came to Ghirapur for the Fair. Gremlins came for the feast.

name: Fateful Showdown
text: Tonight at the Grand Exhibition, witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar.

name: Furious Reprisal
text:
"Now that's the Chandra I've been waiting to see."
—Liliana Vess

name: Giant Spectacle
text: The giant-decorating contest at the migration festival is a tradition that may have started as a dare.

name: Hijack
text: "Whoa there. Easy. We're just going to take a little detour."

name: Incendiary Sabotage
text: "All of those Consulate safety measures undone with one simple tweak."

name: Inventor's Apprentice
text:
"Everyone starts off making garbage. If you finally make something halfway decent, it'll be the best day of your life."
—Nehra, inventor

name: Maulfist Doorbuster
text: "Knock, knock . . . too late."

name: Quicksmith Genius
text: Quicksmiths are eager to jump from one project to the next, relying on flashes of inspiration rather than careful research.

name: Reckless Fireweaver
text: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

name: Renegade Tactics
text: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

name: Ruinous Gremlin
text: City officials once sent twenty gleaming automatons to exterminate a nest of gremlins. They soon saw the error of their ways.

name: Salivating Gremlins
text: If an elf can dream it, a dwarf can build it, and a gremlin can eat it.

name: Fairgrounds Warden
text: "You're coming with me."

name: Spark of Creativity
text:
"To invent is to rebel."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Speedway Fanatic
text: If her vehicle even has a brake, she couldn't tell you which pedal it is.

name: Spireside Infiltrator
text: "The Consulate promised that we would all have access to aether. I'm just keeping them honest."

name: Spontaneous Artist
text: Graffiti of the "leaking spire" symbol is found wherever the renegades have been.

name: Start Your Engines
text: Inventors from around the world have come to the Fair hoping their creations will fly, drive, or sail their way to a top prize.

name: Territorial Gorger
text: Inventors have been known to capture gremlins with the intent to release them in a rival's workshop. More often than not, that plan backfires.

name: Terror of the Fairgrounds
text:
"Consider this a high alert, people. Permission to destroy on sight. Either we take it down or it'll take down the Fair."
—Pav, gremlin watch

name: Thriving Grubs
text: Some passengers ride without tickets.

name: Wayward Giant
text:
"The giants follow the flow of aether, and twice a year it leads them through here. Lesson learned. More clearance is needed."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Fragmentize
text:
"Too much friction on your bearings, your countersinking is inconsistent, and there are lines in your casting. Dispose of it, and begin again."
—Dovin Baan

name: Welding Sparks
text:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Appetite for the Unnatural
text:
"I'd just let the monkey have it if I were you. You can make another, but the same can't be said of your fingers."
—Turni, Greenwheel groundskeeper

name: Arborback Stomper
text: The power of aether draws creatures to it like a magnetic force, and those that are touched by it are forever altered.

name: Architect of the Untamed
text: Next to her designs, life seems like a pale imitation.

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Attune with Aether
text: "I've never seen a world where aether weaves through every aspect of nature."

name: Blossoming Defense
text: Those who move harmoniously with the flow of aether can channel the power of the natural world.

name: Commencement of Festivities
text: Never before have there been so many brilliant minds and wondrous inventions in one place. Denizens from every corner of Kaladesh will flock to the once-in-a-lifetime Inventors' Fair.

name: Cowl Prowler
text: Consulate guards who pursue fleeing renegades into the Cowl often become lost—occasionally permanently—in the city's wildest greenbelt.

name: Fumigate
text:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Creeping Mold
text: Sanctions, mandates, regulations . . . These things mean nothing to the natural world.

name: Fairgrounds Trumpeter
text: The louder the elephant trumpeted, the more the crowd cheered. And the more the crowd cheered . . .

name: Ghirapur Guide
text: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

name: Hunt the Weak
text: Natural evolution is often at odds with industrial progress.

name: Kujar Seedsculptor
text: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

name: Gearshift Ace
text: Some display their trophies at the Hall of Mechanists. Others display their talent in the streets of Ghirapur.

name: Larger Than Life
text:
"They say Head Judge Tezzeret will be reviewing every invention at the Fair. I made sure to build something that will stand out."
—Jehvani, Vahadar artificer

name: Longtusk Cub
text: It won't be small forever.

name: Nature's Way
text: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

name: Ornamental Courage
text: Inspired by the thorns and brambles of the untamed wilds, elvish armor is both beautiful and formidable.

name: Oviya Pashiri, Sage Lifecrafter
text: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."

name: Peema Outrider
text: Connected as artificer and invention, bonded as rider and steed.

name: Sage of Shaila's Claim
text: Even now, Shaila's descendants proudly occupy the greenway that she refused to relinquish to the Consulate.

name: Servant of the Conduit
text: "Creation without connection to nature is just manufacture."

name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
text: "Shine bright, bolts tight."

name: Take Down
text: The drake flew true. The arrow flew truer.

name: Thriving Rhino
text: As unpredictable as aether, and just as hard to contain.

name: Wild Wanderer
text: "We all began in nature, and nature is where we belong."

name: Wildest Dreams
text:
"I opened my mind to the immensity of the wonders around me. It was only then that I could see the Great Conduit."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Wily Bandar
text: Part feline, part primate, all trouble.

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Contraband Kingpin
text: "Don't waste my time with trifles. Bring me works of art, and I will make you rich."

name: Herald of the Fair
text: "Welcome, one and all! Right this way! Open your eyes, your ears, and your imaginations to the wonders of the Inventors' Fair!"

name: Empyreal Voyager
text: "For years, I studied the aethersphere from afar, but it was not until I touched the aether for myself that I came to know the power contained in the swirling sky."

name: Hazardous Conditions
text: "There are many reasons we invent, of which survival is not the least."

name: Kambal, Consul of Allocation
text: He has "friends" in places both high and low, and all seem to owe him favors.

name: Restoration Gearsmith
text: All she touches turns to well-oiled, delicately calibrated, perfectly balanced gold.

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Veteran Motorist
text: He's set to compete in every race at the Fair, and he plans to win them all.

name: Impeccable Timing
text: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

name: Whirler Virtuoso
text: The first tentative flaps are like a song to his soul.

name: Accomplished Automaton
text: Was it just lonely, or was some form of evolution inevitable?

name: Aetherflux Reservoir
text: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.

name: Animation Module
text: Design leads to progress.

name: Aradara Express
text: It glides around the city, a sublime combination of elegance and utility.

name: Bastion Mastodon
text: The Consulate's automaton bank contains only the most impressive specimens.

name: Aerial Responder
text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

name: Inspired Charge
text: One dwarf on a build team ensures competence. All dwarves on the team ensures brilliance.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Consulate Skygate
text: All skyships entering or leaving the fairgrounds must pass through the security checkpoint.

name: Decoction Module
text: Progress leads to inspiration.

name: Dukhara Peafowl
text: Elegant filigree birds perch along the eleven bridges that cross Canal Dukhara.

name: Dynavolt Tower
text:
"I like that Tezzeret. He has vision the other judges don't. He sees the potential in what we're making here."
—Faiz, inventor

name: Eager Construct
text: Loyal to a fault, it anticipates its master's every need.

name: Master Trinketeer
text: "Let us never forget the joy that lies at the heart of invention."

name: Fabrication Module
text: Inspiration leads to design.

name: Filigree Familiar
text:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Ghirapur Orrery
text: This detailed model allows the edificers to examine the city from every angle.

name: Iron League Steed
text: The Iron League prides itself on its metal-shaping techniques.

name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
text: The Consulate keeps watch at each of the eleven bridges to ensure that the market remains a haven for commerce, not for con artists.

name: Key to the City
text: It would be unfortunate if the key fell into the wrong hands.

name: Narnam Cobra
text: Some say tales of the Narnam greenhouse are told to scare the children, but every tale grows from a seed of truth.

name: Ovalchase Dragster
text: It'll either crash or win the race. Possibly both.

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Perpetual Timepiece
text: Do not be so caught up in keeping track of time that you forget to make use of it.

name: Prakhata Pillar-Bug
text: Not a mote of dust escapes the dutiful cleaners that keep the exclusive Prakhata Club immaculate.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: To understand Kaladesh, one must first understand how aether and invention flow together through the great Aether Cycle.

name: Pressure Point
text: Everything has an off switch.

name: Scrapheap Scrounger
text: Some machines refuse to accept their own obsolescence.

name: Self-Assembler
text: It sees itself in all of its creations.

name: Snare Thopter
text:
"I did not think I would understand the cold filigree creatures of this world, but they too are governed by the laws of nature."
—Nissa Revane

name: Torch Gauntlet
text:
"Good morning, children. Please open your aether valves and ignite your gauntlets."
—Rakib, Ghirapur schoolteacher

name: Weldfast Monitor
text: The avant-garde among Ghirapur's inventors disregard the Consulate's safety standards completely.

name: Whirlermaker
text:
"Our creations are more than mere things. They have life in them, little bits of ourselves."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Propeller Pioneer
text: "The sky isn't the limit. It's the starting point."

name: Workshop Assistant
text: Sometimes the smallest things make the biggest difference.

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Blooming Marsh
text: A retreat to nature can inspire even the most jaded inventor.

name: Botanical Sanctum
text: Life inspires technology, which expands life's domain.

name: Concealed Courtyard
text: Where high society and dark opportunity intersect.

name: Inspiring Vantage
text: Ghirapur is a beacon of inspiration, attracting the most brilliant minds on Kaladesh.

name: Spirebluff Canal
text: There's so much more to Ghirapur than can be accessed by traditional roads.

name: Refurbish
text:
"There's no reason to buy a new one when I've got the tools to fix the one you've got."
—Ripu, repair specialist

name: Revoke Privileges
text: "By order of Consulate Mandate 482, I am required to detain you, citizen."

name: Flame Lash
text: "This is just my warm-up."

name: Renegade Firebrand
text: "For freedom! For fame! For fire!"

name: Stone Quarry
text: The Inventors' Renaissance came on the heels of the Great Aether Boom, hiking demand for raw materials of every kind.

name: Servo Exhibition
text:
"The judges really put them through their paces, but they prevailed. I think they even impressed Head Judge Tezzeret."
—Ritika, artificer

name: Terrain Elemental
text:
"You tread upon the land all the time, yet you seem dismayed when it moves to step on you."
—Nissa Revane

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Skyswirl Harrier
text: The great birds dive through the sky, wings skimming the aether streams, to fall upon their unsuspecting prey.

name: Skywhaler's Shot
text: In the moment of truth, it is as though time stands still, and the whale waits, suspended in the sky.

name: Tasseled Dromedary
text: There is no dress code for the Inventors' Fair, but you'll be hard-pressed to find anyone or anything not done up in their finest.

name: Thriving Ibex
text: Textiles at the Inventors' Fair feature threads from every corner of Kaladesh.

name: Toolcraft Exemplar
text: "If you wish to produce the finest work, you must start with the finest tools."

name: Trusty Companion
text: It shows affection an automaton never could.

name: Visionary Augmenter
text: "It's a multifunctional radial extension system with superlateral, force-amplifying rigging. Of course it will win."

name: Aether Tradewinds
text: Consulate engineers have developed safe methods of harvesting aether, but renegades aren't always so careful.

name: Ceremonious Rejection
text: The judges at the Fair are held in such high esteem that a nod of recognition can inspire an inventor for a lifetime—and a wave of dismissal can end a career.

name: Confiscation Coup
text: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

name: Curio Vendor
text: "Step right up! Try your hand! It'll thrill the senses and boggle the mind!"

name: Disappearing Act
text:
"Baral took my family from me back then. I'd do anything to face him now."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Dramatic Reversal
text:
"Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Experimental Aviator
text: "The little thopters seemed lonely up here, so I thought I'd join them."

name: Failed Inspection
text: The most dangerous thing an artificer can do is believe an invention is perfect.

name: Gearseeker Serpent
text: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

name: Glimmer of Genius
text: Creators live for that moment of inspiration: precious, profound, perfect.

name: Authority of the Consuls
text: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

name: Insidious Will
text:
"We meet again, pyromancer."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

name: Janjeet Sentry
text: Janjeet Observatory is open to the public, but access to the adjoining laboratories is restricted.

name: Long-Finned Skywhale
text: The aethersphere is home to the most wondrous beings on all of Kaladesh, although the dangers of traversing it mean that not much is known of them.

name: Malfunction
text: "They don't make them like they used to."

name: Minister of Inquiries
text: "This research violates Consulate law."

name: Nimble Innovator
text: "A failure is simply another opportunity for improvement. Just wait until you see what I come up with next."

name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
text: "Impress me."

name: Aviary Mechanic
text: Pilots take crippled skyships to the Aviaries, trusting Ghirapur's most talented mechanics to get them back into the air.

name: Paradoxical Outcome
text: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

name: Revolutionary Rebuff
text: By the time a Consulate sanction becomes official, the renegade quicksmiths have already found a way to circumvent it.

name: Saheeli's Artistry
text: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

name: Shrewd Negotiation
text: "Pleasure doing business with you."

name: Tezzeret's Ambition
text: "To achieve what none have achieved before, one must dare what none have dared before."

name: Thriving Turtle
text: Aether shapes everything on Kaladesh, from the sky to the sea.

name: Vedalken Blademaster
text: Vedalken have six thin, agile fingers on each hand, giving them unparalleled dexterity.

name: Weldfast Wingsmith
text: "Airships are too confining. If I'm in the sky, I want to feel the wind in my hair and taste the aether."

name: Built to Last
text: Consulate-built automatons have a lifetime warranty.

name: Wind Drake
text: Drakes prowl the skies of Kaladesh, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

name: Aetherborn Marauder
text: "I don't know what that is or who it belongs to, but it's shiny and I want it."

name: Ambitious Aetherborn
text: Aetherborn who are unwilling to accept the decomposition of their bodies invent ways to preserve and augment themselves.

name: Dhund Operative
text: Baral's spies always have the latest technology.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text:
"Show them. Show them how hot your fire can burn."
—Liliana Vess, to Chandra Nalaar

name: Die Young
text: "When the time comes, let go. Nothing lasts forever."

name: Dukhara Scavenger
text: The teeth marks add character.

name: Eliminate the Competition
text: Open hostilities are strictly forbidden at the Inventors' Fair, but "accidents" still happen.

name: Embraal Bruiser
text: In Embraal, inventor gangs defend their turf with ingenious devices and blunt objects.

name: Captured by the Consulate
text:
"At last, the infamous Pia Nalaar."
—Tezzeret

name: Essence Extraction
text: The "gifted" among the aetherborn can draw the life essence of other living beings into themselves.

name: Fortuitous Find
text: An aetherborn wastes neither time nor treasure.

name: Foundry Screecher
text:
"My creations still can't match the dive speed of those floppy-winged mammals. Maybe I should enter one of them in the Fair."
—Viprikti, thopterist

name: Fretwork Colony
text: The swarm leaves behind a flawless pattern that only occasionally threatens the structural integrity of the wood.

name: Harsh Scrutiny
text:
"If you've done nothing wrong, you have nothing to fear."
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

name: Lawless Broker
text: Kaladesh's illicit marketplaces are known as "night markets," but if you know who to ask, you can find what you're looking for at any time of the day.

name: Live Fast
text: "When you have the chance, take it. Laugh, sing, dance. Don't allow the night to end."

name: Lost Legacy
text:
"That name shall not be spoken."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

name: Make Obsolete
text: Yesterday's marvels are today's antiques.

name: Maulfist Squad
text: "Nice invention there. Looks real fragile."

name: Mind Rot
text: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

name: Morbid Curiosity
text: "Every creation carries a piece of its creators. Their knowledge, their dreams, their soul. That is the best part."

name: Night Market Lookout
text: The Consulate rarely cracks the coded announcement of a night market's location before dawn, and enforcers are taken care of if they wander too close.

name: Ovalchase Daredevil
text: "Let me guess. You thought I was dead."

name: Prakhata Club Security
text: It's rare that the Prakhata Club closes its doors. It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal. What are the odds the two would occur on the same day?

name: Rush of Vitality
text: Short lives lead to forbidden choices.

name: Abzan Battle Priest
text: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

name: Feat of Resistance
text: Dragons are extinct on Tarkir, but Abzan magic still emulates their endurance.

name: Barrage of Boulders
text: Crude tactics can be effective nonetheless.

name: Bloodfire Expert
text: Some efreet abandon their homes in the volcanic Fire Rim to embrace the Jeskai Way and discipline their innate flames.

name: Bloodfire Mentor
text: The adept underwent months of preparation to withstand pain, until he was finally ready to receive the efreet master's teachings.

name: Bring Low
text:
"People are often humbled by the elements. But the elements, too, can be humbled."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

name: Burn Away
text:
"Your corruption will burn, serpent, until there is nothing left to defile."
—Asmala, bloodfire mystic

name: Canyon Lurkers
text: The broken Qal Sisma foothills make poor terrain for cavalry, but a perfect setting for ambushes.

name: Dragon-Style Twins
text: "We are the flicker of the flame and its heat, the two sides of a single blade."

name: Goblinslide
text: Goblins, like snowflakes, are only dangerous in numbers.

name: Firehoof Cavalry
text: "What warrior worth the name fears to leave a trail? If my enemies seek me, let them follow the ashes in my wake."

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Leaping Master
text: "Strength batters down barriers. Discipline ignores them."

name: Mardu Blazebringer
text:
"Make sure he's pointed in the right direction before you light him. And don't let the goblins anywhere near the torch."
—Kerai Suddenblade, Mardu hordechief

name: Mardu Heart-Piercer
text: "Those who have never ridden before the wind do not know the true joy of war."

name: Mardu Warshrieker
text:
"No body can contain so much fury. It reminds me of another battle, long past."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

name: Shatter
text: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

name: Summit Prowler
text:
"Do you hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? They are as fierce as the bear that fears no foe and as sly as the mink that creeps unseen. You will be as much prey as they."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

name: Swift Kick
text: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Trumpet Blast
text:
"Do you hear that, Sarkhan? The glory of the horde! I made a legend from what you abandoned."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Valley Dasher
text: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.

name: War-Name Aspirant
text: No battle means more to a Mardu warrior than the one that earns her war name.

name: Alpine Grizzly
text: The Temur welcome bears into the clan, fighting alongside them in battle. The relationship dates back to when they labored side by side under Sultai rule.

name: Archers' Parapet
text: Every shaft is graven with a name from a kin tree, calling upon the spirits of the ancestors to make it fly true.

name: Awaken the Bear
text: When Temur warriors enter the battle trance known as "awakening the bear," they lose all sense of enemy or friend, seeing only threats to the wilderness.

name: Dragonscale Boon
text:
"When we were lost and weary, the ainok showed us how to survive. They have earned the right to call themselves Abzan, and to wear the Scale."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

name: Feed the Clan
text: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Heir of the Wilds
text: In the high caves of the Qal Sisma mountains, young hunters quest to hear the echoes of their fierce ancestors.

name: Highland Game
text:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon her head. This one hears the whispers."
—Chianul, at the weaving of Arel

name: Hooting Mandrills
text: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

name: Incremental Growth
text: The bonds of family cross the boundaries of race.

name: Kin-Tree Warden
text: "The amber of the tree and the blood of my veins are the same."

name: Jeskai Student
text: Discipline is the first pillar of the Jeskai Way. Each member of the clan trains in a weapon, perfecting its use over a lifetime.

name: Naturalize
text: The remains of ancient sky tyrants now feed the war-torn land.

name: Sagu Archer
text: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.

name: Scout the Borders
text:
"I am in my element: the element of surprise."
—Mogai, Sultai scout

name: Kill Shot
text: Mardu archers are trained in Dakla, the way of the bow. They never miss their target, no matter how small, how fast, or how far away.

name: Seek the Horizon
text: The Temur call the flickering lights the Path of Whispers, believing that they lead the way to ancestral knowledge.

name: Smoke Teller
text: "See your enemies from a thousand sides. Then you will find a thousand ways to kill them."

name: Sultai Flayer
text: "You can have the body, necromancer. I just want the skin."

name: Tusked Colossodon
text: A band of Temur hunters, fleeing the Mardu, dug a hideout beneath such a creature as it slept. The horde found them and attacked. For three days the Temur held them at bay, and all the while the great beast slumbered.

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Windstorm
text:
"When the last dragon fell, its spirit escaped as a roar into the wind."
—Temur tale

name: Woolly Loxodon
text: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

name: Mardu Hateblade
text: "There may be little honor in my tactics, but there is no honor in losing."

name: Abzan Guide
text: "These roads are desolate and changeable. Follow me, or die in the wastes."

name: Anafenza, the Foremost
text: Rarely at rest on the Amber Throne, Anafenza always leads the Abzan Houses to battle.

name: Ankle Shanker
text: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

name: Armament Corps
text: The Abzan avoid extended supply lines by incorporating weapons stores into their battle formations.

name: Avalanche Tusker
text:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

name: Bear's Companion
text: "The Sultai came hunting for a bear hide. Now I have a belt of naga skin, and my friend has a full belly."

name: Chief of the Edge
text: "We are the swift, the strong, the blade's sharp shriek! Fear nothing, and strike!"

name: Mardu Hordechief
text: The horde grows with each assault.

name: Chief of the Scale
text: "We are the shield unbroken. If we fall today, we will die well, and our trees will bear our names in honor."

name: Crackling Doom
text: Do not fear the lightning. Fear the one it obeys.

name: Death Frenzy
text: The crocodiles' putrid jaws swallow everything but the screams.

name: Duneblast
text: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

name: Flying Crane Technique
text: There are many Jeskai styles: Riverwalk imitates flowing water, Dragonfist the ancient hellkites, and Flying Crane the wild aven of the high peaks.

name: Highspire Mantis
text: Its wings produce a high-pitched, barely audible whirring sound in flight. Only Jeskai masters are quiet enough to hear one coming.

name: Ivorytusk Fortress
text: Abzan soldiers march to war confident that their Houses march with them.

name: Kin-Tree Invocation
text: The passing years add new rings to the tree's trunk, bolstering the spirits that dwell within.

name: Mantis Rider
text: Mantis riders know their mounts owe them no allegiance. Even a mantis ridden for years would consume a rider who loses focus for only a moment.

name: Mardu Roughrider
text: The most ferocious saddlebrutes lead the assault, ramming through massed pikes and stout barricades as if they were paper and silk.

name: Master the Way
text:
"The Way has no beginning and no end. It is simply the path."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

name: Mindswipe
text:
"The past and the unwritten are frozen. To understand their meaning requires heat."
—Arel the Whisperer

name: Rush of Battle
text: The Mardu charge reflects the dragon's speed—and its hunger.

name: Rakshasa Deathdealer
text: "Death fills me and makes me strong. You, it will reduce to nothing."

name: Rakshasa Vizier
text: Rakshasa offer deals that sound advantageous to those who forget who they are dealing with.

name: Ride Down
text:
"I will wash you from my hooves!"
—Mardu taunt

name: Sage of the Inward Eye
text: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

name: Sagu Mauler
text: The Sagu Jungle's thick undergrowth conceals even the largest predators—if they wish to remain hidden.

name: Secret Plans
text: Rakshasa trade in secrets, amassing wealth from their careful revelation.

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Sage-Eye Harrier
text: These winged warriors meditate in flight, tracing mandalas in the clouds.

name: Siege Rhino
text: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

name: Snowhorn Rider
text: Sure-footed, strong-willed, and ill-tempered—and so is the ram.

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Sultai Soothsayer
text: The naga of the Sultai Brood made deals with dark forces to keep their power.

name: Surrak Dragonclaw
text: Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.

name: Trap Essence
text:
"Meat sustains the body. The spirit requires different sustenance."
—Arel the Whisperer

name: Salt Road Patrol
text:
"Soldiers win battles, but supplies win wars."
—Kadri, Abzan caravan master

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Villainous Wealth
text: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

name: Warden of the Eye
text: The wardens guard the sacred documents of Tarkir's history, though they are forbidden to read the words.

name: Winterflame
text:
"The mountains scream with the dragons' throats."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Abzan Banner
text: Stone to endure, roots to remember.

name: Altar of the Brood
text: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.

name: Briber's Purse
text: Victory is certain. The price, negotiable.

name: Cranial Archive
text: The greatest idea the zombie ever had in its head wasn't even its own.

name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
text: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

name: Seeker of the Way
text: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

name: Ghostfire Blade
text: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.

name: Heart-Piercer Bow
text: Designed by an ancient artificer, the finest Mardu bows are carved from dragon bone and strung with the wind itself.

name: Jeskai Banner
text: Discipline to persevere, insight to discover.

name: Lens of Clarity
text:
"Water shifts and confuses, but as ice it holds the stillness of truth."
—Arel the Whisperer

name: Mardu Banner
text: Speed to strike, fury to smash.

name: Sultai Banner
text: Power to dominate, cruelty to rule.

name: Temur Banner
text: Savagery to survive, courage to triumph.

name: Ugin's Nexus
text: All at once Sarkhan's mind fell silent.

name: Witness of the Ages
text: It strode through the clash of dragons, the fall of Ugin, and the rise of the khans.

name: Siegecraft
text:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Bloodstained Mire
text: Where dragons once triumphed, their bones now molder.

name: Flooded Strand
text: Where dragons once slept, their bones now rest.

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Polluted Delta
text: Where dragons once prevailed, their bones now sink.

name: Smite the Monstrous
text:
"The dragons thought they were too strong to be tamed, too large to fall. And where are they now?"
—Khibat the Revered

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
text:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Windswept Heath
text: Where dragons once roared, their bones now keen.

name: Wooded Foothills
text: Where dragons' breath once burned, their bones now freeze.

name: Take Up Arms
text:
"Many scales make the skin of a dragon."
—Abzan wisdom

name: Venerable Lammasu
text: Lammasu are the enigmatic travelers of Tarkir, soaring high above all lands in all seasons. None know their true purpose, but they often arrive on the eve of great conflicts or turning points in history.

name: War Behemoth
text:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

name: Ainok Bond-Kin
text: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

name: Blinding Spray
text:
"The stronger our enemies seem, the more vulnerable they are."
—Sultai secret

name: Cancel
text:
"Even the greatest inferno begins as a spark. And anyone can snuff out a spark."
—Chanyi, mistfire sage

name: Clever Impersonator
text:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

name: Crippling Chill
text: In the silence of the ice, even dreams become still.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Embodiment of Spring
text: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.

name: Alabaster Kirin
text: The appearance of a kirin signifies the passing or arrival of an important figure. As word of sightings spread, all the khans took it to mean themselves. Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

name: Force Away
text: Where an enemy once rode, not even a whisper remains.

name: Glacial Stalker
text:
"Have you spent a winter high in the mountains, where the ice walks and speaks to the wind? It is not a place for those who have not learned respect."
—Ulnok, Temur shaman

name: Icy Blast
text: "Do not think the sand or the sun will hold back the breath of winter."

name: Jeskai Windscout
text: They range from Sage-Eye Stronghold to the farthest reaches of Tarkir.

name: Monastery Flock
text:
"The arrow strikes one bird down, but the flock remains."
—Jeskai teaching

name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
text: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

name: Brave the Sands
text: Enduring the most desolate and dangerous conditions, Abzan sentries unfailingly guard the stronghold gates.

name: Riverwheel Aerialists
text: Adepts of the Riverwheel Stronghold can run through rain and never get wet; masters use the raindrops as stepping stones.

name: Scaldkin
text: The Temur believe that scaldkin are born when eruptions melt the frozen whispers of sleeping ancestors.

name: Scion of Glaciers
text:
"There is nothing so free as the spring river born of winter's ice."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

name: Set Adrift
text: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

name: Stubborn Denial
text: The Temur have no patience for subtlety.

name: Taigam's Scheming
text: "The Jeskai would have me bow in restraint. So I have found a people unafraid of true power."

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Dazzling Ramparts
text: When Anafenza holds court under the First Tree, the gates of Mer-Ek are sealed. No safer place exists in all of Tarkir.

name: Waterwhirl
text:
"Be as water: untamed and unheld, yet inexorably flowing toward a greater goal."
—Shensu, Riverwheel mystic

name: Weave Fate
text: Temur shamans speak of three destinies: the now, the echo of the past, and the unwritten. They find flickering paths among tangled possibilities.

name: Wetland Sambar
text: As a test of calm and compassion, a Jeskai monk softly approaches a grazing sambar and offers it a lotus from his or her hand. If the creature eats, the student ascends to the next level of training.

name: Bitter Revelation
text:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

name: Bloodsoaked Champion
text: "Death is merely another foe the Mardu will overcome."

name: Dead Drop
text:
Got a diving lesson
—Sultai expression meaning "was fed to the crocodiles"

name: Debilitating Injury
text:
"If weakness does not exist within the Temur then we shall force it upon them."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai

name: Despise
text:
"You have returned from fire, traitor. This time I will see you leave as ashes."
—Zurgo, to Sarkhan Vol

name: Defiant Strike
text:
"Stand where the whole battle can see you. Strike so they'll never forget."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

name: Disowned Ancestor
text: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.

name: Dutiful Return
text:
"We have a word for enemies too mutilated for military service: furniture."
—Taigam, Sidisi's Hand

name: Empty the Pits
text: The Sultai would rebuild the empire on the backs of the dead.

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "We all want to know what's going on in someone else's head. I simply open it up and look."

name: Gurmag Swiftwing
text:
"Anything a falcon can do, a bat can do in pitch darkness."
—Urdnan the Wanderer

name: Kheru Bloodsucker
text: It stares through the empty, pain-twisted faces of those it has drained.

name: Kheru Dreadmaw
text: Its hunting instincts have long since rotted away. Its hunger, however, remains.

name: Krumar Bond-Kin
text: "The Abzan replaced my savagery with a noble heritage. I would give my life for my House."

name: End Hostilities
text: Her palm flared like the eye of a waking dragon. Then all was calm.

name: Molting Snakeskin
text: Flesh wounds are meaningless to those who discard their flesh so readily.

name: Murderous Cut
text: The blades of a Sultai assassin stab like the fangs of a dragon.

name: Raiders' Spoils
text:
"To conquer is to eat."
—Edicts of Ilagra

name: Rakshasa's Secret
text: The voice of a rakshasa is soft, its breath sweet. But every word is the murmur of madness.

name: Retribution of the Ancients
text: Abzan ancestors died to protect their Houses, and they protect them still.

name: Rite of the Serpent
text:
"From your death, new life. From your loss, our profit."
—Kirada, Qarsi overseer

name: Rotting Mastodon
text: Mastodons became extinct long ago, but foul forces of the Gurmag Swamp sometimes animate their decaying remains. The Sultai happily exploit such creatures but consider them inferior to their own necromantic creations.

name: Shambling Attendants
text:
"Let the world behold what becomes of those who defy us."
—Taigam, Sidisi's Hand

name: Erase
text:
"Truth is hard enough to see, let alone understand. We must remove all distractions to find clarity."
—Zogye, wandering sage

name: Sidisi's Pet
text: The Sultai distinguish between pet and slave by the material of the chain.

name: Sultai Scavenger
text: Since they guard armies of walking carrion, Sultai aven are never far from a meal.

name: Swarm of Bloodflies
text: In the Gudul delta, bloodfly bites are indistinguishable from spear wounds.

name: Throttle
text:
"The best servants are made from those who died without a scratch."
—Sidisi, khan of the Sultai

name: Unyielding Krumar
text: "The man whom I call father killed the orc who sired me, offering his world and his blade in return."

name: Act of Treason
text:
"The Sultai take our dead, so we shall take their living!"
—Taklai, Mardu ragesinger

name: Ainok Tracker
text: Some ainok of the mountains are accepted among the Temur as trusted hunt-mates.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Lightning burns its own path.

name: Arrow Storm
text: First the thunder, then the rain.

name: Amulet of Vigor
text:
"Everyone is obsessed with this cosmium stuff, but I can sense some kind of comparable power in this droplet of ancient amber."
—Quintorius Kand, research notes

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"Markings on the hilt are faded, but resemble Komon Winaq familial glyphs. Relic recovered for further study."
—Oltec archaeological survey

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"The rose is common in Legion heraldry. Thorns and petals tell of specific family achievements."
—Quintorius Kand, research notes

name: Colossus Hammer
text:
"Relic retrieval is delayed. Mentioning it was forty feet tall might have helped us prepare."
—Queen's Bay Company dispatch

name: Expedition Map
text:
"Oltec maps are not simple charts of place and distance. Each tells a story of exploration and learning, celebrating the meaning beyond the discovery."
—Huatli's travel journal

name: Fist of Suns
text:
"Willem put it on and started shooting sparks from his hands like some kind of wizard! Was supposed to be my turn next, but the blasted thing won't come off his hand. Send help."
—Brazen Coalition expedition dispatch

name: Lightning Greaves
text:
"Skim all the gold and magic rocks you want, but if I see one greasy fingerprint on my new boots, you'll be drinking bilgewater for a month."
—Note from Captain Lannery Storm

name: Strionic Resonator
text:
"Akal theorizes that it is some sort of signal, resonating beyond this cavern's physical space. But if so, who—or what—is the signal for?"
—Huatli's travel journal

name: Temple Bell
text:
"Bells ring out to mark every great moment in the Malamet's tale of years: victories and tragedies, feasts and discoveries, the ascension of each sovereign and their passage into the dark beyond."
—Sun Empire expedition report

name: Thought Vessel
text:
"The artifact's interaction with the mycoid network seems to allow non-mycoids to connect to the gestalt consciousness. Thus far, all who have done so have fled screaming."
—Alvaro, Dusk Legion researcher

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text:
"It bends the light somehow, rendering it—and its wearer—functionally invisible. I never would have found it if I hadn't tripped over it!"
—Quintorius Kand, research notes

name: Worn Powerstone
text:
"The strange energy source isn't cosmium after all, but some unidentifiable material that has leached cosmium residue from the walls. Could be dangerous. Could change everything."
—Oltec archaeological survey

name: Bellowing Aegisaur
text: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Kinjalli's Sunwing
text:
"There are moments when I feel I could fly like the sunwing. Far away I would soar, but always a golden gale pushes me back."
—Huatli

name: Majestic Heliopterus
text:
"Its rise is like the sun's, a beautiful beginning. Its descent is like the sun's, a frightful ending."
—Huatli

name: Martyr of Dusk
text: "Should I fall, take up our standard and carry on. The Legion must always prevail."

name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
text: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Temple Altisaur
text:
"Kinjalli sculpted humans from clay, but the dinosaurs were carved from unyielding stone."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
text:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Welcoming Vampire
text: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Azure Fleet Admiral
text:
"Your concern for my safety is touching, but as long as your gunners remain reliably erratic, I see no reason to change course."
—Admiral Yelise, to Commodore Axurik

name: Benthic Biomancer
text: "I am my life's work."

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Corsair Captain
text: "Lungs full of sea air and a hold full of loot. Ah, what a life!"

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Daring Saboteur
text: "They'll never see me coming."

name: Deeproot Waters
text: A visit to the Deeproot Tree and its ancient spring replenishes a merfolk's connection to nature.

name: Distant Melody
text: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

name: Evacuation
text:
"Abandon ship! No, grab the treasure first!"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Herald of Secret Streams
text: "You might as well try to stop the waterfall."

name: Kindred Discovery
text: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
text: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

name: Master of the Pearl Trident
text: "Let the land dwellers know the coast is no longer the border between our realms. A new age of empire has begun."

name: Merchant Raiders
text: "Tell you what, you keep the rope."

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "Be like the sea: flow around that which is unmovable; for everything else, crash into it unrelentingly."

name: Merrow Reejerey
text: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Seafloor Oracle
text: Where the light falls dim and blue on broken ships, secrets lie unclaimed.

name: Siren Stormtamer
text: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Stonybrook Banneret
text: Made from trout scales and crawfish whiskers, merrows' shimmering banners flash in the water like lightning.

name: Surgespanner
text: They ride on waves of aether, washing out anything that might pollute the Merrow Lanes.

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Blood Artist
text:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

name: Blood Money
text: The more you have, the more you have to lose.

name: Bloodline Necromancer
text: "The veil of death hides little from our kind."

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Champion of Dusk
text: "Drench these golden streets in the blood of our enemies."

name: Cordial Vampire
text: "Please, come in! Hors d'oeuvres are on the table."

name: Crossway Troublemakers
text: "Lady Anje said no violence at the wedding. She never said anything about the journey there!"

name: Dire Fleet Ravager
text: His fists fume with the decay of death, each strike a plague on the hearts of his enemies.

name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
text: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

name: Dusk Legion Zealot
text: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

name: Exquisite Blood
text: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Fathom Fleet Captain
text: "Join me, and take the world for yourself!"

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Indulgent Aristocrat
text: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

name: New Blood
text:
"Now isn't that better?"
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Nighthawk Scavenger
text: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

name: Oathsworn Vampire
text:
"My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest."
—Queen Miralda the Pious

name: Olivia's Wrath
text:
"These worthless cattle think they can sneak unnoticed into my wedding? Dispose of them."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Pact of the Serpent
text: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

name: Sanctum Seeker
text: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

name: Village Rites
text: The Skelle raise scorn poles in conquered villages—cursed effigies of wood and bone that sap survivors of physical strength and the will to fight back.

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Angrath's Marauders
text: Captain Angrath cares less about treasure than mayhem. If he can't leave Ixalan, he'll burn the plane down.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Captivating Crew
text: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

name: Chandra's Ignition
text: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

name: Coercive Recruiter
text: "Choose, vampire: our hat on your head, or no hat, no head."

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
text: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

name: Marauding Raptor
text:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

name: Otepec Huntmaster
text: "Forward! Let the Burning Sun's light guide you to deserving prey!"

name: Port Razer
text: "Smash and grab, loot and burn, then it is the next town's turn!"

name: Shared Animosity
text:
"It is the nature of souls that they burn more brightly together than apart."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

name: Apex Altisaur
text: It brings belligerence to new heights.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Branching Evolution
text: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Deeproot Elite
text: "You think I stand alone? I have the forest at my call, the waters at my back. I outnumber you."

name: Drover of the Mighty
text: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Farseek
text: Her song twines throughout the Core, a melodic message to all Oltec near and far: you are home.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Ranging Raptors
text: They cover their territory like a tide of teeth and claws.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Ripjaw Raptor
text: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Ruinous Intrusion
text: The gourd carving was supposed to take place *after* the feast.

name: Runic Armasaur
text: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

name: Thunderherd Migration
text: The herds follow as new growth arises.

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
text:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Admiral Beckett Brass
text: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

name: Atzocan Seer
text: Streams of gold and bright feathers flash in the orb, visions of past and future.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Cruel Celebrant
text: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
text: Her centuries-long search is ended.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Kiora's Follower
text: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

name: Legion Lieutenant
text: "We long ago abandoned the things that make humans weak: friendship, marriage, family. All that remains is the strength of our devotion."

name: Merfolk Mistbinder
text:
"The mist clothes us when we are bare, hides us when we are alone, and unites us when we are together."
—Nirit of Pashona's band

name: Don Andres, the Renegade
text: "Why climb the tangled rigging of the Legion of Dusk's hierarchy when I can fly a free flag of my own?"

name: Raging Regisaur
text: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

name: Raging Swordtooth
text: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

name: Rakdos Charm
text:
"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

name: Regisaur Alpha
text:
"Seeing a pack of these monsters hunt together, I'm at a loss to imagine the size of their prey."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

name: Rhythm of the Wild
text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
text: "For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me."

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Mind Stone
text:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: "It is said Chimil never sees the same lands twice. So too must we expand our horizons."

name: Alchemist's Refuge
text: Persecuted alchemists fled deep into Kessig's wilds, seeking solitude to continue their ghoulish craft.

name: Canopy Vista
text: Chuuy Kaaj, "The Hanging City," has endured for centuries as the thriving hub of Malamet art, life, and culture.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: Oteclan, the Oltec capital, encompasses diverse satellite cities. The Oltec can live in any environment and maintain connection.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text: It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The Sun Empire bends nature— rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
text: All are welcome.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects: the creative sun, the sustaining sun, and the destructive sun.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Nephalia Drownyard
text:
"Some see a coastal disaster. I see a fully-stocked seagraf."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sulfur Falls
text: Skirsdag cultists meet behind a waterfall's curtain and plot with demonic forces.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Charismatic Conqueror
text: "There's a whole world under the surface, waiting for the light of our salvation."

name: Wave Goodbye
text: Whatever the tide brings in, the shapers can wash away.

name: Master of Dark Rites
text: "With each sacrifice, we step closer to the Age of Everflowing Blood."

name: Broadside Bombardiers
text: When they ran short on cannonballs, they went for the pots and pans.

name: Wrathful Raptors
text: They gulp down their prey on the run, claws dripping with blood as they hunt for their next meal.

name: Curious Altisaur
text: After long days of squeezing through cramped tunnels, the Sun Empire's dinosaurs were overjoyed to stretch their necks and survey the wonders of the Core.

name: Deeproot Historian
text: "The language of the Komon Winaq has much in common with the tongue of our ancestors. Surely the two peoples once lived and worked in close harmony."

name: Don Andres, the Renegade
text: "Why climb the tangled rigging of the Legion of Dusk's hierarchy when I can fly a free flag of my own?"

name: Dinosaur Egg
text: The Oltec revere dinosaurs as living remnants of the bygone Fourth Age.

name: Sunfrill Imitator
text: With a flare of plumage and an earthshaking bellow, it can scare off predators three times its size.

name: Topography Tracker
text: "Good thing I'm not afraid of heights."

name: Tributary Instructor
text: "Like water between rivers, wisdom must flow freely from one generation to the next."

name: Charismatic Conqueror
text: "There's a whole world under the surface, waiting for the light of our salvation."

name: Wave Goodbye
text: Whatever the tide brings in, the shapers can wash away.

name: Master of Dark Rites
text: "With each sacrifice, we step closer to the Age of Everflowing Blood."

name: Broadside Bombardiers
text: When they ran short on cannonballs, they went for the pots and pans.

name: Wrathful Raptors
text: They gulp down their prey on the run, claws dripping with blood as they hunt for their next meal.

name: Curious Altisaur
text: After long days of squeezing through cramped tunnels, the Sun Empire's dinosaurs were overjoyed to stretch their necks and survey the wonders of the Core.

name: Deeproot Historian
text: "The language of the Komon Winaq has much in common with the tongue of our ancestors. Surely the two peoples once lived and worked in close harmony."

name: Dinosaur Egg
text: The Oltec revere dinosaurs as living remnants of the bygone Fourth Age.

name: Sunfrill Imitator
text: With a flare of plumage and an earthshaking bellow, it can scare off predators three times its size.

name: Topography Tracker
text: "Good thing I'm not afraid of heights."

name: Tributary Instructor
text: "Like water between rivers, wisdom must flow freely from one generation to the next."

name: Abuelo's Awakening
text: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

name: Deathcap Marionette
text: Mycoids have no concept of life or death. All things exist, and all things can be made useful.

name: Deep Goblin Skulltaker
text: "Go away! I found it first!"

name: Deep-Cavern Bat
text: The first shriek locates the prey. The second immobilizes it.

name: Echo of Dusk
text:
"It's a mournful fate, to remember so well the taste of blood yet be forever unable to drink."
—Bartolomé del Presidio, director of the Queen's Bay Company

name: Fanatical Offering
text: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

name: Gargantuan Leech
text:
"Does *everything* down here want to suck my blood?"
—Derilene, expedition porter

name: Greedy Freebooter
text: Neither Nurgam nor the mycoid who laid the trap could quite believe their luck.

name: Envoy of Okinec Ahau
text: Though wary of each other at first, the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids. They began to share glyph knowledge and other crafting secrets.

name: Join the Dead
text: The more creatures that plunge to their deaths in the abyss, the more angry Echoes that arise to drag others down.

name: Malicious Eclipse
text: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness. At long last, his bloody reign would begin.

name: Mephitic Draught
text:
"Don't look at me. I'm not drinking it."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain

name: Primordial Gnawer
text: Cave crawlers devour anything from plant matter to solid rock, but they prefer fresh meat.

name: Ray of Ruin
text:
"We know Chimil's light as a warming, healing presence, but make no mistake: to those who would desecrate her lands, it is a terrible force of scouring fury."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Screaming Phantom
text: After a slow death in darkness, she flies into a rage at the slightest glimpse of light.

name: Skullcap Snail
text:
"Oh, come on! Aren't regular snails gross enough?"
—Derilene, expedition porter

name: Soulcoil Viper
text:
"As the snake sheds its skin to be born anew, we cast off death to rise as servants of Aclazotz."
—Vito, Church of Dusk heretic

name: Souls of the Lost
text: "Do you remember us?"

name: Stinging Cave Crawler
text: Caverns uninhabited by mycoids are often infested with worse.

name: Synapse Necromage
text:
"It's no good killing them? Then what do we do? Distract them with a tea party?"
—Mervin, Brazen Coalition prospector

name: Tarrian's Journal
text: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.

name: Terror Tide
text: Those who go under rise again as cruel mockeries of their former selves, spewing foul water and keening with sorrow.

name: Family Reunion
text: Huatli smiled up at Akal. "Our peoples have too long been parted, and yet we are cousins still."

name: Vito's Inquisitor
text: "We usher in the Age of Everflowing Blood, when those who are fed upon will be fed, and those who feed will be satiated."

name: Abrade
text:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Ancestors' Aid
text:
"You surface-dwellers may have forgotten your history, but it has not forgotten you."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Belligerent Yearling
text: One day it will be as terrifying as it thinks it is.

name: Brazen Blademaster
text: "The secret is footwork. Plus an extra sword."

name: Burning Sun Cavalry
text: "By fire and lightning, tooth and claw, we will send these invaders fleeing back to Torrezon!"

name: Calamitous Cave-In
text:
"For 'immortal conquerors,' these vampires seem very susceptible to being crushed by boulders."
—Chara Rebal, bat rider

name: Child of the Volcano
text: It is a living eruption, unquenchable fury given form.

name: Curator of Sun's Creation
text: "Put your hammers away and bring me some blankets! Such a gift from Tilonalli must be handled with the utmost care."

name: Dinotomaton
text:
"Oh, Saheeli would *love* you."
—Huatli

name: Dowsing Device
