text:
"A little innovation can lead to a big score."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Dreadmaw's Ire
text:
"That's the fifth ship lost in three days! Can't we build them out of something stronger?"
—Malcolm Lee

name: Enterprising Scallywag
text: "He would've wanted me to have it!"

name: Glorifier of Suffering
text: "Everyone wants to be remembered. Few are willing to do what it takes."

name: Goblin Tomb Raider
text: Enterprising goblins can extract their body weight in loot. Ambitious ones have a big meal first.

name: Goldfury Strider
text:
"Let's send our vampiric visitors a welcoming party, shall we?"
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon

name: Hotfoot Gnome
text: As the surface-dwellers became bolder in their intrusions, Oltec artificers began to repurpose courier gnomes for intelligence gathering and distraction.

name: Panicked Altisaur
text: Early Sun Empire expeditions learned the hard way that some surface dinosaurs were particularly ill-suited to the caverns' enclosed environments.

name: Guardian of the Great Door
text: The Core was sealed long ago by the Deep Gods, who set the angels to the eternal task of defending its golden gates.

name: Plundering Pirate
text: "Whatever it is, it set off a trap. It must be valuable!"

name: Poetic Ingenuity
text: "You inspire me."

name: Rampaging Ceratops
text: Anticipating tight spaces and trivial fauna, the first Dusk Legion expeditions were small, mobile, and lightly armored. Hundreds of casualties later, they started sending plate-clad platoons.

name: Rumbling Rockslide
text: Sometimes an expedition reaches a natural conclusion. Sometimes it all just comes crashing down.

name: Scytheclaw Raptor
text:
"She's a smart one. Noticed all on her own that the bloodsuckers wave their hands around to do their filthy magic, so she rips off their hands first."
—Citamitzin, Sun Empire warrior

name: Sunfire Torch
text: "Let Tilonalli's light burn a path through this darkness."

name: Sunshot Militia
text: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.

name: Tectonic Hazard
text:
"The ground is on fire, the ceiling's made of spears, and I think a mushroom tried to curse me. Don't tell me not to panic!"
—Jino Grag, Brazen Coalition scout

name: Helping Hand
text: Itzmin walked away from the collapse with a new friend—and an enduring fear of heights.

name: Triumphant Chomp
text: With crunchy outer shells and juicy innards, cave crawlers quickly became a favorite snack of the Sun Empire's dinosaur companions.

name: Volatile Wanderglyph
text: Touched eons ago by Ojer Axonil's flaming macuahuitl, it still burns with his boundless fury.

name: Armored Kincaller
text:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli

name: Basking Capybara
text:
"Even our most learned philosophers can only hope to approach the inner serenity of the humble capybara."
—Nelli, Oltec didact

name: Bedrock Tortoise
text: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.

name: Cenote Scout
text: "If you're afraid to dive into the unknown, how will you ever find anything new?"

name: Coati Scavenger
text: The difference between trash and treasure is a matter of perspective.

name: Ironpaw Aspirant
text:
"Train your mind and your muscles with equal ferocity, cub. Without wisdom, even a mighty warrior is nothing but a bully."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau

name: Colossadactyl
text: Accustomed to hunting nimble flying prey, the dinosaur was delighted to have its meal delivered neatly in a box.

name: Disturbed Slumber
text: "I'm telling you, the wall just blinked!"

name: Earthshaker Dreadmaw
text:
"I suggest we leave this cavern for someone else to conquer."
—Amalia, master cartographer

name: Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant
text: A thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.

name: Glimpse the Core
text:
"Wow. It's a good thing we brought a poet."
—Wayta

name: Huatli's Final Strike
text:
"Inti's name will grace our poems and histories for generations. Yours will collect dust, forgotten, in this cave."
—Huatli, to Vito

name: Hulking Raptor
text:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli

name: In the Presence of Ages
text:
"Finally, those glowing purple bone-monsters are gone and we can get back to the real excitement: archaeology!"
—Quintorius Kand

name: Ixalli's Lorekeeper
text: "Did we follow the dinosaurs out of the caverns, or did they follow us? These glyphs could change our entire understanding of our history."

name: Jadelight Spelunker
text: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

name: Malamet Battle Glyph
text:
"Let's not give the surface-dwellers time to learn what tactics work best here."
—Daram, Malamet marshal

name: Malamet Brawler
text: "I bear the marking of the Deep King, and in his name I will rend you to nothing but spores on the wind!"

name: Acrobatic Leap
text: As the cliff began to crumble, Wayta danced fearlessly across the tumbling stones, knowing Ajij would never let her fall.

name: Malamet Veteran
text: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

name: Mineshaft Spider
text: Anything that falls into the pit—relics, rubble, even corpses—ends up snared in its magic-infused web.

name: Pathfinding Axejaw
text: When you don't know what dangers you'll face, bring the biggest danger with you.

name: Poison Dart Frog
text:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

name: Pugnacious Hammerskull
text:
"I don't know whether it hates the mycoids or just loves breaking things. I say we leave it be."
—Samin, Oltec scout

name: Malamet War Scribe
text: The glyph is mightier than the sword.

name: Seeker of Sunlight
text: "We weren't fleeing a broken world. We were running toward paradise!"

name: Sentinel of the Nameless City
text: "Halt, traveler. Whatever you seek, you will not find it here."

name: Staggering Size
text:
"Ah well... the temple was due for a new roof anyhow."
—Kusi, Oltec gardener

name: Tendril of the Mycotyrant
text: Every mycoid carries within itself the makings of an entire colony.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text:
"I suppose we'll just hope those ancient monoliths lost to our people for centuries weren't particularly important."
—Toxayac, Sun Empire historian

name: Abuelo, Ancestral Echo
text: "Come, friends. Let us see if this world remembers us."

name: Market Gnome
text: "Maize, sweet and fresh! Tamal, hot and filling! Water, still or sparkling!"

name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
text: "If we are to protect this world, we can no longer hide within it!"

name: Bartolomé del Presidio
text: "Bless this sinner, who sacrificed his blood so that I may live."

name: Captain Storm, Cosmium Raider
text: "To the mother lode, and death take the wary!"

name: Might of the Ancestors
text: Malamet histories speak of a time when they were not yet confined to mortal bodies and existed as ferocity unrestrained.

name: Itzquinth, Firstborn of Gishath
text:
"Dinosaurs have no concept of royalty, but they recognize the scent of the mightiest among them."
—Atla Palani, nest tender

name: Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar
text: "Invaders in the West Chasm? Give me an hour and they'll be fungus food."

name: Nicanzil, Current Conductor
text: "This water can guide you anywhere, if you know how to ask."

name: Saheeli, the Sun's Brilliance
text: What began as a single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons unlike anything ever seen on Ixalan.

name: Sovereign Okinec Ahau
text: As surface empires send their explorers down, his hungry eyes look upward.

name: Squirming Emergence
text: Due to archaic Brazen Coalition guidelines regarding hats, a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.

name: Cartographer's Companion
text: Ever since the Fomori's attempt long ago to extinguish Chimil's light, the Oltec have taken extensive measures to never get lost in the Core.

name: Mischievous Pup
text:
"Either he made a gnome very angry when he took that, or he'll make one very happy when he brings it back."
—Ihio, Oteclan market vendor

name: Compass Gnome
text:
"I'm certain it's some kind of sophisticated navigational tool. If only I had any idea what it was telling me!"
—Colbo, Brazen Coalition surveyor

name: Disruptor Wanderglyph
text: Wherever the spores begin to take hold, it crushes the ground to rubble.

name: Hoverstone Pilgrim
text: They scour for secrets in places too distant or dangerous for humans to tread.

name: Hunter's Blowgun
text:
"Ow! I think a wasp just stung me, cap'n."
—Nirk Doobin, last words

name: Runaway Boulder
text: "Run, hearties, run! Or we'll end our days as pirate paste!"

name: Scampering Surveyor
text: It knows the length, pitch, and orientation of every tunnel it has ever traversed.

name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
text: Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power... and his hunger.

name: Cavernous Maw
text: Many footprints lead into the cave. None lead out.

name: Echoing Deeps
text: The still, silent waters reflect what was, not what is.

name: Forgotten Monument
text: The Komon Winaq left behind few written records, but their handiwork stands strong all throughout the Core.

name: Promising Vein
text: United under the banner of the Brazen Coalition, pirates put aside their feuds to plunder the underground bounty.

name: Oltec Cloud Guard
text: Many Oltec youth dream of one day joining the elite bat-riding cavalry of the Thousand Moons military force.

name: Adaptive Gemguard
text: Left to their own devices, gnomes reengineer their own devices.

name: Petrify
text: Those who break the laws of the Malamet become cold, silent warnings to others who might try.

name: Quicksand Whirlpool
text:
"Those who would steal the blood and breath of the living will drink their fill of the sand."
—Sovereign Okinec Ahau

name: Ruin-Lurker Bat
text:
"Look! Aclazotz sends his children to watch over our pilgrimage."
—Clavileño, First of the Blessed

name: Sanguine Evangelist
text: "Fang-brethren, we feed together."

name: Abuelo's Awakening
text: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

name: Sanguine Evangelist
text: "Fang-brethren, we feed together."

name: Deeproot Pilgrimage
text: "These glyphs are more than trail markings! They tell a story as they go. But does it end in celebration or tragedy?"

name: Souls of the Lost
text: "Do you remember us?"

name: Thousand Moons Crackshot
text: The Thousand Moons practice every maneuver thousands of times, allowing them to strike flawlessly without hesitation in the heat of battle.

name: Tarrian's Journal
text: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.

name: Terror Tide
text: Those who go under rise again as cruel mockeries of their former selves, spewing foul water and keening with sorrow.

name: Poetic Ingenuity
text: "You inspire me."

name: Bedrock Tortoise
text: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.

name: Thousand Moons Infantry
text: The Thousand Moons train and fight in tight-knit squads of ten. Every tenth Moon functions as an officer, every hundredth as a captain, and the thousandth, Anim Pakal, as supreme commander.

name: Jadelight Spelunker
text: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

name: Sentinel of the Nameless City
text: "Halt, traveler. Whatever you seek, you will not find it here."

name: Squirming Emergence
text: Due to archaic Brazen Coalition guidelines regarding hats, a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.

name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
text: Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power... and his hunger.

name: Attentive Sunscribe
text: Few humans are steady-handed enough to match a gnome's precision. Even the slightest change to a single line can wildly alter a glyph's meaning.

name: Tinker's Tote
text: Never leave home without a gnome.

name: Vanguard of the Rose
text: "No one soul is worth more than Torrezon's salvation. Press on."

name: Akal Pakal, First Among Equals
text: "These lost children of Aclazotz are misguided, but perhaps there can be reconciliation of our ideals without war."

name: Ancestral Reminiscence
text: A typical conversation with Echoes is three parts wisdom and one part gossip.

name: Brackish Blunder
text: When the Malamet told him to avoid the river, he thought they meant it wasn't safe to drink.

name: Chart a Course
text: As the River Heralds began to decipher the ancient map, they were staggered by the vastness of the world-within-the-world that it revealed.

name: Cogwork Wrestler
text: Years of adventure and adversity on the open seas did not prepare Brog for the humiliation of losing a sparring match to a cogwork doll less than half his size.

name: Confounding Riddle
text: Explorers learned not to tamper with sites of ancient power without learning their purpose.

name: Council of Echoes
text: The Komon Winaq, ancestors of the Oltec, linger on as the eldest of the Echoes.

name: Deeproot Pilgrimage
text: "These glyphs are more than trail markings! They tell a story as they go. But does it end in celebration or tragedy?"

name: Didact Echo
text: The folk of the Sun Empire respect their ancestors. The Oltec go further, communing with spirits of esteemed elders after death.

name: Eaten by Piranhas
text: It is ill-advised to swim where even the River Heralds do not.

name: Frilled Cave-Wurm
text:
"Remember that weird salamander thing we found in the jungle stream? I think we just met its god."
—Carella, quartermaster of the *Windshark*

name: Hermitic Nautilus
text: It devoured the shell's original owner long ago, but it's just about ready to start looking for a new home—and a meal to go with it.

name: Marauding Brinefang
text: Ancient glyphs are a lot harder to decipher when attached to an apex predator.

name: Merfolk Cave-Diver
text:
"Learn all you can of this underground sea. I suspect more secrets of our ancestors lie waiting in its depths."
—Tishana

name: Oaken Siren
text: The ship's carpenter adorned the figurehead with a small cosmium gem, never expecting the figurehead to take flight.

name: Orazca Puzzle-Door
text: Between Quintorius's archaeological expertise and Huatli's knowledge of ancient glyphs, the "impossible" lock finally yielded, and the door to the underground world rumbled open.

name: Out of Air
text:
"The Core is not a simple trove to be plundered by intruders from the surface. It will reject those who do not accord it respect."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Cosmium Blast
text: Cosmium is the tangible essence of Chimil's power. The Oltec's cosmium-laced tattoos ensure that power can be called upon when needed.

name: Pirate Hat
text: "Landlubbers just don't understand the value of a proper hat."

name: Relic's Roar
text:
"Well, that's one less share to divide up."
—Dranach, Dire Fleet boatswain

name: River Herald Scout
text: "Don't worry, little swimmers. I'm here for the ruins, not you."

name: Sage of Days
text: "After this age, another."

name: Self-Reflection
text: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

name: Shipwreck Sentry
text: "That's close enough, stranger."

name: Staunch Crewmate
text: "Leave you? Not a chance. You still owe me money."

name: Dauntless Dismantler
text: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

name: Unlucky Drop
text:
"First rule down here is the same as it is on the water: always double-check your knots."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Waylaying Pirates
text: "The only drink in your future is seawater."

name: Abyssal Gorestalker
text: Its kin once overran entire civilizations, but they tore each other to pieces in their unending hunger. Now only it remains.

name: Acolyte of Aclazotz
text: "Great Aclazotz, receive this offering. Wrought with skill. Captured with strength. Anointed with the blood of your enemies."

name: Deconstruction Hammer
text:
"All that is made can be unmade. Chimil's light is the only constant."
—Oltec artificers' creed

name: Another Chance
text: The pull of duty was so strong that they barely paused to notice they'd died.

name: Bitter Triumph
text: Though he wept at Inti's death, Caparocti's eyes were keen, and his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileño's tainted heart.

name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
text: Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.

name: Bloodthorn Flail
text:
"This weapon embodies both the strength and the weakness of the Legion of Dusk. They will endure any pain to achieve their ends, but they suffer pointlessly just to prove their dedication."
—Huatli

name: Broodrage Mycoid
text: As the massive mycoids known as rage titans charge into battle, lesser ones swarm in their wake, gobbling up any survivors.

name: Chupacabra Echo
text: It needs no food, yet still it hungers.

name: Dead Weight
text: The hired goblins were not, as advertised, worth their weight in gold.

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

name: Frozen Shade
text:
"There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Nightmare
text: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Plague Rats
text:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text: "They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,/ Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;/ It had been strange, even in a dream,/ To have seen those dead men rise."/ —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Bone
text: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"About, about in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Dragon Whelp
text:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

name: Dwarven Demolition Team
text: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text:
"And topples round the dreary west
A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin King
text: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

name: Gray Ogre
text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Ironclaw Orcs
text: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Orcish Artillery
text: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

name: Roc of Kher Ridges
text: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could quite make out what it was.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Two-Headed Giant of Foriys
text: None know if this Giant is the result of aberrant magics, Siamese twins, or a mentalist's schizophrenia.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

name: Wall of Fire
text: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Elvish Archers
text: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Ironroot Treefolk
text: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Whenever the Llanowar Elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

name: Timber Wolves
text: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Wall of Brambles
text: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

name: Wall of Ice
text:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Wood
text: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

name: War Mammoth
text: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

name: Jade Statue
text:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—Song of the Artificer

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

name: Pearled Unicorn
text: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

name: Samite Healer
text: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Benalish Hero
text: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
text: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

name: Phantasmal Forces
text: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

name: Phantom Monster
text:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Drudge Skeletons
text: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

name: Frozen Shade
text: "There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade." —Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Nightmare
text: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

name: Plague Rats
text:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Scathe Zombies
text:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,/ Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;/ It had been strange, even in a dream,/ To have seen those dead men rise."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Bone
text: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"About, about in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Dragon Whelp
text:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

name: Dwarven Demolition Team
text: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Fire Elemental
text: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

name: Firebreathing
text:
"And topples round the dreary west A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

name: Goblin King
text: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

name: Gray Ogre
text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

name: Hill Giant
text: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Ironclaw Orcs
text: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Orcish Artillery
text: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

name: Roc of Kher Ridges
text: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Two-Headed Giant of Foriys
text: None know if this Giant is the result of aberrant magics, Siamese twins, or a mentalist's schizophrenia.

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

name: Wall of Fire
text: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

name: Wall of Stone
text: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Elvish Archers
text: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Giant Spider
text: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

name: Ironroot Treefolk
text: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

name: Ley Druid
text: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Whenever the Llanowar Elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shanodin Dryads
text: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

name: Timber Wolves
text: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

name: Wall of Brambles
text: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

name: Wall of Ice
text:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Wall of Wood
text: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

name: War Mammoth
text: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

name: Jade Statue
text:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—Song of the Artificer

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Northern Paladin
text: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

name: Pearled Unicorn
text: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,

—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Wall of Air
text: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

name: Wall of Water
text: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Bog Wraith
text: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

name: Divine Transformation
text: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

name: Glyph of Doom
text:
"He knows he has a short span of life, that the day will come when he must pass through the wall of oblivion . . ."
—William Faulkner

name: Greed
text: "There is no calamity greater than lavish desires./ There is no greater guilt than discontentment./ And there is no greater disaster than greed." —*Tao Tê Ching 46*

name: Headless Horseman
text:
". . . [T]he ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head . . . he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast . . ."
—Washington Irving, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

name: Hell Swarm
text: The brightness of day turned in an instant to dusk as the swarm descended upon the battlefield.

name: Hell's Caretaker
text: You might leave here, Chenndra, should another take your place . . . .

name: Hellfire
text: "High on a throne of royal state . . . insatiate to pursue vain war with heav'n." —John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

name: Horror of Horrors
text:
"And a horror of outer darkness after,/ And dust returneth to dust again."
—Adam Lindsay Gordon, The Swimmer

name: Jovial Evil
text: "Today, for a lark, let's visit the plains. I'm sure we'll find something to entertain us."

name: Elder Land Wurm
text: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping dragons lie.

name: Lost Soul
text: She walks in the twilight, her steps make no sound,/ Her feet leave no tracks on the dew-covered ground./ Her hand gently beckons, she whispers your name—/ But those who go with her are never the same.

name: Nether Void
text: These days, some wizards are finding that they have a little too much spell left at the end of their mana.

name: Pit Scorpion
text: Sometimes the smallest nuisance can be the greatest pain.

name: Shimian Night Stalker
text: "'Tis now the very witching time of night,/ When churchyards yawn and hell itself breathes out/ Contagion to this world." —William Shakespeare, Hamlet

name: Syphon Soul
text:
"Her lips suck forth; see, where it flies!"
—Christopher Marlowe, *The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus*

name: The Abyss
text: "An immense river of oblivion is sweeping us away into a nameless abyss." —Ernest Renan, *Souvenirs d'Enfance et de Jeunesse*

name: Touch of Darkness
text:
"Black spirits and white, red spirits and gray,/
Mingle, mingle, mingle, you that mingle may."
—Thomas Middleton, The Witch

name: Transmutation
text: "You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!" —Randall

name: Underworld Dreams
text: "In the drowsy dark cave of the mind dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan." —Rabindranath Tagore

name: Vampire Bats
text: "For something is amiss or out of place/ When mice with wings can wear a human face." —Theodore Roethke, "The Bat"

name: Walking Dead
text: The Walking Dead are the remains of freakish experiments by the Necromantic Lords.

name: Aerathi Berserker
text: Ærathi children who show promise are left to survive for a year in the wilderness. Those who return are shown the way of the Berserker.

name: Beasts of Bogardan
text: Bogardan is a land as volatile as the creatures who live there.

name: Crimson Kobolds
text: "Kobolds are harmless." —Bearand the Bold, epitaph

name: Crimson Manticore
text: Noted neither for their good looks nor their charm, Crimson Manticores can be fearsome allies. As dinner companions, however, they are best left alone.

name: Crookshank Kobolds
text: The Crookshank military boasts a standing army of nearly twenty-four million, give or take twenty-two million.

name: Eternal Warrior
text: Warriors of the Tsunami-nito School spend years in training to master the way of effortless effort.

name: Firestorm Phoenix
text: "The bird of wonder dies, the maiden phoenix,/ Her ashes new-create another heir/ As great in admiration as herself." —William Shakespeare, *King Henry the Eighth*

name: Frost Giant
text: The Frost Giants have been out in the cold a long, long time, but they have their rage to keep them warm.

name: Giant Strength
text: "O! it is excellent/ To have a giant's strength, but it is tyrannous/ To use it like a giant." —William Shakespeare, *Measure for Measure*

name: Glyph of Life
text: Any wall can be battered down, but at what cost?

name: Gravity Sphere
text: On the morning of the Battle of Gal-Shan, the Sorcerer's cry rang out: "Let no bird fly, let no creature take wing, let all the battle join as one."

name: Hyperion Blacksmith
text:
"The smith a mighty man is he/ With large and sinewy hands./ And the muscles of his brawny arms/ Are strong as iron bands."
—Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, The Village Blacksmith

name: Kobold Drill Sergeant
text: "Joining this army is easy, boy. Just survive your first battle."

name: Kobold Overlord
text: "One for all, all for one; we strike first, and then you're done!" —Oath of the Kobold Musketeers

name: Kobold Taskmaster
text: The Taskmaster knows that there is no cure for the common Kobold.

name: Kobolds of Kher Keep
text: Kher Keep is unique among fortresses: impervious to aerial assault but defenseless from the ground.

name: Mountain Yeti
text: The Yeti's single greatest asset is its unnerving ability to blend in with its surroundings.

name: Primordial Ooze
text: The thick, moving mass from the beginning of evolution swallows and digests the animate and inanimate as it unthinkingly strives to continue its existence.

name: Pyrotechnics
text: "Hi! ni! ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me!/ Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return." —Navajo war chant

name: Quarum Trench Gnomes
text:
"O Great Captain, all is lost. They tunneled, they burrowed, they trenched. They sapped the strength of our defenses."
—Sorgus, *Chronicles of the Quarum Plains*

name: Raging Bull
text:
"Sometimes the bulls win, and sometimes the bears win. But the bulls have more fun."
—Anonymous

name: Spinal Villain
text: "Striking silent as a dream,/ Cutting short the strangled scream . . ." —Tobrian, "Watchdragon"

name: The Brute
text: "Union may be strength, but it is mere blind brute strength unless wisely directed." —Samuel Butler

name: Wall of Dust
text: An ever-moving swarm of dust engulfs and disorients anything that comes near.

name: Wall of Earth
text: The ground shuddered violently and the earth seemed to come to life. The elemental force contained in the vast wall of earth was trapped, bent to its controller's will.

name: Wall of Heat
text: At a distance, we mistook the sound for a waterfall . . .

name: Wall of Opposition
text: Like so many obstacles in life, the Wall of Opposition is but an illusion, held fast by the focus and belief of the one who creates it.

name: Winds of Change
text: "'Tis the set of sails, and not the gales,/ Which tells us the way to go." —Ella Wheeler Wilcox

name: Barbary Apes
text: Unpredictable in the extreme, these carnivorous apes will prey even upon their own kind.

name: Cat Warriors
text: These stealthy felines have survived so many battles that some believe they must possess many lives.

name: Craw Giant
text: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

name: Durkwood Boars
text: "And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine; and the herd ran violently . . ." —Mark 5:13

name: Elven Riders
text:
"Sometimes it is better to be swift of foot than strong of swordarm."
—Elven Proverb

name: Emerald Dragonfly
text: "Flittering, wheeling, / darting in to strike, and then / gone just as you blink." —"Dragonfly Haiku," poet unknown

name: Giant Turtle
text:
"The turtle lives 'twixt plated decks/ Which practically conceal its sex./ I think it clever of the turtle/ In such a fix to be so fertile."
—Ogden Nash, "The Turtle"

name: Hornet Cobra
text:
"Then inch by inch out of the grass rose up the head and spread hood of Nag, the big black cobra, and he was five feet long from tongue to tail."
—Rudyard Kipling, *The Jungle Books*

name: Killer Bees
text: The communal mind produces a savage strategy, yet no one could predict that this vicious crossbreed would unravel the secret of steel.

name: Moss Monster
text: After the battle, an eerie silence gripped the forest. The losers' remains were lightly dusted with green.

name: Alabaster Potion
text: "Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity." —D'Avenant proverb

name: Holy Day
text:
"The day of spirits; my soul's calm retreat/ Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "Silex Scintillans"

name: Revelation
text: "Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek." —Ecclesiastes 3:19

name: Rust
text:
"How dull it is to pause, to make an end,/ To rust unburnished, not to shine in use,/ As though to breathe were life!"
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "Ulysses"

name: Shelkin Brownie
text: Leave a bowl of milk on your doorstep each night for the brownies, or they'll cause you no end of mischief.

name: Typhoon
text: Fierce winds ripped across the tropical landscape. What they did not destroy with their fiery breath was washed away by torrential rain.

name: Indestructible Aura
text: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.

name: Winter Blast
text: "Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!" —William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

name: Wolverine Pack
text: "Give them great meals of beef and iron and steel, they will eat like wolves and fight like devils." —William Shakespeare, *King Henry V*

name: Adun Oakenshield
text: ". . . And at his passing, the bodies of the world's great warriors shall rise from their graves and follow him to battle." —*The Anvilonian Grimoire*

name: Angus Mackenzie
text: "Battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas." —Angus Mackenzie, *Diary*

name: Barktooth Warbeard
text: He is devious and cunning, in both appearance and deed. Beware the Warbeard, for this brute bites as well as he barks!

name: Bartel Runeaxe
text: Thundering down from Hammerheim, no foe could slow Bartel's charge.

name: Dakkon Blackblade
text: "My power is as vast as the plains, my strength is that of mountains. Each wave that crashes upon the shore thunders like blood in my veins." —*Memoirs*

name: Gwendlyn Di Corci
text: Urborg became the final resting place of many swordsmen of renown, their steel outmatched by the wiles of Gwendlyn.

name: Halfdane
text: Hail from Tolaria the ever changing 'Dane.

name: Ivory Guardians
text: The elite guard of the Mesa High Priests, the Ivory Guardians, were created to protect the innocent and faithful. Some say their actions are above the law.

name: Hunding Gjornersen
text: "You would never guess, at the terrifying sight of the man, that Hunding was as charming a companion as one could wish for."

name: Jacques le Vert
text: Abandoning his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, Jacques le Vert devoted his life to protecting the creatures of his homeland.

name: Jasmine Boreal
text: "Peace must prevail, even if the wicked must die."

name: Jedit Ojanen
text: Mightiest of the Cat Warriors, Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

name: Jerrard of the Closed Fist
text: Once, the order of the Closed Fist reached throughout the Kb'Briann Highlands. Now, Jerrard alone remains to uphold their standard.

name: Kasimir the Lone Wolf
text: Popular indeed is the tale of how Kasimir was once a Holy man who renounced his order to take up the sword. But this tale is no more likely than any other.

name: Keepers of the Faith
text: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."

name: Lady Evangela
text: "When milady was young, the sight of a rainbow would fill her soul with peace. As she grew, she learned to share her rapture with others." —*Lady Gabriella*

name: Lady Orca
text: "I do not remember what he said to her. I remember her fiery eyes, fixed upon him for an instant. I remember a flash, and the hot breath of sudden flames made me turn away. When I looked again, Angus was gone." —A Wayfarer, on meeting Lady Orca

name: Livonya Silone
text: Livonya's own nature is a matter of mystery. Nothing is known for sure, merely rumors of unearthly stealth, and unholy alliances.

name: Marhault Elsdragon
text: Marhault follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

name: Pavel Maliki
text: We all know the legend: Pavel wanders the realms, helping those in greatest need. But is this a measure of his generosity, or of his obligation to atone?

name: Ragnar
text: "On the field of honor, a soldier need have no fear."

name: Ramirez DePietro
text: Ramirez DePietro is a most flamboyant pirate. Be careful not to believe his tall tales, especially when you ask his age.

name: Riven Turnbull
text: "Political violence is a perfectly legitimate answer to the persecution handed down by dignitaries of the state."

name: Sir Shandlar of Eberyn
text: "Remember Sir Shandlar! Remember and stand firm!" —rallying cry of the Eberyn militia

name: Sivitri Scarzam
text: Even the brave have cause to tremble at the sight of Sivitri Scarzam. Who else has tamed Scarzam's Dragon?

name: Sunastian Falconer
text: Sunastian has roots in both sorcery and swordplay; he has learned never to depend too heavily on the latter.

name: The Lady of the Mountain
text: Her given name has been lost in the mists of time. Legend says that her silent vigil will one day be ended by the one who, pure of heart and spirit, calls out that name again.

name: Tobias Andrion
text: Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, Tobias is the military right arm of the empire and the figurehead of its freedom.

name: Torsten Von Ursus
text: "How can you accuse me of evil? Though these deeds be unsavory, no one will argue: good shall follow from them."

name: Tuknir Deathlock
text: An explorer of the Æther, Tuknir often discovers himself in the most unusual physical realms.

name: Lifeblood
text:
"Foolish wizard! As you tap the power of your lofty keep, so grows my strength."
—Malvern Xelionos, *Letters*

name: Xira Arien
text: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

name: Al-abara's Carpet
text: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger, and the carpet carried her high out of our reach.

name: Moat
text: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

name: Horn of Deafening
text: "A blast, an echo . . . then silence."

name: Osai Vultures
text: A sign of battle, the Vultures circle and wait for the victorious to depart.

name: Planar Gate
text: Nireya reached through the Gate, sensing the energies trapped beyond.

name: Amrou Kithkin
text: Quick and agile, Amrou Kithkin can usually escape from even the most fearsome opponents.

name: Petra Sphinx
text: What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs in the afternoon, and three legs in the evening?

name: Hammerheim
text: "'Tis distance lends enchantment to the view,/ And robes the mountain in its azure hue." —Thomas Campbell, "Pleasures of Hope"

name: Karakas
text: "To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee,/ One clover, and a bee,/ And revery." —Emily Dickinson

name: Pendelhaven
text: "This is the forest primeval. The murmuring pines and the hemlocks . . . / Stand like Druids of old." —Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, "Evangeline"

name: Tolaria
text: "Fairest Isle, all isles excelling,/ Seat of Pleasures, and of loves . . ." —John Dryden

name: Urborg
text: "Resignedly beneath the sky/The melancholy waters lie./So blend the turrets and shadows there/That all seem pendulous in air,/While from a proud tower in town/Death looks gigantically down." —Edgar Allan Poe, "The City in the Sea"

name: Righteous Avengers
text: Few can withstand the wrath of the righteous.

name: Thunder Spirit
text:
"It was full of fire and smoke and light and . . . it drove between us and the Efrafans like a thousand thunderstorms with lightning."
—Richard Adams, *Watership Down*

name: Tundra Wolves
text: I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains.

name: Visions
text:
"Visions of glory, spare my aching sight,/ Ye unborn ages, crowd not on my soul!"
—Thomas Gray, *The Bard*

name: Wall of Caltrops
text: "Ow! Ow ow ow! Oooh, ow, OW!"

name: Wall of Light
text: As many attackers were dazzled by the wall's beauty as were halted by its force.

name: Azure Drake
text: The Azure Drake would be more powerful were it not so easily distracted.

name: Boomerang
text:
"O! call back yesterday, bid time return."
—William Shakespeare, *King Richard the Second*

name: Cleanse
text: The clouds broke and the sun's rays burst forth; each foul beast in its turn faltered, and was gone.

name: Devouring Deep
text: "Full fathom five thy father lies;/ Of his bones are coral made;/ Those are pearls that were his eyes;/ Nothing of him that doth fade,/ But doth suffer a sea-change/ Into something rich and strange." —William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

name: Dream Coat
text:
"Adopt the character of the twisting octopus, which takes on the appearance of the nearby rock. Now follow in this direction, now turn a different hue."
—Theognis, *Elegies 1, 215*

name: Field of Dreams
text: Some people say that the world is round, and if you travel far enough you'll come to the other side, where everything is upside down.

name: Flash Counter
text:
"She grinned at me—a wicked grin. 'I hope you weren't relying too heavily on that, my dear.'"
—Medryn Silverwand, *Diary*

name: Flash Flood
text: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.

name: Gaseous Form
text:
". . . [A]nd gives to airy nothing/ A local habitation and a name."
—William Shakespeare, *A Midsummer-Night's Dream*

name: Part Water
text:
". . . and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left."
—Exodus, 14:22

name: Psionic Entity
text: Creatures of the Æther are notorious for neglecting their own well-being.

name: Remove Soul
text: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

name: Segovian Leviathan
text:
"Leviathan, too! Can you catch him with a fish-hook/ or run a line round his tongue?"
—*Job 40:25*

name: Wall of Vapor
text:
"Walls of a castle are made out of stone,/ Walls of a house out of bricks or of wood./ My walls are made out of magic alone,/ Stronger than any that ever have stood."
—Chrysoberyl Earthsdaughter, *Incantations*

name: Wall of Wonder
text: So confusing is the Wall's appearance that few of its victims even see it move.

name: Zephyr Falcon
text: Although greatly prized among falconers, the Zephyr Falcon is capricious and not easily tamed.

name: Divine Offering
text: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact. The fight was getting ugly.

name: Carrion Ants
text: "'War is no picnic,' my father liked to say. But the Ants seemed to disagree." —*General Chanek Valteroth*

name: Cosmic Horror
text: "Then flashed the living lightning from her eyes,/ And screams of horror rend th' affrighted skies." —Alexander Pope, *The Rape of the Lock*

name: Cyclopean Mummy
text: The ritual of plucking out an eye to gain future sight is but a curse that enables the living to see their own deaths.

name: Darkness
text: "If I must die, I will encounter darkness as a bride,/ And hug it in my arms." —William Shakespeare, *Measure for Measure*

name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
text: "The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat."

name: Ghosts of the Damned
text: The voices of the dead ring in the heart long after they have faded from the ears.

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."

name: Goblin Grappler
text: Daru soldiers learned it's better to have a clean death from a sharp blade than to tangle with a goblin's rusted chains.

name: Goblin Lookout
text: "Throw rocks at 'em! Throw spears at 'em! Throw Furt at 'em!"

name: Hunter Sliver
text: Once they get the scent, there is no escape.

name: Lavaborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Macetail Hystrodon
text: The goblins tracked the hystrodon with much stealth and cunning. Then they were eaten with much pain and yelling.

name: Magma Sliver
text: As malleable as molten steel, but as dangerous as the finished blade.

name: Ridgetop Raptor
text:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

name: Skirk Alarmist
text: "I treat each day as your last."

name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
text: "I order you to volunteer."

name: Skirk Outrider
text: Once the goblins thought about it, they preferred being atop a slateback to being in front of, behind, or underneath one.

name: Berserk Murlodont
text:
"The harder we press forward, the harder Krosa pushes us back."
—Aven scout

name: Branchsnap Lorian
text: Lorians treat trees and prey the same way: by ripping them limb from limb.

name: Brontotherium
text: Lucky victims get run over. Unlucky victims get run through.

name: Brood Sliver
text: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

name: Defiant Elf
text: "I lost one home when Yavimaya was destroyed. I will not lose another."

name: Elvish Soultiller
text: Mutated elves wondered if this was their final form, or if it was just another step.

name: Enormous Baloth
text: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

name: Glowering Rogon
text: A herd of one.

name: Hundroog
text:
"New links are being added to the food chain on a daily basis."
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Essence Sliver
text: The slivers would survive, even at the expense of every other creature on Otaria.

name: Needleshot Gourna
text: The first aven scout squad returned from Krosa with disturbing stories. The second returned with disturbing casualties.

name: Quick Sliver
text: The directors of the Riptide Project wanted instant results on the sliver experiments. They got their wish.

name: Root Sliver
text:
"It would take another apocalypse to stop the slivers now."
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Stonewood Invoker
text: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

name: Totem Speaker
text: "Elves and beasts are tied together, and I am the knot that binds them."

name: Vexing Beetle
text: As the Mirari's mutating effects grew out of control, centaurs and druids fled—but insects swarmed closer.

name: Wirewood Channeler
text: "Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."

name: Wirewood Hivemaster
text: "Most insects have been drawn to the Mirari. But all that remain in Wirewood are under my care."

name: Glowrider
text: "It is not yet time."

name: Lowland Tracker
text:
"I feed my hatred to the righteous and they join my crusade."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Planar Guide
text: "Every moment has its own savior."

name: Plated Sliver
text: Overcoming extinction has only made the slivers more determined to live.

name: Akroma's Devoted
text: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

name: Starlight Invoker
text: The Mirari glows in her eyes.

name: Stoic Champion
text: His outer calm belies his inner fury.

name: Wall of Hope
text:
"What cage would you rather be inside of than out?"
—Daru riddle

name: Ward Sliver
text: The first wave of slivers perished from the Riptide wizards' magic. The second wave shrugged off their spells like water.

name: Whipgrass Entangler
text: "Now that I have your attention, perhaps I can tell you of the Order."

name: White Knight
text: In the wretched depths of the Grand Coliseum, his soul shines like a single torch blazing in the night.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Aven Redeemer
text: Redeemers rise with the sun, and the spirits of the people rise with them.

name: Aven Envoy
text: Their grieving faces tell far more than a list of casualties ever could.

name: Cephalid Pathmage
text: Pathmages can open doors that aren't even there.

name: Covert Operative
text: Some spies seek clarity. Others seek transparency.

name: Dreamborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Fugitive Wizard
text: Many wizards came to the Riptide Project hoping to return home with answers. Most, however, wouldn't return home at all.

name: Glintwing Invoker
text: The Mirari flares in his mind.

name: Keeneye Aven
text: "I have no need of a map. The very continent itself guides my way."

name: Keeper of the Nine Gales
text: "You cannot fight the storm."

name: Merchant of Secrets
text: To scrape out a living in Aphetto, wizards are reduced to selling rumors, lies, forgeries, or—if they get desperate enough—the truth.

name: Mistform Sliver
text: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

name: Mistform Ultimus
text: It may wear your face, but its mind is its own.

name: Primoc Escapee
text: Though a completely artificial species, primocs are a natural fit for the skies of Otaria.

name: Beacon of Destiny
text: "We all borrowed life from the Ancestor to exist in this world. Today, I repay that debt."

name: Riptide Director
text: Those who lead others to wisdom become the wisest themselves.

name: Riptide Mangler
text: It wants you to be its chum.

name: Shifting Sliver
text: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

name: Synapse Sliver
text:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Warped Researcher
text: New insights yield new senses.

name: Blood Celebrant
text:
"Their blood is the nectar that nourishes the Cabal."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Crypt Sliver
text:
"Death couldn't contain the slivers. What made us think we could?"
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Dark Supplicant
text: Cabal clerics serve two masters: their patriarch and their god.

name: Deathmark Prelate
text: Death is a secret he is willing to share.

name: Drinker of Sorrow
text: It strikes at your soul, heedless of your prayers.

name: Dripping Dead
text: It oozes death from every pore.

name: Earthblighter
text: "A single dedicated mind can bring about the greatest destruction. That, or goblins—goblins work too."

name: Cloudreach Cavalry
text: "It's easy to lose sight of hope until you gaze out from my vantage point."

name: Goblin Turncoat
text:
"Goblins won't betray their own kind for any price. They'll do it for a very specific price."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Graveborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Havoc Demon
text: A cry of pain as it enters this world. A chorus of screams as it leaves.

name: Noxious Ghoul
text: Plague and death wrapped in one convenient package.

name: Smokespew Invoker
text: The Mirari festers in its flesh.

name: Sootfeather Flock
text: They pick at the remains of the city's corpse.

name: Spectral Sliver
text:
"Sure, I've seen agents of the Cabal here and there. Well, not here, and certainly not in any of the sliver labs. Oh dear, I've said too much."
—Apprentice researcher

name: Toxin Sliver
text: It doesn't need to use its venom—it just needs you to know it can.

name: Vile Deacon
text: "The Cabal and the Order really aren't that different. After all, we are both empowered by faith."

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Zombie Brute
text: Measure its determination by the screams of its prey.

name: Blade Sliver
text: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria—much to the dismay of life on Otaria.

name: Clickslither
text: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

name: Crested Craghorn
text:
"Craghorns experience a wide range of emotions: rage, fury, anger . . ."
—Foothill guide

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: The Mirari burns in his heart.

name: Frenetic Raptor
text:
"How do you stop a raptor from charging? No, seriously! Help!"
—Blarg, goblin jester

name: Goblin Assassin
text: The more victims he kills, the more likely he is to get the right one.

name: Goblin Clearcutter
text:
"Did you know that wood burns even better than rocks?"
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

name: Goblin Firebug
text: Most goblins leave behind a wake of destruction. A few goblins take one with them.

name: Goblin Goon
text: Giant-sized body. Goblin-sized brain.

name: Boggart Birth Rite
text: Auntie excitedly held up the squalling newborn. "This one looks like Byoog! Maybe he'll tell us what he saw and felt in the beyond."

name: Boggart Loggers
text: Auntie Flint lent axes to Nibb and Gyik, thinking they'd share their experiences with her. She's still waiting for them to come back.

name: Dreamspoiler Witches
text: At night, the faeries steal dreamstuff for their queen. At daybreak, countless creatures wake weak and hollow.

name: Exiled Boggart
text: Among the boggarts, there is only one real rule: all new treasures and experiences must be shared. Those who hoard their gifts commit the one truly unforgivable sin.

name: Eyeblight's Ending
text:
"Those without beauty are Lorwyn's greatest tumor. The winnowers have an unpleasant duty, but a necessary one."
—Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana

name: Facevaulter
text: Boggarts get so excited when they find something new to smash that they really don't notice who gets underfoot.

name: Faerie Tauntings
text: Beneath the fae's constant pranks runs a subtler undercurrent of mockery: the influence of Oona, their hidden queen.

name: Final Revels
text: One whiff of the sweet, pungent scent leads to euphoria—or to an early grave.

name: Fodder Launch
text: Leave it to a boggart to come up with a projectile as disgusting as it is deadly.

name: Footbottom Feast
text: The scent of rot and vinegar fills the marsh, inviting boggarts from every warren to reunite and feast.

name: Ghostly Changeling
text: In desolate places, changelings may take the shape of fancies, or memories, or fears.

name: Hornet Harasser
text:
"And though she didn't get her honey, Auntie found something far more interesting."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Hunter of Eyeblights
text: Snokk ran as fast as he could, but the sound of hooves grew ever louder in his ears.

name: Knucklebone Witch
text: Each bone honors its owner's best pranks.

name: Lys Alana Scarblade
text: In beauty-obsessed Lys Alana, one cut of her blade means the difference between a high society feast and raking through the dungheap for scraps.

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Makeshift Mannequin
text:
"This vulgar mimicry will end now."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Moonglove Winnower
text: Winnowers live to eliminate eyeblights, creatures the elves deem too ugly to exist.

name: Mournwhelk
text: It hoards Lorwyn's rare sorrows.

name: Nameless Inversion
text: Just as a changeling's influence can have dramatic effects, so too can its sudden withdrawal.

name: Nath's Buffoon
text: Smik learned the elvish dance quickly enough. The most difficult, yet most important step was to stay out of Nath's sight until called to perform.

name: Nectar Faerie
text:
"The unpredictable fae are just as likely to provide a blight as a boon."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Nightshade Stinger
text:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Oona's Prowler
text: Deep in Glen Elendra blossoms Oona, queen of the faeries, nourished by secrets and pollinated by stolen dreams.

name: Peppersmoke
text: Like being trapped in a perpetual sneeze, faerie-dust poisoning is both exhilarating and agonizing.

name: Prowess of the Fair
text: An elvish duel is a thing of beauty: the warriors' grace, the crash of steel, then the artful spray of blood.

name: Quill-Slinger Boggart
text:
"A good day in Goldmeadow is one in which I don't spend all evening picking quills out of my backside."
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Scarred Vinebreeder
text: For disfigured elves, there are few choices beyond death or nettlevine.

name: Favor of the Mighty
text:
"What does a mountain fear of a fly? Giants are barely aware of us, let alone afraid."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Skeletal Changeling
text: Though they lack true flesh and bone of their own, changelings imitate either with equal ease.

name: Spiderwig Boggart
text: Auntie Flint was the first to pioneer the spiderwig, a mass of arachnids intended to be worn rather than eaten.

name: Squeaking Pie Sneak
text:
"Why do our pies squeak? It's all the faeries, mice, and prickly-hogs we stuff inside."
—Borb of the Squeaking Pie warren

name: Thorntooth Witch
text: The crone's boughs creaked as she spoke. "You look peaked, little one. Come, sip from my warm brew. It'll have you blooming in no time."

name: Thoughtseize
text: "Any dream is a robust harvest. Still, I prefer the timeworn dreams, heavy with import, that haunt the obsessive mind."

name: Warren Pilferers
text: "What do they need all this stuff for? They're dead. We're alive. Simple enough."

name: Axegrinder Giant
text: The angriest of giants are often the most skillful weaponsmiths. Their grudges fuel endless sessions at the forge, all the while growling ferociously to themselves.

name: Blades of Velis Vel
text: "The changing kind suffers as we do. We must join as one to quench our tyrants!"

name: Blind-Spot Giant
text: Among the solitude-loving giantkind, teamwork is unusual. But he appreciates hearing the occasional "Swing down and to your left."

name: Boggart Forager
text:
"Reach in this hole, lose a hand. Reach in that hole, find a sparkly."
—Auntie wisdom

name: Boggart Shenanigans
text: Boggarts revel in discovering new sensations, from the texture of an otter pellet to the squeak of a dying warren mate.

name: Boggart Sprite-Chaser
text:
"Auntie pointed out to the faerie how much mischief a flying boggart could wreak, and a beautiful new friendship was born."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Caterwauling Boggart
text:
"As far as I can tell, that frog dangling from the stick serves absolutely no purpose whatsoever."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Ceaseless Searblades
text: Flamekins' fires burn cool until they decide otherwise.

name: Goldmeadow Dodger
text: "I've gotten close enough to a giant to smell his breath, but none has ever so much as spotted me. I wonder how long my record can extend?"

name: Consuming Bonfire
text:
