name: Rise of the Witch-king
text: In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face.

name: Sauron's Ransom
text: "He was dear to you, I see. And now he shall endure the slow torment of years."

name: Shadow Summoning
text:
"Whose shall the horn be? Who shall call them from the grey twilight, the forgotten people? The heir of him to whom the oath they swore."
—Malbeth the Seer

name: Saruman's Trickery
text:
"I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly."
—Saruman

name: Strider, Ranger of the North
text: The greatest traveler and huntsman of this age of the world.

name: Théoden, King of Rohan
text: "Dark have been my dreams of late, but I feel new-awakened. I only fear that already you have come too late, Gandalf."

name: Uglúk of the White Hand
text: "I am Uglúk. I command. I return to Isengard by the shortest road."

name: Ent-Draught Basin
text: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigor as it coursed upward, right to the tips of the hair.

name: Horn of the Mark
text:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Éowyn

name: Inherited Envelope
text:
"Keep it secret, and keep it safe!"
—Gandalf

name: Lembas
text: They could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran.

name: Mirror of Galadriel
text: "Your Quest stands upon the edge of a knife. Stray but a little and it will fail, to the ruin of all. Yet hope remains while all the Company is true."

name: Phial of Galadriel
text: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."

name: Soothing of Sméagol
text: Frodo's heart sank. This was too much like trickery, and certainly what he did would seem a treachery to the poor treacherous creature.

name: Shire Scarecrow
text:
"How bright your garden looks!"
—Gandalf

name: Stone of Erech
text:
"At the Stone of Erech they shall stand again and hear there a horn in the hills ringing."
—Malbeth the Seer

name: Barad-dûr
text:
"Those who pass the gates of Barad-dûr do not return."
—Gandalf

name: Great Hall of the Citadel
text:
"Renewed shall be blade that was broken: The crownless again shall be king."
—Bilbo

name: The Grey Havens
text: There dwelt Círdan the Shipwright, and some say he dwells there still, until the Last Ship sets sail into the West.

name: Minas Tirith
text:
"I would see the White Tree in flower again in the courts of the kings, and Minas Tirith in peace."
—Faramir

name: Mines of Moria
text:
"Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!"
—Glóin

name: Stern Scolding
text: "Fool of a Took! This is a serious journey, not a Hobbit walking-party. Throw yourself in next time, and then you will be no further nuisance. Now be quiet!"

name: Rivendell
text:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn

name: The Shire
text:
"You must start somewhere and have some roots, and the soil of the Shire is deep."
—Merry

name: Shire Terrace
text: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.

name: Storm of Saruman
text: Isengard had once been filled with fruitful trees, but no green thing grew there in the latter days of Saruman.

name: The Battle of Bywater
text: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head. Merry now had enough sturdy Hobbitry to deal with the ruffians.

name: Flowering of the White Tree
text: Aragorn planted the new tree in the court by the fountain, and swiftly and gladly it began to grow.

name: Willow-Wind
text: The branches of the willow began to sway violently. Frodo called for help, but he could hardly hear his own voice: it was blown away from him by the willow-wind and drowned in a clamor of leaves.

name: Borne Upon a Wind
text:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

name: Goldberry, River-Daughter
text: "Fear nothing! For tonight you are under the roof of Tom Bombadil."

name: Press the Enemy
text: "I showed the blade reforged to him. He is not so mighty yet that he is above fear."

name: Rangers of Ithilien
text: "We have a new errand on this journey: to ambush the Men of Harad."

name: Call of the Ring
text: "The Ring is mine!"

name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
text: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

name: Display of Power
text:
"The Nazgûl closed round at night, and I was besieged. Such light and flame cannot have been seen on Weathertop since the war-beacons of old."
—Gandalf

name: Bitter Downfall
text:
"I tried to take the Ring from Frodo. I am sorry. I have paid."
—Boromir

name: Moria Marauder
text: There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit; amid the clamor a deep voice was raised in command.

name: Delighted Halfling
text: There were toys the Hobbit-children had never seen before, all beautiful, and some obviously magical.

name: Elven Chorus
text: "A Elbereth Gilthoniel, silivren penna míriel o menel aglar elenath!"

name: Doors of Durin
text: "Speak, friend, and enter."

name: The Black Breath
text:
"When the black breath blows, death's shadow grows."
—A rhyme of old days

name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
text:
"Whatever is wrong in the Shire, Lotho will be at the bottom of it: you can be sure of that."
—Pippin

name: Sauron's Ransom
text: "He was dear to you, I see. And now he shall endure the slow torment of years."

name: Horn of the Mark
text:
"He that blows this horn shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends."
—Éowyn

name: Call of the Ring
text: "The Ring is mine!"

name: Phial of Galadriel
text: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."

name: Cirith Ungol Patrol
text:
"Spies feared on Stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs."
—Shagrat's orders

name: Claim the Precious
text:
"I think it is a sad story, and it might have happened to others, even to some Hobbits that I have known."
—Gandalf

name: Dunland Crebain
text:
"What's that, Strider? It don't look like a cloud."
—Sam

name: Eagle of Deliverance
text: Even as he came swooping down, Gwaihir saw the two figures fall, worn out, hiding their eyes from death.

name: Mirkwood Channeler
text: The dark things that were driven out of Mirkwood have returned in greater numbers, and it is again an evil place, save where the Elvish realm is maintained.

name: Eagle of Deliverance
text: Even as he came swooping down, Gwaihir saw the two figures fall, worn out, hiding their eyes from death.

name: Easterling Vanguard
text: An army of Easterlings charged forth, while from the hills poured Orcs innumerable.

name: Mirkwood Channeler
text: The dark things that were driven out of Mirkwood have returned in greater numbers, and it is again an evil place, save where the Elvish realm is maintained.

name: Gollum, Patient Plotter
text: "They'll take it, steal my Precious. Thieves. We hates them."

name: Gollum's Bite
text:
"It was Pity that stayed Bilbo's hand. Do not be too eager to deal out death in judgment; Gollum has some part to play yet, before the end."
—Gandalf, to Frodo

name: Gríma Wormtongue
text: "Do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength. Let others deal with these irksome guests."

name: East-Mark Cavalier
text:
"The Rohirrim have long been the friends of the people of Gondor, though they are not akin to them."
—Aragorn

name: Haunt of the Dead Marshes
text:
"You should not look in when the candles are lit."
—Gollum

name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
text: Isildur cut the Ring from Sauron's hand with the hilt-shard of his father's sword, and Sauron himself was overthrown.

name: Lash of the Balrog
text: Even as the Balrog fell, it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about Gandalf's knees, dragging him to the brink of the abyss. "Fly, you fools!" he cried, and was gone.

name: March from the Black Gate
text: Like a storm, they broke upon the line of the Men of Gondor.

name: Mirkwood Bats
text:
"The enemy has many spies and many ways of hearing."
—Gandalf

name: Mordor Muster
text:
"Orcs, thousands of Orcses. Nice Hobbits mustn't go to those places."
—Gollum

name: Morgul-Knife Wound
text: Frodo felt a pain like a dart of poisoned ice pierce his left shoulder.

name: Nasty End
text:
"And that's the end of that. A nasty end for Saruman, and I wish I needn't have seen it; but it's a good riddance."
—Sam

name: Excommunicate
text:
"Our law prohibits capital punishment. We believe even the gravest offenders have the chance to redeem themselves."
—Torian Sha, soul warden

name: Hypnotic Specter
text: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.

name: Kelinore Bat
text: The nesting bats of Kelinore sleep soundly while the sun passes, nestled among their grisly collections.

name: Looming Shade
text: Its form never rests, propelled by some undetectable gale from beyond the gloom.

name: Megrim
text:
"It's a vicious circle. Stress breeds pain. Pain breeds stress. It's simply beautiful, wouldn't you agree?"
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Mind Rot
text:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

name: Mind Shatter
text: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Glorious Charge
text:
"One's blade is only as sharp as one's conviction."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

name: Soul Bleed
text: Whether the end comes swift or slow, it always comes too soon.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Unholy Strength
text:
"Born under the moon, the second child will stumble on temptation and seek power in the dark places of the heart."
—Codex of the Constellari

name: Vampire Aristocrat
text: "I admit, I am a creature of the city. The sights, the nightly excitement, the abundance of fine drink . . ."

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Griffin Sentinel
text: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

name: Warpath Ghoul
text: The battle was over, but the carnage continued for days.

name: Weakness
text: "For strength to have any meaning, there must also be . . . you."

name: Zombie Goliath
text:
"Phirax of Blood Ridge has sent a war giant at us? What, do I have to spell it out for you? Kill the giant, scoop out its skull, and drive it back to Blood Ridge. Honestly, what kind of necromancer minions are you?"
—Keren-Dur, necromancer lord

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Berserkers of Blood Ridge
text: They take a blood oath to die in battle. So far none have failed to fulfill the promise.

name: Burning Inquiry
text: Jariad burned the midnight oil, burned through scroll after scroll, and then burned down his laboratory.

name: Burst of Speed
text: Great generals inspire by example. Goblin chieftains inspire by electrifying the barracks.

name: Guardian Seraph
text: Her gaze prevents the petty sins and her sword punishes the rest.

name: Canyon Minotaur
text:
"We'll scale these cliffs, traverse Brittle Bridge, and then fight our way down the volcanic slopes on the other side."
"Isn't the shortest route through the canyon?"
"Yes."
"So shouldn't we—"
"No."

name: Capricious Efreet
text: "You wish for great destruction? It is done, my master."

name: Earthquake
text: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

name: Fiery Hellhound
text: Once a barbarian army has conquered a region, their shamans summon hellhounds that keep undesirables out and prisoners in.

name: Firebreathing
text: The mage breathed in life-giving air and breathed out death-bringing fire.

name: Goblin Artillery
text: Most goblins get their turn firing the catapult, but few achieve the coveted title of Ammunition Holder.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

name: Harm's Way
text: Even when fate is already written, there's always time to change the names.

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Ignite Disorder
text: The shaman prowled the academy halls, shaking his head at the pomp and babble of the sages inside. He knew just the spell to liven the place up.

name: Inferno Elemental
text:
"Those who wish to invade our monastery, please take it up with my servant."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Jackal Familiar
text:
"Let the gray-hairs keep their ravens and drakes. My familiar will be a reflection of me: bloodthirsty, with a predator's instinct."
—Taivang, barbarian warlord

name: Kindled Fury
text:
"Rage is a dangerous weapon. Your enemies will try to use your anger against you. Use it against them first."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"A flash of the lightning, a break of the wave,
He passes from life to his rest in the grave."
—William Knox, "Mortality"

name: Manabarbs
text:
"I don't know why people say a double-edged sword is bad. It's a sword. With two edges."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Holy Strength
text:
"Born under the sun, the first child will seek the foundation of honor and be fortified by its righteousness."
—Codex of the Constellari

name: Panic Attack
text:
"What do they see in the throes of panic? I'm not sure I want to know."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Seismic Strike
text:
"Life up here is simple. Adapt to the ways of the mountains and they will reward you. Fight them and they will end you."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

name: Shatter
text: Days of planning. Weeks of building. Months of perfecting. Seconds of smashing.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Sparkmage Apprentice
text: Sparkmages are performance artists of sorts, but pain is the price of admission.

name: Stone Giant
text: A typical day for a giant. A momentous event for a goat.

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Trumpet Blast
text: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack. They need signals to tell them when to stop.

name: Viashino Spearhunter
text: Viashino lack the majesty of their draconic ancestors, but they lash out with equal rage and twice the spite.

name: Wall of Fire
text: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

name: Yawning Fissure
text: The mapmaker scowled. He sighed, unrolled his parchment, and painted a large black blob where the Eternal Meadow was once marked.

name: Ant Queen
text:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

name: Awakener Druid
text: The druids of Mazar treat each seedcone with respect for the warrior it will become.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Each feather in its tail is a souvenir of an exotic land, a memory condensed in hue.

name: Borderland Ranger
text: "Only fools and bandits use roads."

name: Bountiful Harvest
text: Following the sun's cycle, harvest season comes once a year—unless the druids bid the sun behave otherwise.

name: Bramble Creeper
text:
"I've seen the fully grown ones tear a baloth to gory ribbons in seconds."
—Kivi, thornberry harvester

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Craw Wurm
text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Emerald Oryx
text: After the oryx dies, its flesh returns to the earth, but its emerald bones remain as a tribute to the forest.

name: Lifelink
text: The spoils of war are not measured only in gold and silver.

name: Enormous Baloth
text: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

name: Entangling Vines
text: Every living thing has roots in nature. Sometimes nature gets its roots into you.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Giant Spider
text: The giant spider's silk naturally resists gravity, almost weaving itself as it blankets the forest canopy.

name: Great Sable Stag
text: Ineffable and incorruptible.

name: Howl of the Night Pack
text: The murderous horrors of Raven's Run are legendary, but even that haunted place goes quiet when the night wolves howl.

name: Kalonian Behemoth
text:
"Do not fire upon it—it is bad luck. And a waste of arrows."
—Alera Benath, Kalonian ranger

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Lurking Predators
text: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

name: Might of Oaks
text:
May your weapon be no sword forged. May your armor be no metal wrought.
—Elvish saying

name: Mist Leopard
text:
"I can't claim to hunt all creatures. There are some things in the jungle that simply can't be hunted."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Mold Adder
text: The more you struggle against its coils, the tighter they get.

name: Naturalize
text: If you want to destroy something lifeless, make it live.

name: Nature's Spiral
text: Like nature, the fern spirals back on itself, eternally seeking its own center.

name: Oakenform
text:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Prized Unicorn
text:
"The desire for its magic horn inspires such bloodthirsty greed that all who see the unicorn will kill to possess it."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Angel's Mercy
text:
"Until that day I cursed the angels, those uncaring lights in the sky. They rewarded my scorn with the gift of time, every year of which I've spent in devotion to their names."
—Torian Sha, soul warden

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Regenerate
text: "This wound shall be like the chills of winter: swiftly forgotten when spring shoots rise."

name: Runeclaw Bear
text: Bears aren't always as strong and as mean as you imagine. Some are even stronger and meaner.

name: Stampeding Rhino
text:
"Sometimes I wonder if our weapons and armor are a step backward."
—Soron, rhox pikemaster

name: Windstorm
text:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Coat of Arms
text: A banner for bonds of blood or belief.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Open the Vaults
text: When the vaults are empty, everyone is rich.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

name: Howling Mine
text: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

name: Kraken's Eye
text: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

name: Mirror of Fate
text: As the glass shattered, forgotten realities and dead memories came flooding back.

name: Ornithopter
text: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

name: Pithing Needle
text: It disables with pinpoint accuracy.

name: Platinum Angel
text: In its heart lies the secret of immortality.

name: Rod of Ruin
text:
"My masterpiece is complete—and so shall be my triumph."
—Saldrath, master artificer

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Spellbook
text:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

name: Gargoyle Castle
text: Most knew of the tower's wizard and gargoyle. Few realized which was guardian and which was master.

name: Palace Guard
text: "I'm not nearly as bothered by being outnumbered as I am by their foul stench."

name: Razorfoot Griffin
text: Like a meteor, it strikes from above without warning. Unlike a meteor, it then carries you off and eats you.

name: Rhox Pikemaster
text: When the rhoxes charge, everyone else knows which way to run.

name: Righteousness
text: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

name: Safe Passage
text: With one flap of her wings, the angel beat back the fires of war.

name: Serra Angel
text: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

name: Armored Ascension
text: "The meadow sprang up beneath me, and I perceived a path from our people's defeat to our highest glory."

name: Siege Mastodon
text:
"Defending the citadel is easy. I just take these big fellows outside the main gate and let the enemy take a good long look."
—Mastodon keeper

name: Silence
text:
"All the wizardry in the world has to pass through one small and easily sealed door."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Silvercoat Lion
text: Hunters of every species on the savannah, silvercoats disdain camouflage in favor of total dominance of the food chain.

name: Solemn Offering
text:
"A relic donation is suggested."
"The suggestion is mandatory."
—Temple signs

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Stormfront Pegasus
text:
"At summer's end, the pegasus herd stampedes across the sky. Their silent footfalls taunt the clouds and bid the rains to come."
—Stormfront fable

name: Tempest of Light
text: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

name: Undead Slayer
text: "My motive is not vengeance but mercy. I deliver the soulless back to their severed souls."

name: Veteran Armorsmith
text: "Courage is a proud and gleaming shield. It does not bend or hide from sight. To fight with courage, we must forge in steel."

name: Veteran Swordsmith
text: "Truth is a straight, keen edge. There are no soft angles or rounded edges. To fight for truth, we must forge in steel."

name: Baneslayer Angel
text: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

name: Wall of Faith
text:
"This is a fine suit, armorsmith. I will be safe from harm. If only you could forge rings to mail the rest of my people . . ."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Air Elemental
text:
"The East Wind, an interloper in the dominions of Westerly Weather, is an impassive-faced tyrant with a sharp poniard held behind his back for a treacherous stab."
—Joseph Conrad, *The Mirror of the Sea*

name: Alluring Siren
text:
"The ground polluted floats with human gore,
And human carnage taints the dreadful shore
Fly swift the dangerous coast: let every ear
Be stopp'd against the song! 'tis death to hear!"
—Homer, *The Odyssey*, trans. Pope

name: Clone
text: The shapeshifter mimics with a twin's esteem and a mirror's cruelty.

name: Convincing Mirage
text: "Where are we? You must learn to ask more useful questions than that."

name: Coral Merfolk
text: Merfolk are best known for their subtle magic. But those who try to fight them in their own territory quickly realize that merfolk are hardly defenseless on the field of battle.

name: Disorient
text:
"If it has a brain, even a primitive one, we can most surely scramble it."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Blinding Mage
text: "I carry the light of truth. Do not pity those it blinds, for they never had eyes to see."

name: Essence Scatter
text: Some wizards compete not to summon the most interesting creatures, but to create the most interesting aftereffects when a summons goes awry.

name: Fabricate
text:
"I'm one masterpiece away from ruling this pathetic world."
—Saldrath, master artificer

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Hive Mind
text:
"All consciousness is one, separated only by a thin veil of the physical."
—Jace Beleren

name: Horned Turtle
text: It's a mistake to say turtles hide in their shells. They merely need time to contemplate how best to bite your head off.

name: Illusionary Servant
text:
"Illusion is a handy but fragile medium. Use it only in a pinch, or against the dim-witted."
—Jace Beleren

name: Jump
text:
"Humanity has always envied the power of flight. So we took it."
—Scytha, aeromage

name: Levitation
text: The horses of Scytha's army must be well trained. A thrown rider would fall miles before meeting the ground.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "The sharks envy our ferocity. The eels envy our cunning."

name: Mind Control
text:
"Why fight the body when you can dominate the mind that rules it?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"The construction of a defense is not accomplished by adding bricks."
—Jace Beleren

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Sage Owl
text: Some owls house the souls of archmages of ages past.

name: Celestial Purge
text:
"We see clearly the error of your ways. It does not matter that you choose not to."
—Urien of the Lightwielders

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Snapping Drake
text: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

name: Telepathy
text:
"The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are."
—Teferi, fourth-level student

name: Time Warp
text: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

name: Tome Scour
text: Genius is overrated, especially when it's someone else's.

name: Traumatize
text:
"The educated mind is heavy with lore and knowledge. It's also the most likely to collapse under its own weight."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Twincast
text: Imitation is the most dangerous form of flattery.

name: Unsummon
text: Mages routinely summon creatures from the Æther. It's only fair that they occasionally throw one back.

name: Divine Verdict
text: Giants and pit spawn attempted to topple the cathedral's pillars. The fine grit of their remains still swirls in the breeze outside.

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Wind Drake
text: A smaller cousin to the dragon, drakes are often seen at the side of powerful wizards who use them as airborne eyes and ears.

name: Zephyr Sprite
text: "I've never understood why so many beings lumber around on the ground. There are three dimensions, yet they use only two."

name: Acolyte of Xathrid
text: Like all priests, she gives her blessings only to those truly worthy of them.

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Bog Wraith
text: She died in this swamp, and so will you.

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Child of Night
text: A vampire enacts vengeance on the entire world, claiming her debt two tiny pinpricks at a time.

name: Elite Vanguard
text: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

name: Deathmark
text: Even the noblest of intentions and strongest of wills inevitably crumble into dust.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Disentomb
text:
"Stop complaining. You can rest when you're dead. Oh—sorry."
—Liliana Vess

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Dread Warlock
text: "I don't know who to pity more: those who flee from my presence or the damned who can withstand it."

name: Drudge Skeletons
text:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Gravedigger
text: Oddly, no one questioned the Cabal's wisdom in hiring a zombie to work at the cemetery.

name: Howling Banshee
text: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

name: Cloud Crusader
text: Each crusader bonds with a griffin fledgling while still a child, and the two grow up as siblings.

name: Howling Banshee
text: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

name: Liliana's Caress
text: "This might hurt less if you don't fight so hard. But I doubt it."

name: Liliana's Specter
text:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

name: Mind Rot
text: Not every thought is a good one.

name: Nantuko Shade
text: In life, the nantuko study nature by revering it. In death, they study nature by disemboweling it.

name: Nether Horror
text:
"My dreams darkened and seeped into my waking hours. Spellcraft and nightmare merged to create this monstrosity."
—Sunniva, witch of Holm Hollow

name: Nightwing Shade
text:
"There is one hour of the night even we do not watch."
—Sedva, captain of the watch

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Quag Sickness
text: The dread gases didn't kill Farbid. But as he lay in the muck, miserable and helpless, watching ghouls and rats advance on him, he wished they had.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text: Though you may see the same bones, you'll never see the same skeleton twice.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Rotting Legion
text: Zombies have one speed: shamble.

name: Royal Assassin
text: An assassin is a king's most trusted courier, ensuring his messages are heard by even the most unwilling recipients.

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Stabbing Pain
text:
"You can take the fight out of nearly any creature if you know where its soft spot is."
—Guttor, flesh-warper

name: Unholy Strength
text:
"Born under the moon, the second child will stumble on temptation and seek power in the dark places of the heart."
—Codex of the Constellari

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Ancient Hellkite
text: When a dragon attacks, there are no bystanders.

name: Arc Runner
text: The storms of the wastelands form quickly and hit hard. Few have anything to do with rain.

name: Berserkers of Blood Ridge
text: They take a blood oath to die in battle. So far none have failed to fulfill the promise.

name: Bloodcrazed Goblin
text:
"A single drop of blood draws their attention, then they strip your bones clean before you have time to die."
—Jamias, hermit of Telfer Peak

name: Canyon Minotaur
text:
"We'll scale these cliffs, traverse Brittle Bridge, and then fight our way down the volcanic slopes on the other side."
"Isn't the shortest route through the canyon?"
"Yes."
"So shouldn't we—"
"No."

name: Chandra's Outrage
text:
"Her mind is an incredible mix of emotion and power. Even if I could grasp it, I couldn't hold it for long."
—Jace Beleren, on Chandra Nalaar

name: Chandra's Spitfire
text: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

name: Elite Vanguard
text: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

name: Destructive Force
text: The end of the world rarely comes quietly.

name: Earth Servant
text:
"Fire. Air. Water. These elements spread, filling in the spaces they are not. But earth is implacable like a sullen child."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Ember Hauler
text: Flurk's crude goblin language didn't differentiate between "I *bring* the flame" and "I *am* the flame."

name: Fiery Hellhound
text:
"I had hoped to instill in it the loyalty of a guard dog, but with fire's power comes its unpredictability."
—Maggath, Sardian elementalist

name: Fire Servant
text:
"Elemental fire shimmers with rose hues and, unlike terrestrial blazes, smolders long after it's extinguished."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Excommunicate
text:
"Our law prohibits capital punishment. We believe even the gravest offenders have the chance to redeem themselves."
—Torian Sha, soul warden

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "The enemy is getting too close! Quick! Inflate the toad!"

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Goblin Tunneler
text:
"You never know what's going to be in goblin tunnels. Even in the best case, there will still be goblins."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Incite
text: The veneer of rationality peeled from the mage, revealing the spite and rage beneath.

name: Lava Axe
text: From the heart of the mountain into the heart of the mage.

name: Goldenglow Moth
text:
"Little moth, fluttering bright,
What luck will you bring tonight?"
—Benalish children's rhyme

name: Manic Vandal
text: It's fun. He doesn't need another reason.

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

name: Pyretic Ritual
text: The Multiverse is filled with limitless power just waiting for someone to reach out and seize it.

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Reverberate
text:
"I'm not indecisive. I just don't like to limit my options."
—Maxti, pyromancer

name: Thunder Strike
text: Lightning reflexes, thunderous might.

name: Volcanic Strength
text: His blood boiled over, and he erupted with fists of stone.

name: Vulshok Berserker
text: He will carve out a legend for himself with his own two hands.

name: Holy Strength
text:
"Born under the sun, the first child will seek the foundation of honor and be fortified by its righteousness."
—Codex of the Constellari

name: Autumn's Veil
text: The rustling of leaves and a passing shadow are a dryad's only trace.

name: Awakener Druid
text: The druids of Mazar treat each seedcone with respect for the warrior it will become.

name: Back to Nature
text:
"Nature is a mutable cloud which is always and never the same."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson, *Essays*

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Brindle Boar
text: The war lasted for generations. The boars didn't need to hunt for food anymore. They fed on the fallen corpses, and the living fed off of them.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Dryad's Favor
text: She grants knowledge of the ways to traverse the forest's invisible connections.

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Fauna Shaman
text: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Giant Spider
text: The giant spider's silk naturally resists gravity, almost weaving itself as it blankets the forest canopy.

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Any fool can pick up a sword and charge into battle. To emerge alive at the end, that is a gift that comes from leadership and experience."

name: Greater Basilisk
text: Bone, stone . . . both taste the same to a hungry basilisk.

name: Hornet Sting
text: It was only then—to his infinite sorrow—that Gork realized hornets don't make honey.

name: Hunters' Feast
text: Those who kill a jawspur rhino must prepare spells to lift the carcass—even a dozen hunters can't lift its bulk.

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Naturalize
text:
"Nature does not need adornment."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Nature's Spiral
text: Snail shell, fern, tornado—the world connects all things in form.

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

name: Plummet
text: "You are the grandest of all," said the archdruid to the trees. They became so proud of bark and branch that they suffered no creature to fly overhead or perch upon a bough.

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: Prized Unicorn
text:
"The desire for its magic horn inspires such bloodthirsty greed that all who see the unicorn will kill to possess it."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Runeclaw Bear
text:
"Nature has grown tired of the impositions of men and will begin to outfit its creations with tools for bloody instruction."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Sacred Wolf
text:
"I raised my bow, and the wolf stared at me. Under its gaze, my finger would not release the string."
—Aref the Hunter

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"They're as much like plants as animals. Leave them unchecked, and they'll choke out all other forms of life."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Wall of Vines
text: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.

name: Ajani's Mantra
text:
"He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence."
—Zaliki of Naya

name: Yavimaya Wurm
text: Anywhere else, colossal. In the forests of Yavimaya, commonplace.

name: Angel's Feather
text: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

name: Brittle Effigy
text:
"In my early experiments in phylactery, I found that fragile forms have their uses."
—Rocati, Duke of Martyne

name: Crystal Ball
text: It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Dragon's Claw
text:
"If there is a fire that never ceases to burn, it surely lies in the maw of a dragon."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Gargoyle Sentinel
text:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander

name: Jinxed Idol
text: "Please, honored friend, take it with my compliments. I insist."

name: Juggernaut
text: The mighty city of An Karras, with its rich history, built over thousands of years, fell in three hours.

name: Kraken's Eye
text: It's seen the wonders of entire worlds trapped in the depths of a bottomless ocean.

name: Ornithopter
text: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Sorcerer's Strongbox
text: Simun the Quiet filled the chest with his most precious thoughts. But in a fit of paranoia, he locked up the memory of where he hid the key.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Stone Golem
text: The sculptor, like most artists, put his heart and soul in his work. But the newly awakened golem decided he wanted his creator's other, more tangible parts.

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Temple Bell
text: Enlightenment is not gained by striking the bell or hearing its toll. It's found in the silence that follows.

name: Triskelion
text:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

name: Voltaic Key
text: The missing piece to every puzzle.

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Warlord's Axe
text: To split wood with it would be sacrilege. This tool has but one purpose, and that is war.

name: Wurm's Tooth
text:
"The great wurm bit down on me. Instead of being crunched bloody, I slid into the space where its tooth was missing. One tooth—a boon most potent, indeed."
—*The Tall Tales of Oleander*

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Palace Guard
text: "I'm not nearly as bothered by being outnumbered as I am by their foul stench."

name: Safe Passage
text: With one flap of her wings, the angel beat back the fires of war.

name: Serra Angel
text: Perfect justice in service of a perfect will.

name: Siege Mastodon
text:
"The walls of the wicked will fall before us. Ready the siege engines. We proceed to war!"
—General Avitora

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Silence
text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Silvercoat Lion
text:
"In the wild, white fur like mine is an aberration. We lack natural camouflage, but the inability to hide encourages other strengths."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Solemn Offering
text:
"A relic donation is suggested."
"The suggestion is mandatory."
—Temple signs

name: Stormfront Pegasus
text:
"At summer's end, the pegasus herd stampedes across the sky. Their silent footfalls taunt the clouds and bid the rains to come."
—Stormfront fable

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Tireless Missionaries
text: If they succeed in their holy work, their order will vanish into welcome obscurity, for there will be no more souls to redeem.

name: War Priest of Thune
text: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

name: Wild Griffin
text: Farmers typically keep their flocks at thirteen sheep—one to distract the griffins while they take the other twelve to market.

name: Aether Adept
text: Some mages do their best work in solitude. Others do their best work creating it.

name: Air Servant
text:
"Wind is forceful, yet ephemeral. It can knock a dragon out of the sky, yet pass through the smallest crack unhindered."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Alluring Siren
text:
"The ground polluted floats with human gore,
And human carnage taints the dreadful shore
Fly swift the dangerous coast: let every ear
Be stopp'd against the song! 'tis death to hear!"
—Homer, *The Odyssey*, trans. Pope

name: Armored Cancrix
text: Creatures displaced from time still turn up every year, stranded by the temporal disaster that once swept across Dominaria.

name: Azure Drake
text: More so than "storm" or "pirate," "drake" is the word a sailor least wants to hear.

name: Call to Mind
text:
"It's hard to say which is more satisfying: the search for that missing piece or fitting that piece into place."
—Evo Ragus

name: Clone
text: The shapeshifter mimics with a twin's esteem and a mirror's cruelty.

name: Armored Ascension
text: With skill and strength honed upon the prairie, Naxtil won his battles high above it.

name: Cloud Elemental
text:
"The sky teems with just as much life as the forest or the deep seas."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Diminish
text:
"'That was a narrow escape!' said Alice, a good deal frightened at the sudden change, but very glad to find herself still in existence."
—Lewis Carroll,
*Alice's Adventures in Wonderland*

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Foresee
text: Two eyes to see what could be, two eyes to see what will.

name: Harbor Serpent
text: Like most giant monsters villagers worship as gods, it proves a fickle master.

name: Jace's Erasure
text: "You should try to clear your mind of idle thoughts. And if you can't, I will."

name: Assault Griffin
text:
"Fine soldiers guarded the northern front. They waited for two-legged foes and left the skies unheeded."
—General Avitora

name: Jace's Ingenuity
text: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Maritime Guard
text: Once common in the Kapsho Seas, merfolk were hunted almost to extinction. They survived those dark days and emerged calculating and determined to endure.

name: Merfolk Sovereign
text: "Be like the sea: flow around that which is unmovable; for everything else, crash into it unrelentingly."

name: Mind Control
text:
"The mind: a great weapon and an even greater weakness."
—Jace Beleren

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Phantom Beast
text: As insubstantial as fear, and as dangerous.

name: Baneslayer Angel
text: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

name: Redirect
text:
"Your strategy is marvelous. I've just made a few minor adjustments."
—Veris, watcher of Indi Keep

name: Scroll Thief
text: I've learned how to disable wards, pick locks, and decode the Agaran language—all before even reading the scroll!

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Time Reversal
text:
"Optimists see the world as they wish it to be. Pessimists see the world as it is. Must these roles be mutually exclusive?"
—Evo Ragus

name: Tome Scour
text: Genius is overrated, especially when it's someone else's.

name: Traumatize
text: He was left with just enough memory to understand what he had lost.

name: Unsummon
text:
"You're trespassing in my reality. Ask permission next time."
—Simun the Quiet

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Blinding Mage
text: "I carry the light of truth. Do not pity those it blinds, for they never had eyes to see."

name: Water Servant
text:
"This creature has innate perceptiveness. It knows when to rise and when to vanish into the tides."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Barony Vampire
text: "Poor little sun-dweller out past curfew. And to think, you might have survived if it wasn't so close to suppertime."

name: Blood Tithe
text: The Crimson Throne may be empty, but its coffers are full.

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: "The underclass often forget that they are not tenants, or servants, but property."

name: Bog Raiders
text: Zombies are the perfect marshland fighters—they don't need to breathe and they don't care what they step in.

name: Child of Night
text: A vampire enacts vengeance on the entire world, claiming her debt two tiny pinpricks at a time.

name: Corrupt
text: The power of the fens sleeps lightly, and always awakens hungry.

name: Celestial Purge
text:
"They say only the good die young. Obviously, you are one of the exceptions."
—Delrobah, cleric of Ivora Gate

name: Dark Tutelage
text:
"It is a rough road that leads to the heights of greatness."
—Seneca, *Epistles*, trans. Gummere

name: Deathmark
text: There are few ways to escape the deathmark: bargaining with a demon, washing in the fabled waters of youth, and of course, death.

name: Demon of Death's Gate
text: The locks on the cages of the damned are opened with keys of marrow, sinew, and blood.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Disentomb
text: The armies of the dead always report well rested.

name: Doom Blade
text: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Gravedigger
text: Only a thin layer of dirt separates civilization from an undead apocalypse.

name: Benalish Veteran
text: "One day I will rest and join my comrades in the afterlife, but not while scum like you still sully this world."

name: Hideous Visage
text: "Seeing you cower before me is its own reward."

name: Mind Rot
text: Not every thought is a good one.

name: Monomania
text:
"What do vermin cling to when all hope is lost?"
—Sorin Markov

name: Onyx Mage
text:
"We wield death and darkness, powers that make lesser mages tremble in fear."
—Onyx creed

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Royal Assassin
text: An assassin is a king's most trusted courier, ensuring his messages are heard by even the most unwilling recipients.

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Smallpox
text: Take away a few things, and a rebellion may ensue. Take away everything, and the oppression will be accepted as fate.

name: Celestial Purge
text:
"A world without evil? Boring. Give me vile fiends to smite and banish any day."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Sorin's Thirst
text: "All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."

name: Sorin's Vengeance
text: "Cherish these last moments. Though your miserable life has come to nothing, I have given it a magnificent end."

name: Taste of Blood
text:
"How blessed are some people, whose lives have no fears, no dreads, to whom sleep is a blessing that comes nightly, and brings nothing but sweet dreams."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Warpath Ghoul
text: Ghouls are often found skulking on the fringes of great battles, showing themselves only to snatch the wounded and weak, dragging their victims screaming into the shadows.

name: Wring Flesh
text:
"Don't blame me. You're the one walking around with skin."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Zombie Goliath
text:
"Removing the encumbrance of useless brain tissue grants several advantages: a slight increase in mobility, a response of revulsion and horror from the enemy, and, in the case of large specimens, room for passengers."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Bonebreaker Giant
text: One thing's for sure—his fists are harder than your skull.

name: Chandra's Outrage
text: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

name: Circle of Flame
text:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Crimson Mage
text:
"We wield the fires of rage. War is our blood and destruction our birthright."
—Crimson creed

name: Demystify
text: Behind every mage is a trail of shattered lies.

name: Fiery Hellhound
text: There's nothing more exciting than a game of fetch the still-beating heart.

name: Firebreathing
text: The mage breathed in life-giving air and breathed out death-bringing fire.

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: He marks his territory with fire and wrath, etching the mountainside with his charring breath.

name: Fling
text: About halfway to the target, Snukk vowed that he had been tricked for the last time.

name: Furyborn Hellkite
text:
"Careful. A drop of blood here means death for us all."
—Kalek, mountain guide

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "It's time for the 'Smash, Smash' song!"

name: Goblin Fireslinger
text: A rock between your eyes hurts. A burning rock between your eyes ruins your whole day.

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: Goblin Grenade
text: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Goblin Tunneler
text: "The best way over the mountain is through."

name: Goblin War Paint
text:
"The secret to our war paint is hot peppers and stinkbugs. Lots of stinkbugs."
—Skab, goblin secretkeeper

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Incinerate
text:
"Spontaneous combustion is a myth. If you burst into flame, someone wanted you to."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Lava Axe
text: It can chop down a redwood in a single stroke. Your sternum isn't going to fare any better.

name: Lightning Elemental
text:
"Oh, it's easy enough to kill, but I'm not going anywhere near it."
—Norin the Wary

name: Elite Vanguard
text: The vanguard is skilled at waging war alone. The enemy is often defeated before its reinforcements reach the front.

name: Manabarbs
text:
"I don't know why people say a double-edged sword is bad. It's a sword. With two edges."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Manic Vandal
text: It's fun. He doesn't need another reason.

name: Reverberate
text: For every action, there is a swifter and more violent reaction.

name: Scrambleverse
text: Sometimes a little chaos is in order.

name: Shock
text:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

name: Slaughter Cry
text: It's rather embarrassing to end up with your head mounted over his hearth.

name: Stormblood Berserker
text: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

name: Tectonic Rift
text:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

name: Wall of Torches
text: The foolish try to leap through the unlit spaces. The arrogant believe the fires harmless. The wise find a different door.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Autumn's Veil
text: The rustling of leaves and a passing shadow are a dryad's only trace.

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Bountiful Harvest
text:
"When we fail to see the beauty in every tree, we are no better than humans."
—Saelia, elvish scout

name: Brindle Boar
text:
"Tell the cooks to prepare the fires. Tonight we feast!"
—Tolar Wolfbrother, Krosan tracker

name: Gideon's Avenger
text: "The good don't sit and wait for the evil to act. They prepare to defend. They prepare to punish."

name: Doubling Chant
text: What's scarier than one of every beast in the forest?

name: Dungrove Elder
text: All the trees of the forest are his army, and every leaf his shield.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Fog
text: It's hard enough to find your way through uncharted wilderness when you can see the tip of your nose.

name: Giant Spider
text:
"The wild is always changing, but it does have a few constants."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Gladecover Scout
text: "The forest is my cover and I hold it close. In such a tight embrace, there is no room for wickedness."

name: Greater Basilisk
text: Bone, stone . . . both taste the same to a hungry basilisk.

name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
text: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Jade Mage
text:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

name: Llanowar Elves
text:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

name: Lure
text: It makes the insignificant conspicuous, the repulsive alluring, and the deadly irresistible.

name: Naturalize
text:
"When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: Grand Abolisher
text: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: Rites of Flourishing
text: "Dance, and bring forth the coil! It is an umbilical to Gaea herself, fattening us with the earth's rich bounty."

name: Runeclaw Bear
text: The only honey it wants is the sweet nectar flowing through your veins.

name: Sacred Wolf
text:
"I raised my bow, and the wolf stared at me. Under its gaze, my finger would not release the string."
—Aref the Hunter

name: Stampeding Rhino
text: The quickest way to get through the jungle is to agitate a rhino and run in its wake.

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Titanic Growth
text: The pup looked over the treetops, eyeing the man who just yesterday had kicked her. Suddenly, her hunger was infused with pure delight.

name: Alabaster Mage
text:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

name: Griffin Rider
text: After fighting alongside the griffin riders, older knights of Thune learned to admire a mount that could rip an enemy to shreds in seconds.

name: Vastwood Gorger
text: The gorger's insect-like eyes pick up the slightest movement in any direction. Its body then whips toward its prey with startling speed, swallowing it in one engulfing gulp.

name: Adaptive Automaton
text: Such loyalty can only be made.

name: Angel's Feather
text: The angel represents divine perfection; even the smallest feather is imbued with beauty and benevolence.

name: Crown of Empires
text:
"With this crown, assert your authority."
—Crown inscription

name: Demon's Horn
text: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

name: Dragon's Claw
text:
"If there is a fire that never ceases to burn, it surely lies in the maw of a dragon."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Greatsword
text: The only blow that matters is the killing blow.

name: Griffin Sentinel
text: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

name: Kite Shield
text:
"To my sword I owe my glory, but to my shield I owe my life."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Kraken's Eye
text: It's seen the wonders of entire worlds trapped in the depths of a bottomless ocean.

name: Manalith
text: Planeswalkers seek out great monuments throughout the Multiverse, knowing that their builders were unknowingly drawn by the convergence of mana in the area.

name: Quicksilver Amulet
text: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

name: Rusted Sentinel
text: It has to deliberate a moment on the best way to break your face.

name: Scepter of Empires
text:
"With this scepter, smite your enemies."
—Scepter inscription

name: Guardians' Pledge
text: A dozen fighting for each other are worth a thousand fighting for themselves.

name: Thran Golem
text: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

name: Throne of Empires
text:
"With this throne, unite your nation."
—Throne inscription

name: Worldslayer
text:
"If that is what you seek, try looking in craters."
—Fodrus, mastersmith

name: Wurm's Tooth
text: Jevna Nor lugged it around, bragging of his triumph over the wurm. Luckily, the tavern regulars didn't notice it was only a baby tooth.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Lifelink
text: The spoils of war are not measured only in gold and silver.

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: "Scholars seek to understand the way the world is. I wish to shape the world into what it should be."

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Peregrine Griffin
text: A griffin is not just an eagle's wings and a lion's claws. It is also the fiercest of hearts.

name: Personal Sanctuary
text:
"There is a place deep within my soul where no foe can intrude and no tyrant can conquer."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Pride Guardian
text: "Any hotheaded cub can raise a sword in anger."

name: Roc Egg
text: A thin shell lies between the roc and a world of bite-sized treats.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Siege Mastodon
text:
"The walls of the wicked will fall before us. Ready the siege engines. We proceed to war!"
—General Avitora

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Stonehorn Dignitary
text: It did not escape the ambassador's notice that the sound of war drums could also marshal the city to attention.

name: Stormfront Pegasus
text: Its hooves touch the earth only when a hero must rise.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Angel's Mercy
text: Angels appear before both the blessed and the cursed, though most don't know which they are until they feel either the angel's kiss or her sword.

name: Timely Reinforcements
text: The gods are not always kind, but they do have a soft spot for plucky underdogs.

name: Aether Adept
text: "The universe is my instrument, and the song I play upon it is one you are forbidden to hear."

name: Alluring Siren
text: She lures victims with promises of flesh, captures them in a net of deceit, and destroys them in the embrace of the sea.

name: Amphin Cutthroat
text:
"The amphin have long built their society in secret. While surface dwellers squabbled over trivial borders, they patiently expanded, building their ammonite temple-caves. Now amphin priests eye the shore, and amphin hunters gird for war."
—Gor Muldrak, *Cryptohistories*

name: Aven Fleetwing
text:
"It was too fast, even for our veteran archers. They might as well have been blowing it kisses."
—Vulok, elvish archer

name: Azure Mage
text:
"We draw our power from the infinite ocean of the mind, where all manner of things can be conceived."
—Azure creed

name: Chasm Drake
text:
"Once he's got you, hold on. Fall from a drake and you'll suffer much worse than a bruise."
—Garl, drake trainer

name: Coral Merfolk
text: Merfolk are best known for their subtle magic. But those who try to fight them in their own territory quickly realize that merfolk are hardly defenseless on the field of battle.

name: Arbalest Elite
text: There are few things as satisfying as a good, healthy thunk.

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Is cold merely the absence of heat, or a force unto itself? Would a display of its power help you decide?"
—Zubarek, Icewinder Magus

name: Flight
text:
"Those who claim to know the world in its entirety rarely have the requisite perspective."
—Ulmarus the Wise

name: Frost Breath
text: If you have to be stuck somewhere for a while, it's better to be stuck there with a friend.

name: Harbor Serpent
text: Like most giant monsters villagers worship as gods, it proves a fickle master.

name: Jace's Archivist
text: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

name: Archon of Justice
text: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

name: Jace's Erasure
text: "You should try to clear your mind of idle thoughts. And if you can't, I will."

name: Levitation
text: "Why fight over scraps of land when there's so much sky waiting to be claimed?"

name: Lord of the Unreal
text: "The dream does not end until I say so."

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Master Thief
text: Possession is ten-tenths of the law.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Merfolk Mesmerist
text:
"Don't you think if I saw a half-woman, half-fish with three glowing eyes, I'd have remembered?"
—Drugo, town guard

name: Mind Control
text:
"Every primitive mind has a motive. Easy to find, and eminently exploitable."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Mind Unbound
text: The creations of the hand are confined by reality. The creations of the mind know no such limits.

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Armored Warhorse
text:
"When we of the Northern Verge claim a mount, no peasant's nag will do. It must be as strong as our virtue, and must join us of its own will."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Phantasmal Bear
text:
"You know it to be false, but when its claws find you, what you know won't matter much at all."
—Pol Jamaar, illusionist

name: Phantasmal Dragon
text: Its hunger and ire are no less for being wrought of lies and mist.

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Redirect
text:
"It's actually quite simple, but since you've only recently begun to walk upright, it may take some time to explain."
—Jace Beleren, to Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Skywinder Drake
text: It's so light and fragile that it can glide where the air is thinnest.

name: Time Reversal
text:
"Any oaf can conquer a kingdom. It takes true power to conquer time."
—Shai Fusan, archmage

name: Turn to Frog
text: "Ribbit."

name: Unsummon
text:
"It's nothing personal. I'd just prefer if you weren't."
—Ashurel, voidmage

name: Assault Griffin
text:
"Griffins do not serve. They give freely to those they trust."
—Amira, skycaptain of Thune

name: Visions of Beyond
text:
"The past is the foundation for all that exists in the present. We merely reconstruct what our ancestors have already discovered."
—Sachimir, Sage of Memories

name: Blood Seeker
text: A drop now is all he needs to find you later.

name: Bloodrage Vampire
text: The most genteel facades hide the most abominable desires.

name: Brink of Disaster
text:
"When you find yourself teetering on the edge of oblivion, mine will be the hands taking pleasure in giving you the final push."
—Liliana Vess

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"You clerics brag about your strength of spirit, yet I take away the tiniest fragment, and you crumple like a rag doll."
—Sorin Markov

name: Dark Favor
text: When he began to curse what he held holy, his strength grew unrivaled.

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Deathmark
text:
"Let the final vision of doom be etched upon their unblinking eyes."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Devouring Swarm
text: Their arrival is heralded by the deafening hum of ten thousand wings. Their departure is marked by the silence of the dead.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Disentomb
text:
"Stop complaining. You can rest when you're dead. Oh—sorry."
—Liliana Vess

name: Distress
text: "Of course I'm sure I've gone mad. The little man who crawled out of my eye was quite clear on this."

name: Drifting Shade
text: It stalks the fens by the light of the full moon, gathering shadows as it floats among them.

name: Duskhunter Bat
text: The swamps go silent at its approach, but it still hears the heartbeat of the prey within.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Gravedigger
text: His grim ritual ushers the dead to their new life.

name: Crusader of Odric
text: "We are Odric's sword. We strike without fear, for his mind has divined how our foe will be slain."

name: Mind Rot
text:
"What a pity. You should have written it down."
—Liliana Vess

name: Mutilate
text:
"It's only torture if you're strong enough to survive. Otherwise, it's a simple, gruesome death. I'm happy either way."
—Liliana Vess

name: Public Execution
text: Though the executioner did not speak, the villagers got the message.

name: Ravenous Rats
text: Devouring books is only the beginning. The librarian's next.

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"For my enemies, one death. For my allies, many."
—Liliana Vess

name: Servant of Nefarox
text: "My cause is power, and at the altar of power I will gladly forfeit my soul."

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Veilborn Ghoul
text: Liliana's voice carries far, reaching beyond the cold pall of death.

name: Vile Rebirth
text:
"'Here lies our beloved Gartu, the gentlest of all men.' Ooh, I love irony."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a mortal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it's a constant motivation. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Wit's End
text:
"Your patheitc ideas lie in shambles, Planeswalker. Where is your arrogant pride now?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Zombie Goliath
text:
"Removing the encumbrance of useless brain tissue grants several advantages: a slight increase in mobility, a response of revulsion and horror from the enemy, and, in the case of large specimens, room for passengers."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Divine Verdict
text: "Guilty."

name: Arms Dealer
text:
"Guaranteed to leave your enemies sufficiently stabbed, bitten, cleaved, or exploded."
—Grezkrick's Emporium motto

name: Bladetusk Boar
text: Those who dare stand in its path are either brave or mindless. Or in the case of goblins, both.

name: Canyon Minotaur
text:
"We'll scale these cliffs, traverse Brittle Bridge, and then fight our way down the volcanic slopes on the other side."
"Isn't the shortest route through the canyon?"
"Yes."
"So shouldn't we—"
"No."

name: Chandra's Fury
text: "I asked if they wanted to do things the easy way. I meant easy for me."

name: Cleaver Riot
text: Measure once, cut twice.

name: Craterize
text:
"'Utterly' is my favorite way to destroy something."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Fervor
text:
"We won't sit like lazy gob-slugs waiting for death to come to us. We'll bring death, shiny sharp, to our enemies."
—Krenko, mob boss

name: Erase
text:
"Don't trust your eyes, for mages are skilled in deception. Trust only in your faith. It will wipe everything clean."
—Lila, Erunian priest

name: Fire Elemental
text:
"Fire set free is a fearsome force—destructive, merciless, always hungry. Given direction, it is much worse."
—Jeflin, Vastwood shaman

name: Firewing Phoenix
text:
"When a phoenix nests in a volcano, we rejoice, for it means a hundred years of war."
—Golmak, Keldon warlord

name: Flames of the Firebrand
text:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Goblin Battle Jester
text: Somehow goblins found a tactical advantage by sending a clown to war.

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Kindled Fury
text:
"Rage is a dangerous weapon. Your enemies will try to use your anger against you. Use it against them first."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Krenko's Command
text: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

name: Faith's Reward
text:
"I thought the wind was ushering me to my final destination, but it lifted me to my feet and I fought on."
—Idrus, war priest of Thune

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Mark of Mutiny
text: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

name: Mindclaw Shaman
text: Nicol Bolas gives power to those who will abuse it most.

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Reckless Brute
text: His mind knows no fear, registering only the burning impulse to destroy.

name: Reverberate
text: "Not bad, but I can think of a better use for that."

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: To a goblin, value is based on the four S's: shiny, stabby, smelly, and super smelly.

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Smelt
text:
"Looks like that wasn't darksteel after all."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Glorious Charge
text:
"One's blade is only as sharp as one's conviction."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Torch Fiend
text: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

name: Trumpet Blast
text: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack. They need signals to tell them when to stop.

name: Turn to Slag
text:
"If it wasn't a blackened, stinking, melted abomination before, it certainly is now."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Volcanic Geyser
text: "The mountain's fire surges beneath your feet, demanding release. Can you not feel it?"

name: Volcanic Strength
text: The mountains bend to no one.

name: Wall of Fire
text: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

name: Wild Guess
text: No guts, no glory.

name: Worldfire
text: Even the smallest spark may set a world ablaze.

name: Griffin Protector
text: The drums of war stir the hearts of all who fight for righteousness.

name: Arbor Elf
text: "The forest will surround you with its life if you are still and calm."

name: Bond Beetle
text:
A beetle on your shoulder
—Elvish expression meaning "a blessing of luck"

name: Boundless Realms
text:
"Planeswalking cannot be taught. Either you see the doors or you do not."
—Nissa Revane

name: Bountiful Harvest
text:
"When we fail to see the beauty in every tree, we are no better than humans."
—Saelia, elvish scout

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Deadly Recluse
