text: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: He knows the name of every elf born in the last four centuries. More importantly, they all know his.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Guardian Lions
text: Approach in peace or not at all.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Flinthoof Boar
text: Through the smoke and flames it hunts, sniffing out the panicked and confused.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Fungal Sprouting
text:
"Saprolings need only a host to feed upon. Numbers will take care of the rest."
—Ghave, Guru of Spores

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Ground Seal
text:
"Let all we have buried be buried forever."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Mwonvuli Beast Tracker
text: "The more dangerous, the better."

name: Naturalize
text:
"When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Guardians of Akrasa
text:
"Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Predatory Rampage
text:
"It is the fate of the weak to fall."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Primal Huntbeast
text:
"To the unskilled, it appears as blurred patches of distorted light. Few have seen its true form."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Quirion Dryad
text:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Ranger's Path
text: The forest can seem like a dense maze. Those who travel the canopy know otherwise.

name: Revive
text: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

name: Roaring Primadox
text:
"They're easy enough to find. Question is, are you sure you want to find one?"
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Sentinel Spider
text:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Healer of the Pride
text: "No life is without meaning. No living thing is too small to be strong."

name: Serpent's Gift
text: Venom is nature's way of redressing the imbalance between weak and mighty.

name: Silklash Spider
text: By the time the spider comes to slurp up its dinner, its victims have been partially dissolved by acidic silk.

name: Spiked Baloth
text: If a baloth isn't hungry, it's dead.

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Timberpack Wolf
text:
"The need for the pack is bred in their bones. Their true strength will not show itself for any other purpose."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Titanic Growth
text: The pup looked over the treetops, eyeing the man who just yesterday had kicked her. Suddenly, her hunger was infused with pure delight.

name: Vastwood Gorger
text:
"A long and difficult incision revealed that all vital organs are housed in the head, save for a long chain of stomachs, forty in all, leading from its throat to the end of the tail."
—Mulak Ffar, *Vastwood Biodiversity*

name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
text: "I can call an army to my side in the blink of an eye. Best not blink."

name: Yeva's Forcemage
text: "Nature can't be stopped. It rips and tears at Ravnica's tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun."

name: Ajani's Sunstriker
text: "Ajani goes where he is needed most and in his name we keep his lands safe."

name: Intrepid Hero
text: A fool knows no fear. A hero shows no fear.

name: Akroma's Memorial
text:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

name: Chronomaton
text: On the third night, the villagers destroyed their clocks. The sounds of whirring gears and chiming metal held only dread for them.

name: Clock of Omens
text: Most clocks measure time, but a few measure everything.

name: Door to Nothingness
text: Only a madman could create such a door. Only an imbecile would open it.

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Gilded Lotus
text: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

name: Jayemdae Tome
text: A true scribe devotes an entire lifetime to the creation of a single volume, a masterpiece as unique as its maker.

name: Kitesail
text: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text: An invasion weapon of ages past, the glistening oil contained the blueprints of countless atrocities.

name: Knight of Glory
text: "I will uphold the law, and no manner of foe will stop me."

name: Sands of Delirium
text: It counts down your last few moments of sanity.

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Pillarfield Ox
text:
"May starving fleas birth a thousand generations on your stubborn hide, cow!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Rain of Blades
text: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

name: Rhox Faithmender
text: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

name: Angel's Mercy
text:
"She rose above me, and in that moment Varrik the Bloody died and I was born."
—Varrik the Just

name: Safe Passage
text: As she shepherds the faithful, the angel's radiance is a shield of salvation.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Serra Avatar
text: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

name: Show of Valor
text:
"Duty, honor, and valor are either in your heart or they are not. You will never know for certain until you are tested."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Silvercoat Lion
text:
"In the wild, white fur like mine is an aberration. We lack natural camouflage, but the inability to hide encourages other strengths."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Touch of the Eternal
text:
"Time is a vigilant tyrant, but there are those who have broken free of its gaze."
—Laikas, Erunian monk

name: War Falcon
text: The falcon is the picture of nobility, maintaining a regal bearing even as it conducts the bloody business of war.

name: War Priest of Thune
text: "The sacred might of Thune thunders in my soul."

name: Angelic Benediction
text: "Only the bravest are worthy of our blessing."

name: Warclamp Mastiff
text:
"One bite from that dog will send you to the healer's tent for days."
—Watchmaster Finn of An Karras

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Battle of Wits
text: There is no loftier ambition than the pursuit of knowledge.

name: Clone
text: One face, two minds.

name: Courtly Provocateur
text: "My one regret is that I have mastered an art that leaves its audience unable to applaud."

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Downpour
text:
"The sky holds vast oceans. They are at your fingertips if you know how to call them."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Encrust
text:
"Barnacles are the sea's final defense."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"What you attempt to pull from the Æther, I can spread onto the wind."
—Jace Beleren

name: Faerie Invaders
text: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Harbor Serpent
text: Like most giant monsters villagers worship as gods, it proves a fickle master.

name: Hydrosurge
text:
"Thirsty?"
—Drunvalus, hydromancer

name: Index
text: "What good is having all the right answers if you have them at all the wrong times?"

name: Jace's Phantasm
text: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

name: Kraken Hatchling
text: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

name: Master of the Pearl Trident
text: "Let the land dwellers know the coast is no longer the border between our realms. A new age of empire has begun."

name: Aven Squire
text: When the meek charge into battle, courage becomes infectious.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text:
"The merfolk of the Pearl Trident have risen from the waves since the earliest days, at times allies to humans, other times enemies. Now their power is cresting again, and who can say which way the new tide will flow."
—Kalis, Onean scholar

name: Mind Sculpt
text:
"Your mind was a curious mix of madness and genius. I just took away the genius."
—Jace Beleren

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Omniscience
text:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

name: Redirect
text:
"It's actually quite simple, but since you've only recently begun to walk upright, it may take some time to explain."
—Jace Beleren, to Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Rewind
text: "The best denials are simply that: a beginning and end unchanged, a dream with no memory."

name: Scroll Thief
text: The arcane academies along the coast were powerless to protect themselves from the brazen raiders of the Kapsho Seas.

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Battleflight Eagle
text: Eagles make fine mounts, but they're too proud to carry anyone for long.

name: Switcheroo
text: Say hello to your new friend.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Talrand's Invocation
text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

name: Tricks of the Trade
text: "Pathetic. You might as well have protected your treasures with a paper box and some string."

name: Unsummon
text: Not to be. That is the answer.

name: Vedalken Entrancer
text: "Don't get any ideas."

name: Void Stalker
text: Now you see it, now you're gone.

name: Watercourser
text:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

name: Welkin Tern
text:
"It preys on other birds. And drakelings. And drakes. Pretty much anything that crosses its flight path is fair game."
—Amira, skycaptain of Thune

name: Wind Drake
text: A smaller cousin to the dragon, drakes are often seen at the side of powerful wizards who use them as airborne eyes and ears.

name: Blood Reckoning
text:
"There is no greater folly than standing against me."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Bloodhunter Bat
text: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: "What I need is your blood. What I don't need is your permission."

name: Cower in Fear
text:
"You will fully understand fear when you discover it is the final thing you put your faith in."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Crippling Blight
text:
"Still alive? No matter. I'll leave you as a warning to others who would oppose me."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

name: Dark Favor
text: When he began to curse what he held holy, his strength grew unrivaled.

name: Diabolic Revelation
text:
"There are some secrets so dark no human mind should ever contain them. Interested?"
—Nefarox, Overlord of Grixis

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Disentomb
text:
"I deal so often in rotting corpses that when I come across the freshly dead . . . why, it's like my birthday come early."
—Nevinyrral, necromancer

name: Captain's Call
text:
"Who among you has the courage to face certain death? Who will heed my call?"
—Rayel Vanger, Firstblade of Thune

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Essence Drain
text:
"Life's essence is a nectar unlike any I tasted when I lived as a mortal."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Giant Scorpion
text: Its sting hurts, but death is strangely painless.

name: Harbor Bandit
text: He always drops a little trinket into the bay as thanks to the merfolk who taught him all his best tricks.

name: Knight of Infamy
text: "Your laws, like your bones, were made to be broken."

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Grim Return
text: The necromancer's touch strips away memory and loyalty, and only strength and malice remain.

name: Liturgy of Blood
text:
"You harbor such vast potential. It would be such a shame to let you die of old age."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Mind Rot
text:
"What a pity. You should have written it down."
—Liliana Vess

name: Minotaur Abomination
text:
"Look at that. Shuffling, wobbling, entrails placed haphazardly. It's shameful. Who would let that kind of work flap about for all to see?"
—Lestin, necromancer

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Nightwing Shade
text:
"There is one hour of the night even we do not watch."
—Sedva, captain of the watch

name: Capashen Knight
text: He protects Benalia as much with his reputation as with his force of arms.

name: Quag Sickness
text: The dread gases didn't kill Farbid. But as he lay in the muck, miserable and helpless, watching ghouls and rats advance on him, he wished they had.

name: Rise of the Dark Realms
text:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Shrivel
text:
"Do not weep for the frail. Their time couldn't have been that far off."
—Nathrac, plaguesower

name: Syphon Sliver
text: When the hive must feed, every appendage becomes an additional mouth.

name: Tenacious Dead
text: Raising the bones of Hekjek the Mad proved far easier than getting them to lie back down.

name: Undead Minotaur
text:
"The work that went into creating this magnificent specimen. Horrific, deadly, well-balanced. Not all necromancers do elegant work like this."
—Lestin, necromancer

name: Celestial Flare
text:
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura

name: Vampire Warlord
text: "How can you serve me? By dying."

name: Vile Rebirth
text: Grave robbers digging down cautiously listen for anything digging up.

name: Wring Flesh
text:
"You shouldn't be so attached to something as fragile as flesh."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Xathrid Necromancer
text: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

name: Act of Treason
text:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Awaken the Ancient
text: Some days you stand to greet the horizon. Other days the horizon stands to greet you.

name: Barrage of Expendables
text: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.

name: Battle Sliver
text:
"One emitted a strange series of buzzing clicks and guttural commands, then clawed arms emerged from all of them. Is there no limit to their adaptations?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Blur Sliver
text: They move in a synchronized swarm, turning entire squads into heaps of bloody rags and bones in an instant.

name: Charging Griffin
text: Four claws, two wings, one beak, no fear.

name: Burning Earth
text:
"Your world is formed from the same power that wraps my burning hand around your throat."
—Shrazik, lavamancer

name: Canyon Minotaur
text:
"We'll scale these cliffs, traverse Brittle Bridge, and then fight our way down the volcanic slopes on the other side."
"Isn't the shortest route through the canyon?"
"Yes."
"So shouldn't we—"
"No."

name: Chandra's Outrage
text: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

name: Cyclops Tyrant
text: A single eye, blinded by rage.

name: Demolish
text:
"This is why I hate settlements. They lull you into a false sense of security."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Dragon Hatchling
text:
"Those dragons grow fast. For a while they feed on squirrels and goblins and then suddenly you're missing a mammoth."
—Hurdek, Mazar mammoth trainer

name: Flames of the Firebrand
text:
"You're in luck. I brought enough to share."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Fleshpulper Giant
text: He doesn't hate small folk. He just likes the squishing sound they make.

name: Goblin Diplomats
text: When you need to convey that special kind of message.

name: Goblin Shortcutter
text: "I'm not running away! I'm figuring out the best routes."

name: Lava Axe
text: A strict upgrade over the cinder hatchet.

name: Lightning Talons
text:
"The victim was either clawed to death or struck by lightning. Possibly both."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Marauding Maulhorn
text:
"It's not just you. Everyone makes it angry."
—Ardenoth, elvish nature advocate

name: Molten Birth
text:
"Few can coax the creatures within the magma to be cooled and take form."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Ogre Battledriver
text: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

name: Pitchburn Devils
text: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

name: Dawnstrike Paladin
text: She crushes darkness beneath her charger's hooves.

name: Regathan Firecat
text: It stalks the Regathan highlands, leaving behind melted snow, scorched earth, and the charred corpses of would-be temple robbers.

name: Seismic Stomp
text:
"It is not in me to tread lightly."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Shiv's Embrace
text: When you see the world as a dragon sees it, everything looks fit to burn.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Smelt
text:
"Looks like that wasn't darksteel after all."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Striking Sliver
text: You're too busy recoiling in fear to realize that it's already hit you.

name: Thorncaster Sliver
text: Every inch of a sliver's body is a potential claw, appendage, or projectile.

name: Thunder Strike
text: Lightning reflexes, thunderous might.

name: Devout Invocation
text: A prayer to bring demons to their knees.

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Wild Guess
text: No guts, no glory.

name: Wild Ricochet
text:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Advocate of the Beast
text: "I am neither their drover nor their leader. To these majestic beasts, I am simply their herdmate and nothing more."

name: Bramblecrush
text: Nature abhors a lot of things.

name: Briarpack Alpha
text:
"One of my greatest teachers."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Brindle Boar
text:
"Tell the cooks to prepare the fires. Tonight we feast!"
—Tolar Wolfbrother, Krosan tracker

name: Deadly Recluse
text: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Giant Spider
text:
"It has a quickness about it that seems unnatural for its large size, yet its hunger is about right."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Gladecover Scout
text: "The forest is my cover and I hold it close. In such a tight embrace, there is no room for wickedness."

name: Howl of the Night Pack
text: The murderous horrors of Raven's Run are legendary, but even that haunted place goes quiet when the night wolves howl.

name: Hunt the Weak
text: He who hesitates is lunch.

name: Into the Wilds
text:
"Wonders hide where the trees grow thickest."
—Mul Daya proverb

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Kalonian Tusker
text:
"And all this time I thought *we* were tracking *it*."
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Lay of the Land
text: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

name: Manaweft Sliver
text:
"I see in their interconnectedness a strange embodiment of the natural order."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Megantic Sliver
text: Even the thrums, the lowliest of slivers, become deadly in its presence.

name: Naturalize
text:
"When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Oath of the Ancient Wood
text: "Some gaze upon the forest and see trees. I see true power."

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Predatory Sliver
text: No matter how much the slivers change, their collective might remains.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Ranger's Guile
text:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Rootwalla
text: They make terrible pets . . . unless you don't like your other pets.

name: Rumbling Baloth
text: In the dim light beneath the vast trees of Deepglade, baloths prowl in search of prey. Their guttural calls are more felt than heard, but their attack scream carries for miles.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Griffin Sentinel
text: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

name: Voracious Wurm
text: Shepherds in Kalonia know it's better to let sheep roam than have them be trapped when the wurms are feeding.

name: Windstorm
text:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Accorder's Shield
text: An Auriok shield is polished to a mirror finish even on the inside, enabling its bearer to watch foes ahead and behind.

name: Darksteel Forge
text:
"It is as if this world has been expecting our blessings."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Hive Stirrings
text: Sliver young are sorted into clutches according to their potential and their future role. Human scholars can only guess how those are determined.

name: Guardian of the Ages
text:
"At my feet, invasions end."
—Statue inscription

name: Millstone
text: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

name: Pyromancer's Gauntlet
text: An inferno is just a gesture away.

name: Rod of Ruin
text: The good news is it's so simple a goblin could use it. The bad news is it's so simple a goblin could use it.

name: Sliver Construct
text: Slivers destroy those who come close to the Skep, the central hive. Shards of torn metal litter the ground as a warning to any artificers inquisitive about the hive's inner workings.

name: Staff of the Death Magus
text: A symbol of ambition in ruthless times.

name: Imposing Sovereign
text: Some are born to rule. The rest are born to bow before them.

name: Staff of the Flame Magus
text: A symbol of passion in indifferent times.

name: Staff of the Mind Magus
text: A symbol of sagacity in bewildering times.

name: Staff of the Sun Magus
text: A symbol of conviction in uncertain times.

name: Staff of the Wild Magus
text: A symbol of ferocity in oppressive times.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Vial of Poison
text: There are worse ways to die, but not many.

name: Encroaching Wastes
text: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

name: Mutavault
text: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

name: Shimmering Grotto
text: Untold riches await those who forsake the bustling world to search the secret, silent places.

name: Indestructibility
text: "By all means, keep trying."

name: Master of Diversion
text: Choose your battles carefully. For example, avoid the big guy.

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Pay No Heed
text:
"Out of this nettle, danger, we pluck this flower, safety."
—William Shakespeare,
*King Henry IV, Part I*

name: Pillarfield Ox
text:
"You old, immobile clod! If I could stuff your doltish head with knowledge, I'd do it just so someone else could fully comprehend what your stubbornness has cost me!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Angelic Accord
text: As demons are drawn to suffering, angels are drawn to acts of benevolence.

name: Sentinel Sliver
text: Through its watchful gaze, all slivers may see.

name: Seraph of the Sword
text: "Only when my sword lies idle shall I rejoice."

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Show of Valor
text: Cowards watch. Heroes act.

name: Siege Mastodon
text:
"The walls of the wicked will fall before us. Ready the siege engines. We proceed to war!"
—General Avitora

name: Silence
text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Solemn Offering
text:
"You will be reimbursed for your donation.""The reimbursement is spiritual."
—Temple signs

name: Soulmender
text: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

name: Steelform Sliver
text:
"Though the slivers may sometimes resemble us, they are not human. Anyone who fights them must remember this."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Stonehorn Chanter
text: With the Stonehorn, piety and power are one.

name: Angelic Wall
text:
"The air stirred as if fanned by angels' wings, and the enemy was turned aside."
—Tales of Ikarov the Voyager

name: Suntail Hawk
text:
"They are the finest companions in the realm. Swift, clever, and easily trained to hunt intruders."
—Almira, falconer

name: Wall of Swords
text:
"When I said we needed more swords to protect the realm, this was not quite what I had in mind."
—Olander, tactician of the Northern Verge

name: Air Servant
text:
"Wind is forceful, yet ephemeral. It can knock a dragon out of the sky, yet pass through the smallest crack unhindered."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Armored Cancrix
text: Creatures displaced from time still turn up every year, stranded by the temporal disaster that once swept across Dominaria.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Clone
text: He knows your strengths, your weaknesses, and the shape of that unfortunate birthmark on your backside.

name: Coral Merfolk
text: Early sailors thought they were tricks of the mind or perhaps manatees. As more and more ships were classified as lost to "manatee attacks," the truth began to dawn.

name: Archangel of Thune
text: Even the wicked have nightmares.

name: Dismiss into Dream
text:
"You trust in the shadows of a breeze."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Disperse
text: Gryffid found his way home and resumed life as best he could, constantly hiding his newfound fear of clouds.

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"What you attempt to pull from the Æther, I can spread onto the wind."
—Jace Beleren

name: Frost Breath
text: "I'll make ice chimes of your bones."

name: Galerider Sliver
text: Masters of adaptation, galeriders serve multiple purposes useful to the hive. When they're not patrolling their territories, their majestic wings serve to circulate cool air through the vast hive chambers.

name: Glimpse the Future
text:
"No simple coin toss can solve this riddle. You must think and choose wisely."
—Shai Fusan, archmage

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Messenger Drake
text: The more important the message, the larger the messenger.

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Nephalia Seakite
text:
"Keep one eye on the cliff road or you may fall to your death. Keep one eye on the sky or your death may fall on you."
—Manfried Ulmach, Elgaud Master-at-Arms

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"The construction of a defense is not accomplished by adding bricks."
—Jace Beleren

name: Quicken
text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Scroll Thief
text: Kapsho merfolk have infiltrated fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari in their relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Seacoast Drake
text: Seacoast drakes have been known to follow ships for hundreds of miles, waiting to snap up garbage, bait, and the occasional sailor.

name: Sensory Deprivation
text: They call it "stitcher's anesthesia," a spell to deaden the senses while the mad doctors begin their grisly work.

name: Spell Blast
text: "Perhaps you could try throwing a rock? That might be better suited to your intellect."

name: Time Ebb
text:
"Yesterday you were just a figment of your master's imagination. I liked you better then."
—Shai Fusan, archmage

name: Tome Scour
text: "I hope none of those were important!"

name: Trained Condor
text:
"They're smart enough to understand that war means lots of carrion."
—Griv, condor rider

name: Traumatize
text: He was left with just enough memory to understand what he had lost.

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I have seen countless petty warmongers gaze on it for a time before turning away."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Blessing
text:
"Virtue can't survive without strength."
—Ardanna of the Angelic Council

name: Water Servant
text:
"This creature has innate perceptiveness. It knows when to rise and when to vanish into the tides."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Windreader Sphinx
text: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

name: Zephyr Charge
text:
"All armies prefer high ground to low and sunny places to dark."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War*, trans. Giles

name: Accursed Spirit
text: Many have heard the slither of dragging armor and the soft squelch of its voice. But only its victims ever meet its icy gaze.

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

name: Artificer's Hex
text:
"Some treasures aren't worth finding, let alone stealing."
—Dack Fayden

name: Blightcaster
text: "Your flesh is unprepared for my gifts."

name: Blood Bairn
text: The travelers were warned to watch out for children on the road.

name: Bogbrew Witch
text: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Bonescythe Sliver
text:
"Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Corpse Hauler
text:
"He expects a reward, but the only piece of silver he'll get from me is my blade in his gut."
—Shelac, necromancer

name: Corrupt
text: One misstep in the swamp and the evil that sleeps beneath will rise to find you.

name: Dark Favor
text: When he began to curse what he held holy, his strength grew unrivaled.

name: Dark Prophecy
text: When the bog ran short on small animals, Ekri turned to the surrounding farmlands.

name: Deathgaze Cockatrice
text:
"Sometimes I come across a stone finger or foot and I know I'm in cockatrice territory."
—Rulak, bog guide

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Duress
text:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

name: Festering Newt
text: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

name: Gnawing Zombie
text: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Leeching Sliver
text:
"Seeing one slowly devour one of my party begged the question—do they know what cruelty is?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Mind Rot
text:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

name: Necrogen Scudder
text: Contrary to popular belief, it's kept aloft by necrogen gas, not the screaming agony of a thousand murdered souls.

name: Necromancer's Assistant
text: Zombies and necromancers agree: easy access to brains is preferred.

name: Necromancer's Stockpile
text: The experiments decided to perform some research of their own.

name: Nightfire Giant
text: Nightfire turns the greatest weakness of the undead into formidable strength.

name: Ob Nixilis, Unshackled
text: Designed by Brad Muir

name: Rotfeaster Maggot
text: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

name: Shadowcloak Vampire
text: "My favorite guilty pleasure? Are there innocent ones?"

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Typhoid Rats
text: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

name: Ulcerate
text:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

name: First Response
text:
"There's never a good time for a disaster or an attack. That's why we're here."
—Oren, militia captain

name: Unmake the Graves
text: "I'm raising an army. Any volunteers?"

name: Waste Not
text: Designed by the Magic community

name: Witch's Familiar
text: Some bog witches practice the strange art of batrachomancy, reading portents in the number, size, and color of warts on a toad's hide.

name: Xathrid Slyblade
text: Designed by Rob Pardo

name: Zof Shade
text: Shades are drawn to places of power, often rooting themselves in a single area to feed.

name: Act on Impulse
text: "You don't want to know what happens after I put on the goggles."

name: Aggressive Mining
text: Designed by Markus Persson

name: Belligerent Sliver
text:
"The slivers became adept at provoking a fear response in other species."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Geist of the Moors
text:
"The battle is won. There's work to be done. / The Blessed Sleep must wait. / A fiend is about. It stalks the devout. / I'll save them from my fate."
—"The Good Geist's Vow"

name: Blastfire Bolt
text:
"Encase yourself in the most elaborate armor, and cower behind the heaviest shield. I would hate for you to feel helpless."
—Korig the Ruiner

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Brood Keeper
text: "Come, little one. Unfurl your wings, fill your lungs, and release your first fiery breath."

name: Burning Anger
text: "With rage as your forge, your hammer can smite anything."

name: Circle of Flame
text:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Clear a Path
text: "Why do guards always look surprised when we bash them?" asked Ruric. "I think they expect a bribe," said Thar.

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Heliod's Pilgrim
text: The blessings of Heliod are apparent for all to see.

name: Forge Devil
text: A bit of pain never hurts.

name: Foundry Street Denizen
text: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: What he lacks in stature, he makes up for with enthusiasm.

name: Goblin Kaboomist
text: Designed by Stone Librande

name: Goblin Roughrider
text: Astride the bucking creature, Gribble hurtled down the mountainside while his Grotag brethren cheered. It was at that moment that the legend of the Skrill Tamer was born.

name: Heat Ray
text:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Hushwing Gryff
text: An overwhelming sense of calm accompanies the gryffs that wheel above the roofs of Gavony.

name: Inferno Fist
text: "I've never been above throwing the first punch."

name: Krenko's Enforcer
text: He just likes to break legs. Collecting the debt is a bonus.

name: Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient
text: The Onakke were masters of dark arts and artifice. Their creations continue to spread foul magic, paving the way for their return.

name: Lava Axe
text: A strict upgrade over the cinder hatchet.

name: Lightning Strike
text: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

name: Might Makes Right
text: An oath of fealty sworn with a handshake.

name: Miner's Bane
text: There are certain stones even dwarves know to leave in the earth.

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: To a goblin, value is based on the four S's: shiny, stabby, smelly, and super smelly.

name: Kinsbaile Skirmisher
text: "If a boggart even dares breathe near one of my kin, I'll know. And I'll not be happy."

name: Scrapyard Mongrel
text: Trespassers are welcome to try.

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: It requires immense pressure to imbue an item with magic. If the spell is broken . . .

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Torch Fiend
text: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

name: Wall of Fire
text: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

name: Back to Nature
text: There will always be those who presume to improve nature, or dare to befoul it. And nature will always have a response.

name: Marked by Honor
text: Stand your post for duty. Stand your ground for honor.

name: Carnivorous Moss-Beast
text: Ranger wisdom dictates that when fleeing from a moss-beast, you must stay calm, find your bearings, and run south.

name: Charging Rhino
text: The knights of Troinir Keep took the rhino as their emblem due to its intense focus when charging down a perceived threat—a trait they discovered on a hunting excursion.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Feral Incarnation
text: Nature is itself wild—in all its forms.

name: Genesis Hydra
text: Designed by George Fan

name: Hunt the Weak
text: He who hesitates is lunch.

name: Mass Calcify
text: The dead serve as their own tombstones.

name: Hunter's Ambush
text: First you lose your enemy's trail. Then you lose all sense of direction. Then you hear the growls . . .

name: Invasive Species
text: It's easier to relocate a village that lies in their path than to turn the bugs aside.

name: Life's Legacy
text: At the instant of death, the mystery of life.

name: Naturalize
text:
"When your cities and trinkets crumble, only nature will remain."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Netcaster Spider
text: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

name: Overwhelm
text: The Conclave acts with a single will, expressed by countless warriors.

name: Meditation Puzzle
text: Find your center, and you will find your way.

name: Phytotitan
text: Its root system spans the entire floor of the jungle, making eradication impossible.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Ranger's Guile
text:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Restock
text: What looked like a retreat was actually a replenishing.

name: Roaring Primadox
text:
"They're easy enough to find. Question is, are you sure you want to find one?"
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Runeclaw Bear
text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Shaman of Spring
text: Some shamanic sects advocate the different seasons, each working to preserve nature's cycles.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Midnight Guard
text:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Sunblade Elf
text: "We patrol the steppes to keep enemies from the forest verge."

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Undergrowth Scavenger
text: It sees a rotting carcass as a good wine which has been aged properly.

name: Venom Sliver
text:
"We attacked with arrows dipped in poison. The slivers that did not die began to change."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Vineweft
text: Fortified by the wilds.

name: Wall of Mulch
text: Mulch is the fabric of life in the forest. Plants live in it, they die in it, and then they become part of it, feeding countless generations to come.

name: Yisan, the Wanderer Bard
text: Designed by Brian Fargo

name: Sliver Hivelord
text:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Avarice Amulet
text: Designed by Penny Arcade

name: Bronze Sable
text:
The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra, cutting down scores among hundreds. She would have been overcome if not for the aid of the temple guardians whom Karametra awakened.
—*The Theriad*

name: Gargoyle Sentinel
text: The beating of a gargoyle's wings on the air is like the cracking of stones. Intruders who rouse a gargoyle are certain to hear the cracking of bones.

name: Grindclock
text: Pray you never hear it chime.

name: Hot Soup
text:
"Comin' through!"
Designed by James Ernest

name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
text:
After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos. She found that they were quick to take offense, not because they were thin-skinned, but because they were always eager for a fight.
—*The Theriad*

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Meteorite
text: "And if I'm lying," he began . . .

name: Ornithopter
text: Once a year, the skies over Paliano fill with the flying machines of those who hope to be taken on as pupils by the artificer Muzzio.

name: Perilous Vault
text: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy. To disrupt one is to unleash devastation and chaos.

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text:
"To be in the presence of a revoker is to be truly alone."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Profane Memento
text:
"An angel's skull is left too plain by death. I made a few aesthetic modifications."
—Dommique, blood artist

name: Rogue's Gloves
text: Professional pilferers prefer proper preparation.

name: Sacred Armory
text: Arrive for worship. Leave for war.

name: Scuttling Doom Engine
text: A masterwork of spite, inspired by madness.

name: Shield of the Avatar
text:
We are made stronger by those we fight for.
Designed by Richard Garriott

name: Staff of the Death Magus
text: A symbol of ambition in ruthless times.

name: Staff of the Flame Magus
text: A symbol of passion in indifferent times.

name: Staff of the Mind Magus
text: A symbol of sagacity in bewildering times.

name: Staff of the Sun Magus
text: A symbol of conviction in uncertain times.

name: Staff of the Wild Magus
text: A symbol of ferocity in oppressive times.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Tyrant's Machine
text:
"Though tempered differently, all wills can be broken."
—Inquisitor Kyrik

name: Will-Forged Golem
text: The modular nature of the automaton's design makes assembly perfectly intuitive.

name: Pillar of Light
text:
"The vaulted ceiling of our faith rests upon such pillars."
—Darugand, banisher priest

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Razorfoot Griffin
text: Like a meteor, it strikes from above without warning. Unlike a meteor, it then carries you off and eats you.

name: Divine Verdict
text: "Guilty."

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants, . . . and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Cancel
text: "What you are attempting is not against the law. It is, however, extremely foolish."

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Resolute Archangel
text: Cut it down, bury it in snow, put it to the torch. The rose will still bloom again.

name: Seismic Strike
text:
"Life up here is simple. Adapt to the ways of the mountains and they will reward you. Fight them and they will end you."
—Kezim, prodigal pyromancer

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Terra Stomper
text: Its footfalls cause violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms.

name: Sanctified Charge
text: You need only raise your spear to receive this blessing.

name: Selfless Cathar
text: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."

name: Solemn Offering
text:
"You will be reimbursed for your donation."
"The reimbursement is spiritual."
—Temple signs

name: Soulmender
text: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

name: Spirit Bonds
text: Designed by Justin Gary

name: Sungrace Pegasus
text: The sacred feathers of the pegasus are said to have healing powers.

name: Tireless Missionaries
text: If they succeed in their holy work, their order will vanish into welcome obscurity, for there will be no more souls to redeem.

name: Battle Mastery
text:
"Boom! Boom! Boots the size of oxcarts, then an axe like a falling sun. Elves scattered. Trees scattered. Even the hills ran for the hills!"
—*Clachan Tales*

name: Wall of Essence
text:
"If you cannot turn your enemy's strength to weakness, then make that strength your own."
—Gresha, warrior sage

name: Warden of the Beyond
text:
He draws strength from a vast source few mortals can fathom.
Designed by Isaiah Cartwright

name: Aeronaut Tinkerer
text: "All tinkerers have their heads in the clouds. I don't intend to stop there."

name: Aetherspouts
text:
"Don't worry, there's plenty for everyone."
—Vickon, Eleventh Company battlemage

name: Amphin Pathmage
text:
"There are those who do not believe in the existence of the amphin. This seems somehow to be of their own design."
—Gor Muldrak, *Cryptohistories*

name: Chasm Skulker
text: Designed by Mike Neumann

name: Chief Engineer
text: An eye for detail, a mind for numbers, a soul of clockwork.

name: Chronostutter
text: Timing is everything.

name: Diffusion Sliver
text:
"The hive shimmered, and its walls seemed a living mirror."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Dissipate
text:
"This abomination never belonged in our world. I'm merely setting it free."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Divination
text:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Encrust
text:
"The sea blesses the tiny with the power to fell the mighty."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Ensoul Artifact
text: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.

name: Frost Lynx
text: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

name: Fugitive Wizard
text:
"The law has its place—as a footnote in my spellbook."
—Siyani, fugitive mage

name: Hydrosurge
text:
"Thirsty?"
—Drunvalus, hydromancer

name: Illusory Angel
text:
"In a daze, I woke and looked upon the battlefield, where I could swear my dreams were laying waste to the enemy."
—Letter from a soldier

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Into the Void
text:
"The cathars have their swords, the inquisitors their axes. I prefer the 'diplomatic' approach."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Invisibility
text: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

name: Jace's Ingenuity
text: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
text: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

name: Kapsho Kitefins
text:
"It's a truly disconcerting sight to see their shadows cast upon the deck."
—Captain Triff

name: Master of Predicaments
text: Designed by David Sirlin

name: Mercurial Pretender
text: The king went off to find himself. Imagine his terror when he succeeded.

name: Military Intelligence
text: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

name: Constricting Sliver
text: Slivers are often seen toying with enemies they capture, not out of cruelty, but to fully learn their physical capabilities.

name: Mind Sculpt
text:
"Your mind was a curious mix of madness and genius. I just took away the genius."
—Jace Beleren

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Nimbus of the Isles
text: The people of the Sevick Isles have a unique understanding of the term "ominous clouds."

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Polymorphist's Jest
text:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

name: Research Assistant
text: There are many words and phrases that can cause an experienced wizard to tremble in fear. Chief among them is "oops."

name: Statute of Denial
text: "Pyrotechnic activity of any sort is strictly prohibited. It is irrelevant that today is a holiday."

name: Dauntless River Marshal
text: "Thieves and squid squirm the same way when you capture them."

name: Turn to Frog
text: "Ribbit."

name: Void Snare
text:
"I've tried so many variations on how to get rid of annoying things that it's hard to decide which one I like best."
—Ashurel, voidmage

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I have seen countless petty warmongers gaze on it for a time before turning away."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Welkin Tern
text: Sailors have come to regard them as bad luck, for they falsely bring hope of land.

name: Accursed Spirit
text: Many have heard the slither of dragging armor and the soft squelch of its voice. But only its victims ever meet its icy gaze.

name: Black Cat
text: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

name: Blood Host
text: It would be ill-mannered to decline his invitation. It would be ill-advised to accept it.

name: Carrion Crow
text: When carrion feeds on carrion, dark days approach.

name: Caustic Tar
text: A forest fire can rejuvenate the land, but the tar's vile consumption leaves the land forever ruined.

name: Devouring Light
text: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Crippling Blight
text:
"Still alive? No matter. I'll leave you as a warning to others who would oppose me."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

name: Cruel Sadist
text:
Face of innocence. Hand of death.
Designed by Edmund McMillen

name: Feast on the Fallen
text:
"As our numbers dwindle, the ranks of the dead grow ever stronger."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Festergloom
text: The death of a scout can be as informative as a safe return.

name: Flesh to Dust
text:
"Pain is temporary. So is life."
—Liliana Vess

name: Gravedigger
text: A grave is not always for burial.

name: Aegis of the Heavens
text: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

name: Daybreak Chaplain
text: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

name: Hired Blade
text: "If you want them dead, buy some poison. If you want them to have the worst day of their life before dying, then let's talk price."

name: Infectious Horror
text: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

name: Infernal Reckoning
text: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."

name: Infernal Scarring
text: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

name: Lich's Caress
text: A lich must consume mortal souls to feed its eternal life.

name: Liliana's Contract
text: Immortality is worth any price.

name: Macabre Waltz
text: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

name: Mind Rot
text: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

name: Dwarven Priest
text: "These storied halls are under my protection."

name: Murder
text: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

name: Nightmare's Thirst
text: That feeling of something on your chest is usually sleep paralysis. Occasionally, it's something else.

name: Open the Graves
text: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

name: Plague Mare
text: When it passes, those who sleep dream of sickness and death.

name: Ravenous Harpy
text: A harpy's hoard is a filthy, bloodstained pile of trinkets and corpses.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener

name: Skymarch Bloodletter
text: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

name: Gallant Cavalry
text: "Our duty does not stop at our borders."

name: Sovereign's Bite
text:
"You have given all to your kingdom, dear knight. Serenity shall be your prize."
—Queen Lian

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Strangling Spores
text: Imagine a thousand tiny mushrooms cropping up within your lungs.

name: Two-Headed Zombie
text:
"Thread the torsos together with angel hair to ensure they will cooperate in battle."
—*The Stitcher's Tome*

name: Vampire Neonate
text: One day, they may be paragons of deadly elegance. For the moment, they possess nothing but thirst.

name: Vampire Sovereign
text:
"Your service shall be rewarded."
—Queen Lian

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Act of Treason
text: She learned a tragic lesson that day: even the purest can be corrupted when the heart's emotions are twisted.

name: Alpine Moon
text:
"A rare and fascinating phenomenon."
—Tamiyo

name: Apex of Power
text:
"As I desire, so it shall be."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Herald of Faith
text: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Catalyst Elemental
text: As the hyperstormic generator crept past redline, a being emerged from the arc.

name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
text: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

name: Demanding Dragon
text: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

name: Dismissive Pyromancer
text: "Burn. Burn. Keep. Burn."

name: Doublecast
text: First the insult, then the encore.

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Electrify
text: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."

name: Hieromancer's Cage
text: Law protects but also contains.

name: Fiery Finish
text: Negotiations reached an abrupt conclusion.

name: Fire Elemental
text: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

name: Goblin Instigator
text: "We can take 'em. You go first!"

name: Goblin Motivator
text: Small words stoke large flames.

name: Goblin Trashmaster
text: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Havoc Devils
text: For devils, burning things is the highest form of comedy, diversion, and artistic expression.

name: Hostile Minotaur
text: The bellow of a minotaur always translates to "charge."

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants,... and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Lightning Mare
text: When it passes, storm clouds bolt across the land.

name: Lightning Strike
text: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

name: Onakke Ogre
text: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.

name: Shock
text: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

name: Siegebreaker Giant
text: No rampart can withstand the fury of a giant.

name: Smelt
text: The creation of new weapons demands the destruction of others.

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Invoke the Divine
text:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—*Song of All*, canto 1008

name: Sure Strike
text: To survive imminent doom, it sometimes takes a foolhardy soul who acts first and fears later.

name: Tectonic Rift
text:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

name: Thud
text:
"Give 'em a push."
—Mogwin, goblin delinquent

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind. Are they my own madness, or the whispers of another?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Trumpet Blast
text: The sound of the trumpets lights a fire in the hearts of the bold and snuffs the courage of the cowardly.

name: Viashino Pyromancer
text: "I trained with the Ghitu, and I respect the fire as they do."

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

name: Volley Veteran
text: "Fill the sky with stuff!"

name: Isolate
text: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.

name: Bristling Boar
text:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Colossal Majesty
text:
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them."
—Inti, Sun Empire knight

name: Daggerback Basilisk
text: Its ventricles weep venom, and it consumes only poison.

name: Declare Dominance
text:
"If you think yourself a chief, then prove your might."
—Gar-Tun, Mistvalley silverback

name: Druid of Horns
text: No welcome for those who trespass. Only fang and horn and claw.

name: Druid of the Cowl
text: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

name: Dryad Greenseeker
text: "The land already knows its destiny. I simply ask it to share the tale with me."

name: Elvish Clancaller
text: No single root feeds the forest.

name: Knight of the Tusk
text: "Horse? Who needs a horse?"

name: Ghastbark Twins
text: They grow closer with every passing season.

name: Ghirapur Guide
text: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

name: Giant Spider
text:
"After everything I've survived, it's hard to be frightened by anything anymore."
—Vivien Reid

name: Gigantosaurus
text:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Greenwood Sentinel
text: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

name: Highland Game
text:
"Bring down a stag and fix its horns upon Arel's head. She hears the wisdom of our ancestors."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Knight's Pledge
text: "As long as my faith persists, so shall I."

name: Naturalize
text:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

name: Oakenform
text:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Prodigious Growth
text:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid

name: Rabid Bite
text:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Recollect
text: "The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."

name: Rhox Oracle
text: "The further into the future I look, the less certain my vision. Even now, the middle distance is obscured by fire."

name: Root Snare
text: The only casualties were a snapped spear, a lost helmet, and some bruised egos.

name: Aethershield Artificer
text: Most smiths shape metal, but some prefer more delicate materials.

name: Runic Armasaur
text: The Sun Empire's most sacred sites are protected by more than prayers.

name: Scapeshift
text:
"Whether we like it or not, our arrival has altered the landscape."
—Malcolm, navigator of the *Belligerent*

name: Thornhide Wolves
text:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Vigilant Baloth
text: Villagers employ watchdogs as guardians and companions. Druids prefer something a little bigger.

name: Vine Mare
text: When it passes, the dead are displaced by flourishing life.

name: Lena, Selfless Champion
text: "Those who do evil and those who do nothing are equally worthy of contempt."

name: Wall of Vines
text: Like all jungle plants, the vines must fight and claw for sunlight. Once their place is secured, they grow strong, sharp, and impenetrable.

name: Aerial Engineer
text: The best of their trade know every bolt of their rigs, stem to stern.

name: Draconic Disciple
text: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."

name: Enigma Drake
text: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

name: Heroic Reinforcements
text: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

name: Palladia-Mors, the Ruiner
text: Sister of Nicol Bolas. Survivor of the Elder Dragon War. The most vicious of her kin.

name: Leonin Vanguard
text: The best fighters are skilled in both harming and healing.

name: Psychic Symbiont
text: "I turn around and see nothing, yet I know it is behind me. Its fingers rummage in my mind, crafting new ideas."

name: Regal Bloodlord
text: Those of esteemed birth earn a most esteemed death.

name: Satyr Enchanter
text: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."

name: Amulet of Safekeeping
text: Whether it is magical, lucky, or merely old, it is cherished, and that gives it power.

name: Arcane Encyclopedia
text: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

name: Leonin Warleader
text: When one leonin hunts, many more are surely nearby.

name: Desecrated Tomb
text: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.

name: Diamond Mare
text: When it passes, rainbows follow.

name: Explosive Apparatus
text:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Field Creeper
text: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

name: Fountain of Renewal
text: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

name: Gargoyle Sentinel
text:
"Do not mistake a quiet rampart for one that is unguarded. Some things stir only when they need to."
—Bonovar, siege commander

name: Gearsmith Guardian
text: Made in its creator's image, though slightly more clangy.

name: Manalith
text: Planeswalkers seek out great monuments throughout the Multiverse, knowing that their builders were unwittingly drawn by the convergence of mana in the area.

name: Loxodon Line Breaker
text: Loxodons are firm in stature and spirit. No matter the odds, they are always first into battle.

name: Marauder's Axe
text: A sharp axe solves most problems.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Millstone
text: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

name: Rogue's Gloves
text: Thievery requires subtlety, from the beginning of the heist to the end.

name: Skyscanner
text: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled *Camouflage and Its Practical Applications*.

name: Cinder Barrens
text:
"I do as I choose with what is mine. And it is all mine."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Detection Tower
text: Its light exposes enemies and lays secrets bare.

name: Luminous Bonds
text: "Your part in this fight is done, vampire. Get used to your thirst."

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Foul Orchard
text: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

name: Highland Lake
text:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.

name: Stone Quarry
text: The bedrock has many gifts to give.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

name: Timber Gorge
text: Tazeem's embrace is harsh, but for those that call it home, nothing else will do.

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Mighty Leap
text: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

name: Court Cleric
text:
"The healers of Bant are second to none. I owe them a great deal for their tutelage."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Serra's Guardian
text: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

name: Silverbeak Griffin
text: A pair of domesticated griffins escaped from captivity a century ago. Now the skies are filled with the songs of their descendants.

name: Riddlemaster Sphinx
text: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."

name: Pendulum of Patterns
text: Its elaborate designs reveal secrets of aether's flow.

name: Tezzeret's Strider
text:
"More obedient than any dog."
—Tezzeret

name: Arisen Gorgon
text:
"I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."
—Liliana Vess

name: Gravewaker
text: Once every seven years it flies on spectral wings over the moors of ancient battlefields.

name: Tattered Mummy
text: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city of Naktamun crave only to spread their curse.

name: Kargan Dragonrider
text: "Only those who give the dragons the respect they deserve may bear our title."

name: Sarkhan's Dragonfire
text: "I am most myself when I am least human."

name: Novice Knight
text: Even the greatest hero begins with nothing.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Aggressive Mammoth
text:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

name: Skalla Wolf
text:
"This imprint was the familiar of a friend."
—Vivien Reid

name: Ursine Champion
text: "Would you rather feel the edge of my blade or the sharpness of my fangs?"

name: Vivien's Jaguar
text: Each of Vivien's arrows is an invocation of a species.

name: Nexus of Fate
text: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.

name: Sun Sentinel
text: Just as the sun rises at dawn and the days lengthen in summer, the Sun Empire has awakened after long years of quiet.

name: Air Elemental
text: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

name: Befuddle
text: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
text: The leonin of Oreskos are quick to take offense—not because they are thin-skinned but because they are always ready for a fight.

name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
text: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

name: Grasping Scoundrel
text: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

name: Radiating Lightning
text: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Pegasus Courser
text: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

name: Remorseful Cleric
text: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

name: Revitalize
text:
"A potion is no substitute for a skilled surgeon, but it will hold your bits in."
—Torricks, battlefield medic

name: Rustwing Falcon
text: Native to wide prairies and scrublands, falcons occasionally roost in dragon skeletons.

name: Shield Mare
text: When it passes, order defeats chaos.

name: Star-Crowned Stag
text: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

name: Take Vengeance
text: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

name: Trusty Packbeast
text:
"Margaret has traveled with me to the end of the world and back."
—Hewen Frit, merchant

name: Valiant Knight
text: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."

name: Aether Tunnel
text: If you can't find a doorway, make one.

name: Anticipate
text: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

name: Aven Wind Mage
text: "My skill sharpens with each beat of my wings."

name: Aviation Pioneer
text: "They say perfection is unattainable, but they said that about flight too."

name: Bone to Ash
text:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Cancel
text: "I decide what stands in my way."

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Disperse
text: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

name: Divination
text: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

name: Dwindle
text: The collection didn't have room to expand, so the wizard improvised a solution.

name: Essence Scatter
text: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.

name: Exclusion Mage
text: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

name: Frilled Sea Serpent
text:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

name: Gearsmith Prodigy
text: Young artificers on Kaladesh let their imaginations run wild.

name: Ghostform
text: "Picking locks is for beginners."

name: Ajani's Welcome
text: "You cannot defend others if your own well-being is neglected."

name: Mirror Image
text: The life of a shapeshifter is one of constant change.

name: Mistcaller
text: Hospitality is of little concern to those who do not wish to be disturbed.

name: Mystic Archaeologist
text: The delight of discovery drives the pursuit of knowledge.

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Omniscience
text:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

name: One with the Machine
text:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

name: Patient Rebuilding
text: Nicol Bolas would not rest until he was restored to his former glory.

name: Psychic Corrosion
text:
"To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death. It is a terrifying power."
—Jace Beleren

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Angel of the Dawn
text: She sings for all those who have been silenced.

name: Salvager of Secrets
text: The greatest treasure of the deep is an echo from above.

name: Scholar of Stars
