text: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."

name: Sift
text: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Snapping Drake
text: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

name: Supreme Phantom
text: A king's knowledge does not vanish when the heart stops beating.

name: Surge Mare
text: When it passes, waves touch the sky.

name: Switcheroo
text: Say hello to your new friend.

name: Tolarian Scholar
text: The Tolarian Academies embrace a tradition of study and research while discouraging the kinds of experiments that ruined the original island of Tolaria.

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Uncomfortable Chill
text: The cold slowed their movements until only their panicked eyeballs swiveled beneath the ice.

name: Wall of Mist
text: The seafloor is flecked with the bones of fools who dared to sail into the mist.

name: Windreader Sphinx
text: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

name: Abnormal Endurance
text: Tenacity prevails when hopes die.

name: Blood Divination
text: Predicting the future is a messy business.

name: Bogstomper
text:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

name: Bone Dragon
text: Its roar is the clatter of a thousand bones.

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Demon of Catastrophes
text: A pit yawned open, a column of oily smoke arose, and a towering form hissed, "I accept this offering."

name: Diregraf Ghoul
text:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Duress
text:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Fraying Omnipotence
text: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Graveyard Marshal
text:
"Rise and shine, my dears. We have work to do."
—Isareth the Awakener

name: Aerial Assault
text:
"Oh, you must be mistaken. Hawks are solitary hunters, you see."
—Bunder Diedreck, ornithologist

name: Fathom Fleet Cutthroat
text: "It was a bad evening for you, mate. Now it's chow time for the sharks."

name: Feral Abomination
text:
"If you manage to get to the heart of the bog, you'll find things there that make zombies seem downright lovable."
—Byaras, backwoods guide

name: Gravedigger
text: In Amonkhet's ever-shifting sands, nothing stays buried for long.

name: Gruesome Scourger
text: His whips twist and tremble like living things, moved by the fury of the horde he commands.

name: Legion's End
text:
"With a single word, they were unmade."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Mind Rot
text: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

name: Murder
text:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Dawning Angel
text:
"As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Noxious Grasp
text:
"The bog doesn't give a stinking bubble about your title, wealth, or piety. It's just hungry."
—Byaras, backwoods guide

name: Rotting Regisaur
text:
"Now, *that's* a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Scheming Symmetry
text:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Sorcerer of the Fang
text: "The Great Serpent slumbers now, but all warmbloods will grovel in the dirt at its awakening!"

name: Soul Salvage
text: The first mistake the Grimnant knights made was bullying the owner of an Urborg corpse shop. Their second mistake was dying.

name: Thought Distortion
text:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render

name: Undead Servant
text:
"There are always more like you."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Unholy Indenture
text:
"Don't think of it as selling your soul. It's more like you're bequeathing it to me."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

name: Daybreak Chaplain
text: "May the light shine through me to guide the lost."

name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
text: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

name: Vengeful Warchief
text: "Try to steal from me and I'll add your skull to my collection."

name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
text: "You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."

name: Yarok's Fenlurker
text:
"Yarok's nightmares lurk and wait
Where dark despair is near at hand."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 3

name: Act of Treason
text: She learned a tragic lesson that day: even the purest can be corrupted when the heart's emotions are twisted.

name: Chandra's Embercat
text:
"Furballs? Try dealing with fireballs."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Devout Decree
text:
"It is not punishment. I am simply making things as they should be."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

name: Chandra's Outrage
text:
"There's plenty of fire to go around."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Chandra's Spitfire
text: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

name: Daggersail Aeronaut
text: "Coming down is the best part!"

name: Destructive Digger
text: "I love digging. It gives me lots of time to think about how much I love digging."

name: Dragon Mage
text:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Ember Hauler
text: Not every job in the goblin army is glamorous. Actually, *no* job in the goblin army is glamorous.

name: Fire Elemental
text:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Flame Sweep
text:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words

name: Disenchant
text: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

name: Fry
text:
"I'm afraid your dinner got a little . . . overcooked."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

name: Goblin Bird-Grabber
text: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

name: Goblin Smuggler
text: "I am but a humble traveler. I have no taste for sneakery nor thiefiness."

name: Infuriate
text:
"No shirt, no shoes, no service."
—Marketplace sign

name: Keldon Raider
text: Keldon raiders' spoils are limited to what their colos can carry. No matter the value, the rest goes up in smoke.

name: Lavakin Brawler
text: She swings with the ease of flowing lava and hits with the force of a meteor.

name: Maniacal Rage
text: Rage is the culmination of an accelerating cycle of anger and violence that feeds itself in battle, spreading like a flame from one warrior to another.

name: Eternal Isolation
text: "Well, at least it's a lovely view."

name: Marauding Raptor
text:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

name: Pack Mastiff
text: Their loyalty is not to any master, but to the pack.

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Reckless Air Strike
text: "I have a *great* idea!"

name: Reduce to Ashes
text:
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire."
—Harra the Adjudicator

name: Repeated Reverberation
text: It's in the nature of fire to grow.

name: Ripscale Predator
text: Dinosaurs rarely understand the idea of boundaries between the wild and the urban landscape.

name: Scampering Scorcher
text:
"Keep your flammables out of reach."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

name: Scorch Spitter
text:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

name: Fencing Ace
text: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

name: Shock
text: "I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!"

name: Tectonic Rift
text:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

name: Uncaged Fury
text: The cage is a crucible for the rage that builds inside, refining it into something pure and terrible.

name: Unchained Berserker
text: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.

name: Brightwood Tracker
text: "Many have walked here, but there is only one trail I seek."

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Feral Invocation
text: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

name: Ferocious Pup
text: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

name: Greenwood Sentinel
text: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

name: Growth Cycle
text:
"Shed your faded husk! Emerge sleeker and stronger!"
—Tyris, fauna shaman

name: Healer of the Glade
text:
"Grief and rage and nightmares fade
Where hope and comfort make their stand."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 4

name: Howling Giant
text: He and his pack sing the same mournful song to the moon.

name: Leafkin Druid
text: "I am rooted in the life of all that thrives around me. You cannot move me."

name: Loaming Shaman
text:
"The living don't ever stay living, and the dead don't always stay dead."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Mammoth Spider
text:
"If a careless elf ends up caught in a spider's web, we must expect nature to take its course. Do not blame the spider for being a spider."
—Dellin Berting, Tolarian entomologist

name: Might of the Masses
text: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

name: Natural End
text: The haunted blade shattered, and the geist drifted gratefully to the Blessed Sleep.

name: Netcaster Spider
text: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

name: Nightpack Ambusher
text: A strong leader means a growing pack.

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Plummet
text:
"Even the pterodon, who chases the clouds from its skies, must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Rabid Bite
text:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Season of Growth
text: "Awake, and lift your faces to the sun."

name: Sedge Scorpion
text:
Thakolides the Mighty
Slayer of minotaurs
Vanquisher of giants
Killed by a scorpion
—Inscription on an Akroan grave

name: Shared Summons
text:
"In times of need, the forest creates its own protectors."
—Vivien Reid

name: Silverback Shaman
text: The apes of Yavimaya draw strength from the spirits of their ancestors.

name: Thicket Crasher
text:
"Tread too hard in the forest and it will tread on you in return."
—Vivien Reid

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Griffin Protector
text:
"Here is a companion who will never falter, no matter how desperate the battle!"
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Vorstclaw
text: Roots reach deep, and sometimes they tap into things better left undisturbed.

name: Wakeroot Elemental
text:
"When the forest walks, it's too late to run."
—Horent, Khalni druid

name: Woodland Champion
text: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

name: Corpse Knight
text:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Creeping Trailblazer
text: The destruction of a wildfire with the tenacity of a jungle vine.

name: Empyrean Eagle
text: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

name: Ironroot Warlord
text:
"Alone, it's a fortification. At the head of its troops, it's a battering ram."
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

name: Griffin Sentinel
text: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

name: Kethis, the Hidden Hand
text: "The pen is mightier than the crown."

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
text: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

name: Lightning Stormkin
text: "I strike in the same place as many times as necessary."

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Ogre Siegebreaker
text:
"What he doesn't burn, he smashes."
—Captain Wellis, ogre wrangler

name: Risen Reef
text:
"No, not 'washed' ashore. It *walked* ashore."
—Shafring Hulm, beachcomber

name: Skyknight Vanguard
text: "Jump! NOW!"

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

name: Anvilwrought Raptor
text:
"I know its lightness, for I have seen it fly. I know its weight, for I have seen it strike."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

name: Bag of Holding
text: There's no prepared like overprepared.

name: Colossus Hammer
text: "There's only one way to be sure it's really dead."

name: Diviner's Lockbox
text:
"I see it taunting me whenever I close my eyes."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

name: Grafdigger's Cage
text:
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores."
—Constable Trosk

name: Herald of the Sun
text: "Fear neither clouds nor darkness. The light shall overcome them all."

name: Manifold Key
text:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

name: Marauder's Axe
text: A sharp axe solves most problems.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Pattern Matcher
text:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Prismite
text: Even its shadow is a dazzling rainbow.

name: Retributive Wand
text:
"The last blast is the biggest."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Salvager of Ruin
text:
"The next model should be able to achieve a rescue without self-destruction."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Scuttlemutt
text: With five lenses on its "head," it sees the world in a range of colors beyond ordinary perception.

name: Steel Overseer
text:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

name: Inspired Charge
text: "We are armed with light and steel. Who can stand against us?"

name: Stone Golem
text: The sculptor, like most artists, put his heart and soul into his work. But the newly awakened golem decided it wanted its creator's other, more tangible parts.

name: Vial of Dragonfire
text:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

name: Cryptic Caves
text: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Inspiring Captain
text: "Time to show the foe our true mettle."

name: Loyal Pegasus
text:
"Even if I should die in the saddle, she will not let me fall to the ground."
—Hypatia of the Winged Horse

name: Savannah Sage
text: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."

name: Celestial Messenger
text:
"It soars on the winds of dreams."
—Mu Yanling

name: Waterkin Shaman
text: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

name: Master Splicer
text: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.

name: Savage Gorger
text: "I have no patience for sipping blood from crystal goblets. I want to bite and tear."

name: Sorin's Guide
text: "My people serve the dragon Kolaghan, but I give my blood for a greater lord."

name: Thirsting Bloodlord
text: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

name: Chandra's Flame Wave
text: "It's high tide."

name: Pyroclastic Elemental
text:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Wildfire Elemental
text:
"Fire is always dancing, leaping and whirling, seeking more fuel. It never rests, so why should I?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Moment of Heroism
text: "My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."

name: Gnarlback Rhino
text:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid

name: Vivien's Crocodile
text:
"Regardless of where they come from, crocs are usually able to find their way home. For this one, home is me."
—Vivien Reid

name: Bastion Enforcer
text: Headquartered at the Bastion of the Honorable, the soldiers of Ghirapur are charged with the task of keeping peace in the city.

name: Concordia Pegasus
text: In the cloudy skies and dim light of autumn, a flash of white wings is a reminder that better times lie ahead.

name: Haazda Officer
text: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"

name: Impassioned Orator
text: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

name: Imperial Outrider
text: Her mount's hollow crest can produce a trumpeting warning that carries for miles, summoning more knights to her aid.

name: Ironclad Krovod
text:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Prowling Caracal
text: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.

name: Moorland Inquisitor
text: Inquisitors are taught scripture, philosophy, and the fine art of sharpening an axe.

name: Serra's Guardian
text: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

name: Show of Valor
text:
"As the knight struggled to stand, his squire took up his blade. The foe advanced not a single step."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Siege Mastodon
text:
"The walls of the wicked will fall before us. Ready the siege engines. We proceed to war!"
—General Avitora

name: Take Vengeance
text: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

name: Coral Merfolk
text: The merfolk know every contour of their coral homes; each reef is a garden in times of peace, and a refuge and fortress in times of war.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"Only when I saw my enemy walk through all my defenses, untouchable as the moon in the sky, did I truly know what it is to be afraid."
—King Ixes

name: Riddlemaster Sphinx
text: "Safe passage requires only a simple answer to a simple question, traveler."

name: Snapping Drake
text: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

name: Bartizan Bats
text: At night, bats will feast on whatever is drawn to lanterns and streetlights.

name: Pacifism
text: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

name: Bogstomper
text:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

name: Dark Remedy
text:
"Writhing tendrils of darkness stitched him back together. Though his will and body both were broken, the necromancer's magic would not let him rest."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Disentomb
text:
"If we've run out of warm bodies, then cold bodies will have to do."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Gravewaker
text: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Sorin's Thirst
text: "All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."

name: Vampire Opportunist
text: "I think I cracked a fang."

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"What does it mean when the dead feed on the dead? When no new life emerges, but only more death? Is it not an endless spiral into annihilation?"
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Engulfing Eruption
text:
"Compared to the hunger of the fires within the earth, the appetite of a mere wurm is nothing."
—Phelgis Ojin, Keral Keep acolyte

name: Fearless Halberdier
text: "I spent some time in the Legion, but I'm done taking orders all day."

name: Goblin Assailant
text: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.

name: Hostile Minotaur
text: The bellow of a minotaur always translates to "charge."

name: Immortal Phoenix
text: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

name: Nimble Birdsticker
text: "What goes up must get stuck."

name: Rubblebelt Recluse
text: Joining a guild, even the Gruul, would mean giving up some of his independence. He'd rather smash what he wants to smash.

name: Shivan Dragon
text:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words

name: Volcanic Dragon
text:
"That's no ordinary eruption!"
—Grazlash Stonehold, last words

name: Aggressive Mammoth
text:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

name: Bristling Boar
text: The spikes of bone protruding from its hide serve primarily as protection, but as they accumulate bits of foliage from the surrounding forest, they also provide camouflage.

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Frilled Sandwalla
text:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid

name: Oakenform
text:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Prized Unicorn
text:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Woodland Mystic
text: "I sing to the branches, and they reach to the sky. I sing to the leaves, and they open to the sun. I sing to the roots, and they dig their fingers deep. I sing the song that creation sung."

name: Rule of Law
text: The law is meant to ensure that people kill each other with only the utmost fairness.

name: Soulmender
text: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

name: Squad Captain
text: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Steadfast Sentry
text: "Get up, slugabeds! We've got company, and they're not dressed for a party!"

name: Yoked Ox
text: The courage of those who work the land is born of long days of labor in the hot summer sun and the cold winter wind. It is the courage of the earth itself.

name: Aether Gust
text: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

name: Agent of Treachery
text: "The more secrets you have, the more easily you become my pawn."

name: Air Elemental
text: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

name: Anticipate
text: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

name: Befuddle
text: The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still.

name: Bone to Ash
text:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Boreal Elemental
text: Winter's breath given form.

name: Brineborn Cutthroat
text: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

name: Captivating Gyre
text:
"That's enough of that."
—Atemsis, All-Seeing

name: Cerulean Drake
text: Dragons avoid the bright colors of its wings.

name: Cloudkin Seer
text: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

name: Convolute
text: "Let's see how badly you want what you came for!"

name: Drawn from Dreams
text:
"From a sea of infinite possibilities, our choices create the future."
—Mu Yanling

name: Faerie Miscreant
text: One faerie distracts the judge while a second steals the law.

name: Flood of Tears
text:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling

name: Apostle of Purifying Light
text: Waves of gloom crash in vain against his unyielding light.

name: Fortress Crab
text: Unbreakable and unappetizing, the crab grows uninterrupted, sometimes to the size of a cottage and beyond.

name: Frilled Sea Serpent
text:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

name: Frost Lynx
text: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

name: Hard Cover
text: A good book is a refuge, but a great book is a fortress.

name: Metropolis Sprite
text: "Well, if that goblin didn't want his tongue pierced, he shouldn't have stuck it out at me."

name: Moat Piranhas
text:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Battalion Foot Soldier
text: "With me! Break this line and the rest will fall!"

name: Octoprophet
text: In every swirl of the tide, it sees the awakening of things yet to come.

name: Portal of Sanctuary
text:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist

name: Sage's Row Denizen
text: "Forget what you have learned from other teachers. I bring you the truth."

name: Scholar of the Ages
text: "I study the past to find hope for the future."

name: Sleep Paralysis
text: Sleep doesn't always mean rest.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Tale's End
text:
"When you are gone, will anyone remember your story?"
—Unknown

name: Unsummon
text:
"Don't you have somewhere else to be?"
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Bishop of Wings
text: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."

name: Winged Words
text: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

name: Yarok's Wavecrasher
text:
"Yarok's waters rush and rage
Where armies bled into the sand."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 2

name: Zephyr Charge
text:
"The knights charged forward on wings of wind, and the necromancer's horde roared in helpless rage."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Agonizing Syphon
text:
"Your death will take a mere moment, but it will feel like an eternity."
—Vilis, Broker of Blood

name: Audacious Thief
text: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

name: Barony Vampire
text: "Poor little sun-dweller out past curfew. And to think, you might have survived if it wasn't so close to suppertime."

name: Bladebrand
text: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"

name: Blightbeetle
text: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.

name: Blood Burglar
text:
"You've heard that a vampire can't enter a home without an invitation? A lie meant to help you sleep at night."
—Kerin, watch sergeant

name: Brought Back
text:
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

name: Bloodsoaked Altar
text: Blood seeps into the stone, and darkness emerges.

name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
text: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

name: Bone Splinters
text:
"I will make your bones into a weapon that will lay even the mighty low."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Boneclad Necromancer
text: "Living or dead, everyone responds to the proper motivation."

name: Disfigure
text:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch

name: Dread Presence
text: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.

name: Duress
text: Resistance is unthinkable.

name: Embodiment of Agonies
text: "I feel your pain. It's exquisite."

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Basri's Solidarity
text:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket

name: Gloom Sower
text:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—*The Tragedy of Morein*

name: Grasp of Darkness
text:
"I welcome the use of even the foulest magic if it will rid us of the monstrosities that plague our world."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Grim Tutor
text: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.

name: Infernal Scarring
text: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

name: Kaervek, the Spiteful
text: "Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."

name: Liliana's Devotee
text: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

name: Celestial Enforcer
text: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
text: The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.

name: Liliana's Steward
text: Servants at Vess Manor are chosen for their strong work ethic and respectful demeanor. Being alive is not required.

name: Masked Blackguard
text: Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.

name: Mind Rot
text: Many an inventor has collapsed under the pressure to create a flawless design.

name: Peer into the Abyss
text:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Pestilent Haze
text:
"Your crops will rot. The air itself will turn against you. You will suffer as I have suffered."
—Karaz, outcast

name: Rise Again
text:
"I love those who are eager to serve."
—Liliana Vess

name: Concordia Pegasus
text: In the cloudy skies and dim light of autumn, a flash of white wings is a reminder that better times lie ahead.

name: Sanctum of Stone Fangs
text:
Renounce all limits,
False chains binding potential.
Power knows no bounds.

name: Sanguine Indulgence
text:
"Drink from the vein? How provincial."
—Lord Duchorvin

name: Silversmote Ghoul
text: Being trapped between two forms of unlife is a fate worse than mere death.

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"Soul, flesh, even eyes—none of these are strictly necessary for deadly precision."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Village Rites
text: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
text: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Witch's Cauldron
text: The best recipes start with reliable cookware.

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Bolt Hound
text: Its spark is worse than its bite.

name: Bone Pit Brute
text: Welcome to the club.

name: Brash Taunter
text: "You hit like a kobold!"

name: Burn Bright
text:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Chandra's Magmutt
text:
"Is it purebred? No, but it's pure fire."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Chandra's Pyreling
text:
"I think Chandra just wanted something to blame random scorch marks on."
—Jace Beleren

name: Daybreak Charger
text: It's often mistaken for the coming dawn as it gallops across the horizon.

name: Destructive Tampering
text:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

name: Double Vision
text: "Your eyes aren't playing tricks on you. I am."

name: Fiery Emancipation
text:
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression."
—*The Molten Prophecy*

name: Furious Rise
text: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

name: Furor of the Bitten
text: Those who only believe themselves infected with lycanthropy can be as dangerous as those who really are.

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Goblin Wizardry
text: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

name: Havoc Jester
text: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

name: Defiant Strike
text: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

name: Heartfire Immolator
text: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

name: Hellkite Punisher
text:
"We'll pay no more tribute to that tyrannical lizard. A new age starts today!"
—Mayor Kadrim, now deceased

name: Hobblefiend
text: Bedbugs aren't the only things you need to worry about biting you at night.

name: Igneous Cur
text: Some dogs just aren't meant to be indoor pets.

name: Onakke Ogre
text: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.

name: Pitchburn Devils
text: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

name: Sanctum of Shattered Heights
text:
Rage smolders within,
An all-consuming wildfire
Burning fear to ash

name: Scorching Dragonfire
text: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

name: Shock
text:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

name: Dub
text: "Rise, knight of New Benalia."

name: Soul Sear
text: There was no witty retort, no confident boast to accompany the attack. There was only pain.

name: Spellgorger Weird
text: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

name: Sure Strike
text: To survive imminent doom, it sometimes takes a foolhardy soul who acts first and fears later.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

name: Traitorous Greed
text:
"Remind me again, what's the going rate for betrayal these days?"
—Captain Rhenmir

name: Transmogrify
text: "I'd like to introduce you to the new and improved me."

name: Turn to Slag
text:
"If it wasn't a blackened, stinking, melted abomination before, it certainly is now."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Turret Ogre
text: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.

name: Unleash Fury
text: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
"The common folk call it the breaking of the crust or the spilling of fire. Geomancers call it target practice."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Volcanic Salvo
text: Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Burlfist Oak
text: If a tree fells you in the forest and no one is around to hear it, "does it make a sound" is the last thing you need to worry about.

name: Canopy Stalker
text: The forest's cover offers shade, shelter, and an increased risk of sudden death.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Drowsing Tyrannodon
text: What the rangers thought were warning growls turned out to be nothing but monstrous snoring.

name: Falconer Adept
text: "My falcons are family, as much as any other member of my clan."

name: Feline Sovereign
text: Dogs beg. Cats lay claim.

name: Fungal Rebirth
text:
"We're all food for something in the end."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Garruk's Gorehorn
text:
"It certainly takes after its master: big and brutish, and you can smell it from a mile away."
—Liliana Vess

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Hunter's Edge
text: The hunt ends. Lunch begins.

name: Invigorating Surge
text: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Life Goes On
text:
"If you believe the God-Pharaoh tests you, charge with me to prove yourself. If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!"
—Samut, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Llanowar Visionary
text: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

name: Portcullis Vine
text: Nature's way of saying "take the long way home."

name: Primal Might
text: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

name: Quirion Dryad
text:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Ranger's Guile
text:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Alpine Watchdog
text:
"On the eighth day, a blizzard hit. Supplies were lost, and morale plummeted. On the ninth day, Dover found us."
—*To the Summit: A Tale of Survival*

name: Gale Swooper
text:
"Be glad the griffin set you back on your feet when it was done with you. My goat wasn't so lucky."
—Arram, goatherd

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara

name: Run Afoul
text:
"What did you catch today, my pet? Ah, it looks like a bit of vampire stuck between your teeth."
—Atla Palani, nest tender

name: Sabertooth Mauler
text:
"I hope the idiot who introduced these creatures to the jungle was their first meal."
—Opar, veteran guide

name: Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest
text:
Beneath bright blossoms
Verdant with spring's rich bounty,
The soul blooms in song.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Skyway Sniper
text: "No sight is more beautiful than a clear sky."

name: Snarespinner
text:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia

name: Sporeweb Weaver
text: It spins its web throughout the undercity, strange growths sprouting in its wake.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Track Down
text: Scents fade and footprints wash away, but some trails can never be erased.

name: Trufflesnout
text: Its exploits are the stuff of legends among local chefs and fuel for nightmares among the forest thallids.

name: Warden of the Woods
text: Weak and strong alike seek shelter beneath its branches.

name: Conclave Mentor
text: "I have faith in your potential."

name: Experimental Overload
text: Explosions aren't necessarily failures, just a different kind of success.

name: Indulging Patrician
text: "Just a nibble for now. I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite."

name: Griffin Aerie
text: When griffins started nesting atop the northern tower, the castellan worried they'd be a nuisance. Instead, they took the entire castle under their protection.

name: Leafkin Avenger
text: "My roots are ash, my heart a smoldering ember. What I could not protect, I will avenge."

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Obsessive Stitcher
text: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

name: Twinblade Assassins
text: Rumors swirl of a pair of deadly Golgari assassins known only as the Left and Right Hands of the Ochran.

name: Chromatic Orrery
text: Visitors marvel at its design, unaware of the other world that inspired it.

name: Chrome Replicator
text: Who would you trust to watch your back more than yourself?

name: Epitaph Golem
text: Many names and many memories bound together in grim purpose.

name: Forgotten Sentinel
text: It was built to withstand the ages, but no one remembers who built it or why it keeps its eternal watch.

name: Meteorite
text: "And if I'm lying," he began . . .

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Prismite
text: Even its shadow is a dazzling rainbow.

name: Short Sword
text:
"Sometimes the only difference between a martyr and a hero is a sword."
—Captain Sisay, *Memoirs*

name: Silent Dart
text: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"

name: Skyscanner
text: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

name: Legion's Judgment
text: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Animal Sanctuary
text:
"No owners allowed."
—Sanctuary sign

name: Fabled Passage
text: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Light of Promise
text: The light washed over him, and in the wind he heard the roars of all the pridemates who had come before.

name: Makeshift Battalion
text: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

name: Pack Leader
text: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

name: Angelic Ascension
text: Within her battalion she was known as the Angel of Arkvale. Until now, that was only a metaphor.

name: Rambunctious Mutt
text: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

name: Revitalize
text:
"A potion is no substitute for a skilled surgeon, but it will hold your bits in."
—Torricks, battlefield medic

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Grim Tutor
text: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Adherent of Hope
text: "Basri has shown me the way forward, and I will follow."

name: Basri's Aegis
text:
"As long as we survive, we can rebuild."
—Basri Ket

name: Sigiled Contender
text: "All right. Warm-ups are over."

name: Historian of Zhalfir
text: "Come and listen. I'll tell you the story of a nation lost to time, and of the man who caused it."

name: Mystic Skyfish
text: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

name: Liliana's Scorn
text: "We're done here."

name: Sanctum of Tranquil Light
text:
An untroubled mind
Dwells in perfect harmony
With a peaceful heart.

name: Liliana's Scrounger
text: "This arm's got plenty of use left in it. Who'd throw such a nice thing away?"

name: Spirit of Malevolence
text: Great evil weighs on the soul.

name: Keral Keep Disciples
text: "You're not setting foot in here. Not on our watch!"

name: Storm Caller
text: He became elder shaman when his predecessor was mysteriously struck by lightning on a cloudless day.

name: Predatory Wurm
text:
"The strong eat. The weak are eaten. That's the way of things."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Wildwood Patrol
text: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

name: Seasoned Hallowblade
text: "I don't know that I'll win every fight. But I have faith, and that's carried me this far."

name: Secure the Scene
text:
"You know it's a great show when the Azorius arrest the props, too!"
—Judith, the Scourge Diva

name: Selfless Savior
text: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.

name: Speaker of the Heavens
text: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

name: Staunch Shieldmate
text: "Gilded with gold from a dragon's trove, it is! And etched with the image of the dragon I slew to take it."

name: Pack Leader
text: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

name: Selfless Savior
text: She raised him from an orphaned pup and gave him a life of love. With his last act, he thanked her.

name: Frantic Inventory
text: "Another village, another angry mob. Why do I even bother unpacking?"

name: Eliminate
text:
"Cruelty? No. This is necessity."
—Kaervek

name: Heartfire Immolator
text: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

name: Llanowar Visionary
text: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

name: Anointed Chorister
text: "I sing of benevolence and mercy, of golden wings bringing comfort to the meek and downtrodden."

name: Swift Response
text:
"There's nothing quite as satisfying as delivering a good kick to the face."
—Adrasteia, Akroan captain

name: Tempered Veteran
text: "I've been carrying a sword since before you were born. I wouldn't give up my oath for all the peace and comfort in the world."

name: Valorous Steed
text: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.

name: Vryn Wingmare
text: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

name: Warded Battlements
text: In dire times, even a place of refuge can become a weapon of war.

name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
text: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

name: Cancel
text: "I decide what stands in my way."

name: Enthralling Hold
text:
"I offered to pay him to do the job, but he refused. So I took matters into my own hands."
—Tahim, the Puppetmaster

name: Aven Gagglemaster
text: An aven's gear is enchanted to avoid weighing them down during aerial maneuvers.

name: Frantic Inventory
text: "Another village, another angry mob. Why do I even bother unpacking?"

name: Frost Breath
text: "I'll make ice chimes of your bones."

name: Keen Glidemaster
text: "Fear is a rational response, but waiting won't make it any easier. Just jump!"

name: Library Larcenist
text: "I specialize in missing manuscripts, pilfered poetry, and lifted letters."

name: Lofty Denial
text: The mage scowled as yet another bolt splashed harmlessly against seemingly empty air.

name: Miscast
text:
"Next time, try something more appropriate for your skill level."
—Barrin, Tolarian archmage

name: Mistral Singer
text: "I sang of storms, there came a squall. I sang of waves, the seas grew tall. I sang of love, but no voice called."

name: Opt
text: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's Planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

name: Baneslayer Angel
text: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

name: Rain of Revelation
text: "As the sky opened up, we ran for shelter. Halfway there I came to the sudden realization that, already soaked, there might be more to gain from experiencing the rain than running from it."

name: Read the Tides
text: Charts and instruments work fine, but the best navigators aren't above a spell or two to nudge the tides in a more favorable direction.

name: Rewind
text: "The best denials are simply that: a beginning and end unchanged, a dream with no memory."

name: Roaming Ghostlight
text: Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.

name: Rookie Mistake
text: "Stop locking your knees as you strike! Now stand up and try again."

name: Rousing Read
text: Great literature can transport the reader.

name: Sanctum of Calm Waters
text:
Truth lurks in the depths,
Invisible from the shore.
Knowledge inundates.

name: See the Truth
text: "What is this that is neither future nor past?"

name: Shacklegeist
text: The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

name: Shipwreck Dowser
text: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
text:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

name: Teferi's Protege
text: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.

name: Teferi's Tutelage
text: "Tarassel's sixth law of temporal recursion is easy to understand as long as you know the first seven."

name: Tide Skimmer
text: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

name: Basri's Acolyte
text: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

name: Tolarian Kraken
text:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Tome Anima
text: Sometimes knowledge takes on a life of its own.

name: Unsubstantiate
text:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

name: Vodalian Arcanist
text: The Vodalian Empire tends to be insular. The scholarly Volshe caste are the exception, using education as an antidote to xenophobia.

name: Waker of Waves
text: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

name: Wishcoin Crab
text:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks

name: Bad Deal
text: There are still places where a smile and a handshake are all you need to seal a deal.

name: Blood Glutton
text: "Some savor the hunt. I savor the kill."

name: Caged Zombie
text: "Six consecutive life sentences" takes on a new meaning when necromancy is involved.

name: Crypt Lurker
text:
"Even the rats refuse to set foot inside. I fear to think what might be waiting in there."
—Gravedigger's journal

name: Deathbloom Thallid
text:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

name: Duress
text: Resistance is unthinkable.

name: Eliminate
text:
"Cruelty? No. This is necessity."
—Kaervek

name: Finishing Blow
text: "In this world, it's kill or be killed. I'd rather not be the latter."

name: Wonderscape Sage
text: "I do not need to walk the land to find my way."

name: Aether Refinery
text: Avaati Vya's invention stabilized raw aether, but even she didn't know it would also create life.

name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
text: His crew proudly maintains an accident rate of 100% per day.

name: Aggressive Biomancy
text:
"I am an esteemed scientist. Base violence is beneath me. Luckily, it's not beneath my subjects."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Bloodbraid Challenger
text: Hasal knew hunting in the Rip would be dangerous. He didn't know it would be so much fun.

name: Broodmate Tyrant
text: Karrthus was not the first Tyrant of Jund, nor will he be the last.

name: Gluttonous Hellkite
text: Its maw opens, and entire species disappear.

name: Infested Thrinax
text: Jund doesn't have a food chain so much as a mass feeding frenzy.

name: Sphinx of the Revelation
text: Crafted from absolute law. Enforcer of absolute order.

name: Conversion Apparatus
text:
"The most useful objects really ought to be the most beautiful."
—Saheeli

name: Stone Idol Generator
text:
"Like my people's ambitions, it is both awe-inspiring and unfinished."
—Nahiri

name: Planar Nexus
text: The violence of the Conflux gave way to rebirth.

name: Trenchpost
text: What once watched from among the clouds now lies buried and forgotten beneath an artificial sky.

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Eldrazi Conscription
text: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

name: Oblivion Sower
text: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

name: Skittering Invasion
text:
"The brood spread far faster than we could kill it. I fear the worst is yet to come."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Aethergeode Miner
text: Gremlins in the wild feed on nodules of pure aether, which are also prized by miners.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Aethertide Whale
text:
"To survive up here, I've learned when to use my harpoon and when to just enjoy the view."
—Kadhu, skywhaler

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Confiscation Coup
text: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Drown in Dreams
text:
"Within our minds are limitless depths. Dive down, but don't forget to surface."
—Teferi

name: Evacuation
text:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Finale of Revelation
text: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Glimmer of Genius
text: Creators live for that moment of inspiration: precious, profound, perfect.

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Summary Dismissal
text: "Let's start fresh, shall we?"

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Ugin's Insight
text:
"You speak to me of the threat of Ulamog. But do not forget: they came as three."
—Ugin, to Jace Beleren

name: Archon of Cruelty
text: Malice spreads on wings of tyranny.

name: Graveshifter
text: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

name: Mortivore
text: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Suffer the Past
text: Ulamog's tentacles, their touch like burning ice, rummaged through his soul and stung his memories one by one.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Chandra's Ignition
text: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Lightning Runner
text: "Catch me if you can."

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
text:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Hour of Promise
text: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

name: Lhurgoyf
text:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

name: Magus of the Candelabra
text:
"What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"
—Teferi, to Jhoira

name: Mana Reflection
text: The greatest wonders of nature are found in the smallest saplings straining toward the canopy.

name: Poison Dart Frog
text:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Scute Swarm
text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Eureka Moment
text: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Hydroid Krasis
text: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Sire of Stagnation
text: As the great scourge passed by, Zendikar shivered, then lay silent.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Whirler Virtuoso
text: The first tentative flaps are like a song to his soul.

name: Altar of the Goyf
text:
"What dies grows the [illegible]"
—Clawed-out statue inscription

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Decoction Module
text: Progress leads to inspiration.

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Eldrazi Monument
text:
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Forsaken Monument
text:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Gonti's Aether Heart
text: Despite the magic that sustains Gonti's life, the crime lord is often described as heartless.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Mirage Mirror
text: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Brushland
text:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Cascading Cataracts
text:
"The rushing water is as the God-Pharaoh. It encompasses all. It nurtures all."
—Temmet, vizier of Naktamun

name: Castle Vantress
text: Without Vantress's knowledge, the realm would lose itself in darkness.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Eldritch Immunity
text: The hail of arrows flew straight and true. But as the arrows got close, they simply ceased to be.

name: Cloudpost
text:
"He watches from above. He watches from below. He watches from within."
—Inscription on Tel-Jilad, the Tree of Tales

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Corrupted Crossroads
text:
"Look, and see the future."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Dreamroot Cascade
text: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Inversion Behemoth
text: In its presence, up becomes down, life becomes death, and the end becomes the beginning.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Glimmerpost
text: What once spied upon Mirrodin from above now waits below for another to assume control.

name: Selective Obliteration
text:
"I don't know what's worse—that my family was taken, or that I wasn't."
—Elsen, Sea Gate survivor

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Lush Oasis
text:
"Finally, a stroke of luck! Had to taste the water myself to believe it wasn't a mirage."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Mystic Gate
text: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

name: Spawnbed Protector
text:
"They are mere vestiges of the titan's true form. Their deaths are but a brief respite."
—Ugin

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Port Town
text: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Quandrix Campus
text: Mage-students who see beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Riveteers Overlook
text: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods
text: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Ulamog's Dreadsire
text:
"A general is only as good as their army. Maybe Ulamog is a better leader than I thought."
—Gideon Jura

name: Spawning Bed
text: Young Eldrazi crawl forth from the dust, compelled by a greater will.

name: Sulfurous Springs
text: Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Thornwood Falls
text: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

name: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon
text:
"The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones. Is this more dragon trickery?"
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Underground River
text:
"The war polluted the land, turning what had once been fruitful fields into fetid morasses of mud and rusted corpses."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Urza's Mine
text: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Urza threw himself into his research, pushing the boundaries of both possibility and morality.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza studied the creations of the Thran not simply to learn from them, but to surpass them.

name: Vesuva
text: It is everywhere you've ever been.

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Viridescent Bog
text: Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.

name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
text:
"Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower. There is as much life here as in the rest of Dominaria together."
—Karn

name: Localized Destruction
text: Imperial detonators are calibrated to maximize devastation while minimizing collateral damage.

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Silverquill Lecturer
text: "Did you bring enough to share with the rest of the class?"

name: Copy Land
text:
"Most mortals are blissfully ignorant of the thin veil that separates their world from the Underworld."
—Ephara

name: Wonderscape Sage
text: "I do not need to walk the land to find my way."

name: Mutated Cultist
text: It tirelessly gurgles Emrakul's blessings from inhuman mouths.

name: Aether Refinery
text: Avaati Vya's invention stabilized raw aether, but even she didn't know it would also create life.

name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
text: His crew proudly maintains an accident rate of 100% per day.

name: Chittering Dispatcher
text: Eldrazi spawn are not their cherished young—they are smaller weapons.

name: Aggressive Biomancy
text:
"I am an esteemed scientist. Base violence is beneath me. Luckily, it's not beneath my subjects."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Bloodbraid Challenger
text: Hasal knew hunting in the Rip would be dangerous. He didn't know it would be so much fun.

name: Broodmate Tyrant
text: Karrthus was not the first Tyrant of Jund, nor will he be the last.

name: Gluttonous Hellkite
text: Its maw opens, and entire species disappear.

name: Infested Thrinax
text: Jund doesn't have a food chain so much as a mass feeding frenzy.

name: Sphinx of the Revelation
text: Crafted from absolute law. Enforcer of absolute order.

name: Conversion Apparatus
text:
"The most useful objects really ought to be the most beautiful."
—Saheeli

name: Stone Idol Generator
text:
"Like my people's ambitions, it is both awe-inspiring and unfinished."
—Nahiri

text: The violence of the Conflux gave way to rebirth.

name: Trenchpost
text: What once watched from among the clouds now lies buried and forgotten beneath an artificial sky.

text: Imperial detonators are calibrated to maximize devastation while minimizing collateral damage.

name: Silverquill Lecturer
text: "Did you bring enough to share with the rest of the class?"

name: Copy Land
text:
"Most mortals are blissfully ignorant of the thin veil that separates their world from the Underworld."
—Ephara

name: Coppercoat Vanguard
text: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.

name: Filter Out
text: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.

name: Blot Out
text: After the invasion, many wanted to leave a life of violence. But once you're a Reckoner, you die a Reckoner.

name: Kolaghan Warmonger
text: Conflict is a constant. Only the enemies change.

name: Reckless Handling
text: The relic shattered, and something in Nahiri broke as well.

name: Blot Out
text: After the invasion, many wanted to leave a life of violence. But once you're a Reckoner, you die a Reckoner.

name: Animist's Might
text: The creature was unlike any Nissa had seen, but she dealt with it as she would any threat.

name: Campus Renovation
text: Reconstructing the past is Lorehold's specialty.

name: Cosmic Rebirth
text:
"When all the stories find their ends, a new one shall begin."
—*The Endsaga*

name: Danitha, New Benalia's Light
text: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
text: To hear them tell it, they charged bare-handed into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn all by themselves.

name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
text: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

name: Nahiri's Resolve
text: "Zendikar is *my* home!"

name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
text: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

name: Nashi, Moon's Legacy
text: The story circle continues.

name: Rebuild the City
text: The Phyrexian design had to go, but the materials could be put to good use.

name: Tyvar the Bellicose
text: "Today, we become gods again."

name: Kolaghan Warmonger
text: Conflict is a constant. Only the enemies change.

name: Reckless Handling
text: The relic shattered, and something in Nahiri broke as well.

name: Animist's Might
text: The creature was unlike any Nissa had seen, but she dealt with it as she would any threat.

name: Leyline Immersion
text: When Nissa tapped into Zhalfir's leylines, she was shocked to feel not a piece of Dominaria, but a plane all its own.

name: Undercity Upheaval
text: Light shone on parts of the undercity for the first time in centuries.

name: Campus Renovation
text: Reconstructing the past is Lorehold's specialty.

name: Cosmic Rebirth
text:
"When all the stories find their ends, a new one shall begin."
—*The Endsaga*

name: Danitha, New Benalia's Light
text: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

name: Harnessed Snubhorn
text: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.

name: Feast of the Victorious Dead
text: To hear them tell it, they charged bare-handed into New Phyrexia and beat up Elesh Norn all by themselves.

name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
text: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

name: Jirina, Dauntless General
text: "Our strength lies not in our walls, but in our people."

name: Nahiri's Resolve
text: "Zendikar is *my* home!"

name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
text: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

name: Nashi, Moon's Legacy
text: The story circle continues.

name: Metropolis Reformer
text: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
text: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

name: Pia Nalaar, Consul of Revival
text: Renegade turned revolutionary turned rebuilder.

name: Rebuild the City
text: The Phyrexian design had to go, but the materials could be put to good use.

name: Samut, Vizier of Naktamun
text: "Try to keep up, Djeru. We have lots of work to do."

name: Tyvar the Bellicose
text: "Today, we become gods again."

name: Spark Rupture
text: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

name: Drannith Ruins
text: Like Orn before it, Drannith was reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters.

name: Filter Out
text: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.

name: Training Grounds
text: For those who survived, being prepared for the next crisis became one of the greatest virtues.

name: Ethersworn Canonist
text: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Umbral Mantle
text: It harnesses the power of night in a land where daylight fears to show itself.

name: Basilisk Gate
text: The eastern passage into the city is filled with reminders that the patriars are literally looking down on you.

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.
