name: Reliquary Tower
text: When the aven scouts located the tower in Esper, the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a righteous crusade to recover their lost treasures.

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
text: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

name: Future Sight
text:
"My past holds only pain and loss. I will conquer it by creating the perfect future."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Hullbreacher
text: "I don't need a map to find riches."

name: Lifetap
text:
Keep a green tree in your heart and perhaps the singing bird will come.
—Chinese proverb

name: Goblin Settler
text: Be it ever so crumbled, there's no place like home.

name: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami
text: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

name: Goblin Gang Leader
text: They're even more dangerous outside the arena.

name: Velukan Dragon
text: The most powerful among them, Ashuza rules Veluk with flame and claw.

name: Crackdown
text:
"There is no place for mercy in defense of our lives."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Nomads en-Kor
text: The Kor forsake roots for the winding of the path; forsake voices for the silence of the mind; forsake all else for the poverty of isolation.

name: Path to Exile
text: Her resentment vanished as strange, unknown lands opened up before her.

name: Scalelord Reckoner
text: The justice of dragons demands more than just an eye for an eye.

name: Serenity
text:
"Just think of me as the storm before the calm."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Back to Basics
text:
"A ruler wears a crown while the rest of us wear hats, but which would you rather have when it's raining?"
—Barrin, *Principia*

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Counterspell
text:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Cunning Wish
text: He wished for knowledge, but not for the will to apply it.

name: Prismatic Ending
text: Right before his demise, he experienced a shattering revelation.

name: Energy Flux
text: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

name: Equilibrium
text:
Seek balance in all things—as long as the scales are weighted in your favor.
—Vodalian saying

name: Mana Short
text:
"Remove their power, and their will to fight will follow."
—Tolarian wizard

name: Merchant Scroll
text: Lat-Nam wizards trade knowledge on scrolls made of magic so they can better guard against thieves and spies.

name: Mindbreak Trap
text:
"Life is a maze. This is one of its dead ends."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Show and Tell
text: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

name: Standstill
text: "Take your time."

name: Stifle
text:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Tinker
text: "What separates us from mere beasts is the capacity for self-improvement."

name: Cabal Ritual
text: The Patriarch is long dead, but his name still stains the lips of cultists.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Eye of twilight, give us sight.
Take our offer, give us might.
Make our power tears of night."

name: Death's Shadow
text: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.

name: Demonic Consultation
text: Abandon hope . . . .

name: Eater of the Dead
text: Even the putrid muscles of the dead can provide strength to those loathsome enough to consume them.

name: Rain of Daggers
text: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

name: Snuff Out
text: "The bigger they are, the faster they rot."

name: Zombie Master
text: He controlled the zombies even before his own death; now nothing can make them betray him.

name: Control of the Court
text: "Power-hungry eunuchs, the curse of the dynasty, have thrown the masses of the people into the depths of misery."

name: Final Fortune
text: A reward is worthless if you aren't around to enjoy it.

name: Goblin King
text: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

name: Goblin Lackey
text: At the first sign of enemy scouts, Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.

name: Goblin Recruiter
text: "Next!"

name: Ruination
text:
"We have built a wall upon sand. The wall will vanish. The sand will remain."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Environmental Sciences
text: First-years quickly learn how the Vastlands earned its name.

name: Spirit of the Labyrinth
text: Students at the Dekatia Academy learn that being sent to study with her is a lesson in itself.

name: Collected Company
text: Many can stand where one would fall.

name: Greater Good
text:
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death."
—Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*

name: Mirri's Guile
text: Hanna was astounded. Mirri read every leaf and wisp of breeze like a book of ancient lore.

name: Stony Silence
text: The relic's purpose? Its design? Whatever the intent, it is now a mere curiosity that breaks up the horizon.

name: Seeker of Skybreak
text:
"We shun them not for their dream but for their refusal to let such a noble dream die a noble death."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself."
—Gerrard

name: Krark-Clan Ironworks
text: All the junk, refuse, and offal of the Krark Clan is diligently collected, melted down, and made into more junk, refuse, and offal.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Lotus Petal
text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

name: Meekstone
text: The bigger they are, the stronger its pull.

name: Power Matrix
text: As he repaired the ship's planeswalking engine, Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Static Orb
text:
Time passes, time crawls;
Time doesn't move at all.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

name: Torpor Orb
text:
"Phyrexia is certainly dangerous, but I have to admire some of its innovations."
—Tezzeret

name: Rishadan Port
text: Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.

name: Tower of the Magistrate
text: Like the city, weakest at its foundation.

name: Foil
text: Among wizards, poor timing is the most consistent mistake.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text: The smartest—and only—goblin cabin boy aboard the *Weatherlight*, Squee has learned that intelligence and common sense are very different things. This matters little, however, since he has neither.

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Captain Sisay
text: Sisay continued the quest for the Legacy even when Gerrard chose to abandon it. She is devoted to the cause of good at whatever the price.

name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
text: The heir to the Legacy has finally returned to the *Weatherlight*.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?

name: Displacer Kitten
text:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

name: Gitaxian Probe
text:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance

name: Mental Misstep
text:
"Your first mistake was thinking I would let you live long enough to make a second."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective

name: Mystical Dispute
text: "Poor, lost mage. Your feet are on land, yet you're in over your head, aren't you?"

name: Paradoxical Outcome
text: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Spell Pierce
text:
"There's a hole in your plan."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Unnatural Selection
text: What nature makes, magic can modify.

name: Archon of Emeria
text:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

name: Culling the Weak
text:
"The blood of the weak shall be the ink with which we scribe great Yawgmoth's glorious name."
—Stronghold architect, journal

name: Dead Ringers
text: "Beautiful, isn't it?" crowed Crovax. "They fought together. Now they will die together."

name: Faerie Macabre
text: The line between dream and death is gauzy and fragile. She leads those too near it from one side to the other.

name: King's Assassin
text: Fear is as effective a weapon as the blade.

name: Leyline of the Void
text: Where treachery and oblivion converge.

name: Mutilate
text: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

name: Rat Colony
text: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Cathar Commando
text: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

name: Worst Fears
text: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Rite of Flame
text: Deep beneath the ice, beneath the soil and the rock, Dominaria's fire still burned hot.

name: Cathars' Crusade
text: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

name: Simian Spirit Guide
text:
"It's rarely worth questioning where the mana comes from. Just be grateful."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Unholy Heat
text: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

name: Wish
text:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

name: Collector Ouphe
text:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Elvish Spirit Guide
text:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"On this plane, the use of magic can provoke a ferocious reprisal from nature. Whoever the Eldrazi were, their relics left Zendikar forever enraged."
—Jace Beleren

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Noxious Revival
text:
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Seedtime
text:
The hippo grows wings to fight the condor.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Kitchen Finks
text: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
text: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
text: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

name: Deafening Silence
text:
"They have forsaken their vows. The edict of the Circle demands their voices be silenced."
—Syr Tasdale, knight of Ardenvale

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Hollow One
text: The embodiment of yearning, forever drifting the deserts to find what had once made it whole.

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Ekthi, Contaminator Priest
text: "Only through sacred infection can a vessel become pure."

name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
text: "Turn your studies into uncompromising power. Only then will you be a royal mage."

name: Istvan, Butcher of Eln
text: No beast in Terisiare is more frightening than the man who haunts its woods.

name: Kuroki, Thief of Talents
text: Ever seeking a voice all its own.

name: Chira, All In
text: "No risk, no reward!"

name: Jabs, Mistress of Mockery
text: All her shows have a captive audience.

name: Joven and Chandler
text: Thicker than thieves.

name: Autumn Willow, Harmony
text: "The land lives and breathes, as we do. Nurture it, and it will respond in kind."

name: Blor the Impervious
text: "Blor's defenses are still impervious!"

name: Glava, Five-Advents Mage
text:
"The Third Advent brings hunger. Feed it, but never sate it. Hunger begets growth."
—*Path of the Pentarch*

name: Maular, the Next Evolution
text: An unnatural ruler for the natural world.

name: Meatsqueak, Hoard Lord
text: One squirrel in Krosa never goes hungry.

name: Chief Magistrate of Mercadia
text: The throne was his in appearance only.

name: Davvol, Evincar of Rath
text: "Returned from your hunt? I hope you've brought me something good for my birthday."

name: Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle
text: "Definitely try this at home, kids!"

name: Homer, the Hermit
text: He requires no destination, just a direction—a welcome respite for the weary traveler upon the sea floor.

name: Lyna, Veil of Vengeance
text: "Phyrexia has much to answer for."

name: The Madcap Jester
text: He who bears the cap laughs last.

name: The Muckslinger Gang
text: Niv-Mizzet enthusiastically rejected their bid to become an eleventh guild.

name: Nephilim Epochal
text: When it awoke, the five stirred from their slumber.

name: Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned
text: In Lim-Dûl's stead may he forever reign.

name: Uugguu, the Omniplasm
text: It doesn't hunt. It doesn't hunger. It simply waits as all oozes eventually find their way back to it.

name: Whtz, the Bibliophile
text: Created to keep the library well-stocked.

name: Zagorka, Mother of Sanctum
text: She had been the first to call the city home. Many more would follow and find its sanctuary.

name: Yume, Chronicler of Valor
text: Tales of heroics fill the air between matches at Valor's Reach.

name: Valko Indorian
text: "xe [being organic pl 2:4] 'št[mother pl 2:2] [weep 2:3], loxuφ [being mixed organic/inorganic pl 2:4] φl[phyrexia-eternal-love] [comfort 1:2]. ^'elš norn.

name: Perforator Crocodile
text: The tag on its toe read "deceased." It vehemently disagreed.

name: Overcooked
text: "You'll eat it and you'll like it! Anyone care to argue?"

name: Dust to Dust
text:
"All this nonsense made by mages
Rusts and crumbles through the ages."
—Aline Corralurn, "Inheritance"

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"When you can't find your way home, find home where you can."
—Rho, veteran hero

name: Flitwing, Lyev Detective
text: "People often miss the little details. Thankfully, every tiny mistake they make is a big clue for me!"

name: Grandmother Goby
text: She wraps the fry nursery in nullwater so the ruckus of wayward mages doesn't bother the little ones.

name: Accorder Paladin
text: "I fight for the suns, the surface, and everything in between."

name: Brass Squire
text:
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Copper Carapace
text:
"We will fight as they do: our flesh protected behind metal."
—Tae Aquil, Viridian weaponsmith

name: Darksteel Plate
text:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Decimator Web
text: Mycosynth grew unfettered beneath the black lacuna, metastasizing into a matrix of noxious energy.

name: Dross Ripper
text:
"Such a creation serves no purpose other than exterminating every one of us."
—Sadra Alic, Neurok strategist

name: Gust-Skimmer
text: Phyrexian smog clouds choked the skies, threatening creatures who couldn't comprehend the menace below.

name: Hexplate Golem
text:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Leonin Skyhunter
text: "The infection has spread farther than we could glimpse from the heights of Taj-Nar."

name: Ichor Wellspring
text:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Lumengrid Gargoyle
text:
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Mirrorworks
text: The faces of Geth's corpse-dredgers are disturbingly similar.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Myr Welder
text: Memnarch designed some myr to follow the levelers and reaffix lost parts. Mirran partisans put that instinct to good use.

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Loxodon Partisan
text: "This war is not about loxodon or leonin, Sylvok or Auriok. To defeat these rotters, we must do it together."

name: Phyrexian Digester
text:
"Our cause will ripen in the fertile flesh of the unworthy."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Phyrexian Juggernaut
text: Where nature impedes, Phyrexians overcome.

name: Phyrexian Revoker
text: Basic senses like sight and taste are reserved for those in power.

name: Pierce Strider
text:
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Piston Sledge
text: Only the goblins could make a simple machine so complex.

name: Plague Myr
text: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Razorfield Rhino
text: Adapted to tread on razorgrass, the rhino proved adept at treading on Phyrexians as well.

name: Rusted Slasher
text:
"It's a beautiful vision. Discarded debris is reborn as a singular entity."
—Urabrask the Hidden

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Master's Call
text: The need to obey was inscribed on every plate in their bodies.

name: Signal Pest
text: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

name: Silverskin Armor
text: Partisan spies warned that no armor would protect the body from Phyrexian infection. Neurok strategists took that as a challenge.

name: Spin Engine
text:
"It will be battle-ready before our strike at Oxid Ridge, and it will guarantee our victory."
—Ketuc of the Helm

name: Tangle Hulk
text:
"A true Phyrexian predator. It will never know death, just as nature intended."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Mirran Crusader
text: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

name: Training Drone
text:
"Vulshok flail, Viridian shield, loxodon blade . . . Tazzir, bring the Moriok hook and assemble the rookies."
—Vy Covalt, Neurok agent

name: Viridian Claw
text: "Phyrexians can't corrupt what they can't get close enough to touch."

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Priests of Norn
text:
"May our blessings sever the tongues of the forsaken."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Tine Shrike
text: A new bird of prey—one that hunts sentience.

name: Victory's Herald
text: The corruption stirred the heavens above, awaking a shining champion.

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Ardent Recruit
text: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

name: Consecrated Sphinx
text: Blessed by the hands of Jin-Gitaxias.

name: Corrupted Conscience
text: Karn's creation is now his master.

name: Cryptoplasm
text:
"If left in the enemy's shape too long, it might be lost to them."
—Vy Covalt, Neurok agent

name: Distant Memories
text:
"The fleeting shadows of his primitive self have all but vanished."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Fuel for the Cause
text: "Your ideas will be discarded and your will repurposed."

name: Mirran Spy
text: Accurate information is a precious commodity in times of war.

name: Mitotic Manipulation
text:
"They can't even comprehend nature. How could they improve it?"
—Venser

name: Neurok Commando
text: "There's no more time for secluded study. Answers are there only for those with the courage to take them."

name: Oculus
text:
"In its gaze I saw no mercy, no recognition that I was worthy to exist."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Banishment Decree
text:
"Unworthy of consecration."
—Axsh, lesser cenobite

name: Quicksilver Geyser
text:
"Phyrexians are tenacious. That's not the same thing as clever."
—Tezzeret

name: Serum Raker
text: The serum from the blinkmoths they gather greases the joints of witch engines.

name: Spire Serpent
text: A mirror to draw its eye, a rod to rouse its rage, and a sword to break its bonds.

name: Steel Sabotage
text:
"You are hopelessly obsolete, my brothers. Come and join the Great Work."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Turn the Tide
text:
"Let their mindless armies come and face the might of genius."
—Varil, Neurok partisan

name: Vedalken Anatomist
text: "Specimen 211 examination report. Observation: graft sublimation incomplete. Result: death. Prepare specimen 212."

name: Vedalken Infuser
text: "All plans begin as dreams. I intend to awaken them."

name: Vivisection
text: Phyrexians research with the grace of surgeons and the finesse of butchers.

name: Black Sun's Zenith
text:
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Choking Fumes
text:
"Fall to your knees and welcome our embrace."
—Qal-Sha, Priest of Norn

name: Caustic Hound
text: At first, the Mirrans aimed for its exposed gut. The survivors quickly learned to do otherwise.

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Horrifying Revelation
text:
"Ours is a glorious transmission! Behold a future where all bow to the Father of Machines."
—Isila, Priest of Sheoldred

name: Morbid Plunder
text: Even the dead are raw materials for the Phyrexian vision of perfection.

name: Nested Ghoul
text:
"The chest cavity is cleared of useless meat. I know just what to do with the space."
—Gyed, Vault Priest

name: Phyresis
text:
"Perfection is at hand. You have been freed of weakness and made *compleat*."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Divine Offering
text:
"The Phyrexians *are* vulnerable. Do not despair. We will prevail!"
—Juryan, rebel leader

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Scourge Servant
text:
"The union of the oil and necrogen has produced many pleasing reactions."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Spread the Sickness
text: Life is ephemeral. Phyrexia is eternal.

name: Virulent Wound
text: Sadly, the extent of Gerkk's healing knowledge was "don't pick at it."

name: Blisterstick Shaman
text: A productive warren requires a good deal of prodding.

name: Burn the Impure
text: Flame doesn't kneel to Phyrexia.

name: Frantic Salvage
text: "We will mourn when there is time. For now, we survive."

name: Concussive Bolt
text: Shock one, awe the rest.

name: Crush
text: A golem's hands know no tenderness.

name: Galvanoth
text: It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.

name: Gnathosaur
text: Mirran creatures that could withstand the Phyrexian oil found an abundance of crunchy snacks.

name: Goblin Wardriver
text:
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy."
—Qerk of the Secret Warren

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Into the Core
text:
"They believe they're driving us back, but we're leading them to their doom."
—Kethek, furnace stoker

name: Koth's Courier
text: Koth sent partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the safe haven of the tunnels below Kuldotha.

name: Gore Vassal
text:
"Rid them of their unfaithful organs. Bring new hearts to the unbelievers."
—*Tome of Machines*, verse 1703

name: Kuldotha Ringleader
text: Being surrounded by goblins is less objectionable when they're fighting *for* you.

name: Metallic Mastery
text:
"All will be reforged in the fires of glory."
—Urabrask the Hidden

name: Ogre Resister
text: He didn't have a word for "home," but he knew it was something to be defended.

name: Rally the Forces
text:
"Drive them back! Make their underworld into their grave!"
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Slagstorm
text:
"As long as we have the will to fight, we are never without weapons."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Spiraling Duelist
text: "I never move the same way twice. Those rotters can't grasp chaos."

name: Creeping Corrosion
text:
"We will reveal the futility of their heresy by showing them how fragile their relics are."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Fangren Marauder
text:
"The fangren fight without comfort of any kind. We can ask no less of ourselves."
—Tilien, Sylvok partisan

name: Glissa's Courier
text:
"So, the survivors from Oxid Ridge are on the move. Let them come and witness predation in its purest form."
—Glissa

name: Green Sun's Zenith
text: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

name: Melira's Keepers
text: Her warriors are the last defense against the coming storm.

name: Mirran Mettle
text: "Our land will not yield to Phyrexian corruption!"

name: Pistus Strike
text:
"Even a nuisance such as the pistus fly has a purpose in our new world."
—Glissa

name: Plaguemaw Beast
text: Phyrexia's spiral of consumption grows ever wider and darker.

name: Praetor's Counsel
text: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

name: Quilled Slagwurm
text: Vorinclex removed its teeth so it wouldn't waste time chewing before moving to the next kill.

name: Kemba's Legion
text: The squabble over succession was quickly replaced by the struggle to survive.

name: Tangle Mantis
text: The fiercest hunters in the Tangle don't seek out the mantises. They *are* the mantises.

name: Thrun, the Last Troll
text: His crime was silence, and now he suffers it eternally.

name: Unnatural Predation
text:
"Domination by the strongest—that is all that matters in the Tangle now."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Bladed Sentinel
text: The Mirran partisans created hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me."
—Sorin Markov

name: City of Brass
text:
"There is much to learn here, but few can endure the ringing of the spires."
—Nulakam the Archivist

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Not every church is a place of faith.

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
text: "We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."

name: Duress
text:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

name: Kataki, War's Wage
text:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Raise the Alarm
text: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

name: Zealous Persecution
text:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

name: Dust to Dust
text: Tervish never noticed that the amulet had vanished. It had disappeared not only from his possession, but from his memory as well.

name: Jokulhaups
text:
"I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster. The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Mountain Yeti
text: The Yeti's single greatest asset is its unnerving ability to blend in with its surroundings.

name: Pyroblast
text:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Spinal Villain
text:
"Striking silent as a dream, Cutting short the strangled scream . . ."
—Tobrian, "Watchdragon"

name: Stone Giant
text: What goes up, must come down.

name: Elder Land Wurm
text: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping dragons lie.

name: Varchild's War-Riders
text:
"What tries to crush our spirit only strengthens our resolve."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Winds of Change
text:
"'Tis the set of sails and not the gales Which tells us the way to go."
—Ella Wheeler Wilcox, "Winds of Fate"

name: Autumn Willow
text:
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Carnivorous Plant
text:
"It had a mouth like that of a great beast, and gnashed its teeth as it strained to reach us. I am thankful it possessed no means of locomotion."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Chub Toad
text:
"Chub toad, chub toad
At the door.
Run away quick
Or you'll run no more."
—Traditional children's rhyme

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text:
"Living side by side with the elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Hungry Mist
text:
"If the air must feed, let it take the self-righteous."
—Murat, death speaker

name: Nature's Lore
text:
"Fyndhorn is our home."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Primal Order
text:
"It's strange, but I can feel it when the land is corrupted. I understand why the Autumn Willow is so protective."
—Daria

name: Roots
text:
"That which nourishes can also bind."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Shambling Strider
text: Freyalise forbid that any stranger should wander into the striders' territory.

name: Spectral Bears
text:
"I hear there are bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest."
—Gulsen, abbey matron

name: Thicket Basilisk
text: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the basilisk's power.

name: Thorn Thallid
text:
"The danger in cultivating massive plants caught the elves by surprise."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Winter Blast
text:
"Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!"
—William Shakespeare, King Lear

name: Wyluli Wolf
text:
"When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?"
—Maimun al-Wyluli, diary

name: Hallowed Ground
text:
"On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Yavimaya Ants
text:
"Few natural forces are as devastating as hunger."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Adun Oakenshield
text:
". . . And at his passing, the bodies of the world's great warriors shall rise from their graves and follow him to battle."
—The Anvilonian Grimoire

name: Centaur Archer
text:
"Centaurs will kill our aesthir if they can; they've always been enemies. Destroy the horse-people on sight."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

name: Dakkon Blackblade
text:
"My power is as vast as the plains, my strength is that of mountains. Each wave that crashes upon the shore thunders like blood in my veins."
—Dakkon Blackblade, Memoirs

name: Energy Arc
text:
"Relent, and you may transcend your situation."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Hymn of Rebirth
text:
"There will come soft rains, and spring shall be amongst us, a welcome friend."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Jacques le Vert
text: Abandoning his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, Jacques le Vert devoted his life to protecting the creatures of his homeland.

name: Hand of Justice
text:
"The Hand of Justice will come to cleanse the world if we are true."
—Oliver Farrel

name: Ashnod's Transmogrant
text: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

name: Cursed Rack
text: Ashnod invented several torture techniques that could make victims even miles away beg for mercy as if the End had come.

name: Dragon Engine
text: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Holy Light
text:
"Bathed in hallowed light, the infidels looked upon the impurities of their souls and despaired."
—The Book of Tal

name: Onulet
text: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

name: Phyrexian War Beast
text:
"Knowing its origins, how could they have thought they could control it?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Shield of the Ages
text:
"This shield is a true rarity: an artifact whose purpose is obvious."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Shield Sphere
text:
"My soldiers know that they need never fear for their protection."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

name: Stone Calendar
text: The Pretender Mairsil ordered a great calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.

name: Su-Chi
text: Flawed copies of relics from the Thran Empire, the su-chi were inherently unstable but provided useful knowledge for Tocasia's students.

name: Icatian Lieutenant
text: To become an officer, an Icatian soldier had to pass a series of tests. These evaluated not only fighting and leadership skills, but also integrity, honor, and moral strength.

name: Urza's Chalice
text: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

name: Walking Wall
text:
"The fortress is not what it seems."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Zuran Orb
text:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Island of Wak-Wak
text: The Isle of Wak-Wak, home to a tribe of winged folk, is named for a peculiar fruit that grows there. The fruit looks like a woman's head, and when ripe speaks the word "Wak."

name: Rainbow Vale
text: In the feudal days of Icatia, finding the Rainbow Vale was often the goal of knights' quests.

name: Icatian Town
text: Icatia's once peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

name: Knights of Thorn
text:
"With a great cry, the goblin host broke and ran as the first wave of knights penetrated its ranks."
—Tivadar of Thorn, History of the Goblin Wars

name: Mesa Pegasus
text: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the mesa pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a mesa pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

name: Moat
text: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

name: Order of Leitbur
text:
"Trained to battle the followers of Tourach, the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with orcish and goblin raiders."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Petra Sphinx
text: What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs in the afternoon, and three legs in the evening?

name: Righteous Avengers
text: Few can withstand the wrath of the righteous.

name: Amnesia
text:
"When one has witnessed the unspeakable, 'tis sometimes better to forget."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Argivian Archaeologist
text: Fascinated by the lore of ancient struggles, the archaeologist searches incessantly for remnants of an earlier, more powerful era.

name: High Tide
text:
"May Svyelun and her tides favor you."
—Traditional merfolk blessing

name: Hydroblast
text:
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Illusionary Forces
text:
"This school was founded in secret, operates in secret, and exists for the teaching of secrets. Those who would alter reality must first escape it."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Illusionary Wall
text:
"Let them see what is not there and feel what does not touch them. When they no longer trust their senses, that is the time to strike."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Phantom Monster
text:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

name: Polar Kraken
text:
"It was big. Really, really, big. No, bigger than that. It was big!"
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: River Merfolk
text:
"Dwelling in icy mountain streams near goblin and orcish foes, the river merfolk were known for their stoicism."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

name: Sea Sprite
text:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, sea troll

name: Benalish Hero
text: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

name: Vodalian Knights
text: Fear the knight leaping from the water into the air, weapon ready.

name: Word of Undoing
text:
"It was in Urza's journals that I finally found the secret at the core of the summonings."
—Journal, author unknown

name: Baron Sengir
text:
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."
—Ihsan's Shade

name: Basal Thrull
text:
Initially bred for sacrifice, the thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results.
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Breeding Pit
text: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Derelor
text:
"Strength it has, but at the cost of a continuous supply of energy. Such failure can bear only one result."
—Execution order of Endrek Sahr, master breeder

name: Eater of the Dead
text: Even the putrid muscles of the dead can provide strength to those loathsome enough to consume them.

name: The Fallen
text: Magic often masters those who cannot master it.

name: Death Speakers
text:
"Such innocent little birds. They sing a sweet song, sitting on their fragile branch."
—Grandmother Sengir

name: Feast or Famine
text:
"We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Hyalopterous Lemure
text:
"The lemures looked harmless, until they descended on my troops. Within moments, only bones remained."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: Knowing the hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transciptions.

name: Juzám Djinn
text:
"Expect my visit when the darkness comes. The night I think is best for hiding all."
—Ouallada

name: Phyrexian Boon
text:
"Phyrexia's touch is painful to all but the blackest of hearts."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Thrull Champion
text:
"Those idiots should never have bred thrulls for combat!"
—Jherana Rure

name: Thrull Retainer
text:
"Until the Rebellion, thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

name: Artifact Blast
text: The first line of defense against Urza and Mishra, the artifact blast achieved widespread fame until an unlucky mage discovered it was useless on the devices the brothers had already created.

name: Balduvian Horde
text:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Brothers of Fire
text: Fire is never a gentle master.

name: Divine Transformation
text: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

name: Crookshank Kobolds
text: The Crookshank military boasts a standing army of nearly twenty-four million, give or take twenty-two million.

name: Dwarven Catapult
text:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Dwarven Soldier
text:
"Let no one say we did not fight until the last . . . ."
—Headstone fragment from a mass grave found in the Crimson Peaks

name: Fissure
text:
"Must not all things at the last be swallowed up in death?"
—Plato, Phædo, trans. Jowett

name: Goblin Chirurgeon
text:
"Perhaps goblins are good for something after all."
—General Khurzog

name: Goblin Grenade
text:
"According to accepted theory, the grenade held some kind of flammable mixture and was carried to its target by a hapless goblin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Goblin Mutant
text: If only it had three brains, too.

name: Granite Gargoyle
text:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, The Underworld Cookbook

name: Abbey Gargoyles
text:
"Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."
—Gulsen, abbey matron

name: Disenchant
text:
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Krovikan Fetish
text: Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.

name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
text:
"The guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Misinformation
text:
"When you cannot rely on your sources, trust your own senses. When you cannot trust those, you must follow your instincts."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Necrite
text: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.

name: Ritual of the Machine
text:
"Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Songs of the Damned
text: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

name: Stromgald Cabal
text:
"Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost."
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Ambush Party
text:
"Fair fight? I'll take survival over chivalry any day!"
—Tor Wauki, Bandit King

name: Anarchy
text:
"The shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: An-Zerrin Ruins
text:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

name: Brassclaw Orcs
text:
"A whole skin is worth a thousand victories."
—Orcish veteran of the Battle of Montford

name: Errand of Duty
text:
"May they speed to their task, for the skyknights alone cannot hold Kjeldor safe."
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

name: Burnout
text:
"GOTCHA!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Conquer
text:
"Why do we trade with those despicable elves? You don't live in forests, you burn them!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Errantry
text:
"There is no shame in solitude. The lone knight may succeed where a hundred founder."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: Flame Spirit
text:
"The spirit of the flame is the spirit of change."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Glacial Crevasses
text:
"We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled. I can't believe it was mere coincidence."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Goblin Ski Patrol
text:
"AIIIEEEE!"
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Each generation teaches the next that artifice is the enemy of natural order."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Ironclaw Orcs
text: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan.

name: Karplusan Giant
text:
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Lava Burst
text:
"Overkill? This isn't a game of Kick-the-Ouphe!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Meteor Shower
text:
"Eenie, meenie, minie, moe . . . oh, why not all of them?"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Orc General
text:
"Your army must fear you more than the enemy. Only then will you triumph."
—Malga Phlegmtooth

name: Orcish Cannoneers
text:
"It's a thankless job, and you'll probably die in an explosion. But the pay is pretty good."
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

name: Orcish Captain
text: There's a chance to win every battle.

name: Farrel's Zealot
text: Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

name: Orcish Farmer
text:
"Yes, the farmers keep our soldiers fed. But why do they have to make every battlefield a pigpen?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

name: Orcish Veteran
text: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

name: Panic
text:
"If you'd been there, you would've run from that deer, too!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Pillage
text:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Pyrokinesis
text:
"Anybody want some . . . toast?"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Stone Spirit
text:
"The spirit of the stone is the spirit of strength."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Stonehands
text:
"Trust in the power of stone. Stone is strong; stone shatters swords; stone breaks bones. Trust in stone."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Varchild's Crusader
text:
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!"
—General Varchild

name: Aurochs
text: One aurochs may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.

name: Elvish Hunter
text:
"As the climate cooled, many elves turned to thallid farming for food, while the hunters honed their skills on what little game remained."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Elvish Ranger
text:
"How can any human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Elvish Spirit Guide
text:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Icatian Phalanx
text: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the phalanxes fought on, standing solidly against the onrushing raiders. Disciplined and dedicated, they held their ranks to the end, even in the face of tremendous losses.

name: Essence Filter
text:
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Feral Thallid
text:
"Born and bred of fungus, thallids were nearly impossible to kill."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Folk of the Pines
text:
"Our friends of the forest take many forms, yet all serve the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

name: Forgotten Lore
text: In ashes are the gems of history.

name: Fungal Bloom
text:
"Thallids could absorb energy from the forest itself. Even elves were at a disadvantage in fighting them."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Fyndhorn Pollen
text:
"I breathed deeply, and suddenly I knew not who or where I was."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Johtull Wurm
text:
"To bring her down we must be on all sides at once—leave one avenue open and we'll all be dead."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Icatian Scout
text:
"Because the orc hordes attacked along the entire border, Scouts were essential to Icatia's defense."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Kaysa
text: Kaysa speaks as the elder druid, but Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

name: Leaping Lizard
text:
"I never question the Autumn Willow about her motives, not even when she turns people into lizards. It's her way."
—Devin, faerie noble

name: Night Soil
text: The elves gathered huge piles of rot to grow fungus. Out of imitation or forethought, the thallids did the same.

name: Ritual of Subdual
text:
"That which does not bend to the will of Freyalise shall surely break."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Shrink
text:
"Do not fear adversity. Let your courage be your strength."
—Onatah, Anaba shaman

name: Stampede
text:
"We could see the horizon blacken with the great beasts, but it was too late. The icefield offered no immediate safety, but luckily most of us reached a crevasse in which we could take cover."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Inheritance
text:
"More than lessons may be gained from the past."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Thelonite Druid
text:
"The magic at the heart of all living things can bear awe-inspiring fruit."
—Kolevi of Havenwood, elder druid

name: Thermokarst
text:
"Finally we understand the lesson of our home: loss begets renewal."
—Kolbjörn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Woolly Mammoths
text:
"Mammoths may be good to ride on, but they're certainly bad to fall off of!"
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Woolly Spider
text:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Yavimaya Ancients
text:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

name: Diabolic Vision
text:
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Elemental Augury
text:
"It is the changing of perception that is important."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Fumarole
text:
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills."
—Klazina Jansdotter, leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

name: Giant Trap Door Spider
text:
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Nature's Blessing
text:
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Skeleton Ship
text:
"The sea gives up her dead as easily as the soil."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Storm Spirit
text:
"Come to us, with your lightning. Come to us, with your thunder. Serve us with your strength, and smite our foes with your power."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian shaman

name: Wings of Aesthir
text:
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit."
—Arnjlot Olasson, sky mage

name: Juniper Order Advocate
text:
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order advocate

name: Adarkar Sentinel
text:
"We encountered the sentinels in the wastes, near no living thing. Their purpose was inscrutable."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Aeolipile
text:
"Although fragile, the aeolipile could be quite destructive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

name: Ashnod's Cylix
text: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

name: Despotic Scepter
text:
"We were not meant to have such terrible things. They should be left where we found them, if not destroyed!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Elven Lyre
text: Scholars are uncertain whether it was the actual sound or some other magical property of the elven lyre that transformed its player.

name: Kjeldoran Elite Guard
text: The winged helms of the guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

name: Mishra's Groundbreaker
text: The very ground yielded to Mishra's wishes.

name: Roterothopter
text:
"The roterothoper is as insidious as it is ingenious. It is one of the few creations of our school that I take no pride in."
—Baki, wizard attendant

name: Skull Catapult
text:
"Let any who doubt the evil of using the ancient devices look at this infernal machine. What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

name: Soldevi Digger
text:
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Soldevi Simulacrum
text: They look human—until they bleed.

name: Whirling Catapult
text:
"Direct confrontation never was to the orcs' taste."
—General Varchild

name: Kjeldoran Skycaptain
text:
"If we do our duty and uphold our honor, Kjeldor shall stand for a thousand years."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: Lost Order of Jarkeld
text:
"Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Order of the Sacred Torch
text: A blazing light to drive out the shadows.

name: Order of the White Shield
text:
"Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Ravages of War
text:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching, trans. Feng and English

name: Reinforcements
text:
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."
—General Varchild

name: Reprisal
text:
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Royal Trooper
text:
"Fortune does not side with the fainthearted."
—Sophocles, Phaedra

name: Sacred Boon
text:
"Divine gifts are granted to those who are worthy."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Shield Bearer
text:
"You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a skyknight."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: Sustaining Spirit
text:
"Faith is our greatest protector."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"The so-called barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Warning
text:
"The folk of the Karplusan mountains are impossible to ambush."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Aether Storm
text:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

name: Armor of Faith
text:
"Keep your chainmail, warrior. I have my own form of protection."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Balduvian Conjurer
text:
"The very lands of Balduvia are alive."
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

name: Binding Grasp
text:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Browse
text:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Counterspell
text:
"The duel was going badly for me, and Zur thought I was finished. He boasted that he would eat my soul—but all he ate were his words."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Enervate
text:
"Worlds turn in crucial moments of decision. Make your choice."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

name: Essence Flare
text: Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.

name: Krovikan Sorcerer
text:
"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Lat-Nam's Legacy
text:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Mesmeric Trance
text:
"Magic overused can freeze the mind. Creativity is more important than power."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Narwhal
text:
"Who needs a spear? Ya break off the horn, and ya stab the fish with it. Easy!"
—Kakra, sea troll

name: Aysen Bureaucrats
text:
"I would say that our bureaucrats are no better than vipers—but I shouldn't insult the vipers."
—Murat, death speaker

name: Red Cliffs Armada
text: By the battle of Red Cliffs in the year 208, the Wu kingdom controlled more than seven thousand warships on the Yangtze.

name: Sea Spirit
text:
"It rose above our heads, above the ship, and still higher yet. No foggy, ice-laden sea in the world could frighten me more."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Shyft
text:
"Capturing this specimen was not easy. Study it well, that you someday might be as versatile."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Sibilant Spirit
text:
"Relax. I'm sure it's just a snake hissing."
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Aysen Crusader
text:
"A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true crusader make."
—Irini Sengir

name: Thunder Wall
text:
"The lemures had barely taken wing when the sky roared with thunder. The swarm of little beasts wavered, divided, and fell, crashing to the earth."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: Viscerid Armor
text: A fallen viscerid's only tribute is to be worn by a comrade.

name: Viscerid Drone
text: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .

name: Wall of Kelp
text:
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it."
—Zeki, reef pirate

name: Wind Spirit
text:
"To visit the sky requires bravery, and thought, and little else. To master the sky requires the binding of its masters, and little else."
—Arnjlot Olasson, sky mage

name: Zuran Spellcaster
text:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Armor Thrull
text:
"The worst thing about being a mercenary for the Ebon Hand is having to wear a dead thrull."
—Ivra Jursdotter

name: Brine Shaman
text:
"The shamans of Marit Lage do her bidding in secret, but they do it gladly."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Drift of the Dead
text:
"Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Dry Spell
text:
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer."
—Autumn Willow

name: Combat Medic
text:
"Without combat medics, Icatia would probably not have withstood the forces of chaos as long as it did."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

name: Foul Familiar
text:
"Serve me, and live forever."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Funeral March
text:
"This party is such fun—but it's a shame to mourn just one."
—Irini Sengir

name: Grandmother Sengir
text:
"Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear grandmother."
—Baron Sengir

name: Icequake
text:
"When the earth shakes, and their animals are swallowed up by the ground, perhaps they will think twice before attacking again."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Ihsan's Shade
text:
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal."
—Baris, Serra inquisitor

name: Imperial Seal
text: "If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."

name: Infernal Darkness
text:
"I thought the day had brought enough horrors for our ragged band, but the night was far worse."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Kjeldoran Dead
text:
"They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Knight of Stromgald
text:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Exorcist
text: Though they often bore little greater charm than the demons they battled, exorcists were always welcome in Scarwood.

name: Frost Giant
text: The frost giants have been out in the cold a long, long time, but they have their rage to keep them warm.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Kobold Drill Sergeant
text: "Joining this army is easy, boy. Just survive your first battle."

name: Kobold Overlord
text:
"One for all, all for one; we strike first, and then you're done!"
—Oath of the Kobold Musketeers

name: Kobold Taskmaster
text: The Taskmaster knows that there is no cure for the common Kobold.

name: Kobolds of Kher Keep
text: Kher Keep is unique among fortresses: impervious to aerial assault but defenseless from the ground.

name: Lu Bu, Master-at-Arms
text: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer,/ Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

name: Raging Minotaur
text: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

name: False Defeat
text:
"All warfare is based on deception."
—Sun Tzu, Art of War (trans. Giles)

name: Zodiac Dragon
text: ". . . The kingdoms three are now the stuff of dream,/ For men to ponder, past all praise or blame."

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text:
They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred. Let them be cast out."
—Ailheen, Speaker of the Council

name: Faerie Noble
text:
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, there's some straight talkers."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

name: Jungle Lion
text: The lion's only loyalty is to its hunger.

name: Killer Bees
text: The communal mind produces a savage strategy, yet no one could predict that this vicious crossbreed would unravel the secret of steel.

name: Meng Huo, Barbarian King
text: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

name: Meng Huo's Horde
text: Through his allies, Meng Huo commanded several hundred thousand troops composed of cavalry, rattan-armored warriors, infantry, naked men with swords, and wild animals.

name: Guan Yu's 1,000-Li March
text: "He Guan Yu covered the ground on a thousand-li horse;/ With dragon blade he took each pass by force."

name: Riding the Dilu Horse
text:
"All men have their appointed time; that's something no horse can change."
—Liu Bei, after being told that the Dilu brings its master ill fortune

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Slashing Tiger
text:
"Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cubs."
—Sun Tzu, Art of War (trans. Giles)

name: Three Visits
text:
"Trying to meet a worthy man in the wrong way is as bad as closing the door on an invited guest."
—Mencius, a Chinese philosopher

name: Trip Wire
text: Trip wire, hooked poles, and sunken pits were commonly used to unhorse riders during the Three Kingdoms period.

name: Willow Priestess
text:
"Those of faith are those of strength."
—Autumn Willow

name: Heal
text:
"Sometimes even the smallest boon can save a life."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

name: Angus Mackenzie
text:
"Battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas."
—Angus Mackenzie, Diary

name: Barktooth Warbeard
text: He is devious and cunning, in both appearance and deed. Beware the Warbeard, for this brute bites as well as he barks!

name: Bartel Runeaxe
text: Thundering down from Hammerheim, no foe could slow Bartel's charge.

name: Gwendlyn Di Corci
text: Urborg became the final resting place of many swordsmen of renown, their steel outmatched by the wiles of Gwendlyn.

name: Ivory Guardians
text: The elite guard of the Mesa High Priests, the Ivory Guardians, were created to protect the innocent and faithful. Some say their actions are above the law.

name: Halfdane
text: Hail from Tolaria the ever changing 'Dane.

name: Hunding Gjornersen
text: "You would never guess, at the terrifying sight of the man, that Hunding was as charming a companion as one could wish for."

name: Jedit Ojanen
text: Mightiest of the cat warriors, Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

name: Jerrard of the Closed Fist
text: Once, the order of the Closed Fist reached throughout the Kb'Briann Highlands. Now, Jerrard alone remains to uphold their standard.

name: Kjeldoran Frostbeast
text:
"Two of my Warriors found that the creature was dangerous not only in combat, but also in simple proximity."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

name: Lady Evangela
text:
"When milady was young, the sight of a rainbow would fill her soul with peace. As she grew, she learned to share her rapture with others."
—Lady Gabriella

name: Lady Orca
text:
"I do not remember what he said to her. I remember her fiery eyes, fixed upon him for an instant. I remember a flash, and the hot breath of sudden flames made me turn away. When I looked again, Angus was gone."
—A Wayfarer, on meeting Lady Orca

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Livonya Silone
text: Livonya's own nature is a matter of mystery. Nothing is known for sure, merely rumors of unearthly stealth, and unholy alliances.

name: Marhault Elsdragon
text: Marhault Elsdragon follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

name: Pavel Maliki
text: We all know the legend: Pavel wanders the realms, helping those in greatest need. But is this a measure of his generosity, or of his obligation to atone?

name: Ragnar
text: "On the field of honor, a soldier need have no fear."

name: Ramirez DePietro
text: Ramirez DePietro is a most flamboyant pirate. Be careful not to believe his tall tales, especially when you ask his age.

name: Riven Turnbull
text: "Political violence is a perfectly legitimate answer to the persecution handed down by dignitaries of the state."

name: Sir Shandlar of Eberyn
text:
"Remember Sir Shandlar! Remember and stand firm!"
—rallying cry of the Eberyn militia

name: Sivitri Scarzam
text: Even the brave have cause to tremble at the sight of Sivitri Scarzam. Who else has tamed Scarzam's Dragon?

name: Spectral Shield
text:
"What can be a stronger shield than concealment? Have you ever defeated an enemy you didn't know existed?"
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Sunastian Falconer
text: Sunastian has roots in both sorcery and swordplay; he has learned never to depend too heavily on the latter.

name: Lightning Blow
text:
"If you do it right, they'll never know what hit them."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

name: The Lady of the Mountain
text: Her given name has been lost in the mists of time. Legend says that her silent vigil will one day be ended by the one who, pure of heart and spirit, calls out that name again.

name: Tobias Andrion
text: Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, Tobias is the military right arm of the empire and the figurehead of its freedom.

name: Torsten Von Ursus
text: "How can you accuse me of evil? Though these deeds be unsavory, no one will argue: good shall follow from them."

name: Tuknir Deathlock
text: An explorer of the Æther, Tuknir often discovers himself in the most unusual physical realms.

name: Xira Arien
text: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

name: Liu Bei, Lord of Shu
text:
"Only wisdom and virtue can truly win men's devotion."
—Liu Bei

name: Barl's Cage
text: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

name: Bone Flute
text: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

name: Coal Golem
text:
"Three such creatures stood burning at the crest of the hill. Only seconds later, the fireball struck our front line."
—Lydia, Countess Brellis

name: Didgeridoo
text:
"Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, called the Pretender

name: Alabaster Potion
text:
"Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity."
—D'Avenant proverb

name: Sol Grail
text:
"Look deep into the Grail, and see there what you desire most."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

name: Hammerheim
text:
"'Tis distance lends enchantment to the view,/ And robes the mountain in its azure hue."
—Thomas Campbell, "Pleasures of Hope"

name: Karakas
text:
"To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee,/ One clover, and a bee,/ And revery."
—Emily Dickinson

name: Misfortune's Gain
text: The mourning families of commanders and generals were often given land, valuables, or money to compensate for their losses.

name: Urborg
text:
"Resignedly beneath the sky/The melancholy waters lie./So blend the turrets and shadows there/That all seem pendulous in air,/While from a proud tower in town/Death looks gigantically down."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The City in the Sea"

name: Peach Garden Oath
text:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood. . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

name: Shu Cavalry
text: In establishing the Shu kingdom, Liu Bei's forces fought against Ma Chao at Chengdu. Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

name: Shu Elite Companions
text: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
text: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

name: Wall of Light
text: As many attackers were dazzled by the wall's beauty as were halted by its force.

name: Zhang Fei, Fierce Warrior
text: Zhang Fei's uncharacteristic alliance with a defeated Riverlands general, Yan Yan, allowed Shu forces to advance through forty-five Riverlands strongpoints with no casualties.

name: Benthic Explorers
text: The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare. The Explorers found their ancient enemies spawning everywhere.

name: Amrou Kithkin
text: Quick and agile, Amrou Kithkin can usually escape from even the most fearsome opponents.

name: Boomerang
text:
"O! call back yesterday, bid time return."
—William Shakespeare, King Richard the Second

name: Borrowing 100,000 Arrows
text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

name: Brilliant Plan
text: At Red Cliffs, Kongming and Zhou Yu each wrote his plan for defeating Wei on the palm of his hand. They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: Flash Flood
text: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.

name: Forced Retreat
text:
"Leadership, not numbers, determines victory."
—A Wu commander, before his 5,000 troops forced 15,000 Wei troops to retreat from Ruxu

name: Infuse
text:
"The potential for change lies in all things. Know a thing's nature, know its possibilities, and know it anew."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

name: Labyrinth Minotaur
text:
"I doubt any labyrinth minotaurs still live—but then again, we minotaurs are stubborn beings."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Lu Meng, Wu General
text: As the Wu chief commander, Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants on boats filled with hiding troops.

name: Remove Soul
text: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then felt lifeless to the ground.

name: Reveka, Wizard Savant
text:
"It's nice to see a sister Dwarf in a position of such power, but why'd it have to be one of those seafaring muleheads?"
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

name: Cleanse
text: The clouds broke and the sun's rays burst forth; each foul beast in its turn faltered, and was gone.

name: Strategic Planning
text: "Plans evolved within the tent decide a victory 1,000 li away."

name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

name: Wu Elite Cavalry
text: At the second battle of Ruxu, the brave Wu general Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 men with only 100 cavalry. Not a single man or horse was lost.

name: Wu Warship
text: Both Wu and Wei warships patrolled the Yangtze River, the natural border between the two kingdoms.

name: Ashes to Ashes
text:
"All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, Memoirs of a Soldier

name: Banshee
text: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

name: D'Avenant Archer
text: Avenant's archers are also trained as poets, so that each arrow is guided by a fragment of verse.

name: Carrion Ants
text:
"'War is no picnic,' my father liked to say. But the ants seemed to disagree."
—General Chanek Valteroth

name: Cosmic Horror
text:
"Then flashed the living lightning from her eyes,/ And screams of horror rend th' affrighted skies."
—Alexander Pope, The Rape of the Lock

name: Desperate Charge
text: "Lieutenants dishonored, corpses carted home; The general raises troops again to take revenge."

name: Famine
text: "But it was a year of dearth. People were reduced to eating leaves of jujube trees. Corpses were seen everywhere in the countryside."

name: Fevered Strength
text:
"The burst of strength brought on by this plague should not be mistaken for a sign of renewed health."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

name: Ghostly Visit
text: Cao Cao was haunted to death by the ghosts of the empresses and other high courtiers he had murdered.

name: Ghosts of the Damned
text: The voices of the dead ring in the heart long after they have faded from the ears.

name: Grim Tutor
text:
One who goes unpunished never learns.
—Greek proverb

name: Hellfire
text:
"High on a throne of royal state . . . insatiate to pursue vain war with heav'n."
—John Milton, Paradise Lost

name: Nether Void
text: These days, some wizards are finding that they have a little too much spell left at the end of their mana.

name: Stolen Grain
text: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot, leaving him with no way to feed his troops.

name: The Abyss
text:
"An immense river of oblivion is sweeping us away into a nameless abyss."
—Ernest Renan, Souvenirs d'Enfance et de Jeunesse

name: Wei Elite Companions
