text: Cao Cao was more concerned with capabilities than lineage. He excelled at recruiting and retaining men of talent to serve him.

name: Wei Infantry
text: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan and then foiled a Wu scheme to incite rebellion.

name: Wei Strike Force
text: At the battle of Chang'an, Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass but was forced to flee when Cao Cao's trickery turned his own ally against him.

name: Young Wei Recruits
text:
"To send the common people to war untrained is to throw them away."
—Confucius, The Analects (trans. Lau)

name: Anaba Ancestor
text:
"The Ancestors are the wisdom of the tribe and the soul of the Homelands. I am eternally in their debt."
—Taysir

name: Anaba Spirit Crafter
text:
"The Spirit Crafters sing of all our people. They sing of those lost, of those found, and of those who are yet to be."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

name: Cinder Storm
text: When the sky's rain has turned to fire, what will put it out?

name: Crimson Kobolds
text:
"Kobolds are harmless."
—Bearand the Bold, epitaph

name: Crimson Manticore
text: Noted neither for their good looks nor their charm, manticores can be fearsome allies. As dinner companions, however, they are best left alone.

name: Fire Ambush
text: "With fire he broke the battle at Bowang . . . . Striking fear deep into Cao Cao's soul, thus Kongming scored a coup at his debut."

name: Fire Drake
text: Brimstone marks this drake's territory. Unfortunately for travelers, all of the Burning Isles smell likewise.

name: Firestorm Phoenix
text:
"The bird of wonder dies, the maiden phoenix,/ Her ashes new-create another heir/ As great in admiration as herself."
—William Shakespeare, King Henry the Eighth

name: Alaborn Musketeer
text: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

name: Zombie Master
text: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

name: Artifact Blast
text: The first line of defense against Urza and Mishra, the Artifact Blast achieved widespread fame until an unlucky mage discovered it was useless on the devices the brothers had already created.

name: Dust to Dust
text:
"All this nonsense made by mages Rusts and crumbles through the ages."
—Aline Corralurn, "Inheritance"

name: Bird Maiden
text:
"Four things that never meet do here unite
To shed my blood and to ravage my heart,
A radiant brow and tresses that beguile
And rosy cheeks and a glittering smile."
—The Arabian Nights, trans. Haddawy

name: Devastation
text: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

name: Goblin Bully
text: It's easy to stand head and shoulders over those with no backbone.

name: Goblin Cavaliers
text: They get along so well with their goats because they're practically goats themselves.

name: Goblin General
text: Lead, follow, or run like crazy.

name: Goblin Warrens
text:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

name: Sedge Troll
text: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Alluring Scent
text: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

name: Bee Sting
text:
Busy as a bumblebee, blistered as a goblin.
—Alaborn saying

name: Elite Cat Warrior
text: "Hear that? No? That's a cat warrior."

name: Ironhoof Ox
text: The good news is it's vegetarian. The bad news is it just doesn't like you.

name: Sandstorm
text: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

name: Southern Elephant
text: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

name: Squall
text:
"To-night the winds begin to rise . . . The rooks are blown about the skies . . . ."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, In Memoriam

name: Kismet
text:
"Make people wait for what they want, and you have power over them. This is as true for merchants and militia as it is for cooks and couples."
—Gwendlyn Di Corci

name: Whiptail Wurm
text: It's hard to say for certain which end is more dangerous.

name: Wild Ox
text: It has the run of the swamps, and it knows it.

name: Aesthir Glider
text:
"Sacrilege! A noble ally in life, made nothing more than a glorified kite in death!"
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

name: Al-abara's Carpet
text: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger, and the carpet carried her high out of our reach.

name: Amulet of Kroog
text: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog. As a sign of friendship, Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets; afterwards, thousands journeyed to Kroog in hope of healing, greatly adding to the city's glory.

name: Leeches
text:
"Where our potions and powders fail, perhaps nature will succeed."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

name: Candelabra of Tawnos
text: Tawnos learned quickly from Urza that utter simplicity often led to wondrous, yet subtle utility.

name: Celestial Sword
text:
"So great is its power, only the chosen can wield it and live."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

name: Clay Statue
text: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

name: Martyr's Cry
text:
"It is only fitting that one such as I should die in pursuit of knowledge."
—Vervamon the Elder

name: Clockwork Gnomes
text:
"Until I came to the Floating Isle, I never had to oil the servants."
—Baki, wizard attendant

name: Colossus of Sardia
text: Buried under a thin layer of dirt, it was known for centuries as Mount Sardia.

name: Diabolic Machine
text:
"The bolts of our ballistae smashed into the monstrous thing, but our hopes died in our chests as its gears continued turning."
—Sevti Mukul, The Fall of Alsoor

name: Dragon Engine
text: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

name: Ebony Rhino
text:
"That Rhino would fetch us a tidy sum, Joven. Perhaps it's time to make it ours."
—Chandler

name: Alaborn Trooper
text:
"I dedicate my body to my country And my life to my King."
—Alaborn Soldier's Oath

name: Floodwater Dam
text: Viscerid dams may be of living creatures as well as bones and mud.

name: Grapeshot Catapult
text: For years scholars debated whether these were Urza's or Mishra's creations. Recent research suggests they were invented by the brothers' original master, Tocasia, and that both used these devices.

name: Horn of Deafening
text: "A blast, an echo . . . then silence."

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Living Wall
text: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

name: Mightstone
text: While exploring the sacred cave of Koilos with his brother Mishra and their master Tocasia, Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

name: Obelisk of Undoing
text: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

name: Obsianus Golem
text:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone . . ."
—"Song of the Artificer"

name: Onulet
text: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's Onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

name: Pentagram of the Ages
text:
"Take this item, for instance. How would it destroy us, Relicbane?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Planar Gate
text: Nireya reached through the Gate, sensing the energies trapped beyond.

name: Rakalite
text: Urza was the first to understand that the war would not be lost for lack of power, but for lack of troops.

name: Ring of Renewal
text: To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.

name: Scarecrow
text: There was more malice in its button eyes than should have been possible in something that had never known life.

name: Soldevi Golem
text: Slow and steady wins the race.

name: Staff of Zegon
text: Though Mishra was impressed by the staves Ashnod had created for Zegon's defense, he understood they only hinted at her full potential.

name: Righteous Charge
text: Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul.

name: Tablet of Epityr
text: Originally considered the work of Urza, this tablet was created by forgers seeking to imitate Urza's masterpieces.

name: Tawnos's Weaponry
text: When Urza's war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

name: Urza's Chalice
text: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

name: Vibrating Sphere
text:
"Unearthly and invisible fibers emanate from this sphere, entangling all who draw near."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Weakstone
text: During the brothers' childhood, Tocasia took them to explore the sacred cave of Koilos. There, in the Hall of Tagsin, Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

name: Savannah Lions
text: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

name: Yotian Soldier
text: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again, even while laying siege to a city far from their homes.

name: Mishra's Workshop
text: Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia, Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose. Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Strip Mine
text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Mine
text: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction requires immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction requires immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction requires immense resources.

name: Urza's Power Plant
text: Artifact construction requires immense resources.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Urza's Tower
text: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

name: Serra Aviary
text:
"Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."
—Taysir

name: Spotted Griffin
text: When the cat flies and the bird stalks, guard your horses carefully.

name: Steam Catapult
text: "You idiots! Turn it around! Turn it around!"

name: Temple Acolyte
text: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
text: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

name: White Knight
text: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

name: Wild Aesthir
text:
"High in the Karplusans, death is swift and razor-clawed."
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

name: Wild Griffin
text: Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.

name: Air Elemental
text: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

name: Argivian Blacksmith
text: Through years of study and training, the Blacksmiths of Argive became adept at reassembling the mangled remains of the strange, mechanical creatures abounding in their native land.

name: Drowned
text: We asked Captain Soll what became of the Serafina, but all he said was, "Ships that go down shouldn't come back up."

name: Armageddon
text:
"'O miserable of happy! Is this the end Of this new glorious world . . . ?'"
—John Milton, Paradise Lost

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood amongst the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mystic Decree
text:
"Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers. Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."
—Irini Sengir

name: Phantasmal Forces
text: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Reconstruction
text: Tedious research made the Sages of the College of Lat-Nam adept in repairing broken artifacts.

name: Sea Serpent
text: Legend has it that Serpents used to be bigger, but how could that be?

name: Symbol of Unsummoning
text:
". . . inviting the soul to wander for a spell in abysses of solitude . . . ."
—Kate Chopin, The Awakening

name: Talas Researcher
text:
From time, knowledge.
From knowledge, power.

name: Theft of Dreams
text: Energy is never lost, only transformed.

name: Thing from the Deep
text: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.

name: Water Elemental
text: Unpredictable as the sea itself, water elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

name: Black Knight
text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

name: Dakmor Plague
text: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

name: Demonic Hordes
text: Created to destroy Dominiaria, demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

name: Champion Lancer
text: The flash of his lance projects the pure radiance of his honor.

name: Gate to Phyrexia
text:
"The warm rain of grease on my face immediately made it clear I had entered Phyrexia."
—Jarsyl, Diary

name: Minion of Tevesh Szat
text:
"A minion given over to Tevesh Szat is a stronger minion gained."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Prowling Nightstalker
text: Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.

name: Rain of Daggers
text: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

name: Force of Virtue
text:
"Where divinity leads, victory follows."
—Silverblade motto

name: Plague Engineer
text:
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Putrid Goblin
text: Too stupid to survive, too dumb to die.

name: Rank Officer
text: It recruits the fresh and tosses the rotten.

name: Ransack the Lab
text:
"I think someone is stealing from my laboratory. It had better not be you!"
—Geralf, letter to Gisa

name: Return from Extinction
text: The First Sliver calls. The dead answer.

name: Sadistic Obsession
text: Not everyone should take joy in their work.

name: Shatter Assumptions
text: Rigid minds are the first to break.

name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
text: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

name: Smiting Helix
text: Malice is appropriate when vengeance is called for.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Throatseeker
text:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words

name: Umezawa's Charm
text: "Be ever loyal to your own best interests."

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Unearth
text: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

name: Venomous Changeling
text: It doesn't contain venom. It is venom.

name: Warteye Witch
text: Eyeballs that portend unpleasant futures become slimy snacks instead.

name: Bladeback Sliver
text: Slivers can turn a last stand into a stunning victory.

name: Gilded Light
text: Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second.

name: Bogardan Dragonheart
text: A hunger to soar must be sated.

name: Cleaving Sliver
text: When it wriggled closer to a thrum of slivers, their talons hardened and glinted in the sun. One took a playful swipe at a tree trunk, and its new blade cut clean through.

name: Firebolt
text: "There's more where that came from!"

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Geomancer's Gambit
text: Telepathy changes minds, necromancy changes lives, but geomancy changes the world.

name: Goatnap
text: "The steering horns ain't steering!"

name: Goblin Champion
text: The stories of his heroics are inspiring, though none of them are remotely true.

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Goblin Oriflamme
text:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Hollowhead Sliver
text:
"Brilliant! They evolved away from energy-taxing brains and respond only to spinal reflex arcs from the hive mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Igneous Elemental
text: Volcanic violence made manifest.

name: Lava Dart
text:
"Small outbursts are healthy."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Magmatic Sinkhole
text: Opening like the maw of a hellion, the earth swallowed the traveler whole.

name: Ore-Scale Guardian
text: A dragon's loyalty cannot be earned, but it can be bought.

name: Pashalik Mons
text: The thunderhead that leads in the storm.

name: Pillage
text:
"The embers of our homes still smolder, and already the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation. What they have started, we will finish."
—Lovisa Coldeyes

name: Impostor of the Sixth Pride
text: The tribe was as strong as his longing, their territory as vast as his isolation. The changeling knew he had found a home, and a form.

name: Planebound Accomplice
text: "Told you I had friends."

name: Pyrophobia
text:
"I hate this! I hate fire! I hate you for taking me on this route!"
—Norin the Wary

name: Ravenous Giant
text: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

name: Shenanigans
text: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

name: Spinehorn Minotaur
text: "If you think twice, I'll cut twice."

name: Spiteful Sliver
text: Victories against the hive are tragedies.

name: Tectonic Reformation
text: Alone in the charred desolation of her kingdom, she regretted many things—most of all not acting sooner.

name: Irregular Cohort
text: Where fickle form meets lasting loyalty.

name: Vengeful Devil
text: Devils love adding injury to injury.

name: Volatile Claws
text: Whether modeled after bear, bird, or baloth, all claws send the same message.

name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
text: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

name: Ayula's Influence
text: Ayula's runic clawmarks ensure her territories are never left defenseless.

name: Bellowing Elk
text:
"Their two-tone vocalization contains a whistle and a roar. Both mean get away."
—Vivien Reid

name: Collector Ouphe
text:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

name: Conifer Wurm
text: During seasonal thaws, the wurms slough their skin against trees to promote growth.

name: King of the Pride
text:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Elvish Fury
text: Fail to respect the forest and you will fertilize it.

name: Excavating Anurid
text: Turg's spawn ruled long after he croaked.

name: Force of Vigor
text: The vines overgrew the construct, snapping gears and soaking up aether.

name: Frostwalla
text: Glare from the snows in the boreal expanse hides its true size.

name: Genesis
text: Not dryad, centaur, or avatar but life itself.

name: Glacial Revelation
text: The harshest environments offer the greatest opportunities for exploration.

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Mother Bear
text: Even without her, the cubs will always know their mother's love.

name: Murasa Behemoth
text: The loss of its hunting grounds made it all the more dangerous.

name: Nantuko Cultivator
text: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

name: Nimble Mongoose
text: One thread connected all the travelers' stories: the ferocity of the mongoose.

name: Regrowth
text: While the root remains, the tree yet lives.

name: Rime Tender
text: "Fools view winter as the season of death because they cannot see the life underneath."

name: Saddled Rimestag
text: Horns of hoarfrost grow every night, gleam at dawn, and melt by dusk.

name: Savage Swipe
text: Nine generations of metalworking skill are no match for nine hundred pounds of rage.

name: Lancer Sliver
text:
"These polearms were supposed to help!"
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Spore Frog
text: A progenitor of tadpoles and allergies in equal measure.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

name: Tempered Sliver
text: The question isn't whether slivers will adapt to a world's perils but whether the world's perils will adapt to slivers.

name: Thornado
text: Every bough, branch, and bramble lashed out in defense of the forest.

name: Trumpeting Herd
text: An elephant never forgives.

name: Twin-Silk Spider
text: A forest-wide network of webs brings a hungry couple to captured prey.

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Weather the Storm
text: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

name: Webweaver Changeling
text: Eight legs carrying endless phobias.

name: Winding Way
text: Every path leads to discovery.

name: Cloudshredder Sliver
text: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

name: Eladamri's Call
text: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

name: Answered Prayers
text: Angels cannot ignore pious pleas.

name: On Thin Ice
text: He cursed the wind. He cursed the cold. But by stepping on the ice, he cursed himself.

name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
text: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Lavabelly Sliver
text: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

name: Munitions Expert
text: When dealing with goblins, if it isn't nailed down, it's headed your way.

name: Nature's Chant
text:
"Plant every sword. Embrace every soul."
—Trostani

name: Reap the Past
text: The ground cracked and unleashed a thousand years of history at once.

name: Rotwidow Pack
text: For each one you see, ten see you.

name: Ruination Rioter
text: "Those urbanist cobble-roaches won't know what hit them!"

name: Soulherder
text: It watches over every absence.

name: Thundering Djinn
text: It strikes like a bolt from a brainstorm.

name: Unsettled Mariner
text: The call of the sea shapes many souls.

name: Altar of Dementia
text:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

name: Amorphous Axe
text: A weapon forged for every hand.

name: Recruit the Worthy
text: For peace of mind, they mustered for war.

name: Arcum's Astrolabe
text: Though the Time of Ice has ended, its relics still slumber in New Argive.

name: Birthing Boughs
text: Changelings can't remember where they came from. They just know it wasn't a cradle.

name: Farmstead Gleaner
text: When it finishes the harvest, you'll have nowhere to hide.

name: Fountain of Ichor
text: Sun Empire priests thought they were digging a well. What they tapped was something different entirely.

name: Icehide Golem
text: In colder climates, ice is more obedient than stone.

name: Reprobation
text: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Fiery Islet
text: Where water is the canvas and lava the paint.

name: Rhox Veteran
text: "Battle is all about where you stand. Never stand in my way."

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
text: The stronghold of Theros's light.

name: Nurturing Peatland
text: New life is born within its shadows.

name: Prismatic Vista
text: There is beauty in the uncertainty of potential.

name: Silent Clearing
text: The expedition's end began the marsh's story.

name: Sunbaked Canyon
text: Since the river ran dry, travelers wander where fish once swam.

name: Waterlogged Grove
text: The trees pull water from deep underground, filling the forest for miles.

name: Segovian Angel
text: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

name: Settle Beyond Reality
text: Two taken, two judged, one returned.

name: Shelter
text: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

name: Stirring Address
text: "For glory! For justice! For our queen!"

name: Trustworthy Scout
text: "Don't worry. If you lose me I'll be right behind you."

name: Wall of One Thousand Cuts
text: Families of the fallen donate the swords of their loved ones to bolster the city's defenses.

name: Wing Shards
text: Her feathers cut the air, as sharp as they are silent.

name: Zhalfirin Decoy
text:
"Never let them take their eyes off you."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Battle Screech
text: All sounds harmonize with the Worldsoul.

name: Bazaar Trademage
text: He traded a lamp for a scepter, the scepter for a ruby, and the ruby for a simple rug.

name: Chillerpillar
text: From its cocoon, a flurry takes flight.

name: Choking Tethers
text: A wizard can be outnumbered but never outsmarted.

name: Cunning Evasion
text:
"Begin with your escape and work backward."
—*Way of Secrets*

name: Echo of Eons
text: The present is a matter of perspective.

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Eyekite
text:
"This one will need direction. After all, each of its eyes is larger than its brain."
—Cyla, Lord of the Aerie

name: Dismantling Blow
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound, but do try to destroy it the first time."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Every choice is a joy."

name: Faerie Seer
text: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

name: Force of Negation
text: "Try, if you must."

name: Future Sight
text:
"Is the inevitable any less miraculous?"
—Veldka, wandering sage

name: Iceberg Cancrix
text: Its shell can withstand anything but a thaw.

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Enduring Sliver
text: Time has ground mountains to sand, but the slivers ever remain.

name: Oneirophage
text: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

name: Phantasmal Form
text: Within each of us lurks the fathomless.

name: Phantom Ninja
text:
"Ninjas can run across water, pull ladders from pockets, kill with a kiss, and slip between bricks. Pack of lies, I say."
—Benden, teahouse gossip

name: Pondering Mage
text: "Never leave the future to fate."

name: Rain of Revelation
text: "As the sky opened up, we ran for shelter. Halfway there I came to the sudden realization that, already soaked, there might be more to gain from experiencing the rain than running from it."

name: Rebuild
text: The first step in any artificer's scheme is to take inventory.

name: Scour All Possibilities
text: Searching the future for answers often leads to further questions.

name: Scuttling Sliver
text: A living fossil active after eons of dormancy.

name: Spell Snuff
text: "Good night."

name: Windcaller Aven
text: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

name: Face of Divinity
text: Pure souls shine bright as daybreak.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: It has no respect for the deeds of martyrs, reducing their legacy to a mouthful of flesh.

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Cordial Vampire
text: "Please, come in! Hors d'oeuvres are on the table."

name: Crypt Rats
text:
"Shoo, you little worm tails—go away! My corpses aren't your dinner!"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Dead of Winter
text:
"At last, silence."
—Tevesh Szat

name: Defile
text: The only shortcut in a bog is to the bottom.

name: Diabolic Edict
text:
"Always give your foes a choice when they have none."
—Ob Nixilis

name: First Sliver's Chosen
text: The most tenacious members of the hive instinctually guard the First Sliver.

name: Gluttonous Slug
text: No amount of salt will save you.

name: Graveshifter
text: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

name: Headless Specter
text: No tongue to chant, yet the forsaken hymn still emanates from its body.

name: Mind Rake
text: Spells of madness often require a sacrifice of sanity.

name: Mob
text: Not all monsters fight with teeth and claws.

name: Nether Spirit
text: Four walls and a roof won't provide safety from that which is buried.

name: Ninja of the New Moon
text: The night is the greatest ally of all.

name: Abiding Grace
text:
"Into the smothering dark, Serra spoke a single word: 'Hope.'"
—*Song of All*, canto 2

name: Sudden Edict
text:
"In one future, I see glory. In the other . . . well, that's another story."
—Whisper, blood liturgist

name: Tourach's Canticle
text: The same hymns Tourach sang to praise the Ebon Praetor would later be adapted to glorify Tourach himself.

name: Tragic Fall
text: Every final journey begins with a single misstep.

name: Underworld Hermit
text: Some souls yearn to escape death. Others are content to feed the wildlife.

name: Unmarked Grave
text:
"I'm sure they were once someone important, but I couldn't tell you who they were."
—Doros, expedition guide

name: Vermin Gorger
text:
"Once, vampires ruled this world, commanding the fear and respect that befit our noble blood. Have we truly sunk so low?"
—Sorin Markov

name: Vile Entomber
text: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

name: Disciple of the Sun
text: Heart of a titan, faith as bright as the dawn.

name: Young Necromancer
text: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

name: Captain Ripley Vance
text: The Spitfire Bastion bristles with cannons claimed from every ship she's conquered.

name: Esper Sentinel
text: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

name: Chef's Kiss
text: "Cooked to perfection, of course."

name: Faithless Salvaging
text: All that's left are broken beliefs.

name: Flame Blitz
text: "Blast it, not again!"

name: Galvanic Relay
text: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.

name: Fairgrounds Patrol
text: "No signs of any suspicious activity. Yet."

name: Goblin Traprunner
text: The best traprunners know exactly where to step. The others . . . do their best.

name: Gouged Zealot
text: He can't fear what he can't see.

name: Harmonic Prodigy
text: Each note strikes with deadly precision.

name: Lightning Spear
text: When wielded, it begs to be released.

name: Mine Collapse
text: "Good ol' rock," muttered Rhirhok as the shaking began. "Nice ol' rock . . . ."

name: Mount Velus Manticore
text: Born from a stray spark that flew from Purphoros's forge.

name: Glorious Enforcer
text: "You are unworthy of life, but take heart. You have earned a clean death."

name: Skophos Reaver
text: "KILL! KILL FOR MOGIS!"

name: Slag Strider
text: Imbued with life by a stray bolt of spellcraft, it began to wander about the foundry, to the blacksmiths' alarm.

name: Spreading Insurrection
text: Everyone wants to be on the winning side.

name: Strike It Rich
text: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.

name: Tavern Scoundrel
text: "No refunds. I cheated you fair and square."

name: Unholy Heat
text: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

name: Viashino Lashclaw
text: "Victory is the greatest motivator of all. So sayeth the bey."

name: Abundant Harvest
text: "Gaea knows what you need. Do you?"

name: Guardian Kirin
text:
Followed the kirin
—Ojutai expression meaning
"died a hero's death"

name: Blessed Respite
text:
"Water the soil with blood, if you must. Eventually it must be tilled with forgiveness."
—Greensleeves

name: Chatterstorm
text:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit

name: Crack Open
text: What no spell or lockpick could open, the forest coaxed apart.

name: Deepwood Denizen
text: "You didn't come all this way just to bother me, did you? Say your piece and be gone."

name: Duskshell Crawler
text: They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.

name: Fae Offering
text:
"Beware the gift when you do not know the giver."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Healer's Flock
text: The sight of a flock overhead is bittersweet. It means many are wounded, but it also means help is on the way.

name: Foundation Breaker
text: The castle finally got vengeance for enduring years of royally bad taste.

name: Funnel-Web Recluse
text: It thrives on a steady diet of hastily disposed-of evidence.

name: Glimmer Bairn
text: "Tricks and treats, souls and sweets! On wooded path, whom shall we meet?"

name: Glinting Creeper
text: Natural crystalline growths filter and refract light in dazzling displays that attract pollinators and daze predators.

name: Herd Baloth
text: Baloth social structure is simple: the biggest one's the leader.

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

name: Jade Avenger
text:
"Froggy fighter at the gate.
Draw your sword and meet your fate."
—Traditional children's rhyme

name: Jewel-Eyed Cobra
text:
"Sure, they're worth a lot, but I'd rather survive to spend my earnings."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Knighted Myr
text:
"This one fights like a leonin!"
—Jor Kadeen

name: Sanctum Weaver
text: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

name: Smell Fear
text:
"It's fun when they run a little."
—Wasitora, Nekoru queen

name: Squirrel Sovereign
text: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

name: Sylvan Anthem
text:
The harsher the winter, the more glorious the spring.
—Yavimaya saying

name: Urban Daggertooth
text: Stop, smell the roses, eat the peoples.

name: Wren's Run Hydra
text: The boggart hopped carelessly among the roots . . . until the roots woke up.

name: Arcus Acolyte
text: "Archery requires holding an enormous amount of tension and making it look effortless."

name: Breathless Knight
text: A deadly charge in eerie silence.

name: Late to Dinner
text: "I knew you were set in your ways, friend, but even I didn't expect you to keep our engagement, under the circumstances."

name: Combine Chrysalis
text:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Dihada's Ploy
text: The last piece was finally in place.

name: Drey Keeper
text: He gave the squirrels acorns. They gave him vengeance.

name: Foundry Helix
text: Steel never forgets the strike of the forge.

name: Garth One-Eye
text: A humble appearance belies a master's skill.

name: General Ferrous Rokiric
text: "The Boros Legion always stands for justice, but it never stands alone."

name: Lens Flare
text: The key for surviving a war is never becoming its focus.

name: Goblin Anarchomancer
text: A good Gruul shaman can work a whole clan into a frenzy. A great one will wait until the enemy's nearby.

name: Lazotep Chancellor
text:
"Cease all psychic attacks pending intel on enemy countermeasures."
—Dimir communiqué

name: Master of Death
text: Coming back from the dead, like most things, gets easier with practice.

name: Moderation
text:
"Good things come to those who are judicious in their appetites."
—*The Book of Bruna*

name: Piru, the Volatile
text: Chasms of dueling energies course within her.

name: Marble Gargoyle
text:
"Once past the stony exterior, the meat is exquisite and can be stuffed with thallids or simmered in a broth of manticore venom."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar,
*The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Rakdos Headliner
text: Caution: Audience in front row may have throats ripped out.

name: Ravenous Squirrel
text:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

name: Storm God's Oracle
text: The lives of Keranos's chosen are brief and brilliant as lightning.

name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
text: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

name: Terminal Agony
text: His mouth melted to slag, yet somehow he kept screaming.

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Nykthos Paragon
text: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.

name: Altar of the Goyf
text:
"What dies grows the [illegible]"
—Clawed-out statue inscription

name: Bottle Golems
text: Reinforcements *and* refreshments!

name: Brainstone
text: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

name: Diamond Lion
text:
"The merchant asked for riches no one had ever dreamed of. The djinn, smiling, granted his wish."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Fodder Tosser
text:
"In event of siege, load copiously with: hot oil, cannonballs, caltrops, rubble, old swords, mess-hall leftovers, chamber pots, broken chairs, salt, cousin Furt . . ."
—Trebuchet instructions

name: Liquimetal Torque
text:
"Weaponized jewelry has a long and respected history."
—Ervos Trax

name: Monoskelion
text: An unfinished body with unfinished business.

name: Myr Scrapling
text:
"They're useful creatures, but quite replaceable. I find it best not to get too attached."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Sanctuary Raptor
text: The song of the Worldsoul can take on life in the most unlikely places.

name: Sojourner's Companion
text: Before Phyrexia's corruption, many of Mirrodin's creatures were more curious than cruel.

name: Tormod's Cryptkeeper
text: It guards not a body, but a secret.

name: Piercing Rays
text: The forecast calls for pain.

name: Vectis Gloves
text: Thieves love technological innovations almost as much as artificers do.

name: Void Mirror
text:
"A mirror does more than reflect reality—it shapes it."
—Niko Aris

name: Darkmoss Bridge
text: The path to power is forged in ruthlessness.

name: Drossforge Bridge
text: The path to ruin is forged in pain.

name: Goldmire Bridge
text: The path to glory is forged in ambition.

name: Mistvault Bridge
text: The path to knowledge is forged in hunger.

name: Prismatic Ending
text: Right before his demise, he experienced a shattering revelation.

name: Razortide Bridge
text: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

name: Rustvale Bridge
text: The path to strength is forged in stability.

name: Silverbluff Bridge
text: The path to genius is forged in creativity.

name: Slagwoods Bridge
text: The path to action is forged in confidence.

name: Tanglepool Bridge
text: The path to change is forged in insight.

name: Thornglint Bridge
text: The path to growth is forged in balance.

name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
text:
"Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower. There is as much life here as in the rest of Dominaria together."
—Karn

name: Angelic Curator
text:
"Do not treat your people as you treat your artifacts. Let them go, and they will live; seal them here, and they will die."
—Urza, to Radiant

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Shackle the body, and the anguish lasts only until death. Shackle the soul, and the wicked can be punished for eternity."
—Inquisitor Laerin

name: Sea Drake
text: Highly territorial, they often attack boats whose colors too closely resemble those of other drakes.

name: Seal of Removal
text:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

name: Upheaval
text: The calm comes after the storm.

name: Wonder
text:
"It fell silently from the sky and broke the surface without a ripple. Was it even here at all?"
—Fisherman's journal

name: Braids, Cabal Minion
text: "Home is where you can find a decent graveyard and strangers can disappear without awkward questions."

name: Greed
text: What is a sliver of one's soul compared to unimaginable wealth?

name: Patriarch's Bidding
text:
"There's some new darkness in the air tonight. If I were you, I'd stay home and lock the doors."
—Ferrick, village warden

name: Skirge Familiar
text:
"The skirges screech along with the bone saw. It makes a terrible racket, but they seem to enjoy it."
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

name: Chance Encounter
text:
"What are the odds, indeed?"
—Yusri, to Desera

name: Flame Rift
text:
"You might want to step back."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

name: Scour the Desert
text: Even in the most barren wastelands, every death feeds more life.

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Imperial Recruiter
text: A passionate recruiter will win a war before the first arrow flies.

name: Mogg Salvage
text: Three moggs, one treasure, too bad.

name: Enchantress's Presence
text: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

name: Hunting Pack
text: There is no "I" in "team," but there is definitely "meat."

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

name: Squirrel Mob
text: An army of squirrels is still an army.

name: Search the Premises
text:
"To halt these lurid practices, Geralf must be found and made an example of."
—Inquisitor Delmund

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

name: Cursed Totem
text:
"Sorry, Great One, but did I hear correctly? I'm to entrust this powerful artifact to our *worst* researchers?"
—Flesdrim, Cabal servant

name: Extruder
text: As the invasion drew closer, Urza's means began to resemble Phyrexia's end.

name: Millikin
text: "Another failure," grumbled the toymaker. She slammed the door with such gusto that she failed to notice the eyes watching her.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
text: Nevinyrral's final act of spite was to make sure all of his magic was destroyed along with him.

name: Patchwork Gnomes
text: One wizard's trash is another wizard's roving gang of abominations.

name: Arcbound Mouser
text: It doesn't purr. It hums.

name: Serra's Emissary
text: Where swords fail, faith transcends.

name: Zuran Orb
text:
"Obsession is Zur's one flaw as a magic user. His total preoccupation with immortality has become an affliction for his otherwise brilliant mind."
—Jodah, Archmage Eternal

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Riptide Laboratory
text: Working with the best of intentions, its researchers unwittingly unleashed a plague of troubles upon Dominaria.

name: Imperial Recruiter
text: A passionate recruiter will win a war before the first arrow flies.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Its passage through history is marked by warped desires and insatiable greed.

name: Shardless Agent
text: "The left blade for a swift, painless death. The right blade for a long, lingering one. The choice is mine."

name: Vindicate
text: "I am the mad one!"

name: Cabal Coffers
text: The Cabal required a suitably immense space to house the lucrative fruits of their religious zeal.

name: Blossoming Calm
text: Mood: A spell that protects her from her enemies.

name: Esper Sentinel
text: Action: Using the reference as inspiration, we'd like you to design a soldier who is a similar mix of flesh and etherium (a magical metal found only on Esper).

name: Late to Dinner
text: Mood: A friendship that can outlast death.

name: Lens Flare
text: Intent: The spell shows a creature being damaged by powerful rays of light.

name: Nykthos Paragon
text: Action: Start with 190C and design a spirit known as an Eidolon that resembles a human solider carrying a large shield.

name: Search the Premises
text: Mood: Determined to find evidence of wrongdoing.

name: Floodhound
text: Action: This creature is a BLOODHOUND formed entirely of WATER.

name: Fractured Sanity
text: Action: We'd like an epic, abstract illustration of a fantastical moon (not the real-life earth moon), which has cracked open.

name: Mystic Redaction
text: Action: Show GLOWING BLUE GLYPHS being TORN out of a GRIMOIRE, leaving BLANK PAGES behind.

name: Phantasmal Dreadmaw
text: Action: Using the original art of Colossal Dreadmaw as inspiration, design a illusionary version of the dinosaur.

name: Thraben Watcher
text:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."

name: Rise and Shine
text: Mood: "You can't keep us locked away anymore. To battle!"

name: Thought Monitor
text: Mood: An efficient, well-designed machine.

name: Kitchen Imp
text: Action: Show an imp that's a kitchen helper for Asmor, the Underworld Cook.

name: Persist
text: Action: Show a kithkin (see pg. 28) emerging from under the ground where he was buried.

name: Sudden Edict
text: Intent: This illustration uses an existing visual gag that shows the moments before and after a spell was cast. We'd like you to use this visual gag for a spell that destroys a creature.

name: Underworld Hermit
text: Mood: He's the Pied Piper of squirrels.

name: World-Weary
text: Intent: This is an abstract depiction of a spell that causes a person to rapidly age.

name: Faithless Salvaging
text: Mood: A bit regretful but still looking for loot.

name: Gargadon
text: Intent: Magic has made a Greater Gargadon and a Lesser Gargadon (see ref). We want you to design the "average" Gargadon.

name: Harmonic Prodigy
text: Focus: The musician-wizard.

name: Abundant Harvest
text: Mood: Surrounded by the abundance of nature.

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: Intention: Do a mirror image of the Noble Hierarch card, only this time with a goblin.

name: Jade Avenger
text: Action: Show a frog samurai who is a master swordsman. Skilled and agile, he stands about four feet tall and wields a daisho (see ref).

name: Sylvan Anthem
text: Action: This is an abstract illustration that celebrates green creatures.

name: Timeless Witness
text: Intent: We'd like to re-imagine the Eternal Witness as an initiate on Amonkhet.

name: Combine Chrysalis
text: Action: Please design a Simic device that turns smaller creatures into big flying beasts.

name: Ethersworn Sphinx
text: Intent: Most Esper sphinxes have minimal filigree enhancement, but this sphinx has been extensively enhanced.

name: Garth One-Eye
text: Mood: A powerful, quirky, curious man.

name: General Ferrous Rokiric
text: Appearance: A skilled military commander, Ferrous is a new character for you to design.

name: Lazotep Chancellor
text: Mood: We will conquer you.

name: Aeromoeba
text: Some clouds heed no wind.

name: Moderation
text: Intent: This card prevents you from casting multiple spells per turn but rewards you for your restraint.

name: Rakdos Headliner
text: Mood: Unrestrained violence in a festival atmosphere.

name: Ravenous Squirrel
text: Action: This is a squirrel who eats everything.

name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
text: Action: We'd like you to design Sythis, a legendary green- and white-aligned female dryad who's closely tied to Karametra, the god of the harvest (p.26).

name: Burdened Aerialist
text: "Curse this glorious golden weight!"

name: Blacksmith's Skill
text: Before he was subjugated by demonic forces, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry.

name: Marble Gargoyle
text:
"Once past the stony exterior, the meat is exquisite and can be stuffed with thallids or simmered in a broth of manticore venom."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar
*The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Prismatic Ending
text: Right before his demise, he experienced a shattering revelation.

name: Resurgent Belief
text: No god on Theros ever truly dies as long as there are those who still have faith in them.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Shackled the body, and the anguish lasts only until death. Shackle the soul, and the wicked can be punished for eternity."
—Inquisitor Laerin

name: Timeless Dragon
text: It has flown the sky for eons without ever touching ground.

name: Aeromoeba
text: Some clouds heed no wind.

name: Rishadan Dockhand
text: It's not hard to find work in Rishada, so long as you've got a strong back and don't ask too many questions.

name: Step Through
text: Doors open both ways.

name: Bone Shards
text: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, its not hard to improvise an offense.

name: Nested Shambler
text: Home is where the heart was.

name: Arcbound Prototype
text: It flickered to life, saw itself alone, and began to build.

name: Etherium Spinner
text: "Thopters from a foundry always lack that personal touch."

name: Persist
text: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

name: Profane Tutor
text: As Dakkon forged the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, he unwittingly forged himself into her schemes.

name: Vile Entomber
text: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

name: Galvanic Relay
text: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.

name: Mine Collapse
text: "Good ol' rock," muttered Rhirhok as the shaking began. "Nice ol' rock...."

name: Filigree Attendant
text:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

name: Chatterstorm
text:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit

name: Gaea's Will
text: With every end, a new beginning.

name: Glimmer Bairn
text: "Tricks and treats, souls and sweets! On wooded path, whom shall we meet?"

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

name: Squirrel Sovereign
text: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

name: Floodhound
text: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.

name: Garth One-Eye
text: A humble appearance belies a master's skill.

name: Goblin Anarchomancer
text: A good Gruul shaman can work a whole clan into a frenzy. A great one will wait until the enemy's nearby.

name: Piru, the Volatile
text: Chasms of dueling energies course within her.

name: Shardless Agent
text: "The left blade for a swift, painless death. The right blade for a long, lingering one. The choice is mine."

name: Terminal Agony
text: His mouth melted to slag, yet somehow he kept screaming.

name: Brainstone
text: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

name: Diamond Lion
text:
"The merchant asked for riches no one had ever dreamed of. The djinn, smiling, granted his wish."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Liquimetal Torque
text:
"Weaponized jewelry has a long and respected history."
—Ervos Trax

name: Monoskelion
text: An unfinished body with unfinished business.

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Sol Talisman
text: It contains the energy of a dying star, caught at the moment of its explosion.

name: Void Mirror
text:
"A mirror does more than reflect reality—it shapes it."
—Niko Aris

name: Fractured Sanity
text: The body grows stronger under stress. The mind does not.

name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
text:
"Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower. There is as much life here as in the rest of Dominaria together."
—Karn

name: Hard Evidence
text: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

name: Lose Focus
text: The spell wavered, caught on the tip of his tongue and at the edge of his awareness.

name: Sanctum Prelate
text: "This area is off-limits to you."

name: Lucid Dreams
text: Never be afraid to look where others can't—or won't.

name: Mental Journey
text: "My wandering mind has always been an asset."

name: Mystic Redaction
text: "I'm sorry, but this information is classified."

name: Parcel Myr
text:
"Crack it open. Maybe it knows something we can use."
—Kara Vrist, Mirran resistance

name: Phantasmal Dreadmaw
text:
"That was perhaps the most terrifying thing I thought I almost saw."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Raving Visionary
text: "Fear not, child. Open your eyes and witness Keranos's truth!"

name: Recalibrate
text:
"Trial 991: Still encountering issues with accidental aetherization. Maybe if we widen the dimensional matrix to 0.7?"
—Izzet research notes

name: Rishadan Dockhand
text: It's not hard to find work in Rishada, so long as you've got a strong back and don't ask too many questions.

name: Blacksmith's Skill
text: Before he was subjugated by demonic forces, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry.

name: Scuttletide
text:
"We're going to need more butter."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Shattered Ego
text:
"You can't even fathom the depths of your own insignificance."
—Geyadrone Dihada

name: Steelfin Whale
text: It feeds on metal filings suspended in the water, sieving flecks of precious ore through magnetic baleen.

name: Step Through
text: Doors open both ways.

name: Suspend
text: Time moves in mysterious ways.

name: Sweep the Skies
text: A gleam of refracted light is often the only warning.

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Vedalken Infiltrator
text: "An expert always keeps their tools close at hand."

name: Archon of Cruelty
text: Malice spreads on wings of tyranny.

name: Bone Shards
text: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, its not hard to improvise an offense.

name: Cabal Initiate
text: "Hear our prayers, oh Shadowed One, and bless us in bloody agony."

name: Discerning Taste
text: "Everyone loves a dash of crushed pixie . . . except the pixie."

name: Echoing Return
text: A single ambition unleashes a legion of horrors.

name: Feast of Sanity
text: The tastiest morsels are found in the mazes of the mind.

name: Flay Essence
text:
"Your argument as to why I should spare you lacked substance. Now, so do you."
—Geyadrone Dihada

name: Gilt-Blade Prowler
text:
"Let's just say my people are in the business of capital acquisition and intellectual property speculation."
—Er-Miral

name: Hell Mongrel
text: It feeds on shadows, fear, and blood.

name: Kitchen Imp
text: "Order up! Ooze aspic and jellied anurid eyes!"

name: Caprichrome
text: It is what it eats.

name: Legion Vanguard
text: It takes guts to be a trailblazer.

name: Loathsome Curator
text: She collects only the choicest of deaths.

name: Magus of the Bridge
text: "The dead know their place."

name: Nested Shambler
text: Home is where the heart was.

name: Persist
text: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

name: Radiant Epicure
text: Taste is not a sensation for the tongue alone.

name: Sinister Starfish
text:
"Throw that one back. I don't like how it's looking at me."
—Netos, Meletian fisherman

name: Breaker of Creation
text: The shackles of reality were stifling. It would unmake all that had bound it.

name: Marionette Apprentice
text: "Ah! Yes! I got its leg to twitch!"

name: Refurbished Familiar
text: When her beloved pet died, the artificer turned to necromancy.

name: Retrofitted Transmogrant
text:
"Repair it again! I need reinforcements by tomorrow."
—Ashnod

name: Ripples of Undeath
text: As the monster lay dying, it stared into the eyes of the human who slew it. Decades later, it has yet to break its gaze.

name: Scurrilous Sentry
text: Queen Marchesa's agents always manage to find the exact evidence they're looking for.

name: Warren Soultrader
text: "The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."

name: Wither and Bloom
text:
"Death itself is nothing to cry about. The real tragedy is letting a death go to waste."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

name: Wurmcoil Larva
text: Even a scrap of Phyrexian machinery can be lethal.

name: Fanged Flames
text: With Dorble's natural immunity to venom, he'd always taken certain comfort in the knowledge that he wouldn't die of snakebite.

name: Flare of Duplication
text: "Decent. But let me show you what mastery looks like."

name: Null Elemental Blast
text:
"Despite my years, I am still but a student of the Multiverse. How arrogant to think yourself its master."
—Ugin, to Nicol Bolas

name: Frogmyr Enforcer
text: Laws of nature on Mirrodin are always malleable.

name: Furnace Hellkite
text: Some mornings it wakes up determined to consume the red sun itself.

name: Galvanic Discharge
text:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

name: Ghostfire Slice
text: Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it won't hurt.

name: Glimpse the Impossible
text: Gisela beheld true divinity, and was humbled.

name: Infernal Captor
text: Possession is nine-tenths of the law. His fist is the other tenth.

name: Mogg Mob
text: There was absolutely nothing suspicious about three moggs carrying barrels of explosives—or so they told everyone who would listen.

name: Phyrexian Ironworks
text:
"We have made a friend today."
—Slobad, Iron Goblin

name: Powerbalance
text: For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.

name: Reiterating Bolt
text: "Eureka! Now to show those fools at the Academy how easily I can replicate *these* results!"

name: Sarpadian Simulacrum
text: Built to be super soldiers, the goblins preferred just being super destructive.

name: Skittering Precursor
text: It pushes ahead, eliminating lookouts and tactically sowing spawn.

name: Skoa, Embermage
text: "I need kindling. You'll do nicely."

name: Thriving Skyclaw
text: As wild as unbound aether, and just as dangerous.

name: Wheel of Potential
text: The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.

name: Colossal Dreadmask
text: No legs to quake, no lungs to bellow, but if you see its teeth, it's still too late.

name: Eldrazi Repurposer
text:
"I almost admire their ability to avoid waste. Almost."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Evolution Witness
text: She remembers every breakthrough, from the gene's mutation to the new life's propagation.

name: Flare of Cultivation
text: "You need to expand your horizons."

name: Fowl Strike
text: With a resounding wallop, the ancient battle between buzzard and druid was finally finished.

name: Gift of the Viper
text: Ohran mages willingly endure the bites of vipers, believing the snakes bestow great power on those who survive their venom.

name: Horrific Assault
text: With shifting forms and no angel to pray to, Innistrad's werewolves were especially susceptible to Emrakul's influence.

name: Warped Tusker
text: Once, foraging for truffles, the very average boar fell asleep beneath the moon . . . .

name: Malevolent Rumble
text: What emerged from Turntimber was even more twisted than the forest itself.

name: Nightshade Dryad
text: "Death is a natural part of life. Without the mulch to feed new sprouts, everything withers."

name: Primal Prayers
text: When Gaea speaks, all of nature falls silent.

name: Signature Slam
text: A lone dinosaur in gorilla territory doesn't stand a chance.

name: Temperamental Oozewagg
text: Its position on the food chain causes great confusion in everyone from hunters to other monsters.

name: Trickster's Elk
text:
"Wait. Is *that* one Dad?"
—Rowan Kenrith, to Will

name: Wumpus Aberration
text: All who behold its twisted form are consumed by a single-minded obsession: destroy it.

name: Abstruse Appropriation
text:
"Kozilek experiences reality on his own terms."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Conduit Goblin
text: Warned against wearing metal in a lightning storm, Smurt took it as a challenge.

name: Aerie Auxiliary
text: The hordechief's ground tactics were unsurpassed. If only he'd thought to watch the skies.

name: Cranial Ram
text: To ensure proper fit, the mandibles can be inserted directly into the ears.

name: Expanding Ooze
text:
"It eats the royal garbage. Of course it's growing!"
—Prince Bolbuss

name: Faithful Watchdog
text: Though its official designation was Third Battalion Patrol Hound 7, the soldiers dubbed their new companion Lord Fancy-Paws.

name: Horrid Shadowspinner
text:
"The daylight's done, the nightmare's spun. It crawls off the loom, and into your room."
—Kithkin children's rhyme

name: Invert Polarity
text:
"Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with... Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg."
—Ral Zarek

name: Izzet Generatorium
text: Hard hats are required. Shock-resistant coveralls aren't, but are highly recommended.

name: Kudo, King Among Bears
text: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

name: Planar Genesis
text: Out of nothing, something was born.

name: Psychic Frog
text: Some frogs poison the body. Some frogs poison the mind.

name: Pyretic Rebirth
text: Death has never kept Darigaaz down for long.

name: Scurry of Gremlins
text: A whiff of aether brings the horde out of hiding.

name: Snapping Voidcraw
text: Once considered a delicacy, turtle soup is no longer served in Nephalia's inns.

name: Sneaky Snacker
text: Though the High Fae gave explicit instructions not to tarry, she stayed in Sweettooth Village for seconds, thirds, and then dessert.

name: Titans' Vanguard
text: With a shriek, it directed the spawn toward the temple where the refugees sheltered.

name: Wight of the Reliquary
text: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

name: Vexing Bauble
text: No one knew who invented it. No one knew its purpose. All anyone knew was they didn't like being anywhere near it.

name: Winter Moon
text:
"The sun and moon have decided to make a competition of our misery."
—Naromin, veteran explorer

name: Bloodstained Mire
text: A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.

name: Flooded Strand
text: Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.

name: Polluted Delta
text: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.

name: Envoy of the Ancestors
text: "No Abzan has ever stood alone."

name: Urza's Cave
text: No matter how deep Urza delved, he couldn't escape his regrets.

name: Windswept Heath
text: An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.

name: Wooded Foothills
text: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.

name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah
text: His pride denied him; his brother did not.

name: Razorgrass Ambush
text: When disturbed, razorgrass skewers unwary intruders in violent, jingling bursts.

name: Witch Enchanter
text: Shilgengar's famine once starved Stensia into embracing vampirism. The Dawnhart Coven would not let the same happen to Kessig.

name: Essence Reliquary
text:
"It safeguards the greatest treasure of all: our memories of those most precious to us."
—Elspeth

name: Hydroelectric Specimen
text: Whenever the research team stepped out, the specimen emerged to conduct experiments of its own.

name: Sink into Stupor
text: The kami help travelers find profound relief, by freeing them from their mortal concerns.

name: Boggart Trawler
text: "Look what I found, and it's only been dead for a week!"

name: Fell the Profane
text:
"I can think of no fate more fitting for one so foul as you."
—Aryel, knight of Windgrace

name: Pinnacle Monk
text: Narset brought the Jeskai djinn ancient wisdom and the promise to challenge the status quo.

name: Sundering Eruption
text:
"Idea: Climbing boots also balanced for running."
—Expedition journal entry, very scorched

name: Bridgeworks Battle
text:
"I thought trolls were supposed to be *under* bridges!"
—Nelvin, Vantress squire

name: Disciple of Freyalise
text: "Freyalise is gone, but her song lives on."

name: Drowner of Truth
text:
"Mangeni's children take their places among us."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Glasswing Grace
text: Serra may be long gone, but Benalia's faithful still draw strength from her blessings.

name: Legion Leadership
text:
"The firemane angels are mighty, but their greatest value lies in the fervor their presence kindles in the heart of a soldier."
—Agrus Kos

name: Revitalizing Repast
text:
"Today, we feast! Tomorrow, we fight! Then, we feast again!"
—Harald, king of Skemfar

name: Rush of Inspiration
text:
"Insight is like a waterfall—near-limitless power, but only if properly harnessed."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Strength of the Harvest
text: The Kelema Veil flows through Setessa, allowing Karametra's faithful followers direct access to her wisdom and power.

name: Stump Stomp
text:
"Don't be a superstitious coward. What's a tree going to do, slowly fall on us?"
—Sebastian the Logger

name: Flare of Fortitude
text: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

name: Suppression Ray
text: The Consulate's aether spotlights have a setting to incapacitate trespassers on contact.

name: Waterlogged Teachings
text: The long-dead librarians are still on hand to recommend selected titles.

name: Recruiter of the Guard
text: "The kingdom is in peril! Who among you is brave enough to defend it?"

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Estrid's Invocation
text: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.

name: Shrieking Drake
text:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

name: Ophiomancer
text:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Meltdown
text: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

name: Branching Evolution
text: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Sylvan Safekeeper
text:
"He has been to the heart of the wood. Did you truly expect to wield power over him?"
—Oakhide druid

name: Wirewood Symbiote
text: It drinks fatigue.

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

name: Emerald Medallion
text: It is a sun-dappled glade in the morning, the aroma of spring's first blossoms, and the melody of birds chirping in a joyful chorus. It is life.

name: Jet Medallion
text: It is the imposing heft of a ruler's scepter, the stench of death after a victory in battle, and the mournful wail of an enemy kneeling in supplication. It is power.

name: Junk Diver
text: Garbage in, treasure out.

name: Pearl Medallion
text: It is a helping hand reaching out to the downtrodden, the acrid-sweet tang of burning incense during prayer, and the harmony of voices uplifted in unison. It is faith.

name: Ruby Medallion
text: It is the warm glow of the setting sun at journey's end, the scent of the evening meal crackling over a fire, and the cacophony of a raucous song shared over tankards of mead. It is freedom.

name: Sapphire Medallion
text: It is the glimpse of a new horizon beyond the hills, the briny taste of salt spray off a ship's hull, and the whisper of pages turning in a new book. It is discovery.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy."
—Urza, to Tawnos

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Drownyard Lurker
text: When Emrakul arrived on Innistrad, even fossils answered her twisted call.

name: Deserted Temple
text: A monument to long-forgotten gods, it stands as a tribute to the fleeting nature of human ways.

name: Nesting Grounds
text: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

name: Phyrexian Tower
text:
"A cursed silhouette to look upon. Even if the halls stand empty, its vile shadows blight the land. I shudder to think of the evils that it held."
—Koth

name: Mandibular Kite
text: The Machine Orthodoxy finds skin impure, and will not sully their creations with impure material.

name: Metastatic Evangel
text: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."

name: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor
text: "For all his crimes, Lord Konda's greatest legacy is his daughter. I will guide her as I can."

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "They laughed because I couldn't walk. Now they tremble as I take flight."

name: Kudo, King Among Bears
text: Ayula's consort is the hearth to her fire, the honey to her sting, and the mirror to her splendor.

name: It That Heralds the End
text:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Null Elemental Blast
text:

—Ugin, to Nicol Bolas

text: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

text: "The kingdom is in peril! Who among you is brave enough to defend it?"

name: Wrath of the Skies
text: Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.

name: Aether Spike
text:
"The shield doesn't block the fire physically. It tells the fire to stop."
—Genku, future shaper

name: Brainsurge
text: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

name: Flare of Denial
text: "I see where you're going with that, and I don't like it."

name: Accursed Marauder
text: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

text: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.

text: The best hiding places are other people.

text: Within its body, three lineages warred for supremacy.

text: Forced to behold such a pitiful demonstration of scholarship, Archmage Jeven could hold his tongue no longer.

text: The rising moon calls mercilessly to the waves, commanding the sea to rise high enough to devour mountains.

text: "Someday, we will walk the Blind Eternities and see the truths that lie beyond the stifling veil of reality."

name: Serum Visionary
text: "Pre-criminal notions detected in the Sixth Precinct. The suspect will confess when arrested in two hours."

name: Shadow of the Second Sun
text: Live fully, then return to the beginning.

name: Strix Serenade
text: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.

name: Tempest Harvester
text: "The Golden City was a trinket compared to the power that lies beneath the waves."

name: Tune the Narrative
text: "The kami whisper of other worlds, brimming with stories untold. It would take a lifetime to learn them. A lifetime well spent."

name: Unfathomable Truths
text:
"Maybe we are all just figments of Kozilek's imagination."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Utter Insignificance
text: "I used to think my life was meaningless. Now I know for certain."

name: Accursed Marauder
text: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

name: Breathe Your Last
text:
"Bodies are so much more cooperative with the soul out of the way."
—Liliana

name: Consuming Corruption
text: While crossing the mire, Lort the Sneaky found the perfect shortcut to the end of his life.

name: Dreadmobile
text: Made tough, with extra corpsepower.

name: Dreamdrinker Vampire
text: The dream she tastes will be your last.

name: It That Heralds the End
text:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Etched Slith
text: The inherently adaptive bodies of the slith made them coveted subjects for *compleation*.

name: Eviscerator's Insight
text: "We're all just the sum of our parts."

name: Fetid Gargantua
text:
When the night comes knocking
—Kessig expression meaning "in dire times"

name: Flare of Malice
text: "Suffer as I have suffered. Lose as I have lost."

name: Kami of Jealous Thirst
text: The bustle of life in Towashi opened up new avenues for less benevolent kami.

name: Leinore, Autumn Sovereign
text: She keeps the festival's revels from faltering, infusing the witches' rituals with hope.

name: Forgotten Creation
text:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Havengul Runebinder
text: "So many corpses, so little time."

name: Hour of Eternity
text: To serve as an eternal is the afterlife granted to the worthy.

name: Rooftop Storm
text:
"Let those idiot priests tremble! A new era in unlife begins here and now. Oglor, raise the lightning vane!"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Cleaver Skaab
text: Furious and unable to separate, the bitter rivals consoled themselves by splitting everything else they saw in half.

name: Dark Salvation
text: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.

name: Death Baron
text: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
text: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Gravespawn Sovereign
text: The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.

name: Liliana's Devotee
text: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Open the Graves
text: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

name: Spark Reaper
text:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

name: Syphon Flesh
