text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Drown in Dreams
text:
"Within our minds are limitless depths. Dive down, but don't forget to surface."
—Teferi

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Zombie Apocalypse
text:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Bestial Menace
text:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

name: Death's Presence
text:
"We traffic in flesh, not souls. Still, it's a shame to let anything go to waste."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Kessig Cagebreakers
text: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Somberwald Sage
text: "You can face any danger when all of nature is on your side."

name: Wild Beastmaster
text: "When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."

name: Diregraf Captain
text: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Gisa and Geralf
text:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

name: Heron's Grace Champion
text: Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Ruthless Deathfang
text:
"Bring forth the dead, their skull-grins and rattle-bones. We will feast upon their wailing ghosts."
—Silumgar, translated from Draconic

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Charcoal Diamond
text: The essence of night to harden the soul.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Sky Diamond
text: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Ravenous Rotbelly
text: The patrol found the graf empty save for a few well-chewed bones.

name: Celebrate the Harvest
text: The Harvesttide dance is one of joyous abandon, a last revel before winter nights.

name: Curse of Clinging Webs
text: Clare realized too late why no one ever took the shortcut through the abandoned mill.

name: Heronblade Elite
text: "When angels fall, humans must rise."

name: Ruinous Intrusion
text: The gourd carving was supposed to take place *after* the feast.

name: Sigardian Zealot
text: "We fight together! In Sigarda's name, ready your weapons!"

name: Avacyn's Memorial
text: They had no marble, so the faithful repaired her likeness with wood, straw, twine, and clay.

name: Curse of Obsession
text: He ripped up board after board until his hands were bloody. Still, he could not find whatever it was he sought.

name: Kyler, Sigardian Emissary
text: "Even when the angels succumbed to madness, Sigarda stood strong. She is hope."

name: Celestial Judgment
text:
"I was going to suggest silver, but a beam of pure angelic fury works even better."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer

name: Curse of Conformity
text: Whether you'll fit in isn't up to you at all.

name: Moorland Rescuer
text: "Hold on tight, little one. I'll get you to safety."

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Ainok Bond-Kin
text: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

name: Angel of Glory's Rise
text: "Justice isn't done until undeath is undone."

name: Bastion Protector
text: "As long as I stand, so will your cause."

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Dearly Departed
text:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Stalwart Pathlighter
text: "Festival's just ahead. You're almost there!"

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Victory's Envoy
text: Her paean is the clash of spears, her prayer a battle cry.

name: Aetherspouts
text:
"Don't worry, there's plenty for everyone."
—Vickon, Eleventh Company battlemage

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Cathar Commando
text: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

name: Ecstatic Awakener
text: "Great Ormendahl, I kneel before you, a fragment of your will, a servant of your tyranny. I beg you, release the strength within me!"

name: Foul Play
text: The evidence was overwhelming. Tovolar's howlpack was getting bolder, smarter, and stronger.

name: Ghoulish Procession
text: It was a family reunion to die for.

name: Heirloom Mirror
text: "Speak my name thrice, and be rewarded."

name: Hobbling Zombie
text:
"I see someone tried to stop you, my pet. How delightful."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
text: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"

name: Cathar's Call
text: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking. The rest redoubled their efforts to carry out her work.

name: Mask of Griselbrand
text: The legacy of evil lives on.

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Morkrut Behemoth
text:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: No Way Out
text: In the maze-like passages of the Erdwal, a wrong turn can be fatal.

name: Novice Occultist
text: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.

name: Olivia's Midnight Ambush
text: "And you were almost finished with that ritual, weren't you, darling? How very rude of me. To make it up to you, I'll send you an invitation to my wedding."

name: Rotten Reunion
text: Aunt and Uncle Greyfeld loved dinner guests.

name: Shady Traveler
text: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

name: Siege Zombie
text: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.

name: Slaughter Specialist
text: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.

name: Stromkirk Bloodthief
text: With House Voldaren ascendant, some members of the Stromkirk line took it upon themselves to "borrow" from the blood tithes.

name: Vampire Interloper
text: The Voldaren have begun demanding blood offerings from the villagers in their territory. Their agents arrive from the sky to collect the ceremonial bowls in eerie silence.

name: Vengeful Strangler
text: As the flames consumed the killer, his eyes remained fixed on the executioner's face, his hands twitching like angry spiders.

name: Abandon the Post
text: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

name: Ardent Elementalist
text: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.

name: Burn the Accursed
text: Nothing remained but a few drifting embers and the smell of smoldering hair.

name: Cathartic Pyre
text: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

name: Curse of Shaken Faith
text: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

name: Falkenrath Perforator
text: "Lady Anje sends her regards. I'll carve the rest of her message into your skin."

name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
text: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

name: Famished Foragers
text: Furious to find the workshop empty, the starving vampires flew into a frenzy.

name: Fangblade Brigand
text: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

name: Clarion Cathars
text: The sound of the trumpet is both warning and comfort: it tells of approaching danger but also reminds the village folk that someone is there to stand against it.

name: Festival Crasher
text: So many candles. So many flammables. So little time.

name: Flame Channeler
text: At the edge of night, on the cusp of winter, the allure of fire grows ever stronger.

name: Harvesttide Infiltrator
text: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.

name: Immolation
text: Nothing is funnier to a devil than setting someone—anyone—on fire.

name: Lambholt Harrier
text:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch

name: Lunar Frenzy
text: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.

name: Moonrager's Slash
text: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

name: Mounted Dreadknight
text: Markov vampires cultivate an image of such decadent elegance that it can be easy to forget they can field a deadly fighting force.

name: Neonate's Rush
text:
"We spend our entire existence pursuing the joy of our first night's feast."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Obsessive Astronomer
text: "Sleep? I can sleep when I'm dead!"

name: Pack's Betrayal
text: Tovolar's howl of command was too much to resist, even for Arlinn's own loyal pack.

name: Play with Fire
text: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

name: Raze the Effigy
text: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.

name: Duelcraft Trainer
text: "It's all in the follow-through."

name: Stolen Vitality
text: "There's nothing like a good meal to really lift the spirit."

name: Tavern Ruffian
text: She dispatched every challenger with a sickening snap of bone.

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Village Watch
text: "You have my word. You'll see no wolf attacks while we're around!"

name: Voldaren Ambusher
text: "Gotcha."

name: Voldaren Stinger
text: A duel to first blood means something very different when a vampire is involved.

name: Bird Admirer
text: She won't rest until she's collected specimens of every bird on Innistrad.

name: Bounding Wolf
text: With their usual prey scared off by werewolves, the wolves of the Ulvenwald adopted inventive new hunting techniques.

name: Brood Weaver
text: Travelers in the Somberwald scan the ground for werewolves and other threats, unaware of what lurks above.

name: Candlelit Cavalry
text: "On this night, the dark will fear us."

name: Clear Shot
text: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

name: Contortionist Troupe
text: "Welcome to the greatest show in Kessig!"

name: Fateful Absence
text: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

name: Dawnhart Rejuvenator
text: "Wherever there is life, there is power for one who knows the old ways."

name: Defend the Celestus
text: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

name: Dryad's Revival
text: "Pleased to meet you, Seven."

name: Eccentric Farmer
text: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."

name: Harvesttide Sentry
text: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.

name: Hound Tamer
text: "You and me, we're not built for captivity."

name: Might of the Old Ways
text: Brimming with power from their disrupted ritual, the Dawnhart witches lashed out at the werewolf intruders.

name: Flare of Faith
text: "I fell to my knees. I called out to Sigarda. And then I saw my tormentors blaze with blessed sunlight."

name: Outland Liberator
text: "Just hold still. I'll help you."

name: Pestilent Wolf
text: Wolves that feast on zombie flesh and survive carry the foul diseases of the dead wherever they roam.

name: Plummet
text:
"A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Shadowbeast Sighting
text:
"Werewolves leave tracks. Vampires leave wrung-out corpses. This is something else."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Snarling Wolf
text:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

name: Timberland Guide
text: Hiring an experienced wilderness guide isn't cheap, but it costs less than a search party. Or a funeral.

name: Tireless Hauler
text: The new hire proved more than enough to replace the three farmhands who disappeared the week before.

name: Tovolar's Huntmaster
text: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

name: Unnatural Growth
text: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

name: Willow Geist
text: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

name: Angelfire Ignition
text: "My angel is the flint, and I am her steel."

name: Gavony Silversmith
text: More than heat and the strength of his arm, it was his faith that gave the blade its unyielding edge.

name: Bladestitched Skaab
text: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

name: Can't Stay Away
text: Death is no impediment to dinner.

name: Croaking Counterpart
text: Frog is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Dawnhart Wardens
text: "The balance of day and night is shattered. We must find the Moonsilver Key."

name: Gavony Trapper
text: The elite cathars of the Parish-Blades train in all manner of techniques designed to delay and frustrate the beasts that hunt the crossways.

name: Faithful Mending
text: "What has been looted can be restored. The church lives on within us."

name: Fleshtaker
text: A soulless husk of endless hunger.

name: Galvanic Iteration
text: Better potent than predictable.

name: Grizzly Ghoul
text: The hunters spent the evening celebrating their kill and the rest of the night running from it.

name: Join the Dance
text: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."

name: Hedgewitch's Mask
text: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.

name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
text: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

name: Kessig Naturalist
text: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."

name: Rite of Harmony
text: Nature bends to the witches' call.

name: Rite of Oblivion
text: Revenge is a circle without end.

name: Sacred Fire
text:
"Do not confuse justice with mercy."
—Odric, Order of Saint Traft

name: Homestead Courage
text: "C'mon, fiend. I'll carve you up like a Harvesttide ham."

name: Sunrise Cavalier
text: "Like us, the morning fights for survival."

name: Crossroads Candleguide
text: Do the candleguides' heads turn to follow you as you pass, or is it merely a trick of the flickering light?

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
text: By the end of the festival, it was the only thing still grinning.

name: Moonsilver Key
text: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

name: Mystic Skull
text: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.

name: Pithing Needle
text: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

name: Silver Bolt
text:
"When a werewolf charges, you'll only have time for one shot. Best make it count."
—Captain Eberheart

name: Stuffed Bear
text: It takes a taxidermist of unusual skill to cleanly stuff and mount a beast without severing its primal, predatory drive.

name: Loyal Gryff
text: Silverstreak had lost her rider, but not her instinct to help humankind.

name: Deserted Beach
text: Drownyard floods and unnatural frost made the once peaceful boardwalk deceptively treacherous.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Haunted Ridge
text: Swirling eddies of ash hide crumbling cliffs, treacherous drops, and the slavering maws of unknown evils.

name: Overgrown Farmland
text: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

name: Rockfall Vale
text: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

name: Shipwreck Marsh
text: The bones of doomed ships jut out from the muck while the bones of their sailors molder below.

name: Lunarch Veteran
text: "Even in our darkest times, Avacyn's light still guides us."

name: Mourning Patrol
text: "It's creepy out here, isn't it, boy? I always feel like someone's watching us."

name: Odric's Outrider
text: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

name: Beloved Beggar
text: Charity is rare on Innistrad, but kindness is always repaid.

name: Ritual Guardian
text: "By ancient magics, by angels' grace, we will survive this night."

name: Ritual of Hope
text: "Tonight, we can be anything."

name: Search Party Captain
text: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

name: Sigardian Savior
text: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."

name: Soul-Guide Gryff
text: It conducts the souls of the righteous to their blessed rest and the spirits of the evil to justice.

name: Sungold Barrage
text: Heida allowed herself a moment of satisfaction as she watched the beast fall, then turned to seek another foe. It would be a long, long night.

name: Triskaidekaphile
text: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Thraben Exorcism
text: Chandra, Teferi, and Arlinn sought clues to the Moonsilver Key's whereabouts while Kaya dispatched the spirits obstructing their path.

name: Play with Fire
text: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

name: Join the Dance
text: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."

name: Bereaved Survivor
text: "With Avacyn gone, I no longer knew who to pray to. Alone, I wept for a sister who would never return."

name: Unruly Mob
text: "We survived the Travails! Killer angels! Horrors from beyond the moon! Now some big werewolves think they can scare us? Let 'em try."

name: Vanquish the Horde
text: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.

name: Baithook Angler
text: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

name: Component Collector
text: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Curse of Surveillance
text: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.

name: Delver of Secrets
text: "If my hypothesis is correct . . ."

name: Devious Cover-Up
text: Widow Weber's new scarecrow seemed to attract more crows than it scared off.

name: Dissipate
text:
"Morning light, morning light,
Chase away the fears of night."
—Gavony children's rhyme

name: Blessed Defiance
text: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"

name: Drownyard Amalgam
text: When human corpses are in short supply, stitchers get creative.

name: Fading Hope
text: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

name: Falcon Abomination
text: The foulest of fowl.

name: Firmament Sage
text: The cause remained unclear, but the fact was undeniable: nights were lengthening faster than in any autumn past.

name: Flip the Switch
text:
"Works every time! Well, every time they don't explode, anyway."
—Barton, stitcher

name: Galedrifter
text:
"If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie."
—Geor, Havengul fisher

name: Geistwave
text: Necro-alchemists gained popular support during the Travails, when geist-fueled weapons helped defend towns against mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

name: Grafted Identity
text: Autonomy is only skin deep.

name: Grafted Identity
text: Autonomy is only skin deep.

name: Larder Zombie
text: The cathars arrived at the abandoned lab to find many of the unfinished projects gnawing on one another.

name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
text: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

name: Borrowed Time
text: Teferi stepped calmly into the fray. Suddenly the sun paused in the sky and the werewolves' snarls froze on their faces.

name: Locked in the Cemetery
text: "Help! I'm not a zombie! Let me out!"

name: Mysterious Tome
text: The villagers pored through the old storybook, hoping that one of the tales within might hold some clue to saving the fading sun.

name: Ominous Roost
text:
"One raven is a bad omen. Two are a curse. I don't know what this is, but it can't be good."
—Verna, priest of Sigarda

name: Organ Hoarder
text: The stitcher died years ago, but her dutiful assistant still keeps the laboratory well stocked.

name: Overwhelmed Archivist
text: "Bah! As if I had time to preserve everything."

name: Patrician Geist
text: He rides in agitated circles, snapping orders at servants who've long since found their peace.

name: Phantom Carriage
text: Passage to the abyss is free, but the return trip will cost you.

name: Revenge of the Drowned
text: A heavy net doesn't always mean a good catch.

name: Secrets of the Key
text: As Sigarda and Sorin battled, Arlinn and Teferi recovered the key from the Markov catacombs.

name: Shipwreck Sifters
text: A loyal crew sticks together, even after death.

name: Skaab Wrangler
text: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

name: Sludge Monster
text: Tracking it isn't the hard part.

name: Stormrider Spirit
text: The weary travelers mistook the flickering lights for a candleguide pointing the way to Harvesttide. Their relief turned to terror as lightning lit the sky.

name: Candlegrove Witch
text: "Like a thousand candles fighting back the darkness, we are strongest when we stand together."

name: Triskaidekaphile
text: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

name: Unblinking Observer
text:
"Day 77: The homunculus within the crystal continues to mimic my every movement. I wonder what they are writing?"
—Laboratory notes of Yzlkpk

name: Vivisection
text: Though their work is widely reviled, stitchers see themselves as being on the cutting edge of science.

name: Arrogant Outlaw
text: The debased remnants of the Falkenrath bloodline prowl the passes near their ruined castles.

name: Baneblade Scoundrel
text: "I was a mere cutpurse until I learned the going rate for fresh corpses."

name: Bat Whisperer
text: "My little winged friends tell me which of these townsfolk are worth tasting for myself."

name: Bladebrand
text: Skirsdag cultists believe that the right poison "purifies" a tainted soul before it makes its way to Ormendahl.

name: Blood Pact
text: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult. They simply turned their worship to the next demon to emerge from the shadows bearing offers of power.

name: Bloodline Culling
text: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."

name: Bloodtithe Collector
text: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

name: Champion of the Perished
text: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

name: Defenestrate
text: The chaplain would perhaps have found some small comfort had he known that the replacement window would be named in his honor.

name: Dreadhound
text: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

name: Duress
text: The Voldaren torture pits are so expansive that prisoners have a nasty tendency to be forgotten for years.

name: Eaten Alive
text:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

name: Afterlife
text: Facets of life, reflections of the soul.

name: Disenchant
text:
"There are harsher ways to learn the meaning of the word 'no.'"
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Tidal Wave
text: When mountains ride the sea, waves live upon the fields.

name: Vaporous Djinn
text:
"What is taking them so long to fill the waterskins?"
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

name: Wave Elemental
text:
"Consider the wave: how weak the mother yet how strong the child."
—Tywanna, Shaper Guildmage

name: Abyssal Hunter
text: Some smiles show cheer; some merely show teeth.

name: Ashen Powder
text:
"What you call decay, I call ripening. You'll gain no sustenance from this harvest."
—Kaervek

name: Barbed-Back Wurm
text:
"The Mwonvuli Jungle has given the darkness teeth for tearing the gift of life from the weak."
—Jolrael

name: Binding Agony
text:
A crash of rhinos in my head
—Femeref expression meaning "a severe head pain"

name: Bone Harvest
text:
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once."
—Kaervek

name: Breathstealer
text:
"As a child, I slept with a cloth over my face, to hide from the spirits that might pull the air from my lungs."
—Mosi, Femeref weaver

name: Divine Offering
text:
"Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Cadaverous Knight
text:
Grieve for the soul in death dishonored.
—Shadow Guild saying

name: Carrion
text: King or herder, the maggots care not.

name: Choking Sands
text:
"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"Femeref was guided by the wisdom of the Council of Voices. But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"The ceremony ended with a voice from the shadows, a voice with vast, ominous power."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

name: Dirtwater Wraith
text:
"The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Dread Specter
text:
Whatever follows life is incurable.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

name: Divine Retribution
text:
"To the undiscerning eye, justice and vengeance can look the same."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Enfeeblement
text:
"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it."
—Kaervek

name: Feral Shadow
text:
"The night stalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."
—Kaervek

name: Fetid Horror
text:
"Of the six who went down the Uuserk Trail to scout ahead, one returned. She clawed at her eyes and nostrils and sobbed with horror. I was curious about what she saw, but we chose another path."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

name: Grave Servitude
text:
"I no longer believe in a final resting place."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Gravebane Zombie
text:
"A zombie's bed must be a lumpy one or he wouldn't leave it so often."
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Harbinger of Night
text:
Embrace the Harbinger
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"

name: Infernal Contract
text:
"But I signed nothing!"
—Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage

name: Ekundu Griffin
text:
"My goat was a small price to pay for the chance to see the hunting griffin dive and seize it."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Kaervek's Hex
text:
"If the curse does not strike you dead, question your soul."
—Kaervek

name: Mire Shade
text:
"We realized the bog had not given up a soul but had come to claim a new one."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

name: Nocturnal Raid
text:
"The finest offering of night is not stealth but daring."
—Tetlok, Breathstealer

name: Painful Memories
text:
"It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory."
—Jolrael

name: Phyrexian Tribute
text:
"In your final breath you still have something to offer Phyrexia."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Ravenous Vampire
text: Eternal life brings eternal hunger.

name: Reign of Terror
text:
"I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

name: Restless Dead
text:
The rich's heirs often thank them after death . . . but preferably not in person.
—Suq'Ata epigram

name: Sewer Rats
text:
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Shadow Guildmage
text:
To keep the dead so others may live.
—Shadow Guild maxim

name: Shallow Grave
text: Good help is hard to dig up.

name: Skulking Ghost
text:
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

name: Soul Rend
text:
"Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life."
—Kaervek

name: Soulshriek
text:
"The flesh is a casket for the soul."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Ethereal Champion
text:
"If I have learned anything as a wizard it is this: never fight your own battles."
—Waffa, sorcerer of Nyomba

name: Wall of Corpses
text:
"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."
—Kaervek

name: Withering Boon
text:
"Life for life: this is the immutable law."
—Panya, Granger Guildmage

name: Armorer Guildmage
text:
Zhalfir's destiny rings in tempered steel.
—Armorer Guild maxim

name: Barreling Attack
text:
"The trollish game of push-fall inspired this impressive tactic."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Blind Fury
text:
"Tell me . . . have you ever sung the Song of Blood?"
—Purraj of Urborg

name: Blistering Barrier
text:
I live without food, stand without leg, wound without force, and am harder to fight than to kill. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Builder's Bane
text: There is only so much a person may be buried with.

name: Burning Palm Efreet
text: Even the lion envies the lark.

name: Burning Shield Askari
text:
"Any day that I ride my horse up to my ankles in the remains of my enemies is a good day."
—Akin, seasoned askari

name: Chaosphere
text:
"I dance the nothing dance, / Feet in the air, knives in the ground."
—Femeref chant

name: Crimson Hellkite
text:
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Dwarven Miner
text:
"Fetch the pestridder, Paka—we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!"
—Jamul, Femeref farmer

name: Femeref Healer
text:
"Faith is my shield, and hope is my armor; I am vulnerable only to myself."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Dwarven Nomad
text:
A dwarf's life belongs as much to the land as to the dwarf.
—Creed of the Stonethrow Clan

name: Ekundu Cyclops
text:
"Big one I, One big eye. One-eye see Two-eye die!"
—Traditional cyclops chant

name: Emberwilde Djinn
text: A hefty price is no guarantee of quality merchandise.

name: Final Fortune
text:
Want all, lose all.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

name: Firebreathing
text:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Flame Elemental
text: Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.

name: Flare
text:
"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Goblin Elite Infantry
text: They talk a good fight.

name: Goblin Scouts
text:
"Pathetic—like I wouldn't know a goblin painted up to look like a dwarf!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Goblin Soothsayer
text:
"I see a great victory and rivers of blood. And . . . hmm, looks like a spleen."
—Grishnak, goblin soothsayer

name: Femeref Knight
text:
"I will return / with lizard skins for your sandals. Paint your eyes black and wait for me."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"Can they *do* that?"
—Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words

name: Incinerate
text:
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'"
—Akin, seasoned askari

name: Kaervek's Torch
text:
The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown

name: Lightning Reflexes
text: "Inhale. Kill. Exhale."

name: Pyric Salamander
text:
When you've been chased by a dragon, you run from every lizard.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Raging Spirit
text:
"Its burning power is more elusive than shade on the Unyaro Plains, more perilous than the horn of a rhino."
—Akin, seasoned askari

name: Reckless Embermage
text: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

name: Femeref Scouts
text:
"The days before the war were filled with strange portents: scouts and herders spoke of villages reduced to ash, of farmers taken from their fields, and of foul beasts roaming the plains in packs. I know, for I spoke to them all."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Reign of Chaos
text:
"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."
—Kaervek

name: Searing Spear Askari
text: When the other soldiers of Zhalfir fall, the askaris will yet stand.

name: Sirocco
text:
"Blow, fiery wind, / strip illusion from the eye. / Blow, fiery wind of truth."
—Femeref chant

name: Spitting Earth
text:
"There are times solid ground gives precious little comfort."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Stone Rain
text:
"What rainbow could possibly come of this rain?"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Subterranean Spirit
text:
"Air hot with sulfur. / Earth heaves beneath me. / Could it be the mountain / ate something bad?"
—Dwarven mining song

name: Talruum Minotaur
text:
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Telim'Tor
text:
"The curious merely amass knowledge. The ambitious use it."
—Telim'Tor

name: Telim'Tor's Edict
text:
"Execution awaits the dissenter."
—Kasib ibn Naji, *Letters*

name: Torrent of Lava
text: The mountain's voice shouts us all down.

name: Alarum
text:
"One timely cry of warning can save nine of surprise."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Healing Salve
text:
"The Femeref look only to the Sun for healing; they have never truly understood life's cycle."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

name: Viashino Warrior
text:
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Wildfire Emissary
text:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

name: Brushwagg
text:
"Defiantly, the young cyclops popped the brushwagg into his mouth. His cheeks suddenly puffed, his eye bulged, and he was forced to agree with his elder."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Canopy Dragon
text:
"In the Mwonvuli you must divide your attention between what hangs overhead and what lies underfoot."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Illumination
text:
"A brilliant light can either illuminate or blind. How will you know which until you open your eyes?"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Crash of Rhinos
text:
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way.
—Femeref adage

name: Cycle of Life
text: Thus does nature assert herself.

name: Early Harvest
text:
"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Fallow Earth
text:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Femeref Archers
text:
"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course: they have no faith to guide their darts."
—Nuru, Femeref archer

name: Fog
text:
"More armies have been lost in the confusion of the jungle mists than to any battle."
—Jolrael

name: Foratog
text: Five hundred years to grow—barely a minute to eat.

name: Giant Mantis
text:
"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

name: Gibbering Hyenas
text:
Hyenas laughing—what's the joke?
—Femeref phrase meaning "that's not funny"

name: Iron Tusk Elephant
Granger Guildmage
text:
Leave no mouth agape, no stomach unfilled.
—Granger Guild maxim

name: Jolrael's Centaur
text:
"What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?"
—Jolrael

name: Jungle Wurm
text: Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

name: Karoo Meerkat
text:
"Be like the meerkat, my daughters: ever vigilant, true to your own, and wary of strangers."
—Nabil Alamat, Suq'Ata merchant

name: Locust Swarm
text: Better a fierce thunderhead than a sky filled with locusts.

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Mtenda Lion
text:
"The lion drank that lake right up! In thanks, he gave Siti the power to speak with lions and make them leave the goats alone."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Nettletooth Djinn
text:
"The few of us who survived were denied entry to our camp for two days—so like the pox were the marks we bore."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

name: Rampant Growth
text:
"I've never *heard* growth before."
—Gowon, Femeref herder

name: Regeneration
text:
"Death is not a debt I am yet willing to pay."
—Purraj of Urborg

name: Sandstorm
text:
Better to fight the sand for a few hours than to sleep beneath it forever.
—Suq'Ata truism

name: Jabari's Influence
text:
"Common soldiers can't understand what a sidar knows: the enemy can be a resource."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Seeds of Innocence
text:
"I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?"
—Jolrael

name: Serene Heart
text:
"If magic is your crutch, cast it aside and learn to walk without it."
—Teferi

name: Stalking Tiger
text: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

name: Tranquil Domain
text:
"An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests. Even during the civil war, the guilds stood together, a testament to the wisdom of Teferi."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Tropical Storm
text:
"After the storm, I found a sea turtle dying on the sands, a blade of grass driven through its shell."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

name: Uktabi Faerie
text:
Victim of the two-toed faerie
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "broken"

name: Unseen Walker
text:
"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands."
—Kamau, "Proper Passage"

name: Unyaro Bee Sting
text:
"Much can be learned from the bees about dying for a cause."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Village Elder
text:
"Enchant me with your tale-telling. Tell about Tree, Grass, River, and Wind. / Tell why Truth must fight with Falsehood, and why Truth will always win."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Waiting in the Weeds
text: The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.

name: Wall of Roots
text: Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.

name: Wild Elephant
text:
"I will tell my father's stories . . . . How the elephants trampled the leopard cub, and its father, though he knew, killed nine goats instead."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Worldly Tutor
text:
"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Asmira, Holy Avenger
text:
"Omens lie in this early harvest's fruit."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Benthic Djinn
text:
"In all my years I've only met one mage who successfully trapped a djinn—and none who tried and failed."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Cadaverous Bloom
text:
"It's filthy work, planting them."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

name: Circle of Despair
text:
"Life is a resource that should belong only to the strong."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Emberwilde Caliph
text: The fire breathes while the air burns.

name: Energy Bolt
text: Life and death are two faces of the same coin.

name: Grim Feast
text: "Hmmm—midnight snack."

name: Harbor Guardian
text:
"Our guardian levies a tax on all traders. Wise travelers pay with a minimum of fuss."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

name: Haunting Apparition
text: Like some foul herdbeast, it grazes on the dead.

name: Hazerider Drake
text:
"The hazerider danced in the thunderstorm and sang to its music."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Jungle Troll
text:
"You eat plants; I eat plants. You eat beasts; I eat you."
—Drulvurg, troll king

name: Melesse Spirit
text: Like a laughing knife, immaculate and sharp, is the Melesse.

name: Leering Gargoyle
text:
"Only a gargoyle would take such delight in a thunderstorm."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

name: Phyrexian Purge
text: Only those who have nothing have nothing to fear.

name: Prismatic Boon
text:
"How ironic that the greatest forge of civilization is battle."
—Mangara

name: Radiant Essence
text:
"Her beauty was the beauty of the Sun at midday, deadly to those who underestimated her strength."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

name: Reflect Damage
text:
From you to me, so me to you.
—Femeref children's taunt

name: Reparations
text: "Sorry I burned down your village. Here's some gold."

name: Rock Basilisk
text: In the eastern reaches of Jamuraa are arrangements of massive stones. No one knows their origins—for certain.

name: Mtenda Griffin
text:
"Unlike Zhalfir, the griffin needs no council to keep harmony among its parts."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

name: Sealed Fate
text: It's good to know more about your enemy's fate than your enemy does.

name: Shauku's Minion
text:
"My minions serve me in the light; I serve no one."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Spatial Binding
text:
Time is the one shackle you can't break.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

name: Unfulfilled Desires
text:
"Like Day from Night, / I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky, / because you cannot change, my dear, and nor can I."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Vitalizing Cascade
text:
"Water is like breathing—necessary for life."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Warping Wurm
text: Even wurms start out small.

name: Windreaper Falcon
text:
Watching the windreaper
—Zhalfirin phrase meaning "daydreaming"

name: Mtenda Herder
text:
"All animals—even humans—can be herded. The trick is to make them think they choose their own destination."
—Mangara

name: Zebra Unicorn
text:
"I'll capture gentle zebras / for your steeds and fill the stable with every kind of unicorn."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Amulet of Unmaking
text:
Trade to trade, not to keep.
—Suq'Ata motto

name: Bone Mask
text:
"The protection offered comes at a price. How numerous are your kin?"
—Purraj of Urborg

name: Chariot of the Sun
text:
"Sun follows Moon until she tires, then carries her until she's strong / and runs ahead of him again."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Crystal Golem
text:
"Once, a wealthy king commissioned an artificial creature to be crafted from the royal treasury, thinking it a clever ploy to have the jewels guard themselves."
—Azeworai, "The Golem's Wish"

name: Cursed Totem
text:
Pass me from soul to soul / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls.
—Totem inscription (translated)

name: Noble Elephant
text:
"Proud am I, / strong am I, / courageous in defending my children / and fierce in punishing what stands in my way."
—"So the Elephant Speaks," Zhalfirin song

name: Elixir of Vitality
text:
"Eternal life or your money back."
—Unnamed Suq'Ata merchant, deceased

name: Ersatz Gnomes
text:
From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

name: Horrible Hordes
text: Few are able to underestimate the hordes.

name: Igneous Golem
text:
"The creature rose from the mountain, its body weeping fire."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Lead Golem
text: Slow and heavy swings the club.

name: Lion's Eye Diamond
text:
Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

name: Null Chamber
text: Discovered by Femeref mages, the Null Chamber is the ultimate testing ground for the uncreative.

name: Misers' Cage
text:
"Let him be imprisoned while his possessions wander free."
—Suq'Ata legal decree

name: Patagia Golem
text: It scattered falcons like a lion hunting among jackals.

name: Paupers' Cage
text: A cage may keep you in, but it does not keep the stones out.

name: Phyrexian Vault
text:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

name: Razor Pendulum
text:
"Amazing thing, gravity. It seems to work every time."
—Telim'Tor

name: Pacifism
text: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

name: Telim'Tor's Darts
text:
"People laughed at my darts—once."
—Telim'Tor

name: Pearl Dragon
text:
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Teferi's Isle
text: The three wizards knew only that this isle held a great mystery—and that patience alone would solve it.

name: Rashida Scalebane
text: It is not by the blood of dragons that Rashida measures victories, but by the sum of children who no longer wake from nightmares of scales and fire.

name: Ritual of Steel
text:
"Our soldiers are blessed with lizard scales as hard and cold as steel."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Sacred Mesa
text:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Shadowbane
text: Light creates shadow; light destroys shadow. Such is the transience of darkness.

name: Sidar Jabari
text:
"Prophecy is whatever one makes of it, but destiny cannot be changed."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Benevolent Unicorn
text:
The best use for a unicorn's horn is to adorn a unicorn.
—Femeref adage

name: Spectral Guardian
text:
"A treasure to guard other treasures is worth the highest price."
—Mtai, Civic Guildmage

name: Sunweb
text:
"There is no sweeter music than the wails of a dying dragon."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Teremko Griffin
text:
"When we're aloft, I love to lean over the *Weatherlight*'s railing and watch the patterns the griffins' shadows make on the clouds below."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Unyaro Griffin
text: The griffin's shadow gives courage to the righteous and dread to the idle.

name: Wall of Resistance
text: Telim'Tor could no longer recall the exact number of assaults—but his troops could.

name: Zhalfirin Commander
text:
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Blinding Light
text:
"My shield will bear a shining sun so you will always be with me. / Inlaid with gold, it will shine like glowing embers."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Zhalfirin Knight
text:
"You returned a warrior. . . . Your hair was cut, your eye tattooed with the red triangle of war."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Zuberi, Golden Feather
text:
"If the griffins tell of their gods, perhaps they speak of feathers bright as the Sun."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Ancestral Memories
text:
"Even the ancient storytellers proclaimed Zhalfir to be dominant over all Jamuraa. Kaervek's invasion shocked us all."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Azimaet Drake
text:
"A vizier's dish, best served drenched in honey and almonds."
—Suq'Ata royal recipe

name: Bay Falcon
text:
"Wear the falcon's feathers in your hair—
be fast as the falcon, bright as the Sun."
—"Rise on Wings," Zhalfirin song

name: Boomerang
text: A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

name: Cerulean Wyvern
text:
"Once, a Quirion asked why I was so cautious when the day was clear. I told him of the sky-blue hide of the cerluean wyvern, and he offered me double if I could conjure a strong tailwind!"
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Cloak of Invisibility
text:
"Useful . . . if you can find it."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Daring Apprentice
text: In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.

name: Dissipate
text:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

name: Dream Cache
text:
Dreams' riches are easily spent.
—Suq'Ata adage

name: Dream Fighter
text: Not only the sleeping should fear dreams.

name: Ether Well
text: "Whoa—my tail will *never* fit through that hole!"

name: Floodgate
text:
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"
—Makht, goblin casualty

name: Harmattan Efreet
text:
"One moment I was walking along the beach, and the next I was high in the air, staring into a hideous smiling face."
—Tarub, Suq'Ata sailor

name: Civic Guildmage
text:
To condemn the innocent you must first condemn yourself.
—Civic Guild maxim

name: Jolt
text:
"There's nothing like a sudden shock to clarify one's thoughts."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Kukemssa Pirates
text:
". . . pirates gambled with a djinn and lost the thing more dear than gold."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Meddle
text:
"Shadimir was as surprised as he was relieved when the blow turned aside."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"The caliph was so intelligent he could not remember what he knew."
—Azeworai, "Three Riddles"

name: Merfolk Raiders
text:
"Turn your back for a second and they just vanish! As if they weren't shifty enough before."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

name: Merfolk Seer
text:
The sea leaves no room for tears.
—Zhalfirin adage

name: Mind Harness
text: Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.

name: Mist Dragon
text:
"Across the plains, farmers who braved the mists began to vanish. Most blamed the goblins; none guessed the truth."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Mystical Tutor
text:
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Political Trickery
text:
"Politics is a game—move a stone here, move a stone there—except sometimes the stones bleed."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Polymorph
text: "Ahh! Opposable digits!"

name: Psychic Transfer
text:
"The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning."
—Kaervek

name: Ray of Command
text: "Heel."

name: Reality Ripple
text:
"Can you prepare for the unexpected? No, you cannot. You can prepare only to be surprised."
—Teferi

name: Sandbar Crocodile
text:
"We've run aground sandbars before, but today, a sandbar ran aground us."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

name: Disempower
text:
"Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"
—Kaervek

name: Shaper Guildmage
text:
Shape this world in Zhalfir's image.
—Shaper Guild maxim

name: Shimmer
text:
To buy unseen land, pay in unseen coin.
—Suq'Ata maxim

name: Soar
text:
"Would you give up your hands to fly? That is what the birds have done."
—*The One Thousand Questions*

name: Suq'Ata Firewalker
text:
"Comfortable even in a furnace? I've never met one who'd accept my wager."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Taniwha
text:
"Taniwha rolls in its sleep, and the land is awash with the waves."
—Poetics of Hanan

name: Teferi's Curse
text:
"Stepping through time is like riding a camel. It may get you where you want to go, but the ride is rarely pleasant."
—Teferi

name: Teferi's Drake
text:
"We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Teferi's Imp
text: Made you look.

name: Thirst
text: The first of the Thousand Deaths.

name: Kaust, Eyes of the Glade
text: If you think you're being watched, you're probably right.

name: Immortal Obligation
text: Death is no reprieve from an Orzhov debt.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Enhanced Surveillance
text:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

name: Erdwal Illuminator
text:
"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

name: Finale of Revelation
text: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

name: Mechanized Production
text:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

name: Nadir Kraken
text: Meeting one is definitely the low point of your life.

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: Sphinx of the Second Sun
text: He watches in silence as the shadows shift, bringing Amonkhet ever nearer to the Hour of Revelation.

name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
text:
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi

name: Thought Monitor
text: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

name: Black Sun's Zenith
text:
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Doom Whisperer
text: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Redemption Arc
text: Crime doesn't pay nearly as well as the Agency.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

name: Rise of the Dark Realms
text:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Sinister Starfish
text:
"Throw that one back. I don't like how it's looking at me."
—Netos, Meletian fisherman

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Whispering Snitch
text: "Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"

name: Brash Taunter
text: "Why don't you come a little closer and say that again, you spineless spit-licker!"

name: Trouble in Pairs
text: Together, they're greater than the sum of their rap sheets.

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Fiendish Duo
text: Half the size, double the mayhem.

name: Frontier Warmonger
text: She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

name: Jeska's Will
text:
"Gather your strength. Prepare yourself."
—Jeska, to Radha

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Graf Mole
text:
"Their keen sense of smell draws them to the unnatural. To find one is a boon."
—Veka, hinterland inspector

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Krosan Colossus
text: When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Wild Growth
text: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

name: Wilderness Reclamation
text:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

name: Copy Catchers
text:
"I honestly don't know if they're sabotaging our records or trying to help me sort."
—Kruno, Agency clerk

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Boros Reckoner
text:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Dimir Spybug
text: Just assume every conversation is on record.

name: Disinformation Campaign
text:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

name: Hydroid Krasis
text: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

name: Notion Rain
text: City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Final-Word Phantom
text: "Just one more thing . . ."

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Follow the Bodies
text:
"The culprit doesn't seem to care about covering their tracks. Let's hope that's a good thing."
—Morska

name: Inspiring Statuary
text: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Scroll of Fate
text:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Tangletrove Kelp
text: Even experienced detectives can be strung along by planted evidence.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Access Tunnel
text: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Hostile Desert
text: Amonkhet's desiccated land thirsts for blood.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Eye of Duskmantle
text: Most thought the Dimir had been wiped out. This suited the Dimir perfectly.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Labyrinth of Skophos
text: For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: River of Tears
text:
"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Sacred Peaks
text: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods
text: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text: Its courtyards are lit during every hour of the day so that night may never fall within its walls.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Boltbender
text: "You should really work on your aim."

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Throne of the High City
text: A shining symbol of Paliano's true ruler—ambition.

name: Tocasia's Dig Site
text: Sent by their noble parents to toughen up and learn something of the world's past, Urza and Mishra instead uncovered Terisiare's future.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Duskana, the Rage Mother
text:
"A pale bear shall herald the rise of the old gods."
—Gruul prophecy

name: Kaust, Eyes of the Glade
text: If you think you're being watched, you're probably right.

name: Immortal Obligation
text: Death is no reprieve from an Orzhov debt.

name: Redemption Arc
text: Crime doesn't pay nearly as well as the Agency.

name: Trouble in Pairs
text: Together, they're greater than the sum of their rap sheets.

name: Mob Verdict
text: The court of public opinion doesn't hear appeals.

name: Copy Catchers
text:
"I honestly don't know if they're sabotaging our records or trying to help me sort."
—Kruno, Agency clerk

name: Final-Word Phantom
text: "Just one more thing . . ."

name: Follow the Bodies
text:
"The culprit doesn't seem to care about covering their tracks. Let's hope that's a good thing."
—Morska

name: Tangletrove Kelp
text: Even experienced detectives can be strung along by planted evidence.

name: Eye of Duskmantle
text: Most thought the Dimir had been wiped out. This suited the Dimir perfectly.

name: Boltbender
text: "You should really work on your aim."

name: Mob Verdict
text: The court of public opinion doesn't hear appeals.

name: Showstopping Surprise
text:
"I prefer gasps and screams to polite applause."
—Judith

name: On the Trail
text: Where the victim's journey ends, the investigator's begins.

name: Showstopping Surprise
text:
"I prefer gasps and screams to polite applause."
—Judith

name: Counterpoint
text: "Nice theory, but I'm going to have to poke some holes in it."

name: Knowledge Is Power
text: "Tremble, criminal, before the overwhelming might of meticulously organized evidence!"

name: Panoptic Projektor
text: It displays every fact, every suspect, and every scrap of evidence for every case the Agency oversees.

name: On the Trail
text: Where the victim's journey ends, the investigator's begins.

name: Counterpoint
text: "Nice theory, but I'm going to have to poke some holes in it."

name: Knowledge Is Power
text: "Tremble, criminal, before the overwhelming might of meticulously organized evidence!"

name: Panoptic Projektor
text: It displays every fact, every suspect, and every scrap of evidence for every case the Agency oversees.

name: Kaust, Eyes of the Glade
text: If you think you're being watched, you're probably right.

name: Duskana, the Rage Mother
text:
"A pale bear shall herald the rise of the old gods."
—Gruul prophecy

name: Bennie Bracks, Zoologist
text: His enthusiastic curiosity puts even the most fearsome of beasts at ease.

name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
text:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Fumigate
text:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

name: Gideon's Sacrifice
text: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

name: Loran of the Third Path
text: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Organic Extinction
text:
"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Search the Premises
text:
"To halt these lurid practices, Geralf must be found and made an example of."
—Inquisitor Delmund

name: Smuggler's Share
text: One way or another, everyone gets paid what they're owed.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Welcoming Vampire
text: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Brainstorm
text: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

name: Confirm Suspicions
text: Everyone has something to hide.

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Curate
text: "Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to... No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."

name: Presumed Dead
text: "Corpses are pulled from the undercity canals every day. They'll assume one's mine."

name: Repeat Offender
text: "Blasted sketch artist did too good a job. Looks like it's time for me to lie low for a little while."

name: Rot Farm Mortipede
text: Every week, the necropsy lab's unclaimed bodies are transferred to the Golgari for "recycling."

name: Slice from the Shadows
text:
"Proft has been poking his nose where it doesn't belong. I want him out of the way."
—Judith, to Massacre Girl

name: Slimy Dualleech
text:
"Isn't it gorgeous? It's my most efficient corpse eliminator! One head bites while the other chews."
—Glogus, Golgari leechbreeder

name: Snarling Gorehound
text:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith

name: Soul Enervation
text: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.

name: Toxin Analysis
text: "Poison this deadly is only used by the Ochran. Either the Golgari are behind this, or someone wants us to think they are."

name: Undercity Eliminator
text: With their guild shunned for opening the doors to Phyrexia, some among the Golgari embraced their status as pariahs and took out their bitterness on all who crossed their paths.

name: Unscrupulous Agent
text: Obtaining evidence through the "proper" channels can take weeks of paperwork. Sometimes justice just can't wait.

name: Defenestrated Phantom
text:
"Never parley near high windows."
—Teysa

name: Vein Ripper
text: "I'm afraid your investigation has reached a dead end."

name: Bolrac-Clan Basher
text: Determining the culprit was not difficult. Getting him to stop committing the crime long enough to be arrested, however, was a massive challenge.

name: Caught Red-Handed
text: "Wait, stop! I've been framed! Extremely convincingly!"

name: The Chase Is On
text: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.

name: Connecting the Dots
text: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"

name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
text: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

name: Cornered Crook
text: Monax knew attacking the detective was a reckless move, but he was at the end of his rope.

name: Crime Novelist
text: "But then he peeled off the mask, revealing a sight that made Groja's blood run cold—Brulu was actually Vogos in disguise!"

name: Demand Answers
text: After the attempt on Aurelia's life, she gave the Agency an ultimatum: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

name: Expedited Inheritance
text: Astronomical wealth hinders peaceful succession.

name: Felonious Rage
text: It's hard to keep the peace if you can't even control your temper.

name: Galvanize
text: "Why doesn't Kylox put an off switch on these things?!"

name: Gearbane Orangutan
text:
"In her defense, thopters are very fun to smash."
—Udol of the Foundway Associates

name: Doorkeeper Thrull
text: Parties at Karlov Manor are strictly invitation only.

name: Goblin Maskmaker
text: "When you can't show your own face, try one of mine!"

name: Harried Dronesmith
text: After the eleventh consecutive thopter failed to return from Gruul territory, she developed a disposable model.

name: Innocent Bystander
text: "Whoops, this isn't my street! Don't mind me! I'll just be on my way while you enjoy your . . . very sharp knives."

name: Lamplight Phoenix
text: The only warning was the faint smell of burning plasma.

name: Offender at Large
text:
"In a city this big, anyone can blend in."
—Imel of the Foundway Associates

name: Person of Interest
text: "Maybe they're following someone else," Alvis thought to himself, despite mounting evidence to the contrary.

name: Pyrotechnic Performer
text: "Let's get this party started."

name: Reckless Detective
text: He's gonna crack this thing wide open.

name: Red Herring
text:
"Thopters are but one option in our suite of autonomous surveillance solutions."
—Kylox

name: Rubblebelt Braggart
text: "I did it! Double—no, triple homicide! In a building I set on fire. Yep, all me."

name: Shock
text: She realized that she could not, in fact, handle the truth.

name: Suspicious Detonation
text:
"Clearly someone wanted us to find this."
—Runubi of the Foundway Associates

name: Torch the Witness
text:
"He was scheduled to meet me tomorrow with something important to share. This was no coincidence."
—Algrom of the Foundway Associates

name: Vengeful Tracker
text: "I won't waste my time hunting down petty thieves while my brother's killer still walks free."

name: Aftermath Analyst
text: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like . . . a lot more?"

name: Essence of Antiquity
text: In a city as old as Ravnica, history takes on a life of its own—even when you least expect it.

name: Audience with Trostani
text: Trostani was as regal and vibrant as ever, but Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off, some discordant note lurking deep within the chorus.

name: Chalk Outline
text:
"In your search for a suspect, never forget that the most important person is the victim."
—Ezrim, Agency chief

name: Culvert Ambusher
text: The bite at the end of the tunnel.

name: Fanatical Strength
text: "What is this? An ambush or a staring contest?" Kaya taunted. As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.

name: Get a Leg Up
text: "Apologies for using you like a stepladder. On the other hand, thank you, you're a wonderful stepladder!"

name: Glint Weaver
text: The spider just loved how the gems twinkled, and the high-class prey they attracted.

name: Hard-Hitting Question
text:
"Keen eyes and an analytical mind are some of a detective's most important tools. As is a mean left hook."
—Senior Inspector Holjo

name: Hide in Plain Sight
text: The trees look beautiful... until they look back.

name: Loxodon Eavesdropper
text: He's all ears.

name: Griffnaut Tracker
text:
"The desperate will tread unexpected paths. Be prepared to follow."
—Tam Sennic, Ezrim's second-in-command

name: Pick Your Poison
text: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.

name: Pompous Gadabout
text: "Stand aside, nobodies."

name: Sample Collector
text: "Whatever broke out of here is *at least* half bear... and I'd say some lizard as well."

name: They Went This Way
text:
