"Running doesn't prove guilt, but innocent people don't typically flee into the North Ridge Forest."
—Alst of the Foundway Associates

name: Topiary Panther
text: The gardens around Karlov Manor are oddly bereft of birdsong.

name: Haazda Vigilante
text: "Call the Boros if you want. While they figure out if they have enough people to send a patrol, I'll be out clobbering the lowlifes who robbed you."

name: Tunnel Tipster
text: "When your perp goes underground, I know where to find 'em."

name: Undergrowth Recon
text:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates

name: Vengeful Creeper
text: Seeking intact evidence in the Rubblebelt is a fool's errand.

name: Agrus Kos, Spirit of Justice
text: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."

name: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole
text: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.

name: Assassin's Trophy
text:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

name: Inside Source
text: "I was never here."

name: Break Out
text: "Hey, kiddo. Your ride's here."

name: Coerced to Kill
text:
"People are being brainwashed into these attacks. We must find the puppet master."
—Alquist Proft

name: Curious Cadaver
text:
"When you said I could learn a lot from a corpse, I have to admit I wasn't expecting it to lecture me on forensic procedure."
—Kellan, to Ezrim

name: Deadly Complication
text: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions... and a dead friend.

name: Detective's Satchel
text: It's a crime lab in a bag.

name: Doppelgang
text:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates

name: Drag the Canal
text: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."

name: Karlov Watchdog
text: Teysa trusts only those for whom money has no meaning.

name: Ill-Timed Explosion
text: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.

name: Insidious Roots
text: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi allowed Trostani to reach every crack and crevice in the city.

name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
text: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."

name: Kraul Whipcracker
text:
"Er, sir, we could try to cite him for mishandling evidence, but I'm not sure he technically has hands."
—Argyle, Agency junior detective

name: Lightning Helix
text: After heavy casualties in the Phyrexian invasion, the Boros mage-priests trained as many rank-and-file soldiers as possible to wield the Legion's legendary battle magic.

name: Meddling Youths
text: "Well, if it isn't mean old Mr. Larchbottom, who's always been so eager to have the only dumpling stall in Oxblood Alley."

name: Make Your Move
text:
"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
—Teysa

name: No More Lies
text:
"Lies fester and flourish in shadow. Our job is to bathe them in light."
—Ezrim, Agency chief

name: Officious Interrogation
text: No guest was permitted to leave before being questioned in an Azorius verity circle.

name: Private Eye
text: "Yep. It's a vase, all right."

name: Rakdos, Patron of Chaos
text: "Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!"

name: Relive the Past
text:
"Many have tried to subjugate Ravnica. All have failed. All will fail."
—Museum of Ravnican History

name: Repulsive Mutation
text:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher

name: Riftburst Hellion
text: Like any Ravnican denizen, it decided to visit Plaza West for lunch.

name: Rune-Brand Juggler
text: Notice: Guests of Hellbender may be exposed to occasional bursts of flame.

name: Makeshift Binding
text: Kaya clung to the cords of the barrier ward with all her might, trapping the thrashing dryad like a fly in a spider's web.

name: Shady Informant
text: Rakdos snitches rarely survive to get stitches.

name: Soul Search
text: Taking a secret to your grave still doesn't make it safe from the Orzhov.

name: Sumala Sentry
text: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.

name: Tin Street Gossip
text: "The lawmages are trying to hush it up, but I'm telling you—the guard didn't fall off that balcony. He was pushed!"

name: Treacherous Greed
text: Loot's easy to divide by one.

name: Trostani, Three Whispers
text: Tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, they guard their secrets from eager ears.

name: Marketwatch Phantom
text: "It's amazing how efficient a detective you can be when you're not slowed down by things like self-preservation or walls."

name: Urgent Necropsy
text:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates

name: Warleader's Call
text: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.

name: Worldsoul's Rage
text: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

name: Museum Nightwatch
text: "You there, halt! The gallery is closed. Wait—what are you doing?"

name: Gravestone Strider
text: The empty graves grew tired of waiting for bodies to fill them and set out to make some.

name: Lumbering Laundry
text: A true crime of fashion.

name: Magnetic Snuffler
text: It recovers precious jewelry, murder weapons, and discarded food tins with equal excitement.

name: Magnifying Glass
text:
"These footprints mean only one thing: the streetcleaner is running late!"
—Argyle, Agency junior detective

name: Sanitation Automaton
text: "I am once again bursting with discarded theories. Disposal imminent."

name: Thinking Cap
text:
"I find that my greatest insights rarely arrive when my ears are cold."
—Senior Inspector Holjo

name: Neighborhood Guardian
text: A rare and beloved exception to the Agency's "no one is above suspicion" rule.

name: Escape Tunnel
text: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.

name: No Witnesses
text: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

name: Not on My Watch
text: "You know, Proft, I've done a lot of questionable things in my life, but helping a pompous detective save lives is a new low, even for me."

name: Assemble the Players
text:
"One of these people is the mastermind. I wonder, do they still believe they won't be caught?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Auspicious Arrival
text:
"The Azorius are too obsessed with facts to see the truth that knits them together. They'll never solve this case unless I step in."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Call a Surprise Witness
text:
"Honestly, the real surprise would be if a powerful member of the Orzhov *didn't* hang around after their demise."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Novice Inspector
text:
"If the perfect evidence appears at your feet, your first task is to rule out misdirection."
—The Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations handbook

name: Makeshift Binding
text:
"With the treacherous Oba separated from her sisters, I'm hopeful that Trostani will, in some form, eventually recover."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Not on My Watch
text:
"It's not so bad working with Etrata. She's taciturn, and she has saved my life twice today."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: On the Job
text:
"The Agency's detectives will eliminate the false leads. I will find the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Deduce
text:
"Of course! It was all so obvious. I should have made the connection days ago."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Reenact the Crime
text:
"As I suspected, Kylox had prepared a secret exit. But the question remains: Did he escape his assailants or was he taken against his will?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Unauthorized Exit
text:
"The Azorius will be annoyed with me for breaking out their star suspect, but what else is new."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: It Doesn't Add Up
text:
"Etrata claims she has no memory of committing the murder. Somehow, I believe she's telling the truth."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Assemble the Players
text:
"All will soon be made clear, but I can give you this: our killer is here with us, in this very room."
—Alquist Proft

name: On the Job
text: For all their differences, Kaya, Kellan, and Agrus Kos agreed on one thing: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.

name: Murder
text:
"The manner of death, the way the body was displayed, the carefully arranged guild emblems . . . someone is trying to send a message."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Slice from the Shadows
text:
"Something about Massacre Girl's brazen attack doesn't make sense. Why would the Cult of Rakdos be involved at all?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: The Chase Is On
text:
"If she's innocent, as she so vehemently claims, why did she run?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Demand Answers
text:
"I suppose, from Aurelia's perspective, she was being generous by giving us one entire day to solve the most complex case in Ravnican history."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Audience with Trostani
text:
"More bizarre metaphors about rot and renewal. Wildly unhelpful."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Perimeter Enforcer
text: He makes sure no one sets foot in a fresh crime scene—not even himself.

name: Fanatical Strength
text:
"Kaya and Kellan were attacked today! This is excellent news. Clearly we are on the trail of the true killer."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Coerced to Kill
text:
"Mind control—anyone could be a threat!"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Deadly Complication
text:
"Etrata was in custody long before Teysa was killed. It's impossible that she could be the culprit."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Officious Interrogation
text:
"Oh gods, here come the verity circles. Do the Azorius ever tire of them?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Warleader's Call
text:
"I fear a war between the guilds is exactly what our killer wants. Who could stand to benefit from such destruction?"
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Worldsoul's Rage
text:
"Oba fought Realmbreaker's corruption alone, hiding her pain even from her sisters. Even after everything she's done, I can't hate her. I pity her."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

name: Seasoned Consultant
text:
"I appreciate working with associates whose greatest loyalty is to the job at hand."
—Skurad of the Foundway Associates

name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
text: CHARISMATIC AND WELL CONNECTED. KNOWS THEIR WORTH AND CHARGES ACCORDINGLY.

name: Doorkeeper Thrull
text: NO HELP. ANSWERED QUESTIONS WITH A MIX OF HISSING AND DROOL.

name: Neighborhood Guardian
text: CURRENTLY DEFINES ITS NEIGHBORHOOD AS ALL OF DISTRICTS EIGHT AND NINE, EXTENDING LATELY INTO PARTS OF THE TENTH.

name: Wojek Investigator
text: A GREAT BOON TO HAVE AN ANGEL ON HAND, BUT HIGHLY SUSPECT SHE REPORTS INFORMATION TO AURELIA BEFORE US.

name: Conspiracy Unraveler
text: INVARIABLY REACHES THE CORRECT CONCLUSION. CANNOT BE RUSHED.

name: Homicide Investigator
text: INVESTIGATIVE SKILLS: IMPECCABLE. PEOPLE SKILLS: LACKING.

name: Vein Ripper
text: IDENTITY UNKNOWN. BODY COUNT UNKNOWN BUT POTENTIALLY IN THE DOZENS.

name: Culvert Ambusher
text: JUST LET THE GOLGARI DEAL WITH IT.

name: Curious Cadaver
text: PATIENT AND SURPRISINGLY CLEVER, THOUGH HE DOES NEED TO BE REMINDED NOT TO EAT THE CORPSES.

name: Wojek Investigator
text: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know..."

name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
text: OWNER AND STAR OF HELLBENDER. A TRENDSETTER IN BOTH FASHION AND VIOLENCE.

name: Kraul Whipcracker
text: DO NOT APPROACH. STAY A SAFE DISTANCE AWAY, AND THEN TAKE FIVE MORE STEPS BACK.

name: Meddling Youths
text: CHAOTIC, BUT SURPRISINGLY FEARLESS. OFTEN SEEN IN THE COMPANY OF A STRANGELY INTELLIGENT HOUND.

name: Rakdos, Patron of Chaos
text: AN ACTUAL SIGNATORY OF THE ORIGINAL GUILDPACT. OVER 10,000 YEARS OLD, BUT DOESN'T LOOK A DAY OVER 2,500.

name: Magnetic Snuffler
text: KYLOX'S MOST ADVANCED DETECTOR YET. DON'T LET IT NEAR YOUR KEYS.

name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
text: CHARISMATIC AND WELL CONNECTED. KNOWS THEIR WORTH AND CHARGES ACCORDINGLY.

name: Conspiracy Unraveler
text: INVARIABLY REACHES THE CORRECT CONCLUSION. CANNOT BE RUSHED.

text: AN ACTUAL SIGNATORY OF THE ORIGINAL GUILDPACT. OVER 10,000 YEARS OLD, BUT DOESN'T LOOK A DAY OVER 2,500.

name: No Witnesses
text: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

name: Steamcore Scholar
text: "Hm. That's weird."

name: Benthic Criminologists
text: Scientists from the Simic Combine are regularly seconded to various detective agencies in hopes that sharing their expertise will improve the guild's tarnished reputation.

name: Outrageous Robbery
text:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata

name: Connecting the Dots
text: "How could I have missed it? The answer was right in front of me all along!"

name: Expedited Inheritance
text: Astronomical wealth hinders peaceful succession.

name: Lamplight Phoenix
text: The only warning was the faint smell of burning plasma.

name: Pyrotechnic Performer
text: "Let's get this party started."

name: Bubble Smuggler
text: By the time they noticed the missing vials, Glovax was three fathoms away.

name: Hide in Plain Sight
text: The trees look beautiful... until they look back.

name: Undergrowth Recon
text:
"I want eyes on the scene of the crime, day and night. I have a feeling our killer won't be able to resist coming back."
—Thare of the Foundway Associates

name: Assassin's Trophy
text:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

name: Doppelgang
text:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates

name: Drag the Canal
text: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."

name: Ill-Timed Explosion
text: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.

name: Relive the Past
text:
"Many have tried to subjugate Ravnica. All have failed. All will fail."
—Museum of Ravnican History

name: Burden of Proof
text: "You must have known all those lies would catch up to you eventually."

name: Treacherous Greed
text: Loot's easy to divide by one.

name: Urgent Necropsy
text:
"The Golgari can read the dead like a newspaper."
—Taboro of the Foundway Associates

name: Wojek Investigator
text: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know..."

name: Vein Ripper
text: IDENTITY UNKNOWN. BODY COUNT UNKNOWN BUT POTENTIALLY IN THE DOZENS.

name: Cold Case Cracker
text: "It's a rare privilege to investigate one's own death."

name: Conspiracy Unraveler
text: "There can be many motives and opportunities, but there is always only one truth."

name: Auspicious Arrival
text: Proft brushed past the guards and introduced himself as "the great Detective Proft" without a hint of irony, then identified the culprit within minutes.

name: Curious Inquiry
text: Each time he replayed the attack in his mind, new details emerged.

name: Deduce
text: Proft lit up like a man who had just been handed a glorious and unexpected gift. "I know who's responsible for this," he said. "And I can prove it."

name: Eliminate the Impossible
text: "Half the city had motive. Time to narrow down who also had the means and opportunity."

name: Furtive Courier
text:
"Glad to see you made it in one piece. Next time, try not looking so obviously nervous."
—Linghu of the Foundway Associates

name: Call a Surprise Witness
text: "Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate? I'm going to be here for a long, long time."

name: Hotshot Investigators
text: They always think they're better than the local investigators. They're usually right.

name: Jaded Analyst
text: "Oh, good, another case with too many victims and not enough clues."

name: Out Cold
text:
"We'll get their statements after they defrost."
—Dvika of the Foundway Associates

name: Projektor Inspector
text: "Bring up the particulars from yesterday's altercation, and enhance."

name: Reasonable Doubt
text: "Merle had the motive, but Blovinac was the one caught with the murder weapon. And who was the seven-foot-tall hooded figure? This case is a mess!"

name: Reenact the Crime
text: At Proft's command, an ethereal model of the ransacked workshop sprang into being, every detail perfectly recreated. He'd missed something—he knew it—but what?

name: Steamcore Scholar
text: "Hm. That's weird."

name: Sudden Setback
text: "Look, buddy, you're not in trouble. I just wanna ask you a questio—"

name: Surveillance Monitor
text: Thopters don't take breaks, and neither does he.

name: Unauthorized Exit
text: Proft had never been a by-the-book investigator, but even he never expected to find himself breaking a notorious assassin out of a maximum-security Azorius holding cell.

name: Agency Coroner
text: "Well, cause of death seems pretty straightforward, but what else can you tell me, friend?"

name: Cerebral Confiscation
text:
"Never rely on secondhand description. Always review the memory yourself."
—Lazav

name: Festerleech
text:
"Four Dead in Zombie Leech Attack, Dozens Nauseated"
—*Tenth District Times* headline

name: Homicide Investigator
text: In her line of work, the dead are often better sources than the living.

name: It Doesn't Add Up
text: Etrata had committed dozens of murders, all of which she recalled in perfect, loving detail. But no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't remember killing Zegana.

name: Leering Onlooker
text: "Ooh, this one does look nasty. Maybe they'll send Proft!"

name: Long Goodbye
text: As the days grew longer, so did the list of missing persons.

name: Macabre Reconstruction
text:
"Eyewitness testimony, coming right up! Just let me finish regenerating their eyes."
—Nelo, Agency coroner

name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
text: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

name: Murder
text: Laughter and conversation trailed off as the revelers gathered around Zegana's body. Three things quickly became clear: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.

name: Outrageous Robbery
text:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Vampire Lacerator
text: The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.

name: Vampire Outcasts
text: Some vampires reject the decadent trappings of their kind. Once they turn feral, no amount of blood will satisfy their hunger.

name: Waking Nightmare
text:
"Once each year, the oni and other evil spirits paraded through villages to disturb mortals' sleep. During the war, this parade became a nightly event."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Banefire
text: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

name: Blades of Velis Vel
text: "The changing kind suffers as we do. We must join as one to quench our tyrants!"

name: Blood Ogre
text:
"Ogres taunt the dragons by moving into their territory, but even the hellkites find them too much trouble to hunt."
—Marza, mountain scout

name: Bloodshot Trainee
text: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

name: Brute Force
text: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

name: Celestial Purge
text:
"They say only the good die young. Obviously, you are one of the exceptions."
—Delrobah, cleric of Ivora Gate

name: Dragonsoul Knight
text: The farther he roamed from Jund and its dragons, the more he felt their essence in himself.

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Goblin Fireslinger
text: A rock between your eyes hurts. A burning rock between your eyes ruins your whole day.

name: Goblin War Paint
text: War paint made from kolya fruit heightens senses and lessens fear. Unfortunately, fear is usually what keeps you alive.

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Gut Shot
text:
"Down here, we have a more pointed version of the scriptures."
—Urabrask's enforcer

name: Inner-Flame Igniter
text: A light an army can follow.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Smash to Smithereens
text: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

name: Smokebraider
text: "Be silent and listen to your inner fire. Only then can you walk the Path of Flame."

name: Soulbright Flamekin
text: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

name: Spikeshot Elder
text: Now that he knows a thousand ways of hurting people, his next shamanic quest is to discover a thousand more.

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Splinter Twin
text: "I know just the person for that job."

name: Court Homunculus
text: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.

name: Stormblood Berserker
text: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

name: Tribal Flames
text:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Viashino Slaughtermaster
text: "I'll fight two at once, and then lick their guts from my blades."

name: Wildfire
text: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a big appetite.

name: Wrap in Flames
text:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Algae Gharial
text: It lurks just under the surface, using the algae-choked tar pits of Jund as both home and hunting blind.

name: All Suns' Dawn
text:
"When the fifth sun rose, Mirrodin saw its first true dawn."
—Inscribed on the skin of Thrun, the last troll

name: Ant Queen
text:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

name: Daybreak Coronet
text:
"Let the deception of the gods yield to the pure light of day."
—Brimaz, king of Oreskos

name: Bestial Menace
text:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Karplusan Strider
text: The strider's long, loping gait is an adaptation that allows it to move quickly in deep snow.

name: Kozilek's Predator
text: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

name: Matca Rioters
text: When outsiders interrupted the matca championship, things got ugly.

name: Mutagenic Growth
text:
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Nest Invader
text: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Overwhelm
text: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"

name: Overwhelming Stampede
text:
"I trust the instincts of any beast over the advice of any human who presumes to be an expert in the art of war."
—Rinshel, elf insurgent

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

name: Scatter the Seeds
text: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Scion of the Wild
text: It has a hundred thousand extinctions to avenge.

name: Scute Mob
text:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Simic Initiate
text: Simic initiates begin their training as experimental subjects. Failures are flushed to the undersewers.

name: Sundering Vitae
text: Centuries of wind, rain, and roots compressed into an instant of destruction: such is the power of Selesnya.

name: Sylvan Bounty
text: Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Thrive
text: The most successful of Simic creations is cytoplasm, a living, symbiotic substance that feeds off genetic rhythms and strengthens its host in return.

name: Tukatongue Thallid
text: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Boros Swiftblade
text: When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.

name: Drooling Groodion
text:
"The Golgari expand, yes, but I refuse to call their tainted creations 'growth.'"
—Veszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Ethercaste Knight
text: "We coat ourselves in steel every day. What is etherium but the next logical step?"

name: Horde of Notions
text: Even the oldest treefolk was but an acorn when Lorwyn's first mysteries were born.

name: Lorescale Coatl
text:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

name: Mystic Snake
text: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

name: Necrogenesis
text:
"Those may be the squirms of one life ending or of another beginning. Either way, I'd leave it alone."
—Rakka Mar

name: Pillory of the Sleepless
text: Which is worse—the sleep which never ends or that which never comes?

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Sigil Blessing
text: "For unwavering commitment and unflinching strength, the Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil. Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty."

name: Wrecking Ball
text: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

name: Indomitable Archangel
text:
"Every sword drawn to defend is an angelic blade, guided to justice by an angelic hand."
—Auriok proverb

name: Ashenmoor Gouger
text: After his hands had crumbled away, leaving only wickedly sharp points, he decided his only purpose was war.

name: Fulminator Mage
text:
"Unsafe Terrain Ahead—Turn Back"
—Sign near the former location of Pyrtagh Cairn

name: Hearthfire Hobgoblin
text: Hobgoblins are best left alone. They sharpen their farm implements far more than is necessary for their work in the fields.

name: Nobilis of War
text:
"A great siege is a banquet to him; a long and terrible battle, the most exquisite delicacy."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Swans of Bryn Argoll
text: Any being that harms them quickly learns its lesson.

name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
text: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

name: Alloy Myr
text: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.

name: Blinding Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for inscribing our souls with subservience, to reinforce the sacred order."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Copper Carapace
text:
"We will fight as they do: our flesh protected behind metal."
—Tae Aquil, Viridian weaponsmith

name: Culling Dais
text:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Darksteel Axe
text: Heavier than it looks, tricky to wield, guaranteed to last.

name: Etched Champion
text: Its predecessors were etched with the wisdom of ancients; its own etchings bear warnings of a future fraught with war.

name: Kami of Ancient Law
text:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

name: Etched Monstrosity
text: Now etched only with the scars of phyresis.

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Frogmite
text: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

name: Gust-Skimmer
text: Phyrexian smog clouds choked the skies, threatening creatures who couldn't comprehend the menace below.

name: Kitesail
text: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

name: Lodestone Golem
text:
"Somehow it warps the Æther. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Kor Duelist
text: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

name: Lodestone Myr
text: When necessary, myr can override and control any artificial object, as can their creator.

name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
text: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

name: Mox Opal
text: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Rusted Relic
text:
"We consider rust a curable disease."
—Tarrin, Hammer-Tribe shaman

name: Skyreach Manta
text: As the dawns break, the manta soars.

name: Spellskite
text:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Tumble Magnet
text: Magnetic devices that keep massive golems and structures standing can also be used for the opposite purpose.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Eye of Ugin
text: An eye closes. A race awakens.

name: Mirran Crusader
text: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Myrsmith
text: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Raise the Alarm
text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
text:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Sunspear Shikari
text: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

name: Terashi's Grasp
text:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Air Servant
text:
"Wind is forceful, yet ephemeral. It can knock a dragon out of the sky, yet pass through the smallest crack unhindered."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Argent Sphinx
text: A great mirage, a dream of wings and silver.

name: Cloud Elemental
text:
"The sky teems with just as much life as the forest or the deep seas."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Hurkyl's Recall
text: Hurkyl's research at the College of Lat-Nam wasn't enough to stop the two brothers, but for centuries thereafter her spellcraft taught artificers restraint.

name: Inexorable Tide
text:
"See how gratefully this world accepts our blessings."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Narcolepsy
text:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Qumulox
text: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

name: Remand
text: For the Azorius, the law can be a physical shield against chaos and anarchy.

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Somber Hoverguard
text: The vedalken interrogate all intruders—once the hoverguards are done with them.

name: Steady Progress
text: "More of that strange oil . . . It's probably nothing."

name: Stoic Rebuttal
text: Obsessed with the pursuit of knowledge above all else, vedalken can appear to be cold and emotionless.

name: Telling Time
text: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Vapor Snag
text:
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Water Servant
text:
"This creature has innate perceptiveness. It knows when to rise and when to vanish into the tides."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Wings of Velis Vel
text: Changeling magic grants unusual wishes.

name: Bitterblossom
text: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

name: Bone Splinters
text: Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy. For now, they must harvest vis from the living to fuel their dark magics.

name: Daggerclaw Imp
text: The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Death Denied
text: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

name: Deathmark
text: There are few ways to escape the deathmark: bargaining with a demon, washing in the fabled waters of youth, and of course, death.

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Dread Drone
text: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

name: Duskhunter Bat
text: The swamps go silent at its approach, but it still hears the heartbeat of the prey within.

name: Ghostly Changeling
text: In desolate places, changelings may take the shape of fancies, or memories, or fears.

name: Grim Affliction
text: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

name: Instill Infection
text:
"The results of our ninth inoculation were the same. The specimen was, of course, euthanized before the contagion could spread."
—Vedalken research notes

name: Midnight Banshee
text: Many have heard the beginning of its low, sustained shriek but few the end.

name: Nameless Inversion
text: Just as a changeling's influence can have dramatic effects, so too can its sudden withdrawal.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Arrest
text: Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text: Though you may see the same bones, you'll never see the same skeleton twice.

name: Scavenger Drake
text: Dragons consider drakes to be mockeries of their perfection, destroying them on sight.

name: Shrivel
text:
"Have you ever killed insects nibbling at your crops? I think that's what the Eldrazi believe they're doing to us."
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

name: Sickle Ripper
text: His sickle was forged in the heat of another cinder's funeral pyre.

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Spread the Sickness
text: Life is ephemeral. Phyrexia is eternal.

name: Attended Knight
text: The virtues of knighthood are best taught in the field.

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Magma Jet
text: Some Akroans make the dangerous pilgrimage to the volcanic temples of Purphoros, where oracles known as flamespeakers glean omens from lava.

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Molten Rain
text: It came as a cruel answer to the farmers' prayers.

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Pyroclasm
text:
"Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Rubblebelt Maaka
text:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Kor Skyfisher
text: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

name: Scorched Rusalka
text: Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.

name: Skirsdag Cultist
text: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

name: Traitorous Instinct
text: The horror lurched about like a puppet from a madman's nightmare, squeezing the life from its own kind.

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Death-Hood Cobra
text:
"Size alone does not guarantee survival."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Druid's Deliverance
text: "So many oppose us, but we are the reed that bends without breaking."

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Gaea's Anthem
text:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Hungry Spriggan
text: If a spriggan's eyes are larger than its stomach, it has ways to remedy the situation.

name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
text: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.

name: Might of Old Krosa
text:
"Krosa the great. Krosa the enduring. Look to the forest, and it will share its bounty."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Revive
text: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Seal of Primordium
text:
"I am the simplifier, the root that drags all artifice to earth."
—Seal inscription

name: Slaughterhorn
text: The Orzhov clergy would never cross its path, but sending thrull couriers to do so is cheap and entertaining.

name: Slime Molding
text:
"Give me enough refuse and mana and I will summon an ooze that can engulf all of Ravnica."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Strength in Numbers
text:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Lone Missionary
text: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Ulvenwald Tracker
text: "Peace will come to Innistrad, but only after all abominations have been dealt with, one by one."

name: Vital Splicer
text:
"For every one that falls, ten shall rise. The revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Advent of the Wurm
text: The consciousness of Mat'Selesnya does not always spread in peaceful ways.

name: Agent of Masks
text: "Two-faced" is an understatement.

name: Master Splicer
text: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Bronzebeak Moa
text: They fight for their home with more loyalty than any conscript.

name: Broodmate Dragon
text: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter—and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Carnage Gladiator
text: Not the foulest or bloodiest act at Rix Maadi by a stretch.

name: Centaur Healer
text: Instructors at the Kasarna training grounds are capable healers in case their students fail to grasp the subtleties of combat.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Deputy of Acquittals
text: "Everyone deserves a day in court."

name: Dinrova Horror
text:
"Welcome to the Dimir Public Offices. Not responsible for death or loss of property. Basement off-limits."
—Sign outside Dinrova Building

name: Evil Twin
text: You can always tell the evil one by the dagger he's sticking in you.

name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
text: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

name: Fiery Justice
text: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate, they tried a more internal approach to depose the pretender king.

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Golgari Germination
text: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

name: Golgari Rotwurm
text: Like corpse-worms through a carapace, rotwurms slide through the hollowed bones of the undercity.

name: Ground Assault
text:
"Taking down a dragon is easy. All you need is enough space to get in a good swing."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Gruul War Chant
text:
"We are the heart of the wild, the fire in its eyes, and the howl in its throat. Come, join the battle to which you were born."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Moroii
text:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

name: Mystic Genesis
text:
"The Simic can grow anything out of a puddle of sludge. I just hope they never join forces with the Golgari."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
text: He has no patience for minds that do not inspire him or explode by trying.

name: Pilfered Plans
text: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the chances of the other guilds.

name: Putrefy
text:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Pitfall Trap
text: Each spike is poisoned—the trapmaker's idea of mercy.

name: Rhox War Monk
text: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

name: Simic Sky Swallower
text:
"We've bred out the shortcomings of the species' natural form and replaced them with assets of our own design."
—Momir Vig

name: Sin Collector
text: "That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

name: Soul Manipulation
text:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Spike Jester
text: For the Rakdos, "suicidal charge" and "good showmanship" are one and the same.

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Ranger of Eos
text: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

name: Stoic Angel
text: Even the most battle-hardened soldiers pause in her presence for a moment of introspection.

name: Talon Trooper
text: "The volcanic winds make a maze of the skies of Jund. If we mean to invade, we must first learn their invisible paths."

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Thundersong Trumpeter
text:
"Hear that? Those notes mean we've arrived at Sunhome! Let our allies' hearts soar and our enemies' hearts shatter at the sound!"
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Tower Gargoyle
text:
"Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance."
—Tezzeret

name: Unflinching Courage
text: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Vanish into Memory
text: Out of sight, into mind.

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Boros Reckoner
text:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Gift of Orzhova
text:
"Remember by whose gift you ascend."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Sundering Growth
text:
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade."
—Trostani

name: Tattermunge Witch
text: The Tattermunge gang has no words for the spell that whips their instinctual rage into a frenzy. They only know they like it.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Damping Matrix
text: The priests tried cursing it. The mages tried dispelling it. In the end, they all obeyed it.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Grafdigger's Cage
text:
"If you wind up in one of mine, you can be sure as silver it will be your last."
—Grafdigger Wulmer

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Sensor Splicer
text: With clarity of vision comes clarity of function.

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: The scarred rubble around the gate is testament to past meetings of the Clans, summits that inevitably devolved into brawls.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Beyond lies the culmination of all Izzet projects, a grand experiment led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet himself.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Maze-runners who pass through the Rakdos gate leave behind their scruples and a significant amount of skin.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: The Selesnya welcome all to help them heal the city's wounds. The price, however, is devotion to the guild and a selfless belief in Trostani.

name: Shimmering Grotto
text: Untold riches await those who forsake the bustling world to search the secret, silent places.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Simic biomancers don't concern themselves with guarding a gate. Their ever-present creations are enough to ward off trespassers.

name: Stony Silence
text: The relic's purpose? Its design? Whatever the intent, it is now a mere curiosity that breaks up the horizon.

name: Urbis Protector
text:
"Guilds be damned. We can fend for ourselves."
—Vennick of the Gateless

name: Wake the Reflections
text:
"You see a bird, an oak, a packbeast. I see the potential for an army."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Blade Splicer
text: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

name: Azure Mage
text:
"We draw our power from the infinite ocean of the mind, where all manner of things can be conceived."
—Azure creed

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Crippling Chill
text: One breath of the geist turns veins to rivers of ice and freezes hearts midbeat.

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Familiar's Ruse
text: Because of their capricious nature, faeries can serve as living lenses for disruptive magic.

name: Ghostly Flicker
text: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

name: Kraken Hatchling
text: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

name: Mist Raven
text:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Rewind
text: "The best denials are simply that: a beginning and end unchanged, a dream with no memory."

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Serum Visions
text: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

name: Eyes in the Skies
text:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

name: Spell Pierce
text:
"There's a hole in your plan."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Spire Monitor
text: Each monitor is given an eye for each spire it is to guard.

name: Temporal Mastery
text: Time is a marvelous plaything.

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Wing Splicer
text: "Progress is our great inheritance, perfection our ultimate destination."

name: Abyssal Specter
text: It rides to a chorus of whispers that are more felt than heard.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Bone Splinters
text: Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy. For now, they must harvest vis from the living to fuel their dark magics.

name: Cower in Fear
text:
"You will fully understand fear when you discover it is the final thing you put your faith in."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Death's Shadow
text: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.

name: Delirium Skeins
text: There came a rush, a sudden fire in the mind. Then the two saw only the sooty fog of madness, heard only the crackling of their last thoughts burning away.

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
text: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Gnawing Zombie
text: On still nights you can hear its rotted teeth grinding tirelessly on scavenged bones.

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

name: Mind Shatter
text: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

name: Mortician Beetle
text: To the soldier, war is famine; to the scavenger, a feast.

name: Night Terrors
text: Innistrad is a place where dreams invade the mind and mere shadows exact a terrible toll.

name: Graceful Reprieve
text: "In my moment of death, I had a vision of the world, dark and unwelcoming. I wanted to hide in the deepest meander, but the light pulled me back."

name: Ogre Jailbreaker
text: It took three years for it to occur to him to use the chain as a weapon, but once it did, he made up for lost time.

name: Pit Keeper
text: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

name: Recover
text: "Wisdom from the past is best gathered directly from the source."

name: Seal of Doom
text:
"A basilisk's gaze is effective, but disposing of physical remains is a tiresome task. It's far more discreet to dissolve one's victim entirely."
—Szadek

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Vampire Aristocrat
text: "I admit, I am a creature of the city. The sights, the nightly excitement, the abundance of fine drink . . ."

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Chandra's Outrage
text: Chandra never believed in using her "inside voice."

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Dynacharge
text: Nothing evens the odds like a little lightning.

name: Goblin Assault
text: A goblin raid is a delicate gambit—a blend of stealth, precision, and screaming death.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Hellrider
text:
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Madcap Skills
text: The larger the crowd, the harder it is for them to run away.

name: Adarkar Valkyrie
text: She doesn't escort the dead to the afterlife, but instead raises them to fight and die again.

name: Syphon Life
text: Leeches never tire of feeding.

name: Warren Pilferers
text: "What do they need all this stuff for? They're dead. We're alive. Simple enough."

name: Warren Weirding
text:
"And that's when it was discovered that boggarts have just half a brain."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

name: Blind-Spot Giant
text: Among the solitude-loving giantkind, teamwork is unusual. But he appreciates hearing the occasional "Swing down and to your left."

name: Blood Moon
text: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

name: Brute Force
text: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

name: Crush Underfoot
text:
Five-toed grave
—Kithkin phrase meaning "a giant's footprint"

name: Court Homunculus
text: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
"They'd pour out of the warrens to make war (and to make room for the littering matrons)."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Grinning Ignus
text:
"Take care what you offer the ignus. Food, perhaps. Coins. But nothing flammable!"
—Stovic, village eccentric

name: Dispeller's Capsule
text:
"I find its symmetry pleasing. It rids our world of offensive refuse while disposing of itself."
—Dolomarus, Proctor of the Clean

name: Lava Spike
text: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

name: Rift Elemental
text:
"It's difficult to heal a rift after it begins wandering about on its own."
—Teferi

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: From trinket to trauma.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

name: Stinkdrinker Daredevil
text: Boggarts constantly strive to outdo each other with the things they bring back to the warren, each hoping the exploit will become as well-known as those of Auntie Grub.

name: Sudden Shock
text: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

name: Tar Pitcher
text:
"Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms. At the same time, her warren decided to share with her a sensory greeting of hot tar . . . ."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Thundercloud Shaman
text: He cares not for the disasters his storm brings as long as his path ahead is clear.

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Tribal Flames
text:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: War-Spike Changeling
text:
"Aren't there boggarts enough in Lorwyn? Couldn't it turn into a sheep? Or a sunflower?"
—Olly of Goldmeadow

name: Ethersworn Canonist
text: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

name: Citanul Woodreaders
text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

name: Echoing Courage
text: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Greater Mossdog
text: Man's best fungus.

name: Hana Kami
text: It grew in lands lit by pride and watered by tears.

name: Imperiosaur
text:
"An ancient, powerful force has overtaken the valley. I sympathize for its former inhabitants, but I rejoice for the land itself."
—Olanti, Muraganda druid

name: Incremental Growth
text:
"Tie a mouse under a bridge, and your cabbages will triple in size."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Feudkiller's Verdict
text:
"There are all kinds of strengths, but if you have strength of soul, the others will follow."
—Galanda Feudkiller

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Reach of Branches
text: Growth has no limits.

name: Riftsweeper
text: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Sylvan Bounty
text: Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Tromp the Domains
text: Ground into the footprints of the ravaging herd were clumps of salt from Benalia, moss from Llanowar, dust from Hurloon, and ash from as far as Urborg.

name: Electrolyze
text: The Izzet learn something from every lesson they teach.

name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
text: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

name: Knight of the Reliquary
text:
"Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend."
—Elspeth

name: Lightning Helix
text:
"Rage is not the answer. Rage followed by fitting vengeance is the answer."
—Ajani

name: Hillcomber Giant
text: The giants believe the fossils they find in Lorwyn's rocky heights are dreams frozen in time, and they treasure them.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Mind Funeral
text:
"The soul is only as eternal as I say it is."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Demigod of Revenge
text:
"His laugh, a bellowing, deathly din, slices through the heavens, making them bleed."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Divinity of Pride
text:
"She spoke of mystery and portent, of such unfathomable things that my mind screamed for pity."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Kitchen Finks
text: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

name: Manamorphose
text:
"Master the chaotic forces of nature, and you shall master magic."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Plumeveil
text:
"It was vast, a great sheet of soaring wings, and equally silent. It caught us unawares and blocked our view of the kithkin stronghold."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Amrou Scout
text: The people of Amrou were scattered by war and driven into hiding. Scouts maintain the beacon fires that signal "return" and "home."

name: Kataki, War's Wage
text:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

name: Arcbound Worker
text: The parts are as strong as the whole.

name: Bonesplitter
text:
"It puts an end to what ails you."
—Jeorg, Valla battlemaster

name: Frogmite
text: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Kithkin Greatheart
text: Sometimes a curious giant singles out a "little one" to follow for a few days, never realizing the effect it will have on the little one's life.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Paradise Mantle
text:
"It contains the wisdom of generations of our people. We permit only a chosen few to don the raiment."
—Imran, Viridian elder

name: Pyrite Spellbomb
text:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Runed Stalactite
text: When a changeling adopts a form no other changeling has taken, a rune appears in the caverns of Velis Vel to mark the event.

name: Skyreach Manta
text: As the dawns break, the manta soars.

name: Academy Ruins
text: Its secrets once wrought the greatest artifice ever known. Now crabs loot the rubble to decorate their shells.

name: City of Brass
text:
"There is much to learn here, but few can endure the ringing of the spires."
—Nulakam the Archivist

name: Glimmervoid
text: An empty canvas holds infinite possibilities.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Saltfield Recluse
text: He remembers a past of light and healing. But he lives the bitter present—parching salt, scouring wind, and the withering heat of the desert.

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Sandsower
text: It drifts through the streets as a breeze of collective sighs, wilting the bustle with dreams and heavy eyelids.

name: Amrou Seekers
text: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

name: Stonehewer Giant
text: "No matter how strong, an unarmed fighter is no more than a fool."

name: Terashi's Grasp
text:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Test of Faith
text: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

name: Veteran Armorer
text: "Give me a sword and I'll kill a few enemies. But give me a hammer and a fiery forge, and I'll turn the tide of battle."

name: Careful Consideration
text:
"Sages who take the time to verify their sources are rewarded for their diligence."
—Jhoira, to Teferi

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Esperzoa
text: The more metal it digests, the more its jelly will fetch on the alchemists' market.

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
text: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

name: Auriok Salvagers
text: "Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps. Scraps are enough."

name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
text: He loved his cities in the clouds. When he traveled to the lands below, he brought many reminders of his home.

name: Mothdust Changeling
text:
"Ever seen a changeling fly into a lantern?"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Narcomoeba
text: It was created by the Iquati as a living memory—one that objects to being forgotten.

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Perilous Research
text: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned that no amount of death could deter the stream of thieves and desperate scholars.

name: Pestermite
text: The fae know when they're not wanted. That's precisely why they show up.

name: Avian Changeling
text: Today it flies with the flock. Tomorrow it may wake to find them gone, its body in an unfamiliar form.

name: Reach Through Mists
text:
"Know one part of the name, obsession begins. Know two parts, paranoia sets in. Know three parts, madness descends. Know all, and only the kami know what will become of you."
—Lady Azami

name: Spell Snare
text: Every culture has its unlucky numbers. In a city where you're either alone, in a crowd, or being stabbed in the back, two is the worst number of all.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

name: Vedalken Dismisser
text:
"I crept up on him, quiet as a guttermouse. And then suddenly I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market."
—Sirislav, Dimir spy

name: Blightspeaker
text: One croaked sermon spreads propaganda and plague.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Death Cloud
text: The swarm's million wings stir the foulest of breezes.

name: Death Denied
text: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

name: Bound in Silence
text: A fight put off forever is already won.

name: Drag Down
text: The barbarians of Jund believe the bottomless tar pits extend forever into other, darker worlds.

name: Dreamspoiler Witches
text: At night, the faeries steal dreamstuff for their queen. At daybreak, countless creatures wake weak and hollow.

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Facevaulter
text: Boggarts get so excited when they find something new to smash that they really don't notice who gets underfoot.

name: Faerie Macabre
text: The line between dream and death is gauzy and fragile. She leads those too near it from one side to the other.

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
text: The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.

name: Cenn's Enlistment
text: The more the scarier.

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Peppersmoke
text: Like being trapped in a perpetual sneeze, faerie-dust poisoning is both exhilarating and agonizing.

name: Rathi Trapper
text: Tangling vines, fetid murk, paralyzing poisons, and crawling dead. The swamp is nature's trap waiting to be exploited by unnatural minds.

name: Raven's Crime
text: It plucks away memories like choice bits of carrion.

name: Slaughter Pact
text: Death is only the beginning of the end.

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Saprazzan Outrigger
text: The Saprazzans excel at both tactics: hit *and* run.

name: Saprazzan Raider
text: Some quick dagger work and then back to the sea—that's the Saprazzan way.

name: Shoving Match
text: Rishadan barkeeps know something the Mercadians have yet to learn: if you keep pushing, someone will eventually push back.

name: Soothsaying
text: The vizier's wisdom proved invaluable in untangling the Mercadian knot of lies.

name: Squeeze
text: Any pirate would prefer Rishada's swift and cruel justice to Saprazzo's patient punishments.

name: Statecraft
text:
"Inside these walls, peace; outside, sharks. You choose."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Tidal Bore
text: The dry riverbed became a raging torrent, and the Cho-Arrim claimed their prize.

name: Cho-Manno, Revolutionary
text:
"Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth. Our day has come at last."
—Cho-Manno

name: Tidal Kraken
text: To merfolk, pirates are a nuisance. To pirates, merfolk are a threat. To the kraken, they're both appetizers.

name: Timid Drake
text: It flees from anything that isn't shaped like a cloud.

name: Trade Routes
text: Like the price of goods, the value of the routes was renegotiated daily.

name: War Tax
text: The worst thing about being a depraved pirate is having to work with a bunch of depraved pirates.

name: Waterfront Bouncer
text: Closing time comes earlier to some than to others.

name: Alley Grifters
text: One distracts the victim, the other extracts the valuables.

name: Bog Smugglers
text: They slide over the bog like oil across glass.

name: Bog Witch
text: The world is the body. The mana is the blood. The witch is the surgeon.

name: Cackling Witch
text: The touch of his madness can drive anyone into a killing frenzy.

name: Cateran Brute
text: The Cateran guild prefers to call them "public relations."

name: Cateran Kidnappers
text: Recruits aren't always volunteers.

name: Cateran Summons
text: Even when recruitment is slow, the guild can always cook something up.

name: Corrupt Official
text: His favor comes at a high price.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Eye of twilight, give us sight.
Take our offer, give us might.
Make our power tears of night."

name: Common Cause
text: Mercadia City's troops are at their best when they have no enemy to fight.

name: Deepwood Ghoul
text: They feed on the living to stay undead.

name: Delraich
text: It wears the souls of its victims like jewels on a chain.

name: Extortion
text: The enforcers make no effort to distinguish gold from flesh.

name: Forced March
text: The Caterans call it a screening process. The dead are in no condition to argue.

name: Ghoul's Feast
text: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."

name: Haunted Crossroads
text: It seemed as if no one wanted them to reach the Henge of Ramos—not even the dead.

name: Highway Robber
text: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

name: Cornered Market
text:
Don't step on the livelihood of other vendors, or they may step on you.
—Mercadian saying

name: Instigator
text: The desecration of their dead makes even the Saprazzans careless.

name: Intimidation
text: "If they move, kill them. In fact, kill one now to make sure the other understands."

name: Liability
text: Gerrard realized that the helpless woman they'd rescued from Rath was nothing of the sort.

name: Maggot Therapy
text:
