"If this is the cure, I'd hate to see the disease."
—Orim

name: Midnight Ritual
text: Bury old friends deeply, lest they return bearing worms.

name: Misshapen Fiend
text: You'd scarcely believe they could fly until they drop out of the sky onto you.

name: Molting Harpy
text: Shed harpy feathers leave painful wounds—which explains the harpies' mood.

name: Nether Spirit
text: It roams in both the worlds of the living and the dead but belongs to neither.

name: Crackdown
text:
"There is no place for mercy in defense of our lives."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

name: Notorious Assassin
text: He wears his infamy like a fine silk shirt.

name: Pretender's Claim
text: The surest way to lose your holdings is to plead for them in Mercadia City's courts.

name: Primeval Shambler
text: His mind, like his body, is made up of the swamp's flotsam.

name: Putrefaction
text:
"Do you want to be alive or whole?"
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

name: Rain of Tears
text: Mercadian elitism is reinforced daily by physical position: their neighbors are literally beneath them and are treated accordingly.

name: Rampart Crawler
text:
"Not even the magistrate in his lofty tower is out of our reach."
—Cateran overlord

name: Scandalmonger
text: Silence costs extra. Breaking it costs extra still.

name: Sever Soul
text:
"With the proper tools, even the Great River can be dammed."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

name: Crossbow Infantry
text: The crossbow is the ideal weapon for the lazy Mercadians: just point and shoot.

name: Silent Assassin
text: She feels no need to disturb her victim's slumber.

name: Skulking Fugitive
text: In the Cateran guild, being caught is a capital offense.

name: Snuff Out
text: Squee watched his Kyren cousins fall with a mixture of sympathy and relief.

name: Soul Channeling
text: Driven by masters more terrible than the Mercadians could imagine, the dark overseers would pay any price to keep their shipwrights working.

name: Specter's Wail
text: As he gritted his teeth to focus through the pain, Tahngarth glanced at Takara. She seemed completely unaffected.

name: Strongarm Thug
text: "No, I insist—let *me* carry all that heavy jewelry."

name: Thrashing Wumpus
text: Young wumpuses are malevolent and vicious—but they grow out of it.

name: Undertaker
text: The weight of death is heavy but not immovable.

name: Devout Witness
text: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

name: Vendetta
text: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

name: Wall of Distortion
text: It reflects only nightmares.

name: Arms Dealer
text: He has the weapons, he has the connections, and he knows the hangar's dark secret.

name: Battle Squadron
text: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

name: Blaster Mage
text: "Don't get up. I'll show myself out."

name: Brawl
text: Anything can happen when patience is scarce and wine is abundant.

name: Disenchant
text:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

name: Cave-In
text: One fleet was gone; others were poised.

name: Ceremonial Guard
text:
"These guards are the most disciplined military unit in the city. They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline."
—Gerrard, to Sisay

name: Cinder Elemental
text: Their rage can grow to such proportions that they explode in a cloud of fire.

name: Close Quarters
text: The Mercadians' ineptitude in close combat sometimes accidentally pays off.

name: Crag Saurian
text: It follows the strongest leader—the one with the longest whip.

name: Crash
text: Gerrard shook his head as the ground rushed to meet him. "This," he thought, "is not the start I was hoping for."

name: Fountain Watch
text: The Cho-Arrim didn't rely only on a secret location to protect their Fountain.

name: Flaming Sword
text:
"It's not Talruum crystal, but I must admit—it gets the job done."
—Tahngarth

name: Furious Assault
text:
"Does it burn, Saprazzan? Do you wish you had never raised arms against us?"
—Kyren overseer

name: Gerrard's Irregulars
text: Had Gerrard realized he'd end up fighting against them, he might not have trained them so well.

name: Hammer Mage
text: When he's holding the hammers, everything looks like a nail.

name: Kris Mage
text: Her blade draws blood without ever touching its target.

name: Kyren Glider
text: Mercadia's Kyren goblins are the opposite of Dominarian goblins: they're smart and cowardly.

name: Kyren Negotiations
text: Kyren goblins always speak in questions and never allow wrong answers.

name: Kyren Sniper
text: Kyren goblins always act behind the scenes—even in battle.

name: Alabaster Wall
text: Its mortar is mixed with waters straight from the Fountain of Cho.

name: Fresh Volunteers
text: Every Cho-Arrim villager is a potential warrior; when they are called, they abandon their peaceful way of life and take up arms to defend it.

name: Lightning Hounds
text: Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.

name: Lithophage
text: It's viciously territorial, destroying every creature on the mountain it has chosen to consume.

name: Lunge
text: Cho-Arrim righteousness was no match for Benalish combat training.

name: Magistrate's Veto
text: The magistrate had been the goblins' puppet for so long that he made the right decisions with little prompting.

name: Mercadia's Downfall
text: With an explosion that shook the foundation of the city, the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: He doesn't have to be smart—his masters only ever give him one command.

name: Puppet's Verdict
text:
"What was heads again?"
—Mercadian magistrate

name: Robber Fly
text: In pursuit of the juicy fly, Squee stumbled on the hidden hangar.

name: Honor the Fallen
text:
"May the River claim Cho-Manno's body, wherever it lies."
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

name: Rock Badger
text: The Kyren goblins created most of the inverted mountain's tunnels simply by driving the beast before them.

name: Seismic Mage
text: The ground shakes when he walks. His customers shake if they're late with his fee.

name: Shock Troops
text: When goblins blow themselves up, it's called stupidity. When humans do, it's called heroism.

name: Sizzle
text: Explosions ripped through the ship overhead, and those unfortunate enough to be directly below scrambled to find cover.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text: "General?!" Tahngarth roared. "General *nuisance*, maybe."

name: Stone Rain
text: The return of Ramos was foretold by devastating natural disasters and unnatural storms.

name: Tectonic Break
text: Only the foolish and the rich build their houses where the land is thin and the ocean is near.

name: Territorial Dispute
text: Bit by bit, Mercadia City had forced the Cho-Arrim from their ancestral lands. They would be pushed no further.

name: Ignoble Soldier
text: Cowardice is a term invented by those with no cunning.

name: Tremor
text: Without a word, Gerrard and Sisay ran deeper into the mountain. Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

name: Uphill Battle
text: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard. If that's what it took to free his people, he'd pay the price.

name: Volcanic Wind
text: The Cho-Arrim call it "the fury of Ramos."

name: War Cadence
text: The rhythm isn't a call to arms, but a signal that the goblins have made a new enemy.

name: Warmonger
text: Funny how money and war travel so well together.

name: Warpath
text: Cho-Manno had never seen Mercadia City's forces fight so well. The magistrate must have hired a new hero.

name: Wild Jhovall
text: Jhovalls sharpen their claws on trees—or on Mercadians, if no trees are handy.

name: Ancestral Mask
text: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

name: Inviolability
text: A soldier's faith is magic strong enough to protect against any blade.

name: Boa Constrictor
text: Its eyes are bigger than its stomach, but its mouth is larger still.

name: Briar Patch
text: As easily as the dryads could close a fist, so could the branches and underbrush entangle.

name: Caustic Wasps
text: Even the wasp knows how to pay the magistrate his due respect.

name: Collective Unconscious
text: Gerrard knew little of Ramos, the sky god they worshiped. But he felt the power of the chant.

name: Dawnstrider
text: Morning's mists can hide many things.

name: Deadly Insect
text: With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.

name: Deepwood Drummer
text: His drums echo Deepwood's heartbeat.

name: Ivory Mask
text: "I did not choose my role, Orim," said Cho-Manno patiently, "and I suspect Gerrard did not choose his."

name: Deepwood Elder
text: They'd guarded the Henge so long that they were as attuned to the powerstones as they were to the trees.

name: Deepwood Tantiv
text: A single tantiv is just as dangerous as a herd.

name: Deepwood Wolverine
text: The jhovalls are depleting its food sources, the Mercadians are eroding its home, and you're wondering why it's angry?

name: Desert Twister
text: The magical dust clouds Mercadian mages use to traverse the plane generate storms that devastate the surrounding terrain. But as long as the storms don't touch the mountain, the nobles simply don't care.

name: Erithizon
text: Unlike scorpions, the erithizon isn't immune to its own weaponry.

name: Ferocity
text:
"You lot go on ahead. I'll keep killing them until it sticks."
—Tahngarth

name: Jhovall Queen
text: War-trained jhovalls eat twice their weight in war-trained soldiers daily.

name: Groundskeeper
text: Whereas the rebels fight to defend the land, they work to renew it.

name: Horned Troll
text:
"If I says it's a troll, it's a troll. Goblins is always right in Mercadia."
—Squee

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Ley Line
text:
"I can feel the strength of the entire forest."
—Gerrard

name: Lumbering Satyr
text:
The satyr carves the path that all of Rushwood follows.
—Cho-Arrim saying

name: Lure
text: Deepwood's reach is not long, so it invites its enemies in.

name: Jhovall Rider
text: Don't be fooled by the riders' fluid grace—it takes years of practice to ride these beasts.

name: Natural Affinity
text: As long as the dryads are a part of the forest, the forest is a part of the army.

name: Pangosaur
text: Only Rushwood is vast enough to swallow this creature whole.

name: Revive
text: Gerrard's heart ached, recalling the living wreath Mirri laid for her dead kin. No such memorial was left for her in Rath.

name: Rushwood Dryad
text: Rushwood is a living jewel that reflects its dwellers' hearts.

name: Rushwood Herbalist
text: When generals gather their armies, healers gather their herbs.

name: Saber Ants
text: They stay on the battlefield only long enough to consume the losers.

name: Sacred Prey
text: To see one is a good omen to the Cho-Arrim.

name: Last Breath
text: "The River flows. My soul returns."

name: Snake Pit
text:
If the ground is smooth, the way will be rough.
—Deepwood saying

name: Snorting Gahr
text: There's little advantage to surprising the gahr.

name: Spidersilk Armor
text: It hardly weighs anything, but it takes all day to remove.

name: Spontaneous Generation
text: Saprolings always thrive on the ruins of others, and Mercadia ruins more than most.

name: Squall
text: The air that holds them aloft can just as easily put them down.

name: Squallmonger
text: "Squall, gale, hurricane—it's all a matter of size . . . and price."

name: Sustenance
text: Like the dryads, the forest itself willingly gives up some of its life for the sake of the future.

name: Tiger Claws
text: Cho-Arrim martial artists emulate the beasts of their home.

name: Moment of Silence
text: The silence commemorates not those who've died, but those about to.

name: Tranquility
text: Sisay had been restored to her place on the ship, the Legacy had been recovered, and the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria. Gerrard focused on the debts he'd settled . . . and on those he'd soon collect.

name: Venomous Breath
text: The dryads need neither size nor strength to defeat their enemies in battle.

name: Venomous Dragonfly
text: A pretty little death is still death.

name: Vine Trellis
text: "We protect our own with our own."

name: Barbed Wire
text: A steel snake with ten thousand teeth.

name: Bargaining Table
text: Although it looks like a game, business around the table is deadly serious.

name: Moonlit Wake
text:
"As long as Rushwood glows, no life is ever truly lost."
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

name: Crenellated Wall
text: Mercadian soldiers excel at finding things to stand behind.

name: Distorting Lens
text: The magistrate seems to prefer a distorted perspective of reality.

name: Eye of Ramos
text: Ramos wept, and there were seas.

name: General's Regalia
text: A uniform fit for a goblin.

name: Heart of Ramos
text: Ramos bled, and there was fire.

name: Henge Guardian
text: Like so many Thran relics, the wurm engine kept operating long after its creators were gone.

name: Horn of Plenty
text:
"This horn is an exact replica of the fabled Horn of Ramos, except mine is more lavish."
—Mercadian magistrate

name: Horn of Ramos
text: Ramos touched, and there was life.

name: Armistice
text:
We all must profit for peace to last.
—Mercadian saying

name: Muzzle
text:
Clenched teeth do not bite.
—Cho-Arrim saying

name: Iron Lance
text:
"The only way to get Mercadians to fight on the front lines is to give them really long weapons."
—Gerrard

name: Mercadian Atlas
text: One may as well chart the clouds as try to map Mercadia.

name: Panacea
text: A drop numbs the tongue. A sip sends the heart racing. A draught reforges the body.

name: Power Matrix
text: As he repaired the ship's planeswalking engine, Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

name: Nightwind Glider
text: Once you learn to float on the shadows, you'll never fear them again.

name: Puffer Extract
text: The puffer's flesh is the deadliest in the sea—and therefore the most useful.

name: Rishadan Pawnshop
text: Everything comes to the waterfront eventually, on the tide or on credit.

name: Skull of Ramos
text: Ramos fell, and there was night.

name: Tooth of Ramos
text: Ramos smiled, and there was day.

name: Henge of Ramos
text:
It is the hub. We are the wheel.
—Dryad saying

name: Noble Purpose
text: Fighting for the right reason is itself a source of strength.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Rishadan Port
text: Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.

name: Tower of the Magistrate
text: Like the city, weakest at its foundation.

name: Pious Warrior
text: The Cho-Arrim make no distinction between healers and soldiers.

name: Ramosian Captain
text: The Cho-Arrim believe in leading by example.

name: Ramosian Commander
text: "Cho-Manno guides your spirit. I guide your sword."

name: Ramosian Lieutenant
text: "Give me your hand and I will give you victory."

name: Ramosian Sergeant
text: Her commands are part rallying cry, part sermon, and wholly undeniable.

name: Arrest
text: Orim had no memory of the previous night—the first thing she could remember was waking up with the dead guard's blood on her hands.

name: Ramosian Sky Marshal
text: The Cho-Arrim fell from the sky onto Mercadia City like a vengeful rain.

name: Renounce
text: Gerrard offered no defense to Orim's condemnation; the mission was under his command, and he was responsible.

name: Revered Elder
text: The Cho-Arrim worship life and revere those who've experienced it longest.

name: Righteous Aura
text:
"There is a great difference between pain and injury."
—Cho-Manno

name: Righteous Indignation
text: "You are the disease that plagues Mercadia. I am the healer's knife that will cut you out."

name: Soothing Balm
text: Orim taught Ta-Karnst and the other Cho-Arrim healers a far less invasive method of healing.

name: Ballista Squad
text: The perfect antidote for a tightly packed formation.

name: Steadfast Guard
text: The Mercadians were prepared for the guard, but the guard was even more prepared for the Mercadians.

name: Task Force
text: They are the reflection of Rushwood's glow on the edge of a wooden sword.

name: Thermal Glider
text:
"The Mercadians are too busy looking down on us to see us coming."
—Cho-Arrim rebel

name: Tonic Peddler
text: "The price is written at the bottom of the cup."

name: Trap Runner
text: "How could I catch her when the trees conspired to stop me?"

name: Wave of Reckoning
text: Inner conflict can defeat a soldier more quickly than any army.

name: Wishmonger
text: "It's not what you ask for, but how you ask for it."

name: Aerial Caravan
text: Successful delivery is *not* guaranteed.

name: Balloon Peddler
text: The market festival turned out to be the high point of Jaffy's visit.

name: Blockade Runner
text: "I need to get back to Mercadia City," said Sisay. "We can get you there," the vizier answered. "Easily."

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Bribery
text: In Mercadia City, loyalties extend only as far as your purse can stretch.

name: Buoyancy
text: Saprazzan merfolk become legged on land, but some find it quicker to bring the water with them.

name: Chambered Nautilus
text: What's merely a home for the nautilus can become exquisite jewelry in the hands of Saprazzan artisans.

name: Charisma
text: It was Gerrard's nature to lead and the Mercadians' to follow.

name: Cloud Sprite
text: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

name: Coastal Piracy
text: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

name: Counterspell
text:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Charmed Griffin
text: Are you sure you can afford such a luxury?

name: Cowardice
text: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' greatest hero; they followed him blindly. When he left, they stumbled around blindly.

name: Customs Depot
text: A bribe is always faster than filling out paperwork.

name: Darting Merfolk
text: You might as well try to catch water with a net.

name: Dehydration
text:
"You say Saprazzo is a city built on water? I hope they have enough to wash the dust from my throat."
—Sisay

name: Drake Hatchling
text: There is beauty in the space between learning to fly and taking it for granted.

name: Energy Flux
text: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

name: Extravagant Spirit
text: The fewer your possessions, the fewer your worries.

name: False Demise
text: "Go down there and fish him out. Maybe his hide will fetch a price."

name: Glowing Anemone
text: Beautiful to behold, terrible to be held.

name: Gush
text: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

name: High Seas
text:
Bend as the wave breaks or it will break you as well.
—Saprazzan saying

name: Hoodwink
text: The youths of Rishada's marketplace are always ready for a quick footrace.

name: Indentured Djinn
text: It's not always clear who's the master and who's the servant.

name: Misstep
text:
The feet have no eyes.
—Saprazzan saying

name: Overtaker
text: "It's no challenge to master a Mercadian."

name: Cho-Arrim Bruiser
text: He doesn't know why the Cho-Arrim fight the Mercadians, but he's happy to bash heads for them anyway.

name: Port Inspector
text: "There may be a few minor additional fees, levies, duties, surtaxes, tariffs, imposts, tolls . . . ."

name: Rishadan Airship
text: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.

name: Rishadan Cutpurse
text:
The bigger the purse, the greater the fool.
—Rishadan saying

name: Rishadan Footpad
text: "The best things in life are free. Money, for instance."

name: Sailmonger
text: Clients who cheat the sailmonger make an impact on the rest.

name: Saprazzan Heir
text: Within the walls of the floating city, Saprazzan wealth is like Saprazzan water: abundant, free-flowing, and accessible to all.

name: Shalai and Hallar
text: Between the angel's blade and the elf's bow, few Phyrexians made it as far as Llanowar's canopy.

name: Chivalric Alliance
text: "I dub thee Syr Hellraker. For now."

name: Gimbal, Gremlin Prodigy
text: You are what you eat, and everything he'd eaten was brilliant.

name: Excise the Imperfect
text: "Riddles are but petty diversions. Phyrexia is the only truth."

name: Abzan Battle Priest
text: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Angel of Finality
text: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Battle Screech
text: All sounds harmonize with the Worldsoul.

name: Blade Splicer
text: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

name: Devouring Light
text: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Flight of Equenauts
text: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Vulpine Harvester
text:
"Fear the fox given strength to match its cunning."
—Vivien Reid

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Knight Exemplar
text: "If you think you are brave enough to walk the path of honor, follow me into the dragon's den."

name: Knight of the White Orchid
text: Both guide and guard on open plain.

name: Master Splicer
text: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Wand of the Worldsoul
text:
"May Mat'Selesnya bind our hearts as one."
—Selesnya prayer

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Secure the Wastes
text:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Shattered Angel
text: She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Valiant Knight
text: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."

name: Village Bell-Ringer
text: "Priests, hunters, slayers—to arms! The enemy approaches!"

name: Worthy Knight
text: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

name: Herald of Hoofbeats
text: Most dismissed her love of horses as a passing childhood fancy. Years later it saved their lives.

name: Distant Melody
text: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

name: Echo Storm
text: An organized and methodical reproduction.

name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
text: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

name: Fallowsage
text: Memories of ages past are said to swim the minds of lounging fallowsages.

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Perplexing Test
text: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

name: Path of the Enigma
text: "We were caught unprepared once. I won't let it happen again."

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Saheeli's Artistry
text: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Shimmer Dragon
text: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

name: Stroke of Genius
text: "Every thought is a star illuminating the darkness. Inspiration comes from finding the constellations that link them."

name: Schema Thief
text: "An intriguing design, but it would be much better without all that oil."

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Vedalken Humiliator
text: "And who will stop me? You?"

name: Workshop Elders
text:
"Fear not what's under the bed. The toys are watching."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Go for the Throat
text: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

name: Graveshifter
text: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

name: Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
text: "Perfection is elusive. Let us try again."

name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
text: The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Phyrexian Delver
text: Because the dead have no will to resist.

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Smitten Swordmaster
text: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

name: Locthwain Lancer
text: For years she believed persistence meant hunting for the Cauldron of Eternity. Now she knew it meant never giving up the fight against a world gone mad.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
text: Centuries ago, a mad god offered a simple trade.

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Ghirapur Aether Grid
text: The city of Ghirapur is a living thing, and living things defend themselves.

name: Goblin Instigator
text: "We can take 'em. You go first!"

name: Goblin Medics
text: Dorik was unshakably confident, having learned medicine from the finest butcher shops in Yotia.

name: Hellkite Igniter
text: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

name: Ion Storm
text: When enough artifacts lie too long in the same place, their magical radiation weakens reality, opening rifts of unpredictable destructive power.

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "Save that one! She looks rich!"

name: Vampires' Vengeance
text: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

name: Dance with Calamity
text: It was just another day on Innistrad.

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Crack Open
text: What no spell or lockpick could open, the forest coaxed apart.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Gimbal, Gremlin Prodigy
text: You are what you eat, and everything he'd eaten was brilliant.

name: Hindervines
text:
"Woodlands and laws. Both grow faster than the Azorius's ability to manage them."
—Suniel the Woodwise

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Hedron Detonator
text: "*Compleat* this!"

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Arvad the Cursed
text: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

name: Combine Chrysalis
text:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Conclave Mentor
text: "I have faith in your potential."

name: Corpse Knight
text:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Enduring Scalelord
text: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

name: Good-Fortune Unicorn
text: Catching even a glimpse of one is the start of eight years of good luck.

name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
text: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

name: Improbable Alliance
text:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Knights of the Black Rose
text: "Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!"

name: Knights' Charge
text:
"By hoof, wing, or paw. For the realm!"
—Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
text: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

name: Mortify
text:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
text: "For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me."

name: Whirlwind of Thought
text: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Fractured Powerstone
text: The Thran learned to capture mana, but power inevitably escapes its bonds.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Inspiring Statuary
text: Ghirapur's most celebrated inventors have been immortalized in clockwork.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Orzhov Locket
text:
"It looks expensive, doesn't it? You have no idea..."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Psychosis Crawler
text:
"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Skyclave Relic
text: Skyclaves held the key to reshaping the world.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Triskelion
text:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Our world is vast, but Thraben is its heart. The cathedral must stand even if the hinterlands are lost."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Cutthroat Negotiator
text: "Either you two figure out how to share, or I'm going to share these swords with the insides of your skulls."

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Gavony Township
text:
"The protective wards of the church have weakened, and no one can tell us why. It's time to look to our own defenses."
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Goldmire Bridge
text: The path to glory is forged in ambition.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Mossfire Valley
text: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Port Town
text: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

name: Mistmeadow Vanisher
text: Thanks to the thoughtweft, kithkin mages knew the instant one of their own was in danger.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Silverquill Campus
text: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Remote but always watching, the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Vodalian Wave-Knight
text: As Phyrexian portals roared open, she whispered a prayer to Svyelun for the strength to cleanse the sky.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Ichor Elixir
text: The corrupted essence of Kaldheim's World Tree became the seed from which New Phyrexia's Realmbreaker grew.

name: Infernal Sovereign
text: Dominaria was his to conquer. The Phyrexians were merely the latest fools to stand in his way.

name: Begin the Invasion
text: Across many worlds, millions of eyes witnessed the same impossible horror.

name: Cut Short
text: With one swift, merciful stroke, Tamiyo's story came to an end.

name: Dreg Recycler
text: Bodies too damaged to survive phyresis are collected and broken down into useful raw materials.

name: Etched Familiar
text:
"No refunds."
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Final Flourish
text: Strixhaven braced for another Oriq assault, but something far worse arrived.

name: Glistening Deluge
text: As oil began to pour from Ikoria's crystals, some monsters developed strange mechanical mutations. Others were simply pulled under.

name: Dusk Legion Duelist
text: "We sailed to Ixalan guided by a promise—the Age of Everflowing Blood. No machine will take that from us."

name: Ichor Shade
text: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.

name: Merciless Repurposing
text: As the harvesters bore away the last of his limbs, what remained of Urabrask heard Elesh Norn say, "Leave the traitor be."

name: Mirrodin Avenged
text: "You were my mistake. I will forever bear the weight of your horrors, and of your end."

name: Nezumi Informant
text: "Tell Boss Umezawa there's a new gang moving in on our territory. I'm forwarding their insignia. Watch for it elsewhere."

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text:
"Of course I'd rather it hadn't skinned six of my best wizards, but as nightmare fuel goes, it's a truly inspired design."
—Braids

name: Render Inert
text: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source. The *compleated* invaders ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

name: Scorn-Blade Berserker
text: "Before I fall, I will taste the blood of Sarulf himself!"

name: Traumatic Revelation
text: "My new form must be hard to understand."

name: Unseal the Necropolis
text: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.

name: Vanquish the Weak
text: When Atraxa first arrived, the people of New Capenna rejoiced at the sight of such a grand angel. Then the slaughter began.

name: Elspeth's Smite
text: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

name: Akki Scrapchomper
text: The Furnace Host found great value in the chaotic ingenuity of Kamigawa's akki and allowed willing converts to "experiment" however they saw fit.

name: Burning Sun's Fury
text: Ixalan greeted Phyrexia with a defiant roar.

name: Coming In Hot
text: "I have a reckless idea," Koth offered. Chandra grinned and cracked her knuckles.

name: Fearless Skald
text: "Hold nothing back, my friends. Tonight we feast in Starnheim!"

name: Enduring Bondwarden
text: "I will be with you. Always."

name: Furnace Host Charger
text: With barely a moment's warning, a one-giant avalanche crashed into Kaldheim's defenders.

name: Harried Artisan
text: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.

name: Into the Fire
text: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.

name: Golden-Scale Aeronaut
text: Johar had never heard of a pterodon. He just knew Saheeli's new invention let him fly circles around the invading monsters.

name: Karsus Depthguard
text: He stood his ground in the Mirrored Depths, his roar of defiance echoed by a thousand crystalline reflections.

name: Lithomantic Barrage
text: Nahiri's rage shattered hedrons into deadly, burning ruin.

name: Nahiri's Warcrafting
text: "Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved."

name: Onakke Javelineer
text: With the ways between worlds thrown open, the Chain Veil's foul magic seeped from a vault deep within Ravnica all the way to Shandalar's dormant masters.

name: Pyretic Prankster
text: It'd played the same prank a hundred times, never noticing the flame's slowly evolving pattern.

name: Ral's Reinforcements
text: "Good thing maintenance never got around to decatalyzing the bithermic plasma displacement conduits!"

name: Guardian of Ghirapur
text: She was hope incarnate, an incandescent bulwark against the tide of machines.

name: Redcap Heelslasher
text: Biffle was delighted to have an excuse to use the nice cutlery he'd liberated from Edgewall.

name: Scrappy Bruiser
text:
"My flesh is an affront to existence? Come say that to my fist, you bloated rust bucket."
—Koko, Riveteers welder

name: Searing Barb
text: "You always were such a sharp student. Shame it took you so long to get the point."

name: Shivan Branch-Burner
text: The New Coalition gave Shiv time to prepare a warm welcome for the invaders.

name: Stoke the Flames
text: The Atarka shamans roused the fire into a scorching rebuke of the invaders and a beacon of hope for the survivors.

name: Thrashing Frontliner
text: With Urabrask in hiding, the masterless Furnace Host was unleashed on the Multiverse to spread mayhem and destruction.

name: Trailblazing Historian
text: Spells once used to traverse Lorehold excavation sites were swiftly repurposed to keep the students one step ahead of the Invasion Tree's grasp.

name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn
text:
"*Compleat* the faith, *compleat* the god."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Volcanic Spite
text: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

name: Voldaren Thrillseeker
text: "The end is always nigh. Let's have some fun!"

name: War-Trained Slasher
text:
"That's my girl. Just don't eat it—wouldn't want you getting an upset stomach again."
—Jalina, Ikorian bonder

name: Wrenn's Resolve
text: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.

name: Arachnoid Adaptation
text:
"Deploy the blightwidows. Rankle's pests should make for a delicious meal."
—Ayara, Furnace Queen

name: Atraxa's Fall
text:
"Fallen angels should stay fallen."
—Henzie "Toolbox" Torre

name: Bonded Herdbeast
text: Though both had lost their families, the *eludha*—the spiritual connection between the monsters of Ikoria and their human bonders—gave them something greater.

name: Infected Defector
text: The diamond storms of Gobakhan hampered Phyrexia's progress until they recruited some of the local shieldmages.

name: Converter Beast
text: Slowly, the distinct screams of the trapped faded into muffled gurgles of glistening oil.

name: Copper Host Crusher
text: Walls built to withstand assaults even from Ikoria's apex monsters were quickly deemed tactically irrelevant by Vorinclex's forces.

name: Cosmic Hunger
text: The Copper Host sought only the strongest converts. In Koma, it found perfection.

name: Crystal Carapace
text:
"Why won't you die, wretched flesh-beast?"
—Lukka

name: Deeproot Wayfinder
text: Her warning raced through the roots and rivers of Ixalan: prepare for war.

name: Fertilid's Favor
text: The denizens of Lorwyn were accustomed to resisting darkness.

name: Glistening Dawn
text: Unleashed on new worlds, the Phyrexians were driven by a simple imperative: spread and conquer.

name: Gnottvold Hermit
text: The Hagi trolls stood little chance against Phyrexia, having killed everyone who came to Gnottvold to warn them.

name: Herbology Instructor
text: "As you see, these flowers . . . can have either restorative or poisonous . . . what is that?"

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"Let's show these soulless fiends what a real army looks like! Forward!"
—Shella, knight of Zhalfir

name: Iridescent Blademaster
text: Her arm and spirit were weary, but as the Halo flowed across her blade, it became weightless, and new strength flooded through her. She would fight on.

name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
text: Nashi knelt reverently before the kami and envisioned his family reunited.

name: Overgrown Pest
text: If only the biofluctuations students could have seen what became of their prize specimen after its escape.

name: Placid Rottentail
text: It had always loved munching on daisies and crystalweed, but lately its favorite snacks were the strange, round roots popping up everywhere.

name: Aerial Boost
text: "Ha! You missed!"

name: Polukranos Reborn
text: Freed from the Underworld, the World Eater resumed his endless feast with reckless enthusiasm.

name: Portent Tracker
text: In the days before the invasion, the symbol of its perpetrator appeared in strange places all across the Multiverse.

name: Ravenous Sailback
text: Converter beasts were sent to ensnare as many of Ixalan's dinosaurs as possible. Many of them were converted themselves—into snacks.

name: Seed of Hope
text: Wrenn had given everything and asked for nothing. She deserved a monument, but rest in a quiet meadow is all she would've wanted.

name: Serpent-Blade Assailant
text: "Kaldheim's cosmos was never yours to corrupt."

name: Storm the Seedcore
text: In that moment, the fate of countless worlds rested with one dryad and a handful of the bravest Mirrodin had to offer.

name: Streetwise Negotiator
text: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.

name: Tandem Takedown
text:
"I take no pleasure in this, but Vadrok might."
—Vivien Reid, to Lukka

name: Timberland Ancient
text: Only the trees were old enough to remember what happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.

name: Tribute to the World Tree
text:
"The Tree was the heart of our world. It made me what I am and pulled me back from the brink of death. I won't allow it to be forgotten."
—Esika, god of the Tree

name: Vengeant Earth
text: When Zendikar's defenders faltered, the Roil rose up to shake the invaders from its back.

name: War Historian
text: All children on Kamigawa learn of the Kami War. Hostilities with beings from another reality were understood, and no time was wasted in disbelief.

name: Wary Thespian
text: The Cabaretti performance had veered off-script ... so how were the acrobats still moving in perfect unison?

name: Wildwood Escort
text: With Eldraine's human knights called away to defend the courts, lost travelers were surprised to find themselves whisked to safety by the secretive folk of the wilds.

name: Kithkin Billyrider
text: "Brother, guide my right hand. Sister, my left. Rest well, my kin, but Lorwyn still needs me. I will not be joining you quite yet."

name: Kroxa and Kunoros
text: When the Invasion Tree reached the Underworld, it found only teeth and fury.

name: Marshal of Zhalfir
text: "How kind of our foes to move in such perfect, predictable unison. Split into squadrons and execute the Lion's Claw!"

name: Mirror-Shield Hoplite
text: In the shield's gleaming surface, the Phyrexian saw a reflection of what it once had been, and paused.

name: Mutagen Connoisseur
text: Much to the Phyrexians' delight, sheer curiosity drove many to willingly surrender to *compleation*.

name: Knight of the New Coalition
text: Raised in a long tradition of heroes, every Benalish knight knows the day might come when they will be called to face Phyrexia.

name: Rampaging Geoderm
text: The Phyrexian juggernaut found itself crushed between a rock and a hard place.

name: Stormclaw Rager
text: No amount of spilled oil and crushed metal could slake her bloodlust.

name: Yargle and Multani
text:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.

name: Halo Hopper
text: Folded by an imaginative child, animated by a mischievous kami, and blessed by an otherworldly angel.

name: Kitesail
text: "Just like dodging stampedes in the Makindi Trenches back home!"

name: Phyrexian Archivist
text: Silence quickly went from an annoying library rule to an imperative for survival.

name: Skittering Surveyor
text: Though no bigger than a hand, the surveyors were as vital to the resistance as the largest war constructs.

name: Urn of Godfire
text: Ephara blessed the defenders of Theros with godfire, a Nyx-infused incendiary substance that burned without fuel.

name: Bloodfell Caves
text: Having learned of New Capenna's Halo supply, Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.

name: Blossoming Sands
text: The Copper Host brought a hideous mockery of new life to Amonkhet's death-cursed desert.

name: Dismal Backwater
text: The Invasion Tree's branches snaked through the streets of Otawara, turning Kamigawa's soaring city into a clouded nightmare.

name: Kor Halberd
text: An ancient weapon for a modern war.

name: Jungle Hollow
text: On the surface of Ixalan's vast tar pits, Phyrexian oil glistened, and old bones began to stir.

name: Rugged Highlands
text: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

name: Scoured Barrens
text: As oil seeped from Ikoria's crystals, strange metallic mutations emerged in monsters all across the plane.

name: Swiftwater Cliffs
text: Kaladesh's wondrous inventions and glowing aether were of utmost interest to Jin-Gitaxias and his Chrome Host.

name: Thornwood Falls
text: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

name: Tranquil Cove
text: The sky darkened and the seas turned to oil as the gods of Theros themselves fell to New Phyrexia.

name: Wind-Scarred Crag
text: Serra was a symbol of hope to Dominaria, so Norn defiled her temples with monuments to Phyrexia.

name: Monastery Mentor
text: "One path. Many feet."

name: Phyrexian Censor
text: Quintorius muffled a sob as he watched the thing that was once Professor Pitnik "confiscate" yet another priceless historical tome.

name: Yargle and Multani
text:
"I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled. "There was a time when I'd balk at your aid, phantom, but she has shown me the merit in Urborg's strange ways."
"Gnshhagghkkapphribbit," replied Yargle.

name: Phyrexian Pegasus
text:
"It is glory, exalted and *compleat*."
—Cymede, regent of the Alabaster Host

name: Seedpod Caretaker
text: His body clicked and hummed—a lullaby meant only for machines.

name: Zephyr Winder
text: It twines through the roiling cloudscape feeding on the energies of nascent storms.

name: Realmbreaker's Grasp
text: The Invasion Tree wasn't merely a conduit through which to breach planes. It was a living, writhing extension of Phyrexia's will.

name: Terror of Towashi
text: Takumi knew where all the bodies were buried. After all, he'd buried most of them.

name: Axgard Artisan
text: Skodreg knew the Phyrexians wouldn't appreciate his craftsmanship, but they'd get an up-close look just the same.

name: Fairgrounds Trumpeter
text:
"What is that horrible flesh-noise?! We must silence it before it grows even louder!"
—Thxmir, Machine Legion scout

name: Ruins Recluse
text: Desert horrors were its favorite treat, but it happily expanded its diet to include extraplanar horrors.

name: Surrak and Goreclaw
text: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

name: Scrollshift
text: Bim lashed out with the only weapon she'd never run out of: lecture notes.

name: Faerie Mastermind
text: Yuta Takahashi, World Champion XXVII

name: Seraph of New Capenna
text: The angels had vowed to protect New Capenna. She was determined to uphold that vow, no matter the cost.

name: Sigiled Sentinel
text: "Alara has been broken before. I will not let it break again."

name: Sun-Blessed Guardian
text: Light glinted off the raised weapons of the Sun Empire, filling her with an unbreakable hope . . .

name: Alabaster Host Sanctifier
text: "Heliod shines his light on all things, excising the shadows of doubt. Rejoice, for beneath his purifying eyes, Theros is united as one!"

name: Sunfall
text:
"Let the light scour away your imperfect flesh."
—Heliod

name: Surge of Salvation
text: No Meletian had ever laid eyes on an angel, but when protective Halo flooded the Multiverse, they knew a divine blessing was at hand.

name: Swordsworn Cavalier
text: The Royal Knights of Belenon are equally practiced in courtesy and combat.

name: Tarkir Duneshaper
text:
"Obey the teachings of the dragonlords, for they provide all. They grant us magic and safety, and in return we offer respect."
—Baihir, Dromoka mage

name: Zhalfirin Lancer
text: The Phyrexians armored themselves against blades, fire, and every conjuration they could think of. She brought a war rhino.

name: Artistic Refusal
text: Errant wouldn't allow anything to stop her from decorating the streets of New Capenna.

name: Assimilate Essence
text: "You have no viable escape vector. Cease your resistance and accept perfection."

name: Captive Weird
text: Izzet researchers agreed to keep the unusual weird contained until they understood the extent of its powers.

name: Angelic Intervention
text: Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.

name: Change the Equation
text: "It's not your fault. Strixhaven taught you an imperfect premise. Okay, the imperfect execution was your fault."

name: Expedition Lookout
text: Skills honed on perilous treasure hunts helped Zendikar's adventurers stay a crucial step ahead of their Phyrexian foes.

name: Eyes of Gitaxias
text: No longer bound by the myopic limitations of flesh, Ekken would truly see the realms.

name: Faerie Mastermind
text: Yuta Takahashi, World Champion XXVII

name: Furtive Analyst
text: Where had she first seen that symbol? She usually took such detailed notes, but her memory of it was like a fading nightmare.

name: Halo-Charged Skaab
text: Innistrad's stitchers were practiced at incorporating magical substances into undead creations.

name: Meeting of Minds
text:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

name: Moment of Truth
text: On the precipice of eternity, Elspeth made a choice. The fight would not end without her.

name: Negate
text: Teferi gave them time. Karn gave them a chance. But it was Melira who paid the ultimate price to free Ajani from Phyrexia's grasp.

name: Oculus Whelp
text: Even before Phyrexia's forces arrived on Tarkir, Silumgar's draconic brood had a discerning eye for valuables.

name: Attentive Skywarden
text: The same sturdy kitesail that once carried her safely through the Roil now allows her to monitor the pods' progress from above.

name: Omen Hawker
text: After years of fabricating visions for naive customers of the Obscura, Stafano was flummoxed by the nightmarish scenes that played out unbidden in his mind's eye.

name: Order of the Mirror
text: The Magic Mirror of Vantress showed Catrina a twisted vision of black oil and bloody machines.

name: Preening Champion
text: On Kylem, the omens of impending invasion went largely unnoticed, drowned out by the everyday fanfare of Valor's Reach.

name: Protocol Knight
text: "Ingress without proper writ of extraplanar intent? Unacceptable!"

name: Saiba Cryptomancer
text: "Good luck getting through a class-seven proxy ward, creep."

name: Skyclave Aerialist
text: Together with her beloved falcon, she had explored every waterway on Zendikar, from the Tazeem highlands to the inland sea.

name: Stasis Field
text: Old glitches in mage-ring function became critical tools in Vryn's defense.

name: Temporal Cleansing
text: "Now's not a good time."

name: Thunderhead Squadron
text: Just as all seemed lost, the griffin riders of Zhalfir arrived with the force of a gathered storm.

name: Transcendent Message
text: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.

name: Xerex Strobe-Knight
text: Phyrexia broke the laws of reality to invade the planes. On Xerex, reality merely bent around the invaders.

name: Zhalfirin Shapecraft
text: Patient and observant, the people of Zhalfir lurked beyond the veil of time until their moment came to finally strike at Phyrexia.

name: Aetherblade Agent
text: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .

name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
text: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.

name: Blightreaper Thallid
text: Mudcreep loved the taste of the funny oil that leaked from the wrecked machines in Urborg.

name: Breach the Multiverse
text:
"All worlds will know perfection."
—Elesh Norn

name: Collective Nightmare
text: Night fell all at once. Specifically, on the Phyrexian.

name: Compleated Huntmaster
text: The elves of Lorwyn sought perfection. The Etched Host supplied it.

name: Consuming Aetherborn
text: Doji found the Phyrexian's essence foul, but every drop added an hour to their life.

name: Corrupted Conviction
text:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Deadly Derision
text: Daretti looked down disdainfully. "You call yourself machines? Where's the elegance? Nothing but ugly piles of scrap."

name: Ballyrush Banneret
text: Only wool from the side of the springjack turned most often to the sun can be woven into kithkin battle standards. Jackherds record every movement of their woolly-jacks until shearing.

name: Forfend
text:
"Suddenly there stood a fortress protecting the clachan, its walls hewn of valor and mortared with honor."
—*Clachan Tales*

name: Roar of the Crowd
text: One voice is but a pebble to the rest of the world. A thousand voices at once is an avalanche.

name: Seething Pathblazer
text:
"Flamekin death rites are elaborate and spectacular affairs. Their greatest fear is death in obscurity."
—Tollek Worldwatcher, journal

name: Sensation Gorger
text: More, more, more!

name: Shard Volley
text: "Let the mountain's teeth pierce our oppressors."

name: Shared Animosity
text:
"It is the nature of souls that they burn more brightly together than apart."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Stingmoggie
text: A path vexed by the stingmoggie was probably the wrong path anyhow.

name: Sunflare Shaman
text: A spark to light the guttered heart.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Graceful Reprieve
text: "In my moment of death, I had a vision of the world, dark and unwelcoming. I wanted to hide in the deepest meander, but the light pulled me back."

name: Vengeful Firebrand
text: The flame of a warrior is never extinguished.

name: War-Spike Changeling
text:
"Aren't there boggarts enough in Lorwyn? Couldn't it turn into a sheep? Or a sunflower?"
—Olly of Goldmeadow

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Bosk Banneret
text: Deep in a murmuring bosk, where the trees' memories span centuries, the simple banner of green and copper signifies an elder whose rings number more than a faerie's days.

name: Bramblewood Paragon
text: Those who seek to escape her blades succeed only in dying on their stomachs.

name: Deglamer
text: The more pleasant an illusion's garb, the more indecent its form laid bare.

name: Earthbrawn
text: Gremil finally felt in touch with nature—and felt a need to share the experience with others.

name: Idyllic Tutor
text:
"If one's life is blessed, solutions to all life's problems will appear at the right moment."
—*The Book of Kith and Kin*

name: Elvish Warrior
text: As graceful as a deer leaping a stream and as deadly as the wolf waiting in ambush on the other side, elvish warriors are the eyes of the forest as well as its unsheathed claws.

name: Everbark Shaman
text: "May you rise again, from seed to sapling to sentience."

name: Game-Trail Changeling
text:
"I pity them, never knowing the pleasures of a single familiar form, but at least they find a noble shape at times."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Gilt-Leaf Archdruid
text: "In our hands, the natural world finds more beauty than nature alone could ever provide."

name: Greatbow Doyen
text: "My arrows will ever find you."

name: Heritage Druid
text:
"Study the great spirits of our age and those of the past. Prune secrets from the branching traceries of our lineage."
—Twila, Gilt-Leaf archdruid

name: Hunting Triad
text: "Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

name: Luminescent Rain
text: Storms in Lorwyn don't patter on village rooftops, but rather drench the clachan in rays of amber light.

name: Indomitable Ancients
text:
"Odum and Broadbark were the only beings mighty enough to challenge the giant Moran the Destroyer. Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep. He awoke as Moran the Gardener."
—*The Tale of Odum and Broadbark*

name: Orchard Warden
text: "After the Rising, a treefolk's mind is as limber and green as its limbs, and is at its most receptive to our teachings."

name: Reach of Branches
text: Growth has no limits.

name: Rhys the Exiled
text: Once a famed hunter and packmaster, now a renegade seeking his own path.

name: Scapeshift
text:
"Changes far greater than the turning of the leaves await us at season's end."
—Colfenor, the Last Yew

name: Wolf-Skull Shaman
text: A chorus of howls answers his call.

name: Obsidian Battle-Axe
text: It's the flint that sparks a warrior's rage.

name: Mutavault
text: Some changelings born at Velis Vel never return, but their essence never leaves.

name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
text: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

name: Mosquito Guard
text: His aim is as sure as a mosquito's sting, but with none of the warning.

name: Order of the Golden Cricket
text:
"Should you take it in mind to ride a springjack, remember: there are easier ways to fly, and harder ways to break your skull."
—Lann of Cloverdell

name: Battletide Alchemist
text: "I do not heal. Healing means that the pain has already been felt. To stop suffering, one must prevent the world's wounds altogether."

name: Preeminent Captain
text: "If you need an example to lead others to the front lines, consider the precedent set."

name: Stonehewer Giant
text: "No matter how strong, an unarmed fighter is no more than a fool."

name: Stonybrook Schoolmaster
text: Merrow schools rarely form by design. They come together naturally as eager learners surround the wisest teachers.

name: Swell of Courage
text: "Tideshaping is more than creating a few new puddles."

name: Wandering Graybeard
text: His tales are as tall as he is, and only a giant's life is long enough to listen to them all.

name: Weight of Conscience
text: Sometimes the weight of the world on your shoulders is a literal one.

name: Declaration of Naught
text: Every story, even a faerie tale, comes to an end.

name: Burrenton Bombardier
text: The flasks provide ballast, a means of steering, and—with a little luck—a way to deliver ward-spells to cohorts below.

name: Dewdrop Spy
text: Only in dew from Oona herself is there clarity enough to see a victim's mind.

name: Disperse
text: Gryffid scowled at the sky. A perfect day for the hunt tainted by clouds. He wished them gone. High above, the clouds looked down, scowled, and made a wish of their own.

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Fencer Clique
text:
You may as well try to swat a faerie
—Flamekin expression meaning "that's impossible"

name: Burrenton Shield-Bearers
text: Soul and bones, kithkin are woven into their clans. They fight fiercely and without self-interest.

name: Merrow Witsniper
text: "The world above the waterline must be monitored—and, when necessary, adjusted."

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Mothdust Changeling
text:
"Ever seen a changeling fly into a lantern?"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Sage of Fables
text: "There is no secret that cannot be sold."

name: Sage's Dousing
text:
"Curse these merrows and their meddling! Since coming near the river, I can't so much as sneeze without being soaked."
—Ashling the Pilgrim

name: Sigil Tracer
text: "The reflection is true. It is you who are distorted and false."

name: Cenn's Tactician
text: The choke point was the plan, but devoted camaraderie was always her strategy.

name: Stonybrook Banneret
text: Made from trout scales and crawfish whiskers, merrows' shimmering banners flash in the water like lightning.

name: Stream of Unconsciousness
text: Dreams are tempting because one is so powerful in them. Dreams are dangerous because that power is a lie.

name: Bitterblossom
text: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

name: Blightsoil Druid
text: "See the beauty in death: the clean white bones lying in the fertile soil and the brightly colored moonglove sprouting from the fell earth."

name: Changeling Sentinel
text: There's nothing more unsettling than locking blades with something that looks just like you.

name: Fendeep Summoner
text: "What is drowned is not forgotten. I will fulfill my oath. Come back to me, my brethren, as I have come back for you."

name: Festercreep
text: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

name: Final-Sting Faerie
text: Many heroes' last sight is a grin at the other end of a rapier.

name: Frogtosser Banneret
text: The Frogtossers thread feathers, bones, and trophies from past raids into their standards, believing they fuel the warren with the anger of its victims.

name: Maralen of the Mornsong
text: Maralen sent Veesa, Endry, and Iliona—the Vendilion clique—on the gravest of tasks.

name: Mind Shatter
text: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

name: Pack's Disdain
text: Like the sun to a flower, the adoring gaze of the tribe is sustenance to an elf. To be shunned is to wither.

name: Prickly Boggart
text:
"Even without the spines, who would dare to touch it?"
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Scarblade Elite
text: "Rejoice, eyeblight. In your last hours above the earth, those who bury you will finally make you beautiful."

name: Stenchskipper
text:
"Many believe it to be the manifestation of all that is vile about the boggarts. I believe it should be avoided—from upwind, if possible."
—Cenn Deagan

name: Daily Regimen
text: What self-indulgence tears down, discipline builds up again.

name: Violet Pall
text: A faerie is the offspring of Oona and mischief.

name: Warren Weirding
text:
"And that's when it was discovered that boggarts have just half a brain."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

name: Weed-Pruner Poplar
text:
"When Byoog reached down to pull up a bit of root for the stew, he didn't expect the root to pull back."
—A tale of Auntie Wort

name: Weirding Shaman
text: All boggarts have an auntie, but they don't all have a mum.

name: Boldwyr Heavyweights
text: Even if giants bring nothing else on a journey, they bring attention.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Borderland Behemoth
text: Giants share nothing but their fury.

name: Brighthearth Banneret
text: The banner symbolizes the goodwill of the Brighthearth. Their emissaries bring the mastery of fire to other races.

name: Feudkiller's Verdict
text:
"There are all kinds of strengths, but if you have strength of soul, the others will follow."
—Galanda Feudkiller

name: Hostile Realm
text: Lorwyn's crust explodes with power when the greater elementals are born. The flamekin use the fallout as cover for forays into enemy territory.

name: Kindled Fury
text:
"All beings carry the fire inside them. The challenge is to unleash it before they dwindle into oblivion."
—Illulia, flamekin soulstoke

name: Lunk Errant
text: "One's plenty," observed the merrow. "Way too plenty," agreed the boggart.

name: Rivals' Duel
text: They could agree on one thing only: one of them must die.

name: Wasteland
text:
"I will show you fear in a handful of dust."
—T. S. Eliot, "The Waste Land"

name: Cloudstone Curio
text: With innovative stabilizing techniques, Suja Pavani brings this piece of the sky itself to the Inventors' Fair.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: By isolating liquid aether at room temperature, foundry hand Jitya Reyath has given us a glimpse of raw aetheric matter—the very stuff of the cosmos.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: This matched set incorporates aetheric accelerators and deflection matrices in an elegant, wearable design.

name: Lotus Petal
text: Each of these intricate mechanical petals stores enough power to supply all of Ghirapur, if only for a fleeting moment.

name: Mana Crypt
text: An utterly silent chamber, submitted by an artificer who wished to remain anonymous.

name: Mind's Eye
text: Developed and tested by researchers at the Consulate's House of Knowledge, these devices allow anyone to see with a visionary's eye.

name: Mox Opal
text: On loan from a private collection, this unique mechanism extracts power from a carefully prepared gemstone.

name: Painter's Servant
text: This whimsical automaton helps create beautiful murals, then stands guard as they dry.

name: Rings of Brighthearth
text: Crafted in emulation of dwarven hearth decorations, these devices doubled the output of Amrit Vatyam's forges.

name: Sculpting Steel
text: Perfected by the kinetic sculptor Shanti Makam, these self-assembling metal strands can be coaxed into any shape imaginable.

name: Sol Ring
text: It took the reclusive Venya Sangmi a lifetime to realize her childhood vision: a band of sunlight made solid.

name: Static Orb
text: Reduction of energy and motion within the stasis field creates the illusion of slowed time.

name: Steel Overseer
text: In an unusual foray into the humanoid form, Venand Kapur—known as the Gearherder—built this automaton to keep watch over his clockwork herds.

name: Arcbound Ravager
text:
"Top-performing automaton combatants are to be seized and modified for service."
—Confiscation directive

name: Defense Grid
text:
"Woven together, strands of aether can form a mesh of surprising stability, though such a network tends to pull power from nearby devices."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"With a few minor adjustments, we were able to convert sky-dock assisters into a defense system for the Aether Spire."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Grindstone
text:
"All attempts to halt the machine failed. We must find a way to repurpose it."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Meekstone
text:
"When it oscillated above a particular frequency, the stone induced acute listlessness in several researchers."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Ornithopter
text:
"Consider all confiscated items hostile until proven otherwise."
—Confiscation directive

name: Paradox Engine
text:
"This device was submitted to the Fair anonymously. It is imperative that its maker be found. We must understand it."
—Confiscation directive

name: Planar Bridge
text:
"Rashmi's design was just the beginning. We are most eager to see what the High Consul has planned for it."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Platinum Angel
text:
"Adi Thandray's angel is a Priority One confiscation from the Fair. Once you see it, you'll understand why."
—Confiscation directive

name: Sphere of Resistance
text:
"At the outset, we weren't aware of Chief Baral's motives for the project. It's now apparent that he intends to use the device to hamper the 'mages' among the ranks of the renegades."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Sundering Titan
text:
"Truth be told, my team had hoped never to see the day it was deployed."
—Consulate engineer's log

name: Trinisphere
text:
"This exhibition of Nehra's Threshold Principle must be expropriated and examined for its potential applications in enforcement."
—Confiscation directive

name: Champion's Helm
text: Adi Thandray designed this helm as a tribute to his mentor, the great Daljit Gavaskar.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: It exemplifies the motto of the Luminary League: "Innovation requires insatiable curiosity and a good source of light."

name: Altar's Light
text:
"The altar does nothing; the device is crushed under the weight of its own impurity."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

name: Leonin Elder
text:
"The wisdom of the elders is just as much a weapon as a sword or spear. We must learn to wield it."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

name: Megatog
text: In an ironic bit of evolution, the megatog's dozens of teeth are mainly ornamental. It prefers swallowing things whole.

name: Molten Rain
text: When the molten rains fall, entire landscapes melt and flow away in rivulets of fire.

name: Ogre Leadfoot
text: When the goblins need more scrap for the Great Furnace, they simply let the ogres loose and follow in their wake.

name: Rustmouth Ogre
text: It has an iron stomach. Literally.

name: Seething Song
text: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

name: Shatter
text: Days of planning. Weeks of building. Months of perfecting. Seconds of smashing.

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: From trinket to trauma.

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Spikeshot Goblin
text: The path of a goblin shaman is a journey through a thousand ways of hurting people.

name: Trash for Treasure
text: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.

name: Leonin Skyhunter
text: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

name: Vulshok Battlemaster
text: "I could demonstrate how the leonin sunsplicer works, but then you'd be too dead to buy one."

name: Vulshok Berserker
text: He experiences every emotion with passion and repays every slight with vengeance.

name: Battlegrowth
text: "I would gladly die for the forest, but I'm much better at killing for it."

name: Bloodscent
text: To study the predators of the Tangle, two people are required: one to watch from above, and one to run like hell.

name: Brown Ouphe
text: In a strange twist of fate, one of the most annoying creatures in the multiverse was brought to the place where it could cause the most damage.

name: Copperhoof Vorrac
text: Like all forest beasts, it lives by one rule: if there's no room to grow, make some.

name: Creeping Mold
text: The deadliest force on Mirrodin isn't the largest organism—it's the smallest.

name: Deconstruct
text: "Nothing in this world, not even magic, likes to be caged."

name: Fangren Hunter
text: Big ones hunt the elves, so the elves hunt the small ones to keep them from getting big.

name: Loxodon Mender
text: The Auriok believe that in the hands of a loxodon, no weapon can be broken.

name: Glissa Sunseeker
text: "There's a secret at the heart of this world, and I will unlock it."

name: Groffskithur
text: It growls not to threaten, but to summon.

name: Hum of the Radix
