text: The elves learned long ago that anything left here slowly vanishes. Now it is a sacred site where the dead are laid to rest and where unnatural magic is erased forever.

name: Living Hive
text: In its center is a single red ant, a queen that regulates the hive's movements.

name: Molder Slug
text: Fortunately for it, Mirrodin is a plane without salt.

name: Plated Slagwurm
text: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

name: Predator's Strike
text: If you hear it coming, you're not its prey.

name: Slith Predator
text: Born amid the molten metal of the Great Furnace, the slith have more than adapted to the perils of a metal world.

name: Sylvan Scrying
text: One glimpse of an elf's home lasts her weeks away in the wild.

name: Tel-Jilad Archers
text: They are extensions of the Tangle, stretching its vines into the furthest reaches of the sky.

name: Tel-Jilad Chosen
text: "It is my honor to keep safe Tel-Jilad's secrets, not to know them."

name: Tel-Jilad Exile
text: For his crimes, he was made to forget all the trolls' secrets. Now he knows only that he is outcast, but not why.

name: Troll Ascetic
text: It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.

name: Trolls of Tel-Jilad
text: "The secret of this world weighs upon us, and we have been shaped by time and duty to bear it."

name: Turn to Dust
text: Mirrodin's inhabitants must be prepared for anything—including suddenly being unprepared.

name: Viridian Joiner
text: "The Tangle reaches out to itself constantly, forming new connections. We must follow its example."

name: Viridian Shaman
text: Because the elves are so in touch with Mirrodin's nature, they understand best how to dismantle it.

name: Loxodon Punisher
text: The loxodons believe punishment comes in two steps: pain and atonement. They carry a weapon for each.

name: Wurmskin Forger
text: It takes three weeks for a patrol of hunters to down a slagwurm. It takes just as long to make a single cut in its hide.

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Alpha Myr
text: First to charge, first to fight.

name: Blinkmoth Urn
text: The vedalken embed such urns in their living artifact creations.

name: Bosh, Iron Golem
text: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Cathodion
text: Cathodions repair the Great Furnace by soldering parts of themselves to the mechanism. Eventually, they become one with the machine.

name: Chromatic Sphere
text:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Cobalt Golem
text: Centuries before the first tides of the Quicksilver Sea rose to meet each new sun, Mirrodin's light shone on the golems alone.

name: Copper Myr
text: The elves thought of the myr as minor threats, just as the myr thought of the elves.

name: Crystal Shard
text: The vedalken know it is not of this world, so they know that this world is not the only one.

name: Raise the Alarm
text: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

name: Damping Matrix
text: The priests tried cursing it. The mages tried dispelling it. In the end, they all obeyed it.

name: Dragon Blood
text: A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.

name: Dross Scorpion
text: They skitter out of the mists to consume fresh kill before Mephidross has a chance to corrode it away.

name: Duskworker
text: At the setting of each sun, it emerges to clean Mirrodin's floor of the day's carrion.

name: Elf Replica
text: It hunts with unnerving ferocity.

name: Razor Barrier
text: "We protect our homelands. Why should they not protect us?"

name: Farsight Mask
text: It turns the adversity of the moment into the knowledge of a lifetime.

name: Frogmite
text: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

name: Galvanic Key
text: A solution in search of a problem.

name: Gilded Lotus
text: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

name: Goblin Replica
text: It destroys with unthinking glee.

name: Gold Myr
text: The leonin thought of the myr as omens, never imagining the sinister fate they foretold.

name: Granite Shard
text: It's a piece of a world the goblins have never seen but would dearly like to blow up.

name: Grid Monitor
text: The vedalken protect the Knowledge Pool at any cost.

name: Heartwood Shard
text: Like all other relics, it was left on the Radix by the elves to be destroyed. Unlike all other relics, it persisted.

name: Hematite Golem
text: Centuries before the first peaks of the Oxidda Chain rewrote the laws of magnetism, the golems patrolled Mirrodin's featureless surface unhindered.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: A model of Mirrodin in both shape and spirit.

name: Iron Myr
text: The goblins didn't think of the myr at all, which allowed the myr to observe everywhere unhindered.

name: Rule of Law
text: Appointed by the kha himself, members of the tribunal ensure all disputes are settled with the utmost fairness.

name: Krark's Thumb
text:
"I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for."
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

name: Leaden Myr
text: The Moriok saw the myr as fellow scavengers, never knowing just who the myr were scavenging for.

name: Leonin Sun Standard
text: The commander tells the troops where to go, but the standard reminds them why they're there.

name: Leveler
text: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

name: Lifespark Spellbomb
text:
"Awaken that which was never asleep."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Arrest
text:
"Unfortunately, it doesn't restrain the beast's smell."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Second Sunrise
text: The bright tunnel sometimes leads back to life.

name: Lodestone Myr
text: When necessary, myr can override and control any artificial object, as can their creator.

name: Malachite Golem
text: Centuries before the first branches of the Tangle gave shelter from the suns' cold light, the shadows of golems were Mirrodin's only shade.

name: Mesmeric Orb
text: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Skyhunter Cub
text: Every young leonin wishes to become a skyhunter, for they soar closest to the suns.

name: Myr Adapter
text:
"The simplest way to plan ahead is merely to be ready for everything."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Myr Mindservant
text: It knows what you are planning, and does not approve.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Necrogen Spellbomb
text:
"Forget that which was never known."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Needlebug
text: Near Tel-Jilad, the Tangle is almost silent, save for the trolls' chants and the skittering of needlebugs.

name: Skyhunter Patrol
text:
"They are the first to raise the alarm when the levelers attack, and the first to risk their lives to defend the pride."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

name: Nim Replica
text: It kills with unfeeling malice.

name: Nuisance Engine
text: All Auriok children know the tale, "Bolgri and the Long Day of Squashing."

name: Omega Myr
text: Last to charge, last to fall.

name: Ornithopter
text: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

name: Pearl Shard
text: Leonin folktales claim it was brought from beyond the sky by the first kha.

name: Pewter Golem
text: Centuries before the first chimneys of Mephidross belched clouds of toxic gas, only the golems' movements stirred the air of Mirrodin.

name: Platinum Angel
text: In its heart lies the secret of immortality.

name: Power Conduit
text: Never content, vedalken artificers continually tinker with their creations.

name: Slith Ascendant
text: Instinctively drawn to the light of its "mother-sun," each slith follows that sun's path around Mirrodin.

name: Psychogenic Probe
text: The same devices sold as surgeons' tools in Lumengrid are sold as implements of torture in Mephidross.

name: Pyrite Spellbomb
text:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Rustspore Ram
text: Where herds have passed, the dented ground is lined with piles of rust.

name: Sculpting Steel
text: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

name: Silver Myr
text: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

name: Skeleton Shard
text: Metal permeates the marrow of every bone in Mephidross—except one.

name: Soldier Replica
text: It fights with inhuman vigor.

name: Steel Wall
text:
"We sculpt the land into what we need—homes, armament, fortresses of war. Our strength comes not only from knowing, but from *commanding* the terrain."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

name: Soul Nova
text: Within seconds, the nim was consumed in blinding sunfire. Afterwards, only a puddle of molten iron remained.

name: Sunbeam Spellbomb
text:
"Cure that which was never ill."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Tanglebloom
text: Druids converted swaths of the Tangle into tanglebloom orchards. Though heavy tools are needed to cut a leaf in the Tangle, tanglebloom fruit is easily plucked by hand.

name: Tangleroot
text: As if there's glitch in the system, the Tangle sometimes folds in on itself, throwing off sparks of mana in a mystifying display.

name: Sphere of Purity
text: Purity rejects artifice.

name: Tel-Jilad Stylus
text: Etched on Tel-Jilad's trunk is an entire history of Mirrodin—except for an expanse near the ground scrubbed smooth by an unknown hand.

name: Titanium Golem
text: Centuries before the first blades of the Razor Fields chimed in the wind, Mirrodin echoed with the golems' footsteps.

name: Tower of Champions
text: The ur-golem runes tell of the transformation of Mirrodin's warden from silent guardian to merciless god.

name: Tower of Eons
text: Its etchings tell the ur-golems' stories of an entity able to force life into a lifeless plane.

name: Tower of Fortunes
text: The ur-golem etchings begin by celebrating Mirrodin's creator, a golem of almost limitless power. They end by cursing its protector, a being called Memnarch.

name: Tower of Murmurs
text: Etched on its surface are warnings from a long-lost race of ur-golems pushed to the brink of extinction.

name: Welding Jar
text: The wires crawl over broken metal and heat themselves to melting, filling cracks quickly and efficiently.

name: Wizard Replica
text: It responds with unnatural precision.

name: Yotian Soldier
text: Poets dream the verses of otherworldly stories. Artificers dream the blueprints of otherplanar artifacts.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Blinkmoth Well
text: When dictated by blinkmoth migratory patterns, clouds of tiny lights well up from Mirrodin's core.

name: Tempest of Light
text:
"This world reeks of another's hand. Someone or something is defying the power of the gods and shaping this planet. I intend for it to stop."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Cloudpost
text:
"He watches from above. He watches from below. He watches from within."
—Inscription on Tel-Jilad, the Tree of Tales

name: Glimmervoid
text: An empty canvas holds infinite possibilities.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Tree of Tales
text: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

name: Vault of Whispers
text: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

name: Annul
text:
"Murder of the living is tragic, but murder of the idea is unforgivable."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

name: Auriok Bladewarden
text: The Auriok have learned through constant struggle that allies are more precious than water.

name: Disarm
text: "Be thankful I left you your clothes."

name: Domineer
text: Since they haven't seen their original master for millennia, golems are eager to take orders from anyone.

name: Fabricate
text: "The secret to invention is to see something in your mind, then find where it hides in the world."

name: Fatespinner
text: No one knows what she is watching, but she never takes her eyes off it.

name: Inertia Bubble
text:
"I wouldn't want you to hurt yourself."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Looming Hoverguard
text: Although mute, hoverguards get their message across loud and clear.

name: Lumengrid Augur
text: Information pumps like blood through vedalken society.

name: Auriok Steelshaper
text: They put their safety in his hands. He puts sharpened steel in theirs.

name: Lumengrid Sentinel
text: The vedalken order their Neurok sentinels to watch over the shores of the Quicksilver Sea, as if they know of intruders yet to come.

name: Lumengrid Warden
text: The Neurok, like the vedalken, are on a constant quest for knowledge. It is their currency, their trade, their life.

name: Neurok Spy
text: From the murk of Mephidross to the heart of Kuldotha, the vedalken send their servants forth to gather knowledge from every inch of Mirrodin.

name: Override
text: "The Knowledge Pool has all the answers—especially 'No.'"

name: Psychic Membrane
text: The vedalken always put their best thought forward.

name: Regress
text:
"Once cast, a spell can be undone. But once revealed, a secret can never again be kept."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

name: Auriok Transfixer
text: "My grandfather knew enough spells to fill a hundred scrolls. Nowadays, if a spell cannot fight the levelers, it is not even taught to our young."

name: Slith Strider
text: A slith's form and function are determined by the color of the sun under which it's born.

name: Somber Hoverguard
text: The vedalken interrogate all intruders—once the hoverguards are done with them.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Lymph, the fluid essence of blinkmoths, is prized by wizards for the rush of intellect it provides.

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Vedalken Archmage
text:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

name: Wanderguard Sentry
text: Created by the vedalken to guard Lumengrid, the drones' empty eyes look beyond the Quicksilver Sea.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Awe Strike
text: Stunned by the mere presence of the leonin kha, the nim raider quickly fell to its knees.

name: Consume Spirit
text: Mephidross changes all who dwell there, taking their lives and adding them to its own.

name: Contaminated Bond
text: This leash disciplines the master.

name: Disciple of the Vault
text: He stands in the shadow of his lord, Geth, drinking in the dark energies of the Vault.

name: Dross Prowler
text:
"I would never have believed that on a world with four suns there could exist a place so dark."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Irradiate
text: The blast ignores the cage of metal but devours the flesh inside.

name: Moriok Scavenger
text: Many go to Mephidross in search of lost riches. Most end up as part of the cache.

name: Necrogen Mists
text: Mephidross filled with roars of fury and wails of despair as the leonin fought to keep their memories from being pulled into the mists.

name: Nim Lasher
text: The rotting metal feeds the necrogen mists, and in turn the mists feed the nim.

name: Nim Shambler
text: Called "the Dross" by its inhabitants, Mephidross is home to the nim, Mirrodin's mindless, ravenous undead.

name: Nim Shrieker
text: As imps they were an annoyance. As nim they are a pestilence.

name: Relic Bane
text: A sword that has seen cowardice in battle exacts the price of honor from its wielder.

name: Slith Bloodletter
text: Goblins fear the slith, believing they are children banished from the womb of the Steel Mother, deep within Kuldotha.

name: Terror
text:
"A simple trap in a dark corner of the mind, and their nightmares catch up with them."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Leonin Abunas
text: Only leonin clerics who can survive the Razor Fields for one turning of the suns can stand in the Cave of Light.

name: Vermiculos
text: Mirrodin's artificial environment requires its own predators, scavengers, and senseless forces of nature.

name: Wall of Blood
text: Blood is thicker than mortar.

name: Wrench Mind
text: What is the sound of one head snapping?

name: Arc-Slogger
text: A shuffling sound and the smell of ozone follow the slogger as surely as its electric tail.

name: Atog
text: On Dominaria, a scavenger. On Mirrodin, a predator.

name: Detonate
text: The goblins have forty-two different words for "ow."

name: Electrostatic Bolt
text: It's hard to avoid electric shock when the entire plane is metallic.

name: Leonin Den-Guard
text: No one under the four suns can elude the watchful eye of the den-guard.

name: Fists of the Anvil
text: Gron's mind reeled with possibilities, most of which are best left unmentioned.

name: Goblin Striker
text: There's no word in the goblin language for "strategy." Then again, there's no word in the goblin language for "word."

name: Krark-Clan Grunt
text: The more weapons a goblin breaks in battle, the more respected he becomes.

name: Krark-Clan Shaman
text: "What do you mean, we're out of stuff to melt down? Give me your leg."

name: Mass Hysteria
text: The sooner you see the whites of their eyes, the sooner you'll spill the red of their blood.

name: Willie Lumpkin, Postman
text: Neither snow nor rain nor Doombots nor Galactus stays him from his appointed rounds.

name: Doom's Time Platform
text: "Time itself yields to Doom."

name: Hulkbuster Armor
text:
"You wouldn't like me when I'm angry either, Banner."
—Iron Man, Tony Stark

name: Avenge
text:
"Ultron. We would have words with thee."
—Thor

name: Panther Habit
text: No mere costume, the mantle of the Panther is not a prize to be won. It is a legacy to be earned.

name: Panther Robot
text: Immensely powerful, the Prowlers may be released only by Wakanda's royal family.

name: Unstable Molecule Suit
text:
"Clothes that won't burn off? Finally!"
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

name: The Great Mound
text: Mena Ngai, where the heaven-sent metal dwells.

name: Bastion Protector
text:
"Director Fury's not receiving visitors today."
—Agent Gabe Jones

name: Bovine Intervention
text: After the Skrull invasion of Earth was thwarted, they volunteered to do no more harm in exchange for a peaceful life.

name: Cleansing Nova
text: "I'm still Frankie Raye. Just a newer, better Frankie Raye. And I'm free!"

name: Cut a Deal
text: "Enjoy your family, Richards. And remember every time you look at your wife and daughter that Doom saved them both . . . when you could not."

name: Destroy Evil
text:
"You're not the first two-bit tyrant I've punched in the face."
—Captain America, Steve Rogers

name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
text: Everett learned from his experiences escorting Wakandan royalty. This time he brought a bigger car and an extra pair of pants.

name: Dispatch
text: There are few ways to enter Wakanda, but there are many ways to leave.

name: Divine Visitation
text:
"We have proved we can punish the guilty. But can we protect the innocent?"
—Ayo, leader of the Midnight Angels

name: Folk Hero
text: When evil arises, heroes are born.

name: Generous Gift
text:
"What am I supposed to do with this?"
—Everett K. Ross, State Department liaison

name: Loyal Retainers
text: For the priests of Wakanda, no duty is more sacred than the preparation of the heart-shaped herb.

name: Make Your Move
text:
"The Supreme Intelligence is defenseless now. I just hope we're doing the right thing."
—Black Knight, Dane Whitman

name: Martial Coup
text:
"Namor thinks himself safe beneath the waves. Show him how wrong he is."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Monologue Tax
text: Never interrupt a villain when they are making a long-winded mistake.

name: Falcon and Redwing
text: "Redwing and I are here, Cap. And we brought some reinforcements."

name: Palace Jailer
text: "I've never needed to use this. Don't make me start now."

name: Path to Exile
text:
"I ain't a man any more. I'm just . . . a monster."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: And so was born the Fantastic Four! And from that moment on, the world would never again be the same!

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"Gotta get that corn planted before the world ends again."
—Clint Barton

name: Tragic Arrogance
text:
"Here we are again, Victor. This is how it always goes."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Vibranium can absorb, and it can also reflect."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Vanquish the Horde
text:
"Invading Wakanda is the last mistake you will ever make, Doom."
—Shuri, the Black Panther

name: Arcane Denial
text:
"Your mundane wizardry will not harm the Sorcerer Supreme."
—Doctor Strange

name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
text: "You have a lovely face. Mind if I borrow it?"

name: Deep Analysis
text: One thing is sure: Reed Richards will always overthink things.

name: Hatut Zeraze Strike Force
text: Wakanda's dogs of war keep it safe from the shadows.

name: Kindred Discovery
text: It is in the nature of a hero to inspire others.

name: Propaganda
text: "Why vote for a mere mortal when you can vote for a god?"

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text:
"This was supposed to be a stealth mission. I can't take you noisy boys anywhere!"
—Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff

name: Recurring Insight
text: On trial for sparing Galactus, Reed Richards found a cosmic truth and an unexpected ally.

name: Kindred Dominance
text: When the screams subsided, only the dry slither of scales and the hiss of cold breath remained.

name: Night's Whisper
text: A carefully placed word in the right ears can be as devastating as Ragnarok itself.

name: Syphon Mind
text:
"Initiating brain wave transferal protocol."
—Ultron

name: Tombstone, Career Criminal
text: "I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"Zemo insults me by tasking me with weaklings such as you. Even together, you pose no challenge."
—Radioactive Man, Dr. Chen Lu

name: Withering Torment
text:
"Hell is real, Richards. I will show you!"
—Doctor Doom

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Now watch as I do what you could not."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner

name: Chaos Warp
text: Loki chortled. "The trap is sprung, and Loki has achieved his most brilliant jest!" Thor prepared a thunderous reply. "Ribbit ribbit!"

name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
text: Boomerang managed to assemble a squad that really wasn't all that sinister and certainly wasn't all that six.

name: Vandalblast
text:
"C'mon in. Make yourself at home. Here, let me take your things."
—Molecule Man, Owen Reece

name: Beast Within
text: Raw vibranium is hazardous to any who touch it, causing irreversible mutations.

name: Heroic Return
text: "If you knock me down, you'd better make sure you take me out."

name: Birds of Paradise
text: The migration of the cranes is believed to be a portent of coming abundance in Wakanda.

name: Conduit of Worlds
text:
"Welcome, T'Challa, to the City of the Dead."
—Bast

name: Cultivate
text:
"Don't get so caught up in the science that you forget to embrace the wonder in front of you."
—Reed Richards, to Valeria Richards

name: Farseek
text: In the race to be first to the stars, four brave explorers undertook a dangerous journey aboard an experimental spaceship, the *Marvel-1*.

name: Greater Good
text: A mantle passed on through sacrifice and love.

name: Harmonize
text: "You have done well, Child of Bast. Now rest, sit in the shade of the country you have fought for, and heal. For at least a moment, until you are called to fight again."

name: Loyal Guardian
text:
"The strength of Wakanda lies in more than its technology."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Nature's Lore
text:
"How can you build a better future without first looking to the past?"
—Queen Mother Ramonda

name: Overwhelming Stampede
text: The Black Panther is only the tip of Wakanda's spear.

name: Path of Discovery
text: After a perilous journey, the Fantastic Four beheld Attilan, the Great Refuge of the Inhumans.

name: Heroic Sacrifice
text: "We can win this, Cap! Don't try and stop me."

name: Three Visits
text:
"Three against four. I like our odds."
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

name: Bedevil
text:
"That's the thing about the Avengers and their heroics. So easy to predict. So easy to foil!"
—Grim Reaper, Eric Williams

name: Expressive Iteration
text:
"Whaddaya say Flame-Os, let's put on a real show!"
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

name: Galvanic Iteration
text: Thanks to time travel, Nathaniel Richards had many second chances to set things right.

name: Hull Breach
text:
"Kang, ol' buddy, you think you know all about time? Ben, tell Kang what time it is!"
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

name: Prowler, Clawed Thief
text: "It's nothing personal, kid. It's just money."

name: Rip Apart
text:
"If you let me play with your toys, I'm definitely gonna break them."
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

name: Taunt from the Rampart
text:
"Wotta revoltin' development."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Terminate
text: "I think, therefore I annihilate!"

name: Invisible Force Field
text: "Behind me. Now."

name: Whirlwind of Thought
text:
"I want to build a different future than the tomorrow I see on the horizon. What kind of man am I if I don't do everything I can to make that happen?"
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards

name: Arcane Signet
text: "The new ID cards are amazing! Instant communication with any Avenger worldwide, top level security clearance in over a hundred countries, and ten percent off at the cafe downstairs!" -She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"Thing Rings, do your thing."
—Ms. Thing, Darla Deering

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"We are everywhere. We are HYDRA."
—[Name redacted]

name: Arcane Signet
text:
