name: Fortified Village
text:
"Our villages are the lifeblood of Wakanda. When the common people prosper, so do we."
—Queen Mother Ramonda

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: Odin's son journeyed to the icy realm of Jotunheim, seeking to test his raging thunder against the Frost Giant horde.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text:
"Time to find out if the heads keep growing back if you burn them with fire."
—Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Glacial Fortress
text:
"Avengers Mountain is built inside of a Celestial corpse. Weird? Yes. But we go jogging in the femoral artery, so it has its perks."
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

name: Glittering Massif
text: The city skyline is full of hope. Even if the worst should befall New York, it has heroes to stand up for it.

name: The Great Mound
text: Mena Ngai, where the heaven-sent metal dwells.

name: Alicia Masters, Skilled Sculptor
text: "Ben, I've never needed eyes to see the gentleness of your soul."

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"You swabs did all right. But I got my own crew ta get back to. Ship's yers now. Sail 'er well."
—Blackbeard the Pirate, Ben Grimm

name: Irrigated Farmland
text:
"O beautiful for spacious skies, for amber waves of grain."
—"America the Beautiful"

name: Luxury Suite
text:
"Doom doesn't demand adulation! The people simply take it upon themselves to recognize greatness."
—Doctor Doom

name: Port Town
text:
"I think you'll find that our little island will make an ideal base for your Quinjets!"
—Stingray, Walter Newell

name: Prairie Stream
text:
"Fetch, Jeff! Good boy, Jeff! No, don't bite that man's hand off, Jeff!"
—Gwenpool

name: Radiant Summit
text: The Sentry's Watchtower lay just beyond sight for decades, until his memory returned.

name: Razorverge Thicket
text: Wakanda's true nature remained hidden for centuries, disguised from the eyes of outsiders by their own blind assumptions.

name: Rejuvenating Springs
text: Time with family cures many ills.

name: Rootbound Crag
text:
"I been ta space, a buncha dimensions 'n' universes . . . and I always end up right back here on Yancy Street."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Scattered Groves
text:
"Just because you have ravaged your natural resources and paved over your forests, do not think we have made the same mistake."
—King T'Chaka, to the United Nations

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: The remnants of titanic clashes, immortalized by the desert sands.

name: Scorched Geyser
text:
"Greatest city on Earth, I'm telling youse. Next month, it'll be like it never happened."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: Deep within Subterranea dwell the fearsome Lava Men, beings made of living magma.

name: Sodden Verdure
text:
"Sheesh. Ya call a place Monster Isle and wotta ya expect? It's not gonna be full a' petunias and bunny bun buns."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Spectator Seating
text:
"Did you see that? Did you see that? The Wasp waved at *me*!"
—Kamala Khan

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"I have witnessed the creation of all life on this world and its inevitable end. There is nothing in between to challenge one such as me."
—Kang the Conqueror

name: Sungrass Prairie
text:
"We learn many lessons from nature, my son. See how the panther patiently stalks the herd through the tall grass, waiting for the right moment to strike?"
—King T'Chaka, to his young son T'Challa

name: Sunken Hollow
text: There are regions of Subterranea where even the Moloids dare not tread, lest they never return. Or worse, lest they do.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text:
"Birnin Zana is not a cold and dead city like those of other nations. Our city lives. It *thrives*."
—Queen Mother Ramonda

name: Captain America, Team Leader
text: "Avengers assemble!"

name: Firebird, Blazing Ranger
text: She streaks across the desert sky in search of those who would do evil.

name: Throne of the High City
text: In times of trouble, Wakandans still look to the throne for reassurance.

name: Fall to Earth
text:
"No longer art thou God of Thunder! Nor shall Mjölnir serve thee now!"
—Odin, to Thor

name: Hawkeye, Clint Barton
text: "What can you do with arrows? A whole lot."

name: Franklin Richards, Ascendant
text: All alone in his room, a boy created a baby universe.

name: Mockingbird, Bobbi Morse
text: "How did I get here? I'm not rich. Not a mutant. Not a natural. I just try harder."

name: Peggy Carter, Secret Agent
text: "A lot of people told me I could never do this work. I've been proving those people wrong my whole life."

name: Valkyrior Skyrider
text: For warriors of Asgard, there can be no more welcome sight than the Valkyries entering the fray atop their noble steeds.

name: Wondrous Revival
text:
"You're going to have to do better than just killing me."
—Wonder Man, Simon Williams

name: A.I.M. Bot
text: "Thank you for visiting the Advanced Idea Mechanics laboratory. You will now be eradicated. Goodbye!"

name: Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper
text: "Join me, run, or die. The choice is yours."

name: Graviton, Fundamental Force
text: "I don't think you understand the gravity of the situation. Let me show you!"

name: Repulsor Bots
text:
"I can't be everywhere at once, but they can."
—Iron Man, Tony Stark

name: Stark's Ingenuity
text: "Every detail matters. It's *my* life on the line in this thing."

name: Boomerang, Blade Flinger
text: "I wouldn't want to catch these. They're sharp, you know?"

name: Doom's Servo-Guards
text:
"My robot army stands guard night and day! For no one knows what is best for you—except your mighty sovereign!"
—Doctor Doom

name: Glamorous Grapplers
text: "Let's see if you still believe wrestling is all fake once we're through with you."

name: Infernal Rebirth
text:
"Dormammu—hear me now! Grant me the strength of the Dark Dimension."
—The Hood, Parker Robbins

name: Minotaur, Roxxon CEO
text: "When I became CEO, Roxxon was stepping up their renewable energy program. I took us in the opposite direction. Weaponry."

name: Furious Strength
text:
"Time for my closing argument!"
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

name: Happy Hogan, Dauntless Driver
text: "Traffic is a little heavy this morning, Tony, but we'll get you there on time."

name: Marvelous Melee
text: "One giant knuckle sandwich, comin' right up!"

name: Quicksilver, Pietro Maximoff
text: "I must be going now. This has all been extraordinarily tedious."

name: She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
text: "Consider yourselves served."

name: Smashing Spree
text: "Puny humans! Still you get in my way!? That just makes me mad. And the madder I get . . . the stronger I am!"

name: Wiccan, Young Avenger
text: "Possibility is limited only by imagination."

name: The Fabulous Frog-Man
text: "Shove off, Spider-Man! Step aside, Torch! There's a new Super Hero in town! I'm gonna make Dad so proud."

name: Loki's Scepter
text: "Nothing is safe from me. Not even your mind."

name: Feral Ferocity
text: "The thoughts in my head, they go all animal. Eyesight turns blood red until nothing of me is left."

name: Flora Colossus
text:
"You mean there was a *whole planet* of Groots out there?"
—Rocket Raccoon

name: Moon-Boy, Dino Rider
text: "To have such a brother is to be filled with pride!"

name: Thing Swing
text: "Nobody's catchin' me without a fight!"

name: Warriors of Wakanda
text: The Five Tribes are not without internal strife. But to outside invaders, they show only one face: Wakanda.

name: Atlas, Sizable Stooge
text: "I wish you guys would fire your weapons a little down and to the left. I've got an itch under my ribs like you wouldn't believe!"

name: Brawn, Amadeus Cho
text: "I'm totally awesome!"

name: Iron Lad, Young Avenger
text: "I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."

name: Nova Flame
text: The Human Torch channels every iota of his power into a single burst—a burst that rivals the energies of an exploding star!

name: Patriot, Young Avenger
text: "I wear this uniform out of respect for Captain America . . . Isaiah Bradley, my grandfather."

name: Stature, Young Avenger
text: "Sorry, Mom! We have insurance, right?"

name: War Machine, James Rhodes
text: "Stay down, there's a hundred more where that came from."

name: Team Transmitter
text: No matter where they are or what they're doing, when the signal activates, the Avengers assemble.

name: Victor Mancha, Runaway
text:
"Truly, you are my greatest creation."
—Ultron

name: Pacifism
text:
"You wish to get up, brother? It is very simple! All you have to do is be worthy!"
—Thor

name: Doom Blade
text: "Doom has found diversion in the thrust and parry of our storied struggle. But you have fallen behind, Richards. Now you shall fall asunder!"

name: Tombstone, Career Criminal
text: "I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

name: Thriving Bluff
text: Throughout the ages Mount Wundagore has yielded wonders, supernatural and scientific, sacred and profane.

name: Thriving Grove
text: A place of perfect calm in a raging world.

name: Photon, Mighty Marvel
text: "I believe I can shed some light on this situation."

name: Thriving Heath
text:
"Braddock Manor is fraught with memories, both joyous and heartbreaking."
—Captain Britain, Brian Braddock

name: Thriving Isle
text: A strange mountain that rises from the surface of the sea like an unearthly, grotesque face.

name: Thriving Moor
text: As the Quinjet soars overhead, something stirs in the swamp below, roused by the strong wills of the heroes on board.

name: Amazing Spider-Girl
text:
"I've got to do this Spider-thing no matter what pain or misery awaits me—this is a Spider-Girl World!"
—Spider-Girl, Mayday Parker

name: Blur of Heroism
text:
"I haven't always been the best hero. But I've always been the fastest!"
—Blur, Stanley Stewart

name: Bucky Barnes, Eager Ally
text: "Yes sir, Cap! I won't let you down."

name: Falcon, Joaquin Torres
text: "Don't be jealous if he likes me better, Sam. Redwing is like, my brother now. Sort of."

name: Foggy Nelson, On Retainer
text: "Matt! I think I found our exculpatory . . . Matt? Where does he get off to?"

name: General Thunderbolt Ross
text: "Those costumed clowns had their chance. Now it's our turn."

name: Hawkeye, Bowslinger
text: "Go out, fight hard, screw up. Save the world a few times . . . Just keep taking the shots, okay?"

name: The Howling Commandos
text:
"We've been fightin' this or that war our whole lives. And yeah, war is hell, but spend enough time in hell and you can fight like the devil."
—Dum Dum Dugan

name: Hyperion, Supreme Hero
text: "Truth without compromise. Thought without error. All things for the betterment of the whole."

name: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria
text: "Kneel before Doom."

name: She-Hulk, Wallbreaker
text: "Knock knock!"

name: Photon, Lady of Light
text: In the darkest times, she shines brightest.

name: Quantum Entanglement
text:
"Mar-Vell is part of me now. Like I am of him."
—Rick Jones

name: Secure Detention
text: "Enjoy your stay, Zemo. The quiet should help you ponder the consequences of your actions."

name: Strategic Intervention
text:
"Tell Fury the intelligence checked out and we're taking out the trash now. This HYDRA cell didn't stand a chance."
—Phil Coulson, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Ultimate Alliance
text:
"When you said 'no man can equal you'? You had to know that was just begging for Jen to hit you."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Wakandan Shield Guard
text: "Hail Wakanda! Hail Damisa-Sarki!"

name: Wall Off
text: "It's the first ship back to Skrullos, gentlemen. There will be no invasion today."

name: Zarda, the Power Princess
text: "We Utopians don't just dream of a better world, we make the world better."

name: Atlantean Skirmisher
text: "Take away your air, and you're nothing but food for the crabs."

name: Collector's Case
text:
"Hardly the jewel of my collection. Yet even the most absurd of specimens has its place."
—The Collector

name: Daughter of the Deep
text:
"Our kingdom stretches to every corner of the planet. We are her true rulers."
—Princess Fen

name: Dismissive Denial
text: "To quote the *real* Thor: 'I say thee nay.'"

name: Titania, Proud Pummeler
text: "I do my best talking with my fists."

name: Fantastic Bounce
text:
"I don't know if I'd call that 'an equal and opposite reaction,' but it sure was fun to watch!"
—Invisible Woman, Sue Storm

name: Flying Drone
text:
"It's no Redwing, but it'll do."
—Captain America, Sam Wilson

name: Happy Hogan, Bodyguard
text: "Move along folks. Move along."

name: Imperial Cosmographer
text: "The Supreme Intelligence guides our empire. It requires a constant infusion of knowledge."

name: Impossible Man
text: "Everyone knows we Poppupians can turn ourselves into anything, just by thinking of it!"

name: Iron Man, Bleeding Edge
text: "You haven't seen *anything* yet!"

name: Living Lies of Loki
text:
"Haha! My thickheaded brother, will you never learn?"
—Loki

name: Loki, Lord of Misrule
text: "What a grim place Asgard would be without me. Absent chaos, there is but tedium."

name: Multiversal Recruitment
text: "We are Kang. We shall conquer."

name: War Machine, Avenging Arsenal
text: There's always room for a little more firepower.

name: Mysterio's Mirage
text: "I do not need to control reality when I can manipulate your perception of it. You see what I want you to see."

name: Reed Richards, Smartest Man
text: "I believe that if you look hard enough, everything has an answer."

name: Shi'ar Soldier
text: "For the Majestrix! For Chandilar!"

name: Shipwreck Patrol
text: "The currents are treacherous here, and we know them all."

name: Ancestral Communion
text:
"I am always here, my son. We all are."
—King T'Chaka

name: Spaceshift
text: "My quest takes me through strange myriad dimensions. For a lesser being this would be a fatal endeavor, but Thanos endures."

name: Timeline Inquiry
text: At the Time Variance Authority, Chronomonitors ceaselessly scan existence for temporal misconduct.

name: Victor Timely, Wily Tycoon
text: "No time like the present. No present like the future."

name: Virtual Assistant
text: "This new suit has some interesting possibilities, Mister Stark."

name: Vision, Spectral Synthezoid
text: "If I am to be called 'The Vision,' is it not logical for me to look the part? Spectral . . . unearthly . . ."

name: Vulture, Feathered Fiend
text: "A simple plan. If you can fly."

name: Wasp, Shrinking Savior
text: "I guess someone needs a little more negative reinforcement."

name: Armed Assailant
text:
"No matter where you flee, I shall find you and destroy you!"
—Melter, Bruno Horgan

name: Black Widow, Deadly Hunter
text: "Does the spider offer mercy to the fly?"

name: Bob, Reluctant HYDRA Agent
text: "I mainly joined up for the benefits . . ."

name: Fight for the Throne
text:
"Let it end where it began, at Warrior Falls."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Citizen V, Helmut Zemo
text: "I have always been the savior of the human race. I'm simply wearing a more acceptable mask."

name: Count Nefaria
text: "If I already possess so much, what more could I want? Why, the rest of it, of course!"

name: Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil
text: "My Masters of Evil is a *for-profit* organization, not a vendetta."

name: Doctor Doom, Unrivaled
text: "Those who dare stand against Doom do not stand for long!"

name: Fixer, Techno Terror
text: "You've got a problem? I'm The Fixer. I fix things. It's what I do."

name: Hammerhead, Maggia Boss
text: "This city is wide open, just itching for someone to come along and take it."

name: MACH-1, Swooping Scoundrel
text: He's an ace pilot and fighter jet, all in one.

name: Minion Missile
text: "You're fired!"

name: Radioactive Man
text: "Radiation is my plaything—but now it will become your doom!"

name: Sadistic Slash
text: "Let's see some of that famously radioactive blood, Spider-Man!"

name: Titanium Man
text: "My armor was created with but one thought in mind . . . to smash Iron Man!"

name: Undead Hand Ninja
text: Once the Hand has its hooks in you, there is no escape. Not even in death.

name: Viper, Cruel Conspirator
text: "Before unleashing my master plan, I will pay back those few animals who dared defy me in the past."

name: Void Helix
text:
"Something good always comes out of something evil in the long run. It's a messy thing."
—The Void

name: Voltaic Whip
text: "There will be no justice for Tony Stark. Only vengeance, dispensed with his own tools of destruction."

name: White Widow, Yelena Belova
text: "Assassinations only happen to important people. It's a compliment!"

name: Asgardian Inspiration
text: "Mayhaps you've fought a Thor, but you've never fought this Thor."

name: Medusa, Inhuman Queen
text: "I speak for Black Bolt. We will not stand for those who would threaten our Terrigen and the safety of our people."

name: Bionic Blow
text: "Spider-Man pulls his punches. I don't."

name: Chase Stein, Runaway
text: The Steins lamented their son didn't inherit their genius. Chase was just glad he didn't inherit their evil.

name: Contract Hero
text: "Paladin always gets his man."

name: Elektra, Femme Fatale
text: "To look upon me . . . is to see the end of life."

name: Hulkling, Young Avenger
text: "We're never alone. That's the deal. Forever."

name: Inspired Fire
text: "You're about to learn something about The Human Torch . . . I'm just too hot to handle!"

name: Intrepid Ace
text:
"I went the day I turned eighteen. I wanted to fly. More than anything in the world."
—Colonel Carol Danvers

name: Karolina Dean, Runaway
text: "I'm not hiding who I am anymore."

name: Lady Spider, Maybelle Reilly
text: "I built the suit with car parts. Finally getting to put my three university degrees to good use."

name: Luke Cage, Hero for Hire
text: "Sweet Christmas!"

name: Mjölnir's Might
text: "Foul villain! Have at thee and feel the might of Mjölnir!"

name: Molly Hayes, Runaway
text: "I *can too* help! Don't leave me in the Leapfrog!"

name: W'Kabi, Shield of the Nation
text: "Direct me to that which you wish stomped flat. It shall be done."

name: Pick Up the Pace
text:
"Care for a little race, Tommy?"
—Quicksilver, Pietro Maximoff

name: Quinjet Technician
text:
"We're powered up here, folks. And I added a few toys I think you're really going to like."
—Fabian Stankiewicz

name: Spider-Man, New Champion
text: "I'm not an Avenger. I'm not Peter. I'm just a kid in a mask doing the best I can. But I'll never give up on anyone that needs me. I'm Miles Morales. And I'm Spider-Man."

name: Stick, Fearless Mentor
text: "Every strength was a weakness once. Don't you ever forget it."

name: The Vision and Scarlet Witch
text: No matter how many times they are disassembled, teleported, or possessed, their love always brings them back together.

name: Wanda's Vision
text:
"I made a family, just like everyone else."
—Scarlet Witch, Wanda Maximoff

name: Whirlwind, Killer Cyclone
text: "The wind is unstoppable. Just like me!"

name: Wakanda Forever!
text: "Each of us is strong. Together, we are unbreakable."

name: The Whizzer, Classic Speedster
text: In the Golden Age, he fought alongside the mightiest heroes in the All-Winners Squad. He's slowed down since then but, as is the case with many heroes, retirement didn't quite take.

name: Advancing the Spirit
text: "I am the old ways from which we came. I am here because the universe demanded it."

name: Big Bertha
text: "I've got a body that can stop traffic!"

name: Black Tom Cassidy
text: "I talk to the dirt and the dirt talks back. And you listen to Black Tom—the dirt knows everything."

name: Bushmaster, Coiled Henchman
text: "Lost my limbs in an accident. Roxxon labs put me back together as a snake. Zemo offers me a job . . . I go where I'm wanted."

name: Colossus, Steel Stalwart
text: "Behind me comrades! Use my armored body as a shield!"

name: Devil Dinosaur
text:
"His kind was never known to run from danger."
—Moon-Boy

name: Zuri, Warrior of Wakanda
text: Zuri is a veteran of T'Chaka's army and a mentor to his son. He is one of the few entrusted to carry the spear of Bashenga, the founder of the Panther tribe.

name: Doorman
text: "No door? No problem!"

name: Flatman
text: "Name's Flatman. I'm the deputy leader of the Great Lakes Avengers! And I need answers!"

name: Giant-Man, Gargantuan Genius
text: "I did it, Jan! Hank Pym will be overlooked no more!"

name: Hit-Monkey
text:
"He's a hitman. Who's a monkey. You don't believe me. Look around you, dude—he's real!"
—Deadpool, Wade Wilson

name: Hulk, Strongest There Is
text: The world seems to stand still, trembling on the brink of infinity, as his ear-splitting scream fills the air!

name: Lucky the Pizza Dog
text:
"Who's a good boy?"
—Hawkeye, Clint Barton

name: Mister Immortal
text: Craig Hollis couldn't stay dead even if he wanted to.

name: Ant-Man, Elusive Avenger
text:
"Break into vaults? Very 'old me.' Slip into vaults through subatomic gaps? Now we're talking."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang

name: Rhino, Terrible Trampler
text: "Gettin' in and gettin' out ain't a problem. You want the place to stay standing? No promises there."

name: Storm, Shaker of Skies
text: "While storms are pliable things . . . at heart, they are indomitable."

name: Tippy-Toe, Terrific Partner
text: Squirrel Girl's bravest and bestest friend.

name: Voracious Brood
text: "We are Brood. And soon you will be too."

name: White Tiger, Amulet Keeper
text: "Now is the hour of light! This is the time . . . of the White Tiger!"

name: Wolverine, Claws Out
text: "Okay, suckers—you've taken your best shot! Now it's my turn!"

name: X-23, Deadly Weapon
text: Born in a lab. Raised to be a weapon. Determined to be so much more.

name: Archnemesis
text: Rivals at the start, and rivals to the end.

name: Astonishing Spider-Man
text: "Watch out! Friendly neighborhood Spider-Man coming through!"

name: Iceman and Firestar
text:
"Aren't my friends amazing?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Marvel Boy, Noh-Varr
text: "I come from a dimension of universal enlightenment and transcendental peace. Do you have any idea how boring that is?"

name: Shuri, Vibranium Technologist
text: "Vibranium is the heart of Wakanda, and I have always been able to feel that heartbeat."

name: Tiger Shark, Abyssal Hunter
text: "The sea shall acknowledge a new master . . . a new tyranny!"

name: Wakandan Tusker
text:
"Elephants have worn this armor since ancient times, defending Wakanda as bravely as any warrior."
—Zuri, warrior of Wakanda

name: Daily Bugle Newspaper
text:
"How can the public be sure there wasn't any pineapple on there as well?"
—J. Jonah Jameson

name: Bast, Panther Goddess
text: "Will you prove worthy of my blessing?"

name: Iron Suitcase
text: Iron Man always has a spare suit on hand.

name: Machine Man, Model X-51
text: "They made me in their own image, then condemned me to death for being too human."

name: Swordsman's Steel
text: "How perfectly it sings as it slices! Encore!"

name: Fogwell's Gym
text:
"You trained here, Father. You trained and made me promise to stay away. I came here anyway. I became a fighter just like you. Endless hours. On the ropes. At the bag."
—Matt Murdock

name: Thor, Asgard's Avenger
text: "Flee, villain! For mine is the power of the very lightning itself!"

name: Virtuous Variant
text:
"I'm a Spider-Man from the future. No time to explain, but I'm here to save the world."
—Spider-Man, Max Borne

name: Ant-Man's Air Force
text:
"Cavalry incoming! Swat them if you dare!"
—Ant-Man, Hank Pym

name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
text: The reach of Atlantis travels far beyond the waves.

name: TVA Bureaucrat
text:
"Time is chaos. We supply order."
—Mobius M. Mobius

name: Songbird, Sonic Screamer
text: "Now, will you fellas stay down? Or are you begging for an encore?"

name: Extremis Elite
text: In the arms race to recreate the Super-Soldier Serum, something far more dangerous was let loose on the world.

name: Sif's Spearmaster
text:
"Strike now for honor! For glory! For Asgard!"
—Sif

name: Wolfsbane, Highland Hero
text: "Life's so much simpler as a wolf. Sometimes I wish I could stay that way forever."

name: Aunt May
text: "I cooked your favorite breakfast, Petey—wheatcakes!"

name: City Pigeon
text:
"Aw, that was my lunch!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Black Widow, Agile Avenger
text: "Hello there. Expecting someone else?"

name: Flash Thompson, Spider-Fan
text:
"No one cares about your Spider-Man obsession, Flash."
—Liz Allan

name: MJ, Rising Star
text: "Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital*."

name: Selfless Police Captain
text:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

name: Spectacular Tactics
text:
"Not bad, kid, but you've got a lot to learn."
—Spider-Woman, Jessica Drew

name: Spider-Man, Web-Slinger
text: "Nothing like a little crimefighting before class."

name: Spider-UK
text: "Spiders across the Multiverse are dying. I must keep them safe."

name: Starling, Aerial Ally
text:
"Aaaah! Is this what it's like for people I swing around? I'm gonna throw up!"
—Spider-Man, Miles Morales

name: Sudden Strike
text: Sometimes, one decisive blow is all it takes to turn a fight around.

name: Captain Marvel, Apex Avenger
text: Higher. Further. Faster. More.

name: Thwip!
text: "Yes! This is what being Spider-Man is all about! Swinging through the sky—a New York sky—patrolling the city. Every moment a chance to make a difference. To fight the good fight."

name: Wild Pack Squad
text: Silver Sable doesn't accept second best.

name: Doc Ock, Sinister Scientist
text: "You dared to mock me before. Where are your taunts *now*, Spider-Man?"

name: Doc Ock's Henchmen
text: "Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!"

name: Flying Octobot
text:
"How many helping hands do you need, Doc?"
—Spider-Man

name: Robotics Mastery
text: Mendel Stromm didn't just seek revenge. He engineered it.

name: Think Twice
text:
"You have long tried to eliminate me from your timeline, Kang. And yet I remain. We are forever bound. We are one."
—Immortus

name: Time Warp
text:
"Victory is inevitable. I have all the time in the world."
—Kang the Conqueror

name: Unstable Experiment
text:
"The solution is turning green! But . . . why? What does it mean?"
—Norman Osborn

name: Cosmic Crucible
text: "We ignored the risks and the cosmic rays tore through our ship. That's how it all began."

name: Whoosh!
text: "Sorry, I have no time for banter today."

name: Common Crook
text:
"Just taking that money out for a walk?"
—Spider-Man

name: Dark Ritual
text: "Behold! The most arcane powers of the multiverse are mere tools in service of Doom's ambition."

name: Deadly Dispute
text:
"Ain't you heard a' honor among thieves?"
—Tombstone, to Anaconda

name: Doomfall
text: "Thus falls Doom? No. No! I deny you, Death! Victor von Doom must not die!"

name: Doomsday
text: "Before this day is ended, all shall grovel helplessly at my feet!"

name: Inner Demons Gangsters
text:
"Inner Demons? Even for a guy named Mister Negative, that's a bit on the nose."
—Spider-Man

name: The Spot's Portal
text:
"You've been working too hard, Spider-Man. I think you deserve a little vacation somewhere you won't be so . . . in the way."
—The Spot, Johnathon Ohnn

name: Swarm, Being of Bees
text:
"Evil never dies. It just becomes bees."
—Swarm, Fritz von Meyer

name: Crystal, Inhuman Princess
text: "Attilan can't stay hidden forever. It's time we showed them how fantastic we are."

name: Venom, Evil Unleashed
text: "We like seeing fear in our victim's eyes."

name: Venomized Cat
text: New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.

name: Big Score
text: "Bank robbery? In Harlem? On a Sunday? You must be outta your mind."

name: Grapeshot
text: As the mother rewrites the fabric of reality, so too does the son.

name: Hobgoblin, Mantled Marauder
text:
"Alrighty, let's see who's behind the mask this time. Kingsley, is that you?"
—Spider-Man

name: Lightning Bolt
text: "I am the god of thunder, the lord of the savage lightning, and the very skies must tremble when speaks The Mighty Thor!"

name: Masked Meower
text: Neither criminals nor veterinarians had much luck pinning down the uncatchable Spider-Cat.

name: Romantic Rendezvous
text:
"Face it, tiger. You just hit the jackpot!"
—Mary Jane Watson

name: Shock
text: If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.

name: Director Nick Fury
text: "All the heroes are out there fighting their own battles. Someone has to connect the dots."

name: Stegron the Dinosaur Man
text: "It isss my intention to return the dinosaur to hisss rightful place as master of thisss earth."

name: Taxi Driver
text: "I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

name: Unlucky Witness
text:
"I should have known you'd be involved in this somehow, Turk."
—Daredevil, Matt Murdock

name: Wisecrack
text: "I support your right to bear arms, Grizzly, but this is getting ridiculous."

name: Commune with Dinosaurs
text: "Ssstegron reignsss sssupreme!"

name: Farseek
text: In the race to be first to the stars, four brave explorers undertook a dangerous journey aboard an experimental spaceship, the *Marvel-1*.

name: Lurking Lizards
text: "The ssserum . . . Connorsss . . . what have you done to usss?!"

name: Spider-Rex, Daring Dino
text: On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

name: Terrific Team-Up
text:
"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Gallant Citizen
text:
"People cheer for that webbed menace. They should be cheering for my son."
—J. Jonah Jameson

name: Mob Lookout
text:
"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead

name: Pumpkin Bombardment
text:
"Happy Halloween, Spider-Man!"
—Green Goblin, Norman Osborn

name: Rhino's Rampage
text: Spider-Man wasn't looking to fight, but that was all Rhino wanted.

name: Eerie Gravestone
text:
"You've murdered a mask, but you haven't murdered a man."
—Peter Parker

name: Spider-Mobile
text: With Johnny Storm's help, Spider-Man took the all-terrain vehicle to the next level.

name: Savage Lands
text:
"The greatest hunter can go from predator to prey here in a single heartbeat."
—Ka-Zar

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"This is . . . I can't explain it. The opposite of all we know. A negative zone."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards

name: Black Panther, Claws of Bast
text: "As guardian of Wakanda, I would not ask my people to risk danger in my stead."

name: First Family
text:
"Matchstick, you're on toast. Suzie's got the waffles. Stretch, keep that OJ coming. The kids and I will stand here and look pretty."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Iron Man, Modern Marvel
text: "Technology is iterative. I'm always better than ever."

name: Hulk, Brutal Brawler
text: "Puny Banner thinks he can keep me locked away! I want to be free!"

name: Ant-Man, Scott Lang
text: "Most times, they don't look down until it's too late."

name: Captain's Defense
text: "You're safe with me!"

name: The Falcon, Sam Wilson
text: "You've never seen a falcon with moves like these!"

name: Hawkeye, Clint Barton
text: "What can you do with arrows? A whole lot."

name: Hawkeye's Shot
text: "Keep 'em coming! I've got a full quiver and nowhere else to be!"

name: Hawkeye, Avenging Archer
text: "If I miss, it means I've been fooling myself this whole time. So I don't."

name: Hero in Training
text:
"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow."
—Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder

name: Mandroid Squadron
text: The Avengers have extraordinary powers and abilities. Mandroid armor lets S.H.I.E.L.D. even the score.

name: Mockingbird, Bobbi Morse
text: "How did I get here? I'm not rich. Not a mutant. Not a natural. I just try harder."

name: Soldier On
text: "Everything I've endured, everything I've trained for, has brought me here. You think I'll give up now?"

name: The Wasp, Janet Van Dyne
text: "Careful, wasps are known to sting."

name: Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes
text: "Hey Steve, sorry for giving you the cold shoulder all those years I was a brainwashed killing machine."

name: Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff
text: "They tell me now that I'm an Avenger I can't kill anyone. You want to put that to the test?"

name: Concentrated Fire
text: "Big target, big firepower. Don't hold back!" Tony shouted. "Copy that. I never do," James calmly replied.

name: Crimson Operative
text:
"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive."
—Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin

name: Happy Hogan, Dauntless Driver
text: "Traffic is a little heavy this morning, Tony, but we'll get you there on time."

name: Hulk, Bruce Banner
text: "Hulk smash!"

name: Power Boost
text: Daredevil could feel his enemies fall back as the Scarlet Witch's energy surged around him. He didn't give them time to retreat.

name: Quicksilver, Pietro Maximoff
text: "I must be going now. This has all been extraordinarily tedious."

name: Repulsor Rays
text:
"Negotiations have failed. Time to take matters into my own hands."
—Iron Man, Tony Stark

name: Scarlet Witch, Wanda Maximoff
text: "Reality is not solid or immutable. It is but a slightly stable raft, tossing upon a sea of chaos."

name: Smashing Spree
text: "Puny humans! Still you get in my way!? That just makes me mad. And the madder I get . . . the stronger I am!"

name: Spider-Man, Hometown Hero
text: "Anyone who threatens NYC has to go through me."

name: Love on the Battlefield
text: "They want to tear us apart, Vizh. We won't let them. We can't."

name: Spider-Gwen, Free Spirit
text: At the edge of the Spider-Verse, a Gwen Stacy becomes a hero.

name: Captain America, Team Leader
text: "Avengers assemble!"

name: Namor, Atlantean King
text: "IMPERIUS REX!"

name: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria
text: "Kneel before Doom."

name: Thor, Asgard's Avenger
text: "Flee, villain! For mine is the power of the very lightning itself!"

name: Okoye, Mighty and Adored
text: "My king is merciful. I am not."

name: Molecule Man
text: "I now control every molecule in the universe and even beyond!"

name: Quicksilver, Speedster
text: "Tiresome, this. Next time, try to keep up."

name: Red Ghost, Intangible Genius
text: "To me, my Super Apes!"

name: Scarlet Witch, Chaotic Avenger
text: "Reality is what I make of it."

name: Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings
text: "The rings are heavy with responsibility, but I don't mind. I can handle the weight."

name: Shuri, the Black Panther
text: "Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."

name: T'Chaka, Venerable King
text: "I am king of Wakanda. A line unbroken. A crown unconquered."

name: Agent 13, Sharon Carter
text: "Coulson, I'm in, but the intel was wrong. No, no extraction. This is bigger than we thought!"

name: Captain America, Wings of Freedom
text:
"Our worst day is only where we start from. Where we *rise* from."
—Captain America, Sam Wilson

name: HYDRA Infiltration
text: "HYDRA has spread its tentacles throughout all levels of society. The only question is, where will we strike next?"

name: HYDRA Troopers
text: Evil never lacks foot soldiers to do its will.

name: Kingpin's Enforcers
text: "Mister Fisk heard that you have an issue with the way he does business. We've come to resolve this dispute."

name: Klaw, Sonic Subjugator
text: "Listen to the sound of death. Hear the sound of your own cells exploding."

name: The Masters of Evil
text:
"You have made many enemies, Avengers. And your enemies have made many friends."
—Baron Zemo

name: Moonstone, Harsh Mistress
text: "Let me show you the dark side of the moon."

name: Ninja of the Hand
text:
"They are ruthless killers. I was one of them."
—Elektra Natchios

name: Project Deathlok Soldier
text: "ENERGY OUTPUT AT 97.003%. WAKE UP, DEATHLOK UNIT. REPEAT: WAKE UP."

name: Red Room Recruit
text:
"The Red Room doesn't grade on a curve. Only the deadliest make it out."
—Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff

name: Swordsman, Sharp Scoundrel
text: "None can match me with the blade!"

name: Thunderbolts Conspiracy
text: Justice, like lightning.

name: Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born
text: "I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"

name: Visions of Villainy
text: As Thanos gazed into the cosmic vortex of the Infinity Well, he beheld the means to serve Death all the better.

name: Whiplash, Vengeful Engineer
text: "Wrap yourself in whatever armor you wish. I will shred you apart."

name: Yellowjacket, Heartless Marauder
text: "They won't see me, but they'll certainly feel my sting."

name: Blazing Crescendo
text: "So much for diplomacy."

name: Crimson Operative
text:
"I think you will find the latest version of my armor particularly impressive."
—Crimson Dynamo, Dimitri Bukharin

name: Evil's Thrall
text:
"Stay your fists, Rand. You are not well!"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Fin Fang Foom
text: His limbs shatter mountains. His back scrapes the sun.

name: Colleen Wing, Street Samurai
text: "This sword is my heritage. I respect it by having the skill to wield it."

name: Hawkeye, Young Avenger
text:
"Not bad for a girl with no superpowers, huh?"
—Hawkeye, Kate Bishop

name: Hex Magic
text: At the Scarlet Witch's touch, probabilities shift and the impossible becomes real.

name: Hire a Crew
text: "You want subtle, you call the other guys. We're the Wrecking Crew."

name: HYDRA Assault Robot
text: "I have come for you, Nick Fury!"

name: Iron Fist, Living Weapon
text: Danny Rand plunged his fists into the molten heart of the dragon, again and again, until they glowed and smoldered like hot iron.

name: Jessica Jones, Private Eye
text: "I would trade all my powers for a fresh pot of hot coffee right now."

name: Crowd of True Believers
text: Being a hero is easy when you know who you're fighting for.

name: K'un-Lun Warrior
text:
"The old men of K'un-Lun were afraid to train me. Now I am their last line of defense."
—Sparrow, Thunderer of K'un-Lun

name: Kree Sentinel
text: "The Supreme Intelligence claims this planet."

name: Lightning Strike
text: Invoking Thor's wrath is a mistake few villains are stupid enough—or sturdy enough—to make twice.

name: Machinesmith Automaton
text:
"Every day, I find new ways to improve upon my designs. This is the inherent superiority of metal over flesh and blood."
—Machinesmith, Samuel Saxon

name: Misty Knight, Hero for Hire
text: "Hello, hero. This is Control. Are you for hire tonight?"

name: Photon Blast Barrage
text:
"Try to outrun light, suckers."
—Photon, Monica Rambeau

name: Red Hulk
text: To finally defeat the Hulk, General "Thunderbolt" Ross became what he hated most.

name: Helicarrier Strike
text: "Light 'em up, people!"

name: Repulsor Blast
text: "Mind if I cut in?"

name: The Scarlet Witch
text: "Some are bound by the whims of chaos, but I found freedom in its endless possibility."

name: Speed, Young Avenger
text: "Wait? Sorry, not in my vocabulary."

name: Stark Industries Executive
text:
"Tony's ideas are . . . expensive. Someone has to make sure we can put them into practice."
—Pepper Potts

name: Team Tactics
text: "Most of my trick arrows don't talk this much."

name: Truck Toss
text:
"NO! I LOVE TACOS!"
—Hulk

name: Vision of Love
text: Love transcends all barriers.

name: Volcanic Villain
text:
"Get out of my way or get burned."
—Volcana, Marsha Rosenberg

name: Hero in Training
text:
"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow."
—Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder

name: Ant-Man's Army
text: "C'mon girls, we're not here for snacks. Okay, maybe just one."

name: Call Damage Control
text: When the heroes clock out, they clock in.

name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
text: "Go ahead, Bruce. Let out your feelings."

name: Epic Fight
text:
"You think being big is going to help you? Bub, all that does is make you easier to hit."
—Wolverine

name: Giant Growth
text: "Cap called for Giant-Man, not Ant-Man. Something big must be going down."

name: Guerrilla Gorilla
text:
"I thought you all were globe-trotting Super Hero types. You act like you've never seen a talking gorilla before."
—Gorilla-Man, Ken Hale

name: Invisible Woman, Sue Storm
text: "I'll hold down the fort while you guys bicker."

name: Hellcat, Undying Vigilante
text: "I've been to hell and back. You punks barely even register."

name: Hercules, Prince of Power
text: "No need to avert your eyes, mortal admirers! Nay, I say feast them!"

name: Heroic Feast
text: The Thing belched. "I told youse guys. Yancy Street has the best sandwiches."

name: Hulkling, Burgeoning Bruiser
text: "We all named ourselves after the original Avengers. I picked the Hulk. Be honest. Wouldn't you?"

name: Knight of Wundagore
text:
"Well struck, Lord Gator! Let our atomic steeds carry us to victory!"
—Lord Tyger

name: Mister Hyde, Monster Within
text:
"I read what I wanted to read and became what I wanted to become."
—Dr. Calvin Zabo

name: Mole Man, Moloid Master
text: "Forward, my mindless minions! To the surface, to take what's ours!"

name: Pet Avengers
text:
"Lockheed! Hairball! Lockjaw! Redwing! To me!"
—Throg

name: Powerful Broker
text: "Our new product makes disobedience literally unthinkable!"

name: Jennifer Walters
text: "I will remind the witness that I have permission to treat her as hostile."

name: Punishing Punch
text:
"I can't help it! Your face is just so punchable!"
—Titania, Mary MacPherran

name: Rapid Rescue
text: Another day, another disaster.

name: Restorative Technique
text:
"Mastery is more than body and mind. You must also know your place in the universe."
—Shang-Chi

name: Rick Jones, Destined Sidekick
text: "Mar-Vell, did you know I once saved Hulk's life? Hulk, go on. You tell it better than I do."

name: Savage Land Dinosaur
text:
"Sometimes small things spook them."
—Ka-Zar of the Savage Land

name: Serpent Specialist
text:
"A wonderful score, my pet. I can't wait to see what we slither away with tomorrow."
—Princess Python, Zelda DuBois

name: Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu
text: "Many underestimate me because I carry no weapon. But I am the weapon."

name: She-Hulk, Jade Defender
text: "Buddy, you blew through the wrong stop sign."

name: Super Strength
text: "SEE! HULK STRONG . . . STRONGEST THERE IS!"

name: Kree Commandos
text: The Kree Empire has existed for millennia. With each world it conquers, it finds new ways to fight.

name: The Thing, Ben Grimm
text: "Don't worry, pal! Soon all yer problems'll be over, 'cause it's clobberin' time!"

name: Tigra, Feline Fury
text: "Say 'Here, kitty kitty' one more time. I dare you."

name: Training Regimen
text:
"Rerack your weights, heroes. Gym staff could actually die trying to do it."
—Avengers training room note

name: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl
text: "We're here to eat nuts and kick butts!"

name: Undercover Skrull
text: They're already here.

name: Wakandan Royal Guard
text: The shields and spears of Wakanda are forever united in defense of their king.

name: Abomination, Terrifying Titan
text: "Stop me? Puny fools. Stop me how?"

name: Agent Maria Hill
text: "You're going to have to trust me. You don't have the security clearance for the truth."

name: Luke Cage, Power Man
text: "People call me with their problems. They feel the cops don't care, the Avengers got bigger issues, and Spidey's number isn't listed. But they have my number, so they call me."

name: Alien Invasion
text:
"New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see."
—Thor

name: Ares, God of War
text: "Let the slaughter begin!"

name: Beast, Erudite Aerialist
text: "Oh, my stars and garters!"

name: Black Panther, Vanguard
text: "Wakanda forever!"

name: Black Widow, Double Agent
text: "Careful, I bite."

name: Bullseye, Death Dealer
text: "I don't miss."

name: Captain America, Living Legend
text: "They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here."

name: Ghost, Spectral Saboteur
text: "Do not speak foolishly of ghosts . . . or you may soon become one."

name: Iron Man, Master of Machines
text: "The future is what we make it."

name: Killmonger, Scourge of Wakanda
text: "I was stolen from paradise, but paradise never came looking for me."

name: Mockingbird, Ace Agent
text: "My first love was lab work, but these days my heart's in the field."

name: Madame Hydra
text: "This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"

name: Scientist Supreme of A.I.M.
text: "A weapon to kill a god? A.I.M. can do that, if you have the money."

name: The Serpent Society
text:
"Serpents of the world, unite!"
—King Cobra

name: Speedball, New Warrior
text: "Ah, to be a young and carefree Super Hero! Not a worry in the world for this spandex savior! I wish!"

name: Spider-Woman, Secret Agent
text: "I'm not friendly, and this isn't my neighborhood."

name: Monica Rambeau
text: Above the city, she glows . . .

name: Storm, Windrider
text: "Wind and lightning, hear my call!"

name: Thanos, the Mad Titan
text: "I shall restore the cosmic balance."

name: Thor Odinson
text: "Now, my hammer shall speak for me . . . in a voice of thunder!"

name: Titania, Rugged Rumbler
text: "Face it. There's only room for one strongest woman . . . and it ain't you!"

name: U.S.Agent, John Walker
text: "Rogers can talk all he wants about unity and dreams. Enemies understand strength."

name: Vision Quest
text: "Is there a problem, Wanda?"

name: War Machine, Legacy of Iron
text: "Listen up, you *screw-heads*. You're history!"

name: Wolverine, Fierce Fighter
text: "You picked the wrong dance partner, bub."

name: Worlds Within Worlds
text:
"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang

name: A.I.M. Synthoids
text: "M.O.D.O.K.—commands—that—you—be—neutralized! Nothing—must—interfere—with—our—programmed—mission!"

name: Arc Reactor
text: A true marvel of engineering.

name: Captain America's Shield
text: It defends what is and stands for what could be.

name: Dependable Quinjet
text:
"Eh, I've flown enough Quinjets to know not to get too attached."
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

name: H.E.R.B.I.E. Scout Unit
text: One can never have too many Highly Engineered Robots Built for Interdimensional Exploration around.

name: The Ten Rings
text:
"The rings act as if they have a will of their own."
—Shang-Chi

name: Ultron, Artificial Malevolence
text:
"Father, humans served their purpose. My imperative now is to terminate them . . . and you."
—Ultron, to Hank Pym

name: Ultron Drone
text: Many eyes. Many hands. One mind.

name: Vibranium Energy Daggers
text:
"These daggers can penetrate adamantium and disrupt nervous systems. What chance have you?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: A.I.M. Labs
text:
"Once I was a mere human guinea pig for A.I.M. scientists. But they did their job too well, and now I am their master!"
—M.O.D.O.K.

name: Asgardian Citadel
text:
"Asgard remains Asgard, be it in space, a mystic realm, or floating above Broxton, Oklahoma."
—Thor

name: Avengers Hangar
text:
"I made some modifications I think you'll like. You were a test pilot, weren't you, Carol? Want to take the new Quinjet for a spin?"
—Tony Stark

name: Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes
text: For some, making a better world means mending bodies while pretending to never see faces.

name: Baxter Building
text:
"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Birnin Zana Plaza
text: At the heart of Birnin Zana lies a monument to Bast and her chosen, the Black Panther.

name: Castle Doom
text: Those in Doom's shadow know his protection. And his wrath.

name: Dark Fortress
text:
"You talk of freedoms. Liberty. Whose hands do you think built these battlements? In their hearts, peasants want to be ruled."
—Baron Zemo

name: Fisk Tower
text:
"Fisk Tower is a symbol of my support and patronage of the city. You can rest assured I am always there, looking down."
—Kingpin, Wilson Fisk

name: Gathering Place
text:
"Will your friends be staying the night, Master Stark?"
—Edwin Jarvis, Avengers Mansion butler

name: Gleaming Bastion
text:
"Welcome to S.H.I.E.L.D. Impressive, huh? Fury needed someplace to park his car."
—Agent Maria Hill

name: Hell's Kitchen
text:
"Where else would the devil live?"
—Daredevil, Matt Murdock

name: Hidden Lair
text: While the Avengers worried over the threat of Ultron-19, in a remote bunker, the construction of Ultron-2458 neared completion.

name: Okoye, Dora Milaje Leader
text: "No, my king, we did not kill them. There were, however, many injuries."

name: Los Diablos Missile Base
text:
"My men have been stationed here for weeks because of your infernal delays, Banner! Are you going to test that gamma bomb or not?"
—General "Thunderbolt" Ross

name: Pym Technologies
text:
"These ants are the best lab assistants I've ever had. No offense, Bill."
—Hank Pym

name: Stark Industries
text:
"Good to see the new industrial-scale reactor is almost online. Too bad I'm already designing the next one."
—Tony Stark

name: Subterranean Cavern
text:
"Down here, I am no longer alone. I needed a kingdom, and they needed a king."
—Mole Man, Harvey Elder

name: Surveillance Room
text: S.H.I.E.L.D. always keeps a watchful eye on the world from the shadows.

name: Training Compound
text:
"I've been authorized to set up a California expansion team. Who's with me?"
—Hawkeye, Clint Barton

name: Panther Pounce
text:
"Did you truly think you could run from me?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

name: Agent of Atlas
text:
"I don't do 'conquest.' The Atlas Foundation is now a force for peace."
—Jimmy Woo

name: Patriot, Shield Wielder
text: "They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."

name: Multiversal Incursion
text:
"There are paths between worlds. Rarely, some of them become open."
—Doctor Strange

name: Arc Reactor
text: "I should have died all those years ago, and a dozen times since. I've kept myself alive with my inventions. And I must make good use of this borrowed time."

name: The Ten Rings
text: "Every time I wear them, I worry they'll corrupt me. That they'll turn me into my father."

name: Quake, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.
text: "Let's see you drive away without a road."

name: Raft Security Officer
text:
"We've upgraded the power dampeners since your last escape. No more breakouts on my watch."
—[Name withheld on S.H.I.E.L.D. orders], last words

name: Red Guardian, Super-Soldier
text: "You fight for your nation, Captain America. I fight for mine."

name: The Sentry, Golden Guardian
text: "For all the kindness I spread, the Void only sows terror."

name: Super Villain Lockup
text: "Welcome to the Raft, pal."

name: Take Up the Shield
text:
"I got this, Cap."
—Falcon, Sam Wilson

name: Agent Phil Coulson
text: "The big guns are in flight. Agent 13, what's your status?"

name: Wakandan Drone Flock
text: Wakandan engineers look to nature for inspiration as they develop new technologies.

name: Agent Phil Coulson
text: "The big guns are in flight. Agent 13, what's your status?"

name: Kang the Conqueror
text: "My time . . . is all times."

name: Web Up
text:
"You just hang tight and reflect on the choices that brought you here, Tasky."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Thunderbolts Conspiracy
text: Justice, like lightning.

name: Fin Fang Foom
text: His limbs shatter mountains. His back scrapes the sun.

name: Heroic Feast
text: The Thing belched. "I told youse guys. Yancy Street has the best sandwiches."

name: Mole Man, Moloid Master
text: "Forward, my mindless minions! To the surface, to take what's ours!"

name: Alien Invasion
text:
"New York? Again? Too afraid of Asgard, I see."
—Thor

name: Ares, God of War
text: "Let the slaughter begin!"

name: White Widow, Free Agent
text: "For years I wanted to be you, Natasha, but I make my own way now."

name: Scientist Supreme of A.I.M.
text: "A weapon to kill a god? A.I.M. can do that, if you have the money."

name: The Serpent Society
text:
"Serpents of the world, unite!"
—King Cobra

name: Worlds Within Worlds
text:
"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang

name: Castle Doom
text: Those in Doom's shadow know his protection. And his wrath.

name: Aerial Doombot
text:
"I have seen your rightful place. Beneath me."
—Doctor Doom

name: The Scarlet Witch
text: "There's nothing I cannot do. You would be wise to remember that."

name: A.I.M. Scientists
text: Science demands sacrifice.

name: Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born
text: "I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"

name: Patriot, Shield Wielder
text: "They say true heroes always put their teammates before themselves. I often find it's the other way around."

name: Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
text: He's always in control of the situation, even when stretched thin.

name: Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord
text: "Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"

name: Moonstone, Harsh Mistress
text: "Let me show you the dark side of the moon."

name: Speed, Young Avenger
text: "Wait? Sorry, not in my vocabulary."

name: Captain America, Living Legend
text: "They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here."

name: Atlantean Cavalry
text:
"These surface dwellers feel safe with their feet on dry land. Let us remind them why they fear the deep water."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner

name: Madame Hydra
text: "This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"

name: Baxter Building
text:
"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

name: Attuma, Atlantean Warlord
text: "All who swim the tides shall bow to my command!"

name: Bold Biochemist
text:
"Dr. Pym always told me I was meant for big things. Turns out, he was right."
—Dr. Bill Foster

name: Bruce Banner
text: "You shouldn't make me angry . . ."

name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
text: Behind every S.H.I.E.L.D. solo mission are dozens of intelligence operatives, logistics coordinators, and backup agents.

name: Depower
text: "WAIT . . . I feel funny . . . something's not right."

name: Echo, Perceptive Prodigy
text: "I've seen the fighting techniques of some of the best. Now their strengths are mine."

name: Futurist Forge
text:
"You saw what I built in a cave. Imagine what I can do here."
—Tony Stark

name: Giant-Sized Flying Ant
text: Ultron laughed at the swarm, so Pym upped the ante.

name: Hydraulic Helper
text:
"Put it here. No, not there. I *said* not there. Great. You've ruined six million dollars' worth of research, and I still don't have my coffee."
—Tony Stark

name: I Am Iron Man
text:
"Any questions?"
—Tony Stark

name: Iron Lad, Diverging Destiny
text: "If you had a chance to change your fate, would you take it?"

name: Kang the Conqueror
text: "My time . . . is all times."

name: Kid Loki
text: "A lie is nothing but a story. We can choose to tell a different one."

name: Loki, God of Mischief
text: "Foolish heroes. Loki can match you trick for trick, and *then* some."

name: Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
text: He's always in control of the situation, even when stretched thin.

name: Multiversal Incursion
text:
"Dibs on not dying this time."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Borough Backup
text:
"Ninjas? Again? Lose our number, man."
—Luke Cage, Power Man

name: Pym Particles
text:
"There's a whole different perspective from down here. I like it."
—The Wasp, Janet Van Dyne

name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone
text: One of the core capabilities of S.H.I.E.L.D. is deploying agents anywhere within minutes.

name: Shuri, Wakandan Inventor
text: While her older brother T'Challa ruled Wakanda, Shuri perfected its defenses and vibranium-based weapons.

name: Stature, Size Shifter
text: "Aw, cute! Fun-sized Dooms!"

name: Super Intelligence
text:
"With my gamma-enhanced genius, I am always at least two-hundred steps ahead."
—Leader, Samuel Sterns

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "I am the Watcher. My species learned long ago the perils of interfering. For now, we observe."

name: Brave Brawler
text:
"You guys want a taste, eh? Knuckle sandwiches for everyone!"
—D-Man, Dennis Dunphy

name: Trickster's Stratagem
text: "Let's take you off the board, shall we?"

name: Wiccan, Rising Magician
text: "Step outside of reality for a moment. It might improve your attitude."

name: The Wondrous Wasp
text: "Don't overlook the little things."

name: Agents of HYDRA
text: "Hail HYDRA! Immortal HYDRA! We shall never be destroyed! Cut off one head and two more shall take its place! We serve none but the Master—as the world shall soon serve us! Hail HYDRA!"

name: Arnim Zola, Bio-Fanatic
text: "You are not the only one who found a way to live across the ages, Captain America."

name: Baron Strucker, HYDRA Overlord
text: "Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!"

name: Crossbones, Malicious Mercenary
text: "I consider myself an artist—a craftsman who specializes in murder, destruction, and terror!"

name: Cruel Alliance
text:
"Die, you pathetic swine!"
—Viper, Ophelia Sarkissian

name: Dark Deed
text:
"You're pretty good, toots. But me? I'm magic."
—Bullseye

name: Decoy Ploy
text: "What fools you are that you cannot discern between a robotic servant and that which is . . . Doom!"

name: Elektra, Daughter of the Hand
text: "I am Elektra Natchios. Not even the stars are safe in the sky."

name: Grim Reaper, Lethal Legionnaire
text: "The corpses have been sown. Now, to harvest!"

name: Hour of Defeat
text:
"Tomorrow's sun will rise on a new king of Wakanda!"
—Erik Killmonger

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
text: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
text: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

name: Firja, Judge of Valor
text: She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
text: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
text: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
text: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
text: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
text: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."

name: Reyav, Master Smith
text: "There's always room for improvement."

name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
text: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."

name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
text: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

name: Teysa Karlov
text: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of *compleation* is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."

name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
text:
"His blades were the ultimate agents of transformation. All Phyrexians who met them were transformed into pieces."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.

name: Horobi, Death's Wail
text:
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—Records of the Living Historians

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
text: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

name: Horobi, Death's Wail
text:
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—*Records of the Living Historians*

name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
text:
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
text:
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians

name: Squee, the Immortal
text:
Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both.
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
text: "I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.

name: Aegar, the Freezing Flame
text: Though Phyrexian machines could adapt to extremes of heat or cold, they never figured out how to adapt to both at once.

name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
text:
"Teach these people the price of their insolence."
—Elesh Norn

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Leading from behind had never been her style.

name: Dina, Soul Steeper
text: Her concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue. They would be studied for generations.

name: Firja, Judge of Valor
text: Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."

name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
text: She protected Ravnica with the same things that thrilled her fans: courage, charisma, and a grand assortment of spiked chains.

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
text: "Sure, the invasion was violent, but where was the beauty? As an artist, I had to intervene."

name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
text:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha

name: Reyav, Master Smith
text: His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.

name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
text: While many fought valiantly to preserve humanity, Rona wished only to strip hers away.

name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
text:
"The *Weatherlight* gave so much. It deserved justice as much as any of us."
—Shanna

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

name: Teysa Karlov
text: Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text:
"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands
To break the hosts that foul its lands."
—*Triumph of Bala Ged*, stanza 6

name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
text: Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
text: Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
text: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
text: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

name: Horobi, Death's Wail
text:
"From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami. And thereafter at every battle came Horobi, Death's Wail."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.

name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
text:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

name: Squee, the Immortal
text: "You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
text: The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
text: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
text: "Even in death, we never stop growing."

name: Anhelo, the Painter
text: Every work of art is a hit.

name: Angelic Sleuth
text: Some crime scenes' secrets can only be discerned from an angel's-eye view.

name: Damning Verdict
text: "Guilty as charged!"

name: Grand Crescendo
text: The roar of applause drowned out the melee raging in the lobby.

name: Jailbreak
text: Obscura spies rarely stay locked up long enough to make it to trial.

name: Anhelo, the Painter
text: Every work of art is a hit.

name: Avenging Huntbonder
text: "I teach the cubs how to kill the two-legs quickly, and why it's best for the pride."

name: Call the Coppercoats
text: When the alarm crystals flash, Drannith's finest answer the call.

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Luminarch Aspirant
text: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Smuggler's Share
text: One way or another, everyone gets paid what they're owed.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Clone Legion
text: Their lust for battle was so great that they didn't care their enemies wore their own faces.

name: Daring Saboteur
text: "They'll never see me coming."

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Drawn from Dreams
text:
"From a sea of infinite possibilities, our choices create the future."
—Mu Yanling

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Cephalid Facetaker
text: Few think to look past a familiar face and a friendly smile.

name: River's Rebuke
text: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

name: Skyship Plunderer
text: Escapes should always be daring.

name: Talrand's Invocation
text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Wingspan Mentor
text: Their bond grew over time, as did the height of their jumps.

name: Zndrsplt's Judgment
text: Zndrsplt retired from officiating when she teamed up with Okaun, but she still knows the penalties better than anyone else.

name: Aether Snap
text:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Bloodsoaked Champion
text: "Death is merely another foe the Mardu will overcome."

name: Custodi Lich
text:
"Keeping order is a task too important to relinquish in death."
—Abrado, Custodi priest

name: Damnable Pact
text:
"Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
text: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Extravagant Replication
text: "Just one aether tiger? What do I look like, a peasant?"

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Double Vision
text: "Your eyes aren't playing tricks on you. I am."

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Squee, the Immortal
text: "You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."

name: Stalking Vengeance
text: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Evolutionary Leap
text: The essence of nature is change.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Giant Adephage
text:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Leafkin Druid
text: "I am rooted in the life of all that thrives around me. You cannot move me."

name: Life's Legacy
text: At the instant of death, the mystery of life.

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Sandwurm Convergence
text: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Scute Swarm
text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Steelbane Hydra
text: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.

name: Temur Sabertooth
text: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text:
"Odd. I didn't see any lightning . . . ."
—Herreth, poacher, last words

name: Treeshaker Chimera
text: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

name: Wall of Roots
text:
"Mana grows and changes like the roots of a plant. Like a plant, it must be nurtured."
—Nissa Revane

name: Storm of Forms
text: Beware the fine print.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: World Shaper
text: "The Great River will not be tamed."

name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
text: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

name: Artifact Mutation
text:
"There's nothing technology can build that nature can't eventually reclaim."
—Vivien Reid

name: Aura Mutation
text:
"Nature has a way of adapting to and overcoming any force that seeks its end."
—Vivien Reid

name: Aven Mimeomancer
text: "If the skies are our only refuge, I will see all of us take wing."

name: Bellowing Mauler
text: He's pretty sure he can't get charged with murder if he calls it "organic demolition."

name: Bant Charm
text: Bant is a world where death and chaos hold no sway.

name: Bedevil
text:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

name: Call the Skybreaker
text: It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

name: Camaraderie
text:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Body Count
text: "Your friends stayed quiet, and look what happened to them. You feeling a little more talkative yet?"

name: Gahiji, Honored One
text: He can stir the gentlest spirit to wild ferocity.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Inkfathom Witch
text: The murk of the Wanderbrine concealed unseemly rituals designed to bring out the worst in merrowkind.

name: Jenara, Asura of War
text: Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
text: Each of his twenty-two braids is bound with bone and leather from a foe.

name: March of the Multitudes
text: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

name: Primal Empathy
text: "From this day forward, we confront this world together, lifting each other up."

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
text: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

name: Windgrace's Judgment
text: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
