text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Make an Example
text: As the Adversary's influence grew, the conflicts between families escalated.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Power Conduit
text: Never content, vedalken artificers continually tinker with their creations.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Esper Panorama
text: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Gavony Township
text:
"The protective wards of the church have weakened, and no one can tell us why. It's time to look to our own defenses."
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Grixis Panorama
text: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

name: Jund Panorama
text: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Plant life in the valley changes for the worse as runoff from dwarven forges contaminates the water.

name: Naya Panorama
text: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

name: Nesting Grounds
text: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Legend says a mighty angel appears to pilgrims in need who reach this lofty height.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: The ancient magic of sun elves keeps these lands in an eternal summer.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Thriving Bluff
text: As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.

name: Thriving Grove
text: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

name: Thriving Isle
text: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

name: Thriving Moor
text: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Determined Iteration
text: "Only a fool believes they have nothing left to learn."

name: Bribe Taker
text: In New Capenna, it's survival of the richest.

name: Crash the Party
text: The profits from that night barely paid for the damages.

name: Grime Gorger
text: Sometimes the trash throws you out.

name: Life Insurance
text: All the money in the world won't buy back a pulse.

name: Oskar, Rubbish Reclaimer
text: "So many fools think throwing something away is the same as disposing of it."

name: Prosperous Partnership
text: Partners in love, partners in life, and partners in crime.

name: False Floor
text:
"That performance was truly the pits."
—Jetmir

name: Bennie Bracks, Zoologist
text: His enthusiastic curiosity puts even the most fearsome of beasts at ease.

name: Spiteful Repossession
text: Late payment shall be extracted however they see fit.

name: Swift Reconfiguration
text: On the bright side, the bear now had cupholders.

name: Vedalken Engineer
text: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Goblin Razerunners
text: Finding an unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

name: Access Denied
text: The Saiba Futurists guard their secret experiments with ever-evolving networks of cutting-edge defensive technology.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The soul of Jukai reaches far beyond the forest's edge."
—Shigeki, Jukai visionary

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Primeval Protector
text: The earth shook in support of their cause, offering a champion of its own.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Imposter Mech
text: The best way to fight evil is with its own weapons.

name: Soul's Majesty
text: An avatar he sculpts of wisdom and strength.

name: Spearbreaker Behemoth
text: Few Nayans dare hunt the gargantuans. They're regarded not as animals but as forces of nature, like landslides or typhoons.

name: Whiptongue Hydra
text:
"Where'd all the birds go?"
—Kaldrin, jungle sightseer

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Grumgully, the Generous
text: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Mage Slayer
text:
"When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do."
—Kresh the Bloodbraided

name: Rhythm of the Wild
text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Gold Myr
text: The leonin thought of the myr as omens, never imagining the sinister fate they foretold.

name: Mirage Mirror
text: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

name: Peacewalker Colossus
text:
"Peace? Its sole purpose is fear."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Shimmer Myr
text: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

name: Silver Myr
text: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

name: Research Thief
text: The Futurists eagerly supplement their research with their rivals' closely guarded secrets.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Universal Surveillance
text: Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

name: Port Town
text: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Remote but always watching, the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

name: Spire of Industry
text: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

name: Kotori, Pilot Prodigy
text: "Some people test limits. I prefer to demolish them."

name: Ascendant Acolyte
text: "Limits exist solely to test the will."

name: Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful
text: Day after day he sat there, knowing that the Wanderer would soon be back for him.

name: Drumbellower
text: By the second night after the kami had drifted into town, the local general store was completely sold out of earplugs.

name: Ironsoul Enforcer
text: "You break it, you buy it. You steal it, I find it."

name: Kotori, Pilot Prodigy
text: "Some people test limits. I prefer to demolish them."

name: Aeronaut Admiral
text: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

name: Organic Extinction
text:
"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists

name: Armed and Armored
text: The dwarves of Axgard seldom have reason to leave their impregnable underground kingdom—but when they do, they go in force.

name: Crush Contraband
text: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Indomitable Archangel
text:
"Every sword drawn to defend is an angelic blade, guided to justice by an angelic hand."
—Auriok proverb

name: Myrsmith
text: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Release to Memory
text:
"Those who have passed are beyond war, beyond suffering. Mourn them, envy them, but above all, remember them."
—Light-Paws, Imperial advisor

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Etherium Sculptor
text: The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

name: Master of Etherium
text: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

name: Riddlesmith
text: The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.

name: Sai, Master Thopterist
text: "Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard."

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Lawbringer
text:
One injustice starts a thousand riots. One law stops a thousand crimes.
—Lawbringer creed

name: Animate Land
text: Irony is getting walked on by the earth instead of the other way around.

name: Coiling Woodworm
text: Only the elves know where the woods end and the woodworm begins.

name: Fog Patch
text: Realizing they weren't getting past the fog, the elves did the only thing they could do: wait.

name: Harvest Mage
text: "Why should one limit oneself to the resources at hand?"

name: Mossdog
text: The more you look at it, the more dangerous it becomes.

name: Overlaid Terrain
text: One must reap before one can sow.

name: Pack Hunt
text: The one you see is just a diversion.

name: Lightbringer
text:
One thought opens a thousand eyes. One sun brings a thousand dawns.
—Lightbringer creed

name: Seal of Strength
text:
"I am the feeder, the morsel that revives the starving."
—Seal inscription

name: Skyshroud Claim
text: The forest's constant struggle is to keep the spreading flowstone at bay.

name: Skyshroud Poacher
text: "It's OK. They're just elves."

name: Stampede Driver
text: "The thunder of hooves is music to my ears."

name: Treetop Bracers
text: Gravity is truly what you make of it.

name: Wild Mammoth
text: "Sit. Heel! Down! HELP!"

name: Belbe's Armor
text: It protects her from the ravages of Phyrexia and the savages of Rath.

name: Belbe's Portal
text: The fight will continue on a new battlefield.

name: Complex Automaton
text:
"This wasteful design cannot possibly be Phyrexian."
—Belbe

name: Netter en-Dal
text: The wizard's vocabulary of mogg profanities increased with every net she cast.

name: Flowstone Thopter
text: Airborne flowstone isn't less dangerous, only less common.

name: Kill Switch
text: Success is largely a matter of knowing which lever to pull.

name: Parallax Inhibitor
text:
"The best I can offer is a temporary reprieve."
—Belbe

name: Predator, Flagship
text:
"The scourge of Skyshroud is airborne once more."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Rackling
text: "This may hurt a little."

name: Noble Stand
text: Soldiers will always endanger their lives to defend many other lives.

name: Viseling
text: "This may hurt a lot."

name: Off Balance
text: A heavy weapon deals plenty of damage—but it does have to hit.

name: Oracle's Attendants
text: The future isn't sacred, but its speaker is.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Silkenfist Fighter
text:
Simple wooden staff
Made from life, protecting life,
Stronger than cold steel.

name: Silkenfist Order
Spiritual Asylum
text: Trapped in safety is still trapped.

name: Topple
text:
"Let all witness the fate of those who defy me."
—Crovax

name: Voice of Truth
text:
"Above them all is Truth, and Truth must be set free. If the wings of Truth are clipped, the voices will fall silent."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

name: Accumulated Knowledge
text:
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."
—Takara, to Eladamri

name: Aether Barrier
text:
"Creatures fade in and out of existence. It's an unfortunate side effect. The losses are tolerable."
—Belbe

name: Air Bladder
text: Random mutations among Rootwater merfolk were common—and disturbing.

name: Blinding Angel
text: "Their eyes will shrivel and blacken before faith's true light."

name: Dominate
text:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

name: Ensnare
text: Rootwater has become as dangerous to its denizens as to its enemies.

name: Infiltrate
text: Getting in was the easy part. Getting out proved to be more difficult.

name: Oraxid
text:
"I'm constantly amazed by the tenacity of living creatures on this plane. Even in the stronghold's white-hot core, life persists."
—Ertai

name: Pale Moon
text: Denizens of Rath had never seen the moon before. It was a symbol of change, not constancy.

name: Rising Waters
text: Rising waters, sinking hope.

name: Rootwater Commando
text: Rootwater merfolk are seldom seen these days, but elf corpses are as numerous as ever.

name: Chieftain en-Dal
text: The clearest commands are practical examples.

name: Seahunter
text: "They can't feel pain. They just wiggle 'cause they're scared."

name: Seal of Removal
text:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

name: Sliptide Serpent
text: It's futile to fight something you can see only in the corner of your eye.

name: Sneaky Homunculus
text: Keep watch only for the giants and you'll be eaten by the ants.

name: Stronghold Biologist
text: He twists the laws of nature until they scream.

name: Stronghold Machinist
text: She stretches the laws of physics until they snap.

name: Stronghold Zeppelin
text: As long as the stronghold controlled the sky, the rebels were doomed.

name: Trickster Mage
text: "If it ain't broke, I'll break it. If it *is* broke, I'll fix it."

name: Wandering Eye
text: The evincar has many ways of keeping track of his subjects.

name: Ascendant Evincar
text:
"Things are going to change around here."
—Crovax

name: Belbe's Percher
text: Long and powerful, these birds were used to carry messages to and from the evincar.

name: Carrion Wall
text: A wall built from the bodies of the enemy will never lack building material in times of war.

name: Dark Triumph
text: All that's left is the coronation.

name: Death Pit Offering
text:
"Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits."
—Crovax

name: Mind Slash
text: "I can't think with all that screaming."

name: Murderous Betrayal
text: In darkness, the assassin sneaked into the village and destroyed what Eladamri loved most: his daughter.

name: Phyrexian Driver
text: Although the abuse was initially effective, the troops soon became numb to it.

name: Plague Witch
text: "I can ail what cures you."

name: Seal of Doom
text:
"I am the banisher, the ill will that snuffs the final candle."
—Seal inscription

name: Spineless Thug
text: These troops are only as strong as the evincar's control.

name: Spiteful Bully
text: Like most creatures bent on total destruction, they rarely bother to double-check their targets.

name: Stronghold Discipline
text:
"Crovax never passes up an opportunity to cause widespread misery."
—Belbe

name: Vicious Hunger
text:
"Blood is foul, the flesh dross. My ascendance thirsts for life itself."
—Crovax

name: Volrath the Fallen
text: "I stepped out. I did not step down."

name: Bola Warrior
text: The ingredients for panic include equal parts danger, uncertainty, and helplessness.

name: Fanatical Devotion
text: The Oracle told Eladamri he would save his people by abandoning them. His followers adopted that ideal.

name: Flame Rift
text: Crovax hungered for power, and the stronghold devoured the sky.

name: Flowstone Crusher
text:
"Someone must have done something very bad to make a rock that angry."
—Rebel scout

name: Flowstone Overseer
text: The rebels couldn't see where the roar was coming from. Then they saw it was coming from everywhere.

name: Flowstone Slide
text: It may look like soil, but its nature is malice.

name: Flowstone Strike
text: Aggression exacts its toll.

name: Flowstone Surge
text: The army was never at a loss for weapons; Crovax was their forge.

name: Flowstone Wall
text: The rebels assaulted the wall, never suspecting the wall would assault back.

name: Laccolith Grunt
text: They leave a trail of ash and sorrow.

name: Laccolith Titan
text: Proximity guarantees injury or death.

name: Lashknife
text: Those it won't scare, it scars.

name: Laccolith Warrior
text: The screams are brief. The silence lingers.

name: Laccolith Whelp
text: They don't feed; they stoke.

name: Mogg Alarm
text: They make mountains into mogg holes.

name: Mogg Salvage
text: Three moggs, one treasure, too bad.

name: Moggcatcher
text: "They're not worth much, but they're easy to catch."

name: Rupture
text: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

name: Seal of Fire
text:
"I am the romancer, the passion that consumes the flesh."
—Seal inscription

name: Shrieking Mogg
text: You have to admire its enthusiasm.

name: Eiganjo Exemplar
text: Imperial samurai undergo strict training, honing their skills and purifying their spirits in the hope that they will prove worthy of a kami's blessing.

name: Inkrise Infiltrator
text: "They can't follow your footprints if you never touch the ground."

name: Invoke Despair
text: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.

name: Kaito's Pursuit
text: Kaito knew every rooftop in the city, and closed in quickly on his quarry—but he knew nothing of the Planar Bridge until it was already too late.

name: Kami of Terrible Secrets
text: It feeds on things better left unknown, savoring the bitterness of lies and regrets.

name: Malicious Malfunction
text:
"That? A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak."
—Jin-Gitaxias

name: Mukotai Ambusher
text: The Mukotai Reckoners specialize in stealth and subterfuge.

name: Nezumi Bladeblesser
text: "It's not one or the other, kami or technology. Both offer power. I will not limit myself."

name: Okiba Salvage
text: "Some fool would rather throw a whole mech away than repair one hydraulic actuator? It must be my lucky day."

name: Reckoner Shakedown
text:
"That's a start. What else do you have for us?"
—Takumi, Reckoner enforcer

name: Reckoner's Bargain
text: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.

name: Return to Action
text:
"You're hurt? Too bad. You stop fighting when I say, and not a moment sooner."
—Satoru Umezawa

name: Twisted Embrace
text: Evil kami are drawn to mortals who share their grim fascinations.

name: Undercity Scrounger
text: "That will pay for another arm extension all by itself! Well, as long as it doesn't explode."

name: Virus Beetle
text:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

name: You Are Already Dead
text: So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.

name: Akki Ember-Keeper
text: "Follow my lantern, little ones."

name: Akki Ronin
text:
"Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade."
—Keni-Keni, akki smith

name: Akki War Paint
text: Akki paint bright, bold designs on their salvaged Imperial mechs, leaving no doubt as to who they belong to now.

name: Ambitious Assault
text: In the clangor and chaos of the akki attack, few even noticed the frogs on their heads.

name: Crackling Emergence
text: The transition from spiritual to material is sometimes as shocking as it is beautiful.

name: Explosive Entry
text: Kaito and Tamiyo charged headlong into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting their arrival.

name: Go-Shintai of Shared Purpose
text: It seeks those who act with kindness and offers friendship.

name: Flame Discharge
text: "What? Why would it need a cooling unit?"

name: Go-Shintai of Ancient Wars
text: It seeks those consumed with rage and offers burning blades.

name: Heiko Yamazaki, the General
text: "I prefer to let my sword do the talking."

name: Ironhoof Boar
text:
"I'm glad she can run again, but this might have been a bit much."
—Kenji, Sokenzan artisan

name: Kami of Industry
text: It takes many arms to arm an army.

name: Golden-Tail Disciple
text: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

name: Kami's Flare
text: "The flames are a gift from my companion. They won't hurt me. You, on the other hand..."

name: Kindled Fury
text: The only thing better than hitting hard is hitting first.

name: Peerless Samurai
text: "I fear I have run out of worthy opponents."

name: Scrap Welder
text: "This big metal guy will make some amazing wind chimes!"

name: Hotshot Mechanic
text: "If your mech is factory standard, you might as well be walking."

name: Scrapyard Steelbreaker
text: "You've got about three seconds to get out of here before you get a faceful of metal."

name: Seismic Wave
text: "Step carefully, Imperial. Even the earth rises against you."

name: Sokenzan Smelter
text: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.

name: Tempered in Solitude
text: Many master samurai make pilgrimages deep into the Sokenzan Mountains, where they train and meditate in silence, hoping to commune with a lava kami.

name: Towashi Songshaper
text: Most Uprisers augment their bodies for speed, strength, or protection, but a few just want to be one with the music.

name: Twinshot Sniper
text: "Pierce the heart and pierce the head, even the mightiest fall down dead."

name: Unstoppable Ogre
text: Touma never met a door he didn't hate.

name: Imperial Oath
text: Those chosen to guard the Imperial Palace are not only unrivaled warriors but also lionhearted champions of the Imperial cause.

name: Upriser Renegade
text: "My streets, my rules. You picked the wrong neighborhood for a fight."

name: Bamboo Grove Archer
text: "Do not mistake tranquility for domestication. This land is wild, and will always remain so."

name: Bearer of Memory
text: Members of the Living Historians don't simply chronicle the past; they embody it.

name: Boon of Boseiju
text: She closed her eyes and remembered the smell of the leaves of Jukai Forest. When she opened them, the buildings of Towashi had grown small.

name: Commune with Spirits
text: The kami of Jukai Forest accept only the most respectful petitioners.

name: Fade into Antiquity
text:
"Memories fade and wither with time. If we do not nurture the garden of history, we may once more wander blindly through barren lands."
—Reki, founder of the Living Historians

name: Fang of Shigeki
text:
"Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land."
—Shigeki, founder of the Order of Jukai

name: Favor of Jukai
text: The land chooses its own champions.

name: Generous Visitor
text: It is said that one must modestly refuse a gift three times before accepting it to show humility before the kami.

name: Geothermal Kami
text: A mysterious kami will sometimes appear to overworked monks and offer them a warm, relaxing bath.

name: Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor
text: It seeks those with untamed spirits and offers wild strength.

name: Greater Tanuki
text: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

name: Imperial Subduer
text: "Cease your pathetic struggling."

name: Harmonious Emergence
text: Where the spirit and mortal realms overlap, the laws of reality are rewritten.

name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
text: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

name: Invoke the Ancients
text: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

name: Jukai Preserver
text: "The kami grant you this boon, not I."

name: Jukai Trainee
text: "The Order of Jukai accepts only the strongest of body and spirit. I will train until I meet their expectations."

name: Master's Rebuke
text: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."

name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
text: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

name: Season of Renewal
text: Pavement ripped like paper as the ancient kami awoke from her long slumber beneath the city.

name: Spinning Wheel Kick
text: Members of the Order of Jukai commune with kami to enhance their martial prowess.

name: Tamiyo's Safekeeping
text: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

name: Asari Captain
text: "Go! Show them your fury!"

name: Eiganjo Uprising
text: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

name: Enthusiastic Mechanaut
text: "Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.

name: Kitsune Ace
text: "Oh, sorry—were we racing?"

name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
text: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.

name: Hinata, Dawn-Crowned
text: Hope races on sunlit hooves.

name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
text: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

name: Jukai Naturalist
text: He had heard rumors of the cities—the constant noise, the stagnant air, the tainted water—and he had no wish to learn if they were true.

name: Naomi, Pillar of Order
text: "Progress comes only when we rise above our petty quarrels."

name: Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
text: "The tempest is the only ally I need."

name: Automated Artificer
text:
"I sometimes watch them build more of their kind and wonder: Will there come a day when they no longer need us?"
—Saku, Futurist technician

name: Light the Way
text: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

name: Bronze Cudgels
text:
"These were made when Michiko was young. Wield them wisely."
—Chiyoko, Jukai elder

name: Brute Suit
text:
"Send them a message they can't ignore."
—Satoru Umezawa

name: Circuit Mender
text: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

name: Containment Construct
text: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.

name: Dramatist's Puppet
text:
"Who cares if the story's true as long as people are entertained?"
—Shin, Towashi street performer

name: Iron Apprentice
text:
"I needed an extra set of hands, so I built one."
—Kenji, Sokenzan artisan

name: Network Terminal
text: Public access terminals around Towashi provide residents with up-to-date information on everything from traffic delays to hostile kami sightings.

name: Ninja's Kunai
text: A point to pierce flesh and spirit alike.

name: Papercraft Decoy
text:
"And what, precisely, was so important that you left the entrance unguarded?"
—Fumika, Imperial enforcer

name: Patchwork Automaton
text: It dwells happily near the ever-burning forges of Sokenzan City, crafting small things of beauty from discarded scraps.

name: Runaway Trash-Bot
text: One day it might roll over your foot, the next day your entire house.

name: Searchlight Companion
text: The merging of the spirit and material realms has resulted in some unusual friendships.

name: Shrine Steward
text: From broken swords, the first Imperials forged a peaceful servant to tend the shrines of Eiganjo.

name: Thundersteel Colossus
text:
"*This* is what I needed all that alloy for."
—Arima, to Emire

name: Lucky Offering
text: The playful kami reserved its greatest blessings for those who brought not wealth or rare delicacies, but particularly amusing trinkets.

name: Roadside Reliquary
text: Travelers who leave an offering may pass freely through the forest kami's domain.

name: Uncharted Haven
text: Untouched by mortal or kami, unspoiled by their wars.

name: Banishing Slash
text: "In the name of Kyodai, begone!"

name: Mothrider Patrol
text:
"Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings. Rise and become the western wind."
—Swift-Arm, Golden-Tail headmaster

name: Norika Yamazaki, the Poet
text: "The blades will have their say, but peace is built with words."

name: Regent's Authority
text: Before her spark pulled her away again, the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.

name: Repel the Vile
text:
"You are a guest in this realm, and you've overstayed your welcome."
—Yui, Imperial intercessor

name: Seven-Tail Mentor
text: "I have taught you all I can. Take this blade and rise as my equal."

name: Sky-Blessed Samurai
text: Imperial samurai who show exceptional honor and dexterity are invited to train as mothriders, elite guards charged with protecting the skies of Eiganjo.

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Wanderer's Intervention
text: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion. One mighty slash was enough to take the praetor out of the fight.

name: When We Were Young
text: Since Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend—she had to suffer him calling her "your emperorness" for much of their shared youth.

name: Acquisition Octopus
text: You can never have too many arms.

name: Anchor to Reality
text: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.

name: Blade-Blizzard Kitsune
text: In the time it takes most to master one blade, he mastered two.

name: Invoke Despair
text: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Enthusiastic Mechanaut
text: "Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.

name: Disruption Protocol
text: "Let's just turn that off, shall we?"

name: Jukai Naturalist
text: He had heard rumors of the cities—the constant noise, the stagnant air, the tainted water—and he had no wish to learn if they were true.

name: Essence Capture
text: The Futurists regard the tradition of kami-bonding as anachronistic and inefficient, striving constantly to surpass spiritual power with technology.

name: Futurist Operative
text: "The Imperials can't arrest you for illegal tech if you never even existed."

name: Futurist Sentinel
text:
"I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates."
—Katsumasa, the Animator

name: Go-Shintai of Lost Wisdom
text: It seeks those driven by curiosity and offers enlightenment.

name: Guardians of Oboro
text: "The palace is closed to outsiders."

name: Invoke the Winds
text:
"Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?"
—Risona, leader of the Asari Uprisers

name: Mnemonic Sphere
text:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

name: Moonfolk Puzzlemaker
text: "Research is hardly the dry, serious pastime outsiders make it out to be."

name: Brilliant Restoration
text:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal

name: Network Disruptor
text: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

name: Planar Incision
text: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking. Spirits that could pass between worlds made for perfect test subjects.

name: Reality Heist
text: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.

name: Replication Specialist
text: "Step one is innovation. Step two is production. Sometimes step one is optional."

name: Saiba Trespassers
text: One to clear the way, another to erase their trail.

name: Skyswimmer Koi
text: Once they swam alone among the clouds, but now the people of Kamigawa have built high enough to reach them.

name: Spell Pierce
text: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.

name: Suit Up
text: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

name: Assassin's Ink
text: A Reckoner always has another trick up their sleeve—or as their sleeve.

name: Dragonfly Suit
text: Cutting-edge Imperial sentinel mechs patrol the skies over Eiganjo.

name: Clawing Torment
text: A kami's anger never fades, never sleeps, never loosens its grasp.

name: Debt to the Kami
text: The masters weren't speaking figuratively when they said guilt could be all-consuming.

name: Dockside Chef
text: The squirming is how you know it's fresh.

name: Dokuchi Shadow-Walker
text: Don't fear the blade, fear the shadows.

name: Enormous Energy Blade
text: "Heavy? Maybe for you."

name: Go-Shintai of Hidden Cruelty
text: It seeks those with hate in their hearts and offers vengeance.

name: Gravelighter
text: It appears only to those whose lives are ending, welcoming them to their fate.

name: Exclusion Ritual
text:
"Your desires have become our discretion."
—Izathel, priest of the Annex

name: Vulshok Refugee
text: "I will carve my people's vengeance on the face of Phyrexia."

name: Whipflare
text: The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Corrosive Gale
text:
"Wipe Sheoldred's spies from the sky. She'll see the result of our vision soon enough."
—Glissa

name: Fresh Meat
text: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

name: Forced Worship
text: Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.

name: Glissa's Scorn
text:
"If it were fit to survive, it wouldn't have been so easily put down."
—Glissa

name: Glistener Elf
text: "Beg me for life, and I will fill you with the glory of Phyrexian perfection."

name: Greenhilt Trainee
text: "Our ancestors adapted to this world of metal. Just as they did, we will adapt to this world of evil."

name: Leeching Bite
text: A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.

name: Melira, Sylvok Outcast
text: Once a pariah, now Mirrodin's greatest hope.

name: Mutagenic Growth
text:
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Mycosynth Fiend
text:
"I wish I could take credit for it, but nature progresses on its own, just the way it should."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Noxious Revival
text:
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Inquisitor Exarch
text:
"Skin is the prison of the blessed and the stronghold of the heretic."
—Argent Etchings, plate 64, passage 17

name: Rotted Hystrix
text: Vorinclex had no grand plan. The oil did its own work, evolving creatures into worthy predators.

name: Thundering Tanadon
text:
"We do not need beakers and vials to test our predators."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Viridian Betrayers
text: To secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks, they hunted their surviving kin.

name: Viridian Harvest
text:
"In the midst of horror beyond imagining, I still see things that lift my heart."
—Ezuri

name: Vital Splicer
text:
"For every one that falls, ten shall rise. The revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
text: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

name: Alloy Myr
text: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.

name: Lost Leonin
text: Mirrans were broken down and rebuilt, made to be loyal servants of the force they had fought.

name: Blinding Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for inscribing our souls with subservience, to reinforce the sacred order."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Darksteel Relic
text:
"It's the last thing we can call our own."
—Minhu, Mirran resistance

name: Etched Monstrosity
text: Now etched only with the scars of phyresis.

name: Hex Parasite
text: Drawn by power, fueled by conquest.

name: Hovermyr
text: Originally created to harvest blinkmoths, the hovermyr are now the silent observers of a dying world.

name: Immolating Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for melting the sinful that we may be reminded of our own insignificance."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Loxodon Convert
text: Just one drop of the glistening oil can eventually stain even a soul as stalwart as a loxodon's beyond redemption.

name: Insatiable Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for culling our sick so that the strong may earn their triumphs."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Isolation Cell
text:
"Attrition is the answer. Starve them, and let their despair be their undoing."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Kiln Walker
text: If it possesses an ability to understand and appreciate life, it has never shown it.

name: Mindcrank
text:
"Let go of your memories and be reborn."
—Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27

name: Mycosynth Wellspring
text: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

name: Myr Superion
text: Two kinds of myr survive: the powerful and those that stay close by them.

name: Marrow Shards
text:
"We are a single entity. Dissenters must be sutured into the Orthodoxy."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text: An invasion weapon of ages past, the glistening oil contained the blueprints of countless atrocities.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Soul Conduit
text:
"You have an unhealthy attachment to your selfhood. I can help you with that."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Spellskite
text:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Master Splicer
text: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

name: Surge Node
text: Without a foe to focus on, the machine priests had time to indulge in new sciences.

name: Torpor Orb
text:
"Phyrexia is certainly dangerous, but I have to admire some of its innovations."
—Tezzeret

name: Trespassing Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for surveilling our lives that we may be preserved from our own ignorance."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Unwinding Clock
text:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

name: Phyrexia's Core
text:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Porcelain Legionnaire
text:
"My new design has lightweight plating specially cultivated from heretics' spare tissues."
—Izathel, priest of the Annex

name: Remember the Fallen
text: When the Mirrans had fallen, Planeswalkers carried the burden of remembrance.

name: Shattered Angel
text: She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.

name: Shriek Raptor
text:
"That's no glint hawk. The skies have changed for the worse."
—Ria Ivor, White Sun partisan

name: War Report
text: Underling Ethu's 263rd report read simply "Yes, my lord. Overwhelmingly, my lord." This marked the end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War.

name: Argent Mutation
text:
"My world is corrupted beyond cleansing. I must prevent this from happening to others."
—Karn

name: Arm with Aether
text: "Anything we can do to hurt the Phyrexian invaders is worth dying for."

name: Blighted Agent
text:
"Urabrask may suspect our surveillance, but he cannot stop it."
—Avaricta, Gitaxian sective

name: Auriok Survivors
text: "We are Mirrodin's children. We will reclaim her—one scrap at a time, if we have to."

name: Corrupted Resolve
text:
"Flesh is a sickness that infects Phyrexia."
—Avaricta, Gitaxian sective

name: Defensive Stance
text:
"It isn't for fighting. It's for when the fighting's gone bad."
—Kara Vrist, Mirran resistance

name: Gitaxian Probe
text:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance

name: Impaler Shrike
text:
"Interrogation is an unnecessary step for acquiring information."
—Politus, Gitaxian morphologist

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

name: Mental Misstep
text:
"Your first mistake was thinking I would let you live long enough to make a second."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective

name: Mindculling
text:
"Why infiltrate their strongholds when what we seek resides in such a poorly guarded safe?"
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Psychic Barrier
text:
"I tolerate Phyrexians because the dragon requires it. But I have no patience for uninvited guests."
—Tezzeret

name: Spined Thopter
text:
"I appreciate the depravity of noble designs turned to devious ends."
—Tezzeret

name: Spire Monitor
text: Each monitor is given an eye for each spire it is to guard.

name: Vapor Snag
text:
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Xenograft
text:
"I despise Vorinclex and his slobberings about 'evolution.' Only I know true progress."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Caress of Phyrexia
text: "I am weak. Make . . . me . . . ideal."

name: Dementia Bat
text:
"When terror outweighs all other thoughts, they will understand that I am the true Father of Machines."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Despise
text:
"Truth is always a weapon in your enemies' hands."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Enslave
text: Phyrexia extended its command until there was nothing left to take.

name: Evil Presence
text:
"The Accorders would lament the transformation of their cherished lands, had they lived to see it."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Geth's Verdict
text:
"Everyone should owe you something."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Grim Affliction
text: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

name: Ichor Explosion
text: The first explosion that didn't excite goblins.

name: Life's Finale
text: The feeble resistance of the flesh is over. Phyrexia spreads its shadow over all.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text:
"Behold blessed perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Pith Driller
text: After boring up through the crust of Mirrodin, it turned its expertise upon the surface dwellers.

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Praetor's Grasp
text: Sheoldred weaves every thread of information into a noose to hang her enemies.

name: Toxic Nim
text: The nim have become roving killers marshaled by whichever thane holds tenuous leadership.

name: Vault Skirge
text: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

name: Artillerize
text: Phyrexian or Mirran, most goblins stick to the job they know best.

name: Due Respect
text:
"A display of humility is required of those who still possess such frailties."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Flameborn Viron
text:
"Large or small, all will toil for the Great Work."
—Decree of Urabrask

name: Furnace Scamp
text: Born of the core, and dying to stoke it.

name: Geosurge
text:
"The mountains have been corrupted. Otherwise, they would not lend me their fire so easily."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Gut Shot
text:
"Down here, we have a more pointed version of the scriptures."
—Urabrask's enforcer

name: Moltensteel Dragon
text: An apocalypse in dragon form.

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Priest of Urabrask
text: Even in New Phyrexia, red mana sparks glimmers of individualism, passion, and freedom.

name: Rage Extractor
text: New Phyrexia is an engine that both consumes and creates malice.

name: Razor Swine
text:
"They aren't helping the forges. Send them to the surface."
—Furnace boss, sector 12

name: Ruthless Invasion
text:
"For the survival of our people, every conflict must now end in retreat."
—Pythor, Mirran resistance

name: Scrapyard Salvo
text:
"Squealstokers! Build me a glorious pile of Mirran metal. Then add yourselves to the pile."
—Furnace boss, sector 11

name: Slag Fiend
text:
"Seal the furnace vents. Admit no others. We'll tend our forges without their tainted ways."
—Decree of Urabrask

name: Slash Panther
text: It runs an endless circuit along the ruined roads of the soon-to-be-forgotten Mirran civilization.

name: Tormentor Exarch
text:
"Tend the molten slag, or be the molten slag."
—Urabrask's enforcer

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Victorious Destruction
text:
"The refugees look at these structures with hope. We must relieve them of this burden."
—Juex, tormentor exarch

name: Juzám Djinn
text: "Expect my visit when the darkness comes. The night I think is best for hiding all." —Ouallada

name: Jester's Cap
text:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most dragons are cruel, the Shivan dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Hurloon Minotaur
text: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Every Hope Shall Vanish
text: "Oh, I think I *will* get away with this."

name: Every Last Vestige Shall Rot
text: "May bloodberries grow from your remains."

name: Evil Comes to Fruition
text: "The plants justify the means."

name: Feed the Machine
text: "Even you have a purpose. Your blood will oil the gears."

name: I Delight in Your Convulsions
text: "I can't imagine what you're feeling right now, but I'll try my best."

name: Ignite the Cloneforge!
text: "Heroes innovate. Villains duplicate."

name: All in Good Time
text: "Take a moment. Ponder the depths of your insignificance."

name: Into the Earthen Maw
text: "You may even see them again. Full digestion takes three hundred years."

name: Introductions Are in Order
text: "Meet my newest minion. Come now, don't be shy—shake her pincer."

name: The Iron Guardian Stirs
text: "It would be disappointing if you were unable to overcome this simplest of defenses. Hilarious, but disappointing."

name: Know Naught but Fire
text: "Cranial explosions for everyone. Still planning to outthink my dragons?"

name: Look Skyward and Despair
text: "Today I take the reins of destiny itself. Today the Draconic Apocalypse is upon you."

name: May Civilization Collapse
text: "This should halt the spread of your insolence."

name: Mortal Flesh Is Weak
text: "I certainly would have accepted my offer of eternal life. But if you choose death instead, who am I to argue?"

name: My Genius Knows No Bounds
text: "I can see . . . everything. The beginning and the end of time. The raw edges of reality. And now I see exactly how to kill you."

name: All Shall Smolder in My Wake
text: "It's my goal to find the melting point of every substance."

name: My Wish Is Your Command
text: "Indulge me. Just one spell. One potentially fatal spell gone horribly awry."

name: Only Blood Ends Your Nightmares
text: "But nothing will end your regret."

name: The Pieces Are Coming Together
text: "Cretins build machines. I construct destiny."

name: Realms Befitting My Majesty
text: "Look around you. All you behold is mine to rule. It's the natural way."

name: Roots of All Evil
text: "I assure you, these are not the kind that thrive on sunlight and water."

name: Rotted Ones, Lay Siege
text: "Don't come back until you've got brains in your teeth."

name: Surrender Your Thoughts
text: "Or, if you prefer, just surrender."

name: Approach My Molten Realm
text: "It's a dragon-infested lavascape of notorious peril. Make yourselves at home."

name: Tooth, Claw, and Tail
text: "Silence your wailing. This is but a taste of the destruction my pets have in store."

name: Which of You Burns Brightest?
text: "Let that be a lesson to you, your family, and everyone you've ever known."

name: Your Fate Is Thrice Sealed
text: "I can't abide laziness. Arise, forces of nature, and serve your master!"

name: Your Puny Minds Cannot Fathom
text: "I have seen far beyond this imperfect world, into a tomorrow that doesn't include you."

name: Your Will Is Not Your Own
text: "Fool. I'll show you how to use that thing."

name: Behold the Power of Destruction
text: "I'd call that a successful first test. Golem! Rearm the Doom Citadel!"

name: Choose Your Champion
text: "It seems the fate of the world rests on your shoulders, feeble child."

name: The Dead Shall Serve
text: "Tell your old master I said hello."

name: A Display of My Dark Power
text: "What would you say is my greatest attribute? Is it my gluttonous lust for power?"

name: Embrace My Diabolical Vision
text: "My vision is for the good of everyone. Mostly me."

name: Scrivener
text: A good memory is no match for a good scribe.

name: Standstill
text: "Take your time."

name: Syncopate
text:
"Memories can't simply be washed away. The mind must be scrubbed clean."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Think Tank
text: Cephalids seek knowledge not to better themselves, but to best others.

name: Thought Devourer
text: Thinking is hard.

name: Thought Eater
text: The first memory it sucks out of its host is how to get rid of it.

name: Thought Nibbler
text: Balshan wizards have long used them to gnaw away the memories they wish to forget.

name: Time Stretch
text: There's lots of time like the present.

name: Touch of Invisibility
text: Cephalids specialize in things unseen, be they politics, betrayal, or themselves.

name: Beloved Chaplain
text: Nomad and Nantuko, eagle and elephant; all the birds and beasts are charmed by his quiet dignity.

name: Traumatize
text: Dreads had half a mind to leave.

name: Treetop Sentinel
text: Crian's patrols afford him plenty of opportunity to take potshots at the "dirtwalkers" far below.

name: Unifying Theory
text: Scribbles of a lunatic and formulas of a genius are often indistinguishable.

name: Upheaval
text: The calm comes after the storm.

name: Words of Wisdom
text: Knowledge can't be kept in a bottle or sealed in a box. It yearns to be spread and shared.

name: Afflict
text: When one of the Patriarch's champions displeased him, he would only shake his finger. That was enough.

name: Braids, Cabal Minion
text: "Home is where you can find a decent graveyard and strangers can disappear without awkward questions."

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Blessed Orator
text: His quiet words fade into the night's chill, yet they burn into his listeners' minds with all the power of a thousand suns.

name: Caustic Tar
text:
"Twisted magic, twisted fate, Force the land to ooze with hate."
—Cabal chant

name: Crypt Creeper
text: To unearth its dinner, it inters itself.

name: Cursed Monstrosity
text:
"Run away! It's an . . . um . . . run away!"
—Nomad sentry

name: Decompose
text:
"Sheesh! How am I supposed to make a decent living around here?"
—Cabal grave robber

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

name: Dusk Imp
text: It despises humans and squirrels and beasts and dwarves and cephalids . . . well, it despises just about everything.

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Execute
text:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Face of Fear
text:
"It's only frightened five people to death. Not my best work."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Famished Ghoul
text: Memories have distinct tastes. Its favorites are the sickly sweetness of lost love and the bitter smokiness of cruel murder.

name: Filthy Cur
text: Some things even fleas won't bite.

name: Fledgling Imp
text: Imps aren't born knowing how to fly—just how to annoy.

name: Ghastly Demise
text:
"Anyone can snap her fingers and yank a soul. I prefer to kill creatively."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Cease-Fire
text: When the crimson fades from the magical embers, a final wisp of smoke will rise. Soon after, hostilities will begin anew.

name: Gravedigger
text: Oddly, no one questioned the Cabal's wisdom in hiring a zombie to work at the cemetery.

name: Hint of Insanity
text: "Practice makes perfect, but obsession makes better."

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Malevolent Awakening
text: The most popular pit fighters are brought back for encore performances.

name: Mind Burst
text: As haunting as a zombie's curse.

name: Mindslicer
text: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

name: Confessor
text: "There will be gains for our losses. There will be rights for our wrongs."

name: Overeager Apprentice
text: Slow and steady may not always win the race, but at least it doesn't end up splattered on the walls.

name: Rotting Giant
text: Wracked with rot, it wrecks and ruins.

name: Sadistic Hypnotist
text: "Victory in the pits is almost as rewarding as the methods I use to achieve it."

name: Dedicated Martyr
text:
"If he's so willing to suffer for his cause, then by all means, let us oblige him."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Screams of the Damned
text: It's important to face your inner demons . . . unless they're the kind of demons that can kill you.

name: Stalking Bloodsucker
text: The pits feed both its thirst for combat and its thirst for blood.

name: Tombfire
text: The fondest memories burn brightest. As they're lost forever, the flames grow hotter still.

name: Whispering Shade
text: It glides through the shadows until it reaches yours.

name: Zombie Assassin
text:
"Zombies don't kill. They recruit."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Zombie Cannibal
text: Nothing is sacred to the undead—not even their own kind.

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Zombify
text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

name: Anarchist
text: Those who will not follow are doomed to lead.

name: Ashen Firebeast
text:
"I'm not sure which impresses me most, its thoroughness or its intensity."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Barbarian Lunatic
text:
"I once saw a single barbarian charge a band of twenty nomads. I've seen some crazy ones, too."
—Nomad sentry

name: Battle Strain
text: The pits swallow the weak as predators swallow prey.

name: Blazing Salvo
text: Barbarians equate courage with the ability to endure pain.

name: Devoted Caretaker
text: Her eyes blaze with the strength of twenty shields. Every glance is a salvation.

name: Burning Sands
text:
"Pain teaches lessons no scholar can."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Chance Encounter
text: The more unlikely the victory, the more memorable the success.

name: Demolish
text:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

name: Dwarven Grunt
text:
Hard as stone and twice as stubborn.
—Dwarven compliment

name: Dwarven Strike Force
text: Any given foothill may hide dozens of dwarves waiting to spill from their tunnels like fire ants.

name: Divine Sacrament
text: Their whispered prayers rally the nomads better than any war cry could.

name: Ember Beast
text:
Spot one ember beast, attack.
Spot a second, best fall back.
—Dwarven saying

name: Epicenter
text: Sometimes destruction is Dominaria's way of rebuilding. Sometimes it's not.

name: Firebolt
text: Reach out and torch someone.

name: Flame Burst
text: As hot as a dwarf's rage.

name: Frenetic Ogre
text: The best thing about ogres is that they never try to sneak up on you.

name: Halberdier
text: His reputation precedes him—and so does his weapon.

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: "I didn't come to play. I came to win."

name: Dogged Hunter
text: The relationship between hunter and hunted knows nothing of alliances.

name: Lava Blister
text:
To treat flesh wounds, use earth. To treat earth wounds, use flesh.
—Barbarian saying

name: Liquid Fire
text: There's no such thing as a little bit of lava.

name: Mad Dog
text: The bones it buries may be yours.

name: Magma Vein
text:
Standing near a volcano
—Barbarian expression meaning "asking for it"

name: Minotaur Explorer
text: After the invasion devastated the Talruum and Hurloon tribes, the survivors began to search for other minotaurs.

name: Molten Influence
text: Lavamancers make simple requests: obey or die.

name: Mudhole
text: "Doing okay back there, Tarv? Tarv?"

name: Need for Speed
text: His feet buckled the ground, his hands cut the wind to ribbons, and he was gone.

name: Earnest Fellowship
text:
"The world has enough strife as it is. Where would we be if we turned against each other?"
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Obstinate Familiar
text:
"Lizards make excellent familiars. They never know when they've lost."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Pardic Firecat
text:
"I've heard of putting the cat out, but this isn't what I had in mind."
—Nomad sentry

name: Pardic Miner
text: "Punch and drag, Toss the slag, Sift the soil, Leave the spoil."

name: Pardic Swordsmith
text: A finely crafted blade will never meet as many blows on the battlefield as it did on the anvil.

name: Price of Glory
text:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Spark Mage
text: The Pardic Mountains are known for their spicy cuisine.

name: Tremble
text: Otaria's frequent tremors are the last stages of Dominaria's recovery from the Phyrexian war.

name: Whipkeeper
text: "If you don't hit your adversaries while they're down, they might get up again."

name: Bearscape
text:
"Nature is the endless dance between life and death."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Gallantry
text: The courageous accomplish more in a single moment than the cowardly do in a lifetime.

name: Cartographer
text: "Finding the way once is luck. Finding the way twice takes a good map."

name: Druid Lyrist
text: The druids and the forest are in perfect harmony. They sing the same songs.

name: Druid's Call
text: Suffer the little creatures, for they may yet rise up and beat you senseless.

name: Gorilla Titan
text: "I want a banana *this* big!"

name: Ground Seal
text:
"Let all we have buried be buried forever."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Ivy Elemental
text: In the gardens of the centaurs, many travelers have mysteriously vanished while admiring the elaborate topiaries.

name: Krosan Avenger
text: She'd have a fearsome reputation if she left any survivors.

name: Krosan Beast
text: Those who see the squirrels go underground in the winter aren't ready for what emerges in the spring.

name: Leaf Dancer
text: A leaf dancer sweeps through the forest like a spring breeze, evading even the sharpest eyes and ears.

name: Metamorphic Wurm
text: Only a handful have seen it transform. Or, from the wurm's perspective, only a mouthful.

name: Muscle Burst
text: As strong as a centaur's will.

name: Nantuko Disciple
text:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nantuko Elder
text:
Plant a field with wishes, and you will grow more wishes.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nantuko Mentor
text:
That which grows without roots cannot be uprooted.
—Nantuko teaching

name: New Frontiers
text: Spreading a blanket of growth to warm a weary world.

name: Nimble Mongoose
text: Faster than a cobra's bite.

name: Overrun
text:
The dance of angry feet
—Nantuko expression meaning "stampede"

name: Piper's Melody
text: Those who follow nature's path eventually walk in a circle.

name: Primal Frenzy
text:
"Don't dismiss its anger as mindless fury. I assure you, it has purpose."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Rabid Elephant
text: When in doubt, stomp.

name: Refresh
text:
Death is a moth that dances toward our inner flame. The brightest fire can singe its wings.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Seton, Krosan Protector
text: "Survival of the fittest is not only the law of the pits, it is the law of nature. That is why I fight."

name: Simplify
text:
A blossom's petals close inward to shut out the frost.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Spellbane Centaur
text: "No mage's deception can harm those who keep nature balanced."

name: Springing Tiger
text: The ground trembled in a violent purr.

name: Squirrel Mob
text: An army of squirrels is still an army.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the Krosan Forest, you've got to keep an eye out for the squirrels.

name: Still Life
text: The centaurs' simple magic can undo a basilisk's gaze, but only for a short time.

name: Twigwalker
text:
"Break one in half and you'll get a decent—if gooey—pair of weapons."
—Centaur warrior

name: Vivify
text: Near the Krosan border, farmers keep watch over their fields lest the sod get up and wander away.

name: Werebear
text: He exercises his right to bear arms.

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Woodland Druid
text: What is a tree? Slow hard thought. What is a flower? Swift soft flesh. What is a druid? Both.

name: Zoologist
text: "With friends like these, who needs people?"

name: Atogatog
text: It relishes old-fashioned family meals.

name: Decimate
text:
"Anyone can admire creation. Only a barbarian sees the beauty in demolition."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Iridescent Angel
text: She enraptures all, encompasses all, endures all.

name: Lieutenant Kirtar
text:
"His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same."
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Catalyst Stone
text: The gems' incandescence invades the dreams of all who see them.

name: Darkwater Egg
text:
"Do you thirst for knowledge no matter the cost?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

name: Angelic Wall
text:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

name: Life Burst
text: As uplifting as a mystic's dreams.

name: Limestone Golem
text: Dwarves have been known to take pickaxes to their own creations, hoping to discover treasures within.

name: Millikin
text: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

name: Mirari
text:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Mossfire Egg
text:
"Can you feel your instincts overwhelm your reason?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

name: Patchwork Gnomes
text: When building gnomes, dwarves adhere to the highest standards. The gnomes themselves aren't as particular.

name: Sandstone Deadfall
text:
"Two or three tons of rock can really get you down—and keep you there."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Shadowblood Egg
text:
"Does your passion for power consume your soul?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

name: Skycloud Egg
text:
"Have your dreams of a better society become an obsession?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

name: Luminous Guardian
text: "There is no victory without virtue."

name: Steamclaw
text:
"There's dead, and then there's *dead* dead."
—Steamclaw driver

name: Sungrass Egg
text:
"Has your peaceful nature led you on a crusade?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

name: Crystal Quarry
text:
"How tragic that greed eclipses beauty."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Master Apothecary
text: It takes a remarkable cleric to turn a group of healers into a hospital.

name: Deserted Temple
text: A monument to long-forgotten gods, it stands as a tribute to the fleeting nature of human ways.

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Mystic Visionary
text: "The aven are heralds of divinity. The greatest glory is to join them in the sky."

name: Mystic Zealot
text: Nomad youths aspire to one of two roles in the tribe: priest or warrior. Their secret dream is to become both.

name: Nomad Decoy
text: If you can take something from a nomad, it's probably bait.

name: Patrol Hound
text: To the camp, it was a fierce and loyal protector. To the sentry's youngest daughter, it would always be her "Wuv Muffin."

name: Pianna, Nomad Captain
text: Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

name: Animal Boneyard
text:
"The animal spirits are the Ancestor's grandchildren. Remember them."
—Mystic elder

name: Pilgrim of Justice
text: "I would die a thousand deaths before I let you harm another."

name: Pilgrim of Virtue
text: "A life is measured by the lives it saves."

name: Resilient Wanderer
text: Nomads understand many cultures and therefore travel without fear.

name: Second Thoughts
text: It suddenly dawned on Jorin that farming was quite a noble profession.

name: Shelter
text: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

name: Soulcatcher
text:
"Holy couriers guide aven spirits up to the home of the Ancestor."
—Mystic elder

name: Sphere of Duty
text: Duty subdues instinct.

name: Sphere of Grace
text: Grace repels darkness.

name: Auramancer
text: Beauty stirs the memory like a sweet perfume excites the air.

name: Sphere of Law
text: Law smothers anarchy.

name: Sphere of Reason
text: Reason exposes deception.

name: Sphere of Truth
text: Truth tempers fanaticism.

name: Spiritualize
text:
"There is purity in all things. Even hatred."
—Lieutenant Kirtar

name: Testament of Faith
text:
"Belief in the Ancestor is admirable, but our enemies often demand something more . . . tangible."
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Tireless Tribe
text: "We've survived starvation, dwarf attacks, and heatstroke. Why should a little sandstorm bother us?"

name: Aboshan, Cephalid Emperor
text: "No one can fight the tide forever."

name: Aven Archer
text: Aimed by the eyes of eagles, their arrows never miss the mark.

name: Aether Burst
text: As fleeting as a cephalid's promise.

name: Amugaba
text: The aven claim it feeds on thunder and rainbows.

name: Aura Graft
text: "It's not really stealing. It's more like extended borrowing."

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Aven Smokeweaver
text: In a world still pained from burns, some are born already scarred.

name: Aven Windreader
text: "The tiniest ripple tells a story ten fathoms deep."

name: Balshan Griffin
text: It helps to have an extra direction in which to run.

name: Battle of Wits
text: The wizard who reads a thousand books is powerful. The wizard who memorizes a thousand books is insane.

name: Aven Cloudchaser
text:
"At the Reapportionment, Eagle begged to be human. The Ancestor granted half that prayer."
—Nomad myth

name: Careful Study
text: Books are like crops—they must be thinned for best yield.

name: Cephalid Broker
text: Cephalids value the free exchange of ideas—except for the "free" part.

name: Cephalid Looter
text: "Amazing, isn't it, what humans will throw away when they're drowning?"

name: Cephalid Retainer
text: Cephalids whisper flattery in your ear, put jewels in your hand, spin dreams in your head, and stick knives in your back.

name: Cephalid Scout
text: The more they survey the dreadful dry expanses, the more the cephalids thirst to tame them.

name: Chamber of Manipulation
text: Politics is just a subtle form of mind control—and cephalids are master politicians.

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Aven Flock
text: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

name: Deluge
text:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan

name: Divert
text: "What's the fun of being a wizard if you can't mess with people's heads?"

name: Escape Artist
text: "Not even my shadow knows where I am."

name: Extract
text: To say Nixar had a splitting headache would be a bit of an understatement.

name: Fervent Denial
text:
"Your tenacity is admirable. And futile."
—Emperor Aboshan

name: Laquatus's Creativity
text: One never knows when inspiration will bubble up.

name: Patron Wizard
text: "The best way to teach is by example."

name: Pedantic Learning
text: Even the trivial can inspire.

name: Peek
text: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.

name: Persuasion
text: "Protocol demands that you bow down before me. I always stand on protocol."

name: Phantom Whelp
text: It lurks in the mist, waiting for stragglers to fall behind. When the fog clears, nothing remains but footprints.

name: Psionic Gift
text: For sale: Complete wizard's library. Rare scrolls, grimoires, and works of ancient spellcrafting! Slightly abridged.

name: Puppeteer
text: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

name: Repel
text:
"I have a hunch we'll be seeing that one again soon."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: The Mighty Will Fall
text: "Cry out for your comrades so that they may join you in misery."

name: My Laughter Echoes
text: "Groveling already? I'm just starting to enjoy myself."

name: No One Will Hear Your Cries
text: "Your companions were lucky to have died first."

name: A Reckoning Approaches
text: "The gates open to my new era."

name: There Is No Refuge
text: "The dunes smell spilled blood."

name: This World Belongs to Me
text: "Little insects, I have created entire worlds and extinguished twice as many."

name: What's Yours Is Now Mine
text: "Vow your allegiance to true power."

name: When Will You Learn?
text: "Don't fret, infants. It wouldn't have worked anyway."

name: Delight in the Hunt
text: "Pain is a delusion of the weak. I'll demonstrate."

name: Every Dream a Nightmare
text: "Let me unburden you of these fatuous hopes."

name: For Each of You, a Gift
text: "My generosity blesses you all, even the undeserving."

name: Make Yourself Useful
text: "To think you've spent years honing your body only to die like this."

name: Walker of the Wastes
text: In the absence of life, something yet grows.

name: Reality Hemorrhage
text: Tarek could not tell whether he was losing his blood or his mind.

name: Akoum Flameseeker
text: In the face of extinction, the most perilous endeavors can be cause for hope.

name: Boulder Salvo
text:
