"If someone claims the sky is falling, I listen."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Brute Strength
text: It's not the size of the rock. It's how badly you want to lift it.

name: Cinder Hellion
text: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

name: Devour in Flames
text: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality—except Chandra Nalaar.

name: Expedite
text: "I run, and thunder follows."

name: Fall of the Titans
text: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

name: Warden of Geometries
text: The wastelands disorient even the most experienced scouts, making them easy prey for Kozilek's drones.

name: Goblin Freerunner
text: There are old goblins and ambitious goblins, but very few old, ambitious goblins.

name: Kazuul's Toll Collector
text: Travelers are advised to bring extra swords, preferably shiny ones.

name: Oath of Chandra
text: "If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch."

name: Pyromancer's Assault
text: Never ask a pyromancer if that's the best she's got.

name: Sparkmage's Gambit
text:
"A touch of lightning, and anyone can be taught to dance."
—Tobin, sparkmage

name: Tears of Valakut
text: When Kozilek destroyed Sea Gate, distant Valakut could not contain its grief.

name: Zada's Commando
text:
"There's a word for someone who brings too much gear to battle: 'survivor.'"
—Zada of Slab Haven

name: Stalking Drone
text: As the Eldrazi adapted to the jungles of Zendikar, some took on the tactics of more familiar predators.

name: Baloth Pup
text: A young baloth channels its energy into playful destructiveness. Over time, it becomes less playful but no less destructive.

name: Bonds of Mortality
text: Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek to reality, but it was Nissa who could trace it on her world.

name: Canopy Gorger
text: The settlement's defenders were glad to have such a massive, ferocious creature join the fight—but less glad to see it flatten their homes along the way.

name: Elemental Uprising
text:
"My heart and Zendikar's beat as one. Together we will endure."
—Nissa Revane

name: Harvester Troll
text: Having no interest in the greater conflict, the trolls continue to prey upon whatever wanders into their domain.

name: Lead by Example
text: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

name: Loam Larva
text: The forest floor of Murasa is home to life as diverse and vibrant as that of the canopy above.

name: Natural State
text:
"Killing the Eldrazi is not enough. We must erase all memory of them from this world."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Netcaster Spider
text: In the jungles of Tazeem, aerial assault is not always advantageous.

name: Affa Protector
text: "Through all the terrors we face, I hold on to the memory of the world before the Eldrazi came. I'd like to see that world again."

name: Oath of Nissa
text: "For the life of every plane, I will keep watch."

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Saddleback Lagac
text:
"A good lagac will carry you through thick and thin. A bad one . . . well, it's a tasty dinner."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Seed Guardian
text: It is a reminder that spring will always follow winter.

name: Sylvan Advocate
text: "The land gives of itself. Its abundance provides, even in times of chaos."

name: Tajuru Pathwarden
text: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

name: Vines of the Recluse
text: "The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."

name: Allied Reinforcements
text: "Our formation was scattered after Sea Gate fell. If you're fighting the Eldrazi, consider us your newest recruits."

name: Baloth Null
text:
"Humans use pigs to hunt for mushrooms, don't they? It's like that."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

name: Cliffhaven Vampire
text: "My people are no longer slaves to the Eldrazi, beholden to the past. We will determine our own future."

name: Joraga Auxiliary
text: "Before the battle, I heard them take an oath near the ruins of Sea Gate. I hope they inspire others to keep watch."

name: Jori En, Ruin Diver
text: "Some relic hunters have given up exploring and gone to fight the Eldrazi. But I know our work is more important than ever. The secrets we uncover could lead to the world's salvation."

name: Mina and Denn, Wildborn
text: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

name: Relentless Hunter
text: "I swore to take one head for each member of my family they killed. My task is nowhere near its end."

name: Stormchaser Mage
text: Roilmages' tactics are as chaotic as the energies they channel.

name: Call the Gatewatch
text:
"I've heard it said that a Planeswalker is someone who can always run from danger. But Gideon's right: we're also the ones who can choose to stay."
—Jace Beleren

name: Weapons Trainer
text: "When I'm done training you, anything will be a deadly weapon."

name: Bone Saw
text: Once a simple tool, it—like everything else on Zendikar—has been turned into a weapon against the Eldrazi.

name: Captain's Claws
text: Forged for victory in a time of despair.

name: Chitinous Cloak
text:
"If we're going to survive, we have to use every tool at our disposal. Especially the disgusting ones."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

name: Hedron Crawler
text:
"It's endearing, in a mystical, pointy sort of way."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Seer's Lantern
text: A light to bring hope in dark times.

name: Stoneforge Masterwork
text: The nomadic kor carry only necessities on their long treks. The coming of the Eldrazi redefined "necessities."

name: Strider Harness
text:
"Sometimes being fast is as important as being smart."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

name: Cinder Barrens
text: A mudflow swallowed the lowlands years ago. All that remains are a bottomless mire and an endless rain of ash.

name: Corrupted Crossroads
text:
"Look, and see the future."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Dazzling Reflection
text:
"The light of a felidar's horns can give even an Eldrazi pause."
—Zarra, lullmage

name: Holdout Settlement
text: Even in areas of profound devastation, the hedrons remained intact.

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Sea Gate Wreckage
text: Once a center for knowledge, Sea Gate now serves as a reminder of what was lost.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

name: Timber Gorge
text: Tazeem's embrace is harsh, but for those that call it home, nothing else will do.

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Despite the chaos of the Roil and the devastation of the Eldrazi, Zendikar is a world of breathtaking beauty.

name: Unknown Shores
text: Kozilek's presence warped the land, stripping away layer after layer.

name: Eldrazi Mimic
text: It is consistently inconsistent.

name: Immolating Glare
text:
"The sun can warm your skin or blister it, nurture your crops or wither them, light your path or blind you. She is a fickle friend, but a far worse enemy."
—Nazra of the Stone Havens

name: Iona's Blessing
text:
"Walk now in my light. When the rest of the world closes its eyes, you will still see."
—Iona

name: Isolation Zone
text: When properly aligned, hedrons become powerful tools of binding.

name: Kor Scythemaster
text: The kor of Zendikar are known for quiet determination in the face of overwhelming odds.

name: Kor Sky Climber
text: "With rope, I can fly as far as the rope can reach. But with light, the sky is the limit."

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Makindi Aeronaut
text: "The Eldrazi have surprised us before. It's my job to make sure that never happens again."

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"We may have lost faith in our gods, but we are far from losing faith in ourselves."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Munda's Vanguard
text: "Do not let yourselves fall now. Zendikar is depending on us—on you!"

name: Oath of Gideon
text: "For justice and peace, I will keep watch."

name: Ondu War Cleric
text: "I will follow the light of Iona into battle, and I will know no fear."

name: Relief Captain
text: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

name: Searing Light
text:
"Light can lay bare our fears. It can also make them go away."
—Nazra of the Stone Havens

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
text:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

name: Spawnbinder Mage
text: "Follow me. Step lightly. And resist the urge to kick them."

name: Steppe Glider
text: It glides over the landscape. It also happens to be one.

name: Stone Haven Outfitter
text: The makers and menders are the first called to battle and the last to leave.

name: Stoneforge Acolyte
text: "The stone speaks. We are merely interpreters."

name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
text: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

name: Blinding Drone
text:
"Zendikar's true gods have risen. Whether in reverence or agony, all the world will kneel."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Prophet of Distortion
text: It doesn't twist words. It twists worlds.

name: Slip Through Space
text: The Eldrazi twisted in a direction that had no name, and a frontal assault became a panicked rout.

name: Thought Harvester
text:
"I never thought I'd miss the gomazoa."
—Trinda, Hada spy patrol

name: Void Shatter
text: Eldrazi break concentration like glass.

name: Kozilek's Pathfinder
text:
"We didn't know where it came from or where it was going. All we knew was that we did not matter."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Ancient Crab
text: After the fall of Sea Gate and the draining of the Halimar basin, the crab set off to find a new home.

name: Comparative Analysis
text:
"Our time grows short. If we wish to vanquish the Eldrazi, we must unlock the hedrons' secrets."
—Jace Beleren

name: Cyclone Sire
text: The rampaging Roil creates life out of the most volatile elements.

name: Gift of Tusks
text: It's an experience you'll never forget.

name: Jwar Isle Avenger
text: Though solitary by nature, the sphinxes did not hesitate to join in the fight against the Eldrazi.

name: Negate
text:
"Eventually, everything returns to silence."
—Zarra, lullmage

name: Oath of Jace
text: "For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch."

name: Roiling Waters
text:
"The Roil may be unpredictable, but it is not uncontrollable."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem roilmage

name: Sphinx of the Final Word
text: He answers questions as readily as he asks them, but his answer is always "no."

name: Sweep Away
text: The Roil takes many forms. It also takes many victims.

name: Umara Entangler
text: "Sea Gate is gone, the Halimar basin empty. But rebuild the seawall and give these waters time, and they will fill the basin anew."

name: Unity of Purpose
text: Faced with the novel problem of inspiring an army, Jace asked himself: "What would Gideon say?"

name: Dread Defiler
text: It left behind an echoing emptiness more horrible than the grave.

name: Essence Depleter
text: When Kozilek emerged at Sea Gate, his brood lineage swarmed to the surface.

name: Reality Smasher
text: As easy to stop as it is to comprehend.

name: Flaying Tendrils
text: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

name: Havoc Sower
text: It grew with a terrible swiftness.

name: Inverter of Truth
text: In its shadow, everything changed.

name: Kozilek's Shrieker
text: Listen to the sound of defeat.

name: Kozilek's Translator
text: From nothingness, sustenance.

name: Oblivion Strike
text: It's bad enough to be torn to pieces. It's worse by far to be torn from the world itself.

name: Reaver Drone
text: Kozilek's brood infiltrates and deceives. The spawn of Ulamog mindlessly consume.

name: Sky Scourer
text:
"The Eldrazi are nothing if not thorough."
—Jace Beleren

name: Slaughter Drone
text: It kills what is, making way for what should not be.

name: Spatial Contortion
text:
"For those without the Planeswalker spark, the merest touch of the Blind Eternities can kill."
—Ugin

name: Unnatural Endurance
text:
"Eldrazi don't die easy. Sometimes they don't die at all."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Witness the End
text:
"Ulamog stood before us at Sea Gate, ready to succumb . . . and then Kozilek arose. Whatever hope I had for our world died."
—Vandri, Kalastria emissary

name: Corpse Churn
text:
"The distraction of your life has ended. Now your service begins."
—Kalitas, thrall of Ulamog

name: Drana's Chosen
text: "Drana commands me. I command my nulls. And so her bidding is done."

name: Grasp of Darkness
text:
"I welcome the use of even the foulest magic if it will rid us of the monstrosities that plague our world."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Malakir Soothsayer
text: "Your blood whispers secrets your mind could never comprehend."

name: Null Caller
text: Zendikar's defenders include both healers and vampires. One way or another, the fallen will return to the fight.

name: Remorseless Punishment
text:
"I have suffered a thousand lifetimes of agony on this wretched world. I've far less time to share with you, but I assure you, no less pain."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Tar Snare
text: The amorphous, magically animated residue known as the Fathom Sludge lurks in the Hagra Cistern, attacking its prey with pseudopods and dragging it down to be digested.

name: Untamed Hunger
text:
"Mindlessness is not weakness. When we are lost to hunger we are unstoppable."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Vampire Envoy
text: "Zendikar will fight until it has bled its last."

name: Zulaport Chainmage
text: The chains obey her. Everything else would do best to get out of her way.

name: Consuming Sinkhole
text:
"What will not yield will be consumed."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Eldrazi Aggressor
text:
"They employ a foul sort of teamwork."
—General Tazri, allied commander

name: Immobilizer Eldrazi
text: It denied the Zendikari the chance to stand and die fighting.

name: Maw of Kozilek
text:
"The Eldrazi make worse than ruins—they make a world where not even ruins stand."
—Gideon Jura

name: Force of Will
text: 2011 Legacy Championship Winner

name: Brainstorm
text: 2012 Legacy Championship Winner

name: Wasteland
text: 2013 Legacy Championship Winner

name: Gaea's Cradle
text: 2014 Legacy Championship Winner

name: Tundra
text: 2015 Legacy Championship Winner

name: Underground Sea
text: 2016 European Legacy Champion

name: Badlands
text: 2016 North American Legacy Champion

name: Taiga
text: 2017 European Legacy Champion

name: Savannah
text: 2017 North American Legacy Champion

name: Scrubland
text: 2018 Europe Legacy Champion

name: Plateau
text: 2018 Asia Legacy Champion

name: Volcanic Island
text: 2018 North America Legacy Championship

name: Tropical Island
text: 2019 Europe Legacy Champion

name: Bayou
text: 2019 Asia Legacy Champion

name: City of Traitors
text: 2019 North America Legacy Champion

name: Karakas
text: 2020 Legacy Champion

name: Rishadan Port
text: 2020 Legacy Champion

name: Maze of Ith
text: 2020 Legacy Champion

name: Wasteland
text: 2021 Legacy Champion

name: Bayou
text: 2021 Legacy Champion

name: Sylvan Library
text: 2021 Legacy Champion

name: Gaea's Cradle
text: 2022 Asia Legacy Championship

name: Scrubland
text: 2022 North America Legacy Championship

name: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
text: 2022 Europe Legacy Championship

name: Lightning Bolt
text: 2023 North American Legacy Championship

name: Force of Will
text: 2023 Europe Legacy Championship

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Blight Mamba
text: Its venom drips with Phyrexia's hate.

name: Carrion Call
text: The natural order is out of order.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Mycosynth Fiend
text:
"I wish I could take credit for it, but nature progresses on its own, just the way it should."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Noxious Revival
text:
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

name: Heroic Reinforcements
text: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

name: Jor Kadeen, the Prevailer
text: "As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."

name: Phyresis Outbreak
text:
"It is amusing that the fleshlings believe we are at war. In truth, they are nothing but scurrying pests to be eradicated."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Mortify
text:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Rip Apart
text: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Goldwardens' Gambit
text: At Neyali's command, they took position. At Otharri's signal, they struck.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Plague Myr
text: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Kher Keep
text:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Slayers' Stronghold
text: Its courtyards are lit during every hour of the day so that night may never fall within its walls.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Monumental Corruption
text:
"Funny, I always thought the Phyrexians were a heartless lot."
—Kaya

name: Call the Coppercoats
text: When the alarm crystals flash, Drannith's finest answer the call.

name: Court of Grace
text: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

name: Cut a Deal
text:
"Abandon your selfish ambitions and become one with the Flesh Singularity."
—Elesh Norn

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Finale of Glory
text: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.

name: Flawless Maneuver
text:
"Captain, your units are the tip of our spear. There is zero room for failure."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Fumigate
text:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Harmonious Archon
text: First among equals.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Midnight Haunting
text: The path back to the world of the living is murky and bewildering. A geist may not even realize that it's terrifying its own loved ones.

name: Phantom General
text: After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.

name: Phyrexian Rebirth
text: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Caress of Phyrexia
text: "I am weak. Make . . . me . . . ideal."

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Plague Stinger
text: It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Hate Mirage
text: Each monstrosity that fails to kill him expands his conjured arsenal.

name: Offer Immortality
text: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."

name: Pestilent Syphoner
text: The praetors of the other Spheres privately wonder how Sheoldred always has a surplus of glistening oil at her disposal.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred

name: Ravenous Necrotitan
text: Some of Sheoldred's goliaths spread the glory of Phyrexia. Others just eat.

name: Scheming Aspirant
text: "I have raised many of my own contenders for the Coliseum. This one will be fearsome one day, mark my words."

name: Sheoldred's Edict
text: "Congratulations. I am entertained."

name: Sheoldred's Headcleaver
text: The punishment for sedition, like every other crime in the Dross Pits, is execution.

name: Stinging Hivemaster
text: From within its form, a single word echoed forth: "Devour."

name: Testament Bearer
text: She proudly carries the weight of Phyrexia's creed, both figuratively and literally.

name: Vat Emergence
text: The first rebirth is a reward. The fifty-first is a punishment.

name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
text: "Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."

name: Vraska's Fall
text: The dull, creeping pain of phyresis curdled in Vraska's blood. She knew as soon as it took her, she would betray everything—even Jace.

name: Whisper of the Dross
text: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."

name: All Will Be One
text: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

name: Awaken the Sleeper
text:
"Without faith in each other, we truly would have nothing left. Isn't that right, Malach? ...Malach?"
—Darven, Mirran rebel, last words

name: Axiom Engraver
text: "I will not rest until the truth of Phyrexia is inscribed across the Multiverse."

name: Barbed Batterfist
text: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."

name: Bladegraft Aspirant
text: "To dance to the music of Juex, leap like the flickering flame and hit like the hammer."

name: Blazing Crescendo
text:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar

name: Chimney Rabble
text:
"They're violent, headstrong, and wildly unpredictable. It should be amusing to see how Norn's vaunted tactics try to cope with them."
—Urabrask

name: Goldwarden's Helm
text: "My mother wore this into battle against the first Phyrexians. Now I wear it in her honor."

name: Free from Flesh
text: He finally understood that phyresis was not an ending, but a new, perfect beginning.

name: Furnace Punisher
text: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

name: Furnace Strider
text: With the Quiet Furnace closed to all other factions, Urabrask's smiths were free to build anything their creativity demanded.

name: Gleeful Demolition
text: Urabrask encourages creativity in all its forms, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.

name: Hazardous Blast
text: The Machine Orthodoxy finds strength in numbers. The Quiet Furnace finds that amusing.

name: Hexgold Slash
text:
"No matter how tough they are, even Phyrexians prefer to keep their guts on the inside."
—Jor Kadeen

name: Kuldotha Cackler
text: You would laugh too if you just burned through a tyrranax's stomach.

name: Molten Rebuke
text: "Perhaps this will show the Orthodoxy what we think of their attempts at indoctrination."

name: Nahiri's Sacrifice
text: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.

name: Oxidda Finisher
text: Popular wisdom says that Phyrexians don't feel fear. But popular wisdom has never tried to hold a bridge against an angry ogre.

name: Rebel Salvo
text: "That Great Work of yours is looking pretty fragile, Urabrask!"

name: Red Sun's Twilight
text:
"Where once there was apathy, Urabrask brought passion, and the Great Work truly began."
—Monument inscription

name: Resistance Skywarden
text: When the Vulshok taught him the word for "home," he knew it was what he had been fighting for.

name: Sawblade Scamp
text: Sometimes the Great Work requires destruction to allow for more efficient reconstruction.

name: Shrapnel Slinger
text:
"They may have unlimited mites, but that just means we have unlimited ammunition."
—Urabrask

name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
text: Once he fought to save Mirrodin. Now he fights to remake it.

name: Incisor Glider
text:
"You think it's creepy now? You should see how it eats."
—Melira

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: As the infection spread, Nahiri's thoughts grew tangled. She needed to protect what she loved from Phyrexia... or maybe only Phyrexia could protect what she loved.

name: Urabrask's Anointer
text: "You were so eager to spy on my work, I assume you'll appreciate a hands-on demonstration."

name: Vindictive Flamestoker
text: Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.

name: Volt Charge
text:
"There's a war brewing between Norn and Urabrask. Exploit the chaos, and we can take them both down for good."
—Koth

name: Vulshok Splitter
text:
"Not my style, but it'll get the job done."
—Nahiri

name: Armored Scrapgorger
text: "Eat. Sort. Eat. Sort. Eat."

name: Branchblight Stalker
text: Some Vicious Swarm aspirants hang motionless in the canopy for weeks, allowing poisonous flowers to root in their flesh and weave tendrils through their hair.

name: Copper Longlegs
text: Its webs are not true silk, but woven from thousands of delicate mycosynth strands.

name: Ichorspit Basilisk
text: Warm forges and tasty goblins lured it from the Hunter Maze to the Quiet Furnace.

name: Incubation Sac
text:
"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer

name: Infectious Bite
text:
"Let me tell you why you must never close your eyes when on watch. Not even for a second."
—Jor Kadeen

name: Lattice-Blade Mantis
text:
"Urabrask doesn't think big enough."
—Glissa Sunslayer

name: Noxious Assault
text: Even as they brought the beast down, they could feel its poison working into their blood, altering their bodies, and filling their minds with the thrill of the eternal hunt.

name: Oil-Gorger Troll
text: Metal or flesh, it didn't matter—seasoned with ichor, it all tasted so good.

name: Paladin of Predation
text: The strategies and politics of the Vicious Swarm are as subtle as Vorinclex himself.

name: Jawbone Duelist
text: "I have room for a few more teeth in my collection. Who's next?"

name: Predation Steward
text:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira

name: Rustvine Cultivator
text:
"All elves aspire to be part of nature. Only Phyrexia can truly grant that wish."
—Glissa Sunslayer

name: Ruthless Predation
text: In the Hunter Maze, today's apex predator is tomorrow's prey.

name: Skyscythe Engulfer
text:
"I bet even Skithiryx would take the long way around this one."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

name: Titanic Growth
text:
"It is as the Mirrans say: True strength comes from within."
—Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer

name: Tyrranax Atrocity
text: While some predators specialize in speed, size, or deadly venom, the adaptive tyrranax see no need to limit themselves.

name: Tyvar's Stand
text: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."

name: Unnatural Restoration
text: "If you don't reassemble me immediately, the Mother of Machines will notice my absence, and this entire layer will face her wrath!"

name: Venerated Rotpriest
text:
"This was once a peaceful spring, but I wouldn't advise taking a sip."
—Melira

name: Cephalopod Sentry
text: Silent observers swim through the air of Norn's Seedcore, watching the nascent Invasion Tree for any signs of interference.

name: Annex Sentry
text: There's never a need to change the watch, for the servants of Norn are sleepless.

name: Leonin Lightbringer
text: "It's hard to fight for the future if you can't see the way forward."

name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
text: "Ah, my old friends. Have you decided at last to stop clinging to the past and join me in the grand pursuit of perfection?"

name: Mandible Justiciar
text: While one mouth feeds, the other chatters mindless paeans of Elesh Norn's glory.

name: Slaughter Singer
text: After giving in to the thrill of the hunt, he could never again return to the quiet of the Basilica.

name: Vivisection Evangelist
text: "May you rejoice in the magnificence of Norn. May your flesh serve perfection."

name: Basilica Skullbomb
text: It shines with the conviction of a zealous acolyte.

name: Dross Skullbomb
text: It seethes with the ambition of a ruthless gladiator.

name: Dune Mover
text: The shifting, unpredictable sands were deemed a disobedient affront to the Flesh Singularity.

name: Furnace Skullbomb
text: It burns with the passion of an unbound creator.

name: Maze Skullbomb
text: It pulses with the might of an apex predator.

name: Mirran Safehouse
text:
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside."
—Koth

name: Myr Convert
text: Humble, obedient, and tireless, myr require little modification to excel as servants of Phyrexia.

name: Myr Custodian
text:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch

name: Myr Kinsmith
text:
"Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure."
—Melira

name: Phyrexian Atlas
text: Since conquering Mirrodin, Phyrexian engineers have worked tirelessly to transform the plane's original two layers into a more fitting array of nine.

name: Prophetic Prism
text:
"The five suns may have dimmed, but their light still guides us."
—Thrun

name: Prosthetic Injector
text: Why carry a subject to a surgical lab when you can bring the surgical lab to them?

name: Norn's Wellspring
text:
"Drown, so you may breathe again."
—Atraxa

name: Soulless Jailer
text:
"Lock the door and eat the key."
—Vraan, Executioner Thane

name: Surgical Skullbomb
text: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.

name: Zenith Chronicler
text: It watches through the never-ending day, motionless save for the unsettling, twitching dance it performs as each sun reaches its apex.

name: The Autonomous Furnace
text: In Urabrask's domain, mighty forges echo day and night with the clangor of the Great Work.

name: Blackcleave Cliffs
text: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.

name: Copperline Gorge
text: Where fire meets ferocity, a greater evolution begins.

name: Orthodoxy Enforcer
text: The mites sniff out any potential interlopers. He handles the rest.

name: Darkslick Shores
text: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.

name: The Dross Pits
text: In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.

name: The Fair Basilica
text: In Elesh Norn's domain, the gospel of unity is the highest law.

name: The Hunter Maze
text: In Vorinclex's domain, only the mightiest survive, and all are prey in his endless hunt.

name: The Mycosynth Gardens
text: As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.

name: Razorverge Thicket
text: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

name: Seachrome Coast
text: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.

name: Ossification
text: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.

name: The Surgical Bay
text: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth

name: Phyrexian Vindicator
text:
"Behold your inevitable defeat."
—Elesh Norn

name: Ossification
text: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.

name: Sheoldred's Edict
text: "Congratulations. I am entertained."

name: Planar Disruption
text: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival. Elesh Norn knew they were coming.

name: Slaughter Singer
text: After giving in to the thrill of the hunt, he could never again return to the quiet of the Basilica.

name: Bladed Ambassador
text: Obedience is the armor that turns any blade.

name: Sinew Dancer
text: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.

name: Quicksilver Fisher
text: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.

name: Plated Onslaught
text:
"Witness the glory of true, unwavering unity."
—Ajani

name: Bonepicker Skirge
text: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.

name: Furnace Punisher
text: Etch your victories in iron, that the world may celebrate them forever.

name: Sawblade Scamp
text: Be the blade that severs hierarchy.

name: Urabrask's Anointer
text: Will you be the flame which burns the world, or merely be consumed as fuel?

name: Rustvine Cultivator
text: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.

name: Myr Convert
text: In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.

name: Apostle of Invasion
text: "Be not afraid of the holy chorus. Join in rapturous harmony."

name: Porcelain Zealot
text: "There is a single, glorious truth, etched in the hearts of the faithful. Join in unity, or be washed away."

name: Phyrexian Vindicator
text: Submit and know the Mother's glory. Resist and and know her wrath.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very ground they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.

name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
text: Do not fear death. Fear failure.

name: Resistance Reunited
text: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth. "I was about to say the same, my friend," Elspeth replied.

name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
text: The Forge embraces all who contribute to the Great Work.

name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
text: Who is an enemy but a friend who has yet to accept perfection?

name: Sinew Dancer
text: He spreads word of the Argent Etchings to a captive audience.

name: Swooping Lookout
text:
"It's hard to tell with this glare, but those must be the skyhunter reinforcements! They have arrived at last!"
—Prahan, Mirran rebel

name: Vanish into Eternity
text: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.

name: Veil of Assimilation
text:
"Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth."
—Atraxa

name: Aspirant's Ascent
text: For the aspirants of the Progress Engine, being launched into the sphere's upper reaches is a great honor. Some are even granted wings beforehand.

name: Serum Sovereign
text: A thousand riddles, each with a single answer: "The glory of Phyrexia."

name: Rhuk, Hexgold Nabber
text: Never get between a goblin and the closest shiny object.

name: Atmosphere Surgeon
text: It is Jin-Gitaxias's deepest exasperation that any part of his domain still requires maintenance.

name: Bladed Ambassador
text: Obedience is the armor that turns any blade.

name: Phyrexian Vindicator
text: Submit and know the Mother's glory. Resist and and know her wrath.

name: Sinew Dancer
text: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.

name: Blue Sun's Twilight
text:
"Where once there was ignorance, Jin-Gitaxias brought knowledge, and an age of progress dawned."
—Monument inscription

name: Quicksilver Fisher
text: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.

name: Bonepicker Skirge
text: Even the most insignificant creature can be perfected.

name: Bring the Ending
text: Kaya watched in horror as the illusion vanished from her hands. Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text: Take everything from them. Lives. Flesh. The very gorund they walk on. Only then will your victory be compleat.

name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
text: Do not fear death. Fear failure.

name: Furnace Punisher
text: Etch your victories in iron, that the world may celebrate them forever.

name: Sawblade Scamp
text: Be the blade that severs hierarchy.

name: Slobad, Iron Goblin
text: The Forge embraces all who contribute to the Great Work.

name: Chrome Prowler
text: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.

name: Urabrask's Anointer
text: Will you be the flame which burns the world, or merely be consumed as fuel?

name: Rustvine Cultivator
text: Feel the joy of losing yourself to feed the land.

name: Distorted Curiosity
text: "Free will was an illusion so perfect it fooled even me. I know better now."

name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
text: Who is an enemy but a friend who has yet to accept perfection?

name: Encroaching Mycosynth
text:
"Careful—however they might look, they're not human. A step too close and they'll drag you in."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

name: Myr Convert
text: In the embrace of the Mother of Machines, hard work never goes unrewarded.

name: Escaped Experiment
text: One morning, the test subject decided to perform trials on the scientists.

name: Bladed Ambassador
text: "Let those thanebound dissenters prattle about their dead god. I serve the Mother of Machines, and in her name I carve out their heresy."

name: Font of Progress
text:
"Drink deeply of the truth, and become *compleat*."
—Tamiyo

name: Gitaxian Anatomist
text: An inconsistency in a routine vivisection sparked a revelation about the inner workings of the Orthodoxy's centurions.

name: Gitaxian Raptor
text: Bored with the ruins of Lumengrid, it migrated to the ruins of the Mephidross.

name: Glistener Seer
text: "The oil is all-knowing. The trick is to ask the right questions."

name: Ichor Synthesizer
text: "I've isolated the chirality of the glistening oil, so there will be no wasted precursors."

name: Malcator's Watcher
text: Each of the Gitaxian sectives watches the others, looking for any hint of imperfection.

name: Meldweb Curator
text:
"Imagine a giant room, like a library . . . except instead of books, it's filled with body parts."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

name: Minor Misstep
text: No matter how many times he saw it, Sarnvax always relished the look of dawning horror as his foes realized their mistake.

name: Prologue to Phyresis
text: "Please, for science, tell me how it feels. Leave nothing out."

name: Quicksilver Fisher
text: It no longer needs to eat, but old instincts are put to use ridding the Surgical Bay of spies.

name: Reject Imperfection
text:
"Your theory holds merit. You do not."
—Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective

name: Serum Snare
text: "I bring a message from the Autonomous Furn—argh!"

name: Tamiyo's Immobilizer
text: Visitors to the Surgical Bay often become permanent residents.

name: Compleat Devotion
text: "Elspeth, my friend, the Multiverse has answered my prayers to bring you here so that I may gather you into my pride and forever protect you."

name: Tamiyo's Logbook
text:
"We are opening a new chapter in the one true story of Phyrexia. Someone must record it for posterity."
—Tamiyo

name: Vivisurgeon's Insight
text: "Experimental Log 290: Leaving the subject's pain receptors active appears to yield an unprecedented combination of incoherence and hyperawareness."

name: Watchful Blisterzoa
text: After a series of ambushes, Uulbrek demanded a sentry with no blind spots.

name: Ambulatory Edifice
text: The Mirran forces thought they'd vanquished their foes . . . until a nearby monument got up and started stalking toward them.

name: Crawling Chorus
text: "We need not be swift. We are inexorable."

name: Annihilating Glare
text: By gaze, sting, and claw, Vraska will see the will of Phyrexia done.

name: Anoint with Affliction
text: Many vatkeepers use necrogen etchings to judge the value of their aspirants. If the wounds rot and fester, the recipient is not worth further effort.

name: Bilious Skulldweller
text:
"Watch your footing around here. Anything you might step on probably has teeth."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

name: Black Sun's Twilight
text:
"Where once there was complacence, Sheoldred brought ambition, and soon the will of Yawgmoth reigned."
—Monument inscription

name: Bonepicker Skirge
text:
"Get away from there! I must rebuild that one for the next bout. Shoo, shoo!"
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

name: Chittering Skitterling
text: What cannot be remade will be unmade, one scrap at a time.

name: Cruel Grimnarch
text: The gospel of lies sounds sweetest when whispered by many mouths.

name: Cutthroat Centurion
text: "We both serve the Demon Thane. Your parts would better serve with me."

name: Duelist of Deep Faith
text: "There is no hate behind our blades. We kill out of love, and the desire to share Norn's blessings with all."

name: Drown in Ichor
text: Sinking into the Dross is neither a gentle death nor a quiet one. But once the necrogen takes hold, it is inevitable.

name: Duress
text:
"Give of yourself, for compleation awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

name: Feed the Infection
text: They wished to become vital parts of the Dross Pits. Azax-Azog granted their request.

name: Fleshless Gladiator
text: What she lacks in skin she makes up in swagger.

name: Geth, Thane of Contracts
text: "It seems someone forgot to read the fine print."

name: Gulping Scraptrap
text:
"Does anyone else hear that horrible crunching sound?"
—Jace

name: Infectious Inquiry
text: "I give you pain, you give me information. A simple trade, is it not?"

name: Akroma's Blessing
text: The clerics saw her as a divine gift. She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

name: Catapult Master
text: "There's no 'I' in 'team,' but there's a 'we' in 'weapon.'"

name: Nameless One
text: "Open your mind to me."

name: Psychic Trance
text: The Riptide Project was perhaps the only school devoted to preventing the spread of knowledge.

name: Read the Runes
text: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

name: Reminisce
text: "Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges."

name: Riptide Biologist
text: "I gave it two choices: life in the lab or death in the hunt."

name: Riptide Chronologist
text: The wizard consulted the Riptide Project about how to further his research. He wasn't prepared for what they told him.

name: Catapult Squad
text: Together they could hit anything between the heavens and the horizon.

name: Rummaging Wizard
text: "I've got everything you'd ever need right here. Just give me some time to find it."

name: Sage Aven
text: From their mountain aeries, aven scholars see far more than the distant horizon.

name: Sea's Claim
text:
"My vengeance will drown my enemies as my storms drown the desert."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Slipstream Eel
text: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

name: Standardize
text: At that point, the wizards' argument got a lot uglier.

name: Supreme Inquisitor
text: "It's hard to fight on an empty mind."

name: Words of Wind
text:
"Be logical in all things. Do not allow instinct or passion to cloud your mind."
—*Volume II, The Book of Insight*

name: Accursed Centaur
text:
"The Cabal mocks the natural order. For its minions, death is just a pause between duties."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Anurid Murkdiver
text: Aphetto's swamps are alive with the dead.

name: Aphetto Dredging
text: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

name: Blackmail
text: Even the most virtuous person is only one secret away from being owned by the Cabal.

name: Boneknitter
text: Nothing comes together as easily as it comes apart.

name: Cabal Archon
text: "You are weak. I am strong. The protocol is obvious."

name: Cabal Slaver
text: "In its natural habitat, the goblin is stupid, yet devious. Now it's stupid, devious, and powerful."

name: Crown of Suspicion
text: "Darkness, hide my fear."

name: Cruel Revival
text: Few Cabal fighters fear death. They fear what follows it.

name: Death Match
text: The Cabal breeds many things for the pit fights, but it never breeds compassion.

name: Disciple of Malice
text: The lantern he carried did not light his way—it signaled his approach.

name: Convalescent Care
text: Enlightenment comes most swiftly at life's end.

name: Doomed Necromancer
text:
"His sacrifice shall not be forgotten. Now toss his body over there with the others."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Fade from Memory
text: Proper burial is a luxury Otarians can no longer afford.

name: Fallen Cleric
text: The most terrifying zombies are those with just a hint of their old selves left.

name: False Cure
text:
"I do unto others as others have done unto me."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Feeding Frenzy
text: It wasn't as much a strategy as a dim instinct to drown their prey.

name: Festering Goblin
text: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

name: Crowd Favorites
text:
"The rabble likes them. Make sure they win, then book them for tomorrow."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Gangrenous Goliath
text: Cabal clerics don't heal the sick—they heal the dead.

name: Gluttonous Zombie
text: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

name: Gravespawn Sovereign
text: The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.

name: Grinning Demon
text: It's drawn to the scent of screaming.

name: Infest
text:
"It is from Phage that this evil springs, and to her it shall return."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Crown of Awe
text: "Honor, guide my step."

name: Patriarch's Bidding
text:
"Family plots are so convenient."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Profane Prayers
text: "We have ways to make you talk, but you have nothing interesting to say."

name: Prowling Pangolin
text: It's always hungry, yet easily sated.

name: Severed Legion
text: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

name: Shade's Breath
text: The grim business of the Coliseum casts long shadows.

name: Shepherd of Rot
text:
"My priests swore loyalty to the Cabal not until death, but beyond it."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Crude Rampart
text: Success is one part inspiration, nine parts desperation.

name: Smother
text:
"I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Soulless One
text: "Surrender your soul to me."

name: Spined Basher
text:
"How cute. Does it do any other tricks?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Strongarm Tactics
text: "If you can't pay your gambling debts, you just might be tomorrow's main attraction at the Grand Coliseum."

name: Swat
text: Few who cross Phage have the chance to repeat the mistake.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Syphon Soul
text: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred. Then she lost herself again in the joy of her victims' suffering.

name: Thrashing Mudspawn
text: It just obeys you. It doesn't *like* you.

name: Visara the Dreadful
text: "My eyes are my strongest feature."

name: Walking Desecration
text: Such sacrilege turns blinding grief into blinding rage.

name: Words of Waste
text:
"Terror corrupts order and paralyzes instinct."
—*Volume III, The Book of Decay*

name: Wretched Anurid
text: The only prince inside this frog is the one it ate.

name: Aether Charge
text: "Is it just me, or does that meteor have teeth?"

name: Airdrop Condor
text: It has two kinds of droppings, neither of which is particularly pleasant.

name: Battering Craghorn
text: Their skeletons can be found all over Skirk Ridge, tangled in each other's horns.

name: Break Open
text: There are two ways to resolve puzzling situations: thoughtful contemplation or force. After thoughtful contemplation, most barbarians choose force.

name: Brightstone Ritual
text: Wizards fought over the stone to exploit its power. Goblins fight over it because it's shiny.

name: Butcher Orgg
text: It can kill you with three arms tied behind its back.

name: Charging Slateback
text: Goblins prize its hide for building rock sled runners.

name: Crown of Fury
text: "Passion, fire my heart."

name: Custody Battle
text: Goblins resolve disputes by splitting everything straight down the middle.

name: Dragon Roost
text: A powerful mage created the roost to guard a portal between the planes. The mage is long gone, but dragons still keep watch at the gate.

name: Dwarven Blastminer
text: "Life is too short for something like a hunk of rock to get in my way."

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

name: Daru Lancer
text: Although the Order frowned upon his preparations for the pits, behind closed doors most saw the fights as a necessary evil.

name: Goblin Piledriver
text: Throw enough goblins at any problem and it should go away. At the very least, there'll be fewer goblins.

name: Goblin Pyromancer
text: "The good news is, we figured out how the wand works. The bad news is, we figured out how the wand works."

name: Goblin Sky Raider
text: The goblin word for "flying" is more accurately translated as "falling slowly."

name: Goblin Sledder
text: "Let's play 'sled.' Here's how it works: you're the sled."

name: Daunting Defender
text: "I will wield the stone of my homeland as though it were the fists of the Ancestor."

name: Goblin Taskmaster
text: For some reason, goblin fighting school isn't as crowded on day two.

name: Grand Melee
text: Hot blood washes away cold reason.

name: Gratuitous Violence
text: Only the Cabal could make a fight to the death more deadly.

name: Insurrection
text:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Lay Waste
text: Skirk Ridge had survived earthquakes, mudslides, and meteor showers. Then the goblins moved in.

name: Lightning Rift
text: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

name: Mana Echoes
text: When the ground is saturated with mana, even the lightest footstep can bring it to the surface.

name: Nosy Goblin
text: To his surprise, Furt discovered that the strange creatures were not at all like bugs.

name: Pinpoint Avalanche
text:
"Some solve problems by thinking and talking. Others use rocks."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

name: Reckless One
text: "Release chaos with me!"

name: Rorix Bladewing
text: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land. The rest seek any opportunity to restore the broken pride of their race.

name: Searing Flesh
text: Zemoo found out the hard way that "inflammable" and "flammable" mean the same thing.

name: Shaleskin Bruiser
text: Its only predators are the elements.

name: Shock
text:
"I love lightning! It's my best invention since the rock."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

name: Skirk Fire Marshal
text: He's boss because he's smart enough to get out of the way.

name: Defensive Maneuvers
text: "Only on the battlefield can we repay all the Order has given us."

name: Skirk Prospector
text:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Sparksmith
text: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

name: Spitfire Handler
text: "Wait 'til Toggo sees this!"

name: Spurred Wolverine
text: After a few painful experiences, goblins learned not to pick their noses around the beasts.

name: Starstorm
text: Pardic barbarians didn't complain when the Order started blaming every crisis on the Cabal.

name: Demystify
text: "The truth will outshine all lies."

name: Thoughtbound Primoc
text: Efforts to use them as spies failed when they kept reporting to the enemy.

name: Threaten
text: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

name: Wave of Indifference
text:
"Darius?"
"Yeah?"
"There's a goblin sneaking up on you."
"So?"
"Just sayin'."

name: Words of War
text:
"Passions can't be shackled by laws or mastered with logic. The choice is freedom or death."
—*Volume IV, The Book of Fire*

name: Barkhide Mauler
text: Anywhere else they would be hunted for their skins, but in Wirewood, they are safe.

name: Biorhythm
text:
"I have seen life's purpose, and now it is my own."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Bloodline Shaman
text: Every creature of the forest has a name, and she knows them all.

name: Disciple of Grace
text: Dread was as foreign to her as the landscape ahead.

name: Centaur Glade
text: The Mirari called to the centaurs, and all who heard it were forever changed.

name: Crown of Vigor
text: "Life, be my shield."

name: Elven Riders
text: "Wirewood cannot hide great size. Only with speed and skill can we survive here."

name: Elvish Guidance
text: "Old home never forgotten, new home ours forever."

name: Elvish Pathcutter
text: In harsh times, the strongest currency is cooperation.

name: Elvish Pioneer
text:
"Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Elvish Scrapper
text: "The stories tell of a distant time when machines overran the forests, destroying everything that lived. That time will not come again."

name: Elvish Vanguard
text: "Our lives are woven together like the trees' branches over our heads, forming a canopy that protects us all."

name: Dive Bomber
text: "Your graves will lie beneath my final nest."

name: Elvish Warrior
text: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

name: Enchantress's Presence
text: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Heedless One
text: "Channel your vitality through me."

name: Invigorating Boon
text: The Mirari's echoes rang in the scouts' minds long after they had returned from the Krosan Forest.

name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
text: "My mind has changed. My strength has not."

name: Kamahl's Summons
text: As Krosa unleashed the peace in Kamahl, he unleashed the fury in Krosa.

name: Doubtless One
text: "Share your devotion with me."

name: Krosan Colossus
text: When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.

name: Krosan Groundshaker
text: You know it's coming when you hear the distant thunder. You know where it's been when you see the path of broken trees.

name: Leery Fogbeast
text: It emerges from the mists only to feed.

name: Mythic Proportions
text: The blood of Krosa turns rational beings into primal forces.

name: Naturalize
text: "From here, let the world be reborn."

name: Overwhelming Instinct
text: The biggest difference between a victory and a massacre is which side you're on.

name: Ravenous Baloth
text:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

name: Run Wild
text: Wirewood's beasts didn't seem to mind when the elves moved in. In fact, they hardly noticed them underfoot.

name: Silklash Spider
text: The only thing that flies over the Krosan Forest is the wind.

name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
text: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

name: Snarling Undorak
text: Most creatures in the Krosan Forest feared the Mirari's power. A few fed upon it.

name: Stag Beetle
text: Its voice crackles with the hum of a thousand wings beating at once.

name: Steely Resolve
text: No one in Wirewood understands what is happening. They just know it's unnatural—and coming from Krosa.

name: Symbiotic Beast
text: The insects found a meal in the carrion of the beast's prey. The beast found a spiffy new hairstyle.

name: Symbiotic Elf
text: The elves arriving in Wirewood had no homes, let alone weapons, but they knew that the forest would always provide.

name: Symbiotic Wurm
text: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

name: Foothill Guide
text: "Like any pests, goblins must be repelled quickly or they multiply."

name: Taunting Elf
text: The safety of the village depends on the beast thinking with its stomach.

name: Towering Baloth
text: The Mirari twisted all that lived in the Krosan Forest into gross mockeries of their former selves.

name: Treespring Lorian
text: No matter your strength, the Krosan Forest is stronger. No matter your speed, the Wirewood Forest is faster.

name: Tribal Unity
text: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him, but he still believes in the power of muscle.

name: Voice of the Woods
text: The ritual of making draws upon the elves' memories and pasts. And elves have long memories and ancient pasts.

name: Wall of Mulch
text: Mulch is the fabric of life in the forest. Plants live in it, they die in it, and then they become part of it, feeding countless generations to come.

name: Weird Harvest
text: Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.

name: Ancestor's Prophet
text: "We have faced horrors of war and terrors beyond imagining. We will overcome the uncertainties of this new life."

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Wirewood Elf
text: "The land belongs to nature as far as our eyes can see. The higher we climb, the more we can see."

name: Wirewood Herald
text: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

name: Wirewood Pride
text: "Though you may leave this haven we have found, may our strength never leave you."

name: Wirewood Savage
text:
"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

name: Words of Wilding
text:
"Instinct is undaunted by terror, unchained by logic. It is the path from which all other paths diverge."
—*Volume V, The Book of Life*

name: Cryptic Gateway
text: Its lock changes to fit each key.

name: Dream Chisel
text: Itself a product of Ixidor's tortured psyche, the chisel brings his darkest dreams to life.

name: Glory Seeker
text: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

name: Slate of Ancestry
text: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

name: Grassland Crusader
text: "Everyone deserves a chance to live. My job is to make sure they get it."

name: Gustcloak Harrier
text: Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.

name: Gustcloak Runner
text: Cabal spies trying to follow the Order's movements are constantly frustrated by tracks that stop dead.

name: Gustcloak Savior
text:
"Our death-arrows flew in high arcs towards the aven. And then . . . nothing."
—Coliseum guard

name: Gustcloak Sentinel
text: Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.

name: Gustcloak Skirmisher
text: They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

name: Harsh Mercy
text:
"There is no greater burden than choosing who to save."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Astral Slide
text:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

name: Improvised Armor
text: "I trust what I make for myself. Do you trust more what is made for you by another?"

name: Inspirit
text: "We will force the Cabal into their own pits!"

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Mobilization
text: Newcomers to Otaria find themselves at the bottom of the heap. In the pits, they at least have the chance to climb atop a heap of bodies.

name: Nova Cleric
text: "Our noblest thoughts are our very first and our very last."

name: Oblation
text: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

name: Pacifism
text: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

name: Aura Extraction
text: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Sandskin
text: "Those who live by the sword will die by the sword. I choose to do neither."

name: Shared Triumph
text: "Win together, die alone."

name: Shieldmage Elder
text: "You may fight if I deem your cause worthy."

name: Sigil of the New Dawn
text:
"We lay our dead to rest in a beautiful bed, in hopes that the Ancestor will think it a fit cradle for the next life."
—Mystic elder

name: True Believer
text: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

name: Unified Strike
text: The tall, reedy grass of the Daru Plains rustles loudly in the winds, a perfect cover for any ambush.

name: Whipcorder
text: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

name: Words of Worship
text:
"The faithful don't succumb to terror, nor are they ruled by passion. They adhere to order, for order is life."
—*Volume I, The Book of Faith*

name: Airborne Aid
text:
"We help our Southern Order comrades as much as we can. But the Cabal's insidious influence spreads, dividing our forces and leaving new arrivals to fend for themselves."
—Commander Eesha

name: Annex
text: Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.

name: Aphetto Alchemist
text: He brews trouble.

name: Aphetto Grifter
text: Aphetto con artists started working in pairs to make it less likely they'd be the victims of con artists.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

name: Aven Brigadier
text: He represents what little pride the Order has left.

name: Backslide
text: Some things are better left unknown.

name: Blatant Thievery
text: "I'll leave subtlety to the rich."

name: Crafty Pathmage
text: The most valuable commodity in the pits is a way out.

name: Crown of Ascension
text: "Wisdom, clear my eyes."

name: Discombobulate
text:
"I said 'pick his brain,' not 'tear off his head.'"
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Aven Soulgazer
text: "Every question has a proper answer. Every soul has a proper place."

name: Dispersing Orb
text:
"Like the seas, the Æther is fickle and ever-changing. If we can control one, we can master the other."
—Riptide Project director

name: Disruptive Pitmage
text: "Show weakness to hide your strength."

name: Essence Fracture
text:
"Shaping reality is simply a matter of knowing where to apply pressure."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Fleeting Aven
text: "Don't become so enthralled with magic that you forget you can fly without it."

name: Future Sight
text:
"My past holds only pain and loss. I will conquer it by creating the perfect future."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Graxiplon
text:
"Attempts to revive this ancient species have not been entirely successful, but results indicate potential for future development."
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Imagecrafter
text: When Otarians learned not to trust wizards, the wizards learned to adapt.

name: Information Dealer
text:
"One wizard is a suspect. Two wizards are a conspiracy."
—Elvish refugee

name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor
text: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."

name: Battlefield Medic
text: "Death never stops to rest. Neither can we."

name: Ixidor's Will
text: "Some dreams should not come to be."

name: Mage's Guile
text: "Next time, don't bother."

name: Meddle
text: Strength may win the fight, but style wins the crowd.

name: Mistform Dreamer
text: Devotion, the second myth of reality: The faithful are most hurt by the objects of their faith.

name: Mistform Mask
text: Trust, the fifth myth of reality: Every truth holds the seed of betrayal.

name: Mistform Mutant
text: Familiarity, the first myth of reality: What you know the best, you observe the least.

name: Mistform Skyreaver
text: Conviction, the third myth of reality: Only those who seek the truth can be deceived.

name: Mistform Wall
text: Fellowship, the fourth myth of reality: As the tides of war shift, so do loyalties.

name: Akroan Jailer
text: He ensures escape attempts are just that—attempts.

name: Cleric of the Forward Order
text: War after war, a healer's enemy is always the same—death itself.

name: Infernal Scarring
text: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
text: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

name: Languish
text: Life is such a fragile thing.

name: Macabre Waltz
text:
"All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy."
—Savra

name: Malakir Cullblade
text: Each cut stains his blade with fresh blood that he samples to increase his strength.

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
"The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace."
—Nantuko teaching

name: Nightsnare
text: Ravnica would be safer if mere coin was all the Dimir could steal.

name: Priest of the Blood Rite
text: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

name: Rabid Bloodsucker
text: She haunts the streets, wings spread wide, with carrion on her breath and blood in her eyes.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Reave Soul
text:
"I was not convinced you had a soul until I saw it for myself."
—Liliana Vess

name: Returned Centaur
text: Driven away by his living kin, he wanders mourning through the wilderness, seeking the dead city of Asphodel.

name: Revenant
text: Born from the slaughter of an entire army, it bears the wrath of a hundred souls.

name: Shambling Ghoul
text: Once he gets up and going, he will forever shamble on.

name: Enlightened Ascetic
text: "I do not reject the gods. I reject their authority, their pettiness, and their arrogance."

name: Tainted Remedy
text:
"Drink this, brother. It will bring you rest."
—Liliana Vess

name: Thornbow Archer
text: "I will not rest until the stench of eyeblights is eradicated from these woods."

name: Tormented Thoughts
text:
"Not all nightmares can be escaped by waking."
—Ashiok

name: Undead Servant
text:
"Get up. You're not finished yet."
—Liliana Vess

name: Unholy Hunger
text: Liliana viewed the attention of the angels as a testament to her power. Even so, they were an annoyance.

name: Weight of the Underworld
text: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

name: Act of Treason
text: She learned a tragic lesson that day: even the purest can be corrupted when the heart's emotions are twisted.

name: Enshrouding Mist
text: True faith is letting the blade fall without parry. True cunning is using that moment to strike a deadly blow.

name: Avaricious Dragon
text: Waste follows want.

name: Bellows Lizard
text: As the price of wood and coal rose, smiths found creative ways to keep their forges burning.

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Chandra's Fury
text: "They started it."

name: Chandra's Ignition
text: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

name: Cobblebrute
text: Ravnica's most ancient streets take on a life of their own. A few have decided to move to nicer neighborhoods.

name: Demolish
text: Nothing of nature nor of mortals can stand forever.

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Enthralling Victor
text: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

name: Exquisite Firecraft
text: Chandra's gift set her apart and others aflame.

name: Fiery Conclusion
text: The Boros legionnaire saw a noble sacrifice, the Rakdos thug a blazing suicide, and the Izzet alchemist an experiment gone awry.

name: Fiery Impulse
text: "Well, this got out of hand."

name: Ghirapur Aether Grid
text: The city of Ghirapur is a living thing, and living things defend themselves.

name: Ghirapur Gearcrafter
text: The metal must be pure. The hand must be steady. The product must be perfect.

name: Grasp of the Hieromancer
text:
"There is power in abandon, but far more in control."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

name: Lightning Javelin
text: The harpies descended without mercy upon Akros, only to find their attack put them within range of the javelineers.

name: Mage-Ring Bully
text: "Don't be rude, Beleren. We just want to enjoy the view with you."

name: Magmatic Insight
text: Chief among the tenets of Purphoros is that one must destroy in order to create.

name: Molten Vortex
text: If you can't take the heat . . . well, that's going to be a problem.

name: Prickleboar
text:
"Canyons in the Phoberos badlands are essentially gates to the Underworld."
—Mirinthes, Akroan captain

name: Ravaging Blaze
text: In time, not even the fire monks could keep up with Chandra.

name: Hallowed Moonlight
text: Creatures of darkness instinctively hide from the light.

name: Seismic Elemental
text:
"Trying to stop it would be foolish. If you feel it coming—run!"
—Sergeant Ryda

name: Skyraker Giant
text: She will not be content until hers is the highest head in the sky.

name: Smash to Smithereens
text: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

name: Subterranean Scout
text: When things get ugly above ground, goblins resort to alternate routes of passage.

name: Volcanic Rambler
text: It moves through lava with the force of an erupting volcano.

name: Aerial Volley
text: Drakes can swerve to avoid a single arrow, but they can't dodge the whole sky.

name: Healing Hands
text: The ethereal touch brings relief. The physical touch brings peace.

name: Caustic Caterpillar
text:
"The rare and beautiful butterflies inspire the design of our thopters. The larvae, however, are a different story entirely."
—Kiran Nalaar, Ghirapur inventor

name: Conclave Naturalists
text: "Your swords and wards have no power here."

name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
text: "This is our land. We will not allow eyeblights to poison its beauty."

name: Dwynen's Elite
text:
"Come, my beautiful brothers and sisters. Let us hunt."
—Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf daen

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Evolutionary Leap
text: The essence of nature is change.

name: Heavy Infantry
text: Doors, walls, skulls . . . it matters not. All barriers will be broken.

name: Herald of the Pantheon
text: The distinction of bearing the gods' banner is nothing compared to the glory of being closer to Nyx.

name: Hitchclaw Recluse
text: Not all spiders need webs to catch their prey.

name: Joraga Invocation
text:
"A single tree does not a forest make. We are stronger when we stand together."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

name: Leaf Gilder
text: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

name: Mantle of Webs
text:
"Why does everything the Golgari touch end up sticky?"
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Might of the Masses
text: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

name: Nissa's Revelation
text: The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.

name: Orchard Spirit
text:
"Pick not the rotten fruit, but neither touch the best. Leave those as an offering for our unseen guests."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: Skysnare Spider
text: The only thing more ill-tempered than a griffin in a web is the spider that must subdue it.

name: Ampryn Tactician
text: "It's all a game. You shouldn't get too attached to the pieces."

name: Knight of the Pilgrim's Road
text: "To be a knight, Gideon, is to be the shield for the meek against the cruel."

name: Timberpack Wolf
text: Their strength is no mere numbers game. An intangible force augments the wolves when they run together.

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Vastwood Gorger
text:
"A long and difficult incision revealed that all vital organs are housed in the head, save for a long chain of stomachs, forty in all, leading from its throat to the end of the tail."
—Mulak Ffar, *Vastwood Biodiversity*

name: Vine Snare
text: Nissa found that the vines of the marsh could ensnare just as well as forest vines could—maybe even better.

name: Wild Instincts
text: Nissa had only the space of a heartbeat to react, her instincts steering her blade.

name: Yeva's Forcemage
text: "Nature can't be stopped. It rips and tears at Ravnica's tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun."

name: Zendikar's Roil
text:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

name: Blazing Hellhound
text: It tears the flesh from your bones and then swallows the ash with its fiery maw.

name: Blood-Cursed Knight
text: "The bloodlust shall not control me, for my oath is my greatest compulsion."

name: Bounding Krasis
text: Unpredictable as a storm and destructive as a tidal wave.

name: Citadel Castellan
text: "I am the first line of defense. You will not encounter the second."

name: Iroas's Champion
text: Accustomed to battling before an audience in the arena, Iroas's champions know how to put on a good show.

name: Possessed Skaab
text: A stitcher's attempt at a skaab with a soul.

name: Shaman of the Pack
text: To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.

name: Thunderclap Wyvern
text: Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.

name: Zendikar Incarnate
text:
"Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath. That is why Nissa is the last of the animists."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

name: Alchemist's Vial
text: A weapon best suited for those with good aim and steady hands.

name: Alhammarret's Archive
text: It contains the totality of Alhammarret's notes, theories, and ponderings.

name: Angel's Tomb
text:
"Faith can quicken the stones themselves with life."
—Writings of Mikaeus

name: Bonded Construct
