text: Loyal to a fault, it heeds its master's every command.

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
text: Blessed by the gods. Coveted by mortals. Beholden to neither.

name: Guardian Automaton
text: The wealthy in the city of Ghirapur outfit their lives with grand machines, entrusting even their children to filigree and gears.

name: Guardians of Meletis
text: The histories speak of two feuding rulers whose deaths were celebrated and whose monuments symbolized the end of their wars. In truth they were peaceful lovers, their story lost to the ages.

name: Helm of the Gods
text: Its blessings are as numerous as the stars of Nyx.

name: Jayemdae Tome
text: A true scribe devotes an entire lifetime to the creation of a single volume, a masterpiece as unique as its maker.

name: Meteorite
text: "And if I'm lying," he began . . .

name: Orbs of Warding
text: One orb to guard the body, one to protect the mind, and one to shield the soul.

name: Prism Ring
text: Wear it on your dominant hand and it will follow your lead.

name: Pyromancer's Goggles
text:
"I hope to meet Jaya Ballard someday. I think we'd get along."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Ramroller
text: As unstoppable as it is unsteerable.

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Sigil of Valor
text: With each honor he earns, Gideon paves the path to his redemption.

name: Kytheon's Irregulars
text: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Veteran's Sidearm
text: "I've broken three swords, eighteen lances, and countless shields, but this little blade has survived every battle, just like I have."

name: War Horn
text: The reverberations course through the warriors' veins, beat with their hearts, and pound with their footfalls as they charge into battle.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Foundry of the Consuls
text: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

name: Kytheon's Tactics
text: "Seal the gate. This is our fight now."

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Mighty Leap
text:
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly."
—Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard

name: Murder Investigation
text: "Every death has a web of consequences. Our job is to find the spider."

name: Divine Verdict
text: "Guilty."

name: Eagle of the Watch
text:
"Even from miles away, I could see our eagles circling. That's when I knew we were needed at home."
—Kanlos, Akroan captain

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Into the Void
text:
"The cathars have their swords, the inquisitors their axes. I prefer the 'diplomatic' approach."
—Terhold, archmage of Drunau

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Weave Fate
text: Destiny is a flickering path among tangled possibilities.

name: Patron of the Valiant
text: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

name: Flesh to Dust
text:
"Another day. Another avenging angel. Another clump of feathers to toss in the trash."
—Liliana Vess

name: Mind Rot
text:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Fiery Hellhound
text:
"I had hoped to instill in it the loyalty of a guard dog, but with fire's power comes its unpredictability."
—Maggath, Sardian elementalist

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Plummet
text:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

name: Prized Unicorn
text:
"The desire for its magic horn inspires such bloodthirsty greed that all who see the unicorn will kill to possess it."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Terra Stomper
text: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

name: Anointer of Champions
text: "Arise. You have been anointed by the light. Go forth and fight without fear, for you shall be victorious."

name: Sentinel of the Eternal Watch
text: The portcullis is superfluous.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Suppression Bonds
text:
"A master of hieromancy can see the advantage in any scenario."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

name: Topan Freeblade
text: "My scars are my sigils. I will wear them with pride long after you're gone."

name: Totem-Guide Hartebeest
text: It is hunted, but not for the kill. The magic within draws others to its presence.

name: Tragic Arrogance
text: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

name: Valor in Akros
text: They became a single entity, a phalanx in the Temple of Triumph standing against a host of enemies.

name: Vryn Wingmare
text: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

name: War Oracle
text: "When you are felled by my mace, you shall know it was divine fate."

name: Yoked Ox
text:
It was in fields of grain, not fields of battle, that the Champion learned to bear the yoke of duty to the gods. She worked the land long before she was called on to defend it.
—*The Theriad*

name: Artificer's Epiphany
text: The artificers of Kaladesh strive ceaselessly for perfection, progress, and the ultimate expression of elegance.

name: Bone to Ash
text:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Clash of Wills
text: Alhammarret rose to his feet, and the full force of his mind hit Jace like a storm front.

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Deep-Sea Terror
text: After stripping the sunken ships, it rises to the surface for another helping.

name: Disperse
text: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

name: Displacement Wave
text: The sea respects no boundaries, least of all the coast.

name: Dreadwaters
text: Stray into the Morkrut and it may rise to claim you.

name: Faerie Miscreant
text: One faerie distracts the judge while a second steals the law.

name: Hydrolash
text:
"I don't need your mage-rings or your mana equations. I call, and the sea answers."
—Keyta, rebel hydromancer

name: Aven Battle Priest
text: When the shadow of the aven falls across the battlefield, hope rises in the hearts of the soldiers.

name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy
text: "People's thoughts just come to me. Sometimes I don't know if it's them or me thinking."

name: Jhessian Thief
text: "Where's the fun in an escape if it's not at least a little daring?"

name: Maritime Guard
text: To stand as a guardian of the sea, one must possess the resolve of a mounting wave.

name: Mizzium Meddler
text: Energy surges in Izzet labs are opportunities for experimentation.

name: Negate
text: Masters of the arcane savor a delicious irony. Their study of deep and complex arcana leads to such a simple end: the ability to say merely yes or no.

name: Psychic Rebuttal
text: "I know what you're thinking," Jace whispered in the mage's mind. "It's not going to work."

name: Ringwarden Owl
text: The owls learn of mana from the mages who know it best.

name: Scrapskin Drake
text:
"The cathars killed my skaabs down below. Let's see how high their swords can reach."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Blessed Spirits
text: Not all heroes die in armor.

name: Screeching Skaab
text: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

name: Separatist Voidmage
text:
"As long as each side thinks it can win, the balance holds, and the mage-rings stand."
—Alhammarret

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Skaab Goliath
text: Three heads are better than one.

name: Soulblade Djinn
text: He grants endless wishes, as long as you always wish for a blade.

name: Sphinx's Tutelage
text: "You've never considered the implications of dealing with another telepath, Jace."

name: Celestial Flare
text:
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura

name: Tower Geist
text: Jenrik's tower is served by those who once sought to enter it uninvited.

name: Turn to Frog
text: "Ribbit."

name: Watercourser
text:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

name: Willbreaker
text: "Master your mind, or I shall master it for you."

name: Blightcaster
text: "Your flesh is unprepared for my gifts."

name: Catacomb Slug
text:
"The entire murder scene was covered in dripping, oozing slime. No need for a soothsayer to solve that one."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Cruel Revival
text: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

name: Charging Griffin
text: Four claws, two wings, one beak, no fear.

name: Deadbridge Shaman
text: Ending her life won't end the infestation.

name: Despoiler of Souls
text: Rats and vultures devour. It desecrates.

name: Eyeblight Assassin
text: "Boggart blood disgusts me almost as much as the foul creatures themselves."

name: Eyeblight Massacre
text:
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"
—Nissa Revane, to Dwynen

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Mind's Dilation
text: Infinite wisdom cannot be contained within a single mind.

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Opt
text:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Radical Idea
text: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.

name: Slither Blade
text: Some naga initiates move as silently as the suns' reflections on the water.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Triton Shorestalker
text: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."

name: Windfall
text: "Rich" is a relative term.

name: Winged Boots
text: Get carried away.

name: Aetherborn Marauder
text: "I don't know what that is or who it belongs to, but it's shiny and I want it."

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Curtains' Call
text:
"We give the audience what they want."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Dire Fleet Ravager
text: His fists fume with the decay of death, each strike a plague on the hearts of his enemies.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: Marshland Bloodcaster
text: Blood magic is more artery than science.

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Nighthawk Scavenger
text: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Painful Truths
text: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

name: Tenured Inkcaster
text: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

name: Lock and Load
text: "Always bring a little extra thunder."

name: Veinwitch Coven
text: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

name: Witch of the Moors
text: Many hands for many evils.

name: Angrath's Marauders
text: Captain Angrath cares less about treasure than mayhem. If he can't leave Ixalan, he'll burn the plane down.

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Bitter Reunion
text: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

name: Captivating Crew
text: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

name: Electrostatic Field
text:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

name: Glittering Stockpile
text: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "Fire! Fire! Fire! What joy! What fire! Burn it all!"

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Magmatic Insight
text: Chief among the tenets of Purphoros is that one must destroy in order to create.

name: Mass Mutiny
text:
"What say you, my most trusted advisors? . . . Advisors?"
—Edra, merfolk sovereign

name: Back in Town
text:
"Well, there's a good day's work ruined."
—Erin Nath, Omenport gravedigger

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Unholy Heat
text: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Ancient Greenwarden
text: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.

name: Eccentric Farmer
text: "Careful now. Don't want to get the seeds stuck to your feelers like last time."

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Harrow
text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

name: Hour of Promise
text: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Nantuko Cultivator
text: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Scute Swarm
text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Heartless Conscription
text:
"History remembers the conquerors, not the bones they stand on."
—Gonti

name: Turntimber Sower
text: "Zendikar's wounds can be healed."

name: Void Attendant
text: The Eldrazi don't merely extinguish life—they supplant it.

name: Winding Way
text: Every path leads to discovery.

name: World Shaper
text: "The Great River will not be tamed."

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
text: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Escape to the Wilds
text: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Extract Brain
text: No thought is as succulent as a secret.

name: Galvanic Iteration
text: Better potent than predictable.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Thieving Varmint
text: After seeing what the varmint was doing with her pocket watch, Elsa wasn't sure she even wanted it back.

name: Kaza, Roil Chaser
text: "What sort of life is that, huddling in the familiar and safe? No thanks. Put me right in the center of the action."

name: Life Insurance
text: All the money in the world won't buy back a pulse.

name: Plasm Capture
text:
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Cataclysmic Prospecting
text:
"Now *that's* how you strike gold!"
—Jolene, plundering pugilist

name: Third Path Iconoclast
text: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

name: Thrilling Discovery
text:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Villainous Wealth
text: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Bladegriff Prototype
text: The new model has improved aerodynamics but introduced a few glitches in the targeting system.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

name: Darksteel Ingot
text:
"It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Dead Before Sunrise
text: Daniel's mistake wasn't just coming alone. It was believing his rival had done the same.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Perpetual Timepiece
text: Do not be so caught up in keeping track of time that you forget to make use of it.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Scaretiller
text: Fields of battle turn to fields of grain.

name: Sol Ring
text: When the great vault fell, it scattered its wonders across Thunder Junction.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

name: Elemental Eruption
text: The crater screamed into the wind, and the wind carried its blazing voice across the sky.

name: Access Tunnel
text: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Blackcleave Cliffs
text: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Embrace the Unknown
text: "Everyone's gotta die somehow. I'll be damned if I meet my end cowering in some cellar."

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkslick Shores
text: Where curiosity meets cruelty, hideous innovations arise.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Desolate Mire
text: Silence, the poetry of a whispering wind, the centurial fall of tar on pale sand.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

name: Dunes of the Dead
text: The Curse of Wandering permeated Amonkhet long before Nicol Bolas. He simply harnessed it.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Stability and volatility churn together, creating beauty and danger both.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: In places where the sea meets the trees, it's easy to forget the darkness that rules most of Innistrad.

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Not every church is a place of faith.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Painted Bluffs
text: Centuries of scouring sands have carved and polished the rocky terrain of the Shefet.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: When the last scrap of flesh is scoured away, the Curse of Wandering ends. Then the dead may sleep.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Rumbleweed
text: It's a one-ecosystem army.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:

name: Alaborn Cavalier
text:
"Course he ran! *I* wouldn't want to stare down that barrel, either!"
—Alaborn soldier

name: Angelic Wall
text: Be at peace, and observe its beauty. Be at war, and feel its justice.

name: Goblin Mountaineer
text: Goblin mountaineer, barely keeps his family fed.

name: Goblin Piker
text: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

name: Goblin Raider
text:
"I seen lots o' fights. To win ya gotta bash hard and not get bashed back."
—Goblin grunt

name: Goblin War Cry
text:
"Goblins cry, soldiers fly.
Stones fly, soldiers die!"

name: Lava Axe
text: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

name: Obsidian Giant
text: After a while, ships stopped sailing within his reach.

name: Ogre Berserker
text: The machine does the growling, so the ogre's free to smile.

name: Ogre Taskmaster
text: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

name: Ogre Warrior
text: Assault and battery included.

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Stone Rain
text: There goes the neighborhood!

name: Tremor
text: One little goblin shook up the ground. When the dust cleared, no one was found.

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Armageddon
text: War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.

name: Alluring Scent
text: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

name: Barbtooth Wurm
text: In its lair lies a carpet of bones.

name: Bear Cub
text:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

name: Bee Sting
text:
Busy as a bumblebee, blistered as a goblin.
—Alaborn saying

name: Golden Bear
text: The elvish scout was scrupulous about the truth. She told the traders that gold lay nearby.

name: Ironhoof Ox
text: The good news is it's vegetarian. The bad news is it just doesn't like you.

name: Lynx
text: Rarely seen, hardly heard, never caught.

name: Monstrous Growth
text: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

name: Natural Spring
text: The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.

name: Nature's Lore
text:
"Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us."
—Arathel, elvish queen

name: Norwood Archers
text:
"'Air superiority?' Not while our archers scan the skies."
—Elvish scout

name: Norwood Ranger
text: Some trees bear deadly fruit.

name: Norwood Riders
text: "Trade my moose? Sure—when I find a *horse* that can spear ten goblins at a time!"

name: Bargain
text: Bargaining with a goblin is like trading with a child; both believe they already own everything.

name: Norwood Warrior
text: "The woods hold peace for those who desire it, but those who seek battle will find me."

name: Plated Wurm
text:
"I'd hate to see the bird that could get *this* wurm!"
—Alaborn soldier

name: Razorclaw Bear
text:
One razorclaw is three bears too many.
—Elvish saying

name: Renewing Touch
text: Death just encourages life the more.

name: River Bear
text: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

name: Salvage
text:
"What was taken shall be restored."
—Arathel, elvish queen

name: Sylvan Yeti
text: The deeper the wood, the greater its strength.

name: Tree Monkey
text:
"They serve the world best on a platter with shallots and onions."
—Talas sailor

name: Wild Ox
text: It has the run of the swamps, and it knows it.

name: Festival of Trokin
text: Everyone loves a good sale.

name: Path of Peace
text:
"You could die famous or you could die old. I chose old."
—Former soldier

name: Alaborn Grenadier
text:
"Ever proud, ever vigilant."
—Grenadier motto

name: Righteous Charge
text:
"Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

name: Steam Catapult
text: "You idiots! Turn it around! Turn it around!"

name: Temple Acolyte
text: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

name: Temple Elder
text:
"Give us breath. Give us life. Prepare us for the day we make."
—The Alaborn "Rite of Battle"

name: Town Sentry
text:
"So he gots a sword. Big deal."
"Yeah, it's a big deal—it's a big sword!"
—Two goblins outside the gates of Trokin

name: Trokin High Guard
text: Battle tempers soldiers as fire tempers steel.

name: Vengeance
text: A bullet renders all sizes equal.

name: Volunteer Militia
text: People fight hardest on their own soil.

name: Alaborn Musketeer
text: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

name: Wild Griffin
text: Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.

name: Air Elemental
text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

name: Armored Galleon
text:
"Information equals profits. Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

name: Déjà Vu
text: History is the study of repetition.

name: Alaborn Trooper
text:
"I dedicate my body to my country And my life to my King."
—Alaborn Soldier's Oath

name: Piracy
text: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.

name: Steam Frigate
text:
"Is it merchants or is it pirates?"
"It's Talas—there's no difference."

name: Talas Air Ship
text:
"Their ships pollute our air as they themselves pollute our forest."
—Arathel, elvish queen

name: Talas Merchant
text: The trader let loose a laugh that made all around him check their purses.

name: Talas Researcher
text:
From time, knowledge.
From knowledge, power.

name: Talas Scout
text:
"Scouting a battle before you fight it is just good business."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

name: Talas Warrior
text: The sea is in their blood. Literally.

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Theft of Dreams
text: "First they fight, then they sleep, then they dream. And finally I receive my reward."

name: Tidal Surge
text: Four little goblins, trapped by the sea. One teased a serpent, and then there were three.

name: Time Ebb
text:
"The ogre had come from out of the blue, so that's where I sent it back."
—Talas wizard

name: Touch of Brilliance
text: "I don't want what I don't have. I want more of what I *do* have."

name: Wind Sail
text: It pays to be at home both on the sea *and* in the sky.

name: Ancient Craving
text:
"Knowledge demands sacrifice."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Bloodcurdling Scream
text:
"I have all the weapons my enemies have—and far deeper rage."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Chorus of Woe
text: When nightstalkers sing, nothing in creation sleeps.

name: Coercion
text:
"Human tenderness is simply weakness in a pretty package."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Cruel Edict
text:
"Such a fragile organ, the brain."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Dakmor Bat
text: The bat thrives on what underestimates it.

name: Dakmor Plague
text: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

name: Dakmor Scorpion
text: A scorpion this big you won't find curled up in your boot. Maybe *around* your boot, but not *in* it.

name: Dark Offering
text:
"Our greatest hope has become our enemy's greatest triumph."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

name: Hand of Death
text: The touch of death is never gentle.

name: Kiss of Death
text:
"I'd sooner lock lips with a viper. At least I might walk away from *that*."
—Elvish scout

name: Lurking Nightstalker
text: The shadows know.

name: Moaning Spirit
text: The dead sing their own lullabies.

name: Muck Rats
text:
"Just as some fool said it couldn't get worse, the rats began to show up."
—Alaborn soldier

name: Nightstalker Engine
text: Part metal, part bone, and all death.

name: Prowling Nightstalker
text: Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.

name: Raiding Nightstalker
text:
"Our steeds need food, water, stabling. Theirs just need prey."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

name: Rain of Daggers
text: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

name: Raise Dead
text:
"Life from death is part of the natural cycle. This is merely a shortcut."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Angelic Blessing
text: The man who rose up to fight was not the same man knocked down.

name: Blaze
text:
"This isn't what I meant by 'facing the heat of battle!'"
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

name: Goblin Cavaliers
text: They get along so well with their goats because they're practically goats themselves.

name: Goblin General
text: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

name: Goblin Glider
text: The goblins call the gliders "death from above." Everyone else calls them "clods in the clouds."

name: Goblin Lore
text:
"I done forgot more than you'll ever know, pipsqueak."
"Yeah—that's your problem."

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"There was no trace
Of aught on that illumined face . . . ."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Char
text: If you've never choked on the embers of your own spell, you aren't casting it hard enough.

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Greater Auramancy
text: "The wonders of Nyx do not belong solely to the gods."

name: Omniscience
text:
"In the arrogance of my youth, I believed I knew all there was to know. Now, my greatest wisdom is a humble awareness of all I have yet to learn."
—Teferi

name: Parallel Lives
text: Neither Urza nor Mishra would admit it, but it was their similarities, rather than their differences, that drove their obsessive rivalry.

name: Stranglehold
text:
"Control the Halo and you control the whole city."
—Jetmir

name: Smothering Tithe
text: A witch once foretold that Glavin would die surrounded by unimaginable wealth. Until that moment, he'd taken that to mean he'd be rich.

name: Training Grounds
text: "Practice alone will not bring perfection. The practice itself must be perfect. Again!"

name: No Mercy
text: "If you wish to assassinate a master assassin, you'll have to do better than that."

name: Painter's Servant
text: It gathers hues from the twilight mist so that its master can paint a better world.

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Serra Angel
text: She soars on wings of Serra's light, her sword of faith meting out justice to the wicked.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Eternal Witness
text: "I have watched over this land since the first seedling emerged from the primeval soil."

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Ball Lightning
text: The most frightening storms are those not woven by nature's hand.

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"The entire parish is gone. This was no execution. This was a massacre."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Incluso los báloths le temen cuando es su hora de comer.

name: Dragonlord Atarka
text: When she's hungry, no one is safe.

name: Dramatic Reversal
text:
"Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "No symphony can compare to the melody of the ferrox's roar."

name: Dovin's Veto
text: "It must be infuriating, to pour so much rage into your assault and see it wasted. Perhaps you'll learn something from this."

name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
text: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: „Wir können den Wald ebenso wenig verlassen wie die Sterne den Nachthimmel."

name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
text: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

name: Wall of Roots
text: Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Kor Haven
text:
"Find shelter where none but the angels can reach you."
—Kor saying

name: Vindicate
text:
"Hol visto intere civiltà. sorgere e crollare. Voi mortali non siete che polvere per me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Lotus Petal
text: Three decades since blooming, it remains a thing of beauty.

name: Rukh Egg
text: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: Неоспоримый хозяин Шиванских гор.

name: Quicksmith Rebel
text: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

name: Curator of Mysteries
text: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

name: Duress
text:
"We decide who is worthy of our works."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Uktabi Orangutan
text:
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Chill
text:
"Temper, temper."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Diabolic Edict
text: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

name: Creeping Mold
text:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Fling
text: It's raining rats and moggs.

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Arc Lightning
text:
"It is vain to look for a defense against lightning."
—Publius Syrus, Maxim 835, trans. Lyman

name: Dauthi Slayer
text:
"A wisp of life remains in the undergloom of Death: a visible form, though no heart beats within it."
—Homer, *The Iliad*, trans. Fitzgerald

name: Mana Leak
text:
"If a man will begin with certainties, he shall end in doubts."
—Sir Francis Bacon,
*The Advancement of Learning*

name: Okina Nightwatch
text: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

name: Castigate
text:
"We have no need for military might. We wield two of the sharpest swords ever forged: Faith in our left hand, Wealth in our right."
—Vuliev of the Ghost Council

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Pouncing Jaguar
text: One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.

name: Skittering Skirge
text: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

name: Rewind
text:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Knight of New Alara
text: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

name: Retaliator Griffin
text: For every eye, an eye. For every tooth, a tooth. Griffins are nothing if not fair.

name: Angel of Glory's Rise
text: "Justice isn't done until undeath is undone."

name: Defiant Bloodlord
text:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Barrage Tyrant
text: Terrible fury. Excellent aim.

name: Radiant Flames
text: The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.

name: Scythe Leopard
text: Eldrazi are not the leopard's preferred prey, but they are better than no prey at all.

name: Hero of Goma Fada
text: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

name: Silent Sentinel
text: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Forgestoker Dragon
text: The Akroans fashion their helms to honor the dragons, not to protect against them, as that would be of little help.

name: Armored Griffin
text: When an order for griffin barding comes in, blacksmiths prepare their forges for months of exacting work. They know griffins always detect imperfections and never haggle.

name: Noggle Ransacker
text: Noggles live purely by what they can scavenge. There is not a single thing a noggle eats, wears, or uses that did not once belong to another.

name: Vela the Night-Clad
text: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Farsight Mask
text: It turns the adversity of the moment into the knowledge of a lifetime.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Fractured Powerstone
text: The Thran learned to capture mana, but power inevitably escapes its bonds.

name: Sai of the Shinobi
text: The passing of the sai presages the end of the old clan and the ascent of the new.

name: Thran Golem
text: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Shimmering Grotto
text:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
text:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Three Dreams
text:
"Choose one to heal, one to harm, and one to grant you the prudence to use them."
—Miotri, auratouched mage

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Cancel
text: "What you are attempting is not against the law. It is, however, extremely foolish."

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Illusory Angel
text:
"Yes, she is made of pure belief—but I hardly see why that makes her unique."
—Reith, master illusionist

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Peregrine Drake
text: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

name: Primal Plasma
text: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

name: See Beyond
text: Ancient lore locked in a mind driven mad is just as safe as when it was locked deep underground.

name: Sunken Hope
text:
"I don't concern myself with my enemy's hopes. Hopes follow the tides. They will retreat soon enough."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Liliana's Specter
text:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Arc Trail
text:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Fiery Conclusion
text: The Boros legionnaire saw a noble sacrifice, the Rakdos thug a blazing suicide, and the Izzet alchemist an experiment gone awry.

name: Fiery Fall
text: Jund feasts on the unprepared.

name: Fling
text: About halfway to the target, Snukk vowed that he had been tricked for the last time.

name: Hellion Eruption
text: Just when you thought you'd be safe, in the middle of an open field with no Eldrazi around for miles.

name: Hissing Iguanar
text: Viashino thrashes keep iguanars as hunting companions, giving them wounded captives as playthings.

name: Mark of Mutiny
text: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

name: Mass Mutiny
text:
"What say you, my most trusted advisors? . . . Advisors?"
—Edra, merfolk sovereign

name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
text: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

name: Celestial Ancient
text:
"We thought the clouds had moved from the night sky. Then the night sky moved, and the horizon grew wings."
—Josuri

name: Rivals' Duel
text: They could agree on one thing only: one of them must die.

name: Thunder-Thrash Elder
text: Viashino thrashes are led by elders who have survived countless challenges.

name: Warstorm Surge
text: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

name: Aura Gnarlid
text: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Boar Umbra
text: "From in here, everything looks like dinner."

name: Bramble Elemental
text: In abandoned corners of Ravnica, nature has begun to reclaim what it once owned.

name: Brindle Shoat
text: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Dowsing Shaman
text: He combs the streets looking for the lost light, the discarded enigmas of the city.

name: Dreampod Druid
text: "Don't mistake my creations for mere vegetation. They are my children, loyal and fierce."

name: Gluttonous Slime
text: On Jund, everything eventually ends up in something else's stomach.

name: Lumberknot
text: Animated by geists fused in its oak, it hungers for more life to add to its core.

name: Nest Invader
text: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Nullmage Advocate
text: "Our unity unmasks your deceit."

name: Ondu Giant
text: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Quiet Disrepair
text:
"Artifice has always stood upon nature's shoulders. Let us watch nature take a turn."
—Freyalise

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Tukatongue Thallid
text: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Dragonlair Spider
text: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

name: Elderwood Scion
text: The Sunbriar druids believe that every life begins in its heart and ends under its hooves.

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Enlisted Wurm
text: A match for any army—even its own.

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Glen Elendra Liege
text: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

name: Hellkite Hatchling
text: A killing machine from birth.

name: Inkfathom Witch
text: The murk of the Wanderbrine concealed unseemly rituals designed to bring out the worst in merrowkind.

name: Krond the Dawn-Clad
text: Krond, the personification of the dawn's light, lives to exact justice on his nemesis Vela.

name: Armored Griffin
text: When an order for griffin barding comes in, blacksmiths prepare their forges for months of exacting work. They know griffins always detect imperfections and never haggle.

name: Noggle Ransacker
text: Noggles live purely by what they can scavenge. There is not a single thing a noggle eats, wears, or uses that did not once belong to another.

name: Vela the Night-Clad
text: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Farsight Mask
text: It turns the adversity of the moment into the knowledge of a lifetime.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Fractured Powerstone
text: The Thran learned to capture mana, but power inevitably escapes its bonds.

name: Sai of the Shinobi
text: The passing of the sai presages the end of the old clan and the ascent of the new.

name: Thran Golem
text: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Shimmering Grotto
text:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
text:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Three Dreams
text:
"Choose one to heal, one to harm, and one to grant you the prudence to use them."
—Miotri, auratouched mage

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Cancel
text: "What you are attempting is not against the law. It is, however, extremely foolish."

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Illusory Angel
text:
"Yes, she is made of pure belief—but I hardly see why that makes her unique."
—Reith, master illusionist

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Peregrine Drake
text: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

name: Primal Plasma
text: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

name: See Beyond
text: Ancient lore locked in a mind driven mad is just as safe as when it was locked deep underground.

name: Sunken Hope
text:
"I don't concern myself with my enemy's hopes. Hopes follow the tides. They will retreat soon enough."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Assassinate
text:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Liliana's Specter
text:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Arc Trail
text:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

text: A killing machine from birth.

name: Inkfathom Witch
text: The murk of the Wanderbrine concealed unseemly rituals designed to bring out the worst in merrowkind.

name: Krond the Dawn-Clad
text: Krond, the personification of the dawn's light, lives to exact justice on his nemesis Vela.

name: 1996 World Champion
text: It takes great sacrifice to make it to the top.

name: Robot Chicken
text: Why did the chicken cross the road? To die in the name of science.

name: Zur the Enchanter
text: "Now they always say 'Congratulations'"

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Abolish
text: As war raged on, the young mages became more direct in their tactics, often at great cost.

name: Ridgeline Rager
text: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

name: Scoria Cat
text: Like a volcano, it too can erupt without warning.

name: Search for Survivors
text: There's no rest for a Keldon.

name: Searing Wind
text:
"The first wind of ascension is Forger, burning away impurity."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Spur Grappler
text: Grapplers hunt in packs, driving their victims over steep mountain cliffs.

name: Veteran Brawlers
text: Death awaits them on both fronts.

name: Whip Sergeant
text: Keldon soldiers learn to move faster than the whip.

name: Zerapa Minotaur
text: There's no difference between bone and crystal when it's piercing your throat.

name: Calming Verse
text: The chattering forest fell silent as the otherworldly song began.

name: Darba
text: Legend has it the darba gave up its wings in return for an extra stomach.

name: Jolrael, Empress of Beasts
text: "I need no army. I have Jamuraa."

name: Jolrael's Favor
text:
"War destroys; nature renews."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

name: Living Terrain
text: Keldons were accustomed to rugged terrain, but they never expected it to be aggressive.

name: Marsh Boa
text: Though a powerful constrictor, it prefers simply to drown its prey.

name: Mungha Wurm
text: Cities have crumbled under its weight.

name: Jeweled Spirit
text: As he knows all the world completely, the world refuses him harm.

name: Pygmy Razorback
text: As a rite of passage, Kipamu youths taunt razorbacks with long sticks . . . then flee.

name: Rib Cage Spider
text: Everything it sees it considers food—and with that many eyes, it's not liable to miss much.

name: Root Cage
text: The Vintara Forest welcomes its enemies with a crushing embrace.

name: Silt Crawler
text: If they could replenish the land instead of draining it, Jamuraa would be teeming with them.

name: Spore Frog
text: The end of one life is merely the beginning of thousands more.

name: Squirrel Wrangler
text: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

name: Thresher Beast
text: It destroys everything in its path, including the path itself.

name: Thrive
text: "We wait and watch, and as we prepare for war, we grow strong."

name: Mageta the Lion
text: In the jungle of war there is always a Lion.

name: Verdant Field
text: Jolrael tends the land so that the land will tend the beasts.

name: Vintara Elephant
text: Trained with the aid of rhystic magic, they become uneasy in its absence.

name: Vintara Snapper
text:
"The snapper is still when all else moves
And strikes when all are dozing."
—*Tales of the Vintara Forest*

name: Vitalizing Wind
text:
"The fifth wind of ascension is Exalter, fulfilling Keld's destiny."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Wild Might
text: The hunted can become the fiercest hunters.

name: Wing Storm
text: A thousand wings beating as one can choke the sky itself.

name: Chimeric Idol
text: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

name: Copper-Leaf Angel
text:
"When Serra made angels, people called her a goddess. My angels are far superior to hers."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Hollow Warrior
text: Though it moves like a living thing, anyone can tell it lacks a soul—not to mention mercy.

name: Mageta's Boon
text:
When the Lion roars, his cubs grow stronger.
—Kipamu saying

name: Well of Discovery
text:
When you have given everything, then you are capable of anything.
—Well inscription

name: Well of Life
text:
When you have given everything, then you have everything to gain.
—Well inscription

name: Rhystic Cave
text:
"All mages dip into the same well; some are just in more of a hurry."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Wintermoon Mesa
text: Dark is light and day is night When the winter moon shines.

name: Mercenary Informer
text: The problem with rebels is that they so quickly reject authority.

name: Mine Bearer
text: "The Keldons may have explosive tempers, but *I* have explosives."

name: Mirror Strike
text:
"Enemies can be your weapons or your shields. Simply show them which they are."
—*The Teachings of Zho*

name: Reveille Squad
text: "To arms! To arms! The Lion roars!"

name: Rhystic Circle
text: The circle buys time—an important commodity in battle.

name: Aura Fracture
text: Jamuraa's rhystic mages treat magic as their garden, uprooting unwanted spells as bothersome weeds.

name: Rhystic Shield
text: A shield for one is good. A shield for everyone is even better.

name: Samite Sanctuary
text:
Our war is against suffering, not against those who cause it.
—Samite creed

name: Sheltering Prayers
text: "It matters not if the gods hear my prayers. Jamuraa does."

name: Shield Dancer
text: The harder your strike, the stronger her defense.

name: Soul Charmer
text: She seeks the warmth of the living.

name: Sword Dancer
text: Most soldiers think of the sword as a weapon. In the hands of Zho monks, swords are also the strongest of shields.

name: Trenching Steed
text: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war. They'd never seen such a light beast stand so firm.

name: Troubled Healer
text: "Which is worse: nothing to defend, or no one to defend it?"

name: Alexi, Zephyr Mage
text: The Keldons didn't know her name, but they still cursed her in battle.

name: Alexi's Cloak
text:
"Doesn't look like much, does it?"
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Coastal Hornclaw
text: Jamuraan farmers fear three things above all else: droughts, floods, and hornclaws.

name: Denying Wind
text:
"The third wind of ascension is Eliminator, clearing Keld's path to victory."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Excavation
text:
"There are secrets out there begging to be rediscovered. We just need to look in the right places."
—Teferi, planeswalker

name: Gulf Squid
text: If it could capture the power it wastes, it would be invincible.

name: Hazy Homunculus
text: They hide in dreams and whispers and faraway thoughts.

name: Heightened Awareness
text:
"It startles me how alive one feels on the edge of death."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Mana Vapors
text: The scent of magic can rob you of your senses, blinding you to the world.

name: Overburden
text: The Kipamu League knew what Keld refused to acknowledge: the land could support no more.

name: Blessed Wind
text:
"The fourth wind of ascension is Anointer, deifying the worthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Quicksilver Wall
text: "Ogg hit wall. Ogg no kill wall. Ogg hate wall!"

name: Rethink
text: "Are you *sure* you want to do that?"

name: Rhystic Deluge
text:
"I'll rain down on you with the power of magic itself. Then we'll see who prevails."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Rhystic Scrying
text:
"The trick is to ask when no one's listening."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Ribbon Snake
text: All snakes slither. Only this one soars.

name: Shrouded Serpent
text: Many travelers have wandered into a fog only to find that it had teeth, claws, and an appetite.

name: Spiketail Drake
text: "The spell will have to wait," said Alexi, pointing up. "Drakes."

name: Spiketail Hatchling
text: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

name: Stormwatch Eagle
text: When eagles leave the sky, sailors leave the sea.

name: Sunken Field
text: The land is heavy with promise, the harvest ripe with betrayal.

name: Troublesome Spirit
text: As erratic and turbulent as a summer squall.

name: Windscouter
text: These nimble ships were designed for hit-and-run tactics.

name: Withdraw
text: "We outnumber them! Charge! Charge! Hey, where'd you guys go? Retreat! Retreat!"

name: Agent of Shauku
text: "Go ahead. Take it. You'll be so very powerful . . . and what harm can it do?"

name: Bog Elemental
text:
"When the bog walks, the wise run."
—Erissa, bog witch

name: Chilling Apparition
text: Mortal minds shrivel at its touch.

name: Diving Griffin
text:
To outrace the griffin
—Kipamu expression meaning "to do the impossible"

name: Coffin Puppets
text: The ground won't accept them.

name: Death Charmer
text: It vents the chill of the grave.

name: Despoil
text: Nothing could grow where the vile smoke had been, and no one could breathe it and live.

name: Endbringer's Revel
text: First death. Then Shauku.

name: Fen Stalker
text: As silent as a shadow, and just as hard to flee.

name: Flay
text: The Keldons would never admit it, but Greel unsettles them, too.

name: Greel, Mind Raker
text: "You're Latulla's gift to me, and I always play with my presents."

name: Greel's Caress
text: Greel's grin is far less loathsome than his touch.

name: Nakaya Shade
text: Made strong by reckless magic. Made horrid by reckless strife.

name: Entangler
text: "Tell me again," said Latulla, raising her fist, "how just one woman held back an entire Keldon platoon."

name: Noxious Field
text: Ultimately, it became a three-way battle: the land attacked both armies.

name: Outbreak
text: This plague chooses its victims.

name: Plague Fiend
text: As the strange plague ravaged Jamuraa, the fiends multiplied.

name: Plague Wind
text:
"The second wind of ascension is Reaver, slaying the unworthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Rebel Informer
text: The problem with mercenaries is that if you can buy their loyalty, others can too.

name: Rhystic Syphon
text: Jamuraan wizards are linked together by magic, a bond that only the wicked dare exploit.

name: Rhystic Tutor
text: Any lock can be undone, any secret revealed.

name: Soul Strings
text: Everyone is manipulated. It's just more obvious with the dead.

name: Steal Strength
text: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

name: Excise
text:
"Creation is no great feat. Anything you make, I can unmake in a heartbeat."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Wall of Vipers
text:
What wall can never be climbed, but is always scaled?
—Nakaya riddle

name: Whipstitched Zombie
text: Pity the tailor.

name: Barbed Field
text: Wherever they went, the Keldons transformed the land into a weapon.

name: Branded Brawlers
text:
"The sword or the lash. Choose."
—Akul, Keldon whip sergeant

name: Brutal Suppression
text:
"They no longer care about their own suffering. Show them something worse."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Citadel of Pain
text:
"Battle is our religion. This fortress is our temple."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Devastate
text:
"You're willing to die for your homeland. I'm willing to kill for it."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Fault Riders
text: They turn geological upheaval into tactical advantage.

name: Fickle Efreet
text: Flame chooses its own course.

name: Flowering Field
text: Some lands are soothing, and their peace can be felt in the soul.

name: Inflame
text: Wound, maim, kill: it's all the same to a Keldon.

name: Keldon Arsonist
text:
"Fields can be replanted. Settlements can be rebuilt. Burn it all."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Keldon Berserker
text: They fight beyond thought, beyond fear, and beyond mercy.

name: Keldon Firebombers
text:
"If there isn't enough of Jamuraa left to stand on, I will still claim it for Keld."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

name: Latulla, Keldon Overseer
text:
"Everything around her suffers."
—Haddad, Kipamu soldier

name: Lesser Gargadon
text:
Trod on by a gargadon
—Kipamu expression meaning "wiped out"

name: Panic Attack
text: Sometimes everyone decides to go for help at the same time.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Vulshok Sorcerer
text: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

name: Boggart Ram-Gang
text:
"We're going to need a bigger gate."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Fire Servant
text:
"Elemental fire shimmers with rose hues and, unlike terrestrial blazes, smolders long after it's extinguished."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Price of Progress
text: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

name: Thunderbolt
text:
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Jackal Pup
text: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

name: Reverberate
text:
"I'm not indecisive. I just don't like to limit my options."
—Maxti, pyromancer

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Flames of the Blood Hand
text: Many ogres extracted blood oaths from the oni they summoned. Others simply extracted blood.

name: Sudden Impact
text:
"Some say it's better to think before you act. While those people are considering all the options, that's usually when I kill them."
—Dravus, lava mage

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Spark Elemental
text: Vulshok shamans could never keep them alive for more than a few seconds, yet those few seconds seemed to be enough.

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Cinder Pyromancer
text: "If the whole world burns, I'll never grow cold."

name: Inkwell Leviathan
text:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

name: Blazing Archon
text:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Sickening Dreams
text: The Patriarch dreams of vile plague.

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Hidden Horror
text: If the presence of evil were obvious, it wouldn't be nearly as dangerous.

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
text: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

name: Render Silent
text: "We have confiscated your spells as evidence. Once we conclude our investigation, you may petition to have them returned."

name: Avatar of Discord
text: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Ravenous Demon
text: His twisted words entice the weak.

name: Mondronen Shaman
text: "Tovolar, my master. Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak."

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
text: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

name: Zhalfirin Void
text:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

name: Serra Angel
text: 天使は過去の自分を夢のように思い出していた。自分の歌が牧草地を支えたこと。自分の刃が闇を追い返したこと。自分の翼がずっと自分を運んでいたことを。

name: Opt
text: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
text: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Bonescythe Sliver
text:
"Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Ogre Battledriver
text: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Nalathni Dragon
text:
These small but intelligent Dragons and their Olesian allies held back the tide of Pashalik Mons's hordes of Goblin Raiders.
*DragonCon 1994*

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Arashin Sovereign
text: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

name: Boltwing Marauder
text: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.

name: Harbinger of the Hunt
text: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

name: Pristine Skywise
text: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

name: Assembled Alphas
text: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

name: Ulvenwald Observer
text:
"I tell you, the trees were closing in! It's by the grace of the Heron alone that I made it out of the Ulvenwald!"
—Ricton, traveling merchant

name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
text: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

name: Overbeing of Myth
text:
"She walks among us unseen, learning from our imperfections."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Gush
text: Eternal Weekend 2022 Vintage

name: Ponder
text: Eternal Weekend 2022 Legacy

name: Mental Misstep
text:
Eternal Weekend
Vintage Championship 2023

text: Eternal Weekend Legacy Championship 2023

text:
Eternal Weekend
Vintage Championship 2024

text:
Eternal Weekend
Legacy Championship 2024

text:
Eternal Weekend
Legacy Championship 2025

text:
Eternal Weekend
Vintage Championship 2025

Eternal Weekend
Vintage Championship 2026
