text:
Eternal Weekend
Legacy Championship 2026

name: Monstrous Hound
text: "Stay."

name: Sol Ring
text: An arcane device with the power to rouse armies, raze enemies, and reward emperors.

name: Gandalf, Friend of the Shire
text: "After a hundred years, Hobbits can still surprise you at a pinch."

name: J. Jonah Jameson
text: "And don't come back, you menace!"

name: Tifa Lockhart
text: "Four guys between us . . . Okay. Let's not keep Cloud waiting."

name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
text: Beware! Her words will CORRUPT your mind!

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Double their peril. Double your winnings!"

name: Explore
text:
"Starfleet could have sent a probe out here to make maps and take pictures, but they didn't. They sent us, so that we could explore with our own senses."
—Captain Jonathan Archer

name: Consecrated Sphinx
text: A curse is just another name for an unwanted blessing.

name: Counterspell
text:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Dragonscale General
text: "Dragons seek war. I bring it to them."

name: Sandsteppe Mastodon
text: A mastodon's path always leads to an oasis.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: "Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Mutavault
text: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

name: Thought Erasure
text: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."

name: Sinister Sabotage
text:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

name: Necrotic Wound
text: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

name: Skarrg Goliath
text:
"They bind us with their laws. We free ourselves with nature's fist."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Diabolical Salvation
text: To succeed, the wizards made a deal with devils.

name: M'Odo, the Gnarled Oracle
text: Those with vision always have a path.

name: Kharis & The Beholder
text: #sponsored

name: Fabled Path of Searo Point
text:
"Who built such a wonder?"
"It took many hands."

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
text: Great devotion yields great reward.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Windseeker Centaur
text: Loyal and passionate in battle, the Windseeker tribe roams the Green Lands near the Honeyed Sea.

name: Giant Badger
text: The wizard Greensleeves called a Giant Badger to her aid in an battle with the desert mage Karli.

name: Chandra, Gremlin Wrangler
text: "Sure, I could set things on fire by myself. But teamwork can be fun, too."

name: Nira, Hellkite Duelist
text: "Keep rising."

name: Treasure Hunt
text:
"Some call me a thief. I prefer to think of myself as a discreet borrower."
—Dack Fayden, Planeswalker

name: Ogre Arsonist
text:
"All of Ravnica's looking for you, Dack, from the Wojek on down."
—Maytov

name: High Tide
text: "There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."

name: Gaze of Granite
text: "Show yourself, thief."

name: Wash Out
text:
"Perhaps planning should become a higher priority for me."
—Dack Fayden

name: Acquire
text: "'Ownership' is such a gray area."

name: Duress
text: "Your nightmares inspire me, Dack."

name: Feast of Blood
text: Imbued in the Ancient Fang were spells far darker than any Dack Fayden would cast.

name: Arrest
text: Fayden didn't know if the giant had created the spehere's magic—only that he had to escape it to find Sifa.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Youth is wasted on the young. So I help myself to some of it from time to time."
—Sifa Grent

name: Standstill
text:
"You learn a lot in no time when you're about to get your neck snapped."
—Dack Fayden

name: Breath of Malfegor
text: The draconic demon loomed over Dack, and he suddenly sensed he wasn't the only Planeswalker that Malfegor had encountered.

name: Raging Kavu
text: "Yavaimayae necesse mille annis fuit ut illa aluerent, sed modo momentum necesse fuit ut illa pretium probaverent."

name: Automated Assembly Line
text:
"You needn't be afraid of me. It's my securitrons that are going to kill you."
—Mr. House

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

name: Biomass Mutation
text: Vault 87's Evolutionary Experimentation Program exposed subjects to an airborne version of FEV. Rapid physical enhancements accompanied sharp mental regression, and the oldest mutants would become almost feral.

name: Casualties of War
text: War... war never changes.

name: Fervent Charge
text: NCR's rangers were feared far and wide. Even Caesar's Legion respected them in single combat.

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

name: Wake the Past
text: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text: "It's not a perfect replica, but your skull won't know the difference."

name: Panharmonicon
text: The difference between surviving and living is joy.

name: Steel Overseer
text: "Welcome, Administrator. Targeting Parameters have been erased and set to ADMIN_USER_GROUP• <Token. Name=Faction>."

name: Canopy Vista
text: Before the war, people came here to enjoy the view. Now, the only visitors are the birds who call harshly from the twisted trees.

name: Canyon Slough
text:
"I pray for the safety of all good people who come to Zion."
—Joshua Graham

name: Cinder Glade
text: With the Scorched below and toxic smog above, few survived fissure site Omega.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text:
"From up here, you could almost imagine how it was before."
—Wasteland survivor

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: The mirelurks seem significantly happier here than the commuters were.

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: The Poseidon offshore oil rig became one of the Enclave's mightiest fortresses, and eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

name: Exotic Orchard
text: Orwell Orchards is about as peaceful and pleasant as a tomb can get.

name: Fetid Pools
text: Ask any of the old-timers and they'll all agree—something ancient and terrifying haunts the sea.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Considered the greatest battle in history, Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

name: Irrigated Farmland
text:
"Sure, there are prettier farms in the Commonwealth, but none of them know how to grow tarberries like we do."
—Wiseman

name: Isolated Chapel
text: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

name: Mossfire Valley
text:
"I come from a place far to the northwest. It's called The Pitt. It's ... well ... let's be honest ... a nightmare."
—Wernher

name: Nesting Grounds
text: The ooze may look like honey, but stingwings aren't as sweet.

name: Prairie Stream
text: Hunting mirelurks. Selling their eggs. It's not much, but it's honest work . . . for a raider.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.

name: Scattered Groves
text: Awaiting harvest around the Groves family cabin are plump pumpkins, hearty carrots, juicy mutfruit, and ravenous scorchbeasts.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: The only things you need out in the wastes are food, water, and bullets. Everything else is details.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text:
"If anyone is reading this, this place isn't safe anymore."
—Hunter's warning note

name: Sheltered Thicket
text:
"This is a great spot . . . . Traders run close enough for easy pickins, but not so close that we end up skinned."
—Sully's Log

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: Even worse, the only toilet paper was locked in a nearby safe.

name: Spire of Industry
text: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.

name: Electrosiphon
text: "I calculate your chance of success to be . . . well, I don't want to be morbid . . ."

name: Sulfur Falls
text: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: Sometimes, just for a moment, the wind is moving gently through the trees, the brahmin are grazing beneath a blue sky, and everything is at peace.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: Stranded far from home, the *FMS Northern Star* is a rusting hulk crewed by ghouls.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text:
"Must have been something to see a movie on a screen that big."
—Preston Garvey

name: Temple of Abandon
text: You can't just travel through without stopping to see Dinky and the world's second-largest thermometer.

name: Temple of Deceit
text: Vault-Tec's vaults, rather than being the savior of humanity, were actually a series of unethical psychological experiments.

name: Temple of Enlightenment
text: Once, a symbol of national pride. Now, used only for target practice.

name: Temple of Epiphany
text: The Institute's FEV experiments failed. Only Shaun's DNA made organic synths possible.

name: Temple of Malady
text: The world ended, yet the ads kept rolling.

name: Temple of Malice
text: The Saugus Ironworks is controlled by the Forged, a raider gang who worship fire and metal.

name: Inventory Management
text: Constant danger requires constant preparedness.

name: Temple of Mystery
text: Fear the glow, not the dark.

name: Temple of Plenty
text: Pre-owned, pre-rusted, pre-irradiated.

name: Temple of Silence
text:
"We are a family of dreamers, a band of astral explorers, and a church of the mind."
—Jackson

name: Temple of Triumph
text: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

name: Treasure Vault
text: The vault of the Sierra Madre Hotel & Casino contains a fortune in gold . . . and a tragic tale.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

name: Kellogg, Dangerous Mind
text: "We both know how this will end. So... you ready?"

name: Intelligence Bobblehead
text: Bobbleheads were once an exclusive perk for Vault-Tec executives and residential vault dwellers.

name: War Room
text: A speech to stir the Brothers of Steel, a speech to bring the Enclave to heel, a speech to rouse a robotic ideal.

name: Legate Lanius, Caesar's Ace
text: "Victory shall be ours, it shall be swift, and it will be honest, purchased with blood."

name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
text: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

name: Mutational Advantage
text: "Ow, my pipe!"

name: The Nipton Lottery
text: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

name: Paladin Elizabeth Taggerdy
text: "Into the killing ground!"

name: Raul, Trouble Shooter
text: "Raul Alfonso Tejada, former gunslinger and sole survivor of Hidalgo Ranch, at your service."

name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
text:
"That little fella is deadly in his own fashion."
—The Mariner

name: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ
text: "You're listening to Galaxy News Radio, bringing you the truth, no matter how bad it hurts."

name: White Glove Gourmand
text: "Here's to us! It's time we move beyond beef!"

name: Brotherhood Vertibird
text: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

name: Intelligence Bobblehead
text: Bobbleheads were once an exclusive perk for Vault-Tec executives and residential vault dwellers.

name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
text: "Proud to serve!"

name: Desolate Mire
text: The region known to survivors as "Toxic Valley" is covered by industrial white powder and polluted water sources. The lake and other deadly waters of the Toxic Valley region are home to all manner of mutated, aquatic beasts.

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Even before it was a super mutant camp, the water treatment plant was used for all sorts of questionable experiments.

name: HELIOS One
text: The plant is still capable of activating the devastating ARCHIMEDES satellite weapon.

name: Junktown
text: It's not much, but it's home.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Unfortunately for Vault 34's remaining residents, a battle over the armory resulted in flooding, a leaking reactor, and broken doors.

name: Sunscorched Divide
text:
"To the Divide they came. In the Divide, they rest."
—Ulysses

name: Viridescent Bog
text: The Master had literally built his army one mutant at a time. Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

name: All That Glitters
text: Sooner or later, the House always wins.

name: Crush Contraband
text: "This tech is unworthy of preservation."

name: Dispatch
text: "Structural weakness detected. Exploiting."

name: Gary Clone
text: "Gary!"

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Synths are crawling all over the place! Thin them out before we drop!"
—Proctor Ingram

name: Impassioned Orator
text: "Come forth and drink the waters of the Glow, for this ancient weapon of war is our salvation. It is the very symbol of Atom's glory!"

name: Intangible Virtue
text:
"A real soldier's bravery comes from within ... from his heart and his soul."
—Elder Arthur Maxson

name: Martial Coup
text: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

name: Open the Vaults
text:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

name: Path to Exile
text: In the end, he marched into the desert sands, leaving the Vault behind him.

name: Idolized
text: Renowned for your extensive support and goodwill, you are idolized by the community.

name: Puresteel Paladin
text: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

name: Secure the Wastes
text: "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter."

name: Single Combat
text: Some fight to destroy their enemies. Some fight to destroy themselves.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: At the Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center, Mr. Handy robots were repurposed for farming—and turning intruders into fertilizer.

name: Valorous Stance
text: "I had to put on a brave face as long as there were still people counting on me."

name: Fraying Sanity
text: "The king! The king has been murdered! It is regicide! Vault Boy... what did you do? What did... *we* do?"

name: Glimmer of Genius
text: Dr. Madison Li's genius was an asset for both Project Purity and, later, the Institute.

name: Inexorable Tide
text: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

name: Mechanized Production
text: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds were reassigned to weapons development.

name: One with the Machine
text: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: A blend of seventeen fruit flavors, cola, and a weaponized-isotope byproduct that barely passed safety approval.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: In the year 2271, the Desert Rangers of Nevada and rangers of the New California Republic met at this spot to sign the Ranger Unification Treaty.

name: Black Market
text: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

name: Deadly Dispute
text:
"You go break up that bar brawl yet? People are gonna get hurt unless you step in."
—Sheriff Marion

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: "It's hardly a crime to take gear that's lying around without an owner. The crime part is where I make sure it doesn't have an owner."

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "You won't need this. I made sure of that."

name: Blasphemous Act
text: Everyone knew the bombs were coming. Everyone but the public.

name: Chaos Warp
text: No one knew what the Zetans wanted. But whatever it was, it involved cattle.

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: "Does Ramos know you're walking around without a guard?"

name: Stolen Strategy
text: "Hacking is just good science!"

name: Unexpected Windfall
text: "Nice. Coming back later for you. . . ."

name: Branching Evolution
text: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

name: Cultivate
text: Like him, his tiny flower friend continued to grow larger each day.

name: Farseek
text: "Me and Jacob went separate ways after the business with the rig. I went east into the Rockies, looking for other mutants like myself."

name: Fertile Ground
text: Fertile does not always mean safe.

name: Guardian Project
text:
"They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland."
—The Master

name: Paladin Danse, Steel Maverick
text: "I need to be the example, not the exception."

name: Hardened Scales
text: The wastes will toughen anybody up—even those who were already tough to begin with.

name: Harmonize
text: "I'm already a ghoul—what more can the sun do?"

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

name: Inspiring Call
text: Loyal members of the Enlightened return to Point Pleasant during the seasonal equinox to honor the Wise Mothman, despite interference from the blasphemous "Dim Ones."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Freed from human industry and sheltered from nuclear destruction, Appalachia's plant life finally had a chance to flourish.

name: Rancor
text: Rancorous Ruth, Malefic Maud, and Irate Ida formed the core of Maud's Muggers, Freeside's most terrifying villains.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the wasteland, the radsquirrels have their eyes out for you.

name: Wild Growth
text:
"Our researchers noted a sense of euphoria and claimed to hear incomprehensible voices. Extreme measures will need to be taken to cull this organism."
—Strangler vine research notes

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: A popular weapon with the muscular crowd.

name: Biomass Mutation
text: Vault 87's Evolutionary Experimentation Program exposed subjects to an airborne version of FEV. Rapid physical enhancements accompanied sharp mental regression, and the oldest mutants would become almost feral.

name: Casualties of War
text: War... war never changes.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Vault 22's experiments were supposed to yield plentiful plant food for the survivors. Ironically, the survivors were plentiful food for the plants.

name: Fervent Charge
text: NCR's rangers were feared far and wide. Even Caesar's Legion respected them in single combat.

name: General's Enforcer
text:
"A veteran ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see."
—NCR trooper

name: Heroic Reinforcements
text:
"Assaulting the Institute has been set irrevocably in motion. All able-bodied field agents are already en route here."
—Desdemona

name: Putrefy
text: Even in death, a glowing one can emit a lethal amount of radiation. The fungus doesn't seem to mind though.

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

name: Wake the Past
text: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Something to love, honor, and cherish—and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

name: Fireshrieker
text: The flamer is a specially engineered flamethrower suited for extended combat engagements. It delivers sustained energy damage and can completely immolate a target.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: No matter how big the fall is, you're safe as long as you land with both feet.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text: "It's not a perfect replica, but your skull won't know the difference."

name: Mind Stone
text:
"When facing a crisis, don't forget to squeeze your official Vault-Tec stress ball!"
—*Overseer's Manual*

name: Panharmonicon
text: The difference between surviving and living is joy.

name: Skullclamp
text:
"The flesh is weak! But steel! Steel is strong!"
—The Mechanist

name: Sol Ring
text: The Beverageers were pleased by Project Cobalt. Not only did they discover new weaponizable isotopes but a tasty beverage additive to boot.

name: Steel Overseer
text: "Welcome, Administrator. Targeting Parameters have been erased and set to ADMIN_USER_GROUP• <Token. Name=Faction>."

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text: "I don't need brakes. I usually find that if something stops me, it's interesting enough to stop for."

name: Talisman of Conviction
text: Grognak. Silver Shroud. Manta Man. Mistress of Mystery. The Inspector. The heroes united together to become ... The Unstoppables.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text: Science fiction? Not anymore. Now these tales are science fact.

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text: While cleverly written and absorbing, its stionable content may lead to people learning dangerously misinformed lessons.

name: Talisman of Dominance
text: Aside from the cool articles on loincloths and axes, it's got some great tips on weapon care!

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text: The ghouls of the FMS *Northern Star* seemed interested in moving up in the world of business.

name: Talisman of Indulgence
text: After decades of squalor, wastelanders would kill for a new hairdo.

name: Talisman of Progress
text: More sensation than science, these medical magazines only encouraged malpractice.

name: Talisman of Resilience
text: These tales of the strange prepared their readers to combat the horrors of the wasteland.

name: Thought Vessel
text: A window into the mind of someone you once knew.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: What better way to spend some fun quality time than collecting some snow globes?

name: Ash Barrens
text: War has survivors but rarely has winners.

name: Buried Ruin
text: Venture into the abandoned subway and you'll get more than your ticket punched.

name: Canopy Vista
text: Before the war, people came here to enjoy the view. Now, the only visitors are the birds who call harshly from the twisted trees.

name: Canyon Slough
text:
"I pray for the safety of all good people who come to Zion."
—Joshua Graham

name: Cinder Glade
text: With the Scorched below and toxic smog above, few survived fissure site Omega.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text:
"From up here, you could almost imagine how it was before."
—Wasteland survivor

name: Command Tower
text:
"New Vegas is more than a city—it's the remedy to mankind's derailment."
—Mr. House

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: The mirelurks seem significantly happier here than the commuters were.

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: The Poseidon offshore oil rig became one of the Enclave's mightiest fortresses, and eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"One day, maybe, kids will play here again."
—Preston Garvey

name: Exotic Orchard
text: Orwell Orchards is about as peaceful and pleasant as a tomb can get.

name: Fetid Pools
text: Ask any of the old-timers and they'll all agree—something ancient and terrifying haunts the sea.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Considered the greatest battle in history, Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

name: Irrigated Farmland
text:
"Sure, there are prettier farms in the Commonwealth, but none of them know how to grow tarberries like we do."
—Wiseman

name: Isolated Chapel
text: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: Once, the "Houses of Tomorrow." Now, the tombs of today.

name: Memorial to Glory
text: It commemorates the Battle of Hoover Dam. The rangers lured the best of Caesar's Legion into Boulder City, then blew the whole town up.

name: Mortuary Mire
text: Burying the dead. What an archaic idea.

name: Mossfire Valley
text:
"I come from a place far to the northwest. It's called The Pitt. It's ... well ... let's be honest ... a nightmare."
—Wernher

name: Mystic Monastery
text:
"Hey, come see me at the Top of the World when you get a chance. I've got something for you. And, I pinky-swear I won't kill you."
—Rose, robotic raider

name: Nesting Grounds
text: The ooze may look like honey, but stingwings aren't as sweet.

name: Nomad Outpost
text: The Fort served as Caesar's base of operations. From here, the Legion dreamed of transforming themselves from nomads to an empire.

name: Opulent Palace
text:
"Gather now, faithful followers of the most wise and beneficent Mothman. Let us light his holy beacon with the radiance of the fireflies."
—Brother Moncrief

name: Path of Ancestry
text: "Your mother would have been so proud."

name: Prairie Stream
text: Hunting mirelurks. Selling their eggs. It's not much, but it's honest work . . . for a raider.

name: Razortide Bridge
text: In order to join the Order of the Tadpole, one must pass an athletics test that requires participants to run along the bridge, contending with feral ghouls, bloodbugs, and the bridge's dilapidated state. Don't forget to stretch!

name: Roadside Reliquary
text: You'd be surprised what people leave behind on the old roads. Gotta keep your eyes peeled for the good stuff.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: The Railroad is an organization dedicated to freeing synths from the influence of the Institute. Their HQ is a secret location found by following the Freedom Trail.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.

name: Rustvale Bridge
text:
"The Institute . . . It's important. It really is humanity's best hope for the future, no matter what those above ground might think of us."
—Father

name: Scattered Groves
text: Awaiting harvest around the Groves family cabin are plump pumpkins, hearty carrots, juicy mutfruit, and ravenous scorchbeasts.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: The only things you need out in the wastes are food, water, and bullets. Everything else is details.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text:
"If anyone is reading this, this place isn't safe anymore."
—Hunter's warning note

name: Sheltered Thicket
text:
"This is a great spot . . . . Traders run close enough for easy pickins, but not so close that we end up skinned."
—Sully's Log

name: Silverbluff Bridge
text: A good way to avoid getting your feet wet (and irradiated) as long as you're willing to contend with raiders, scavengers, and super mutants.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: Even worse, the only toilet paper was locked in a nearby safe.

name: Spire of Industry
text: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.

name: Sulfur Falls
text: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: Sometimes, just for a moment, the wind is moving gently through the trees, the brahmin are grazing beneath a blue sky, and everything is at peace.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: Stranded far from home, the *FMS Northern Star* is a rusting hulk crewed by ghouls.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text:
"Must have been something to see a movie on a screen that big."
—Preston Garvey

name: Tainted Field
text: The Glowing Sea is the most highly irradiated region in the entire Commonwealth. According to local legend, it was ground zero for the high-yield nuclear blast that devastated most of the area.

name: Tainted Isle
text: The island's signal tower protected it from mirelurks but did nothing against the raiders.

name: Tainted Peak
text: The Rockhound excavator was powered by four nuclear reactors and proved to be ... too efficient. Its mining efforts devastated the area and transformed the land into the Ash Heap.

name: Tainted Wood
text: Wasteland survival tip: deathclaws can't swim.

name: Temple of Abandon
text: You can't just travel through without stopping to see Dinky and the world's second-largest thermometer.

name: Temple of Deceit
text: Vault-Tec's vaults, rather than being the savior of humanity, were actually a series of unethical psychological experiments.

name: Temple of Enlightenment
text: Once, a symbol of national pride. Now, used only for target practice.

name: Temple of Epiphany
text: The Institute's FEV experiments failed. Only Shaun's DNA made organic synths possible.

name: Temple of Malady
text: The world ended, yet the ads kept rolling.

name: Temple of Malice
text: The Saugus Ironworks is controlled by the Forged, a raider gang who worship fire and metal.

name: Temple of Mystery
text: Fear the glow, not the dark.

name: Temple of Plenty
text: Pre-owned, pre-rusted, pre-irradiated.

name: James, Wandering Dad
text: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

name: Temple of Silence
text:
"We are a family of dreamers, a band of astral explorers, and a church of the mind."
—Jackson

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"Pain clears the mind of evil thoughts and allows them to better comprehend the glory of the Master."
—Father Lasher

name: Temple of Triumph
text: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: A new civilization was built, bit by bit, from the scrap of the old one.

name: Treasure Vault
text: The vault of the Sierra Madre Hotel & Casino contains a fortune in gold . . . and a tragic tale.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

name: Nick Valentine, Private Eye
text: "Your case is my top concern."

name: Piper Wright, Publick Reporter
text: "You can't stop the press."

name: Automated Assembly Line
text:
"You needn't be afraid of me. It's my securitrons that are going to kill you."
—Mr. House

name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
text: "Proud to serve!"

name: Radstorm
text: Green sky at night, ghoul's delight.

name: James, Wandering Dad
text: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

name: Nick Valentine, Private Eye
text: "Your case is my top concern."

name: Piper Wright, Publick Reporter
text: "You can't stop the press."

name: Wasteland Raider
text: Honor means nothing. Survival means everything.

name: Megaton's Fate
text: Do the right thing—or the wrong thing.

name: Wild Wasteland
text: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

name: Animal Friend
text: "I scratch their back, they scratch you."

name: Power Fist
text: A fist fight will leave a bruise. A power fist fight will leave a crater.

name: Strong, the Brutish Thespian
text: "Strong learn secret to human power from Mack Beth."

name: Tato Farmer
text: "Try one! They're disgusting!"

name: Almost Perfect
text: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

name: Vexing Radgull
text: Fighting one is a terrible experience.

name: Electrosiphon
text: "I calculate your chance of success to be . . . well, I don't want to be morbid . . ."

name: Kellogg, Dangerous Mind
text: "We both know how this will end. So... you ready?"

name: Liberty Prime, Recharged
text: "Democracy is nonnegotiable."

name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
text: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

name: Mutational Advantage
text: "Ow, my pipe!"

name: The Nipton Lottery
text: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

name: Paladin Elizabeth Taggerdy
text: "Into the killing ground!"

name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
text:
"That little fella is deadly in his own fashion."
—The Mariner

name: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ
text: "You're listening to Galaxy News Radio, bringing you the truth, no matter how bad it hurts."

name: Brotherhood Vertibird
text: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

name: Desolate Mire
text: The region known to survivors as "Toxic Valley" is covered by industrial white powder and polluted water sources. The lake and other deadly waters of the Toxic Valley region are home to all manner of mutated, aquatic beasts.

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Even before it was a super mutant camp, the water treatment plant was used for all sorts of questionable experiments.

name: HELIOS One
text: The plant is still capable of activating the devastating ARCHIMEDES satellite weapon.

name: Junktown
text: It's not much, but it's home.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Unfortunately for Vault 34's remaining residents, a battle over the armory resulted in flooding, a leaking reactor, and broken doors.

name: Sunscorched Divide
text:
"To the Divide they came. In the Divide, they rest."
—Ulysses

name: Viridescent Bog
text: The Master had literally built his army one mutant at a time. Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Synths are crawling all over the place! Thin them out before we drop!"
—Proctor Ingram

name: Martial Coup
text: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

name: Open the Vaults
text:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

name: Puresteel Paladin
text: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

name: Secure the Wastes
text: "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter."

name: Single Combat
text: Some fight to destroy their enemies. Some fight to destroy themselves.

name: Fraying Sanity
text: "The king! The king has been murdered! It is regicide! Vault Boy... what did you do? What did... *we* do?"

name: Inexorable Tide
text: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

name: Mechanized Production
text: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds were reassigned to weapons development.

name: One with the Machine
text: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

name: Black Market
text: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

name: Blasphemous Act
text: Everyone knew the bombs were coming. Everyone but the public.

name: Chaos Warp
text: No one knew what the Zetans wanted. But whatever it was, it involved cattle.

name: Stolen Strategy
text: "Hacking is just good science!"

name: Branching Evolution
text: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

name: Guardian Project
text:
"They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland."
—The Master

name: Nuclear Fallout
text: The end of the world occurred as predicted: too many humans, not enough space or resources to go around. The details are trivial and pointless. The reasons, as always, purely human ones.

name: Hardened Scales
text: The wastes will toughen anybody up— even those who were already tough to begin with.

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

name: Biomass Mutation
text: Vault 87's Evolutionary Experimentation Program exposed subjects to an airborne version of FEV. Rapid physical enhancements accompanied sharp mental regression, and the oldest mutants would become almost feral.

name: Casualties of War
text: War... war never changes.

name: Fervent Charge
text: NCR's rangers were feared far and wide. Even Caesar's Legion respected them in single combat.

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

name: Wake the Past
text: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

name: Ruthless Radrat
text: They'll make you miss the mole rats.

name: All That Glitters
text: Sooner or later, the House always wins.

name: Crush Contraband
text: "This tech is unworthy of preservation."

name: Dispatch
text: "Structural weakness detected. Exploiting."

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Synths are crawling all over the place! Thin them out before we drop!"
—Proctor Ingram

name: Impassioned Orator
text: "Come forth and drink the waters of the Glow, for this ancient weapon of war is our salvation. It is the very symbol of Atom's glory!"

name: Intangible Virtue
text:
"A real soldier's bravery comes from within ... from his heart and his soul."
—Elder Arthur Maxson

name: Martial Coup
text: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

name: Open the Vaults
text:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

name: Path to Exile
text: In the end, he marched into the desert sands, leaving the Vault behind him.

name: Puresteel Paladin
text: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

name: Secure the Wastes
text: "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter."

name: Single Combat
text: Some fight to destroy their enemies. Some fight to destroy themselves.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: At the Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center, Mr. Handy robots were repurposed for farming—and turning intruders into fertilizer.

name: Valorous Stance
text: "I had to put on a brave face as long as there were still people counting on me."

name: Fraying Sanity
text: "The king! The king has been murdered! It is regicide! Vault Boy... what did you do? What did... *we* do?"

name: Glimmer of Genius
text: Dr. Madison Li's genius was an asset for both Project Purity and, later, the Institute.

name: Inexorable Tide
text: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

name: Mechanized Production
text: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds were reassigned to weapons development.

name: One with the Machine
text: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: A blend of seventeen fruit flavors, cola, and a weaponized-isotope byproduct that barely passed safety approval.

name: Wild Wasteland
text: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: In the year 2271, the Desert Rangers of Nevada and rangers of the New California Republic met at this spot to sign the Ranger Unification Treaty.

name: Black Market
text: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

name: Deadly Dispute
text:
"You go break up that bar brawl yet? People are gonna get hurt unless you step in."
—Sheriff Marion

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: "It's hardly a crime to take gear that's lying around without an owner. The crime part is where I make sure it doesn't have an owner."

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "You won't need this. I made sure of that."

name: Blasphemous Act
text: Everyone knew the bombs were coming. Everyone but the public.

name: Chaos Warp
text: No one knew what the Zetans wanted. But whatever it was, it involved cattle.

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: "Does Ramos know you're walking around without a guard?"

name: Animal Friend
text: "I scratch their back, they scratch you."

name: Stolen Strategy
text: "Hacking is just good science!"

name: Unexpected Windfall
text: "Nice. Coming back later for you. . . ."

name: Branching Evolution
text: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

name: Cultivate
text: Like him, his tiny flower friend continued to grow larger each day.

name: Farseek
text: "Me and Jacob went separate ways after the business with the rig. I went east into the Rockies, looking for other mutants like myself."

name: Fertile Ground
text: Fertile does not always mean safe.

name: Guardian Project
text:
"They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland."
—The Master

name: Hardened Scales
text: The wastes will toughen anybody up— even those who were already tough to begin with.

name: Harmonize
text: "I'm already a ghoul—what more can the sun do?"

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

name: Inspiring Call
text: Loyal members of the Enlightened return to Point Pleasant during the seasonal equinox to honor the Wise Mothman, despite interference from the blasphemous "Dim Ones."

name: Rampant Growth
text: Freed from human industry and sheltered from nuclear destruction, Appalachia's plant life finally had a chance to flourish.

name: Rancor
text: Rancorous Ruth, Malefic Maud, and Irate Ida formed the core of Maud's Muggers, Freeside's most terrifying villains.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the wasteland, the radsquirrels have their eyes out for you.

name: Wild Growth
text:
"Our researchers noted a sense of euphoria and claimed to hear incomprehensible voices. Extreme measures will need to be taken to cull this organism."
—Strangler vine research notes

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: A popular weapon with the muscular crowd.

name: Break Down
text: "Old human junk. Worst kind of human junk."

name: Biomass Mutation
text: Vault 87's Evolutionary Experimentation Program exposed subjects to an airborne version of FEV. Rapid physical enhancements accompanied sharp mental regression, and the oldest mutants would become almost feral.

name: Casualties of War
text: War... war never changes.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Vault 22's experiments were supposed to yield plentiful plant food for the survivors. Ironically, the survivors were plentiful food for the plants.

name: Fervent Charge
text: NCR's rangers were feared far and wide. Even Caesar's Legion respected them in single combat.

name: General's Enforcer
text:
"A veteran ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see."
—NCR trooper

name: Heroic Reinforcements
text:
"Assaulting the Institute has been set irrevocably in motion. All able-bodied field agents are already en route here."
—Desdemona

name: Putrefy
text: Even in death, a glowing one can emit a lethal amount of radiation. The fungus doesn't seem to mind though.

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

name: Wake the Past
text: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

name: Cathedral Acolyte
text: "Master, evolve me to perfection!"

name: Arcane Signet
text: Something to love, honor, and cherish— and a reminder of someone who once did that for you.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

name: Glowing One
text: The glowing one mumbles something and then falls silent. He drools uncontrollably.

name: Fireshrieker
text: The flamer is a specially engineered flamethrower suited for extended combat engagements. It delivers sustained energy damage and can completely immolate a target.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: No matter how big the fall is, you're safe as long as you land with both feet.

name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
text: "It's not a perfect replica, but your skull won't know the difference."

name: Mind Stone
text:
"When facing a crisis, don't forget to squeeze your official Vault-Tec stress ball!"
—*Overseer's Manual*

name: Panharmonicon
text: The difference between surviving and living is joy.

name: Skullclamp
text:
"The flesh is weak! But steel! Steel is strong!"
—The Mechanist

name: Sol Ring
text: The Beverageers were pleased by Project Cobalt. Not only did they discover new weaponizable isotopes but a tasty beverage additive to boot.

name: Steel Overseer
text: "Welcome, Administrator. Targeting Parameters have been erased and set to ADMIN_USER_GROUP• <Token. Name=Faction>."

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text: "I don't need brakes. I usually find that if something stops me, it's interesting enough to stop for."

name: Talisman of Conviction
text: Grognak. Silver Shroud. Manta Man. Mistress of Mystery. The Inspector. The heroes united together to become ... The Unstoppables.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text: Science fiction? Not anymore. Now these tales are science fact.

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text: While cleverly written and absorbing, its stionable content may lead to people learning dangerously misinformed lessons.

name: Talisman of Dominance
text: Aside from the cool articles on loincloths and axes, it's got some great tips on weapon care!

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text: The ghouls of the FMS *Northern Star* seemed interested in moving up in the world of business.

name: Talisman of Indulgence
text: After decades of squalor, wastelanders would kill for a new hairdo.

name: Talisman of Progress
text: More sensation than science, these medical magazines only encouraged malpractice.

name: Talisman of Resilience
text: These tales of the strange prepared their readers to combat the horrors of the wasteland.

name: Thought Vessel
text: A window into the mind of someone you once knew.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: What better way to spend some fun quality time than collecting some snow globes?

name: Ash Barrens
text: War has survivors but rarely has winners.

name: Buried Ruin
text: Venture into the abandoned subway and you'll get more than your ticket punched.

name: Canopy Vista
text: Before the war, people came here to enjoy the view. Now, the only visitors are the birds who call harshly from the twisted trees.

name: Canyon Slough
text:
"I pray for the safety of all good people who come to Zion."
—Joshua Graham

name: Cinder Glade
text: With the Scorched below and toxic smog above, few survived fissure site Omega.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text:
"From up here, you could almost imagine how it was before."
—Wasteland survivor

name: Command Tower
text:
"New Vegas is more than a city—it's the remedy to mankind's derailment."
—Mr. House

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: The mirelurks seem significantly happier here than the commuters were.

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: The Poseidon offshore oil rig became one of the Enclave's mightiest fortresses, and eventually, the site of their greatest defeat.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"One day, maybe, kids will play here again."
—Preston Garvey

name: Exotic Orchard
text: Orwell Orchards is about as peaceful and pleasant as a tomb can get.

name: Fetid Pools
text: Ask any of the old-timers and they'll all agree—something ancient and terrifying haunts the sea.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Considered the greatest battle in history, Operation: Anchorage showcased the effectiveness of the winterized T-51b power armor.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

name: Irrigated Farmland
text:
"Sure, there are prettier farms in the Commonwealth, but none of them know how to grow tarberries like we do."
—Wiseman

name: Isolated Chapel
text: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: Once, the "Houses of Tomorrow." Now, the tombs of today.

name: Memorial to Glory
text: It commemorates the Battle of Hoover Dam. The rangers lured the best of Caesar's Legion into Boulder City, then blew the whole town up.

name: Lumbering Megasloth
text: When threatened, it slowly shakes its body to produce spores from the mushrooms growing on its back.

name: Mortuary Mire
text: Burying the dead. What an archaic idea.

name: Mossfire Valley
text:
"I come from a place far to the northwest. It's called The Pitt. It's ... well ... let's be honest ... a nightmare."
—Wernher

name: Mystic Monastery
text:
"Hey, come see me at the Top of the World when you get a chance. I've got something for you. And, I pinky-swear I won't kill you."
—Rose, robotic raider

name: Nesting Grounds
text: The ooze may look like honey, but stingwings aren't as sweet.

name: Nomad Outpost
text: The Fort served as Caesar's base of operations. From here, the Legion dreamed of transforming themselves from nomads to an empire.

name: Opulent Palace
text:
"Gather now, faithful followers of the most wise and beneficent Mothman. Let us light his holy beacon with the radiance of the fireflies."
—Brother Moncrief

name: Path of Ancestry
text: "Your mother would have been so proud."

name: Prairie Stream
text: Hunting mirelurks. Selling their eggs. It's not much, but it's honest work . . . for a raider.

name: Razortide Bridge
text: In order to join the Order of the Tadpole, one must pass an athletics test that requires participants to run along the bridge, contending with feral ghouls, bloodbugs, and the bridge's dilapidated state. Don't forget to stretch!

name: Power Fist
text: A fist fight will leave a bruise. A power fist fight will leave a crater.

name: Roadside Reliquary
text: You'd be surprised what people leave behind on the old roads. Gotta keep your eyes peeled for the good stuff.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: The Railroad is an organization dedicated to freeing synths from the influence of the Institute. Their HQ is a secret location found by following the Freedom Trail.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Mutant strangler vines carried the town of Tanagra up into the treetops, where it remains to this day.

name: Rustvale Bridge
text:
"The Institute . . . It's important. It really is humanity's best hope for the future, no matter what those above ground might think of us."
—Father

name: Scattered Groves
text: Awaiting harvest around the Groves family cabin are plump pumpkins, hearty carrots, juicy mutfruit, and ravenous scorchbeasts.

name: Scavenger Grounds
text: The only things you need out in the wastes are food, water, and bullets. Everything else is details.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text:
"If anyone is reading this, this place isn't safe anymore."
—Hunter's warning note

name: Sheltered Thicket
text:
"This is a great spot . . . . Traders run close enough for easy pickins, but not so close that we end up skinned."
—Sully's Log

name: Silverbluff Bridge
text: A good way to avoid getting your feet wet (and irradiated) as long as you're willing to contend with raiders, scavengers, and super mutants.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: Even worse, the only toilet paper was locked in a nearby safe.

name: Spire of Industry
text: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.

name: Sulfur Falls
text: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: Sometimes, just for a moment, the wind is moving gently through the trees, the brahmin are grazing beneath a blue sky, and everything is at peace.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: Stranded far from home, the *FMS Northern Star* is a rusting hulk crewed by ghouls.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text:
"Must have been something to see a movie on a screen that big."
—Preston Garvey

name: Tainted Field
text: The Glowing Sea is the most highly irradiated region in the entire Commonwealth. According to local legend, it was ground zero for the high-yield nuclear blast that devastated most of the area.

name: Tainted Isle
text: The island's signal tower protected it from mirelurks but did nothing against the raiders.

name: Tainted Peak
text: The Rockhound excavator was powered by four nuclear reactors and proved to be ... too efficient. Its mining efforts devastated the area and transformed the land into the Ash Heap.

name: Tainted Wood
text: Wasteland survival tip: deathclaws can't swim.

name: Temple of Abandon
text: You can't just travel through without stopping to see Dinky and the world's second-largest thermometer.

name: Temple of Deceit
text: Vault-Tec's vaults, rather than being the savior of humanity, were actually a series of unethical psychological experiments.

name: Temple of Enlightenment
text: Once, a symbol of national pride. Now, used only for target practice.

name: Temple of Epiphany
text: The Institute's FEV experiments failed. Only Shaun's DNA made organic synths possible.

name: Temple of Malady
text: The world ended, yet the ads kept rolling.

name: Temple of Malice
text: The Saugus Ironworks is controlled by the Forged, a raider gang who worship fire and metal.

name: Temple of Mystery
text: Fear the glow, not the dark.

name: Temple of Plenty
text: Pre-owned, pre-rusted, pre-irradiated.

name: Temple of Silence
text:
"We are a family of dreamers, a band of astral explorers, and a church of the mind."
—Jackson

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"Pain clears the mind of evil thoughts and allows them to better comprehend the glory of the Master."
—Father Lasher

name: Strong, the Brutish Thespian
text: "Strong learn secret to human power from Mack Beth."

name: Temple of Triumph
text: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: A new civilization was built from the scrap of the old one.

name: Treasure Vault
text: The vault of the Sierra Madre Hotel & Casino contains a fortune in gold . . . and a tragic tale.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

name: Super Mutant Scavenger
text: Out in the wastelands, everything's a steal.

name: Tato Farmer
text: "Try one! They're disgusting!"

name: Watchful Radstag
text: Don't mistake timidness for defenselessness.

name: Well Rested
text: When you're a deep sleeper, any bed will do.

name: Automated Assembly Line
text:
"You needn't be afraid of me. It's my securitrons that are going to kill you."
—Mr. House

name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
text: "Proud to serve!"

name: Almost Perfect
text: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

name: James, Wandering Dad
text: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

name: Nick Valentine, Private Eye
text: "Your case is my top concern."

name: Piper Wright, Publick Reporter
text: "You can't stop the press."

name: Wasteland Raider
text: Honor means nothing. Survival means everything.

name: Megaton's Fate
text: Do the right thing—or the wrong thing.

name: Wild Wasteland
text: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

name: Animal Friend
text: "I scratch their back, they scratch you."

name: Power Fist
text: A fist fight will leave a bruise. A power fist fight will leave a crater.

name: Armory Paladin
text: "Ad victoriam!"

name: Strong, the Brutish Thespian
text: "Strong learn secret to human power from Mack Beth."

name: Tato Farmer
text: "Try one! They're disgusting!"

name: Almost Perfect
text: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

name: Atomize
text: Plasma rifles—separating soft tissues from hard ones since 2077.

name: Electrosiphon
text: "I calculate your chance of success to be . . . well, I don't want to be morbid . . ."

name: Kellogg, Dangerous Mind
text: "We both know how this will end. So... you ready?"

name: Liberty Prime, Recharged
text: "Democracy is nonnegotiable."

name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
text: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

name: Mutational Advantage
text: "Ow, my pipe!"

name: The Nipton Lottery
text: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

name: Paladin Elizabeth Taggerdy
text: "Into the killing ground!"

name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
text:
"That little fella is deadly in his own fashion."
—The Mariner

name: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ
text: "You're listening to Galaxy News Radio, bringing you the truth, no matter how bad it hurts."

name: Brotherhood Vertibird
text: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

name: Desolate Mire
text: The region known to survivors as "Toxic Valley" is covered by industrial white powder and polluted water sources. The lake and other deadly waters of the Toxic Valley region are home to all manner of mutated, aquatic beasts.

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Even before it was a super mutant camp, the water treatment plant was used for all sorts of questionable experiments.

name: HELIOS One
text: The plant is still capable of activating the devastating ARCHIMEDES satellite weapon.

name: Junktown
text: It's not much, but it's home.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Unfortunately for Vault 34's remaining residents, a battle over the armory resulted in flooding, a leaking reactor, and broken doors.

name: Sunscorched Divide
text:
"To the Divide they came. In the Divide, they rest."
—Ulysses

name: Viridescent Bog
text: The Master had literally built his army one mutant at a time. Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Synths are crawling all over the place! Thin them out before we drop!"
—Proctor Ingram

name: Martial Coup
text: Elder Nolan McNamara broke the Chain That Binds, starting the events which led to Hardin's coup.

—Overseer

text: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

text: "The king! The king has been murdered! It is regicide! Vault Boy... what did you do? What did... *we* do?"

text: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

name: Mechanized Production
text: At the onset of the Great War, Nuka-Cola's best minds were reassigned to weapons development.

name: Contaminated Drink
text: A little Rad-X helps, but nothing quite blocks out the taste.

name: One with the Machine
text: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

name: Black Market
text: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

name: Blasphemous Act
text: Everyone knew the bombs were coming. Everyone but the public.

name: Chaos Warp
text: No one knew what the Zetans wanted. But whatever it was, it involved cattle.

name: Stolen Strategy
text: "Hacking is just good science!"

name: Branching Evolution
text: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

name: Guardian Project
text:
"They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland."
—The Master

name: Hardened Scales
text: The wastes will toughen anybody up— even those who were already tough to begin with.

name: Heroic Intervention
text:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

name: Devil's Play
text: A devil's hands are never idle.

name: Mayor of Avabruck
text: He can deny his true nature for only so long.

name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
text: "A great leader must have the wisdom to know what's right and the courage to make it so."

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
text: "Those who say money can't buy happiness clearly don't have enough."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Glorious Anthem
text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

name: Whirling Dervish
text: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

name: Elvish Champion
text: "We've endured your slights to Gaea with the grace of tolerance. Now behold the grace of our ferocity."

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Cast the weight as though it were a die, to see a rival's fate.

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: 大蛇の領地には墓石が無い。死んだ戦士は木の苗と共に埋められ、死して後に森の一部となるのだ。

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Glorious Anthem
text: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Whirling Dervish
text: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

name: Elvish Champion
text: "We've endured your slights to Gaea with the grace of tolerance. Now behold the grace of our ferocity."

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Spawn of Thraxes
text: Sparks from Purphoros's forge fill the belly of every dragon.

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Hall of Triumph
text: Heroes act without thought of glory or reward. Accolades are a consequence, not a goal.

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Dawnbringer Charioteers
text: "Nyx may belong to the gods, but the skies of Theros are ours."

name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
text: Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

text: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

name: Elvish Champion
text: "We've endured your slights to Gaea with the grace of tolerance. Now behold the grace of our ferocity."

name: Glory
text:
"תהילה נﬠלמה; תהילה הייתה בכל מקום."
—מגילת ההיווצרות והמקור

name: Chief of the Foundry
text: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

name: Saheeli's Artistry
text: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

name: Heir of the Wilds
text: In the high caves of the Qal Sisma mountains, young hunters quest to hear the echoes of their fierce ancestors.

name: Ankle Shanker
text: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

name: Avalanche Tusker
text:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy"
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

name: Ivorytusk Fortress
text: Abzan soldiers march to war confident that their Houses march with them.

name: Rakshasa Vizier
text: Rakshasa offer deals that sound advantageous to those who forget who they are dealing with.

name: Sage of the Inward Eye
text: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
text: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: The tastiest morsels rarely make it to their intended destination.

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
text: Becoming a dragon only sharpened his raw ambitions.

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its passage through the flowering expanse doesn't disturb so much as a single petal.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: "Death is not the end. I give myself to the land, and thus I live on past my demise."

name: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage
text: "A single lifetime is barely enough to scratch the surface of all that our ancestors have to teach us."

name: Magus of the Arena
text: The magus still hears the roar of the crowds. They're gone, but the will to compete remains.

name: Needlepeak Spider
text:
"It's a testament to the forests' devastation that giant spiders now make their homes amid Dominaria's barren spires."
—Aznaph, greenseeker

name: Timecrafting
text: Oddly, an unstable time stream makes wizards want to tinker with it even more.

name: Poultice Sliver
text:
"Its broad claw suggests a chitinous shield, but in fact it conceals glands that secrete a remarkably swift healing agent."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Blood Knight
text: His is the fury of the wildfire, the boiling blood of the volcano. He fights you not because you've wronged him, but because you're there.

name: Brute Force
text: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text:
"Learn to burn!"
—Institute of Arcane Studies motto

name: Rebuff the Wicked
text:
"I cannot teach you their brand of magic, but I can teach you how to defend against it."
—Tavalus, priest of Korlis

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Shivan Wumpus
text: It's easier to move the village than to divert the wumpus.

name: Simian Spirit Guide
text:
"All my spells smell like burnt hair lately."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Skirk Shaman
text: In a shaman's grimy hands, a concoction of dried Skirk Ridge herbs can become the face of panic.

name: Citanul Woodreaders
text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

name: Retether
text: The rifts reach into infinite time streams, bringing the divergent products of alternate pasts into the present.

name: Jedit Ojanen of Efrava
text: The cat warriors recognized this Jedit's face, but not his fierce loyalty to Efrava.

name: Kavu Predator
text: In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.

name: Life and Limb
text:
"It was a sight of pain and awe—a twisted forest, migrating across the salt plain in search of richer soil."
—Edahlis, greenseeker

name: Magus of the Library
text: The ancient books slowly crumbled, their secrets turning to dust. But their every word sings within the magus's head.

name: Mire Boa
text: Mire slime courses through its veins in place of blood. No sooner does it bleed than it opens its mouth to replace the loss.

name: Reflex Sliver
text:
"This sliver comes into the world a perfect predator. It's ready to hunt and devour its first meal within seconds of hatching."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Sophic Centaur
text: He endures the pain of remembering Krosa as it once was and hopes that a future generation will have need of his memories.

name: Timbermare
text: Only nature wreaks such lovely havoc.

name: Utopia Vow
text: "I'll guard this fruit and its seedling until the land is healed. My life now belongs to Dominaria."

name: Essence Warden
text:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Fa'adiyah Seer
text: "My visions don't show me home. They show me where home is yet to be found."

name: Gaea's Anthem
text:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Groundbreaker
text: The earth's memory is long, its retribution brief.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Saltblast
text: Dominaria erodes with each passing gust.

name: Healing Leaves
text: The elves of Llanowar don't trust in alchemy. They rely instead on pure herbs harvested from the forest's sacred heart.

name: Hedge Troll
text: His abode was clean and bare, not a morsel in sight. I asked him what he ate, fearing the answer. He smiled and said his faith alone sustained him.

name: Keen Sense
text: Crovax sensed that Mirri wasn't ready for the curse taking hold of her. Weeping in his heart, he fled.

name: Seal of Primordium
text:
"I am the simplifier, the root that drags all artifice to earth."
—Seal inscription

name: Darkheart Sliver
text:
"At first we thought we were in some haunted wood. Then the branches twisted and scuttled toward us."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Dormant Sliver
text:
"It triggers the hive's period of Ætheric fertility—a time when even feeding is a lower priority than reproduction."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Saltfield Recluse
text: He remembers a past of light and healing. But he lives the bitter present—parching salt, scouring wind, and the withering heat of the desert.

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Run home, cur. I've already taken your master's head. Don't make me thrash you with it."

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Serra's Boon
text:
"The light of an angel's glance is warm, but her fixed stare blinds and burns."
—Calexis, deacon of the New Order of Serra

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Malach of the Dawn
text:
"The sun rises, but the world still feels dark. Pray for the arrival of the malachim—they'll bring Dawn to the world and to our hearts."
—Sister Betje, *Miracles of the Saints*

name: Mana Tithe
text:
"Those who seek to upset the balance must be taxed for such ambitions."
—Verithain, mesa high priest

name: Mesa Enchantress
text: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

name: Revered Dead
text:
"The mists coalesced into silent warriors. We charged them and broke through their lines, only to see them swirl and re-form behind us."
—Golas Mahr, black knight

name: Crovax, Ascendant Hero
text: Crovax was destined for an angel's curse, but one warped timeline saw the noble redeemed.

name: Sinew Sliver
text: As the muscle cords of the creature twitched, Hanna saw an unsettling unanimity in the others' rippling flesh. She didn't know what it meant, but she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Auramancer's Guise
text: "Consider not what the mask hides, but what it can reveal."

name: Body Double
text: Where the dead outnumbered the living, mimics scavenged faces from the fallen.

name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
text: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

name: Dismal Failure
text:
"Two magi could trade spells all day and never crown a victor. The real battle is not one of power but of will. If your confidence breaks, so too shall you."
—Venser

name: Dreamscape Artist
text: He's mastered the art of sleight of land.

name: Magus of the Bazaar
text: "Some trade in goods, some in secrets. My soul has walked the futures, and I offer the rare coin of possibility."

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Synchronous Sliver
text:
"With a twitch of its muscles, its timeline forks. Then, just as quickly, its two selves reintegrate. Causality, strangely, seems not to mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Venarian Glimmer
text: Dream of nothing, and wake to a dream come true.

name: Wistful Thinking
text: "To probe the wonders of the multiverse, to gaze upon worlds unspoiled by blade or spell . . . it's enough to make one weep for the possibilities denied."

name: Frozen Aether
text: Gjornersen entertained his followers by taking bets on which would move first—the drowsing land wurm or the frozen goblins.

name: Gossamer Phantasm
text:
"Belief matters more than truth. Every moment, belief in imaginary things alters lives while truth sits unnoticed and waits."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Merfolk Thaumaturgist
text:
"Blasted fishtails! It's not enough that they meddle with my head, but they twist my body as well."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Ovinize
text:
"You wish for me to cow your enemies? I can do better than that . . . ."
—Teferi, second-level student

name: Primal Plasma
text: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

name: Ghost Tactician
text: Its ethereal hand confers a lifetime of experience with combat and steel.

name: Serendib Sorcerer
text: "Even a dragon is humble as a kitten if it thinks itself a slave."

name: Serra Sphinx
text: Sphinxes drink from the mystic meres of Serra's realm, where their keen eyes watch reflections of what is and what is yet to come.

name: Blightspeaker
text: One croaked sermon spreads propaganda and plague.

name: Brain Gorgers
text: In spite of their hunger, they're slow eaters.

name: Cradle to Grave
text:
"As the fell soil's appetite grows, it gulps down passersby upon their first footfall."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Dash Hopes
text:
"Focus an enemy's mind on what's already gone, and it's easier to take away more."
—Holux, stronghold racketeer

name: Imp's Mischief
text:
"Do the innocent pay for the crimes of the guilty? Of course they do. That's the fate of the weak."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Magus of the Coffers
text: All that remains of the Cabal are the echoes in its deepest vault. Yet those who hear the echoes feel a power undiminished by the dust of ages.

name: Mirri the Cursed
text: A hero fails, a martyr falls. Time twists and destinies interchange.

name: Ridged Kusite
text:
"It offers but a taste of the power that the shadows have to offer. But even that is a heady wine indeed."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Magus of the Tabernacle
text: The Tabernacle's disciples channel the emanations from Pendrell Vale, spreading its paradoxical demand to be both worshipped and left alone.

name: Spitting Sliver
text:
"Our lances' reach had been our saving grace in our fight against the hive. Now even that advantage is taken from us."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish knight

name: Temporal Extortion
text:
"The scythe of time or my blade at your throat—the choice is yours."
—Holux, stronghold racketeer

name: Bog Serpent
text:
"We thought it was a fallen tree trunk. Then it ate Snod."
—Sneed, goblin barkwright

name: Dunerider Outlaw
text: Tales of the outlaw's cruelty and might grew more embellished with each crime.

name: Kor Dirge
text: Rath's new evincar eliminated the brutish moggs and took a new slave race, one more reminiscent of her own feline grace.

name: Null Profusion
text:
"Some say that time is cyclical and that history inevitably repeats. My will is my own. I won't bow to fate."
—Volrath

name: Rathi Trapper
text: Tangling vines, fetid murk, paralyzing poisons, and crawling dead. The swamp is nature's trap waiting to be exploited by unnatural minds.

name: Vampiric Link
text: The familiar's fangs deliver the master's bite.

name: Battering Sliver
text: Covered with hard shell-like plates, these slivers burrow through solid rock to carve out new nests for their hives.

name: Dust Corona
text:
"They infiltrated deep into the enemy camp under cover of darkness . . . and dirt."
—Corus, viashino warrior

name: Fatal Frenzy
text:
"I hope to have such a death—lying in triumph upon the broken bodies of those who slew me."
—Radha, Keldon warlord

name: Firefright Mage
text: After millennia of advancement in goblin military theory, Toggo VI realized that almost everyone is afraid of fire.

name: Reliquary Tower
text:
"The tower isn't the structure itself. It is all of us, and the wisdom we share. It grows ever upward, a stone for every new arrival."
—Archmage Vintra

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Thought Vessel
text: Unlimited potential needs only a spark of ambition.

name: Sheoldred's Edict
text: 「おめでとう。楽しませてもらったよ。」

name: Incinerate
text:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

name: Aura Blast
text: "None of your history books mention me?" laughed Daria. "They will now."

name: Daring Leap
