text: Most warriors think in only two dimensions. Agnate and his metathran brethren were trained to battle in three.

name: Destructive Flow
text: Stage two of the Phyrexian invasion included the complete alteration of Dominaria's landscape.

name: Dralnu's Crusade
text:
"Don't you agree that mogg intellects are improved by zombification?"
—Lord Dralnu

name: Eladamri's Call
text: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

name: Ertai, the Corrupted
text: Altered by Phyrexian science, corrupted by black mana, and twisted by rage, Ertai still looked in the mirror and saw only glory.

name: Ertai, the Corrupted
text: Altered by Phyrexian science, corrupted by black mana, and twisted by rage, Ertai still looked in the mirror and saw only glory.

name: Gerrard's Command
text: "Unless you like the idea of becoming some goblin's lunch, get up and move!"

name: Horned Kavu
text: "That didn't happen naturally," said Multani. "Rath's overlay is interfering with the Æther itself."

name: Hull Breach
text: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

name: Malicious Advice
text:
"Rule through fear, Darigaaz. Only if the dragons feel terror will they truly be your servants."
—Tevesh Szat

name: Meddling Mage
text: Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.

name: Phyrexian Tyranny
text:
"He is Yawgmoth's reward to me. I shall kill him a hundred times a day."
—Crovax, to Ertai

name: Planeswalker's Mirth
text:
"I enjoy a good joke as much as the next guy."
—Commodore Guff

name: Radiant Kavu
text: When angered or frightened, it protects itself with a burst of blinding light.

name: Terminate
text: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

name: Urza's Guilt
text: Deep in Yawgmoth's realm, Urza stopped dead in his tracks and rubbed his soot-filled eyes. "Mishra?"

name: Mana Cylix
text: Overflowing with visions of the possible future, it lends power to those in the present.

name: Star Compass
text: It doesn't point north. It points home.

name: Stratadon
text: Designed like the gargadons of Keld—big and brutal.

name: Meteor Crater
text: Legend has it that meteor craters are haunted by the ghosts of those who died on impact.

name: Sunscape Familiar
text: The spirits of fallen battlemages can serve their guilds as familiars by joining with any physical form.

name: Aurora Griffin
text: Though a fierce fighter, its true value is that it inspires beleaguered forces.

name: Allied Strategies
text: Each commander looked at the others and wondered who would be first to break the alliance.

name: Confound
text: "Did I know Szat would betray us?" Urza asked quizzically. "I was counting on it."

name: Ertai's Trickery
text: "Don't worry, Gerrard," said Ertai. "I'm sure the crew will come to your rescue as quickly as they came to mine."

name: Escape Routes
text:
"I'll get you to safety—or whatever passes for safety these days."
—Urborg ferry pilot

name: Gainsay
text:
"I'd be happy to stop contradicting you, Urza, just as soon as you start being right."
—Bo Levar, planeswalker

name: Hunting Drake
text: Even the fiercest beast will flee when faced with the possibility of becoming dinner.

name: Planar Overlay
text: The Phyrexians don't want to conquer Dominaria. They want to remake it.

name: Disciple of Kangee
text: When no birds are available, Kangee's disciples fill the sky with anything that's willing to fight.

name: Sea Snidd
text: It always has the home-turf advantage.

name: Shifting Sky
text:
Master the sky and you rule everything beneath it.
—Metathran saying

name: Stormscape Familiar
text: Each Stormscape apprentice must hand-raise and train an owl before attaining the rank of master.

name: Sunken Hope
text: While Dominarians fought for their world, Rath stole it from under their feet.

name: Dark Suspicions
text:
"After four thousand years, you learn to plan for betrayal."
—Urza

name: Death Bomb
text: There's no higher honor in Phyrexia than dying for Yawgmoth's glorious vision.

name: Exotic Disease
text:
"Do not fear death. I shall release you from the eternal bonds and bring you glory."
—Lord Dralnu

name: Lord of the Undead
text:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

name: Maggot Carrier
text:
"The mere sight of our undead allies sickens me. What unholy bargain have you struck?"
—Grizzlegom, to Agnate

name: Morgue Toad
text:
"The toads of Urborg aren't fast, powerful, or pleasant, but they have their uses."
—Ertai

name: Nightscape Familiar
text: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

name: Noxious Vapors
text: Urborg would just as soon steal your memories as your life.

name: Guard Dogs
text:
"A good guard is alert. A great guard is also loyal."
—Benalish kennelmaster

name: Phyrexian Bloodstock
text: It reeks of terror and chaos.

name: Shriek of Dread
text: When Crosis roared, the battle ended and the slaughter began.

name: Sinister Strength
text:
"I bless the living with a song of death."
—Lord Dralnu

name: Slay
text: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

name: Volcano Imp
text: Its claws cut faster than a flame flickers.

name: Warped Devotion
text:
"Before the glory of Yawgmoth, yes, even this makes sense."
—Urza, to Gerrard

name: Caldera Kavu
text: As powerful and malleable as the molten rock it calls home.

name: Deadapult
text:
"Nothing ruins your day like a blazing zombie."
—Tahngarth

name: Heroic Defiance
text:
"Wear courage as your armor. Wield honor as your blade."
—Gerrard

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Implode
text: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

name: Insolence
text:
"Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here."
—Darigaaz, to Rith

name: Kavu Recluse
text: Few ever see this particular breed of kavu, which hides in forests of its own making.

name: Mire Kavu
text: "At this rate," said Sisay, "the next kavu we see will have wings."

name: Mogg Jailer
text:
Hey, wake up!
—Mogg secret password

name: Mogg Sentry
text:
"Nobody stands in one place better than a mogg."
—Tahngarth

name: Singe
text: Burnt flesh. Blackened soul.

name: Slingshot Goblin
text: It's most effective when it doesn't eat the ammunition.

name: Strafe
text:
"All right, let's light 'em up!"
—Gerrard

name: Thunderscape Familiar
text: Thunderscape masters release familiars to help guide their apprentices down the thunderscape path.

name: Alpha Kavu
text: Kavu leaders instinctively protect their herds from harm.

name: Amphibious Kavu
text: Merfolk raided the shores untroubled for years . . . until the shores started fighting back.

name: Honorable Scout
text: "I've faced your kind before. This time I'm ready for you."

name: Gaea's Herald
text: "I bring word from Gaea. Fight on! She will never allow her children to die alone."

name: Gaea's Might
text: With the Heart of Yavimaya aiding him, Multani didn't even strain at the load.

name: Mirrorwood Treefolk
text: It doesn't need a bite. The bark works just fine.

name: Multani's Harmony
text: "Welcome to paradise."

name: Planeswalker's Favor
text: Freyalise strengthens her faithful.

name: Pygmy Kavu
text: "We could learn a lot by watching the little ones," said Agnate. "Define 'little,'" replied Grizzlegom.

name: Quirion Dryad
text:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Quirion Explorer
text:
Fight with a friend at your back, steel in your hands, and magic in your veins.
—Quirion creed

name: Root Greevil
text: The root of all greevils.

name: Skyshroud Blessing
text: "Behold," said Freyalise to Eladamri. "Your Skyshroud home has followed you to Dominaria."

name: Stone Kavu
text: To maintain its hide, it consumes a variety of rocks—not to mention a variety of Phyrexians.

name: Thornscape Familiar
text: Blessed with many options, Thornscape masters favor scarabs as familiars.

name: Ancient Spider
text: It outlived both king and castle.

name: Graveborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: No Rest for the Wicked
text:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: High Ground
text: In war, as in society, position is everything.

name: Orcish Artillery
text:
"So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game."
—General Khurzog

name: Shatterstorm
text: From a marvel of magical mechanization to a smoking stack of scrap in one easy step.

name: Hurricane
text:
"Don't envy the grandeur of drakes. Their impression of grace fades when the first gust sends them crashing into one another."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Rhox
text: It's as solid as the club in its hand—and about as subtle.

name: Nomad Mythmaker
text: On the wild steppes, history vanishes in the dust. Only the mythmakers remain to say what was, and is, and will be.

name: Doubling Cube
text: The cube's surface is pockmarked with jagged runes that seem to shift when unobserved.

name: Spellbook
text:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Treasure Hunter
text: "The treasures of the ancients belong in museums, not in the grubby hands of grave robbers."

name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
text: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

name: Dockside Extortionist
text: "It's just business."

name: Annoyed Altisaur
text: It pairs a long neck with a short temper.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Body Double
text: "I am who I pretend to be."

name: Carrier Thrall
text:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Boon Reflection
text: Twice brewed and twice blessed, the remedy restores both body and mind.

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Gelatinous Genesis
text: Even as the world was left cracked and gory by the marauding Eldrazi, new life began to drip from its wounds.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Rhys the Redeemed
text: Whole again in honor and horn.

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Academy Ruins
text: Its secrets once wrought the greatest artifice ever known. Now crabs loot the rubble to decorate their shells.

name: Buried Ruin
text: History has buried its treasures deep.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Stonehewer Giant
text: "No matter how strong, an unarmed fighter is no more than a fool."

name: Wooded Bastion
text: The elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood continually expand the palisade surrounding the sanctuary. They hope to one day enclose the entire forest within its walls.

name: Frogify
text: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.

name: Reshape
text:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Serra Sphinx
text: Sphinxes drink from the mystic meres of Serra's realm, where their keen eyes watch reflections of what is and what is yet to come.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Lantern of Insight
text: Each eye sees a different possibility for tomorrow.

name: Vedalken Orrery
text: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Thought Courier
text: It is telling of the vedalkens' culture that they trust human couriers more than their own comrades.

name: Vedalken Mastermind
text: The vedalken see other beings from a cold distance, as either experimental subjects or objects of study.

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Vulshok Sorcerer
text: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Arcane Laboratory
text:
Too many wizards spoil the spell, but too many spells spoil the wizard.
—Sign on entry to arcane lab

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Fungusaur
text: Rather than sheltering her young, the female fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

name: Fyndhorn Elder
text: "It is useful to be able to speak to the trees. But it is truly wondrous to be able to listen to them."

name: Maro
text: No two see the same Maro.

name: Elfhame Palace
text: The elfhames are the closest thing to "civilization" the elves allow themselves.

name: Curiosity
text: "You know that secret? The one that wakes you up at night in a cold sweat? The one you think no one else in the world knows? Well, guess what."

name: Intruder Alarm
text: One footstep among many is silent. One footstep alone is deafening.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Phyrexian Obliterator
text:
"Behold blessed perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Vampire Lacerator
text: The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
text:
"On dark nights you can still see the light of the Vess girl's lantern out in the Caligo, seeking her lost brother. Those who follow are doomed to join her endless search."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Balduvian Horde
text:
"We earn no medals and fight for no titles. Blood is proof of our victory."
—Lovisa Coldeyes

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Hordeling Outburst
text:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

name: Jackal Pup
text: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Pillage
text:
"The embers of our homes still smolder, and already the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation. What they have started, we will finish."
—Lovisa Coldeyes

name: Geist of the Moors
text:
"The battle is won. There's work to be done. / The Blessed Sleep must wait. / A fiend is about. It stalks the devout. / I'll save them from my fate."
—"The Good Geist's Vow"

name: Spikeshot Goblin
text:
"Proximity discouraged. Do not approach."
—Vulshok field guide

name: Uncaged Fury
text:
"It's right to fear those that you keep locked away."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
text: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Ambassador Oak
text: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

name: Ember Weaver
text:
"Each night, the sun unravels and blows away. Each day, the spiders set a new one in the sky."
—Sunseeder myth

name: Kavu Climber
text:
The kavu might be above you
—Llanowar expression meaning "keep an open mind"

name: Nettle Sentinel
text: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Knight of the Skyward Eye
text: The Order of the Skyward Eye does the bidding of an evil force, unwittingly stirring fear and mistrust across Bant in accordance with his plans.

name: Baloth Null
text:
"Humans use pigs to hunt for mushrooms, don't they? It's like that."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

name: Blightning
text: While the smell of burning flesh is common in Grixis, the odor of smoldering brain matter is a rare treat.

name: Nicol Bolas
text: Dominaria's most ancient evil.

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Pernicious Deed
text: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

name: Pillory of the Sleepless
text: Which is worse—the sleep which never ends or that which never comes?

name: Loyal Sentry
text: His watch ends only when he does.

name: Perilous Myr
text: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Lunarch Mantle
text:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
text: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

name: Path of Peace
text: As Hedrax stepped into oblivion, he welcomed the unwavering silence.

name: Promise of Bunrei
text: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

name: Renewed Faith
text: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Blue Elemental Blast
text: Nothing escapes a sharp mind.

name: Borrowing 100,000 Arrows
text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Curiosity
text: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

name: Ghost Ship
text: Going down with the ship is just the beginning.

name: Horseshoe Crab
text: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

name: Jalira, Master Polymorphist
text: "You can become anything if I just put my mind to it."

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Murder of Crows
text: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
text: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Phantasmal Bear
text:
"You know it to be false, but when its claws find you, what you know won't matter much at all."
—Pol Jamaar, illusionist

name: Cloudshift
text:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

name: Retraction Helix
text: Where the geometries of the world collapse, a master of the aether can harvest power beyond comprehending.

name: Caustic Tar
text: The spite of the Cabal turns meadow into mire.

name: Erg Raiders
text: Their skills are extensive, and their appetite for battle just as vast.

name: Fallen Angel
text: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

name: Hell's Caretaker
text: "The rules are clear. If you want to leave, you need only convince another to take your place."

name: Ihsan's Shade
text: No mortal could atone for Ihsan's betrayal. Redemption required him to become something else.

name: Caught in the Brights
text: While hunting aether, a gremlin may ignore other stimuli, including threats to its own life.

name: Sweatworks Brawler
text: The residents of Embraal were never known for finesse, just for getting things done.

name: Greenbelt Rampager
text: Subtlety is not a necessary part of sabotage.

name: Conviction
text: "There is no greater coward than one who believes in nothing."

name: Silkweaver Elite
text: Elvish weavers use spidersilk to make everything from tapestries to rappelling ropes.

name: Countless Gears Renegade
text: "Go forth and cause trouble, my little one!"

name: Consulate Dreadnought
text:
"It's like they planted another Bastion right in the middle of the harbor."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

name: Crackdown Construct
text:
"All buildings are subject to search. Resistance will be punished."
—Enforcer-Chief Ranaj

name: Hope of Ghirapur
text: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

name: Decommission
text: "A key weakness in the design is its vulnerability to repeated, forceful blows."

name: Irontread Crusher
text: "We've been through a lot together."

name: Renegade Map
text: "We have safe houses in every zone, but you'll never find one without this."

name: Universal Solvent
text:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

name: Felidar Guardian
text: The loyalty of a felidar is hard won but worth the effort.

name: Tezzeret's Betrayal
text:
"You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion."
—Tezzeret

name: Restoration Specialist
text: Dwarves' tools are priceless heirlooms handed down through generations.

name: Bastion Inventor
text: "This armor transcends the limitations of mere flesh and bone."

name: Dispersal Technician
text: As renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire, Consulate blockades failed one by one.

name: Hinterland Drake
text:
"As a kid, I dreamed of flying on those wild drakes. They inspired me to build wings of my own."
—Nadja Cloudtoucher, aerowright

name: Mechanized Production
text:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

name: Metallic Rebuke
text:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

name: Wind-Kin Raiders
text: Small aeronaut societies like the Wind-Kin had little to lose by siding with the renegades, and much to gain.

name: Alley Strangler
text: "You never know what day might be your last."

name: Daring Demolition
text: Living so close to death gives the aetherborn an unusual perspective on risk.

name: Fen Hauler
text:
"Success is found where others fear to look."
—Ara, renegade smuggler

name: Alley Evasion
text: "Sure, you know the law. But I know the streets."

name: Gifted Aetherborn
text: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

name: Renegade's Getaway
text: You can't fight what you can't find.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Chandra's Revolution
text: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.

name: Destructive Tampering
text:
"I don't think they'll appreciate my . . . adjustments."
—Karavin, renegade saboteur

name: Frontline Rebel
text: "Will you be strong and stand with me?"

name: Invigorated Rampage
text: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
text: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

name: Release the Gremlins
text:
"Being an inventor means knowing how to use the tools at hand to make something great—or to bring it down."
—Pia Nalaar

name: Siege Modification
text: Perfect for getting through to the consuls.

name: Demanding Dragon
text: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Bucknard's Everfull Purse
text: As long as it's never left empty, this magic pouch produces coins every dawn.

name: Feign Death
text: A drastic measure for dangerous times.

name: Grim Bounty
text: Freed from the need to pay tribute to the dragon, the villages gladly paid the dragon-slayers instead.

name: Power Word Kill
text: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.

name: Skullport Merchant
text: "Buy something or get out."

name: Boots of Speed
text: Click your heels and become the wind.

name: Magic Missile
text: A tried-and-true favorite of many wizards, whatever their school.

name: Rust Monster
text:
"They don't seem scary, but then you're suddenly standing there in your underclothes without a weapon. Then everything looks like a threat."
—Jarro, battle master

name: Unexpected Windfall
text: Fortune favors the fortunate.

name: Xorn
text: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.

name: You See a Pair of Goblins
text:
"I have the shot. Shall I take it?"
—Varis, Silverymoon ranger

name: Old Gnawbone
text: The ancient green dragon Claugiyliamatar is often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.

name: The Tarrasque
text: When it rises, nations fall.

name: Bruenor Battlehammer
text: "Knew I'd find ye in trouble if I came out an' looked for ye!"

name: Loyal Warhound
text: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.

name: Tiamat
text: "My children will rule over all!"

name: Leather Armor
text: Lightweight, flexible, and protective.

name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
text: Selûne guides her devotees with majestic wisdom and grace.

name: Treasure Vault
text: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

name: Portable Hole
text: "They fall for it every time."

name: Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar
text: "You studied hard. How delicious!"

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
text: The raging behir reared back, opened its terrible maw . . . and collapsed in a fit of horrifying giggles.

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Miasmic Mummy
text: Its breath doesn't assault the senses. It pollutes the mind.

name: Painful Lesson
text:
"You wish to remember this lesson? I will write it down for you."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Scarab Feast
text:
"The face of mediocrity is wrapped in anointed linen. Aspire to a better end."
—Epnokep, vizier of Bontu

name: Djeru's Resolve
text: "When I wish to be strong, I train. When I wish to be wise, I study. When I wish to rest, I start again."

name: Trespasser's Curse
text: Even in the relative safety of the city, there are places best left undisturbed.

name: Unburden
text:
"Ambition requires clarity. If you have any doubts, they must be abandoned."
—Bontu, god of ambition

name: Wander in Death
text: Forever restless. Forever growing in number.

name: Ahn-Crop Crasher
text:
"Hesitation breeds dissension. To be worthy of the next life, you must never look back."
—Anep, vizier of Hazoret

name: Blazing Volley
text: The arrows fell like fiery rain, and for a moment, the sky itself seemed to burn.

name: Bloodlust Inciter
text: "To victory! To glory! To eternity!"

name: By Force
text:
"Dissent? Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Cartouche of Zeal
text: The fifth cartouche is the final affirmation of glory, granted only to the worthy dead.

name: Desert Cerodon
text: The endless expanse of desert surrounding Naktamun sometimes yields threats that the gods themselves must answer.

name: Forsake the Worldly
text: "Why cling to these trappings? They are but tools and affectations. True wealth can be possessed only in the afterlife."

name: Fling
text: Never flinch. Never falter. Never fear.

name: Hyena Pack
text: With carrion a rarity in the Broken Lands, the hyenas that stalk the deserts hunt in packs.

name: Magma Spray
text:
"Ashes can't be embalmed."
—Neheb, initiate of Ahn crop

name: Nimble-Blade Khenra
text:
"In the Hour of Glory, the gods and the untested will prove their worth before the God-Pharaoh."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Thresher Lizard
text: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

name: Bitterblade Warrior
text: "The vizier of poisons teaches an unconventional kind of strength."

name: Dissenter's Deliverance
text:
"When all doubts have melted away, the worthy will meet the Hour of Eternity and earn a place at the God-Pharaoh's side."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Giant Spider
text: The Broken Lands are littered with the remnants of civilizations long dead and infested by terrors very much alive.

name: Greater Sandwurm
text: A sandwurm can lie in wait beneath the sands for years until the slightest tremor alerts it to the presence of prey.

name: Gust Walker
text: "I'm never unarmed."

name: Hooded Brawler
text: Nagas wielding twin daggers excel at the fighting technique known as the Bite of Rhonas.

name: Manglehorn
text:
"Rely too much on your weapons and watch your dreams shatter in your hands."
—Rhonas, god of strength

name: Pouncing Cheetah
text: Rhonas's monument is home to a wider variety of creatures than anywhere else in the city of Naktamun—a feature most initiates fail to appreciate.

name: Stinging Shot
text: Initiates must train to resist the natural toxins they use as weapons.

name: Anointed Procession
text:
"The gods here may walk among the people, but they are not with them."
—Gideon Jura

name: Oketra's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

name: Rhonas's Monument
text:
"The worthy shall hone a strong body to endure the boundless energies of the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

name: Regal Caracal
text: Oketra's closest viziers are known as her chosen, though others may have a better claim to that moniker.

name: Painted Bluffs
text: Centuries of scouring sands have carved and polished the rocky terrain of the Shefet.

name: Rhet-Crop Spearmaster
text: "In the afterlife, I'll have no need of sleep. And until then, I have no time for it!"

name: Seraph of the Suns
text:
"Angels? My feelings remain unchanged."
—Liliana Vess

name: Sparring Mummy
text: Aspiring to earn their place in the afterlife, acolytes train every day against those who fell short of that glory.

name: Vizier of Remedies
text: "You'll need all your strength for the trials to come."

name: Winged Shepherd
text:
"When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma, for its protection will be needed no longer."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

name: Cartouche of Knowledge
text: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

name: Compelling Argument
text:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

name: Decision Paralysis
text:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
text: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

name: Lay Claim
text: Initiates need worry only about the trials. Everything else is in the hands of the gods.

name: River Serpent
text: Though the Luxa River brings life to Naktamun, it's not without dangers.

name: Shimmerscale Drake
text: They are drawn by the brilliant blue glint of the mineral lazotep from the mines below.

name: Slither Blade
text: Some naga initiates move as silently the suns' reflections on the water.

name: Baleful Ammit
text:
"Not all in our crop deserve the afterlife. We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

name: Blighted Bat
text: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

name: Bone Picker
text: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

name: Cursed Minotaur
text:
"Look! That is why we must never waver. That is what awaits us if we fail."
—Djeru, initiate of Tah crop

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: There is only one fate left to those banished from the God-Pharaoh's city.

name: Dune Beetle
text: The scouring sands of Shefet polish its carapace, and the ranks of the cursed fill its belly.

name: Final Reward
text: Those who earn a glorious death are given the highest honor. They are carried on funeral barges through the gate to the afterlife.

name: Grim Strider
text:
"As a child I saw something walking in the distance, far beyond the Hekma—shadow-dark, and taller than the gods. Even now, it passes through my dreams."
—Pytamun, initiate of Nef crop

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Drumhunter
text: "I feel the vine-rhythm as my friends drive the beast to me. I will not miss my mark."

name: Invincible Hymn
text: Bantians believe those who are born into the highest caste and live a life of discipline and virtue can ascend to become angels.

name: Wild Nacatl
text: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

name: Knight-Captain of Eos
text: The strength of Bant's caste system is the unfailing loyalty of its meekest members.

name: Godsire
text:
"Lay sacrifice to the godsire that it may spare us, but save some for his progeny who also will hunger."
—Syeena, elvish godtoucher

name: Hellkite Overlord
text:
"The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization—just hunger, heat, and need."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Qasali Ambusher
text: The surprise of a battle cry can be as deadly as a blade.

name: Sedris, the Traitor King
text: He bids his minions rise from their graves to their knees.

name: Violent Ultimatum
text:
"Words are a waste of time. Destruction is a language everyone understands."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Ranger of Eos
text: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

name: Lich's Mirror
text: It shows not what you are but what you were.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Mindlock Orb
text: Rogue mechanists once rummaged through the wastes of the Tidehollow, constructing unauthorized golems to threaten the hegemony of the sphinxes. The orbs put a stop to that.

name: Puppet Conjurer
text: He scowls at his imperfect creation, then crushes it to scrap. He salvages the etherium and begins anew.

name: Powerstone Minefield
text:
"We have fought this far and lost too much. We will not turn back."
—Grizzlegom

name: Putrid Warrior
text: "I do not like it," said Grizzlegom, "but I will take every soldier I can get."

name: Quicksilver Dagger
text: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

name: Razorfin Hunter
text: No one knew if they'd been lurking under the sea all along, or if they'd been created by the Phyrexian overlay.

name: Temporal Spring
text: One splash of the spring's water knocks you clear into last week.

name: Standard Bearer
text: The standard was a rallying point for the army and a target for the enemy.

name: Ice Cave
text: Even the oppressive cold of the cave could not temper Eladamri's ire.

name: Phyrexian Gargantua
text: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

name: Diversionary Tactics
text: "It's the oldest trick in the book," said Guff. "And I ought to know—I wrote it."

name: Penumbra Kavu
text:
"These kavu are so stubborn they even refuse to die."
—Tahngarth

name: Sen Triplets
text: They are the masters of your mind.

name: Wargate
text: Bant mages still call to the heavens for aid, but angels are not the only ones who answer.

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Wall of Denial
text: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

name: Architects of Will
text: This secret society of mages manipulates the beliefs and opinions of others.

name: Nemesis of Reason
text: Words describing it fail. Pages relating it shrivel. Tales recounting it end.

name: Time Sieve
text:
"I pray that I am never considered useless or old."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Filigree Angel
text: "I craved enlightenment, and Crucius's etherium opened my eyes. I would share my sight with you, but first you must believe."

name: Enlisted Wurm
text: A match for any army—even its own.

name: Grizzled Leotau
text:
"Não há nenhuma glória em morrer de velhice, como até mesmo os leotaus sabem. Quando o inverno penetra sua couraça, eles buscam as terras mais perigosas para poder morrer do mesmo modo que viveram."
—Aarsil, a Abençoada

name: Meddling Mage
text: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."

name: Spellbound Dragon
text: A king in Jund, a serf in Esper.

name: Battle Hymn
text:
"A church is just wood and walls. A congregation is the faithful praising the angels."
—Kolman, elder of Gatstaf

name: Dual Casting
text: Hours after the Helvault opened, his powers returned twice as strong as before.

name: Malignus
text: It descended on Estwald like a sudden storm. Moments later, only ashes and agony remained.

name: Reforge the Soul
text: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Alchemist's Refuge
text: Persecuted alchemists fled deep into Kessig's wilds, seeking solitude to continue their ghoulish craft.

name: Seraph of Dawn
text: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

name: Misthollow Griffin
text: For some creatures, existing is only a whim.

name: Royal Trooper
text: "Loyalty guides me. Pride compels me. Anger sustains me. And the pay isn't bad."

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
text:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

name: Silverchase Fox
text:
"Be careful in your hunt. The clever little creature can steal your wards and lead you right into the werewolf's den."
—Britta, midwife of Gatstaf

name: Tandem Tactics
text: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

name: Benthic Giant
text:
"Some fates you can see coming for you, plain as day, and there's nothing you can do about them."
—Callaphe the mariner

name: Call to Heel
text: On Bant, a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty. The one who bears it may be called to fulfill that charge at any moment.

name: Coralhelm Guide
text:
"She knows every step of this coastline, both above and below the surface, and she has hideouts all along the way. She will get you there."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Fog Bank
text:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

name: Frost Lynx
text: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

name: Impulse
text: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Watercourser
text:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

name: Painful Lesson
text:
"You wish to remember this lesson? I will write it down for you."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Battle Rampart
text:
"I will build no sanctuaries. The safety you seek can be won only by the sword."
—Yannash, outpost builder

name: Earth Elemental
text: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

name: Enthralling Victor
text: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

name: Expedite
text: "I run, and thunder follows."

name: Flamewave Invoker
text: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

name: Lightning Talons
text:
"The victim was either clawed to death or struck by lightning. Possibly both."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Canopy Spider
text: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

name: Charging Rhino
text: The knights of Troinir Keep took the rhino as their emblem due to its intense focus when charging down a perceived threat—a trait they discovered on a hunting excursion.

name: Elvish Visionary
text: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

name: Feral Hydra
text: It shreds its prey as each head fights for the choicest bits.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"The prohibition of unnecessary tossing of the citizenry by giants shall also extend to spontaneous giants."
—Isperia's Edict, provision VII.789.2

name: Kraul Warrior
text: The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.

name: Lead by Example
text: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

name: Return to the Earth
text:
"Dragons are feared for their breath and their bite, but it is their wings that make them unconquerable. Bring them to earth, and they die like any other beast."
—Kassur, Sultai hunter

name: Kiss of the Amesha
text: Once a year, Akrasa holds a joust that draws knights and their leotaus from every nation on Bant. The prize is an Akrasan sigil, but the true reward is the angel's kiss.

name: Riptide Crab
text: It sleeps with its claws open.

name: Hexplate Golem
text:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Juggernaut
text: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Yotian Soldier
text: Poets dream the verses of otherworldly stories. Artificers dream the blueprints of otherplanar artifacts.

name: Jubilant Mascot
text: The competition is but one aspect of the spectacle.

name: Fumble
text: A moment of distraction, a lifetime of regret.

name: Game Plan
text: Plan for victory, or prepare for defeat.

name: Out of Bounds
text: The wardens watch for illegal tactics and protect spectators from the occasional rogue fireball.

name: Azra Bladeseeker
text: "Never get too attached to a weapon. You must allow a better one to find its way to you."

name: Bonus Round
text: When the twin-spell bonus round begins, the crowd rises to its feet in anticipation of incredible combinations.

name: Cheering Fanatic
text: "Punch 'em, kick 'em, bite 'em, beat 'em! Burn 'em all and we'll defeat 'em!"

name: Bramble Sovereign
text: "Within this grove, you belong to me."

name: Combo Attack
text: Success at Valor's Reach requires not only individual skill but also the ability to merge that skill with a partner's.

name: Jungle Wayfinder
text: She is adept at navigating the stadium's ever-changing landscape.

name: Azra Oddsmaker
text: "I never give odds on my own fights. Unless, of course, you want to bet *against* me . . ."

name: Bountiful Promenade
text: No pilgrimage to Valor's Reach is complete without a stroll through its celebrated shopping district.

name: Sea of Clouds
text: Skybridges from across Kylem converge at the grand stadium of Valor's Reach.

name: Angelic Chorus
text: The harmony of the glorious is a dirge to the wicked.

name: Battle Mastery
text:
"There is elegance in all the Ojutai do—even their killing."
—Kirada, Silumgar enforcer

name: Lightwalker
text:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Midnight Guard
text:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

name: Demon's Grasp
text:
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Kalastria Nightwatch
text:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Nirkana Assassin
text: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

name: Voracious Null
text:
"These days, there's no shortage of food for the nulls of Guul Draz."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Goblin War Paint
text:
"The Eldrazi may not be intimidated, but if it boosts the goblins' confidence, I see no reason to discourage it."
—Jalun, Affa sentry

name: Makindi Sliderunner
text: After a battle, it breaks the hillsides into manageable pieces to prepare for next time.

name: Ondu Champion
text:
"Put a minotaur at the head of an army and suddenly all the soldiers act like they have horns."
—Gideon Jura

name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
text: A force as voracious as time itself.

name: Outnumber
text: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

name: Rolling Thunder
text:
"Zendikar is always angry, though I've never seen that anger so precisely directed."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Valakut Invoker
text:
"As long as we have walked this world, we have known it as a harsh and unforgiving place."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Valakut Predator
text:
"Whatever volcanoes dream of, it seems like they always wake up grumpy."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Brood Monitor
text: The tenderness of a mother. The pity of a mantis.

name: Call the Scions
text: Ulamog's progeny swarm the land, draining Zendikar's mana to feed the titan's insatiable hunger.

name: Broodhunter Wurm
text: The native creatures of Zendikar have adapted to live under rocks and crawl through underbrush in order to avoid the most voracious predators. The Eldrazi have yet to make such adjustments.

name: Lifespring Druid
text: "The land is not dead, merely sick. I will nurse it back to health."

name: Murasa Ranger
text: "If you're not prepared to fight, you'd best be prepared to die."

name: Angel of Renewal
text: "No more fear. No more failure. No more death. No more!"

name: Plated Crusher
text:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

name: Reclaiming Vines
text:
"This world tires of its long occupation."
—Nissa Revane

name: Seek the Wilds
text: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

name: Snapping Gnarlid
text: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Tajuru Warcaller
text: Her rallying cry reaches far beyond the Tajuru elves, inspiring all those who hear it.

name: Cliffside Lookout
text: Though losses run high among the scouts of the Stone Havens, they never flinch from their duty.

name: Drana's Emissary
text: "The taste of freedom is sweeter than blood."

name: Blighted Fen
text:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Felidar Sovereign
text: It surveys the withering landscape, waiting for a victory only it can see.

name: Breaker of Armies
text:
"There are some who have lost everyone and everything. They actively seek out the Eldrazi, eager for the smallest measure of vengeance."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Kor Bladewhirl
text: The high-pitched whirl of a hook is the only battle cry she needs.

name: Ondu Greathorn
text:
"May your horns get lodged in an Eldrazi's bony face, ornery brute!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Stone Haven Medic
text: "These days, soldiers never stick around long enough for a proper healing. They just want me to knit them up so they can hurry back to the fight."

name: Desolation Twin
text:
"With precise coordination and enough blood spilled, one can be driven off, even brought down. But two . . . that's a lot of blood."
—Munda, ambush leader

name: Eldrazi Devastator
text:
"No matter how big your champion, theirs is bigger. No matter how great your numbers, theirs are greater. No matter how voracious your appetite, they are hungrier. That is why the Eldrazi will win."
—Kalitas, thrall of Ulamog

name: Brilliant Spectrum
text: There are more sights on Zendikar than the eyes can see.

name: Dispel
text:
"I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis. Ugin's arguments were . . . unconvincing."
—Jace Beleren

name: Wave-Wing Elemental
text:
"Do you see? All of Tazeem strains at its tether."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem roilmage

name: Ancient Cornucopia
text:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

name: Overprotect
text:
"Blor's defenses are impervious!"
—Blor the Impervious

name: Stormcatch Mentor
text: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

name: Shrike Force
text:
"I've trained every one of them in aerial maneuvers, talon strikes, and dive precision. They are the top of my class, and they may surpass me one day."
—Quickwing, master flyer

name: Shoreline Looter
text: A water skimmer's ability to sense danger in the slightest ripple makes them a prized companion for Long River trawlers.

name: Fell
text: When Glarb ordered the egg stolen, the Great Maha communicated its anger in a universal language.

name: Sol Ring
text: Water surges in a mysterious crater created eons ago, revered by batfolk as a nexus for the cosmos.

name: Path to Exile
text: Her resentment vanished as strange, unknown lands opened up before her.

name: Nadier's Nightblade
text: Checking around every corner doesn't help if you forget to look up.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Explore
text: As he crested the final peak, Nidd gasped at the beauty laid out before him. Finally, he had found a place to rest his weary legs. A place to call home.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Archetype of Endurance
text: Despite its fearsome stature, it is as elusive as a shadow, circling round to stalk those who presume to hunt it.

name: Akroan Phalanx
text: Shields up, spears out, heels set, hearts firm.

name: Spirit of the Labyrinth
text: Students at the Dekatia Academy learn that being sent to study with her is a lesson in itself.

name: Vanguard of Brimaz
text: "The humans and their gods never blessed me. Only the pride deserves my allegiance."

name: Archetype of Courage
text:
"It has been my experience that soldiers most fervently follow generals who lead by example."
—Elspeth

name: Archetype of Finality
text: She sees mortals not as they wish to be, but as what they will become.

name: Archetype of Aggression
text:
"Did Purphoros bless Maikal because of his rage? Or did Maikal's rage blossom after he'd been blessed? Only the gods know."
—Eocles, oracle of Purphoros

name: Kami of False Hope
text:
"Across the rift of battle, a bridge of gossamer. And for one moment, it holds."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: In the Web of War
text:
"In desperation, Konda sent warriors to parley with the ogre-magi. No one knows whether they were slaughtered at Shinka or if they even reached its bloodstained walls."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Mannichi, the Fevered Dream
text:
"Early in his reign, Konda fell ill. His head burned with fever, and he saw visions of his future. In them, he saw a spirit-child, and, in that child's eyes, a way to make his empire last forever."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Mirror Gallery
text: Only in mirrors do heroes find their equal.

name: Shuko
text:
"One scratch on a wall meant safe passage, two that the target had already been raided, and three warned of a trap."
—*Weaponry of Kamigawa*

name: That Which Was Taken
text:
"This god held prisoner in human hands has put all humanity in the hands of angry gods."
—Masako the Humorless

name: Empty-Shrine Kannushi
text: "Crease the folds, bend the paper, turn the spirits, shield the soul."

name: Final Judgment
text:
"The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Shimmering Glasskite
text: A child's whisper could crack its shell, but not even an oni's scream could penetrate it.

name: Toils of Night and Day
text:
"The war sent Kamigawa into turmoil. Here it was spring and there winter. For some, time stood still, while for others, moments flashed past like minnows in a pond."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Moment of Defiance
text: "Well? What are you waiting for? Let's not keep the buzzards waiting."

name: Bitter Reunion
text: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.

name: Giant Cindermaw
text:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

name: Argothian Opportunist
text: "Nature adapts. So should we."

name: Gaea's Gift
text: When it came to fighting an army of trees, even Mishra's best generals were stumped.

name: Haywire Mite
text:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Rust Goliath
text:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant

name: Brushland
text:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Tocasia's Welcome
text: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

name: Blood Rites
text: In war, the best leaders are open to all tactics.

name: Witch Hunt
text: The accusations spread like hungry flames.

name: Curse of Predation
text:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Night Soil
text: Some said killing the thallids only encouraged them.

name: Arcane Melee
text: Debates between wizards are never purely academic.

name: Archangel
text: The sky rang with the cries of armored seraphs, and the darkness made a tactical retreat.

name: Phyrexian Delver
text: Because the dead have no will to resist.

name: Angel of the Dire Hour
text: She arrived like a meteorite, and the enemy fell in a shock wave of holy vengeance.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
text: The infamous Ezuri commands the highest bounty the vedalken have ever placed upon an outlaw.

name: Praetor's Counsel
text: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Song of the Dryads
text: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

name: Wolfcaller's Howl
text:
"Knowledge is a stain that only instinct and ferocity can cleanse."
—Drarg, wolfcaller

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Ambition's Cost
text: The waters of wisdom are as dust in the mouth of one who thirsts for power.

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Seal of Doom
text:
"A basilisk's gaze is effective, but disposing of physical remains is a tiresome task. It's far more discreet to dissolve one's victim entirely."
—Szadek

name: Desperate Ravings
text: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Bane of Progress
text: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Underworld Coinsmith
text: Coins of the Underworld are shaped from clay funerary masks.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Crystal Chimes
text: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, chancellor of the Tolarian Academy

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Aura of Silence
text: Not all silences are easily broken.

name: Dawnglare Invoker
text:
"What we knew as Emeria, Ula, and Cosi were not divine beings at all, but a cruel trick, and a grave error."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Executioner's Capsule
text: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

name: Wight of Precinct Six
text: Even the lost and undead need a protector.

name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
text:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

name: Frenzied Fugue
text: Forever after, she lived in fear of the madness reclaiming her.

name: Evolutionary Escalation
text: Survival is a constant competition from which both sides can benefit.

name: Zhur-Taa Druid
text: "Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."

name: Thopter Foundry
text:
"Etherium is limited. Innovation is not."
—Tezzeret

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis
text: "Look what we fought for. Look what we built together."

name: Boompile
text:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

name: Sanctum Gargoyle
text: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Alms Collector
text: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

name: Kindred Discovery
text: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
text: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Rain of Thorns
text: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

name: Crosis's Charm
text: A pretty bauble of persecution.

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Nin, the Pain Artist
text: "Your body is a delicate instrument that tells me truths. These devices help me 'tune' that instrument."

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Armillary Sphere
text: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

name: Fist of Suns
text:
"It is all in my grasp. Every petty dream, every grand scheme, every soul, every fear. It all flows through me and from me."
—Memnarch

name: Hero's Blade
text: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira, sylvok outcast

name: Bloodsworn Steward
text: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Qasali Slingers
text: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

name: Traverse the Outlands
text: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
text: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

name: Leonin Arbiter
text: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Opportunity
text: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

name: Curse of Verbosity
text: Idle chatter beckons many an attentive ear.

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Treasure Hunt
text:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Aura Gnarlid
text: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Dawn's Reflection
text: Only Sylvok magic could truly capture the perfection of a Mirrodin sunrise.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Spawning Grounds
text: It's the only water source in miles of desert, but the local tribes avoid it at all costs.

name: Wild Growth
text: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Mortify
text: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

name: Savage Twister
text:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Unflinching Courage
text: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave—much to the other guilds' dismay.

name: Crystal Ball
text: It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Warped Landscape
text: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

name: Ravenous Slime
text: Death eventually wiggles toward us all.

name: Tawnos, Urza's Apprentice
text: "My master believes anything is achievable."

name: Thantis, the Warweaver
text: She spins a web few can resist. Its sweet aroma sparks chaos in every heart.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Archetype of Imagination
text:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

name: Dream Cache
text:
Dreams' riches are easily spent.
—Suq'Ata adage

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Sundering Growth
text:
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade."
—Trostani

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Rix Maadi, Dungeon Palace
text: Even miles away, if you put your ear to the sewer vents, you can hear the screams and the tempestuous laughter.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Marisi, Breaker of the Coil
text: "Cast off the law! Awaken your rage!"

name: Empowered Autogenerator
text: Magic, unlike physics, has no unbreakable laws.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Netherborn Altar
text: It is spoken of only in whispers, visited only by the desperate.

name: Bonder's Ornament
text:
"Found families deserve a family crest too."
—Kinnan, bonder prodigy

name: Kalamax, the Stormsire
text: Its mood changes with the weather, and vice versa.

name: Rout
text:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Serum Visions
text: Serum was once derived from Mirrodin's blinkmoths, offering visions of inspiration. Now it is pulled from Phyrexian inkmoths, yielding visions of perfection.

name: Excavation Technique
text: "Stand back. This part gets messy."

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Seething Song
text: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

name: Monologue Tax
text:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

name: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage
text: "Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
text: The weapon wields the hand that holds it.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Blossoming Bogbeast
text:
As subtle as a bogbeast
—Witherbloom expression meaning
"crude and clumsy"

name: Pest Infestation
text: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

name: Marrow-Gnawer
text: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

name: Rend Flesh
text:
"The Reito Massacre was a testament to the kami's unstoppable power. The human defenders might as well have been moths battling a forest fire."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
text: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the men. The kami are coming."

name: Seshiro the Anointed
text: His family was the first to reach out to the human monks. He soon knew as many koans as he did blade strikes.

name: Kitsune Blademaster
text: Those kitsune trained in the blade preferred to fight with a blade-catching jitte in the off hand, buying them just enough time to deliver the first deadly cut.

name: Eiganjo Castle
text: Since the war began, the castle's walls mark the only place on Kamigawa where no kami has ever set foot.

name: Minamo, School at Water's Edge
text: Its students graduate the school and enter history.

name: Okina, Temple to the Grandfathers
text: If a land can be said to have a heart, Okina is the heart of Kamigawa.

name: Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep
text: The glow from within looks inviting, but woe awaits whomever finds out who stokes the fire or what simmers in the pot.

name: Shizo, Death's Storehouse
text: Centuries ago, Shizo was a verdant field of wildflowers. After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

name: Masako the Humorless
text: Konda's servants dared not neglect their duties for a moment under Masako's icy gaze, knowing that what she saw, Lord Konda would hear.

name: Honden of Seeing Winds
text: To the sorrow of all, its winds found sin in the hearts of those who once learned from its wisdom.

name: Ethereal Haze
text:
"Imagine a dove flying through smoke. Does the dove injure the smoke? Does the smoke impede the dove?"
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Soratami Savant
text: "To prevent, one must first predict."

name: Squelch
text: Oku-Doku had gone through all the motions: the same akki cursewords, the same ingredients with their horrid stink, the same rude gestures. Yet not a person died.

name: Cloudkill
text: As the acrid fumes drifted through the Lower City, even the vermin ceased to stir.

name: Crystal Dragon
text:
"Wait, it was just guarding a bunch of eggs! Where is the treasure?"
—Xalcorin the bard

name: Summon Undead
text: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.

name: Bhaal's Invoker
text: "The Lord of Murder has freed me from the shackles of mortal laws and gifted me with fire to carry out his will."

name: Breath Weapon
text: "In the name of Tempus, Lord of Battles, you will die honorably in righteous fire."

name: Coronation of Chaos
text: When Sarevok's deception was unmasked, the cheering crowd erupted into an outraged mob.

name: Far Traveler
text: You have traveled to many places, over mountains and across seas, but a new journey always calls.

name: Inspired Tinkering
text: "What do you mean 'Does it work?' What an insulting question."

name: Lightning Bolt
text:
"Hasn't she heard of knocking?!"
—Snerd, Flaming Fist guard

name: Reckless Barbarian
text: The best defense is not even knowing what the word "defense" means.

name: Taunting Kobold
text: Pozo's heart was full of courage, right up until it was full of elven steel.

name: Young Red Dragon
text: For most, deadly. For a dragon, decadent.

name: Dread Linnorm
text: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

name: Jaheira, Friend of the Forest
text: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."

name: Baba Lysaga, Night Witch
text: Better the cold night than her warm hospitality.

name: Cadira, Caller of the Small
text: She roams the border between wilderness and civilization, protecting those who need it most.

name: Commander Liara Portyr
text: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

name: Decanter of Endless Water
text:
"Now, remember: Under no circumstances should you utter the word 'geyser' in the same room as—oh, blast it!"
—Bindlehaim, Upper City merchant

name: Patriar's Seal
text: Only a fool ignores a letter bearing the official mark of a patriar family.

name: Stonespeaker Crystal
text: It whispers words spoken centuries ago, coaxing wisdom from the ghosts of civilizations past.

name: Baldur's Gate
text:
"Of course I know what 'eponymous' means! It's a little horse."
—Krizz, gate guard

name: Black Dragon Gate
text: An imposing visage that looms over all who would rise above their station.

name: Citadel Gate
text: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.

name: Cliffgate
text: A partition between the hopeless living and the restless dead.

name: Manor Gate
text: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Gale stared into the pool and saw a stranger. The similarities were uncanny, but it was not him.

name: Sea Gate
text: An efficient route from a smuggler's ship to a patriar's manor.

name: Archivist of Oghma
text: "Knowledge is the greatest tool of the mortal mind, outweighing anything made by mortal hands. Before anything else can exist, the idea must exist."

name: Steadfast Unicorn
text: Only the good-hearted may set foot in a unicorn's domain.

name: Your Temple Is Under Attack
text: "You trespass on sacred ground, monster. Leave while you still can."

name: You're Confronted by Robbers
text: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.

name: Blur
text: "It's as much a trick of the mind as it is a trick of the eye."

name: Candlekeep Inspiration
text: Tales of heroes past galvanize the heroes of the future.

name: Bane's Invoker
text: "The Lord of Darkness elevates only those who serve."
