name: Irenicus's Vile Duplication
text:
"You will serve me better in this form."
—Jon Irenicus

name: Mindcrank
text:
"Let go of your memories and be reborn."
—Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27

name: Mutavault
text: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

name: Run Away Together
text: True love means always knowing what's on the other's mind.

name: Afterlife Insurance
text: As far as the Orzhov Syndicate is concerned, it is the height of irresponsibility not to have a plan for your own ghost.

name: Portal Manipulator
text: "The next punch you throw hits the back of your own head."

name: Slip Out the Back
text: "I was never here."

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Tuktuk the Explorer
text: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Bottle Gnomes
text: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Coldsteel Heart
text: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

name: Brave the Sands
text: Enduring the most desolate and dangerous conditions, Abzan sentries unfailingly guard the stronghold gates.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Deserted, but not uninhabited.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Memory Erosion
text:
"The Filigree Texts do not compel you to act in accordance with their precepts. They only specify the consequences should you fail."
—Lodus of the Ethersworn

name: Slipstream Eel
text: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

name: Festercreep
text: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

name: Gravedigger
text: Only a thin layer of dirt separates civilization from an undead apocalypse.

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Curse of the Nightly Hunt
text: When the moon rises and the bloodlust takes hold, nothing matters but the kill.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fall of the Hammer
text: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

name: Desert Twister
text: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

name: Essence Warden
text:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Imperious Perfect
text: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

name: Mulch
text: The land knows no difference between the graves of commoners and nobles.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Wellwisher
text: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
text: "Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."

name: Skyward Eye Prophets
text: They lament the doom that is coming to Bant without realizing the part their own leaders have played in it.

name: Terminate
text:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Righteous Cause
text:
"Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Eldrazi Monument
text:
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Thornwind Faeries
text: Guarding the ship is the Thornwinds' first concern. Getting along with the locals ranks fourth or fifth at best.

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Rager
text:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Death by Dragons
text: Suddenly, Eldo felt very alone.

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Magmatic Force
text:
"Granted, it's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness. So what would you call *two* of them?"
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Spawnwrithe
text: Its victims feel only an itchy, wriggling feeling just under their skin. By then, it's far too late.

name: Aura Shards
text: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

name: Martyr's Bond
text:
"Our lives are connected by divine law. The truth of this will be made evident in time."
—Zedruu the Greathearted

name: Dominus of Fealty
text:
"Nothing is truly your own. It is his, whether you know it or not."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Acorn Catapult
text: The Kalonian word for "ammunition" is the same as the word for "bait."

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Loyal Drake
text:
"Doves and pigeons are too subtle. When I send a message, I want it to have some teeth."
—Aeschel, royal diplomat

name: Angelic Field Marshal
text: Her presence on the battlefield can transform an unruly mob into a disciplined army.

name: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder
text: Creator of life, bringer of death.

name: Exsanguinate
text: "I didn't say I would help you find your way home. I said I would help you finish your adventure."

name: Extinguish All Hope
text: Phenax, god of deception, offered the soldiers protection from every poison on Theros. He saw no need to mention that Pharika's poisons were drawn from Nyx.

name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
text: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

name: Neheb, the Eternal
text:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Keleth, Sunmane Familiar
text: She chooses her riders carefully and bears them to glory in battle after battle.

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Meteor Golem
text: Herala sighed as the creature pulled itself from the smoldering pit, the ground boiling beneath its still-glowing feet. She had just plowed that field.

name: Sunblade Angel
text: At Feather's command, squadrons of battle angels swarmed out of the *Parhelion II*, unsheathing blades made of molten dawn.

name: Gemhide Sliver
text: Squee had been disemboweled many times before, but never by something so stunningly beautiful.

name: Manaweft Sliver
text: Their pearlescent scales are highly sought after by those who lack the instincts for self-preservation.

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Crashing Drawbridge
text:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
text: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

name: Trove Tracker
text: The best treasures are the least shared.

name: Court of Ambition
text: Watch your step.

name: Falthis, Shadowcat Familiar
text: She sticks to her chosen master closer than their own shadow.

name: Court of Grace
text: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

name: Alena, Kessig Trapper
text: "Halana and I have a bond that'll never be broken."

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Crimson Fleet Commodore
text:
"Kindly steer your fleet clear of the waters west of Scrub Isle. It would be a shame to incinerate such exquisite maritime craftsmanship."
—Commodore Axurik, to Admiral Yelise

name: Frenzied Saddlebrute
text: The drumbeats of the horde echo in every heart.

name: Goblin Trailblazer
text:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

name: Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar
text: Kediss loves molten metal, searing flames, and head scratches.

name: Krark, the Thumbless
text: "Double or nothing."

name: Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh
text: Strength is relative.

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

name: Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood
text: "Something mighty stirs in the forest. Can't you feel it?"

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Hans Eriksson
text: "Nothing could ruin such a fine day, Saffi."

name: Jared Carthalion, True Heir
text: "I'm here for what's mine."

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
text: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
text: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

name: Reyav, Master Smith
text: "There's always room for improvement."

name: Commander's Plate
text: Not all beautiful things are fragile.

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Training Center
text: Between matches, combatants practice to stay in peak mental and physical form.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
text:
"To sail through those waters is to offer oneself as tribute."
—Captain Hoyrik

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Expedite
text: "I run, and thunder follows."

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Slaughter the Strong
text:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

name: Glacian, Powerstone Engineer
text:
"His energy is as boundless as the powerstones'."
—Rebbec, architect of ascension

name: Sphinx of the Second Sun
text: He watches in silence as the shadows shift, bringing Amonkhet ever nearer to the Hour of Revelation.

name: Windborne Charge
text: The merfolk call the sky goddess Emeria. The kor call her Kamsa. The two races agree on little except that she offers many blessings to the faithful.

name: Zealous Strike
text: "Cower, fiend. The night is yours no longer."

name: Caller of Gales
text: "Some merfolk choose to rest their fins in the water. I believe wisdom exists not only where we were born but where we were told not to go."

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Fleeting Distraction
text: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Driver of the Dead
text: Some vampires resorted to corpse trading after cathars burned their estates and drove them from their ancestral feeding grounds.

name: Infest
text:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

name: Stromkirk Patrol
text: "You'd best move along, human. Our palates are far less discerning than our master's."

name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
text: "The enemy is getting too close! Quick! Inflate the toad!"

name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
text: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur Forest

name: Fade into Antiquity
text:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

name: Lay of the Land
text: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

name: Palace Sentinels
text:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Ravenous Leucrocota
text: Hunger makes a leucrocota dangerous. A full belly makes it angry and dangerous.

name: Akroan Hoplite
text: "Fair fight? How could it be a fair fight? We're Akroans. They're not."

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Recruiter of the Guard
text: Before a cause can have supporters, it has to have a voice.

name: Canal Courier
text: The most effective roadways in Paliano aren't roads at all.

name: Expropriate
text: Few things are more valuable than time or money—and Leovold has plenty of both.

name: Jeering Homunculus
text: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

name: Keeper of Keys
text: For the right price, he'll unlock your path to the throne.

name: Stunt Double
text: No duelist is without equal in Paliano.

name: Marchesa's Decree
text:
"Those who seize power must have the means to hold it."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Regicide
text: "You're done!"

name: Thorn of the Black Rose
text: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of bureaucracy.

name: Besmirch
text: The whitest robes stain best.

name: Crown-Hunter Hireling
text: While most in Paliano seek fame through favor, he'll settle for infamy through blood.

name: Subterranean Tremors
text: The market is now closed.

name: Domesticated Hydra
text: "Sit. Fetch. Devastate."

name: Entourage of Trest
text:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

name: Hymn of the Wilds
text: Many attempt to speak with nature. Selvala speaks less, and nature answers more.

name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
text: "I'm sure we can come to an arrangement."

name: Spy Kit
text: Imitation is the sincerest form of treachery.

name: Doomed Traveler
text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

name: Reviving Dose
text: Samite healers never mix their pungent elixir with sweetener or tea. The threat of a second dose is enough to get most warriors back on their feet.

name: Wild Griffin
text: Farmers typically keep their flocks at thirteen sheep—one to distract the griffins while they take the other twelve to market.

name: Brago's Representative
text: On Fiora, no matter is settled until King Brago offers an opinion.

name: Heartless Hidetsugu
text: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

name: Council's Judgment
text: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

name: Echoing Courage
text: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

name: Treasonous Ogre
text:
"Everything comes with a price. Especially revolution."
—Grenzo, dungeon warden

name: Predator's Howl
text:
"And Muzzio says my arguments have no teeth."
—Selvala, ranger of the Lowlands

name: Cogwork Librarian
text: Why wait for answers?

name: Kor Chant
text: Sacred rites repurposed to fight an ancient threat.

name: Wakestone Gargoyle
text: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

name: Dream Fracture
text:
"Creation is a paradox. It hatches from its opposite."
—Olka, Mistmeadow witch

name: Maelstrom Archangel
text: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Font of Mythos
text: Those who drink from Malfegor's cup are tainted with hunger and stained with lies.

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Built in honor of Alara's creatures, the ziggurat vanished long ago. When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Unstable Frontier
text: The goblins went to sleep in Jund and awoke in Grixis. They'd never seen a zombie before. They would never see one again.

name: Rhox Meditant
text: The weight of her conviction balances on the harmony of her soul.

name: Aven Squire
text: When the meek charge into battle, courage becomes infectious.

name: Master Transmuter
text: "Wasted potential surrounds us. Lend me that bauble, and let me see what it can be made to be."

name: View from Above
text: "This air feels so heavy and thick. There are no winds to speak of. I fear the knowledge that comes from a place like this."

name: Kederekt Parasite
text: When the smell of passing thoughts piques its hunger, its maw becomes primed with acid and a taste for brains.

name: Toxic Iguanar
text: There are no "weak" creatures on Jund. Even the smallest can strike a deadly blow.

name: Lapse of Certainty
text: Without a connection of mind and body, magic is just an idea stuck in the head, a word on the tip of a tongue.

name: Adarkar Valkyrie
text: She doesn't escort the dead to the afterlife, but instead raises them to fight and die again.

name: Thermopod
text: Slicking the ice with its heated underside, the thermopod skates at great speed to overtake its prey.

name: Boreal Druid
text: Some creatures are bound to the cold by Rimewind magic. Others seek it out, adapted by two thousand years of the Ice. The Boreal, where Heidar's frigid sway is strongest, is home to both.

name: Into the North
text:
"Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter. Go forth and reclaim them for Yavimaya."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Panglacial Wurm
text:
"Step lightly and we might be able to use it as a bridge."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Juniper Order Ranger
text: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

name: Phyrexian Snowcrusher
text: Its plow wasn't designed for snow, but to carve a path through shrieking armies.

name: Phyrexian Soulgorger
text: The Phyrexian minds that constructed it did not live past its awakening.

name: Frost Marsh
text:
"Now caged in Winter's bitter chill,
Our people cry, their voices shrill—
Eternal cold breaks down their will."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
text:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

name: Stromgald Crusader
text: "The White-Shielders think their code justifies their actions. In truth it only binds their hands."

name: Balduvian Rage
text:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

name: Braid of Fire
text: "To a trained mind, the cold is but a momentary distraction."

name: Lovisa Coldeyes
text: "I lead my horde to the northwest. I won't return until the ice wizards fall and their fiendish contraptions are crushed!"

name: Skred
text:
"This close to Rimewind Keep, no avalanche is nature's doing."
—Ukoten, centaur chieftain

name: Siege Zombie
text: A barricade only buys time. So the wealthy buy more barricades.

name: Akki Coalflinger
text: No matter where you find them, goblins love rocks.

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Elvish Warrior
text: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

name: Boggart Shenanigans
text: Boggarts revel in discovering new sensations, from the texture of an otter pellet to the squeak of a dying warren mate.

name: Gush
text: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

name: Flame Javelin
text: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Angelsong
text: Clash of sword and cry of beast fall mute when angels sound the call to prayer.

name: Otherworldly Journey
text:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

name: Serra's Embrace
text: The touch of Serra's angels bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

name: Cackling Imp
text: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Liliana learned the secrets she sought, but at a price that was etched on her fate.

name: Breeding Pit
text: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

name: Consume Spirit
text:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

name: Lignify
text: Bulgo paused, puzzled. What was that rustling sound, and why did he feel so stiff? And how could his *feet* be so thirsty?

name: Nature's Lore
text: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

name: Deathgreeter
text: "The bones of allies grant wisdom. The bones of enemies grant strength. The bones of dragons grant life eternal."

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Priest of Gix
text:
"Gix doesn't want a people to rule but puppets to entertain his madness."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

name: Goldmeadow Harrier
text:
"It's a proven fact that sling-stones from the dawn side of the riverbank sail the farthest and truest."
—Deagan, cenn of Burrenton

name: Argivian Restoration
text:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Knight Exemplar
text: "If you think you are brave enough to walk the path of honor, follow me into the dragon's den."

name: Knight of Meadowgrain
text: "By tradition, we don't speak for two days after battle. If our deeds won't speak for themselves, what else could be said?"

name: Seething Song
text: If your flesh can withstand the flame, the spirit of the dragon will burn within your soul.

name: Slavering Nulls
text: Having lost their minds, they now want yours.

name: Countersquall
text:
"The essence of every world, every spell, and every thought is power. Nothing else matters, because nothing else exists."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Stone Giant
text: A typical day for a giant. A momentous event for a goat.

name: Force Spike
text: "I don't *think* so."

name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
text: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

name: Doomgape
text: It eats and eats until the juiciest morsel it can find is itself.

name: Feast or Famine
text:
"The living cannot understand the benefits of death."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

name: Lavaborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Flame Slash
text: After millennia asleep, the Eldrazi had forgotten about Zendikar's fiery temper and dislike of strangers.

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"Wood is wasted in the dirt."
—Orcish proverb

name: Phantasmal Dragon
text: Its hunger and ire are no less for being wrought of lies and mist.

name: Sadistic Augermage
text: "Don't worry. I know the drill."

name: Nekrataal
text:
"You can't protect them all, Jace."
—Vraska

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

name: Orcish Cannonade
text:
"Crispy! Scarback! Load another volcano-ball."
—Stumphobbler Thuj, orcish captain

name: Infantry Veteran
text: "Swords, to me! We must engage their line to protect our archers and mages. Let no one fail this task!"

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: "Do not concern yourself with my origin, my race, or my ancestry. Seek my record in the pits, and then make your wager."

name: Coral Trickster
text: They wait in darkened depths, laughing eagerly.

name: Sparkmage Apprentice
text: Sparkmages are performance artists of sorts, but pain is the price of admission.

name: Lone Missionary
text: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

name: Dregscape Zombie
text: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

name: Faerie Invaders
text: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

name: Goblin Deathraiders
text: Every once in a while, when they aren't getting incinerated in lava, crushed under rock slides, or devoured by dragons, goblins experience moments of unmitigated glory in battle.

name: Mana Leak
text: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

name: Gustcloak Skirmisher
text: They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

name: Kor Skyfisher
text: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

name: Loxodon Partisan
text:
"On every plane I've encountered loxodons, I've found stalwart and loyal friends."
—Elspeth

name: Mortal's Ardor
text:
"Such deeds should be common fare for such as us."
—Anax, king of Akros

name: Mother of Runes
text: She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.

name: Soul Parry
text:
"I was called to this world of steel, and it will be my steel that answers."
—Elspeth

name: Veteran Swordsmith
text: "Truth is a straight, keen edge. There are no soft angles or rounded edges. To fight for truth, we must forge in steel."

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Peel from Reality
text: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

name: Surrakar Banisher
text: Surrakar grab things they don't want.

name: Whelming Wave
text:
"I can see why this appeals to Thassa."
—Kiora

name: Explore
text:
"I will never run out of new oceans to explore or new sea-dwellers to embrace as my own."
—Kiora

name: Court Street Denizen
text: "The Boros fight for justice. The Azorius fight for law. I hold the line between, and make sure the people are given both."

name: Kiora's Follower
text: "She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths."

name: Dictate of Heliod
text:
"In our war Heliod gave mortals some favor, yet other times he withheld aid. Are we still no more than game pieces to him?"
—Polyxene the Doubter

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Groundswell
text: "This world will not be tamed."

name: Territorial Baloth
text: Its territory is defined by wherever it is at the moment.

name: Bloodrite Invoker
text:
"The brood lineages unfolded across the world, each patterned after one of three progenitors, each a study in mindless consumption."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Induce Despair
text: All the angel saw was her doom.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Emrakul's Hatcher
text: Wordlessly it leads its abhorrent brood.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Oust
text:
"'Invincible' is just a word."
—Gideon Jura

name: Bonds of Faith
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

name: Village Bell-Ringer
text: "Priests, hunters, slayers—to arms! The enemy approaches!"

name: Voice of the Provinces
text: Her horn is heard across Innistrad, lifting the hearts of the righteous.

name: Mist Raven
text:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

name: Nephalia Smuggler
text: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

name: Champion of the Parish
text: "I stand for every cobbler, tanner, and fool in this town—and they stand for me."

name: Stitched Drake
text:
"The best skaabs are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Dread Return
text: The will to return can overpower the will to survive.

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Natural Connection
text: "Zendikar will not surrender, and neither can we."

name: Oakgnarl Warrior
text: "Roam as you will, your roots remain in the strong earth of your Rising."

name: Oran-Rief Invoker
text:
"The world was not hostile to us—we were beneath its notice, and presented no danger."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Seek the Horizon
text:
"The horizon is the perpetual ideal, the constant promise of hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Altar's Reap
text:
"I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Citanul Woodreaders
text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

name: Blistergrub
text:
"Avoid anything that scuttles, scrabbles, or shambles."
—Opar, veteran guide

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Grim Discovery
text: Few among the living understand just how much of their world is shaped by the ruins of the dead.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Renegade Demon
text: Confront it at your own peril, for it will confront you for its own amusement.

name: Crop Rotation
text: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

name: Snap
text: It doesn't matter if the mind or body cracks first. They both have to go.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: The Unspeakable
text: The rumors are horrifying; the truth is worse.

name: Empty the Warrens
text: It's never just *one* goblin.

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Nucklavee
text: It loathes all tastes but two: spells and flesh.

name: Firebolt
text: "There's more where that came from!"

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Guttural Response
text: A savage cry with the power to shatter minds.

name: Coat of Arms
text: A banner for bonds of blood or belief.

name: Merfolk Looter
text: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

name: Mind Spring
text: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

name: Scroll Thief
text: Kapsho merfolk have infiltrated fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari in their relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

name: Tidal Warrior
text: The tide of battle favors those who can swim.

name: Wake Thrasher
text: Anyone who thinks merrows have more brains than brawn has never been run over by one.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Six feet of earth muffled his cries.

name: Brute Strength
text: It's not the size of the rock. It's how badly you want to lift it.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "It's time for the 'Smash, Smash' song!"

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Krenko's Command
text: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

name: Tarfire
text:
"After Auntie brushed the soot from her eyes, she discovered something wonderful: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

name: Ivy Lane Denizen
text: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Elvish Archdruid
text: "The elves tend the forest, and the forest sustains the elves. My role is to ensure that the cycle continues."

name: Reclusive Artificer
text: It's not wise to disturb an artist at work.

name: Pyrite Spellbomb
text:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Ezuri's Archers
text: Eyes and arrows trained ever skyward.

name: Stock Up
text: "We are now accepting over eleven different interplanar currencies, including polished moonfall!"

name: Opal Lake Gatekeepers
text: Sentries guard Ravnica's landmarks and outlying districts, unaware of these places' import to the maze.

name: Gruul War Chant
text:
"We are the heart of the wild, the fire in its eyes, and the howl in its throat. Come, join the battle to which you were born."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Pain Magnification
text: The Rakdos make sure their victims remember their pain—or at least give up a little bit of their sanity in order to forget.

name: Magewright's Stone
text: The stones hark back to an age before civilization, when the living earth blessed all who trod its untamed wilds.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

name: Spell Snare
text: Every culture has its unlucky numbers. In a city where you're either alone, in a crowd, or being stabbed in the back, two is the worst number of all.

name: Ogre Gatecrasher
text: A popular game among ogres is to see how many revolutions a head can make before it pops off.

name: Celestial Ancient
text:
"We thought the clouds had moved from the night sky. Then the night sky moved, and the horizon grew wings."
—Josuri

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice *now*!"
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Indrik Stomphowler
text:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

name: Dawntreader Elk
text: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

name: Hunger of the Howlpack
text:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Strangleroot Geist
text: Geists of the hanged often haunt the tree on which they died.

name: Wild Hunger
text: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions. The snake was filled only with Otto.

name: Young Wolf
text: The Ulvenwald makes no allowances for youth. Today's newborn is either tomorrow's hunter or tomorrow's lunch.

name: Diregraf Captain
text: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

name: Drogskol Captain
text: Dead or alive, true leaders can inspire an entire army.

name: Stromkirk Captain
text:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade
text: Those who grasp its hilt soon hear the demon's call.

name: Counterlash
text: "Pathetic. Let me show you how it's done."

name: Burden of Guilt
text:
"Grab an axe and defend the gate! Your despair is an extravagance we can ill afford."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Jazal Goldmane
text:
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
text: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

name: Echoing Truth
text: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: General Marhault Elsdragon
text: Driven by rage, directed by his emperor's claw.

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

name: Gempalm Incinerator
text: "I've got this under control! Probably!"

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Fa'adiyah Seer
text: She nurtures each flower from seed to blossom, and in return, they whisper secrets only she can hear.

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Savannah Lions
text:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

name: Serra Angel
text: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Shadow Prophecy
text: "Lord Windgrace, grant me wisdom."

name: Meria's Outrider
text: Arrows fashioned from the living wood of Yavimaya carry all of the forest's rage in their fire-hardened points.

name: Twinferno
text:
"More fire?" Jaya asked.
"More fire," Jodah agreed.

name: Destroy Evil
text: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

name: Tear Asunder
text: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
text: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
text: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

name: Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart
text: "This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."

name: Tura Kennerüd, Skyknight
text: "The sky is my birthright. I dare you to try and take it from me."

name: Relic of Legends
text:
"If the worst parts of history can repeat themselves, it stands to reason that the best parts can as well."
—Teferi

name: Sunlit Marsh
text: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

name: Resolute Reinforcements
text: Morale rarely survives the sudden appearance of a squad of Sursi skirmishers at an army's flank.

name: Tolarian Terror
text: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

name: Battle-Rage Blessing
text:
"Since when is it cheating to give one side an unfair advantage?"
—Braids

name: Charge
text:
"Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."
—Danitha Capashen

name: Rat Colony
text: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

name: Thallid Omnivore
text: Thelon of Havenwood created thallids as a food source in times of darkness. Thallids did the same with saprolings.

name: Windgrace Acolyte
text: Acolytes of the lost Lord Windgrace fight to keep Urborg relics out of Cabal hands.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
text: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

name: Bloodstone Goblin
text: The stone whispers tales of darkness and fire. She replies, "Tell me more."

name: Fervent Strike
text:
"The flame paints a bright wheel on the sky, then shifts into a stabbing spark. The enemy falls; the smoke of victory rises."
—"Legends of the Firedancer"

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Ghitu Chronicler
text: "What fire forged, fire remembers."

name: Ghitu Lavarunner
text: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

name: Goblin Chainwhirler
text: "The trick is, once you get moving, don't stop!"

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Not since the days of Pashalik Mons have the Rundvelt goblins been so united or effective.

name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
text: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

name: Rampaging Cyclops
text: Keldon warriors take advantage of the cyclops's inability to focus on more than one thing at a time.

name: Dauntless Bodyguard
text: The Benalish aristocracy is hereditary, but the loyalty of its subjects is earned.

name: Run Amok
text: Keld faced an apocalypse to fulfill a dire prophecy. Now Keldons have nothing left to believe in except themselves.

name: Seismic Shift
text:
"Shiv is a restless land. It heaves ash, bleeds lava, and scabs over in black obsidian."
—*The First Eruption*

name: Skirk Prospector
text: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

name: Two-Headed Giant
text: He watches the pass in both directions, and all must pay his toll.

name: Adventurous Impulse
text: Every odyssey begins with a single step.

name: Arbor Armament
text:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

name: Baloth Gorger
text: A baloth only cares about the many things it eats and the few things that eat it.

name: Broken Bond
text: "I can't bear to see another plane broken before I make my own home whole. I'm sorry, but my watch is over."

name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
text:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—*Fall of the Thran*

name: Gaea's Protector
text: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

name: Krosan Druid
text: "Druids endure disaster as seeds endure winter. Now Krosa blooms once more."

name: Pierce the Sky
text: Llanowar elves conceal their ballistae in the upper canopy of the forest, ready to clear the skies of any intruder.

name: Saproling Migration
text: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

name: Spore Swarm
text: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

name: Yavimaya Sapherd
text:
"When their community grows cluttered, thallids begin a traditional bobbing dance, then trek out in all directions."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

name: Adeliz, the Cinder Wind
text: The passionate intensity of the Ghitu tempered by the cool insight of Tolarian training.

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Adamant Will
text: The shield took a year to craft, a month to enchant, and a decade to master—all for one glorious moment.

name: Healing Grace
text:
"Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."
—Lyra Dawnbringer

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
text: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
text: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Helm of the Host
text: Forged out of flowstone for the queen of Vesuva.

name: Icy Manipulator
text: Ice may thaw, but malice never does.

name: Invoke the Divine
text:
"Let go of all that harms you. Cast your burdens into the darkness, and build for the faithful a house of light."
—*Song of All*, canto 1008

name: Mishra's Self-Replicator
text: It has witnessed history's most significant events, one incarnation after another.

name: Powerstone Shard
text:
"Light passing through a powerstone is refracted by eternity and colored by planar energy. I wonder how the world appeared through Urza's eyes?"
—Teferi

name: Short Sword
text:
"Sometimes the only difference between a martyr and a hero is a sword."
—Captain Sisay, *Memoirs*

name: Skittering Surveyor
text: Like a cross between a spider and a spyglass, but friendlier.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Zhalfirin Void
text:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

name: Mesa Unicorn
text: The unicorns of Sursi are a manifestation of Serra's joy and compassion. They frolic and dance like children, offering blessings to anyone they encounter.

name: On Serra's Wings
text:
"The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."
—*Song of All*, canto 524

name: Aven Sentry
text: "My flock flew from a distant continent ruined by cataclysm and war. Benalia gave us shelter to end our exodus."

name: Serra Disciple
text: Theologians now believe the Ancestor was another divine form of Serra.

name: Baird, Steward of Argive
text: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

name: Academy Journeymage
text: "We don't choose who comes here. We choose how long they stay."

name: Cold-Water Snapper
text: For generations, the inhabitants of Orvada have hungered for turtle soup. For generations, the turtles have frustrated their ambitions.

name: Deep Freeze
text: For cryomancers, studying the Ice Age isn't just an academic exercise.

name: Merfolk Trickster
text: Saved from destruction by one planeswalker's sacrifice, the Eliterate colony forswore the taking of life.

name: Opt
text: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

name: Sage of Lat-Nam
text: Though it was laid to waste by the brothers, many schools of magic trace their origins to the College of Lat-Nam, including the first Tolarian Academy.

name: Syncopate
text: The fire spell stuttered and broke. Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

name: Tempest Djinn
text: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

name: Wizard's Retort
text:
"The second mage learned to dissipate blasts of lightning. Threat and response: thus did the study of magic progress."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Blessing of Belzenlok
text:
"My heart is not mine, it is Belzenlok's. All hearts are his, and all blood."
—"Rite of Belzenlok"

name: Caligo Skin-Witch
text: "Take their faces. The lips of these unbelievers may yet honor the Demonlord."

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Demonic Vigor
text: In the Cabal, death is just another mark of devotion.

name: Drudge Sentinel
text: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.

name: Feral Abomination
text:
"Urborg used to be lovely—scenic volcanoes, respectable lich lords. Since the Cabal came with their nightmares and thrulls, it's all gone to the worms."
—Mister Lostspoons, Skulltown gossip

name: Fungal Infection
text: To thallids, the whole world is just a pile of mulch to grow saprolings in.

name: Bloodmark Mentor
text: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
text: The fall of the evening star never heralds a gentle dawn.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Chaos Warp
text: Tools developed for infiltrating or sabotaging rival teams became new fields of research in their own right.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Deathreap Ritual
text: There is no atrocity Valgavoth's devotees would not commit for the promise of freedom from fear.

name: Command Tower
text:
"It's me and Gribble's special fort. None of the bad things can get us in there."
—Toby

name: Untimely Malfunction
text: "No! This worked perfectly in the lab!"

name: Insidious Fungus
text: Wherever it grows, wood rots, walls turn gray, and flesh becomes fertilizer.

name: Tyvar, the Pummeler
text: "They just keep coming and coming—perfect for my morning workout!"

name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
text: Every night, Cori threw the unsettling doll away. Every morning, it was back on the shelf, its eyes following her every move.

name: Splitskin Doll
text: Those who mock its ragged surface and seeping eyes have a curious tendency to go missing.

name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
text: "Sure, I'm pretty small, but Gribble isn't, so I don't get scared."

name: The Mindskinner
text: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

name: Eater of Days
text: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

name: Geth's Grimoire
text: The book shrieks horribly until its cover is opened, granting the spirit inside a moment's rest from the painful stirrings of the book's contents.

name: Well of Lost Dreams
text: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

name: Pulse of the Grid
text: Before labs or lectures, there was insight.

name: Reshape
text:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

name: Aether Snap
text:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

name: Death Cloud
text: The swarm's million wings stir the foulest of breezes.

name: Echoing Decay
text: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.

name: Grimclaw Bats
text: Even on a world of metal, there are those who thirst for blood.

name: Goblin Archaeologist
text: Always easily impressed, Durg was about to be blown away.

name: Stand Together
text: Strange times make for strange allies.

name: Scion of Ugin
text: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron. As Ugin lay dormant, his spectral guardians kept vigil.

name: Gravepurge
text:
"Lord Silumgar has given you a second chance to please him."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Marsh Hulk
text: Now vengeance is his sole purpose.

name: Dragon's Eye Sentry
text: Even the humblest guard of Ojutai's strongholds ponders the puzzles of the Great Teacher's lessons.

name: Shambling Goblin
text:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

name: Silumgar Butcher
text: Silumgar takes pride in the diversity of his sibsig.

name: Berserkers' Onslaught
text:
"Atarka's people starve while she feasts upon the bounty of their hunts. They must conquer ever more lands just for the sake of their own subsistence."
—Arel, Unseen Whisperer

name: Hardened Berserker
text:
"Just let him loose and follow the charge."
—Yikaro, Atarka warrior

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

name: Rending Volley
text: The sky offers few hiding places.

name: Roast
text:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman

name: Sarkhan's Rage
text: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

name: Screamreach Brawler
text: "My dragonlord's lightning will dance upon your bones!"

name: Enduring Victory
text:
"My dragonlord is immortal. Most dragons are not."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Summit Prowler
text:
"Do you not hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? Their meat is as tender as a bear's and their blood as warming as fire. They are prey that will please Atarka."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Vandalize
text:
"As we have learned from Kolaghan, to ruin is to rule."
—Shensu, Kolaghan rider

name: Volcanic Rush
text:
"The bravest warriors take the shortest path to victory, whatever that path may be."
—Sakta, Atarka hunter

name: Conifer Strider
text: Atarka's presence thaws the glaciers of Qal Sisma, forcing its elementals to migrate or adapt.

name: Dragon-Scarred Bear
text: Bears are a delicacy for the Atarka. The few that remain are the toughest of their species.

name: Epic Confrontation
text: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

name: Pinion Feast
text:
"Even paradise is not without tragedies."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Shape the Sands
text:
"Dragons in flight seldom expect company."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

name: Cunning Breezedancer
text:
"That which is beautiful in form can also be deadly."
—Ishai, Ojutai dragonspeaker

name: Dragonlord Dromoka
text: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.

name: Tapestry of the Ages
text:
"Abzan, Jeskai, Sultai, Mardu, Temur—names lost to history, yet worthy of further study."
—Narset

name: Sandstorm Charger
text:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Contradict
text: Those who question Ojutai may not like the answers they receive.

name: Glint
text: Rakshasa waste no opportunity to display their wealth and power, even in the midst of a sorcerous duel.

name: Gudul Lurker
text: The small are mostly ignored by dragons.

name: Ojutai Interceptor
text: "Though I may soar, I could never fly as high as the dragons."

name: Youthful Scholar
text:
"Too dumb, and you end up a sibsig. Too smart, and you end up a meal. Mediocrity is the key to a long life."
—Mogai, Silumgar noble

name: Champion of Arashin
text: "The blood of Dromoka and the blood of my veins are the same."

name: Coat with Venom
text:
"Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord."
—Xathi the Infallible

name: Defeat
text:
"Wars are decided one life at a time."
—Gvar Barzeel, Kolaghan warrior

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Grasp of the Hieromancer
text:
"There is power in abandon, but far more in control."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

name: Aerial Responder
text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Windrider Eel
text:
"The best spot to hook one is right behind the gills."
—Rana Cloudwake, kor skyfisher

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gorehorn Minotaurs
text: Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.

name: Excoriate
text: The demon had flown past the reach of Erebos's whip but not the point of the sun god's spear.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

name: Stormblood Berserker
text: Blood is holy to those whose god is War.

name: Sudden Demise
text: In the Skyfang Mountains, one misstep can mean the end of an entire clan.

name: Woodborn Behemoth
text: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Beacon of Immortality
text: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

name: Borderland Ranger
text: "There's only one route from Kessig into Stensia. Unless you come with me."

name: Jungle Barrier
text: Within silent clearings guarded by living palisades, the natural world guards its most precious secrets.

name: Zealous Persecution
text: "Rejoice! Your vile blood will help fulfill our righteous cause."

name: Jungle Shrine
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects: the creative sun, the sustaining sun, and the destructive sun.

name: Blatant Thievery
text: Centuries of association with the Sun Empire have taught the dinosaurs that shiny things are important.

name: Concentrate
text: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

name: Changeling Wayfinder
text: No map. No complaints.

name: Shimmercreep
text: It lurks near the borders, harvesting loose threads of wild magic where the planes meet.

name: Sting-Slinger
text: "The first step is to wuzzle the buzzers."

name: Chomping Changeling
text: The knight was irritated when her rations went missing and truly baffled when her weapons started disappearing too.

name: Personify
text:
"I found myself wishing I could run away and start anew. That's when I saw those yellow eyes."
—Yenn, kithkin nomad

name: Revenge of Ravens
text: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again. Her familiars quickly granted his request.

name: Faerie Guidemother
text: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

name: Blow Your House Down
text:
"You think these walls will protect you? My, you have a dim view of the power of the wilds."
—Marawen, barrow witch

name: Bonecrusher Giant
text: Not every tale ends in glory.

name: Flutterfox
text:
"The white fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
text: "Courage is the only shield I need."

name: Fortifying Provisions
text: "To the king, to the Circle, and to the realm! And to not dying."

name: Mad Ratter
text: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

name: Merchant of the Vale
text: "Buying old, worn-out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

name: Giant Killer
text: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
text: A dwarf's grudge runs deeper than the mountains' roots.

name: Edgewall Innkeeper
text: "Warmth. Safety. A fully-stocked larder. You'll find nothing like Edgewall Keep in the wilds, I promise you that!"

name: Fierce Witchstalker
text: While the realm has laws, in the wilds there are other ways of balancing power.

name: Keeper of Fables
text:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Oakhame Adversary
text: The elves remember every secret path from the days when they ruled the realm.

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Hushbringer
text: "Let's begin this conversation again, and this time you will only listen."

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

name: Grumgully, the Generous
text: "Does it matter what it is? Take it and be grateful!"

name: Maraleaf Pixie
text: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.

name: All That Glitters
text: A faerie's glee at her trove quickly fades to contentment, then to boredom, then to an urge to steal more.

name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
text: "Until my last breath, I will defend the realm."

name: Deathless Knight
text:
"Headed to the wilds? Beware the dead riders who serve the Shadow Queen."
—Scalan, Edgewall innkeeper

name: Lucky Clover
text: Syr Branigan always remembered to kiss his good luck charm, having lost his foot to wolverines the last time he forgot.

name: Signpost Scarecrow
text:
"Accursed scarecrow! Sending folk in every direction is the same as sending them nowhere at all."
—Corliss the Wanderer

name: Sorcerer's Broom
text:
"Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies. The fae king smiled."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Stonecoil Serpent
text: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

name: Witch's Oven
text: The wafting smells are both scrumptious and suspicious.

name: Castle Garenbrig
text: Without Garenbrig's strength, the realm would succumb to the wilds.

name: Shepherd of the Flock
text: Not all heroes carry swords.

name: Bonecrusher Giant
text: Not every tale ends in glory.

name: Curious Pair
text: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

name: Silverflame Squire
text: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
text: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

name: Thorn Mammoth
text: It will come to the defense of all wild things, from the shivering wren to the towering giant.

name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
text: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
text: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: True Love's Kiss
text:
"Be careful, dear. Some people deserve their curses."
—Marawen, barrow witch

name: Gadwick, the Wizened
text: His name is spoken only in whispers—but he hears just the same.

name: Bartered Cow
text: At the market, no one heeded Hilda's frantic mooing. The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.

name: Tome Raider
text: "Humans are so forgetful. Every page I steal becomes a secret they can't remember."

name: Wishful Merfolk
text: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

name: Witching Well
text: It was built by the Witch of Lochmere. Most of the wishes it grants are its own.

name: Bake into a Pie
text: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

name: Barrow Witches
text:
"Taste the sweetness, breath for breath. Keep the balance, death for death."
—Barrow witch incantation

name: Cauldron Familiar
text: Every day the cat returns to kill the same mouse, which sinks again into the cauldron's brew.

name: Epic Downfall
text: The dragon had a lot of things going through his mind that day. He didn't expect a sword to be one of them.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Prowling Pangolin
text: "Wait, are *we* the decoys?"

name: Sengir Autocrat
text: "The penalty for idleness is death. The penalty for disputing the penalty is death."

name: Skulking Ghost
text:
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow guildmage

name: Urborg Uprising
text: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: True power is achieved through blood and sweat. But mostly blood.

name: Wake of Vultures
text:
"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'"
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

name: Battle Squadron
text: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

name: Flame Jab
text:
"Fire's out. Should be safe now."
—Gnarltrunk

name: Honden of Infinite Rage
text: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.

name: Kird Ape
text: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

name: Humble
text: Through failure we learn our finest lessons in humility.

name: Orcish Oriflamme
text: The orcs' banner sends a clear message: "Stand against us and meet the same fate as the goblins."

name: Price of Progress
text: Enthusiasm can be tempered in the furnace of the earth.

name: Seismic Stomp
text:
"It is not in me to tread lightly."
—Ryda, geomancer

name: Wildfire Emissary
text:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, vizier of Amiqat

name: Ancestral Mask
text: "I pass to you all we have ever been. Go forth and become all we never could."

name: Commune with the Gods
text: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.

name: Fog
text:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

name: Nimble Mongoose
text: One thread connected all the travelers' stories: the ferocity of the mongoose.

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Seal of Strength
text: When does majestic become ominous?

name: Timberwatch Elf
text: "If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."

name: Armadillo Cloak
text: "Don't laugh. It works."

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Flame-Kin Zealot
text: Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.

name: Goblin Trenches
text:
"Even if we dislodge them, I fear these lands will never again yield crops."
—Kimmick, vanguard knight

name: Ashnod's Altar
text:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

name: Emmessi Tome
text: It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.

name: Millikin
text: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

name: Rally the Peasants
text:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"Find the dens of evil and flood them with light."
—Hulo, the Penitent Wanderer

name: Ballynock Cohort
text: A kithkin's worst enemy is solitude.

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Gaseous Form
text:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Coalition Honor Guard
text: Giving little thought to their own defense, they carried the flag that united their army.

name: Memory Lapse
text: What a lonely agony, the memory of memories lost.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: "You can't learn to enjoy life's amusements in the pages of books. You must seek them out in earnest."

name: Serendib Efreet
text: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

name: Sprite Noble
text: "By thorn and by stone, we will fight to see the day when beauty returns to this world."

name: Tidal Wave
text:
"The floor of the sea is paved with the shattered remnants of vessels that navigated its surface unwelcomed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Annihilate
text:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

name: Blightsoil Druid
text: "See the beauty in death: the clean white bones lying in the fertile soil and the brightly colored moonglove sprouting from the fell earth."

name: Deadbridge Shaman
text: Ending her life won't end the infestation.

name: Duress
text:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

name: Eyeblight's Ending
text:
"Those without beauty are Lorwyn's greatest tumor. The winnowers have an unpleasant duty, but a necessary one."
—Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana

name: Havoc Demon
text: A cry of pain as it enters this world. A chorus of screams as it leaves.

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Thraben Foulbloods
text: The famed hunting hounds of House Cecani continue to prove the quality of their pedigree.

name: Weirded Vampire
text:
"Emrakul makes apparent those whom she has favored."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Alchemist's Greeting
text:
"Impressive."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Brazen Wolves
text: With fewer patrols about, Kessig's roads have become prime hunting grounds.

name: Prophetic Ravings
text: "Keep your herons and shrews! You will find nothing in the moon, for the moon is a lie! It has told me so!"

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Backwoods Survivalists
text: Paranoia has driven some Kessig communities to hunt down anything—and anyone—that travels through their woods.

name: Crossroads Consecrator
text: "May the steel of your blade match the steel in your soul."

name: Hamlet Captain
text: "Bloodsuckers, howlers, monsters from the beyond . . . it doesn't much matter. I won't have to face them alone."

name: Noose Constrictor
text:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

name: Campaign of Vengeance
text:
"There is no saving this world, not anymore. But we shall be its bloody vengeance."
—Sorin Markov

name: Gisa and Geralf
text:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

name: Mercurial Geists
text:
"Procedural misstep: provocation of geists for the purpose of yielding more energy can compromise containment units. Next action: clean up mess."
—Laboratory notes

name: Nephalia Academy
text:
"May knowledge be our sanctuary."
—Yora, academy researcher

name: Faithbearer Paladin
text:
"I've seen cathars riding to battle without a hint of fear. Perhaps that is its own sort of madness."
—Esler, Havengul mercenary

name: Peace of Mind
text: Not all minds touched by the Eldrazi turn to raging psychosis. Some simply withdraw from this world into memories of a better one.

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Thalia's Lancers
text: "Let the points of our lances lead the way."

name: Thraben Standard Bearer
text: The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

name: Contingency Plan
text:
"Improvisation is for those who failed to prepare."
—Jace Beleren

name: Convolute
text:
"There's no sense arguing with insanity."
—Levana, Midnight Duelist

name: Displace
text: "I'll see you soon, Subjects 25 and 26. I've got a good feeling this time!"

name: Enlightened Maniac
text: "At last! Proof that it's not all in my head!"

name: Laboratory Brute
text: It keeps intruders out and experiments in.

name: Turn Aside
text:
"There are tides beyond those in the sea that are driven by Innistrad's silver moon. If you learn their patterns, you can channel them in fascinating ways."
—Tamiyo

name: Unsubstantiate
text:
"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess

name: Boon of Emrakul
text: All around Emrakul, life re-formed in her image.

name: Certain Death
text: Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
text: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

name: Escape Tunnel
text: No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.

name: Biomechan Engineer
text: "Life is a pattern, not a material."

name: Codecracker Hound
text: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

name: Cryogen Relic
text: Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.

name: Inside Out
text: Seyden's temperament didn't take well to the puca's magic. Nor did his face.

name: Noggle Bandit
text: Noggles believe that they were the first race ever to walk Shadowmoor. They don't "steal." They just take back what's rightfully theirs.

name: Recumbent Bliss
text: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

name: Spitemare
text:
"I knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom. Any attempt to leash or exploit it failed, and at terrible cost."
—Ashling

name: Springjack Shepherd
text: "Better for a doun to lose its cenn than its springjacks."

name: Gilder Bairn
text: Do the glowing trinkets show it the way home, or do they set a twisted path for someone else to follow?

name: Slippery Bogle
text: Bogles are very tasty if you can get the skin off. It's getting a blade on them that's the problem.

name: Scarecrone
text: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

name: Cenn's Enlistment
text: The more the scarier.

name: Raven's Crime
text: It plucks away memories like choice bits of carrion.

name: Soul Snuffers
text: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

name: Hatchet Bully
text: "It's not much for eating, but I think we can find somethin' to do with it."

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Stigma Lasher
text: The Extinguisher's curse lasted long after her departure.

name: Bloom Tender
text: Beauty is a seed, waiting to blossom under her capable hands.

name: Savage Conception
text: Some beasts are born not of a mother, but of magic.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Bloodied Ghost
text:
"Only a knife left for a fortnight in the hollow of a ghastbark tree can inflict a wound so grave."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Unmake
text: A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.

name: Spellshock
text: A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.

name: Crashing Boars
text: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

name: Elven Palisade
text:
"Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Skyshroud Elite
text:
"Civilization is a conspiracy to disguise the mutilation of nature."
—Skyshroud elite creed

name: Wood Elves
text: Secure in the embrace of wood, they want no part of Eladamri's war.

name: Erratic Portal
text: "In Barrin's name!" cried Lyna as Hanna's sword passed through her, "Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!"

name: Reconnaissance
text: War favors the informed.

name: Equilibrium
text: In Rath, there are only so many souls to go around.

name: Fade Away
text:
"Consider the fable of the greedy herder. As her flock grew, so did her weariness; she slept, and the sheep wandered off."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Killer Whale
text: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

name: Mana Breach
text: The wizard had it all—until she tried to use it.

name: Treasure Trove
text: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents over sleeping children.

name: Cursed Flesh
text: A farewell to arms . . . and feet . . . and legs . . . .

name: Onslaught
text: The last thing to go through the mogg's mind was its teeth.

name: Pandemonium
text:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Price of Progress
text: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

name: Sabertooth Wyvern
text: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.

name: Helpful Hunter
text:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

name: Clinquant Skymage
