text: Despite their advanced intellect, some aven never quite shake their instinctive need to collect shiny baubles.

name: Mischievous Mystic
text: "Don't worry about where they're taking me. The more pressing question is, why aren't they taking you?"

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Gnorl and Vurg knew all too well how much dragons liked to eat goblins, but they had a dream that could not be dampened: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

name: Seize the Spoils
text: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"Our state-of-the-art laboratories have been stripped of bothersome safety measures."
—Radula, Simic biomancer

name: Infernal Vessel
text: "Rise, my liege! Rise, and blanket the world in eternal night!"

name: Vampire Gourmand
text: "He asked me if I wanted to come in for a bite to eat. Who am I to turn down a stranger's kindness?"

name: Bulk Up
text: Norf would win the arm-wrestling contest this year, at any cost.

name: Goblin Negotiation
text: Either you pay for Krenko's "protection" or you pay to replace your stall. Either way, you pay.

name: Searslicer Goblin
text: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

name: Gore Swine
text:
"The Mardu are like the gore swine. We are wild, hunt in packs, and rarely clean the blood from our blades."
—Vallash, Mardu warrior

name: Humble Defector
text:
"You were once Mardu, so your body and will are strong. Now we must train your mind."
—Houn, Jeskai elder

name: Lightning Shrieker
text: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.

name: Pyrotechnics
text:
"Take inspiration from your enemies, and make their strengths your own."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

name: Abzan Beastmaster
text: His beasts move the great siege towers of the Abzan across the endless sands.

name: Destructor Dragon
text: After countless attacks on the Salt Road where it passes through the frozen tundra, the Abzan began to refer to the area as Atarka territory rather than Temur lands.

name: Feral Krushok
text: In a stunning act of diplomacy, Yasova Dragonclaw ceded a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai. Her clan protested until they saw she had given the Sultai the breeding grounds of the krushoks. They hadn't realized she had a sense of humor.

name: Great-Horn Krushok
text: Perfectly suited for life in the Shifting Wastes, the krushok is well protected by its horn, its hide, and its temper.

name: Frontier Mastodon
text: Each bronze disk on its harness is an offering from a young Temur hunter, a sign of respect to the spirits of the wild.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Temur Sabertooth
text: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

name: Ethereal Ambush
text: The energies of the Temur lands are readily unleashed upon intruders.

name: Grim Contest
text: The invader hoped he could survive the beast's jaws and emerge through its rotting skin.

name: Silumgar, the Drifting Death
text:
"No machinations, no puppet strings, no plots. Just pure, sweeping death."
—Tasigur, the Golden Fang

name: Monastery Mentor
text: "Speak little. Do much."

name: Pressure Point
text: By studying dragon anatomy, Jeskai monks have learned how to locate clusters of nerves that will incapacitate even the mightiest dragons.

name: Soul Summons
text: Ugin's magic reaches beyond the dragons. The clans have adapted it for war.

name: Jeskai Sage
text: "The one who conquers the mind is greater than the one who conquers the world."

name: Refocus
text: "Before you can open your third eye, you must prove you can open the first two."

name: Alesha's Vanguard
text: Boundaries drawn on maps or marked with stone have no meaning for the Mardu.

name: Ancestral Vengeance
text: The defenses of the Abzan extend well beyond the walls of their fortresses.

name: Douse in Gloom
text: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle. He failed to notice the Sultai leader's cruel smile.

name: Merciless Executioner
text: He enjoys his work, for he sees only the worst Abzan criminals: those who betray their own kin.

name: Noxious Dragon
text: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

name: Orc Sureshot
text: "Words have yet to halt an arrow."

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Defiant Ogre
text: "I have no clan, but I still have purpose."

name: Fierce Invocation
text: Anger can empower those who embrace it.

name: Magus of the Moon
text: Tidal forces of the blood moon wrench and buckle the land, drawing monoliths of stone and soil toward the flaming orb.

name: Magus of the Moat
text: "The spirits of the mythic ones ever circle their beloved keep, forbidding entry to all who come with the heavy tread of hate."

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Force of Savagery
text:
"Life cannot be created and then abandoned. It must be nurtured and fed so that it may express its ripened might."
—Freyalise

name: Heartwood Storyteller
text: His roots reach deep, nurtured not by soil and rain, but by millennia of experience.

name: Magus of the Vineyard
text: Battered and beaten by years of salt and claw, he never ceased to walk, and to seed. Only now, in this time of rebirth, do his seeds take root.

name: Wrap in Vigor
text: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
text: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

name: Glittering Wish
text: She wished for gold, but not for the strength to carry it.

name: Akroma's Memorial
text:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

name: Cloud Key
text: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

name: Dryad Arbor
text:
"Touch no tree, break no branch, and speak only the question you wish answered."
—Von Yomm, elder druid, to her initiates

name: Lumithread Field
text: Having conquered the Bastion of Suns, the Ota took its light for their own.

name: Augur of Skulls
text: Within each empty skull, it seeks ways to preserve its own failing undeath.

name: Stronghold Rats
text: In the stronghold's dungeons, the shadows hide in the vermin.

name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
text: There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.

name: Scatter the Seeds
text: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

name: Gelectrode
text:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Boros Elite
text:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

name: Daring Skyjek
text: "The hard part isn't landing in the saddle. The hard part is leaping before you see it."

name: Bomber Corps
text: "Subtlety is for lawmages and spies."

name: Boros Reckoner
text:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Martial Glory
text:
"Yes, Boros tactics are unparalleled. But when your comrades are dying around you, inner strength must carry the day."
—Gideon Jura, to Aurelia

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Azorius Herald
text:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

name: Debtors' Knell
text: One moment, conscious only of a sense of repose. The next moment, hearing the trudge of his own footsteps. He sighed and squinted into the glare ahead.

name: Rakdos Cackler
text: Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Wasteland Viper
text:
"The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society."
—Teysa Karlov

name: Burning-Tree Emissary
text: Those who regard the Gruul as savage simpletons underestimate the subtle power of their shamans.

name: Highcliff Felidar
text: Once the felidar has marked you as prey, there's no point in running.

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Earthshaker Giant
text: "Come, my wild children. Let's give the interlopers a woodland welcome."

name: Maeve, Insidious Singer
text: Her haunting tune drowns out the percussion of snapping masts.

name: Bushmeat Poacher
text: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

name: Supernatural Stamina
text:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Hydrolash
text:
"I don't need your mage-rings or your mana equations. I call, and the sea answers."
—Keyta, rebel hydromancer

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Bombard
text:
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Filigree Familiar
text:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: Each time it is sent to find a safe haven, it takes longer to return.

name: Dune-Brood Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it spawned nameless thousands to herald its arrival.

name: Ink-Treader Nephilim
text: When it awoke, the mirrors of the world reflected only darkness.

name: Witch-Maw Nephilim
text: When it awoke, it shattered the hillsides to make way for its passage.

name: Yore-Tiller Nephilim
text: When it awoke, the worms of the earth hissed in a chorus of beckoning.

name: Orzhova, the Church of Deals
text: Unlike most churches, at Orzhova it's best to pray before you arrive.

name: Spelltithe Enforcer
text: His assistants calculate the amount of the tribute. He measures out the punishment for delinquency.

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: To Arms!
text:
"The call came, spell-borne through mortar and stone to the ear of every soldier. The call came, and the advantage was ours."
—Lodusz, captain of the watch

name: Ghostway
text:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Tin Street Hooligan
text: "Rauck-Chauv's like a holiday! Only it isn't on the calendars, and instead of dancing you knock people flat, and instead of giving gifts you break stuff."

name: Blade Instructor
text: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."

name: Goblin Locksmith
text:
"He's got more finesse than most goblins. He smashes windows with his fist rather than his forehead."
—Arrester Polgar

name: Lava Coil
text:
"Commander, we caught the Dimir spy and took her ashes into custody."
—Kramm, Wojek security officer

name: Sure Strike
text: "I packed three more electroconduits into each test wand. You'll experience a brief tingling sensation."

name: Torch Courier
text: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.

name: Wojek Bodyguard
text: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

name: Affectionate Indrik
text: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Circuitous Route
text:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"The Dimir may look all they want. We never grow tired of swatting their bugs."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Kraul Foragers
text:
Feed on food, you eventually rot. Feed on rot, you live forever.
—Kraul saying

name: Pack's Favor
text: Selesnya grows its ranks in more ways than one.

name: Healer's Hawk
text: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

name: Prey Upon
text:
"Light up the dark to find your way, and the dark may seek you out."
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

name: Siege Wurm
text: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.

name: Boros Challenger
text: "Send your champion. I could use a light workout."

name: Camaraderie
text:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Emmara, Soul of the Accord
text: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."

name: Intrusive Packbeast
text: Good at carrying things. Really good at knocking them down.

name: Hammer Dropper
text: Giants know a solid hit is one part strength, four parts leverage.

name: Hypothesizzle
text:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

name: Join Shields
text: "We are the shield that never breaks, the bough that never burns, the song that can never be silenced."

name: Ochran Assassin
text: "The dagger is just a distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."

name: Rosemane Centaur
text: "I long for peaceful times, when I may tend to my garden instead of our borders."

name: Thought Erasure
text: "It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"Something's causing electrospheric disruption in the blazekite's spire-vanes. Find the cause, and tell them to keep it up!"
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

name: Boros Guildgate
text:
"The more trust breaks down, the more we must throw open the front gates."
—Aurelia

name: Dimir Guildgate
text:
"Every guild dreads infiltration. I should know—I've been a member of all of them."
—Lazav

name: Gateway Plaza
text: The Chamber of the Guildpact stands as a reminder that even the bitterest struggles can end in cooperation.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text:
"Shut the gates. In the Underrealm we will outlast the coming doom."
—Vraska

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text:
"Everyone who crosses that threshold is our most cherished friend. Everyone who crosses it again is our bitterest enemy."
—Trostani

name: Candlelight Vigil
text: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the conclave can.

name: Chemister's Insight
text: "My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."

name: Citywatch Sphinx
text: All those who trade in questions must answer to the Dimir.

name: Leapfrog
text:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Collar the Culprit
text:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Vedalken Mesmerist
text: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."

name: Wishcoin Crab
text:
"What wishes do they grant? Mostly pinching-related ones."
—Omik, superintendent of waterworks

name: Bartizan Bats
text:
"Bats are welcome to eat thousands of my pets. I have multitudes more that will ultimately eat the bats."
—Izoni

name: Dead Weight
text: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.

name: Mephitic Vapors
text: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

name: Dawn of Hope
text:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

name: Never Happened
text: Dimir assassins have the precision to slay a single memory.

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Severed Strands
text: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

name: Barging Sergeant
text: "Don't stop till your horns come out their back."

name: Cosmotronic Wave
text: "This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."

name: Electrostatic Field
text:
"It's both an ingress-denial mechanism and an attractive hallway light!"
—Daxiver, Izzet electromancer

name: Moon-Eating Dog
text: The most nimble of creatures, it chases the most sacred luminence.

name: Ancestor Dragon
text: It is said that Yinglong gave birth to the qilin and the phoenix, and after them, all the hairy and winged beings in the world. Thus it is known as the Ancestor Dragon.

name: Cloak of Mists
text: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

name: Dragon's Presence
text:
"The Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds, amid shattering mountains and sundering earth."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Brilliant Plan
text: A heaven-sent vision is like a lantern to guide the way.

name: Leopard-Spotted Jiao
text: This strange beast has the hide of a leopard, the howl of a dog, and the horns of an ox.

name: Ferocious Zheng
text: Known for their glowing horn and stone-rattling roar, zheng are the fiercest predators in the forest. Few survived before Jiang Yanggu came.

name: Purple-Crystal Crab
text: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

name: Aggressive Instinct
text:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Cleansing Screech
text: "Crackle" and "pop" are the most wondrous sounds.

name: Welkin Tern
text: It stops flying only as its life comes to an end.

name: Nine-Tail White Fox
text: It has waited a millennium just for you, and for a millennium will it watch over your descendants.

name: Mugging
text: Scream: muffled. Pockets: emptied. Neck function: never the same again.

name: Biovisionary
text: He tired of his fellow researchers and their useless prattling, so he decided to make a network of scholars with whom he could carry a conversation.

name: Kingpin's Pet
text:
"Debt and death sound so similar, and thrulls are so hard of hearing. Mistakes are inevitable."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Illusionist's Bracers
text: It's easy to believe you're a god when you're twice as powerful as everyone else.

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Syndic of Tithes
text:
"Entrance is free. Donations are required."
—Notice outside Vizkopa Bank

name: Thrull Parasite
text: The hunger of a vampire and the subtlety of a tax collector.

name: Undercity Informer
text: "Scandal and slander are never welcome news. That's why I'm never the messenger."

name: Heartstone
text:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Strike It Rich
text: A few coins soon grow into an obsession.

name: Door to Nothingness
text:
"All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality. You will die, and no one will mourn."
—Memnarch

name: Nuisance Engine
text: All Auriok children know the tale, "Bolgri and the Long Day of Squashing."

name: Suntouched Myr
text: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

name: Incremental Blight
text: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Mage Slayer
text:
"When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do."
—Kresh the Bloodbraided

name: Khenra Scrapper
text: "There is no tomorrow, so hold nothing back."

name: Djeru's Renunciation
text:
"I was promised an afterlife, not this. Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Beneath the Sands
text: Though buried and muffled, nature's whisper still called to Nissa.

name: Bitterbow Sharpshooters
text:
"Remember, brother, the eyes are always vulnerable."
"I never forgot."

name: Feral Prowler
text: Once favored companions, many cats were left to fend for themselves.

name: God-Pharaoh's Faithful
text: "This is the final trial! Rejoice, for the God-Pharaoh soars among us!"

name: River Hoopoe
text:
"It's a cruel thing to give such a sad song to such a colorful creature."
—Sana, former Ahn-crop initiate

name: Sunset Pyramid
text: Decades to build. Hours to demolish.

name: Survivors' Encampment
text: "What will happen to us?" they asked. The vizier paused. "I think . . . I think that's up to us now."

name: Zealot of the God-Pharaoh
text: The God-Pharaoh's most devoted took it upon themselves to follow his example.

name: Strategic Planning
text:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

name: Striped Riverwinder
text: The denizens of the Luxa River woke angry on the currents of blood.

name: Crested Sunmare
text:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

name: Lethal Sting
text: Initiates once believed defeat was the worst fate possible—a sentiment they quickly abandoned.

name: Marauding Boneslasher
text: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

name: Ruin Rat
text: From every shadow came the dull scratch of teeth on bones.

name: Scrounger of Souls
text: Yell for help, and that may answer.

name: Torment of Hailfire
text: "Your God-Pharaoh has returned."

name: Torment of Venom
text: The Scorpion God's sting sends venom strong enough to poison blood, bone, and spirit.

name: Blur of Blades
text: Samut battled her way through the hordes, shouting the names of those who'd died in her crop and those she hoped yet to save.

name: Disposal Mummy
text: Without the viziers to oversee their actions, some anointed went to extreme lengths to fulfill their directives.

name: Firebrand Archer
text: A word of vengeance, and her arrows awaken in flame.

name: Frontline Devastator
text: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

name: Granitic Titan
text:
"That one's not mine. Run!"
—Nissa Revane

name: Inferno Jet
text: "When the whole world is crazy, it's important to find something you can rely on."

name: Suffocating Fumes
text:
"Yesterday it was flying tigers and crumbling bridges. Who knows what today will bring?"
—Dol, Lavabrink quartermaster

name: Unexpected Fangs
text:
"With the frequent mutations, predator-prey relationships seem to change every moment. I already like it here."
—Vivien Reid

name: Flame Spill
text: Fragile, floating Skysail suddenly seemed like an appealingly safe place to live.

name: Exuberant Wolfbear
text: Sometimes the *eludha* is a sacred harmony of souls. Sometimes the bonder grabs some fur and holds on tight.

name: Imposing Vantasaur
text: Raugrin's coastline can be quite beautiful, as long as you avoid the volcanic dinosaurs, the sea dinosaurs, and the roaming beach dinosaurs.

name: Ram Through
text:
"Need a medic! And some stonemasons!"
—Wyllon, Drannith merchant

name: Sudden Spinnerets
text:
"What's natural on Ikoria continues to delight me."
—Vivien Reid

name: Wilt
text: Nothing returns from the nightmare nests of Indatha unscathed.

name: Eerie Ultimatum
text:
"The ground under our feet is a record of every slight against the world, to be avenged at a time of its choosing."
—Gavi, nest warden

name: Bonders' Enclave
text: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

name: Ketria Triome
text: Nowhere on Ikoria are monsters more integral to the landscape than Ketria, where the river itself will stand up and roar.

name: Neutralize
text: On Ikoria, reactive magic can make the difference between barely grazed and really dead.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Blood Curdle
text: Fear pierces the strongest armor.

name: Grimdancer
text: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.

name: Heartless Act
text:
"It's them or us."
—General Kudro

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

name: Rakdos Drake
text: Rakdos rioters paint their faces to resemble the drakes' bloodied muzzles.

name: Rune-Scarred Demon
text: The litany of the infernal on his flesh pulses to the beating of his dark heart.

name: Wrench Mind
text: What is the sound of one head snapping?

name: Anger of the Gods
text: There was no reason to pray. This was already an act of the gods.

name: Benevolent Ancestor
text: Although the door is flimsy and the lock pathetically small, Josuri's family never fears the night outside.

name: Dragon Egg
text: Dragon birth lairs are littered with treasure to entice the young from their eggs.

name: Fireball
text: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

name: Urabrask the Hidden
text: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

name: Vent Sentinel
text:
"Zendikar fortifies itself against the Great Threat, making sentries of sky, sea, and stone."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Crowned Ceratok
text: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

name: Greater Basilisk
text: Bone, stone . . . both taste the same to a hungry basilisk.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Dragon Bell Monk
text: He has spent years training his eyes and ears to detect the subtle signs of a dragon's approach.

name: Jugan, the Rising Star
text: The light of the rising star empowers the champions of tomorrow.

name: Lure
text: It makes the insignificant conspicuous, the repulsive alluring, and the deadly irresistible.

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Wildsize
text: Two times the size, four times the smell.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Rosheen Meanderer
text: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Moonglove Extract
text: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

name: Guided Strike
text:
"May the Ancestor strengthen my hand and guide my blade."
—Nomad war prayer

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Iona's Judgment
text: Beneath the gaze of angels, only the righteous may stand without fear.

name: Yosei, the Morning Star
text: The caress of the morning star frees all from the clutch of darkness.

name: Amass the Components
text: "I knew I'd find a use for all that newt spittle!"

name: Bewilder
text:
"Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken. Silly, yes, but exactly the thing we needed to break the stifling tension."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Condescend
text: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

name: Diminish
text: Everything seems a little less ferocious when it's running from a house cat.

name: Doorkeeper
text: One piercing stare usually convinces thieves to go elsewhere.

name: Angel of Mercy
text: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

name: Jace's Phantasm
text: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"It augments anamnesis. What is so confusing about that?"
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Riverwheel Aerialists
text: Adepts of the Riverwheel Stronghold can run through rain and never get wet; masters use the raindrops as stepping stones.

name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
text: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

name: Thought Scour
text:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Bala Ged Scorpion
text: Fast and lethal, with a penchant for the weak and infirm.

name: Butcher's Glee
text: The Crave made Kneecleaver think she was bigger than the dragon.

name: Child of Night
text: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

name: Dead Reveler
text: He's the unlife of the party.

name: Auriok Champion
text: Mirrodin's deepest caverns conceal its brightest hopes.

name: Festering Newt
text: Its back bubbles like a witch's cauldron, and it smells just as vile.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Killing Wave
text: "Try again in the next life, darling."

name: Village Rites
text: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

name: Subjugator Angel
text: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Blood Artist
text:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

name: Butcher Ghoul
text: Without a mind, it doesn't fear death. Without a soul, it doesn't mind killing.

name: Phyrexian Battleflies
text: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

name: Phyrexian Infiltrator
text:
"It is Yawgmoth's will incarnate: an efficient machine that replaces inefficient flesh."
—Tsabo Tavoc

name: Obliterate
text: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

name: Shivan Harvest
text:
"The blood of your ancestors ran heavy on this soil. Now it's your turn to sacrifice for the glory of Shiv."
—Viashino heretic

name: Elvish Champion
text:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Skyshroud hymn

name: Tangle
text: Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

name: Whip Silk
text: Llanowar forges weapons of steel. Yavimaya grows her weapons within.

name: Angelic Shield
text:
"If only an angel's wings could shelter us all."
—Barrin

name: Aura Shards
text: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

name: Backlash
text: Darigaaz decided his foe would be more useful as a weapon.

name: Pledge of Loyalty
text: Urza convinced many Dominarians not only to set aside their differences, but to embrace them.

name: Tsabo Tavoc
text: "I might almost pity my enemies—if it wasn't so amusing to watch them die."

name: Vile Consumption
text: The plague moved faster than an army and was far more deadly.

name: Yavimaya Barbarian
text: Not all elves embrace the pastoral life. Some still roam the forest's edge, forever making war against their hated enemies.

name: Chromatic Sphere
text:
"Let insight and energy be your guides."
—The Blind Seer, to Gerrard

name: Juntu Stakes
text:
"Those who can't survive are of no consequence."
—Tsabo Tavoc

name: Planar Portal
text: The sky split, and the air crackled and roiled. The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria had finally begun.

name: Power Armor
text:
"Great peril demands formidable weaponry."
—Urza

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: A beacon of hope for a battered army.

name: Urborg Volcano
text: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

name: Dream Thrush
text: Whether for good or ill, their arrival always means change.

name: Empress Galina
text: "Above the waves you may be mighty indeed, but down here you belong to me."

name: Vodalian Hypnotist
text: "Deceit is the heart of war."

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Balefire Dragon
text: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Travel Preparations
text: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

name: Invisible Stalker
text: "All that concerns me is the vampires' sense of smell and those freezing Nephalian nights."

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Rooftop Storm
text:
"Let those idiot priests tremble! A new era in unlife begins here and now. Oglor, raise the lightning vane!"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Diregraf Ghoul
text:
"At least this one still has arms and legs. Well, most of its legs."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Blessed Defiance
text: "If I'm going, I'm taking you with me!"

name: Chittering Rats
text: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

name: Arms Dealer
text:
"Guaranteed to leave your enemies sufficiently stabbed, bitten, cleaved, or exploded."
—Grezkrick's Emporium motto

name: Go for Blood
text: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Not since the days of Pashalik Mons have the Rundvelt goblins been so united or effective.

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Krenko's Command
text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

name: Take Up the Shield
text: "You are all part of my pride. As long as I live, I will protect you."

name: Plagon, Lord of the Beach
text: "No more lurking in the shallows. We ride!"

name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
text: To cross swords with her is a shockingly bad idea.

name: Crimson Wisps
text: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

name: Shroofus Sproutsire
text: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

name: Renegade Tactics
text: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
text: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
text: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

name: Witch of the Moors
text: Many hands for many evils.

name: Exquisite Blood
text: Even as humans regained the upper hand, some still willingly traded their lives for a chance at immortality.

name: Spiteful Prankster
text: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

name: Cinder Elemental
text:
"The old gods awoke and sent fingers of fire to see what was left of the old ways under the endless city."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

name: Release the Dogs
text: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

name: Stone Haven Pilgrim
text: The persistence to overcome obstacles is the most esteemed of kor virtues.

name: Supply Runners
text: Good dogs stay by your side until the end. Great dogs leave to bring back aid.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"The land has its own intentions, beyond the understanding of those who live on it."
—Nissa Revane

name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
text: It is the soul of a philosopher who died of starvation contemplating the universe.

name: Bassara Tower Archer
text: Setessan warriors of Bassara Tower are known for their guerrilla tactics and skill with the bow. Interlopers into the Nessian Wood do not get far.

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Lagonna-Band Trailblazer
text: Go forth with honor, return with glory.

name: Dakra Mystic
text: Choices are rarely as simple as they seem.

name: Dictate of Erebos
text: "I take no pleasure in your suffering, but it is necessary. Once you accept your fate you'll find eternity more tolerable."

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
text: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.

name: Swelter
text: No circle has a beginning, but many have foreseeable ends.

name: Harvester Druid
text: "In the end, the same soil lies atop the field, within the mountain, and under the sea."

name: Serene Sunset
text: The armies paused, silent, as the warriors reflected on the sunsets of their youth.

name: Unquestioned Authority
text:
"Only the Ancestor should be revered."
—Mystic heretic

name: Valor
text:
"The cracks widened, the shell crumbled, and Valor spread throughout the land."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Mental Note
text: Some minds are more open than others.

name: Benevolent Bodyguard
text: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

name: Web of Inertia
text: Cephalids specialize in lose-lose situations.

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Filth
text:
"As the portal closed, Filth oozed through. The stench of evil followed it in."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Arcane Teachings
text: Dwarves may teach at the speed of stone, but their results are solid.

name: Chastise
text:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

name: Dwarven Bloodboiler
text: His battle cry unleashes an avalanche of dwarves.

name: Flaring Pain
text:
"I don't rub salt in wounds. I use sulfur."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Commander Eesha
text: "War glides on the simplest updrafts while peace struggles against hurricane winds. It is the way of the world. It must change."

name: Jeska, Warrior Adept
text: "My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge. Kamahl has a temper of fire. I have a temper of steel."

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Ghostly Flicker
text: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: Poison-Tip Archer
text: "One more step and you're mine."

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Vengeful Reaper
text: "Starnheim is closed to you, coward."

name: Axgard Cavalry
text:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

name: Broken Wings
text:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—*Saga of the Wisdom Seeker*

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
text: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

name: Guardian Gladewalker
text: The raiders' only warning was a whisper floating through the mist: "Trespassers."

name: Jaspera Sentinel
text: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.

name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
text: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

name: Narfi, Betrayer King
text: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

name: Vega, the Watcher
text: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

name: Cosmos Elixir
text: The Skoti owe their immortality to the elixir, and the manner of its creation is their most closely guarded secret.

name: Barkchannel Pathway
text:
"Listen! The trees tell tales of their ancestors in the whisper-song of leaves."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

name: Blightstep Pathway
text:
"The waters smell oddly sweet, but do not be enticed. You don't want to meet what lurks below the surface."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior

name: Darkbore Pathway
text:
"Hush, and stay still. No matter how dreary the darkness, a light in the Skelle Mire is never a good sign."
—Haugar, Kannah wayfinder

name: Hengegate Pathway
text:
"I cannot read these runes, yet somehow they seem like a warning. Have we passed unknowingly into a new realm?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator

name: Rimewood Falls
text:
"For a fortnight, our warband lay still beneath the icy waters, breathing through reeds as we waited for the great bear to appear."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Shimmerdrift Vale
text: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

name: Woodland Chasm
text:
"Is this the grave of a god? A tunnel carved by the Cosmos Serpent? It matters not. It is no place for us."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

name: Starnheim Aspirant
text: "I do not fear death. I know my soul will rise to Starnheim, where I will feast forever among valkyries and heroes. Can you say the same?"

name: Warchanter Skald
text: "Who will be the hero of my tale?"

name: Youthful Valkyrie
text: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

name: Behold the Multiverse
text: Countless worlds unfolded before Niko, every one in need of heroes.

name: Cyclone Summoner
text: Frost giants study for centuries in isolation, honing their ability to harness elemental mayhem.

name: Clarion Spirit
text: To the living, the horn sounds faint and mournful, but to the spirits of Istfell, it is a thunderous call that must be obeyed.

name: Mistwalker
text:
"To escape Littjara, follow a bird."
—Tuskeri folklore

name: Demonic Gifts
text: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

name: Acrobatic Maneuver
text: Renegades find ever more creative ways to work around the Consulate's aether regulations.

name: Subtle Strike
text: Renegades do some of their best work right under the Consulate's nose.

name: Tidy Conclusion
text: Aetherborn patrons use any means necessary to secure victory for their protégés.

name: Weaponcraft Enthusiast
text:
"No, I don't believe they have the proper permits for those, but I'm not going to be the one to ask."
—Caru, Consulate warden

name: Built to Smash
text: Free from Consulate regulations, renegade-built automatons push performance to the limit.

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

name: Giant Spectacle
text: The giant-decorating contest at the migration festival is a tradition that may have started as a dare.

name: Reckless Fireweaver
text: Architects find inspiration in the dragon's beauty of form, while artificers are influenced by the function of its fire.

name: Renegade Tactics
text: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

name: Ruinous Gremlin
text: City officials once sent twenty gleaming automatons to exterminate a nest of gremlins. They soon saw the error of their ways.

name: Salivating Gremlins
text: If an elf can dream it, a dwarf can build it, and a gremlin can eat it.

name: Fairgrounds Warden
text: "You're coming with me."

name: Wayward Giant
text:
"The giants follow the flow of aether, and twice a year it leads them through here. Lesson learned. More clearance is needed."
—Sram, senior edificer

name: Fragmentize
text:
"Too much friction on your bearings, your countersinking is inconsistent, and there are lines in your casting. Dispose of it, and begin again."
—Dovin Baan

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Blossoming Defense
text: Those who move harmoniously with the flow of aether can channel the power of the natural world.

name: Commencement of Festivities
text: Never before have there been so many brilliant minds and wondrous inventions in one place. Denizens from every corner of Kaladesh will flock to the once-in-a-lifetime Inventors' Fair.

name: Creeping Mold
text: Sanctions, mandates, regulations . . . These things mean nothing to the natural world.

name: Larger Than Life
text:
"They say Head Judge Tezzeret will be reviewing every invention at the Fair. I made sure to build something that will stand out."
—Jehvani, Vahadar artificer

name: Nature's Way
text: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

name: Peema Outrider
text: Connected as artificer and invention, bonded as rider and steed.

name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
text: "Shine bright, bolts tight."

name: Take Down
text: The drake flew true. The arrow flew truer.

name: Contraband Kingpin
text: "Don't waste my time with trifles. Bring me works of art, and I will make you rich."

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Veteran Motorist
text: He's set to compete in every race at the Fair, and he plans to win them all.

name: Aetherflux Reservoir
text: While most power is used for ordinary, everyday tasks, one shouldn't underestimate its potential for the extraordinary.

name: Aerial Responder
text: Dwarves have an instinct for repair, an inherent understanding of how systems work, and a reputation for fearlessness. They're perfect candidates for the Fair's emergency response team.

name: Dukhara Peafowl
text: Elegant filigree birds perch along the eleven bridges that cross Canal Dukhara.

name: Fabrication Module
text: Inspiration leads to design.

name: Foundry Inspector
text: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
text: The Consulate keeps watch at each of the eleven bridges to ensure that the market remains a haven for commerce, not for con artists.

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Perpetual Timepiece
text: Do not be so caught up in keeping track of time that you forget to make use of it.

name: Prakhata Pillar-Bug
text: Not a mote of dust escapes the dutiful cleaners that keep the exclusive Prakhata Club immaculate.

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Refurbish
text:
"There's no reason to buy a new one when I've got the tools to fix the one you've got."
—Ripu, repair specialist

name: Terrain Elemental
text:
"You tread upon the land all the time, yet you seem dismayed when it moves to step on you."
—Nissa Revane

name: Aether Tradewinds
text: Consulate engineers have developed safe methods of harvesting aether, but renegades aren't always so careful.

name: Curio Vendor
text: "Step right up! Try your hand! It'll thrill the senses and boggle the mind!"

name: Failed Inspection
text: The most dangerous thing an artificer can do is believe an invention is perfect.

name: Authority of the Consuls
text: Citizens are free to do as they wish, within the confines of the Consulate's laws.

name: Weldfast Wingsmith
text: "Airships are too confining. If I'm in the sky, I want to feel the wind in my hair and taste the aether."

name: Built to Last
text: Consulate-built automatons have a lifetime warranty.

name: Wind Drake
text: Drakes prowl the skies of Kaladesh, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

name: Ambitious Aetherborn
text: Aetherborn who are unwilling to accept the decomposition of their bodies invent ways to preserve and augment themselves.

name: Die Young
text: "When the time comes, let go. Nothing lasts forever."

name: Dukhara Scavenger
text: The teeth marks add character.

name: Essence Extraction
text: The "gifted" among the aetherborn can draw the life essence of other living beings into themselves.

name: Fretwork Colony
text: The swarm leaves behind a flawless pattern that only occasionally threatens the structural integrity of the wood.

name: Lawless Broker
text: Kaladesh's illicit marketplaces are known as "night markets," but if you know who to ask, you can find what you're looking for at any time of the day.

name: Prakhata Club Security
text: It's rare that the Prakhata Club closes its doors. It's also rare that Lord Gonti meets with Consul Kambal. What are the odds the two would occur on the same day?

name: Rush of Vitality
text: Short lives lead to forbidden choices.

name: Abzan Battle Priest
text: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

name: Feat of Resistance
text: Dragons are extinct on Tarkir, but Abzan magic still emulates their endurance.

name: Barrage of Boulders
text: Crude tactics can be effective nonetheless.

name: Bloodfire Expert
text: Some efreet abandon their homes in the volcanic Fire Rim to embrace the Jeskai Way and discipline their innate flames.

name: Bring Low
text:
"People are often humbled by the elements. But the elements, too, can be humbled."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

name: Canyon Lurkers
text: The broken Qal Sisma foothills make poor terrain for cavalry, but a perfect setting for ambushes.

name: Goblinslide
text: Goblins, like snowflakes, are only dangerous in numbers.

name: Firehoof Cavalry
text: "What warrior worth the name fears to leave a trail? If my enemies seek me, let them follow the ashes in my wake."

name: Leaping Master
text: "Strength batters down barriers. Discipline ignores them."

name: Mardu Warshrieker
text:
"No body can contain so much fury. It reminds me of another battle, long past."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Swift Kick
text: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

name: Valley Dasher
text: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.

name: Alpine Grizzly
text: The Temur welcome bears into the clan, fighting alongside them in battle. The relationship dates back to when they labored side by side under Sultai rule.

name: Dragonscale Boon
text:
"When we were lost and weary, the ainok showed us how to survive. They have earned the right to call themselves Abzan, and to wear the Scale."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

name: Feed the Clan
text: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.

name: Hooting Mandrills
text: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

name: Kin-Tree Warden
text: "The amber of the tree and the blood of my veins are the same."

name: Sagu Archer
text: His arrows whistle like a serpent's hiss.

name: Woolly Loxodon
text: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

name: Abzan Guide
text: "These roads are desolate and changeable. Follow me, or die in the wastes."

name: Armament Corps
text: The Abzan avoid extended supply lines by incorporating weapons stores into their battle formations.

name: Bear's Companion
text: "The Sultai came hunting for a bear hide. Now I have a belt of naga skin, and my friend has a full belly."

name: Mardu Hordechief
text: The horde grows with each assault.

name: Highspire Mantis
text: Its wings produce a high-pitched, barely audible whirring sound in flight. Only Jeskai masters are quiet enough to hear one coming.

name: Kin-Tree Invocation
text: The passing years add new rings to the tree's trunk, bolstering the spirits that dwell within.

name: Mantis Rider
text: Mantis riders know their mounts owe them no allegiance. Even a mantis ridden for years would consume a rider who loses focus for only a moment.

name: Mardu Roughrider
text: The most ferocious saddlebrutes lead the assault, ramming through massed pikes and stout barricades as if they were paper and silk.

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Sultai Soothsayer
text: The naga of the Sultai Brood made deals with dark forces to keep their power.

name: Utter End
text:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Warden of the Eye
text: The wardens guard the sacred documents of Tarkir's history, though they are forbidden to read the words.

name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
text: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

name: Seeker of the Way
text: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

name: Siegecraft
text:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Frontier Bivouac
text:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

name: Mystic Monastery
text: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: War Behemoth
text:
"The Houses always hope for peace, but we always pack for war."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar commander

name: Ainok Bond-Kin
text: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

name: Cancel
text:
"Even the greatest inferno begins as a spark. And anyone can snuff out a spark."
—Chanyi, mistfire sage

name: Clever Impersonator
text:
"Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment."
—Narset, khan of the Jeskai

name: Embodiment of Spring
text: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.

name: Scion of Glaciers
text:
"There is nothing so free as the spring river born of winter's ice."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

name: Set Adrift
text: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Bitter Revelation
text:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

name: Disowned Ancestor
text: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.

name: Krumar Bond-Kin
text: "The Abzan replaced my savagery with a noble heritage. I would give my life for my House."

name: Murderous Cut
text: The blades of a Sultai assassin stab like the fangs of a dragon.

name: Rakshasa's Secret
text: The voice of a rakshasa is soft, its breath sweet. But every word is the murmur of madness.

name: Rite of the Serpent
text:
"From your death, new life. From your loss, our profit."
—Kirada, Qarsi overseer

name: Shambling Attendants
text:
"Let the world behold what becomes of those who defy us."
—Taigam, Sidisi's Hand

name: Unyielding Krumar
text: "The man whom I call father killed the orc who sired me, offering his world and his blade in return."

name: Ainok Tracker
text: Some ainok of the mountains are accepted among the Temur as trusted hunt-mates.

name: Arrow Storm
text: First the thunder, then the rain.

name: Azure Fleet Admiral
text:
"Your concern for my safety is touching, but as long as your gunners remain reliably erratic, I see no reason to change course."
—Admiral Yelise, to Commodore Axurik

name: Distant Melody
text: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Farseek
text: Her song twines throughout the Core, a melodic message to all Oltec near and far: you are home.

name: Canopy Vista
text: Chuuy Kaaj, "The Hanging City," has endured for centuries as the thriving hub of Malamet art, life, and culture.

name: Ancestors' Aid
text:
"You surface-dwellers may have forgotten your history, but it has not forgotten you."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Sunshot Militia
text: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.

name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
text: "If we are to protect this world, we can no longer hide within it!"

name: Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar
text: "Invaders in the West Chasm? Give me an hour and they'll be fungus food."

name: Dauntless Dismantler
text: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

name: Wirewood Channeler
text: "Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."

name: Ward Sliver
text: The first wave of slivers perished from the Riptide wizards' magic. The second wave shrugged off their spells like water.

name: Dreamborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Keeper of the Nine Gales
text: "You cannot fight the storm."

name: Riptide Director
text: Those who lead others to wisdom become the wisest themselves.

name: Shifting Sliver
text: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

name: Blood Celebrant
text:
"Their blood is the nectar that nourishes the Cabal."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Crypt Sliver
text:
"Death couldn't contain the slivers. What made us think we could?"
—Riptide Project researcher

name: Drinker of Sorrow
text: It strikes at your soul, heedless of your prayers.

name: Noxious Ghoul
text: Plague and death wrapped in one convenient package.

name: Spectral Sliver
text:
"Sure, I've seen agents of the Cabal here and there. Well, not here, and certainly not in any of the sliver labs. Oh dear, I've said too much."
—Apprentice researcher

name: Toxin Sliver
text: It doesn't need to use its venom—it just needs you to know it can.

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Blade Sliver
text: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria—much to the dismay of life on Otaria.

name: Goblin Assassin
text: The more victims he kills, the more likely he is to get the right one.

name: Footbottom Feast
text: The scent of rot and vinegar fills the marsh, inviting boggarts from every warren to reunite and feast.

name: Hunter of Eyeblights
text: Snokk ran as fast as he could, but the sound of hooves grew ever louder in his ears.

name: Skeletal Changeling
text: Though they lack true flesh and bone of their own, changelings imitate either with equal ease.

name: Fire-Belly Changeling
text:
"My ears say it hisses. My fingers say it burns."
—Auntie Wort

name: Giant's Ire
text: The only feeling greater than hurling something a mile is crushing something else with it that was really, really irritating you.

name: Needle Drop
text:
"First it was plovers and mulldrifters. Now it's knitting needles the size of javelins."
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Incremental Growth
text:
"Tie a mouse under a bridge, and your cabbages will triple in size."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Seedguide Ash
text: "May you shade three generations of seedlings."

name: Woodland Changeling
text: Changelings cannot resist the draw of a new shape, even if doing so would be in their best interests.

name: Doran, the Siege Tower
text: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

name: Dolmen Gate
text: Lorwyn's stones resonate with the place from which they were hewed. Though taken far, still they call to their home when silence is upon the land.

name: Runed Stalactite
text: When a changeling adopts a form no other changeling has taken, a rune appears in the caverns of Velis Vel to mark the event.

name: Springleaf Drum
text: After trying mudskippers for an afternoon, Scratch decided that crickcarp made the best noise.

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
text: Paradoxically, to tilt the massive jug for a sip, you'd need the energy of the giant's tonic.

name: Ancient Amphitheater
text: The arbiter Galanda Feudkiller judges Lorwyn's squabbles from a lofty perspective.

name: Gilt-Leaf Palace
text: Dawn's Light, greatest palace of Gilt-Leaf Wood, is built on tiers of wood and power.

name: Wanderwine Hub
text: Below the great river, a bustling hub channels the flow of merrow trade.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Oblivion Ring
text: A circle of sugar and a word of forbiddance.

name: Shields of Velis Vel
text: Changelings can alter shape based on what the beings around them desire most.

name: Avian Changeling
text: Today it flies with the flock. Tomorrow it may wake to find them gone, its body in an unfamiliar form.

name: Veteran of the Depths
text: In the backwaters of the Merrow Lanes lie stones scarred with tallies of countless generations, each representing a victory of merrow soldiers.

name: Wizened Cenn
text: "Thoughtweft binds us together as one, part of an intricate pattern that would unravel if even one thread came loose."

name: Familiar's Ruse
text: Because of their capricious nature, faeries can serve as living lenses for disruptive magic.

name: Forced Fruition
text:
"Petals within petals within petals, tadpole. The truth lurks below an opulence of illusion."
—Neerdiv, fallowsage

name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
text: "We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."

name: Shapesharer
text: One good mimic deserves another.

name: Silvergill Douser
text: The Silvergill school monitors traffic on the Lanes, ensuring that the riffraff don't interfere with travelers.

name: Turtleshell Changeling
text: A changeling involuntarily mimics the nearest being at hand, sometimes trading a borrowed shell for borrowed claws.

name: Hypnotic Specter
text: Its victims are known by their eyes: shattered vessels leaking broken dreams.

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Burning Inquiry
text: Jariad burned the midnight oil, burned through scroll after scroll, and then burned down his laboratory.

name: Lurking Predators
text: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

name: Howling Mine
text: The mine's riches never end, nor do the moans of the spirits doomed to haunt them.

name: Undead Slayer
text: "My motive is not vengeance but mercy. I deliver the soulless back to their severed souls."

name: Fabricate
text:
"I'm one masterpiece away from ruling this pathetic world."
—Saldrath, master artificer

name: Jump
text:
"Humanity has always envied the power of flight. So we took it."
—Scytha, aeromage

name: Bog Wraith
text: She died in this swamp, and so will you.

name: Liliana's Caress
text: "This might hurt less if you don't fight so hard. But I doubt it."

name: Liliana's Specter
text:
"The finest minions know what I need without me ever saying a thing."
—Liliana Vess

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Pyretic Ritual
text: The Multiverse is filled with limitless power just waiting for someone to reach out and seize it.

name: Garruk's Packleader
text:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Hornet Sting
text: It was only then—to his infinite sorrow—that Gork realized hornets don't make honey.

name: Elixir of Immortality
text:
"Bottled life. Not as tasty as I'm used to, rather stale, but it has the same effect."
—Baron Sengir

name: Sword of Vengeance
text: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

name: Triskelion
text:
"Why do bad things always come in threes?"
—Gisulf, expedition survivor

name: War Priest of Thune
text: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

name: Demon of Death's Gate
text: The locks on the cages of the damned are opened with keys of marrow, sinew, and blood.

name: Sorin's Vengeance
text: "Cherish these last moments. Though your miserable life has come to nothing, I have given it a magnificent end."

name: Goblin Grenade
text: Don't underestimate the aerodynamic qualities of the common goblin.

name: Dungrove Elder
text: All the trees of the forest are his army, and every leaf his shield.

name: Jade Mage
text:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Crown of Empires
text:
"With this crown, assert your authority."
—Crown inscription

name: Kite Shield
text:
"To my sword I owe my glory, but to my shield I owe my life."
—Sarlena, paladin of the Northern Verge

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Stonehorn Dignitary
text: It did not escape the ambassador's notice that the sound of war drums could also marshal the city to attention.

name: Timely Reinforcements
text: The gods are not always kind, but they do have a soft spot for plucky underdogs.

name: Jace's Archivist
text: "This is a sacred duty. Master Beleren's trust has bought an eternity of my loyalty."

name: Public Execution
text: Though the executioner did not speak, the villagers got the message.

name: Mindclaw Shaman
text: Nicol Bolas gives power to those who will abuse it most.

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Boundless Realms
text:
"Planeswalking cannot be taught. Either you see the doors or you do not."
—Nissa Revane

name: Sentinel Spider
text:
"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

name: Healer of the Pride
text: "No life is without meaning. No living thing is too small to be strong."

name: Clock of Omens
text: Most clocks measure time, but a few measure everything.

name: Odric, Master Tactician
text: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

name: Battle of Wits
text: There is no loftier ambition than the pursuit of knowledge.

name: Battleflight Eagle
text: Eagles make fine mounts, but they're too proud to carry anyone for long.

name: Talrand's Invocation
text: After Talrand conquered the depths of Shandalar, his ambitions drove him skyward, joined by servants whose drive and curiosity equaled his own.

name: Molten Birth
text:
"Few can coax the creatures within the magma to be cooled and take form."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Regathan Firecat
text: It stalks the Regathan highlands, leaving behind melted snow, scorched earth, and the charred corpses of would-be temple robbers.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Kalonian Hydra
text: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

name: Manaweft Sliver
text:
"I see in their interconnectedness a strange embodiment of the natural order."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Hive Stirrings
text: Sliver young are sorted into clutches according to their potential and their future role. Human scholars can only guess how those are determined.

name: Millstone
text: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

name: Angelic Accord
text: As demons are drawn to suffering, angels are drawn to acts of benevolence.

name: Sentinel Sliver
text: Through its watchful gaze, all slivers may see.

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Bogbrew Witch
text: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

name: Divine Favor
text: With an armory of light, even the squire may champion her people.

name: Nightfire Giant
text: Nightfire turns the greatest weakness of the undead into formidable strength.

name: Rotfeaster Maggot
text: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

name: Shadowcloak Vampire
text: "My favorite guilty pleasure? Are there innocent ones?"

name: Typhoid Rats
text: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

name: Act on Impulse
text: "You don't want to know what happens after I put on the goggles."

name: Blastfire Bolt
text:
"Encase yourself in the most elaborate armor, and cower behind the heaviest shield. I would hate for you to feel helpless."
—Korig the Ruiner

name: Forge Devil
text: A bit of pain never hurts.

name: Foundry Street Denizen
text: After the Foundry Street riot, Arrester Hulbein tried to ban bludgeons. Which, inevitably, resulted in another riot.

name: Goblin Kaboomist
text: Designed by Stone Librande

name: Goblin Roughrider
text: Astride the bucking creature, Gribble hurtled down the mountainside while his Grotag brethren cheered. It was at that moment that the legend of the Skrill Tamer was born.

name: Inferno Fist
text: "I've never been above throwing the first punch."

name: Krenko's Enforcer
text: He just likes to break legs. Collecting the debt is a bonus.

name: Miner's Bane
text: There are certain stones even dwarves know to leave in the earth.

name: Wall of Fire
text: Mercy is for those who keep their distance.

name: Marked by Honor
text: Stand your post for duty. Stand your ground for honor.

name: Carnivorous Moss-Beast
text: Ranger wisdom dictates that when fleeing from a moss-beast, you must stay calm, find your bearings, and run south.

name: Genesis Hydra
text: Designed by George Fan

name: Hunter's Ambush
text: First you lose your enemy's trail. Then you lose all sense of direction. Then you hear the growls . . .

name: Meditation Puzzle
text: Find your center, and you will find your way.

name: Ranger's Guile
text:
"You don't survive in the wild by standing in plain sight."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Restock
text: What looked like a retreat was actually a replenishing.

name: Runeclaw Bear
text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

name: Venom Sliver
text:
"We attacked with arrows dipped in poison. The slivers that did not die began to change."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Yisan, the Wanderer Bard
text: Designed by Brian Fargo

name: Sliver Hivelord
text:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

name: Hot Soup
text:
"Comin' through!"
Designed by James Ernest

name: Oreskos Swiftclaw
text:
After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos. She found that they were quick to take offense, not because they were thin-skinned, but because they were always eager for a fight.
—*The Theriad*

name: Ornithopter
text: Once a year, the skies over Paliano fill with the flying machines of those who hope to be taken on as pupils by the artificer Muzzio.

name: Soulmender
text: "Healing is more art than magic. Well, there is still quite a bit of magic."

name: Amphin Pathmage
text:
"There are those who do not believe in the existence of the amphin. This seems somehow to be of their own design."
—Gor Muldrak, *Cryptohistories*

name: Chasm Skulker
text: Designed by Mike Neumann

name: Chronostutter
text: Timing is everything.

name: Ensoul Artifact
text: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Invisibility
text: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

name: Military Intelligence
text: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

name: Constricting Sliver
text: Slivers are often seen toying with enemies they capture, not out of cruelty, but to fully learn their physical capabilities.

name: Mind Sculpt
text:
"Your mind was a curious mix of madness and genius. I just took away the genius."
—Jace Beleren

name: Accursed Spirit
text: Many have heard the slither of dragging armor and the soft squelch of its voice. But only its victims ever meet its icy gaze.

name: Black Cat
text: Its last life is spent tormenting your dreams.

name: Crippling Blight
text:
"Still alive? No matter. I'll leave you as a warning to others who would oppose me."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

name: Hired Blade
text: "If you want them dead, buy some poison. If you want them to have the worst day of their life before dying, then let's talk price."

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Skeleton Archer
text:
"When it comes to killing with precision, a soul is but a hindrance."
—Isareth the Awakener

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Alpine Moon
text:
"A rare and fascinating phenomenon."
—Tamiyo

name: Fire Elemental
text: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

name: Goblin Instigator
text: "We can take 'em. You go first!"

name: Goblin Motivator
text: Small words stoke large flames.

name: Goblin Trashmaster
text: "Folks 'round here are too in love with their contraptions. Does them some good if we smash one every so often."

name: Inspired Charge
text:
"Impossible! How could they overwhelm us? We had barricades, war elephants,... and they were barely a tenth of our number!"
—General Avitora

name: Onakke Ogre
text: The ogres you know are nothing like the Onakke. Possessing both intellect and industry, they had brute strength without being brutish.

name: Shock
text: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

name: Smelt
text: The creation of new weapons demands the destruction of others.

name: Sparktongue Dragon
text: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

name: Tectonic Rift
text:
"You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"
—Ash Kronor, Keldon warlord

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

name: Bristling Boar
text:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid

name: Centaur Courser
text:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

name: Daggerback Basilisk
text: Its ventricles weep venom, and it consumes only poison.

name: Druid of the Cowl
text: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

name: Knight of the Tusk
text: "Horse? Who needs a horse?"

name: Gigantosaurus
text:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

name: Gigantosaurus
text:
「歯の一本一本が馬ほどの長さで、新しい歯が16日おきに生えてくるの。もっと近くで見てみましょう。」
――ビビアン・リード

name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
text: You don't want to know how she got that name.

name: Greenwood Sentinel
