text: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

name: Naturalize
text:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

name: Thornhide Wolves
text:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Titanic Growth
text: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

name: Vine Mare
text: When it passes, the dead are displaced by flourishing life.

name: Draconic Disciple
text: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."

name: Satyr Enchanter
text: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."

name: Diamond Mare
text: When it passes, rainbows follow.

name: Fountain of Renewal
text: Entrepreneurs have attempted to sell the water, but to no avail. Whatever magic it contains disappears upon bottling.

name: Meteor Golem
text: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

name: Millstone
text: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

name: Skyscanner
text: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: All the books were dusty with disuse, save the one titled *Camouflage and Its Practical Applications*.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.

name: Mighty Leap
text: "I feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh in the Second Sun, and I rise upon its rays."

name: Silverbeak Griffin
text: A pair of domesticated griffins escaped from captivity a century ago. Now the skies are filled with the songs of their descendants.

name: Novice Knight
text: Even the greatest hero begins with nothing.

name: Nexus of Fate
text: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.

name: Befuddle
text: "The trick to talking sense into Keldons is getting them to hold still."

name: Grasping Scoundrel
text: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

name: Llanowar Elves
text: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

name: Pegasus Courser
text: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

name: Star-Crowned Stag
text: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

name: Take Vengeance
text: "Your death will be a balm, your passing a welcome revision, and all will sigh with peace to know of your demise."

name: Anticipate
text: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

name: Divination
text: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

name: Essence Scatter
text: Dependence on luck is anathema to Kefnet's rigorous studies. Those who hope to escape his maze by chance never succeed.

name: Frilled Sea Serpent
text:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

name: Ajani's Welcome
text: "You cannot defend others if your own well-being is neglected."

name: Mirror Image
text: The life of a shapeshifter is one of constant change.

name: Psychic Corrosion
text:
"To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death. It is a terrifying power."
—Jace Beleren

name: Sleep
text:
"I give them dreams so wondrous that they hesitate to return to the world of the conscious."
—Garild, merfolk mage

name: Snapping Drake
text: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

name: Uncomfortable Chill
text: The cold slowed their movements until only their panicked eyeballs swiveled beneath the ice.

name: Epicure of Blood
text: "Fleshy, with just a hint of leather. A fine vintage."

name: Murder
text:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Rotting Regisaur
text:
"Now, *that's* a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
text: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

name: Dragon Mage
text:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

name: Disenchant
text: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

name: Marauding Raptor
text:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

name: Scorch Spitter
text:
"Yes, she can be a nuisance. But at least my tea never gets cold."
—Marlan Farthwald, innkeeper

name: Unchained Berserker
text: Sathros turned his restraints to revenge.

name: Overcome
text:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

name: Season of Growth
text: "Awake, and lift your faces to the sun."

name: Shared Summons
text:
"In times of need, the forest creates its own protectors."
—Vivien Reid

name: Vorstclaw
text: Las raíces más profundas a veces alcanzan cosas que sería mejor no despertar.

name: Empyrean Eagle
text: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

name: Kethis, the Hidden Hand
text: "The pen is mightier than the crown."

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Risen Reef
text:
"No, not 'washed' ashore. It *walked* ashore."
—Shafring Hulm, beachcomber

name: Skyknight Vanguard
text: "Jump! NOW!"

name: Manifold Key
text:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

name: Savage Gorger
text: "I have no patience for sipping blood from crystal goblets. I want to bite and tear."

name: Thirsting Bloodlord
text: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

name: Pacifism
text: "Can't a fella get a moment's peace around here?"

name: Bogstomper
text:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

name: Nimble Birdsticker
text: "What goes up must get stuck."

name: Volcanic Dragon
text:
"That's no ordinary eruption!"
—Grazlash Stonehold, last words

name: Woodland Mystic
text: "I sing to the branches, and they reach to the sky. I sing to the leaves, and they open to the sun. I sing to the roots, and they dig their fingers deep. I sing the song that creation sung."

name: Cloudkin Seer
text: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

name: Metropolis Sprite
text: "Well, if that goblin didn't want his tongue pierced, he shouldn't have stuck it out at me."

name: Scholar of the Ages
text: "I study the past to find hope for the future."

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Bishop of Wings
text: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."

name: Audacious Thief
text: "Skill, imagination, smarts: none of it matters unless you have the nerve to use it."

name: Bladebrand
text: "One knife, two knives, three knives, four—which will drop you to the floor?"

name: Blightbeetle
text: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.

name: Brought Back
text:
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
text: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

name: Bone Splinters
text:
"I will make your bones into a weapon that will lay even the mighty low."
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

name: Basri's Solidarity
text:
"The will to fight and act as one is not limited to a single world. Oketra's teachings are universal."
—Basri Ket

name: Gloom Sower
text:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—*The Tragedy of Morein*

name: Liliana's Devotee
text: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

name: Peer into the Abyss
text:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Rise Again
text:
"I love those who are eager to serve."
—Liliana Vess

name: Goblin Wizardry
text: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

name: Havoc Jester
text: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Feline Sovereign
text: Dogs beg. Cats lay claim.

name: Hunter's Edge
text: The hunt ends. Lunch begins.

name: Invigorating Surge
text: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
text: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

name: Llanowar Visionary
text: The elves of Llanowar look to their past to determine the shape of their future.

name: Quirion Dryad
text:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

name: Alpine Watchdog
text:
"On the eighth day, a blizzard hit. Supplies were lost, and morale plummeted. On the ninth day, Dover found us."
—*To the Summit: A Tale of Survival*

name: Conclave Mentor
text: "I have faith in your potential."

name: Griffin Aerie
text: When griffins started nesting atop the northern tower, the castellan worried they'd be a nuisance. Instead, they took the entire castle under their protection.

name: Obsessive Stitcher
text: No one is as dedicated to perfection as a stitcher working on their latest masterpiece.

name: Animal Sanctuary
text:
"No owners allowed."
—Sanctuary sign

name: Fabled Passage
text: From here, the path to anywhere may be found.

name: Radiant Fountain
text:
"All peoples treasure a place where the weary traveler may drink in peace."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Pack Leader
text: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

name: Rambunctious Mutt
text: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

name: Storm Caller
text: He became elder shaman when his predecessor was mysteriously struck by lightning on a cloudless day.

name: Wildwood Patrol
text: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

name: Speaker of the Heavens
text: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

name: Valorous Steed
text: A unicorn chooses only the most virtuous and noble of knights to be its companion.

name: Vryn Wingmare
text: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

name: Shipwreck Dowser
text: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

name: Tide Skimmer
text: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

name: Basri's Acolyte
text: Basri carries on his god's legacy, spreading her teachings throughout the Multiverse.

name: Tolarian Kraken
text:
"It's contemplative, resourceful, and original. Everything else aside, it's the perfect student."
—Naban, dean of iteration

name: Waker of Waves
text: On the open sea, there is nowhere to hide.

name: Bad Deal
text: There are still places where a smile and a handshake are all you need to seal a deal.

name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
text: His crew proudly maintains an accident rate of 100% per day.

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Poison Dart Frog
text:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

name: Sire of Stagnation
text: As the great scourge passed by, Zendikar shivered, then lay silent.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Brushland
text:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Silverquill Lecturer
text: "Did you bring enough to share with the rest of the class?"

name: Blot Out
text: After the invasion, many wanted to leave a life of violence. But once you're a Reckoner, you die a Reckoner.

name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
text: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
text: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

name: Accorder Paladin
text: "I fight for the suns, the surface, and everything in between."

name: Signal Pest
text: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

name: Training Drone
text:
"Vulshok flail, Viridian shield, loxodon blade . . . Tazzir, bring the Moriok hook and assemble the rookies."
—Vy Covalt, Neurok agent

name: Viridian Claw
text: "Phyrexians can't corrupt what they can't get close enough to touch."

name: Priests of Norn
text:
"May our blessings sever the tongues of the forsaken."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Corrupted Conscience
text: Karn's creation is now his master.

name: Phyresis
text:
"Perfection is at hand. You have been freed of weakness and made *compleat*."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Goblin Wardriver
text:
"A true warrior fights with whatever's handy."
—Qerk of the Secret Warren

name: Fangren Marauder
text:
"The fangren fight without comfort of any kind. We can ask no less of ourselves."
—Tilien, Sylvok partisan

name: Glissa's Courier
text:
"So, the survivors from Oxid Ridge are on the move. Let them come and witness predation in its purest form."
—Glissa

name: Melira's Keepers
text: Her warriors are the last defense against the coming storm.

name: Kemba's Legion
text: The squabble over succession was quickly replaced by the struggle to survive.

name: Thrun, the Last Troll
text: His crime was silence, and now he suffers it eternally.

name: Raise the Alarm
text: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

name: Alluring Scent
text: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

name: Talas Researcher
text:
From time, knowledge.
From knowledge, power.

name: Plague Engineer
text:
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Putrid Goblin
text: Too stupid to survive, too dumb to die.

name: Sling-Gang Lieutenant
text: Freshly promoted to "first rock," Zaz was eager to make an impact.

name: Smiting Helix
text: Malice is appropriate when vengeance is called for.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*

name: Warteye Witch
text: Eyeballs that portend unpleasant futures become slimy snacks instead.

name: Fists of Flame
text:
"Fire has always been my most faithful companion."
—Jared Carthalion

name: Geomancer's Gambit
text: Telepathy changes minds, necromancy changes lives, but geomancy changes the world.

name: Goblin Matron
text: A mother only a child could love.

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Goblin Oriflamme
text:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Impostor of the Sixth Pride
text: The tribe was as strong as his longing, their territory as vast as his isolation. The changeling knew he had found a home, and a form.

name: Shenanigans
text: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

name: Irregular Cohort
text: Where fickle form meets lasting loyalty.

name: Volatile Claws
text: Whether modeled after bear, bird, or baloth, all claws send the same message.

name: Collector Ouphe
text:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

name: King of the Pride
text:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Elvish Fury
text: Fail to respect the forest and you will fertilize it.

name: Force of Vigor
text: The vines overgrew the construct, snapping gears and soaking up aether.

name: Trumpeting Herd
text: An elephant never forgives.

name: Twin-Silk Spider
text: A forest-wide network of webs brings a hungry couple to captured prey.

name: Winding Way
text: Every path leads to discovery.

name: Cloudshredder Sliver
text: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

name: Unsettled Mariner
text: The call of the sea shapes many souls.

name: Arcum's Astrolabe
text: Though the Time of Ice has ended, its relics still slumber in New Argive.

name: Birthing Boughs
text: Changelings can't remember where they came from. They just know it wasn't a cradle.

name: Farmstead Gleaner
text: When it finishes the harvest, you'll have nowhere to hide.

name: Reprobation
text: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Segovian Angel
text: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

name: Settle Beyond Reality
text: Two taken, two judged, one returned.

name: Wall of One Thousand Cuts
text: Families of the fallen donate the swords of their loved ones to bolster the city's defenses.

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Dismantling Blow
text:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound, but do try to destroy it the first time."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Every choice is a joy."

name: Faerie Seer
text: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

name: Oneirophage
text: It manifests at wizard academies to siphon inspiration from young prodigies.

name: Pondering Mage
text: "Never leave the future to fate."

name: Windcaller Aven
text: Every cry lifts her allies toward the thunder.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: It has no respect for the deeds of martyrs, reducing their legacy to a mouthful of flesh.

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Graveshifter
text: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

name: Mind Rake
text: Spells of madness often require a sacrifice of sanity.

name: Underworld Hermit
text: Some souls yearn to escape death. Others are content to feed the wildlife.

name: Young Necromancer
text: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

name: Esper Sentinel
text: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

name: Faithless Salvaging
text: All that's left are broken beliefs.

name: Spreading Insurrection
text: Everyone wants to be on the winning side.

name: Tavern Scoundrel
text: "No refunds. I cheated you fair and square."

name: Fae Offering
text:
"Beware the gift when you do not know the giver."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Ignoble Hierarch
text: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

name: Jade Avenger
text:
"Froggy fighter at the gate.
Draw your sword and meet your fate."
—Traditional children's rhyme

name: Sanctum Weaver
text: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

name: Combine Chrysalis
text:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Garth One-Eye
text: A humble appearance belies a master's skill.

name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
text: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

name: Academy Manufactor
text: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

name: Nykthos Paragon
text: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.

name: Ornithopter of Paradise
text:
"Through even our darkest days, we must never cease creating. Each new invention brings value to the world, be it beauty, utility, or both."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

name: Rustvale Bridge
text: The path to strength is forged in stability.

name: Thornglint Bridge
text: The path to growth is forged in balance.

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

name: Gorilla Shaman
text:
"Frankly, destruction is best left to professionals."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

name: Arcbound Mouser
text: It doesn't purr. It hums.

name: Late to Dinner
text: Mood: A friendship that can outlast death.

name: Thraben Watcher
text:
"Fear not the angels' constant eyes,
E'er on watch from lightless skies;
Eternal vigil will we keep,
Protectors of the Blessed Sleep."

name: Gaea's Will
text: With every end, a new beginning.

name: Floodhound
text: The thief doubled back twice, doused herself with perfume, crossed the ocean, and still woke up with her pursuer close on her heels.

name: Hard Evidence
text: The investigator felt a pinch on his ankle. When he looked down, something glittered in the sand.

name: Bone Shards
text: In the Kathari dumping grounds known as the Boneheaps, its not hard to improvise an offense.

name: Marionette Apprentice
text: "Ah! Yes! I got its leg to twitch!"

name: Glimpse the Impossible
text: Gisela beheld true divinity, and was humbled.

name: Gift of the Viper
text: Ohran mages willingly endure the bites of vipers, believing the snakes bestow great power on those who survive their venom.

name: Ruby Medallion
text: It is the warm glow of the setting sun at journey's end, the scent of the evening meal crackling over a fire, and the cacophony of a raucous song shared over tankards of mead. It is freedom.

name: Metastatic Evangel
text: "I am no sleeper agent. I am a liberator. It is you who are asleep."

name: Emrakul's Messenger
text: "Obey her will! Don't be a fool! Submit your mind to Emrakul!"

name: Shadow of the Second Sun
text: Live fully, then return to the beginning.

name: Accursed Marauder
text: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

name: Drown in Dreams
text:
"Within our minds are limitless depths. Dive down, but don't forget to surface."
—Teferi

name: Zombie Apocalypse
text:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Novice Occultist
text: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.

name: Ardent Elementalist
text: While the Dawnhart witches focus their magic on nature and community, other covens consort with devils and twist the elements to their will.

name: Cathartic Pyre
text: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

name: Lunar Frenzy
text: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.

name: Clear Shot
text: As werewolf attacks increased, brutal weapons not seen since the Travails were dusted off and put to work.

name: Tovolar's Huntmaster
text: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

name: Overgrown Farmland
text: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

name: Search Party Captain
text: "Werewolves leave messy trails. Easy to follow. Hard to forget."

name: Geistwave
text: Necro-alchemists gained popular support during the Travails, when geist-fueled weapons helped defend towns against mad cultists and Eldrazi monstrosities.

name: Blood Pact
text: Griselbrand's defeat did not mark the end of the Skirsdag cult. They simply turned their worship to the next demon to emerge from the shadows bearing offers of power.

name: Dreadhound
text: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

name: Afterlife
text: Facets of life, reflections of the soul.

name: Cadaverous Knight
text:
Grieve for the soul in death dishonored.
—Shadow Guild saying

name: Dirtwater Wraith
text:
"The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Wall of Corpses
text:
"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."
—Kaervek

name: Burning Palm Efreet
text: Even the lion envies the lark.

name: Dwarven Miner
text:
"Fetch the pestridder, Paka—we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!"
—Jamul, Femeref farmer

name: Flame Elemental
text: Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.

name: Incinerate
text:
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'"
—Akin, seasoned askari

name: Kaervek's Torch
text:
The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Early Harvest
text:
"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Rampant Growth
text:
"I've never *heard* growth before."
—Gowon, Femeref herder

name: Zebra Unicorn
text:
"I'll capture gentle zebras / for your steeds and fill the stable with every kind of unicorn."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Ersatz Gnomes
text:
From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

name: Phyrexian Vault
text:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

name: Sacred Mesa
text:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Teremko Griffin
text:
"When we're aloft, I love to lean over the *Weatherlight*'s railing and watch the patterns the griffins' shadows make on the clouds below."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Boomerang
text: A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

name: Cerulean Wyvern
text:
"Once, a Quirion asked why I was so cautious when the day was clear. I told him of the sky-blue hide of the cerulean wyvern, and he offered me double if I could conjure a strong tailwind!"
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Dissipate
text:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

name: Floodgate
text:
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"
—Makht, goblin casualty

name: Suq'Ata Firewalker
text:
"Comfortable even in a furnace? I've never met one who'd accept my wager."
—Talibah, embermage

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Snarling Gorehound
text:
"I'd offer your dog a treat, but I'm afraid I don't have any appendages to spare."
—Alquist Proft, to Judith

name: Demand Answers
text: After the attempt on Aurelia's life, she gave the Agency an ultimatum: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

name: Pick Your Poison
text: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.

name: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole
text: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.

name: Rakdos, Patron of Chaos
text: "Finally, a performance worthy of my applause!"

name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
text: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Blades of Velis Vel
text: "The changing kind suffers as we do. We must join as one to quench our tyrants!"

name: Dragonsoul Knight
text: The farther he roamed from Jund and its dragons, the more he felt their essence in himself.

name: Goblin Fireslinger
text: A rock between your eyes hurts. A burning rock between your eyes ruins your whole day.

name: Gut Shot
text:
"Down here, we have a more pointed version of the scriptures."
—Urabrask's enforcer

name: Smash to Smithereens
text: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

name: Court Homunculus
text: Mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of servants in their retinues.

name: Bestial Menace
text:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Kozilek's Predator
text: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Thrive
text: The most successful of Simic creations is cytoplasm, a living, symbiotic substance that feeds off genetic rhythms and strengthens its host in return.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Ethercaste Knight
text: "We coat ourselves in steel every day. What is etherium but the next logical step?"

name: Swans of Bryn Argoll
text: Any being that harms them quickly learns its lesson.

name: Alloy Myr
text: With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.

name: Blinding Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for inscribing our souls with subservience, to reinforce the sacred order."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Copper Carapace
text:
"We will fight as they do: our flesh protected behind metal."
—Tae Aquil, Viridian weaponsmith

name: Frogmite
text: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

name: Darksteel Citadel
text: Structures built from darksteel yield to neither assault nor age.

name: Mirran Crusader
text: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
text:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Terashi's Grasp
text:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Cloud Elemental
text:
"The sky teems with just as much life as the forest or the deep seas."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Flashfreeze
text:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Hurkyl's Recall
text: Hurkyl's research at the College of Lat-Nam wasn't enough to stop the two brothers, but for centuries thereafter her spellcraft taught artificers restraint.

name: Somber Hoverguard
text: The vedalken interrogate all intruders—once the hoverguards are done with them.

name: Steady Progress
text: "More of that strange oil . . . It's probably nothing."

name: Thoughtcast
text: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

name: Vapor Snag
text:
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

name: Death Denied
text: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Dread Drone
text: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

name: Ghostly Changeling
text: In desolate places, changelings may take the shape of fancies, or memories, or fears.

name: Grim Affliction
text: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

name: Instill Infection
text:
"The results of our ninth inoculation were the same. The specimen was, of course, euthanized before the contagion could spread."
—Vedalken research notes

name: Nameless Inversion
text: Just as a changeling's influence can have dramatic effects, so too can its sudden withdrawal.

name: Plagued Rusalka
text:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

name: Arrest
text: Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Molten Rain
text: It came as a cruel answer to the farmers' prayers.

name: Rubblebelt Maaka
text:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Death-Hood Cobra
text:
"Size alone does not guarantee survival."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Gaea's Anthem
text:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Revive
text: Even what is lost beyond recall returns when coaxed by a dryad's hand.

name: Strength in Numbers
text:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Agony Warp
text: Life's circle has become inverted in Grixis. The same energy is endlessly recycled and becomes more stagnant with each pass.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Fiery Justice
text: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate, they tried a more internal approach to depose the pretender king.

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Pitfall Trap
text: Each spike is poisoned—the trapmaker's idea of mercy.

name: Rhox War Monk
text: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

name: Soul Manipulation
text:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Ranger of Eos
text: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

name: Tower Gargoyle
text:
"Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance."
—Tezzeret

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Gift of Orzhova
text:
"Remember by whose gift you ascend."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Sensor Splicer
text: With clarity of vision comes clarity of function.

name: Soul Warden
text: "One does not question the size or shape of the grains of sand in an hourglass. Nor do I question the temperament of the souls under my guidance."

name: Wake the Reflections
text:
"You see a bird, an oak, a packbeast. I see the potential for an army."
—Lalia, Selesnya dryad

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Eyes in the Skies
text:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

name: Spire Monitor
text: Each monitor is given an eye for each spire it is to guard.

name: Temporal Mastery
text: Time is a marvelous plaything.

name: Wall of Frost
text:
"I welcome it. The pasture is cleared of weeds and the wolves are frozen solid."
—Lumi, goatherd

name: Cower in Fear
text:
"You will fully understand fear when you discover it is the final thing you put your faith in."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
text: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

name: Mind Shatter
text: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

name: Pit Keeper
text: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

name: Recover
text: "Wisdom from the past is best gathered directly from the source."

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Dynacharge
text: Nothing evens the odds like a little lightning.

name: Goblin Assault
text: A goblin raid is a delicate gambit—a blend of stealth, precision, and screaming death.

name: Madcap Skills
text: The larger the crowd, the harder it is for them to run away.

name: Greater Mossdog
text: Man's best fungus.

name: Masked Admirers
text: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

name: Riftsweeper
text: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
text: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

name: Mind Funeral
text:
"The soul is only as eternal as I say it is."
—Sharuum the Hegemon

name: Aether Spellbomb
text:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

name: Paradise Mantle
text:
"It contains the wisdom of generations of our people. We permit only a chosen few to don the raiment."
—Imran, Viridian elder

name: Perilous Research
text: When the School of the Unseen fell, so many magical treasures lay abandoned that no amount of death could deter the stream of thieves and desperate scholars.

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Soothsaying
text: The vizier's wisdom proved invaluable in untangling the Mercadian knot of lies.

name: Trade Routes
text: Like the price of goods, the value of the routes was renegotiated daily.

name: Cackling Witch
text: The touch of his madness can drive anyone into a killing frenzy.

name: Primeval Shambler
text: His mind, like his body, is made up of the swamp's flotsam.

name: Sever Soul
text:
"With the proper tools, even the Great River can be dammed."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

name: Crossbow Infantry
text: The crossbow is the ideal weapon for the lazy Mercadians: just point and shoot.

name: Devout Witness
text: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

name: Vendetta
text: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

name: Arms Dealer
text: He has the weapons, he has the connections, and he knows the hangar's dark secret.

name: Cave-In
text: One fleet was gone; others were poised.

name: Ceremonial Guard
text:
"These guards are the most disciplined military unit in the city. They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline."
—Gerrard, to Sisay

name: Fountain Watch
text: The Cho-Arrim didn't rely only on a secret location to protect their Fountain.

name: Hammer Mage
text: When he's holding the hammers, everything looks like a nail.

name: Kyren Negotiations
text: Kyren goblins always speak in questions and never allow wrong answers.

name: Mercadia's Downfall
text: With an explosion that shook the foundation of the city, the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

name: Puppet's Verdict
text:
"What was heads again?"
—Mercadian magistrate

name: Ancestral Mask
text: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

name: Briar Patch
text: As easily as the dryads could close a fist, so could the branches and underbrush entangle.

name: Hunted Wumpus
text: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

name: Lure
text: Deepwood's reach is not long, so it invites its enemies in.

name: Saber Ants
text: They stay on the battlefield only long enough to consume the losers.

name: Last Breath
text: "The River flows. My soul returns."

name: Snake Pit
text:
If the ground is smooth, the way will be rough.
—Deepwood saying

name: Spidersilk Armor
text: It hardly weighs anything, but it takes all day to remove.

name: Crenellated Wall
text: Mercadian soldiers excel at finding things to stand behind.

name: Nightwind Glider
text: Once you learn to float on the shadows, you'll never fear them again.

name: Noble Purpose
text: Fighting for the right reason is itself a source of strength.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Trap Runner
text: "How could I catch her when the trees conspired to stop me?"

name: Coastal Piracy
text: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

name: Energy Flux
text: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

name: Rishadan Cutpurse
text:
The bigger the purse, the greater the fool.
—Rishadan saying

name: Rishadan Footpad
text: "The best things in life are free. Money, for instance."

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Graveshifter
text: "Why throw away a perfectly good identity?"

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"If their ears are to the ground, we will make them bleed!"
—Taklai, Kolaghan warrior

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Knights of the Black Rose
text: "Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!"

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Gavony Township
text:
"The protective wards of the church have weakened, and no one can tell us why. It's time to look to our own defenses."
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Unseal the Necropolis
text: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.

name: Elspeth's Smite
text: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

name: Fearless Skald
text: "Hold nothing back, my friends. Tonight we feast in Starnheim!"

name: Volcanic Spite
text: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

name: Wrenn's Resolve
text: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.

name: Atraxa's Fall
text:
"Fallen angels should stay fallen."
—Henzie "Toolbox" Torre

name: Iridescent Blademaster
text: Her arm and spirit were weary, but as the Halo flowed across her blade, it became weightless, and new strength flooded through her. She would fight on.

name: Storm the Seedcore
text: In that moment, the fate of countless worlds rested with one dryad and a handful of the bravest Mirrodin had to offer.

name: Streetwise Negotiator
text: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.

name: Timberland Ancient
text: Only the trees were old enough to remember what happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.

name: Surrak and Goreclaw
text: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

name: Surge of Salvation
text: No Meletian had ever laid eyes on an angel, but when protective Halo flooded the Multiverse, they knew a divine blessing was at hand.

name: Meeting of Minds
text:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

name: Corrupted Conviction
text:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Spitebellows
text: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Bramblewood Paragon
text: Those who seek to escape her blades succeed only in dying on their stomachs.

name: Deglamer
text: The more pleasant an illusion's garb, the more indecent its form laid bare.

name: Game-Trail Changeling
text:
"I pity them, never knowing the pleasures of a single familiar form, but at least they find a noble shape at times."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

name: Gilt-Leaf Archdruid
text: "In our hands, the natural world finds more beauty than nature alone could ever provide."

name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
text: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

name: Stonybrook Schoolmaster
text: Merrow schools rarely form by design. They come together naturally as eager learners surround the wisest teachers.

name: Swell of Courage
text: "Tideshaping is more than creating a few new puddles."

name: Mothdust Changeling
text:
"Ever seen a changeling fly into a lantern?"
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

name: Stonybrook Banneret
text: Made from trout scales and crawfish whiskers, merrows' shimmering banners flash in the water like lightning.

name: Boldwyr Intimidator
text: "Now everyone knows what you are."

name: Molder Slug
text: Fortunately for it, Mirrodin is a plane without salt.

name: Predator's Strike
text: If you hear it coming, you're not its prey.

name: Viridian Joiner
text: "The Tangle reaches out to itself constantly, forming new connections. We must follow its example."

name: Viridian Shaman
text: Because the elves are so in touch with Mirrodin's nature, they understand best how to dismantle it.

name: Crystal Shard
text: The vedalken know it is not of this world, so they know that this world is not the only one.

name: Hematite Golem
text: Centuries before the first peaks of the Oxidda Chain rewrote the laws of magnetism, the golems patrolled Mirrodin's featureless surface unhindered.

name: Krark's Thumb
text:
"I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for."
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

name: Leveler
text: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

name: Second Sunrise
text: The bright tunnel sometimes leads back to life.

name: Pearl Shard
text: Leonin folktales claim it was brought from beyond the sky by the first kha.

name: Power Conduit
text: Never content, vedalken artificers continually tinker with their creations.

name: Silver Myr
text: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

name: Tower of Eons
text: Its etchings tell the ur-golems' stories of an entity able to force life into a lifeless plane.

name: Tower of Fortunes
text: The ur-golem etchings begin by celebrating Mirrodin's creator, a golem of almost limitless power. They end by cursing its protector, a being called Memnarch.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Great Furnace
text: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

name: Tree of Tales
text: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

name: Fatespinner
text: No one knows what she is watching, but she never takes her eyes off it.

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Wall of Blood
text: Blood is thicker than mortar.

name: Detonate
text: The goblins have forty-two different words for "ow."

name: Mass Hysteria
text: The sooner you see the whites of their eyes, the sooner you'll spill the red of their blood.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
text:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Daring Saboteur
text: "They'll never see me coming."

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text:
"Odd. I didn't see any lightning . . . ."
—Herreth, poacher, last words

name: Treeshaker Chimera
text: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

name: Wall of Roots
text:
"Mana grows and changes like the roots of a plant. Like a plant, it must be nurtured."
—Nissa Revane

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Skyshroud Claim
text: The forest's constant struggle is to keep the spreading flowstone at bay.

name: Belbe's Armor
text: It protects her from the ravages of Phyrexia and the savages of Rath.

name: Belbe's Portal
text: The fight will continue on a new battlefield.

name: Seahunter
text: "They can't feel pain. They just wiggle 'cause they're scared."

name: Seal of Removal
text:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

name: Dark Triumph
text: All that's left is the coronation.

name: Fanatical Devotion
text: The Oracle told Eladamri he would save his people by abandoning them. His followers adopted that ideal.

name: Moggcatcher
text: "They're not worth much, but they're easy to catch."

name: Rupture
text: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

name: Seal of Fire
text:
"I am the romancer, the passion that consumes the flesh."
—Seal inscription

name: Reckoner's Bargain
text: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair—the sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.

name: Virus Beetle
text:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

name: You Are Already Dead
text: So swift and sharp was his blade that the ogre never even felt the cut.

name: Imperial Oath
text: Those chosen to guard the Imperial Palace are not only unrivaled warriors but also lionhearted champions of the Imperial cause.

name: Greater Tanuki
text: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

name: Master's Rebuke
text: "You have always been a promising student, but your arrogance far outstrips your prowess."

name: Circuit Mender
text: Inspired by industrious silkworms, its maker crafted it to restore the broken pieces of the world.

name: Containment Construct
text: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.

name: Patchwork Automaton
text: It dwells happily near the ever-burning forges of Sokenzan City, crafting small things of beauty from discarded scraps.

name: Banishing Slash
text: "In the name of Kyodai, begone!"

name: Spirited Companion
text: She formed a friendship with several playful spirits, and soon "the pack" was known as the source of much mischief in Eiganjo.

name: Acquisition Octopus
text: You can never have too many arms.

name: Suit Up
text: With a reckless leap into the pilot's seat, Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.

name: Dockside Chef
text: The squirming is how you know it's fresh.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Mutagenic Growth
text:
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Noxious Revival
text:
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Immolating Souleater
text:
"We thank the souleaters for melting the sinful that we may be reminded of our own insignificance."
—Drones' hymn of gratitude

name: Master Splicer
text: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

name: Unwinding Clock
text:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

name: Porcelain Legionnaire
text:
"My new design has lightweight plating specially cultivated from heretics' spare tissues."
—Izathel, priest of the Annex

name: Shattered Angel
text: She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.

name: Blighted Agent
text:
"Urabrask may suspect our surveillance, but he cannot stop it."
—Avaricta, Gitaxian sective

name: Gitaxian Probe
text:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance

name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
text: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

name: Spined Thopter
text:
"I appreciate the depravity of noble designs turned to devious ends."
—Tezzeret

name: Geth's Verdict
text:
"Everyone should owe you something."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Artillerize
text: Phyrexian or Mirran, most goblins stick to the job they know best.

name: Due Respect
text:
"A display of humility is required of those who still possess such frailties."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Ruthless Invasion
text:
"For the survival of our people, every conflict must now end in retreat."
—Pythor, Mirran resistance

name: Slag Fiend
text:
"Seal the furnace vents. Admit no others. We'll tend our forges without their tainted ways."
—Decree of Urabrask

name: Time Stretch
text: There's lots of time like the present.

name: Beloved Chaplain
text: Nomad and Nantuko, eagle and elephant; all the birds and beasts are charmed by his quiet dignity.

name: Words of Wisdom
text: Knowledge can't be kept in a bottle or sealed in a box. It yearns to be spread and shared.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

name: Mindslicer
text: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

name: Sadistic Hypnotist
text: "Victory in the pits is almost as rewarding as the methods I use to achieve it."

name: Zombie Infestation
text: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

name: Anarchist
text: Those who will not follow are doomed to lead.

name: Chance Encounter
text: The more unlikely the victory, the more memorable the success.

name: Dwarven Grunt
text:
Hard as stone and twice as stubborn.
—Dwarven compliment

name: Earnest Fellowship
text:
"The world has enough strife as it is. Where would we be if we turned against each other?"
—Pianna, nomad captain

name: Price of Glory
text:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Druid's Call
text: Suffer the little creatures, for they may yet rise up and beat you senseless.

name: Muscle Burst
text: As strong as a centaur's will.

name: Nantuko Elder
text:
Plant a field with wishes, and you will grow more wishes.
—Nantuko teaching

name: New Frontiers
text: Spreading a blanket of growth to warm a weary world.

name: Squirrel Mob
text: An army of squirrels is still an army.

name: Squirrel Nest
text: In the Krosan Forest, you've got to keep an eye out for the squirrels.

name: Werebear
text: He exercises his right to bear arms.

name: Shelter
text: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

name: Tireless Tribe
text: "We've survived starvation, dwarf attacks, and heatstroke. Why should a little sandstorm bother us?"

name: Aboshan, Cephalid Emperor
text: "No one can fight the tide forever."

name: Aven Fisher
text: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

name: Careful Study
text: Books are like crops—they must be thinned for best yield.

name: Cephalid Broker
text: Cephalids value the free exchange of ideas—except for the "free" part.

name: Patron Wizard
text: "The best way to teach is by example."

name: Pedantic Learning
text: Even the trivial can inspire.

name: Reality Hemorrhage
text: Tarek could not tell whether he was losing his blood or his mind.

name: Boulder Salvo
text:
"If someone claims the sky is falling, I listen."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Cinder Hellion
text: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

name: Fall of the Titans
text: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

name: Zada's Commando
text:
"There's a word for someone who brings too much gear to battle: 'survivor.'"
—Zada of Slab Haven

name: Elemental Uprising
text:
"My heart and Zendikar's beat as one. Together we will endure."
—Nissa Revane

name: Affa Protector
text: "Through all the terrors we face, I hold on to the memory of the world before the Eldrazi came. I'd like to see that world again."

name: Oath of Nissa
text: "For the life of every plane, I will keep watch."

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Tajuru Pathwarden
text: "My people blazed these pathways long ago, before the Eldrazi came. We will ride them long after the Eldrazi are gone."

name: Mina and Denn, Wildborn
text: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

name: Weapons Trainer
text: "When I'm done training you, anything will be a deadly weapon."

name: Bone Saw
text: Once a simple tool, it—like everything else on Zendikar—has been turned into a weapon against the Eldrazi.

name: Isolation Zone
text: When properly aligned, hedrons become powerful tools of binding.

name: Kor Sky Climber
text: "With rope, I can fly as far as the rope can reach. But with light, the sky is the limit."

name: Make a Stand
text: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

name: Ondu War Cleric
text: "I will follow the light of Iona into battle, and I will know no fear."

name: Searing Light
text:
"Light can lay bare our fears. It can also make them go away."
—Nazra of the Stone Havens

name: Slip Through Space
text: The Eldrazi twisted in a direction that had no name, and a frontal assault became a panicked rout.

name: Jwar Isle Avenger
text: Though solitary by nature, the sphinxes did not hesitate to join in the fight against the Eldrazi.

name: Oblivion Strike
text: It's bad enough to be torn to pieces. It's worse by far to be torn from the world itself.

name: Remorseless Punishment
text:
"I have suffered a thousand lifetimes of agony on this wretched world. I've far less time to share with you, but I assure you, no less pain."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Tar Snare
text: The amorphous, magically animated residue known as the Fathom Sludge lurks in the Hagra Cistern, attacking its prey with pseudopods and dragging it down to be digested.

name: Untamed Hunger
text:
"Mindlessness is not weakness. When we are lost to hunger we are unstoppable."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Vampire Envoy
text: "Zendikar will fight until it has bled its last."

name: Zulaport Chainmage
text: The chains obey her. Everything else would do best to get out of her way.

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Court of Grace
text: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

name: Cut a Deal
text:
"Abandon your selfish ambitions and become one with the Flesh Singularity."
—Elesh Norn

name: Sheoldred's Edict
text: "Congratulations. I am entertained."

name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
text: "Soon enough each praetor will have hired me to kill the others, and I will stand alone as the true Father of Machines."

name: Barbed Batterfist
text: "Finally, a safe way to punch the rotters in the face."

name: Blazing Crescendo
text:
"They call themselves the Quiet Furnace? Ironic."
—Tyvar

name: Furnace Punisher
text: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

name: Tyvar's Stand
text: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."

name: Surgical Skullbomb
text: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.

name: Razorverge Thicket
text: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

name: Ossification
text: Only Elesh Norn's most loyal servants are granted the honor of becoming part of her throne.

name: Planar Disruption
text: New Phyrexia's planar defenses scattered the Planeswalker strike team on arrival. Elesh Norn knew they were coming.

name: Quicksilver Fisher
text: Phyrexia will stretch from sea to sky, across worlds and realities, inescapable and perfect.

name: Vanish into Eternity
text: Faced with a blast that would level not only New Phyrexia, but also a dozen innocent worlds, Elspeth consigned it—and herself—to the nothingness in between.

name: Read the Runes
text: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

name: Gravespawn Sovereign
text: The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.

name: Shepherd of Rot
text:
"My priests swore loyalty to the Cabal not until death, but beyond it."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Visara the Dreadful
text: "My eyes are my strongest feature."

name: Brightstone Ritual
text: Wizards fought over the stone to exploit its power. Goblins fight over it because it's shiny.

name: Dwarven Blastminer
text: "Life is too short for something like a hunk of rock to get in my way."

name: Goblin Taskmaster
text: For some reason, goblin fighting school isn't as crowded on day two.

name: Skirk Fire Marshal
text: He's boss because he's smart enough to get out of the way.

name: Sparksmith
text: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

name: Words of War
text:
"Passions can't be shackled by laws or mastered with logic. The choice is freedom or death."
—*Volume IV, The Book of Fire*

name: Centaur Glade
text: The Mirari called to the centaurs, and all who heard it were forever changed.

name: Elven Riders
text: "Wirewood cannot hide great size. Only with speed and skill can we survive here."

name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
text: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

name: Symbiotic Beast
text: The insects found a meal in the carrion of the beast's prey. The beast found a spiffy new hairstyle.

name: Wall of Mulch
text: Mulch is the fabric of life in the forest. Plants live in it, they die in it, and then they become part of it, feeding countless generations to come.

name: Ancestor's Prophet
text: "We have faced horrors of war and terrors beyond imagining. We will overcome the uncertainties of this new life."

name: Nova Cleric
text: "Our noblest thoughts are our very first and our very last."

name: Whipcorder
text: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

name: Annex
text: Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.

name: Aphetto Alchemist
text: He brews trouble.

name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor
text: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."

name: Infernal Scarring
text: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

name: Nantuko Husk
text:
"The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace."
—Nantuko teaching

name: Rabid Bloodsucker
text: She haunts the streets, wings spread wide, with carrion on her breath and blood in her eyes.

name: Reave Soul
text:
"I was not convinced you had a soul until I saw it for myself."
—Liliana Vess

name: Returned Centaur
text: Driven away by his living kin, he wanders mourning through the wilderness, seeking the dead city of Asphodel.

name: Revenant
text: Born from the slaughter of an entire army, it bears the wrath of a hundred souls.

name: Enlightened Ascetic
text: "I do not reject the gods. I reject their authority, their pettiness, and their arrogance."

name: Thornbow Archer
text: "I will not rest until the stench of eyeblights is eradicated from these woods."

name: Weight of the Underworld
text: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

name: Bellows Lizard
text: As the price of wood and coal rose, smiths found creative ways to keep their forges burning.

name: Boggart Brute
text: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

name: Chandra's Ignition
text: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

name: Cobblebrute
text: Ravnica's most ancient streets take on a life of their own. A few have decided to move to nicer neighborhoods.

name: Fiery Impulse
text: "Well, this got out of hand."

name: Lightning Javelin
text: The harpies descended without mercy upon Akros, only to find their attack put them within range of the javelineers.

name: Magmatic Insight
text: Chief among the tenets of Purphoros is that one must destroy in order to create.

name: Prickleboar
text:
"Canyons in the Phoberos badlands are essentially gates to the Underworld."
—Mirinthes, Akroan captain

name: Healing Hands
text: The ethereal touch brings relief. The physical touch brings peace.

name: Caustic Caterpillar
text:
"The rare and beautiful butterflies inspire the design of our thopters. The larvae, however, are a different story entirely."
—Kiran Nalaar, Ghirapur inventor

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Heavy Infantry
text: Doors, walls, skulls . . . it matters not. All barriers will be broken.

name: Mantle of Webs
text:
"Why does everything the Golgari touch end up sticky?"
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Might of the Masses
text: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

name: Reclaim
text: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

name: Skysnare Spider
text: The only thing more ill-tempered than a griffin in a web is the spider that must subdue it.

name: Vastwood Gorger
text:
"A long and difficult incision revealed that all vital organs are housed in the head, save for a long chain of stomachs, forty in all, leading from its throat to the end of the tail."
—Mulak Ffar, *Vastwood Biodiversity*

name: Yeva's Forcemage
text: "Nature can't be stopped. It rips and tears at Ravnica's tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun."

name: Zendikar's Roil
text:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

name: Bounding Krasis
text: Unpredictable as a storm and destructive as a tidal wave.

name: Citadel Castellan
text: "I am the first line of defense. You will not encounter the second."

name: Iroas's Champion
text: Accustomed to battling before an audience in the arena, Iroas's champions know how to put on a good show.

name: Zendikar Incarnate
text:
"Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath. That is why Nissa is the last of the animists."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

name: Alchemist's Vial
text: A weapon best suited for those with good aim and steady hands.

name: Alhammarret's Archive
text: It contains the totality of Alhammarret's notes, theories, and ponderings.

name: Guardians of Meletis
text: The histories speak of two feuding rulers whose deaths were celebrated and whose monuments symbolized the end of their wars. In truth they were peaceful lovers, their story lost to the ages.

name: Meteorite
text: "And if I'm lying," he began . . .

name: Sigil of Valor
text: With each honor he earns, Gideon paves the path to his redemption.

name: Sword of the Animist
text: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

name: Flesh to Dust
text:
"Another day. Another avenging angel. Another clump of feathers to toss in the trash."
—Liliana Vess

name: Fiery Hellhound
text:
"I had hoped to instill in it the loyalty of a guard dog, but with fire's power comes its unpredictability."
—Maggath, Sardian elementalist

name: Sentinel of the Eternal Watch
text: The portcullis is superfluous.

name: Suppression Bonds
text:
"A master of hieromancy can see the advantage in any scenario."
—Warden Hixus, to Kytheon

name: Topan Freeblade
text: "My scars are my sigils. I will wear them with pride long after you're gone."

name: Tragic Arrogance
text: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

name: Dreadwaters
text: Stray into the Morkrut and it may rise to claim you.

name: Aven Battle Priest
text: When the shadow of the aven falls across the battlefield, hope rises in the hearts of the soldiers.

name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy
text: "People's thoughts just come to me. Sometimes I don't know if it's them or me thinking."

name: Ringwarden Owl
text: The owls learn of mana from the mages who know it best.

name: Blessed Spirits
text: Not all heroes die in armor.

name: Sigiled Starfish
text: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

name: Skaab Goliath
text: Three heads are better than one.

name: Sphinx's Tutelage
text: "You've never considered the implications of dealing with another telepath, Jace."

name: Celestial Flare
text:
"You were defeated the moment you declared your aggression."
—Gideon Jura

name: Catacomb Slug
text:
"The entire murder scene was covered in dripping, oozing slime. No need for a soothsayer to solve that one."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Third Path Iconoclast
text: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Opulent Palace
text: The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Kirri, Talented Sprout
text:
"He may be a little green, but trust me, he's far from spineless."
—Yuma, proud protector

name: Heliod's Intervention
text: "I bring a dawn that no night can follow."

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Treasure Dredger
text: The old miners' trail across Blacksnag Bog is littered with lost fortunes and the bones of those who searched for them.

name: Return the Favor
text: "Don't you know it's rude not to share?"

name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
text: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the *plants* have an attitude?"

name: Requisition Raid
text: The Freestriders believe in liberation, in all its many forms.

name: Double Down
text: The best alibi is being in multiple places at the same time.

name: Lively Dirge
text: "Now rip your partner from the grave, and form an undead killing wave!"

name: Bear Cub
text:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

name: Golden Bear
text: The elvish scout was scrupulous about the truth. She told the traders that gold lay nearby.

name: Ironhoof Ox
text: The good news is it's vegetarian. The bad news is it just doesn't like you.

name: Norwood Archers
text:
"'Air superiority?' Not while our archers scan the skies."
—Elvish scout

name: River Bear
text: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

name: Salvage
text:
"What was taken shall be restored."
—Arathel, elvish queen

name: Temple Acolyte
text: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

name: Trokin High Guard
text: Battle tempers soldiers as fire tempers steel.

name: Air Elemental
text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

name: Ancient Craving
text:
"Knowledge demands sacrifice."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Dakmor Plague
text: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

name: Hand of Death
text: The touch of death is never gentle.

name: Rain of Daggers
text: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

name: Raise Dead
text:
"Life from death is part of the natural cycle. This is merely a shortcut."
—Tojira, swamp queen

name: Goblin Lore
text:
"I done forgot more than you'll ever know, pipsqueak."
"Yeah—that's your problem."

name: Vela the Night-Clad
text: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

name: Fractured Powerstone
text: The Thran learned to capture mana, but power inevitably escapes its bonds.

name: Dreampod Druid
text: "Don't mistake my creations for mere vegetation. They are my children, loyal and fierce."

name: Thran Golem
text: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

name: Whispersilk Cloak
text: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
text:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Arc Trail
text:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Mark of Mutiny
text: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

name: Rivals' Duel
text: They could agree on one thing only: one of them must die.

name: Nest Invader
text: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

name: Ondu Giant
text: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
