text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Tukatongue Thallid
text: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Dragonlair Spider
text: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

name: Fusion Elemental
text: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

name: Abolish
text: As war raged on, the young mages became more direct in their tactics, often at great cost.

name: Scoria Cat
text: Like a volcano, it too can erupt without warning.

name: Spore Frog
text: The end of one life is merely the beginning of thousands more.

name: Squirrel Wrangler
text: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

name: Vintara Snapper
text:
"The snapper is still when all else moves
And strikes when all are dozing."
—*Tales of the Vintara Forest*

name: Reveille Squad
text: "To arms! To arms! The Lion roars!"

name: Denying Wind
text:
"The third wind of ascension is Eliminator, clearing Keld's path to victory."
—*Keld Triumphant*

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Spiketail Drake
text: "The spell will have to wait," said Alexi, pointing up. "Drakes."

name: Stormwatch Eagle
text: When eagles leave the sky, sailors leave the sea.

name: Entangler
text: "Tell me again," said Latulla, raising her fist, "how just one woman held back an entire Keldon platoon."

name: Steal Strength
text: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

name: Lesser Gargadon
text:
Trod on by a gargadon
—Kipamu expression meaning "wiped out"

name: Fire Servant
text:
"Elemental fire shimmers with rose hues and, unlike terrestrial blazes, smolders long after it's extinguished."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

name: Blood Knight
text: His is the fury of the wildfire, the boiling blood of the volcano. He fights you not because you've wronged him, but because you're there.

name: Brute Force
text: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

name: Rebuff the Wicked
text:
"I cannot teach you their brand of magic, but I can teach you how to defend against it."
—Tavalus, priest of Korlis

name: Simian Spirit Guide
text:
"All my spells smell like burnt hair lately."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Jedit Ojanen of Efrava
text: The cat warriors recognized this Jedit's face, but not his fierce loyalty to Efrava.

name: Kavu Predator
text: In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.

name: Utopia Vow
text: "I'll guard this fruit and its seedling until the land is healed. My life now belongs to Dominaria."

name: Gaea's Anthem
text:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Groundbreaker
text: The earth's memory is long, its retribution brief.

name: Hedge Troll
text: His abode was clean and bare, not a morsel in sight. I asked him what he ate, fearing the answer. He smiled and said his faith alone sustained him.

name: Keen Sense
text: Crovax sensed that Mirri wasn't ready for the curse taking hold of her. Weeping in his heart, he fled.

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Mana Tithe
text:
"Those who seek to upset the balance must be taxed for such ambitions."
—Verithain, mesa high priest

name: Sinew Sliver
text: As the muscle cords of the creature twitched, Hanna saw an unsettling unanimity in the others' rippling flesh. She didn't know what it meant, but she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

name: Auramancer's Guise
text: "Consider not what the mask hides, but what it can reveal."

name: Braids, Conjurer Adept
text: The rifted multiverse became a sea of conflicting realities, each peopled by possible versions of every living being.

name: Dreamscape Artist
text: He's mastered the art of sleight of land.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Frozen Aether
text: Gjornersen entertained his followers by taking bets on which would move first—the drowsing land wurm or the frozen goblins.

name: Merfolk Thaumaturgist
text:
"Blasted fishtails! It's not enough that they meddle with my head, but they twist my body as well."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Serendib Sorcerer
text: "Even a dragon is humble as a kitten if it thinks itself a slave."

name: Dash Hopes
text:
"Focus an enemy's mind on what's already gone, and it's easier to take away more."
—Holux, stronghold racketeer

name: Vampiric Link
text: The familiar's fangs deliver the master's bite.

name: Ertai, the Corrupted
text: Altered by Phyrexian science, corrupted by black mana, and twisted by rage, Ertai still looked in the mirror and saw only glory.

name: Phyrexian Tyranny
text:
"He is Yawgmoth's reward to me. I shall kill him a hundred times a day."
—Crovax, to Ertai

name: Star Compass
text: It doesn't point north. It points home.

name: Sunscape Familiar
text: The spirits of fallen battlemages can serve their guilds as familiars by joining with any physical form.

name: Confound
text: "Did I know Szat would betray us?" Urza asked quizzically. "I was counting on it."

name: Dark Suspicions
text:
"After four thousand years, you learn to plan for betrayal."
—Urza

name: Lord of the Undead
text:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Implode
text: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

name: Strafe
text:
"All right, let's light 'em up!"
—Gerrard

name: Alpha Kavu
text: Kavu leaders instinctively protect their herds from harm.

name: Ancient Spider
text: It outlived both king and castle.

name: Vampiric Feast
text: It's not always gold the thief is after.

name: Virtue's Ruin
text: All must fall, and those who stand highest fall hardest.

name: Blaze
text: Fire never dies alone.

name: Pyroclasm
text: Chaos does not choose its enemies.

name: Raging Minotaur
text: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

name: Stone Rain
text:
I cast a thousand tiny suns—
Beware my many dawns.

name: Wall of Granite
text: The wisest man builds his house *behind* the rock.

name: Elite Cat Warrior
text: "Hear that? No? *That's* a cat warrior."

name: Elvish Ranger
text: It's up to you if you enter their woods—and up to them if you leave.

name: Jungle Lion
text: The lion's only loyalty is to its hunger.

name: Mobilize
text: A rested mind is the sharpest weapon.

name: Monstrous Growth
text: Some cats are born fighters; others need a little persuading.

name: Willow Dryad
text: Some think that dryads are the dreams of trees.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: A peasant can do more by faith than a king by proclamation.

name: Starlit Angel
text: To soar as high as hope, to dive as swift as justice.

name: Wall of Swords
text: Sharper than wind, lighter than air.

name: Wrath of God
text:
"As flies to wanton boys, are we to the gods. They kill us for their sport."
—William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

name: Cloak of Feathers
text: A thousand feathers from a thousand birds, sewn with magic and song.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Are merfolk humans with fins, or are humans merfolk with feet?

name: Sorcerous Sight
text: Do not react; anticipate.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Symbol of Unsummoning
text:
". . . inviting the soul to wander for a spell in abysses of solitude . . . ."
—Kate Chopin, *The Awakening*

name: Thing from the Deep
text: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.

name: Time Ebb
text: Like the tide, time both ebbs and flows.

name: Arrogant Vampire
text: Charm and grace may hide a foul heart.

name: Cruel Tutor
text: The more you pay for the lesson, the better you'll remember it.

name: Feral Shadow
text: Not all shadows are cast by light—some are cast by darkness.

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

name: Hunted Dragon
text: The knights see a mighty quarry. The dragon sees breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Mindmoil
text:
"My criticism of the Izzet is that their impulse for learning seems too much like impulse and too little like learning."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Loxodon Gatekeeper
text: The gatekeepers are so fastidious that even the winds must wait to pass.

name: Pariah's Shield
text: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

name: Oathsworn Giant
text: The town stands on his ancestors' former burial grounds. Even with the graves long gone, he continues his determined vigil.

name: Duskmantle, House of Shadow
text: In a space where there is no room, in a structure that was never built, meets the guild that doesn't exist.

name: Veteran Armorer
text: "Give me a sword and I'll kill a few enemies. But give me a hammer and a fiery forge, and I'll turn the tide of battle."

name: Flight of Fancy
text: The view from above is an inspiration to the newly winged.

name: Vedalken Dismisser
text:
"I crept up on him, quiet as a guttermouse. And then suddenly I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market."
—Sirislav, Dimir spy

name: Helldozer
text: Sometimes you go to hell, and sometimes hell comes to you.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Frilled Deathspitter
text: Nothing says trouble like a reedy hiss with a hint of liquid gurgle.

name: Mutiny
text: Pirate captains rarely enjoy a peaceful retirement.

name: Needletooth Raptor
text: It hatches with its ferocity fully grown.

name: Reckless Rage
text: "Hard to starboard! Starb— Abandon ship! Abandon ship!"

name: Shatter
text: Today it's a miracle of architecture, a marvel of stained glass, a symbol of the Legion's power. Tomorrow, driftwood.

name: Aggressive Urge
text: "Our lives, our homes, and all our history are at risk. Do not speak to me of peace."

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Hardy Veteran
text: For the Sun Empire, the Immortal Sun is a symbol of national identity. When they reclaim it, the Empire will flourish once more.

name: Hunt the Weak
text:
"Death lizard approaching, cap'n!"
—Brint Doobin, last words

name: Jungleborn Pioneer
text: "We fought so long to hide this place. Let us be first to learn its wonders!"

name: Overgrown Armasaur
text: It embodies the riotous growth of the jungle, where creatures crowd upon creatures, where roots sprawl and vines swarm.

name: Plummet
text:
"Still, the pterodon chasing the clouds from its skies must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Moment of Triumph
text: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
text: Her centuries-long search is ended.

name: Hadana's Climb
text: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

name: Journey to Eternity
text: Every journey has its inevitable end . . .

name: Merfolk Mistbinder
text:
"The mist clothes us when we are bare, hides us when we are alone, and unites us when we are together."
—Nirit of Pashona's band

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

name: Raptor Companion
text: The abundance of foes in Orazca means the raptors no longer need any orders.

name: Vampire Champion
text: "These pirates must answer for their ancestors, who renounced the Church of Dusk and sailed from Torrezon as heretics."

name: Skymarcher Aspirant
text: "I was born to glory."

name: Snubhorn Sentry
text: They're fun to train—if you like stubborn, aggressive, and fiercely territorial.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: River Darter
text:
"Don't make splashes. Make progress."
—Tishana

name: Sailor of Means
text: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

name: Secrets of the Golden City
text: Stolen knowledge can never be stolen back.

name: Silvergill Adept
text: "If you keep to the shallows, you'll never learn the secrets of the depths."

name: Dinosaur Hunter
text: "Aye, the foul beast chomped me, but I got away. You'd best believe when I find it again, it won't get away so easy."

name: Dusk Charger
text: Stories say demon blood runs in its veins, making it fearless and bloodthirsty.

name: Exultant Skymarcher
text: "We have come at last to this holiest of holy places. What was stolen from us long ago is ours once again."

name: Dusk Legion Zealot
text: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

name: Grasping Scoundrel
text: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

name: Gruesome Fate
text:
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?"
—Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock

name: Moment of Craving
text: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

name: Famished Paladin
text: Loyal to his queen, slave to his thirst.

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Charging Tuskodon
text: It doesn't hold grudges. It runs them down and impales them.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Skewer the Critics
text: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

name: Guardian Project
text: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

name: Knight of Sorrows
text: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.

name: Trollbred Guardian
text: His favorite food is kraul.

name: Ministrant of Obligation
text: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

name: Prowling Caracal
text: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.

name: Angelic Exaltation
text:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia

name: Simic Locket
text:
"Like our guild itself, this locket can stand for many things. You must discern what it means for you."
—Vannifar

name: Azorius Guildgate
text:
"If the populace fears our authority, then I'd say we have an appropriately sensible populace."
—Dovin Baan

name: Gruul Guildgate
text:
"Beyond this gate there are no citizens, only predators and prey."
—Domri Rade

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"If you think the cathedral is impressive, you should see what's down below."
—Teysa

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text:
"Slip in the back if you don't want to be recognized. Don't worry—we'll make sure you're never found!"
—Judith

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

name: The Haunt of Hightower
text: It drains vitality from those it touches.

name: Archway Angel
text: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.

name: Chillbringer
text: If you can see your breath, it's too late to run.

name: Clear the Mind
text:
"The best way to keep a secret is to forget it."
—Lazav

name: Arrester's Zeal
text: Law is the light of civilization.

name: Humongulus
text: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.

name: Skitter Eel
text:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Thought Collapse
text:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav

name: Windstorm Drake
text: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

name: Carrion Imp
text: No scrap of nutrition goes to waste in the undercity.

name: Catacomb Crocodile
text:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.

name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
text: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

name: Orzhov Enforcer
text: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

name: Expose to Daylight
text:
"Lies cannot long withstand the harsh light of day."
—Lavinia

name: Plague Wight
text: For some goods, the best couriers are the dead.

name: Undercity's Embrace
text: The undercity is always hungry.

name: Vindictive Vampire
text: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

name: Act of Treason
text: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

name: Repay in Kind
text: Sorin has gathered grudges for centuries, patiently awaiting the day he can exact the perfect vengeance.

name: Skeletal Wurm
text: Necromancers are judged by the most powerful undead they've ever created. There are those who have animated just a single being, yet are considered the pinnacle of their dark craft.

name: Splinter Twin
text: "I know just the person for that job."

name: Khalni Hydra
text:
"In ages past, bargains were struck and promises were made. Now we must collect on our debt. Begin the hymns."
—Moruul, Khalni druid

name: Angelheart Vial
text: It holds a whisper from Iona: "Persevere."

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Soul's Attendant
text: In truth, her own faith was gone, trodden in Ulamog's wake. She pantomimed the blessing in the hope that it would inspire others to continue to struggle.

name: Totem-Guide Hartebeest
text: The kor track hartebeests in hopes of finding magic to help fight the Eldrazi.

name: Narcolepsy
text:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Pathrazer of Ulamog
text: No thought but hunger. No strategy but destruction.

name: Training Grounds
text: Under the master's eye, skills are honed sharper and spells cut deeper.

name: Venerated Teacher
text: "The unfathomable is upon us, students. I have no doubt you will rise to the occasion."

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

name: Axebane Guardian
text: Only a worthy few are permitted within the sentient forest known as Axebane.

name: Mercurial Chemister
text: What some see as "distracted" is really "fathoming the unfathomable."

name: Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage
text: "Preachers of freedom forget that conformity can be beautiful."

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

name: Selesnya Keyrune
text: A mark of unity when you want one; a fierce guardian when you need one.

name: Swift Justice
text:
"Having conviction is more important than being righteous."
—Aurelia

name: Trostani's Judgment
text:
"Some cannot be saved as they are, but all can serve the Worldsoul."
—Trostani

name: Devouring Light
text: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

name: Debt to the Deathless
text: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Rootborn Defenses
text: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Dreadmalkin
text: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

name: Curse of Disturbance
text: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Loyal Subordinate
text: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

name: Torrent of Fire
text: Dragon fire melts any instrument designed to measure it.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Wirewood Guardian
text: Tall as a tree and probably related.

name: Silver Knight
text: Otaria's last defense against the wave of chaos threatening to engulf it.

name: Long-Term Plans
text: "Wait, it'll come to me in a minute."

name: Rush of Knowledge
text:
"Limitless power is glorious until you gain limitless understanding."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Daru Spiritualist
text: He lifts the spirits of his people so they may descend in wrath upon their foes.

name: Unspeakable Symbol
text: The symbols are spread throughout Aphetto, marking sites where minions of the Raven Guild and the Cabal can seek refuge.

name: Zombie Cutthroat
text: The single-mindedness of a zombie, the cunning of an assassin.

name: Rage Reflection
text: Vengeance is a dish best served twice.

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Mistmeadow Skulk
text: Doyo suspected the boggarts of brewing a plot against his crop, so he scythed away his grain to clear the sightlines.

name: Enchanted Evening
text: In the reflection, she saw the rough shell of the world sloughing away, revealing the truth shining underneath.

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Puresight Merrow
text: Stripped of his sight, he was free to see only the ideal.

name: Ghastlord of Fugue
text:
"He is a ghost that has never known life."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Inkfathom Infiltrator
text: No one can navigate the dank maze of Shadowmoor's rivers better than the cruel and covetous merrows. They use the currents to steal—and to steal away.

name: Prison Term
text: Clear out the cell. Bring in the next prisoner.

name: Kulrath Knight
text: Mounted cinders circle the blasted peak at Kulrath, hunting the Extinguisher.

name: Armored Ascension
text:
"Why enchant feathers to make them sturdy when we can enchant shields to make them fly?"
—Braenna, cobblesmith

name: Boggart Ram-Gang
text:
"We're going to need a bigger gate."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Manamorphose
text: For a moment, objects of pure mana glimmered in the wonderstruck boggart's hands. In the next moment, they were in his mouth, as he chewed contentedly.

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"The dead have it easy. They suffer no more. If breaking their rest helps the living, so be it."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Mercy Killing
text: "We will give you the peace you seek, though you may not yet know you seek it."

name: Old Ghastbark
text:
"Beware of trees that talk. Their words are threats. And mind the ones that sway and creak. They too threaten us, but in a foreign tongue."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

name: Oracle of Nectars
text: When elves find a fount of beauty, they protect it. Where there is beauty, there is hope.

name: Rhys the Redeemed
text: Whole again in honor and horn.

name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
text: Every life ends, but life itself never does.

name: Blight Sickle
text: Its scars cut deeper than its blade.

name: Pili-Pala
text: It wasn't really expected to fly. Then again, it wasn't expected to move, either.

name: Reaper King
text: It's harvest time.

name: Scuttlemutt
text: Built to shuttle goods from the river, it took off one day carrying a cauldron of dyes.

name: Umbral Mantle
text: It harnesses the power of night in a land where daylight fears to show itself.

name: Cerulean Wisps
text:
"If you see ghostly lights by the river, eat three twigs of marshroot to ward off kelpies."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Deepchannel Mentor
text: The rivers can no longer provide safe passage for travelers and commerce. They serve only as highways for raiders and channels for blood and woe.

name: Faerie Swarm
text: Untouched by the Aurora, Oona's faeries greeted the night like any other day.

name: Aphotic Wisps
text: Merrows skulk the silty bogs around the Wanderbrine, their very thoughts stained with evil.

name: Beseech the Queen
text: Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.

name: Goldenglow Moth
text: Ordinary moths follow it, drawn to its light.

name: Boggart Arsonists
text: The Aurora transformed Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders. They still don't know much about tool safety.

name: Cragganwick Cremator
text: Each night that his bowl fills, a village mourns.

name: Crimson Wisps
text: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

name: Knollspine Dragon
text: It woke to find a vast world in need of a master.

name: Antagonize
text:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Glittering Stockpile
text: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."

name: Torch Breath
text: "Fried squid, comin' up!"

name: Giada, Font of Hope
text: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

name: Jewel Thief
text: "They can afford the loss. They build it into their prices."

name: Prizefight
text: Underweight, underpaid, underestimated.

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Brokers Hideout
text: Once the witness was inside, the safe house vanished first from sight, then from memory.

name: Jetmir's Garden
text: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

name: Skybridge Towers
text: New Capenna's districts are a series of tiers; wealth and power always rise to the top.

name: Raffine's Informant
text: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"

name: Refuse to Yield
text: Her opponent threw her through the window, so she retaliated by throwing the window through her opponent.

name: Rumor Gatherer
text: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

name: Sky Crier
text: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

name: Majestic Metamorphosis
text: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

name: Crooked Custodian
text: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

name: Always Watching
text:
"We pray to Avacyn on high. On snow-white wings fearless you fly. Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives. May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

name: Call the Bloodline
text: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

name: Dauntless Cathar
text: "The harder they try to extinguish my faith, the brighter it burns in the darkness."

name: Farbog Revenant
text: Spiteful geists rise from the muck of the Farbogs, eager to lure travelers to their doom.

name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
text: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

name: Hound of the Farbogs
text: As you hear it baying in the distance, you'll feel its breath on your neck.

name: Macabre Waltz
text: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

name: Merciless Resolve
text: "You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded."

name: Murderous Compulsion
text: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

name: Olivia's Bloodsworn
text: "As we muster for war, I have little patience for lethargy or recalcitrance."

name: Stallion of Ashmouth
text: Echoing hoofbeats can no longer be assumed to be help from the Gavony Riders.

name: Devilthorn Fox
text: On expeditions through Ashmouth, the hunters of Devilthorn Lodge rely on the cleverness of foxes to counteract the mischief of devils.

name: Twins of Maurer Estate
text:
"Children, where are your parents?"
—Reig, wandering monk, last words

name: Vessel of Malignity
text: From within its prison, the book endlessly whispers words of cruelty and spite.

name: Dual Shot
text: There is an eagerness among the Quiver of Kessig to prove they are the equal of the other cathar orders.

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Hulking Devil
text: Fear the patient devil, the one who is calm in the midst of chaos. Beware the silent devil, the one whose cackle does not mingle with the others.

name: Incorrigible Youths
text:
"Ah, to be young again."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Insolent Neonate
text: "Manners are for mortals."

name: Rush of Adrenaline
text: Scarecrows only go so far in sending the message to stay away.

name: Vessel of Volatility
text:
"To be honest, I'm not quite sure what's going to happen."
—Renna, Selhoff alchemist

name: Expose Evil
text:
"Only the pure stand tall in the light."
—Sigarda

name: Voldaren Duelist
text: "I have yet to find my equal."

name: Byway Courier
text: A good courier travels fast and asks no questions.

name: Clip Wings
text: It is a grim duty to save the world from those created to protect it.

name: Cult of the Waxing Moon
text: In times of madness, people cling to the familiar, monstrous though it may be.

name: Stoic Builder
text: Some have returned to Hollowhenge, the ruins of Avabruck, to restore the lost capital of Kessig.

name: Watcher in the Web
text: "Lost in the woods" is an optimistic way to describe a villager's disappearance. "Found in the woods" is frequently more appropriate.

name: Inquisitor's Ox
text: Many fields now lie fallow in Gavony, as the oxen have been confiscated to perform other duties.

name: Tamiyo's Journal
text: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

name: Nahiri's Machinations
text: "Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you."

name: Angelic Purge
text: "We must save you from yourselves."

name: Survive the Night
text: The longest nights are measured not in hours, but in heartbeats.

name: Tenacity
text: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Catalog
text:
"The appearance of these warped stones throughout the provinces is too pervasive to be random. More evidence is needed to determine the reason behind them."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Gone Missing
text:
"Sometimes it's best for the lost to stay lost."
—Herzag, mayor of Havengul

name: Niblis of Dusk
text: It fuels its lanterns by leaching the warmth from its surroundings.

name: Pore Over the Pages
text: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

name: Silent Observer
text: It's not just a feeling—you are being watched.

name: Cathar's Companion
text:
"Unwavering and loyal, they represent stability in uncertain times."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

name: Trail of Evidence
text:
"Every answer seems to lead to a more terrifying question."
—Jace Beleren

name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
text: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

name: Hand of Honor
text: "The sword is just a tool. It is the samurai's hand that brings it to life."

name: Kataki, War's Wage
text:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
text:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Sakura-Tribe Scout
text:
"Scouts of the Sakura Tribe spent two years wandering the forest to learn every leaf and tree. That knowledge was called upon during the Kami War to ensure the orochi's survival."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Blood Clock
text: In an age of war, time is measured not by sand but by blood.

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
text:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

name: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker
text:
"Watch over my father. Tell him I'm safe, but I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace."
—Michiko Konda, last letter to General Takeno

name: Celestial Kirin
text: All bow at its visitation—some in awe, some in honor, some in fear.

name: Freed from the Real
text: When a strong mind moves, form and energy shift to heed it.

name: Ideas Unbound
text: The apprentice stared in puzzlement. "But Master, you finished writing those spells just yesterday. Don't you remember?" The jushi's heart froze.

name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
text:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

name: Footsteps of the Goryo
text: In the case of violent deaths, kami offered a chance for revenge if the deceased offered up its corpse as a host to the invading kami.

name: One with Nothing
text: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

name: Asceticism
text:
"Let my ignominy build walls thicker than iron and stronger than darksteel."
—Thrun, the last troll

name: Blight Mamba
text: Its venom drips with Phyrexia's hate.

name: Golem's Heart
text: The heart of a golem gives life to more than just the iron husk around it.

name: Iron Myr
text: The myr are like rusted metal: gleaming purpose hidden by a thin disguise of debris.

name: Memnite
text: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

name: Tower of Calamities
text: The ur-golems concealed one of their towers out of fear that its power would be abused, and in anticipation of a time when its power would be sorely needed.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Plated Seastrider
text: Die Neurok vergruben umschlingende Kabel direkt unter der Quecksilbersee. Eine Wasserwanderer-Ernte reicht oft aus, um eine ganze Armee mit Rüstung und Schilden auszustatten.

name: Twisted Image
text:
"True strength is in the mind, for the body is too malleable a form."
—Politus, vedalken emisar

name: Bleak Coven Vampires
text: As the shadow of the Mephidross spread over the Tangle, the vampires' territory expanded.

name: Exsanguinate
text: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

name: Tainted Strike
text:
"Welcome to perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Kuldotha Rebirth
text: All goblin rituals serve a dual purpose as fertility rites, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.

name: Send in the Pest
text: Dara couldn't cover her Silverquill bullies in ink but she could do the next best thing.

name: Sneering Shadewriter
text:
"The whole display was uninspired and derivative, and left me wondering: what was the point?"
— *Strixhaven Star* gallery show review

name: Brainstorm
text: "I have a plan. Actually, I have three."

name: Mystical Tutor
text: "It's not just what you know. It's knowing where to find what you don't."

name: Rest in Peace
text: "I will keep watch."

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: A weapon of evil, redeemed in Gideon's hand.

name: Rite of Flame
text: As the flames engulfed her, Chandra opened her heart and offered up her greatest regrets to be consumed by the inferno.

name: Awakening
text:
"There are times when destiny calls forth a people and demands an action. *Now* is the time. *We* are the people. *This* is our action. Charge!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Burgeoning
text:
"The plants said, 'We will fight the stone with root and stem and seed. We are patient. We will win.'"
—Skyshroud myth of the forest

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Primal Rage
text: "Charge!" A great cry went out, and countless elves and Vec soldiers charged up the mountain. Their fury and passion hid the fact that they were horribly outnumbered.

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Heartstone
text:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna

name: Shifting Wall
text:
"You'd almost think Volrath doesn't want me here."
—Gerrard

name: Sword of the Chosen
text: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

name: Warrior en-Kor
text: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

name: Cloud Spirit
text:
Clouds are the soil, dreams are the crop.
—Kor saying

name: Leap
text: Mirri leapt quickly and silently. The guard died likewise.

name: Wall of Tears
text:
"Many have been lost to pity."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Dauthi Trapper
text: Merfolk tell their young of Dandân, humans of Rag Man. Dal tell tales of the Dauthi, and they are far worse.

name: Dungeon Shade
text: A sickness stirs in its eyes, a nightmare born in darkened wails.

name: Mortuary
text:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

name: Tortured Existence
text:
"There are terrors lurking in the unseen corners of us all."
—Crovax

name: Flame Wave
text:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Flowstone Hellion
text: Volrath leaves no stone untrained.

name: Invasion Plans
text: Gerrard studied the globe as Mirri kept watch. Suddenly, his eyes widened. "This is Dominaria!"

name: Mogg Maniac
text: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

name: Explosive Welcome
text: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Bookwurm
text: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.

name: Charge Through
text:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

name: Fortifying Draught
text: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."

name: Shaile, Dean of Radiance
text: "You are so much stronger than you know."

name: Fracture
text:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

name: Quintorius, Field Historian
text: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."

name: Rootha, Mercurial Artist
text: "Art is never finished. Merely abandoned."

name: Witherbloom Apprentice
text: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."

name: Reduce to Memory
text:
"Do not flinch from studying the horrors of the past. History's most important lessons are cloaked in terror and tragedy."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Letter of Acceptance
text: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage natural rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Divide by Zero
text: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."

name: Frost Trickster
text: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

name: Kelpie Guide
text: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.

name: Serpentine Curve
text:
"Math bites."
—Bim, Lorehold mage-student

name: Confront the Past
text: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"

name: Go Blank
text: The only feeling worse than not knowing the answer is the certainty that you once did.

name: Lash of Malice
text:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Plaguemaw Beast
text: Phyrexia's spiral of consumption grows ever wider and darker.

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Guttersnipe
text: "Fire! Fire! Fire! What joy! What fire! Burn it all!"

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: The hydrorats were soon eradicated from the monastery.

name: Sunset Strikemaster
text: "Help the villagers to safety! I will hold the gate!"

name: Dragon Sniper
text: During Dromoka's reign, Qatros Karst City was a haven for the Abzan rebellion. Its current residents have not lost their proficiency against their former foes.

name: Roiling Dragonstorm
text:
"Beware dragonstorms that strike from the sea. Their size always disguises their force."
—Narset

name: Dalkovan Packbeasts
text:
A burden shared is a burden lightened.
—Mardu proverb

name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
text:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Lampad of Death's Vigil
text:
"Grief-struck, she weeps for each mortal's final death."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Mogis's Favor
text: Rage-crowned Mogis swiftly rewards the virtue of brutality.

name: Pharika's Libation
text: "If you will not pour your drink out for me, I shall pour mine out for you."

name: Furious Rise
text: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
text:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Eutropia the Twice-Favored
text: Nylea speaks to her in the windblown leaves; Thassa in the rushing tides.

name: Shadowspear
text: A weapon of darkness for a warrior of light.

name: Mindwrack Harpy
text: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros... and they thoroughly deserve it.

name: Ironscale Hydra
text:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout

name: Omen of the Sun
text: "My time will come, when every soul will bask in my glory and obey my law."

name: Reverent Hoplite
text: "Zeal is the sharpest blade, and piety the strongest shield."

name: Alirios, Enraptured
text: "Why would I ever want to look away?"

name: Omen of the Sea
text: "My time will come, when the rising tide will surge above the tallest mountain."

name: Whirlwind Denial
text: "No, no, and ... no."

name: Cling to Dust
text: In bleak Tizerus, all hope crumbles in your grasp.

name: Hammer of Purphoros
text: All the world is Purphoros's anvil.

name: Vulpine Goliath
text:
"With a diet of hydras, giants, and massive serpents, anything would get that big."
—Corisande, Setessan hunter

name: Warriors' Lesson
text:
"Let each challenge make you a better warrior."
—Anthousa of Setessa

name: Anax and Cymede
text: Akros's greatest heroes are also its royalty.

name: Witches' Eye
text: The price of prophecy is a vacant eye socket.

name: Blood Pet
text: "You are wrong," Volrath said. "I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me." And then he laughed.

name: Dauthi Embrace
text:
"The Dauthi army grows by screams and bounds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Endless Scream
text:
"I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream. The pain will not end, but will bind him to me."
—Volrath

name: Extinction
text:
"I once had an entire race killed just to listen to the rattling of their dried bones as I waded through them."
—Volrath

name: Perish
text:
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Sadistic Glee
text:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Souldrinker
text: Don't drink and thrive.

name: Aftershock
text:
"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Blood Frenzy
text:
"When Torahn bellows, none survive—not even the warrior whose horns he rides."
—Talruum adage

name: Fireslinger
text:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Mogg Conscripts
text:
"Torahn's horns! They've seen us. Now, statue, you must fight to save yourself!"
—Tahngarth, aboard the *Predator*

name: Mogg Raider
text: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

name: Renegade Warlord
text:
"His tongue must be honey, the way he gathers ants to fight with him."
—Volrath

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Scorched Earth
text:
"Fire cleanses as well as destroys; that is the nature of change."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Starke of Rath
text:
"I know to whom I owe the most loyalty, and I see him in the mirror every day."
—Starke

name: Hanna's Custody
text:
"I protect the Legacy with my life if necessary, for its purpose is far more important than my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Elven Warhounds
text:
"If a creature is dumb enough to love you for leashing it, why would you want to follow its lead?"
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Frog Tongue
text: "But *why* can't I get one?" sniveled Squee. "All da bugs here got wings."

name: Horned Sliver
text: A bristling wave of slivers broke against the *Weatherlight*'s timbers.

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Reap
text:
"Let Volrath choke on his crop of hatred."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Scragnoth
text: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

name: Knight of Dawn
text:
Flash like daybreak to the fray.
—Motto of the Knights of Dawn

name: Light of Day
text:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

name: Bottle Gnomes
text:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Fool's Tome
text: Squee: "What's that?" Ertai: "It's a magical book." Squee: "Am I smart enough ta use it?" Ertai: "You could say that."

name: Master Decoy
text:
"A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lotus Petal
text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

name: Puppet Strings
text: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

name: Ancient Tomb
text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

name: Ghost Town
text:
"The air here smells like a grave."
—Crovax

name: Soltari Monk
text:
"Prayer rarely explains."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Soltari Trooper
text:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

name: Legerdemain
text: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place. 'Glok,' he mumbled, and hid.

name: Steal Enchantment
text:
"Why should I flatter another with imitation when I can satisfy myself through possession?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Tradewind Rider
text: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

name: Pardic Collaborator
text: "We've been taught that strength is everything. So how can an alliance with the strongest be a betrayal?"

name: Pitchstone Wall
text: Its material may not be precious, but the minds it protects are.

name: Arrogant Wurm
text: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

name: Breakthrough
text: The ideas came flooding in so fast that they couldn't all be contained.

name: Chainer's Edict
text: The pits have their own form of mercy.

name: Pandemonium
text:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Undead Warchief
text: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

name: Coalition Victory
text:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

name: Evil Eye of Urborg
text:
"Edahlis, what *is* that thing? We should have stayed in Yavimaya . . . ."
—Aznaph, greenseeker

name: Fury Sliver
text:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

name: Ground Rift
text: Some time rifts didn't take away the people but just the ground they stood on.

name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
text: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

name: Lightning Axe
text:
"A gargoyle's meat can be carved with an ordinary cleaver, but for its petrous hide . . ."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Norin the Wary
text: "I have a bad feeling about this."

name: Sedge Sliver
text: Their flesh is as sodden as the fens in which they live, oozing to fill any wound and squishing to absorb any blow.

name: Gemhide Sliver
text:
"The land is weary. Even Skyshroud is depleted. We must find another source of mana—one that is growing despite our withering world."
—Freyalise

name: Might of Old Krosa
text: Sometimes even humble forest creatures were gifted with mighty emanations from the past.

name: Mwonvuli Acid-Moss
text:
"Life gives way to death, and death to new life. Nature feeds upon her own decay."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Spectral Force
text:
"The spirits of old have not left us unguarded."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Ghostflame Sliver
text:
"This breed is on the cusp of evolution. It burns away the markings that connect it to a queen that no longer heeds its call. It seeks a new master. Perhaps I can give it one."
—Freyalise

name: Harmonic Sliver
text:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Mishra, Artificer Prodigy
text: A sojourn through time gave dark inspiration to one gifted young mind.

name: Chromatic Star
text:
"This item is not from . . . now. It reflects a sky no longer ours and gleams with hope that does not exist."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Kher Keep
text:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Vesuva
text: It is everywhere you've ever been.

name: Pull from Eternity
text:
It is best to conquer dragons before they hatch.
—Femeref adage

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Moonlace
text: Once a vision of constancy in the sky, the moon had long been hidden from view by the haze that chokes the heavens. The very sight of it had become a sign that change was in the air.

name: Paradox Haze
text:
"Keep your pace steady through the haze, lest you step on the heels of your future self or trip the self a moment behind you."
—Teferi

name: Telekinetic Sliver
text:
"Slivers are guided only by simple instinct. Advance the hive, and you will be welcomed. Impede the hive, and you will face unrelenting opposition."
—Freyalise

name: Think Twice
text:
"Great books are meant to be read, then read again backwards or upside down!"
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

name: Mirri the Cursed
text: A hero fails, a martyr falls. Time twists and destinies interchange.

name: Urza's Factory
text:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Silence
text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

name: Compost
text:
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout.
—Yavimaya saying

name: Heart Warden
text:
"In Llanowar, we tend the forest's boughs and branches. In Yavimaya, we are a part of them."
—Rofellos of Llanowar

name: Mask of Law and Grace
text: The archangels zealously drove Serra's light into every corner of their new home as if their creator still commanded them.

name: Caltrops
text: Toward the end, Gatha struggled to keep his experiments in and his patrons out.

name: Fodder Cannon
text: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

name: Tormented Angel
text: Falling from heaven is not as painful as surviving the impact.

name: Wall of Glare
text: The blinding barrier served Benalia better than a hundred shields.

name: Aura Thief
text: Illusion steals reality from the unwise.

name: Metathran Elite
text: If the eyes are windows to the soul, their souls are not of this world.

name: Sigil of Sleep
text: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Rayne once made several unkind comparisons between the bird's naked opportunism and Urza's.

name: Bubbling Muck
text: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

name: Phyrexian Monitor
text: Being one would be an honor, if the word "honor" had any meaning in Phyrexia.

name: Goblin Gardener
text: "Grow food in dirt? Save time—eat dirt."

name: Reckless Abandon
text: The climax of a warlord's career is always death.

name: Wake of Destruction
text: Land charred black, rivers boiled, Crops and wells alike despoiled, Mountains leveled, forests felled— Footprints of the beasts of Keld.

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "Your enemies may be cowardly, my lord, but one should never call them gutless."

name: Yavimaya Scion
text: Each time the saw blade bit, the tree spat it out.

name: Martyr's Cause
text: Dying is a soldier's talent.

name: Urza's Blueprints
text: From concept to paper to reality.

name: Wheel of Torture
text: "I'd like to buy a bowel."

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Planar Collapse
text: With heavy heart, Urza doused one world's light to rekindle another's.

name: Blessed Reversal
text: Even an enemy is a valuable resource.

name: Opportunity
text:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Snap
text: Good riddance.

name: Tinker
text:
"I wonder how it feels to be bored."
—Jhoira, artificer

name: Weatherseed Faeries
text: Two days after the forge was completed, the faeries were immune to its flames.

name: Brink of Madness
text:
"The fools thought me dead. But I built an empire inside my tomb."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

name: About Face
text: The overconfident are the most vulnerable.

name: Ghitu Slinger
text: If you survive a slinger attack, the slinger wished you to live.

name: Ghitu War Cry
text: The war cry is not simply a shout but a sacrament.

name: Impending Disaster
text:
"The goblins are in charge of maintenance? Why not just set it on fire now and call it a day?"
—Whip Tongue, viashino technician

name: Hope and Glory
text:
"Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Viashino Heretic
text: "The past is buried for good reason."

name: Gurmag Angler
text: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Songs of the Damned
text: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Firewing Phoenix
text:
"When a phoenix nests in a volcano, we rejoice, for it means a hundred years of war."
—Golmak, Keldon warlord

name: Gamble
text:
"STUFF AND SUNDRIES AND MUNITIONS!"
—Breeches, gunner of the *Belligerent*

name: Magmaw
text:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Penumbra Wurm
text: Its ferocity cannot be contained in one lifetime.

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Gaddock Teeg
text: So great are his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

name: Lotus-Eye Mystics
text: Every action has a foreseen purpose.

name: Phyrexian Altar
text:
"Unskin these impure bodies, Great Yawgmoth, that the flesh may welcome your blessings."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Prismatic Lens
text: A capable mage can tune its focus, refracting mana through each disk in turn to cast any spell they desire.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Eldrazi Conscription
text: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

name: Resurrection
text:
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more."
—War blessing of Serra

name: Sigil of the New Dawn
text: The sigil represents an honor that endures beyond death.

name: Skyspear Cavalry
text: Pray her spear reaches you first. Her griffin is less kind.

name: Wandering Champion
text: "Learn from your enemies, but do not tolerate them."

name: Foil
text: Among wizards, poor timing is the most consistent mistake.

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Ulamog is dead, and his brood is dying. Some of them just don't know it yet."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Apprentice Necromancer
text: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Beware the generosity of demons.

name: Clown Car
text: It runs on laughing gas.

name: Attempted Murder
text: Squawks was quick to establish the social pecking order.

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Sunder
text: The flow of time was disrupted; like a flooding river it rose from its banks. Tolaria was drowned in an instant that stretched toward infinity.

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Zephid's Embrace
text: Spells will shun you, as will everyone else.

name: Corrupt
text: Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed.

name: Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Oppression
text:
"Do not presume to speak for yourself."
—Gix, to Xantcha

name: Rain of Filth
text:
"When I say it rained, it was not small drops, but a thick, greasy drool pouring from the heavens."
—Urza, journal

name: Skirge Familiar
text: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

name: Spined Fluke
text: Its spines are prized as writing quills by the priests of Gix.

name: Acidic Soil
text: Phyrexia had tried to take Urza's soul. He was relieved that Shiv tried to claim only his soles.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

name: Bedlam
text: Sometimes quantity, in the absence of quality, is good enough.

name: Brand
text:
"By this glyph I affirm your role."
—Urza, to Karn

name: Falter
text: Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.

name: Goblin Matron
text: There's always room for one more.

name: Goblin Offensive
text: They certainly are.

name: Outmaneuver
text:
"Push one goblin into sight, an' run a lot. That's tactics."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Shiv's Embrace
text: "Wear the foe's form to best it in battle. So sayeth the bey."

name: Sneak Attack
text: "Nothin' beat surprise—'cept rock."

name: Argothian Elder
text:
Sharpen your ears
—Elvish expression meaning "grow wiser"

name: Citanul Hierophants
text: From deep in the caves beneath the forest, the hierophants planned the druids' raids against the enemy.

name: Cradle Guard
text:
Mother, sleep / Dream our lives
Our roots your soul / Our leaves your bed.

name: Endless Wurm
text: Ages ago, a party of elves took cover to let one pass. They're still waiting.

name: Gaea's Embrace
text: The forest rose to the battle, not to save the people but to save itself.

name: Pouncing Jaguar
text: One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.

name: Retaliation
text: A foul, metallic stench clogged Urza's senses. It was then he knew his brother was no more.

name: Symbiosis
text: Although the elves of Argoth always considered them a nuisance, the pixies made fine allies during the war against the machines.

name: Vernal Bloom
text: Many cultures have legends of a lush, hidden paradise. The elves of Argoth had no need of such stories.

name: Claws of Gix
text: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand. They enshrined it, hoping that one day it would point the way to Phyrexia.

name: Mishra's Helix
text: The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

name: Urza's Armor
text:
"Tawnos's blueprints were critical to the creation of my armor. As he once sealed himself in steel, I sealed myself in a walking crypt."
—Urza

name: Phyrexian Tower
text: Living metal encasing dying flesh.

name: Shivan Gorge
text: Both forge and pyre.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearers.

name: Catastrophe
text: Radiant's eyes flashed. "Go, then," the angel spat at Serra, "and leave this world to those who truly care."

name: Pendrell Drake
text: The mages of Tolaria found strange ways to spend their free time. Occasionally they had contests to see whose kite was eaten last.

name: Peregrine Drake
text: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

name: Defensive Formation
text:
"Your enemies will pound upon the door of your defenses, but only you shall have the key, and it is the key of life."
—*Song of All*, canto 873

name: Rewind
text:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Steamflogger Boss
text:
"Don't quit now, we're almost done.
Then we'll build another one!"

name: Cataclysm
text:
"Keep with you only this much: your mount, your blade, and your wits. The rest you can find, build, or take."
—Horse clans' wisdom

name: Viashino Sandstalker
text:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Elephant Grass
text:
"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?"
—Kasib ibn Naji, Letters

name: Giant Caterpillar
text:
"'I've seen hornworms big as a man's fist,' the traveler said, and nodded soberly when our jaws went slack at his ignorance."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

name: Army Ants
text:
"Do not underestimate the power of many against one."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Miraculous Recovery
text:
"You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

name: Dragon Mask
text:
"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Helm of Awakening
text:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Phyrexian Walker
text:
"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."
—Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters

name: Teferi's Honor Guard
text:
"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Brood of Cockroaches
text:
"It's like waking on a bed of a thousand olives during an earthquake of subtle force."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Crypt Rats
text:
"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea."
—Mundungu chant

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Rock Slide
text:
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

name: Krovikan Sorcerer
text:
"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Demonic Bargain
text:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

name: Fierce Retribution
text: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."

name: End the Festivities
text: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

name: Kessig Flamebreather
text: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.

name: Reckless Impulse
text: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

name: Vampires' Vengeance
text: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

name: Voldaren Epicure
text: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Dig Up
text: Things buried on Innistrad rarely seem to stay that way.

name: Laid to Rest
text:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch

name: Massive Might
text:
"Run! It's coming for us! Eventually!"
—Yaster, Havengul shopkeeper

name: Ancient Lumberknot
text: The soft creak of trees in the wind is not always cause for comfort.

name: Traveling Minister
text: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

name: Alchemist's Retrieval
text: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

name: Serpentine Ambush
text: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

name: Wash Away
text:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

name: Mind Rot
text:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Falkenrath Reaver
text:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

name: Stalking Tiger
text: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

name: Drag Under
text: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

name: Spark Reaper
text:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

name: Vraska's Finisher
text: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

name: Blindblast
text:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Bolt Bend
text:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

name: Burning Prophet
text: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
text:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan

name: Honor the God-Pharaoh
text: In life, they revered a diverse pantheon of gods. Now they revere only the God-Pharaoh.

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

name: Gideon's Sacrifice
text: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

name: Samut's Sprint
text: Samut's war was intensely personal. Every hour she faced enemies she once loved as friends and horrors she once revered as gods.

name: Tibalt's Rager
text:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

name: Bloom Hulk
text:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

name: Challenger Troll
text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

name: Courage in Crisis
text: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

name: Cruel Celebrant
text: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

name: Deathsprout
text:
"They say nothing lasts forever. I say everything lasts forever, just not in the form you may be accustomed to."
—Vraska

name: Invade the City
text: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Firemind Vessel
text: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
text: A dictator's infuriating smirk, an affront to everything Ravnica stood for.

name: Desperate Lunge
text: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

name: Guildpact Informant
text: "Of course you're being followed!"

name: Ravnica at War
text: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.

name: Wanderer's Strike
text:
"Precise, clean cuts. No one saw anything. Again. Tag the report with my code and file it."
—Lavinia

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

name: Crush Dissent
text:
"All I ask is complete obedience."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Flux Channeler
text: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

name: Kiora's Dambreaker
text:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

name: Bond of Discipline
text: "We agree that order benefits everyone, but not until you enforce it."

name: Narset's Reversal
text:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset

name: Bulwark Giant
text:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Thunder Drake
text: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

name: Aid the Fallen
text: "I never liked you. Now get up—we have a fight to finish."

name: Defiant Strike
text: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

name: Kaya's Ghostform
text: The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.

name: Lazotep Behemoth
text:
"I know I should be more concerned. But a big, blue zombie-potamus from beyond the stars? This is what they're invading us with?"
—Mileva, Boros legionnaire

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Secluded Glen
text: Protected by glamers and guile, Glen Elendra harbors the elusive Oona, queen of the fae.

name: Stormkeld Vanguard
text: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

name: Up the Beanstalk
text:
"It's not so bad. All you have to do is keep from looking down."
—Troyan, to Kellan and Ruby

name: Goblin Grenadiers
text: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

name: Lava Hounds
text:
What cats bury, dogs eat.
—Urborg aphorism

name: Orcish Settlers
text: They wouldn't know their house from a charred hole in the ground.

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Dingus Staff
text:
"A sharp conscience is the weapon of the soul."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Serrated Biskelion
text:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Thran Forge
text: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

name: Master of Arms
text:
"Being the best usually means proving it to everyone."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Volunteer Reserves
text:
"I'm always a little leery of anyone who offers to kill other people for free."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Cloud Djinn
text:
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

name: Disrupt
text: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

name: Relearn
text:
"Barrin taught me that the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Teferi's Veil
text:
"I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Vodalian Illusionist
text:
"Torahn gore these shifty fishtails! You can't even get close to one."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Argivian Find
text:
"We often bury our pasts, and then someone comes along and digs them up."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Barrow Ghoul
text:
"They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."
—Crovax

name: Buried Alive
text:
"Is it worse to walk while dead, or to be buried alive? I have witnessed both."
—Crovax

name: Fledgling Djinn
text:
"The young can be quite dangerous. Trust me, I should know."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Mischievous Poltergeist
text:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Benalish Infantry
text:
"My favorite part of getting into the infantry was getting out again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Strands of Night
text:
"I have seen the night torn into thin darkling strips and woven into shapes too bleak for dreams."
—Crovax

name: Boiling Blood
text:
Your father has no horns!
Your mother wears a bell!
You drink the milk of goats!
—Talruum taunts

name: Cone of Flame
text:
"Mine is not the warmth of compassion."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Harabaz Druid
text: "I care nothing for treasure. The land beckons me, and I cannot rest until my feet have touched every inch of it."

name: Leatherback Baloth
text: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

name: Summit Apes
text:
"If you climb Skyfang Peak, avoid the pass. Generations of apes made that trail, and they don't tolerate trespassers."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Amulet of Vigor
text:
"After years of study, I've learned an important lesson: the relics we watch may be watching us back."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Loam Lion
