text: In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

name: Perimeter Captain
text: "We stand between the jaws of chaos and the mantle of order."

name: Jwari Shapeshifter
text: "The best expedition would be an entire team of me."

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Kalastria Highborn
text: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

name: Shoreline Salvager
text:
"They search for treasures that wash up from the depths. Tracking one could lead you to riches. Or in circles."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Quest for the Goblin Lord
text: A shrine to unchecked desire.

name: Ricochet Trap
text: In his last seconds, Remhas regretted using his most powerful spell.

name: Desperate Castaways
text: A pirate crew without a ship is a crew that will do anything to get one.

name: Encampment Keeper
text: Paladins of the Sanctum Seeker order are an adventurous lot, venturing into the wilds with monstrous mastiffs at their side.

name: Raiders' Wake
text: One was spared to tell the gruesome tale.

name: Ruthless Knave
text: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

name: Spreading Rot
text:
"What is this foul presence that defies the sun's cleansing rays?"
—Itzama the Crested

name: Walk the Plank
text: When Captain Thorn adds a new ship to his fleet, he gives the crew a simple choice: follow me, or fall in the sea.

name: Charging Monstrosaur
text: "I knew I should have stayed with the boat. Always stay with the boat!"

name: Demolish
text: What took months for human hands to carve took just seconds for the dinosaur's tail to ruin.

name: Frenzied Raptor
text: Sun Empire warriors are taught to emulate the fearless raptors that fling themselves against towers of horn and muscle a hundred times their size.

name: Hijack
text: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas. No matter how many ships he captures, he cannot break free.

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

name: Star of Extinction
text:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

name: Sun-Crowned Hunters
text: One alone is dangerous, and they are never alone.

name: Swashbuckling
text: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition are the descendants of those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, and they are eager for vengeance.

name: Ixalan's Binding
text: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

name: Ancient Brontodon
text: It is taller than all but the tallest trees, and older than all but the oldest.

name: Blossom Dryad
text: The only force on Ixalan not interested in finding the golden city is Ixalan itself.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Deeproot Champion
text: "No good will come from what you seek. Turn back now or suffer an ignoble death far from your home."

name: Jungle Delver
text: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

name: Snapping Sailback
text: Lurking beneath the murky waters of Ixalan's rivers, sailbacks can rip a meal off the shore in the blink of an eye.

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Admiral Beckett Brass
text: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

name: Belligerent Brontodon
text: Predators try to separate the young, old, or injured from the rest of the herd. The alternative is crushing defeat.

name: Legion's Landing
text:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

name: Raging Swordtooth
text: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

name: Looming Altisaur
text: Nature can't be tamed, but the Sun Empire believes that humans are made stronger when they test themselves against the wild strength of the dinosaurs.

name: Thaumatic Compass
text:
"Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of . . ."
—Jace Beleren

name: Paladin of the Bloodstained
text: Closely linked to the Church of Dusk, the paladins of the Bloodstained order are devout to the point of fanaticism.

name: Sanguine Sacrament
text: "As the sun sets to make way for dawn, so we turn to darkness to bring about the coming salvation."

name: Shining Aerosaur
text:
"The invaders cloak themselves in the shadows of dusk. Aerosaurs hide in the brilliance of the noonday sun."
—Caparocti Sunborn

name: Slash of Talons
text:
"The amber sun smokes with fury, gazing on foes that gather like ants invading our home. We are ready! Blade and claw strike as one."
—Huatli

name: Bellowing Aegisaur
text: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.

name: Territorial Hammerskull
text: From the eyes up, it's solid bone and stubbornness.

name: Chart a Course
text: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

name: Dive Down
text: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

name: Herald of Secret Streams
text: "You might as well try to stop the waterfall."

name: Pirate's Prize
text: Nothing warms the heart like plunder.

name: Prosperous Pirates
text: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

name: Search for Azcanta
text: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

name: Shipwreck Looter
text: One pirate's wreck is another's reward.

name: Siren Stormtamer
text: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

name: Storm Sculptor
text: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

name: Tempest Caller
text: "I *am* the storm."

name: Wind Strider
text: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

name: Bishop of the Bloodstained
text: "They shall give us all they have as penance for their resistance. Their ships. Their goods. Their rebellious blood."

name: Costly Plunder
text: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

name: Deadeye Tormentor
text: Despite their noble heritage, the pirates of the Deadeye Fleet are known for underhanded tactics and despicable trickery.

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Plated Geopede
text:
"Kor armorers buy the scales and claws. Elf oracles buy the rest."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Kazandu Blademaster
text: "If you hire a sell-sword, you'd better watch your back. Hire me, and I'll watch it for you."

name: River Boa
text:
"Sheath your swords! Cudgels only. I see a new pair of waterproof trek boots slithering away."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

name: Trusty Machete
text:
"Until this expedition is done, that blade is your guardian, your liberator, and your best friend all rolled into one."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Shepherd of the Lost
text:
"Should you fall in the wilds, lift your voice to the Sky Realm. The one who answers will be your salvation."
—Emeria's Creed

name: Steppe Lynx
text: Nothing quickens the predator's blood like the unfamiliar scents of new hunting grounds and the mewling cries of new prey.

name: Hedron Crab
text: Hedrons perplex minds both great and small.

name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
text: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

name: Merfolk Seastalkers
text:
"Do they seek knowledge or wealth? Are they bandits or benefactors? It depends on who is chanting the tale."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

name: Spreading Seas
text: Most inhabitants of Zendikar have given up on the idea of an accurate map.

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Sygg, River Cutthroat
text: "It's not a matter of deserving. It's a matter of strength. The power to hold versus the power to take."

name: Invisible Stalker
text: "All that concerns me is the vampires' sense of smell and those freezing Nephalian nights."

name: Hagra Mauling
text:
"Din, turn around! Now!"
—Doros, expedition guide

name: Fearless Fledgling
text: Griffins nest in precarious places, so fledglings often find themselves taking their first flights at surprising moments.

name: Thundering Sparkmage
text: "Stay away from my friends!"

name: Valakut Awakening
text:
"My ancestors reshaped the world to their vision. I have a few ideas of my own."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

name: Bala Ged Recovery
text:
"Always have a backup plan."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

name: Kor Celebrant
text: "The landbind ritual connects us to our sacred sites. More importantly, it binds us with every other kor who has visited here, through countless generations."

name: Spoils of Adventure
text: Survival itself is no small reward.

name: Branchloft Pathway
text:
"Not for the bumble-footed nor wobble-stomached."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

name: Brightclimb Pathway
text:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Clearwater Pathway
text:
"Just when the river seems most peaceful, suddenly you round a bend and hurtle down a waterfall."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Cragcrown Pathway
text:
"The greatest danger on the path is a failure of nerve."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Needleverge Pathway
text:
"Once you really trust the rope, you'll learn to sleep standing up."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Riverglide Pathway
text:
"The wind knows the way. Just let it carry you there."
—Amandi, kitesail expert

name: Ondu Inversion
text:
"At first rumble you'd best hold on tight and pray to any gods you still hold dear."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Chilling Trap
text:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Negate
text: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."

name: Ruin Crab
text: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.

name: Bloodchief's Thirst
text: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."

name: Frodo, Determined Hero
text: Frodo's heart flamed within him. He drew his sword and advanced.

name: Gandalf, White Rider
text: He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and the enemy shall fear him.

name: The Balrog, Flame of Udûn
text: An evil of the Ancient World, both a shadow and a flame.

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Ant Queen
text:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Ancient Hellkite
text: When a dragon attacks, there are no bystanders.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Knight Exemplar
text: "If you think you are brave enough to walk the path of honor, follow me into the dragon's den."

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Hamletback Goliath
text:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

name: Megantic Sliver
text: Even the thrums, the lowliest of slivers, become deadly in its presence.

name: Xathrid Necromancer
text: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Ob Nixilis, Unshackled
text: Designed by Brad Muir

name: Phytotitan
text: Its root system spans the entire floor of the jungle, making eradication impossible.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Resolute Archangel
text: Cut it down, bury it in snow, put it to the torch. The rose will still bloom again.

name: Chasm Skulker
text: Designed by Mike Neumann

name: Mercurial Pretender
text: The king went off to find himself. Imagine his terror when he succeeded.

name: Murder
text: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

name: Desecrated Tomb
text: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.

name: Flame Sweep
text:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Corpse Knight
text:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Disfigure
text:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch

name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
text: "Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."

name: Mirran Crusader
text: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

name: Nicol Bolas
text: ニコル・ボーラスは手下と犠牲者を区別しない。

name: Sandbar Crocodile
text:
"We've run aground sandbars before, but today, a sandbar ran aground us."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

name: Zhalfirin Knight
text:
"You returned a warrior. . . . Your hair was cut, your eye tattooed with the red triangle of war."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Jamuraan Lion
text:
Der Löwe zwinkerte
—Ausdruck der Femeref für "noch einmal davongekommen sein"

name: Talruum Champion
text: タールルームの言葉に、「驚かされる」という言い方はない。

name: Shrieking Drake
text:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

name: Shield Wall
text: もっとも堅牢な壁とは、石の壁でも鋼の壁でもなく、力を合わせた戦士たちの壁である。

name: Warmonger
text: Funny how money and war travel so well together.

name: Lightning Hounds
text: Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.

name: Thorn Elemental
text: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

name: Phyrexian Rager
text: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

name: Ascendant Evincar
text:
"Things are going to change around here."
—Crovax

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'"
—Dal myth of the wurm

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Darksteel Juggernaut
text: One part unstoppable force, one part immovable object.

name: Cunning Sparkmage
text: "I see the weaknesses you hide even from yourself."

name: Chandra's Outrage
text:
"Her mind is an incredible mix of emotion and power. Even if I could grasp it, I couldn't hold it for long."
—Jace Beleren, on Chandra Nalaar

name: Chandra's Spitfire
text: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

name: Phantasmal Dragon
text: 嘘と霧から生み出されたものにも関わらず、その飢えと怒りは力を持つ。

name: Cast Down
text:
「誰でも死後に思い出してもらえるかは心配なもの。でも心配ないわ、死は名も無き者のものよ。あなたに名前がある限リ、それを堂々と掲げなさい。」
――リリアナ

name: Shock
text:
電光は魂と世界をつなぎ合わせるまのだ。
――コーの格言

name: Lava Coil
text:
「司令官、ディミーアのスパイを捕らえ、その遺灰を監禁しました。」
――ウォジェクの警備兵、クラム

name: Staggering Insight
text:
「真実から逃げ出すのは臆病者だけ。」
――哲人ペリソフィア

name: Dark Ritual
text:
「ファイレクシアは虚空から生まれた。 機械の父、偉大なるヨーグモスはその完成された形を予見なされた。 かくして『偉大なる進化』が始まった。」

text:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

name: Ultimecia, Temporal Threat
text:
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate."
—Edea Kramer

text: "It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"

text: "This is the end... for all of you."

text: The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."

text: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

text: "I heard you were making my favorite, Aunt May . . ."

text: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

text: 「世界が滅びるその時は、私といっしょにいてくれる？」

—Phyrexian Scriptures

name: Crop Rotation
text: "Hmm... maybe lotuses this year."

name: Command Tower
text:
"We hope you'll thrive here, and by thriving, prove Strixhaven is the best magical university in existence, capable of meeting the needs of students from across the Planes."
—Kasmina

text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Turtle Lair
text: Home is where your pizza delivers.

name: Command Tower
text:
"On today's tour, you will be allowed into my most secured inner sanctum to see, in the flesh, my newest acquisitions: The Guardians of the Galaxy."
—The Collector

text: "Am I the only one around here having any fun?"

text: Shuri enjoys rhythms as complex as her algorithms.

text: By dawn's early light, through the perilous fight, Steve Rogers was still there.

text: Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.

text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

text: "That is what it is to be human: to make yourself more than you are."

name: Spock, Logical Choice
text: "In critical moments, men sometimes see exactly what they wish to see."

name: Benjamin Sisko, Besieged
text: "If we're going to lose, then we're going to go down fighting, so that when our descendants someday rise up against the Dominion, they'll know what they're made of!"

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "Power. Such an ephemeral commodity—hard to gain, easy to lose. And I once thought I understood it. What vanity."

name: Hulking Raptor
text:
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down."
—Huatli

name: Appa, Aang's Companion
text: A sky bison is a companion for life.

name: Spider-Man, Peter Parker
text: "Heroes save people. It's what we do."

name: Overtaker
text: "It's no challenge to master a Mercadian."

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

text: "Do not let yourselves fall now. Zendikar is depending on us—on you!"

text: It left behind an echoing emptiness more horrible than the grave.

text: To dodge the unerring knife, one must be free of thought.

text: The difference between a nuisance and a threat is often merely a matter of numbers.

text: One chill blast—the exhalation of the grave.

text: When emotions rain down, what rivers will be born?

text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

text: A true warrior's thoughts are of victory, not death.

text: It would be a shame to let life slip away to nothing.

text: What burns the land, boils the seas.

text:
"The best armor is to keep out of range."
—Italian proverb

text: Never doubt a dragon just because of its size.

text: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

text: Dry grass is tinder before the spark.

text: The heart's courage is the soul's guardian.

text: It's easy to stand head and shoulders over those with no backbone.

text: Though slow-witted and slow-moving, they are quick to anger.

text: Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.

text: The bigger they are, the harder they avoid work.

text: Swing your axe as a broom, to sweep away the foe.

text: Don't let its appearance frighten you. Let its claws and teeth do that.

text: Mutual consent is not required for war.

text: The herd's patience, the stampede's fury.

name: Mountain Goat
text: Only the heroic and the mad follow mountain goat trails.

text: Chaos does not choose its enemies.

text: Charging alone takes uncommon daring or uncommon stupidity. Or both.

text: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

text: It pelts the land with its fury, spoiling what was once sweet.

text: "Hesitation is for the faithless. My belief lends me speed."

I cast a thousand tiny suns—
Beware my many dawns.

text: There are few things as motivating as a swarm of bees.

—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

text: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

—*The Bible*, Proverbs 15:33

text: The soldier reaped the profits of peace.

—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Kubla Khan"

—John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

—John Gay, "The What D'Ye Call It"

text: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer, / Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"

text: Ojutai sought to rewrite history. Those who disagreed sought the truth elsewhere.

text:
"What will be has always been."
—Wall inscription

text: "Today's the last day you'll fear sewer crocs, Garg. From now on, the sewer crocs will fear you."

text:
"Oh, how I love gold. I'd eat and breathe it if I could."
—Leland, tax collector

name: Thought Scour
text:
"Sleep and dream, dream and snore,
While we fae complete our chore."
—Fae rhyme

text: "If you make me spill my drink, you're buying me a new one."

text: Not even the most scathing critics can break her concentration.

name: Mana Drain
text: "I suppose you've never heard of conservation of energy."

text: Don't dig up the past if you're not prepared for the consequences.

text: Their bodies rotted, their bones splintered, and their souls frayed to tatters. Only then were they granted the mercy of death.

text:

—Magistrate's assistant

text:
"No sign of movement. Looks like we've got the element of sur—"

text: Confused but undeterred, the butterflies charged into battle.

text:
"Toralf struck the ground with his hammer, and the force of a thousand storms tore through the demonic horde."
—Birgi, god of storytelling

name: Dockside Extortionist
text: The fine print is illegible scribbles, but it is legally binding.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Lord Windgrace dedicated his life to restoring Urborg to its former glory.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers all those who would otherwise be forgotten.

text:

—Huatli

text:
"Realms emerge and wither like autumn leaves, but the World Tree endures eternally."

text: Members of the Simic Combine adapt themselves to suit whatever role they feel drawn to.

text:

—Archelle, chief exterminator

text: To be Arbiter is to dispense few words and many judgments.

text:

text: There's no better defense than simply being out of reach.

text: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

text: Cloudy with a chance of chaos.

text: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
text: Yargle hadn't bargained on her showing up.

name: Vedalken Orrery
text:
"My observations of the Multiverse are too valuable not to preserve for posterity."
—Dovin Baan

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: She awoke with blood on her brow, an axe in her hand, and heads at her feet.

name: Pithing Needle
text: Phyrexians spent countless hours unsuccessfully trying to harvest and recreate blinkmoth serum.

name: Phyrexian Altar
text: Offerings must first be freed from the prison of their own skin before they're welcomed into the Flesh Singularity.

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text:
"From dust and light She coaxed forth an uncorrupted world. By Her grace we dwell here, free from suffering."
—Song of All, canto 11

name: City of Brass
text: To walk its streets is to burn in its beauty.

name: Urza, Prince of Kroog

"At heart, Urza was an inventor, not a warlord. Over time, the burdens of leadership left him as cold and calculating as his mechanical creations."
—The Antiquities War

"With the Brotherhood of Gix whispering in his ear, Mishra's drive to prove himself was slowly twisted into an insatiable hunger for power."
—The Antiquities War

text: Fascinated by the lore of ancient struggles, archaeologists search incessantly for remnants of an earlier, more powerful era.

text:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."

—Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*

—John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

—*The Seer's Parables*

"We're going to need a bigger gate."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
text: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

name: Shrapnel Blast
text: To the Krark Clan, every artifact has a trigger and a barrel.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Raissa transformed herself into a vessel for the Watchword Codex, allowing the arcane lore to flow through her body.

name: Woolly Thoctar
text: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

name: Sprouting Thrinax
text: The vast network of predation on Jund has actually caused some strange creatures to adapt to being eaten.

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Armadillo Cloak
text:
"Don't laugh. It works."
—Yavimaya ranger

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Gerrard's Verdict
text: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

name: Firebolt
text: Reach out and torch someone.

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun-and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Smother
text:
"I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg."
—Phage the Untouchable

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Silver Knight
text: Otaria's last defense against the wave of chaos threatening to engulf it.

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Exalted Angel
text:
"She is a theme of honor and renown, . . . Whose present courage may beat down our foes."
—William Shakespeare, *Troilus and Cressida*

name: Overbeing of Myth
text:
"She walks among us unseen, learning from our imperfections."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Malfegor
text: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

name: Avatar of Discord
text: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

name: Creeping Mold
text:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Diabolic Edict
text: Greven il-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

name: Shock
text:
"Once I saw a goblin shouting at a thunderstorm. He lost the argument pretty quickly."
—Wandering mage

name: Vexing Shusher
text: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

name: Cenn's Tactician
text: "A well-trained force brings peace . . . which brings more time for training!"

name: Engineered Plague
text:
"The admixture of bitterwort in the viral brew has produced most favorable results."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Knight of New Alara
text: "I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Astral Slide
text:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

name: Sparksmith
text: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

name: Lightning Rift
text: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

name: Krosan Warchief
text: It turns prey into predator.

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Ant Queen
text:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

name: Vampire Nocturnus
text: "Your life will set with the sun."

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Hypnotic Specter
text:
"There was no trace
Of aught on that illumined face . . . ."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Phantom"

name: Icy Manipulator
text: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

name: Juggernaut
text: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

name: Headless Horseman
text: ". . . The ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head . . . he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast . . ." —Washington Irving, *The Legend of Sleepy Hollow*

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Whirling Dervish
text: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Duress
text:
"We decide who is worthy of our works."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Zodiac Monkey
text: ". . . By six offensives from the hills of Qi Kongming sought to change Han's destiny. . . ."

name: Pendelhaven
text: The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Wall of Roots
text: Root systems in Mwonvuli twist through currents of mana rather than soil.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Wee Dragonauts
text:
"The blazekite is a simple concept, really-just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

name: Castigate
text:
"We have no need for military might. We wield two of the sharpest swords ever forged: Faith in our left hand, Wealth in our right."
—Vuliev of the Ghost Council

name: Black Knight
text:
"The chill, to him who breathed it, drew / Down with his blood, till all his heart was cold."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, *Idyls of the King*

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: White Knight
text:
"When good men die their goodness does not perish, / But lives though they are gone."
—Euripides, *Termenidae*, trans. Morgan

name: City of Brass
text:
"Enter this palace-gate and ask the news
Of greatness fallen into dust and clay."
—*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Burton

name: Hedge Troll
text: His abode was clean and bare, not a morsel in sight. I asked him what he ate, fearing the answer. He smiled and said his faith alone sustained him.

name: Underworld Dreams
text:
"In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."
—Rabindranath Tagore

name: Ball Lightning
text:
"Life, struck sharp on death,
Makes awful lightning."
—Elizabeth Barrett Browning,
"Aurora Leigh"

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text:
"They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred. Let them be cast out."
—Ailheen, Speaker of the Council

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, wizard savant

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Volcanic Geyser
text:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

name: Longbow Archer
text:
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Roya, Zhalfirin archer

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately."
—Henry David Thoreau, *Walden*

name: River Boa
text:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Uktabi Orangutan
text:
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Ophidian
text:
"I will . . . tell thee more than thou hast wit to ask."
—Christopher Marlowe, *Doctor Faustus*

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Dauthi Slayer
text:
"A wisp of life remains in the undergloom of Death: a visible form, though no heart beats within it."
—Homer, *The Iliad*, trans. Fitzgerald

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Mogg Fanatic
text:
"As if his chest had been a mortar, he burst his hot heart's shell upon it."
—Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*

name: Fireslinger
text:
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

name: Time Warp
text:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Tradewind Rider
text:
"'Tis a shame, in such a tempest, to have but one anchor."
—Laurence Sterne, *Tristram Shandy*

name: Bottle Gnomes
text:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Scragnoth
text: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

name: Jackal Pup
text:
"Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war."
—William Shakespeare, *Julius Caesar*

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Chill
text:
"Temper, temper."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Zoetic Cavern
text: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

name: Yixlid Jailer
text: He holds the keys to a tombful of incarcerated secrets.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Fling
text: It's raining rats and moggs.

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Wall of Blossoms
text:
"Everything in Nature contains all the powers of Nature."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Compensation"

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
text: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

name: Wood Elves
text: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

name: Carnophage
text:
"And in their blind and unattaining state their miserable lives have sunk so low that they must envy every other fate."
—Dante, *Inferno*, trans. Ciardi

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Cast the weight as though it were a die, to see a rival's fate.

name: Pouncing Jaguar
text: One pounce, she's hungry-you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs-you're in for a long day.

name: Gaea's Cradle
text:
"Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Arc Lightning
text:
"It is vain to look for a defense against lightning."
—Publius Syrus, Maxim 835, trans. Lyman

name: Elvish Lyrist
text:
"Make me thy lyre, even as the forest is:
What if my leaves are falling like its own!"
—Percy Bysshe Shelley,
"Ode to the West Wind"

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Rewind
text:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Skittering Skirge
text: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

name: Lu Bu, Master-at-Arms
text: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer, / Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

name: Resurrection
text:
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more."
—War blessing of Serra

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Char
text: If you've never choked on the embers of your own spell, you aren't casting it hard enough.

name: Phyrexian Negator
text: They exist to cease.

name: Broodmate Dragon
text: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter-and were promptly eaten by its diving mate.

name: Warmonger
text: Funny how money and war travel so well together.

name: Lightning Hounds
text: Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.

name: Merrow Reejerey
text: Steady and silent as the deep current, the reejerey guides the course of the school.

name: Slave of Bolas
text: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

name: Accumulated Knowledge
text:
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."
—Takara, to Eladamri

name: Marisi's Twinclaws
text:
"Looks like we're completely outnumbered."
"Lucky for us. I thought we'd be bored."

name: Naya Sojourners
text: The elves had entered a land like an open grave-an act of fortitude or folly?

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Kor Duelist
text: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Day of Judgment
text:
"I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust. It brought no pleasure, even to a heart as dark as mine."
—Sorin Markov

name: Boomerang
text:
"Returne from whence ye came. . . ."
—Edmund Spenser, *The Faerie Queene*

name: Terminate
text: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Chainer's Edict
text: The pits have their own form of mercy.

name: Arrogant Wurm
text: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

name: Whipcorder
text: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Rukh Egg
text: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

name: Myr Enforcer
text: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Okina Nightwatch
text: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

name: Mind Control
text:
"Why fight the body when you can dominate the mind that rules it?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Meddling Mage
text: Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.

name: Pernicious Deed
text:
"The tyrannous and bloody deed is done,
The most arch deed of piteous massacre
That ever yet this land was guilty of."
—William Shakespeare, *Richard III*

name: Sudden Shock
text: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

name: Terra Stomper
text: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

name: Pathrazer of Ulamog
text: No thought but hunger. No strategy but destruction.

name: Curse of Wizardry
text:
"We must all push through the pain to heal our world."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Cloudpost
text:
"He watches from above. He watches from below. He watches from within."
—Inscription on Tel-Jilad, the Tree of Tales

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle en-Vec

name: Fling
text: Sometimes the cannoneer must become the cannonball.

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Ancient Hellkite
text: When a dragon attacks, there are no bystanders.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Birds of Paradise
text:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Wild Nacatl
text: "The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city-once the toll is paid."

name: Memoricide
text: "You claim wisdom, yet I see nothing in here but tawdry wishes."

name: Plague Stinger
text: It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.

name: Golem's Heart
text: The heart of a golem gives life to more than just the iron husk around it.

name: Memnite
text: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

name: Pierce Strider
text:
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Peace Strider
text:
"The Vanished must have sent it from beyond to aid us in this struggle."
—Kessla, Sylvok shaman

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Bitterblossom
text: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

name: Mirran Crusader
text: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

name: Plague Myr
text: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

name: Master's Call
text: The need to obey was inscribed on every plate in their bodies.

name: Signal Pest
text: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

name: Pristine Talisman
text:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Vault Skirge
text: From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.

name: Rhox War Monk
text: Rhox monks are dedicated to spiritual growth and learning, and most bear the sigils of many students. However, they do not gladly suffer fools or those who disagree with their carefully wrought dogma.

name: Darksteel Relic
text:
"It's the last thing we can call our own."
—Minhu, Mirran resistance

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Jace's Ingenuity
text: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

name: Auramancer
text: "In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."

name: Circle of Flame
text:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Tormented Soul
text: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

name: Boneyard Wurm
text: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.

name: Bloodcrazed Neonate
text: While elder vampires select their meals with care, the newly sired frenzy at the first whiff.

name: Mayor of Avabruck
text: He can deny his true nature for only so long.

name: Devil's Play
text: A devil's hands are never idle.

name: Curse of the Bloody Tome
text: After seeing his life's work drip away, the mage decided it was a good time to go crazy.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Go for the Throat
text: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

name: Despise
text:
"Truth is always a weapon in your enemies' hands."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Glistener Elf
text: "Beg me for life, and I will fill you with the glory of Phyrexian perfection."

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Curse of Thirst
text:
"May you drink until you drown but never be sated."
—Odila, witch of Morkrut

name: Ravenous Demon
text: His twisted words entice the weak.

name: Mondronen Shaman
text: "Tovolar, my master. Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak."

name: Nearheath Stalker
text: "Do not speak of this to the elders. They look unfavorably upon my indulgences."

name: Gather the Townsfolk
text: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

name: Natural Order
text: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Retaliator Griffin
text: For every eye, an eye. For every tooth, a tooth. Griffins are nothing if not fair.

name: Honor of the Pure
text: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

name: Ancient Ziggurat
text: Leylines branch out from its foundation like roots from a tree. These draw mana from every region and welcome all living things into its verdant chambers.

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Leatherback Baloth
text: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Ancient Grudge
text: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar-especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text:
"Living side by side with the elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."
—Kolbjorn, elder druid of the Juniper Order

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: Knowing the hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

name: Pyrokinesis
text:
"Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Staff of Nin
text:
"I have attuned the staff to your screams so that only I may benefit from your pain."
—Volux, disciple of Nin

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

name: Dryad Militant
text: "We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost."

name: Gitaxian Probe
text:
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on."
—Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance

name: Pillar of Flame
text: "May the worthy spend an eternity in Blessed Sleep. May the wicked find the peace of oblivion."

name: Deadbridge Goliath
text: Some Golgari insects live for centuries-and they never stop growing.

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Carnival Hellsteed
text: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law-strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members-and the doomed.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Show and Tell
text: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

name: Nether Void
text: These days, some wizards are finding that they have a little too much spell left at the end of their mana.

name: The Abyss
text:
"An immense river of oblivion is sweeping us away into a nameless abyss."
—Ernest Renan, *Souvenirs d'Enfance et de Jeunesse*

name: Mishra's Workshop
text: Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia, Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose. Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.

name: Moat
text: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

name: Metalworker
text:
"At this rate I fully expect to be replaced by a clockwork golem by year's end."
—Barrin

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Skarrg Goliath
text:
"They bind us with their laws. We free ourselves with nature's fist."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Searing Spear
text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Render Silent
text: "We have confiscated your spells as evidence. Once we conclude our investigation, you may petition to have them returned."

name: Megantic Sliver
text: Even the thrums, the lowliest of slivers, become deadly in its presence.

name: Dimir Charm
text:
"Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to."
—Lazav

name: Rakdos Cackler
text: Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.

name: Vengevine
text: Leave but a shred of root and it will return, bursting with vigor.

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
text:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Sin Collector
text: "That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Karametra's Acolyte
text: "The wilds are a garden tended by divine hands."

name: Sylvan Caryatid
text: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.

name: Anthousa, Setessan Hero
text: The warriors she leads can rarely keep pace with her, and neither can the tales.

name: Entomb
text: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Warleader's Helix
text:
"There is no time to remedy our enemies' ignorance. Blast it out of them."
—Aurelia

name: Greater Good
text:
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death."
—Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*

name: Banisher Priest
text: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

name: Silent Sentinel
text: It serves a justice higher than the whims of the gods.

name: Eater of Hope
text: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

name: Forgestoker Dragon
text: The Akroans fashion their helms to honor the dragons, not to protect against them, as that would be of little help.

name: Encroaching Wastes
text: Every world is a work in progress, constantly reshaped by time, disasters, and even the powerful magic of Planeswalkers.

name: Lion's Eye Diamond
text:
Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
text: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
text: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

name: Stealer of Secrets
text: www.MagicTheGathering.com

name: Xathrid Necromancer
text: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
text: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Spawn of Thraxes
text: Sparks from Purphoros's forge fill the belly of every dragon.

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Heroes' Bane
text: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

name: Dawnbringer Charioteers
text: "Nyx may belong to the gods, but the skies of Theros are ours."

name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
text: Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.

name: Dissolve
text: "You thought only the gods could stop you?"

name: Magma Spray
text: A stone hurled at an enemy is deadlier in liquid form.

name: Hall of Triumph
text: Heroes act without thought of glory or reward. Accolades are a consequence, not a goal.

name: Resolute Archangel
text: Cut it down, bury it in snow, put it to the torch. The rose will still bloom again.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Mercurial Pretender
text: The king went off to find himself. Imagine his terror when he succeeded.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Phytotitan
text: Its root system spans the entire floor of the jungle, making eradication impossible.

name: Bile Blight
text: Not an arrow loosed, javelin thrown, nor sword raised. None were needed.

name: Prophet of Kruphix
text: "Time is fluid as a dance, and truth as fleeting."

name: Font of Fertility
text: Drink deep, and know the path to the heart of the wilds.

name: Ivorytusk Fortress
text: Abzan soldiers march to war confident that their Houses march with them.

name: Avalanche Tusker
text:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

name: Rakshasa Vizier
text: Rakshasa offer deals that sound advantageous to those who forget who they are dealing with.

name: Sage of the Inward Eye
text: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
text: "Do not concern yourself with my origin, my race, or my ancestry. Seek my record in the pits, and then make your wager."

name: Sultai Charm
text: "Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."

name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
text: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Dragonscale General
text: "Dragons seek war. I bring it to them."

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: "Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Sandsteppe Mastodon
text: A mastodon's path always leads to an oasis.

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Griselbrand
text:
"Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price—him."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

name: Rishadan Port
text: Rishada is the gateway to free trade-but the key will cost you.

name: Fierce Invocation
text: Anger can empower those who embrace it.

name: Hewed Stone Retainers
text:
"Their origins are shrouded in mystery. I believe they are the protectors of the lost secrets of our world."
—Jilaya, Temur whisperer

name: Wildcall
text: A howl on the wind hides many dangers.

name: Soul Summons
text: Ugin's magic reaches beyond the dragons. The clans have adapted it for war.

name: Sultai Emissary
text: To the Sultai, Ugin's power was just one more resource to be exploited.

name: Ugin's Construct
text: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin, but he gleaned the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.

name: Debilitating Injury
text: Weakness exists within all who are not dragons.

name: Smite the Monstrous
text: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.

name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
text: "There are many different paths. The Great Teacher reveals them all."

name: Ghostfire Blade
text: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.

name: Ainok Tracker
text:
"The ainok are wild dogs, not fit to join us around the fire."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Briber's Purse
text: The bigger the hand, the higher the price.

name: Hordeling Outburst
text: Kolaghan goblins rush into battle to satisfy their desire for violence as well as their desire not to be eaten.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Altar of the Brood
text: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "Your enemies may be cowardly, my lord, but one should never call them gutless."

name: Arc Lightning
text: Lightning burns the dragon's path.

name: Dragonscale Boon
text: Only those who have proved themselves worthy are granted a dragon's scale.

name: Ravages of War
text:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*, trans. Feng and English

name: Dualcaster Mage
text: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Wasteland
text: The land was left depleted and empty, an unsettling taste of things to come.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Frost Walker
text:
"As the clans carved out their territories, we saw allies where the Mardu saw only obstacles."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Abzan Beastmaster
text: His beasts move the great siege towers of the Abzan across the endless sands.

name: Sunscorch Regent
text:
"We trust in the scalelords, bringers of justice that none can escape."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Arashin Sovereign
text: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

name: Boltwing Marauder
text: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.

name: Pristine Skywise
text: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

name: Harbinger of the Hunt
text: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

name: Seeker of the Way
text: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

name: Valorous Stance
text:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
text: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

name: Siege Rhino
text: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

name: Dromoka, the Eternal
text:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text: That which endures, survives.

name: Mizzium Meddler
text: Energy surges in Izzet labs are opportunities for experimentation.

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Hero of Goma Fada
text: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

name: Defiant Bloodlord
text:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Barrage Tyrant
text: Terrible fury. Excellent aim.

name: Roast
text: The wave of lava seared cloth from skin, skin from flesh, and flesh from bone.

name: Anticipate
text: "You thought I wouldn't see that coming?"

name: Ultimate Price
text: "He's paid his price. Now you pay mine."

name: Scythe Leopard
text: Eldrazi are not the leopard's preferred prey, but they are better than no prey at all.

name: Oblivion Sower
text: The Eldrazi hunger without limit and consume without pause.

name: Accumulated Knowledge
text:
"Learn not only from the failures of the past, but also from its triumphs."
—Isperia

name: Explore
text:
"I will never run out of new oceans to explore or new sea-dwellers to embrace as my own."
—Kiora

name: Mother of Runes
text: She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Munda's Vanguard
text: "Do not let yourselves fall now. Zendikar is depending on us-on you!"

name: Dread Defiler
text: It left behind an echoing emptiness more horrible than the grave.

name: Clash of Wills
text:
"The mind of an Eldrazi is a puzzle that can never be solved. The trick is to make sure a piece goes missing."
—Jace Beleren

name: Smash to Smithereens
text:
"All these old relics have one thing in common. Every last one of them is made of smithereens."
—Zada of Slab Haven

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The worst part isn't the pain, or the smell, or even the fear of death. It's hearing the clatter of bone on stone and knowing the bones are yours.

name: Goblin Warchief
text: Inspiration comes in all shapes and sizes.

name: Flameblade Angel
text: "You must pay for your sin in blood."

name: Markov Dreadknight
text: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

name: Soul Swallower
text: Being engulfed is just the beginning of the nightmare.

name: Blighted Fen
text:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

name: Elusive Tormentor
text: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Dread Return
text: The will to return can overpower the will to survive.

name: Ravenous Bloodseeker
text:
"Nothing will cool the fire in their blood. They are too far gone. We must keep them away from our towns at any cost."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
text: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned-at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

name: Assembled Alphas
text: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

name: Ulvenwald Observer
text:
"I tell you, the trees were closing in! It's by the grace of the Heron alone that I made it out of the Ulvenwald!"
—Ricton, traveling merchant

name: Spatial Contortion
text:
"For those without the Planeswalker spark, the merest touch of the Blind Eternities can kill."
—Ugin

name: Flaying Tendrils
text: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

name: Saheeli's Artistry
text: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Call the Bloodline
text: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: The Rack
text: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the rack was once his most feared creation.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law-strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The form of the sigil is just as important as the sigil itself. If it's carried on a medallion, its bearer is a master. If it's tattooed on the body, its bearer is a slave.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Grave Titan
text: Death in form and function.

name: Razorfin Hunter
text: No one knew if they'd been lurking under the sea all along, or if they'd been created by the Phyrexian overlay.

name: Lowland Oaf
text: "I don't know why the little one was so mad. He said to put him down, and I put him down."

name: Rupture
text: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

name: Grindstone
text: Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone.

name: Scryb Sprites
text: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

name: Thran Golem
text: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members-and the doomed.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Inferno
text:
"Some have said there is no subtlety to destruction. You know what? They're dead."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Snap
text: Good riddance.

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

name: Chittering Rats
text: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

name: Epic Struggle
text:
"If our foes will not listen to words, perhaps hooves and claws will make them take notice."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Hoodwink
text: The youths of Rishada's marketplace are always ready for a quick footrace.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Aether Storm
text:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Fire-Lit Thicket
text: Occupancy of the den changes from night to night as boggart gangs fight for control of a place they aren't willing to simply eat.

name: Decimate
text: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

name: Exploration
text:
"Only when we journey into the unknown can we find the impossible."
—Cyrul the Wanderer

name: Rout
text:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Triumph of Ferocity
text:
"Rid me of this curse, witch, or die with me."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Exclude
text:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

name: Elvish Pioneer
text: "Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."

name: Consume the Meek
text:
"Others ask why the Eldrazi destroy. I ask why they preserve."
—Ganda, Goma Fada deserter

name: Silkwrap
text: Better scarves than scars.

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
text: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Burgeoning
text: The first vine shows the others where to grow.

name: Wave of Reckoning
text: We shall suffer turmoil equal to that which we have wrought, whether in this life or the next.

name: Beacon of Unrest
text: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

name: Crop Rotation
text: Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Doom Blade
text:
"One little word was all it took. The world shook as I said it. The doom of Zendikar was here at last."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Wood Elves
text: Through the waves of Eldrazi attacks, the Murasan jungles seemed to regrow as soon as they were destroyed.

name: Fortune's Favor
text: Uncertainty has its own allure.

name: Incendiary Flow
text: "What's your plan?" Gideon asked. "Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

name: Quicksmith Rebel
text: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

name: Noose Constrictor
text:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

name: Gaddock Teeg
text: So great is his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: Servo Exhibition
text: Impressing a judge is one thing. Delighting a child is another.

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Aether Hub
text: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Ramunap Excavator
text: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

name: Reverse Engineer
text: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

name: Renegade Rallier
text: "This fight belongs to us all."

name: Doran, the Siege Tower
text: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

name: Pendelhaven
text: The limbs of Pendelhaven extend as far as the meek roam, and reach as high as they strive.

name: Bishop of Rebirth
text: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

name: Burning Sun's Avatar
text:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
text: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

name: Zhalfirin Void
text:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

name: Opt
text: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

name: Cast Down
text:
"Your life is finished, your name lost, and your work forgotten. It is as though Mazeura never existed."
—*Chainer's Torment*

name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
text: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

name: Vampiric Tutor
text: "I can tell you what you wish to know. But first, there is the matter of my fee."

name: Merchant Scroll
text: A rare find, suitable for the most discerning collector.

name: Desecrated Tomb
text: The grave robbers were startled, for the door to the mausoleum was already open.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: The most holy treasures are kept far from unclean soil.

name: Murder
text: "It's not work if you enjoy it."

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Lord of Atlantis
