text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Food Chain
text: Every predator is something else's prey.

name: Brainstorm
text: "I have a plan. Actually, I have three."

name: Blue Elemental Blast
text: "Contrary to popular wisdom, I find it's best to fight fire with its opposite."

name: Mystical Tutor
text: "It's not just what you know. It's knowing where to find what you don't."

name: Threads of Disloyalty
text: "Every thought is a string. You just have to find the right ones to pull."

name: Curious Pair
text: "It's gingerbread, like Mother makes. What is there to be afraid of?"

name: Smitten Swordmaster
text: "My quest? Why, to marry Ayara. Or die trying."

name: Embereth Shieldbreaker
text: "Courage is the only shield I need."

name: Merchant of the Vale
text: "Buying old, worn out junk. Selling marvels of real value."

name: Garenbrig Carver
text: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

name: Giant Killer
text: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

name: Shepherd of the Flock
text: Not all heroes carry swords.

name: Bonecrusher Giant
text: Not every tale ends in glory.

name: Flaxen Intruder
text: The middle blade was just right.

name: Tuinvale Treefolk
text: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

name: Merfolk Secretkeeper
text: Merfolk curiosity usually has dire consequences, but rarely for the merfolk.

name: Lovestruck Beast
text: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

name: Silverflame Squire
text: Beacons along the borderlands are lit at any incursion from the wilds.

name: Rosethorn Acolyte
text: "Old battlefields make great gardens. So rich from the blood of the fallen."

name: Faerie Guidemother
text: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Akiri, Line-Slinger
text: Her bold movements are anchored in the careful precision of each rope.

name: Elite Spellbinder
text: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Dragonsguard Elite
text: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

name: Fracture
text:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

name: Mortality Spear
text: "Death is my life's work."

name: Decisive Denial
text: "I've heard enough."

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Rip Apart
text: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

name: Sanctum Prelate
text: "This area is off-limits to you."

name: Giver of Runes
text: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: King of the Pride
text:
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Force of Negation
text: "Try, if you must."

name: Faerie Seer
text: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

name: Plague Engineer
text:
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Defile
text: The only shortcut in a bog is to the bottom.

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—The Red Book of Mezdrithalik

name: Imperial Recruiter
text: A passionate recruiter will win a war before the first arrow flies.

name: Magmatic Sinkhole
text: Opening like the maw of a hellion, the earth swallowed the traveler whole.

name: Shenanigans
text: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
text: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

name: Force of Vigor
text: The vines overgrew the construct, snapping gears and soaking up aether.

name: Llanowar Tribe
text: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

name: Weather the Storm
text: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

name: Mirari's Wake
text: Its passage through history is marked by warped desires and insatiable greed.

name: Shardless Agent
text: "The left blade for a swift, painless death. The right blade for a long, lingering one. The choice is mine."

name: Vindicate
text: "I am the mad one!"

name: Lavabelly Sliver
text: Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.

name: Universal Automaton
text:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Curiosity
text:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Talisman of Resilience
text:
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest."
—Vraska

name: Cabal Coffers
text: The Cabal required a suitably immense space to house the lucrative fruits of their religious zeal.

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
text: The stronghold of Theros's light.

name: Prismatic Vista
text: There is beauty in the uncertainty of potential.

name: Triskaidekaphile
text: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

name: Sigarda's Summons
text: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

name: Strionic Resonator
text: Its tines cannot be rung by mere physical force. Only magic of great power can start its eldritch resonance.

name: Spelltwine
text: "Two spells are more than one."

name: Enter the Infinite
text: There is no knowledge that is not power.

name: Blast of Genius
text:
"Knowledge is the greatest virtue—with the courage to apply it."
—Rowan and Will Kenrith

name: Essence Warden
text: "Life begets life."

name: Invoke Despair
text: Although officials said it was a sewer failure, the people whispered that it was a warning of night's reach.

name: Mishra's Bauble
text:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

name: Green Sun's Zenith
text: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Mortify
text:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

name: Pestilence Demon
text: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

name: Deadbridge Goliath
text: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

name: Carnival Hellsteed
text: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Demigod of Revenge
text:
"His laugh, a bellowing, deathly din, slices through the heavens, making them bleed."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Vexing Shusher
text: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

name: Elusive Tormentor
text: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

name: Markov Dreadknight
text: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

name: Flameblade Angel
text: "You must pay for your sin in blood."

name: Ravenous Bloodseeker
text:
"Nothing will cool the fire in their blood. They are too far gone. We must keep them away from our towns at any cost."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Soul Swallower
text: Being engulfed is just the beginning of the nightmare.

name: Memoricide
text: "You claim wisdom, yet I see nothing in here but tawdry wishes."

name: Elektra, Daughter of the Hand
text: Elektra immersed herself in a dark and bloody vendetta against the world.

name: Riddles in the Dark
text:
"What have I got in my pocket?"
—Bilbo

name: Super Shredder
text:
"The last of the mutagen! He must've drank it!"
—Donatello

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Ultima
text: "Witness my creation!"

name: Revenant
text:
"Not again."
—Hans

name: Slith Firewalker
text: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

name: Royal Assassin
text: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Whirling Dervish
text: Amid this whirling hurricane of blades, there is no calm eye in which the hapless can find shelter.

name: Glorious Anthem
text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

name: Elvish Champion
text: "We've endured your slights to Gaea with the grace of tolerance. Now behold the grace of our ferocity."

name: Mad Auntie
text: One part cunning, one part wise, and many, many parts demented.

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Elvish Lyrist
text:
"Make me thy lyre, even as the forest is: What if my leaves are falling like its own!"
—Percy Bysshe Shelley,
"Ode to the West Wind"

name: City of Brass
text:
"Enter this palace-gate and ask the news Of greatness fallen into dust and clay."
—*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Burton

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Cast the weight as though it were a die, to see a rival's fate.

name: Anthousa, Setessan Hero
text: The warriors she leads can rarely keep pace with her, and neither can the tales.

name: Karametra's Acolyte
text: "The wilds are a garden tended by divine hands."

name: Sylvan Caryatid
text: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Alert Shu Infantry
text: Kongming's predecessor helped Liu Bei win the battle of Fancheng by recognizing and defeating Cao Ren's use of the dreaded "Eight Gold Locks" formation.

name: Barbarian General
text:
"Barbarian tribes with their rulers are inferior to Chinese states without them."
—Confucius, *The Analects* (trans. Lau)

name: Barbarian Horde
text: Only twenty years after the Sima clan united the empire, invading barbarians divided it again.

name: Blaze
text: "Spreading flames illumined cloud and sea: Cao Cao went down; 'twas Zhou Yu's victory."

name: Burning Fields
text:
"In raiding and plundering, be like fire, in immovability like a mountain."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

name: Control of the Court
text: "Power-hungry eunuchs, the curse of the dynasty, have thrown the masses of the people into the depths of misery."

name: Desert Sandstorm
text: While pursuing the remnants of Yuan Shao's forces into the Wuhan Desert, Cao Cao was temporarily turned back by a fierce sandstorm.

name: Liu Bei, Lord of Shu
text:
"Only wisdom and virtue can truly win men's devotion."
—Liu Bei

name: Eunuchs' Intrigues
text: Taking control of powerful court positions one by one, eunuchs eventually brought on the fall of the Han dynasty, leading to the chaos of the Three Kingdoms.

name: Fire Ambush
text: "With fire he broke the battle at Bowang . . . . Striking fear deep into Cao Cao's soul, thus Kongming scored a coup at his debut."

name: Independent Troops
text: "The empire, long united, must divide, and long divided, must unite."

name: Lu Bu, Master-at-Arms
text: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer, / Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

name: Mountain Bandit
text: Penniless and far from home, many former Yellow Scarves and other soldiers became bandits to survive.

name: Ravaging Horde
text: Upon his return to the capitol after taking soldiers to loot a nearby peaceful town, the prime minister, Dong Zhou, boasted of it as a victory over bandits.

name: Relentless Assault
text: With only 70,000 men under his command at the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao was able to defeat Yuan Shao and his 700,000.

name: Renegade Troops
text: "Across the land rebellions seethed and swarmed / As vicious war lords swooped down on all sides."

name: Stone Rain
text: Soldiers often blocked off the steep mountain passes to ambush enemy troops in western and central China.

name: Warrior's Oath
text:
"If I fail, my head is yours."
—Warrior's oath common during the Three Kingdoms period

name: Yellow Scarves General
text: Zhang Jue, leader of the Yellow Scarves rebellion, was a Taoist master and tutored his soldiers in those arts.

name: Yellow Scarves Troops
text: Over 500,000 commoners followed Zhang Jue, General of Heaven, in his attempt to overthrow the corrupt Han dynasty.

name: Misfortune's Gain
text: The mourning families of commanders and generals were often given land, valuables, or money to compensate for their losses.

name: Zodiac Dog
text: ". . . Jiang Wei alone still strove with might and main: / Nine times more he fought the north—in vain. . . ."

name: Zodiac Dragon
text: ". . . The kingdoms three are now the stuff of dream, / For men to ponder, past all praise or blame."

name: Zodiac Goat
text: ". . . Near death in Baidi, having reigned three years, / Bei sadly placed his son in Kongming's care. . . ."

name: False Mourning
text: Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other famous generals feigned their deaths in order to later surprise their opponents.

name: Forest Bear
text:
Fish and bear paws—one can't have both.
—Chinese idiom meaning "you can't have it both ways"

name: Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen
text:
"A man, and such a fool! I, a woman, will fight them for you."
—Lady Zhurong to her husband Meng Huo, before leading an army against the Shu

name: Pang Tong, "Young Phoenix"
text: ". . . It was Pang Tong's boat-connecting scheme That let Zhou Yu accomplish his great deed."

name: Meng Huo, Barbarian King
text: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

name: Meng Huo's Horde
text: Through his allies, Meng Huo commanded several hundred thousand troops composed of cavalry, rattan-armored warriors, infantry, naked men with swords, and wild animals.

name: Riding the Dilu Horse
text:
"All men have their appointed time; that's something no horse can change."
—Liu Bei, after being told that the Dilu brings its master ill fortune

name: Slashing Tiger
text:
"Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cubs."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

name: Southern Elephant
text: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

name: Spring of Eternal Peace
text: Bathing in this spring could cure ailments of body and mind alike.

name: Stalking Tiger
text: Throughout Chinese history, generals have often been referred to as tigers for their fierceness, strength, and bravery.

name: Peach Garden Oath
text:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood . . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

name: Taoist Hermit
text: Taoists chose to be hermits for many reasons, but all shared one unchanging goal: to follow the Tao.

name: Taoist Mystic
text: By appearing in places miles apart at the same time, Zuo Ci exhibited the mystic's ability to "shrink the land."

name: Taunting Challenge
text: Incensed by their opponents' unrelenting taunts, even wise generals were known to rashly lead their troops into battle—often to disastrous defeats.

name: Three Visits
text:
"Trying to meet a worthy man in the wrong way is as bad as closing the door on an invited guest."
—Mencius, a Chinese philosopher

name: Trained Cheetah
text: "[King Mulu's cheetahs] came riding on the winds, charging, with fangs bared and claws flexed."

name: Trained Jackal
text: To taunt a man into action, call him a coward. To insult him beyond forgiveness, call him a jackal.

name: Trip Wire
text: Trip wire, hooked poles, and sunken pits were commonly used to unhorse riders during the Three Kingdoms period.

name: Wielding the Green Dragon
text: Named for the eastern part of the sky, the source of energy and renewal, Guan Yu's crescent-moon blade weighed over 100 pounds.

name: Zodiac Horse
text: ". . . 'First take Jingzhou, next the Riverlands; / On that rich region, base your own royal stand.' . . ."

name: Zodiac Monkey
text: ". . . By six offensives from the hills of Qi Kongming sought to change Han's destiny. . . ."

name: Zodiac Ox
text: ". . . Cao's abdication changed the face of all; / No mighty battles marked the Southland's fall. . . ."

name: Zodiac Rabbit
text: ". . . The world's affairs rush on, an endless stream; / A sky-told fate, infinite in reach, dooms all. . . ."

name: Zodiac Rooster
text: ". . . But the time of Han had run—could he [Kongming] not tell?— / That night his master star fell past the hills. . . ."

name: Zodiac Tiger
text: ". . . Three kings no more—Chenliu, Guiming, Anle. / The fiefs and posts must now be filled anew. . . ."

name: Ravages of War
text:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching* (trans. Feng and English)

name: Riding Red Hare
text: One of the greatest steeds in the empire, Red Hare could travel a thousand *li* a day and climb hills as if running on flat ground.

name: Shu Cavalry
text: In establishing the Shu kingdom, Liu Bei's forces fought against Ma Chao at Chengdu. Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

name: Shu Defender
text: Confronting Cao Cao's army at Steepslope Bridge, Zhang Fei bellowed, "I am Zhang Fei of Yan! Who dares fight me to the death?" Cao Cao's army cowered and fled.

name: Shu Elite Companions
text: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

name: Shu Elite Infantry
text: Kongming's first campaign against the Wei kingdom was a rousing success until an arrogant Shu general, Ma Su, foolishly lost the city of Jieting.

name: Shu Farmer
text:
"The common folk are ceaselessly active. The fields are fertile and the soil productive, and neither flood nor drought plagues us."
—A Shu diplomat

name: Shu Foot Soldiers
text: Liu Bei lost many men at the battle of Runan because of his lack of strategy. It wasn't until he met Kongming that he began to truly succeed as a leader.

name: Shu Grain Caravan
text: Keeping a million-man army fed was no easy task. Grain and rice caravans were the lifeblood of the empire.

name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
text: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

name: Vengeance
text:
"Until I've gnawed their flesh and exterminated their clans, my humiliation will not be effaced."
—Liu Bei, on the death of his oath-brother Guan Yu

name: Virtuous Charge
text: "The empire belongs to no one man but to all in the empire. He who has virtue shall possess it."

name: Empty City Ruse
text: Out of time and options, Kongming was forced to bluff at Xicheng. He tricked an army of 150,000 Wei by leaving the city gates open and calmly playing the zither.

name: Volunteer Militia
text: After making the Peach Garden Oath, the three brothers raised an army of 500 youths to fight the Yellow Scarves rebellion.

name: Zhang Fei, Fierce Warrior
text: Zhang Fei's uncharacteristic alliance with a defeated Riverlands general, Yan Yan, allowed Shu forces to advance through forty-five Riverlands strongpoints with no casualties.

name: Zhao Zilong, Tiger General
text: Zhao Zilong was a brave and noble warrior. Twice he rescued Liu Bei's son, Liu Shan.

name: Borrowing 100,000 Arrows
text: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

name: Brilliant Plan
text: At Red Cliffs, Kongming and Zhou Yu each wrote his plan for defeating the Wei on the palm of his hand. They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

name: Broken Dam
text: Using nature to their advantage, wise Three Kingdoms generals often let dammed rivers loose to destroy their enemies.

name: Capture of Jingzhou
text: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

name: False Defeat
text:
"All warfare is based on deception."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

name: Council of Advisors
text: Sun Quan's long and successful rule in the years 199 to 251 was due to his ability to choose and foster talented advisors and generals.

name: Counterintelligence
text: Before the battle of Red Cliffs, a supposedly sleeping Zhou Yu allowed his old friend, a Wei advisor, to steal a planted letter forged as if from Wei's two best admirals.

name: Exhaustion
text: Starving and worn, Cao Cao escaped from the battle of Red Cliffs with only 27 of his original 800,000 men.

name: Forced Retreat
text:
"Leadership, not numbers, determines victory."
—A Wu commander, before his 5,000 troops forced 15,000 Wei troops to retreat from Ruxu

name: Lady Sun
text: Sister to Sun Quan and wife to Liu Bei, Lady Sun often felt her loyalty to both tested.

name: Lu Meng, Wu General
text: As the Wu chief commander, Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants on boats filled with hiding troops.

name: Lu Su, Wu Advisor
text: Lu Su served as an intermediary between the Wu and Shu kingdoms until Zhou Yu's death in 210, when he became Wu's supreme commander.

name: Flanking Troops
text: Following the battle of Redcliffs, both Liu Bei and Sun Quan coveted the province of Jingzhou. After Sun Quan's troops failed to capture it, Liu Bei's succeeded.

name: Red Cliffs Armada
text: By the battle of Red Cliffs in the year 208, the Wu kingdom controlled more than 7,000 warships on the Yangtze.

name: Sage's Knowledge
text:
"Those who know do not talk. Those who talk do not know."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*
(trans. Feng and English)

name: Strategic Planning
text: "Plans evolved within the tent decide a victory 1,000 *li* away."

name: Straw Soldiers
text: The overnight appearance of miles of "armed" Wu forts at Guangling frightened a much vaster Wei force into fleeing for their lives.

name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

name: Wu Admiral
text: The Wu kingdom's well-trained admirals were integral to the Southlands' victory at Red Cliffs as well as the kingdom's defense.

name: Wu Elite Cavalry
text: At the second battle of Ruxu, the brave Wu general Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 men with only 100 cavalry. Not a single man or horse was lost.

name: Wu Infantry
text: The first battle of Hefei was Sun Quan's last as a field general. From then on he let his generals command in the field while he directed battle from behind the front lines.

name: Wu Light Cavalry
text: A cunning strategist, Cao Ren tricked Zhou Yu by letting him enter Nanjun. Zhou Yu thought he was capturing the city until Cao Ren's arrows rained down upon him.

name: Wu Warship
text: Both Wu and Wei warships patrolled the Yangtze River, the natural border between the two kingdoms.

name: Zhou Yu, Chief Commander
text:
"After making me, Zhou Yu, did you have to make Kongming?"
—Zhou Yu crying to heaven on his deathbed

name: Zhuge Jin, Wu Strategist
text: When Zhuge Jin proposed the marriage of Guan Yu's daugher and Sun Quan's heir, Guan Yu's arrogant refusal led to disaster.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"When you give offense to heaven, to whom can you pray?"
—Cao Cao, quoting Confucius

name: Cao Ren, Wei Commander
text: Cao Cao's cousin, Cao Ren was known throughout the three kingdoms as the fiercest of warriors.

name: Guan Yu's 1,000-Li March
text: "He [Guan Yu] covered the ground on a thousand-*li* horse; / With dragon blade he took each pass by force."

name: Coercion
text: Though he held the title of prime minister, Cao Cao used the emperor's name to exert his own influence on the empire.

name: Deception
text: Believing they wrote the forged letter that had been stolen from Zhou Yu, Cao Cao rashly executed his two best admirals for treason.

name: Desperate Charge
text: "Lieutenants dishonored, corpses carted home; The general raises troops again to take revenge."

name: Famine
text: "But it was a year of dearth. People were reduced to eating leaves of jujube trees. Corpses were seen everywhere in the countryside."

name: Ghostly Visit
text: Cao Cao was haunted to death by the ghosts of the empresses and other high courtiers he had murdered.

name: Imperial Edict
text: Frustrated with Cao Cao's control of the imperial court, Emperor Xian secretly issued an edict condemning him, using his own blood as ink.

name: Imperial Seal
text: "If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."

name: Overwhelming Forces
text: By the year 208, Cao Cao commanded more than 1,000 experienced generals and a million infantry, cavalry, and naval troops.

name: Huang Zhong, Shu General
text: "Virile in war, he kept the north in fear; His prodigies subdued the western sphere."

name: Poison Arrow
text: In ancient China, not wearing armor could be a fatal mistake. Guan Yu, Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other heros were struck by poison arrows.

name: Return to Battle
text: "Swallowing his eye, the valiant Xiahou Dun fought on; / But Cao Cao's vanguard, its commander wounded, could not hold out for long."

name: Sima Yi, Wei Field Marshal
text: Sima Yi fought for four generations of the Cao family before his own grandson became emperor and united the three kingdoms.

name: Stolen Grain
text: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot, leaving him with no way to feed his troops.

name: Wei Ambush Force
text: The battle of Puyang marked the beginning of the end for Lu Bu. He lost the city—and later his life—to Cao Cao.

name: Wei Elite Companions
text: Cao Cao was more concerned with capabilities than lineage. He excelled at recruiting and retaining men of talent to serve him.

name: Wei Infantry
text: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan and then foiled a Wu scheme to incite rebellion.

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Wei Scout
text:
"He will win who, prepared himself, waits to take the enemy unprepared."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

name: Wei Strike Force
text: At the battle of Chang'an, Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass but was forced to flee when Cao Cao's trickery turned his own ally against him.

name: Xun Yu, Wei Advisor
text: "A splendid talent, admired of all men! His folly lay in serving Cao Cao's power."

name: Young Wei Recruits
text:
"To send the common people to war untrained is to throw them away."
—Confucius, *The Analects* (trans. Lau)

name: Zodiac Pig
text: ". . . Zhong Hui and Deng Ai next led armies west: / And to the Cao, Han's hills and streams now passed. . . ."

name: Zodiac Rat
text: " . . . Cao Pi, Cao Rui, Fang, Mao, and briefly, Huan— / The Sima took the empire in their turn. . . ."

name: Zodiac Snake
text: "Thrice Xuande's ardent quest led to Nanyang, / Where Sleeping Dragon unveiled Han's partition: . . ."

name: Dragon Fodder
text: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

name: Dirtcowl Wurm
text: Few of Rath's rivers follow a steady course, so many new channels are carved for them.

name: Laquatus's Champion
text: Темный дар Чейнера еще более темной душе.

name: Sudden Shock
text: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

name: False Prophet
text: "You lived for Serra's love. Will you not die for it?"

name: Beast of Burden
text: "If it is meant to be nothing but a machine," Karn finally asked Jhoira, "why did Urza build it to be like me?"

text: None of them could defeat Spider-Man alone. Together, they would be unstoppable.

name: Ertai
text: After serving his apprenticeship under Barrin of Tolaria, Ertai graced the *Weatherlight* crew with his presence as the ship's "resident" wizard. He realizes that few recognize his greatness—but then how could they, when they lack his insight and wisdom?

name: Gerrard
text: Soldier. Adventurer. Heir to the Legacy. Gerrard has, over the years, traveled much of Dominaria in search of fortune and glory. Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence and to take up the battle against the Lord of the Wastes.

name: Karn
text: Both part of the Legacy and an individual in his own right, the silver golem Karn is haunted by a single, terrible incident: while serving to protect the young Gerrard, Karn accidentally took the life of another. Wakened from years spent as a statue, the golem has vowed to never kill again as he rejoins Gerrard.

name: Maraxus
text: Too chaotic for even the other warlords of Keld, Maraxus has devoted himself to serving as a hired killer for the sinister Volrath. A man fond of his work, he's more than willing to put in those extra hours needed to perfect his craft.

name: Mirri
text: Mirri and Gerrard have been the best of friends since they trained together under the maro-sorcerer Multani. A fierce and agile warrior, she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate shortly after he assumed command of the flying ship.

name: Sisay
text: While captain of the *Weatherlight*, Sisay undertook a quest for the Legacy, a collection of artifacts needed to defeat the Lord of the Wastes. She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it. Sisay is devoted to the cause of good at whatever price.

name: Squee
text: The smartest—and only—goblin cabin boy aboard the *Weatherlight*, Squee has learned that intelligence and common sense are very different things. This matters little, however, since he has neither. Fortunately, he doesn't know what he's missing.

name: Tahngarth
text: Tahngarth, first mate of the *Weatherlight* under Sisay, knows that there are really only two forms of life: the ugly ones and the minotaurs. A narcissist, he considers the condition of his hide as important as the accuracy of his blade.

name: Barrin
text: An old and powerful wizard living on the mysterious isle of Tolaria, Barrin is the teacher who trained the young Ertai. He is also Hanna's father, but for reasons known only to the two of them neither acknowledges the other—or their strained relationship.

name: Crovax
text: How does one escape a curse? For Crovax, a wealthy noble, the answer may lie in joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay. Secretly, he hopes in his journeys to find Selenia, the angelic being who abandoned him and his family years ago.

name: Greven il-Vec
text: As a ruthless leader for Volrath, Greven *il*-Vec serves his lord by commanding the flying ship *Predator*. Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations, the majority of which were blessed by Volrath himself.

name: Hanna
text: Educated in Argive and highly knowledgeable in the field of artifacts, this expert navigator of the *Weatherlight* believes that scholarship does not necessarily lead to understanding. Her diligence in pursuing both is her greatest asset.

name: Orim
text: Trained in the Samite arts, Orim serves as the healer aboard the *Weatherlight*. She is quick with languages and was educated at the same Argivian university as Hanna. A student by nature, Orim keeps a diary of all her new discoveries—both physical and spiritual—during her travels.

name: Selenia
text: Once a guardian of Crovax's estate, Selenia was freed from her magical bindings by the wealthy noble. Instead of remaining at his side, the angel chose to venture out into the world. For reasons unknown to Crovax, Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.

name: Starke
text: Starke believes in situational ethics—the situation determines the ethics. He's switched sides so often that he has become everyone's ally yet no one's friend. This former merchant of Rath accompanies the *Weatherlight* crew on their journey to his home world.

name: Volrath
text: The son of Gerrard's surrogate father, Sidar Kondo, Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece. Now, he is an evincar, or agent, of the Lord of the Wastes. Armed with exceptional magical powers, he plots to conquer the entire multiverse.

name: Eladamri
text: Proud, shrewd, and charismatic, Eladamri has a commitment to his people that is absolute. The guerilla war he wages against Volrath has convinced him that the only way to liberate the Skyshroud elves is to lead *all* Rath's refugees to freedom. So be it.

name: Lyna
text: One of the few Soltari who can cross the shadow barrier, Lyna serves as an emissary to the outside world. A quick thinker and convincing speaker, she does whatever she can to lead her people out of the shadows and into substance.

name: Multani
text: In mentoring apprentice mages, the forest spirit Multani teaches each to respect nature while making use of its gifts. Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines so that both would be improved.

name: Oracle
text: Known simply by her title, Oracle uses her gift of prophecy to aid her people. She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny. Her only doubt is whether she will be strong enough to guide him to his destiny.

name: Rofellos
text: Gerrard's longtime friend and fellow student under the maro-sorcerer Multani, Rofellos is an excellent warrior and excellent company. Though adept at both magic and swordplay, he's far more comfortable with a flagon in his hand and a good companion at his side.

name: Sidar Kondo
text: Kondo served as guardian to the infant Gerrard and raised him alongside his own son, Vuel. He taught both boys to be strong and to lead, but whereas Gerrard became a champion of honor, Vuel's bitterness led him to become an equally devastating force of malice.

name: Sliver Queen, Brood Mother
text: Though long held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold, the sliver queen is actually freer than most of Rath's denizens. Her maternal instincts always take precedence—even when they conflict with the evincar's agenda—and through her numerous litters, she ranges across all of Rath.

name: Takara
text: Takara banishes the shadow of her father's ignoble reputation through the dedication, plain speaking, and swift action of a warrior. By refusing Starke's path of self-interest and opportunism, she has learned what he never will know: the value of sacrifice for a worthy cause.

name: Ashnod
text: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War. Whereas Mishra works in metals and stone, however, Ashnod works in living flesh. She sees all living things as prototype machines; her "improvements" to them make her as feared by allies as by enemies.

name: Gix
text: Through ruthlessness and raw ambition, Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor. Even while overseeing many of Phyrexia's most important undertakings, Gix continues his own quest for supremacy . . . for in Phyrexia, the weak become fodder for the strong.

name: Mishra
text: Both complement and antithesis to his older brother Urza, Mishra also mastered the intricacies of artifice. It was Mishra's strength that first gave rise to the massive Phyrexian war engines on Dominaria, and it was his weakness that pushed him, Urza, and Dominaria itself to the point of annihilation.

name: Serra
text: Named for a benevolent goddess at birth, Serra fulfilled the prophecy of that goddess's coming. As a planeswalker, she embodies white mana and helps whole civilizations develop while both directly and indirectly inspiring countless individuals to be steadfast and strong in the service of light.

name: Tawnos
text: Tawnos brings a childlike wonder and an inherent skill to Urza's studio and bridges the wizardry of the workshop with the grandeur of the royal court. His speed and flexibility quickly earned him promotion from apprentice to master artificer.

name: Titania
text: Voice of the Argoth forest, defender of its creatures, and enforcer of its laws, Titania is literally an aspect of the forest itself. Her power and her very existence are linked to the land: when the forest is healthy, Titania is ascendant. When Argoth suffers, Titania also bleeds.

name: Urza
text: An artificer of unparalleled renown, Urza was a powerful cipher even before he was able to planeswalk. Seeing the world as a large, integrated machine is his greatest strength and weakness, enabling him to solve almost any problem but blinding him to his solutions' effects on others.

name: Xantcha
text: A Phyrexian "sleeper agent," Xantcha has developed an inviolate sense of self. This aberration earned her a death sentence, but she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade. Her Phyrexian credo of "Waste not, want not" has helped Urza more than even he comprehends.

name: Curse of the Bloody Tome
text: After seeing his life's work drip away, the mage decided it was a good time to go crazy.

name: Bloodcrazed Neonate
text: While elder vampires select their meals with care, the newly sired frenzy at the first whiff.

name: Boneyard Wurm
text: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.

name: Gather the Townsfolk
text: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

name: Curse of Thirst
text:
"May you drink until you drown but never be sated."
—Odila, witch of Morkrut

name: Nearheath Stalker
text: "Do not speak of this to the elders. They look unfavorably upon my indulgences."

name: Mind Stone
text: The stones, like their holders, were drawn to each other. United, their true power awoke.

name: Conjurer's Closet
text:
"Skeletons? You should be so lucky."
—Gisa, to Geralf

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
text:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

name: Cultivate
text: Hand in hand, they sowed the seeds, and the battered earth began to flourish once again.

name: Rampant Growth
text: All through the winter Sam remained as patient as he could. Spring surpassed his wildest hopes.

name: Serra Angel
text: Every setback and every triumph had led to this: the moment when she played her last card and knew without a doubt she had won.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Diabolic Tutor
text: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

name: Costly Plunder
text: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

name: Ravenous Squirrel
text:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

name: Crippling Fear
text: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: "Ooh, a Tide Shaper! This is going straight into my Svyelun deck."

name: Zombie Master
text: Not even the cold embrace of death could keep him from his Prerelease events.

name: Goblin King
text: He stepped inside, then stared in awe. Never before had he imagined such joy and wonder could be contained all in one place.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: With the right tool, nothing is impossible.

name: Underworld Connections
text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Unlucky Cabbage Merchant
text: "My cabbages!"

name: Despark
text: "The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it."

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Now is the time... for the death of you all!"

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Monstrous Rage
text:
"My, what big paws y—"
—Thomas the woodsman, last words

name: Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
text: "Primarily, I'm a man of science. I'm only a hero by extension."

name: Echo, Perceptive Prodigy
text: "My story happens in the silence between the notes. That is where the magic happens. That is where you will find me."

name: Dark Deed
text:
"With but a wave of my hand I shall destroy you forever!"
—Doctor Doom

name: Hellcat, Undying Vigilante
text: "Throw me at anything—I'll always land on my feet."

name: Wood Elves
text: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

name: Highly Illogical
text: "The name of the game is called, uh . . . fizzbin."

name: Munitions Enthusiast
text: "There is nothing shameful about falling before a superior enemy, human!"

name: Solemn Simulacrum
text:
"What purpose does emulating humans serve except to remind you that you are incomplete?"
—Lal, to Data

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Burst Lightning
text: Telepathy is a powerful gift, but it leaves Betazoids vulnerable to far more powerful psychic entities.

name: Crystal Ball
text: It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.

name: Tragic Trajectory

"Rejoice, and know all will join you soon."
—Calnan, Monoist assassin

name: Courier of Comestibles

name: Spicy Oatmeal Pizza
text: Another one bites the crust . . .

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Dovin's Veto
text: "I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Augur of Bolas

text:
"Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia."
—Sheoldred

name: Crucible of Worlds
text: Greatness is forged in fire and fervor.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Ruthless Cullblade
text: She wields a blade as bloodthirsty and elegant as herself.

name: Burning Sun's Avatar
text:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Bishop of Rebirth
text: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

name: Vance's Blasting Cannons
text: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

name: Legion's Landing
text:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

name: Thaumatic Compass
text:
"Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of ..."
—Jace Beleren

name: Search for Azcanta
text: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

name: Arguel's Blood Fast
text: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan ...

name: Bastion Protector
text: "As long as I stand, so will your cause."

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Hull Breach
text: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

name: Kaalia of the Vast
text: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
text: "Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."

name: Kaseto, Orochi Archmage
text: "Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs."

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

name: Vela the Night-Clad
text: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Mind's Eye
text: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

name: Seal of the Guildpact
text:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Arcane Sanctum
text:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Crumbling Necropolis
text:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Homeward Path
text:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Aethersnatch
text: "You were saying?"

name: Brainstorm
text:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Gigantoplasm
text:
"I appreciate things that exceed expectations."
—Mizzix

name: Illusory Ambusher
text:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

name: Propaganda
text:
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits."
—Nekusar, the Mindrazer

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Synthetic Destiny
text: To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.

name: Vow of Flight
text:
"Soaring is wasted on the winged."
—Edric, Spymaster of Trest

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Abyssal Persecutor
text: His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Corpse Augur
text: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

name: Daxos's Torment
text: The terrors of the Underworld travel alongside those who return to the mortal realm.

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Dread Summons
text:
"Did you have a nice nap?"
—Liliana Vess

name: Scourge of Nel Toth
text:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

name: Thief of Blood
text: Her hunger will not be denied.

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

name: Tragic Slip
text: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

name: Meteor Blast
text:
"Behold astronomy's contribution to war."
—Fennor Rhyl, starcaller

name: Vow of Lightning
text:
"Ruhan would never agree to such terms."
—Ruhan of the Fomori

name: Arachnogenesis
text: Every movement is a summons-even your screams.

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Ezuri's Predation
text: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Harmonize
text: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Nest Invader
text: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

name: Pathbreaker Ibex
text:
"My skills are wasted here."
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Vow of Wildness
text:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Arjun, the Shifting Flame
text: He speaks directly into his supplicants' minds using fiery words that inflame their thoughts and incite their passions.

name: Behemoth Sledge
text: Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.

name: Dragonlair Spider
text: Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.

name: Throne Warden
text: "Rulers come and go, but my allegiance belongs to the throne."

name: Entrapment Maneuver
text:
"Greed, rage, and bloodlust all lead to death at the hands of those who keep their heads."
—Sergeant Eyra

name: Sanctum Prelate
text: "These halls are sacred. You will be silent."

name: Grip of Phyresis
text:
"Even your blade knows who will triumph here."
—Atraxa, Praetors' Voice

name: Stunt Double
text: No duelist is without equal in Paliano.

name: Keeper of Keys
text: For the right price, he'll unlock your path to the throne.

name: Deepglow Skate
text: Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.

name: Garrulous Sycophant
text:
"Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Thorn of the Black Rose
text: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of bureaucracy.

name: Parting Thoughts
text:
"To spend your life seeking, only to find regret upon achieving ... this is the most delicious irony of all."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

name: Palace Sentinels
text:
"One who ruled willing subjects would need no such protection."
—Adriana, Captain of the Guard

name: Marchesa's Decree
text:
"Those who seize power must have the means to hold it."
—Queen Marchesa

name: Magus of the Will
text: "These eyes have shown me the flaws of flesh."

name: Custodi Lich
text:
"Keeping order is a task too important to relinquish in death."
—Abrado, Custodi priest

name: Frenzied Fugue
text: Forever after, she lived in fear of the madness reclaiming her.

name: Goblin Spymaster
text:
"Infiltrate and infuriate!"
—Goblin Espionage League motto

name: Runehorn Hellkite
text: Inscribed with runes that predate the dragon, its horns possess their own ancient magic.

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Orzhov Advokist
text: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

name: Subterranean Tremors
text: The market is now closed.

name: Domesticated Hydra
text: "Sit. Fetch. Devastate."

name: Evolutionary Escalation
text: Survival is a constant competition from which both sides can benefit.

name: Primeval Protector
text: The earth shook in support of their cause, offering a champion of its own.

name: Stonehoof Chieftain
text: The pounding of his followers' hearts matched the beat of his hooves, and their voices echoed his bellows.

name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
text: "My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper."

name: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus
text:
"It lives ... IT LIVES!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
text: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

name: Akiri, Line-Slinger
text: Her bold movements are anchored in the careful precision of each rope.

name: Recruiter of the Guard
text: Before a cause can have supporters, it has to have a voice.

name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
text: "How does one become a self-taught genius? Naturally, it requires brains."

name: Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix
text: She bears the greatest burden of all: that of knowing.

name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
text: "Through me, the Great Teacher's voice will rattle this world."

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "Now the scaled ones rule Tarkir."

name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
text: "I'm sure we can come to an arrangement."

name: Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis
text: "Look what we fought for. Look what we built together."

name: Traverse the Outlands
text: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

name: Fortunate Few
text: "...Is it over?"

name: Alms Collector
text: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

name: Fractured Identity
text: Self-reflection is not without its perils.

name: Magus of the Mind
text: "I'll show you what you truly desire."

name: Boneyard Scourge
text: Death arrives on tattered wings and stolen bones.

name: Scalelord Reckoner
text: The justice of dragons demands more than just an eye for an eye.

name: Disrupt Decorum
text: Dinner and politics don't mix.

name: Crimson Honor Guard
text: The finest soldiers aren't worth a whit without a set of hands to lead them and a set of eyes to guide them.

name: Bloodsworn Steward
text: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
text: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

name: Qasali Slingers
text: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
text: Spilled blood always begets more of the same.

name: Kindred Charge
text: For goblins, quantity is quality.

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Kindred Discovery
text: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

name: Licia, Sanguine Tribune
text: "I give my blood, my life, all I have in exchange for victory."

name: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami
text: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

name: Curse of Disturbance
text: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Curse of Bounty
text: Flavorful aromas beckon many a salivating maw.

name: Bloodline Necromancer
text: "The veil of death hides little from our kind."

name: Galecaster Colossus
text: Ground bones, broken glass, and splintered shipwrecks make up the sands of his shores.

name: Balan, Wandering Knight
text: "What weapon will you bear against one who's mastered them all?"

name: Mathas, Fiend Seeker
text: "All will know of your crimes."

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Curse of Vitality
text: Good health beckons many a vigorous follower.

name: Curse of Verbosity
text: Idle chatter becons many an attentive ear.

name: Treasonous Ogre
text:
"Everything comes with a price. Especially revolution."
—Grenzo, dungeon warden

name: Entourage of Trest
text:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

name: Expropriate
text: Few things are more valuable than time or money—and Leovold has plenty of both.

name: Salvage
text:
"What was taken shall be restored."
—Arathel, elvish queen

name: Brainwash
text: "They're not your friends; they despise you. I'm the only one you can count on. Trust me."

name: Cruel Tutor
text: The more you pay for the lesson, the better you'll remember it.

name: Xun Yu, Wei Advisor
text: "A splendid talent, admired of all men! His folly lay in serving Cao Cao's power."

name: Huang Zhong, Shu General
text: "Virile in war, he kept the north in fear; His prodigies subdued the western sphere."

name: Lady Sun
text: Sister to Sun Quan and wife to Liu Bei, Lady Sun often felt her loyalty to both tested.

name: Lu Su, Wu Advisor
text: Lu Su served as an intermediary between the Wu and Shu kingdoms until Zhou Yu's death in 210, when he became Wu's supreme commander.

name: Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen
text:
"A man, and such a fool! I, a woman, will fight them for you."
—Lady Zhurong to her husband Meng Huo, before leading an army against the Shu

name: Pang Tong, "Young Phoenix"
text: "...It was Pang Tong's boat-connecting scheme That let Zhou Yu accomplish his great deed."

name: Sima Yi, Wei Field Marshal
text: Sima Yi fought for four generations of the Cao family before his own grandson became emperor and united the three kingdoms.

name: Cao Ren, Wei Commander
text: Cao Cao's cousin, Cao Ren was known throughout the three kingdoms as the fiercest of warriors.

name: Pit Scorpion
text: Sometimes the smallest nuisance can be the greatest pain.

name: Armory Automaton
text: With no flesh to tire or resolve to falter, the machines soon became the Academy's preferred trainers.

name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
text: The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.

name: Boompile
text:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now ... which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

name: Treasure Nabber
text: The Law of Givesies Backsies is respected by every noble pursuer of shiny things.

name: Nylea's Colossus
text:
"Those who seek my protection receive it."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

name: Whiptongue Hydra
text:
"Where'd all the birds go?"
—Kaldrin, jungle sightseer

name: Myth Unbound
text: There are precious few names that echo throughout the Multiverse.

name: Ever-Watching Threshold
text:
"You think they know we're here?"
—Orlo, goblin raider

name: Windgrace's Judgment
text: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

name: Thantis, the Warweaver
text: She spins a web few can resist. Its sweet aroma sparks chaos in every heart.

name: Forge of Heroes
text: History is not delicately woven. It is hammered with fire.

name: Endless Atlas
text: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

name: Tawnos, Urza's Apprentice
text: "My master believes anything is achievable."

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Tuvasa the Sunlit
text: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

name: Crash of Rhino Beetles
text:
"When the herd moves, so should you."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Echo Storm
text: An organized and methodical reproduction.

name: Empyrial Storm
text: An inspiring and glorious ascent.

name: Enchanter's Bane
text: Those who fail to respect power will soon be consumed by it.

name: Turntimber Sower
text: "Zendikar's wounds can be healed."

name: Skull Storm
text: A rapid and catastrophic decline.

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Vedalken Humiliator
text: "And who will stop me? You?"

name: Loyal Subordinate
text: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

name: Ravenous Slime
text: Death eventually wiggles toward us all.

name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
text: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Loyal Drake
text:
"Doves and pigeons are too subtle. When I send a message, I want it to have some teeth."
—Aeschel, royal diplomat

name: Estrid's Invocation
text: Enchanters add layer upon layer of complexity to the world around them.

name: Angelic Guardian
text: "No single arrow can pierce an entire flock."

name: Angler Turtle
text: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

name: Vengeant Vampire
text: "Those who stood in my path now lay behind me."

name: Immortal Phoenix
text: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

name: Rampaging Brontodon
text: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

name: Hardened-Scale Armor
text: A pangolin's scales are resistant to all sorts of damage and weaponry. Desire for them threatens to drive the pangolin to extinction.

name: Leopard-Spotted Jiao
text: This strange beast has the hide of a leopard, the howl of a dog, and the horns of an ox.

name: Feiyi Snake
text: Two bodies, twice the malice.

name: Timber Gorge
text: Near the Western Seas lies Mount Zhaoyao—a forest of stones that reaches the clouds, a bountiful land of wondrous treasures and strange animals.

name: Meandering River
text: Clouds and mists cover the lake as though it were a dreamland. When the wind rises, the mists disperse, opening great vistas of rippling reeds.

name: Armored Whirl Turtle
text: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.

name: Colorful Feiyi Sparrow
text: These nimble sparrows, not often seen, delight in tricking the pangolins that wander the forest.

name: Purple-Crystal Crab
text: A precious shell without, a delicious taste within.

name: Welkin Tern
text: It stops flying only as its life comes to an end.

name: Vivid Flying Fish
text: The rainbow seen above the Great Lake of Cloud Dream just after the rain is nothing but the vivid-colored flying fishes' ritual dance.

name: Nine-Tail White Fox
text: It has waited a millennium just for you, and for a millennium will it watch over your descendants.

name: Earth-Origin Yak
text: Deep in the Northern Mountains, the yaks linger silently, channeling the powers of the earth.

name: Moon-Eating Dog
text: The most nimble of creatures, it chases the most sacred luminence.

name: Stormcloud Spirit
text: The spirits of all the rivers and oceans came together as an unstoppable force, unleashing their fury as lightning and thunder.

name: Heavenly Qilin
text: It strides through the universe as though stepping on the stars, crossing freely between the celestial and earthly worlds.

name: Ancestor Dragon
text: It is said that Yinglong gave birth to the qilin and the phoenix, and after them, all the hairy and winged beings in the world. Thus it is known as the Ancestor Dragon.

name: Dragon's Presence
text:
"The Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds, amid shattering mountains and sundering earth."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Brilliant Plan
text: A heaven-sent vision is like a lantern to guide the way.

name: Cloak of Mists
text: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

name: Drown in Shapelessness
text: "From the swallows, I learned how to ride the winds to anywhere, and from my tears, I mastered how to harness the water."

name: Qilin's Blessing
text:
"Interesting . . . This mortal being seems to have been blessed with Qilin's essence."
—Mu Yanling's journal

name: Sacred White Deer
text: The pale deer are believed to have lived a thousand years, the pure white five hundred more. Those who seek them would gladly wander the wilds forever for the merest glimpse of these sacred beings.

name: Reckless Pangolin
text:
"A pangolin's power grows with its speed. Strike when you have the chance!"
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Ferocious Zheng
text: Known for their glowing horn and stone-rattling roar, zheng are the fiercest predators in the forest. Few survived before Jiang Yanggu came.

name: Giant Spider
text: The welcoming appearance of the Arrow Bamboo Forest masks its deathly hostility.

name: Fire-Omen Crane
text: If you can see it clearly, you're already on fire.

name: Earthshaking Si
text:
"For reasons unknown to me, herds in the Arrow Bamboo Forest have become more and more agitated."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Aggressive Instinct
text:
"Mowu was wary that day, as though he sensed the danger ahead."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

name: Confidence from Strength
text:
"Prepare for battle!"
—Jiang Yanggu

name: Breath of Fire
text: Fire leads to more fire.

name: Journey for the Elixir
text: "As my hands touched it, I realized that I had not found it—it had been leading me here."

name: Screeching Phoenix
text: Its wings are a heavenly inferno that sets the world ablaze.

name: Cleansing Screech
text: "Crackle" and "pop" are the most wondrous sounds.

name: Throne of the High City
text: A shining symbol of Paliano's true ruler—ambition.

name: Protector of the Crown
text: "I gladly offer my weapon and my life to the glory of my sovereign."

name: Duelist's Heritage
text: The best techniques outlive their creators.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Day of Judgment
text:
"I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust. It brought no pleasure, even to a heart as dark as mine."
—Sorin Markov

name: Terra Stomper
text: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

name: Isolate
text: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.

name: Silkwrap
text: Better scarves than scars.

name: Searing Blood
text: Purphoros's blessing: sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane. Always ablaze.

name: Wild Slash
text: Never mistake deception for cleverness.

name: Ribbons of Night
text:
"My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar."
—Aszala of House Dimir

name: Roofstalker Wight
text: No heartbeat to hear, no greed to bribe, no fear of death.

name: Sadistic Augermage
text: "Don't worry. I know the drill."

name: Sewerdreg
text: They hardly have form, dripping through pipe and grate with the slip and stench of flowing sewage.

name: Strands of Undeath
text:
"Why limit yourself to mortal law when you can outlive those who enforce it?"
—Czaric, Orzhov prelate

name: Thoughtpicker Witch
text: "Once the brew gets the brains nice and pickled, they're a lot easier to pick through."

name: Undercity Shade
text:
"Officially, there's nothing under that bridge to hunt . . . . Unofficially, my torchers are too terrified to go there after nightfall."
—Agrus Kos

name: Vigor Mortis
text: After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.

name: Vindictive Mob
text: Many minds, a single madness.

name: Woebringer Demon
text: Each soul he devours adds its hunger to his own.

name: Barbarian Riftcutter
text:
"Riftcutters are suicidal anarchists, waving those lightning axes around so much that the walls are as likely to fall as their foes."
—Heruj, Selesnya initiate

name: Blockbuster
text: Vendors hung cords heavy with roots and laid out boxes of salted meat, unaware of the fiery disaster swiftly approaching.

name: Char
text: Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.

name: Cleansing Beam
text:
"Justice is toothless without punishment. Righteousness cannot succeed without the suffering of the guilty."
—Razia

name: Coalhauler Swine
text: Nothing stops industry in Ravnica—certainly not the safety of its workers.

name: Courier Hawk
text: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica. Soon the service became one of their most profitable businesses.

name: Dogpile
text: There is no shelter from this storm, its rain of fists, or the thunderous cackles of bloodlust.

name: Excruciator
text:
"Though used as a piercing weapon, the tusk is more akin to a stinger, spreading pain instantly throughout the body of its victim. This specimen deserves further study."
—Simic research notes

name: Fiery Conclusion
text: The Boros legionnaire saw a noble sacrifice, the Rakdos thug a blazing suicide, and the Izzet alchemist an experiment gone awry.

name: Flame Fusillade
text:
"A single item acting as lantern and lance? Now *that's* military efficiency."
—Brev Grezar, Boros lieutenant

name: Frenzied Goblin
text: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

name: Goblin Spelunkers
text: Chimney sweeps, explorers of abandoned buildings, spire climbers . . . goblin spelunkers have found countless niches within Ravnica's metropolis.

name: Greater Forgeling
text: Few have seen the inner workings of Ravnica's furnaces, but neighboring districts catch brief glimpses in the horrors that escape the flames.

name: Devouring Light
text: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

name: Hammerfist Giant
text:
"Oh sure, they buy a lot of ale, but I always find myself needing to rebuild after the giants have paid a visit."
—Belko, owner of Titan's Keg tavern

name: Hunted Dragon
text: The knights see a mighty quarry. The dragon sees breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Incite Hysteria
text:
"The Boros say they want to bring order to Ravnica. Funny then, how well they use chaos."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Indentured Oaf
text: All it knows is the difference between friend and food.

name: Instill Furor
text:
"The Rakdos know little of technology, but they definitely know how to push buttons."
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Mindmoil
text:
"My criticism of the Izzet is that their impulse for learning seems too much like impulse and too little like learning."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

name: Molten Sentry
text: Some take after their father, Stone, some after their mother, Fire.

name: Ordruun Commando
text: Thick of muscle, stout of heart, and possessing a burning love of justice and the battlefield, the Ordruun minotaurs are the foundation of the Boros Legion.

name: Rain of Embers
text: There's plenty to talk about in the marketplaces of Ravnica, be it the latest feud between guilds or the terrible weather.

name: Reroute
text: Three hundred years of practice thwarted by an instant of mischief.

name: Divebomber Griffin
text: Justice flies swiftly on angry wings.

name: Sabertooth Alley Cat
text: It has eight lives' worth of hunger to satisfy.

name: Seismic Spike
text: Natural disasters in Ravnica are largely nullified by the Izzet. Unnatural disasters, on the other hand, happen all the time.

name: Sell-Sword Brute
text: "Killing is easy. Just wrap your hand around the haft, and wrap your enemy around the blade."

name: Smash
text: Ravnica's laws protect not its citizens but its industry. Aging equipment is destroyed rather than restored, to bring more money into the factories' coffers.

name: Sparkmage Apprentice
text: Pajik was amazed and pleased at his newfound powers. His pet cat Rivin was slightly less enthusiastic.

name: Stoneshaker Shaman
text: There is no place in Ravnica for stagnation, no room for lands unfilled and untilled.

name: Surge of Zeal
text:
"If only my poxes were as infectious as their zealotry."
—Savra

name: Torpid Moloch
text: Market hucksters sell molochs for use as watchdogs. Of course, that's all molochs do. Sit around . . . and watch.

name: Viashino Fangtail
text:
"When the bony terminus gets too large, it's shed from the tail in coinciding periods of heightened aggression and hunger."
—Simic research notes

name: Viashino Slasher
text: Citizens of Ravnica stick to the main streets. Shortcuts may look tempting, but down each alley, dozens of hungry hands await, and screams do not carry into the busy market throng.

name: Dromad Purebred
text:
"I have seen much from the back of my dromad, most of it terribly wrong. The more I see, the more I am convinced of the rightness of my path."
—Heruj, Selesnya initiate

name: War-Torch Goblin
text:
"In a town shaped by the subtle machinations and political intrigue of its guilds, it's reassuring to see a goblin waving his torch and screaming about some nonsense or other."
—Agrus Kos

name: Wojek Embermage
text: "Your brother's crimes are your crimes. You stood by and lent support, so you too must face judgment."

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Bramble Elemental
text: Ravnica is a seamless urban tapestry, each city bleeding into the next. In abandoned corners, however, nature has begun to reclaim what it once owned.

name: Carven Caryatid
text: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Dowsing Shaman
text: He combs the streets looking for the lost light, the discarded enigmas of the city.

name: Dryad's Caress
text:
"I awoke to the face of beauty, my body fully healed. In that moment I knew my destiny was the Conclave's to shape."
—Rogad, Selesnya initiate

name: Elves of Deep Shadow
text: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

name: Elvish Skysweeper
text: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Fists of Ironwood
text: Saprolings add the three and the four to the "one-two punch."

name: Goliath Spider
text: The glittering strands of its complex web catch everything from a buzzing gnat to a passing bloatdrake.

name: Greater Mossdog
text: Man's best fungus.

name: Festival of the Guildpact
text: Everyone knows that violence at the Festival brings the worst of luck, so for at least one day a year arms are laid down in favor of brimming goblets.

name: Ivy Dancer
text: Her ivy locks are a remnant of the wooded wilds now lost to Ravnica forever.

name: Nullmage Shepherd
text: The shepherds work in secret, seeking out abominations against nature and returning them to earth and dust.

name: Overwhelm
text: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"

name: Perilous Forays
text:
"*This* is the place? This map has got to be wrong . . . ."
—Svania Trul, wayfinder novice, last words

name: Primordial Sage
text: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

name: Recollect
text:
