"The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
—Savra

name: Rolling Spoil
text: The shadow that fell over the grove was silent yet horribly alive, roiling with millions of tiny minions dedicated to the process of rot.

name: Scatter the Seeds
text: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

name: Scion of the Wild
text: It has a hundred thousand extinctions to avenge.

name: Siege Wurm
text: The Rubblefield was once among the wealthiest districts in Ravnica. All it took was a single wurm to reduce it to ruins.

name: Stone-Seeder Hierophant
text: Her touch brings to bare stone what water and sun bring to rich soil.

name: Sundering Vitae
text: Centuries of wind, rain, and roots compressed into an instant of destruction: such is the power of Selesnya.

name: Transluminant
text: "Forget yourself. Forget your city. Forget your homes, your families, the debts and obligations that hold you to this world."

name: Ursapine
text: A friendly ursapine means a constant supply of sharp spears. An unfriendly one means a constant supply of small holes.

name: Vinelasher Kudzu
text: It grows to hate you.

name: Gate Hound
text:
"Ditri, I leave this checkpoint in your capable teeth."
—Kitov, nightguard patrol

name: Agrus Kos, Wojek Veteran
text: Lieutenant Kos has never met a group of recruits he could not inspire or a mob he could not quell.

name: Autochthon Wurm
text: The trainer awoke to begin the journey from the wurm's tail to its head. The sun was setting when she arrived.

name: Bloodbond March
text: The Golgari support a vast army because death never ends its soldiers' service.

name: Boros Swiftblade
text: When the Boros Legion attacks, swiftblades enter the fray first. They pick off the archers and mages, softening the enemy front before the flame-kin and giants go in.

name: Brightflame
text:
"Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way."
—Razia

name: Chorus of the Conclave
text: "We are many, yet one. We are separate in body, yet speak with a single voice. Join us in our chorus."

name: Congregation at Dawn
text: "It is fitting that we meet in the first hour of light, for we are called by the Conclave to pierce a threat of darkness."

name: Consult the Necrosages
text: Dimir rank and file never see nor hear their guildmaster. All orders are given through mysterious necrosages who appear from the shadows, tersely toss out a command, and then melt into the darkness.

name: Bathe in Light
text: "Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."

name: Ghosts of the Innocent
text:
"Ma said we should offer up blini-cakes and salt to the good ones, but I get that chill up my spine and just shut the door."
—Otak, Tin Street shopkeep

name: Dark Heart of the Wood
text:
"The soil here is rich with the rotting dead, and the sun's fingers barely penetrate the dark canopy. Plant our brethren here. This shall be our sanctuary."
—Savra

name: Dimir Cutpurse
text: Other guilds demand tolls from those who travel their territories, but not House Dimir. It takes its share secretly, one coin purse at a time.

name: Dimir Doppelganger
text: "Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."

name: Drooling Groodion
text:
"The Golgari expand, yes, but I refuse to call their tainted creations 'growth.'"
—Veszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Flame-Kin Zealot
text: Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.

name: Glare of Subdual
text: The righteous light of Selesnya is channeled through the devout, striking out to blind the nonbelievers.

name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
text:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

name: Golgari Germination
text: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text:
"Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity."
—Niszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Golgari Rotwurm
text: Like corpse-worms through a carapace, rotwurms slide through the hollowed bones of the undercity.

name: Guardian of Vitu-Ghazi
text: It stands sentinel to the great City-Tree, home of the Selesnya Conclave.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Loxodon Hierarch
text: "I have lived long, and I remember how this city once was. If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it."

name: Moroii
text:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

name: Phytohydra
text:
"Look at this creature, so like the Conclave it serves. Cut one head and it grows two. Damage it and it flourishes."
—Veszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Hunted Lammasu
text: The lammasu ruled the velds before the city grew. Now they roam Ravnica's skies, but their ancient enemies have not forgotten them.

name: Psychic Drain
text:
"Gold can be reearned, goods restored. The moroii steal youth, more precious than either, and once gone, it's gone forever."
—Berta Suszat, civic healer

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Rally the Righteous
text: Yuri took up the ragged Boros banner, and his brethren, inspired by the act, followed him back into the fight.

name: Razia, Boros Archangel
text: Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.

name: Razia's Purification
text: Only the chosen ones are spared.

name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
text: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

name: Searing Meditation
text:
"When I meditate I see the world as it should be. All that does not fit, I remove."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Seeds of Strength
text: Beneath the beauty of light and seed is the might of Vitu-Ghazi.

name: Selesnya Evangel
text: "The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."

name: Selesnya Sagittars
text:
"What's their strike range, you ask? Let's put it this way: sagittars aim their bows using *maps*."
—Otak, Tin Street shopkeep

name: Leave No Trace
text: The magic of the Boros patrols the streets even when their soldiers do not.

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

name: Sunhome Enforcer
text:
"Law soothed his savage heart. Where fury once burned, the enduring flame of order now shines."
—Razia

name: Thundersong Trumpeter
text:
"Hear that? Those notes mean we've arrived at Sunhome! Let our allies' hearts soar and our enemies' hearts shatter at the sound!"
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Twisted Justice
text: In Otiev's mind, he ruled in favor of the accused. But in his courtroom he was only a spectator, watching his hand deliver the sign of death.

name: Vulturous Zombie
text:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Watchwolf
text: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

name: Light of Sanction
text: The Legion looks after its own.

name: Woodwraith Corrupter
text:
"Its darkened sap penetrates natural fibers and spreads its own genes. Emulation experiments are underway."
—Simic research notes

name: Woodwraith Strangler
text:
"Nothing could be more natural than roots sucking nourishment from the dead."
—Savra

name: Boros Recruit
text:
"Look at this goblin, once wild, untamed, and full of idiocy. The Boros have given him the skill of a soldier and focused his heart with a single cause."
—Razia

name: Centaur Safeguard
text: Swift, strong, and selfless, the centaurs are the shields of the Conclave.

name: Gaze of the Gorgon
text: Even the dead give way to the mineral gaze of the gorgon.

name: Lurking Informant
text: In the undercity, forgetfulness is often encouraged at the point of a blade.

name: Loxodon Gatekeeper
text: The gatekeepers are so fastidious that even the winds must wait to pass.

name: Shadow of Doubt
text:
"Your ignorance is my bliss."
—Szadek

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Cloudstone Curio
text: It *wants* to remain a mystery, banishing the curious in favor of less inquisitive company.

name: Cyclopean Snare
text: The spoiled, gluttonous halls of the Orzhov teem with gaudy, needless wealth. Even their security measures are made for beauty first, efficiency second.

name: Nightguard Patrol
text: "The Wojek defend the laws. We defend the people."

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Glass Golem
text: Izzet artificers have learned to steer their beautiful constructs clear of Boros warhammers—and the opera house.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Junktroller
text: One man's trash is another man's troller.

name: Leashling
text: Constructed of leather and irony.

name: Nullstone Gargoyle
text: Nullstone absorbs and dampens most forms of magical energy, as well as light, sound, and heat.

name: Pariah's Shield
text: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

name: Peregrine Mask
text: The mask confers both the prowess of a falcon and its loyalty.

name: Oathsworn Giant
text: The town stands on his ancestors' former burial grounds. Even with the graves long gone, he continues his determined vigil.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Spectral Searchlight
text: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

name: Voyager Staff
text: Voyager staffs are sought by those hoping to find an escape from the sprawling glut of Ravnica.

name: Duskmantle, House of Shadow
text: In a space where there is no room, in a structure that was never built, meets the guild that doesn't exist.

name: Sandsower
text: It drifts through the streets as a breeze of collective sighs, wilting the bustle with dreams and heavy eyelids.

name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
text: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Screeching Griffin
text: They were master fishers, but their seas are now the streets and their catch, the goblins that run pell-mell from the screeching in the sky.

name: Benevolent Ancestor
text: Although the door is flimsy and the lock pathetically small, Josuri's family never fears the night outside.

name: Seed Spark
text:
"If you ask me, those root-lovers value mindless dogma over progress."
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Suppression Field
text: The most feared of Azorius punishments is to be freed—sent back out into the world, stripped of all magical defenses.

name: Three Dreams
text:
"Choose one to heal, one to harm, and one to grant you the prudence to use them."
—Miotri, auratouched mage

name: Veteran Armorer
text: "Give me a sword and I'll kill a few enemies. But give me a hammer and a fiery forge, and I'll turn the tide of battle."

name: Votary of the Conclave
text: An ageless order, the votaries receive the gift of rejuvenation from the temple gardens they guard.

name: Wojek Apothecary
text: "A few arrows aren't enough to pierce your faith, soldier. You'll be back on the battlefield by sun's dawn."

name: Wojek Siren
text: It is the call to arms, the call to fury, the call to blood.

name: Cerulean Sphinx
text:
"About the sphinx, I have mixed feelings. Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate."
—Szadek

name: Blazing Archon
text:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Convolute
text: The words came to the sorcerer's lips but refused to budge any further.

name: Copy Enchantment
text: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

name: Drake Familiar
text:
"Falconry? A fine sport I suppose, if you're attracted to the frailty of birds."
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Dream Leash
text: The tendrils of sorcery find easy purchase on the soft underbelly of dreams.

name: Flight of Fancy
text: The view from above is an inspiration to the newly winged.

name: Flow of Ideas
text:
"A system to direct the flow of Ravnica's entire water supply? Thinking a bit small, aren't we?"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

name: Followed Footsteps
text: Æther can turn a footprint into a blueprint.

name: Grayscaled Gharial
text: Each tooth carries enough bacteria to kill a person in a day or two. But then, gharials do have 138 teeth.

name: Halcyon Glaze
text:
"Earth to æther, window to wonder, stillness to the sky."
—Glazing incantation

name: Lore Broker
text: Lies are sold as often as truths—and used just as effectively.

name: Mark of Eviction
text: Tharashk the Bold suddenly wasn't himself. Or anyone else, for that matter.

name: Mnemonic Nexus
text: True enlightenment comes not with a new thought, but with understanding of all the old ones.

name: Caregiver
text: "The guilds each believe its way is right, but their ways only bring blood to Ravnica's streets and tears to Ravnica's families."

name: Peel from Reality
text: When House Dimir's secrets are in danger of exposure, the guild takes drastic measures to cover its tracks.

name: Quickchange
text: Most Ravnicans lead lives of desperate survival. Those who thrive are malleable enough to change with the ever-shifting politics of the guilds.

name: Remand
text: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

name: Snapping Drake
text: The irritable drakes are solitary nesters. Even brooding females barely contain the urge to attack their own young.

name: Spawnbroker
text: "The trick isn't setting up the bad trade. It's making each side think it got the better deal."

name: Stasis Cell
text: The Simic created the cells to preserve their experiments. The Azorius put the cells to use on the guilty.

name: Surveilling Sprite
text: Their natural curiosity, combined with a knack for trespassing, makes sprites excellent spies.

name: Tattered Drake
text:
"Drakes embody the worst of Ravnica: great potential, twisted by selfishness and greed."
—Razia

name: Telling Time
text: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

name: Terraformer
text: "This feels a little more like home."

name: Vedalken Dismisser
text:
"I crept up on him, quiet as a guttermouse. And then suddenly I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market."
—Sirislav, Dimir spy

name: Vedalken Entrancer
text: Their denial reaches far into your future.

name: Wizened Snitches
text:
"Be careful what information you ask them to find, for it will likely be the subject of tale time at the alehouse."
—Sirislav, Dimir spy

name: Zephyr Spirit
text: A spiteful force exists on Ravnica that binds these ghosts to the land of the living but forbids them to touch it.

name: Carrion Howler
text: They chase tirelessly after the bone-carts that speed along the streets of the Plague Quarter.

name: Clinging Darkness
text: There's an experience worse than blindness—it's the certainty that your vision is perfect and the horror that there's no world around you to see.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Disembowel
text:
"We thought we found the victim's clothes lumped in the street. As it turned out, it *was* the victim, insides sucked out—just a sack of skin and robes."
—Agrus Kos

name: Empty the Catacombs
text: When the dead are laid to rest in Ravnica, it's usually just a nap.

name: Helldozer
text: Sometimes you go to hell, and sometimes hell comes to you.

name: Hex
text: When killing five just isn't enough.

name: Conclave Equenaut
text: Equenauts are the seeds of the Conclave, scattered on the four winds, searching for new places to take root.

name: Infectious Host
text:
"Lost man, dead man, knocking on the door. Cankerman, soreman, knock no more."
—Ravnican children's rhyme

name: Keening Banshee
text: Her cold wail echoes in the alleys and under-eaves, finding the unfortunate and turning their blood to ice.

name: Last Gasp
text: "Allow me a moment to catch your breath."

name: Mausoleum Turnkey
text: When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.

name: Moonlight Bargain
text: At every fifth full moon, the Moon Market convenes to peddle Ravnica's most forbidden wares.

name: Mortipede
text: Mortipede pheromones choke the streets with sickly sweetness, luring the rash and unwary into its waiting jaws.

name: Don't Move
text:
"Keep absolutely still. Its vision is based on movement."
—Alan Grant

name: Ian Malcolm, Chaotician
text: "You've heard of chaos theory?"

name: Owen Grady, Raptor Trainer
text: "I don't control the raptors. It's a relationship. It's based on mutual respect."

name: Permission Denied
text: "Ah, ah, ah! You didn't say the magic word."

name: Cresting Mosasaurus
text: It preyed on anything it could sink its teeth into.

name: Dino DNA
text:
"Dinosaurs left their blueprints behind for us."
—Mr. DNA

name: Command Tower
text:
"Corporate felt genetic modification would up the 'wow' factor."
—Claire Dearing

name: Don't Move
text:
"Keep absolutely still. Its vision is based on movement."
—Alan Grant

name: Cresting Mosasaurus
text: It preyed on anything it could sink its teeth into.

name: Spitting Dilophosaurus
text: "Nice boy . . . nice boy. Nice dinosaur!"

name: Spitting Dilophosaurus
text: "Nice boy . . . nice boy. Nice dinosaur!"

name: Hunting Velociraptor
text:
"Clever girl."
—Robert Muldoon

name: Life Finds a Way
text:
"Life breaks free. It expands to new territories and crashes through barriers. Painfully, maybe even dangerously. But, uh, well there it is."
—Ian Malcolm

name: Savage Order
text:
"Well... it's a superpredator."
—Billy Brennan

name: Compy Swarm
text:
"There's no reason for it to fear man."
—Robert Burke

name: Ian Malcolm, Chaotician
text: "You've heard of chaos theory?"

name: Hunting Velociraptor
text:
"Clever girl."
—Robert Muldoon

name: Owen Grady, Raptor Trainer
text: "I don't control the raptors. It's a relationship. It's based on mutual respect."

name: Permission Denied
text: "Ah, ah, ah! You didn't say the magic word."

name: Dino DNA
text:
"Dinosaurs left their blueprints behind for us."
—Mr. DNA

name: Life Finds a Way
text:
"Life breaks free. It expands to new territories and crashes through barriers. Painfully, maybe even dangerously. But, uh, well there it is."
—Ian Malcolm

name: Savage Order
text:
"Well... it's a superpredator."
—Billy Brennan

name: Compy Swarm
text:
"There's no reason for it to fear man."
—Robert Burke

name: Force of Negation
text: 「現実は優しくない。現実はまったく優しくない。ならば、愚かな者、おまえたち!こうするしかない」

name: Arcane Denial
text: 「輝く星も、やがて消える……。」

name: Imperial Ceratops
text:
"The music of blades against its silver armor merely inspires it to bellow more full-throated melodies."
—Huatli

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Fanatical Firebrand
text:
"The Brazen Coalition is a firecannon pointed at our enemies. Goblins like him are the spark to its powder."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Frilled Deathspitter
text: Nothing says trouble like a reedy hiss with a hint of liquid gurgle.

name: Goblin Trailblazer
text:
"Why are we following the goblin? Can he even read that map?"
—Daphne Vail, *Diremore* first mate

name: Mutiny
text: Pirate captains rarely enjoy a peaceful retirement.

name: Needletooth Raptor
text: It hatches with its ferocity fully grown.

name: Orazca Raptor
text:
"If you come across a raptor in the city, stay perfectly still. At least then you'll be well rested when you die."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Pirate's Pillage
text: Goblins can carry their body weight in loot.

name: Legion Conquistador
text: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

name: Reckless Rage
text: "Hard to starboard! Starb— Abandon ship! Abandon ship!"

name: Shake the Foundations
text: A threefold calamity with a single will.

name: Shatter
text: Today it's a miracle of architecture, a marvel of stained glass, a symbol of the Legion's power. Tomorrow, driftwood.

name: Silverclad Ferocidons
text:
"Control them? No. I gird them in armor and let them loose."
—Yacha, Otepec huntmaster

name: Stampeding Horncrest
text: When the golden city opened, the dinosaurs inside were eager to greet the new visitors.

name: Storm Fleet Swashbuckler
text: "A bolt to the eye, a blade to the neck. That's the way to clear the deck!"

name: Sun-Collared Raptor
text:
"With Tilonalli's gifts, even the smallest of us can become great."
—Huatli

name: Swaggering Corsair
text: "I'm about to make you famous. From the golden city to High and Dry, they'll talk about how fast you died!"

name: Luminous Bonds
text: "Your part in this fight is done, vampire. Get used to your thirst."

name: Aggressive Urge
text: "Our lives, our homes, and all our history are at risk. Do not speak to me of peace."

name: Cacophodon
text: When a cacophodon is angry, the whole jungle knows.

name: Cherished Hatchling
text: Despite its appearance, it's anything but defenseless.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text:
"Remember when it was the most terrifying thing you'd ever seen?"
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Crested Herdcaller
text:
"Our survival, like theirs, depends on our ability to work together."
—Huatli, to Tishana

name: Deeproot Elite
text: "You think I stand alone? I have the forest at my call, the waters at my back. I outnumber you."

name: Majestic Heliopterus
text:
"Its rise is like the sun's, a beautiful beginning. Its descent is like the sun's, a frightful ending."
—Huatli

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
text: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Giltgrove Stalker
text: "The only gold I need is the sheltering shimmer of the trees."

name: Hardy Veteran
text: For the Sun Empire, the Immortal Sun is a symbol of national identity. When they reclaim it, the Empire will flourish once more.

name: Hunt the Weak
text:
"Death lizard approaching, cap'n!"
—Brint Doobin, last words

name: Jade Bearer
text: "Sisora wore this, who defeated the tyrant of Azcanta, and before her Natena of Vuhana's band. May it bring you their strength."

name: Jadecraft Artisan
text: "A blade is not fully forged until it is given."

name: Jungleborn Pioneer
text: "We fought so long to hide this place. Let us be first to learn its wonders!"

name: Knight of the Stampede
text: "My whisper becomes a thousand roars."

name: Naturalize
text:
"Better to let the sword go than to lose the arm with it."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Martyr of Dusk
text: "Should I fall, take up our standard and carry on. The Legion must always prevail."

name: Orazca Frillback
text: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.

name: Overgrown Armasaur
text: It embodies the riotous growth of the jungle, where creatures crowd upon creatures, where roots sprawl and vines swarm.

name: Plummet
text:
"Still, the pterodon chasing the clouds from its skies must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

name: Polyraptor
text: An innumerable pack is concealed in a single reflection.

name: Strength of the Pack
text: The pack that ambushes, eviscerates, and devours together stays together.

name: Swift Warden
text: A warning shout would take too long.

name: Thrashing Brontodon
text: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

name: Thunderherd Migration
text: The herds follow as new growth arises.

name: Moment of Triumph
text: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

name: World Shaper
text: "The Great River will not be tamed."

name: Atzocan Seer
text: Streams of gold and bright feathers flash in the orb, visions of past and future.

name: Dire Fleet Neckbreaker
text: The buccaneers scaled the sides of buildings as easily as they boarded enemy ships.

name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
text: Her centuries-long search is ended.

name: Hadana's Climb
text: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

name: Paladin of Atonement
text: For every wound there is a blessing; for every death, a reckoning.

name: Journey to Eternity
text: Every journey has its inevitable end . . .

name: Jungle Creeper
text:
"You cannot kill it, not for long. It ripens where the ground is soaked with the blood of the slaughtered."
—Atiuru, priest of the Verdant Sun

name: Legion Lieutenant
text: "We long ago abandoned the things that make humans weak: friendship, marriage, family. All that remains is the strength of our devotion."

name: Merfolk Mistbinder
text:
"The mist clothes us when we are bare, hides us when we are alone, and unites us when we are together."
—Nirit of Pashona's band

name: Profane Procession
text: Vona sought a conqueror. Mavren sought a savior. Both found what they sought . . .

name: Protean Raider
text: Imitation is the sincerest form of piracy.

name: Raging Regisaur
text: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

name: Relentless Raptor
text: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

name: Siegehorn Ceratops
text: To a siegehorn, there is no such thing as a dead end.

name: Storm Fleet Sprinter
text:
"Charge like a red-hot cannonball straight to your target. You slow down, you sink."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Awakened Amalgam
text:
"The fools have done it."
—Tishana

name: Gleaming Barrier
text:
"Gold without freedom might as well be lead."
—Angrath

name: Silent Gravestone
text: Made to ward off the Grim Captain and silence the lure of undeath.

name: Strider Harness
text:
"Because the giant, implacable death lizard wasn't scary enough already."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Traveler's Amulet
text:
"The best kind of treasure is the kind that leads to more treasure!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Evolving Wilds
text: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text: In the galleon's grand cathedral, conquistadors swore vows of faith. In its wreckage, they swore vows of revenge.

name: Foul Orchard
text: The stench of rotting meat lures flies, goblins, and young raptors.

name: Highland Lake
text:
"A place like this makes me wonder if there's more to life than blood and treasure . . . Nah."
—Boyl Bucksalt, Storm Fleet swab

name: Raptor Companion
text: The abundance of foes in Orazca means the raptors no longer need any orders.

name: Stone Quarry
text: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Countless streams flow into the nine rivers, and the nine rivers flow into the Great River. The River Heralds guard them all.

name: Vampire Champion
text: "These pirates must answer for their ancestors, who renounced the Church of Dusk and sailed from Torrezon as heretics."

name: Vraska's Conquistador
text: Abandoning both queen and church, he chose to follow power.

name: Sanguine Glorifier
text: For the Legion of Dusk, the Immortal Sun is a source of eternal life. When they reclaim it, they will no longer be forced to subsist on the blood of the wicked.

name: Angrath's Ambusher
text: Orcs have been enemies of the Legion of Dusk since it was formed, and the entire race has been declared anathema.

name: Swab Goblin
text: Though small, goblins can hold their own in a fight. Foolhardy confidence goes a long way.

name: Cinder Barrens
text:
"Burn their fleet to the waterline, and sink whatever's left."
—Angrath

name: Skymarcher Aspirant
text: "I was born to glory."

name: Slaughter the Strong
text:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

name: Snubhorn Sentry
text: They're fun to train—if you like stubborn, aggressive, and fiercely territorial.

name: Sphinx's Decree
text:
"Be still."
—Azor

name: Sun Sentinel
text: "I will not sleep until Orazca is ours once more."

name: Sun-Crested Pterodon
text:
"Pterodons tolerate no intrusion into their skies. Even the clouds must ask permission."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

name: Temple Altisaur
text:
"Kinjalli sculpted humans from clay, but the dinosaurs were carved from unyielding stone."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Trapjaw Tyrant
text:
"I would advise you not to struggle."
—Huatli

name: Blazing Hope
text:
"No shadow remains for you to hide in."
—Caparocti Sunborn

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Admiral's Order
text: "Damn the cannons, mates. Charge!"

name: Crafty Cutpurse
text: Possession is eleven-tenths of the pirate code.

name: Deadeye Rig-Hauler
text: "Up you go, you soggy rat."

name: Flood of Recollection
text: Jace tumbled down the waterfall and plunged deep into his past.

name: Hornswoggle
text: Being a merciful pirate, she saved the vampire's gold from falling overboard.

name: Cleansing Ray
text:
"The sun creates, sustains, and consumes so it can create again."
—Caparocti Sunborn

name: Kitesail Corsair
text: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
text: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Release to the Wind
text: "Here and gone like a fleeting breeze."

name: River Darter
text:
"Don't make splashes. Make progress."
—Tishana

name: Riverwise Augur
text: "Time flows as the rivers do, toward an unknown sea. The wise know to look downstream."

name: Sailor of Means
text: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

name: Divine Verdict
text: Cunning warriors and dim-witted beasts alike fall under the church's harsh judgment.

name: Sea Legs
text: "When the waves pick up, either you find your feet or you lose your lunch."

name: Seafloor Oracle
text: Where the light falls dim and blue on broken ships, secrets lie unclaimed.

name: Secrets of the Golden City
text: Stolen knowledge can never be stolen back.

name: Silvergill Adept
text: "If you keep to the shallows, you'll never learn the secrets of the depths."

name: Siren Reaver
text: "Prepare to be boarded."

name: Slippery Scoundrel
text: "I'd rather be caught red-handed than leave empty-handed!"

name: Soul of the Rapids
text: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rose from their riverbeds and the waterfalls took flight.

name: Sworn Guardian
text: For the River Heralds, the Immortal Sun is an object of terror and devastation. The idea that anyone would retrieve it for their own use is utterly abhorrent.

name: Everdawn Champion
text:
"Undefeated in battle, she is the shining future our empire deserves."
—Huatli

name: Arterial Flow
text: "It is impious to admit, but I do enjoy pirate blood. Something in the salty tang of it, the spice of rebellion."

name: Canal Monitor
text: The first goblin tried to swim the canal. The second built a raft. The last and craftiest goblin launched herself from a firecannon and soared over the canal, trailing smoke. All were eaten, but only one was cooked.

name: Champion of Dusk
text: "Drench these golden streets in the blood of our enemies."

name: Dark Inquiry
text: "Your mind is no longer yours to waste."

name: Dinosaur Hunter
text: "Aye, the foul beast chomped me, but I got away. You'd best believe when I find it again, it won't get away so easy."

name: Dusk Charger
text: Stories say demon blood runs in its veins, making it fearless and bloodthirsty.

name: Exultant Skymarcher
text: "We have come at last to this holiest of holy places. What was stolen from us long ago is ours once again."

name: Dusk Legion Zealot
text: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

name: Fathom Fleet Boarder
text: Without frequent raids, orcs sometimes get bored and plunder their own ships.

name: Grasping Scoundrel
text: "I can hear the plunder calling. It asks for me by name."

name: Gruesome Fate
text:
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?"
—Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock

name: Impale
text: Never let the glitter of gold distract you from the gleam of steel in the shadows.

name: Mastermind's Acquisition
text: Another piece of a nefarious puzzle.

name: Moment of Craving
text: "The time of condemnation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and I consign you to eternal darkness!"

name: Famished Paladin
text: Loyal to his queen, slave to his thirst.

name: Oathsworn Vampire
text:
"My conquistadors are never slain, merely laid to rest."
—Queen Miralda the Pious

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "Shame to let good gold go to the grave."

name: Ravenous Chupacabra
text: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

name: Reaver Ambush
text: Onora knew with sudden, grim certainty he would never see the Great River again.

name: Recover
text:
"No more fear of death's oblivion—is this not the greatest treasure of all?"
—Gurezan, Legion resurrectionist

name: Sadistic Skymarcher
text: "I will catch you, child of the sun. I will drink your life and leave you a husk, discarded in the shadows."

name: Vampire Revenant
text:
"A thick fog obscures the port of Leor, but it's not thick enough to muffle the screams."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Voracious Vampire
text: The purest devotion isn't the Blood Fast itself, but the craving that follows.

name: Blood Sun
text: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

name: Bombard
text:
"Want to sink a ship? Blow a hole in the hull. Want to kill a regisaur? Same answer."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Brass's Bounty
text:
"Why squabble for trinkets when we could be living large off all this gold?"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Brazen Freebooter
text: Finders, keepers.

name: Buccaneer's Bravado
text: Never underestimate the power of panache.

name: Charging Tuskodon
text: It doesn't hold grudges. It runs them down and impales them.

name: Daring Buccaneer
text: No ancient lore ties the pirates of the Brazen Coalition to the Immortal Sun. But it's a powerful ancient artifact in a city of gold—what's not to covet?

name: Haazda Officer
text: "You two, cover the alley! You, with me! Eyes on windows, balconies, and rooftops. Who knows what a fish-octopus-crab can do!"

name: Feral Maaka
text:
"Lost are the lush meadows and verdant forests, where maaka prowled and lammasu soared. Lost are the wilds, where our hearts were free."
—Daiva, Gruul storyteller

name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
text: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

name: Gates Ablaze
text: When the Izzet's spirit of invention extends to the city's infrastructure, the results are sometimes explosive.

name: Ghor-Clan Wrecker
text: "Today the Rubblebelt is a bit larger. That's a good day's work."

name: Goblin Gathering
text: Two's a party. Three's a felony.

name: Gravel-Hide Goblin
text:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade

name: Immolation Shaman
text: "Hello, kindling."

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Hero of Precinct One
text: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.

name: Rubble Reading
text: Gruul oracles see omens in all forms of destruction: the entrails of a maaka's prey, the flight of vultures over a battlefield, the scattering of toppled stone.

name: Rubblebelt Recluse
text: Joining a guild, even the Gruul, would mean giving up some of his independence. He'd rather smash what he wants to smash.

name: Rumbling Ruin
text: The Rubblebelt grows restless.

name: Scorchmark
text: "Have you seen your face? Trust me, this will be an improvement."

name: Skewer the Critics
text: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

name: Smelt-Ward Ignus
text: "Come in, yes? Is warm!"

name: Spear Spewer
text:
"Don't waste time aiming, you lazy gob-slug! Fire!"
—Krenko, mob boss

name: Spikewheel Acrobat
text: "Every street's a stage, and every screaming bystander's an audience."

name: Storm Strike
text: "My shout is thunder and my fist is lightning!"

name: Impassioned Orator
text: In times of unrest, the crowd is eager for the comfort of strong convictions.

name: Tin Street Dodger
text: "That giant didn't even see me, let alone catch me! And I was close enough to smell him! Of course, that's not saying much."

name: Axebane Beast
text:
"Imagine a gigantic pine cone that's extremely territorial and always in a foul mood."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster

name: Biogenic Upgrade
text:
"To survive exceptional times we must adapt by exceptional means."
—Vannifar

name: End-Raze Forerunners
text:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

name: Enraged Ceratok
text: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"

name: Gatebreaker Ram
text: So-called "battering rams" pale in comparison to the real thing.

name: Gift of Strength
text:
"When the sky screams, when the ground groans, the End-Raze will soon begin."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Justiciar's Portal
text: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.

name: Guardian Project
text: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

name: Mammoth Spider
text:
"The good news is that the migrating drakes are no longer a problem."
—Bell Migellic, Azorius hussar

name: Open the Gates
text:
"If you don't have a destination in mind, the route is all that matters."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Rampage of the Clans
text: "Rage! Rage until the whole world burns!"

name: Rampaging Rendhorn
text: Tumult is its natural habitat.

name: Regenesis
text:
"When you get right down to it, the difference between death and life is just a membrane-enclosed environment maintained by a metabolic process."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Root Snare
text: The roots run deep under stone and street, with strength that needs but a whisper to awaken.

name: Sagittars' Volley
text:
"My bowstring hums in tune with the song of the Worldsoul."
—Alcarus, Selesnya sagittar

name: Saruli Caretaker
text: "I hold the seed of our new beginning."

name: Knight of Sorrows
text: The helmet reveals no eyes to witness your penance, no mouth to offer absolution.

name: Sauroform Hybrid
text:
"Within each of us, the potential for great power waits to be released."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

name: Silhana Wayfinder
text: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

name: Steeple Creeper
text:
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources."
—Vannifar

name: Stony Strength
text: "What you build, we will destroy . . . and bury you in the rubble!"

name: Sylvan Brushstrider
text: The mournful lowing of brushstriders warns of changing weather and ill winds.

name: Territorial Boar
text:
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger."
—Yeva, Nature's Herald

name: Titanic Brawl
text: Whoever wins, the neighborhood loses.

name: Tower Defense
text:
"We've been practicing for this all our lives. This is the final test!"
—Korun Nar, Rubblebelt hunter

name: Trollbred Guardian
text: His favorite food is kraul.

name: Wilderness Reclamation
text:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

name: Wrecking Beast
text:
"The best construction makes the most satisfying destruction."
—Domri Rade

name: Absorb
text: "In your misguided attempt to subvert the law, you have eloquently explained why the law must exist."

name: Aeromunculus
text:
"The absence of binocular vision imposes certain challenges for a flying creature, which are overcome via echolocation."
—Simic research notes

name: Azorius Knight-Arbiter
text: Thanks to the magic in his Writ of Passage, alms beasts lumbered aside, anarchs bowed their heads, and even Rakdos acrobats rolled their spikewheels out of his way.

name: Azorius Skyguard
text: "These new thopters are all well and good, but four eyes are better than none."

name: Basilica Bell-Haunt
text: You can hear their tolling only when your debt is due.

name: Bedevil
text:
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger."
—Tajic

name: Bolrac-Clan Crusher
text: Jaharg discovered that the shapes and symmetries so pleasing to the sculptor's eye also yielded a well-balanced bludgeon.

name: Ministrant of Obligation
text: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

name: Dovin's Acuity
text: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska . . . and Bolas made an even six.

name: Prowling Caracal
text: A hunter in the city requires the utmost cunning to survive. It must pounce only if the kill is certain, and leave the remains where no one will see.

name: Ethereal Absolution
text:
"Time to let the dead be dead."
—Kaya, to Teysa

name: Final Payment
text: There's nothing quite like the feeling of paying off a large debt.

name: Fireblade Artist
text: "Let's find out what kind of audience you are. Festive? Fearless?"

name: Frilled Mystic
text: "Your arrival was expected...and unwelcome."

name: Galloping Lizrog
text:
"I might have overfed him."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

name: Get the Point
text:
"Vraska sees the grandeur in death but misses the hilarity."
—Judith

name: Grasping Thrull
text: "Debt due! Debt due!" The thrull's screeching makes children flinch and debtors quail. "Debt due!"

name: Growth Spiral
text: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

name: Gruul Spellbreaker
text: She displays her scars with pride.

name: Rally to Battle
text: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.

name: Gyre Engineer
text: "As I contemplate what is, I dive ever deeper into the depths of possibility. Then I set an experiment in motion and watch the truth rise to the surface."

name: Hackrobat
text: "They all want to see me fall."

name: Hydroid Krasis
text: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

name: Imperious Oligarch
text: The rights of ghosts are strictly protected under Orzhov bylaws, and those who enforce them can count on the ghosts' assistance.

name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
text: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

name: Kaya's Wrath
text: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
text: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

name: Resolute Watchdog
text: A friend in good times, a guardian in bad times, and a savior when all else fails.

name: Macabre Mockery
text: The Rakdos put the "fun" in "funeral."

name: Mortify
text:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

name: Nikya of the Old Ways
text: "The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak—and their city—to dust!"

name: Pitiless Pontiff
text: "Pay in gold. Pay in blood. Pay with the servitude of your spirit kin. But pay you must."

name: Rakdos Firewheeler
text: Ever wonder why you never see an old Rakdos cultist?

name: Rakdos Roustabout
text:
"That one has a bright future—perfect instincts for the rhythm of mayhem."
—Judith

name: Rakdos, the Showstopper
text: "Entertain me."

name: Angelic Exaltation
text:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia

name: Rhythm of the Wild
text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

name: Rubblebelt Runner
text: The sly, stealthy warriors of the Slizt Clan survive by hiding in high ground and ambushing their enemies. Other Gruul call them skulkers and cowards, but only from a safe distance.

name: Savage Smash
text: A Gruul berserker is never unarmed.

name: Sphinx of New Prahv
text: Azorius sphinxes are loyal to the precepts of the law, not to any particular guildmaster—even one of their own kind.

name: Sphinx's Insight
text: "Do not think me blind to your true mission...or your true master, Grand Arbiter."

name: Sky Tether
text:
"If you can't control your mount, I will control it for you."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Sunder Shaman
text: "You take our wilds, we take your city."

name: Teysa Karlov
text: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

name: Zhur-Taa Goblin
text: Among the Zhur-Taa Clan, goblins are the first to enter battlefury. When the battle is over, the survivors are still frothing at the mouth, looking for someone to hit.

name: Footlight Fiend
text:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

name: Rubble Slinger
text:
"Tear down the city, lie by lie. Then throw it back at the liars, stone by stone."
—Domri Rade

name: Senate Griffin
text:
"The Senate griffins overhead used to make people think of order and safety. Not anymore."
—Lavinia

name: Smothering Tithe
text:
"I await your donation."
—Dasha, Orzhov priest

name: Vizkopa Vampire
text: Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them. The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

name: Spirit of the Spires
text: She breathes fair winds to tired griffins and lifts songbirds beyond the reach of stalking cats.

name: Azorius Locket
text:
"Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency."
—Dovin Baan

name: Glass of the Guildpact
text:
"Counterbalanced forces sustain this city. No faction above others. A beautiful idea."
—Emmara

name: Gruul Locket
text:
"In life, it was a cunning survivor, fearless and quick. May its power pass to you as you wear its skull."
—Gna, Gruul shaman

name: Junktroller
text:
"Hey, wait! That's my boot!"
—Darijo, Ivy Street ruffian

name: Orzhov Locket
text:
"It looks expensive, doesn't it? You have no idea..."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Rakdos Locket
text:
"This trinket will gain you admittance to some painfully exclusive gatherings."
—Exava, blood witch

name: Scrabbling Claws
text: Feed it steel. Feed it gold. Feed it bone. In the belly of the furnace, the flames know no difference.

name: Screaming Shield
text: Shhh . . .

name: Summary Judgment
text: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.

name: Simic Locket
text:
"Like our guild itself, this locket can stand for many things. You must discern what it means for you."
—Vannifar

name: Tome of the Guildpact
text:
"Reading it has given me a glimpse of what makes this deeply flawed city so very magnificent."
—Dovin Baan

name: Azorius Guildgate
text:
"If the populace fears our authority, then I'd say we have an appropriately sensible populace."
—Dovin Baan

name: Azorius Guildgate
text:
"If you want to know what's really going on in any building, you don't walk in the front door. You stake out the back."
—Lavinia

name: Blood Crypt
text: Life is a show, and death its final performance.

name: Breeding Pool
text:
"One beginning, many paths."
—Vannifar

name: Gateway Plaza
text: The Chamber of the Guildpact has fallen silent, its bright promise broken.

name: Godless Shrine
text: Sin is debt, and absolution is paid in tithes of gold and blood.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text:
"Beyond this gate there are no citizens, only predators and prey."
—Domri Rade

name: Syndicate Messenger
text:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia

name: Gruul Guildgate
text:
"Old turf. Powerful turf. Much good blood spilled here."
—Ruric Thar

name: Hallowed Fountain
text: The ever-watchful center of a growing web of eyes.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"If you think the cathedral is impressive, you should see what's down below."
—Teysa

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text:
"My servants take pains for your pleasure, and take pleasure in your pain!"
—Rakdos

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text:
"Slip in the back if you don't want to be recognized. Don't worry—we'll make sure you're never found!"
—Judith

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"When the Prime Speaker goes too far, I will be here in the safety of the deeps to correct her."
—Zegana

name: Stomping Ground
text:
"What we begin, the End-Raze will finish. Then we will dance in Ravnica's rubble."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Tenth District Veteran
text: "I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will."

name: Elite Arrester
text: "Hold it! I need to see your papers."

name: Dovin's Dismissal
text: "We're finished here."

name: Dovin's Automaton
text: It was made for battle, but that doesn't mean it's unsophisticated.

name: Ragefire
text: "Your precious laws can't save you now!"

name: Domri's Nodorog
text: "Good girl."

name: The Haunt of Hightower
text: It drains vitality from those it touches.

name: Twilight Panther
text: A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.

name: Archway Angel
text: A ray of hope breaks through the shroud of rain.

name: Watchful Giant
text: Loitering is not only illegal but unwise, since those who stay too long in one place are apt to be stepped on.

name: Arrester's Admonition
text: Law is the voice of reason.

name: Benthic Biomancer
text: "I am my life's work."

name: Chillbringer
text: If you can see your breath, it's too late to run.

name: Clear the Mind
text:
"The best way to keep a secret is to forget it."
—Lazav

name: Coral Commando
text: Few Ravnicans are aware of the vast reefs in their world's hidden ocean. Far beneath the great sinkholes, where the light is blue and dim, merfolk tend the coral labyrinths that feed the benthic ecosystem.

name: Essence Capture
text:
"It's not enough to defeat our foes. We must learn from them, too."
—Vannifar

name: Eyes Everywhere
text: "They've got eyes inside my head!"

name: Faerie Duelist
text: Faeries are easily offended and quick to exact a quirky revenge.

name: Arrester's Zeal
text: Law is the light of civilization.

name: Gateway Sneak
text: "I've been through every guildgate in this city, and no one sees me come or go."

name: Humongulus
text: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.

name: Mass Manipulation
text: Those who cross the Dimir find enemies everywhere they turn.

name: Precognitive Perception
text: "To control the present we must master the future."

name: Prying Eyes
text: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."

name: Quench
text: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."

name: Sage's Row Savant
text: The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.

name: Bring to Trial
text: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

name: Senate Courier
text:
"This Dovin Baan came from nowhere. Watch him. Read his letters. He is more than he appears."
—Lazav

name: Shimmer of Possibility
text:
"There's something peculiar about the rain today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

name: Skatewing Spy
text:
"A better Ravnica begins with a better Simic."
—Vannifar

name: Skitter Eel
text:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Slimebind
text:
"Relax. It's quite harmless. And it will dissolve completely in a month or two."
—Navona, Simic field tester

name: Sphinx of Foresight
text: "I do not understand the future I see: the guilds subverted, the world at war, armies bent to a cruel conqueror's will."

name: Swirling Torrent
text:
"Oops!"
—Grupgrup, sluiceway technician

name: Thought Collapse
text:
"I can think of no greater punishment than answering your question in full."
—Lazav

name: Verity Circle
text:
"Here, there is only truth."
—Barvisa, Azorius emissary

name: Wall of Lost Thoughts
text: Those who intrude upon the Dimir seldom remember that they have done so.

name: Civic Stalwart
text: "These are your streets. Defend them! This is your neighborhood. Honor it! This is your city. Save it!"

name: Windstorm Drake
text: Drakes become especially voracious as they prepare for their autumn migration, hunting the city's thoroughfares from dawn to dusk.

name: Awaken the Erstwhile
text: In preparation for the conflict all foresaw, the Golgari called upon an army that had slept for millennia beneath the city.

name: Bankrupt in Blood
text: "Your spirits can rest in peace, for your debts are paid."

name: Bladebrand
text:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith

name: Bloodmist Infiltrator
text: Blood seeks blood, and nothing shall hold back its hunger.

name: Carrion Imp
text: No scrap of nutrition goes to waste in the undercity.

name: Catacomb Crocodile
text:
"I am sewer-king!" said Rat. "I am quick and cunning and I know every tunnel."
"No, I am king!" said Zombie. "I am cold and deadly and no rot can harm me."
Then Croc came and ate them both.

name: Clear the Stage
text: "Make way! It's time for the final act!"

name: Consign to the Pit
text: First your whole life flashes before your eyes. Then you have considerable time to reflect on every regret as you plummet.

name: Concordia Pegasus
text:
"What makes a frog lizard any worse than a bird horse? Prejudice against the Simic, that's what. It's unfair!"
—Thados Arquef,
Guardian Project biomancer

name: Cry of the Carnarium
text: If your ears bleed, it's a party. If your eyes bleed, it's a Rakdos party.

name: Dead Revels
text: You're only as dead as you feel.

name: Debtors' Transport
text: By design, the sarcophagus muffles the debtors' moans but does not silence them.

name: Drill Bit
text: Never boring.

name: Font of Agonies
text:
"No worthwhile reward is easily gained."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Grotesque Demise
text:
"A debtor's soul has little value, except as a warning to others who might consider defaulting on their loans."
—Ubea, Orzhov ministrant

name: Gutterbones
text:
"Down here, things don't stay dead."
—Lavinia

name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
text: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

name: Noxious Groodion
text:
"Behold the groodion! Ichor-slurper, oozing fiend. Foulest wonder underground. Grandest vermin of them all!"
—Zalin the Gutter Bard

name: Orzhov Enforcer
text: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

name: Expose to Daylight
text:
"Lies cannot long withstand the harsh light of day."
—Lavinia

name: Orzhov Racketeers
text: "Looks like you need protection."

name: Pestilent Spirit
text: Its stench corrodes steel. Its miasma sickens angels. Its finality ends hope.

name: Plague Wight
text: For some goods, the best couriers are the dead.

name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
text: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

name: Rakdos Trumpeter
text:
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos."
—Lazav

name: Spire Mangler
text: Its mandibles can leave a rider in the clouds astride a headless griffin.

name: Thirsting Shade
text:
"Your life is a blinding light, your breath a gale, your pulse a deafening drum. Be still. Be still."
—Dahlya Trul, "Irbitov Lament"

name: Undercity Scavenger
text:
"We grow strong by feasting on failure."
—Izoni

name: Undercity's Embrace
text: The undercity is always hungry.

name: Forbidding Spirit
text: "You will respect the dead."

name: Vindictive Vampire
text: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

name: Act of Treason
text: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

name: Burn Bright
text:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Burning-Tree Vandal
text: The ostentatious splendor of the Orzhov church was just asking to be smashed.

name: Cavalcade of Calamity
text: Let the Dimir worry about witnesses. For the Rakdos, screams count as applause.

name: Clamor Shaman
text:
"Little goblin. Big noise."
—Ruric Thar

name: Dagger Caster
text: "Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."

name: Deface
text:
"Leave no stone unturned."
—Ruric Thar

name: Electrodominance
text: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Skittering Invasion
text:
"The brood spread far faster than we could kill it. I fear the worst is yet to come."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Consume the Meek
text:
"Why does it destroy? It does, and to talk of reasons wastes time and breath."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Contaminated Ground
text:
"The Na Plateau is lost. Do not ask what happened, and never return there."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Curse of Wizardry
text:
"We must all push through the pain to heal our world."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Death Cultist
text: Death inevitably seduces all who study it.

name: Demonic Appetite
text:
"Morality is just shorthand for the constraints of being powerless."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
text: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

name: Dread Drone
text: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

name: Escaped Null
text: Left masterless by Kozilek, it wandered the wilds, raving in its ceaseless hunger.

name: Essence Feed
text: Eldrazi grow wherever something else dies.

name: Gloomhunter
text: Scavengers both mundane and magical follow in its wake, feeding on the scraps of flesh and spirit it leaves behind.

name: Induce Despair
text: All the angel saw was her doom.

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

name: Last Kiss
text:
"Romanticize it, glamorize it, call it what you will. To me, it will always be carnal, bloody murder."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Mortician Beetle
text: To the soldier, war is famine; to the scavenger, a feast.

name: Nighthaze
text:
"To evade the brood lineages, one must be made dark to all the senses."
—Traga, Zulaport runner

name: Nirkana Revenant
text: Hate is an everlasting wellspring from which it is eternally sustained.

name: Perish the Thought
text: It removed only one idea from her mind: defiance.

name: Pestilence Demon
text: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

name: Repay in Kind
text: Sorin has gathered grudges for centuries, patiently awaiting the day he can exact the perfect vengeance.

name: Shrivel
text:
"Have you ever killed insects nibbling at your crops? I think that's what the Eldrazi believe they're doing to us."
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

name: Skeletal Wurm
text: Necromancers are judged by the most powerful undead they've ever created. There are those who have animated just a single being, yet are considered the pinnacle of their dark craft.

name: Suffer the Past
text: Ulamog's tentacles, their touch like burning ice, rummaged through his soul and stung his memories one by one.

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Vendetta
text:
"Consider my debt to your kin paid in full."
—Idrol, Guul Draz assassin

name: Zof Shade
text: It haunts the remnants of the Helix of Zof, leeching strength from the vast Eldrazi ruin.

name: Akoum Boulderfoot
text:
"If you're in Akoum and you glimpse a shadow overhead, the worst thing you can do is duck."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Battle Rampart
text:
"I will build no sanctuaries. The safety you seek can be won only by the sword."
—Yannash, outpost builder

name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
text: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: Conquering Manticore
text: It speaks no commands but is always obeyed.

name: Affa Guard Hound
text: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

name: Devastating Summons
text: Things born in magma are always angry.

name: Emrakul's Hatcher
text: Wordlessly it leads its abhorrent brood.

name: Fissure Vent
text:
"Something down there has an appetite for what we're standing on. Let's hope it doesn't want seconds."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Flame Slash
text: After millennia asleep, the Eldrazi had forgotten about Zendikar's fiery temper and dislike of strangers.

name: Forked Bolt
text:
"Play no favorites. Everybody dies."
—Sparkmage saying

name: Goblin Arsonist
text: With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.

name: Goblin Tunneler
text:
"You never know what's going to be in goblin tunnels. Even in the best case, there will still be goblins."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Grotag Siege-Runner
text:
"I don't think he's bringing in the mail . . . ."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Heat Ray
text:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Hellion Eruption
text: Just when you thought you'd be safe, in the middle of an open field with no Eldrazi around for miles.

name: Kiln Fiend
text: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

name: Lagac Lizard
text: Tracing their ancestry back to Zendikar's earliest forms of life, lagac lizards have seen the comings and goings of planeswalkers and the Eldrazi, and the rise of the vampire clans, none of which has changed them one bit.

name: Lavafume Invoker
text:
"Then the ancient masters themselves, towers of rapacity, rose and began their calamitous feast."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Magmaw
text:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

name: Ogre Sentry
text:
"You have to appreciate the genius of it. Why bother building defenses when you can just fill the pass with angry ogres?"
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Dawnglare Invoker
text:
"What we knew as Emeria, Ula, and Cosi were not divine beings at all, but a cruel trick, and a grave error."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Rage Nimbus
text: The settlement knew there was something strange about the cloud when the old priest Mandli suddenly grabbed an axe and ran screaming into the hills.

name: Raid Bombardment
text: Goblins in the first wave of a fire raid always bemoan the aim of everyone else.

name: Soulsurge Elemental
text: It draws its strength from those around it, but the pleasure of destruction is all its own.

name: Spawning Breath
text: Death by death, Kozilek's lineage spread.

name: Splinter Twin
text: "I know just the person for that job."

name: Traitorous Instinct
text: The horror lurched about like a puppet from a madman's nightmare, squeezing the life from its own kind.

name: Tuktuk the Explorer
text: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

name: Deathless Angel
text:
"I should have died that day, but I suffered not a scratch. I awoke in a lake of blood, none of it apparently my own."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Valakut Fireboar
text:
"Just move very slowly, and for the love of Ula, do not get it mad."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Vent Sentinel
text:
"Zendikar fortifies itself against the Great Threat, making sentries of sky, sea, and stone."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Wrap in Flames
text:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Aura Gnarlid
text: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Boar Umbra
text: "From in here, everything looks like dinner."

name: Demystify
text: The Singing City was silent, the pathway stones were still, and the winds of the Howling Spire ceased.

name: Bramblesnap
text: A bramblesnap is formed by grafting together thirteen different plants that already hunger for meat.

name: Broodwarden
text:
"The least of gods shall tower over the mightiest of mortals, and death shall reign over all."
—Crypt of Agadeem inscription

name: Daggerback Basilisk
text:
"Petrifying gaze, deadly fangs, knifelike dorsal spines, venomous saliva . . . Am I missing anything? . . . Toxic bones? Seriously?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Gelatinous Genesis
text: Even as the world was left cracked and gory by the marauding Eldrazi, new life began to drip from its wounds.

name: Gigantomancer
text: "All life is driven by an indomitable will to survive. I simply turn that into something more . . . tangible."

name: Gravity Well
text: Storms spread throughout Oran-Rief, ripping the skies with wind and rain. Airborne creatures sought shelter where they could.

name: Haze Frog
text: Its breath leaves its prey too drowsy to struggle.

name: Irresistible Prey
text: The baloth's instincts boiled, its muscles pulled taut, and its razor-spines bristled, as it turned to face—a runt meepling.

name: Jaddi Lifestrider
text: Nature's arms encircle all who are willing to draw close.

name: Khalni Hydra
text:
"In ages past, bargains were struck and promises were made. Now we must collect on our debt. Begin the hymns."
—Moruul, Khalni druid

name: Kozilek's Predator
text: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

name: Leaf Arrow
text:
"Those who think the trees shall remain bystanders throughout this conflict shall be sorely mistaken."
—Sutina, Speaker of the Tajuru

name: Living Destiny
text: "That our enemies are great only brings us greater hope."

name: Might of the Masses
text: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

name: Momentous Fall
text: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

name: Naturalize
text:
"The scholars wept when we destroyed the hedron. I had no such pity. What would this world be like had we done so sooner?"
—*The War Diaries*

name: Nema Siltlurker
text: In one gargantuan bite, it will swallow not only you but also the riverbank you were standing on.

name: Nest Invader
text: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

name: Ondu Giant
text: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Pelakka Wurm
text: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

name: Sporecap Spider
text:
"They don't move much, but then again, if you get caught in its web, it has all the time in the world to get to you."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Stomper Cub
text:
"This one is only a yearling, but it would be wise to move away before we provide it with excellent hunting practice."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Tajuru Preserver
text: "No more blood shall be spilled to satisfy another's deluded lust for power."

name: Vengevine
text: Leave but a shred of root and it will return, bursting with vigor.

name: Wildheart Invoker
text:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Angelheart Vial
text: It holds a whisper from Iona: "Persevere."

name: Dreamstone Hedron
text: Only the Eldrazi mind thinks in the warped paths required to open the hedrons and tap the power within.

name: Enatu Golem
text: Golems conjured from the debris of Enatu Temple provided a sturdy but expendable first line of defense against the Eldrazi.

name: Hedron Matrix
text: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi, forming superstructures that radiated overwhelming magic.

name: Keening Stone
text: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

name: Glory Seeker
text: "There's no contract to sign, no oath to swear. The enlistment procedure is to unsheathe your sword and point it at the enemy."

name: Ogre's Cleaver
text: She adopted the weapon of the slave-lord Kazuul, and with it, all his cruelty.

name: Pennon Blade
text: Draped with the pennon of a fallen outpost, the sword came to symbolize the peoples of Zendikar becoming one.

name: Prophetic Prism
text: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

name: Reinforced Bulwark
text: Built of wood and iron. Held together by hope and prayer.

name: Runed Servitor
text: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

name: Sphinx-Bone Wand
text: Its host's final curse lies captured within.

name: Warmonger's Chariot
text: The best defense is a good offense.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: Each temple is a door to a horrible future.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Guard Duty
text: "I was told these were standard issue. Do I look standard to you?"

name: Harmless Assault
text: After encasing it in a paralyzing beam of light, the angel studied the Eldrazi as a child would study a bug, curiously and without fear.

name: Eldrazi Conscription
text: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

name: Kor Line-Slinger
text:
"I tried to tell her to stay behind, that this fight was too dangerous. I spent the next hour tied to the rafters."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Lightmine Field
text: If you want to kill a lot of goblins, just make sure your defenses look like fun.

name: Linvala, Keeper of Silence
text: Those who seek to disturb the harmony of life will see their instruments taken from them.

name: Lone Missionary
text: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

name: Luminous Wake
text:
"If destiny's champions have arisen to fight the Ancient Ones, then let me, too, do my part."
—Ravuel of Graypelt

name: Makindi Griffin
text: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, the griffins were forced to seek new territory lest their aeries be crushed between the massive stone monoliths.

name: Near-Death Experience
text: Lands ravaged, cities in ruins, so many lives sacrificed, and yet there was no other word for it but victory.

name: Oust
text:
"'Invincible' is just a word."
—Gideon Jura

name: Puncturing Light
text:
"The vampires knew what was coming. I know it. And they did nothing. They deserve to feel the same agony they've caused all of us."
—Anitan, Ondu cleric

name: Repel the Darkness
text: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

name: Smite
text:
"The mighty rely solely on their strength. They are shocked when we do the same."
—Tars Olan, kor world-gift

name: Soul's Attendant
text: In truth, her own faith was gone, trodden in Ulamog's wake. She pantomimed the blessing in the hope that it would inspire others to continue to struggle.

name: Soulbound Guardians
text: The kor's most righteous dead are given the greatest reward: an eternity tied to the land they so cherish.

name: Stalwart Shield-Bearers
text:
"Hold fast the line! Either we stop them here or we wake up in their guts!"
—Tala Vertan, Makindi shieldmate

name: Time of Heroes
text: No one spoke. There was no need. The threat of the Eldrazi presented a simple choice: lay down your weapons and die for nothing, or hold them fast and die for something.

name: Hand of Emrakul
text:
"I believed in a beautiful god. But this is the true face of the divine."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Totem-Guide Hartebeest
text: The kor track hartebeests in hopes of finding magic to help fight the Eldrazi.

name: Umbra Mystic
text: "I have found the courage to face death—twice, if I must."

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Aura Finesse
text:
"Although armor and auras can be similar, the brains required to use them are worlds apart."
—Zilan, Makindi auramancer

name: Champion's Drake
text:
"'Fraid of heights? Ride a horse. 'Fraid of missing out? Rein up a drake."
—Trinda, Hada spy patrol

name: Deprive
text:
"That would have brought shame to you as a mage. Tell you what—I'll keep your secret."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Fleeting Distraction
text:
"To distract an archmage would take incredible power. But for a simpleton, something sparkly will do."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Frostwind Invoker
text:
"We thought Zendikar's rage was kindled by its explorers and plunderers. But the world had sensed the stirrings of the Eldrazi."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Gravitational Shift
text: As they awakened, the Eldrazi reasserted their mastery over all of Zendikar's natural forces.

name: It That Betrays
text: Your pleas for death shall go unheard.

name: Guard Gomazoa
text: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

name: Jwari Scuttler
text:
"Yeah, they've got a lot of meat. The only downside to eating 'em is that you often find human bones and body parts inside."
—Jaby, Silundi Sea nomad

name: Lay Bare
text:
"It's good to learn from your failures, but I prefer to learn from the failures of others."
—Jace Beleren

name: Merfolk Observer
text: "The structure gets bigger every hour, with hedrons coalescing even deep under the surface. If I could only get inside . . . ."

name: Merfolk Skyscout
text: "Emeria is a pleasant lie, a figment to hide Emrakul's hideous face. I can only hope to uncover a truth that lies deeper still."

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"I'd build an entire fortress of them if I could."
—Mzali, Lighthouse archmage

name: Narcolepsy
text:
"It's so cute when it's sleeping, isn't it? Actually, it's still as abhorrent as ever, but at least it's not trying to kill us."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Phantasmal Abomination
text: Create an illusion so strong that it becomes another's reality, and you can become the master of all.

name: Reality Spasm
text: From the moment the first Eldrazi spawn squirmed free, everything on Zendikar took on an adjusted meaning, a new slant toward or away from the waking giants.

name: Regress
text:
"Never look too deep, where the waters turn dark. What the sea has hidden there may not stay down forever."
—Jaby, Silundi Sea nomad

name: Renegade Doppelganger
text: To truly know a creature, slither a mile in its tentacles.

name: Sea Gate Oracle
text: "The secret entrance should be near."

name: See Beyond
text: Ancient lore locked in a mind driven mad is just as safe as when it was locked deep underground.

name: Shared Discovery
text: Riches must be divided, but real wealth can be shared.

name: Sphinx of Magosi
text: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

name: Pathrazer of Ulamog
text: No thought but hunger. No strategy but destruction.

name: Training Grounds
text: Under the master's eye, skills are honed sharper and spells cut deeper.

name: Unified Will
text:
"We're glad to be of service—to be an audience to your failure."
—Maizah Shere, Tazeem lullmage

name: Venerated Teacher
text: "The unfathomable is upon us, students. I have no doubt you will rise to the occasion."

name: Arrogant Bloodlord
text: "I would rather take my own head than be thwarted by a presumptuous wretch with a shield and a dream."

name: Bala Ged Scorpion
text: Fast and lethal, with a penchant for the weak and infirm.

name: Baneful Omen
text: "Ah, again it does not bode well for you."

name: Bloodrite Invoker
text:
"The brood lineages unfolded across the world, each patterned after one of three progenitors, each a study in mindless consumption."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Bloodthrone Vampire
text: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

name: Cadaver Imp
text: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

name: Eyes in the Skies
text:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

name: Minotaur Aggressor
text: The smelting district is home to many who see the guilds as not for them.

name: Pursuit of Flight
text:
"Watch the voltage. We don't need another charred, crashing viashino."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

name: Pyroconvergence
text:
"The Izzet are an equation that turns lunacy into explosions."
—Leonos, Azorius arbiter

name: Racecourse Fury
text: Close finishes are settled by who can dismount and get to weapons first.

name: Splatter Thug
text: The mask isn't meant to hide his identity. It's meant to keep the viscera out of his eyes.

name: Survey the Wreckage
text: Goblins and architects seldom get along.

name: Tenement Crasher
text: Nothing was going to stop it—not the narrow alleys, not the Boros garrison, and certainly not the four-story Orzhov cathedral.

name: Traitorous Instinct
text: Joining the Worldsoul took years of study and meditation. Severing that connection took the snap of Rakdos's fingers.

name: Fencing Ace
text: His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Viashino Racketeer
text: "You may call me a fool, selling this stuff on Orzhov turf. Well, you need to be a little reckless to survive."

name: Aerial Predation
