text: In the towering trees of the Samok Stand and the predators that guard them, the might of the Ravnican wild has returned.

name: Archweaver
text: The silk of the archweavers adds structural integrity to otherwise unstable Izzet building sites.

name: Axebane Guardian
text: Only a worthy few are permitted within the sentient forest known as Axebane.

name: Axebane Stag
text:
"When the spires have burned and the cobblestones are dust, he will take his rightful place as king of the wilds."
—Kirce, Axebane guardian

name: Brushstrider
text: Magistrate Ludy agreed to designate land for the brushstriders only after several broken windows and dozens of missing blini-cakes.

name: Centaur's Herald
text: The farther they go from Vitu-Ghazi, the less willing the crowd is to part for them.

name: Chorus of Might
text:
"In each of us is the strength of all of us."
—Trostani

name: Keening Apparition
text: Some souls are too damaged to be of use to the Orzhov.

name: Deadbridge Goliath
text: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

name: Death's Presence
text:
"We traffic in flesh, not souls. Still, it's a shame to let anything go to waste."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Drudge Beetle
text: The Street Swarm is the labor class that drives the Golgari's endless cycle of life and death.

name: Druid's Deliverance
text: "So many oppose us, but we are the reed that bends without breaking."

name: Gatecreeper Vine
text: Every inch of Ravnica is home to something.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"The prohibition of unnecessary tossing of the citizenry by giants shall also extend to spontaneous giants."
—Isperia's Edict, provision VII.789.2

name: Gobbling Ooze
text: The furious citizens blamed the Simic for releasing it in their district. The Simic pointed out that rats were no longer a problem.

name: Horncaller's Chant
text:
"The Selesnya are gathering armies. Do you still believe they aren't preparing for war?"
—Teysa, to Isperia

name: Oak Street Innkeeper
text: The city is vast and perilous, but there are places where a weary traveler can feel very much at home.

name: Rubbleback Rhino
text: The trouble started when a street urchin bet a goblin he could ride one until the clock on Shilbo's Tower struck thirteen.

name: Savage Surge
text: Gruul warriors never need to be stirred to battle. They need only to be shown where the battle is.

name: Seek the Horizon
text: Raked by vertical spikes of glass and stone, Ravnica's vistas offer only a rare glimpse of the horizon.

name: Slime Molding
text:
"Give me enough refuse and mana and I will summon an ooze that can engulf all of Ravnica."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Stonefare Crocodile
text: The Izzet's plans to exploit the undercity ran into a few stubborn obstacles.

name: Towering Indrik
text: It chases its airborne prey relentlessly, heedless to what it pulverizes beneath its hooves.

name: Urban Burgeoning
text: The ruins of Old Prahv became a wildspace, although all birdsong was silenced by lingering Azorius magic.

name: Wild Beastmaster
text: "When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."

name: Martial Law
text:
"The good of society matters much more than the inconvenience of a few."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Armada Wurm
text: No one in the Conclave acts alone.

name: Auger Spree
text:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

name: Azorius Charm
text:
"The rules of logic and order have already made the choice for you."
—Isperia

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Carnival Hellsteed
text: Its favorite treats are candied hands and sweet hearts.

name: Centaur Healer
text: Instructors at the Kasarna training grounds are capable healers in case their students fail to grasp the subtleties of combat.

name: Palisade Giant
text: Refusing guild allegiances, she fights for those who can't protect themselves.

name: Collective Blessing
text: Senators of Azorius often hired agents to spy on the Selesnya. They were told to record every spore and root they saw, as each could become a deadly foe.

name: Common Bond
text: Wolf riders hone their skills traversing the perilous rooftops, each dizzying step bringing elf and wolf closer together.

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

name: Coursers' Accord
text: Bleak rumors reached Trostani's ears. She decreed that no one should travel alone.

name: Dramatic Rescue
text:
"I never thought I'd be so glad to see two tons of beak and claws bearing down on me at the speed of an arrow."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Dreadbore
text: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

name: Phantom General
text: After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.

name: Essence Backlash
text:
"The other guilds will learn the hard way not to interfere with our investigations."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

name: Fall of the Gavel
text: "My ruling is final. Order is upheld. Justice is done."

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Havoc Festival
text:
"We can't control enemies who have no regard for their own survival."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Heroes' Reunion
text: They share no bloodline, but a bond greater than family unites them. Such are the gifts of the Worldsoul.

name: Hussar Patrol
text:
"You think no one is watching, you think you're smart enough to escape, and most foolish of all, you think no one cares."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Precinct Captain
text: "In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."

name: Hypersonic Dragon
text:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
text: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

name: Jarad's Orders
text: "The Izzet are searching for something. Discern what or die trying."

name: Lotleth Troll
text: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

name: Rest in Peace
text: Some corpses the Golgari cannot claim. Some souls the Orzhov cannot shackle.

name: Mercurial Chemister
text: What some see as "distracted" is really "fathoming the unfathomable."

name: Nivix Guildmage
text: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
text: He has no patience for minds that do not inspire him or explode by trying.

name: Rakdos Charm
text:
"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

name: Rakdos Ragemutt
text: Ragemutts pull the chariots of the Butcher Clowns, a trio of wingless, zombified faeries formerly of the Izzet.

name: Rakdos's Return
text: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

name: Risen Sanctuary
text: When one of the great guardians arises, it sweeps enemies aside like chaff yet takes care not to crush a single insect underfoot.

name: Rites of Reaping
text: Don't cross a Devkarin elf unless you long for an early grave.

name: Rix Maadi Guildmage
text: Insatiable, irresistible, and insane.

name: Search Warrant
text: "And would you care to explain why your satchel is radiating an aura of unstable energy?"

name: Skull Rend
text:
"We could never accept anyone with a face that pretty or a mind that sane."
—Nyoser, Gore-House ringleader

name: Skymark Roc
text:
"Try not to look guilty. Or delicious."
—Thorpe, street urchin

name: Spawn of Rix Maadi
text:
"Straight from the blood-drenched imagination of our illustrious parun!"
—Nyoser, Gore-House ringleader

name: Armory Guard
text: The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Thoughtflare
text: "If this is thinking, I don't know what I was doing before."

name: Treasured Find
text: Gorgons crave beautiful things: gems, exquisite amulets, the alabaster corpses of the petrified dead . . .

name: Trestle Troll
text: Unwelcome in Golgari colonies, he found his own dark place from which to represent the Swarm.

name: Vitu-Ghazi Guildmage
text: "Preachers of freedom forget that conformity can be beautiful."

name: Selesnya Sentry
text: Ravnicans still tell tales about the Battle of Sumala where four Selesnya sentries held off an entire clan of Gruul warriors.

name: Blistercoil Weird
text: Azorius lawmages would like to outlaw the creation of weirds, but first they'd have to settle their long-standing debate on how to classify them.

name: Cryptborn Horror
text: Although Cryptwitch Merree vanished after a spat with Rakdos, her playthings lingered.

name: Dryad Militant
text: "We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost."

name: Frostburn Weird
text: Many chemisters are oblivious to the innumerable machinations of their guild, instead focusing obsessively on creating the perfect weird.

name: Golgari Longlegs
text: Despite its enormous stature, it can fold itself into a tunnel with startling quickness, vanishing back into the undercity.

name: Growing Ranks
text:
"We will grow an army large enough to withstand the Izzet's madness."
—Trostani

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Nivmagus Elemental
text: When it escaped, the experimenters hesitated. It would cause untold havoc, yet they wished to see it in action.

name: Seller of Songbirds
text:
"Lady Wren is the one merchant in Keyhole Downs who isn't running a scam."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Rakdos Cackler
text: Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.

name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
text: "If there were such a thing as a soul, I think it would be behind the gallbladder but above the kidneys."

name: Slitherhead
text:
"It makes better use of Uncle Dragi's head than he ever did."
—Pesha, retired blacksmith

name: Sundering Growth
text:
"One day every pillar will be a tree and every hall a glade."
—Trostani

name: Vassal Soul
text: For the Azorius, the opportunity to serve the law is too great an honor for death to interrupt.

name: Azorius Keyrune
text:
"The higher the mind soars, the greater its understanding of the law."
—Isperia

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

name: Civic Saber
text: Those without a guild signet often display a different form of protection.

name: Golgari Keyrune
text: Like a single ant, it only hints at the colony below.

name: Pithing Needle
text: The fearful want the procedure before a blood festival. The guilty seek it afterward.

name: Rakdos Keyrune
text: The Rakdos use it for everything you can think of and plenty more than that.

name: Selesnya Keyrune
text: A mark of unity when you want one; a fierce guardian when you need one.

name: Street Sweeper
text: The sweepers roam endlessly, scrubbing away the refuse—and anything else too slow or too clumsy to get out of their way.

name: Tablet of the Guilds
text: It is rumored the Azorius paid an exorbitant sum to ensure its symbol would appear at the top.

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Blood Crypt
text: Where the dead serve as diversion, decor, and dessert.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Sphere of Safety
text: The Rakdos believe that all are eager to join their revels, even when told otherwise.

name: Hallowed Fountain
text: A place to relax, if you have the proper permit.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Overgrown Tomb
text: The best funeral shroud is the fabric of new life.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Steam Vents
text: Crafted with genius, energized with madness.

name: Temple Garden
text: In the gardens of the Conclave, order and beauty are the roots of power.

name: Sunspire Griffin
text:
"For each griffin wounded by an arrow, there's a corpse with a bow nearby."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Swift Justice
text:
"Having conviction is more important than being righteous."
—Aurelia

name: Trained Caracal
text: Some Ravnicans consider carrying a sword to be beneath them, preferring instead a tooth-and-claw escort.

name: Trostani's Judgment
text:
"Some cannot be saved as they are, but all can serve the Worldsoul."
—Trostani

name: Aquus Steed
text: In water, it's as graceful as a dolphin. On land, it darts and jerks so unpredictably that few can ride it for long.

name: Arrest
text:
"We will prove your guilt. We don't arrest the innocent, you know."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

name: Blustersquall
text: Weather is more predictable than the Izzet.

name: Cancel
text:
"It is forbidden. Asking why is irrelevant."
—Sergiu, Opal Lake magistrate

name: Chronic Flooding
text: With the Izzet occupied elsewhere, many of their public works fell into disrepair.

name: Conjured Currency
text: A bargain in Keyhole Downs is always too good to be true.

name: Crosstown Courier
text: Information travels quickly through Ravnica's network of messengers and thought agents.

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Dispel
text:
"Civilization will subsume us unless we overwhelm it instead."
—Speaker Zegana

name: Doorkeeper
text: One piercing stare usually convinces thieves to go elsewhere.

name: Faerie Impostor
text: Many Tin Street shops display a sign on the door: "No cloaks allowed."

name: Avenging Arrow
text:
"Forgive the theft. Punish the deception."
—Alcarus, Selesnya archer

name: Hover Barrier
text: As whispers and rumors increased, so did the demand for fail-safe barriers.

name: Inaction Injunction
text:
"To prevent action is to prevent transgression."
—Azorius Arrester motto

name: Inspiration
text:
"Day 31: I finally succeeded in my time reversal experiment!
"Day 30: I might have a problem here."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

name: Paralyzing Grasp
text:
"Obviously, the Firemind's mission is worth more than a few goblins."
—Pelener, chamberlain of Niv-Mizzet

name: Psychic Spiral
text: An elocutor forces criminals to confess to the laws they merely intended to break.

name: Runewing
text: In the hands of the open-minded, a runewing quill writes wisdom of its own.

name: Azorius Arrester
text: "You have the right to remain silent. Mostly because I tire of your excuses."

name: Skyline Predator
text:
"It will dodge your first arrow and flatten you before there's a second."
—Alcarus, Selesnya archer

name: Sphinx of the Chimes
text: "I've dreamt of the future, Isperia. Danger is on the horizon. You must heed my warning."

name: Stealer of Secrets
text: The Dimir would hire her, if only they knew where she lived. The Azorius would condemn her, if only they knew her name.

name: Syncopate
text: "Patience, mage. Killing you now would be too easy."

name: Tower Drake
text: The first motion put forth in the pristine Jelenn Column was for severe restrictions on the airspace around New Prahv.

name: Voidwielder
text:
"He makes up his own laws, and that's dangerous to all who love peace and prosperity. Kill him on sight."
—Mirela, Azorius hussar

name: Assassin's Strike
text: When Selesnya missionaries moved into the Shanav Quarter, they faced scorn, ridicule, and ultimately martyrdom.

name: Catacomb Slug
text:
"The entire murder scene was covered in dripping, oozing slime. No need for a soothsayer to solve that one."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

name: Cremate
text:
"Without a body, the soul is helpless to fight the terms of our contracts."
—Somhaur, Orzhov pontiff

name: Azorius Justiciar
text: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

name: Daggerdrome Imp
text: One of the many reasons why open-air markets close at dusk.

name: Dark Revenant
text: The murderer faced justice in the Azorius courts, but his soul was set free on a technicality.

name: Dead Reveler
text: He's the unlife of the party.

name: Destroy the Evidence
text: Everyone knew the Dimir had done the damage. Everyone suspected the Izzet had hired them.

name: Deviant Glee
text: "You just need the right incentive to fulfill my dreams."

name: Drainpipe Vermin
text: When times are tough, the poor eat the rats. When times are tougher, the rats eat the poor.

name: Grim Roustabout
text: He'll point you to your death row seats.

name: Launch Party
text: Life's too short to not do the things you love.

name: Bazaar Krovod
text: The Hauler's Collective wields great influence over the Ravnican merchant class. Without it, little moves in the city.

name: Mind Rot
text: With no memories left to compare to his present situation, Andalum was finally content.

name: Necropolis Regent
text: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

name: Ogre Jailbreaker
text: It took three years for it to occur to him to use the chain as a weapon, but once it did, he made up for lost time.

name: Perilous Shadow
text: There are some shadows that even the Dimir fear.

name: Shrieking Affliction
text: A gargoyle's voice reaches pitches that will shatter glass and warp bone.

name: Slum Reaper
text: It's sent into unguilded districts by the Orzhov to collect the souls of those no one will miss.

name: Tavern Swindler
text: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

name: Concordia Pegasus
text:
"A kick from its hooves is like a bolt of lightning. I'd know. I've been hit by both."
—Rencz, Izzet chemister's aide

name: Terrus Wurm
text:
"We follow it through its tunnels, and where it dies, we farm."
—Mihas, spore druid

name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
text: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

name: Underworld Connections
text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Annihilating Fire
text:
"The most impressive performances can be done only once."
—Mote, Rakdos madcap

name: Ash Zealot
text: "Smarter than death? Let's see you outsmart my mace, necromancer!"

name: Batterhorn
text: Novice shopkeeps spend hours deciding how best to display their wares. Veterans focus on portability.

name: Bellows Lizard
text: As the price of wood and coal rose, smiths found creative ways to keep their forges burning.

name: Bloodfray Giant
text: The star performer of the Juri Revue, his shows have fans and blood spilling into the street.

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

name: Cobblebrute
text: The most ancient streets take on a life of their own. A few have decided to move to nicer neighborhoods.

name: Dynacharge
text: Nothing evens the odds like a little lightning.

name: Explosive Impact
text:
"Such boorish noise is what passes for subtlety among the Boros."
—Vraska

name: Goblin Rally
text: You don't so much hire goblins as put ideas in their heads.

name: Gore-House Chainwalker
text: If the pig's blood drips on you, you're next on the chain.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Lobber Crew
text: It's easier to just aim at everything.

name: Boros Elite
text:
"First, you must fight among the rank and file. It is there I will discern your skills as a leader."
—Aurelia, to Gideon Jura

name: Arclight Phoenix
text: Some storms never blow over.

name: Bloodfray Giant
text: The star performer of the Juri Revue, his shows have fans and blood spilling into the street.

name: Bomber Corps
text: "Subtlety is for lawmages and spies."

name: Burn Bright
text:
"From a great bonfire at the dawn of time, the first Gruul kindled their rage. The same flame burns in you."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

name: Burning Prophet
text: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

name: Burning-Tree Vandal
text: The ostentatious splendor of the Orzhov church was just asking to be smashed.

name: Demolish
text:
"For every inch of land they take from us, we take it back or we burn it. Give them nothing."
—Aurelia

name: Greater Forgeling
text: Few have seen the inner workings of Ravnica's furnaces, but neighboring districts catch brief glimpses in the horrors that escape the flames.

name: Bulwark Giant
text:
"Where did *she* come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Homing Lightning
text:
"I see countless worlds. What makes them think I can't find them in just one?"
—Ral Zarek

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Krenko's Command
text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Mugging
text: Scream: muffled. Pockets: emptied. Neck function: never the same again.

name: Carom
text: Her enemy's strength is her own.

name: Rubblebelt Maaka
text:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

name: Scorched Rusalka
text: Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.

name: Skewer the Critics
text: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

name: Skullcrack
text: The lawmage's argument was clever and well reasoned, but Blunk's response proved irrefutable.

name: Stalking Vengeance
text: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

name: Taste for Mayhem
text: The taste of blood breaks down what little self-control the Rakdos possess.

name: Tin Street Dodger
text: "That giant didn't even see me, let alone catch me! And I was close enough to smell him! Of course, that's not saying much."

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Conclave Equenaut
text: Equenauts are the seeds of the Conclave, scattered on the four winds, searching for new places to take root.

name: Wojek Bodyguard
text: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

name: Arboreal Grazer
text:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

name: Band Together
text: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Drudge Beetle
text: The Street Swarm is the labor class that drives the Golgari's endless cycle of life and death.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Fists of Ironwood
text: Saprolings add the three and the four to the "one-two punch."

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Forced Adaptation
text:
"We're planting the seeds of change. Sometimes, we plant them in people."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Forced Landing
text: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.

name: Fungal Rebirth
text:
"We're all food for something in the end."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Greater Mossdog
text: Man's best fungus.

name: Guardian Project
text: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

name: Horncaller's Chant
text:
"The Selesnya are gathering armies. Do you still believe they aren't preparing for war?"
—Teysa, to Isperia

name: Loaming Shaman
text: His work determines who is remembered and who feeds the worms.

name: Devouring Light
text: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

name: Open the Gates
text:
"If you don't have a destination in mind, the route is all that matters."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Overwhelm
text: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Rampaging Rendhorn
text: Tumult is its natural habitat.

name: Siege Wurm
text: Suddenly, all the haggling didn't seem so important.

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Titanic Brawl
text: Whoever wins, the neighborhood loses.

name: Wasteland Viper
text:
"The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society."
—Teysa Karlov

name: Wurmweaver Coil
text: Some use magic to spy through walls. Others use it to crush them.

name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
text: "I can call an army to my side in the blink of an eye. Best not blink."

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Eyes in the Skies
text:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

name: Cartel Aristocrat
text: "Your life serves a higher purpose now: ensuring the continuation of my own."

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Conclave Cavalier
text: "Just as leaves fall and the tree blooms again, one day I will fall and the Conclave will endure."

name: Debt to the Deathless
text: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

name: Deputy of Acquittals
text: "Everyone deserves a day in court."

name: Dreadbore
text: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

name: Footlight Fiend
text:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

name: Fresh-Faced Recruit
text:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic

name: Frilled Mystic
text: "Your arrival was expected...and unwelcome."

name: Glowspore Shaman
text: From death she grows living grandeur.

name: Gobhobbler Rats
text: Lyzolda's pet rats eat better than the average citizen. In fact, they can usually be found eating the average citizen.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Golgari Findbroker
text: "We gather the past from surface dwellers and sell it right back to them."

name: Ghostway
text:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Judge's Familiar
text:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
text: "Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."

name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
text: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Angelic Exaltation
text:
"If we cannot have peace, we will have justice."
—Aurelia

name: Merfolk of the Depths
text: When giant sinkholes opened across Ravnica, they revealed buried oceans and the merfolk, once thought to be extinct.

name: Moroii
text:
"Touched by moroii"
—Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"

name: Mortus Strider
text: Dimir's best agents hide from death itself.

name: Mourning Thrull
text: During their ascent to spirithood, patriarchs of Orzhova shed both flesh and emotion. This earthly slag is collected and formed into thrulls.

name: Nightveil Predator
text:
"Three daggers left in an angel's back, three enforcers with memory loss, three keys stolen from my own belt—and you talk of peace?"
—Tajic, to Aurelia

name: Petrahydrox
text: It departs through the streets' fissures with a sound like gravel pouring into a pond.

name: Keening Apparition
text: Some souls are too damaged to be of use to the Orzhov.

name: Phytohydra
text:
"Look at this creature, so like the Conclave it serves. Cut one head and it grows two. Damage it and it flourishes."
—Veszka, Selesnya evangel

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Rakdos Firewheeler
text: Ever wonder why you never see an old Rakdos cultist?

name: Rhythm of the Wild
text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
text: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

name: Scab-Clan Mauler
text: They inflict pain to forget their own and break foes to feel whole.

name: Makeshift Battalion
text: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

name: Selesnya Evangel
text: "The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."

name: Skyknight Legionnaire
text:
"I do not know which gives me more pride: the legions of soldiers marching in thunderous lockstep, or the cry of the skyknights riding their rocs like jagged lightning overhead."
—Razia

name: Slitherhead
text:
"It makes better use of Uncle Dragi's head than he ever did."
—Pesha, retired blacksmith

name: Sphinx of New Prahv
text: Azorius sphinxes are loyal to the precepts of the law, not to any particular guildmaster—even one of their own kind.

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Stitch in Time
text: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

name: Ministrant of Obligation
text: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

name: Sunder Shaman
text: "You take our wilds, we take your city."

name: Vernadi Shieldmate
text: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."

name: Voidslime
text:
"It is technically an ooze, but its lifespan measures only seconds. In that short time, its appetite for magic is extraordinary."
—Simic research notes

name: Whisper Agent
text: He has a job to finish, and it's you.

name: Wild Cantor
text: They are the voice of the wild, crying out with nature's fury and bringing forth its primeval might.

name: Mistral Charger
text: Some sky steeds break from the thundering herd to ride free on the open winds.

name: Rising Populace
text: Grief is a crucible where resolve is tempered.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Boros Signet
text:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

name: Civic Saber
text: Those without a guild signet often display a different form of protection.

name: Cloudstone Curio
text: It *wants* to remain a mystery, banishing the curious in favor of less inquisitive company.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Rootborn Defenses
text: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

name: Illusionist's Bracers
text: It's easy to believe you're a god when you're twice as powerful as everyone else.

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Junktroller
text: One man's trash is another man's troller.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Pariah's Shield
text: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Seal of the Guildpact
text:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Silent Dart
text: "These terms are acceptable to House Dimir. Shall we shake on it?"

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Summary Judgment
text: Any challenge to Azorius authority is met with swift and potent retribution.

name: Voyager Staff
text: Voyager staffs are sought by those hoping to find an escape from the sprawling glut of Ravnica.

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Sunhome Stalwart
text: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Syndicate Messenger
text:
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings."
—Lavinia

name: Armory Guard
text: The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."

name: To Arms!
text:
"The call came, spell-borne through mortar and stone to the ear of every soldier. The call came, and the advantage was ours."
—Lodusz, captain of the watch

name: Blazing Archon
text:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

name: Blind Obedience
text: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Devouring Light
text: Into the light the good are welcomed, and with the light the evil are banished.

name: Ghostway
text:
"I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty. I saw its face contort in rage but could not hear it snarl."
—Klattic, Boros legionnaire

name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
text: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
text: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Copy Enchantment
text: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Quicken
text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Tidespout Tyrant
text: He unmakes the world in his own image.

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

name: Urbis Protector
text:
"I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement. I'm sure this comes as no surprise to you."
—Teysa, to Lazav

name: Vindictive Vampire
text: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

name: Arclight Phoenix
text: Some storms never blow over.

name: Guttersnipe
text: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

name: Krenko, Mob Boss
text:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

name: Krenko's Command
text: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

name: Light Up the Stage
text:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

name: Aetherplasm
text: Its fickle form holds hints of a thousand former identities.

name: Skewer the Critics
text: Going to a Rakdos show is dangerous. Trying to leave early can be fatal.

name: Skullcrack
text: The lawmage's argument was clever and well reasoned, but Blunk's response proved irrefutable.

name: Utvara Hellkite
text: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

name: Arboreal Grazer
text:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Long ago, birds of paradise littered the skies. Thanks to the city's sprawl, most now exist as pets of society's elite.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Guardian Project
text: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
text: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

name: Loaming Shaman
text: His work determines who is remembered and who feeds the worms.

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Silhana Ledgewalker
text: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

name: Call of the Conclave
text: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

name: Cartel Aristocrat
text: "Your life serves a higher purpose now: ensuring the continuation of my own."

name: Cerulean Sphinx
text:
"About the sphinx, I have mixed feelings. Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate."
—Szadek

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Debt to the Deathless
text: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

name: Dreadbore
text: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

name: Frilled Mystic
text: "Your arrival was expected...and unwelcome."

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: When asked how much power is required, Izzet mages always answer "more."

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
text: "Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."

name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
text: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"

name: Rhythm of the Wild
text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
text: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Stitch in Time
text: Quyzl was told by his mentor to "make more time" for his studies.

"It is technically an ooze, but its lifespan measures only seconds. In that short time, its appetite for magic is extraordinary."
—Simic research notes

text: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

text: It *wants* to remain a mystery, banishing the curious in favor of less inquisitive company.

text: It's easy to believe you're a god when you're twice as powerful as everyone else.

name: Pariah's Shield
text: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

text:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

name: Azorius Guildgate
text: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Arrester's Zeal
text: "Law is the light of civilization."

name: Cyclonic Rift
text: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

name: Golgari Guildgate
text: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Izzet Guildgate
text: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

name: Rakdos Guildgate
text: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Simic Guildgate
text: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

name: Eyes Everywhere
text: "They've got eyes inside my head!"

name: Rest in Peace
text: Some corpses the Golgari cannot claim. Some souls the Orzhov cannot shackle.

name: Sphere of Safety
text: The Rakdos believe that all are eager to join their revels, even when told otherwise.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Enter the Infinite
text: There is no knowledge that is not power.

name: Gigantoplasm
text:
"I appreciate things that exceed expectations."
—Mizzix

name: Narcomoeba
text:
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?"
—Ravnican riddle

name: Wilderness Reclamation
text:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

name: Kasmina's Transmutation
text:
"Hop away now, little Eternal. Go eat some flies."
—Kasmina

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

name: Magewright's Stone
text: The stones hark back to an age before civilization, when the living earth blessed all who trod its untamed wilds.

name: Pithing Needle
text: The fearful want the procedure before a blood festival. The guilty seek it afterward.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of The *Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
text: As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.

name: Keymaster Rogue
text: "This one opens the grate outside Zelzo Base. This one is for Ismeri Library. This one is for an invisible door . . . No, I've said too much."

name: Kiora's Dambreaker
text:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

name: Leapfrog
text:
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

name: Azorius Arrester
text: "You have the right to remain silent. Mostly because I tire of your excuses."

name: Murmuring Mystic
text: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Quasiduplicate
text: "My greatest creation—me!"

name: Quench
text: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."

name: Quicken
text: A skilled Izzet chronarch can carry out an epic vendetta between the fall of one hourglass grain and the next.

name: Radical Idea
text: Genius is finding the edge of what's possible, then jumping over it.

name: Remand
text: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

name: Azorius Justiciar
text: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Sinister Sabotage
text:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

name: Tidespout Tyrant
text: He unmakes the world in his own image.

name: Totally Lost
text: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

name: Vedalken Mesmerist
text: "There's no need to sound the alarm. You are minding your post admirably. I am authorized. All is well."

name: Bladebrand
text:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith

name: Burglar Rat
text:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

name: Basilica Guards
text: "None may pass . . . for free."

name: Dark Confidant
text: Greatness, at any cost.

name: Debtors' Transport
text: By design, the sarcophagus muffles the debtors' moans but does not silence them.

name: Disembowel
text:
"You're right. I'm sure your Legion friends *are* looking for you. And once we've hidden a piece of you in each district, they'll get to keep looking for a long time."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

name: Dreadmalkin
text: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

name: Ill-Gotten Inheritance
text: "The suffering of others is not my concern."

name: Last Gasp
text: "Allow me a moment to catch your breath."

name: Blazing Archon
text:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

name: Macabre Waltz
text:
"All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy."
—Savra

name: Mausoleum Turnkey
text: When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.

name: Mephitic Vapors
text: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Orzhov Enforcer
text: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

name: Plaguecrafter
text: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

name: Blind Obedience
text: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
text: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
text: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

name: Ultimate Price
text:
"Let him be an example to others who would default on their debts to us."
—"The Cozen," Orzhov assassin

name: Undercity's Embrace
text: The undercity is always hungry.

name: Vindictive Vampire
text: In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.

name: Woebringer Demon
text: Each soul he devours adds its hunger to his own.

name: Act of Treason
text: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Wild Griffin
text: Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.

name: Giant Octopus
text: At the sight of the thing the calamari vendor's eyes went wide, but from fear or avarice none could tell.

name: Sea Eagle
text: Where air meets water, fish meets talon.

name: Time Ebb
text: Like the tide, time both ebbs and flows.

name: Vizzerdrix
text: Its swamp cousin may be meaner, but the vizzerdrix is much bigger.

name: Hand of Death
text: The touch of death is never gentle.

name: Lava Axe
text: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: Just because they have a club doesn't mean they're organized.

name: Ogre Warrior
text: Assault and battery included.

name: Trained Orgg
text: All orggs know how to kill; training teaches them *what* to kill.

name: Durkwood Boars
text:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—*The Bible*, Mark 5:13

name: Monstrous Growth
text: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

name: Moon Sprite
text:
"I am that merry wanderer of the night."
—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

name: Willow Elf
text: The forest lives in the elf as the elf lives in the forest.

name: Eager Cadet
text: The enthusiasm of the young, sharpened by the discipline of a soldier.

name: Knight Errant
text:
". . . Before honor is humility."
—*The Bible*, Proverbs 15:33

name: Royal Falcon
text: Hunter by instinct, weapon by training.

name: Goblin Commando
text: With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.

name: Goblin General
text: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

name: Goblin Glider
text: The goblins call the gliders "death from above." Everyone else calls them "clods in the clouds."

name: Goblin Hero
text: When you're a goblin, you don't have to step forward to be a hero—everyone else just has to step back.

name: Goblin Lore
text:
"I done forgot more than you'll ever know, pipsqueak."
"Yeah—that's your problem."

name: Goblin Mountaineer
text: Goblin mountaineer, barely keeps his family fed.

name: Goblin Settler
text: Be it ever so crumbled, there's no place like home.

name: Hulking Goblin
text: The bigger they are, the harder they avoid work.

name: Hulking Ogre
text: Once they realized the ogre had more size than speed, the soldiers simply went around it.

name: Champion Lancer
text: The flash of his lance projects the pure radiance of his honor.

name: Lava Axe
text: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
text: Just because they have a club doesn't mean they're organized.

name: Ogre Warrior
text: Assault and battery included.

name: Raging Goblin
text: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

name: Scorching Spear
text: Lift your spear as you might lift your glass, and toast your enemy.

name: Charging Paladin
text: A true warrior's thoughts are of victory, not death.

name: Trained Orgg
text: All orggs know how to kill; training teaches them *what* to kill.

name: Tremor
text: One little goblin shook up the ground. When the dust cleared, no one was found.

name: Volcanic Dragon
text: Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

name: Volcanic Hammer
text: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

name: Alluring Scent
text: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

name: Barbtooth Wurm
text: In its lair lies a carpet of bones.

name: Bull Hippo
text: Stay alert: his lumbering may shake the ground itself, but in water, he glides.

name: Durkwood Boars
text:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—*The Bible*, Mark 5:13

name: Gorilla Warrior
text: They were formidable even before they learned the use of weapons.

name: Grizzly Bears
text: Don't worry about provoking grizzly bears; they come that way.

name: Devoted Hero
text: The heart's courage is the soul's guardian.

name: Lynx
text: Rarely seen, hardly heard, never caught.

name: Monstrous Growth
text: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

name: Moon Sprite
text:
"I am that merry wanderer of the night."
—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

name: Natural Spring
text: The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.

name: Nature's Lore
text: Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us.

name: Norwood Archers
text:
"'Air superiority?' Not while our archers scan the skies."
—Elvish scout

name: Norwood Ranger
text: Some trees bear deadly fruit.

name: Devout Monk
text: Discipline wears many robes.

name: Renewing Touch
text: Death just encourages life the more.

name: Silverback Ape
text: His true majesty is not in his silver, but in his size.

name: Southern Elephant
text: Neither predator nor prey, the elephant chooses its place in the battle.

name: Squall
text:
"To-night the winds begin to rise . . . The rooks are blown about the skies . . . ."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, *In Memoriam*

name: Summer Bloom
text: Summer sends its kiss with warmth and blooming life.

name: Sylvan Yeti
text: The deeper the wood, the greater its strength.

name: Whiptail Wurm
text: It's hard to say for certain which end is more dangerous.

name: Eager Cadet
text: The enthusiasm of the young, sharpened by the discipline of a soldier.

name: Wild Ox
text: It has the run of the swamps, and it knows it.

name: Willow Elf
text: The forest lives in the elf as the elf lives in the forest.

name: False Peace
text: Mutual consent is not required for war.

name: Foot Soldiers
text: Infantry deployment is the art of putting your troops in the wrong place at the right time.

name: Gerrard's Wisdom
text: "You'll lose a duel if your enemy comes expecting a war."

name: Knight Errant
text:
". . . Before honor is humility."
—*The Bible*, Proverbs 15:33

name: Path of Peace
text:
"You could die famous or you could die old. I chose old."
—Former soldier

name: Righteous Charge
text: Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul.

name: Royal Falcon
text: Hunter by instinct, weapon by training.

name: Royal Trooper
text:
"Fortune does not side with the faint-hearted."
—Sophocles, *Phaedra*

name: Sacred Nectar
text:
"For he on honey-dew hath fed,
And drunk the milk of Paradise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Kubla Khan"

name: Steadfastness
text: Brute force wins the battles. Conviction wins the wars.

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Vengeance
text: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Veteran Cavalier
text:
Spirit is the sword and experience the sharpening stone.
—Arabian proverb

name: Wild Griffin
text: Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.

name: Air Elemental
text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

name: Coral Eel
text: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

name: Giant Octopus
text: At the sight of the thing the calamari vendor's eyes went wide, but from fear or avarice none could tell.

name: Man-o'-War
text: Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch.

name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
text: Are merfolk humans with fins, or are humans merfolk with feet?

name: Phantom Warrior
text: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

name: Piracy
text: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.

name: Relearn
text: The hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned.

name: Remove Soul
text: When your enemies are denied soldiers, they are denied victory.

name: Ardent Militia
text: Some fight for honor and some for gold, but the militia fight for hearth and home.

name: Sea Eagle
text: Where air meets water, fish meets talon.

name: Snapping Drake
text: Drakes claim to be dragons—until the dragons show up.

name: Storm Crow
text: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

name: Tidings
text:
"Many wearing rapiers are afraid of goose-quills."
—William Shakespeare, *Hamlet*

name: Time Ebb
text: Like the tide, time both ebbs and flows.

name: Time Warp
text:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Touch of Brilliance
text: "I don't want what I don't have. I want more of what I *do* have."

name: Vizzerdrix
text: Its swamp cousin may be meaner, but the vizzerdrix is much bigger.

name: Water Elemental
text:
The water that a ship sails on is the same water that swallows it up.
—Chinese proverb

name: Wind Drake
text:
"No bird soars too high, if he soars with his own wings."
—William Blake, *The Marriage of Heaven and Hell*

name: Wind Sail
text: It pays to be at home both on the sea and in the sky.

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Bog Imp
text: Don't be fooled by their looks. Think of them as little knives with wings.

name: Bog Raiders
text: Those who live amid decay must expect scavengers.

name: Bog Wraith
text: It moved through the troops leaving no footprints, save on their souls.

name: Chorus of Woe
text: When nightstalkers sing, nothing in creation sleeps.

name: Coercion
text: "Human tenderness is simply weakness in a pretty package."

name: Bargain
text: Bargaining with a goblin is like trading with a child; both believe they already own everything.

name: Dakmor Ghoul
text:
"Cursed be the sickly forms that err from honest Nature's rule!"
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "Locksley Hall"

name: Dakmor Lancer
text: The darkness of his shield reflects the inky blackness of his soul.

name: Dakmor Plague
text: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

name: Dakmor Scorpion
text: A scorpion this big you won't find curled up in your boot. Maybe *around* your boot, but not *in* it.

name: Dark Offering
text:
"Our greatest hope has become our enemy's greatest triumph."
—Court counselor

name: Feral Shadow
text: Not all shadows are cast by light—some are cast by darkness.

name: Grim Tutor
text:
One who goes unpunished never learns.
—Greek proverb

name: Blinding Light
text: Let the unjust avert their faces and contemplate their peril.

name: Hand of Death
text: The touch of death is never gentle.

name: Hollow Dogs
text: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

name: Howling Fury
text: I howl my soul to the moon, and the moon howls with me.

name: Muck Rats
text:
"Just as some fool said it couldn't get worse, the rats began to show up."
—Foot soldier

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Scathe Zombies
text: Luckily for them, it doesn't take much brains to slaughter and maim.

name: Serpent Warrior
text: A hiss before dying.

name: Border Guard
text: "Join the army, see foreign countries!" they'd said.

name: Soul Feast
text: Evil often dines alone.

name: Cinder Storm
text: When the sky's rain has turned to fire, what will put it out?

name: Devastation
text: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

name: Earth Elemental
text: Its voice has the tremor of deafening thunder, its blow the force of an avalanche.

name: Fire Elemental
text: You are drawn to your death as a moth to the flame.

name: Goblin Cavaliers
text: They get along so well with their goats because they're practically goats themselves.

name: Goblin Chariot
text: They have to replace the wheels, they have to replace the boar, and sometimes they have to replace the goblin.

name: Atarka, World Render
text:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Scourge of Nel Toth
text:
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled."
—Meren of Clan Nel Toth

name: Sign in Blood
text: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

name: Soul Shatter
text: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

name: Spark Reaper
text:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

name: Citywide Bust
text:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

name: Syphon Flesh
text: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

name: Syphon Mind
text: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

name: Titan Hunter
text: "Monster or human, my rate's the same."

name: Undead Augur
text:
"To see past the veil of death, cross it."
—The Red Book of Mezdrithalik

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Vampiric Rites
text: Scions of the Markov line take particular pleasure in the perversion of humans' holy rituals.

name: Vengeful Dead
text: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Vizier of the Scorpion
text: His blessing is a curse.

name: Cleansing Nova
text: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Zombie Apocalypse
text:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Abrade
text: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Brash Taunter
text: "You hit like a kobold!"

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Crucible of Fire
text:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

name: Commander's Insignia
text: At the general's triumphant return, renewed strength surged through the soldiers' ranks.

name: Demanding Dragon
text: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

name: Dictate of the Twin Gods
text: Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.

name: Dragon Mage
text: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
text:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

name: Dream Pillager
text: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

name: Explosion of Riches
text: "You've got how much gold there?"

name: Flameblast Dragon
text: He marks his territory with fire and wrath, etching the mountainside with his charring breath.

name: Furnace Whelp
text: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

name: Geode Rager
text: Its crystalline core refracts light into chaos.

name: Guttersnipe
text: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

name: Hate Mirage
text: A trick of the light, though momentary, can still be deadly.

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: it's a long way down.

name: Magmaquake
text:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Magmatic Force
text: It's the pinnacle of utter destructiveness.

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Provoke the Trolls
text:
"I like burning and pillaging as much as anyone, but sometimes it's just easier to throw a rock and let the trolls do the work."
—Urik, Tuskeri raid leader

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Runehorn Hellkite
text: Inscribed with runes that predate the dragon, its horns possess their own ancient magic.

name: Crush Contraband
text: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

name: Sweltering Suns
text: The Hekma may repel storms and monsters, but nothing holds back the heat of the suns.

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Tyrant's Familiar
text: Nothing escapes its gaze—or its breath.

name: Unleash Fury
text: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Wild Ricochet
text:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

name: Dawn of Hope
text:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

name: Wildfire Devils
text: Devils sow grief and harvest glee.

name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
text: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Blossoming Defense
text: Those who move harmoniously with the flow of aether can channel the power of the natural world.

name: Citanul Hierophants
text: From deep in the caves beneath the forest, the hierophants planned the druids' raids against the enemy.

name: Collective Unconscious
text: "The beasts of the wild are my senses. It is through their eyes that all knowledge shall come to me."

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Curse of Bounty
text: Flavorful aromas beckon many a salivating maw.

name: Drumhunter
text: "I feel the vine-rhythm as my friends drive the beast to me. I will not miss my mark."

name: Devouring Light
text: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Great Oak Guardian
text: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Harvest Season
text: A true reflection of nature: death fostering life.

name: Dictate of Heliod
text: "Daxos, I'm in need of a champion. Who else would I turn to but you?"

name: Hunter's Insight
text:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

name: Hunter's Prowess
text: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

name: Jade Mage
text:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

name: Jaspera Sentinel
text: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.

name: Karametra's Favor
text: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

name: Leafkin Druid
text: "I am rooted in the life of all that thrives around me. You cannot move me."

name: Loaming Shaman
text:
"The living don't ever stay living, and the dead don't always stay dead."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Loyal Guardian
text: Each scar on its hide is a badge of honor.

name: Emmara, Soul of the Accord
text: "Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."

name: Disenchant
text: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

name: Nullmage Shepherd
text: The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting their scorn poles. The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.

name: Overrun
text: Nature doesn't walk.

name: Overwhelming Instinct
text: The biggest difference between a victory and a massacre is which side you're on.

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Primal Might
text: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
text: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Scatter the Seeds
text: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Scavenging Ooze
text: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

name: Shamanic Revelation
text: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Thunderfoot Baloth
text:
"Odd. I didn't see any lightning . . . ."
—Herreth, poacher, last words

name: Verdant Force
text: Left to itself, nature overflows any container, overthrows any restriction, and overreaches any boundary.

name: Voice of Many
text: His words echo every roar, screech, and howl of the wilds.

name: Absorb
text: "Your presumption is your downfall."

name: Aura Mutation
text:
"Nature has a way of adapting to and overcoming any force that seeks its end."
—Vivien Reid

name: Breath of Malfegor
text: The blood of the demons quickened as their master rose over the battlefield. The blood of the angels also quickened: here was the chance to finally end the war started millennia ago.

name: Camaraderie
text:
"Within the song of Mat'Selesnya, one becomes all."
—Heruj, Selesnya hierophant

name: Cloudblazer
text: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

name: Collective Blessing
text: Senators of Azorius often hired agents to spy on the Selesnya. They were told to record every spore and root they saw, as each could become a deadly foe.

name: Dauntless Escort
text: Elspeth's squires do not seek advancement. For them, no knightly glory could surpass the glory of serving their champion.

name: Diregraf Captain
text: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

name: Draconic Disciple
text: "If I am to die, I will die in the embrace of immeasurable flame."

name: Empyrean Eagle
text: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

name: Fires of Yavimaya
text: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Harbinger of the Hunt
text: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

name: Havengul Lich
text: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

name: Jubilant Skybonder
text: She was born unable to walk. Through the eludha, she was able to fly.

name: Kaervek the Merciless
text:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

name: Kangee, Sky Warden
text: "Let their horrors and machines come. We will meet them blow for blow."

name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
text: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

name: March of the Multitudes
text: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

name: Pilfered Plans
text: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the chances of the other guilds.

name: Rakdos Charm
text:
"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

name: Selesnya Evangel
text: "The clamor of the city drowns all voices. But together we can sing a harmony that will resonate from Ravnica's tallest spires to her deepest wells."

name: Skycat Sovereign
text: The bounty on its head is as old as Skysail, but no one has ever tried to collect.

name: Sphinx's Revelation
text: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

name: Spiteful Visions
text: Knowledge brings the sting of disillusionment, but the pain teaches perspective.

name: Staggering Insight
text:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Stormfist Crusader
text:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—Legend of the Gilded Knights

name: Terminate
text: All suns must set.

name: Thunderclap Wyvern
text: Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Undermine
text: "Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"

name: Unlicensed Disintegration
text: "I'd stand back if I were you."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Atarka Monument
text: Atarka is worshipped and fed by her subjects at Ayagor, the Dragon's Bowl.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Sky Diamond
text: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

name: Skyscanner
text: The municipal senate makes extensive use of the thopters, mostly to gather dirt on rival senators.

name: Slate of Ancestry
text: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Thought Vessel
text: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Worn Powerstone
text: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

name: Canopy Vista
