text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cinder Barrens
text: A mudflow swallowed the lowlands years ago. All that remains are a bottomless mire and an endless rain of ash.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Coastal Tower
text: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

name: Command Tower
text:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Elfhame Palace
text: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

name: Gisa and Geralf
text: "These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you." "A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

name: Rally of Wings
text: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

name: Holdout Settlement
text: Even in areas of profound devastation, the hedrons remained intact.

name: Meandering River
text: The river split into many channels as it flowed to the Halimar Sea. Few travelers could follow the same one twice.

name: Remorseful Cleric
text: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Salt Marsh
text:
Only death breeds in stagnant water.
—Urborg saying

name: Shivan Oasis
text: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Rootborn Defenses
text: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

name: Stensia Bloodhall
text: The revelry ends when the supply of fresh ingenues runs dry.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Timber Gorge
text: Tazeem's embrace is harsh, but for those that call it home, nothing else will do.

name: Tranquil Expanse
text: Despite the chaos of the Roil and the devastation of the Eldrazi, Zendikar is a world of breathtaking beauty.

name: Urborg Volcano
text: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Soul Snare
text:
"Shackle the body, and the anguish lasts only until death. Shackle the soul, and the wicked can be punished for eternity."
—Inquisitor Laerin

name: Steel-Plume Marshal
text: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

name: Storm Herd
text:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: True Conviction
text: "Heroism is more than a single act; it is hundreds of small decisions, made every day, in pursuit of a heroic cause."

name: Valor in Akros
text: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
text: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

name: Vow of Duty
text:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Angler Turtle
text: It is ancient, immense, and irresistible.

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Ever-Watching Threshold
text:
"You think they know we're here?"
—Orlo, goblin raider

name: Faerie Formation
text: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

name: Favorable Winds
text:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

name: Gravitational Shift
text: As they awakened, the Eldrazi reasserted their mastery over all of Zendikar's natural forces.

name: Laboratory Drudge
text:
"Many hands make light work."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Negate
text: "As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"

name: Sharding Sphinx
text: Whether mechanical or biological, life finds a way to propagate itself.

name: Sinister Sabotage
text:
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds."
—Lazav

name: Sphinx of Enlightenment
text: "I would be a fool if I taught you everything I know."

name: Tide Skimmer
text: Fishing boats often follow hunting drakes to find the largest schools of fish.

name: Warden of Evos Isle
text: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

name: Windreader Sphinx
text: "Your mind is too filled with foolish concerns to hear the subtle whispers that the breeze brings."

name: Winged Words
text: Magic written across the sky falls like rain on thirsty ground, bringing forth wisdom in its season.

name: Ambition's Cost
text:
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Archfiend of Depravity
text: "Why would I kill you all? Who then would be left to worship me?"

name: Army of the Damned
text: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

name: Bloodgift Demon
text: He relishes the devotion of his Skirsdag puppets and their belief that it will earn them immortality.

name: Archon of Redemption
text: Until Emeria is freed, he raises his sword in her name.

name: Cemetery Reaper
text: Every grave cradles a recruit.

name: Champion of the Perished
text: He rose from the graf for every cobbler, tanner, and fool who'd been slaughtered in the parish—and they rose and shambled after him.

name: Crippling Fear
text: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

name: Cruel Revival
text: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

name: Curse of Disturbance
text: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

name: Deadly Tempest
text: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

name: Dredge the Mire
text: Fortunately, the reanimation spell just missed the long-dead colony of dung scorpions.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Fleshbag Marauder
text: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

name: Gravespawn Sovereign
text: The warlocks never expected their creations to create servants of their own.

name: Aven Gagglemaster
text: An aven's gear is enchanted to avoid weighing them down during aerial maneuvers.

name: Indulgent Tormentor
text: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

name: Lazotep Reaver
text: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.

name: Liliana's Devotee
text: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

name: Liliana's Mastery
text: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

name: Liliana's Standard Bearer
text: The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.

name: Lord of the Accursed
text: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

name: Lotleth Giant
text:
"I prefer the big and looming to the small and skittering."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—The Theriad

name: Loyal Subordinate
text: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

name: Midnight Reaper
text: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Murder
text: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Necrotic Hex
text:
"You foolish knights pound your breastplates and vow to fight until your last breath. As if that's when it ends."
—Tormod, the Desecrator

name: Open the Graves
text: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

name: Rock Jockey
text: Goblins don't know much about physics, but they know lots about falling and rocks.

name: Spark Spray
text: It's the only kind of shower goblins will tolerate.

name: Torrent of Fire
text: Dragon fire melts any instrument designed to measure it.

name: Uncontrolled Infestation
text: The grounds of the Riptide Project are now populated only by slivers, broken beakers, and the lonely screeching of gulls.

name: Accelerated Mutation
text: Its food just got a lot smaller and its stomach a lot bigger.

name: Dragonstalker
text:
"When the skies are filled with flames, the brave shall step forward to quench them."
—Order prophecy

name: Alpha Status
text: The best leaders are made by their followers.

name: Ancient Ooze
text: The ooze has always been. The ooze will always be.

name: Break Asunder
text: "No good will come of this."

name: Claws of Wirewood
text: They say the forest has eyes. They never mention its claws.

name: Divergent Growth
text: Nature has forgotten its own rules.

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Krosan Drover
text: "Sit."

name: Krosan Warchief
text: It turns prey into predator.

name: Kurgadon
text: When it walks through Krosa, trees step aside, leaves take wing, and the ground shudders.

name: Primitive Etchings
text: Ancient carvings in the trees of Krosa glow with power once again.

name: Titanic Bulvox
text: With natural laws abandoned, excess thrives.

name: Exiled Doomsayer
text: He's desperate to hold back the future because he has seen it.

name: Treetop Scout
text: At home among the swaying, supple branches of the treetops, some scouts live their entire lives never touching ground.

name: Upwelling
text: Once again, Kamahl felt the full force of the Mirari's pull, but he had learned much since the last time.

name: Wirewood Guardian
text: Tall as a tree and probably related.

name: Wirewood Symbiote
text: It drinks fatigue.

name: Xantid Swarm
text: When they land on you, all you can think about is tearing them off.

name: Sliver Overlord
text: The end of evolution.

name: Ark of Blight
text: When opened, it erases entire landscapes from minds and maps.

name: Stabilizer
text:
"Hold that thought."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Gilded Light
text: "Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second."

name: Guilty Conscience
text:
Those who most feel guilt don't need to, while those who most need to feel guilt never do.
—Order proverb

name: Rain of Blades
text: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

name: Recuperate
text:
"Rise once more, so you may continue to destroy our enemies."
—Karona, false god

name: Reward the Faithful
text: "When you have drunk your fill, pass the cup to others who thirst."

name: Silver Knight
text: Otaria's last defense against the wave of chaos threatening to engulf it.

name: Wipe Clean
text: "The light of the Ancestor will scour the taint of darkness from the land."

name: Zealous Inquisitor
text: "I only return what rightly belongs to another."

name: Aphetto Runecaster
text: "The ignorant fear change; the wise use it as a weapon."

name: Aven Farseer
text: His enemies' trickery and deceit only fuel his righteous anger.

name: Coast Watcher
text: The aven came to fear the forest's clawing branches, but the watchers quickly renewed their courage.

name: Dispersal Shield
text: "Maybe next time."

name: Faces of the Past
text: The ties that bind can also strangle.

name: Long-Term Plans
text: "Wait, it'll come to me in a minute."

name: Metamorphose
text: If it's not one thing, it's another.

name: Raven Guild Initiate
text: The Raven Guild soars on winds of unease.

name: Rush of Knowledge
text:
"Limitless power is glorious until you gain limitless understanding."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

name: Daru Spiritualist
text: He lifts the spirits of his people so they may descend in wrath upon their foes.

name: Scornful Egotist
text: "Once I was human. Now I am far more."

name: Stifle
text:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

name: Thundercloud Elemental
text: Some days it's better to stay inside.

name: Cabal Conditioning
text:
"Hear only the Cabal's voice.
See only the Cabal's way.
Speak only the Cabal's word."
—Cabal mantra

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Daru Warchief
text: His victories speak for him.

name: Clutch of Undeath
text: The hand of death recognizes its own.

name: Consumptive Goo
text: Silent as fog and relentless as plague, it is wet, creeping death.

name: Death's-Head Buzzard
text: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

name: Fatal Mutation
text:
"You wear that shell as a mask. Now it's your coffin."
—Cabal cleric

name: Final Punishment
text: The pain of a lifetime—every scrape, illness, and bruise—condensed into a single moment.

name: Lethal Vapors
text: The vapors infiltrate every crevice, poison every lung, and snuff out every life.

name: Lingering Death
text:
"Looks bad. I don't know if he'll make it through the night."
—Cabal cleric

name: Dawn Elemental
text: It was midnight on the Daru Plains, yet it seemed the sun was rising.

name: Nefashu
text: Where the nefashu pass, blood rolls like a silk carpet.

name: Putrid Raptor
text: It eagerly gobbles up bits of its own rotting flesh as they fall to the swampy ground.

name: Skulltap
text:
"Finally, a use for that head of yours."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Unburden
text: Cabal initiates enter training full of hopes and fears. They graduate with neither.

name: Undead Warchief
text: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

name: Unspeakable Symbol
text: The symbols are spread throughout Aphetto, marking sites where minions of the Raven Guild and the Cabal can seek refuge.

name: Vengeful Dead
text: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

name: Zombie Cutthroat
text: The single-mindedness of a zombie, the cunning of an assassin.

name: Bonethorn Valesk
text: Barbarians weave its spurs into ceremonial charms to proclaim their hardiness in battle.

name: Dragon Mage
text: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
text: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

name: Enrage
text: "You wouldn't like me when I'm angry."

name: Extra Arms
text:
"Perhaps extra heads would have served them better."
—Foothill guide

name: Goblin Brigand
text: After the Skirk Ridge collapsed, the goblins erected a system of ropes and pulleys to hold up what was left.

name: Goblin Psychopath
text: The destruction he causes is nothing next to the chaos in his mind.

name: Goblin War Strike
text: "Fire, aim, ready!"

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Grip of Chaos
text: When the world is consumed by chaos, the skilled and the foolish are on equal footing.

name: Misguided Rage
text: Only when the anger passed did Varv realize he had burned down his home, destroyed his weapons, and killed his friend Furt.

name: Preordain
text: As the four Warriors of Light, they felt overwhelmed by the great task destiny had placed before them.

name: Death's Shadow
text: "Who dares disturb my sleep?"

name: City of Brass
text: Many visitors come to Bhujerba to enjoy the open-air parks with spectacular views only available to those who live in the sky.

name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
text: "Captain, are you going to punch me again, over and over, until your arm weakens? Clearly you want to. So tell me, why did you allow me to live?"

name: Apothecary Initiate
text: Kithkin jealously hoard their knowledge of poultices and remedies so that no outside threat can benefit from their wisdom.

name: Kithkin Shielddare
text: The nova glyph is a potent symbol. A shield embossed with it can resist the force of even the most determined giant.

name: Mudbrawler Cohort
text: Before a raid, the members of Wort's gang egg each other on with tales of their hunger and what they'll do to sate it, each outdoing the last.

name: Power of Fire
text: The cinders believe their flame was stolen by one they call the Extinguisher. All who now wield fire draw their desperate wrath.

name: Puncture Bolt
text: Cinder pyromancers measure their success by counting their enemies' smoking holes.

name: Pyre Charger
text: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

name: Rage Reflection
text: Vengeance is a dish best served twice.

name: Rustrazor Butcher
text: A Bloodwort's blade is salted with blood and peppered with rust, seasoning and slaughtering in a single swipe.

name: Slinking Giant
text: "I need a better hiding place."

name: Smash to Smithereens
text: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

name: Wild Swing
text: Though the shaman rarely got what she wanted, she was never disappointed in the result.

name: Crabapple Cohort
text: Seven wives made seven pies from seven apples, each plucked from its branches. Now bare and bitter, it comes to exact its price: one apple, one bone.

name: Last Breath
text:
"Tsk. You'd think those nasty merrows would know how to hold their breath."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Dramatic Entrance
text: Some things aren't worth waiting for.

name: Drove of Elves
text: "The light of beauty protects our journeys through darkness."

name: Farhaven Elf
text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

name: Flourishing Defenses
text: Many horrors take the bait of brave elf volunteers walking alone, only to fall to the blades of rescuers lurking nearby.

name: Foxfire Oak
text:
"The brethren shall blaze with unnatural fire, and the flame shall consume and purify our rage."
—Treefolk catastrophe myth

name: Gloomwidow
text: When gloomwidows mature, they abandon venom in favor of massive webs that span the eaves of cliffs.

name: Gloomwidow's Feast
text: Each night, gloomwidows cull fresh prey for their ravenous hatchlings.

name: Howl of the Night Pack
text: The murderous horrors of Raven's Run are legendary, but even that haunted place goes quiet when the night wolves howl.

name: Mass Calcify
text: The dead serve as their own tombstones.

name: Hungry Spriggan
text: If a spriggan's eyes are larger than its stomach, it has ways to remedy the situation.

name: Juvenile Gloomwidow
text: Gloomwidow venom is particularly virulent during the spider's first years, when it does most of its hunting near the forest floor.

name: Mana Reflection
text: Despite its darkness, Shadowmoor doesn't want for growth. Legions of creeping things thrive in the shade.

name: Nurturer Initiate
text: The elves alone preserve the few shreds of beauty left. There is no one else who cares.

name: Presence of Gond
text: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

name: Prismatic Omen
text: In times of portent, the land sculpts itself in accordance with the sigils burned on the sky.

name: Raking Canopy
text:
"Raven's Run has awoken, and ravens will no longer cry in its branches."
—Roon Ghastbark

name: Roughshod Mentor
text: He didn't hear the cries of the treefolk whose branches he snapped or of the elves caught underfoot. He had eyes only for the path ahead.

name: Spawnwrithe
text: Its victims feel only an itchy, wriggling feeling just under their skin. By then, it's far too late.

name: Toil to Renown
text: The last survivor of her patrol, the warrior returned expecting disappointment and scorn. Instead she found gratitude. "You are alive. That is reason to celebrate."

name: Viridescent Wisps
text: In the wisps that night, the once timid boggart saw all the terrible, bloody things he was capable of. And it was glorious.

name: Wildslayer Elves
text: Some elves battled too long in the deep shadow, their swords dipped too often in tainted flesh and poisoned blood.

name: Augury Adept
text: Moonstones grant limited foresight but unlimited advantages.

name: Barrenton Cragtreads
text: "Boggarts are easy to get around. Just toss some mutton in another direction. Giants are a little harder. You have to be quick to avoid their steps. Cinders are the difficult ones, but even they have fears to be exploited."

name: Curse of Chains
text: The giant's real punishment was the fleeting moment when he was allowed to stand before being dragged down to his knees again.

name: Mistmeadow Skulk
text: Doyo suspected the boggarts of brewing a plot against his crop, so he scythed away his grain to clear the sightlines.

name: Enchanted Evening
text: In the reflection, she saw the rough shell of the world sloughing away, revealing the truth shining underneath.

name: Godhead of Awe
text:
"What she saw crawling upon this world repulsed her. Yet she could not tear her gaze away."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Mirrorweave
text:
"Those who are different are untrustworthy, unpredictable. Put your safety in the hands of your own kind."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Plumeveil
text:
"It was vast, a great sheet of soaring wings, and equally silent. It caught us unawares and blocked our view of the kithkin stronghold."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Puresight Merrow
text: Stripped of his sight, he was free to see only the ideal.

name: Silkbind Faerie
text: "The bigger they are, the more fun it is to watch them fall flat on their faces."

name: Somnomancer
text: "Are you tired? You look tired."

name: Niveous Wisps
text: In a world devoid of sun, illumination comes from cheerless fires or the wandering spirits of the dead.

name: Swans of Bryn Argoll
text: Any being that harms them quickly learns its lesson.

name: Thistledown Liege
text: The thoughtweft is his informant, and he its devoted guardian.

name: Thoughtweft Gambit
text: The kithkin mind-bond is even tighter in Shadowmoor, reinforcing the unity of their community to the point of xenophobia.

name: Turn to Mist
text:
"Did you expect me to dodge? How quaint."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Worldpurge
text: The Aurora is not the only magic capable of remaking a world.

name: Zealous Guardian
text: Parapet watchers patrol the outer edges of the doun, signaling to others who wait patiently in shadow.

name: Cemetery Puca
text:
"'Tis a strange creature indeed that chooses the vanquished over the victor."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

name: Order of Whiteclay
text: Made from the clay of burial mounds, the face paint of the priests is a sign of their respect for those whose rest they interrupt.

name: Dream Salvage
text: Awylla tried hard to forget the horrors she had seen, but someone else had developed a keen interest in them.

name: Fate Transfer
text:
"The cinders find strength in suffering, the elves in beauty. But if you make an elf suffer, he gets weaker. I wonder what happens if you make a cinder beautiful?"
—Hrugash, leech bonder

name: Ghastlord of Fugue
text:
"He is a ghost that has never known life."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Glen Elendra Liege
text: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

name: Gravelgill Axeshark
text:
"Their sharp scales would make good armor, if they'd just stay dead."
—Taeryn, cinder armorkeep

name: Inkfathom Infiltrator
text: No one can navigate the dank maze of Shadowmoor's rivers better than the cruel and covetous merrows. They use the currents to steal—and to steal away.

name: Inkfathom Witch
text: The murk of the Wanderbrine concealed unseemly rituals designed to bring out the worst in merrowkind.

name: Memory Plunder
text:
"Vengeance is the echo of the victim's own crime."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Pale Wayfarer
text: As it wandered Shadowmoor, it did not remember its crime—only its shame.

name: Merrow Grimeblotter
text: Grimeblotters spend so much time in the Dark Meanders that they're able to bring a piece with them wherever they go.

name: Oona's Gatewarden
text: "So now you've seen Glen Elendra. Take a good look. It will be the last thing you'll ever see."

name: Scarscale Ritual
text: Some words are too important to trust to something as fragile as memory.

name: Sygg, River Cutthroat
text: "It's not a matter of deserving. It's a matter of strength. The power to hold versus the power to take."

name: Torpor Dust
text: "Some folk these days are too restless to dream the dreams we need. We need to teach them to stop and catch their breath."

name: Wanderbrine Rootcutters
text: Most dirtwalkers only know of the vicious merrows that dwell in the shallows. They can't begin to fathom the wickedness that skulks in the Dark Meanders.

name: Wasp Lancer
text:
"I doubt that faeries understand how short their lives are, compared to the rest of us. If they did, would they so readily charge into battle, heedless of the danger before them?"
—Awylla, elvish safewright

name: Prison Term
text: Clear out the cell. Bring in the next prisoner.

name: Ashenmoor Gouger
text: After his hands had crumbled away, leaving only wickedly sharp points, he decided his only purpose was war.

name: Ashenmoor Liege
text: Cinders carry an ancestral grudge that makes them slow to trust and quick to retaliate.

name: Cultbrand Cinder
text: "Your seared flesh will be the first step in your journey to dark enlightenment."

name: Demigod of Revenge
text:
"His laugh, a bellowing, deathly din, slices through the heavens, making them bleed."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Din of the Fireherd
text: Vengeance in stampede form.

name: Everlasting Torment
text: When night fell, the plane itself was scarred.

name: Fulminator Mage
text:
"Unsafe Terrain Ahead—Turn Back"
—Sign near the former location of Pyrtagh Cairn

name: Resplendent Mentor
text: Thoughtweft gives new meaning to the phrase "common knowledge."

name: Kulrath Knight
text: Mounted cinders circle the blasted peak at Kulrath, hunting the Extinguisher.

name: Manaforge Cinder
text: Cinder mystics set traps for sluaghs and other spirits of flame, seeking to extract the secrets of the fire their own hearts have lost.

name: Poison the Well
text: Wells that provide clean, unhaunted water are rare enough to be worth building an entire town around.

name: Scar
text:
"What is a scar? A sign of courage in the face of danger? A mere trick of flesh? Or a constant reminder of agonizing pain, and the follies of war."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Sootstoke Kindler
text: "Nothing warms my heart better than a spirit kindled with rage."

name: Sootwalkers
text: "Why allow the fires of others to burn, when ours do not? Why leave them content, while we suffer? If there is to be misery, let it be borne by all."

name: Spiteflame Witch
text: Cinder beliefs revolve around the Path of Sorrow, a spiritual descent into oblivion. They don't mind taking others on their journey down.

name: Spiteful Visions
text: Knowledge brings the sting of disillusionment, but the pain teaches perspective.

name: Armored Ascension
text:
"Why enchant feathers to make them sturdy when we can enchant shields to make them fly?"
—Braenna, cobblesmith

name: Rune-Cervin Rider
text: Things of beauty are in constant peril. The riders whisk them to safety, ahead of the encroaching darkness.

name: Tyrannize
text:
"I can stab you where it hurts, or where you will feel absolutely nothing."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Boartusk Liege
text: The boar leads its rider to victory in battle, but it doesn't know how close it is to becoming the victory feast.

name: Boggart Ram-Gang
text:
"We're going to need a bigger gate."
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Deus of Calamity
text:
"He bears the marks of ages upon his skin, memories of dreams long dead and best left buried."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Fossil Find
text:
"Some secrets want to be revealed. They burst through the soil of their own accord."
—Dindun of Kulrath Mine

name: Guttural Response
text: Wort had a raiding-bellow that could shatter steel, melt auras, and slice countermagic in half.

name: Impromptu Raid
text: For the Scuzzback gang, it's always "raid o'clock."

name: Loamdragger Giant
text: Giants sleep soundly and long, sometimes for long enough that a crust of earth and moss grows over them. But inevitably something disturbs their slumber, and they wake unhappy.

name: Manamorphose
text: For a moment, objects of pure mana glimmered in the wonderstruck boggart's hands. In the next moment, they were in his mouth, as he chewed contentedly.

name: Morselhoarder
text: It scours the hills for living matter, savoring even the tang of poisonous fungi.

name: Mudbrawler Raiders
text: To reach the ravine of the Wanderbrine River, they were told to take the shortcut "through the mountains." They took the directions literally.

name: Rosheen Meanderer
text: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

name: Scuzzback Scrapper
text: The Scuzzback gang scavenges rusty armor covered in barbed protrusions. No threat is more effective than the threat of infection.

name: Tattermunge Maniac
text: It shows up at one meal wearing the carcass of the last.

name: Safehold Sentry
text: "These bracers were worn by my father and by his mother before him. Boggart fangs have shattered on them. Cinder flames have withered at their touch. While I wear them, the safehold will not fall."

name: Tattermunge Witch
text: The Tattermunge gang has no words for the spell that whips their instinctual rage into a frenzy. They only know they like it.

name: Valleymaker
text: Their home uprooted by a giant, the gang of boggarts mourned their old stomping ground.

name: Vexing Shusher
text: The stench of bloodcap mushrooms on the breath is enough to ward off even the most potent magics, especially when combined with a special chant: "Hushhh."

name: Dawnglow Infusion
text: Dawnglove bloom is a potent nostrum, but the dawnglow brewed from its sap is nothing less than life itself.

name: Elvish Hexhunter
text: "All manner of curses, blights, and luckspoils infect Shadowmoor. We stalk them all, one perilous quest at a time."

name: Fracturing Gust
text: Elvish dawnhands test a relic's worthiness before collecting it for the safehold. If it can't stand up to a stiff breeze, it's left behind.

name: Kitchen Finks
text: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

name: Spectral Procession
text:
"The dead have it easy. They suffer no more. If breaking their rest helps the living, so be it."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Medicine Runner
text: Elvish healers carry vials of the balm known as dawnglow, reserving it for those wounds that herbs cannot treat.

name: Mercy Killing
text: "We will give you the peace you seek, though you may not yet know you seek it."

name: Old Ghastbark
text:
"Beware of trees that talk. Their words are threats. And mind the ones that sway and creak. They too threaten us, but in a foreign tongue."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

name: Oracle of Nectars
text: When elves find a fount of beauty, they protect it. Where there is beauty, there is hope.

name: Oversoul of Dusk
text:
"Some say she hid the sun herself, a desperate act to save it from its ultimate extinction."
—*The Seer's Parables*

name: Raven's Run Dragoon
text: "I have a gift. The ability to sense encroaching darkness has saved many lives. And yet constantly feeling the force of so much ugliness is a terrible burden."

name: Reknit
text:
"An axe may break upon a ribbon if the ribbon's will is the stronger."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

name: Rhys the Redeemed
text: Whole again in honor and horn.

name: Safehold Elite
text: "I refuse to die—not at the hands of one such as you."

name: Strip Bare
text:
"All glamers lifted, all lies revealed, all flesh exposed."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

name: Safewright Quest
text: Elves search for sources of beauty in a nighted world. Meanwhile, the nighted world searches for the blood of elves.

name: Seedcradle Witch
text: She whispered a prayer for strength, and her wishes wafted away like seeds on the wind.

name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
text: Every life ends, but life itself never does.

name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
text: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

name: Blight Sickle
text: Its scars cut deeper than its blade.

name: Chainbreaker
text: Scarecrows deemed too malevolent to roam free are shackled to boulders or dolmen stones. Their animosity usually outlives the chains.

name: Elsewhere Flask
text: One night Oona bottled the sky. The next night she aligned the stars and released it.

name: Gnarled Effigy
text:
"Bits of fallen scarecrow, laces of elfskin leather, teeth of an axeshark merrow . . . An industrious soul can find new uses for the most mundane items."
—Mowagh the Gwyllion

name: Grim Poppet
text: Beware a scarecrow bearing gifts—especially sloshing vessels of acid.

name: Heap Doll
text:
"I know one night it won't come back. Then I'll know it's truly done its job."
—Braenna, cobblesmith

name: Illuminated Folio
text: Most such relics remain clasped shut for fear of what ominous truths might be carved into the diptych inside.

name: Lurebound Scarecrow
text: It's a fool's race to run if all is lost if it be won.

name: Painter's Servant
text: It gathers hues from the twilight mist so that its master can paint a better world.

name: Pili-Pala
text: It wasn't really expected to fly. Then again, it wasn't expected to move, either.

name: Windbrisk Raptor
text: It awakened to gloom-fouled skies and responded with a righteous rage that shook the heavens.

name: Reaper King
text: It's harvest time.

name: Revelsong Horn
text: A deflated sigh breathed into the horn emerges as an inspiring melody.

name: Scrapbasket
text: Once a tool of kithkin farmers, scarecrows of all shapes now skitter and lurch across Shadowmoor, animated by residual rustic magics.

name: Scuttlemutt
text: Built to shuttle goods from the river, it took off one day carrying a cauldron of dyes.

name: Tatterkite
text:
"I rigged it together from wicker and scrap, yet somehow I find it unalterably perfect."
—Braenna, cobblesmith

name: Trip Noose
text: A taut slipknot trigger is the only thing standing between you and standing.

name: Umbral Mantle
text: It harnesses the power of night in a land where daylight fears to show itself.

name: Watchwing Scarecrow
text: The wings are held in place by wicker rods. The rods are held in place by pure faith.

name: Wicker Warcrawler
text: It's the twisted creation of a kithkin diviner who dreamed of very large crows.

name: Woeleecher
text: One head senses the curse. The second loosens it from the soul. The third drinks it as an invigorating mist.

name: Fire-Lit Thicket
text: Occupancy of the den changes from night to night as boggart gangs fight for control of a place they aren't willing to simply eat.

name: Graven Cairns
text:
"Here did the Extinguisher steal the light from the world. Here will we sacrifice her to bring the Great Rekindling to our people."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Mystic Gate
text: The gate of every kithkin doun is a cunning trap, intended to spill visitors into an oubliette from which there is no escape.

name: Reflecting Pool
text: Does it reflect the future that once was or the past that can never be?

name: Sunken Ruins
text: Without the care of the tideshapers, the Lanes lie neglected. Some have flooded entire towns; others dried to cracked mud.

name: Wooded Bastion
text: The elves of Wilt-Leaf Wood continually expand the palisade surrounding the sanctuary. They hope to one day enclose the entire forest within its walls.

name: Biting Tether
text: A chain of lies as strong as steel.

name: Ballynock Cohort
text: A kithkin's worst enemy is solitude.

name: Briarberry Cohort
text: A clique can cause far more mischief than one faerie on its own.

name: Cerulean Wisps
text:
"If you see ghostly lights by the river, eat three twigs of marshroot to ward off kelpies."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Consign to Dream
text:
"Dreams are fleeting. Reality even more so."
—Oona, queen of the fae

name: Cursecatcher
text: "Of all the things that can be stolen, opportunity is the most valuable."

name: Deepchannel Mentor
text: The rivers can no longer provide safe passage for travelers and commerce. They serve only as highways for raiders and channels for blood and woe.

name: Drowner Initiate
text: Nothing satisfies a merrow as much as drowning what it cannot have.

name: Faerie Swarm
text: Untouched by the Aurora, Oona's faeries greeted the night like any other day.

name: Flow of Ideas
text:
"Beware the merrows, whose envy and covetousness surpasses even that of the ravenous whirlpools where they dwell."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

name: Ghastly Discovery
text: Korrigans, spirits bound to sources of water, shriek when they come upon their own drowned corpses.

name: Barrenton Medic
text: His dreams are filled with noxious powders and clinking vials.

name: Isleback Spawn
text: The more deadly the lake monster, the shorter the tale.

name: Kinscaer Harpoonist
text: The suspicious kithkin of Kinscaer patrol the skies, their eyes attuned to the shapes of outsiders.

name: Knacksaw Clique
text: Most of the Knacksaw clique's skills were hewn from the minds of others.

name: Leech Bonder
text: Some don't know his face, but his pets are a dead giveaway.

name: Merrow Wavebreakers
text: The merrows' prey have retreated from the shore, so they have learned to follow.

name: Parapet Watchers
text: A kithkin doun is not so much a town as a fortress, built to withstand the constantly besieging darkness. Only those most watchful and trustworthy are tasked with guarding its walls.

name: Prismwake Merrow
text: "Seeing is believing" is a fact the merrows ruthlessly exploit in their dealings with the other residents of Shadowmoor.

name: Put Away
text: Kithkin spellbottlers spend half their time preserving old memories and the other half punishing the new.

name: Boon Reflection
text: Kithkin healers chant the clan songs of both their parents over the broth to double its curative effect.

name: Savor the Moment
text: The merrow took a moment for herself. She never gave it back.

name: Spell Syphon
text: Warrik Brutehexer felt betrayed that his aura favored the depths of the Wanderbrine River over its rightful place, hovering around him.

name: Thought Reflection
text: Knowledge fills the mind of a fool and opens the mind of the sage.

name: Whimwader
text:
"Thought? Deceit? Progress? Now you're just making it hungry."
—Abral, kithkin alchemist

name: Aphotic Wisps
text: Merrows skulk the silty bogs around the Wanderbrine, their very thoughts stained with evil.

name: Ashenmoor Cohort
text:
"None will concede a place for us in this world. If it is not for us, neither shall it be for them. We rest not until they choke in its cold ashes."
—Illulia of Nighthearth

name: Beseech the Queen
text: Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.

name: Blowfly Infestation
text: When the giant Tollek Worldslayer fell, a corruption erupted from his corpse to carry on his name.

name: Cinderbones
text: Not all coals lie quietly in their beds of cold ash.

name: Goldenglow Moth
text: Ordinary moths follow it, drawn to its light.

name: Cinderhaze Wretch
text: Thick smoke billows and twists to form disturbing faces that cackle and click their teeth to the popping embers.

name: Corrosive Mentor
text: Guttering cinders stoke their dying flames by snuffing out the lights of others.

name: Corrupt
text: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

name: Crowd of Cinders
text: They envy the life-giving heat so much that they tear it from those who still possess it.

name: Dusk Urchins
text: They spawn from shadow, wreaking chaos until shadow claims them again.

name: Faerie Macabre
text: The line between dream and death is gauzy and fragile. She leads those too near it from one side to the other.

name: Gloomlance
text: Death stings the victim only once, but those left behind feel the pain of loss with every passing memory.

name: Hollowborn Barghest
text: It leaves a trail of crumpled trees and dashed dreams.

name: Hollowsage
text: Dreams of dark nights to come are said to stir in the minds of scheming hollowsages.

name: Greater Auramancy
text: A delicate veil of glamers can prove as sturdy as iron.

name: Incremental Blight
text: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

name: Loch Korrigan
text:
"Don't look upon still waters without first breaking the surface. The korrigan will catch you with her gaze and drag you to your death."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Midnight Banshee
text: Many have heard the beginning of its low, sustained shriek but few the end.

name: Polluted Bonds
text: The mystic bond between spellcasters and the land is just as vulnerable to attack as the casters themselves.

name: Sickle Ripper
text: His sickle was forged in the heat of another cinder's funeral pyre.

name: Smolder Initiate
text: "Life is a circle. Death is a vicious circle."

name: Splitting Headache
text: All faeries delve for dreams. But not all wait for their victims to fall asleep.

name: Inquisitor's Snare
text: Driven by their paranoia, kithkin inflict on their foes all the agonies they believe would have been inflicted on them.

name: Torture
text: What the vigor of life builds up, agony tears down again.

name: Wound Reflection
text: The mission of the Nighthearth, Illulia's cult of murderous cinders, is to intensify every pain suffered in Shadowmoor.

name: Blistering Dieflyn
text: Any kithkin smith would love to catch a dieflyn for her kiln, relieving her of ever having to gather fuel again.

name: Bloodmark Mentor
text: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

name: Bloodshed Fever
text: Cinder mages enjoy seeing their victims in the throes of bloodlust—and seeing the regret that inevitably follows.

name: Boggart Arsonists
text: The Aurora transformed Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders. They still don't know much about tool safety.

name: Cragganwick Cremator
text: Each night that his bowl fills, a village mourns.

name: Crimson Wisps
text: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

name: Deep-Slumber Titan
text: Do not disturb.

name: Kithkin Rabble
text: If even the slightest hint of panic enters the thoughtweft, bakers, potters, and even medics drop their spoons and salves to take up arms.

name: Ember Gale
text:
"Terrible wind. It whipped sparks into our skin, then stoked them even hotter!"
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

name: Flame Javelin
text: Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.

name: Horde of Boggarts
text: Strategies don't come easily to the boggarts' feral minds, but full-on assault hasn't failed them yet.

name: Inescapable Brute
text: If you think you made it past him alive, he's just teasing you.

name: Intimidator Initiate
text: Don't stand in his way, for his way is full of pointy things and fire.

name: Jaws of Stone
text: When giants find their mountain homes infested, they have a whole range of solutions.

name: Knollspine Dragon
text: It woke to find a vast world in need of a master.

name: Knollspine Invocation
text: Witches tempted by the power of flame gathered to study in the ruins of Spinerock Knoll.

name: Thornhide Wolves
text:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Devilthorn Fox
text: On expeditions through Ashmouth, the hunters of Devilthorn Lodge rely on the cleverness of foxes to counteract the mischief of devils.

name: Field Creeper
text: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

name: Sigarda's Aid
text: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

name: Altar of the Brood
text: Worshippers are allowed to pluck one memory from a chosen nonbeliever. Maybe a battle plan. Maybe a profession of love.

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Always they are watching, carefully tallying twig snaps.

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text:
Many live lives of quiet desperation. His
is quite loud.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

name: Tradewind Rider
text: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text: "General?!" Tahngarth roared. "General *nuisance*, maybe."

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Genesis
text:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Glimpse of Nature
text: Dosan sat in repose for many hours. He made no motion, no sound at all. And as he sat, nature revealed itself to him.

name: Lightning Helix
text: Though lesser well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

name: Ponder
text: "We see the same sky as you, just through a different lens."

name: Heritage Druid
text:
"Study the great spirits of our age and those of the past. Prune secrets from the branching traceries of our lineage."
—Twila, Gilt-Leaf archdruid

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Siege Rhino
text: The mere approach of an Abzan war beast is enough to send enemies fleeing in panic.

name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
text: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

name: Arclight Phoenix
text: Some storms never blow over.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text: Bala Ged scribes have stanza upon stanza of its exploits stalking jungles and the mirey quags within.

name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
text: His cleverness is well regarded among the akki, but most of his jokes are just variations on "Leaving Zo-Zu'n?" and then he shoots fire at you.

name: Altar of the Brood
text: Worshippers are allowed to pluck one memory from a chosen nonbeliever. Maybe a battle plan. Maybe a profession of love.

name: Crop Rotation
text: Everyone gets some time in the good soil. This week it's the Turnipsons.

name: Crop Rotation
text: Everyone gets some time in the good soil. This week it's the Turnipsons.

name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
text: They say you can't take it with you, but he's out to prove them wrong.

name: Isochron Scepter
text: "Again—mana! And tap it! And cast! Feel the burn—you're doing great!"

name: Llanowar Elves
text: Always they are watching, carefully tallying twig snaps.

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text:
Many live lives of quiet desperation. His
is quite loud.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
text: Bala Ged scribes have stanza upon stanza of its exploits stalking jungles and the mirey quags within.

name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
text: His cleverness is well regarded among the akki, but most of his jokes are just variations on "Leaving Zo-Zu'n?" and then he shoots fire at you.

name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
text: They say you can't take it with you, but he's out to prove them wrong.

name: Isochron Scepter
text: "Again—mana! And tap it! And cast! Feel the burn—you're doing great!"

name: Sliver Overlord
text: The end of evolution.

name: Patron Wizard
text:
„Achte immer auf die Schatten der alten Meister. Sie waren vor dir da und werden noch lange nach dir da sein."
—Aus Donatos gesammelten Weisheiten

name: Berserk
text: Das Erste, was ich spüre, ist die Wut — und dann kommt die Kraft.

name: Verduran Enchantress
text:
„Sie verlangt keinen Gehorsam. Doch die Natur lauscht ihrer Bitte, und die Antwort enttäuscht nie."
—*Enzyklopädie von Endres*, „Naturzauber"

name: Triumphant Reckoning
text: "We have defied fate. Our destinies are our own."

name: Savor the Moment
text: "I do."

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Our history is one hand reaching out to another."

name: Bearscape
text: They built a refuge with their bear hands.

name: Heartbeat of Spring
text: "You were right, Ixalan is a paradise," said Saheeli. "Mostly because you're here."

name: Sol Ring
text: The relic had been kept for years in a place of power, of community, and of friendship—distilling magic from the light of love.

name: Mana Confluence
text: Better places poured prismatic dreams into the world, rendering it anew.

name: Idyllic Tutor
text:
"I know she is somewhere in the Multiverse. I will find her no matter what, even if it means I have to travel all worlds that exist."
—Kaito Shizuki

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"Rather than be hunted in the shadows, I choose to face the real enemy. I am not afraid of monsters I can see."
—The Emperor

name: Solve the Equation
text:
"Whoever Tezzeret is working with is after more than the Emperor."
—Tamiyo

name: Praetor's Grasp
text:
"Wake up, new Phyrexian Planeswalker! You will not be the last."
—Jin-Gitaxias

name: Veil of Summer
text:
"I won't tell you or anyone else where my son is. Ever."
—Tamiyo

name: Merciless Executioner
text: Kommandos differ from usual Orks. They still want to kill you. They just want to surprise you before they do it.

name: Aggravated Assault
text: Despite being more cunning than most Orks, Kaptin Badrukk still recognizes that some plans just need more dakka.

name: Blind Obedience
text:
"Man is a beast and it is good that fear fills him."
—Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: Neave Blacktalon is a single-minded hunter and slayer of the enemy's most powerful lords.

name: Loxodon Warhammer
text: The relics of the God-King are many, but no other inspires as much awe in his faithful or dread in his foes.

name: Rewind
text: Sometimes you just have to go for it.

name: Bone Splinters
text: "Looks like they're just piling on now."

name: Knight Exemplar
text: "We slew the last dragon ages ago. Now we fight the *real* monsters."

name: Lord of the Undead
text:
"All of life's problems can be solved—death included."
—Nymara, Rhodosi dreadlord

name: Compost
text:
"The dead ones joined Tocatztli, the seven-legged, each bloom becoming a star in the night sky."
—*The Song of Origins*

name: Matter Reshaper
text: Its powers are simple—mind over matter. Or rather, an immeasurable mind disassembling and reconfiguring matter.

name: Toothy, Imaginary Friend
text: Go ahead, tell it that it isn't real.

name: Pir, Imaginative Rascal
text: Pir always had a *very* big imagination.

name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
text: The mirror's shards sparkled like starfire, and a legend was reborn.

name: Pyretic Ritual
text:
"Sometimes, students, rite makes might."
—Mother Luti

name: Repercussion
text: "Tyrants will always suffer consequences. My favorite are the fiery ones."

name: Pyromancer's Goggles
text: The strongest mentorships kindle the passions of both student and teacher.

name: Void Winnower
text: "I used to think penthouses were for jerks but I'm starting to see the appeal."

name: Goblin Settler
text: The safer outcroppings were already claimed by goblin overachievers.

name: Collector Ouphe
text: "So this orb I got back at Spherecon 1993. It looks a lot like the '94 version but it's actually rounder."

name: Vengevine
text: "RARGLEARGLEARGLE!"

name: Doubling Cube
text:
"Freedom is the right of all sentient beings."
—Optimus Prime

name: True Conviction
text:
"Now light our darkest hour."
—Rodimus Prime

name: Dramatic Reversal
text:
"Megatron must be stopped. No matter the cost!"
—Optimus Prime

name: Fabricate
text: Megatron is no more . . . there is only Galvatron.

name: By Force
text: Decepticon warfare: the art of total annihilation.

name: Greater Good
text:
"One day, an Autobot shall rise from our ranks and use the power of the Matrix to light our darkest hour. Until that day, till all are one."
—Optimus Prime

name: Deepglow Skate
text:
"Blue, glossy green, and velvet black,
They coiled and swam; and every track
Was a flash of golden fire."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

name: Tireless Tracker
text:
"Tell me, Muse, of that man, so ready at need, who wandered far and wide."
—Homer, *The Odyssey*

name: Contagion Engine
text:
"Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there wondering, fearing."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Raven"

name: Sword of Truth and Justice
text:
"'The name of it,' said the lady, 'is Excalibur.'"
—Sir Thomas Malory, *Le Morte d'Arthur*

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: "They claim that dog is man's best friend. But according to my calculations, it's actually this guy!"

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text:
"Heel! Wait, no—fetch the whole leg!"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "Despite its ghastly appearance, the Ravnican murder budgie makes quite an erudite conversationalist."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: He stood transfixed, able to do nothing but ponder a life of peace and redemption. It was the worst five minutes of his life.

name: Wood Elves
text: But *should* elves?

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: An unlikely jail for an impossible inmate.

name: Stasis
text: The universe let out a sigh of relief.

name: Prismatic Omen
text: For a brief eternity, the truth refracted across a thousand futures.

name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
text: There's always another tomorrow.

name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
text: "Fashion belongs to those with the luxuries of style and taste. I have both."

name: Reflector Mage
text: Dressed to suppress.

name: Adaptive Automaton
text: Always on trend.

name: Opt
text: The choice isn't whether to eat, but when to stop.

name: Serra Ascendant
text: Her faith in Serra reached new heights.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text: It's like the cycle of reincarnation, just significantly more abrupt.

name: Winds of Change
text: Sometimes, a butterfly flapping its wings is insufficient.

name: Anger of the Gods
text: Eating those clerics might have been a bad idea.

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possible meals.

name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
text: If you saw her, you'd go, "AAAHHHH!"

name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
text: If you saw her, you'd go, "AAAHHHH!"

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Its diet consists of the rare everyberry, which tastes different every time. It loves the surprise!

name: Birds of Paradise
text: Its diet consists of the rare everyberry, which tastes different every time. It loves the surprise!

name: Sliver Legion
text: An alien from another world, at first glance it looks funny. Maybe scary and also maybe ugly, but mostly funny.

name: Sliver Legion
text: An alien from another world, at first glance it looks funny. Maybe scary and also maybe ugly, but mostly funny.

name: Thought-Knot Seer
text: It thinks, therefore you aren't.

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text: You have been found wanting, though not for much longer.

name: Reality Smasher
text: New perspectives are often fleeting.

name: Eldrazi Temple
text: It housed a congregation of broken, screaming souls.

name: Esika, God of the Tree
text: The beginning of the rainbow.

name: Serra Angel
text:
Through vulnerability and compassion,
We find the humility of truth.

name: Brainstorm
text: James would let his duck compose now and then, but never make the tea!

name: Progenitus
text: Extinction, the perfect tonic for rage.

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: "What's behind my mask? My face, idiot."

name: Spellseeker
text: "Want to know your future? Just three mana!"

name: Magus of the Wheel
text: "You could win a pointy stick! Or a drippy eyeball. Or a little triangle froggy thing. Or some wavy lines . . . ."

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
text: "Once more, with killing!"

name: Faeburrow Elder

text: The navigator guides the ship. The bird guides the navigator.

text: Some muses give birth to art and poetry. Others inspire life itself.

name: Arcane Signet
text: ... for Earth's Mightiest Heroes.

name: Gilded Lotus
text:
"They're a lot tougher than they look. This place... It has a kind of power."
—Aerith Gainsborough

name: Swan Song
text: The gracefulness of their flight makes one wonder whether Nature or, indeed, a rare sort of Magic lifts their wings.

name: Sol Ring
text: Some cars have a combustion engine, a combustion windshield, and a combustion steering wheel too.

name: Sol Ring
text:
"I'll find you Calypso!"
—Sweet Tooth

name: Sol Ring
text: When Valstrax soars in the sky, it may be the last thing you'll ever see.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Thráin I came to Erebor and became King under the Mountain. There he found the Arkenstone, Heart of the Mountain.

name: Command Tower
text: Behold Avengers Tower, the home of Earth's Mightiest Heroes!

name: Birds of Paradise
text: A single vivid feather fetches a royal price—but who, having seen these magnificent creations of Nature, would settle for a feather?

name: Swan Song
text: Even the strongest voice in the universe needs to be heard.

name: Baleful Strix
text: Some superstitious persons believe that owls, being creatures of the night, are agents of Evil; but those who make such claims see only the reflection of their own guilty Consciences.

name: Rest in Peace
text: Lucy had chased every ball, chewed every stick, and rolled in every puddle. She lay down in the sun, content at last.

name: Dig Through Time
text: No matter how deep the treasure is buried, Hunter can always sniff it out.

name: Ancient Grudge
text: Shelby locked eyes with the ferocious creature as the glass began to crack. With one more lunge, she would break through and confront her nemesis at last.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: The boots demonstrated many strange magical properties, but the most remarkable was their ability to withstand Westley's ferocious chewing.

text: Rograkh couldn't bear to watch his father pillage his own people. Not when there were so many other people they could pillage instead.

name: Geralf's Messenger
text: The message is "Run."

name: Empress Galina
text: Few diplomats can resist the charm of Her Serene Highness's imperial seal.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

name: Lightning Bolt
text: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.
