text: If you nourish them, they grow calamitous.

name: Relentless Rats
text: If you revere them, they grow insidious.

name: Dark Ritual
text: "I will bleat you dry."

name: Spell Pierce
text: "You're trying to cast a spell? How quaint."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "Tulips bring love into the world. I bring the tulips."

name: Springleaf Drum
text: The beating drum inspired dancing, provoked fighting, and compelled both.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "Trust me, the quickest path down the mountain is just over this ridge."

name: Angelic Observer
text: Still and solemn as the statues of her kind that decorated the Park Heights rooftops, she gazed in sorrow on the city below.

name: Depopulate
text: No screams rang out. No blood stained the streets. In an instant, the bustling metropolis simply fell silent.

name: Antagonize
text:
"The little guy had guts at least. You can see 'em right there between those cobbles."
—Glunk, freelance crusher

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Call In a Professional
text: For the next week, Park Heights smelled of burnt oil paint and brimstone.

name: Daring Escape
text: As the Adversary's forces descended upon the gala, Elspeth whispered to Giada, "I can get you out of here, but we have to go now."

name: Devilish Valet
text: Nobody thought twice about checking their weapons at the door, until they were informed there was no weapon check at the door.

name: Glittering Stockpile
text: The only thing Ziatora desires is "more."

name: Goldhound
text: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.

name: Jackhammer
text:
"Subtlety is overrated."
—Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder

name: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
text: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

name: Ready to Rumble
text:
"It's too quiet tonight. Go make trouble."
—Ziatora

name: Riveteers Initiate
text: Young viashino flock to the Riveteers for Ziatora's leadership, eager to unleash their own inner dragons.

name: Rob the Archives
text: "Well, I guess stealth's out of the question."

name: Strangle
text: They'd warned him greed would be the death of him. He never thought to take it literally.

name: Structural Assault
text: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

name: Torch Breath
text: "Fried squid, comin' up!"

name: Unlucky Witness
text: The guard took a midnight shift to earn a promotion. Unfortunately, so did the assassin.

name: Gathering Throng
text: A plus-one is simply not enough.

name: Witty Roastmaster
text: If you're lucky, you'll walk out with just your ego singed.

name: Wrecking Crew
text: They built the neighborhood. They know its weak points. They know all the hiding places. When they come for you, they'll find you and bring the roof down on your head.

name: Attended Socialite
text: "Say hello to my little friend."

name: Bootleggers' Stash
text: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

name: Broken Wings
text: New Capenna's demonic masters are quick to extinguish any hint of the angels' power reawakening.

name: Cabaretti Initiate
text:
"Now there's a fellow who knows how to have a good time!"
—Jetmir

name: Giada, Font of Hope
text: The source of the Cabaretti's Halo turned out to be a single teenage girl.

name: Civic Gardener
text: "I've told you knuckleheads a hundred times: You can kill 'em here, but bury the bodies somewhere else. If you disturb my prized azaleas again, you'd better dig a second hole for yourself!"

name: Elegant Entourage
text: "Terribly sorry, but this is a private party, and your name isn't on the list."

name: Evolving Door
text: In with the old, out with the new.

name: For the Family
text: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.

name: Freelance Muscle
text: He never asks why. Just who, when, and where.

name: Glittermonger
text: Street corners in the Mezzio are a tantalizing bazaar of the fantastic, the illicit, and the fake.

name: High-Rise Sawjack
text: Slicing girders, rescuing trapped workers, killing gigantic rust flies—one tool does it all!

name: Jewel Thief
text: "They can afford the loss. They build it into their prices."

name: Luxurious Libation
text:
"Crisp, flavorful, and energizing. Perhaps the most elegant offering of Halo in Park Heights. Five stars."
—Conzuelo, restaurant critic

name: Most Wanted
text: Overnight, Elspeth was branded the most dangerous criminal in New Capenna.

name: Prizefight
text: Underweight, underpaid, underestimated.

name: Rhox Pummeler
text: When all you have is a warhammer, every face looks like a nail.

name: Riveteers Decoy
text: He keeps the heat off his allies—by drawing it all to himself.

name: Social Climber
text: "It's all about who you know, darling. And now you're lucky enough to know me."

name: Take to the Streets
text: No institution, however grand, can withstand the collective will of the people.

name: Hold for Ransom
text:
"Let's find out how much your friends think you're worth."
—Gino, hired kidnapper

name: Warm Welcome
text: "Welcome to the family. Chef Rocco sends their congratulations."

name: Black Market Tycoon
text: "I have exactly what you need. The question is, how badly do you need it?"

name: Body Dropper
text: "Kill count? I lost track years ago."

name: Brazen Upstart
text: "Trust me, you want to deal with me. My associates are much less pleasant."

name: Illuminator Virtuoso
text: The Obscura reserve their keenest blades for traitors in their midst.

name: Brokers Ascendancy
text: "This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship. And more importantly, a profitable one. Now sign here."

name: Cabaretti Ascendancy
text: "Whatever you're looking for—food, family, Halo—we've got the best in town."

name: Ceremonial Groundbreaker
text: Construction in New Capenna is imbued with tradition and ritual.

name: Civil Servant
text: "Together we can build a safer, brighter New Capenna!"

name: Cormela, Glamour Thief
text: She sees the world as a gift meant for her.

name: Corpse Appraiser
text: "Scarcely a mark. A true work of art!"

name: Corpse Explosion
text:
"Well, that's one way to scatter her ashes."
—Calvey, funeral director

name: Inspiring Overseer
text:
"This city could certainly use a bit more divine intervention."
—Inspector Jillard

name: Crew Captain
text: The Riveteers are as good at raising buildings as they are at razing them.

name: Darling of the Masses
text: The people flocked to the glittering parade, turning their backs on the threats in the shadows.

name: Disciplined Duelist
text: Brokers agents defend their charges by all means available, from intricate logic to blunt force trauma.

name: Endless Detour
text: After diverting around the eleventh construction barrier, the taxi driver began to suspect she was being herded into a trap.

name: Exotic Pets
text: Investigators observed that Altonio's beloved fish were thriving after his disappearance.

name: Fleetfoot Dancer
text: The Vanto Beatdown began as an improvised dance-battle at the Rose Room lounge. When word spread of how many were slain at the first event, it became a citywide obsession.

name: Forge Boss
text: "Big furnace like this can reduce anything to ash. You got something you need reduced to ash?"

name: Kill Shot
text:
"In the assassination trade, no one lives to make more than one mistake."
—Anhelo, the Painter

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Ob Nixilis smiled. It had been over one thousand years since his last conquest.

name: Incandescent Aria
text: As the assassins converged on Kitt Kanto, she struck a high note and held it, unbroken, for nearly a minute. When the room fell silent, she was surrounded only by rose petals falling gently to the floor.

name: Jetmir's Fixer
text: When you lose Jetmir's trust, his family makes sure you lose everything else.

name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
text: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.

name: Backup Agent
text: "My sources say the Beamtown Bullies were spotted in the Mezzio. Keep your eyes sharp and stay close to me."

name: Knockout Blow
text: "Subsequent efforts to deconstruct this facility will be punished with increasing severity."

name: Maestros Diabolist
text: "Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . ."

name: Meeting of the Five
text: For years, the five families ruled New Capenna in uneasy peace, and the city prospered.

name: Metropolis Angel
text:
"Angels are living proof that power does not always lead to corruption."
—Elspeth

name: Mr. Orfeo, the Boulder
text: Once he was jumped by a dozen Maestros agents. You can still see their imprints in the pavement if you know where to look.

name: Mage's Attendant
text: Crime sometimes makes unlikely allies into lifelong friends.

name: Ognis, the Dragon's Lash
text: Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.

name: Park Heights Pegasus
text: The burglar turned, bowed, and dropped from the ledge onto her waiting mount.

name: Queza, Augur of Agonies
text: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.

name: Riveteers Ascendancy
text: "We are this city, down to its bones."

name: Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer
text: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

name: Security Rhox
text: Unlucky assassins find out why he's called "Brick Wall" Balzano.

name: Soul of Emancipation
text: Light poured from every crack as the sleepers awoke from their long stone slumber.

name: Syndicate Infiltrator
text: The mansion's vaulted ceilings provided the perfect cover for an ambush.

name: Tainted Indulgence
text: Their toast to good health went immediately, horribly awry.

name: Patch Up
text: "Don't tell me who sent you or who you work for. The less I know, the better."

name: Void Rend
text: Bits of the missing agent were discovered in various alleys across all three boroughs.

name: Arc Spitter
text: "I'm fresh out of mercy today. Why don't you ask Sparky here for forgiveness?"

name: Chrome Cat
text:
"I always say, 'If it's breathing, it's lying.' Luckily my friend here does neither."
—Lord Xander

name: Getaway Car
text: For those who need to make a quick departure without attracting undue attention.

name: Halo Scarab
text: It pulses with the colors that best complement the wearer's outfit.

name: Ominous Parcel
text: The rest of Anhelo's assistant arrived over the following week.

name: Paragon of Modernity
text: No true angels have been created since the founding of New Capenna, but artisans have learned to craft elegant facsimiles.

name: Scuttling Butler
text: Porter, cleaner, and bouncer all in one.

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.

name: Botanical Plaza
text: Public parks are a favored meeting spot for those considering a shift in allegiance.

name: Brokers Hideout
text: Once the witness was inside, the safe house vanished first from sight, then from memory.

name: Cabaretti Courtyard
text: So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.

name: Jetmir's Garden
text: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

name: Maestros Theater
text: Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.

name: Obscura Storefront
text: In volatile times, a sense of certainty is in high demand.

name: Racers' Ring
text: Purchasing chrome racehorses with cash is a common means of dispersing mysterious income.

name: Raffine's Tower
text: The Obscura's Cloud Spire dominates the skyline, its eye a beacon of progress that sees all.

name: Riveteers Overlook
text: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

name: Skybridge Towers
text: New Capenna's districts are a series of tiers; wealth and power always rise to the top.

name: Spara's Headquarters
text: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.

name: Tramway Station
text: A ten-minute ride can take you to the luxury of Park Heights, or the grit of the Caldaia.

name: Waterfront District
text: The bottom of the dark canals is littered with countless corpses and treasures.

name: Raffine's Informant
text: "I've analyzed the vault schematic. Do you want the fast way, the easy way, or the secret way in?"

name: Xander's Lounge
text: Maestros agents can lie low in high style at the opulent Shadow Hostel.

name: Ziatora's Proving Ground
text: Restless Riveteers can always find a sparring partner in the sprawling Treza warehouse.

name: Refuse to Yield
text: Her opponent threw her through the window, so she retaliated by throwing the window through her opponent.

name: Revelation of Power
text: As Ob Nixilis closed in, Halo swept through Giada like an electrical current, and inside her, something long dormant unfurled its wings.

name: Rumor Gatherer
text: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

name: Ballroom Brawlers
text: Don't try to cut in. They'll cut back.

name: Sky Crier
text: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

name: Speakeasy Server
text: "Whatever ails you, friends, this will cure it for tonight! And leave you with a little inspiration for tomorrow."

name: Backstreet Bruiser
text: "I could show you what's in the case, but it'd be the last thing you ever see."

name: Brokers Veteran
text: One last job before he retires.

name: Case the Joint
text: Steel doors and iron bars are child's play for an Obscura operative.

name: Disdainful Stroke
text:
"I've known for a year that you would cast this exact spell, at this exact spot, at this exact time."
—Raffine

name: Boon of Safety
text:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara

name: Echo Inspector
text: The rendezvous took place hours ago, but the Obscura agent read the residue with ease.

name: Errant, Street Artist
text: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.

name: Even the Score
text: Those who try to rob the Obscura often leave behind more than they take away.

name: Expendable Lackey
text:
"Altonio? No, I'm sorry. No one by that name works here."
—Raffine

name: Faerie Vandal
text: "Greedy vault guard, wouldn't share. Now there's Halo in your hair!"

name: Hypnotic Grifter
text: "All is calm. All is well. You know me to be a trusted member of your family, and I would like to discuss the contents of our safe."

name: Ledger Shredder
text: No evidence, no crime.

name: Rumor Gatherer
text: "It's delightful, the things their owners reveal when they think no one is listening."

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

name: Incriminate
text:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

name: Majestic Metamorphosis
text: New Capenna's statues hold Old Capenna's secrets.

name: Brokers Initiate
text: Regarding the relative might of pen and sword, the official position of the Brokers is "Why choose?"

name: Obscura Initiate
text: Obscura initiates are required to bring a gift of information. They are judged on both how useful it is and how hard it was to obtain.

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
text: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

name: Out of the Way
text: "You bore me."

name: Psionic Snoop
text: She knows your next move before you do.

name: Public Enemy
text: Every Halo smuggler walks a razor's edge between untold riches and sudden disaster.

name: Run Out of Town
text: Better to depart in haste than be dearly departed.

name: Buy Your Silence
text: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

name: Sewer Crocodile
text:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased

name: Slip Out the Back
text: "I was never here."

name: Angel of Suffering
text: "If you wish for blessings, mortal, ask your demon masters. We've given enough to your kind."

name: Celebrity Fencer
text: After a brief but memorable incident at her first performance, she was never heckled again.

name: Corrupt Court Official
text:
"I wouldn't call what they have here a justice system. More like an auction."
—Elspeth

name: Crooked Custodian
text: "Nothing to see here. Just carrying a carpet. Yes, the carpet wears boots. Stop asking questions."

name: Cut of the Profits
text: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.

name: Cutthroat Contender
text: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.

name: Deal Gone Bad
text:
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us."
—Kamiz, Obscura Oculus

name: Demon's Due
text: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.

name: Graveyard Shift
text: "Up and at 'em, buddy. We've got more work to do."

name: Illicit Shipment
text: Whatever the Maestros had ordered, it wasn't anyone's business, including his.

name: Incriminate
text:
"If I were you, I'd check that elf's coat. I saw him slipping something into his pocket just before you arrived."
—Krandal, freelance instigator

name: Join the Maestros
text: "We're family now, big guy."

name: Maestros Initiate
text:
"How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?"
—Lord Xander

name: Midnight Assassin
text: The broad avenues and graceful spires of Park Heights are the playground of the affluent. After nightfall, they also make a fine hunting ground.

name: Murder
text: Ob Nixilis decided the fastest way to seize control of New Capenna would be to usurp the networks of power already hidden there. Xander's Maestros were the first to fall.

name: Dapper Shieldmate
text: Descended from Old Capenna's paladins, the Brokers are masters of defensive combat.

name: Rogues' Gallery
text: Between the five of them, they'd committed every crime on the books and invented a few new ones.

name: Shadow of Mortality
text:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall

name: Shakedown Heavy
text: "Look, we both get what we want. I get your Halo. You get to keep your kneecaps."

name: Tavern Swindler
text: "Only a chump stops after one unlucky loss. You're not a chump, are you?"

name: Vampire Scrivener
text: No one remains on her list for long.

name: Whack
text: "It's just business. You understand."

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
「真の不死とは、知識の伝承によってのみ成し得るもの。一つの心を形作れば、何千もの心の中に生きることができる。」
――「血塗られた影響」

name: Zombify
text:
「死者を呼び戻すのは難しいことではありません。ですが、呼びかけに応えたといってもすぐ操れるかというと、それはまた別の話です。」
――ヴェス教授

name: Abrade
text:
「僕たちは発見された遺物から多くの学びを得る。失われた遺物からは、どんな学びを得られただろうね？」
――キーロル

name: Brotherhood's End
text:
「二つの強い意志に、破壊の爪痕が一つ。」
――「アンティキティー戦争」

name: Bulk Up
text:
「噛みつき砕く我が歯牙よ、引き裂き穿つ我が爪よ、怒りに震える我が心よ、狂気の高みへ連れてゆけ。」
――「カソーラの戦唄」第一巻

name: Burst Lightning
text:
「最後の敵が斃れしとき、嵐が跪かんことを。」
――「オタリア人の喊声」

name: Crackle with Power
text:
「大地そのものを持ち上げ、敵に向かってその怒りを解き放て。」
――「フェラドルンの魔術師の秘密」

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
「ゴブリンと対峙する時は、目に見える数の二倍は地下に潜んでると思え。」
――「地形戦術と環境魔法」

name: Jeska's Will
text:
「死してなお、ジェスカの伝説はメラメラと燃え上がる。」
――クイントリウス・カンド

name: Return to the Ranks
text:
"It was not rage that made them fight, but honor."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Monstrous Rage
text:
「怒りはどこまでも私たちを歪め、壊してしまう。」
――「復讐心とその発露」

name: Pyretic Ritual
text:
「一人だけでは、ただの熱と空気と小さな火。力を合わせれば、燃え広がり続ける炎。」
――「炎の姉妹」

name: Subterranean Tremors
text:
「あるところに、タイタンをも震え上がらせる獣がいた。ここでは伏せておくことにしよう。その名を口にすることは、それを呼び寄せることになるのだから。」
――「破滅の歴史」

name: Awaken the Woods
text:
「ファイレクシアの脅威に対抗し、私たちは森を目覚めさせた。そして森は再び眠りにつくことを拒んだのだ。」
――ウィロウダスク

name: Crop Rotation
text:
「人生とは手間がかかるものですが、大切に手入れすれば何倍にもなって返ってくるでしょう。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

name: Giant Growth
text:
「呪文の出力で計算間違いをしたら、緊急用の呪文捕獲ネットをお使いください。」
――クアンドリクスの呪文研究室内の掲示

name: Glimpse of Nature
text:
「団栗の中に樫の木を見出し、幼獣の中に群れの王を見出すこと。生きとし生けるものの中に、大小や目の前の姿に惑わされず、何になり得るかを見出すこと。」
――「無限の自然」第一巻

name: Knockout Maneuver
text:
「獅子と一角獣、どちらが勝つと思う？」
――サナールからキーロルへ

name: Shamanic Revelation
text:
「彼女が操る獣たちは、死の静寂を予告するような轟音をあげた。」
――「多元宇宙の形而上史学」

name: Shared Roots
text:
「二人の愛の強さに心打たれた暁の王子は、二人を永遠に結び合わせ、その周りに大きな森が生まれた。」
――「フェイの物語」

name: Triumph of the Hordes
text:
「避けられる死もあれば、免れようのない死もある。」
――「戦呪文概要」

name: Culling Ritual
text:
「私たちは皆、なにかしらの形で作り直されているが、そのことに誰も口出しできないのです。」
――霊園の庭師、イェドラ

name: Deflecting Palm
text:
「歴史の学徒は誰しもが過去から学ぶ力を持つ。偉大な者たちはそれを自らの利益のために用いる。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

name: Expressive Iteration
text:
「あなたが作り出すものは数多くの選択肢から生じた結果なのだ。自分の心に従え。そうすれば誤りを選びようがなくなる。」
――プリズマリの学部長、ナサーリ

name: Brain Freeze
text:
"It was so embarrassing. Dean Veyran called on me and I just froze. My mind went blank."
—Overheard in the Archive stacks

name: Fracture
text:
「敵の力を元から断つこと。そうすれば、相手の戦意を削ぐことになるでしょう。」
――シルバークイルの学部長、エムブローズ

name: Armageddon
text:
「私を創造した者と同じように、私は完璧を追い求めた。そして彼と全く同じように、私は悲しみを覚えるだけだった。」
――「アージェンタムの終焉：ウルザの後継、カーンの回顧録」

name: Helping Hand
text:
「優しさとは一種の争いであり、決して失ってはいけないものである。」
――「戦癒しの論文」

name: Hop to It
text:
根っこを抜く手は多いほどよい。
――ラビットフォークの諺

name: Prismatic Ending
text:
「アルカイックは、アルケヴィオスの終焉をもって初めて死に至るという人がいます。アルカイックの死は、次元の終わりの先触れだという人もいます。真実はどうなのかって？時が満ちれば自ずとわかりますよ。」
――アルケヴィオスの神託者、ジャズィ

name: Repel Calamity
text:
「燃えがらにも、大口にも負けず、
恐ろしき猛焼にも立ち向かい、
輝きたる我が手の剣、
弱き心を追い払う。」
――「季節の唄」第二十四節

name: Reprieve
text:
「苦しみもがく人に憐みをもって手を差し出すのは、この世界の一員が果たすべき当然の務めなのです。」
――シルバークイルの学部長、マルジョー

name: Cyclonic Rift
text:
"When you see what nature is capable of, do not believe you'll be the one to withstand its force."
—*The Stormwright Texts*

name: Return to the Ranks
text:
「彼らを戦いへ赴かせるのは怒りではなく、誉れなのです。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、オーガスタ

name: Brain Freeze
text:
「すっごく恥ずかしかったんだから。ヴェイラン学部長に当てられた途端、もうなにも考えられなくて。頭の中は真っ白よ。」
――本の山が連なる書庫で耳にしたこと

name: Cyclonic Rift
text:
「自然の底力を目の当たりにしたとき......自分がその力に抗えると思わぬことだ。」
――「嵐大工の文書」

name: Daze
text:
「相手の失敗の叫びを、己の凱歌とせよ。」
――「妨害の秘本」

name: Deduce
text:
「異常を見落としてはならない。そこに謎を解く鍵があることが多いからだ。」
――アルキスト・プロフトの捜査日誌

name: Disdainful Stroke
text:
「賢い魔道士は知っている。敵に打ち勝つのは力ではなく、創意や知性であることを。」
――「否定の力：対抗魔法の探究」

name: Flusterstorm
text:
「我らは歌う、崩れ落ちゆく夜空と、穹窿を支えし英雄の物語を。」
――「遊牧の賢者の伝説」

name: Force of Will
text:
「愛する人を守るには、大切なものを手放す覚悟を決めねばならぬ。」
――「戦時の唄」

name: Daze
text:
"Let their screams of frustration be your victory song."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

name: Pongify
text:
「我々はここに、原理原則とはなんたるかの模範を目撃する。どんなものだろうと"壊す"ことなどありえない。それは壊滅的なまでに再構成されるだけなのだ。」
――ラクサ教授

name: Preordain
text:
「剥き出しの力は個の戦いに勝つが、戦場を選ぶ者は戦に勝つ。」
――「知識の溜まるところ」碑の序文

name: Sleight of Hand
text:
「敵を困惑させることは、武装解除させることに等しく効果的。」
――「生き残るためのトリックスターの指南書」

name: Spell Pierce
text:
「相手より強くなる必要はない。こちらが手の内を明かす前に、むこうに手を打たせるだけでいい。」
――「否定の力：対抗魔法の探究」

name: Stock Up
text:
「知識は無限だが、人生はそうはいかない。自分の時間 を賢く使うこと。」
———「大図書棟:序文」

name: Ad Nauseam
text:
「一部のエリアは書籍を保存するため立入禁止。それ以外は生徒を保護するため立入禁止。」
――大図書棟の古文書保管人、イサボウ

name: Bitter Triumph
text:
「野心は偉大なる力や深い悲しみをもたらす。しかし、両方がもたらされたときのことを覚悟できている者はいない。」
――「リーダーシップとその帰結」

name: Culling the Weak
text:
「偉大なる力は、その代償を飲み込める者を待っている。」
――「損失の季節」第一章

name: Dismember
text:
「苦痛、苦悩、不浄、恐怖、肉体を剥ぎ捨てよ。それらを明け渡せば、一つとなって祝福を受けるだろう。」
――「ファイレクシアの聖句」

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
「飢餓の潮流に抗うことはできない。ただ逃げ惑い、身を潜め――祈るのみ。」
――ずたずたになった日記の中身

name: Deduce
text:
"Do not overlook the unusual, for therein often lie the keys to the unknown."
—Alquist Proft's case journal

name: Living End
text:
「死とは贈り物。終わりの訪れを知る中に、安らぎがあるの。」
――「屍術に関するヴェスから忠告」

name: Locust Spray
text:
「鎧の質は継ぎ目次第。」
――「虚栄の迷路：騎士の愚行」

name: Smallpox
text:
「ある次元の毒は、別の次元では奇跡の特効薬です。ある次元の命を脅かすほどの伝染病は、別の次元ではありふれた風邪です。次元にまたがった医療機関は、計り知れないほど多くの命を救いうるのです。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

name: Stargaze
text:
「夜についての詩には触れないでおく。たしかに美しい響きよ？ でも、どういうわけかいつも、ほんのちょっとだけお腹がすいてきちゃうのよね。」
――アビゲール

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
「真の不死とは、知識の伝承によってのみ成し得るもの。一つの心を形作れば、何千もの心の中に生きることができる。」
――「血塗られた影響」

name: Zombify
text:
「死者を呼び戻すのは難しいことではありません。ですが、呼びかけに応えたといってもすぐ操れるかというと、それはまた別の話です。」
――ヴェス教授

name: Abrade
text:
「僕たちは発見された遺物から多くの学びを得る。失われた遺物からは、どんな学びを得られただろうね？」
――キーロル

name: Brotherhood's End
text:
「二つの強い意志に、破壊の爪痕が一つ。」
――「アンティキティー戦争」

name: Disdainful Stroke
text:
"The clever mage knows that it does not take strength to overcome the enemy, but creativity and intelligence."
—*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*

name: Bulk Up
text:
「噛みつき砕く我が歯牙よ、引き裂き穿つ我が爪よ、怒りに震える我が心よ、狂気の高みへ連れてゆけ。」
――「カソーラの戦唄」第一巻

name: Burst Lightning
text:
「最後の敵が斃れしとき、嵐が跪かんことを。」
――「オタリア人の喊声」

name: Crackle with Power
text:
「大地そのものを持ち上げ、敵に向かってその怒りを解き放て。」
――「フェラドルンの魔術師の秘密」

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
「ゴブリンと対峙する時は、目に見える数の二倍は地下に潜んでると思え。」
――「地形戦術と環境魔法」

name: Jeska's Will
text:
「死してなお、ジェスカの伝説はメラメラと燃え上がる。」
――クイントリウス・カンド

name: Monstrous Rage
text:
「怒りはどこまでも私たちを歪め、壊してしまう。」
――「復讐心とその発露」

name: Pyretic Ritual
text:
「一人だけでは、ただの熱と空気と小さな火。力を合わせれば、燃え広がり続ける炎。」
――「炎の姉妹」

name: Subterranean Tremors
text:
「あるところに、タイタンをも震え上がらせる獣がいた。ここでは伏せておくことにしよう。その名を口にすることは、それを呼び寄せることになるのだから。」
――「破滅の歴史」

name: Awaken the Woods
text:
「ファイレクシアの脅威に対抗し、私たちは森を目覚めさせた。そして森は再び眠りにつくことを拒んだのだ。」
――ウィロウダスク

name: Flusterstorm
text:
"We sing of the night the sky fell and the hero who held the vault of heaven aloft."
—*Legend of the Nomad Sage*

name: Crop Rotation
text:
「人生とは手間がかかるものですが、大切に手入れすれば何倍にもなって返ってくるでしょう。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

name: Giant Growth
text:
「呪文の出力で計算間違いをしたら、緊急用の呪文捕獲ネットをお使いください。」
――クアンドリクスの呪文研究室内の掲示

name: Glimpse of Nature
text:
「団栗の中に樫の木を見出し、幼獣の中に群れの王を見出すこと。生きとし生けるものの中に、大小や目の前の姿に惑わされず、何になり得るかを見出すこと。」
――「無限の自然」第一巻

name: Knockout Maneuver
text:
「獅子と一角獣、どちらが勝つと思う？」
――サナールからキーロルへ

name: Shamanic Revelation
text:
「彼女が操る獣たちは、死の静寂を予告するような轟音をあげた。」
――「多元宇宙の形而上史学」

name: Shared Roots
text:
「二人の愛の強さに心打たれた暁の王子は、二人を永遠に結び合わせ、その周りに大きな森が生まれた。」
――「フェイの物語」

name: Triumph of the Hordes
text:
「避けられる死もあれば、免れようのない死もある。」
――「戦呪文概要」

name: Force of Will
text:
"We must be prepared to part with things we hold dear to protect those we love."
—*A Song of Wartime*

name: Culling Ritual
text:
「私たちは皆、なにかしらの形で作り直されているが、そのことに誰も口出しできないのです。」
――霊園の庭師、イェドラ

name: Deflecting Palm
text:
「歴史の学徒は誰しもが過去から学ぶ力を持つ。偉大な者たちはそれを自らの利益のために用いる。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

name: Expressive Iteration
text:
「あなたが作り出すものは数多くの選択肢から生じた結果なのだ。自分の心に従え。そうすれば誤りを選びようがなくなる。」
――プリズマリの学部長、ナサーリ

name: Fracture
text:
「敵の力を元から断つこと。そうすれば、相手の戦意を削ぐことになるでしょう。」
――シルバークイルの学部長、エムブローズ

name: Pongify
text:
"We see here a perfect example of a fundamental principle. Nothing can be 'destroyed.' It is merely catastrophically reorganized."
—Professor Ruxа

name: Preordain
text:
"Raw power wins battles, but those who choose the shape of the battlefield win the war."
—*The Pool of Knowledge*, opening inscription

name: Sleight of Hand
text:
"Confounding an enemy can be as effective as disarming them."
—*The Trickster's Guide to Staying Alive*

name: Spell Pierce
text:
"One does not need to be stronger than their opponent. You need only force them to play their hand before you've shown your own."
—*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*

name: Stock Up
text:
"Knowledge is infinite, but life is not. Use your time wisely."
—*The Biblioplex: An Introduction*

name: Ad Nauseam
text:
"Some areas are off limits for the preservation of the books. Others for the preservation of the students."
—Isabough, Biblioplex archivist

name: Bitter Triumph
text:
"Ambition can bring you great power or great sorrow, but few prepare for when it brings you both."
—*Leadership and Its Consequences*

name: Culling the Weak
text:
"Great power awaits those who can stomach its cost."
—*The Season of Loss,* chapter one

name: Dismember
text:
"Strip away pain, struggle, impurity, fear, flesh. Surrender the pieces and be blessed as one."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"You cannot fight the Hunger Tide. You can only run, hide—and pray."
—Entry in a tattered journal

name: Armageddon
text:
"Like my creator, I sought perfection. And just as he did, I found only sorrow."
—*End of Argentum: The Memoirs of Karn, Scion of Urza*

name: Living End
text:
"Mortality is a gift. There is a comfort in knowing that the end is coming."
—*Vess's Cautions in Necromancy*

name: Locust Spray
text:
"A suit of armor is only as good as its seams."
—*Vanity Lost: A Knight's Folly*

name: Smallpox
text:
"One plane's poison is another's miracle cure. One plane's deadly plague is another's common cold. An interplanar medical body could save an unfathomable number of lives."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

name: Stargaze
text:
"I stay away from poems about the night. It's beautiful, yes, but somehow it always feels just a little bit hungry."
—Abigale

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
"The only true immortality comes in the passage of knowledge. Mold one mind and you can live in thousands more."
—*The Sanguine Influence*

name: Zombify
text:
"Calling the dead isn't difficult. Commanding them once they answer, however, is a different story."
—Professor Vess

name: Abrade
text:
"We learn so much from the relics we find. What might we have learned from the relics we lost?"
—Kirol

name: Brotherhood's End
text:
"Two strong wills, one wake of destruction."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Bulk Up
text:
"My teeth to bite and break, my claws to rip and rend, my heart with fury quakes, to madness I ascend."
—*Kathorran War Chants, vol. 1*

name: Burst Lightning
text:
"May the storm yield only when your last enemy has fallen."
—*Otarian Battle Cries*

name: Crackle with Power
text:
"Lift up the very land and unleash its fury upon your enemies."
—*Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers*

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
"When engaging goblins in combat, assume that the number underground is at least double that of those you can see."
—*Terrain Tactics and Environmental Magics*

name: Jeska's Will
text:
"Even in death, her legend burns bright."
—Quintorius Kand

name: Monstrous Rage
text:
"There is no limit to the ways that anger can twist and break us."
—*Revenge and Its Manifestations*

name: Pyretic Ritual
text:
"Alone, we are but the heat, the air, and the kindling. Together, we are the ever-spreading flame."
—*The Sisters of Flame*

name: Subterranean Tremors
text:
"There is one beast that makes even titans quail and quake in fear. We shall not name it here, for to name it is to call it."
—*A History of Ruinations*

name: Awaken the Woods
text:
"We woke the forest against the Phyrexian threat, and it's refused to go back to sleep."
—Willowdusk

name: Helping Hand
text:
"Kindness is a war of its own, and one that must never be lost."
—*The War-Healer's Treatise*

name: Crop Rotation
text:
"Life comes at a cost, but steward it well and you will be repaid manyfold."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

name: Giant Growth
text:
"If you make a mistake when calculating your spell's output, please use the emergency spelltrap nets."
—Posting inside Quandrix spell labs

name: Glimpse of Nature
text:
"In the acorn, find the oak; in the cub, find the pride-king. In all living things, great or small, find not what they are, but what they can become."
—*The Nature of Infinity, vol. 1*

name: Knockout Maneuver
text:
"Who do you think would win in a fight: a lion or a unicorn?"
—Sanar, to Kirol

name: Shamanic Revelation
text:
"The beasts she commanded let loose a deafening roar that presaged the silence of death."
—*Multiversal Metahistories*

name: Shared Roots
text:
"Awed by the strength of their love, the Dawn Prince bound them together for eternity, and around them a great forest grew."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Triumph of the Hordes
text:
"Some deaths you can evade. Others are inevitable."
—*Compendium of Warspells*

name: Hop to It
text:
A root is best pulled by many paws.
—Rabbitfolk proverb

name: Culling Ritual
text:
"We are all repurposed in one way or another, and none of us have much say in the matter."
—Yedora, grave gardener

name: Deflecting Palm
text:
"Any student of history has the power to learn from the past. The great ones use it to their advantage."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean

name: Expressive Iteration
text:
"Every piece you create is the result of a thousand choices. Follow your heart, and you cannot choose wrong."
—Nassari, Prismari dean

name: Fracture
text:
"Destroy what makes your enemy powerful, and you will shatter their will."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Armageddon
text:
「私を創造した者と同じように、私は完璧を追い求めた。そして彼と全く同じように、私は悲しみを覚えるだけだった。」
――「アージェンタムの終焉：ウルザの後継、カーンの回顧録」

name: Prismatic Ending
text:
"Some claim the archaics can die only after Arcavios's demise. Others claim their deaths herald the plane's doom. The truth? Only time will tell."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Helping Hand
text:

――「戦癒しの論文」

name: Repel Calamity
text:

Against the dread Wildsear,
With bright sword in paw,
Repel your own fear."
—*Song of the Seasons,* stanza 24

text:

name: Reprieve
text:
"It is our responsibility, as citizens of this world, to reach out with compassion to those who are suffering."
—Margeau, Silverquill dean

name: Ad Nauseam
text:
「一部のエリアは書籍を保存するため立入禁止。それ以外は生徒を保護するため立入禁止。」
――大図書棟の古文書保管人、イサボウ

name: Bitter Triumph
text:
「野心は偉大なる力や深い悲しみをもたらす。しかし、両方がもたらされたときのことを覚悟できている者はいない。」
――「リーダーシップとその帰結」

name: Culling the Weak
text:
「偉大なる力は、その代償を飲み込める者を待っている。」
――「損失の季節」第一章

name: Dismember
text:
「苦痛、苦悩、不浄、恐怖、肉体を剥ぎ捨てよ。それらを明け渡せば、一つとなって祝福を受けるだろう。」
――「ファイレクシアの聖句」

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
「飢餓の潮流に抗うことはできない。ただ逃げ惑い、身を潜め――祈るのみ。」
――ずたずたになった日記の中身

name: Living End
text:
「死とは贈り物。終わりの訪れを知る中に、安らぎがあるの。」
――「屍術に関するヴェスから忠告」

name: Locust Spray
text:
「鎧の質は継ぎ目次第。」
――「虚栄の迷路：騎士の愚行」

name: Smallpox
text:
「ある次元の毒は、別の次元では奇跡の特効薬です。ある次元の命を脅かすほどの伝染病は、別の次元ではありふれた風邪です。次元にまたがった医療機関は、計り知れないほど多くの命を救いうるのです。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

name: Stargaze
text:
「夜についての詩には触れないでおく。たしかに美しい響きよ？ でも、どういうわけかいつも、ほんのちょっとだけお腹がすいてきちゃうのよね。」
――アビゲール

name: Zimone, Infinite Analyst
text: "The best answers leave you with more questions."

name: Coastal Peak
text: Hidden across Arcavios are great sculptures chiseled by the claws of Galazeth Prismari himself.

name: Eclipsed Steppe
text: The Arch Obscura never appears for the same eyes twice. Those who bear witness either find peace in their own insignificance or dread in the unnatural twilight.

name: Scorched Geyser
text: The mana currents around Spectacle Summit are so thoroughly infused with Prismari patterns that a simple drumbeat is enough to make them whirl in response.

name: Turbulent Fen
text:
"Life is beauty and cruelty. Pain and joy. It is the promise of certain death at the end of a glorious journey."
—Beledros Witherbloom

name: Turbulent Moor
text:
"Where others see melancholy, I see promise. All our kindness and cruelty make such haunting poetry."
—Shadrix Silverquill

name: Turbulent Springs
text:
"The Multiverse itself is a never-ending act of creation. Do not look inward so often that you forget how to see it."
—Galazeth Prismari

name: Turbulent Steppe
text:
"Respect for the past is respect for oneself. It's an admission that we too shall pass into history."
—Velomachus Lorehold

name: Turbulent Wilderness
text:
"Existence is more perfect, more informative and unknowable, than the cleverest theorem ever devised."
—Tanazir Quandrix

name: Umbral Expanse
text: A neglected corner of the Adumbral Gardens, used by pages and diplomats seeking solitude for reflection and intrigue.

name: Augusta, Order Returned
text: "I won't leave my students without a guide."

name: Moonshaker Cavalry
text: "Conflict guided our lives and placed blades in our hands. Even after death, we know nothing else."

name: Wave of Reckoning
text: The Dragonsguard ensures peace across Arcavios. Where peace is not possible, they ensure justice.

name: Commander's Insight
text: "There's so much to learn. Sometimes I wish there were more of me."

name: Faerie Mastermind
text: Omenpaths bring new students and new tactics to the field.

name: Pull from Tomorrow
text: "Anyone who says a textbook can't end on a cliffhanger has never read volume one of *Finite Lattice Representation*!"

name: Fallen Ideal
text: "Victory is nonnegotiable."

name: Ophiomancer
text: "Keep them in terrariums? No way! Snakes are meant to roam free, my friend."

name: Screams from Within
text:
"Behind every poised smile lies a seed of insecurity. Identify it, and you can exploit it."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

name: Ceaseless Conflict
text:
"War begets war. We may hope for peace, but it is only ever a brief interlude between bloody ages."
—Plargg, dean of chaos

name: Toxic Deluge
text:
"You must decide what you're willing to give to your spell craft: mana, pest essence, even your own life force. Everything is fair game for a resourceful mage."
—Willowdusk

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"STAY ON THE STAGE!"
—Notices posted during Summitfest

name: Determined Iteration
text: "Have I finally done it? Have I finally freed myself from failure?"

name: Harmonic Prodigy
text: "Why would I deprive the crowd of an encore?"

name: Arcane Signet
text: Each Strixhaven graduate receives a class ring bearing the university's motto: "Through study, know the world; through magic, know yourself."

name: Sol Ring
text:
"What drives the star arches to appear, and what causes them to sometimes disappear? I doubt even the Dawning Archaic knows."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Command Tower
text: Knowledge is wasted if not shared.

name: Fabled Passage
text: The first sight most students see are the Torches of Enlightenment, welcoming them to the beginning of their great adventure.

name: Eldrazi Conscription
text: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Forum Filibuster
text:
"If they will not listen to reason, drown them in nonsense."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Drumbellower
text: By the second night after the kami had drifted into town, the local general store was completely sold out of earplugs.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Kami of Ancient Law
text:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Monologue Tax
text:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

name: Promise of Loyalty
text: "It's us against the world. Forever."

name: Redemption Arc
text: Crime doesn't pay nearly as well as the Agency.

name: Remorseful Cleric
text: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Spirit Mantle
text: The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
text: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

name: Tocasia's Welcome
text: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

name: Tragic Arrogance
text: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

name: Transcendent Envoy
text:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: White Orchid Phantom
text: His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en-*Vec

name: Aether Gale
text: The militia formed up in the central plaza awaiting the onslaught, but the giants never quite made it.

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Expansion Algorithm
text:
"When you find an equation that works, all that's left is finding its many applications."
—Zimone

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Entrancing Melody
text: The stronger the will, the more bewitching the song.

name: Perplexing Test
text: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

name: Resculpt
text: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.

name: Stroke of Genius
text: "Every thought is a star illuminating the darkness. Inspiration comes from finding the constellations that link them."

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Zimone's Hypothesis
text: "There exists a theoretical infinity between the discrete atoms of reality. I'm simply appropriating that infinity as storage space."

name: Blight Mound
text: Pests feed on carrion, mud, and one another.

name: Blood Artist
text:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

name: Doomwake Giant
text: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

name: Hateful Eidolon
text: From the echoes of a violent life, a terrible foe is born.

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
text: "Rise, my pretty thing. Why rot in the river when you can serve at my bidding?"

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Owlin Spiralmancer
text: "I come up here to practice. You can see the entire Garden twisting reality. It's inspiring."

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Plumb the Forbidden
text: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
text: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

name: Umbral Collar Zealot
text: "All things will fall to the Zero Point. By accepting this truth, my path is known and my fate is certain."

name: Veinwitch Coven
text: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Witch of the Moors
text: Many hands for many evils.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Blasphemous Act
text: In the early days of Valley, desperate animalfolk harnessed the power of Calamity Beasts in ways that destroyed more than defended.

name: Dance with Calamity
text: It was just another day on Innistrad.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Redoubled Stormsinger
text: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Volcanic Salvo
text: Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.

name: Awakening Zone
text: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Blossoming Bogbeast
text:
As subtle as a bogbeast
—Witherbloom expression meaning "crude and clumsy"

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Forgotten Ancient
text: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

name: Merchant of Venom
text: Ulna Alley is a maze of market stalls where anything can be purchased for the right price.

name: Goldvein Hydra
text: The key is to slay it before it sprouts so many heads that your fear outpaces your greed.

name: Guardian Augmenter
text: After years of research, he finally unlocked the formula for the perfect punch.

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
text: Nashi knelt reverently before the kami and envisioned his family reunited.

name: Lifeblood Hydra
text: Pharika has written her secrets on its bones so that only the worthy may discover them.

name: Nature's Lore
text: From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.

name: Ohran Frostfang
text: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

name: Ominous Harvest
text: The hunters came for the mushrooms. The trudges came for the mushroom hunters.

name: Pest Infestation
text: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

name: Primal Might
text: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "Regrowth is as inevitable as the tragedy that necessitates it."

name: Steelbane Hydra
text: Many an ancient treasure has been reduced to jagged caltrops by its snapping jaws.

name: Three Visits
text: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

name: Trudge Garden
text:
"Sure, trudges smell like soggy death, but the mushrooms on their backs are the tastiest delicacy in Sedgemoor!"
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

name: Tyvar's Stand
text: "When they write songs about this battle, I will make sure your name is forgotten, devil."

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

name: Assassin's Trophy
text:
"Not just any floriculturist can grow this caliber of nightbloom. We're looking for a rooftop hothouse with quite particular conditions."
—Dr. A of the Foundway Associates

name: Biomass Mutation
text:
"A regression to ancient forms? A glimpse of future evolutions? Or a fleeting alteration of the present?"
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Great power requires great sacrifice. But it need not be my own."

name: Deadly Brew
text: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

name: Decisive Denial
text: "I've heard enough."

name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
text: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

name: Eureka Moment
text: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Fracture
text:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

name: Hydroid Krasis
text: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

name: Inkshield
text: Silverquill's elite know how to offer a scathing rebuttal without uttering a word.

name: Killian, Ink Duelist
text: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."

name: Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
text: The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

name: Furygale Flocking
text: Seek inspiration at your own risk.

name: Moldervine Reclamation
text:
"The heroes of the past nourish our spirits by their example—and nourish our crops by their decay."
—Jeddeg, philosopher of graves

name: Mortality Spear
text: "Death is my life's work."

name: Oversimplify
text:
"A fine example of addition by subtraction."
—Deekah, professor of fractal theory

name: Quandrix Apprentice
text: "The secrets of our world will be mine."

name: Quintorius, Field Historian
text: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."

name: Rip Apart
text: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

name: Rootha, Mercurial Artist
text: "Art is never finished. Merely abandoned."

name: Stormcatch Mentor
text: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

name: Troyan, Gutsy Explorer
text: "The streets of Ravnica were stifling. Eldraine is an endless adventure paved in gold."

name: Vanishing Verse
text: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"

name: Wight of the Reliquary
text: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

name: Prismari Pianist
text: He'd practiced his scales specifically for this moment.

name: Zimone, Quandrix Prodigy
text: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."

name: Containment Construct
text: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Haywire Mite
text:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

name: Relic Retriever
text: Students working in the field for the first time learn the benefits of small, agile spirit statues over large, strong ones.

name: Lightning Greaves
text: When you spend most of your time running for your life, it pays to invest in quality footwear.

name: Millikin
text: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

name: Patchwork Banner
text: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.

name: Perpetual Timepiece
text: Do not be so caught up in keeping track of time that you forget to make use of it.

name: Stonecoil Serpent
text: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Alchemist's Refuge
text: Persecuted alchemists fled deep into Kessig's wilds, seeking solitude to continue their ghoulish craft.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Desolate Mire
text: Silence, the poetry of a whispering wind, the centurial fall of tar on pale sand.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"When you can't find your way home, find home where you can."
—Rho, veteran hero

name: Spirit of Resilience
text:
"We've all been broken and had to put ourselves back together with the pieces that were left."
—Kequia Akosa

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Stability and volatility churn together, creating beauty and danger both.

name: Festering Thicket
text: Evendo's microbial life swiftly adapted to metabolize the leaking star fuel, devouring it like any other nourishment.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Glittering Massif
text: Iridescent debris and chromatic chemical fires litter Kavaron with the beauty of destruction.

name: Grim Backwoods
text:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

name: Haunted Mire
text: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

name: Feral Appetite
text: Once they were given a taste of bone they wouldn't touch anything else.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Lorehold Campus
text: Mage-students obsessed with the secrets of the past choose Lorehold, the college of archaeomancy.

name: Molten Tributary
text: Though dangerous, Shiv teems with both life and mana, making it a tempting destination for ambitious mages.

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Overflowing Basin
text: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

name: Prismari Campus
text: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.

name: Quandrix Campus
text: Mage-students who see the beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.

name: Radiant Summit
text:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Rain-Slicked Copse
text: A forest that never thirsts always flourishes.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Sacred Peaks
text: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Silverquill Campus
text: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

name: Sodden Verdure
text: Lorwyn contains many such places: not bustling, not frenetic, but teeming with life in their own, quiet way.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sunlit Marsh
text: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

name: Nev, the Practical Dean
text: "Adrix and I have always debated for the betterment of our students. That won't change now we're both deans."

name: Sunscorched Divide
text: Majesty rising above the arid sweep of land, a bulwark horizon against the mundane, a divide cleaving inspiration from stagnation.

name: Tangled Islet
text: Many of Terisiare's islands are merely extensions of the root system of the Yavimaya magnigoth forests.

name: Temple of the False God
text: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Vernal Fen
text:
"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

name: Pest Rescuer
text: "The bites and scratches are worth it."

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Viridescent Bog
text: Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.

name: War Room
text: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

name: Witherbloom Campus
text: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Immoral Bargain
text: To control a spell, you must first strip it of its flesh and bones.

name: Brass Infiniscope
text: Styluses are tools used by students to channel their magic. For young Quandrix mages, they can help navigate difficult calculations and focus perspective.

name: Coastal Peak
text: Hidden across Arcavios are great sculptures chiseled by the claws of Galazeth Prismari himself.

name: Eclipsed Steppe
text: The Arch Obscura never appears for the same eyes twice. Those who bear witness either find peace in their own insignificance or dread in the unnatural twilight.

name: Scorched Geyser
text: The mana currents around Spectacle Summit are so thoroughly infused with Prismari patterns that a simple drumbeat is enough to make them whirl in response.

name: Turbulent Fen
text:
"Life is beauty and cruelty. Pain and joy. It is the promise of certain death at the end of a glorious journey."
—Beledros Witherbloom

name: Turbulent Moor
text:
"Where others see melancholy, I see promise. All our kindness and cruelty make such haunting poetry."
—Shadrix Silverquill

name: Turbulent Springs
text:
"The Multiverse itself is a never-ending act of creation. Do not look inward so often that you forget how to see it."
—Galazeth Prismari

name: Turbulent Steppe
text:
"Respect for the past is respect for oneself. It's an admission that we too shall pass into history."
—Velomachus Lorehold

name: Turbulent Wilderness
text:
"Existence is more perfect, more informative and unknowable, than the cleverest theorem ever devised."
—Tanazir Quandrix

name: Umbral Expanse
text: A neglected corner of the Adumbral Gardens, used by pages and diplomats seeking solitude for reflection and intrigue.

name: Augusta, Order Returned
text: "I won't leave my students without a guide."

name: Ceaseless Conflict
text:
"War begets war. We may hope for peace, but it is only ever a brief interlude between bloody ages."
—Plargg, dean of chaos

name: Forum Filibuster
text:
"If they will not listen to reason, drown them in nonsense."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

name: Expansion Algorithm
text:
"When you find an equation that works, all that's left is finding its many applications."
—Zimone

name: Owlin Spiralmancer
text: "I come up here to practice. You can see the entire Garden twisting reality. It's inspiring."

name: Merchant of Venom
text: Ulna Alley is a maze of market stalls where anything can be purchased for the right price.

name: Ominous Harvest
text: The hunters came for the mushrooms. The trudges came for the mushroom hunters.

name: Rootha, Mastering the Moment
text: "The great thrill of perfection is that we'll always be chasing it."

name: Furygale Flocking
text: Seek inspiration at your own risk.

name: Prismari Pianist
text: He'd practiced his scales specifically for this moment.

name: Relic Retriever
text: Students working in the field for the first time learn the benefits of small, agile spirit statues over large, strong ones.

name: Spirit of Resilience
text:
"We've all been broken and had to put ourselves back together with the pieces that were left."
—Kequia Akosa

name: Feral Appetite
text: Once they were given a taste of bone they wouldn't touch anything else.

name: Nev, the Practical Dean
text: "Adrix and I have always debated for the betterment of our students. That won't change now we're both deans."

name: Pest Rescuer
text: "The bites and scratches are worth it."

name: Immoral Bargain
text: To control a spell, you must first strip it of its flesh and bones.

name: Brass Infiniscope
text: Styluses are tools used by students to channel their magic. For young Quandrix mages, they can help navigate difficult calculations and focus perspective.

name: Always Watching
text:
"We pray to Avacyn on high. On snow-white wings fearless you fly. Keep safe our souls. Keep safe our lives. May angels watch us from the skies."
—Children's prayer

name: Chaplain's Blessing
text: "There was a time when the purpose of the church was to heal and protect. I would see that time return."

name: Behind the Scenes
text: It does no good to bar the gate when the enemy is already inside.

name: Behold the Beyond
text: There is power in the abyss, in blackness more profound than the darkest dreams.

name: Biting Rain
text: On Innistrad, it is seldom wrong to stay indoors.

name: Call the Bloodline
text: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

name: Dead Weight
text:
"Dungeons and cages offer far too little sport."
—Relio Voldaren

name: Elusive Tormentor
text: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

name: Dauntless Cathar
text: "The harder they try to extinguish my faith, the brighter it burns in the darkness."

name: Farbog Revenant
text: Spiteful geists rise from the muck of the Farbogs, eager to lure travelers to their doom.

name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
text: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

name: Ghoulsteed
text: It once served a cathar roadwatcher, patrolling the crossways between villages. Its hooves still carry it along the same path.

name: Gisa's Bidding
text: "Soft dirt makes for light work."

name: Heir of Falkenrath
text: Among vampires, there has long been the belief that the urge to feed must be balanced by the poise of nobility.

name: Hound of the Farbogs
text: As you hear it baying in the distance, you'll feel its breath on your neck.

name: Indulgent Aristocrat
text: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

name: Kindly Stranger
text: "I'm not afraid out here, for I know that a higher power protects me."

name: Declaration in Stone
text: The message was clear to Sorin—Nahiri had paid Markov Manor a visit.

name: Liliana's Indignation
text: "Days ago, you came to my door asking for help, Jace. Yet now here you are with accusations?"

name: Macabre Waltz
text: Liliana is never one to follow someone else's lead.

name: Markov Dreadknight
text: The destruction of Markov Manor made the surviving members of the bloodline more dangerous.

name: Merciless Resolve
text: "You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded."

name: Morkrut Necropod
text:
"There's not enough salt in all of Nephalia to wither that thing."
—Ghoulcaller Enslow

name: Murderous Compulsion
text: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

name: Olivia's Bloodsworn
text: "As we muster for war, I have little patience for lethargy or recalcitrance."

name: Pale Rider of Trostad
text:
"What's worse than being alone on the moors at night? Try *not* being alone."
—Nadila Maas, moor chaplain

name: Descend upon the Sinful
text: Above the cries, a phrase rang out: "You will all be saved."

name: Rancid Rats
text: "They're in the walls! Can't you hear them?"

name: Rottenheart Ghoul
text:
"To die failing to save a loved one is just so sad—or, more to the point, pathetic."
—Liliana Vess

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Shamble Back
text: Lost loved ones are never truly gone.

name: Sinister Concoction
text: An old family recipe for an old family grudge.

name: Stallion of Ashmouth
text: Echoing hoofbeats can no longer be assumed to be help from the Gavony Riders.

name: Stromkirk Mentor
text: The lineage of Runo Stromkirk is known for producing some of Nephalia's greatest fencing masters.

name: Throttle
text:
"Victim discovered at dawn with mouth agape and eyes bulging. No evidence of blood loss or dismemberment. Severe bruising around the neck."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

name: To the Slaughter
text:
"Where has little Gossamer gone?"
—Thaniel, Gatstaf shepherd

name: Devilthorn Fox
text: On expeditions through Ashmouth, the hunters of Devilthorn Lodge rely on the cleverness of foxes to counteract the mischief of devils.

name: Twins of Maurer Estate
text:
"Children, where are your parents?"
—Reig, wandering monk, last words

name: Vampire Noble
text:
"No emergency is so dire that it cannot be dealt with elegantly."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Vessel of Malignity
text: From within its prison, the book endlessly whispers words of cruelty and spite.

name: Breakneck Rider
text: Only the most skillful riders brave the Breakneck Ride through Kessig.

name: Convicted Killer
text: None are more dangerous than those who have already been sentenced to death.

name: Dance with Devils
text: Devils sow chaos and reap panic.

name: Devils' Playground
text:
"The city is overrun. I would say burn it to the ground, but that won't be necessary."
—Inquisitor Delmund

name: Dissension in the Ranks
text:
"It came on as quickly as taking in a breath of air. Cathars who had fought shoulder to shoulder were at each other's throats. They were not themselves."
—Halmig, Order of Saint Traft

name: Dual Shot
text: There is an eagerness among the Quiver of Kessig to prove they are the equal of the other cathar orders.

name: Ember-Eye Wolf
text: No howl. No snarl. Just the roar of flames.

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Flameblade Angel
text: "You must pay for your sin in blood."

name: Gatstaf Arsonists
text: The glow in their eyes reveals more than anger or madness.

name: Geier Reach Bandit
text: The cathars realized they had not tracked her—she had led them here.

name: Eerie Interlude
text: The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.

name: Harness the Storm
text:
"There is no place like a rooftop laboratory in a lightning storm. It's where genius strikes."
—Renna, Selhoff alchemist

name: Howlpack Wolf
text: Wolves and werewolves join together for the common cause of the hunt.

name: Hulking Devil
text: Fear the patient devil, the one who is calm in the midst of chaos. Beware the silent devil, the one whose cackle does not mingle with the others.

name: Incorrigible Youths
text:
"Ah, to be young again."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Inner Struggle
text:
"Reflect upon your evils lest they reflect upon you."
—Inquisitor Laerin

name: Insolent Neonate
text: "Manners are for mortals."

name: Lightning Axe
text: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

name: Mad Prophet
text: "I have seen it. Seen the end, seen the beginning, the beginning of the end. Not death, no, no. Transcendence!"

name: Magmatic Chasm
text: The Needle's Eye, a seldom-used passage that winds through Stensia's mountains, carries travelers close to Ashmouth—too close, some would argue.

name: Pyre Hound
text: Its growl is the crackling and popping of a wildfire untamed.

name: Ravenous Bloodseeker
text:
"Nothing will cool the fire in their blood. They are too far gone. We must keep them away from our towns at any cost."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Reduce to Ashes
text: Previously the training center for cathars, the Elgaud Grounds are now used by the Lunarch Inquisition to punish those considered to be heretics.

name: Rush of Adrenaline
text: Scarecrows only go so far in sending the message to stay away.

name: Sanguinary Mage
text: New cults rising in Nephalia have found allies in the Stromkirk bloodline, whose progenitor worships ancient and terrible forces.

name: Ethereal Guidance
text:
"The call of the Blessed Sleep is not so strong as the call to protect those in need."
—Saint Traft

name: Spiteful Motives
text: Having infiltrated the Lunarch Council, the Skirsdag await the perfect moment to strike.

name: Structural Distortion
text:
"As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin."
—Nahiri

name: Tormenting Voice
text:
"The voice has grown louder, its accusations angrier and more insistent. By morning, it will likely drown out all else. I fear what I will do."
—Letter discovered in an abandoned estate

name: Ulrich's Kindred
text:
"I am not its master. We are of the same pack."
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha

name: Uncaged Fury
text:
"It's right to fear those that you keep locked away."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Vessel of Volatility
text:
"To be honest, I'm not quite sure what's going to happen."
—Renna, Selhoff alchemist

name: Expose Evil
text:
"Only the pure stand tall in the light."
—Sigarda

name: Village Messenger
text: "I'm afraid it's bad news."

name: Voldaren Duelist
text: "I have yet to find my equal."

name: Wolf of Devil's Breach
text:
"How can werewolves be considered abominations next to such creatures?"
—Arlinn Kord

name: Aim High
text:
"A slayer gets by on wits and reflexes."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Byway Courier
text: A good courier travels fast and asks no questions.

name: Clip Wings
text: It is a grim duty to save the world from those created to protect it.

name: Confront the Unknown
text:
"Never flinch from the truth."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Cryptolith Rite
text: The chant was incomprehensible, but its power was unmistakable.

name: Cult of the Waxing Moon
text: In times of madness, people cling to the familiar, monstrous though it may be.

name: Deathcap Cultivator
text: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.

name: Equestrian Skill
text: From the jagged peaks of Stensia, to the tangled woods of Kessig, to the bogs of Nephalia, the Gavony Riders prepare for all terrain.

name: Fork in the Road
text:
"This is as far as I go."
—Beckram, Skiltfolk escort

name: Gloomwidow
text:
"An unexpected ally."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

name: Graf Mole
text:
"Their keen sense of smell draws them to the unnatural. To find one is a boon."
—Veka, hinterland inspector

name: Groundskeeper
text: "While the church thinks in terms of legacies, others think in terms of eternities."

name: Hermit of the Natterknolls
text: He hates company . . .

name: Hanweir Militia Captain
text: Her reputation inspires both loyalty and adoration.

name: Hinterland Logger
text:
"There's a forester lives up in the highlands. Tried to sell her one of my finest axes at a bargain, but she wasn't interested."
—Old Rutstein

name: Howlpack Resurgence
text: The renewed howling of werewolves announced the end of the Cursemute—and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.

name: Intrepid Provisioner
text: "How do I know where aid is needed? Look around you."

name: Kessig Dire Swine
text: In the quiet of the Somberwald, new horrors stir.

name: Loam Dryad
text:
"I've never known dryads to suffer visitors in their woods. Beware the Ulvenwald when she welcomes you."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Moldgraf Scavenger
text:
"When I was a child, we worried about picking the wrong mushrooms for the cook pot. Now we must worry about being picked ourselves."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Moonlight Hunt
text: Courage alone won't keep you alive.

name: Hope Against Hope
text: "I have given my life to the church, my soul to Avacyn, and my heart to the people."

name: Quilled Wolf
text:
"I know a ranger that thought to make a cloak of its hide. He ended up losing an eye for his trouble."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

name: Rabid Bite
text:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Seasons Past
text: The seeds of new life take root in the soil of old.

name: Second Harvest
text:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

name: Silverfur Partisan
text: Silverfurs are the last remaining wolfir.

name: Solitary Hunter
text: "Making a living in Kessig is hard, but I've learned some tricks of the trade."

name: Humble the Brute
text: "The element of surprise only works when it's backed up by a bolt between the eyes."

name: Soul Swallower
text: Being engulfed is just the beginning of the nightmare.

name: Stoic Builder
text: Some have returned to Hollowhenge, the ruins of Avabruck, to restore the lost capital of Kessig.

name: Thornhide Wolves
text:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

name: Veteran Cathar
text: "Prayers can be powerful, but I prefer to put faith in my own two hands."

name: Watcher in the Web
text: "Lost in the woods" is an optimistic way to describe a villager's disappearance. "Found in the woods" is frequently more appropriate.

name: Inquisitor's Ox
text: Many fields now lie fallow in Gavony, as the oxen have been confiscated to perform other duties.

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

name: Fevered Visions
text: The mind can only expand so far before it flies apart.

name: Prized Amalgam
text:
"Ludevic's laboratory is a veritable wonderland. I have never felt so inspired."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Inspiring Captain
text: "Our enemies will soon discover that we are not as meek as they had believed."

name: Corrupted Grafstone
text: It is all too easy to disturb the Blessed Sleep.

name: Epitaph Golem
text: Many names and many memories bound together in grim purpose.

name: Explosive Apparatus
text:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

name: Harvest Hand
text: The harvest is never finished.

name: Haunted Cloak
text: Bear the weight of so many spirits and you'll surrender civility and restraint to savagery and instinct.

name: Magnifying Glass
text: Knight-Inquisitors of Saint Raban delve deep into mysteries best left unexplored.

name: Murderer's Axe
text: Though the first who raised it in a fit of passion is long dead, the axe still carries memories of bitter scorn.

name: Militant Inquisitor
text: "I am an instrument of the church wielded against Avacyn's enemies."

name: Neglected Heirloom
text:
"There is a rich history in a blade like this."
—Old Rutstein

name: Runaway Carriage
text:
"They left in one piece. I can't speak to how they arrived."
—Rupirk, porter at the Rusted Anchor Inn

name: Tamiyo's Journal
text: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

name: Thraben Gargoyle
text: Runechanters engrave their strongest wards on those that protect the church.

name: Wicker Witch
text: When there were no more crows to scare, it focused its efforts elsewhere.

name: Moorland Drifter
text: It has no apparent purpose or direction. It simply drifts, buoyed by breezes both tangible and otherworldly.

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Foreboding Ruins
text: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

name: Forsaken Sanctuary
text:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

name: Foul Orchard
text:
"Such a beautiful place for a stroll."
—Liliana Vess

name: Highland Lake
text: With the fate of Innistrad uncertain, some seek solace in remote areas.

name: Port Town
text: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

name: Stone Quarry
text: In Gavony, headstones come only from quarries that have been blessed by chaplains.

name: Nahiri's Machinations
text: "Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you."

name: Warped Landscape
text: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

name: Woodland Stream
text: Two creaking waterwheels herald the approach to Briarbridge through the Ulvenwald.

name: Angelic Purge
text: "We must save you from yourselves."

name: Not Forgotten
text: Visit the dead, and they may return the favor.

name: Open the Armory
text: "Once Avacyn returned, I hoped I'd never need these things again. I didn't think I'd be dusting them off to use against angels."

name: Paranoid Parish-Blade
text: The mind is perfectly capable of creating its own monsters.

name: Pious Evangel
text: "My faith guides my hand . . ."

name: Puncturing Light
text: "If you refuse to see the light, then you will feel it."

name: Silverstrike
text:
"Shield yourself with faith. Arm yourself with silver."
—Slayer Kastinne

name: Spectral Shepherd
text: The restless geists of common folk often continue their lifelong labors.

name: Stern Constable
text: "I'm sure you have a story. Everyone has a story. You can tell it to the bars."

name: Apothecary Geist
text: For some customers, the old apothecary shop still opens its doors.

name: Strength of Arms
text:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Survive the Night
text: The longest nights are measured not in hours, but in heartbeats.

name: Tenacity
text: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Town Gossipmonger
text: "You'll never believe what I heard."
