name: Unruly Mob
text:
"Those who aren't welcome will know it!"
—Kolman, elder of Gatstaf

name: Vessel of Ephemera
text: Geists seeking redemption must first be given the opportunity.

name: Aberrant Researcher
text:
"Metamorphosis is a process."
—Laboratory notes

name: Broken Concentration
text: Some minds bend under pressure. Others break.

name: Catalog
text:
"The appearance of these warped stones throughout the provinces is too pervasive to be random. More evidence is needed to determine the reason behind them."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Compelling Deterrence
text: "So much for neighborly hospitality!"

name: Confirm Suspicions
text: Everyone has something to hide.

name: Daring Sleuth
text: "No matter the cost, I must discover the source of these strange happenings."

name: Deny Existence
text: When all logical solutions fail, try an illogical one.

name: Drownyard Explorers
text: "Angels and inquisitors terrorize villages, but no one seems to notice the stirring out at sea."

name: Drunau Corpse Trawler
text: Seagrafs yield an abundance of resources for stitchers and ghoulcallers alike.

name: Engulf the Shore
text:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

name: Epiphany at the Drownyard
text:
"Is this what you found, Tamiyo?"
—Jace Beleren

name: Avacynian Missionaries
text: "We come bearing the word of Avacyn and the Lunarch Council."

name: Erdwal Illuminator
text:
"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

name: Essence Flux
text: A spirit is both fettered and free—bound in some ways to its previous existence, yet able to transcend much of the corporeal.

name: Forgotten Creation
text:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Furtive Homunculus
text:
"In terms of intelligence, homunculi are somewhere between humans and skaabs—clever enough to follow more complex orders, but dim enough to not question them."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Gone Missing
text:
"Sometimes it's best for the lost to stay lost."
—Herzag, mayor of Havengul

name: Jace's Scrutiny
text: "Just a collage of images: cryptoliths, the sea, a tangle of shipwrecks."

name: Just the Wind
text: "There's nothing to worry about."

name: Lamplighter of Selhoff
text: For stitchers and necro-alchemists, it's important that work can continue at all hours.

name: Niblis of Dusk
text: It fuels its lanterns by leaching the warmth from its surroundings.

name: Pieces of the Puzzle
text: "The clues have begun to reveal a truth I hesitate to accept."

name: Pore Over the Pages
text: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

name: Reckless Scholar
text: Progress comes at a price.

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Seagraf Skaab
text:
"Your recent work is an inspiration. I have the utmost respect for your approach, and your craft is impeccable. At your convenience, I would be honored to collaborate on a project."
—Ludevic, letter to Geralf

name: Silburlind Snapper
text: Nephalia is home to many hard-shelled creatures of unusual size, the largest of which are either avoided or worshipped.

name: Silent Observer
text: It's not just a feeling—you *are* being watched.

name: Sleep Paralysis
text: Sleep doesn't always mean rest.

name: Cathar's Companion
text:
"Unwavering and loyal, they represent stability in uncertain times."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

name: Stitchwing Skaab
text:
"Amazing, isn't it, how scraps can come together to create such a wonder?"
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Stormrider Spirit
text: Thunder isn't all that follows lightning.

name: Trail of Evidence
text:
"Every answer seems to lead to a more terrifying question."
—Jace Beleren

name: Uninvited Geist
text: A slow knock at midnight is best left unanswered.

name: Vessel of Paramnesia
text:
"Write everything down. Trust me."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

name: Asylum Visitor
text: "The ravings of the mad are laced with eldritch knowledge."

name: Aether Shockwave
text:
"The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War. Strange happenings that neither side could control lashed out across Kamigawa."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

name: Glitterfang
text:
"Through the veil's rip spilled hundreds of minor kami, rushing over the battlefield like embers from a kicked campfire. Then they were gone."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Godo's Irregulars
text: Godo trained their muscles and honed their skills, but he left their hearts wild and empty.

name: Hidetsugu's Second Rite
text: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

name: Inner Fire
text: "Heart of Sokenzan, I call to you! Lend me your fire."

name: Oni of Wild Places
text: The oni leapt easily from peak to peak, toying with its victims, its voice a purr from the rumbling depths of nightmare.

name: Path of Anger's Flame
text:
"Walking the path of the kami only leaves you with singed feet."
—Soratami saying

name: Hail of Arrows
text:
"Do not let a single shaft loose until my word. And when I give that word, do not leave a single shaft in Eiganjo."
—General Takeno

name: Ronin Cavekeeper
text: The akki were surprised to encounter a human who could fight in the caves as well as they.

name: Skyfire Kirin
text: Its fiery visitation burns away the fog of war and dissipates the ties of loyalty.

name: Spiraling Embers
text: The akki knew to stay indoors on the days the oni flew their kites.

name: Sunder from Within
text: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

name: Thoughts of Ruin
text:
"In our war with the kami, we annihilate what is our own. Do they too suffer ruination in their hidden world?"
—Diary of Azusa

name: Hand of Honor
text: "The sword is just a tool. It is the samurai's hand that brings it to life."

name: Ayumi, the Last Visitor
text: Before Shinka's walls were built, before the torii at Okina stood, she was there, tall and proud against the sky, and she will be there long after they have fallen into dust.

name: Bounteous Kirin
text: Even the most benevolent and life-giving of kami joined the war against the mortal world, but only with heavy and sorrowful hearts.

name: Briarknit Kami
text: One thorn to warn, ten thorns to defend, a hundred thorns to destroy.

name: Dense Canopy
text: The orochi learned how to move swiftly and surely along the forest floor, like fish darting through gull-watched waters.

name: Dosan's Oldest Chant
text: As Dosan's chant grew in volume, a second, deeper voice rose up in harmony behind it, strong enough to shake the earth and yet vibrant enough to fill the spirit.

name: Inner-Chamber Guard
text:
"It seems that each time I visit Lord Konda his guards are more on edge, perhaps even more eager for the war to reach them."
—Masako the Humorless

name: Fiddlehead Kami
text:
"Like a riddle, it unwinds. Like a green wind, it reaches out. Like a sudden guilt, it seizes."
—Snow Fur, kitsune poet

name: Inner Calm, Outer Strength
text: The ghostly objects around the kami circled faster and faster, creating a dizzying cyclone of motion. When it opened its eyes, it struck.

name: Masumaro, First to Live
text:
"In the waning moments of war, humanity's most ancient ancestors return. But whose side shall they make their own?"
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

name: Molting Skin
text: "We have learned much from the orochi."

name: Kataki, War's Wage
text:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

name: Okina Nightwatch
text: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
text:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Sakura-Tribe Scout
text:
"Scouts of the Sakura Tribe spent two years wandering the forest to learn every leaf and tree. That knowledge was called upon during the Kami War to ensure the orochi's survival."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Seed the Land
text: With a sadness and a sense of hope, Senka left the colony of her birth and, with her attendants, set out to serve as broodmistress, founder of a new colony.

name: Seek the Horizon
text:
"I've seen this great land from every angle. I know its every tree, stone, and river bend. Yet I have come to realize that knowing a thing is not the same as healing it."
—Diary of Azusa

name: Kitsune Bonesetter
text:
"He kept generations whole before the Kami War, and now he turns his century of wisdom to healing the latest casualties."
—Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Ashes of the Fallen
text: The ashes of the dead mingle with the soil, and both become as one.

name: Blood Clock
text: In an age of war, time is measured not by sand but by blood.

name: Ebony Owl Netsuke
text:
"Owls filled the skies during the Kami War, harbingers of darker times to come."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Ivory Crane Netsuke
text: It is said that the feathers of a crane are clouds, plucked and sewn together by the hands of the kami.

name: Scroll of Origins
text: The words from which language sprang, the knowledge from which thought was born, the story from which history was woven.

name: Wine of Blood and Iron
text: Godo never revealed what went into his special brew, but he always had more of it after great victories.

name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
text:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
text: Here the soratami wove their endless plots—graceful, artful, and deceitful, while the unwitting world moved below.

name: Kitsune Loreweaver
text: "Know your history. The lessons of the past will shield you in times of doubt."

name: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker
text:
"Watch over my father. Tell him I'm safe, but I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace."
—Michiko Konda, last letter to General Takeno

name: Araba Mothrider
text:
"My finest creations are fashioned after the moths of Eiganjo. They fly higher, faster, and more gracefully than any of my own designs."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

name: Moonwing Moth
text:
"Night wings sprinkled with dust Of a thousand soldiers dead And a thousand cities fallen."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Plow Through Reito
text: The paths of the kami crisscrossed Kamigawa like scars left by a maddened surgeon.

name: Presence of the Wise
text: "Humbly I bow. Silently I wait. Deeply I listen."

name: Promise of Bunrei
text: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

name: Reverence
text:
"Despite the massive forces that allied against him, Konda never once believed he would lose the Kami War."
—Masako the Humorless

name: Celestial Kirin
text: All bow at its visitation—some in awe, some in honor, some in fear.

name: Cut the Earthly Bond
text:
"The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became, threatening to tear into tatters at the slightest pressure."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

name: Descendant of Soramaro
text: "Soramaro speaks through me. Listen! And I will tell the wisdom of the ancestors."

name: Dreamcatcher
text:
"Be careful where your mind wanders. Even in the quietest moments, the kami are listening, and your thoughts give them shape."
—Lady Azami

name: Freed from the Real
text: When a strong mind moves, form and energy shift to heed it.

name: Ideas Unbound
text: The apprentice stared in puzzlement. "But Master, you finished writing those spells just yesterday. Don't you remember?" The jushi's heart froze.

name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
text:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

name: Meishin, the Mind Cage
text: It's dangerous indeed to be lost in someone else's thoughts.

name: Minamo Scrollkeeper
text: The scrollkeepers never stepped an inch away from the doors of the Great Library, not even when the ogres and their oni masters swept through Minamo.

name: Murmurs from Beyond
text: Like pools of fog that hid treacherous rocks from sailors' eyes, so too were the hands of the kami.

name: Oboro Breezecaller
text:
"I feel their unnatural influence in the weary, weeping land. Do they care nothing for the creatures who walk below their clouds?"
—Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

name: Oppressive Will
text: When Minamo was abandoned, its younger students found themselves thrust into a war beyond their skill with talents beyond their control.

name: Overwhelming Intellect
text: "My brain hurts."

name: Rushing-Tide Zubera
text: Cut off from the kakuriyo by the destruction of their honden, the zubera sought new ways to bring their secrets home.

name: Secretkeeper
text: It is all the things that humanity was not meant to know.

name: Shape Stealer
text:
"Stand back. I know just what to do."
—Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker

name: Trusted Advisor
text: Some of Minamo's students claimed he was as old as the knowledge he dispensed.

name: Curtain of Light
text:
"Paint gold upon the wind, Shape the wind into a shield, And vanish behind the brightness."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

name: Twincast
text: Sometimes you have to search for inspiration, and sometimes it's right there in front of you.

name: Choice of Damnations
text:
"Life is a series of choices between bad and worse."
—Toshiro Umezawa

name: Death Denied
text: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

name: Deathmask Nezumi
text:
"We had him cornered, we did . . . and, well, you know what they say about rats."
—Araba patrol survivor

name: Footsteps of the Goryo
text: In the case of violent deaths, kami offered a chance for revenge if the deceased offered up its corpse as a host to the invading kami.

name: Descendant of Kiyomaro
text: "The blood of Kiyomaro flows in my veins. He did not let Eiganjo fall and neither shall I."

name: Gnat Miser
text: Nezumi insect-shamans enjoyed solitary lives, which was fortunate since no other nezumi could stand to live within half a mile of their foul stench.

name: Hand of Cruelty
text: "The sword is just a tool. It is the samurai's hand that delivers death."

name: Infernal Kirin
text: The kirin bellowed—an echoing, twisted parody of its once-inspirational call.

name: Kagemaro's Clutch
text: The mist was thick, cloying, and constricting. Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

name: Kiku's Shadow
text:
"Me? No, I'm not going to kill you. I won't even lay a finger on you. I promise."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

name: Kuro's Taken
text: Simple bargains are the most tempting, and oni bargains are the simplest of all: eternal life for eternal service.

name: Eiganjo Free-Riders
text:
"The air filled with dust and the sound of wingbeats. The mothriders had joined the fray."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Locust Miser
text: "They're numerous, attack in swarms, and are always hungry. No wonder we rats hold such a kinship with them."

name: One with Nothing
text: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

name: Razorjaw Oni
text: It gnashed its teeth, and the battlefield filled with the screech of blade striking blade.

name: Skull Collector
text: "Your blood I'll use. Your skull I'll keep."

name: Adamaro, First to Desire
text:
"Beware Adamaro! In him all pain and anger is perfected."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

name: Akki Drillmaster
text: "What part of 'hayaku ikee!' did you not understand?"

name: Akki Underling
text:
"I lost my hounds in the war and thus found myself employing akki as servants. I found their training to be remarkably similar."
—Kensuke, houndmaster

name: Captive Flame
text: "Kills and cooks your food in one easy stroke."

name: Feral Lightning
text: They moved like apes, but a thousand times swifter, prying into every corner, leaving pawprints of ash.

name: Gaze of Adamaro
text: Wherever it looked, it saw destruction—the wake of its own gaze.

name: Abuna Acolyte
text: "You can break nothing I cannot mend."

name: Glint Hawk
text: Its eyes burned nearly blind by the Whitesun, it hunts by metallic gleam.

name: Oxidda Daredevil
text: His goggles spattered with grime and his mouth full of bugs, he tossed the engines another priceless relic.

name: Oxidda Scrapmelter
text: It subsists on a diet rich in screaming metal and molten blood.

name: Scoria Elemental
text: A single molten cord links it to the subterranean furnaces, drawing heat and metal from beneath Kuldotha. Until that bond is cut, it carves a swath of raw destruction.

name: Shatter
text:
"I am an artist, a builder, a creator . . . I create the biggest explosions around."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

name: Spikeshot Elder
text: Now that he knows a thousand ways of hurting people, his next shamanic quest is to discover a thousand more.

name: Tunnel Ignus
text: Fight mischief with mischief.

name: Turn to Slag
text:
"If it wasn't a blackened, stinking, melted abomination before, it certainly is now."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Vulshok Heartstoker
text: He fashions stirring words with as much passion as a smith fashioning a warhammer.

name: Acid Web Spider
text: Its web is an excellent source of found copper for the daring or the stupid.

name: Alpha Tyrranax
text: Hunger seized the tyrranax, and the Sylvok's vision quest ended in disaster.

name: Indomitable Archangel
text:
"Every sword drawn to defend is an angelic blade, guided to justice by an angelic hand."
—Auriok proverb

name: Asceticism
text:
"Let my ignominy build walls thicker than iron and stronger than darksteel."
—Thrun, the last troll

name: Blight Mamba
text: Its venom drips with Phyrexia's hate.

name: Blunt the Assault
text:
"Much can be gained from the appearance of vulnerability."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

name: Carapace Forger
text: "Bows and whips cannot save us from these new horrors of the Mephidross."

name: Carrion Call
text: The natural order is out of order.

name: Copperhorn Scout
text: Fangren spur may sound louder, but Viridian resurgents claim that the horn of the vorrac creates a truer, more inspiring note.

name: Cystbearer
text: Phyrexia strives to simulate natural life, but it can't resist improving on the design.

name: Engulfing Slagwurm
text: Its teeth exist only for decoration.

name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
text: The infamous Ezuri commands the highest bounty the vedalken have ever placed upon an outlaw.

name: Kemba, Kha Regent
text: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

name: Ezuri's Brigade
text: Riding ravenous, ever-growing vorracs is almost as dangerous as fitting them with saddles.

name: Lifesmith
text: The Sylvok see the artificer as a gardener, preparing the world for hardy growth.

name: Molder Beast
text:
"A trail of scrap metal can lead it into an ambush. But take care not to overfeed it."
—Adaran, Tangle hunter

name: Slice in Twain
text:
"The hypocrisy of these elves is thicker than steel—destroying 'unnatural metal' with their own enchanted swords."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Tangle Angler
text: A plague on the curious.

name: Tel-Jilad Defiance
text: The Viridian elves had purged their culture of the trolls' traitorous influence. In times of strife, however, the ancestral memories returned.

name: Kemba's Skyguard
text:
"We're now to dispense aid to any Mirran we see battling anything . . . 'strange.' Regent's orders."
—Ranya, skyhunter captain

name: Tel-Jilad Fallen
text: "No longer am I shackled to antiquity. My new masters will etch a glorious future."

name: Untamed Might
text:
"Beasts kill for their very survival. If you would have their strength, you must know their desperation."
—Konnos, Sylvok sage

name: Viridian Revel
text:
"Let them have their revel. Soon those who won't submit will be turned. Those who won't be turned will die."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Wing Puncture
text:
"If I were the air, I wouldn't taunt the ground. It has the weight advantage."
—Konnos, Sylvok sage

name: Withstand Death
text: On Mirrodin, every conflict ends in either death or darksteel.

name: Accorder's Shield
text: An Auriok shield is polished to a mirror finish even on the inside, enabling its bearer to watch foes ahead and behind.

name: Argentum Armor
text: Mirrodin's creator still lives, still shapes metal, and still commands world-shaking power.

name: Auriok Replica
text: All the loyalty of the Auriok with only a trace of their self-righteousness.

name: Barbed Battlegear
text:
"One need only look at the inhabitants of this world to see that they are forged halfway to perfection. All they need is a whisper of the Glorious Word."
—Urabrask the Hidden

name: Leonin Arbiter
text: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

name: Bladed Pinions
text: Lacking trained pterons, the Auriok had to rely on other measures to gain the upper hand in the skies.

name: Chrome Steed
text: According to Auriok myth, it collects scrap in order to reassemble its lost rider.

name: Copper Myr
text: The myr are like verdigris: an ever-present patina on the surface of a metal world.

name: Culling Dais
text:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Darksteel Axe
text: Heavier than it looks, tricky to wield, guaranteed to last.

name: Loxodon Wayfarer
text: The Mirran elders vanished with Memnarch, leaving behind a generation of wayward orphans.

name: Darksteel Juggernaut
text: One part unstoppable force, one part immovable object.

name: Echo Circlet
text: After the vanishing of the elder generations, the Anvil Tribe developed creative solutions to their personnel shortages.

name: Etched Champion
text: Its predecessors were etched with the wisdom of ancients; its own etchings bear warnings of a future fraught with war.

name: Gold Myr
text: The myr are like razorgrass: numberless metal figures, reflecting each other's light.

name: Golem Artisan
text: Better living through metallurgy.

name: Myrsmith
text: The Auriok see the artificer as a conduit, beckoning new creations into the world.

name: Golem's Heart
text: The heart of a golem gives life to more than just the iron husk around it.

name: Grindclock
text: Pray you never hear it chime.

name: Infiltration Lens
text: Neurok spies carry devices that let them look a few moments into the future, giving them an almost insurmountable edge.

name: Iron Myr
text: The myr are like rusted metal: gleaming purpose hidden by a thin disguise of debris.

name: Kuldotha Forgemaster
text: The goblins say it used to be larger, before it began to stoke the Great Furnace with pieces of itself.

name: Razor Hippogriff
text: She incubates her eggs in gold and mana.

name: Leaden Myr
text: The myr are like necrogen: a transformative force unconcerned with the changes they wreak.

name: Liquimetal Coating
text:
"They'll soon become accustomed to wearing skin that is not their own."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Lux Cannon
text: There are few problems that can't be solved by putting a hole in the world.

name: Memnite
text: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

name: Mindslaver
text: It's a helm that leaves the head at its most vulnerable.

name: Moriok Replica
text: All the secrets of the Moriok with only a trace of their corruption.

name: Mox Opal
text: The suns of Mirrodin have shone upon perfection only once.

name: Revoke Existence
text:
"No half measures, no regrets. We'll tell no stories of this day. It will be as if it never existed at all."
—Ganedor, loxodon mystic

name: Myr Galvanizer
text:
"We can't quite determine what they're doing, but they seem to be doing it quite well."
—Vedalken research notes

name: Myr Propagator
text:
"We will ingest and remake this world in our image, not unlike some admirable designs I have seen here."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Myr Reservoir
text: A mana well as bottomless as the myr are tireless.

name: Necrogen Censer
text: Moriok necromancers actively spread necrogen, encouraging the transformation from Mirran to nim.

name: Neurok Replica
text: All the curiosity of the Neurok with only a trace of their duplicity.

name: Salvage Scout
text: "I'm not saying it's dangerous work. I'm just saying don't sign up if you have plans for your seventieth birthday."

name: Palladium Myr
text: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

name: Perilous Myr
text: To Mirrodin, an explosive. To Phyrexia, a missionary.

name: Platinum Emperion
text: It ignores such insignificant forces as time, entropy, and death.

name: Razorfield Thresher
text: DANGER! Keep appendages clear of front of machine. And rear of machine. And side of machine. And top of machine.

name: Rusted Relic
text:
"We consider rust a curable disease."
—Tarrin, Hammer-Tribe shaman

name: Arrest
text: Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.

name: Seize the Initiative
text: The time between spotting a leonin shikari and feeling its claws is just time enough to draw your last breath.

name: Saberclaw Golem
text: The warriors of the Blade Tribe charged the golem, twenty strong. They returned numbering ten . . . and a half.

name: Semblance Anvil
text: Forged from what it forges.

name: Silver Myr
text: The myr are like quicksilver: malleable in function and adaptable in form.

name: Snapsail Glider
text: Built from a reconfigured thresher, it charges with light reflected off the golden plain, ready to take to the air in case of danger.

name: Soliton
text: The gemini engines had lost connection with each other and wandered apart, developing an independent awareness of their surroundings.

name: Strider Harness
text: Each journey begins with a single step—and sometimes ends with that single step as well.

name: Sylvok Lifestaff
text: The druid's lifestaff connects her to generations of bygone Sylvok.

name: Soul Parry
text:
"I was called to this world of steel, and it will be my steel that answers."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Sylvok Replica
text: All the zeal of the Sylvok with only a trace of their conservancy.

name: Throne of Geth
text: At the heart of Ish Sah, Geth stokes the dark fires of Phyrexia.

name: Tower of Calamities
text: The ur-golems concealed one of their towers out of fear that its power would be abused, and in anticipation of a time when its power would be sorely needed.

name: Tumble Magnet
text: Magnetic devices that keep massive golems and structures standing can also be used for the opposite purpose.

name: Vector Asp
text: Phyrexia's machines take inspiration from nature. Twisted, disturbing inspiration.

name: Sunblast Angel
text: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

name: Venser's Journal
text: A Planeswalker's chronicle spans worlds and civilizations, each page a lifetime.

name: Vulshok Replica
text: All the fury of the Vulshok with only a trace of their recklessness.

name: Wall of Tanglecord
text: Rootlike fibers travel far from Mirrodin's metallic forests, emerging from the crust to drink in the mana-infused sunlight.

name: Blackcleave Cliffs
text: Where the Oxidda Chain mingles with the Mephidross, oil-suffused metal crumbles away, leaving walls of blackened bones.

name: Copperline Gorge
text: Where the Tangle overruns the Oxidda mountains, metallic beasts scratch their territories in the verdigris.

name: Darkslick Shores
text: Where the Mephidross leaches into the Quicksilver Sea, the waves writhe with necrogen.

name: Glimmerpost
text: What once spied upon Mirrodin from above now waits below for another to assume control.

name: Razorverge Thicket
text: Where the Razor Fields beat back the Tangle, the crowded thicket yields to bright scimitars of grass.

name: Seachrome Coast
text: Where the Quicksilver Sea laps over the Razor Fields, the landscape reflects the suns' fading hope.

name: Sunspear Shikari
text: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

name: Tempered Steel
text:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

name: True Conviction
text: Dozens of spells known only to the Auriok elders were lost, but the next generation, galvanized by war, devised even more potent magic.

name: Vigil for the Lost
text: "As she grew cold in my arms, I swore an oath that her funeral pyre would be dwarfed by a bonfire of our enemies."

name: Whitesun's Passage
text: All over the Razor Fields, Whitesun is celebrated. Even the followers of the rebel Juryan, far from the Cave of Light, bow their heads in reverence.

name: Argent Sphinx
text: A great mirage, a dream of wings and silver.

name: Bonds of Quicksilver
text: The sea's reach extends beyond its shores.

name: Auriok Edgewright
text: Auriok soldiers craft their own weapons, forging a connection to the steel with each blow of the hammer.

name: Darkslick Drake
text: At the edge of the Mephidross, Phyrexia's influence seeps into life and land.

name: Disperse
text: Most casualties of the power struggle between vedalken and Neurok didn't die on the field of battle; they merely disappeared.

name: Dissipation Field
text:
"Strike me once, shame on you. Strike me twice . . . Well, let's just see if you can."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Halt Order
text: An artificer's least favorite mind-missive may be "I regret to inform you that the funding for your project has been cut."

name: Inexorable Tide
text:
"See how gratefully this world accepts our blessings."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Lumengrid Drake
text: Properly outfitted, drakes made perfect sentries for vedalken strongholds.

name: Neurok Invisimancer
text: "They won't see your shadow or hear your breath, but they will feel your blade."

name: Plated Seastrider
text: The Neurok buried entangling cables just under the Quicksilver Sea. One seastrider harvest can provide an army's worth of armor and shields.

name: Quicksilver Gargantuan
text:
"You know you have achieved true power if the sea itself seeks to emulate your greatness."
—Vy Covalt, Neurok agent

name: Auriok Sunchaser
text:
"Grant me loft. Grant me light. Grant me the accuracy I need to kill all who threaten Bladehold."
—Prayer to the Whitesun

name: Riddlesmith
text: The Neurok see the artificer as an archaeologist, clearing away falsehoods to see the truth hidden beneath.

name: Scrapdiver Serpent
text: Smart artificers clean up after themselves.

name: Screeching Silcaw
text: It's adaptively deaf to its own cries.

name: Sky-Eel School
text: They swim on tides few can see, away from a threat few yet understand.

name: Steady Progress
text: "More of that strange oil . . . It's probably nothing."

name: Stoic Rebuttal
text: Obsessed with the pursuit of knowledge above all else, vedalken can appear to be cold and emotionless.

name: Turn Aside
text: "It's not my job to ask our leaders about their experiments at the Knowledge Pool. It's my job to make sure they can continue performing them."

name: Dispense Justice
text: The Accorders never strike first, but they always strike back.

name: Twisted Image
text:
"True strength is in the mind, for the body is too malleable a form."
—Politus, vedalken emisar

name: Vault Skyward
text:
"The edges of the Quicksilver Sea run dark with the spread of the Mephidross. Two more aerial passes before I can be sure what I'm seeing . . ."
—Lafarius, Neurok sky agent

name: Vedalken Certarch
text: "An appropriately detailed model is indistinguishable from reality, and much easier to control."

name: Volition Reins
text: "Glorifying the will is a mistake. It is simply one more force to be mastered."

name: Blackcleave Goblin
text:
"Bitten? Save time, amputate now."
—Lephar, loxodon surgeon

name: Bleak Coven Vampires
text: As the shadow of the Mephidross spread over the Tangle, the vampires' territory expanded.

name: Blistergrub
text:
"The sooner you join Phyrexia, the sooner you'll forget your painful rebirth."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Carnifex Demon
text: Every contagion has a host.

name: Contagious Nim
text:
"This species has grown to be my preferred receptacle for our divine message."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Corrupted Harvester
text:
"Before the blessed assault begins, we must seek specimens that are well-adapted to our way of . . . life."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Dross Hopper
text: Bred in the vicious Mephidross, dross hoppers learned to eat quickly and escape faster.

name: Exsanguinate
text: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

name: Fume Spitter
text:
"Our archers made sport of it as it fumbled its way up the slag ridge. As it collapsed we thought ourselves safe, but the foul thing carried more than necrogen."
—Adaran, Tangle hunter

name: Grasp of Darkness
text: On a world with five suns, night is compelled to become an aggressive force.

name: Instill Infection
text:
"The results of our ninth inoculation were the same. The specimen was, of course, euthanized before the contagion could spread."
—Vedalken research notes

name: Memoricide
text: "You claim wisdom, yet I see nothing in here but tawdry wishes."

name: Fulgent Distraction
text:
"Channeling the white-hot power of all five suns creates a pretty good diversion."
—Yavash of the Accorders

name: Moriok Reaver
text:
"The Moriok are fools. They try so hard to gain my favor. All I want is for them to die quickly, to join the ranks of the nim."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Necrogen Scudder
text: Contrary to popular belief, it's kept aloft by necrogen gas, not the screaming agony of a thousand murdered souls.

name: Necrotic Ooze
text:
"To death all must go, and so in death lies ultimate power."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Painful Quandary
text:
"For each word spoken, one forgotten. For each thought, a memory rotten."
—Moriok incantation

name: Painsmith
text: The Moriok see the artificer as a taskmaster, forcing lazy metal into more potent shapes.

name: Plague Stinger
text: It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.

name: Psychic Miasma
text:
"A mind may be steeled against madness, but all battlements fall in time."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

name: Relic Putrescence
text:
"Until we shed the curse of sentience, we must endure its grotesque handiwork."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

name: Skinrender
text:
"Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

name: Ghalma's Warden
text: A special unit guards the loxodon artificer known as Ghalma the Shaper. They are armed and armored in her finest works of silver and steel.

name: Tainted Strike
text:
"Welcome to perfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

name: Arc Trail
text:
"Don't try to hit your enemies. Concentrate on the space between them, and fill the air with doom."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

name: Assault Strobe
text: When breaking someone's face once just isn't enough.

name: Barrage Ogre
text: The elves had devised countless strategies to combat Memnarch's war machines, but they had no idea what to do when one was *thrown* at them.

name: Bloodshot Trainee
text: "Just think how strong I'll be if my arms don't tear off!"

name: Embersmith
text: The Vulshok see the artificer as a catalyst, bringing the spark of creation that ignites change.

name: Ferrovore
text: The Vulshok use its digestion to break down the most obstinate artifacts, from darksteel myr to seastrider plates.

name: Flameborn Hellion
text:
"The most reliable omen of a future hellion attack is a past hellion attack."
—Spear-Tribe teaching

name: Furnace Celebration
text: Reduce. Reuse. Wreak havoc.

name: Galvanic Blast
text: Mirrodin has little weather, but it certainly has lightning.

name: Goblin Gaveleer
text:
"When everything looks like a nail, you really need to get yourself a hammer."
—Krol, goblin furnace-priest

name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
text: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

name: Kuldotha Rebirth
text: All goblin rituals serve a dual purpose as fertility rites, even the destructive ones. Especially the destructive ones.

name: Melt Terrain
text: Just as the most finely wrought metal can warp and rust, so too does Mirrodin buckle under pressures from without and within.

name: Ogre Geargrabber
text: Long reach, short attention span.

name: Dig Site Inventory
text: "I checked my pack twice before we left campus. So why do I feel like I forgot something?"

name: Send in the Pest
text: Dara couldn't cover her Silverquill bullies in ink but she could do the next best thing.

name: Sneering Shadewriter
text:
"The whole display was uninspired and derivative, and left me wondering: what was the point?"
— *Strixhaven Star* gallery show review

name: Tragedy Feaster
text: In the wake of the archaics' rampage, much worse was to come.

name: Ulna Alley Shopkeep
text: "This one's from my private stock."

name: Wander Off
text:
"This place may be the Titan's Grave, but if you aren't careful it can be yours as well."
—Professor Dellian Fel

name: Withering Curse
text: Although lumarets are small magical creatures, they can gather to eliminate larger threats.

name: Ancestral Anger
text: An incautious Lorehold student may learn more about the unbound rage of the Blood Age than they wanted to.

name: Archaic's Agony
text: Its past became present became paradox.

name: Eager Glyphmage
text: Sharrel poured his heart into his words and watched them take flight.

name: Charging Strifeknight
text: His spirit has led this charge for centuries, unaware—or perhaps uncaring—of the way the fields have changed.

name: Duel Tactics
text:
"My trick? Hit their casting hand and they lose their advantage. So far, I'm undefeated."
—Alessia, Lorehold duelist

name: Expressive Firedancer
text:
"Now, let your movements respond to the music! Yes, just like that!"
—Introduction to Interpretation

name: Flashback
text: Quintorius found that every new discovery motivated him to keep exploring.

name: Garrison Excavator
text: "I don't care that they're 'off-limits,' the Lost Barracks hold too many war relics to not pay them a visit!"

name: Heated Argument
text: "I don't want to hurt you, Ajani, but whatever Jace is planning needs to be stopped!"

name: Impractical Joke
text: Strixhaven students have a sense of humor. The spirits of the Blood Age do not.

name: Living History
text: Experience is a harsh tutor.

name: Molten-Core Maestro
text: "My media? Fury and flame."

name: Rearing Embermare
text:
"Terrible creatures. A restorer's worst enemy is fire."
—Osgir, the Reconstructor

name: Rubble Rouser
text: "History is patient. I am not."

name: Seize the Spoils
text: The annual arts festival, Summitfest, draws participants from across Arcavios, but only one will walk away with The Grand Muse trophy.

name: Tablet of Discovery
text: Leaving no stone unturned is just the beginning.

name: Tackle Artist
text: "Let's paint the field red!"

name: Tome Blast
text: "You're history."

name: Unsubtle Mockery
text:
"He said it was 'physically impossible' to capture an exact likeness. The technique could use a little work, but I got the expression right."
—Isobel, hot-headed artist

name: Zealous Lorecaster
text: "Sometimes the only way to learn from history is by repeating it."

name: Aberrant Manawurm
text:
"What is the equation for terror?"
—Lost research note, Paradox Gardens

name: Additive Evolution
text:
"Numbers have no limits. Why should nature?"
—Emil, Quandrix fourth-year

name: Burrog Barrage
text: "I had to leave Doradur to attend Strixhaven, so I brought a piece of home with me."

name: Chelonian Tackle
text:
"Scurrids to climb the tower, cervins to cross the stadium, and turtles to win the game."
—Quandrix Mage Tower tactics

name: Comforting Counsel
text: In the grief that followed the Invasion, Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

name: Efflorescence
text:
"Wherever your foot falls, life blossoms in its wake."
—Lisette, dean of the root

name: Environmental Scientist
text: "Now to put into practice what I learned in class."

name: Erode
text:
"Our lives are built upon our pasts. What happens, then, if we are cut off from them?"
—Augusta, dean of order

name: Hungry Graffalon
text: The nature of the Paradox Gardens is such that the beasts that live there are always exactly as tall as they need to be to get a snack.

name: Lumaret's Favor
text: Though the lumarets were ignored by the other Witherbloom students, it was clear to Lluwen they were much more complex than they seemed.

name: Mindful Biomancer
text: "I sometimes think I've learned more from the smallest of beings than from all of my professors combined."

name: Noxious Newt
text: Brightly-colored skin doesn't always mean a creature is poisonous, but why take the risk?

name: Oracle's Restoration
text: Though the archaic had ravaged Titan's Grave and stolen Jadzi from safety, her compassion soothed its frenzy.

name: Pestbrood Sloth
text: The sloths of Titan's Grave move so infrequently that entire ecosystems develop in their fur.

name: Planar Engineering
text:
"All growth comes at a cost. It's up to each of us to determine if the result is worth the sacrifice."
—Oracle Jadzi, to Tam

name: Shopkeeper's Bane
text:
"Pests really live up to their name!"
—Annia, disgruntled Ribtruss Town merchant

name: Graduation Day
text: Not a journey's end but its beginning.

name: Slumbering Trudge
text:
"Yes, she is blocking the path. Are you volunteering to move her?"
—Tam, to Kirol

name: Snarl Song
text:
"Archaics and mana snarls have both existed since the beginning of time. Coincidence? Highly unlikely."
—Zimone

name: Tenured Concocter
text: "Potential can be augmented. Imagination cannot."

name: Topiary Lecturer
text: "Before we can understand nature, we must learn to nurture it."

name: Group Project
text:
"Never be afraid to ask for help. Success is much sweeter when it's shared."
—Quintorius Kand

name: Abstract Paintmage
text: "Life is vivid; the pigments I use should be too."

name: Applied Geometry
text: "I know the prompt was to replicate a scurrid, but I took some creative liberties with my version."

name: Ark of Hunger
text: Few relics survived the turmoil of the Blood Age; those that did are powerful, dangerous, or both.

name: Aziza, Mage Tower Captain
text: "Good play, team! Now let's run it again until it's perfect!"

name: Blech, Loafing Pest
text: Despite Blex's passing, Witherbloom students still continued the tradition of a yearly search in his honor. His son, however, took little effort to find.

name: Bogwater Lumaret
text:
"You will hear rumors that licking lumarets grants prophetic visions. That is untrue. Please refrain from licking the lumarets."
—Witherbloom student handbook

name: Borrowed Knowledge
text: "Professor, we study history and my neighbor wrote his answer first. I was learning from the past."

name: Cauldron of Essence
text: In the gloomy depths of Widdershins Hall sits an iron belly—always hungry, but generous to those who feed it.

name: Harsh Annotation
text:
"I'd start from scratch if I were you."
—Felisa, Silverquill graduate

name: Colorstorm Stallion
text: Prismari students are never afraid to let their imaginations run wild.

name: Conciliator's Duelist
text: "By all means, let's debate."

name: Cuboid Colony
text: It's chaotic in the midst of the swarm—only when you step back does the pattern emerge.

name: Dina's Guidance
text: "This last step is very important. You'll need to know if the friend you're searching for is alive or dead."

name: Elemental Mascot
text: It soars in the presence of true beauty.

name: Embrace the Paradox
text:
"Every lecture you attended—every theorem you memorized and equation you solved—has led to this first step into uncertainty."
—Professor Deekah

name: Essenceknit Scholar
text: "Life and death is a complex pattern that needs careful stitching."

name: Fix What's Broken
text: Two tired souls finally found something to unite them.

name: Fractal Mascot
text: The nature of theory given form and function.

name: Geometer's Arthropod
text:
"Creatures that have survived blood-soaked millennia should not be underestimated."
—Nev, dean of substance

name: Grapple with Death
text: Not until Lluwen watched Professor Fel in action did he truly understand just how closely life and death were intertwined.

name: Growth Curve
text: "There is no force stronger or more daunting than that of exponential growth."

name: Hardened Academic
text: "Do you think I've spent a lifetime studying war and learned nothing?"

name: Imperious Inkmage
text: "It's not ego if you're flawless, darling."

name: Inkling Mascot
text: At the ready when words fail.

name: Killian's Confidence
text: "Don't hold back, because I certainly won't."

name: Rancorous Archaic
text: As the giant shadow loomed, the Forum of Amity fell silent for the first time in its history.

name: Informed Inkwright
text: "My inklings are ideal for gathering information. There's no place on Arcavios they can't reach."

name: Mind into Matter
text: "What the mind conceives," began Dean Adrix. "Magic can achieve," assured Dean Nev.

name: Mind Roots
text: The best ideas stem from dreams.

name: Molten Note
text: It's characteristic of the Blood Age for instruments of music to also be tools of war.

name: Moment of Reckoning
text: The archaics experience all of Arcavian history. Changing that fate threatens their very existence.

name: Old-Growth Educator
text:
"Here is my most important lesson: Within all life dwells a living essence. You must decide for yourselves how you'll use that knowledge."
—Professor Longbranch

name: Pest Mascot
text: Hungering for the zest of life.

name: Practiced Scrollsmith
text: "Every weapon has a story. Let me tell you this one's."

name: Proctor's Gaze
text: Only proctors are allowed to use magic in exam halls, enabling them to more easily catch cheaters in the act.

name: Pterafractyl
text:
"Be careful when traversing the Paradox Gardens. Not all experiments are perfectly contained."
—Professor Berta

name: Pursue the Past
text:
"Stones in your path are not obstacles, but discoveries."
—Velomachus Lorehold

name: Rapturous Moment
text: Fireworks of all kinds fill the skies of Summitfest.

name: Interjection
text: Silverquill professors dislike when students disrupt their lessons, but can't help approving of the confidence needed to do so.

name: Render Speechless
text: "Seems like I took the words right out of your mouth."

name: Resonating Lute
text: School styluses are just tools. Passion is a Prismari's true instrument.

name: Root Manipulation
text: "Nature endures and adapts, and so shall we."

name: Snooping Page
text: Eavesdropping is not a misdeed in the Forum, but a fact of life.

name: Social Snub
text: "Sorry. This seat's taken."

name: Spectacular Skywhale
text: Rootha was humbled in the whale's presence. It was glorious and beautiful, all on its own terms.

name: Spirit Mascot
text: Unflagging, unafraid, and undaunted.

name: Splatter Technique
text: As the marvels of living art they are, elemental whales can't resist contributing to Summitfest's displays.

name: Stadium Tidalmage
text: The Prismari team takes the direction to "flood the zone" literally.

name: Startled Relic Sloth
text:
"Should your sloth become agitated, remove all valuables from the immediate area and wait for it to tire out. This will not take long."
—Lorehold student handbook

name: Stirring Honormancer
text: "Speak as though the world will be a better place after your words are in it."

name: Stress Dream
text: Krelg's attempt at a calming nap proved futile.

name: Suspend Aggression
text:
"Knowledge is your armor. Use it wisely, and it will keep you safe."
—Augusta, dean of order

name: Teacher's Pest
text:
"Stop playing dead, Rinata. No one's believed you for a decade."
—Moseo, dean of the vein

name: Traumatic Critique
text:
"The *artist* should suffer for their craft, not the audience!"
—Galazeth Prismari

name: Vibrant Outburst
text: "I'll show you a 'colorful insult'!"

name: Vicious Rivalry
text: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

name: Visionary's Dance
text: Choreography powers the spell, but improvisation shapes it.

name: Wilt in the Heat
text: "'It'll be fun,' they said. 'The Fields are full of dead things,' they said."

name: Zaffai and the Tempests
text: "Leave everything on the stage and give them a performance they'll never forget."

name: Biblioplex Tomekeeper
text: "Due dates are firm, and will be enforced."

name: Diary of Dreams
text:
"We make art. Art makes us."
—Galazeth Prismari

name: Mage Tower Referee
text: Incapable of choosing a favorite and invulnerable to the influence of magic, it is an ideal and obnoxiously accurate referee.

name: Potioner's Trove
text: The shops of Ribtruss Town sell anything that can be gathered within Titan's Grave. Just don't ask where they acquired their goods.

name: Deathcap Glade
text:
"Life is defined by change. When I shucked my flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection, it was not loss to me, merely a new state of being."
—Moseo, dean of the vein

name: Dreamroot Cascade
text:
"Nature is chaos governed by principle. In analyzing these patterns, I hope to protect Strixhaven's future from any more tragedy."
—Adrix, dean of theory

name: Fields of Strife
text: The terrible Blood Age lives on in the unending battle between thousands of spirits trapped in their final moments.

name: Forum of Amity
text: A sprawling edifice dedicated to promoting and protecting the fragile peace that holds Arcavios together.

name: Paradox Gardens
text: A vast expanse that alters the rules of nature, offering a glimpse into the very structure of reality.

name: Primary Research
text: Witnessing something firsthand is somehow both the best and the worst way to learn.

name: Shattered Sanctum
text:
"The most cordial words are often the ones intended to deceive. It's only of late that I've realized how much strength honesty requires."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

name: Skycoach Waypoint
text:
"Do you have all your books? And your stylus? And your extra uniform? And your lucky scarf?"
—Overheard at Hookiver Station

name: Spectacle Summit
text: Shaped by both its own wild nature and the magic of visiting artists, the Muse and the surrounding landscape are a wonder to behold.

name: Stormcarved Coast
text:
"Careful ideation crashes together with wild creativity. Though I am grateful to be made dean, I've found it difficult to represent just the one side."
—Veyran, dean of perfection

name: Sundown Pass
text:
"Study of the past is preparation for the future. My fail-safe spell, activated upon my death, was precaution born from tales of the careless."
—Augusta, dean of order

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Some say this snarl—the most turbulent, changeable location in all of Arcavios—is the birthplace of the five elder dragons. There are also whispers it's where they are destined to die.

name: Titan's Grave
text: From the scattered skeleton of an ancient death grow the secrets of healing and prolonging life—or quietly ending it.

name: Rapier Wit
text: "I make promises, not threats."

name: Rehearsed Debater
text: "Of course I talk to myself. Who wouldn't want to hear me speak?"

name: Together as One
text: By himself, Lluwen couldn't have hoped to calm the Dawning Archaic—but any time it really mattered, he was never alone.

name: Antiquities on the Loose
text: Raising spirits is easier than taming them.

name: Shattered Acolyte
text: "Just because Extus is gone doesn't mean the rest of us disappeared. We are here, and we are still seeking answers."

name: Erode
text:
"Our lives are built upon our pasts. What happens, then, if we are cut off from them?"
—Augusta, dean of order

name: Informed Inkwright
text: "My inklings are ideal for gathering information. There's no place on Arcavios they can't reach."

name: Stirring Hopesinger
text: Though not all her students have wings, she's determined to help them reach new heights.

name: Exhibition Tidecaller
text:
"Dangerously overflowing with creative expression."
—*Strixhaven Star* gallery show review

name: Mana Sculpt
text: The harder a foe strikes, the stronger a Dragonsguard's defenses become.

name: Soaring Stoneglider
text: "Pranticle Peak is where you get the best views *on land*. I've found an even better vantage!"

name: Mathemagics
text:
"Theory? Meet practice."
—Tam, Quandrix second-year

name: Pensive Professor
text: "To the patient mind, no problem is unsolvable."

name: Wisdom of Ages
text:
"If you take the time to listen, the archaics will tell you that this world has been torn asunder and remade many times before."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Pox Plague
text: The darkest corners of the Detention Bog hide natural laboratories that quietly spawn deadly infections.

name: Withering Curse
text: Although lumarets are small magical creatures, they can gather to eliminate larger threats.

name: Flashback
text: Quintorius found that every new discovery motivated him to keep exploring.

name: Molten-Core Maestro
text: "My media? Fury and flame."

name: Comforting Counsel
text: In the grief that followed the Invasion, Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

name: Stand Up for Yourself
text: "And I won't be writing any more essays for you, either!"

name: Planar Engineering
text:
"All growth comes at a cost. It's up to each of us to determine if the result is worth the sacrifice."
—Oracle Jadzi, to Tam

name: Slumbering Trudge
text:
"Yes, she is blocking the path. Are you volunteering to move her?"
—Tam, to Kirol

name: Applied Geometry
text: "I know the prompt was to replicate a scurrid, but I took some creative liberties with my version."

name: Ark of Hunger
text: Few relics survived the turmoil of the Blood Age; those that did are powerful, dangerous, or both.

name: Aziza, Mage Tower Captain
text: "Good play, team! Now let's run it again until it's perfect!"

name: Cauldron of Essence
text: In the gloomy depths of Widdershins Hall sits an iron belly—always hungry, but generous to those who feed it.

name: Conciliator's Duelist
text: "By all means, let's debate."

name: Dina's Guidance
text: "This last step is very important. You'll need to know if the friend you're searching for is alive or dead."

name: Stirring Hopesinger
text: Though not all her students have wings, she's determined to help them reach new heights.

name: Fix What's Broken
text: Two tired souls finally found something to unite them.

name: Hardened Academic
text: "Do you think I've spent a lifetime studying war and learned nothing?"

name: Mind into Matter
text:
"What the mind conceives," began Dean Adrix.
"Magic can achieve," assured Dean Nev.

name: Moment of Reckoning
text: The archaics experience all of Arcavian history. Changing that fate threatens their very existence.

name: Resonating Lute
text: School styluses are just tools. Passion is a Prismari's true instrument.

name: Splatter Technique
text: As the marvels of living art they are, elemental whales can't resist contributing to Summitfest's displays.

name: Suspend Aggression
text:
"Knowledge is your armor. Use it wisely, and it will keep you safe."
—Augusta, dean of order

name: Traumatic Critique
text:
"The *artist* should suffer for their craft, not the audience!"
—Galazeth Prismari

name: Vicious Rivalry
text: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

name: Stone Docent
text:
"For those who might consider cheating, its eyes can see everything. That includes you, Esme. Please see me after class."
—Professor Ghostforge

name: Zaffai and the Tempests
text: "Leave everything on the stage and give them a performance they'll never forget."

name: Wisdom of Ages
text:
"If you take the time to listen, the archaics will tell you that this world has been torn asunder and remade many times before."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Summoned Dromedary
text: The camel had traveled this route so often in life that its spirit began moving as soon as the mage finished the summoning.

name: Banishing Betrayal
text: One simple push and Jadzi fell into the churning swirl of magic. Tam thought it would be harder—wished that it had been harder.

name: Brush Off
text: "You're the one who brought a priceless scroll to a duel!"

name: Together as One
text: By himself, Lluwen couldn't have hoped to calm the Dawning Archaic—but any time it really mattered, he was never alone.

name: Chase Inspiration
text: Nothing gets in the way of a Prismari student following a great idea.

name: Divergent Equation
text: As Quandrix students advance in their studies, even slight miscalculations can have startling effects.

name: Essence Scatter
text:
"Venturing beyond campus means learning how to deal with creatures not bound by university rules."
—Emil, Vastlands roamer

name: Exhibition Tidecaller
text:
"Dangerously overflowing with creative expression."
—*Strixhaven Star* gallery show review

name: Transcendent Archaic
text: Even as most archaics raged across Arcavios, others seemed to sink into contemplation.

name: Fractal Anomaly
text: "Dear dad, please send sixteen tons of krill in your next care package. Will explain at semester break."

name: Fractalize
text:
"Return your lizards to their natural size before class ends. We don't want another incident."
—Professor Berta

name: Homesickness
text:
"We know you're working hard. Dress warm and get enough sleep. Dad says hi!"
—Love, Mom

name: Hydro-Channeler
text: Only when they can defy the laws of nature can a Quandrix student claim to have mastered a spell.

name: Mana Sculpt
text: The harder a foe strikes, the stronger a Dragonsguard's defenses become.

name: Mathemagics
text:
"Theory? Meet practice."
—Tam, Quandrix second-year

name: Ajani's Response
text: Ajani no longer wanted to swing his axe in battle, but nothing came easier to him than defending those who needed protection.

name: Muse Seeker
text:
"Failure can be a reason to quit or fuel for inspiration. The choice is always yours."
—Veyran, dean of perfection

name: Muse's Encouragement
text: Many Prismari students find their best ideas while under the gaze of the Muse.

name: Orysa, Tide Choreographer
text: Orysa and her troupe of turtles are a staple of Summitfest's daytime celebrations.

name: Pensive Professor
text: "To the patient mind, no problem is unsolvable."

name: Procrastinate
text: "None of these projects are due until end of semester. I've still got a whole week to finish them!"

name: Quick Study
text:
"Even the most familiar formulae can yield unexpected outcomes."
—Professor Ruxa

name: Run Behind
text: The skycoach waits for no one.

name: Antiquities on the Loose
text: Raising spirits is easier than taming them.

name: Wisdom of Ages
text:
"If you take the time to listen, the archaics will tell you that this world has been torn asunder and remade many times before."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Arcane Omens
text: Lluwen suddenly felt that he was seeing something very dangerous. The crackling magic, the thunderous chanting—the urge to turn and run replaced all his curiosity.

name: Arnyn, Deathbloom Botanist
text: "My lovelies need meat, just like any other carnivore."

name: Burrog Banemaker
text: In most colleges, Erren's poisonous skin would have made them a pariah. In Witherbloom, they were one of the most popular students on campus.

name: Cost of Brilliance
text:
"There will be moments when you are exhausted, with nothing left to give. Remember them when you finally succeed."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

name: Dissection Practice
text: From the very first incision, Enid regretted choosing Witherbloom for her intercollege elective.

name: Ascendant Dustspeaker
text: You can always tell who just left Professor Osgir's lecture on practical restoration.

name: End of the Hunt
text: Just because the Oriq have gone silent doesn't mean their Mage Hunters have vanished.

name: Eternal Student
text: She was entering her fiftieth year of graduate study with no signs of stopping.

name: Foolish Fate
text:
"There are some lessons so simple that I thought they needn't be taught. I suppose I was wrong."
—Moseo, dean of the vein

name: Forum Necroscribe
text: She had watched many arguments wither on the Forum floor. Now, it was time to call on them to prove her point.

name: Last Gasp
text:
"A reminder, students, that those of you unlucky enough to have lungs must mask up for this assignment."
—Moseo, dean of the vein

name: Lecturing Scornmage
text: "I expected better from you."

name: Masterful Flourish
text: "Hold your applause. I am not yet finished."

name: Melancholic Poet
text: "We celebrate our sadness because it reminds us of the true value of being alive."

name: Poisoner's Apprentice
text: "Does this taste like hemlock to you?"

name: Pox Plague
text: The darkest corners of the Detention Bog hide natural laboratories that quietly spawn deadly infections.

name: Pull from the Grave
text:
"A little bruised, a little broken, but at least no longer dead."
—Dina

name: Rabid Attack
text:
"Let me guess, the scurrids got to you lot?"
—Witherbloom infirmary attendant

name: Amateur Hero
text: "Spider-Man wouldn't hesitate to save others, and neither will I!"

name: Lethal Protection
text: Venom's favorite crime was punishment.

name: Symbiote Spawn
text: The Life Foundation captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes. Symbiotes they could not control.

name: Venom, Eddie Brock
text: Eddie Brock's prayers for vengeance were answered by a darkness from another world.

name: Double Trouble
text:
"Keep up, Spider-Man. We don't have all night!"
—Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy

name: Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy
text: "No, it's fine. I'm late for practice again, but sure, I have time for a runaway bus."

name: The Mary Janes
text:
"You gotta FACE IT TIGER! FACE IT TIGER!"
—"Face It Tiger"

name: Rampaging Classmate
text:
"I just . . . just . . . wanted to be special . . . like you, Gwen."
—Lizard, Peter Parker (Earth-65)

name: Prowler, Misguided Mentor
text: "I made my choices, Miles, good and bad. Now you need to make yours."

name: Twisted Spider-Clone
text:
"Glurp!"
—Shift, clone of Spider-Man

name: Amazing Alliance
text:
"You know, we should really do this more often."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Venom Blast
text: Miles released his anger, his frustration, and his stored up bio-electricity.

name: MJ, Rising Star
text: "Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital.*"

name: Spider-Man, Peter Parker
text: "Heroes save people. It's what we do."

name: Alchemax Slayer-Bots
text: No opinions, no sick days, and no qualms about collateral damage—just the way Alchemax likes it.

name: Future Flight
text: "Knowledge of the future can be a burden, but I'm not one to be weighed down."

name: Lyla, Holographic Assistant
text: "I'm a 22nd century Lyrate Life-form Approximation. I already know what you need before you do."

name: Spider-Man 2099, Miguel O'Hara
text: "Lyla, did it work? Are we in the Heroic Age?"

name: Grendel, Spawn of Knull
text: An ancient terror from beyond the stars now awakens to ravage the world.

name: Carnage Tyrant
text: Outsiders may marvel at the Sun Empire's "domesticated" dinosaurs, but those who live alongside them know they can never truly be tamed.

name: Chrome Mox
text: Ferren Gibrar's award-winning invention from the Inventor's Fair-now available to the general public.

name: Skysovereign, Consul Flagship
text: Engineers take inspiration form nature when it comes to efficiency and aerodynamics. Why not intimidation too?

name: Eerie Ultimatum
text:
"We are the voice of the untethered and lost ancestors. The memory of the Abzan. We guide those that yet live."
—Betor

name: Emergent Ultimatum
text:
"I will give you a fair and beautiful judgment."
—Teval

name: Genesis Ultimatum
text:
"We sing and the chorus of creation responds."
—Ureni

name: Inspired Ultimatum
text:
"The Way tells us we must strive towards unity of mind. Through shared understanding, we may yet put an end to strife on Tarkir."
—Shiko

name: Ruinous Ultimatum
text:
"Strength comes from community. Together, we can destroy any enemy."
—Neriv

name: Arid Mesa
text:
"This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan. How I have outgrown her."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Marsh Flats
text:
"We remember all the world has endured, everything it has gone through to bring us to today. We are proud of Tarkir."
—Betor

name: Misty Rainforest
text: In the mist, turbulent enough to deafen. Beneath the boughs, serene enough to soothe.

name: Scalding Tarn
text:
"I came here often to meditate on Ojutai's teachings. Now, I must also consider his failings."
—Narset

name: Verdant Catacombs
text: Where dragonlords once schemed, their memory now dissipates.

name: Polyraptor
text: If you see one, you're already surrounded.

name: Idyllic Tutor
text: With every morningtide, Eirdu sheds a single wish for one lucky enough to catch it.

name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
text: The thoughtweft guides his hands with the will of an entire clachan, so his strikes land ever true.

name: Bitterblossom
text:
"It's true, the more painful the sacrifice, the more beautiful the outcome. What would you give for your desires to become reality?"
—Maralen, fae ascendant

name: Faerie Macabre
text: She is drawn to those dreams found only in the eternal sleep.

name: Goblin Chieftain
text: Rotscab looked ridiculous, and his warren-mates were unbearably envious.

name: Goblin Sharpshooter
text: Shadowmoor boggarts fondly remember their first kill. And their second. And their third . . .

name: Heat Shimmer
text: For one glorious moment, the flamekin's heart showed him his blazing potential.

name: Devoted Druid
text: Lasting beauty is to give more than you take.

name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
text: "Change is hard, but necessary. We must realize a world in which elves are guided not by superiority but by harmony."

name: Regal Force
text: Not as old as the yews, nor as strong as the giants, nor as discerning as the elves, yet lord over them all.

name: Manamorphose
text: "No, Oona was not the source of this world's magic. I hear the land's heart beating to a more primal rhythm."

name: Slippery Bogle
text: During the Invasion, the Phyrexians agreed there were some things that were not worth *compleating*.

name: Dolmen Gate
text: Few giants remember the magic woven into the stone gates, the final gift of a wandering ascetic who died eons ago.

name: Painter's Servant
text: A wandering palette seeking a master's hand to give it purpose.

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
text: Was it a thousand years old, or would it make you live for a thousand years? The boggart didn't ask.

name: Eye of Ugin
text: Droplets of an idea pool, until the dam breaks and the flood is unleashed.

name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
text: "When you go where the currents take you, you'll never run short of things to discover."

name: Flesh Duplicate
text: Replace the broken now, mend the cracks in the foundation.

name: Consign to Memory
text: Walls to hold the unsightly past at bay, a new truth painted within.

name: Consider
text: A moment's pause, doubt chips away the facade, the thin veneer exposed.

name: Mind Twist
text: The doubt expunged, the walls restored, memory molded like clay.

name: Splinter Twin
text: The clay is nothing without a hand to shape, the shape yielding until forged in fire.

name: Root Maze
text: A new foundation. A new beginning. But still, cracks. Cracks leaking a thought, an idea.

name: Mana Crypt
text: Many of the ancient civilizations beneath Ixalan were destroyed by outside forces. Others tapped into power they found they could not control.

name: Desertion
text:
"It is one thing to run away. It is quite another to escape your fate."
—Oko

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: "It's downright selfish to die with full pockets."

name: Port Razer
text: "We're taking back what's ours. And a little bit of what's yours."

name: Scapeshift
text:
"These people come from their cities and think to tame the wilderness. They forget that here, the wilderness has a head start."
—Selvala

name: Mystic Snake
text: Travelers who have reached the headwaters of Fool's Fall say that strange serpents dwell in the waters there, though none can recall any more than that.

name: Notion Thief
text: "All these childhood memories are getting in the way of the vault codes."

name: Desert
text:
"Only a fool goes out there unprepared. If the heat doesn't get you, the time alone with your thoughts likely will."
—Ertha Jo, frontier mentor

name: Prismatic Vista
text: When Kellan let his eyes wander to the horizon, he saw a land whose destiny was as uncertain as his own.

name: Thought-Knot Seer
text: Its gaze gifts you with knowledge no mortal mind should possess.

name: Prismatic Ending
text: Sagas sing of realms long forgotten, shattered by doomskars and cleaved violently from the World Tree.

name: Dismember
text:
"No one has heard Drivnod speak. But we have seen him do unspeakable things. As he drifts over Ish Sah, a deathly whisper rides the wind. I can never watch for long—I turn away and hide."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

name: Persist
text:
"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

name: Expressive Iteration
text: "Art exposes truth. Each step of my dance brings me closer to the secrets of the universe."

name: Pitiless Plunderer
text: "The trick to getting the biggest share is to be the last one standing."

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "I'm not as quick as I used to be, but the wheat doesn't mind."

name: Ledger Shredder
text: "Pah! You call this a comprehensive? I call this nest-stuffing!"

name: Rat Colony
text: For every five you see, there are fifty you don't.

name: Relentless Rats
text: Each of them is a bad influence on the rest.

name: Kindred Charge
text:
"Anyone can live next door, but when you fight to defend your neighbors, you become a village."
—Rho, veteran hero

name: Sylvan Tutor
text: The magic of the land is a thread that weaves all of Valley into a tapestry, connecting even the most distant of friends.

name: Frogmite
text:
"It started as a prototype for a frog diving suit, but the internal mechanisms didn't leave room for the frog."
—Fitzwhisker, otterfolk inventor

name: Soul Warden
text: The group called the Benefactors offers what aid and protection it can to other survivors, marking precious safe zones with the sign of the flame.

name: Expropriate
text: Even those who think they have nothing have something left to lose.

name: Damnation
text: Bound to a single house, Valgavoth simply expanded its boundaries until it consumed the plane, turning a vibrant world into his playground of terror.

name: Sacrifice
text: Cultists eagerly undergo the Rite of the Threshold, allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.

name: Unholy Heat
text: He turns every room into a crematorium.

name: Collected Company
text: Survivors who stay together, slay together.

name: Noxious Revival
text:
"Nothing I beat down stays down. I love this place!"
—Tyvar

name: Condemn
text:
"Cyclical as the passing of days, the fiend would return again. And like the sun rising, so would a champion to slay it."
—*Heroics: A Book of Fables*

name: Sphinx's Tutelage
text: Sailors swear by the Sphinx's stars, which always seem to point the way home.

name: Grim Tutor
text:
"I freely trade away my breaths, for the only one I must keep is my last."
—Sopia, Skelle cleric

name: Goblin Bushwhacker
text: "Follow me. I know these hills like the back of my stabbing knife."

name: Bloom Tender
text: Within sky-scraping gardens, New Capenna's fashionable druids maintain the last ties to the war-ravaged land their ancestors left behind.

name: Rampaging Ferocidon
text: Unlike their pack-hunting kin, ferocidons stalk in solitude and lash out at everything that approaches.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "Hello again, my metamorphic friends. What stories have you brought to tell me today?"

name: Akroma's Memorial
text:
"Those who do evil shall face wrath unrelenting."
—Memorial inscription

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: "Proper chronomancy research can't be rushed. Luckily, I've got all the time in the world."

name: Thoughtcast
text: "Exist in the moment. Ignore the world around you. Embrace the one truth of reality, that all life is motion."

name: Bone Miser
text: "I scream, you scream, we all scream... forever."

name: Galvanic Blast
text: "Where do you think you're going, chum?"

name: Chrome Mox
text: Ferren Gibrar's award-winning invention from the Inventor's Fair-now available to the general public.

name: Skysovereign, Consul Flagship
text: Engineers take inspiration form nature when it comes to efficiency and aerodynamics. Why not intimidation too?
