name: Bone Miser
text: "I scream, you scream, we all scream... forever."

name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
text: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"

name: Peter Parker
text: "This batch of web fluid will just have to wait!"

name: Ezekiel Sims, Spider-Totem
text: For all his wealth and power, there is a fear deep inside Ezekiel that spurs him to train others.

name: Grow Extra Arms
text: "I created that potion to rob me of my spider-powers. I wanted it to change me forever. But not like this! NOT LIKE THIS!"

name: Guy in the Chair
text: "Heads up, Miles. There's a disturbance over on Fifth you might want to check out."

name: Kapow!
text: "People are in danger—I don't have time for your games!"

name: Kraven's Cats
text:
"This time the hunter shall get his prey—with the aid of my two little pets!"
—Kraven the Hunter

name: Lizard, Connors's Curse
text: Dr. Curt Connors used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, but it didn't stop there.

name: Lurking Lizards
text: "The ssserum . . . Connorsss . . . what have you done to usss?!"

name: Miles Morales
text: "You can't call yourself Spider-Man without taking a leap of faith. It's a lot to live up to. But I'm creating an all-new legacy."

name: Rent Is Due
text: "You're a month late again, Parker! Give me my money or you're out on the street!"

name: Professional Wrestler
text:
"Any of you! One-on-one! No one can stay in the ring for three minutes with me!"
—Crusher Hogan

name: Radioactive Spider
text:
"Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?"
—Peter Parker

name: Spider-Man, Brooklyn Visionary
text: "Nothing like a little crimefighting after class."

name: Spider-Rex, Daring Dino
text: On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

name: Strength of Will
text: And then—as the agonizing ache in his limbs seems unendurable—from out of the pain—from out of the agony—comes triumph!

name: Supportive Parents
text:
"Te amamos, mijo."
—Rio Morales

name: Selfless Police Captain
text:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

name: Terrific Team-Up
text:
"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Wall Crawl
text: With the proportionate strength and stickiness of a spider, Spider-Man can scale skyscrapers with ease.

name: Cheering Crowd
text: "We love you, Spider-Man!"

name: Cosmic Spider-Man
text: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

name: Doctor Octopus, Master Planner
text: "Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"

name: Gallant Citizen
text:
"People cheer for that webbed menace. They should be cheering for my son."
—J. Jonah Jameson

name: Silver Sable, Mercenary Leader
text: "I have visual on the target. Wild Pack, provide cover—I'm going in!"

name: Green Goblin, Revenant
text:
"The Green Goblin lives again!"
—Green Goblin, Harry Osborn

name: Jackal, Genius Geneticist
text: For Professor Miles Warren, all any problem needs is a lot of clones and not a lot of ethics.

name: Kraven, Proud Predator
text: The hunter seeks only the greatest prey—only Spider-Man's death will quench Kraven's thirst for glory.

name: Kraven the Hunter
text: "I have found honor, not in the civilized, but in the primal."

name: Mary Jane Watson
text: Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.

name: Mister Negative
text: "Light and dark. They are in opposition, but both are necessary. I am both, and so I am all."

name: Mob Lookout
text:
"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead

name: Morbius the Living Vampire
text: "Nothing matters—except the ravening thirst of Morbius! A thirst which must be quenched!"

name: Prowler, Clawed Thief
text: "It's nothing personal, kid. It's just money."

name: Pumpkin Bombardment
text:
"Happy Halloween, Spider-Man!"
—Green Goblin, Norman Osborn

name: Spectacular Spider-Man
text: "Have no fear. Spidey is here!"

name: Rhino, Barreling Brute
text:
"I'm Rhino. I knock things down. That's what I do. That's who I am."
—Rhino, Aleksei Sytsevich

name: Rhino's Rampage
text: Spider-Man wasn't looking to fight, but that was all Rhino wanted.

name: Scarlet Spider, Kaine
text: Those who cross Kaine are forever marked.

name: Shriek, Treblemaker
text: Exposure to the Darkforce dimension left Frances Barrison craving chaos and carnage.

name: Skyward Spider
text:
"What would Uncle Jonah do if he saw me now?"
—Spider-Woman, Mattie Franklin

name: Spider Manifestation
text: Some spiders feed on *other* spiders.

name: Spider-Girl, Legacy Hero
text: On Earth-982, May "Mayday" Parker, the first child of Peter and Mary Jane, continues her father's legacy.

name: Spectacular Tactics
text:
"Not bad, kid, but you've got a lot to learn."
—Spider-Woman, Jessica Drew

name: Spider-Man India
text: "That's why I do what I do. For my people."

name: Spider-Woman, Stunning Savior
text: To know her is to fear her.

name: The Spot, Living Portal
text: Dr. Johnathon Ohnn had no problem breaking laws, physical or otherwise.

name: Sun-Spider, Nimble Webber
text: Breaking expectations and enjoying it.

name: Superior Spider-Man
text:
"I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man."
—Otto Octavius

name: Ultimate Green Goblin
text: Osborn's lust for power was nothing short of monstrous.

name: Vulture, Scheming Scavenger
text: "For all that web-slinging, Spider-Man, you seldom look up."

name: Web-Warriors
text: Together, this group of amazing friends joined forces to mend the severed skeins across time and space.

name: Spider-Man, Web-Slinger
text: "Nothing like a little crimefighting before class."

name: Wraith, Vicious Vigilante
text: Using tech impounded from her various arrests, Captain Yuri Watanabe took the law into her own hands.

name: Bagel and Schmear
text: No fight in New York City was more vicious than the battle over who made the best bagels.

name: Doc Ock's Tentacles
text: Once powerful tools of science, Dr. Otto Octavius's mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons.

name: Eerie Gravestone
text:
"You've murdered a mask, but you haven't murdered a man."
—Peter Parker

name: Hot Dog Cart
text: "One with everything, please."

name: Interdimensional Web Watch
text: The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.

name: Iron Spider, Stark Upgrade
text: Peter appreciated the powerful new suit sent by Tony Stark, but he soon found it came with some strings attached.

name: Living Brain, Mechanical Marvel
text:
"This was cutting edge when I was a kid!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Mechanical Mobster
text:
"A man-made made man? You always knew how to get ahead, Silvermane."
—Spider-Man

name: News Helicopter
text: "C'mon, we can't let Parker get all the shots of Spider-Man."

name: Spider-UK
text: "Spiders across the Multiverse are dying. I must keep them safe."

name: Passenger Ferry
text:
"Staten Island in peril? Uh, give me an hour?"
—Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy

name: Peter Parker's Camera
text:
"How does Parker get those close-ups?"
—J. Jonah Jameson

name: Spider-Bot
text:
"Parker was a fool to waste his time on patrol. I'll have my spider-bots do it for me."
—Superior Spider-Man, Otto Octavius

name: Spider-Mobile
text: With Johnny Storm's help, Spider-Man took the all-terrain vehicle to the next level.

name: Spider-Slayer, Hatred Honed
text: "With each attempt on Spider-Man's life, my father came closer to ending the menace. It is my pleasure to finish the job."

name: Spider-Suit
text: Nothing beats the classic look.

name: Steel Wrecking Ball
text: "Heads up! It's time for a fast game of catch!"

name: Daily Bugle Building
text: Known as "New York's Finest Newspaper," the *Daily Bugle* takes pride in always being fair and impartial.

name: Starling, Aerial Ally
text:
"Aaaah! Is this what it's like for people I swing around? I'm gonna throw up!"
—Spider-Man, Miles Morales

name: Multiversal Passage
text: New worlds await...

name: Ominous Asylum
text:
"We believe each patient has their own unique path to healing."
—Dr. Ashley Kafka, Ravencroft Institute

name: Savage Mansion
text: Exotic trophies from victorious hunts adorn the walls of the Kravinoff estate.

name: Sinister Hideout
text: Under the sea it stands the hidden headquarters of the Master Planner and his band of strangely-garbed criminals.

name: Suburban Sanctuary
text:
"You are always welcome here, Peter."
—Aunt May

name: University Campus
text: The students and faculty of Empire State University are at the forefront of scientific research...and related pursuits.

name: Urban Retreat
text: For Peter, apartment hunting was about location, location, cost, and location.

name: Vibrant Cityscape
text: If you can make it here, you can make it anywhere.

name: Sudden Strike
text: Sometimes, one decisive blow is all it takes to turn a fight around.

name: Thwip!
text: "Yes! This is what being Spider-Man is all about! Swinging through the sky—a New York sky—patrolling the city. Every moment a chance to make a difference. To fight the good fight."

name: Web Up
text: "Courtesy of your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man."

name: Web-Shooters
text: "A spider needs a web! This little device should just do the trick. I'll fasten one to each arm—it'll operate by the slightest pressure of any finger."

text: Silver Sable doesn't accept second best.

name: Hide on the Ceiling
text:
"Peter? Is that you? I could have sworn I heard that boy moving around up here."
—Aunt May

name: Amazing Acrobatics
text: "Hey, who added these deadly laser beams? Rude."

name: Hydro-Man, Fluid Felon
text:
"Well, I always wanted a waterfront view."
—Spider-Man

name: Impostor Syndrome
text:
"I'm the real Spider-Man!"
"No, *I'm* the real Spider-Man!"

name: Mysterio, Master of Illusion
text:
A skilled showman, Quentin Beck incorporated lights, special effects, holography
... all in the service of a... DRAMATIC... ENTRANCE!

name: Spider-Sense
text: "My spider-sense—it's tingling! Something behind me!"

name: Agent Venom
text: Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

name: Morlun, Devourer of Spiders
text: The Inheritors stalk the Spiders across worlds, feeding on their life force for sustenance.

name: Parker Luck
text: "Things have gotta go my way eventually, right?"

name: Villainous Wrath
text: "You fool! You thought you had won?"

name: Beetle, Legacy Criminal
text: Bored with her humdrum existence, Janice Lincoln sought the thrill of her father's life of crime.

name: J. Jonah Jameson
text: "The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."

name: Shadow of the Goblin
text: "It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."

text: "Danger! But where?"

name: Radioactive Spider
text: Sometimes, destiny bites.

name: Doc Ock, Sinister Scientist
text: "You dared to mock me before. Where are your taunts now, Spider-Man?"

name: Aunt May
text: "I cooked your favorite breakfast, Petey—wheatcakes!"

name: Doc Ock's Henchmen
text: "Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!"

name: Flying Octobot
text:
"How many helping hands do you need, Doc?"
—Spider-Man

name: Hide on the Ceiling
text:
"Peter? Is that you? I could have sworn I heard that boy moving around up here."
—Aunt May

name: Hydro-Man, Fluid Felon
text:
"Well, I always wanted a waterfront view."
—Spider-Man

name: Impostor Syndrome
text:
"I'm the real Spider-Man!"
"No, *I'm* the real Spider-Man!"

name: Mysterio, Master of Illusion
text: A skilled showman, Quentin Beck incorporated lights, special effects, holography . . . all in the service of a . . . DRAMATIC . . . ENTRANCE!

name: Mysterio's Phantasm
text: Mysterio's greatest talent was the ability to instill doubt in one's own senses.

name: City Pigeon
text:
"Aw, that was my lunch!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

name: Oscorp Research Team
text: Norman Osborn relentlessly pursues success, and he demands everyone in his employ do the same.

name: Robotics Mastery
text: Mendel Stromm didn't just seek revenge. He engineered it.

name: School Daze
text:
"Peter possesses a brilliant scientific mind. It's a shame he can't grasp being on time."
—Dr. Curt Connors

name: Spider-Byte, Web Warden
text:
"What better place for a virtual spider than a worldwide web?"
—Spider-Byte, Margo Kess

name: Spider-Man No More
text: "Being Spider-Man has brought me nothing but unhappiness! And for what?"

name: Spider-Sense
text: "My spider-sense—it's tingling! Something behind me!"

name: Unstable Experiment
text:
"The solution is turning green! But . . . why? What does it mean?"
—Norman Osborn

name: Whoosh!
text: "Sorry, I have no time for banter today."

name: Agent Venom
text: Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

name: Behold the Sinister Six!
text:
"Open your eyes to your nightmare, Spider-Man."
—Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius

name: Black Cat, Cunning Thief
text: "Spider-Man, I'm truly sorry for all the bad luck you've been having."

name: Common Crook
text:
"Just taking that money out for a walk?"
—Spider-Man

name: Eddie Brock
text: "I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."

name: Inner Demons Gangsters
text:
"Inner Demons? Even for a guy named Mister Negative, that's a bit on the nose."
—Spider-Man

name: Merciless Enforcers
text:
"Montana, Fancy Dan, Ox... you guys are *so* brave to keep dressing like that. And I'm the one wearing spandex!"
—Spider-Man

name: Morlun, Devourer of Spiders
text: The Inheritors stalk the Spiders across worlds, feeding on their life force for sustenance.

name: Parker Luck
text: "Things have gotta go my way eventually, right?"

name: Prison Break
text:
"Anyone who's tired of the slammer, follow us!"
—Electro, Max Dillon

name: Risky Research
text: "Though others fear radiation, I alone am able to make it my servant!"

name: Scorpion, Seething Striker
text: The scorpion is the natural predator of the spider, and so Mac Gargan hunts.

name: Scorpion's Sting
text: "I'm going to kill you, bug."

name: The Spot's Portal
text:
"You've been working too hard, Spider-Man. I think you deserve a little vacation somewhere you won't be so...in the way."
—The Spot, Johnathon Ohnn

name: Swarm, Being of Bees
text:
"Evil never dies. It just becomes bees."
—Swarm, Fritz von Meyer

name: Flash Thompson, Spider-Fan
text:
"No one cares about your Spider-Man obsession, Flash."
—Liz Allan

name: Tombstone, Career Criminal
text: "I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

name: Venom, Evil Unleashed
text: "We like seeing fear in our victim's eyes."

name: Venomized Cat
text: New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.

name: Venom's Hunger
text: Sinner takes all.

name: Villainous Wrath
text: "You fool! You thought you had won?"

name: Angry Rabble
text: "You're a menace and a crook, Spider-Man! Jameson was right!"

name: Electro's Bolt
text:
"Hey Max, while you're at it, do you mind charging my phone?"
—Spider-Man

name: Gwen Stacy
text: "Spiders don't hold still given any other choice, and I have all the choices in the Multiverse!"

name: Hobgoblin, Mantled Marauder
text:
"Alrighty, let's see who's behind the mask this time. Kingsley, is that you?"
—Spider-Man

name: J. Jonah Jameson
text: "The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."

name: Masked Meower
text: Neither criminals nor veterinarians had much luck pinning down the uncatchable Spider-Cat.

name: Molten Man, Inferno Incarnate
text: Is this it? Is this the end of Spider-Man?

name: Raging Goblinoids
text:
"As if one goblin wasn't bad enough."
—Spider-Man

name: Romantic Rendezvous
text:
"Face it, tiger. You just hit the jackpot!"
—Mary Jane Watson

name: Shadow of the Goblin
text: "It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."

name: Shock
text: If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.

name: Shocker, Unshakable
text: Mock him at your peril.

name: Spider-Gwen, Free Spirit
text: At the edge of the Spider-Verse, a Gwen Stacy becomes a hero.

name: Spider-Islanders
text:
"We've done it, Professor Warren. The glorious metamorphosis of Manhattan has begun!"
—Spider-Queen, Adriana Soria

name: Spider-Punk
text: "Disrespect authority. Smash the system."

name: Spider-Verse
text: Every Spider ever...and then some!

name: Stegron the Dinosaur Man
text: "It isss my intention to return the dinosaur to hisss rightful place as master of thisss earth."

name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
text: Boomerang managed to assemble a squad that really wasn't all that sinister and certainly wasn't all that six.

name: Taxi Driver
text: "I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

name: Wisecrack
text: "I support your right to bear arms, Grizzly, but this is getting ridiculous."

name: Damage Control Crew
text: "We got two hours until Spidey's webbing dissolves. I need engineers on-site now."

name: Blue Elemental Blast
text: "Contrary to popular wisdom, I find it's best to fight fire with its opposite."

name: Brainstorm
text: "I have a plan. Actually, I have three."

name: Mystical Tutor
text: "It's not just what you know. It's knowing where to find what you don't."

name: Threads of Disloyalty
text: "Every thought is a string. You just have to find the right ones to pull."

name: Martyr's Bond
text: "One life at a time. That is how the world will be saved."

name: Rest in Peace
text: "I will keep watch."

name: True Conviction
text: "Heroism is more than a single act; it is hundreds of small decisions, made every day, in pursuit of a heroic cause."

name: Worship
text: Even after all that befell Amonkhet, Gideon never believed that his trust in Oketra was misplaced.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: A weapon of evil, redeemed in Gideon's hand.

name: Cathartic Reunion
text: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

name: Pyroblast
text: "Told you it would melt."

name: Rite of Flame
text: As the flames engulfed her, Chandra opened her heart and offered up her greatest regrets to be consumed by the inferno.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs."
—*Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII*

name: Claim the Firstborn
text:
「ヴィル！フェイの物語があるわ！寝る前に読み聞かせてあげましょうか？」
—-ローアン・ケンリス

name: Faithless Looting
text:
「どうやってそれを手に入れたのだ？ いや、気にするな。答えは聞きたくない。」
—-ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

name: Infuriate
text:
「複雑な魔術と優れた戦術をもって決闘する魔道士もいる。一方で、とにかく怒りに任せるだけの魔道士もいる。」
—-フェラドルンの魔術師の秘密

name: Lightning Bolt
text:
「最初の魔術師は荒れ狂う嵐の怒りを目撃し、それに応えようとした。」
—-嵐大工の文書

name: Shock
text:
「今もなお、天は彼に従っていたのか、彼を攻撃していたのか、私にはわからない。」
—-ラル・ザレックの研究記録

name: Stone Rain
text:
「こうして、空槌のブルクはその燃える一瞬で称号と勝利の両方を手にした。」
—-戦呪文撮要

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
「何ができるかという可能性に心が揺さぶられないなら、なぜストリクスヘイヴンに来たのか？」
—-プリズマリの学部長、ナサーリ

name: Adventurous Impulse
text:
「彼女の探検は、すべての探検と同様に、予期せぬ方向への小さな一步から始まった。」
—-探検者の遺言

name: Channel
text:
「呼吸しているかぎり、お前にはまだ貢献できるものがある。」
—-ウィザーブルームの学部長、ヴァレンティン

name: Cultivate
text:
「たったひとつの植物が教えてくれることの多さに驚くと思います。」
――ウィザーブルームの学部長、リセッテ

name: Harmonize
text:
「侵略の血まみれの喧騒が消え
そして再び静かな歌が森の中に鳴り響く。」
—-「フレイアリーズの歌」

name: Krosan Grip
text:
「時がばらばらに引き裂かれた世界では、破壊がすべての心を支配した。」
—-多元宇宙の形而上史学

name: Natural Order
text:
「自然は残酷でも親切でもない。感情ではなく、必要性に応じて機能するのよ。」
――ウィザーブルームの魔道生徒、ダイナ

name: Regrowth
text:
「何世紀も続く競争がアルケヴィオスを破壊した。しかしひとつの種が、長い再生の道を歩み始めた。」
—-神秘の時代：呪文物語

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
"Five suns! Can you even imagine how complicated the orbital calculations must be? What I wouldn't give to tackle an equation like that!"
—Zimone, Quandrix mage-student

name: Snakeskin Veil
text:
「大蛇の親切は決して拒否してはならない。それは二度と施されることがないのだから。」
—-ドルイドの写本の欠片

name: Weather the Storm
text:
「刃も嵐も、穏やかな心の静けさを攻撃することはできない。」
—-ターラウの彫刻

name: Despark
text:
「屈辱を受けてすべての力を失った暴君の話？ それだけで刺激的だよ！」
——シルバークイルの魔道生徒、キリアン

name: Electrolyze
text:
「水圧式パワーグリップは失敗だったが、その電手は大きな成功だった。」
—-首席イズマグナスの日誌

name: Growth Spiral
text:
「たったひとつのシダの渦から、今まで読んだどんな本よりも深い洞察を得ました。」
—-クアンドリクスの学部長、キアン

name: Lightning Helix
text:
「血の時代の魔術師は、敵に雷雨を降らせていたという。我々もその技を模倣できるはずだ。」
—ロアホールドの魔道生徒、ドラディエル

name: Putrefy
text:
「王から肥料に、できるだけ早く。」
—-退位させる者のグリモワール

name: Brainstorm
text:
"Infinite ideas flow through the Multiverse, waiting for an open mind."
—*The Biblioplex: An Introduction*

name: Compulsive Research
text:
"Every Planeswalker remembers the first time their mind touched the staggering vastness of the Multiverse."
—Kasmina

name: Counterspell
text:
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates."
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean

name: Memory Lapse
text:
"Where do our forgotten thoughts go? I knew once, but I can't remember."
—Director Taiva, journal entry

name: Negate
text:
"Shatter your opponent's spell with enough force, and you'll shatter their confidence with it."
—*Tome of Obstructions*, marginalia

name: Opt
text:
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny."
—*Aethershrine*, inscription

name: Day of Judgment
text:
"This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog."
—Director Taiva, to Isabough

name: Strategic Planning
text:
"I can offer only information, young one. What path you choose is up to you."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

name: Time Warp
text:
"Chronomancers have a rather different definition of living in the moment."
—*The Millennium Tome*

name: Whirlwind Denial
text:
"If they try to storm your palace, you must become the storm."
—*Handbook of Imperial Spellcraft*

name: Agonizing Remorse
text:
"Guilt is not absolution. Regret is not justice. But it is right that you suffer."
—Extus Narr

name: Crux of Fate
text:
"One brother fought for the sake of the Multiverse. The other for himself."
—*The Elderspell Parable*

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?"
—*Incantations of Lim-Dûl*

name: Demonic Tutor
text:
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled."
—Scroll case inscription

name: Doom Blade
text:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis

name: Duress
text:
"Magic brought peace to the Vastlands but was soon corrupted."
—*The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells*

name: Defiant Strike
text:
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn."
—*Heroics: A Book of Fables*

name: Eliminate
text:
"It takes so little energy to erase a person. It's almost like the universe doesn't care that they existed at all."
—Extus Narr

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text:
"To dwell within the Blind Eternities is unthinkable. To encounter those who do could shatter the mind."
—*Chronicle of the Titans*

name: Sign in Blood
text:
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions."
—Shaile, Silverquill dean

name: Village Rites
text:
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Chaos Warp
text:
"Be careful when handling old magical trinkets. You never know who they've been."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Claim the Firstborn
text:
"Will! They have a copy of *Tales of the Fae* here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?"
—Rowan Kenrith

name: Faithless Looting
text:
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know."
—Plargg, Lorehold dean

name: Divine Gambit
text:
"Evil is to be unshackled, not slain. Unlock your foe and release the miracle within."
—Keevan, docent of Kollema Hall

name: Infuriate
text:
"Some mages duel using intricate spellcraft and superior tactics. Others just get really, really mad."
—*Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers*

name: Lightning Bolt
text:
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back."
—*The Stormwright Texts*

name: Shock
text:
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him."
—Ral Zarek, research notes

name: Stone Rain
text:
"Thus, Bruk the Skyhammer earned his epithet and won the war, all in one fiery moment."
—*Compendium of Warspells*

name: Thrill of Possibility
text:
"If the prospect of what could be doesn't electrify you to your core, why attend Strixhaven at all?"
—Nassari, Prismari dean

name: Adventurous Impulse
text:
"Her quest began as all quests do, with one small step in an unexpected direction."
—*The Explorer's Testament*

name: Channel
text:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

name: Cultivate
text:
"You'd be amazed how much a single plant has to teach you."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

name: Harmonize
text:
"The bloody din of invasion faded
And silent song rang through the woods again."
—"Song of Freyalise"

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all."
—*Multiversal Metahistories*

name: Natural Order
text:
"Nature is neither cruel nor kind. It operates on necessity, not sentiment."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

name: Regrowth
text:
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal."
—*The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells*

name: Snakeskin Veil
text:
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment

name: Weather the Storm
text:
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind."
—*The Turrau Carvings*

name: Despark
text:
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!"
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

name: Gift of Estates
text:
"We asked for a home and received the world."
—*Scroll of Nine Blessings*

name: Electrolyze
text:
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

name: Growth Spiral
text:
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

name: Lightning Helix
text:
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique."
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

name: Putrefy
text:
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be."
—*The Dethroner's Grimoire*

name: Day of Judgment
text:
「これは公になってはいけない。このような呪文の影響は大きすぎる。制限付きのアーカイブに保管して、カタログ上の記録を破壊しなさい。」
――タイヴァ校長からイサボウへ

name: Defiant Strike
text:
「十二日間休みなく、ソマとは怪物の殻を攻撃した。十三日間のあさ、それは夜明けとともにひび割れた。」
—-英雄伝：寓話の書

name: Divine Gambit
text:
「悪は殺されるのではなく、解き放たれるべきだ。敵を解放し、内にある奇跡を解き放つのだ。」
—-コレム堂の講師、ケーヴァン

name: Gift of Estates
text:
「家を願い世界を受け取った。」
—-九つの祝福の巻物

name: Mana Tithe
text:
「暴君の怒鳴り声は、最後の財宝がその手を逃げ出すと、次第に泣き言になりました。」
——退位させる者のグリモワール

name: Revitalize
text:
「騎士カスリンは目を閉じ、最期を覚悟すました。再びめを開けると、勝利を勝ちっていたのです。」
—-癒し手のタダス、回顧録

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: 「刃使いは新たな敵へと怒りを向けた。根腐りとキャベジのナメクジだ。」 ー神話と奇跡、第七巻

name: Blue Sun's Zenith
text:
「五つの太陽よ！軌道計算がどんなに複雑か想像できる？そんな方程式に挑戦できるというなら、何だって差し出すわ！」
——クアンドリクスの魔導生徒、ジモーン

name: Brainstorm
text:
「無限の考えが多元宇宙を流れ、開かれた心を待っている。」
—-ビブリオプレックス：序論

name: Compulsive Research
text:
「プレインズウォーカーは皆、多元宇宙の驚異的な広大さに初めて精神が触れたときのことを覚えているわ。」
――カズミナ

name: Counterspell
text:
「効果を抑えるために、呪文の詳細を知る必要ありません。呪文が操作する現実の規則を再配置するだけでいいのです。」
——クアンドルクスの学部長、イムブラハム

name: Memory Lapse
text:
「我々が忘れてしまった考えはどこへ行ってすまったのだ？かつて知っていたことが思い出せない。」
——タイヴァ校長の日記

name: Mana Tithe
text:
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp."
—*The Dethroner's Grimoire*

name: Negate
text:
「十分な力で対戦相手の呪文を打ち砕けば、それで自信も打ち砕けるでしょう。」
—-障害の秘本、傍注

name: Opt
text: 「最もよく叶う願いは、自らの運命を選択したいという願いだ。」

name: Strategic Planning
text:
「私が与えられるのは情報だけよ。どの道を選ぶかはあなたの自由。」
——アルケヴィオスの神託者、ジャジ

name: Time Warp
text:
「時間術士は、刹那に生きるということに関して特殊な定義を持っています。」
—-千年秘本

name: Whirlwind Denial
text:
「彼らがあなたの宮殿を荒らそうとするなら、あなたが嵐にならなければなりません。」
—-帝国魔術の手引き

name: Agonizing Remorse
text:
「罪悪感は赦しではない。後悔は正義ではない。だたし、苦しむことは正しい。」
—-エクスタス・ナー

name: Crux of Fate
text:
「兄弟の一人は多元宇宙のために戦った。もう一人は自分のために。」
――*古呪の寓話*

name: Dark Ritual
text:
「奴らは私の方法を信用していない。しかし成果が必要なとき、奴らが探すの誰だと思う？」
——リム＝トゥールの決まり文句

name: Revitalize
text:
"Knight Kathryn closed her eyes, bracing herself for the end. When she opened them again, she stood triumphant over her foe."
—Thadus the Healer, *Memoirs*

name: Demonic Tutor
text: 「悪魔は、自分が賢く、騙されることなどないと信じている者を好む。」 ー巻物入れに刻まれた言葉

name: Doom Blade
text:
「天使は太陽のように輝き、弱者を鼓舞し、暗闇を脅かし勝利を手にすることできる。しかし、結局そんなことは重要ではない。それでも最後は他の害虫と同じように死ぬのだから。」
——オブ・ニクシリス

name: Duress
text:
「魔法は大界に平和をもたらしたが、すぐに腐敗した。」
——神秘の時代：呪文物語

name: Eliminate
text:
「人を消すのにほとんどエネルギーはいらない。稀で宇宙がその存在を全く気にしてないかのようにな。」
——エクスタス・ナー

name: Inquisition of Kozilek
text:
「久遠の闇の中に住むなど考えられない。精神を打ち砕く奴らに遭遇するなど。」
——タイタン年代記

name: Sign in Blood
text:
「最悪の決断をするのは、いつも最も優秀な生徒です。」
——シルバークイル学部長、シェイル

name: Village Rites
text:
「同僚たちは血の時代の野蛮さを避難しているが、俺は無限に続く戦争の魔法から学べることは多いと思っている。」
——シルバークイルの学部長、エムブローズ

name: Chaos Warp
text:
「古い魔法の小物を扱うときは注意してください。それが以前に何者だったか分かりませんから。」
—-ロアホールドの学部長、オーガスタ

name: Bandage
text: Takara shook with guilt. She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

name: Wall of Razors
text:
"In this blessed structure let the very walls baptize themselves in the blood of intruders."
—Stronghold architect, journal

name: Awakening
text:
"There are times when destiny calls forth a people and demands an action. *Now* is the time. *We* are the people. *This* is our action. Charge!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Burgeoning
text:
"The plants said, 'We will fight the stone with root and stem and seed. We are patient. We will win.'"
—Skyshroud myth of the forest

name: Carnassid
text: The hunter would never forget the time or place where he first met the carnassid, for they buried him there.

name: Crossbow Ambush
text:
There is no drake that flies faster than a crossbow bolt.
—Vec saying

name: Elven Rite
text: As the bough stretches, so shall you grow. As the roots spread, so shall you thrive.

name: Endangered Armodon
text: These are its last days. Its doom to be remembered only until the hunters hunger again.

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Lowland Basilisk
text: Unlike their cousins, Rathi basilisks turn their victims into puddles of flowstone.

name: Rolling Stones
text: Walls collapse and kill people all the time. Some are just more aggressive about it.

name: Mulch
text: Hope is the one crop that can grow in any climate.

name: Overgrowth
text: Life needs no encouragement.

name: Primal Rage
text: "Charge!" A great cry went out, and countless elves and Vec soldiers charged up the mountain. Their fury and passion hid the fact that they were horribly outnumbered.

name: Provoke
text: Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

name: Skyshroud Archer
text: In Rath, arrows are guided not by virtue but by necessity.

name: Skyshroud Troopers
text:
"We were not made for war. Like flowstone, Volrath shaped us to it."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Sacred Ground
text:
"That which knows itself cannot be shaped to another's will."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'"
—Dal myth of the wurm

name: Volrath's Gardens
text: "Watch yourself," warned Starke. "These plants aren't nice when they're hungry."

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Acidic Sliver
text: The first sliver burst against the cave wall, and others piled in behind to deepen the new tunnel.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Hibernation Sliver
text: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

name: Sliver Queen
text: Her children are ever part of her.

name: Samite Blessing
text:
Knit bone, darn flesh, Stitch skin, weave breath.
—Samite healing ritual

name: Spined Sliver
text:
"Slivers are evil and slivers are sly; And if you get eaten, then no one will cry."
—Mogg children's rhyme

name: Victual Sliver
text: "We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen. "Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole."

name: Bullwhip
text:
"Pain is a crude way to enforce obedience, but it is cheap and plentiful."
—Volrath

name: Ensnaring Bridge
text:
"I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself."
—Gerrard

name: Heartstone
text:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna

name: Horn of Greed
text:
"Rath grows, and I am nourished."
—Volrath

name: Scapegoat
text: "Enjoy your deception, Vuel," Gerrard said as Volrath's features melted from the dead shapeshifter. "I'll count this one as practice."

name: Shifting Wall
text:
"You'd almost think Volrath doesn't want me here."
—Gerrard

name: Sword of the Chosen
text: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

name: Volrath's Stronghold
text: The seed of a world's evil.

name: Skyshroud Falcon
text:
The falcon slits the sky to let the light drip through.
—Kor saying

name: Smite
text:
"You've got your childhood wish at last. Now you get to die."
—Gerrard, to Volrath

name: Spirit en-Kor
text:
Death free throat from thirst, mouth from speech, feet from earth.
—Kor requiem

name: Temper
text:
"I don't need a plan, just a goal. The rest will follow on its own."
—Gerrard

name: Venerable Monk
text: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

name: Wall of Essence
text:
The ceiling and the floor fell in love, but only the wall knew.
—Dal saying

name: Warrior en-Kor
text: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

name: Warrior Angel
text: She represents not hope, but hope's desperate fury.

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Cloud Spirit
text:
Clouds are the soil, dreams are the crop.
—Kor saying

name: Contempt
text:
"Predictable little man. In all these years you taught me so much yet learned so little."
—Volrath, to Starke

name: Dream Halls
text: Within without.

name: Dream Prowler
text:
"To think that some find sleep a restful state."
—Volrath

name: Evacuation
text: The first step of every exodus is from the blood and the fire onto the trail.

name: Hammerhead Shark
text: Cross the eyes of a hammerhead and you'll dot its teeth.

name: Hesitation
text: Gerrard hesitated, looking up at the enemy ship. The future hesitated with him, changed forever by the pause.

name: Intruder Alarm
text: Mirri was startled by Volrath's apparition—it had no scent.

name: Leap
text: Mirri leapt quickly and silently. The guard died likewise.

name: Mana Leak
text:
"The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy."
—Volrath

name: Contemplation
text:
"How fascinating it is to watch the machinations of one's own mind play themselves out."
—Volrath

name: Rebound
text: Insult, like an arrow, is beyond control once loosed.

name: Sift
text:
"Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Spindrift Drake
text: Sea brine for blood, washing foam for laughter.

name: Tidal Surge
text:
"It is nature that gives us our boundaries and nature that enforces them."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Tidal Warrior
text: The tide of battle favors those who can swim.

name: Walking Dream
text: Dreams, by definition, live shorter lives than those who dream them.

name: Conviction
text: It was not the minotaur's shoulders but his soul that bore the heaviest weight.

name: Wall of Tears
text:
"Many have been lost to pity."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Bottomless Pit
text:
"I'm sure it came with the place. I don't think you build one on purpose."
—Gerrard

name: Cannibalize
text: "Mine."

name: Dauthi Trapper
text: Merfolk tell their young of Dandân, humans of Rag Man. Dal tell tales of the Dauthi, and they are far worse.

name: Death Stroke
text: For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home. As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

name: Dungeon Shade
text: A sickness stirs in its eyes, a nightmare born in darkened wails.

name: Foul Imp
text: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

name: Hidden Retreat
text: After an hour in the hidey-hole, Squee seriously pondered the advantages of danger over boredom.

name: Grave Pact
text:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax

name: Megrim
text: "You can run from your pain," explained Gerrard to Crovax, "but take it from experience: you will tire before it does."

name: Morgue Thrull
text: It's so hard to find good help these days.

name: Mortuary
text:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

name: Rabid Rats
text: Every sentence in Volrath's prisons ends the same way.

name: Revenant
text:
"Not again."
—Hans

name: Serpent Warrior
text: A hiss before dying.

name: Honor Guard
text:
"It is not a choice I make, to have this guard. It is the choice of my people, and my duty to them."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Stronghold Assassin
text: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

name: Stronghold Taskmaster
text:
"With the completion of each joyous task, we are closer to Yawgmoth's divine vision."
—Stronghold architect, journal

name: Torment
text:
"Volrath has killed me. All that remains of me is the scar!"
—Tahngarth

name: Tortured Existence
text:
"There are terrors lurking in the unseen corners of us all."
—Crovax

name: Wall of Souls
text:
"It is the nature of evil to turn you against yourself."
—Starke

name: Amok
text: Crovax's rage was horrifying. Within moments only blood and shreds of flesh remained of the shapeshifter.

name: Craven Giant
text:
What is high as a mountain and low as a snake?
—Dal riddle

name: Duct Crawler
text:
"The mountain's ducts will be like organ pipes, amplifying the glorious roar of the dying."
—Stronghold architect, journal

name: Lancers en-Kor
text: Nearly all sets of Kor twins are trained as lancers.

name: Flame Wave
text:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Fling
text: It's raining rats and moggs.

name: Flowstone Blade
text:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Flowstone Hellion
text: Volrath leaves no stone untrained.

name: Flowstone Mauler
text: Once these horrifying creatures were perfected, there was no need for armodons.

name: Flowstone Shambler
text: Flowstone troops are notoriously difficult to keep in formation.

name: Furnace Spirit
text: If it can survive the Furnace, you don't want it near you.

name: Heat of Battle
text: "Takara, it's me!" shouted Starke. It was no use—she obeyed Volrath.

name: Invasion Plans
text: Gerrard studied the globe as Mirri kept watch. Suddenly, his eyes widened. "This is Dominaria!"

name: Nomads en-Kor
text: The Kor forsake roots for the winding of the path; forsake voices for the silence of the mind; forsake all else for the poverty of isolation.

name: Mob Justice
text: A single stone can start an avalanche.

name: Mogg Bombers
text: Behind every great mogg bomber is another mogg with a shovel and a basket.

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Mogg Maniac
text: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

name: Ruination
text:
"We have built a wall upon sand. The wall will vanish. The sand will remain."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Shock
text:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

name: Environmental Sciences
text: First-years quickly learn how the Vastlands earned its name.

name: Clever Lumimancer
text: "You're too dim to realize it, but you've already lost."

name: Explosive Welcome
text: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.

name: Fuming Effigy
text: Some spirits share ancient wisdom. Others just get mad you touched their stuff.

name: Grinning Ignus
text: On rare occasions, a Prismari student will summon an elemental that shows such promise that it's permitted to stay and enroll.

name: Hall Monitor
text: "No unauthorized summoning. No writing in the library books. And absolutely no indoor dueling!"

name: Heated Debate
text: "While you were wasting time with abstract equations, I mastered ancient Oggyar fire magic. Your move."

name: Igneous Inspiration
text: Prismari fosters a burning need to create.

name: Illuminate History
text: "Look at the detail in this stonework! Professor, our assumptions about early Kathorran tool use may not be correct."

name: Illustrious Historian
text: The most distinguished Lorehold professors are eligible to receive extended tenure, even beyond the limits of their own mortality.

name: Combat Professor
text: "Before Yovus was cut down at Pranticle Peak, she performed which maneuver? Anyone? From the reading?"

name: Mascot Interception
text: Far from the trappings of royalty, Rowan and Will found inspiration from the most popular sport on campus, Mage Tower.

name: Pigment Storm
text: When art projects collapse, Prismari students revel in the beauty of destruction. Everyone else runs for cover.

name: Pillardrop Warden
text: A giant statue of a dwarf is still a giant statue.

name: Start from Scratch
text: "I don't care what they think!" Rootha snapped. "I know I can do better."

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Sudden Breakthrough
text: Rootha created constantly, passionately, in hopes of impressing her greatest critic: herself.

name: Tome Shredder
text:
"Quintorius, would you care to explain why you didn't complete your homework?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Twinscroll Shaman
text: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"

name: Accomplished Alchemist
text: "Tincture of murkroot and lizard feet? Simple. One that doesn't taste like murkroot and lizard feet? I'm working on it."

name: Defend the Campus
text: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

name: Basic Conjuration
text: "I made that! It's mine! Did you see that?"

name: Bayou Groff
text:
"Groffs are great for tracking pests through the muck, but securing the pests before the groff devours them is a dicey endeavor."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

name: Big Play
text:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

name: Bookwurm
text: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.

name: Charge Through
text:
"What a move! Lorehold gets caught flat-footed, and Witherbloom barrels ahead."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

name: Containment Breach
text: For pestkeepers, there's no sound more disheartening than breaking glass.

name: Devouring Tendrils
text: Witherbloom spells often take on the appearance—and personality—of their components.

name: Dragonsguard Elite
text: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

name: Exponential Growth
text: Most Quandrix students fundamentally disagree with the concept of "enough."

name: Fortifying Draught
text: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."

name: Gnarled Professor
text: "Class is in season."

name: Honor Troll
text: First in his clan to attend Strixhaven, and now first in his class.

name: Karok Wrangler
text:
"She showed up to class on a what?"
—Valentin, Witherbloom Dean

name: Leyline Invocation
text:
"Do you still believe my work is nothing but dry, boring equations?"
—Cairu, Quandrix mage-student

name: Mage Duel
text: "Remember the rules. No spells to the face!"

name: Master Symmetrist
text: Tondo lost his very first duel and has spent his entire life trying to get even.

name: Professor of Zoomancy
text: She's brilliant, if a bit overbearing.

name: Reckless Amplimancer
text: "Linear growth? What am I, a first-year?"

name: Scurrid Colony
text: Scurrid teeth evolved to crack open nuts, but they work just as well for crushing bones if the nest is threatened.

name: Spined Karok
text:
"The bogs are deeper than you realize. Most of the space beneath the surface is taken up by these enormous karoks. You might think your feet are touching the bottom. They're probably not."
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

name: Springmane Cervin
text: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.

name: Tangletrap
text:
"It's like that old saying: what goes up . . . feeds the arboretum."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

name: Augmenter Pugilist
text: "Hold still. I have a theory about what's going to happen to your face."

name: Blex, Vexing Pest
text: Pests are typically harvested before they outgrow their enclosures. Blex is far from typical.

name: Extus, Oriq Overlord
text: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."

name: Flamescroll Celebrant
text: "Stand up and fight!"

name: Selfless Glyphweaver
text: He offered his light to make sure no others would be dimmed.

name: Shaile, Dean of Radiance
text: "You are so much stronger than you know."

name: Eager First-Year
text: Today, she learns the basics. She'll knock out advanced theory later this week.

name: Aether Helix
text: Some Quandrix mages prefer to study at twilight, watching their experimental equations trace glowing trails against the encroaching darkness.

name: Biomathematician
text: "I will reach infinity."

name: Blade Historian
text: "So you see, the reckless battle strategy of the Kathorran orcs was effective, but ultimately proved to be a double-edged sword. As did their double-edged swords."

name: Blood Researcher
text: "Dean Valentin warns us not to consume the samples for our safety, but I think he's just being greedy."

name: Blot Out the Sky
text: A drop of ink is a nuisance. A torrent of inklings is a menace.

name: Body of Research
text: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.

name: Closing Statement
text: "In conclusion . . ."

name: Elite Spellbinder
text: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI

name: Cram Session
text: The only thing more delicious than a top grade is Gyome's signature cake.

name: Culling Ritual
text: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

name: Culmination of Studies
text: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.

name: Daemogoth Titan
text:
"Of course it offered you power. Demons always do. But trust me—the sweeter the prize, the more ruinous the price."
—Professor Onyx

name: Daemogoth Woe-Eater
text: "Your pain for my wisdom. You'll get no better deal."

name: Deadly Brew
text: No one ever asked what was in Dina's concoctions, so long as they worked.

name: Decisive Denial
text: "I've heard enough."

name: Double Major
text: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"

name: Expel
text: Quintorius was a daydreamer, far happier digging through history books than practicing battle tactics. He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.

name: Dramatic Finale
text: The enraptured audience barely noticed their programs were suddenly blank.

name: Elemental Masterpiece
text: Rootha passed with flying, living colors.

name: Elemental Summoning
text:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

name: Eureka Moment
text: "At first, the equations were simply numbers. But in those numbers I saw a story, and in that story I saw a pattern, and suddenly it all fit together!"

name: Exhilarating Elocution
text: His words poured forth on waves of golden light, scouring all fear from his audience's hearts and minds.

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Fractal Summoning
text:
"Fractals are just pseudo-dimensional manifestations of asynchronous biosymmetries. It's really quite simple."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

name: Fracture
text:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

name: Guiding Voice
text: When honormancers work together, their compliments are complementary.

name: Golden Ratio
text:
"When I look around, I see a world defined by patterns that still manages to defy them."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

name: Harness Infinity
text:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy

name: Humiliate
text: "Aw, what's that? No comeback?"

name: Infuse with Vitality
text: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.

name: Inkling Summoning
text:
"Think of an insult so vicious, so vulgar, that you hesitate to speak it aloud. The strongest, most aggressive inklings are born from such scorn."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Killian, Ink Duelist
text: "When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option."

name: Lorehold Apprentice
text: Ancient footfalls echo in her head, their timeless rhythm guiding the present.

name: Expanded Anatomy
text: "Changing the equation from incremental to exponential was a stroke of genius on my part."

name: Leonin Lightscribe
text: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.

name: Lorehold Pledgemage
text: "The weight of history can empower you or it can crush you. It's your choice."

name: Maelstrom Muse
text: She's an inspiration to everyone, even herself.

name: Make Your Mark
text: Those who do learn from history may still choose to repeat it.

name: Manifestation Sage
text: The first thing a Quandrix mage learns is the laws of metaphysics. The second thing is how to break them.

name: Moldering Karok
text: Necroluminescence is common among the undead creatures of Sedgemoor, giving the midnight swamp an eerie glow. It's comforting—from a distance.

name: Mortality Spear
text: "Death is my life's work."

name: Needlethorn Drake
text: As they learn to fly, young drakes have a tendency to accidentally impale trees, cliffs, and unsuspecting students.

name: Oggyar Battle-Seer
text: "May Ganathog bless us with bloody visions of glory restored!"

name: Owlin Shieldmage
text: "Aim higher next time."

name: Pest Summoning
text:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—*Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding*

name: Practical Research
text: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way. Will hit the library. Rowan hit everything else.

name: Prismari Apprentice
text: "No one ever created great art by playing it safe!"

name: Prismari Pledgemage
text: Many have the talent to create, but few have the courage to share their creations.

name: Quandrix Apprentice
text: "The secrets of our world will be mine."

name: Quandrix Cultivator
text: In the gardens spread across the Quandrix campus, fern turns to forest before class is even over.

name: Quandrix Pledgemage
text: "The first step toward transcending physical limitations is discarding assumptions about what is possible."

name: Quintorius, Field Historian
text: "Every life has a story to tell. I won't let them be forgotten."

name: Relic Sloth
text: When it comes to transporting priceless, delicate artifacts, safety is more important than speed.

name: Returned Pastcaller
text: Lorehold spirit statues are not forbidden from raising statues of their own.

name: Rip Apart
text: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

name: Rise of Extus
text: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.

name: Rootha, Mercurial Artist
text: "Art is never finished. Merely abandoned."

name: Rushed Rebirth
text: Witherbloom students learn to see death not as tragedy, but as opportunity.

name: Shadewing Laureate
text: "Would you prefer I destroy you using prose or verse?"

name: Pillardrop Rescuer
text: Gentle hands of stone whisk the careless from the crumbling ruins of Pillardrop.

name: Silverquill Apprentice
text: She had spoken the words a hundred times, but under the spotlight, in front of everyone, something new emerged. And the crowd went wild.

name: Silverquill Pledgemage
text: "I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you."

name: Silverquill Silencer
text: "I am very much in the mood to start handing out expulsions."

name: Spectacle Mage
text: "It would be a crime to withhold my light from the world."

name: Spirit Summoning
text:
"Books are fantastic, but if you're really curious about the distant past, why not ask someone who was there?"
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Spiteful Squad
text: "Don't you know first-years pay a toll to walk through here?"

name: Square Up
text: Sometimes the most radical thing you can do is think inside the box.

name: Stonebound Mentor
text: Quintorius beamed, his mind eager to absorb every historical fact the spirit wanted to divulge.

name: Professor of Symbology
text: "A language isn't dead until we stop learning from it."

name: Teach by Example
text:
"Learning to imitate a master is the first step in becoming one."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

name: Tend the Pests
text: "I've got a special treat for you today."

name: Thrilling Discovery
text:
"This must be the lost city of Zantafar, where my people lived before becoming nomads. Think of the history we'll learn here!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student

name: Vanishing Verse
text: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"

name: Witherbloom Apprentice
text: "All we are—every feeling, every action—powered by a single, delicate little organ. Life is so terrifyingly, beautifully fragile."

name: Witherbloom Pledgemage
text: "Death is really just a transfer of energy. Those pests I harvested have the honor of becoming pure magic. What could be more beautiful?"

name: Reduce to Memory
text:
"Do not flinch from studying the horrors of the past. History's most important lessons are cloaked in terror and tragedy."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Zimone, Quandrix Prodigy
text: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."

name: Biblioplex Assistant
text:
"I appreciate the help, and honestly, it's very entertaining."
—Isabough of the Biblioplex

name: Campus Guide
text: "There's nowhere in Strixhaven I can't find. Where do you need to go?"

name: Cogwork Archivist
text:
"It's the largest library in the Multiverse. Of course it has the largest librarians."
—Kasmina

name: Excavated Wall
text:
"Don't be fooled by the quiet. These old stones are trying to talk to you."
—Augusta, Lorehold dean

name: Letter of Acceptance
text: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven. Will saw a chance for arcane study. Rowan saw a chance for power.

name: Reflective Golem
text: "We don't cut through Sedgemoor anymore. Can't get five steps without a groff trying to fight its own reflection."

name: Secret Rendezvous
text: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage natural rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

name: Team Pennant
text: Choosing a college based on Mage Tower results is discouraged, but not unheard of.

name: Access Tunnel
text: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

name: Frostboil Snarl
text: A smoldering storm of chilling fire.

name: Furycalm Snarl
text: A seething locus of reverent rage.

name: Lorehold Campus
text: Mage-students obsessed with the secrets of the past choose Lorehold, the college of archaeomancy.

name: Necroblossom Snarl
text: A hungry lair of flourishing rot.

name: Prismari Campus
text: Mage-students who see spellcraft as the highest form of expression choose Prismari, the college of elemental arts.

name: Quandrix Campus
text: Mage-students who see the beauty in patterns and equations choose Quandrix, the college of numeromancy.

name: Shineshadow Snarl
text: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

name: Silverquill Campus
text: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

name: Witherbloom Campus
text: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.

name: Elite Spellbinder
text: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI

name: Introduction to Annihilation
text:
"I've never seen a student fail quite so spectacularly. There's potential in that."
—Hostram, professor of arcanochemistry

name: Star Pupil
text: "When I'm done here, they'll name entire buildings after me."

name: Stonebinder's Familiar
text:
"Hey, my great-great-grandfather had a dog just like that!"
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

name: Stonerise Spirit
text: The carved cliffs of Pillardrop thrum with the sounds of ancient spirits rising from the past.

name: Strict Proctor
text: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."

name: Study Break
text: "You've been cramming all night. You're taking a nap whether you like it or not."

name: Arcane Subtraction
text: The class learned little that day.

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Dragonsguard Elite
text: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Fracture
text:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Burrog Befuddler
text: Students who seek river herbs in Doradur quickly find themselves slightly damp and thoroughly surrounded.

name: Mortality Spear
text: "Death is my life's work."

name: Rip Apart
text: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

name: Decisive Denial
text: "I've heard enough."

name: Bury in Books
text: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

name: Introduction to Prophecy
text: Final grades are posted on the first day of class.

name: Curate
text: "*Kathorran War Chants, Vol. III*? That doesn't even belong in this wing!"

name: Divide by Zero
text: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."

name: Frost Trickster
text: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

name: Kelpie Guide
text: Kelpies are drawn to paradoxes, making them ideal companions for Quandrix mages.

name: Mentor's Guidance
text: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply. Strixhaven would test not only their magical potential, but also their character.

name: Mercurial Transformation
text: "For sun's sake, I just want a crab!"

name: Pop Quiz
text: "Today is hydromancy? I thought it was amplimancy! I studied for amplimancy!"

name: Mascot Exhibition
text:
"Don't just win the game. Win the crowd."
—Moriana, Mage Tower coach

name: Reject
text:
"Grux, for the last time, you have to do more than simply shout 'Apply!' at the administrators."
—Pavil, admissions officer

name: Resculpt
text: Critics were struck first by the elemental's surprising grace, and then by its fists.

name: Serpentine Curve
text:
"Math bites."
—Bim, Lorehold mage-student

name: Snow Day
text:
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed."
—Prismari dormitory notice

name: Solve the Equation
text: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.

name: Soothsayer Adept
text: One of the first lessons divination students learn is how to recognize the difference between a portent and a simple surface ripple.

name: Symmetry Sage
text: "By my calculations, I should be able to achieve true enlightenment before graduation."

name: Teachings of the Archaics
text: Mages seek out the ancient beings known as the Archaics for their boundless knowledge of history and magic, dispensed only in cryptic metaphors.

name: Tempted by the Oriq
text: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

name: Wandering Archaic
text: "Fly the path of nine birds."

name: Vortex Runner
text: "By using the vortex, I can study for at least fifteen extra minutes between every class. I wasn't being reckless, Dean Imbraham. I was being efficient."

name: Waterfall Aerialist
text: Form and function in perfect unity.

name: Wormhole Serpent
text: After drownings, devourings, and one highly unpleasant algae infestation, unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.

name: Arrogant Poet
text: "I would be kinder to my peers, Professor, but I simply don't have any."

name: Brackish Trudge
text: Most trudges are covered with decaying plant matter, making them ideal breeding grounds for fungal spores.

name: Confront the Past
text: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"

name: Crushing Disappointment
text: Most students could barely endure Dean Embrose's scrutiny for a semester or two; Killian lived with it his entire life.

name: Essence Infusion
text: "I'd say it's still a fair fight—now my friend is about the size of your ego."

name: Eyetwitch
text: Oculomancers see the ideal potion ingredient. The bats don't see it that way.

name: Flunk
text:
"I assure you, no one fails my course more than once."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Go Blank
text: The only feeling worse than not knowing the answer is the certainty that you once did.

name: Lash of Malice
text:
"The strongest shadow spells come from disdain for someone else, not frustration with yourself."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

name: Leech Fanatic
text: "Everyone thinks that leeches maintain a strictly sanguivorous diet, but in fact, most freshwater leeches are carnivores. Wait, where are you going?"

name: Mage Hunter
text: One of the Oriq's most powerful tools is the mage hunter, a vile monstrosity created to seek out and snuff out the arcane.

name: Mage Hunters' Onslaught
text: Extus stood before his alma mater for a moment, remembering first his studies, then his vengeance. At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

name: Necrotic Fumes
text: When live specimens aren't readily available, Witherbloom mages make creative use of ragged spirits clinging to long-dead bodies.

name: Novice Dissector
text: "The professor said to first extract the venom glands, then the acid sac. Next up, the . . . meeping organ?"

name: Ageless Guardian
text: Ancient ruins dot the world of Arcavios, most older than Strixhaven itself and many still guarded by soldiers from the Blood Age, centuries after their deaths.

name: Oriq Loremage
text: Nothing can quell the Oriq's thirst for the forbidden secrets of the past.

name: Plumb the Forbidden
text: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

name: Professor's Warning
text: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus, sounding very much like someone familiar with the rise of tyrants.

name: Promising Duskmage
text: "Your technique is sloppy, but there is talent there. Do it again, and keep your right arm in position this time."

name: Specter of the Fens
text: Foul specters hunt down those who try to back out of a deal with a daemogoth.

name: Tenured Inkcaster
text: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

name: Umbral Juke
text: The sport of Mage Tower was conceived as a playful testing ground for young spellcasters.

name: Beaming Defiance
text:
"I've lived too long in my father's shadow. It's time to find my own light."
—Killian, Silverquill mage-student

name: Unwilling Ingredient
text:
"Don't look at me like that. It was either this or being eaten by a groff."
—Dina, Witherbloom mage-student

name: Academic Dispute
text: "I'll show you original research, you hack!"

name: Ardent Dustspeaker
text: "The Founder Dragons weren't even hatched when this scroll was written!"

name: Blood Age General
text: His troops took the Fortress of Caerdoon centuries ago, yet he fights on.

name: Crackle with Power
text: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl. For a moment, she was luminous, transcendent, terrible.

name: Enthusiastic Study
text: "If the pen is mightier than the sword, just think what a giant tome could do!"

name: Auramancer
text: Beauty stirs the memory like a sweet perfume excites the air.

name: Mirari's Wake
text: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

name: Mistmeadow Witch
text: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Temporal Spring
text: One splash of the spring's water knocks you clear into last week.

name: Terminate
text: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

name: Xira Arien
text: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Golgari Signet
text: Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.

name: Gruul Signet
text: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Simic Signet
text: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

name: Oblivion Ring
text: A circle of sugar and a word of forbiddance.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Bant Panorama
text: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

name: Coastal Tower
text: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

name: Elfhame Palace
text: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

name: Ghost Quarter
text: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

name: Prison Term
text: Clear out the cell. Bring in the next prisoner.

name: Jund Panorama
text: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

name: Savage Lands
text: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

name: Seaside Citadel
text: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Swords to Plowshares
text:
"The so-called barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Confiscate
text:
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit."
—Barrin, progress report

name: Copy Enchantment
text: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

name: Hinder
text:
"Do not react to force in kind. Turn it aside. Direct it to where it can do no harm."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Merfolk Looter
text: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

name: Overwhelming Intellect
text: "My brain hurts."

name: Rhystic Study
text: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

name: Abyssal Gatekeeper
text:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Ashes to Ashes
text:
"All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

name: Buried Alive
text:
"Is it worse to walk while dead, or to be buried alive? I have witnessed both."
—Crovax

name: Carrion Feeder
text: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Phyrexian Arena
text: An audience of one with the malice of thousands.

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Anarchist
text: "I'll take that. You won't need it when the revolution comes."

name: Ancient Grudge
text: The time rifts remind Yavimaya of the enemies of its past and provide fresh fuel for its fires.

name: Anger
text:
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

name: Hissing Iguanar
text: Viashino thrashes keep iguanars as hunting companions, giving them wounded captives as playthings.

name: Keldon Vandals
text: Keldons divide all their spoils into two groups: trophies and catapult ammunition.

name: Enlightened Tutor
text:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

name: Borderland Ranger
text: "Only fools and bandits use roads."

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Civic Wayfinder
text: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

name: Edge of Autumn
text: "At harvest are seeds of next year sown."

name: Elven Cache
text:
"The elves can hide better than most can look."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

name: Elvish Visionary
text: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Explosive Vegetation
text: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

name: Genesis
text:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Jungle Lion
text: The lion's only loyalty is to its hunger.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

name: Penumbra Bobcat
text: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

name: Recollect
text:
"The bones of the past will tell their tales—if you know how to speak their language."
—Savra

name: Rootbreaker Wurm
text: As Gerrard made his escape, the wurm covered his flight by helping itself to three great mouthfuls of merfolk.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Werebear
text: He exercises his right to bear arms.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Kami of Ancient Law
text:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

name: Wirewood Guardian
text: Tall as a tree and probably related.

name: Wood Elves
text: Secure in the embrace of wood, they want no part of Eladamri's war.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: From each seed, a world. From each world, a thousand seeds.

name: Armadillo Cloak
text:
"Don't laugh. It works."
—Yavimaya ranger

name: Coiling Oracle
text: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

name: Jungle Barrier
text: A massive pull of mana caused all of Dominaria to pause—Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

name: Aura of Silence
text: Not all silences are easily broken.

name: Silence
text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Flames of the Blood Hand
text: Many ogres extracted blood oaths from the oni they summoned. Others simply extracted blood.

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Benevolent Bodyguard
text: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

name: Lava Spike
text: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

name: Price of Progress
text: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

name: Pyroblast
text:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Relic of Progenitus
text: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

name: Ethersworn Canonist
text: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

name: Flagstones of Trokair
text: Dust-spiked winds eroded the stones, but the ground where they had stood still holds power.

name: Karakas
text:
"To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee,/ One clover, and a bee,/ And revery."
—Emily Dickinson

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Mangara of Corondor
text: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

name: Serra Avenger
text:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Silent Arbiter
text: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

name: Argent Sphinx
text: A great mirage, a dream of wings and silver.

name: Kuldotha Forgemaster
text: The goblins say it used to be larger, before it began to stoke the Great Furnace with pieces of itself.

name: Spire Serpent
text: A mirror to draw its eye, a rod to rouse its rage, and a sword to break its bonds.

name: Lumengrid Gargoyle
text:
"Anything that watches without sleep and fights without fear is a valuable ally against the Phyrexians."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

name: Darksteel Gargoyle
text: The ultimate treasure is one that guards itself.

name: Memnite
text: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

name: Dispatch
text: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

name: Steelshaper's Gift
text: Some blades seek their own wielders.

name: Viridian Claw
text: "Phyrexians can't corrupt what they can't get close enough to touch."

name: Purge
text: For the first and last time, the horrific creature experienced terror.

name: Test of Faith
text: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

name: Steel Wall
text:
"We sculpt the land into what we need—homes, armament, fortresses of war. Our strength comes not only from knowing, but from commanding the terrain."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

name: Turn the Tide
text:
"Let their mindless armies come and face the might of genius."
—Varil, Neurok partisan

name: Arrest
text: Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
text: Lymph, the fluid essence of blinkmoths, is prized by wizards for the rush of intellect it provides.

name: Stoic Rebuttal
text: Obsessed with the pursuit of knowledge above all else, vedalken can appear to be cold and emotionless.

name: White Sun's Zenith
text: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Coastal Tower
text: A beacon in the night, a dream in the fog.

name: Ardent Recruit
text: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."

name: Seat of the Synod
text: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Fume Spitter
text:
"Our archers made sport of it as it fumbled its way up the slag ridge. As it collapsed we thought ourselves safe, but the foul thing carried more than necrogen."
