—Adaran, Tangle hunter

name: Vedalken Certarch
text: "An appropriately detailed model is indistinguishable from reality, and much easier to control."

name: Myr Sire
text: For the Phyrexians, death is not an end, nor a one-time occurrence.

name: Plague Myr
text: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Desecration Elemental
text: Its precious corpses dance like puppets to attract mindless nim prey.

name: Soul Snuffers
text: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

name: Plaguemaw Beast
text: Phyrexia's spiral of consumption grows ever wider and darker.

name: Phyrexian Juggernaut
text: Where nature impedes, Phyrexians overcome.

name: Protean Hulk
text:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

name: Innocent Blood
text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

name: Myr Retriever
text: Mephidross gives up treasure easily... as long as you take its place.

name: Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Phyrexian Altar
text:
"Your life was meaningless, but your death will glorify Yawgmoth."
—Tsabo Tavoc

name: Morbid Plunder
text: Even the dead are raw materials for the Phyrexian vision of perfection.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Barter in Blood
text:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

name: Reprocess
text: Everything will find its use in Phyrexia. Eventually.

name: Spread the Sickness
text: Life is ephemeral. Phyrexia is eternal.

name: Silver Myr
text: The myr are like quicksilver: malleable in function and adaptable in form.

name: Black Sun's Zenith
text:
"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

name: Ikra Shidiqi, the Usurper
text: "What tribute have you for our dragonlord?"

name: Shadow Summoning
text:
"Beware the spirits that claim knowledge beyond the moon; beware the ritual that summons them."
—Edict of the Lunarch Council

name: Lightning Greaves
text: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

name: Skullclamp
text: Mardu blacksmiths can distill the technology of any clan and make it their own. Whether or not they should is another question.

name: Arcane Signet
text: Sometimes restoring the lost archives of the Jeskai can be as simple as the quiet ruffle of pages and the smell of fresh ink.

name: Sol Ring
text: Mardu lightning fences are the ingenious synthesis of blacksmith skill and stormsinger magic, protecting their dalkovans from even the most fearsome dragonstorms.

name: Command Tower
text: Safe havens amid the desert and dragonstorms, Abzan fortresses attract merchants, travelers, outcasts, and exiles.

name: Ainok Strike Leader
text: When dalkovans need protecting, all respond.

name: Commander's Insignia
text: At the general's triumphant return, renewed strength surged through the soldiers' ranks.

name: Divine Visitation
text: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Expel the Interlopers
text: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

name: Ghostly Prison
text:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

name: Goldnight Commander
text: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

name: Grand Crescendo
text: The roar of applause drowned out the melee raging in the lobby.

name: Aligned Heart
text: When hearts and minds align, so too do actions.

name: Hour of Reckoning
text: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

name: Indomitable Ancients
text:
"Odum and Broadbark were the only beings mighty enough to challenge the giant Moran the Destroyer. Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep. He awoke as Moran the Gardener."
—*The Tale of Odum and Broadbark*

name: Lingering Souls
text: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

name: Monastery Mentor
text: "Speak little. Do much."

name: Nyx-Fleece Ram
text: The gods are fascinated by innocence, perhaps because it's a quality they themselves lack.

name: Release the Dogs
text: They charge into battle and out for their morning walk with the same exuberance.

name: Rhox Faithmender
text: Rhoxes who live long enough to retire from war lend support with their extensive knowledge of combat injuries.

name: Selfless Spirit
text: "There is always more to give."

name: Slaughter the Strong
text:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

name: Stroke of Midnight
text: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared. As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Tocasia's Welcome
text: "Your father was a dear friend to whom I owe much. He wanted me to look after you, to care for you should something happen to him."

name: Wakestone Gargoyle
text: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

name: Wall of Omens
text:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

name: Wall of Reverence
text: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

name: Welcoming Vampire
text: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
text: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

name: Archmage Emeritus
text: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

name: Baral's Expertise
text: "Get out of my way."

name: Compulsive Research
text: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Reunion of the House
text:
"We stand or fall as a family. All of us."
—Betor

name: Deep Analysis
text: "No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"

name: Draconic Lore
text: The wyrmling studied the ancient carvings and dreamed of a day when her own exploits would be immortalized in stone.

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Haughty Djinn
text: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

name: Hedron Crab
text: Hedrons perplex minds both great and small.

name: Keiga, the Tide Star
text: The pull of the tide star holds eternal sway.

name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
text: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.

name: Opt
text: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

name: Ponder
text: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Rapid Hybridization
text:
"From the day we are born, we do our best to survive. We fight. We run. We fear. But we cannot protect ourselves from change."
—Ark, lizardfolk blacksmith

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Wonder
text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Lives taken are lives not easily forgotten.

name: Behind the Scenes
text: It does no good to bar the gate when the enemy is already inside.

name: Bitter Triumph
text: Though he wept at Inti's death, Caparocti's eyes were keen, and his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileño's tainted heart.

name: Blight Pile
text:
"Keep your distance. It may be broken, but it's far from benign."
—Stenn

name: Deadly Dispute
text: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

name: Disciple of Bolas
text: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

name: Eliminate the Competition
text: Open hostilities are strictly forbidden at the Inventors' Fair, but "accidents" still happen.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Infernal Grasp
text: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

name: Mindblade Render
text: "There will be no secrets between us... like it or not."

name: Morbid Opportunist
text: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Deceptive Frostkite
text:
"That's not a dragon. Can't be. It's too small, isn't it?"
—Askar, Temur scout, last words

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

name: Ophiomancer
text:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Reassembling Skeleton
text:
"If none of the bones are original, is it even the same skele—aaagh!"
—Mort the Philosopher, last words

name: Stitcher's Supplier
text: No part goes to waste.

name: Victimize
text:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

name: Viscera Seer
text: In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.

name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
text: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

name: Abrade
text: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Big Score
text: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

name: Blasphemous Act
text: In the early days of Valley, desperate animalfolk harnessed the power of Calamity Beasts in ways that destroyed more than defended.

name: Curse of Opulence
text: Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.

name: Hammerhead Tyrant
text: Without subjects, but a tyrant nonetheless.

name: Dragonlord's Servant
text: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "This world will be ruled by its rightful sovereigns, not these hideous pretenders."

name: Electrodominance
text: "Basically, we turn a bunch of little lightnings into one big lightning."

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Glorybringer
text: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
text: "You burn. I'll pillage."

name: Guttersnipe
text: "Fire! Fire! Fire! What joy! What fire! Burn it all!"

name: Hellkite Courser
text: The charge was heralded not by horns, but by the dragon's echoing roar.

name: Loyal Apprentice
text: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

name: Mana Geyser
text: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

name: Nogi, Draco-Zealot
text: "Glory to the Burning Ones! May their mighty fangs devour all foes!"

name: Ogre Battledriver
text: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

name: Rapacious Dragon
text:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

name: Voracious Bibliophile
text: Finding all of the lost Jeskai archives was merely the first step to restoration. Wresting them from their draconic keeper proved much more challenging.

name: Siege-Gang Commander
text: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

name: Storm-Kiln Artist
text: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

name: Storm's Wrath
text: Distant thunder rumbled, a dread forewarning of Keranos's displeasure.

name: Taurean Mauler
text: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

name: Thunderbreak Regent
text: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Arboreal Grazer
text:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

name: Axebane Guardian
text: Only a worthy few are permitted within the sentient forest known as Axebane.

name: Beast Within
text:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

name: Carven Caryatid
text: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

name: Cultivate
text: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

name: Elemental Bond
text:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Grapple with the Past
text: Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

name: Harrow
text: No spot in nature is truly barren.

name: Jaddi Offshoot
text: On Murasa, even the trees grow trees.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Overgrown Battlement
text:
"Our enemy is nothing less than the end of all life. We shall not want for allies."
—*The War Diaries*

name: Rampant Growth
text: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
text: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Seedborn Muse
text:
"She speaks with the purity of nature and walks with the boldness of the wilds. She is a reminder of a world untamed."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

name: Jaws of Defeat
text:
"The Jeskai like talking about their Way? Let's see them talk their way out of this dilemma."
—Girdah, Abzan beastrider

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Sylvan Caryatid
text: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.

name: Tear Asunder
text: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

name: Tower Defense
text:
"We've been practicing for this all our lives. This is the final test!"
—Korun Nar, Rubblebelt hunter

name: Towering Titan
text: "Knock, knock."

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Wall of Roots
text:
"Mana grows and changes like the roots of a plant. Like a plant, it must be nurtured."
—Nissa Revane

name: Anguished Unmaking
text: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

name: Aron, Benalia's Ruin
text:
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone."
—Danitha

name: Atarka, World Render
text:
"Her hunger knows no limit. Left unchecked, she would feast on all of Tarkir."
—Yasova Dragonclaw

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Dragonlord Dromoka
text: Dromoka's followers forsake blood ties so that they may join a greater family.

name: Expressive Iteration
text: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

name: Faeburrow Elder
text: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

name: Tip the Scales
text:
"Remember, wait till they're near the top. We don't just want them gone—we want them demoralized."
—Vennra, earthcarver tactician

name: Grisly Salvage
text: To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.

name: Harbinger of the Hunt
text: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

name: Indulging Patrician
text: "Just a nibble for now. I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite."

name: Lord of Extinction
text: The forlorn cries of the dead combine to make its laugh.

name: Putrefy
text:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

name: Skull Prophet
text: "I study bone because that's where truth dwells. One monster knucklebone is wiser than all that damp meat in your head."

name: Thalisse, Reverent Medium
text: She hears every voice from the swirling, whispering mist and swears to tell their stories.

name: Third Path Iconoclast
text: "When all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail. I merely propose expanding our toolbox."

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Whirlwind of Thought
text: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Boros Signet
text: Carved high into stone, the signet requires all to look up at it—whether with fear or admiration.

name: Crashing Drawbridge
text:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Idol of Oblivion
text: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

name: Izzet Signet
text: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

name: Millikin
text: "Another failure," grumbled the toymaker. She slammed the door with such gusto that she failed to notice the eyes watching her.

name: Orzhov Signet
text: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

name: Selesnya Signet
text: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat … if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Talisman of Conviction
text:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

name: Caldera Pyremaw
text: It's the reason monks gave up on mapping Qadat.

name: Talisman of Creativity
text:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

name: Talisman of Hierarchy
text:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: Druids hold certain plants to be sacred and use their leaves and wood as a spellcasting focus.

name: Access Tunnel
text: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

name: Adarkar Wastes
text: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

name: Battlefield Forge
text:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Cascade Bluffs
text: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Castle Embereth
text: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

name: Caves of Koilos
text: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

name: Cinder Glade
text: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

name: Clifftop Retreat
text: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

name: Command Beacon
text:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

name: Contaminated Aquifer
text: The caves stretch farther than anyone knows, and the terrible legacy of Yawgmoth lurks in every shadow.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Dreamroot Cascade
text: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.

name: Drownyard Temple
text:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Ferrous Lake
text: Stability and volatility churn together, creating beauty and danger both.

name: Fetid Heath
text:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

name: Flooded Grove
text: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

name: Haunted Mire
text: Some of the nature spirits and wraiths that haunt Urborg take offense at the term "ghost town."

name: Redoubled Stormsinger
text: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

name: Hinterland Harbor
text:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

name: Isolated Chapel
text: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

name: Karplusan Forest
text: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Llanowar Wastes
text:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

name: Mossfire Valley
text: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

name: Overgrown Farmland
text: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Radiant Grove
text: Yavimaya's inhabitants are dedicated to protecting its unspoiled jungle from the scourge of artifice.

name: Reliquary Tower
text: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

name: Rockfall Vale
text: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

name: Rugged Prairie
text: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

name: Shattered Sanctum
text: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

name: Shivan Reef
text: The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Sulfur Falls
text:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text: To the Sun Empire, any place where daylight brightens the jungle floor is sacred ground.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: The House's geography constantly warps and twists, fields melting into floorboards and walls opening into hungry maws.

name: Twilight Mire
text: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

name: Vault of the Archangel
text:
"For centuries my creation kept this world in balance. Now only her shadow remains."
—Sorin Markov

name: Woodland Cemetery
text:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

name: Yavimaya Coast
text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

name: Arbor Adherent
text:
"Many hands make light work! Or two hands and a trunk, as the case may be."
—Sanzar, Kin-Tree Warden

name: Become the Avalanche
text:
"You had your warning. Now you get *us*."
—Eshki Dragonclaw

name: Broodcaller Scourge
text: Younger dragons bow to its will, not out of respect, but out of fear.

name: Canopy Gargantuan
text: Its very presence forces nature to adapt.

name: Floral Evoker
text: "Death is a natural thing. It replenishes the land's energy and nourishes the growth of all life."

name: Steward of the Harvest
text: "Sleep, and return your energy to the lifepool. Sleep, and enrich the land for the next harvest."

name: Ainok Strike Leader
text: When dalkovans need protecting, all respond.

name: Aligned Heart
text: When hearts and minds align, so too do actions.

name: Reunion of the House
text:
"We stand or fall as a family. All of us."
—Betor

name: Deceptive Frostkite
text:
"That's not a dragon. Can't be. It's too small, isn't it?"
—Askar, Temur scout, last words

name: Hammerhead Tyrant
text: Without subjects, but a tyrant nonetheless.

name: Voracious Bibliophile
text: Finding all of the lost Jeskai archives was merely the first step to restoration. Wresting them from their draconic keeper proved much more challenging.

name: Jaws of Defeat
text:
"The Jeskai like talking about their Way? Let's see them talk their way out of this dilemma."
—Girdah, Abzan beastrider

name: Tip the Scales
text:
"Remember, wait till they're near the top. We don't just want them gone—we want them demoralized."
—Vennra, earthcarver tactician

name: Shiko and Narset, Unified
text: For peace, lead by example.

name: Caldera Pyremaw
text: It's the reason monks gave up on mapping Qadat.

name: Redoubled Stormsinger
text: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

name: Arbor Adherent
text:
"Many hands make light work! Or two hands and a trunk, as the case may be."
—Sanzar, Kin-Tree Warden

name: Become the Avalanche
text:
"You had your warning. Now you get us."
—Eshki Dragonclaw

name: Broodcaller Scourge
text: Younger dragons bow to its will, not out of respect, but out of fear.

name: Canopy Gargantuan
text: Its very presence forces nature to adapt.

name: Floral Evoker
text: "Death is a natural thing. It replenishes the land's energy and nourishes the growth of all life."

name: Steward of the Harvest
text: "Sleep, and return your energy to the lifepool. Sleep, and enrich the land for the next harvest."

name: Vanquish the Horde
text:
"Remind Zurgo that the Abzan will not tolerate his marauders. If the Mardu wish to trespass, then I encourage him to face my blade himself."
—Felothar, khan of the Abzan

name: Narset's Reversal
text: "For every problem, a thousand answers. For every answer, a thousand branching consequences."

name: Gravecrawler
text:
"Jade-touched, wisteria-crowned, with gifts of gold and the Harvest's blessing, return this honored one to us as sibsig."
—Priests' chant

name: Young Pyromancer
text: The hydrorats were soon eradicated from the monastery.

name: Life from the Loam
text:
"On a good day, I am not Fangkeeper, war hero, or sibsig, but a farmer again."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Tree of Redemption
text: The Kin-Tree of Anafenza Mevak was the first recovered after Dromoka's reign, and it stands as a symbol of the Abzan's revival.

name: Goblin Electromancer
text: The Jeskai find potential recruits among all walks of life, including other clans.

name: Yathan Tombguard
text: "Our khan would grant you clemency. She is naive. And unfortunately for you, she is also not here."

name: Devoted Duelist
text: "Arrows? Ha! Wood and feather? Toys!"

name: Dracogenesis
text:
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be."
—Sarkhan

name: Equilibrium Adept
text: He regained balance while his opponent regained consciousness.

name: Fleeting Effigy
text: The brushfires of Cori Mountain take on a life all their own.

name: Iridescent Tiger
text: The power of the dragonstorms transformed not only the land but many of the creatures within it.

name: Jeskai Devotee
text: A master of the Whirling Blade technique, he did not hesitate to leap to the monastery's defense.

name: Meticulous Artisan
text: "It isn't about expression or results. Doing the thing is itself the point."

name: Narset's Rebuke
text: With a swift motion Narset struck Sarkhan down. She would not let his fevered dreams of draconic dominance come to fruition. Not after all she had done to free Tarkir.

name: Overwhelming Surge
text: Mardu lightning rods disperse the energy of dragonstorms—or whatever happens to be touching the rods.

name: Rescue Leopard
text:
"The scouts should have been back hours ago. They might be in trouble. I'm sending Kyra."
—Eshki Dragonclaw

name: Seize Opportunity
text: In this year's Lightning Proving, Paala reclaimed her confidence and her place in the Mardu.

name: Fortress Kin-Guard
text: All through the night, the ancestor whispered of ancient battles fought from this very rampart atop Arashin City.

name: Shock Brigade
text: "From Alesha to Zurgo, all Mardu khans started right here. At the front lines."

name: Shocking Sharpshooter
text:
"An arrow alone can't fell a dragon, but an added bolt of lightning brings it tumbling to the ground."
—Balur, Mardu warrior

name: Stormscale Scion
text: Dragons of Tarkir are born fully formed, roars blending with the storms as a single, inseparable voice.

name: Summit Intimidator
text:
"If you see a yeti of Qadat, then it has surely already seen you. And if you are within sight, you are within range."
—Nitula, Temur hunter

name: Sunset Strikemaster
text: "Help the villagers to safety! I will hold the gate!"

name: Twin Bolt
text:
"Fire is only as precise as your control over it."
—Danfeng, Jeskai mage

name: Underfoot Underdogs
text: They're just as renowned for their banter as they are for their tactical teamwork.

name: Furious Forebear
text:
"Your hatred dampens the land with my kin's blood. My love will flood it with yours."
—Hazena, spirit of House Emesh

name: Unsparing Boltcaster
text: Zurgo valued those who took initiative.

name: War Effort
text:
Community is strength.
—Tenet of the Decree of Thunder

name: Ainok Wayfarer
text: "There has to be a faster route through Sagu Jungle. Give me a week."

name: Attuned Hunter
text: "Sokran is no mere bear. She is friend, family, and confidante—and more intelligent than some of my blood relatives."

name: Champion of Dusan
text: Dusan boxing matches allow contestants no weapons, no allies, and no excuses.

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text:
"Some days, you wish you were fighting a dragon."
—Eshki Dragonclaw

name: Dragon Sniper
text: During Dromoka's reign, Qatros Karst City was a haven for the Abzan rebellion. Its current residents have not lost their proficiency against their former foes.

name: Lightfoot Technique
text: Jeskai monks spreading the Way in Abzan territories develop swift reflexes or find their travels abruptly cut short.

name: Dusyut Earthcarver
text: Created by a sudden sinking, Dusyut Forest attracts earthcarvers eager to explore its mysteries and test their magic.

name: Formation Breaker
text:
"The war chargers seem restless. Let them out to play."
—Ermaz, Abzan border guard

name: Heritage Reclamation
text: With an echoing crash the effigy fell, the symbol of Atarka's tyranny expunged from Temur lands.

name: Inspirited Vanguard
text: Abzan soldiers know they never enter battle alone.

name: Knockout Maneuver
text: An exceptional bout during the Zenith celebration will be noted by Temur elders and result in recruitment for higher ranks.

name: Krotiq Nestguard
text: The bushwhacker's machete glanced off the root with a sickening crack. Slowly, the entire undergrowth turned to face him.

name: Loxodon Battle Priest
text: "I grant you the strength of Qatros's walls and the tenacity of Arashin's oasis."

name: Rainveil Rejuvenator
text: In the aftermath of war, Temur mages nurtured the land back to its former vitality.

name: Rite of Renewal
text: The greatest honor a Sultai can receive is to be returned to the realm of the living.

name: Sagu Pummeler
text:
Like talking to a grokmaul
—Tarkir expression meaning "a failure of diplomacy"

name: Sarkhan's Resolve
text: With Taigam whispering encouragement in his ear, Sarkhan threw aside his misgivings. The ritual would return him to his former glory. All he needed was a dragon's heart.

name: Snakeskin Veil
text: "Now I wonder . . . will anyone come to protect *you*?"

name: Mardu Devotee
text: Eskeg and his companion stood watch, the sights of the steppe a constant inspiration.

name: Sultai Devotee
text: Many Sultai villages are protected by naga who weave magics to bless or curse as needed.

name: Surrak, Elusive Hunter
text: "I've spent my life feeding Atarka's desire and hungers. It's time to see to my own."

name: Trade Route Envoy
text: The Abzan pride themselves on the safety of their roads. To reject their escorts invites storm and sorrow.

name: Traveling Botanist
text: Every part of every plant is useful—for food, for medicine, and for ceremonies.

name: Undergrowth Leopard
text: There are those who developed peculiar tastes after generations of dining upon the remains of interclan rivalry.

name: Armament Dragon
text:
"Dragons working alongside the Abzan, not as overlords but as equals. It feels like a dream."
—Anafenza

name: Auroral Procession
text: The Temur celebrate the end of the Unbroken Night with stories, dances, and feasts. They gather to witness the first light of dawn as the land sings in harmony.

name: Bone-Cairn Butcher
text: In power, in hunger, in cruelty—insatiable.

name: Call the Spirit Dragons
text: The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.

name: Cori Mountain Stalwart
text: Zhao had resolved to hold the bridge, defending the village behind him. But the villagers decided Zhao would not stand alone.

name: Death Begets Life
text:
"You need not mourn. Their life essence has returned to the earth, where it will eventually bloom into a new form."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Defibrillating Current
text:
A small shock to save a life, a large one to take it away.
—Mardu healer's adage

name: Poised Practitioner
text:
"Excellent form, Jun! Just keep your weight on that back foot, and you'll master this in no time."
—Narset

name: Dragonclaw Strike
text: Some had doubted the whisperers' choice of Eshki for Dragonclaw. None did so after witnessing her in battle.

name: Eshki Dragonclaw
text: "The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."

name: Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan
text: "Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin─united as one clan! Abzan!"

name: Flamehold Grappler
text: "A flurry of fists doesn't impress you? Perhaps if they're on fire?"

name: Frostcliff Siege
text: Differing philosophies were debated by bloodshed.

name: Glacierwood Siege
text: The Sultai approach was silent. The Temur response was deafening.

name: Gurmag Nightwatch
text: "The fishers were probably exaggerating the size of the crocodile they spotted, but maybe they weren't. Let's check it out."

name: Hardened Tactician
text:
"Life is full of tough calls. We honor the dead today to make better decisions tomorrow."
—Uruna, Mardu lieutenant

name: Host of the Hereafter
text: "I agreed to return and aid the Sultai. My friends here agreed to return and aid me."

name: Inevitable Defeat
text:
"We came seeking a challenge. It seems we must continue searching."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Jeskai Brushmaster
text: Elegance. Precision. Grace. Qualities that must be practiced in writing as well as combat.

name: Jeskai Revelation
text:
"No one of us could have built all this alone. A clan, a school, hope for the future. Thank you all."
—Narset, to Shiko, Taigam, and Elsha

name: Jeskai Shrinekeeper
text: Like clouds and snow, Jeskai dragons prefer to drift among the monastery's highest spires.

name: Karakyk Guardian
text: As the Temur returned to Karakyk during the chill of winter, some shadows overhead were a blessing rather than a threat.

name: Anafenza, Unyielding Lineage
text: "Kin and clan call to me—and I will always answer."

name: Rebellious Strike
text:
"Even if you battle unseen, even if there is no one to witness your sacrifice—strike! Strike true. Strike from the heart. Let that be your legacy."
—Shiko

name: Kin-Tree Severance
text:
"For his crimes—burn his blood and cut him from his ancestors. Perennation is only for family."
—Dictate of House Mevak in the banishment of Oret

name: Kishla Skimmer
text: "Rising waters have flooded many old places from the dragon's rule. I do not miss them."

name: Lie in Wait
text: Some paths through Gurmag Swamp are deserted for good reason.

name: Lotuslight Dancers
text: They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.

name: Marshal of the Lost
text: Gvar carved his way through the Ancestral Maelstrom, seeking to restore the withered Kin-Tree and soothe the raging spirits.

name: Monastery Messenger
text: Lanniao soared from Highspire Monastery all throughout Tarkir, carrying messages for monks and villagers alike.

name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
text: "Each step we take is a decision that changes the course of our futures. We must be careful where we tread."

name: Neriv, Heart of the Storm
text: Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.

name: Perennation
text: The Abzan believe in perennation—death is not only an end, but a return to the beginning.

name: Rakshasa's Bargain
text: "You know you shouldn't and the Sultai forbid you. But you can't resist the temptation, can you?"

name: Reputable Merchant
text: "Dried durian from the Marang River Valley! Candied cherries from the slopes of Cori! Genuine dragon scale cookware!"

name: Sage of the Skies
text: "Gravity is just a suggestion."

name: Skirmish Rhino
text: Slowly, the clans have begun to recover and adapt long-forgotten tactics.

name: Sonic Shrieker
text: To ensure a fair competition, the Great Assemblage's war shriek contest has two divisions: dragons, and everyone else.

name: Temur Battlecrier
text: When called to the land's defense, all come to protect their shared home. It's why many of the Temur use "family" and "herd" interchangeably.

name: Temur Tawnyback
text:
"He just kind of followed me home one day. I mean, could you say no to this face?"
—Karasi, Mistrise provisioner

name: Salt Road Packbeast
text:
"She huffs like she's Queen Hellkite of the Scour, but we've been together for many journeys and she's never let me down."
—Mandakh, Mardu scout

name: Teval, Arbiter of Virtue
text: "As you act, so shall you be judged."

name: Yathan Roadwatcher
text: She keeps watch for dragonstorms and rival clans alike. For dragons, she raises an alarm. For thieves, her blade.

name: Zurgo, Thunder's Decree
text: "Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"

name: Boulderborn Dragon
text: The draconic power that flowed out from the dragonstorms imbued the landscape with draconic features—scales, claws, and appetites.

name: Smile at Death
text:
"Khan Alesha ensured our survival. Now we will forge our future."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Dragonfire Blade
text: It's as if the metal itself rages.

name: Dragonstorm Globe
text: Jeskai scholars fashioned devices to forecast the behavior of the dragonstorms.

name: Embermouth Sentinel
text: Its eternal glow lights the way for weary travelers through the misty heights surrounding Pearl Lake.

name: Jade-Cast Sentinel
text: Set in motion by artificers long forgotten, it remained loyal through the ages to the occupants of Kheru City.

name: Mox Jasper
text:
"Rage. Greed. Arrogance. People only accuse dragons of what they fear in themselves."
—Sarkhan

name: Watcher of the Wayside
text: Against dragonlords, khans, and Ugin himself, the golem survived. Original purpose forgotten, it awaits orders that will never come, from a world that has moved on without it.

name: Starry-Eyed Skyrider
text: Too late, the elders realized the young prodigies shared a love of adventure and mischief.

name: Bloodfell Caves
text:
"These caves hide beasts above and below their waters. For safe passage, the Sultai agree a small cargo trade is fair for risking our necks."
—Samor, Mardu border guard

name: Blossoming Sands
text:
"It's rare to see Temur so far from their own lands. I see no reason to interfere, but keep an eye on them nonetheless."
—Hamza of House Fenzala

name: Cori Mountain Monastery
text: Every spire is a physical dedication to the Way.

name: Dismal Backwater
text:
"I ask only that the winds return you to me as swiftly as they bear you and the Storm Crane away."
—Samthar, Sultai merchant, to Jialing, Jeskai monk

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Dragonstorm chasers are not deterred by danger—they claim there is nothing like witnessing the land embracing the power of a storm.

name: Frontier Bivouac
text: With a warm fire and a fresh catch, Temur hunters find respite in even the coldest climates.

name: Jungle Hollow
text: Long-standing disagreements between the Sultai and Abzan about how to honor their dead have led to rare but fierce skirmishes.

name: Mistrise Village
text: Built on a fumarole field, the village is a refuge of warmth amid the ice of the Qal Sisma mountains.

name: Mystic Monastery
text: Through sun and storm, across steppe and swamp, Storm Crane Monastery flies wherever aid is needed.

name: Nomad Outpost
text:
"The Mardu breathe life into what was lost under the dragonlords. If the Abzan are upset, it should be at themselves."
—Tersa Lightshatter

name: Opulent Palace
text:
"The people must know that the former seat of their oppression is cleansed. Throw open Qarsi's gates and let them see for themselves."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Rugged Highlands
text:
"We may fight the Temur when territory demands it, but we've no desire to profane their sacred places."
—Taklai, Mardu convoy

name: Sandsteppe Citadel
text:
"The most important part of a stronghold isn't its armaments or its walls. It's the reason people have to defend it."
—Gvar Barzeel, krumar captain

name: Scoured Barrens
text: By the codes of Mardu and Abzan alike, both sides allowed their enemies time to grieve after a battle.

name: Swiftwater Cliffs
text: When spring melted the snow, fishers downstream of the Qadat Fire Rim learned of conflict between Temur and Jeskai from the gruesome flotsam.

name: Thornwood Falls
text: By morning the only evidence of conflict between Temur hunters and Sultai scouts were abandoned banners in the freshly fallen snow.

name: Stormbeacon Blade
text: "Sky and Ember, guide my blade!"

name: Tranquil Cove
text:
"Abzan vintages are nice, but the sorghum wine made in Riverwheel Village is beyond compare."
—Iramaz, Abzan trader

name: Wind-Scarred Crag
text: The Mardu are centered in the present. The Jeskai look to the future. But both know when the time for talking is past.

name: Stormplain Detainment
text: Elspeth saw their capture as an inconvenience, costing them precious time. Narset saw it as an opportunity to recruit allies to their cause.

name: Teeming Dragonstorm
text: When caught in a dragonstorm, Mardu and Abzan scouts have no choice but to ride together.

name: Roiling Dragonstorm
text: In every biome of Tarkir, the storms spew forth dragons well suited to dominate.

name: Arashin Sunshield
text:
"The best way to protect the citizens is to defend Arashin, not hunt dragonstorms across Tarkir."
—Sadesh of House Mevak

name: Teeming Dragonstorm
text:
"So, these dragons intend to also manifest through a sandstorm? I take some offense to that."
—Felothar, khan of the Abzan

name: Dracogenesis
text: Some believe dragonstorms to be the combined dregs of the vanquished dragonlords' fury.

name: Magmatic Hellkite
text: It gulps from the lava flow to spew gouts of molten rock upon its prey.

name: Stormscale Scion
text: Some dragonstorms pass without a trace. Others can conquer worlds.

name: Armament Dragon
text: Dragonstorms are a dragon's first natural habitat. They rarely have any issues navigating the howling energies to come to the Abzan's aid.

name: Call the Spirit Dragons
text: The Stormnexus Ritual brought forth draconic protectors, but unleashed the chaos of storms.

name: Jeskai Shrinekeeper
text: The most curious and contemplative dragons gravitate towards Shiko and the scholars of the Jeskai.

name: Karakyk Guardian
text: Only Temur whisperers are allowed in the Dragon's Throat. All others must justify their presence to the valley's guardian.

name: Neriv, Heart of the Storm
text: "For the Mardu, the shelter of my wings; for our foes, the searing heat of lightning."

name: Sonic Shrieker
text:
"When we first saw her exulting in the storm's thunder, we knew she belonged with us."
—Tersa Lightshatter

name: United Battlefront
text: The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.

name: Boulderborn Dragon
text: Dragon scholars flock to understand the innumerable species across Tarkir, but the question of "What is a dragon?" gets more difficult to answer every day.

name: Dragonfire Blade
text: Dragon's scales to adorn the hilt, dragon's bones to polish the blade, and dragon's breath to kindle its edge.

name: Mox Jasper
text: The essence of dragonfire has permeated Tarkir's landscapes since time immemorial.

name: Voice of Victory
text:
"Come crackling spear, come beating wing!
Come cavalier, come taut bowstring!"

name: Agent of Kotis
text:
"I trust Narset. I do not trust those she keeps counsel with."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Bewildering Blizzard
text: Temur scouts reported the arrival of unwanted visitors, and the whisperers ensured a chilling welcome.

name: Cori Mountain Monastery
text: Come to learn. Stay to teach.

name: Kishla Village
text: Silumgar's remnants drown, a new Sultai rises.

name: Mistrise Village
text: There is always an influx of visiting Temur families when the geothermal vents are most active.

name: Bearer of Glory
text: Morale stands so long as he does.

name: Clarion Conqueror
text: The dragon's roar silenced all challengers, yet it was only an echo of Ugin's power.

name: Dracogenesis
text: Ugin and the dragonstorms of Tarkir are intrinsically linked. With his death they weakened. With his life they raged. But even the Spirit Dragon does not hold them fully under his sway.

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text:
"Some days, you wish you were fighting an Eldrazi."
—Ugin

name: Death Begets Life
text:
"Life ensures death. Death ensures life. Yet always I remain. Perhaps an abiding harvest needs an ageless shepherd."
—Ugin

name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
text: With no dragonlord to hold her back, she was free to learn every secret Ugin left behind.

name: Skirmish Rhino
text: Slowly, with or without Ugin's help, the clans are recovering and adapting long-forgotten tactics.

name: Clarion Conqueror
text: The dragon's roar silenced all challengers, yet it was only an echo of Ugin's power.

name: Dracogenesis
text: Ugin and the dragonstorms of Tarkir are intrinsically linked. With his death they weakened. With his life they raged. But even the Spirit Dragon does not hold them fully under his sway.

name: Craterhoof Behemoth
text:
"Some days, you wish you were fighting an Eldrazi."
—Ugin

name: Death Begets Life
text:
"Life ensures death. Death ensures life. Yet always I remain. Perhaps an abiding harvest needs an ageless shepherd."
—Ugin

name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
text: With no dragonlord to hold her back, she was free to learn every secret Ugin left behind.

name: Skirmish Rhino
text: Slowly, with or without Ugin's help, the clans are recovering and adapting long-forgotten tactics.

name: Roiling Dragonstorm
text:
"Beware dragonstorms that strike from the sea. Their size always disguises their force."
—Narset

name: Strategic Betrayal
text: As Sultai blades threatened Qatros city walls, Mehtma of House Fenzala turned her weapons on her political rivals.

name: Temur Battlecrier
text: When called to the land's defense, all come to protect their shared home. It's why many of the Temur use "family" and "herd" interchangeably.

name: Qarsi Revenant
text:
"Evil wears many faces. Keep your windows closed at night, or it might wear yours."
—Sultai warning

name: Dragonstorm Forecaster
text: "This can't be right. I should cross-reference with the archives immediately."

name: Focus the Mind
text: Asham discovered it was impossible to learn if he thought he already knew everything.

name: Fresh Start
text:
"I know leaving your old life was no easy choice. Welcome, Novice Sardul."
—Elsha

name: Highspire Bell-Ringer
text: The sequence of chimes rang out a specific alarm: dragonstorm, half a day, southwest.

name: Humbling Elder
text:
"There is no better way to measure a person's true character than to let them think they're above you."
—Master Xian

name: Iceridge Serpent
text:
"Even dragons avoid Glintglaze Lake in this season. Which of you youngsters can tell me why?"
—Teacher Eliam

name: Clarion Conqueror
text: All challengers were summarily silenced.

name: Kishla Trawlers
text:
"Fish are like any other crop or flock. They must be carefully tended and never overharvested."
—Nasath, Kishla fisher

name: Riverwalk Technique
text: Since the reestablishment of Highspire Monastery, its favored fighting styles have also resurged in popularity.

name: Roiling Dragonstorm
text:
"Beware dragonstorms that strike from the sea. Their size always disguises their force."
—Narset

name: Sibsig Appraiser
text: "Oh, I can absolutely verify its authenticity," chuckled Sarnai. "I was there when it was made."

name: Snowmelt Stag
text: Elementals conjured by Temur mages are forever watchful and swift.

name: Spectral Denial
text: Temur mages are experts at channeling elemental energy, shaping it into familiar forms from the world around them.

name: Stillness in Motion
text: "The Meditation Realm is a willful puzzle. Seek, and it will impede. Wait, and it will permit passage."

name: Coordinated Maneuver
text:
"We follow the dragonstorms, and we take down any threats that emerge from them!"
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

name: Temur Devotee
text: Whisperers are conduits to the spirits of the land. They provide healing, guidance, and support to the Temur people.

name: Unending Whisper
text: In the Endless Song, Temur's whisperers hear spirits murmur of the past, present, and future.

name: Ureni's Rebuff
text: "You say you come in peace. That you come here at all is an act of war."

name: Wingblade Disciple
text: "Our greatest teachers are those which the natural world has so thoroughly refined."

name: Wingspan Stride
text:
"Yes, yes, very good. However, I believe you were supposed to be working on your sword techniques?"
—Taigam

name: Abzan Devotee
text: The Kin-Trees rediscovered after Dromoka's fall are tended by carefully chosen wardens.

name: Adorned Crocodile
text:
"Eat you? Of course she won't. Pherah's got better taste than that."
—Visk, Qarsi Palace caretaker

name: Dalkovan Packbeasts
text:
A burden shared is a burden lightened.
—Mardu proverb

name: Aggressive Negotiations
text:
"When an alliance outlasts its usefulness it's best to end it quickly."
—Heng, Sultai ambassador

name: Alchemist's Assistant
text:
"Do not test the mandrill. He knows a thief when he sees one."
—Notice posted at Lu Fen's apothecary

name: Alesha's Legacy
text: "If I die today, I will ensure my death is worthy of legend."

name: Cruel Truths
text:
"Who are you to defy me? In my time, the sibsig knew their place."
—Sidisi, to Nishang

name: Delta Bloodflies
text: With the rising waters, bloodflies were found far from their usual swamps.

name: Desperate Measures
text:
"Sing for us when we depart for battle, and sing for us if we fail to return."
—Mardu parting

name: Dragon's Prey
text:
"To escape Teval's justice, one must have a better plan than 'run away.'"
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

name: Descendant of Storms
text: The most elite of the Abzan are selected to join the Yathan: a prestigious group acting outside khan supervision for the good of the clan.

name: Gurmag Rakshasa
text: "It's a pity to hoard life essence in a form so weak. Give it to me."

name: Hundred-Battle Veteran
text: She's eager to start a new winning streak.

name: Kin-Tree Nurturer
text: "Thank the ancestors. A few more weeks, and we would have discovered nothing but dead wood and lost kin."

name: Krumar Initiate
text: "Welcome," the spirits of House Emesh whispered to Cemal. "Welcome, newest sprout of our Kin-Tree."

name: Qarsi Revenant
text:
"Evil wears many faces. Keep your windows closed at night, or it might wear yours."
—Sultai warning

name: Salt Road Skirmish
text: Dariya's first mistake was thinking they could short the Mardu trader on a deal. Their last was not considering the trader would bring backup.

name: Sandskitter Outrider
text: "There's a new sinkhole, seven leagues east. I'll take Scratchy."

name: Dragonback Lancer
text: The Mardu's standing army need not always stand on the ground.

name: The Sibsig Ceremony
text: "Once flesh, now gold and jade. Once dead, now alive again. Once respected, now honored beyond imagination."

name: Sidisi, Regent of the Mire
text: As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.

name: Sinkhole Surveyor
text: Vast sinkholes in the Shifting Wastes revealed long-buried structures—and long-buried dangers.

name: Strategic Betrayal
text: As Sultai blades threatened Qatros city walls, Mehtma of House Fenzala turned her weapons on her political rivals.

name: Unburied Earthcarver
text:
"Unless you actually see my spirit join the Kin-Tree, never assume me so unprofessional as to die on the job."
—Ezcul of House Zanhar

name: Unrooted Ancestor
text: Abzan spirits bereft of a Kin-Tree are condemned to a restless existence. Absent the purpose of family connection, many grow angry and violent.

name: Wail of War
text: Mardu war shrieks ensure their enemies are defeated before the battle even starts.

name: Worthy Cost
text:
"'Victory is survival' is the tenet that guides us. My love, know that I will always ensure your survivial."
—Duvir, Mardu warrior, final letter

name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
text:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Grim Physician
text: The Returned retain no memory of their identities, but sometimes they mindlessly attempt familiar tasks.

name: Hateful Eidolon
text: From the echoes of a violent life, a terrible foe is born.

name: Inevitable End
text:
"How many more will die before you accept your fate?"
—Erebos, god of the dead

name: Lampad of Death's Vigil
text:
"Grief-struck, she weeps for each mortal's final death."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Minion's Return
text: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld. As a god, he brings his pawns along the same dark path.

name: Mire Triton
text: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

name: Mire's Grasp
text: Those caught attempting to escape the Underworld spend the rest of their existence trapped in the Mire of Punishment.

name: Mogis's Favor
text: Rage-crowned Mogis swiftly rewards the virtue of brutality.

name: Nyxborn Marauder
text:
"Callaphe guided them into the
darkness of Hetos, the bleak mire;
Blood-horned minotaurs circled them,
axes aglimmer in shadow."
—*The Callapheia*

name: Dreadful Apathy
text: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

name: Omen of the Dead
text: "My time will come, when life's frantic striving will fade into the boundless quiet of death."

name: Pharika's Libation
text: "If you will not pour your drink out for me, I shall pour mine out for you."

name: Rage-Scarred Berserker
text: The fury of the slaughter god Mogis burns within him.

name: Scavenging Harpy
text: Desecrating the dead is a convenient way for harpies to expand their foul collections.

name: Soulreaper of Mogis
text: "We offer to Mogis the blood of the weak, and in return he makes us strong."

name: Temple Thief
text: "I don't know if the gods watch over their temples, but I figure it's best to be stealthy just in case."

name: Treacherous Blessing
text: Phenax is generous with gifts and unforgiving of debts.

name: Eidolon of Obstruction
text: Death turned admirable conviction into pointless intransigence.

name: Underworld Dreams
text: Dreams are just one more form of torment.

name: Venomous Hierophant
text: "Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"

name: Arena Trickster
text: "It's not enough to surprise your opponent. You have to delight the crowd as well."

name: Blood Aspirant
text: It's a small step from revel to bloodbath.

name: Careless Celebrant
text:
"Renata was mesmerized by the satyr's dance of gleeful indifference, of reckless grace and bright disaster."
—Luphea of Setessa, *Histories*

name: Dreamshaper Shaman
text: Magic is the true artist's medium.

name: Dreamstalker Manticore
text: Purphoros forged the manticore's tail from bronze, its teeth from silver, and its heart from hate.

name: Escape Velocity
text: "Not even death can catch me now!"

name: Fateful End
text:
"Everything will be put back in its proper place."
—Klothys, god of destiny

name: Final Flare
text: Those who fought without honor in life are taken to Agonas and doomed to fight forever in its arenas.

name: Flummoxed Cyclops
text:
"A cyclops thinks slowly but strikes quickly. Try to keep it thinking."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

name: Furious Rise
text: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

name: Hero of the Games
text: Winners of the Iroan Games are forever remembered as heroes of their people.

name: Heroes of the Revel
text: Brashness is close enough to bravery.

name: Impending Doom
text: "Feast, for your next meal may be your last!"

name: Incendiary Oracle
text: The flamespeakers of Akros live passionately, devoted to Purphoros and the cycle of destructive creation.

name: Infuriate
text:
"Renata launched a dozen arrows into the minotaur's thick hide, but the monster didn't slow its charge. The fury of Mogis was upon it."
—Luphea of Setessa, *Histories*

name: Iroas's Blessing
text: The blessing is not the strength itself, but the knowledge of how to use it.

name: Irreverent Revelers
text: To some satyrs, only blasphemy is sacred.

name: Nyxborn Brute
text:
"One-eyed and frightful, the cyclops
lifted a boulder and hurled it
seaward from cliff's edge, shattering
masts and scattering sailors."
—*The Callapheia*

name: Omen of the Forge
text: "My time will come, when all the world will be reforged in the fires of my invention."

name: Oread of Mountain's Blaze
text:
"Flame-wrapped, she dances a burning swath amid the clouds."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Portent of Betrayal
text: Mogis can fan a small flame of resentment into an inferno of madness.

name: Favored of Iroas
text: "The promise of victory fills my heart. There is no room for fear."

name: Purphoros's Intervention
text: "I bring a fire to recast all the world."

name: Satyr's Cunning
text: It's hard to keep a satyr down, even in the Underworld.

name: Skophos Warleader
text: The minotaur polis of Skophos boasts grand temples to the god of slaughter.

name: Stampede Rider
text: To a satyr, a stampede is just another kind of revelry.

name: Storm's Wrath
text: Distant thunder rumbled, a dread forewarning of Keranos's displeasure.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

name: Flicker of Fate
text: An infinite journey in an infinitesimal time.

name: Underworld Fires
text: The Underworld is anything but a resting place.

name: Wrap in Flames
text: Bright flames quell the darkest nightmares.

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
text:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Glory Bearers
text: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

name: Gift of Strength
text: The Nessian Wood is never without defenders.

name: Hyrax Tower Scout
text: The scouts of Hyrax Tower keep watch at the edge of Setessan territory, protecting the polis from inhuman monsters and enemy armies.

name: Ilysian Caryatid
text: Those who die as heroes are permitted to dwell in Ilysia, a protected realm of the Underworld as tranquil and vibrant as the rest is bleak.

name: Inspire Awe
text: Nylea appeared amid the howl of a hundred beasts.

name: Klothys's Design
text: The god of destiny grants her followers vision deeper than sight.

name: Loathsome Chimera
text:
"I see... elk? And lion? And... teeth! A lot of teeth!"
—Teraklos of Meletis

name: Mantle of the Wolf
text:
"Be fearless, for a furious rebirth awaits you."
—Nylea, god of the hunt

name: Moss Viper
text: Nylea watches over all the creatures of the forest except for the snakes. Blessed by Pharika, they can take care of themselves.

name: Mystic Repeal
text:
"No power is too great to be undone."
—Karametra, god of harvests

name: Nessian Boar
text: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.

name: Nessian Hornbeetle
text:
"The first rule of politics can be learned from a lowly hornbeetle: it is wise to cultivate powerful friends."
—Pythamon, sage of Meletis

name: Nexus Wardens
text: The Summer Nexus is a holy grove in Setessa where the starfields of Nyx glitter in the shadows.

name: Nylea's Forerunner
text: Where its feet tread, the thunder of many others will follow.

name: Nylea's Huntmaster
text: Nature is stillness and savagery in equal measure.

name: Nylea's Intervention
text: "I bring a wilderness no law can tame."

name: Nyx Herald
text:
"A piercing call, bright as the stars, rang out across the valley, calling the Pheres band to war, to blood and savagery."
—Luphea of Setessa, *Histories*

name: Heliod's Intervention
text: "I bring a dawn that no night can follow."

name: Nyxbloom Ancient
text: Ancient yet ever-young, it is wise and subtle—and cruel and reckless as the spring itself.

name: Nyxborn Colossus
Omen of the Hunt
text: "My time will come, when no road will divide the endless verdure of the trees."

name: Plummet
text: An arrow from Nylea's bow never fails to find its mark.

name: Relentless Pursuit
text: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Far-seeing Kruphix glimpsed the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Setessan Champion
text: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."

name: Setessan Petitioner
text: "Cypress leaves for family, larkspur for protection, amaranth for a bountiful harvest."

name: Archon of Falling Stars
text:
"The archon fell like a star from the sky, meeting the rising sun at the horizon's edge."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Setessan Skirmisher
text: Bassara, the tower of the fox, houses the elite skirmishers who guard the Nessian Wood against trespassers.

name: Setessan Training
text: In the heart of Setessa, the warriors of Leina Tower defend the polis and train its daughters.

name: Skola Grovedancer
text: "From the ashes of last night's revel, I bring the dawn of new growth."

name: Voracious Typhon
text: A typhon's escape from the Underworld makes armies flee and kingdoms fall.

name: Acolyte of Affliction
text: The best healers are intimately familiar with death.

name: Allure of the Unknown
text: The light of hope blinded Pantor to the ills of the world.

name: Dalakos, Crafter of Wonders
text: His imagination soars from the depths of the sea to the heights of the heavens.

name: Devourer of Memory
text: It slips silently through the still waters of the Labyrinth of Memories to feed.

name: Eutropia the Twice-Favored
text: Nylea speaks to her in the windblown leaves; Thassa in the rushing tides.

name: Gallia of the Endless Dance
text: "There's no success like excess!"

name: Haktos the Unscarred
text: "Many have sought my weakness. All have failed."

name: Hero of the Nyxborn
text: Heroic deeds inspire new heroes.

name: Hero of the Pride
text: Leonin fight for neither god nor polis; their loyalty is to their pride.

name: Kunoros, Hound of Athreos
text: Three sharp barks announce an attempt to escape the Underworld. Three sharp bites end it.

name: Mischievous Chimera
text: Some curiosities are best left alone.

name: Rise to Glory
text: A hero dies, and a legend arises.

name: Slaughter-Priest of Mogis
text: "Mogis is pleased by this offering. Bring him more!"

name: Staggering Insight
text:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Hero of the Winds
text: To tame a griffin is to ride into legend.

name: Warden of the Chained
text: "Strength, skill, rage—all have their limits, but patience can be infinite."

name: Bronze Sword
text: Every strike of the smith's hammer infuses a sword with the determination of its creator.

name: Entrancing Lyre
text: Its strings are wayward threads of fate.

name: Shadowspear
text: A weapon of darkness for a warrior of light.

name: Thaumaturge's Familiar
text: Meletian mages can't claim the title of thaumaturge until they have received a gift or omen from the gods. Ephara likes to give tangible tokens of her favor.

name: Thundering Chariot
text: In times of conflict, the philosophers of Meletis trade their podiums for conveyances of war.

name: Idyllic Tutor
text: "You are loved, child."

name: Traveler's Amulet
text: A vision of home, and a glimpse of hope.

name: Wings of Hubris
text: Dalakos's invention worked . . . until it didn't.

name: Labyrinth of Skophos
text: For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.

name: Unknown Shores
text:
"Callaphe gazed on the coastline,
certain her destiny called her
here, where the mist-shrouded rocks sang,
promising glories undreamed of."
—*The Callapheia*

name: Indomitable Will
text:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

name: Lagonna-Band Storyteller
text: "Our stories are full of ancient wisdom; they tell us who we are."

name: Eidolon of Inspiration
text:
"Agios was felled by a minotaur's blade, but I swear I have seen him since—in the midst of battle, wherever help is needed most."
—Phrokos, soldier of Akros

name: Elspeth's Devotee
text: "For her, I would gladly die again."

name: Sunlit Hoplite
text: "Even in her absence, the light Elspeth kindled in our hearts never faltered."

name: Swimmer in Nightmares
text: Ashiok's minions plumb the depths of the ocean and the psyche.

name: Mindwrack Harpy
text: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros... and they thoroughly deserve it.

name: Ashiok's Forerunner
text: "Every dream is a doorway."

name: Leonin of the Lost Pride
text: Leonin band together in the Underworld, taking solace in their strength until, at last, both pride and self are forgotten.

name: Grasping Giant
text: Mirinthes thought death was seconds away when the giant's fist closed around him. Two days later, he was praying for death's release.

name: Victory's Envoy
text: Her paean is the clash of spears, her prayer a battle cry.

name: Nyxborn Courser
text:
"Storms drove them westward to Ketaphos; wide plains shimmered in starlight.
Centaurs greeted them, offering gold-hued apples and grain-cakes."
—*The Callapheia*

name: Sphinx Mindbreaker
text: Riddles draw you in, paradoxes hold you fast, and answers shatter your perceptions.

name: Serpent of Yawning Depths
text:
"Gleams like moonlight on water drew us through the storm and toward our doom."
—Siona, captain of the *Pyleas*

name: Demon of Loathing
text: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

name: Underworld Sentinel
text: Deathless soldiers called phylaskia guard the borders of the Underworld.

name: Deathbellow War Cry
text: Deathbellow Canyon echoes with the roars of minotaurs calling each other to battle.

name: Terror of Mount Velus
text: The forge of Purphoros burns in the heart of Mount Velus, attracting dragons with its blistering heat.

name: Ironscale Hydra
text:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout

name: Treeshaker Chimera
text: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

name: Omen of the Sun
text: "My time will come, when every soul will bask in my glory and obey my law."

name: Phalanx Tactics
text: Every soldier has a place to stand and a role to play.

name: Pious Wayfarer
text: Every footstep is a prayer, every road a temple.

name: Reverent Hoplite
text: "Zeal is the sharpest blade, and piety the strongest shield."

name: Revoke Existence
text:
"The time has come for us to throw off the chains of tyrannical gods and antiquated superstitions."
—Tikaia, disciple of Uremides

name: Rumbling Sentry
text:
"To provoke the mountain is to invite the avalanche."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Arasta of the Endless Web
text: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

name: Alseid of Life's Bounty
text:
"Dawn-kissed, he nourishes the golden grain."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Thirst for Meaning
text: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.

name: Thrill of Possibility
text: "Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."

name: Shatter the Sky
text: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.

name: Sunmane Pegasus
text: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

name: Taranika, Akroan Veteran
text: "I like to think Kytheon keeps watch over all of us."

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

name: Transcendent Envoy
text:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Triumphant Surge
text: Not even death can quench a hero's inner fire.

name: Alirios, Enraptured
text: "Why would I ever want to look away?"

name: Brine Giant
text: The oracles of Meletis foresaw neither its rise from the depths nor the destruction it would leave in its wake.

name: Chain to Memory
text: Those who do not learn from their mistakes are bound to relive them.

name: Deny the Divine
text:
"A great wave crashed, and a mighty wind blew out the stars."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Eidolon of Philosophy
text: "And what did Erekastos teach us is the nature of the soul?"

name: Elite Instructor
text: The greatest minds in Meletis study under the masters at the Dekatia, a renowned school of magic and philosophy.

name: Glimpse of Freedom
text:
"Freedom lies in accepting a single path."
—Nyklos, Meletian philosopher

name: Ichthyomorphosis
text: Tycthis's military career was a flop.

name: Memory Drain
text: Alythos sat and stared blankly out over the glassy oceans of Nerono, trying in vain to remember what he knew he had forgotten.

name: Naiad of Hidden Coves
text:
"Wave-borne, he watches over secrets of the shore."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

name: Nyxborn Seaguard
text:
"Storm-tossed and broken, Callaphe cried out to deep-dwelling Thassa.
Tritons came swiftly to save her, bringing her north to the Lindus."
—*The Callapheia*

name: Omen of the Sea
text: "My time will come, when the rising tide will surge above the tallest mountain."

name: One with the Stars
text:
"Take your place among the stars."
—Kruphix, god of horizons

name: Captivating Unicorn
text:
"Gazing at the unicorn, I felt closer to the majesty of Nyx than I ever had before."
—Oineus, traveling merchant

name: Protean Thaumaturge
text: "Once you see past the veil we call 'reality,' altering your own shape is elementary."

name: Riptide Turtle
text:
"As the storm waves crushed my sailors, I cried out to Thassa. The next time I saw them, hard shells encased them, and they swam away to safety."
—Siona, captain of the *Pyleas*

name: Sage of Mysteries
text: "I see destruction, suffering, and one tormented glimmer of hope."

name: Sea God's Scorn
text: Instead of performing their daily devotions, Heliod's acolytes spent the morning picking strands of kelp off the altar.

name: Shimmerwing Chimera
text: It swims upon the winds and soars through the waves.

name: Shoal Kraken
text: It eats the things that eat the things that are drawn to the light.

name: Sleep of the Dead
text: Normally, a cerberus sleeps one head at a time.

name: Stern Dismissal
text: Cities offer tribute to Ephara and carve her image into their walls, imploring her to protect them from the dangers of the wild.

name: Stinging Lionfish
text: Starfish are its favorite prey.

name: Commanding Presence
text: "In every one of you I see a hero's heart."

name: Sweet Oblivion
text: When memory is torment, oblivion is bliss.

name: Thassa's Intervention
text: "I bring a flood that nothing can withstand."

name: Thirst for Meaning
text: A sip of recollection, an ocean of regrets.

name: Thryx, the Sudden Storm
text: Even in their mountain fortresses, the Akroans have learned not to anger Thassa.

name: Towering-Wave Mystic
text: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

name: Triton Waverider
text: "You can no more stop me than you can halt the tide."

name: Vexing Gull
text:
"May the skies be clear of gales and gulls."
—Meletian prayer

name: Dawn Evangel
text: Is there a greater promise than the glory of the sunrise?

name: Wavebreak Hippocamp
text: Tritons search for omens in its wake.

name: Whirlwind Denial
text: "No, no, and ... no."

name: Witness of Tomorrows
text: "As the future slips its way into the present, it ceases to be my concern."

name: Agonizing Remorse
text: The sharp memory of Daxos's death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.

name: Aphemia, the Cacophony
text:
"Sing, beauty. Sing for death, and for the dead."
—Ashiok

name: Aspect of Lamprey
text: "Some aspire to be mighty like the lion or the hydra. I am the parasite that feeds on them all."

name: Blight-Breath Catoblepas
text: Wherever it walks, famine follows behind.

name: Cling to Dust
text: In bleak Tizerus, all hope crumbles in your grasp.

name: Discordant Piper
text: The death of the party.

name: Drag to the Underworld
text: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.

name: Eat to Extinction
text:
"Kroxa devours what he may—not for sustenance or pleasure, but because it is his nature. He is unending hunger given form."
—Klothys, god of destiny

name: Enemy of Enlightenment
text:
"Evil flourishes where ignorance thrives."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Erebos's Intervention
text: "I bring a death none can escape."

name: Final Death
text: The Underworld erodes memory, identity, and eventually the physical form, leaving only crumbling statues called misera—hollow monuments to mortal futility.

name: Fruit of Tizerus
text: One spiny tree with bitter fruit grows in the realm of Tizerus, outside the palace of Erebos.

name: Funeral Rites
text: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.

name: Battlewise Valor
text: It's never good to walk into an ambush, but with the right spell you might walk out again.

name: Ephara's Warden
text: "When you threaten the sanctity of the polis, you insult Ephara herself. If she doesn't smite you, I will."

name: Pharika's Cure
text:
"The venom cleanses the sickness from your body, but it will not be pleasant, and you may not survive. Pharika's blessings are fickle."
—Solon, acolyte of Pharika

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Returned Centaur
text: Driven away by his living kin, he wanders mourning through the wilderness, seeking the dead city of Asphodel.

name: Returned Phalanx
text: They lived in different nations and fought in different eras, but as the Returned, they link arms as one.

name: Scourgemark
text: To members of the cult of Erebos, gold-infused tattoos symbolize the inevitable grasp of the god of death.

name: Sip of Hemlock
text: Conspirators poisoned the oracle not because her visions were wrong, but because they were right.

name: Thoughtseize
text:
"Knowledge is such a burden. Release it. Release all your fears to me."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

name: Viper's Kiss
text:
"I could heal a snakebite. Looks like you got bitten by a constellation."
—Aescalos, healer of Pharika

name: Akroan Crusader
text: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

name: Anger of the Gods
