text: There was no reason to pray. This was already an act of the gods.

name: Arena Athlete
text: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

name: Borderland Minotaur
text:
"You have led us to triumph over the forces of Mogis!" said Brygus the Brave, clapping the Champion on the back. The Champion wiped the sweat and blood from her brow. "I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."
—*The Theriad*

name: Boulderfall
text:
"Defeating the Meletians was not so difficult. I needed only to move a mountain."
—Eocles, oracle of Purphoros

name: Coordinated Assault
text: It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.

name: Deathbellow Raider
text:
"The temple has been rededicated. It belongs to Mogis now."
—Rastos, disciple of Mogis

name: Demolish
text:
"When fire is shackled to candle and torch, subjected to insignificance, it finds a way to lash out at its masters."
—Vala, disciple of Purphoros

name: Fabled Hero
text: "You. Poet. Be sure to write this down."

name: Firedrinker Satyr
text: Attending a satyr revel requires a high tolerance for pain.

name: Flamespeaker Adept
text: "I see your future, mantled in ash."

name: Hammer of Purphoros
text: All the world is Purphoros's anvil.

name: Ill-Tempered Cyclops
text: A cyclops has two moods: angry and asleep.

name: Labyrinth Champion
text: "It used to be a lair. Now it's just a tunnel."

name: Lightning Strike
text:
"The hand of Keranos can be seen in every rumbling storm cloud. Best not to stand where he points."
—Rakleia of Shrine Peak

name: Messenger's Speed
text:
"He outran arrows. He outran even the archers' insults."
—Bayma, storyteller of Lagonna Band

name: Minotaur Skullcleaver
text:
"Their only dreams are of full stomachs."
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

name: Peak Eruption
text:
"Early olive buds? A good omen. Flock of crows? Not so good. Mountain exploding? Bad. Very, very bad."
—Hira, street oracle

name: Priest of Iroas
text: "Even my last breath will be a blow struck for Iroas."

name: Rageblood Shaman
text:
"I see a spark of pure rage. Soon that spark will spread from the depths of Kragma. Soon its fire will engulf the polis."
—Hira, street oracle

name: Satyr Rambler
text: A satyr is bound by nothing—not home, not family, not loyalty.

name: Spark Jolt
text: Acolytes of Purphoros hammer the world until they see the sparks of change.

name: Titan of Eternal Fire
text: There is no gift more precious or more perilous than fire.

name: Two-Headed Cerberus
text: The left head keeps the right head starved as motivation to track new prey.

name: Wild Celebrants
text: "You can tell something's really valuable by the sound it makes when you slam your staff into it."

name: Agent of Horizons
text: The light in the woods just before dawn reveals a glimmering network of branches, roots, and spiderwebs. The acolytes of Kruphix walk this lattice unseen.

name: Anthousa, Setessan Hero
text: The warriors she leads can rarely keep pace with her, and neither can the tales.

name: Glare of Heresy
text: No foe is more hated than the former friend.

name: Artisan's Sorrow
text: Some seers read bones or entrails. Others just like to break things.

name: Centaur Battlemaster
text:
"A herd is only as strong as its weakest. Our weakest just killed his third minotaur raider—today."
—Braulios of Pheres Band

name: Commune with the Gods
text: For the first time in many years, Elspeth asked for help.

name: Defend the Hearth
text: The defenders said not a word. Their shields, spears, and stances were warning enough.

name: Fade into Antiquity
text:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

name: Feral Invocation
text: Nylea's sacred lynx guards those who honor the Nessian Wood and hunts those who don't.

name: Hunt the Hunter
text:
"A grudge is a tattoo worn on the inside."
—Setessan warrior saying

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Karametra's Acolyte
text: "The wilds are a garden tended by divine hands."

name: Nessian Asp
text: It's not the two heads you should fear. It's the four fangs.

name: Nessian Courser
text:
Khestes the Adamant, the Champion's closest ally among the centaurs, took one stone to his shoulder and another to his flank. He held his stride and his aim, and let fly the arrow that killed the giant Grinthax.
—*The Theriad*

name: Pheres-Band Centaurs
text:
"Poets speak of your unrivaled speed," the Champion said to the assembled centaurs, "but it is plain to see that your true strength lies in your unwavering loyalty to one another."
—*The Theriad*

name: Satyr Hedonist
text: "Any festival you can walk away from wasn't worth attending in the first place."

name: Satyr Piper
text:
"When I asked my commander the reward for killing that prancing nuisance, he told me, 'None! I want to kill him myself!'"
—Phrogas, soldier of Akros

name: Savage Surge
text:
"I thought its back was turned!"
"A centaur has two backs!"

name: Sedge Scorpion
text:
Thakolides the Mighty
Slayer of minotaurs
Vanquisher of giants
Killed by a scorpion
—Inscription on an Akroan grave

name: Shredding Winds
text:
"Enemies of the wood! Your presence here is a slap in Nylea's face. Do not be surprised if she slaps back."
—Telphe, druid of Nylea

name: Staunch-Hearted Warrior
text: As soon as she faces a monster, she begins composing its epitaph.

name: Sylvan Caryatid
text: Those who enter the copse never leave. They find peace there and take root, becoming part of the ever-growing grove.

name: Voyaging Satyr
text: "None can own the land's bounty. The gods made this world for all to share its riches. And I'm not just saying that because you caught me stealing your fruit."

name: Vulpine Goliath
text:
"With a diet of hydras, giants, and massive serpents, anything would get that big."
—Corisande, Setessan hunter

name: Warriors' Lesson
text:
"Let each challenge make you a better warrior."
—Anthousa of Setessa

name: Akroan Hoplite
text: "Fair fight? How could it be a fair fight? We're Akroans. They're not."

name: Anax and Cymede
text: Akros's greatest heroes are also its royalty.

name: Ashen Rider
text: One offering to appease her on her arrival. Another to celebrate her departure.

name: Chronicler of Heroes
text: She paints pictures with words, though not all pictures show the truth.

name: Destructive Revelry
text:
"Stoke a fire hot enough and you'll never run out of things to burn."
—Xenagos, the Reveler

name: Kragma Warcaller
text: A warcaller merely brings the herd together. After that, the meat-hunger is all the encouragement they need.

name: Pharika's Mender
text: "The direst venom becomes a panacea under Pharika's guidance. I bring it to the worthy, clinging at the edge of the abyss."

name: Prophet of Kruphix
text: "Time is fluid as a dance, and truth as fleeting."

name: Cavalry Pegasus
text:
"It is hope, hooved and winged."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Sentry of the Underworld
text: When Athreos gathers the newly dead to be ferried across the Five Rivers That Ring the World, he sends skeletal griffins to fetch those who stray.

name: Shipwreck Singer
text: Her melody melds death and beauty with such artistry that even the gods weep to hear it.

name: Spellheart Chimera
text: Thaumaturges remain silent around chimeras, lest their words conjure even stranger beasts.

name: Steam Augury
text: Keranos is a fickle god, delivering punishment as readily as prophecy.

name: Tymaret, the Murder King
text: His memories remained in the Underworld, but his cruelty crossed the Rivers with him.

name: Lagonna-Band Elder
text: "The best lessons are not the ones I teach. They are the ones the pupils realize for themselves."

name: Anvilwrought Raptor
text:
"I know its lightness, for I have seen it fly. I know its weight, for I have seen it strike."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

name: Bronze Sable
text:
The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra, cutting down scores among hundreds. She would have been overcome if not for the aid of the temple guardians whom Karametra awakened.
—*The Theriad*

name: Burnished Hart
text: Forged by divine hands to wander mortal realms.

name: Flamecast Wheel
text: Beware the gifts of an ill-tempered forge god.

name: Fleetfeather Sandals
text:
"The gods gave us no wings to fly, but they gave us an even greater gift: imagination."
—Daxos of Meletis

name: Guardians of Meletis
text: The histories speak of two feuding rulers whose deaths were celebrated and whose monuments symbolized the end of their wars. In truth they were peaceful lovers, their story lost to the ages.

name: Opaline Unicorn
text: Purphoros once loved Nylea, the god of the hunt. His passion inspired his most astounding works of art.

name: Prowler's Helm
text:
"The youths prattle on about heroic deeds, but avoiding the noose is a feat more daring than their entire careers."
—Basarios the Blade

name: Last Breath
text: In time, all things turn to dust. Some things just take less time.

name: Traveler's Amulet
text:
"What we call magic is nothing more than hope crystallized into a destination."
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Witches' Eye
text: The price of prophecy is a vacant eye socket.

name: Unknown Shores
text: Philosophers speak of a place where myths wash like tides upon the shores of the real.

name: Leonin Snarecaster
text: Formerly oppressed by the polis of Meletis, leonin occasionally "mistake" their old enemies for game.

name: Phalanx Leader
text: His soldiers etch his words on the insides of their shields, their inspiration always in sight during battle.

name: Ray of Dissolution
text: The works of one god last only as long as the patience of another.

name: Scholar of Athreos
text: She asks pointed questions of the dead who wait for Athreos, learning of life from those who are about to leave it.

name: Setessan Battle Priest
text: "Your god teaches you only how to kill. Karametra teaches me to defend what I hold dear. That is why I will prevail."

name: Setessan Griffin
text: Most griffins must be caught and broken into the service of the polis. Not so in Setessa, where they volunteer.

name: Silent Artisan
text:
On the fourth day they passed through a forest of immense stacked stones. Althemone, youngest of the companions, called these pillars the work of a god, but the Champion knew better. She quickened her pace.
—*The Theriad*

name: Soldier of the Pantheon
text: "I hear the gods' voices in my dreams each night, and I offer bloody trophies on their altars each day."

name: Spear of Heliod
text: Legend speaks of the Sun Spear, the mighty weapon that can strike any point in Theros, even the depths of the Underworld.

name: Traveling Philosopher
text:
The Champion and the philosopher Olexa returned from the opposing camp at dusk. Behind them, the enemy raised sail and departed, breaking the siege. When asked what the two had done, the Champion replied, "We spoke to them."
—*The Theriad*

name: Wingsteed Rider
text: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.

name: Yoked Ox
text:
It was in fields of grain, not fields of battle, that the Champion learned to bear the yoke of duty to the gods. She worked the land long before she was called on to defend it.
—*The Theriad*

name: Annul
text:
"Why pray to the gods, who feed on your worship? Dissolve your illusions and see the true nature of things."
—Xenagos, the Reveler

name: Benthic Giant
text:
"Some fates you can see coming for you, plain as day, and there's nothing you can do about them."
—Callaphe the mariner

name: Bident of Thassa
text: The wills of mortals shift as the tide ebbs and flows.

name: Breaching Hippocamp
text: Don't try to ride this steed unless you've got gills too.

name: Coastline Chimera
text: Seeing a chimera overhead foretells good fortune, but only because seeing one any closer foretells dismemberment.

name: Crackling Triton
text: He calls upon both the currents in the sea and the current in the clouds.

name: Curse of the Swine
text: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

name: Dissolve
text: "You thought only the gods could stop you?"

name: Fate Foretold
text: The tale of her life was already written, but that didn't mean she could predict the ending.

name: Gainsay
text:
"You dryfolk must take the air for granted. You constantly insist on wasting it."
—Kenessos, priest of Thassa

name: Chosen by Heliod
text:
"Training and studies aid a soldier in meager amounts. The gods do the rest."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

name: Griptide
text: When the sea god Thassa wishes to speak with a mortal, she does not issue a summons or grant a vision requesting a visit. The sea simply brings her guest before her.

name: Lost in a Labyrinth
text: Even those who leave the labyrinth never escape it, forever dreaming of their time trapped within.

name: Meletis Charlatan
text: "Every object has an echo in the Æther beyond the world. Every idea has a shadow that can be brought to light."

name: Mnemonic Wall
text:
"It augments anamnesis. What is so confusing about that?"
—Perisophia the philosopher

name: Omenspeaker
text: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

name: Dauntless Onslaught
text:
"The people of Akros must learn from our leonin adversaries. If we match their staunch ferocity with our superior faith, we cannot fail."
—Cymede, queen of Akros

name: Sea God's Revenge
text:
"What has neither mouth nor throat, yet swallows captain, crew, and boat?"
—Sphinx's riddle

name: Stymied Hopes
text: When a god's will is against you, the day never ends well.

name: Swan Song
text:
"The most enlightened mages create beauty from violence."
—Medomai the Ageless

name: Thassa's Bounty
text:
"Was this gift cast adrift for any to find, or did Thassa guide the currents to bring it to me alone?"
—Kenessos, priest of Thassa

name: Triton Fortune Hunter
text: "Thassa has blessed me with power and insight. I am careful not to disappoint her."

name: Decorated Griffin
text: The awards and medals of polis-dwellers mean nothing to griffins, but they repay acts of generosity.

name: Triton Shorethief
text:
At sunrise, the Champion and her companions awoke to find their supplies gone and Brygus, their sentry, dead. Carefully arranged piles of ornamental shells gave a clear warning: go no further.
—*The Theriad*

name: Vaporkin
text:
"Mists are carefree. They drift where they will, unencumbered by rocks and river beds."
—Thrasios, triton hero

name: Voyage's End
text: Philosophers say those lost at sea ascended to a more perfect realm. Sailors say they drowned.

name: Agent of the Fates
text: "You are breathing borrowed air."

name: Asphodel Wanderer
text: He killed out of hate, so now only hate sustains him. He sought immortality, so the gods gave it to him.

name: Blood-Toll Harpy
text: When harpies demand a toll to cross through their territory, consider yourself lucky if they permit payment in coin.

name: Divine Verdict
text: The last thing to go through the cyclops's mind was a twelve-ton block of marble.

name: Boon of Erebos
text:
"Death is not a certainty. Erebos determines when a mortal's time is up."
—Iadorna, death priest of Erebos

name: Cutthroat Maneuver
text: "Our ambition drives us forward. Together we will claim what is ours, no matter who holds it."

name: Dark Betrayal
text:
"You're just like me: ruthless, cunning, and ambitious. Obviously you're a threat."
—Basarios the Blade

name: Felhide Minotaur
text:
With spear held high, the Champion came to meet Thyrogog of the Ashlands, who wore the old king's skin as a cloak and fed on the flesh of innocents. The foul minotaur raised the great axe called Goremaster and charged.
—*The Theriad*

name: Fleshmad Steed
text: More disturbing than the unknown is a distortion of the familiar.

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

name: Insatiable Harpy
text: Gold coin, battered helmet, broken wrist bone—all have the same value in the eyes of a harpy.

name: Lash of the Whip
text:
"No matter who their fickle hearts worship, all mortals belong to one god in the end."
—Iadorna, death priest of Erebos

name: March of the Returned
text: The Returned have no memory of the Underworld or of their former lives. The golden masks they wear are the last gifts of the selves they left behind.

name: Fire Navy Trebuchet
text: The trebuchets would be destructive enough even without the fire.

name: Foggy Swamp Hunters
text:
"Set my lines by the riverbed! Caught ten fish and I killed 'em dead!"
—Foggy Swamp Tribe ditty

name: Heartless Act
text:
"Put a muzzle on him!"
—Si Wong Sandbender

name: Joo Dee, One of Many
text: "Hello! My name is Joo Dee. You're in Ba Sing Se now. Everyone is safe here."

name: June, Bounty Hunter
text: "My shirshu can smell a rat a continent away."

name: Lo and Li, Twin Tutors
text: "Almost perfect," Lo began. Li finished, "One hair out of place."

name: Mai, Scornful Striker
text: "You miscalculated. I love Zuko more than I fear you."

name: Avatar Enthusiasts
text: "There he is! There he is! The Avatar's on Kyoshi!"

name: Merchant of Many Hats
text: Also known as Dock the ferryman, Xu the fishmonger, and Bushi the river cleaner, depending on what job needed to be done in Jang Hui village.

name: Northern Air Temple
text:
"This is supposed to be the history of my people..."
—Aang

name: Ozai's Cruelty
text: "You will learn respect, and suffering will be your teacher."

name: Pirate Peddlers
text: "We prefer to think of ourselves as 'high-risk traders.'"

name: Sold Out
text: Haru's good deed went severely punished.

name: Swampsnare Trap
text:
"Just a little closer. Nice and easy. Nothing to worry about. We just fixin' to eat ya."
—Due, Foggy Swamp Tribe member

name: Wolfbat
text: Wolfbats nest in tunnels carved out by badgermoles and hunt for prey in the dark caverns.

name: Zuko's Conviction
text: "I've always had to struggle and fight, and that's made me strong."

name: Boar-q-pine
text: This fiercely territorial beast uses knife- sharp quills to ensure would-be attackers always get the point.

name: Bumi Bash
text: "You thought I was a frail old man, but I'm the most powerful Earthbender you'll ever see."

name: Combustion Man
text:
"The Avatar's alive. I want you to find him, and end him."
—Zuko

name: Combustion Technique
text:
"Sokka, watch out! It's Sparky-Sparky Boom Man!"
—Aang

name: Compassionate Healer
text: Waterbending does not only heal physical wounds. It can also soothe the spirit and calm the mind.

name: Cunning Maneuver
text:
"Is that all you got? Man, they'll make anyone an admiral these days."
—Aang

name: Deserter's Disciple
text: "Follow me! I can get you outta here!"

name: Fire Nation Attacks
text: Everything changed.

name: Fire Nation Cadets
text: Fire Nation training ensures that even the smallest flame burns into a raging inferno.

name: Fire Nation Raider
text: In the Fire Nation's eyes, the world was theirs and they would let the world know it.

name: Fire Sages
text:
"Things have changed. In the past, the sages were loyal only to the Avatar."
—Fire Sage Shyu

name: Firebending Lesson
text:
"Firebending is not something to fear, but if you don't respect it, it'll chew you up and spit you out."
—Zuko

name: Firebending Student
text:
"Fire is the element of power."
—Iroh

name: Curious Farm Animals
text: Earth Kingdom cuisine offers a stunning array of unique meats, like chicken-pork, deer-pork, and beef-pork.

name: How to Start a Riot
text: "Hey! RIOT!"

name: Iroh's Demonstration
text: "Did I ever tell you how I got the nickname 'The Dragon of the West?'"

name: The Last Agni Kai
text: Zuko's journey began when he refused to duel his father, but it would end dueling his sister.

name: Lightning Strike
text: Like lightning, Princess Azula is quick, fierce, and deadly.

name: Mai, Jaded Edge
text: "Finally, something to do."

name: Price of Freedom
text:
"We're going to win a great victory against the Fire Nation today."
—Jet

name: Destined Confrontation
text:
"Just you and me, brother. The showdown that was always meant to be."
—Azula

name: Redirect Lightning
text:
"A Waterbender lets their defense become their offense, turning their opponent's energy against them. I learned a way to do this with lightning."
—Iroh

name: Rough Rhino Cavalry
text:
"Each one is a different kind of weapons specialist. They are also a very capable singing group."
—Iroh

name: Tiger-Dillo
text: Predators with armor plating can be as bold or as cowardly as they desire.

name: Treetop Freedom Fighters
text:
"The Fire Nation thinks they don't have to worry about a couple of kids hiding in the trees. Maybe they're right. Or maybe ... they're dead wrong."
—Jet

name: Ty Lee, Artful Acrobat
text: The circus called to Ty Lee . . . until Azula called a little louder.

name: Earth Kingdom Jailer
text: "Go ahead and run. My ostrich-horse loves a good chase."

name: Wartime Protestors
text: Fire Lord Ozai's cruel reign only forged a stronger resolve in the hearts of the resistance.

name: Yuyan Archers
text:
"Their precision is legendary. The Yuyan can pin a fly to a tree from a hundred yards away without killing it."
—Admiral Zhao

name: Zuko, Exiled Prince
text: "I want the Avatar. I want my honor, my throne."

name: Allies at Last
text: Opposing elements working together in harmony.

name: Badgermole Cub
text: Every mountain starts as a molehill.

name: The Boulder, Ready to Rumble
text: "The Boulder's gonna win this in a landslide!"

name: Earth Kingdom Protectors
text: "Stand your ground! The Earth King must be protected!"

name: Cycle of Renewal
text:
"These acorns are everywhere, Aang. That means the forest will grow back."
—Katara

name: Diligent Zookeeper
text: "I wish I could get her a big, open prairie like she likes. I'd let her hop her way to happiness."

name: The Earth King
text: "Bosco seems to like him."

name: Earthbending Lesson
text:
"Rock is a stubborn element. If you're going to move it, you've got to be like a rock yourself."
—Toph

name: Earthen Ally
text: "Together, we are unshakable."

name: Elemental Teachings
text:
"Understanding others, the other elements, and the other nations will help you become whole."
—Iroh

name: Flopsie, Bumi's Buddy
text:
"Oh, that's a good boy! Yes, who has a soft belly?"
—Bumi, King of Omashu

name: Enter the Avatar State
text:
"The glow is the combination of all your past lives, focusing their energy through your body."
—Avatar Roku

name: Great Divide Guide
text: "Who's ready to cross this here canyon?"

name: Haru, Hidden Talent
text: Haru hid his incredible earthbending abilities out of fear of punishment from the Fire Nation.

name: Invasion Tactics
text:
"Your moment of truth isn't gonna be in front of some map. It's gonna to be out there on the battlefield."
—Aang

name: Origin of Metalbending
text: Metal is just earth that has been purified and refined.

name: Ostrich-Horse
text: Ostrich-horses are renowned in the Earth Kingdom as reliable steeds for couriers, soldiers, and merchants.

name: Pillar Launch
text: Toph hated flying. "Launching," however, was a trajectory under her control.

name: Fancy Footwork
text:
"Dancing isn't something you think about. It's a form of self-expression that no one can ever take away from you."
—Aang

name: Raucous Audience
text: "I think The Boulder is going to win back the belt at Earth Rumble Six!"

name: Rebellious Captives
text: "The Fire Nation will regret the day they set foot on our land!"

name: Rocky Rebuke
text: "I am the greatest Earthbender in the world; don't you two dunderheads ever forget it!"

name: Saber-Tooth Moose-Lion
text: Foo Foo Cuddlypoops didn't look much like a saber-tooth moose-lion to Sokka, but his mother certainly did.

name: Seismic Sense
text: "Even though I was born blind, I've never had a problem seeing ... I feel the vibrations in the earth, and I can 'see' where everything is."

name: Shared Roots
text:
"We are all living together even if most folks don't act like it. We all have the same roots, and we are all branches of the same tree."
—Huu

name: Sparring Dummy
text:
"I am Melon Lord! Mwahaha!"
—Toph, Melon Lord

name: Toph, the Blind Bandit
text: "You think you're so tough?"

name: True Ancestry
text:
"Understanding the struggle between your two great-grandfathers can help you better understand the battle within yourself."
—Iroh

name: Energybending
text:
"Darkness thrives in the void, but always yields to purifying light."
—The Lion-Turtle

name: Gather the White Lotus
text: "I see you favor the white lotus gambit. Not many still cling to the ancient ways."

name: Turtle-Duck
text: A turtle-duckling's greatest defense comes not from their shell, but from their mother.

name: Unlucky Cabbage Merchant
text: "My cabbages!"

name: Walltop Sentries
text: "That drill shall not reach Ba Sing Se! This is what we trained for!"

name: Abandon Attachments
text:
"Learn to let her go, or you cannot let the pure cosmic energy flow in from the universe."
—Guru Pathik

name: Air Nomad Legacy
text: Ancient stories of flying monks inspired generations of gliders to come.

name: Avatar Aang
text: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

name: Beifong's Bounty Hunters
text: "Let's take them now."

name: Glider Kids
text: The Fire Nation never expected the Earth Kingdom to take to the skies.

name: Cat-Owl
text: When it's feeling bored, it chases itself.

name: Cruel Administrator
text: "You're one mistake away from dying where you stand."

name: Earth Kingdom Soldier
text: Trained to be steady as the earth beneath their feet.

name: Earth King's Lieutenant
text: "You know well the cost of war."

name: Earth Village Ruffians
text: "The army 'appreciates' your support."

name: Glider Staff
text: More tools than weapons, gliders were used by Air Nomads to harness wind currents for travel.

name: Fire Lord Azula
text: "I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother."

name: Fire Lord Zuko
text: "Today, this war is finally over!"

name: Foggy Swamp Spirit Keeper
text: "Dang it, Slim, I told you: No eating our spirit buddies!"

name: Hei Bai, Spirit of Balance
text:
"My friend gave me hope that the forest would grow back."
—Aang

name: Hermitic Herbalist
text: "Wounded Earth Kingdom troops still come by now and again—brave boys—and thanks to my remedies they always leave in better shape than when they arrive."

name: Jet, Freedom Fighter
text: "One day, we'll drive the Fire Nation out of here for good."

name: Katara, the Fearless
text: "I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"

name: Long Feng, Grand Secretariat
text: "In silencing talk of conflict, Ba Sing Se remains a peaceful, orderly utopia."

name: Messenger Hawk
text:
"Hawky, welcome to Team Avatar."
—Sokka

name: Ozai, the Phoenix King
text: "Out of the ashes, a new world will be born."

name: Pretending Poxbearers
text: Pentapox, a deadly skin affliction bearing similarity to pentapus markings, was entirely fabricated—but the Fire Nation didn't know that.

name: Professor Zei, Anthropologist
text: "I'm not leaving. I can't. I've spent too long trying to find this place. There's not another collection of knowledge like this on earth."

name: Invasion Reinforcements
text: Many of the those who aided in the invasion of the Fire Nation were not soldiers by occupation, though they were warriors at heart.

name: Sokka, Bold Boomeranger
text: "I'm just a guy with a boomerang!"

name: Sokka, Lateral Strategist
text: "That's called Sokka style. Learn it!"

name: Suki, Kyoshi Warrior
text: "Hoping for another dance lesson?"

name: Sun Warriors
text: A secretive people who protect the ancient origins of firebending.

name: Uncle Iroh
text: "Hope is something you give yourself. That is the meaning of inner strength."

name: Jeong Jeong's Deserters
text: To leave the Fire Nation required incredible trust. They had that in Jeong Jeong.

name: Wandering Musicians
text: "Even if you're lost, you can't lose the love because it's in your heart."

name: White Lotus Reinforcements
text:
"We're all part of the same ancient secret society, a group that transcends the divisions of the four nations."
—Master Piandao

name: Zhao, Ruthless Admiral
text: "We are the sons and daughters of fire, the superior element!"

name: Barrels of Blasting Jelly
text: Not to be confused with barrels of jelly candy.

name: Bender's Waterskin
text: Katara's waterskin ensured that she would always have water for bending, healing, or drinking.

name: Kyoshi Battle Fan
text: Kyoshi Warriors wield traditional war fans to honor their namesake.

name: Meteor Sword
text: Crafted from a fallen meteor, symbolizing the sudden change that wielding it brings.

name: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong
text: It charts the movements of heavenly bodies, forecasting the fates of nations.

name: Kyoshi Warriors
text: As long as a single Kyoshi Warrior is alive, their island remains protected.

name: Trusty Boomerang
text:
"Boomerang! You do always come back!"
—Sokka

name: The Walls of Ba Sing Se
text:
"That is why the city is named Ba Sing Se. It's the 'impenetrable city.'"
—General Sung

name: White Lotus Tile
text:
"Most people think the lotus tile insignificant, but it is essential for the unusual strategy that I employ."
—Iroh

name: Abandoned Air Temple
text: Aang once knew this place to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison.

name: Agna Qel'a
text:
"The frozen tundra is treacherous, the landscape itself is an icy fortress."
—Admiral Zhao

name: Airship Engine Room
text: The Fire Nation's expansion fueled progress, and their progress fueled expansion.

name: Boiling Rock Prison
text:
"The highest security prison in the Fire Nation. It's on an island in the middle of a boiling lake. It's inescapable."
—Zuko

name: Foggy Bottom Swamp
text: The Foggy Swamp is home to many creatures and many more secrets.

name: Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop
text: Where the secret ingredient truly is love.

name: Kyoshi Village
text:
"I created Kyoshi Island so my people could be safe from invaders."
—Avatar Kyoshi

name: Meditation Pools
text:
"As you see, there are several pools where the water swirls around before flowing on. These pools are like our chakras."
—Guru Pathik

name: Misty Palms Oasis
text: A shadow of its former self, a whisper of its eventual glory.

name: North Pole Gates
text: The Northern Water Tribe knew their safety was earned through diligence and caution.

name: Omashu City
text:
"The Earth Kingdom city of Omashu! I used to always come here to visit my friend Bumi."
—Aang

name: Realm of Koh
text: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.

name: Secret Tunnel
text:
"I forget the next couple of lines, but then it goes...'Secret tunnel! Secret tunnel!"
—Chong, nomad musician

name: Serpent's Pass
text:
"The Serpent's Pass? Only the truly desperate take that deadly route!"
—Ying, Earth Kingdom refugee

name: Sun-Blessed Peak
text: The sacred site of firebending's first spark.

name: White Lotus Hideout
text:
"The White Lotus opens wide to those who know her secrets."
—Fung, White Lotus member

name: Zuko's Exile
text: As punishment for his disobedience, Zuko was banished and sent to capture the Avatar. Only then could he return home with his honor.

name: Path to Redemption
text: "You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving you will come to a better place."

name: Rabaroo Troop
text: Rabaroos are famous enjoyers of hopping and infamous enjoyers of cabbage.

name: Razor Rings
text:
"There's someone in there! He's bending the vines!"
—Sokka

name: South Pole Voyager
text: "The winds can be brutal, so be brave."

name: Southern Air Temple
text: The birthplace of the last Airbender.

name: Avatar Aang
text: "It's easy to do nothing. It's hard to forgive."

name: South Pole Voyager
text: "The winds can be brutal, so be brave."

name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
text: "I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"

name: The Mechanist, Aerial Artisan
text: "We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."

name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
text: "I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"

name: Day of Black Sun
text: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.

name: Mai, Scornful Striker
text: "You miscalculated. I love Zuko more than I fear you."

name: Wartime Protestors
text: Fire Lord Ozai's cruel reign only forged a stronger resolve in the hearts of the resistance.

name: Earthen Ally
text: "Together, we are unshakable."

name: Elemental Teachings
text:
"Understanding others, the other elements, and the other nations will help you become whole."
—Iroh

name: Beifong's Bounty Hunters
text: "Let's take them now."

name: Team Avatar
text: Despite Sokka's best efforts, neither Boomeraang Squad nor Fearsome Foursome caught on.

name: Earth King's Lieutenant
text: "You know well the cost of war."

name: Sokka, Bold Boomeranger
text: "I'm just a guy with a boomerang!"

name: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong
text: It charts the movements of heavenly bodies, forecasting the fates of nations.

name: Abandoned Air Temple
text: Aang once knew this place to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison.

name: Agna Qel'a
text:
"The frozen tundra is treacherous, the landscape itself is an icy fortress."
—Admiral Zhao

name: United Front
text:
"When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!"
—Hakoda

name: Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop
text: Where the secret ingredient truly is love.

name: Realm of Koh
text: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.

name: Secret Tunnel
text:
"I forget the next couple of lines, but then it goes...'Secret tunnel! Secret tunnel!"
—Chong, nomad musician

name: Water Tribe Captain
text: "Follow me to the bay! Our scouts have spotted the Fire Navy's smoketrail approaching, and we shall meet them with force!"

name: Yip Yip!
text:
"You better throw in an extra 'yip'! We gotta move!"
—Sokka

name: Accumulate Wisdom
text:
"To prove your worth as scholars, you have to contribute some worthwhile knowledge."
—Wan Shi Tong

name: Boomerang Basics
text: "All right buddy, don't fail me now!"

name: First-Time Flyer
text: Aang offered ancient Air Nomad wisdom to the newest generation of glider riders: Keep your mouth closed, so you don't swallow any bugs.

name: Flexible Waterbender
text:
"Water is the element of change."
—Iroh

name: Forecasting Fortune Teller
text: Many believe that clouds tell the future, but they do not shape it.

name: Geyser Leaper
text: With enough water pressure, a Waterbender can briefly experience the world as an Airbender.

name: Gran-Gran
text: "It's been so long since I've had hope, but you brought it back to life."

name: Iguana Parrot
text: A common companion for pirates, beloved for their loyalty and craftiness.

name: It'll Quench Ya!
text: "Drink cactus juice. Nothing's quenchier. It's the quenchiest!"

name: Katara, Bending Prodigy
text: "You can't knock me down!"

name: Lost Days
text: At every step, his friend was just out of reach.

name: The Mechanist, Aerial Artisan
text: "We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."

name: North Pole Patrol
text: Waterbenders patrol the coast each day for good fishing spots and bad weather omens.

name: Octopus Form
text: A skilled Waterbender is always well armed.

name: Otter-Penguin
text:
"Will you go penguin sledding with me?"
—Aang

name: Rowdy Snowballers
text: Sokka's training was generally ineffective, but the children of Wolf Cove didn't seem to mind.

name: Airbender's Reversal
text: Aang employed the typical Airbender tactics against Zuko: avoid and evade.

name: Serpent of the Pass
text: Those who walk the Serpent's Pass quickly discover the origin of its name.

name: The Spirit Oasis
text:
"It's the center of all spiritual energy in our land."
—Princess Yue

name: Tiger-Seal
text: Every creature in the world felt the Avatar's return and paid respects in whatever way it could.

name: Airbending Lesson
text:
"Very interesting move, young one."
—Monk Gyatso

name: Waterbending Lesson
text:
"Just push and pull the water—like this."
—Katara

name: Waterbending Scroll
text: The scroll taught Katara many useful skills. So did fighting the angry pirates she stole it from.

name: Yue, the Moon Spirit
text: "You'll save the world again. But you can't give up."

name: Azula Always Lies
text: Azula is a skilled and deadly warrior, but her true passion is emotional torment.

name: Azula, On the Hunt
text: "You can run, but I'll catch you."

name: Beetle-Headed Merchants
text: To these desert-dwelling traders, there is profit to be found under every dune of sand and in every living thing.

name: Buzzard-Wasp Colony
text: What doesn't survive the Si Wong Desert assures that the buzzard-wasps do.

name: Callous Inspector
text: Protection fees can burn a hole in your pocket, but they're better than the alternative.

name: Cat-Gator
text: People don't go fishing for cat-gators. Cat-gators go fishing for people.

name: Corrupt Court Official
text: "Bring out the Wheel of Punishment!"

name: Dai Li Indoctrination
text: "There is no war in Ba Sing Se."

name: Day of Black Sun
text: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.

name: Deadly Precision
text: Mai didn't always care, but she never missed.

name: Epic Downfall
text: With Azula's defeat, all of her nobility, grace, and confidence shattered into harrowing screams from the would-be Fire Lord.

name: Fatal Fissure
text: Long Feng normally used the Dai Li to silence dissidents, but he wasn't above taking a more direct approach.

name: Fire Nation Engineer
text: A lonely worker can find trouble making friends on an airship so massive.

name: Whirlwind Technique
text: Airbenders employ negative jing in combat, preferring to blow their opponents back instead of fighting.

name: Dai Li Censor
text: The Dai Li are the cultural authority of Ba Sing Se and guardians of all Earth Kingdom traditions.

name: Giant Fly
text: Large carcasses lead to large flies. Large flies lead to large problems.

name: Lo and Li, Royal Advisors
text: "Azula, we are concerned for you and your well-being."

name: Ruthless Waterbender
text: "If the Fire Nation thinks they can invade my home, it'll be the last mistake they ever make."

name: Scarring Memories
text: Zuko's scar reminded him of the day he refused to fight his father, and the brutal lessons that followed.

name: Avatar Roku, Firebender
text: "Make sense of our past, Aang, and you will bring peace, and restore balance to the world."

name: Deer-Dog
text: A predator once abundant in the dunes of ages past, now most commonly found as pets napping in the shady areas of the Misty Palms Oasis.

name: Frantic Confrontation
text:
"Enemies and traitors, all working together..."
—Azula

name: Freedom Fighter Recruit
text: Generations of war created lost children in every nation, with no loyalty to anyone but each other.

name: Longshot, Rebel Bowman
text: He rarely used words, but then again, he rarely needed them.

name: Moku, Meandering Drummer
text: Moku marches to the beat of a different drum.

name: Overwhelming Victory
text: "Yes, we defeated you for all time. You will never rise from the ashes of your shame and humiliation!"

name: Reckless Blaze
text: Aang learned the hard way not to play with fire.

name: Smellerbee, Rebel Fighter
text: "As long as I'm confident with who I am, it doesn't matter what other people think."

name: Zuko, Firebending Master
text: "I have changed."

name: Animal Attendant
text: Despite a lack of funds, the elderly zookeeper tried his very best to care for his animals.

name: The Art of Tea
text:
"The secret ingredient is love."
—Iroh

name: Bison Whistle
text:
"I knew a bison whistle would come in handy."
—Aang

name: The Cabbage Merchant
text: "My cabbages..."

name: Cracked Earth Technique
text: Against Toph, an army's greatest mistake is touching the ground.

name: Creeping Crystal Coating
text: Jennamite, also known as "creeping crystal," grows remarkably fast. It's also a delicious candy.

name: Crystalline Armor
text: The Crystal Catacombs offered Aang sharp and enduring armor, making him a fair match against an opponent as sharp and enduring as Azula.

name: Kyoshi Warrior Exemplars
text: Like the Avatar that is their namesake, the Kyoshi Warriors fight with dedication, strategy, and ferocity.

name: Master's Guidance
text: "You are clearly outnumbered," barked the soldier. "You are clearly outmatched," Iroh replied.

name: Tale of Katara and Toph
text: "It's about time we did something fun together."

name: Aang, A Lot to Learn
text: "First you form a ball. Then you've got to get on quick!"

name: Hook Swords
text: Versatile swords for a complicated swordsman.

name: Stand United
text:
"It's not about strength. Our technique is about using your opponent's force against them."
—Suki

name: Zuko, Seeking Honor
text: "My name is Zuko. Prince of the Fire Nation and heir to the throne."

name: Acrobatic Leap
text: Once Aang and The Blue Spirit were under attack, it was unclear which one was rescuing the other.

name: Cloudshift
text:
"Clouds are made of water and air, so between the two of us, we ought to be able to bend them into any shape we want."
—Aang

name: Duelist's Heritage
text:
"Excellent! Using your superior agility against an older opponent."
—Master Piandao

name: Valorous Stance
text: "I'm going to join the Avatar. And I'm going to help him defeat you."

name: Brainstorm
text:
"Now I get it. Something awful happened on that day. I don't know what, but I do know why. Firebenders lose their bending during a solar eclipse!"
—Sokka

name: Coastal Piracy
text:
"Earth Nation! Fire Nation! Water Nation! So long as bargains are your inclination, you're welcome here!"
—Pirate peddler

name: Consider
text:
"Hmm. Delectable tea, or deadly poison?"
—Iroh

name: Dramatic Reversal
text:
"I beat you all before and I'll do it again!"
—Toph

name: Frantic Search
text: In the skies of the Si Wong Desert, a solitary winged lemur searched in vain for a lost friend.

name: Bastion of Remembrance
text: Brave soldier boy comes marching home.

name: Dark Deal
text:
"I want to make a deal. It's time that I regain control of Ba Sing Se, and you have something I need."
—Long Feng

name: Diresight
text: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

name: Bolt Bend
text: By studying the ways of the Waterbenders, Iroh learned how to redirect lightning.

name: Cathartic Reunion
text:
"I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you'd lost your way."
—Iroh

name: Fists of Flame
text: Zuko's rage fueled his firebending, making him one of the fiercest in the Fire Nation.

name: Descendants' Path
text: The wisdom of many in one so small.

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Sozin's comet is arriving and our destinies are upon us!"

name: Many Partings
text: "No! My cabbages!"

name: Suspicious Bookcase
text: Buried beneath the sands of an unforgiving desert, a vast library of knowledge stores mysterious books in its massive halls.

name: Jet, Rebel Leader
text: "Gotta be quicker next time."

name: Monk Gyatso
text: "My ancient cake-making technique isn't the only thing on your mind, is it, Aang?"

name: Sokka, Swordmaster
text: Sokka mastered the sword like his friends mastered the elements.

name: Suki, Kyoshi Captain
text: "The silk thread symbolizes the brave blood that flows through our veins. The gold insignia represents the honor of the warrior's heart."

name: Tale of Momo
text: Rain filled Appa's pawprint, and despair filled Momo's heart.

name: The Blue Spirit
text: To the Avatar, was the Blue Spirit a friend? A foe? Or something else entirely?

name: Katara, Waterbending Master
text: "The strength of your heart makes you who you are."

—Princess Yue

text:
"I guess you've never fought an Airbender before."
—Aang

text: Even Firebenders hate fire ants, so the Sun Warriors ensure the sloths are free to eat their fill.

name: Allied Teamwork
text: Jet's Freedom Fighters are a dangerous band whose strength lies in three things: their purpose, their numbers, and their bond.

name: Appa, Aang's Companion
text: A sky bison is a companion for life.

name: Katara, Heroic Healer
text: "Calm down. It's going to be okay."

name: Kyoshi Warrior Guard
text: Kyoshi Warrior drills are designed to encourage individual discipline as well as uncompromising trust in their fellow warriors.

name: Momo, Rambunctious Rascal
text:
"Where's Momo?"
—A common query among Team Avatar

text: Otter-penguins often play with humans, carrying them on their backs as they sled down snowy embankments.

name: Sokka, Wolf Cove's Protector
text: "It's important that you show no fear when you face a Firebender."

name: Tundra Wall
text: Wolf Cove's snow fort doubles as Sokka's watchtower and a playground for Water Tribe children.

name: Wolf Cove Villager
text: Life is simply slower in the snow. Nobody knows that better than the villagers of Wolf Cove.

name: Deny Entry
text: Her judgment was swift and final... and rather rude.

name: Flying Dolphin-Fish
text: Schools of dolphin-fish follow Fire Nation vessels, hoping to score an easy meal from broken nets.

name: Lost in the Spirit World
text: A place of infinite wonders and endless perils.

name: The Terror of Serpent's Pass
text:
"I think I just figured out why they call it the Serpent's Pass!"
—Sokka

name: Turtle-Seals
text: Their underwater ice caves weave throughout the north pole, providing traversal for those willing to brave the cold.

name: Water Whip
text: "The key is getting the wrist movement right."

name: Elephant-Rat
text:
"The rats that scurried across the floor of my cage were nothing more than skins filled with liquid."
—Hama

name: Fire Nation Ambushers
text: "Hey! That kid's the Avatar!"

name: Fire Nation Sentinels
text: "The Fire Nation shall be victorious by any means necessary."

name: Gilacorn
text: For any creature to survive in the Si Wong Desert, they must be hardworking, extremely opportunistic, or both.

name: Lion Vulture
text: Fire Nation circuses captivate audiences with even more captive animals.

name: Purple Pentapus
text: Useful for whipping up a fictional plague in a pinch.

name: Capital Guard
text: Fire Nation guards rely more on fear than fire.

name: Dragon Moose
text: Noble passengers require noble transportation.

name: Explosive Shot
text:
"You're not to blow the dam until I give the signal."
—Jet

name: Fire Nation Soldier
text: Fire Nation soldiers spread like wildfire during the Hundred Year War.

name: Fire Nation's Conquest
text:
"Come out, Avatar! You can't hide from me forever."
—Zuko

name: Iroh, Firebending Instructor
text: "Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame."

name: Komodo Rhino
text: The Komodo Rhino embodies the spirit of Fire Nation soldiers. They are aggressive, disciplined, and feared.

name: Loyal Fire Sage
text: "You wish to speak to Avatar Roku. I can take you to him."

name: Roku's Mastery
text: Though Avatar Roku mastered all four elements, nothing seemed to quell a brewing conflict like a sun-sized ball of fire.

name: Warship Scout
text: "For the glory of the Fire Nation!"

name: Zhao, the Seething Flame
text: "Stand and fight, Avatar!"

name: Zuko, Avatar Hunter
text: "Once I deliver the Avatar to my father, he will welcome me home with honor and restore my rightful place on the throne."

name: Zuko's Offense
text:
"Looks like I underestimated you."
—Zuko

name: Eel-Hounds
text:
"Nothing runs faster over land or swims quicker than a giant eel-hound."
—Master Piandao

name: Frog-Squirrels
text: Some of the mysterious croaking and chittering heard in the Foggy Swamp can be traced back to frog-squirrels, who hop along the canopy and snack on giant insects.

name: Hippo-Cows
text: While hippo-cows are relatively docile, wise farmers still prefer to keep a safe distance.

name: Match the Odds
text:
"Here's your chance, Earthbenders! Take it! Your fate is in your own hands!"
—Katara

name: Seismic Tutelage
text: "The key is being completely rooted—physically and mentally unmovable."

name: Hog-Monkey Rampage
text: Nothing's wilder than a hog-monkey.

name: Feed the Swarm
text: Buzzard-wasps single-mindedly scour the Si Wong Desert in search of dead or dying prey.

name: Run Amok
text: Even without its rider, a Komodo Rhino will cause its fair share of destruction— unaided and unprompted.

name: Explore
text: Sky bison know no boundaries by land or sea, for the sky above them is boundless.

name: Thriving Bluff
text: Makapu Village was a highly desirable place to live and farm. Though the local fortune teller claimed the volcano was dormant, the Avatar thought otherwise.

name: Thriving Grove
text: With the Avatar's aid, the Ba Sing Se Zoo became a safe haven for animals across the four nations.

name: Thriving Heath
text: Outside the sanctuary of Ba Sing Se's walls, humble Earth Kingdom villages hope to stave off the news of war for just one more day.

name: Thriving Isle
text:
"Ember Island gives everyone a clean slate. Ember Island reveals the true you."
—Lo and Li

name: Thriving Moor
text:
"In the Swamp, we see visions of people we've lost, people we've loved, folks we think are gone."
—Нuu

—A common query among Team Avatar

text: "You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving you will come to a better place."

—Sokka

text:
"All the past Avatars, all their experience and wisdom, is available to you if you look deep inside yourself."
—Avatar Roku

text: "The Fire Lord is Aang's fight. We need to stay focused on stopping that fleet from burning down the Earth Kingdom."

name: Fierce Guardianship
text: "Your technique is useless on me."

name: Mystical Tutor
text:
"Even the separation of the four elements is an illusion. If you open your mind you will see all the elements are one, four parts of the same whole."
—Guru Pathik

name: Deadly Rollick
text: "True power is something you're born with."

name: Entomb
text: "I could spend an eternity in here."

name: Deflecting Swat
text:
"If you let the energy in your own body flow, the lightning will follow it."
—Iroh

name: Gamble
text: "Everyone guesses wrong because the dealer moves the rock at the last minute, but I can feel it with my earthbending."

name: Obscuring Haze
text:
"Toph, there's too many of them. We need an Earthbender. We need you."
—Katara

name: Worldly Tutor
text: "Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights."

name: Arcane Signet
text:
"You chose them from among thousands of toys, Aang. The toys you picked were the four Avatar relics. These items belonged to Avatars past. Your own past lives."
—Monk Tashi

name: Sol Ring
text:
"The road ahead of us is challenging. A hundred years of fighting has left the world scarred and divided. But with the Avatar's help, we can get it back on the right path and begin a new era of love and peace."
—Zuko

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"Air is the element of freedom."
—Iroh

name: Air Nomad Student
text: "Hey everybody! I'm doing it!"

name: The Duke, Rebel Sentry
text: A royal pain in the Fire Nation's backside.

text: Thanks to Katara, the coal meant to fuel enemy ships instead fueled the prisoners' liberation.

name: Jet, Rebel Leader
text: "Gotta be quicker next time."

name: Kindly Customer
text:
"I've seen that girl in here quite a lot. Seems to me she has quite a little crush on you."
—Iroh, to Zuko

name: Koala-Sheep
text: Koala-sheep can fall asleep anywhere, and often do.

name: Monk Gyatso
text: "My ancient cake-making technique isn't the only thing on your mind, is it, Aang?"

name: Pipsqueak, Rebel Strongarm
text: "You think my name is funny?"

text: Sokka mastered the sword like his friends mastered the elements.

text:
"The first thing you must learn is that your weapon is an extension of yourself. You must think of it as another part of your own body."
—Master Piandao

text: "The silk thread symbolizes the brave blood that flows through our veins. The gold insignia represents the honor of the warrior's heart."

text:
"My first girlfriend turned into the moon."
—Sokka

text: Though Sokka believed the toucan-puffins were gathering intel for the enemy, it's far more likely they were simply gathering nesting for their mates.

text: To the Avatar, was the Blue Spirit a friend? A foe? Or something else entirely?

—Princess Yue

name: Unagi's Spray
text: Capable of both blasting ships to pieces and humbling showboating Avatars.

name: Baxter, Fly in the Ointment
text: "What am I? I am nothing anymore! A FREAK! I'll never be taken seriously as a scientist again!"

name: Hamato Ninpō
text: Strike with swiftness. Strike with purpose. Strike true.

name: Leonardo, Worldly Warrior
text: "Push yourself beyond your limits, to a place where there are no limits!"

name: Leo's Guidance
text: Leonardo may have been a goody two-toes and the butt of every joke, but he was also the one they turned to when it was time to put the jokes away.

name: Splinter, Aging Champion
text: Once every decade, Splinter returns to the Battle Nexus. He fights not for glory, but to honor an old friend.

name: Triceraton Regenta
text:
"I am meant to be the Triceraton Regenta, so I must fulfill my destiny and avenge my mother's death!"
—Seri

name: Wooden Cane
text: "A tool need not be complex to be efficient."

name: April O'Neil, Human Element
text: "If you steal mutagen that doesn't exist from aliens that also don't exist, it's not really theft. More like creative writing!"

name: Containment Protocol
text: "What else can we do? No prison could hold Tokka, and she'll hurt someone if we let her out to play."

name: Here Comes a New Hero!
text: "Give me a recap. Are we winning or losing?"

name: Donatello's Science Lesson
text: Now it is the shell who does the shocking.

name: Utrom Monitor
text: The utrom are a peace-minded people, up to a point. Beyond that, they are a laser-minded people.

name: Casey Jones, Asphalt Hooligan
text: "Two minutes for slashing, two minutes for hooking, and my personal favorite, two minutes for high-sticking."

name: Monster Mashup
text:
"Yes! It knows how to destroy! My secret concern is, does it know how to obey?"
—Krang

name: Raphael, Tag Team Tough
text: "How about a five-minute game misconduct for roughing, pal?"

name: Raph's Bravado
text: "Why does everyone have such a hard time believing I'm a good guy?"

name: Irma, Part-Time Mutant
text: "I'm not trying to cause trouble. Trouble just follows me around."

name: Storm of Steel
text: Raphael loves this stuff. There's a flash as his shuriken come out. The toughs don't even see that. Too bad.

name: Ticked Off
text:
"I can take it!"
—Raphael

name: Foe-liage
text:
"Wilcox said a weed is but an unloved flower, but this is the kind of flower only his mother could love!"
—Donatello

name: Mona Lisa, Ever Adaptable
text: "Being surrounded by a little chaos is normally my little happy place, but . . ."

name: Prehistoric Turtlesaurus
text:
"Dinobunga!"
—Michelangelo

name: Study the Classics
text:
"Well, this is *like* meditating . . ."
—Michelangelo

name: Turtle Tracks
text: A good view isn't about location. It's about perspective.

name: Krang, the All-Powerful
text: "I am Krang, the All-Powerful! I have never been defeated!"

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Esposito, my liege, grant me the flavor I am due."
—Splinter, the Nibblemancer

name: Waste Not
text: Devoured by the turtle community.

name: Food Chain
text: Every pizza is some teenager's prey.

name: Supreme Verdict
text: Raphael had no second thoughts about the supreme edict. He'd left text messages warning of the concoction, even though there was no service.

name: Commander's Plate
text: Not all edible things are fragile.

name: Game Over
text:
"I've beaten this turtle already. This is no test."
—Karai

name: Rat King, Pale Piper
text: "Every chessboard requires pawns. Tonight, my pawn, I'll find out just how strong you are."

name: Donatello, the Brains
text: "I always thought there'd be more to the ooze."

name: Swift Demise
text: "My patience wears thin!"

name: Fast Forward
text: The streets are a dangerous place for a pair of neon nightriders.

name: Tempestra, Dame of Games
text: "The stakes have risen, my green friends. Now you are playing for the fate of the world!"

name: Tokka & Rahzar, Unsupervised
text:
"They're not stupid. They're infants."
—Professor Jordan Perry

name: High Score
text: Victory comes in endless forms.

name: Splinter, the Mentor
text: "We choose what holds us back."

name: Leatherhead, Iron Gator
text: She's a thousand pounds of punishing reptile muscle, with the bite to back it up.

name: Ninja Pizza
text: The pizza that vanishes quickly without a trace.

name: Super Combo
text: "Just gotta hit 'em harder than they hit you!"

name: Arcade Cabinet
text: From the golden age of gaming . . .

name: Coin of Mastery
text: Nowhere else can one coin buy you a second chance.

name: Exploding Barrel
text:
"Good news, dudes! It says it's inflammable!"
—Michelangelo

name: Big Apple, 3 a.m.
text:
"All the best comic books start in dark alleys."
—Michelangelo

name: Hidden Hideout
text: Between ninjas, mutants, and alien bases, the subterranean housing market is shockingly competitive.

name: Together Forever
text: One lean, mean, green, incredible team.

name: Vanquish the Horde
text:
"Ninja master, meet derby queen!"
—April O'Neil

name: Wave Goodbye
text:
"Thanks to its increased density, water flowing at just seven miles per hour carries the same kinetic energy as an F5 tornado . . . which is to say: Hold on tight, guys!"
—Donatello

name: Blasphemous Act
text: It was a blunt metaphor: No legacies. No past. From here, the Turtles must choose to live in the present. Or not at all.

name: Acidic Slime
text:
"He's more mutagen than mutant!"
—Donatello

name: Cultivate
text:
"One need not always find peace on the sword's edge, my son. One can find peace as readily in helping things grow."
—Splinter

name: Harmonize
text: "Yo! It's the green machine! / Gonna rock the town without bein' seen! / Have you ever seen a turtle get doooown?"

name: Steelbane Hydra
text: "Slash was too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let him rest in peace . . . Even if the knockoffs proved temperamental."

name: Assassin's Trophy
text: "Who are these . . . freaks? How do they know to fight like that? Answer me, or hang here until you die."

name: Corpsejack Menace
text: "Fear. Feed. Stronger. Spread my spawn."

name: Arcane Signet
text: The power to draw on the wisdom of your allies at any time, from any place . . . or trade cat pics!

name: Chromatic Lantern
text: The Time Scepter can not only control time, but bend reality itself. Its master could rule all of reality, rewriting history to suit their whims.

name: Sol Ring
text: Antonio's accommodated every request, asked no questions, and stayed open late. Truly a light in the darkness.

name: Heroes in a Half Shell
text: They're the world's most fearsome fighting team!

name: Ash Barrens
text: Many interstellar civilizations have dumped their unwanted elements on Planet Morbus, from toxins to lowlifes.

name: Cinder Glade
text: Bury my shell on the lone prairie . . .

name: City of Brass
text: It's like the future's a party that these brothers just crashed . . .

name: Command Tower
text: Back in the '80s, Channel 6 built their headquarters at the corner of Spectacle and Scandal.

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: What began with a deafening roar ends in uncertain silence . . .

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"A hamster sumo wrestler? Snot that's also a crime lord? An alien newt assassin? April, how am I supposed to edit all of this footage into something watchable, much less believable?"
—Irma Langenstein

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"Yooo, Rock, check that out. A *mutant* music club?"
—Bebop

name: Grand Coliseum
text:
"You have traveled from the multitude of diverse universes, and I bid you welcome to the Battle Nexus Tournament."
—Daimyo

name: Hinterland Harbor
text: The 79th dimension of Null-Time—the one the Time Masters call home—is the most stable. Ironically, it is lost to time whether they settled there because of that stability or if they made it so.

name: Continue?
text: "You've gotta give it your all because anything less won't get the job done."

name: Rain-Slicked Copse
text:
"This doesn't report weather. It makes weather! It's Krang's own design. Fair with high clouds . . . mild showers . . . Aha, TOTAL CHAOS!"
—General Traag

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Cruel fate shattered their homeworld into asteroids, with only traces of life preserved beneath emergency shelters. The Triceraton Republic fully intends to make that everyone else's problem . . .

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: Using their stolen Time Scepter—with total command of time and space—Bebop and Rocksteady departed for Prehistoric Earth in search of "somethin' big ta wrassle."

name: Sodden Verdure
text:
"Dis river, she dangerous. Not clean and safe like your sewers back home, ya?"
—Leatherhead

name: Spire Garden
text: The strange nature of Dimension X allows any and every microhabitat to flourish, from planet-sized eyes to an asteroid-top jungle paradise.

name: Sunken Hollow
text:
"The Caribbean in 1530? Rad! Pirates are totally cold! Is that what you say in your time? Or tepid? Cool? Anyway, the Time Scepter says Bebop and Rocksteady should be here somewhere."
—Renet

name: Thriving Grove
text:
"Lookit 'em, Rock. So quiet and content. Dey don't even know they're in a box fer other people ta gawk at. What a buncha dopes."
—Bebop

name: Thriving Isle
text:
"My preservation was a spectacle. Artificial empathy to salve the crushing despair of modern human society. Fool's compassion."
—Ray Fillet

name: Thriving Moor
text:
"Not remember good, papa, but . . . miss home. Miss friend."
—Tokka

name: Undergrowth Stadium
text: "Welcome, wrestling fans, to Stump Asteroid: Home of Stump Arena and the Intergalactic Wrestling Federation! Tonight we welcome new tag-team challengers! They're lean! They're mean! They're green . . ."

name: Vernal Fen
text:
"You are here because the outside world rejects you. The Foot is your family. I am your father."
—Shredder

name: Vibrant Cityscape
text:
"Where do you want to go? Jungle level? Ice level? Lava level? They have all the classics!"
—Donatello

name: April O'Neil, Live on the Scene
text: "This is great! I must really be onto something hot if they're trying to kill me!"

name: Definitely Not a Turtle
text: Nothing a New Yorker ain't seen a thousand times before.

name: Advance Scout
text:
"The soldier's path is worn smooth by the tread of many feet—all in one direction, none returning."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Unstable Shapeshifter
text:
"In a world of untruths, the living lie rules."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Whispers of the Muse
text:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

name: Wind Dancer
text:
"Flying like a bird does not make you as free as one."
—Volrath

name: Wind Drake
text: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly. "You are like the drake," she said, her expression unchanging. "It works hard to maintain its position, but to us it seems to glide along effortlessly. You *must* do the same."

name: Winged Sliver
text:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Abandon Hope
text: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees, Hanna mouthed a silent plea, mourning a crushed dream.

name: Blood Pet
text: "You are wrong," Volrath said. "I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me." And then he laughed.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: "Once they've marked you," Starke said, "the world is made of glass."

name: Clot Sliver
text:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Coercion
text:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

name: Commander Greven il-Vec
text:
"Rage is the only freedom left me."
—Greven *il*-Vec

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"If there is such a thing as too much power, I have not discovered it."
—Volrath

name: Darkling Stalker
text:
"In this dark place, yes, I *am* afraid of my own shadow."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Dauthi Embrace
text:
"The Dauthi army grows by screams and bounds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Dauthi Marauder
text:
"The Dauthi came from beneath the Ruins one night, and the darkness cast them in the best possible light."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

name: Dauthi Mercenary
text:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Dauthi Slayer
text:
"They have knives for every soul."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Death Pits of Rath
text: As the sludge below began to shift and take shapes, Gerrard turned from the railing to Orim. "I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?"

name: Diabolic Edict
text: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

name: Dread of Night
text:
"These moonless, foreign skies keep me in thrall. Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Dregs of Sorrow
text: Crovax gazed upon the dead, and for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

name: Endless Scream
text:
"I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream. The pain will not end, but will bind him to me."
—Volrath

name: Enfeeblement
text: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*. As the battle raged on deck, he felt his strength melt in the heat of her betrayal.

name: Extinction
text:
"I once had an entire race killed just to listen to the rattling of their dried bones as I waded through them."
—Volrath

name: Fevered Convulsions
text:
"Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard, you worthless pile of spine."
—Volrath, to Greven

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Clergy en-Vec
text:
"Faith's shield is hammered out by the blows of unbelievers."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Knight of Dusk
text:
Fall like night upon the foe.
—Motto of the Knights of Dusk

name: Marsh Lurker
text: From the mists it rises, into the mists it retreats; through the mists it walks, fearless and unseen.

name: Mindwhip Sliver
text:
"They share more than their thoughts. We must shatter their link quickly!"
—Hanna, to Orim

name: Perish
text:
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Pit Imp
text: The moans of the Death Pits were underscored by the chattering of imps, for whom the ship was cause for much discussion.

name: Rain of Tears
text:
"These rains cannot quench; they carve the land's face like a scalpel on flesh."
—Crovax

name: Cloudchaser Eagle
text:
When the eagle catches a cloud, it tears it into strips that fall to earth.
—Vec myth of the rains

name: Rats of Rath
text:
"These creatures offer new challenges in the scrutiny of entrails."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Reckless Spite
text:
"My plan's elegance leads my enemies to believe it is spite that fuels me."
—Volrath

name: Sadistic Glee
text:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Screeching Harpy
text:
"They are called 'fowl' for a reason."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Servant of Volrath
text:
"Volrath is a harsh master. My reflection is a constant reminder of that."
—Greven *il*-Vec

name: Skyshroud Vampire
text:
"If it tastes one drop of elvish blood I will cast it from the shroud to see it burn."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Souldrinker
text: Don't drink and thrive.

name: Spinal Graft
text:
"This one has not screamed enough to show effective implantation. Kill it."
—Volrath

name: Disenchant
text: The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."

name: Aftershock
text:
"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Ancient Runes
text: Ertai volunteered to open the portal. He figured he owed it one.

name: Apocalypse
text:
"There is a future in which I can see only mist and a single shadow."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Barbed Sliver
text: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

name: Blood Frenzy
text:
"When Torahn bellows, none survive—not even the warrior whose horns he rides."
—Talruum adage

name: Boil
text:
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Canyon Drake
text: "These runes are tough enough without the distraction," Ertai muttered, one eye on the drake.

name: Canyon Wildcat
text: "Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.

name: Crown of Flames
text: It is the forge of kings.

name: Elite Javelineer
text:
"Precision is frequently more valuable than force."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Deadshot
text:
"Carrion! Keep your distance. My blade will come to you!"
—Crovax

name: Firefly
text:
"If they don't pinch, they burn. Can't ya eat any of da bugs here?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Fireslinger
text:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Flowstone Giant
text:
When the first of these giants woke from the bedrock, he was still sleepy. He yawned and stretched until his legs grew so thin that they snapped like icicles in the sun.
—Vec lore

name: Flowstone Salamander
text: The Furnace of Rath is periodically illuminated by their sparkling yawns.

name: Flowstone Wyvern
text:
"Where I come from, stone stays on the ground."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Giant Strength
text: "Crovax seems filled only with shadows," thought Orim. "Where does his strength come from?"

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

name: Hand to Hand
text: The match between Tahngarth and Greven was close only in the mind of the minotaur.

name: Havoc
text: As Orim put the lightning rod into place on the bow, she cast a spell of protection to shield herself from the heat. That's when the Furnace got personal.

name: Heart Sliver
text: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

name: Jackal Pup
text: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

name: Kindle
text: Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.

name: Lightning Blast
text:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Lightning Elemental
text: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

name: Lowland Giant
text: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

name: Mogg Conscripts
text:
"Torahn's horns! They've seen us. Now, statue, you must fight to save yourself!"
—Tahngarth, aboard the *Predator*

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Mogg Raider
text: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

name: Mogg Squad
text: As they crept into the *Weatherlight*'s hold, the squad leader held up his hand and whispered, "Stop, goblins—what's that sound?"

name: No Quarter
text: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other, the moggs caught between them realized they should flee.

name: Opportunist
text: The third time the Oracle glanced suspiciously at him, Starke decided she had glanced twice too often.

name: Pallimud
text: The old Vec tell tales of a beast that fed on scraps but turned its nose up at the lavish banquet they set in its honor.

name: Rathi Dragon
text: Wrap the flame as twine Kingdoms will be thine.

name: Renegade Warlord
text:
"His tongue must be honey, the way he gathers ants to fight with him."
—Volrath

name: Rolling Thunder
text: "Such rage," thought Vhati, gazing up at the thunderhead from the *Predator*. "It is Greven's mind manifest."

name: Sandstone Warrior
text:
"I used to describe something stable as 'rock solid.' So much for *that* expression."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Gallantry
text: "Forgive me," Mirri whispered. "I thought you a burden, and you saved my life." Hanna quietly accepted the apology.

name: Scorched Earth
text:
"Fire cleanses as well as destroys; that is the nature of change."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Shadowstorm
text:
"You've not seen a storm until you've seen the kind that roars between worlds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Shatter
text:
"Such fuss over machines, Gerrard. Remember that you are the prize of the Legacy. Throw away your toys!"
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Starke of Rath
text:
"I know to whom I owe the most loyalty, and I see him in the mirror every day."
—Starke

name: Stone Rain
text:
"The land shall beg for drink and curse the rain that follows."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Stun
text:
"I concede it was a cheap shot, but it was the only one I could afford."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sudden Impact
text: The *Predator* roared like an unruly beast, and the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed. "No!" screamed Hanna.

name: Tahngarth's Rage
text:
"Taste my horns!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Gerrard's Battle Cry
text: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword. "This won't be a fair fight," he called to his crew. "They should have brought a second ship!"

name: Tooth and Claw
text:
"You deify nature as female—kind and gentle—yet you cringe at what is natural."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Wall of Diffusion
text:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Wild Wurm
text:
Wurm heads appear
Wild wurm near
Wurm tails you see
Wild wurm flee

name: Aluren
text:
Squee bounced up and down. "I sees a horsey, an' a piggy, an' a—"
"If you don't shut up," hissed Mirri, "you'll see a kidney and a spleeny."

name: Apes of Rath
text: Monkeys three, monkeys through.

name: Bayou Dragonfly
text:
"Like a sugar stick with wings!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Broken Fall
text:
"I think I used up all my good luck and all my bad luck in the same fall."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Canopy Spider
text:
"We know our place in the cycle of life—and it is not as flies."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Charging Rhino
text:
"Is it wrong to go straight for what you want? Sneaking is for cats and goblins."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Choke
text:
"One day we shall walk where once was water."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Hanna's Custody
text:
"I protect the Legacy with my life if necessary, for its purpose is far more important than my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Crazed Armodon
text: These are its last days. Mourning is over. Rage remains.

name: Dirtcowl Wurm
text: Few of Rath's rivers follow a steady course, so many new channels are carved for them.

name: Earthcraft
text:
"The land gives up little, but we are masters of persuasion."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Eladamri's Vineyard
text: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin, and his stomach soon followed suit.

name: Eladamri, Lord of Leaves
text:
"We have been patient. We have planned our attack. We are ready . . . *now*."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Elven Warhounds
text:
"If a creature is dumb enough to love you for leashing it, why would you want to follow its lead?"
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Flailing Drake
text: Too many choices will always distract a greedy beast.

name: Frog Tongue
text: "But *why* can't I get one?" sniveled Squee. "All da bugs here got wings."

name: Fugitive Druid
text:
"If the druids are so devoted to their trees, I will carve them coffins from their precious heartwood."
—Volrath

name: Hero's Resolve
text:
"Destiny, chance, fate, fortune—they're all just ways of claiming your successes without claiming your failures."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Harrow
text: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

name: Heartwood Dryad
text: To snare what lies between worlds takes the patient reach of trees.

name: Heartwood Giant
text: Wind in the trees is soothing, but the same can't be said for trees on the wind.

name: Heartwood Treefolk
text:
"In all my years in Llanowar I never understood where trees fit in. They are revered by elves and watered on by dogs."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Horned Sliver
text: A bristling wave of slivers broke against the *Weatherlight*'s timbers.

name: Krakilin
text:
"A perfect reflection of its world: brutal, fetal, and lacking truth."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Mirri's Guile
text: Hanna was astounded. Mirri read every leaf and wisp of breeze like a book of ancient lore.

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Natural Spring
text: Mirri listened intently, even as Hanna held the healing water to her lips. Would the sound of the spring drown out the elves' approach?

name: Humility
text:
"One cannot cleanse the wounds of failure."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Nature's Revolt
text:
"One day the land will don the semblance of flesh and challenge even the plowshare's blade."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Needle Storm
text: The rain is driven like nails.

name: Overrun
text:
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Pincher Beetles
text:
"No fair! Since when does a bug get ta munch on *me*?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Rampant Growth
text: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

name: Reality Anchor
text:
"See how *you* like it."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Reap
text:
"Let Volrath choke on his crop of hatred."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Respite
text: "If they board us we're finished," warned Orim. Crovax nodded. "And if they don't . . . what then?"

name: Root Maze
text:
"We should step up repairs. I think the forest has plans for us."
—Crovax

name: Rootbreaker Wurm
text: As Gerrard made his escape, the wurm covered his flight by helping itself to three great mouthfuls of merfolk.

name: Rootwalla
text: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

name: Scragnoth
text: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

name: Seeker of Skybreak
text:
"We shun them not for their dream but for their refusal to let such a noble dream die a noble death."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Skyshroud Elf
text:
"It is our duty to endure."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Skyshroud Ranger
text:
"Just as you see the grave and remember the friend, I see this forest and remember Llanowar."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Skyshroud Troll
text: The elves and merfolk have nothing but bitterness for each other. The trolls, however, find them both rather tasty.

name: Storm Front
