text: The calmest day on Rath would be thought a storm anywhere else.

name: Knight of Dawn
text:
Flash like daybreak to the fray.
—Motto of the Knights of Dawn

name: Trained Armodon
text: These are its last days. Better to grow broad and heavy. Better that the enemy is crushed beneath its carcass.

name: Tranquility
text:
"Peace will come, but whether born of harmony or entropy I cannot say."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Trumpeting Armodon
text: These are its last days. But it will not go quietly.

name: Verdant Force
text:
Burl, scurf, and bower
Birth fern and flower.

name: Verdigris
text:
"Only the most sophisticated inventions can survive nature's unsophisticated motivations."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Winter's Grasp
text:
Summer is buried there, centuries deep;
A crypt of years where seasons sleep.

name: Ranger en-Vec
text:
"The path of least resistance will seldom lead you beyond your doorstep."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Segmented Wurm
text:
"If only we could so easily leave behind those parts of ourselves that pain us."
—Crovax

name: Light of Day
text:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

name: Selenia, Dark Angel
text:
"I am light. I am dark. I must give my life to serve; not even death can release me."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Sky Spirit
text:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Spontaneous Combustion
text: "Heat of battle" is usually a metaphor.

name: Vhati il-Dal
text: "Sir, I just thought . . . ," explained Vhati. "Don't think," interrupted Greven. "It doesn't suit you."

name: Altar of Dementia
text:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

name: Bottle Gnomes
text:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Coiled Tinviper
text: The bite of the tinviper feels most like a razor drawn across the tongue.

name: Marble Titan
text:
"Strapping on nine hundred pounds of armor every morning would make any warrior cross."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Emmessi Tome
text: It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.

name: Energizer
text: Like a kettle set to boil, it must eventually go off—on someone.

name: Flowstone Sculpture
text: The sculptor, weary of his work, created art that would finish itself.

name: Fool's Tome
text: Squee: "What's that?" Ertai: "It's a magical book." Squee: "Am I smart enough ta use it?" Ertai: "You could say that."

name: Master Decoy
text:
"A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Grindstone
text:
"Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone."
—Crovax

name: Jinxed Idol
text: "Here."

name: Lotus Petal
text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

name: Manakin
text: Hanna regarded Squee sternly. "Because it's *not* a toy, no matter how much it may look like one," she said, taking the manakin from him.

name: Metallic Sliver
text: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

name: Mogg Cannon
text: Moggs never volunteer for anything twice.

name: Patchwork Gnomes
text:
"Just when I get them working, they always start fighting and tearing at each other for spare parts."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Phyrexian Grimoire
text: Every page cost a life; every secret cost a thousand more.

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

name: Puppet Strings
text: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

name: Scalding Tongs
text:
"This has nothing to do with what you know and everything to do with what I wish."
—Volrath

name: Squee's Toy
text: As the horrors closed in on Gerrard, Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort. He didn't know where it came from or why it was so warm, but he was glad he'd kept it near.

name: Static Orb
text:
Time passes, time crawls;
Time doesn't move at all.

name: Telethopter
text: After losing several of the devices to midair collisions, Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

name: Thumbscrews
text:
"We will start small, I think."
—Volrath

name: Watchdog
text: Its growl is a long, rumbling grind of gears and clockwork, its bark a blast of hissing steam.

name: Ancient Tomb
text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

name: Ghost Town
text:
"The air here smells like a grave."
—Crovax

name: Orim's Prayer
text:
"As usual, there will be time for prayer only *after* the worst happens."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Reflecting Pool
text:
"The reflection of land interests me far more than its reality."
—Volrath

name: Orim, Samite Healer
text:
"The silkworm spins itself a new existence. So the healer weaves the threads of life."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Pacifism
text: Frozen by conscience, Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the *Predator*.

name: Pegasus Refuge
text:
The first Rath-born pegasus was so offended by the sky that it hid its eyes in the earth.
—Vec lore

name: Repentance
text: "The cannon wasn't aimed at you!" pleaded Vhati. "I'm not sure which is more pathetic," replied Greven, "your judgment or your aim."

name: Safeguard
text:
"I'm amused by wasted effort when it's not my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Armor Sliver
text:
Hanna: "We must learn how they protect each other."
Mirri: "After they're done trying to kill us, all right?"

name: Serene Offering
text:
"A sacrifice made in peace is worth a dozen made in panic."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Soltari Crusader
text:
"Carry war to the Dauthi, no matter the way, no matter the world."
—Soltari battle chant

name: Soltari Emissary
text: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation. He realized immediately that he was not alone.

name: Soltari Foot Soldier
text:
"Children of the Ruins, raised to be warriors, know that life begins when another speaks their names."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

name: Soltari Lancer
text:
"In times of war the victors rarely save their best for last."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Soltari Monk
text:
"Prayer rarely explains."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Soltari Trooper
text:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Armored Pegasus
text:
"I always charge a little extra to take on a pegasus. They fly like eagles, kick like mules, and hide like hermits."
—Tahli *en*-Dal, bounty hunter

name: Talon Sliver
text: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

name: Warmth
text:
"Flame grows gentle with but a little distance."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Benthic Behemoth
text:
"Deep devourer concealed in darkhome
Shrouded it seeks all becomes fodder
Once we swam alone and asea
But no more."
—*Rootwater Saga*

name: Chill
text:
"Temper, temper."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Counterspell
text:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Dream Cache
text:
"The sanctity of poverty is an invention of the rich."
—Starke

name: Auratog
text: The auratog enjoys eating its wards.

name: Fighting Drake
text: Two things are needed to survive the harsh skies of Rath: a thick hide and a thicker skull.

name: Gaseous Form
text:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Giant Crab
text: During the giant crabs' mating season, Skyshroud nights are filled with the clatter of their skirmishes.

name: Horned Turtle
text:
"So like men are they: a hardened shell with fragile flesh beneath."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Insight
text:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Legerdemain
text: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place. 'Glok,' he mumbled, and hid.

name: Mana Severance
text:
"And when this land is wasted, where will we go?"
—Thalakos lament

name: Manta Riders
text:
"Water is firmament to the finned."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Mawcor
text: From its maw comes neither word nor whisper—only wind.

name: Meditate
text:
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Mnemonic Sliver
text:
"A jigsaw puzzle that lives, breeds, and thinks."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Precognition
text: A gleam like struggling sunlight penetrated Selenia's dark thoughts.

name: Propaganda
text:
"You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."
—Volrath, to Karn

name: Rootwater Diver
text:
"Drop a dagger into the murky deep and the merfolk will cut your throat with it."
—Skyshroud saying

name: Rootwater Hunter
text:
"Bitter water vicious wave
Shadow-cold shallows root-made maze
Home's angry embrace."
—*Rootwater Saga*

name: Rootwater Shaman
text:
"Ugh! When did orcs and fish start having kids?"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Sea Monster
text: Water is life. Or perhaps it is just something to wash it down with.

name: Shimmering Wings
text: The brighter the wings, the deeper the impact crater.

name: Skyshroud Condor
text:
Condor's flight augurs sleepless night.
—Skyshroud proverb

name: Spell Blast
text: Call it the thinking mage's version of brute force.

name: Steal Enchantment
text:
"Why should I flatter another with imitation when I can satisfy myself through possession?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Thalakos Mistfolk
text:
"They are 'between' in every way."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Thalakos Seer
text:
"You see our world when you shut your eyes so tightly that tiny shapes float before them."
—Lyna, to Ertai

name: Thalakos Sentry
text:
"Ill luck and poor geography caught the Thalakos between us and the Dauthi."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Time Ebb
text:
"Gone today, here tomorrow."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Time Warp
text:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Tradewind Rider
text: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

name: Twitch
text: Battles are won in nuance.

name: Action News Crew
text:
"I just hope this isn't another wild turtle chase!"
—Vernon Fenwick

name: Jennika, Bad Apple Big Sister
text: "Splinter said that, once, ninjas defended the poor and the weak from power. We could be real ninjas. We can fight for the people!"

name: Purple Dragon Punks
text:
"These guys are young, but no rookies. They've fought and beat everything on two legs in this area . . . except us."
—Leonardo

name: Raphael, Ninja Destroyer
text: "You guys must be studying the abridged book of ninja fighting."

name: Raphael, the Nightwatcher
text: "Time to punch in."

name: Raphael, Tough Turtle
text:
"Anger is a dangerous ally. It clouds your judgment. You need to control it, lest it control you."
—Splinter

name: Raphael's Technique
text: "Change of plans!"

name: Ravenous Robots
text:
"The mousers have a new command: to consume everything here . . . all of you will be destroyed!"
—Baxter Stockman

name: Rock Soldiers
text: Catching enemies between a rock and a hard place.

name: Slash, Reptile Rampager
text: "Tell 'em you've got a new partner. One who knows the true meaning of being a warrior."

name: Spicy Oatmeal Pizza
text:
"Yeah, I threw in some habaneros to cut the heat on this."
—Raphael

name: Koya, Death from Above
text: "Hello, prey."

name: Wingnut, Bat on the Belfry
text: "Tell me, Screwloose, aren't we good? Mmhm. So, wouldn't that make them evil? Right!"

name: Courier of Comestibles
text: Forgiveness is divine, but never pay full price for late pizza.

name: Cowabunga!
text: When you're open to new things, a weird world of wonder unfolds before you.

name: Frog Butler
text:
"With faithful Alberto's assistance, this shall be a gathering of untold delight! Why would you ever wish to leave?"
—Toad Baron

name: Groundchuck & Dirtbag
text: "Whatever my lil' man D.B. here can't dig under, I can just about bust through. Ain't no one caging us ever again."

name: Guac & Marshmallow Pizza
text:
"There is no fear in my heart. I will overcome even this challenge!"
—Leonardo

name: Michelangelo, Game Master
text:
"A teacher must be ready to accept responsibility for the student, especially when the student is a weirdo."
—Splinter

name: The Last Ronin's Technique
text: They stood beside him. Whether they were figments or true spirits no longer mattered.

name: Mona Lisa, Science Geek
text: "I felt kind of excited about being mutated, you know? I was getting to have this once in a lifetime experience! Maybe I could even base my thesis on it . . ."

name: Mutant Chain Reaction
text: "We live together, we train together, we fight together, we stand together . . . We are ninjas."

name: New Generation's Technique
text: "Uno, Moja, Odyn, and Yi carry on the brothers' legacy. New York will be free once more."

name: Primordial Pachyderm
text:
"Have at me, and we will find out who is the fittest among us."
—Manmoth

name: Ragamuffin Raptor
text: Bebop and Rocksteady's new Cretaceous stowaway quickly developed a taste for leftovers . . . and ears.

name: Saved by the Shell
text:
"I LOVE being a turtle!"
—Michelangelo

name: Tenderize
text: "Get back, all ya'll! Stay away from me! I ain't safe, ya hear! Ain't no friend! I'm a monster!"

name: Transdimensional Bovine
text: The nature of a giant, disembodied cyborg cow head that travels through time and space raises countless questions. But Cudley doesn't like talking with his mouth full.

name: Turtle Power!
text: Unnoticed by the crowd, the strange canister bounced several more times, striking and smashing a glass jar which held four small turtles . . .

name: Venus, Torn Between Worlds
text: Built from scraps. Defined by self.

name: Zoo Escapees
text: They imagine that out beyond the zoo, beyond the pen, there exists another world, and it encroaches with rapid certainty upon their own . . .

name: Baxter Stockman
text: "You flatter me, Ms. O'Neil. I like that."

name: Bebop & Rocksteady
text: "They'll beat you with fists, with a bat, with a knife. / So don't try to stop them, just run for your life! / Get set and get ready, / For Bebop and Rocksteady!"

name: Don & Leo, Problem Solvers
text: Technician. Tactician.

name: Don & Raph, Hard Science
text: "Rest your brains, Donnie, I got my own idea."

name: EPF Point Squad
text: Not all humans fear the unknown. The Earth Protection Force specializes in teaching the unknown to fear them instead.

name: Foot Elite
text: The Foot Elite are the personal students of the Shredder, a reserve guard without equal.

name: Genghis Frog
text: "Free our brothers! The human reign of terror around here ends tonight!"

name: Ice Cream Kitty
text:
"That's not what they mean by 'pet food,' dude!"
—Michelangelo

name: Lessons from Life
text:
"Everyone's got their own strengths, Lita. You never know what cards they might play. Instead, focus on what you know and never doubt your choices."
—Michelangelo

name: Mechanized Ninja Cavalry
text:
"This is absolutely ridiculous, Saki! They aren't meant for riding! What happened to the ninja's famous subtlety?"
—Baxter Stockman

name: Mikey & Leo, Chaos & Order
text: Their strength hailed not from what they shared, but from how their differences complemented one another.

name: Mouser Mark III
text: Designed to get rodents out of small spaces, its Mouser maws can be used to seize all sorts of vermin!

name: Nobody
text: "I don't need a name. I'm nobody."

name: North Wind Avatar
text: Glyph has claimed to be a survivor of an alien war, a deposed minister of weather, and the last of the dinosaurs. Whatever the truth, his origin stories always bear a lesson.

name: Punk Frogs
text: "Weirdo ninjas got some nerve showing up on our turf. Sayin' they don't wanna fight but they got swords and stuff. Heh."

name: Putrid Pals
text:
"Beats working in the sewers. Too many freaky mutants down there."
—Muckman

name: Raph & Leo, Sibling Rivals
text: At odds as brothers, perfectly in sync as fighters.

name: Slithering Cryptid
text:
"The Slithery! He's snatches little kids an' keeps 'em in cages! He don't got no legs and just slithers."
—Lita

name: Splinter, Radical Rat
text: "The first rule of the ninja is 'do no harm.' Unless you need to do harm. Then do lots of harm!"

name: Tainted Treats
text:
"Spray them with the anti-mutagen? No, no. I'm afraid ingestion is the only course."
—Dr. Jordan Perry

name: Tokka & Rahzar, Terrible Twos
text: "Master say have fun . . ."

name: Chrome Dome
text: "Broadcast: Seized. Initiate seek-and-destroy protocols."

name: Henchbots
text: "Apologies for the disturbance, [INCIDENTAL WITNESS], have a pleasant day!"

name: Krang, Utrom Warlord
text: The Molecular Amplification technology of Krang's exo-suit allows him to expand and adapt not only his tactics, but his physical form.

name: Omni-Cheese Pizza
text:
"And just a sprig of parsley for color . . ."
—Michelangelo

name: Skateboard
text: "Why skate a half-pipe when you can skate a sewer pipe?"

name: Technodrome
text: Even unfinished, the Technodrome was magnificent, a wonder of alien technology.

name: Leonardo's Technique
text: "That's right. Eyes on me."

name: Dimension X
text:
"Hey, in crazy backwards land, crazy backwards dude is king."
—Michelangelo

name: Escape Tunnel
text:
"I hear the sewers in Connecticut are really nice."
—Michelangelo

name: Foot Headquarters
text:
"Getting inside will be easy. Getting to Shredder might even be doable. Getting back out? That's going to be hard."
—April O'Neil

name: Illegitimate Business
text: Their recipe isn't the only secret.

name: Mutant Town
text:
"Until we completely understand the mutagenic agent's effects, these people must remain contained for our health and safety."
—Baxter Stockman

name: TCRI Building
text: The light from the Translocation Matrix could be seen throughout the city. The utroms knew they only had a brief window to escape after its accidental activation.

name: Turtle Lair
text: Home is where your pizza delivers.

name: Agent Bishop, Man in Black
text: "Utroms . . . Triceratons . . . there's little difference to me. I help one destroy the other, pick up the pieces, then get them the hell off of my planet."

name: Make Your Move
text: For a moment, there is only relentless snow and frozen breath.

name: Mighty Mutanimals
text:
"Yer right. We're just a scrappy band of mutants. We can't win. But boy, can we stir up trouble."
—Old Hob

name: Prehistoric Pet
text:
"As far as I'm concerned, Pepperoni's one of us!"
—Raphael

name: The Last Ronin's Technique
text: "See you on the other side, bros."

name: Leonardo's Technique
text: "We Turtles don't know the meaning of the word defeat."

name: Sally Pride, Lioness Leader
text: "I got no problem with you, but I think my friends here just might . . ."

name: April O'Neil, Hacktivist
text: "I can figure this out! Don't worry about me—ow!"

name: Donatello's Technique
text: "I've been working on a pan-dimensional portal of my own. It's the real thing. Of course, I haven't actually tested it yet . . ."

name: Kitsune's Technique
text: "Who needs Foot soldiers? I can subdue you with your own fancy footwork."

name: Krang, Master Mind
text: "You don't have to explain it to me, I'm the one who invented it!"

name: Shredder's Technique
text: "So sorry to bring our game to an early conclusion. You wouldn't have won anyway."

name: Splinter's Technique
text: "Behold the secret technique only taught to true masters of the Foot Clan."

name: Broadcast Takeover
text: "Maybe they've forgotten what a great scientist I used to be, but I don't forget."

name: Casey Jones, Vigilante
text: "I'll teach you criminals to befoul our sewers!"

name: Jennika's Technique
text: "Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"

name: Raphael's Technique
text: "Alright, time out! Who's fighting who again?"

name: Groundchuck & Dirtbag
text:
"Mosey along, critters. You're blockin' my way!"
—Groundchuck

name: Michelangelo's Technique
text: "Drop in anytime, micro-dudes."

name: Sally Pride, Lioness Leader
text: "I wanna make things better for everyone. No more squalor. No more fear."

name: New Generation's Technique
text: April's Turtle tots: Moja, Odyn, Uno, and Yi.

name: Bebop & Rocksteady
text: "We got a score to settle with you little twerps."

name: Don & Leo, Problem Solvers
text: "Hey, watch it, Leonardo. You're ruining my finish!"

name: Don & Raph, Hard Science
text: A good ninja can defend themselves with anything.

name: Karai's Technique
text:
"The ninja who loses his temper, loses the battle."
—Karai

name: Mikey & Leo, Chaos & Order
text: "Face it, Leo, this is the only job we're qualified for."

name: North Wind Avatar
text: The Path of the Four Winds is a quest for knowledge. South to the serpent. West to the Jaguar. North to the dragon. East to the eagle.

name: Raph & Leo, Sibling Rivals
text:
"You losers better talk, or else I'm gonna get sarcastic!"
—Raphael

name: Triceraton Commander
text: "For the glory of the Republic!"

name: Splinter, Radical Rat
text: "You have corrupted my teachings. Now you will pay for your crimes."

name: Tokka & Rahzar, Terrible Twos
text: "Master say have fun!"

name: Agent Bishop, Man in Black
text: "Utroms . . . Triceratons . . . there's little difference to me. I help one destroy the other, pick up the pieces, then get them the hell off of my planet."

name: Prehistoric Pet
text:
"As far as I'm concerned, Pepperoni's one of us!"
—Raphael

name: Turtles Forever
text:
"See you around the multiverse, bros."
—One Leonardo or another

name: Kitsune, Dragon's Daughter
text: "You hunger for retribution, I know. And so I come to you with an offering . . ."

name: Turtles in Time
text:
"When are we now?"
—Donatello

name: Armaggon, Future Shark
text: "I am ancient efficiency. I am evolution's future. I am mutation come full, vicious circle!"

name: Madame Null, Power Broker
text: "We suffered a bit of a setback tonight, but rest assured: We'll have the planet purged and primed for you right on schedule."

name: Savanti Romero, Time's Exile
text: "When I am done, there will be no evidence that you ever existed!"

name: South Wind Avatar
text: Snake-Eyes's gift takes others back to their worst memory. To the weak, it is a curse; to the wise, a second chance.

name: Turtles Forever
text:
"See you around the multiverse, bros."
—One Leonardo or another

name: Improvised Arsenal
text:
"I want rock 'n' roll, man! Lucky I brought my own drumsticks . . ."
—Casey Jones

name: Ravenous Robots
text:
"The mousers have a new command: to consume everything here . . . all of you will be destroyed!"
—Baxter Stockman

name: Transdimensional Bovine
text: The nature of a giant, disembodied cyborg cow head that travels through time and space raises countless questions. But Cudley doesn't like talking with his mouth full.

name: Turtle Power!
text: Unnoticed by the crowd, the strange canister bounced several more times, striking and smashing a glass jar which held four small turtles . . .

name: Chrome Dome
text: "Broadcast: Seized. Initiate seek-and-destroy protocols."

name: Uneasy Alliance
text: Other perspectives can help one find the proper direction.

name: April O'Neil, Hacktivist
text: In the fight between mutants, ninjas, and aliens, don't underestimate a resourceful human.

name: April, Reporter of the Weird
text: "Freelance reporting pays even worse than tutoring, but the satisfaction of uncovering the truth makes it all worth it! Also the free ringside tickets to cover intergalactic wrestling don't suck."

name: Buzz Bots
text: Designed for autonomous pollination, the Stocktronics buzz bot's souped-up power plant allows for months of independent service. The optional taser is for defensive purposes only, of course.

name: Crustacean Commando
text:
"Wondering what I've got in the box? Pain, soldier! And lots of it!"
—Herman

name: Donatello, Turtle Techie
text:
"My son, for someone so intelligent, the obvious often eludes you."
—Splinter

name: Donatello, Way with Machines
text: "Unfortunately, the lowly turtle has been saddled by society with the stereotype of being velocity challenged."

name: Donatello's Technique
text: "I'll need my bag of tricks."

name: Dimensional Exile
text:
"Never been defeated, huh? Well, you never tangled with a turtle before!"
—Donatello

name: Fugitive Droid
text: A freak accident transferred Professor Honeycutt's mind into his robot assistant. Blamed for his own death, he fled . . . as the FUGITOID!

name: Kitsune, Dragon's Daughter
text: "You hunger for retribution, I know. And so I come to you with an offering . . ."

name: Kitsune's Technique
text: "Like a monster seeking prey in the night, the truth will hunt you down."

name: Metalhead
text: Metalhead simulates dozens of fighting styles, including Foot ninjutsu.

name: Mind Transfer Protocol
text:
"You will experience some discomfort. Then, for better or worse, the concepts of comfort and discomfort will become quite alien."
—Fugitoid

name: Mondo Gecko
text: "Stealth-o-rama, huh? Righteous."

name: Negate
text: "You guys seriously try to do this with jump kicks?"

name: Ooze Spill
text: Lab safety is everyone's business.

name: East Wind Avatar
text: Azrael was born on the wind to guide others to new beginnings.

name: Renet, Temporal Apprentice
text: "You guys don't get sick during time travel, do you?"

name: Return to the Sewers
text:
"We strike hard and fade away into the night."
—Leonardo

name: Sewer-veillance Cam
text: No one in New York was going to notice one more cockroach.

name: Turtles in Time
text:
"When are we now?"
—Donatello

name: Utrom Scientists
text: Using exoskeletons and false skins, the utroms took up residence on Earth after their ship crashed. Returning home using only Earth's primitive technology has proven challenging.

name: Anchovy & Banana Pizza
text:
"Question: Do you like penicillin on your pizza?"
—Donatello

name: Armaggon, Future Shark
text: "I am ancient efficiency. I am evolution's future. I am mutation come full, vicious circle!"

name: Featherbrained Filcher
text: "HI! I'm Pete!"

name: Death in the Family
text: Often enemies, always brothers . . . till the end.

name: Dream Beavers
text: "We've drained human life force for millennia. Then one day, turtles! Delectable! We'll suck you dry and spit out the shells!"

name: Foot Mystic
text: Mashima would protect the soul of Oroku Saki at any cost.

name: Madame Null, Power Broker
text: "We suffered a bit of a setback tonight, but rest assured: We'll have the planet purged and primed for you right on schedule."

name: Pain 101
text: Your instructor is Casey Jones!

name: Grounded for Life
text: "Of course I know what you did! You always do precisely what I told you not to do!"

name: Savanti Romero, Time's Exile
text: "When I am done, there will be no evidence that you ever existed!"

name: Shredder's Armor
text: The Kuro Kabuto has been the symbol of Foot Clan leadership since its inception over 1,500 years ago.

name: Shredder's Revenge
text: "Tonight I dine on turtle soup."

name: South Wind Avatar
text: Snake-Eyes's gift takes others back to their worst memory. To the weak, it is a curse; to the wise, a second chance.

name: Hamato Guardian Stance
text: "Everything you know, I have shown you, but I have not shown you everything I know."

name: Splinter's Technique
text: "Possess the right thinking. Only then can one receive the gifts of strength, knowledge, and peace."

name: Squirrelanoids
text: It's best to never discover what they squirrel away.

name: Stomped by the Foot
text:
"These guys are good!"
—Leonardo

name: Super Shredder
text: "I have molded myself into perfection, Hamato. Look upon me, and know fear."

name: Tunnel Rats
text: The Rat King's subjects are everywhere you don't want to be.

name: Bot Bashing Time
text:
"Well, I'd say we redecorated the place nicely!"
—Raphael

name: Broadcast Takeover
text: The power of the Foot is its ability to infiltrate every system from the shadows.

name: Casey Jones, Vigilante
text: "Goongala!"

name: High-Flying Ace
text:
"Nice to meet you, Botticelli . . . or whatever your name is. Tell your boss to send some scarier goons next time."
—Ace Duck

name: General Traag, Heart of Stone
text: "Lord Krang, we arrive. We obey. We conquer."

name: Hard-Won Jitte
text: It was fitting that the most dangerous turtle bore a weapon of peace.

name: Improvised Arsenal
text:
"I want rock 'n' roll, man! Lucky I brought my own drumsticks . . ."
—Casey Jones

name: Jennika's Technique
text: "Being a mutant isn't easy. Lucky for me, I've been preparing for this my entire life!"

name: Manhole Missile
text: "SAY YER PRAYERS, TOITLES!"

name: Mouser Attack!
text:
"For me, all things remain strictly business. And today's business happens to be extermination!"
—Baxter Stockman

name: Mouser Foundry
text:
"Hmmm . . . How many should I send? Three? Five? Ten, maybe!"
—Baxter Stockman

name: Mutant Town Musicians
text: After the Bomb's take on thrash metal isn't for everyone . . . and Sheena wouldn't have it any other way.

name: Null Group Biological Assets
text:
"I'm a company woman. I'm part of the plan. I'm part of the team. And I enjoy my work."
—Zodi

name: Old Hob, Alleycat Blues
text: "This is us against them, plain and simple. Either you're with us, or . . ."

name: Angel of Retribution
text: Bitter vengeance never glowed so bright nor sang so sweet.

name: Morningtide
text:
"The spirits of the righteous shall rise into the sky. Even dirtwalkers will fly like aven."
—Major Teroh

name: Grim Lavamancer
text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

name: Hell-Bent Raider
text: He doesn't slow until his spear is weighted with corpses.

name: Longhorn Firebeast
text: Its blast can fuse armor to bone, leaving skeletons that glint brightly in the sun.

name: Overmaster
text:
"Trickery can't defeat raw power."
—Matoc, lavamancer

name: Pardic Arsonist
text: Otaria's epidemic of insanity didn't affect certain barbarians—but no one noticed.

name: Pardic Collaborator
text: "We've been taught that strength is everything. So how can an alliance with the strongest be a betrayal?"

name: Pardic Lancer
text: He gets to the point right away.

name: Mystic Familiar
text: They soar, and the mystics follow.

name: Pitchstone Wall
text: Its material may not be precious, but the minds it protects are.

name: Skullscorch
text:
"A good whack on the head usually has the same effect."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Anurid Scavenger
text: Krosa's topmost bottom feeder.

name: Pay No Heed
text:
"Inhale life. Exhale pain."
—Mystic elder

name: Arrogant Wurm
text: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

name: Centaur Veteran
text: He wears his scars like badges of honor, warning his foes that he's not easily defeated.

name: Dwell on the Past
text:
None can find what hasn't been lost.
—Nantuko teaching

name: Insist
text:
"Finesse is no match for brute force."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Invigorating Falls
text: Krosan druids do not fear death, for they know that nature will only prosper from their passing.

name: Krosan Constrictor
text:
"It's a slithering, coldblooded menace. I've gotta respect that."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Nostalgic Dreams
text: Seton dreams of life renewed.

name: Cabal Coffers
text: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

name: Stern Judge
text: "How to punish the guilty is up to the Ancestor. Deciding who merits such punishment is up to me."

name: Strength of Isolation
text: Don't mistake isolation for safety.

name: Teroh's Faithful
text: The light of reason follows them even into battle.

name: Aven Trooper
text: The very skies seethe with the aven's hatred for the Cabal.

name: Vengeful Dreams
text: Teroh dreams of his enemies' doom.

name: Ambassador Laquatus
text:
"He smiles with poisoned lips."
—Empress Llawan

name: Aquamoeba
text: Some tides need no moon.

name: Balshan Collaborator
text:
"Power, gold, crackers—every bird has its price."
—Chainer, dementia master

name: Breakthrough
text: The ideas came flooding in so fast that they couldn't all be contained.

name: Cephalid Aristocrat
text: It's easy to tell the difference between the devious cephalids and the trustworthy ones. The trustworthy ones are dead.

name: Cephalid Snitch
text: The cautious are wary of their enemies. The wise are also wary of their friends.

name: Churning Eddy
text:
"Magic is like the tide—both ebb, both flow, and both serve my whims."
—Empress Llawan

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: False Memories
text:
"My enemies will forget everything but their anguish."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Hydromorph Guardian
text: In front of every strong leader is a pool of loyal bodyguards.

name: Hydromorph Gull
text:
"The only kind of water that should fly through the air is rain."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Obsessive Search
text: The question strained his sanity. The answer snapped it in half.

name: Plagiarize
text: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

name: Retraced Image
text: An army from a soldier, a flock from a bird, a school from a fish . . . a profit from an atrocity.

name: Skywing Aven
text: "I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

name: Stupefying Touch
text: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

name: Turbulent Dreams
text: Laquatus dreams of seizing control.

name: Cabal Ritual
text:
"Each syllable chills your veins. Each word rattles your mind."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Cabal Surgeon
text: "Clerics give up when their patients die. Can I help it if I'm more compassionate?"

name: Carrion Rats
text:
"Just what I need—more competition."
—Cabal grave robber

name: Carrion Wurm
text: Since it eats only carrion, sometimes it needs to make some from scratch.

name: Chainer's Edict
text: The pits have their own form of mercy.

name: Frantic Purification
text: By definition, madness ends in one of two ways: clarity . . . or death.

name: Insidious Dreams
text: Chainer dreams of ultimate knowledge.

name: Laquatus's Champion
text: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

name: Mind Sludge
text: When you get into the swamp, the swamp gets into you.

name: Mortal Combat
text: The crowd roared, the fighters bled, and the dead piled high in the pits. Only the Cabal could win.

name: Mutilate
text:
"They appreciate my handiwork. I hear their joy in every scream."
—Chainer, dementia master

name: Nantuko Shade
text:
"If the Nantuko only knew what awaits them beyond death, they would abandon all they hold dear."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Organ Grinder
text: It knows what makes you tick. It knows how to make the ticking stop.

name: Restless Dreams
text: Braids dreams of dark rebirth.

name: Major Teroh
text: "I am the holy wind that shall avenge the Cabal's victims."

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Shambling Swarm
text: Chainer's madness personified, it exists only to slaughter the innocent.

name: Sickening Dreams
text: The Patriarch dreams of vile plague.

name: Strength of Lunacy
text: Don't confuse lunacy with courage.

name: Unhinge
text:
"Don't let your mind wander—it might not come back."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Waste Away
text: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing—including viruses.

name: Zombie Trailblazer
text: Some zombies are natural-reborn leaders.

name: Accelerate
text:
"I've seen lightning move slower."
—Nomad sentry

name: Balthor the Stout
text:
"I like to think of him as concentrated barbarian."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

name: Barbarian Outcast
text:
"We offer power to anyone willing to take it. Sadly, few are unburdened enough by their prejudices to accept."
—Cabal surgeon

name: Crackling Club
text: It adds injury to injury.

name: Crazed Firecat
text:
"The longer it's caged, the madder it gets."
—Firecat handler

name: Devastating Dreams
text: Kamahl dreams of storms of fire.

name: Enslaved Dwarf
text: Captive dwarves always regain their freedom, either through escape or through a desperate, fiery death.

name: Angelic Blessing
text: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

name: Conviction
text: It was not the minotaur's shoulders but his soul that bore the heaviest weight.

name: Death Stroke
text: For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home. As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

name: Death's Duet
text: Life has always been a dance. It is only fitting that death sing the tune.

name: Diabolic Edict
text: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

name: Dungeon Shade
text: A sickness stirs in its eyes, a nightmare born in darkened wails.

name: Fugue
text: "My ship . . . ," Sisay mumbled. "Intact," Gerrard reassured her, "which is more than I can say for you, my friend." Sisay laughed despite the pain.

name: Gravedigger
text: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

name: Disenchant
text: The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."

name: Necrologia
text:
"My enemies' death yields threefold benefit: removal, reuse, and research."
—Volrath

name: Rats of Rath
text:
"These creatures offer new challenges in the scrutiny of entrails."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Recurring Nightmare
text:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax

name: Revenant
text:
"Not again."
—Hans

name: Screeching Harpy
text:
"They are called 'fowl' for a reason."
—Mirri of the Weatherlight

name: Serpent Warrior
text: A hiss before dying.

name: Skyshroud Vampire
text:
"If it tastes one drop of elvish blood I will cast it from the shroud to see it burn."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Exalted Dragon
text: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

name: Stronghold Assassin
text: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

name: Thrull Surgeon
text: "Just take a little off the top."

name: Vampire Hounds
text: The hounds' barks are a horrifying chorus of screams, moans, and whispers.

name: Wall of Souls
text:
"It is the nature of evil to turn you against yourself."
—Starke

name: Aftershock
text:
"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Anarchist
text: "I'll take that. You won't need it when the revolution comes."

name: Barbed Sliver
text: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.

name: Canyon Wildcat
text: "Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.

name: Craven Giant
text:
What is high as a mountain and low as a snake?
—Dal riddle

name: Deadshot
text:
"Carrion! Keep your distance. My blade will come to you!"
—Crovax

name: Flame Wave
text:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Flowstone Blade
text:
"Remember the fable of the elf who came upon a cave of gold. In trying to free the largest piece, she was crushed by its weight."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Flowstone Mauler
text: Once these horrifying creatures were perfected, there was no need for armodons.

name: Flowstone Wyvern
text:
"Where I come from, stone stays on the ground."
—Tahngarth of the Weatherlight

name: Furnace Brood
text: Furnace air crackles with magmatic cackles.

name: Goblin Bombardment
text: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

name: Kindle
text: Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.

name: Lightning Blast
text:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Lowland Giant
text: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

name: Gallantry
text: "Forgive me," Mirri whispered. "I thought you a burden, and you saved my life." Hanna quietly accepted the apology.

name: Mage il-Vec
text: Living below a flowstone foundry produces a disproportionate number of fire mages among the il.

name: Maniacal Rage
text: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

name: Mogg Conscripts
text:
"Torahn's horns! They've seen us. Now, statue, you must fight to save yourself!"
—Tahngarth, aboard the Predator

name: Mogg Fanatic
text: "I got it! I got it! I—"

name: Mogg Flunkies
text: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

name: Mogg Maniac
text: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

name: Ogre Shaman
text: Ogre shamans must be bright enough to learn their invocations and dim enough to use them.

name: Pandemonium
text:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Gerrard's Battle Cry
text: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword. "This won't be a fair fight," he called to his crew. "They should have brought a second ship!"

name: Rathi Dragon
text: Wrap the flame as twine, Kingdoms will be thine.

name: Renegade Warlord
text:
"His tongue must be honey, the way he gathers ants to fight with him."
—Volrath

name: Rolling Thunder
text: "Such rage," thought Vhati, gazing up at the thunderhead from the Predator. "It is Greven's mind manifest."

name: Sabertooth Wyvern
text: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

name: Sandstone Warrior
text:
"I used to describe something stable as 'rock solid.' So much for that expression."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Shadowstorm
text:
"You've not seen a storm until you've seen the kind that roars between worlds."
—Lyna, soltari emissary

name: Shatter
text:
"Such fuss over machines, Gerrard. Remember that you are the prize of the Legacy. Throw away your toys!"
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Humility
text:
"One cannot cleanse the wounds of failure."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Spellshock
text: A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.

name: Starke of Rath
text:
"I know to whom I owe the most loyalty, and I see him in the mirror every day."
—Starke

name: Stun
text:
"I concede it was a cheap shot, but it was the only one I could afford."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Wall of Diffusion
text:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, soltari emissary

name: Aluren
text:
Squee bounced up and down. "I sees a horsey, an' a piggy, an' a—"
"If you don't shut up," hissed Mirri, "you'll see a kidney and a spleeny."

name: Canopy Spider
text:
"We know our place in the cycle of life—and it is not as flies."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Carnassid
text: The hunter would never forget the time or place where he first met the carnassid, for they buried him there.

name: Crashing Boars
text: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

name: Elven Rite
text: As the bough stretches, so shall you grow. As the roots spread, so shall you thrive.

name: Kor Chant
text: The true treasure no thief can touch.

name: Endangered Armodon
text: These are its last days. It is doomed to be remembered only until the hunters hunger again.

name: Harrow
text: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

name: Heartwood Dryad
text: To snare what lies between worlds takes the patient reach of trees.

name: Heartwood Giant
text: Wind in the trees is soothing, but the same can't be said for trees on the wind.

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Horned Sliver
text: A bristling wave of slivers broke against the Weatherlight's timbers.

name: Krakilin
text:
"A perfect reflection of its world: brutal, fetal, and lacking truth."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Lowland Basilisk
text: Unlike their cousins, Rathi basilisks turn their victims into puddles of flowstone.

name: Master Decoy
text:
"A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Mirri, Cat Warrior
text:
"Full of beauty and grace, with a predator's instincts . . . Although she wanders, I have always thought Mirri belongs in Llanowar most of all."
—Rofellos, Llanowar emissary

name: Mulch
text: Hope is the one crop that can grow in any climate.

name: Muscle Sliver
text: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

name: Needle Storm
text: The rain is driven like nails.

name: Overrun
text:
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him."
—Tahngarth of the Weatherlight

name: Provoke
text: Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

name: Rampant Growth
text: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

name: Reality Anchor
text:
"See how you like it."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Rootbreaker Wurm
text: As Gerrard made his escape, the wurm covered his flight by helping itself to three great mouthfuls of merfolk.

name: Rootwalla
text: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

name: Skyshroud Elf
text:
"It is our duty to endure."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Skyshroud Troll
text: The elves and merfolk have nothing but bitterness for each other. The trolls, however, find them both rather tasty.

name: Spined Wurm
text:
"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'"
—Dal myth of the wurm

name: Angelic Protector
text:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

name: Nomads en-Kor
text: The kor forsake roots for the winding of the path, forsake voices for the silence of the mind, forsake all else for the poverty of isolation.

name: Trained Armodon
text: These are its last days. Better to grow broad and heavy. Better that the enemy is crushed beneath its carcass.

name: Tranquility
text:
"Peace will come, but whether born of harmony or entropy I cannot say."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Verdant Force
text:
Burl, scurf, and bower
Birth fern and flower.

name: Verdigris
text:
"Only the most sophisticated inventions can survive nature's unsophisticated motivations."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Acidic Sliver
text: The first sliver burst against the cave wall, and others piled in behind to deepen the new tunnel.

name: Crystalline Sliver
text: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

name: Hibernation Sliver
text: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

name: Orim, Samite Healer
text:
"The silkworm spins itself a new existence. So the healer weaves the threads of life."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Selenia, Dark Angel
text: "I am light. I am dark. I must give my life to serve; not even death can release me."

name: Sliver Queen
text: Her children are ever part of her.

name: Spined Sliver
text:
"Slivers are evil and slivers are sly; And if you get eaten, then no one will cry."
—Mogg children's rhyme

name: Vhati il-Dal
text: "Sir, I just thought . . . ," explained Vhati. "Don't think," interrupted Greven. "It doesn't suit you."

name: Victual Sliver
text: "We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen. "Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole."

name: Bottle Gnomes
text:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Coat of Arms
text:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

name: Coiled Tinviper
text: The bite of the tinviper feels most like a razor drawn across the tongue.

name: Pacifism
text: Frozen by conscience, Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the Predator.

name: Emmessi Tome
text: It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.

name: Erratic Portal
text: "In Barrin's name!" cried Lyna as Hanna's sword passed through her, "Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!"

name: Grindstone
text:
"Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone."
—Crovax

name: Jinxed Idol
text: "Here."

name: Lotus Petal
text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

name: Metallic Sliver
text: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

name: Patchwork Gnomes
text:
"Just when I get them working, they always start fighting and tearing at each other for spare parts."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Paladin en-Vec
text: "Our belief shall be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart."

name: Phyrexian Hulk
text:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

name: Skyshaper
text:
"It'll get us to the portal, but I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Telethopter
text: After losing several of the devices to midair collisions, Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

name: City of Traitors
text:
"While we fought, the il surrendered."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Volrath's Stronghold
text: The seed of a world's evil.

name: Wasteland
text:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Repentance
text: "The cannon wasn't aimed at you!" pleaded Vhati. "I'm not sure which is more pathetic," replied Greven, "your judgment or your aim."

name: Shackles
text: Shackles of gold are still shackles.

name: Smite
text:
"You've got your childhood wish at last. Now you get to die."
—Gerrard, to Volrath

name: Soltari Lancer
text:
"In times of war the victors rarely save their best for last."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Soltari Monk
text:
"Prayer rarely explains."
—Orim, Samite healer

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Soltari Trooper
text:
"Dauthi blood is soltari wine."
—Soltari Tales of Life

name: Spirit en-Kor
text:
Death free throat from thirst, mouth from speech, feet from earth.
—Kor requiem

name: Standing Troops
text: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

name: Staunch Defenders
text:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the Weatherlight

name: Wall of Essence
text:
The ceiling and the floor fell in love, but only the wall knew.
—Dal saying

name: Warrior en-Kor
text: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive kor people.

name: Armor Sliver
text:
Hanna: "We must learn how they protect each other."
Mirri: "After they're done trying to kill us, all right?"

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Youthful Knight
text:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Counterspell
text:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Curiosity
text: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

name: Dismiss
text:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Dream Halls
text: Within without.

name: Dream Prowler
text:
"To think that some find sleep a restful state."
—Volrath

name: Ephemeron
text: From nothing came teeth.

name: Fighting Drake
text: Two things are needed to survive the harsh skies of Rath: a thick hide and a thicker skull.

name: Armored Pegasus
text:
"I always charge a little extra to take on a pegasus. They fly like eagles, kick like mules, and hide like hermits."
—Tahli *en*-Dal, bounty hunter

name: Gaseous Form
text:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Hammerhead Shark
text: Cross the eyes of a hammerhead and you'll dot its teeth.

name: Horned Turtle
text:
"So like men are they: a hardened shell with fragile flesh beneath."
—Selenia, dark angel

name: Killer Whale
text: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

name: Legerdemain
text: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place. "Glok," he mumbled, and hid.

name: Mana Leak
text:
"The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy."
—Volrath

name: Mawcor
text: From its maw comes neither word nor whisper—only wind.

name: Meditate
text:
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Merfolk Looter
text: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

name: Mnemonic Sliver
text:
"A jigsaw puzzle that lives, breeds, and thinks."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Rootwater Hunter
text:
"Bitter water, vicious wave;
Shadow-cold shallows, root-made maze.
Home's angry embrace."
—Rootwater Saga

name: Scrivener
text:
"History is a potent weapon."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Sea Monster
text: Water is life. Or perhaps it is just something to wash it down with.

name: Sift
text:
"Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Spell Blast
text: Call it the thinking mage's version of brute force.

name: Bandage
text: Takara shook with guilt. She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

name: Thalakos Drifters
text: They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.

name: Thalakos Seer
text:
"You see our world when you shut your eyes so tightly that tiny shapes float before them."
—Lyna, to Ertai

name: Time Ebb
text:
"Gone today, here tomorrow."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Time Warp
text:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Tradewind Rider
text: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

name: Twitch
text: Battles are won in nuance.

name: Wayward Soul
text:
"No home, no heart, no hope."
—Stronghold graffito

name: Whispers of the Muse
text:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

name: Cataclysm
text: The *Weatherlight* dragged the Predator behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

name: Wind Dancer
text:
"Flying like a bird does not make you as free as one."
—Volrath

name: Wind Drake
text: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly. "You are like the drake," she said, her expression unchanging. "It works hard to maintain its position, but to us it seems to glide along effortlessly. You must do the same."

name: Winged Sliver
text:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight

name: Cannibalize
text: "Mine."

name: Carnophage
text: Eating is all it knows.

name: Clot Sliver
text:
"One would think I would be accustomed to unexpected returns."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Coercion
text:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

name: Commander Greven il-Vec
text: "Rage is the only freedom left to me."

name: Charging Paladin
text: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

name: Cursed Flesh
text: A farewell to arms . . . and feet . . . and legs . . .

name: Dark Banishing
text:
"It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"If there is such a thing as too much power, I have not discovered it."
—Volrath

name: Dauthi Jackal
text:
"All dauthi are jackals, regardless of breed."
—Lyna, soltari emissary

name: Dauthi Marauder
text:
"The dauthi came from beneath the ruins one night, and the darkness cast them in the best possible light."
—Soltari Tales of Life

name: Dauthi Slayer
text:
"They have knives for every soul."
—Lyna, soltari emissary

name: Death Pits of Rath
text: As the sludge below began to shift and take shapes, Gerrard turned from the railing to Orim. "I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?"

name: Evasive Maneuvers
text:
"Hard a-port! Bring us underneath for another volley!"
—Commander William Riker

name: Head of Security
text:
"The Vulcans say that the desert teaches men the meaning of endurance, but it's the ice that forges real strength."
—Commander Shran, Andorian Imperial Guard

name: Shuttle Crew
text: Transporters aren't always reliable, especially when you're coming in hot.

name: Sickbay Orderly
text:
"I never thought size or strength was particularly important in a medical officer, but I can now say with certainty that they have their uses."
—Dr. Beverly Crusher

name: Starfleet Crew
text:
"The first duty of every Starfleet officer is to the truth, whether it's scientific truth, or historical truth, or personal truth. It is the guiding principle on which Starfleet is based."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

name: Will Riker, Assuming Command
text: A good officer brings their best. A great officer brings out the best in their team.

name: Worf, Chief Tactical Officer
text: "The true test of a warrior is not without. It is within."

name: Cryogenic Stasis
text: "Away team to *Merrimack*. We're at the rendezvous, but Ensign Irvine hasn't checked in and won't reply on comms."

name: Exocomp
text: Their ability to replicate new circuits as they learn inadvertently bootstrapped exocomps into sentience in the 2360s.

name: Kolinahr Priest
text:
"What thee are about to see comes down from the time of the beginning without change. This is the Vulcan heart; this is the Vulcan soul. This is our way."
—T'Pau

name: La Forge, Perceptive Engineer
text: "Captain, the sensor sweep is fine, but my VISOR is picking up some disturbing fluctuations in the dilithium crystal matrix."

name: Pelia, Immortal Innovator
text: "Lanthanites live a long time, dear. It lets us learn all sorts of things, but you have to make your own fun."

name: T'Pol, Vulcan Representative
text: "Humans needed the help of the Vulcans when they discovered warp drive. That need hasn't changed."

name: Badgey, Malicious Glitch
text: "Can I teach you a lesson?"

name: Ceti Eel
text: Ceti Alpha V's only remaining native life-form was a parasite who left hosts susceptible to suggestion.

name: Defense Force Aggressor
text:
"You play games with death, little warrior. I like it!"
—Captain Ma'ah

name: Direct Hit
text: Beware a Klingon with a short temper and a big grudge.

name: Gin'tak Charge
text:
Four thousand throats may be cut in one night by a running man.
—Klingon proverb

name: Kruge, Genesis Seeker
text: The Genesis Planet was dangerous. It provided Kruge with an amusing thrill.

name: Mek'leth Berserker
text:
"We Klingons have a reputation for ruthlessness. You will find that it is deserved."
—Commander Kor, military governor of Organia

name: Warship Flight Crew
text: Opponents write off Klingons as unthinking brutes at their own peril. When the Klingon Empire developed warp drive, humanity still relied on horse-drawn carts.

name: Gorn Captain
text: "I weary of the chase. Wait for me. I shall be merciful and quick."

name: Gumato
text: Many sapient species hunt the ferocious gumato both for sport and the supposed medicinal benefits of its distinctive horn.

name: Talarian Hook Spider
text:
"Well, I had a choice. Do I walk away and let the emitter blow itself to hell? Or do I crawl in the Jefferies tube with twenty hook spiders?"
—Chief Miles O'Brien

name: Disruptor Pistol
text: The trusty disruptor pistol not only dissolves matter, but it's heavy enough to serve as a cudgel.

name: Picard, Steadfast Captain
text: "That is what it is to be human: to make yourself more than you are."

name: Spock, Logical Choice
text: "In critical moments, men sometimes see exactly what they wish to see."

name: Trelane, Squire of Gothos
text: "I've been looking in on the doings on your lively little Earth."

name: Bio-Asset Allocator
text: "Your life as it has been is over."

name: Kirk, Enterprising Captain
text: "Risk is our business."

name: Benjamin Sisko, Besieged
text: "If we're going to lose, then we're going to go down fighting, so that when our descendants someday rise up against the Dominion, they'll know what they're made of!"

name: Tenacious Tosk
text: "I am Tosk, the hunted. I live to outwit the Hunters for another day. To survive until I die with honor. But that will not be my fate."

name: Refute
text:
"You're discussing tactics?! Do you realize what this really comes down to? Millions and millions of lives hanging on what this vessel does next!"
—Dr. Leonard McCoy

name: Last Gasp
text:
"Your death is too . . . easy. I find this unsatisfying."
—Armus

name: Run Amok
text:
"I didn't mean to say that the *Enterprise* should be hauling garbage. I meant to say that it should be hauled away *as* garbage!"
—Korax, officer of the *I.K.S. Gr'oth*

name: 70,000 Light-Years from Home
text:
"If these sensors are working . . . we're on the other side of the Galaxy."
—Ensign Harry Kim

name: General Chang, Cold Warrior
text: "Be honest, Captain. Warrior to warrior. You do prefer it this way, don't you? As it was meant to be. No peace in our time."

name: A Good Day to Die
text:
There are no old warriors.
—Klingon proverb

name: He's Dead, Jim
text:
"How can we be powerful enough to wipe out a planet and still be so helpless?"
—Dr. Leonard McCoy

name: Hive Mind Coprocessor
text: "Consensus achieved. Disseminating."

name: DOT-7 Repair Squad
text: The DOT-7s are designed to make repairs in any conditions too dangerous for humanoids.

name: Organic Avulsion Unit
text:
"From this time forward, you will service us."
—Locutus of Borg

name: Relentless Drednok
text: The Vau N'Akat created the Watchers to observe and the Drednoks to enforce.

name: Salt Vampire
text: After the collapse of their civilization, the people of M-113 became little more than predators, but they never abandoned their need for love.

name: Dr. Beverly Crusher
text: "Damn. Where are the calluses we doctors are supposed to grow over our feelings?"

name: Cantankerous Captain
text: "Are you the best crew in the fleet or not?!"

name: Captain's Tutelage
text: Starfleet tactical training demands cadets learn how to handle any situation—even failure.

name: Emergency Medical Hologram
text: The EMH Mark 1 distills thousands of medical references and the experiences of forty-seven medical officers into a single unit, though its bedside manner leaves much to be desired.

name: Horta
text: Before miners discovered the Horta on Janus VI, silicon-based life was considered little more than science fiction.

name: Khaaaaaaaaaaaannn!
text:
"I've done far worse than kill you. I've hurt you, and I wish to go on hurting you."
—Khan Noonien Singh

name: La'An Noonien-Singh, Security
text: "Lesson six of security: know when to bend the rules."

name: Munitions Enthusiast
text:
"What is the point of your spikes?" asked the *boqrat*. "You cannot attack with them."
"Perhaps not," laughed the *targ*. "But they bring me great joy!"

name: Perils of the Past
text: Some knowledge is lost. Some knowledge is buried.

name: Planetary Patrol
text: "Away team to *Enterprise*. No life signs anywhere. It's as if the entire colony simply walked away."

name: Plasma Cascade
text: "Fire in engineering! Response teams, move!"

name: Reckless Impulse
text:
Fortune favors the bold.
—Human proverb

name: Federation Field Medic
text: "Stop whining. Sto-Vo-Kor will be there later."

name: Silicate Surveyor
text: The Tholian Assembly does not suffer trespassers lightly.

name: Free Borg Revolutionaries
text: "Resistance is *not* futile."

name: Common Goal
text: "So be it, human. We shall work together, if only so I can be the one to kill you."

name: Dominion Supervisor
text: The loyal Vorta saw to the distribution of ketracel-white, the Dominion's powerful combination of narcotics and life-giving enzymes.

name: First Contact
text: Interspecies diplomacy isn't a calling for the faint of heart.

name: I'm a Doctor, Not a . . .
text:
"Dammit, Jim. We've been over this!"
—Dr. Leonard McCoy

name: Moopsy
text:
"The moopsy is a small mammal known for its endearing appearance. The creature's diet consists of living bone tissue, which it liquefies and drinks via a process witnesses describe as 'upsettingly swift and graphic.'"
—*Lawmim Galactopedia*

name: Mugato
text: Despite their terrifying appearance, mugato are loving, social creatures who form strong family bonds, even mourning fallen family members.

name: Saurian Explorer
text: The Voth are one of the Galaxy's oldest spacefaring species.

name: Support Mission
text: Before the Cardassian occupation, Bajor was a center of culture and learning.

name: Syndicate Liquidators
text:
"The Orion Syndicate. An alliance of all the worst smugglers, pirates, and general malfeasants you'd cross two streets to avoid."
—Constable Odo

name: Malfunctioning Holodeck
text:
"The holodeck safeties are still engaged, right?"
—Ensign Kei

name: Xenobotanist
text: "Electromagnetic stimulation triggers bioluminescence and causes a 22% increase in aesthetic appeal. But to what end?"

name: Xindi Surveyors
text: Six sapient species evolved in parallel on Xindus. They learned to turn their differences into strengths . . . but only after civil war reduced their number to five.

name: Seven of Nine
text: "I am no longer Borg, but the prospect of becoming human is . . . unsettling. I don't know where I belong."

name: Crystalline Entity
text:
"Ironic, isn't it? That something so unique could care so little for the diversity of life."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

name: Cybernetic Specialist
text: What Airiam lost made what she kept so much more precious.

name: Blood Crypt
text: The hellish mines of Remus fueled the war efforts of the Romulan Star Empire, until the Remans found a champion.

name: Breeding Pool
text: In the milky pools permeating the caves of Mak'ala, Trill symbionts await their new lives.

name: Godless Shrine
text: After Gul Dukat aligned the Cardassian Union with the Dominion, the Founders moved their military headquarters to Cardassia Prime to better oversee war efforts.

name: Hallowed Fountain
text: The metaphasic radiation of the Ba'ku planet promised medical marvels, as long as the locals could be quietly removed.

name: Overgrown Tomb
text: The Zakdorn run Surplus Depot Zed-15, salvaging decommissioned ships to supply future Federation projects.

name: Picard, Leading by Example
text: "I have the utmost confidence in your ability to perform the impossible."

name: Sacred Foundry
text: Sooner or later, every Starfleet vessel passes through Spacedock, whether for resupply, repairs, or complete retrofit.

name: Steam Vents
text: As one of the Galaxy's few ectothermic sapient species, Cardassians prefer high temperatures. Many use sweltering saunas to "charge" themselves before interacting with other species.

name: Stomping Ground
text:
"Neural's active mantle and energetic water cycle create staggeringly beautiful rock formations and a variety of tropical microclimates. Don't feed the wildlife."
—*Lawmim Galactopedia*

name: Temple Garden
text: The Edo view their homeworld as a paradise, though outsiders find their strict justice system senselessly brutal.

name: Watery Grave
text: Earth's restored cetacean population eventually came to see the wreck of the *Bounty* as a sort of holy site.

name: Saavik, Stoic Student
text: "I don't believe this was a fair test of my command abilities."

name: Shields Up!
text: Deflector shields use intense graviton fields to create a "solid" surface from nothing at all.

name: Shuttle Ace
text: Although she was a Kelpien, a prey species, she feared no predator once behind the controls.

name: Tactical Officer
text: "Kouassi to bridge. Captain, the intruders look like Starfleet, but their combadge is different. It's . . . a dagger through a planet?"

name: Crystalline Entity
text:
"Ironic, isn't it? That something so unique could care so little for the diversity of life."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

name: Brad Boimler, Eager Ensign
text: "We all joined Starfleet to dive headfirst into the unknown."

name: Cloistered Telepath
text:
"She has an illusion, and you have reality. May you find your way as pleasant."
—The Keeper, magistrate of Talos IV

name: Dominion Saboteur
text: "You're too late. We are everywhere."

name: Guidance Failure
text: The ionized gasses of the Mutara Nebula wreaked havoc with sensors and shielding.

name: Highly Illogical
text: For the briefest of moments, Spock felt fear. Not of the rabbit, but that the universe could let it exist without logical cause.

name: Hoshi Sato, Exolinguist
text: "Whatever they say, you have to respond in kind. Otherwise they'll take offense."

name: Humpback Whales
text: George and Gracie escaped extinction, and in the process, saved Earth.

name: Marooned
text: "Okay, new plan!"

name: Open Communications
text: Some gestures are universal.

name: Command Decision
text:
"If we're going to be damned, let's be damned for what we really are."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

name: Assault Drone
text:
"We have analyzed your defensive capabilities as being unable to withstand us. If you defend yourselves, you will be punished."
—The Borg

name: Automated Warfare System
text:
Peace through superior firepower.
—Minosian motto, pre-extinction

name: Bat'leth
text: "Your tongue is as sharp as a warrior's! Let's see if your blade is as well!"

name: Battle-Scarred Survivalist
text: "I will rest when my blade knows vengeance."

name: Cha'DIch Investigator
text: Klingons who challenge the High Council are denied the right of personal combat. They must select a second—a *cha'DIch*—to defend them.

name: Collective Drone
text: "You will be assimilated."

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."

name: Spined Sliver
text:
"Slivers are evil and slivers are sly; And if you get eaten, then no one will cry."
—Mogg children's rhyme

name: Stormbind
text:
"Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Teferi's Moat
text:
"Isolation is not the answer."
—Urza, to Teferi

name: Vhati il-Dal
text: "Sir, I just thought . . . ," explained Vhati. "Don't think," interrupted Greven. "It doesn't suit you."

name: Claws of Gix
text: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand. They enshrined it, hoping that one day it would point the way to Phyrexia.

name: Feldon's Cane
text: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

name: Moorish Cavalry
text: Members of the elite Moorish Cavalry are very particular about their mounts, choosing only those whose bloodlines have been pure for generations.

name: Mirari
text:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: The Rack
text: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the rack was once his most feared creation.

name: Tormod's Crypt
text: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

name: Pendelhaven
text:
"This is the forest primeval. The murmuring pines and the hemlocks . . . Stand like Druids of eld."
—Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, "Evangeline"

name: Sacred Mesa
text:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Soltari Priest
text: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

name: Squire
text:
"Of twenty yeer of age he was, I gesse.
Of his stature he was of evene lengthe.
And wonderly delyvere, and of greete strengthe."
—Geoffrey Chaucer,
*The Canterbury Tales*

name: Valor
text:
"The cracks widened, the shell crumbled, and Valor spread throughout the land."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Zhalfirin Commander
text:
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Dandân
text:
"Catch good today. Start replacing crew tomorrow."
—Faysal al-Mousa, fisher captain, log

name: Auratog
text: The auratog enjoys eating its wards.

name: Flying Men
text: Saffiyah clapped her hands and twenty flying men appeared at her side, each well trained in the art of combat.

name: Ghost Ship
text:
"That phantom prow split the storm as lightning cast its long shadow on the battlefield below."
—Mireille Gaetane, *The Valeriad*

name: Lord of Atlantis
text: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

name: Mistform Ultimus
text: It may wear your face, but its mind is its own.

name: Prodigal Sorcerer
text: Occasionally, members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

name: Stormscape Familiar
text: Each Stormscape apprentice must hand-raise and train an owl before attaining the rank of master.

name: Whispers of the Muse
text:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

name: Darkness
text:
"If I must die, I will encounter darkness as a bride, / And hug it in mine arms."
—William Shakespeare,
*Measure for Measure*

name: Dauthi Slayer
text:
"They have knives for every soul."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
text: The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat.

name: Sengir Autocrat
text:
"A thankless job, and a death sentence besides."
—Eron the Relentless

name: Shadow Guildmage
text:
To keep the dead so others may live.
—Shadow Guild maxim

name: Stupor
text:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

name: Uncle Istvan
text: Solitude drove the old hermit insane. Now he only keeps company with those he can catch.

name: Undead Warchief
text: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

name: Undertaker
text: The weight of death is heavy but not immovable.

name: Withered Wretch
text: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

name: Browbeat
text:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

name: Eron the Relentless
text:
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal."
—Reyhan, Samite alchemist

name: Goblin Snowman
text:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

name: Kobold Taskmaster
text: The taskmaster knows that there is no cure for the common kobold.

name: Orcish Librarian
text: "Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . ."

name: Orgg
text: It's bigger than it thinks.

name: Pandemonium
text:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

name: Suq'Ata Lancer
text:
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor

name: Tribal Flames
text:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Uthden Troll
text:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Troll chant

name: Wildfire Emissary
text:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, vizier of Amiqat

name: Craw Giant
text: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

name: Hail Storm
text:
"If they can't take the hail, they'd better stay home."
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

name: Essence Sliver
text: The slivers would survive, even at the expense of every other creature on Otaria.

name: Jolrael, Empress of Beasts
text: "I need no army. I have Jamuraa."

name: Scragnoth
text: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

name: Wall of Roots
text: Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.

name: Coalition Victory
text:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

name: Fiery Justice
text:
"The fire of justice burns like nothing else."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

name: Jasmine Boreal
text: "Peace must prevail, even if the wicked must die."

name: Mystic Snake
text: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

name: Amrou Scout
text: The people of Amrou were scattered by war and driven into hiding. Scouts maintain the beacon fires that signal "return" and "home."

name: Cyclopean Giant
text: A tomb-eye may remain shut for centuries. It opens when it sees a world as twisted and hollow as the wretch beneath its lid.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Drudge Reavers
text:
"The surface of the land is blanched with salt, but the soil beneath is reddened with death—a fertile ground for necromancy."
—Lim-Dûl the Necromancer

name: Evil Eye of Urborg
text:
"Edahlis, what *is* that thing? We should have stayed in Yavimaya . . . ."
—Aznaph, greenseeker

name: D'Avenant Healer
text: "One arrow keenly fired might prevent more battlefield wounds than I could treat."

name: Feebleness
text: Just a small touch of magic can harness the debilitating power of Urborg's poisonous winds.

name: Haunting Hymn
text: The hymn's melody has persisted since Tourach's time, but the words changed to invoke the phobias of each listener.

name: Magus of the Mirror
text: "Behold! The image of the enemy and all that she has. Trust your envy, and take it."

name: Mana Skimmer
text: They traverse the mana-starved wastes in search of richer lands.

name: Mindlash Sliver
text: Though Dominaria's queenless slivers lack a single purpose, in some the instinct for self-sacrifice remains extremely strong.

name: Detainment Spell
text: Bind the mind rather than the wrist, and you stop the intent to harm before it starts.

name: Pit Keeper
text: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

name: Plague Sliver
text: A sliver shares everything with its hive—even its afflictions.

name: Premature Burial
text:
"This soil knows well the taste of the dead. Give it the hunger for a living meal, and it can become a deadly ally."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Sangrophage
text: The living is all it eats.

name: Skittering Monstrosity
text: Most living things were weakened and stunted in the ruinous aftermath of the Phyrexian invasion, but a few grew more horrid than ever.

name: Smallpox
text:
"Great losses often bring only a numb shock. To truly plunge a victim into misery, you must overwhelm him with many small sufferings."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Strangling Soot
text:
"What good is your blade without your breath?"
—Greht, Gathan warlord

name: Sudden Death
