text: Some mages tapped into the time rifts, forcing upon others alternate timelines in which unimaginable horrors befall them.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text:
"Even swamps need sustenance. We will give it to them, and in turn, they will sustain us."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Trespasser il-Vec
text: At the epicenter of the Rathi overlay, the City of Traitors did not align with Dominaria. Many of its inhabitants were caught between the two worlds.

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Vampiric Sliver
text: They draw upon the strength of their hive and of their victims.

name: Viscid Lemures
text:
"Lemurs? Is that all? Finally, something harmless . . ."
—Norin the Wary

name: Ancient Grudge
text: The time rifts remind Yavimaya of the enemies of its past and provide fresh fuel for its fires.

name: Barbed Shocker
text: Fervid shamans willingly submit to shockers in hopes of glimpsing the fortunes of the future.

name: Blazing Blade Askari
text: "This can't be Jamuraa. We could not have failed her this badly . . . ."

name: Bogardan Rager
text: In the erupting heart of Bogardan, it's hard to tell hurtling volcanic rocks from pouncing volcanic beasts.

name: Bonesplitter Sliver
text: As the time streams grew more and more unstable, Dominaria's creatures struggled to adapt. The intense pressures led to many dead ends but also to lethal new forms that appeared as suddenly as the ashen rains.

name: Errant Doomsayers
text: "Heed my words, traveler. Plagues, war, desolation . . . all mere hints of what is yet to come from Dominaria's vault of horrors."

name: Coal Stoker
text:
"The day is mine! I sent three such creatures against my foe, then watched as my magefire popped her soldiers like overripe spleenfruits."
—Dobruk the Unstable, pyromancer

name: Empty the Warrens
text:
"They'd pour out of the warrens to make war (and to make room for the littering matrons)."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

name: Flamecore Elemental
text: To a fire elemental, fools and fuels are one and the same.

name: Flowstone Channeler
text: With the evincars gone, flowstone became erratic and wild, a source of power for mages more desperate than wise.

name: Fury Sliver
text:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

name: Goblin Skycutter
text: He takes out his fear of heights on anything above his head.

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Ground Rift
text: Some time rifts didn't take away the people but just the ground they stood on.

name: Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician
text: "Everybody but me—CHARGE!"

name: Ironclaw Buzzardiers
text: They warn the army of danger as they squawk past in swift retreat.

name: Lightning Axe
text:
"A gargoyle's meat can be carved with an ordinary cleaver, but for its petrous hide . . ."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Flickering Spirit
text: It disappears each time with the hope that it will not return to the same desolation it left behind.

name: Norin the Wary
text: "I have a bad feeling about this."

name: Orcish Cannonade
text:
"Crispy! Scarback! Load another volcano-ball."
—Stumphobbler Thuj, Orcish captain

name: Reiterate
text:
"Echoes of the Mirari's power yet linger."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Sedge Sliver
text: Their flesh is as sodden as the fens in which they live, oozing to fill any wound and squishing to absorb any blow.

name: Sudden Shock
text: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

name: Foriysian Interceptor
text: A focal point for time rifts, Foriys contends simultaneously with foes both new and old.

name: Sulfurous Blast
text: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

name: Tectonic Fiend
text: The barbarians of Pardia are long dead, but its mountains still smolder with rage.

name: Thick-Skinned Goblin
text: The shaman of the tribe is responsible for keeping track of all its treasures, including angry pets and cursed lamps of fiery doom.

name: Two-Headed Sliver
text:
"That which would be a fatal mutation in any other species is merely a source of new powers. I am intrigued, yet too fearful to examine it more closely."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Undying Rage
text: Radha was born in Skyshroud, but her temper is undeniably Keldon.

name: Viashino Bladescout
text: "Find your courage in a desperate moment, and you turn the tide of history. So sayeth the bey."

name: Volcanic Awakening
text: With a great roar, the land opened like a titan's yawn, with teeth of blackened rock and a lolling tongue of magma.

name: Word of Seizing
text: "Obey!"

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Ashcoat Bear
text: The bears wade into time rifts to feed. They do not fear the storms, and they are quick enough to snatch prey just as it blinks in or out of time.

name: Chameleon Blur
text:
"Sometimes the best plan is neither fighting nor running."
—Freyalise

name: Durkwood Tracker
text: These days, trackers must follow their quarry over years as well as miles.

name: Fungus Sliver
text:
"When a sliver of this breed enters the hive, the others claw each other in frenzied fits, thereby ensuring their rapid growth."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Gemhide Sliver
text:
"The land is weary. Even Skyshroud is depleted. We must find another source of mana—one that is growing despite our withering world."
—Freyalise

name: Glass Asp
text: Its venom induces a fever that causes its victims to relive the attack in recurring, haunting visions.

name: Greenseeker
text: "A rumor passes among the snakes, whispered by the rushes, inspiring the seekers: the goddess Freyalise is alive in Skyshroud."

name: Havenwood Wurm
text: Time rifts bring tunneling beasts of old into the hard, dry earth of the present. Most die there, trapped, but the mightiest burst through the surface.

name: Amrou Seekers
text: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

name: Herd Gnarr
text: Long ago, the solitary gnarr was a sign of good luck. Now they have become wild pack hunters, a sign of impending danger.

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Magus of the Candelabra
text:
"What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"
—Teferi, to Jhoira

name: Might of Old Krosa
text: Sometimes even humble forest creatures were gifted with mighty emanations from the past.

name: Might Sliver
text:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Molder
text:
"The forests have succumbed to ruin, but the spirit of Krosa remains alive and vital in these devouring spores."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Mwonvuli Acid-Moss
text:
"Life gives way to death, and death to new life. Nature feeds upon her own decay."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Pendelhaven Elder
text: The elder who carries the ancestral mantle of Jacques le Vert is tasked with his ancient mission: to protect the creatures of Pendelhaven.

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Phantom Wurm
text: It died with the forest, yet both linger on in twisted form.

name: Primal Forcemage
text: Their calls unheeded by the withered forests, nature shamans channeled the life force of their brethren.

name: Scarwood Treefolk
text: To treefolk's sense of time, ages pass as hours. They stood as witnesses to the apocalypse, the years of which they saw as one cacophonous, ultra-destructive moment.

name: Spectral Force
text:
"The spirits of old have not left us unguarded."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Spinneret Sliver
text: Each new generation of slivers evolves to assimilate the strengths of the prey upon which their progenitors fed.

name: Sprout
text: Centuries of temporal strife had stripped Dominaria of its natural defenses, but nature fought back with armies constructed of little more than grime and sunlight.

name: Squall Line
text: The constant shifting of Dominaria's shredded timeline played havoc with its atmosphere, combining savage electrical storms from ages past.

name: Stonewood Invocation
text: "Might of ancient wood and stone, Into spirit, flesh, and bone."

name: Strength in Numbers
text:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Thelon of Havenwood
text: "The sight of my thallids still thriving is a bittersweet welcome to this cold waste."

name: Icatian Crier
text: A thousand years removed from her home, her news of war had lost its context, but not its relevance.

name: Tromp the Domains
text: Ground into the footprints of the ravaging herd were clumps of salt from Benalia, moss from Llanowar, dust from Hurloon, and ash from as far as Urborg.

name: Unyaro Bees
text: With no jungle left to contain it, the "plague of daggers" spread across Dominaria.

name: Yavimaya Dryad
text: The parched earth still shielded those few souls with the heart to call it home.

name: Firewake Sliver
text:
"They are here, and they are hungry. And what they do not eat, they burn. Yavimaya is lost. We must leave now for Skyshroud."
—Edahlis, greenseeker

name: Ghostflame Sliver
text:
"This breed is on the cusp of evolution. It burns away the markings that connect it to a queen that no longer heeds its call. It seeks a new master. Perhaps I can give it one."
—Freyalise

name: Harmonic Sliver
text:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Kaervek the Merciless
text:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

name: Mishra, Artificer Prodigy
text: A sojourn through time gave dark inspiration to one gifted young mind.

name: Opaline Sliver
text:
"When struck, its hide shimmers through sequences of color—a signaling language I am eager to unravel."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Saffi Eriksdotter
text: In the blink of an eye, she strode from deep snow to dusty waste. From the crease of light behind her, a voice rang hollow: "Saffi, wait for me . . . ."

name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
text: "I am the blood of the ur-dragon, coursing through all dragonkind."

name: Stonebrow, Krosan Hero
text: Moments after a fickle rift dropped Stonebrow in the waste of his beloved Krosa, he took up his axe in rage-blind vengeance.

name: Assembly-Worker
text: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

name: Brass Gnat
text: Its buzzing is the sound of its inner mechanisms, ever winding down.

name: Jedit's Dragoons
text: After Efrava was destroyed, the cat warriors scattered across Dominaria. Those who followed Jedit's example were strong enough to survive the ravages of apocalypse.

name: Candles of Leng
text:
"A tome stored in its light is as crisp as the day it was written."
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

name: Chromatic Star
text:
"This item is not from . . . now. It reflects a sky no longer ours and gleams with hope that does not exist."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Hivestone
text: Rath's evincars used hivestones to control the slivers, but the overlay put their power into unwitting hands. Now the stones make not masters, but slaves.

name: Locket of Yesterdays
text: Every hour, at the turning of the glass, its owner had whispered to the locket, seeding it with secrets. This would be her legacy, her memory, if the rifts should take her.

name: Paradise Plume
text: A last wisp of paradise in a fallen world.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Sarpadian Empires, Vol. VII
text: The past still lives within its pages, waiting for its time to come again.

name: Venser's Sliver
text: Venser admired his handiwork and smiled. His first prototype had joined with the hive mind all too well, running with the brood and becoming a predator itself. This one, he thought, would be accepted into the hive but still obey his commands.

name: Academy Ruins
text: Its secrets once wrought the greatest artifice ever known. Now crabs loot the rubble to decorate their shells.

name: Magus of the Disk
text: Studying the journals of the necromage Nevinyrral leaves disciples gripped with the urge to exercise his draconian judgment.

name: Flagstones of Trokair
text: Dust-spiked winds eroded the stones, but the ground where they had stood still holds power.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

name: Swarmyard
text: Where scavengers nest in hollowed-out rib cages and chittering crawlers peer from empty eye sockets, few dare to trespass.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Mangara of Corondor
text: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

name: Urza's Factory
text:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Vesuva
text: It is everywhere you've ever been.

name: Opal Guardian
text: It was a moment in time, cast in stone—a moment whose time had come again.

name: Pull from Eternity
text:
It is best to conquer dragons before they hatch.
—Femeref adage

name: Pulmonic Sliver
text: Like a great bellows it hisses, and its kin, both living and dead, are lifted to safety.

name: Quilled Sliver
text:
"They have long kept us under attack, but we do not lack for ammunition. The very bodies of our foes arm us against them."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Benalish Cavalry
text: "My people swore to protect Benalia to the end. It is battered, but yet stands, as do we."

name: Serra Avenger
text:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

name: Sidewinder Sliver
text:
"They encircled our patrol with the stealth of snakes, corralling us like livestock."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Tivadar of Thorn
text: His blade came down upon the neck of a goblin—but not the one he had charged. When Tivadar looked up, the world he had known was gone.

name: Watcher Sliver
text:
"I have spied them, wandering and watching—but for what? I fear they watch for us."
—Yonat of Amrou

name: Bewilder
text:
"Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken. Silly, yes, but exactly the thing we needed to break the stifling tension."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Castle Raptors
text: "Each place we see is as ruined and lifeless as the last. So here we stay, because this ruin is *ours*."

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Cancel
text: Fendros gasped as he watched the spell drip from the ends of his fingers. He moved his foot, afraid to disturb the spot where it lay slain.

name: Careful Consideration
text:
"Sages who take the time to verify their sources are rewarded for their diligence."
—Jhoira, to Teferi

name: Coral Trickster
text: They wait in darkened depths, laughing eagerly.

name: Deep-Sea Kraken
text: The rift remained open for days, sluicing ancient seawater. It closed only after the last great tentacle squirmed its way through.

name: Dream Stalker
text: What happens when it is the dream that wakes and the sleeper that fades into memory?

name: Drifter il-Dal
text: They study the deeds of their traitorous ancestors, hoping the stories may reveal a way back to the physical world.

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Moonlace
text: Once a vision of constancy in the sky, the moon had long been hidden from view by the haze that chokes the heavens. The very sight of it had become a sign that change was in the air.

name: Paradox Haze
text:
"Keep your pace steady through the haze, lest you step on the heels of your future self or trip the self a moment behind you."
—Teferi

name: Psionic Sliver
text: They evolved the ability to concentrate their neural activity into a single pulse, causing a disruptive but usually suicidal blast of psionic energy.

name: Sage of Epityr
text: Clairvoyants across Dominaria were driven mad by the overload from the widening time rifts, while other random folk gained the gift of future sight.

name: Screeching Sliver
text:
"What wears down my people most, I think, is not the danger, but the endless screeching outside our camp."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Shadow Sliver
text: These slivers, trapped between worlds since the Rathi overlay, are among the last to claim direct lineage from the lost Sliver Queen.

name: Snapback
text:
"If it returns years hence, our knowledge of how to combat it will be that much greater."
—Andorel, Tolarian sentinel

name: Spell Burst
text: The brutish mage's version of thinking.

name: Children of Korlis
text:
"We have a proud history of self-sacrifice. But it is easy, in these bleak times, to find one among us who is eager to die for any cause."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Spiketail Drakeling
text: Drakelings fish with their tails, angling to snare succulent thoughts and memories on their psychic hooks.

name: Sprite Noble
text: "By thorn and by stone, we will fight to see the day when beauty returns to this world."

name: Stormcloud Djinn
text: As fickle as lightning, as slippery as an eel.

name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
text: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

name: Telekinetic Sliver
text:
"Slivers are guided only by simple instinct. Advance the hive, and you will be welcomed. Impede the hive, and you will face unrelenting opposition."
—Freyalise

name: Temporal Eddy
text: As the temporal fractures spread and time itself slowly fell apart, visitors started to appear from across the past and future, and those native to the present began to disappear.

name: Think Twice
text:
"Great books are meant to be read, then read again backwards or upside down!"
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

name: Tolarian Sentinel
text: "It is not just our people I try to rescue. It is our culture, and our hope that we can return to greatness."

name: Chronosavant
text: "In my dreams, I hear the voices of my future selves who have died in times yet to come. I use that knowledge to avoid those dark futures and continue my search for peace."

name: Wipe Away
text: An eyeblink later, all that remained of the tree-beast was the breeze of its momentum.

name: Assassinate
text: The rulers of old Dominaria kept assassins on retainer. However, the true loyalty of these master killers was always to their peers. This elite brotherhood survived the fall of the old royal order.

name: Basal Sliver
text:
"Fascinating . . . These creatures display the paradox of tenacity and purposed self-destruction I have sought to breed into my thrulls."
—Endrek Sahr, master breeder

name: Call to the Netherworld
text: The ritual was normally performed only by horrors and pit spawn. Lesser mages had but one sanity to crack in the casting.

name: Amrou Scout
text: The people of Amrou were scattered by war and driven into hiding. Scouts maintain the beacon fires that signal "return" and "home."

name: Bound in Silence
text: A fight put off forever is already won.

name: Wipe Away
text: An eyeblink later, all that remained of the tree-beast was the breeze of its momentum.

name: Assassinate
text: The rulers of old Dominaria kept assassins on retainer. However, the true loyalty of these master killers was always to their peers. This elite community survived the fall of the old royal order.

name: Blightspeaker
text: One croaked sermon spreads propaganda and plague.

name: Cutthroat il-Dal
text: Her blades slashed across the noble's shadow. He scoffed, then fell over dead.

name: Dread Return
text: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

name: Dunerider Outlaw
text: Tales of the outlaw's cruelty and might grew more embellished with each crime.

name: Feebleness
text: Just a small touch of magic can harness the debilitating power of Urborg's poisonous winds.

name: Castle Raptors
text: "Each place we see is as ruined and lifeless as the last. So here we stay, because this ruin is *ours*."

name: Kor Dirge
text: Every new evincar cements their power with a culling as the weak are purged anew from Rath.

name: Mass of Ghouls
text:
"An army has filled the valley, but it's not like any army I've ever seen. There are no tents, no fires, no horses . . . just a sea of bodies, writhing and moaning, as if a pestilent village were sent to invade us."
—Onean scout

name: Minions' Murmurs
text:
"They are quick to offer advice, those whose mistakes doomed them to undeath. How can I not listen to the wisdom of failure?"
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Mirri the Cursed
text: A hero fails, a martyr falls. Time twists and destinies interchange.

name: Pit Keeper
text: "The undead are not 'awakened.' They are evicted when there is no room left in the pit for more bodies."

name: Premature Burial
text:
"This soil knows well the taste of the dead. Give it the hunger for a living meal, and it can become a deadly ally."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Rathi Trapper
text: Tangling vines, fetid murk, paralyzing poisons, and crawling dead. The swamp is nature's trap waiting to be exploited by unnatural minds.

name: Ridged Kusite
text:
"It offers but a taste of the power that the shadows have to offer. But even that is a heady wine indeed."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Sangrophage
text: The living is all it eats.

name: Skittering Monstrosity
text: Most living things were weakened and stunted in the ruinous aftermath of the Phyrexian invasion, but a few grew more horrid than ever.

name: Slaughter Pact
text: Death is only the beginning of the end.

name: Smallpox
text:
"Great losses often bring only a numb shock. To truly plunge a victim into misery, you must overwhelm them with many small sufferings."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

name: Children of Korlis
text:
"We have a proud history of self-sacrifice. But it is easy, in these bleak times, to find one among us who is eager to die for any cause."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Strangling Soot
text:
"What good is your blade without your breath?"
—Greht, Gathan warlord

name: Street Wraith
text: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

name: Stronghold Rats
text: In the stronghold's dungeons, the shadows hide in the vermin.

name: Sudden Death
text: Some mages tapped into the time rifts, forcing upon others alternate timelines in which unimaginable horrors befall them.

name: Tendrils of Corruption
text:
"Even swamps need sustenance. We will give it to them, and in turn, they will sustain us."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours

name: Tombstalker
text: When it ran out of bodies, it broke down the crypt door and sought new sustenance.

name: Trespasser il-Vec
text: At the epicenter of the Rathi overlay, the City of Traitors did not align with Dominaria. Many of its inhabitants were caught between the two worlds.

name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
text: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

name: Yixlid Jailer
text: "I have an eternity to know the souls who are bound here, to behold their every facet. But moments from now they will be gagged and masked, and they shall be known by none other."

name: Crovax, Ascendant Hero
text: Crovax was destined for an angel's curse, but one warped timeline saw the noble redeemed.

name: Ancient Grudge
text: The time rifts remind Yavimaya of the enemies of its past and provide fresh fuel for its fires.

name: Battering Sliver
text: Covered with hard shell-like plates, these slivers burrow through solid rock to carve out new nests for their hives.

name: Bonesplitter Sliver
text: As the time streams grew more and more unstable, Dominaria's creatures struggled to adapt. The intense pressures led to many dead ends but also to lethal new forms that appeared as suddenly as the ashen rains.

name: Brute Force
text: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

name: Char-Rumbler
text: Elementals flourished as Dominaria healed and new forms of life adapted to the land's reinfusion with mana.

name: Coal Stoker
text:
"The day is mine! I sent three such creatures against my foe, then watched as my magefire popped her soldiers like overripe spleenfruits."
—Dobruk the Unstable, pyromancer

name: Empty the Warrens
text: It's never just *one* goblin.

name: Fury Sliver
text:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

name: Grapeshot
text: Mages often seek to emulate the powerful relics lost to time and apocalypse.

name: Grinning Ignus
text:
"Take care what you offer the ignus. Food, perhaps. Coins. But nothing flammable!"
—Stovic, village eccentric

name: Errant Doomsayers
text: "Heed my words, traveler. Plagues, war, desolation . . . all mere hints of what is yet to come from Dominaria's vault of horrors."

name: Lightning Axe
text:
"A gargoyle's meat can be carved with an ordinary cleaver, but for its petrous hide . . ."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

name: Magus of the Moon
text: Tidal forces of the blood moon wrench and buckle the land, drawing monoliths of stone and soil toward the flaming orb.

name: Needlepeak Spider
text:
"It's a testament to the forests' devastation that giant spiders now make their homes amid Dominaria's barren spires."
—Aznaph, greenseeker

name: Orcish Cannonade
text:
"No ready! No aim! Just fire!"
—Scarback Plagg, orcish captain

name: Pact of the Titan
text: Born of fire, destined for battle.

name: Fortify
text:
"Where metal is tainted and wood is scarce, we are best armed by faith."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Prodigal Pyromancer
text:
"Learn to burn!"
—Institute of Arcane Studies motto

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Reiterate
text:
"Echoes of the Mirari's power yet linger."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Rift Elemental
text:
"It's difficult to heal a rift after it begins wandering about on its own."
—Teferi

name: Simian Spirit Guide
text:
"It's rarely worth questioning where the mana comes from. Just be grateful."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Skirk Shaman
text: In a shaman's grimy hands, a concoction of dried Skirk Ridge herbs can become the face of panic.

name: Storm Entity
text: Dweldian magi don't enter the Realm of Thrones when they die. Instead their souls are drawn to great works of magic.

name: Sudden Shock
text: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

name: Thick-Skinned Goblin
text: The shaman of the tribe is responsible for keeping track of all its treasures, including angry pets and cursed lamps of fiery doom.

name: Two-Headed Sliver
text:
"That which would be a fatal mutation in any other species is merely a source of new powers. I am intrigued, yet too fearful to examine it more closely."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Citanul Woodreaders
text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.

name: Amrou Seekers
text: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

name: Edge of Autumn
text: "At harvest are seeds of next year sown."

name: Fungus Sliver
text:
"When a sliver of this breed enters the hive, the others claw each other in frenzied fits, thereby ensuring their rapid growth."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Gaea's Anthem
text:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Gemhide Sliver
text:
"The land is weary. Even Skyshroud is depleted. We must find another source of mana—one that is growing despite our withering world."
—Freyalise

name: Greenseeker
text: "A rumor passes among the snakes, whispered by the rushes, inspiring the seekers: the goddess Freyalise is alive in Skyshroud."

name: Harmonize
text:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

name: Heartwood Storyteller
text: His roots reach deep, nurtured not by soil and rain, but by millennia of experience.

name: Imperiosaur
text:
"An ancient, powerful force has overtaken the valley. I sympathize for its former inhabitants, but I rejoice for the land itself."
—Olanti, Muraganda druid

name: Keen Sense
text: Crovax sensed that Mirri wasn't ready for the curse taking hold of her. Weeping in his heart, he fled.

name: Krosan Grip
text:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

name: Life and Limb
text:
"It was a sight of pain and awe—a twisted forest, migrating across the salt plain in search of richer soil."
—Edahlis, greenseeker

name: Llanowar Mentor
text: "One day the vines of this forest will be as much a part of you as your own fingers."

name: Might of Old Krosa
text: Sometimes even humble forest creatures were gifted with mighty emanations from the past.

name: Might Sliver
text:
"The colossal thing rumbled over the ridge, tree husks crumbling before it. The ones we were already fighting howled as it came, their muscles suddenly surging, and we knew it was time to flee."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
text: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

name: Pendelhaven Elder
text: The elder who carries the ancestral mantle of Jacques le Vert is tasked with his ancient mission: to protect the creatures of Pendelhaven.

name: Penumbra Spider
text: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

name: Phantom Wurm
text: It died with the forest, yet both linger on in twisted form.

name: Primal Forcemage
text: Their calls unheeded by the withered forests, nature shamans channeled the life force of their brethren.

name: Reflex Sliver
text:
"This sliver comes into the world a perfect predator. It's ready to hunt and devour its first meal within seconds of hatching."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Seal of Primordium
text:
"I am the simplifier, the root that drags all artifice to earth."
—Seal inscription

name: Spinneret Sliver
text: Each new generation of slivers evolves to assimilate the strengths of the prey upon which their progenitors fed.

name: Strength in Numbers
text:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Thelon of Havenwood
text: "The sight of my thallids still thriving is a bittersweet welcome to this cold waste."

name: Thornweald Archer
text: Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.

name: Tromp the Domains
text: Ground into the footprints of the ravaging herd were clumps of salt from Benalia, moss from Llanowar, dust from Hurloon, and ash from as far as Urborg.

name: Utopia Vow
text: "I'll guard this fruit and its seedling until the land is healed. My life now belongs to Dominaria."

name: Yavimaya Dryad
text: The parched earth still shielded those few souls with the heart to call it home.

name: Darkheart Sliver
text:
"At first we thought we were in some haunted wood. Then the branches twisted and scuttled toward us."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Lymph Sliver
text: Its skin remains in a flowing, liquid state that keeps its body coated with potent restorative lymph.

name: Dormant Sliver
text:
"It triggers the hive's period of aetheric fertility—a time when even feeding is a lower priority than reproduction."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Firewake Sliver
text:
"They are here, and they are hungry. And what they do not eat, they burn. Yavimaya is lost. We must leave now for Skyshroud."
—Edahlis, greenseeker

name: Glittering Wish
text: She wished for gold, but not for the strength to carry it.

name: Harmonic Sliver
text:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

name: Kaervek the Merciless
text:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

name: Necrotic Sliver
text: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

name: Radha, Heir to Keld
text: "Run home, cur. I've already taken your master's head. Don't make me thrash you with it."

name: Mana Tithe
text:
"Those who seek to upset the balance must be taxed for such ambitions."
—Verithain, mesa high priest

name: Saffi Eriksdotter
text: In the blink of an eye, she strode from deep snow to dusty waste. From the crease of light behind her, a voice rang hollow: "Saffi, wait for me . . . ."

name: Sliver Legion
text: Hidden within the clicking, chittering swarm is a unique mind, still young, but growing more aware as time passes.

name: Akroma's Memorial
text:
"No rest. No mercy. No matter what."
—Memorial inscription

name: Chromatic Star
text:
"This item is not from ... now. It reflects a sky no longer ours and gleams with hope that does not exist."
—Tavalus, acolyte of Korlis

name: Cloud Key
text: The musical sound of its turning triggers the tumblers of revelation.

name: Hivestone
text: Rath's evincars used hivestones to control the slivers, but the overlay put their power into unwitting hands. Now the stones make not masters, but slaves.

name: Mangara of Corondor
text: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

name: Paradise Plume
text: A last wisp of paradise in a fallen world.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

name: Sliversmith
text: After centuries of labor, its creations outnumber those they were to mimic.

name: Dryad Arbor
text:
"Touch no tree, break no branch, and speak only the question you wish answered."
—Von Yomm, elder druid, to her initiates

name: Flagstones of Trokair
text: Dust-spiked winds eroded the stones, but the ground where they had stood still holds power.

name: Kher Keep
text:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

name: Swarmyard
text: Where scavengers nest in hollowed-out rib cages and chittering crawlers peer from empty eye sockets, few dare to trespass.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Urza's Factory
text:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

name: Vesuva
text: It is everywhere you've ever been.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

name: Flickerwisp
text: Its wings disturb more than air.

name: Intangible Virtue
text: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
text: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

name: Silence
text:
"Take a quiet moment to reflect on your sins."
—Cleph, Order of Redeemed Souls

name: Sram, Senior Edificer
text: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

name: Stonehorn Dignitary
text: It did not escape the ambassador's notice that the sound of war drums could also marshal the city to attention.

name: Thraben Inspector
text: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
text: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Master of the Pearl Trident
text: "Let the land dwellers know the coast is no longer the border between our realms. A new age of empire has begun."

name: Paradoxical Outcome
text: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

name: Remand
text: "Well, at least all of that arm-waving and arcane babbling you did was impressive."

name: Repeal
text:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Dismember
text:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

name: Gurmag Angler
text: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

name: Harvester of Souls
text:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

name: Leyline of the Void
text: Where treachery and oblivion converge.

name: Liliana's Triumph
text: Her triumph came not from escaping her death, but in claiming her independence.

name: Read the Bones
text: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

name: Poultice Sliver
text:
"Its broad claw suggests a chitinous shield, but in fact it conceals glands that secrete a remarkably swift healing agent."
—Rukarumel, field journal

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

name: Thoughtseize
text: "Any dream is a robust harvest. Still, I prefer the timeworn dreams, heavy with import, that haunt the obsessive mind."

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
text: "Greet death with sword in hand."

name: Anger of the Gods
text: There was no reason to pray. This was already an act of the gods.

name: Pulmonic Sliver
text: Like a great bellows it hisses, and its kin, both living and dead, are lifted to safety.

name: Etali, Primal Storm
text: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

name: Exquisite Firecraft
text: Chandra's gift set her apart and others aflame.

name: Feldon of the Third Path
text: "She will come back to me."

name: Lava Spike
text: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

name: Molten Rain
text: When the molten rains fall, entire landscapes melt and flow away in rivulets of fire.

name: Monastery Swiftspear
text: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

name: Rebuff the Wicked
text:
"I cannot teach you their brand of magic, but I can teach you how to defend against it."
—Tavalus, priest of Korlis

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Beast Whisperer
text: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

name: Beast Within
text:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

name: Elvish Mystic
text:
"Life grows everywhere. My kin merely find those places where it grows strongest."
—Nissa Revane

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Evolutionary Leap
text: The essence of nature is change.

name: Farseek
text: "How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

name: Primeval Titan
text: When nature calls, *run*.

name: Reclamation Sage
text: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

name: Sylvan Scrying
text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

name: Thragtusk
text:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

name: Time of Need
text:
"When the kumo attacked the monks' sacred shrine, a mournful toll for help echoed through the forest. Thus began the Battle of Silk, which would last six years."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

name: Return to Dust
text: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The Izzet quickly suspended their policy of lifetime guarantees.

name: Cloudshredder Sliver
text: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

name: Dovin's Veto
text: "I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."

name: Mortify
text: The eyes let flow with tears, then blood, then the very soul—the whole wrung inside out, dripping down into the blackened puddle of the past.

name: Qasali Pridemage
text: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

name: Secret Plans
text: Rakshasa trade in secrets, amassing wealth from their careful revelation.

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
text: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

name: Trygon Predator
text: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

name: Saltblast
text: Dominaria erodes with each passing gust.

name: Crystal Shard
text: The vedalken know it is not of this world, so they know that this world is not the only one.

name: Hedron Archive
text:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

name: Hollow One
text: The embodiment of yearning, forever drifting the deserts to find what had once made it whole.

name: Leveler
text: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

name: Manifold Key
text:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

name: Panharmonicon
text: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

name: Saltfield Recluse
text: He remembers a past of light and healing. But he lives the bitter present—parching salt, scouring wind, and the withering heat of the desert.

name: Ancient Den
text: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

name: Serra Avenger
text:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

name: Sidewinder Sliver
text:
"They encircled our patrol with the stealth of snakes, corralling us like livestock."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

name: Sinew Sliver
text: As the muscle cords of the creature twitched, Hanna saw an unsettling unanimity in the others' rippling flesh. She didn't know what it meant, but she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

name: Sunlance
text:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

name: Watcher Sliver
text:
"I have spied them, wandering and watching—but for what? I fear they watch for us."
—Yonat of Amrou

name: Whitemane Lion
text: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

name: Bewilder
text:
"Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken. Silly, yes, but exactly the thing we needed to break the stifling tension."
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Bonded Fetch
text: A well-made homunculus grooms the mind of its master, pruning the thoughts that lead to madness. Few loredelvers survive the study of the infinite without one.

name: Brine Elemental
text: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

name: Careful Consideration
text:
"Sages who take the time to verify their sources are rewarded for their diligence."
—Jhoira, to Teferi

name: Coral Trickster
text: They wait in darkened depths, laughing eagerly.

name: Dream Stalker
text: What happens when it is the dream that wakes and the sleeper that fades into memory?

name: Dreamscape Artist
text: He's mastered the art of sleight of land.

name: Drifter il-Dal
text: They study the deeds of their traitorous ancestors, hoping the stories may reveal a way back to the physical world.

name: Foresee
text: Wind time's watch, and watch time unwind.

name: Benalish Cavalry
text: "My people swore to protect Benalia to the end. It is battered, but yet stands, as do we."

name: Gossamer Phantasm
text:
"Belief matters more than truth. Every moment, belief in imaginary things alters lives while truth sits unnoticed and waits."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Logic Knot
text: "Such sloppy work. Let's unravel it and try again!"

name: Looter il-Kor
text: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

name: Magus of the Future
text: Those gifted with the sight have one eye in the present and the other in the future.

name: Pact of Negation
text: Those who expect betrayal at every turn are seldom disappointed.

name: Pongify
text: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

name: Primal Plasma
text: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table. There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

name: Sarcomite Myr
text:
"A horrible sight, yes, but the sounds . . . Its twanging tendons and grinding gears are almost musical."
—Brudiclad, Telchor engineer

name: Snapback
text:
"If it returns years hence, our knowledge of how to combat it will be that much greater."
—Andorel, Tolarian sentinel

name: Spiketail Drakeling
text: Drakelings fish with their tails, angling to snare succulent thoughts and memories on their psychic hooks.

name: Blade of the Sixth Pride
text: "My pride may be gone, but our hunt is not over."

name: Stormcloud Djinn
text: As fickle as lightning, as slippery as an eel.

name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
text: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

name: Think Twice
text:
"Great books are meant to be read, then read again backwards or upside down!"
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

name: Tolarian Sentinel
text: "It is not just our people I try to rescue. It is our culture, and our hope that we can return to greatness."

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

name: Whip-Spine Drake
text:
"I swear the clouds were created just so the drakes would have a place to lurk."
—Kasharri, skyknight

name: Wild Colos
text: You'll never get a Keldon's goat.

name: Ancient Silverback
text: The Phyrexian killing machines couldn't have known the seriousness of their mistake in wounding the ape—they'd never seen it angry.

name: Compost
text:
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout.
—Yavimaya saying

name: Elvish Lookout
text: Like a masterful quilter, Yavimaya stitches together patches of color to warn its denizens of threats.

name: Elvish Piper
text:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

name: Emperor Crocodile
text: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

name: Goliath Beetle
text: The balance of nature dictates that one day humans will be stepped on by bugs.

name: Heart Warden
text:
"In Llanowar, we tend the forest's boughs and branches. In Yavimaya, we are a part of them."
—Rofellos of Llanowar

name: Mask of Law and Grace
text: The archangels zealously drove Serra's light into every corner of their new home as if their creator still commanded them.

name: Magnify
text: The seed torches' pollen gives off light, but the elves find it heightens their senses as well.

name: Marker Beetles
text: In case of emergency, crush bug.

name: Multani's Decree
text:
"This is my place of power. Nothing can take root here unless I allow it."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Plated Spider
text: Most spiders wait patiently for their prey to arrive. Most spiders aren't forty feet tall.

name: Plow Under
text:
To renew the land, plow the land. To destroy the land, do nothing.
—Druids' saying

name: Rofellos's Gift
text:
"Rise, elf. We are both of Gaea, and thus we are equal."
—Multani, to Rofellos

name: Master Healer
text: Behind his eyes is the pain of every soldier his hands have healed.

name: Taunting Elf
text: Much to Multani's chagrin, Rofellos gleefully tutored Yavimaya's elves on the rudest and most vulgar words spoken in Llanowar.

name: Thorn Elemental
text: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

name: Yavimaya Enchantress
text: From each seed, a world. From each world, a thousand seeds.

name: Braidwood Cup
text:
"I think it no accident that every civilized people has discovered the art of distillation."
—Rofellos of Llanowar

name: Brass Secretary
text: The students disliked the secretary for its unfailing memory—until they discovered it couldn't dodge thrown objects.

name: Caltrops
text: Toward the end, Gatha struggled to keep his experiments in and his patrons out.

name: Extruder
text: As the invasion drew closer, Urza's means began to resemble Phyrexia's end.

name: Fodder Cannon
text: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

name: Junk Diver
text: Garbage in, treasure out.

name: Mantis Engine
text: Tawnos left a legacy of animal designs in many of Urza's creations.

name: Metalworker
text:
"At this rate I fully expect to be replaced by a clockwork golem by year's end."
—Barrin

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Reliquary Monk
text: A thing of Serra's realm exists only by the grace of her followers' faith.

name: Thran Foundry
text:
"What we do not use up, we use again."
—Urza

name: Thran Golem
text: Karn felt more secure about his value to Urza when he realized he didn't need regular trimming.

name: Urza's Incubator
text:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, Academy Chancellor

name: Yavimaya Hollow
text: For all its traps and defenses, Yavimaya has its havens, too.

name: Replenish
text: Treasures, trinkets, trash—the relics of the past are brought forth again.

name: Sanctimony
text: "To forgive our enemies is to forgive ourselves."

name: Serra Advocate
text: An angel's touch can prepare a soldier for battle more than a thousand military drills.

name: Solidarity
text: Their commitment to Serra is as solid as any shield.

name: Tethered Griffin
text: Poorly trained griffins sometimes attack the noble audiences that gather to watch their progress.

name: Tormented Angel
text: Falling from heaven is not as painful as surviving the impact.

name: Voice of Duty
text:
"Next to Law is Duty, and Duty must be obeyed. If the frame of Duty is broken, none shall weave life's fabric."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

name: Voice of Reason
text:
"Next to Grace is Reason, and Reason must be retained. If the web of Reason comes unwoven, madness will escape."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

name: Wall of Glare
text: The blinding barrier served Benalia better than a hundred shields.

name: Aura Thief
text: Illusion steals reality from the unwise.

name: Blizzard Elemental
text: Students who had seen Rayne argue with Urza were certain she had summoned it to make him seem warmer by comparison.

name: Bubbling Beebles
text:
"Chancellor Rayne canceled the annual beeble roast. I should have married a crueler woman."
—Barrin

name: Capashen Knight
text: Few warriors dare to challenge a knight of Capashen. Should one do so, there is one fewer.

name: Disappear
text: If at first you don't succeed, run away and hide.

name: Donate
text: Campus pranksters initiate new students with the old "beeble bomb" routine.

name: Fatigue
text: "Mind if I just lie down right here for a few weeks?"

name: Fledgling Osprey
text: It isn't truly born until its first flight.

name: Illuminated Wings
text: For a moment, Urza thought not of war and destruction, but of the freedom of the skies.

name: Kingfisher
text: It's tastiest when served with the fish it stole.

name: Mental Discipline
text: Barrin drowned his doubts about Urza's project by delving ever deeper into its details.

name: Metathran Elite
text: If the eyes are windows to the soul, their souls are not of this world.

name: Metathran Soldier
text: Just as Serra crafted angels of light and faith, Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

name: Capashen Standard
text: Benalia has no need for peacocks to serve as symbols of vanity. The Capashens strut more proudly than any bird.

name: Opposition
text:
"Urza says he's sane. Perhaps, but measures of sanity among planeswalkers are hard to come by."
—Barrin

name: Rescue
text:
"Urza, I've discovered more promising students than you and my husband have, combined. And I haven't lost a single one."
—Rayne, Academy Chancellor

name: Sigil of Sleep
text: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

name: Telepathic Spies
text: "Do try to keep an open mind, would you?"

name: Temporal Adept
text:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All her classmates have disappeared."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

name: Thieving Magpie
text: Rayne once made several unkind comparisons between the bird's naked opportunism and Urza's.

name: Capashen Templar
text: Their shields are Benalia's outermost battlements.

name: Treachery
text:
"The academy educates; I employ. It's a perfect arrangement."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

name: Attrition
text:
"I will trade life for life with the insurgents. Our resources, unlike theirs, are limitless."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: Bubbling Muck
text: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

name: Carnival of Souls
text: "'Davvol, blast those elves.' 'Davvol, transport those troops.' No one cares that today is my birthday."

name: Chime of Night
text: Many sent to serve Davvol carried such instruments, as if to remind him who their true masters were.

name: Disease Carriers
text: Rath is a disease all its inhabitants carry.

name: Dying Wail
text: This is a world of spiteful wasps that sting and kill even as they die.

name: Encroach
text:
"The rate of spread in this region is unacceptable. Start again."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: False Prophet
text: "You lived for Serra's love. Will you not die for it?"

name: Lurking Jackals
text: Often it's not the hunter or the hunted but the opportunist who thrives in Rath.

name: Phyrexian Monitor
text: Being one would be an honor, if the word "honor" had any meaning in Phyrexia.

name: Phyrexian Negator
text: They exist to cease.

name: Plague Dogs
text: They're not just retrievers, they're carriers.

name: Rapid Decay
text: The grave robbers arrived the day after the burial. They were a day too late.

name: Ravenous Rats
text:
"For all the priceless tomes they have destroyed, one would think they would taste better."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: Fend Off
text: The best defense is to not get hit.

name: Skittering Horror
text:
"This monstrosity will do—for now."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

name: Slinking Skirge
text: Davvol encouraged the skirges; they made excellent sentries and were quite edible if properly seasoned.

name: Soul Feast
text: As no one has ever accepted a second invitation to Davvol's table, the evincar often dines alone.

name: Squirming Mass
text: Only the coldest hearts and the strongest stomachs can stand against it.

name: Twisted Experiment
text: Gatha showed remarkable prowess in increasing his subjects' stature. Their lifespans, however, were another matter.

name: Yawgmoth's Bargain
text: He craves only one commodity.

name: Aether Sting
text: When Gatha fell, he was called to account for each abomination he created.

name: Bloodshot Cyclops
text: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

name: Colos Yearling
text: A steed grows with its rider.

name: Field Surgeon
text: Commanders order soldiers to attack. Field surgeons order them to heal. Both are obeyed without question.

name: Covetous Dragon
text: Gatha survived as long as he did by giving all Keld's predators exactly what they wanted.

name: Flame Jet
text: Did the land make the Keldons? Did the Keldons make the land? Or were they simply meant for each other?

name: Goblin Berserker
text:
Goblins don't know the meaning of the word "tactics"
—or the word "meaning," for that matter.

name: Goblin Festival
text: "What are we celebratin' again?"

name: Goblin Gardener
text: "Grow food in dirt? Save time—eat dirt."

name: Goblin Masons
text: "Goblins build with true zeal—and anything else within arm's reach."

name: Hulking Ogre
text:
"The Keldons' ogre campaign provided more body parts than my meager facility could properly use."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

name: Impatience
text: Ask a Keldon to hold his temper and you'll be left holding your guts.

name: Flicker
text: Who is truer: you who are, or you who are to be?

name: Keldon Vandals
text: Keldons divide all their spoils into two groups: trophies and catapult ammunition.

name: Landslide
text:
Sometimes the mountain takes.
—Keldon saying

name: Mark of Fury
text: Many Keldon warriors bear the mark of intentional insanity.

name: Reckless Abandon
text: The climax of a warlord's career is always death.

name: Repercussion
text: Not all Keld's warriors are found on the battlefield.

name: Trumpet Blast
text: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack, but when to stop.

name: Wake of Destruction
text:
Land charred black, rivers boiled,
Crops and wells alike despoiled, Mountains leveled, forests felled—
Footprints of the beasts of Keld.

name: Dragonscale Boon
text: Only those who have proved themselves worthy are granted a dragon's scale.

name: Wildcall
text: A howl on the wind hides many dangers.

name: Hewed Stone Retainers
text:
"Their origins are shrouded in mystery. I believe they are the protectors of the lost secrets of our world."
—Jilaya, Temur whisperer

name: Ugin's Construct
text: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin, but he gleaned the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.

name: Altar of the Brood
text: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.

name: Briber's Purse
text: The bigger the hand, the higher the price.

name: Ghostfire Blade
text: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.

name: Smite the Monstrous
text: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.

name: Soul Summons
text: Ugin's magic reaches beyond the dragons. The clans have adapted it for war.

name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
text: "There are many different paths. The Great Teacher reveals them all."

name: Debilitating Injury
text: Weakness exists within all who are not dragons.

name: Grim Haruspex
text: "Your enemies may be cowardly, my lord, but one should never call them gutless."

name: Sultai Emissary
text: To the Sultai, Ugin's power was just one more resource to be exploited.

name: Ainok Tracker
text:
"The ainok are wild dogs, not fit to join us around the fire."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

name: Arc Lightning
text: Lightning burns the dragon's path.

name: Fierce Invocation
text: Anger can empower those who embrace it.

name: Once More with Feeling
text: If yo . . . ted.

name: Chicken à la King
text: During the Chicken Revolution, the king managed to keep his head while the others—well, just ran around.

name: Clambassadors
text: "Sorry we shelled your village—here's some gold."

name: The Cheese Stands Alone
text: The meat, on the other hand, has frequent visitors.

name: Denied!
text: "Don't worry about it. It happens to every mage sooner or later."

name: Fowl Play
text: "I feel like chicken tonight!"

name: Organ Harvest
text: "Lucy, you've got some spleenin' to do."

name: Poultrygeist
text: Farmer Brown never ate eggs again.

name: Temp of the Damned
text: "Not the graveyard shift again!"

name: Chicken Egg
text:
"That's a lotta nuggets."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

name: Goblin Bowling Team
text: Flog was out of his league—this game wasn't up his alley, but the team couldn't spare him if he split.

name: Krazy Kow
text: "I got your milk right here!"

name: Cardboard Carapace
text: . . . that exciting . . . about . . .

name: Elvish Impersonators
text: "Uh-hunh."

name: Flock of Rabid Sheep
text: And their bleating was like a wet salmon slapped upon the land—slap! slap! slap!

name: Growth Spurt
text: MORE TO LOVE: Friendly, nature-loving, Bunyonesque SEM seeks SEF looking for a huge commitment. . . . seeks atog prince

name: Hungry Hungry Heifer
text: Mooo.

name: Timmy, Power Gamer
text: "Just wait till I get my Leviathan . . . ."

name: Paper Tiger
text: The tiger is always quick to fold.

name: Rock Lobster
text: Many take the lobster for granite.

name: Look at Me, I'm the DCI
text: Few understand the DCI's rigorous decision-making process.

name: Scissors Lizard
text: Nothing beats the lizard's shear power.

name: Spatula of the Ages
text:
At last Urza's powers were focused through the incredible artifact.
"Who wants pancakes?" he asked.

name: Angelic Curator
text:
"Do not treat your people as you treat your artifacts. Let them go, and they will live; seal them here, and they will die."
—Urza, to Radiant

name: Gang of Elk
text: The elk is Gaea's favorite, who wears the forest on its brow.

name: Harmonic Convergence
text: When the eternal stars align, can mere mortals resist?

name: Hidden Gibbons
text: When these apes want something, it's a matter of gibbon take.

name: Lone Wolf
text: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

name: Might of Oaks
text: Suddenly, she couldn't see the acorns for the trees.

name: Multani, Maro-Sorcerer
text:
"To make peace with the forest, make peace with me."
—Multani, to Urza

name: Multani's Presence
text: When a tree falls in the forest, Multani hears it.

name: Rancor
text: Hatred outlives the hateful.

name: Silk Net
text: Sometimes it's possible to pull a meal out of thin air.

name: Simian Grunts
text: These monkeys mean business.

name: Treefolk Mystic
text: Urza's wards fell from him like autumn leaves as he entered the dreaming grove. He awoke imprisoned in living wood.

name: Weatherseed Elf
text: "My grandmother once told me the future of our world was inside the Weatherseed. When I touched it, I knew she was right."

name: Wing Snare
text:
"Argoth's doom rained from a clear sky. Yavimaya will not share that fate."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

name: Yavimaya Scion
text: Each time the saw blade bit, the tree spat it out.

name: Knighthood
text:
"He has returned. He who brought the dark ones. He who poisoned our paradise. How shall we greet him? With swift and certain death!"
—Radiant, archangel

name: Yavimaya Wurm
text: When the gorilla playfully grabbed the wurm's tail, the wurm doubled back and playfully ate the gorilla's head.

name: Beast of Burden
text: "If it is meant to be nothing but a machine," Karn finally asked Jhoira, "why did Urza build it to be like me?"

name: Crawlspace
text: The goblins did not understand their attraction to the mana rig. They simply knew it was where they belonged.

name: Defense Grid
text:
"We've managed to keep the goblins in their assigned areas, but there's little we can do about the smell."
—Whip Tongue, viashino technician

name: Grim Monolith
text: Part prison, part home.

name: Iron Maiden
text: The maiden is a jealous lover.

name: Jhoira's Toolbox
text: It entertained Jhoira to craft a kit that could bring her the tools.

name: Martyr's Cause
text: Dying is a soldier's talent.

name: Quicksilver Amulet
text: "Wonderful! You got a lion on your first try. Now put it back."

name: Ring of Gix
text: Not every cage is made of bars.

name: Scrapheap
text: Junk heaps have rats, but scrapheaps have goblins.

name: Thran Lens
text:
"Every device in the rig is evidence of Thran enlightenment. All mana was the same to them, whether from rock or water, growth or decay. Can you imagine such unity of vision?"
—Urza, journal

name: Urza's Blueprints
text: From concept to paper to reality.

name: Wheel of Torture
text: "I'd like to buy a bowel."

name: Mother of Runes
text: "My family protects all families."

name: Opal Avenger
text: As the sun grew cold in the realm, the statue grew warm.

name: Peace and Quiet
text:
"In time our realm will shine again. But it will gleam only when we scour away the taint of doubt."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Planar Collapse
text: With heavy heart, Urza doused one world's light to rekindle another's.

name: Purify
text:
"Our Mother! The sky was Her hair; the sun, Her face. She danced on the grass and in the hills."
—*Song of All*, canto 23

name: Blessed Reversal
text: Even an enemy is a valuable resource.

name: Sustainer of the Realm
text:
"The harder you push, the stronger we become."
—Radiant, to Urza

name: Tragic Poet
text: "I would weep, but my tears have been stolen; I would shout, but my voice has been taken. Thus, I write."

name: Anthroplasm
text: I never metamorphosis I didn't like.

name: Archivist
text: Some do. Some teach. The rest look it up.

name: Aura Flux
text: To some, the Tolarian sunrise was a blinding flash; to others, a lingering glow.

name: Bouncing Beebles
text: Beebles are frequently hurled against stone surfaces at high speed but always zing back into the air with a giggle.

name: Burst of Energy
text:
"I stand ready to die for our world. Who will stand with me?"
—Radiant, archangel

name: Delusions of Mediocrity
text: When nothing but second best will do.

name: Fleeting Image
text: Horas swore off drinking, but after meeting the creature a second time he decided he'd better start again.

name: Frantic Search
text: Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.

name: Intervene
text:
"At first I simply observed. But I found that without investment in others, life serves no purpose."
—Karn, silver golem

name: King Crab
text:
"I'm allergic to shellfish—not only did it kill my entire village, it also gave me this nasty rash."
—Olivia, fisher

name: Levitation
text: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat when he had to get the others back down.

name: Opportunity
text:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Cessation
text:
"The face of Light will shine upon them, and they will know war no more."
—*Song of All*, canto 918

name: Second Chance
text: The greatest gift is the opportunity to right one's wrongs.

name: Snap
text: Good riddance.

name: Thornwind Faeries
text: Guarding the ship is the Thornwinds' first concern. Getting along with the locals ranks fourth or fifth at best.

name: Tinker
text:
"I wonder how it feels to be bored."
—Jhoira, artificer

name: Vigilant Drake
text: Awake and awing in the blink of an eye.

name: Walking Sponge
text: Not only does it catch fish, it cleans them too.

name: Weatherseed Faeries
text: Two days after the forge was completed, the faeries were immune to its flames.

name: Defender of Law
text: "It is not my place to question Radiant's rule. I exist to enforce her will."

name: Brink of Madness
text:
"The fools thought me dead. But I built an empire inside my tomb."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

name: Engineered Plague
text:
"The admixture of bitterwort in the viral brew has produced most favorable results."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Eviscerator
text: It roamed the time bubble like a captured animal. Kerrick knew he must soon find a way to unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.

name: Fog of Gnats
text: You can swat a thousand gnats, but a thousand more will assail you.

name: Giant Cockroach
text: If the sun ever hit the swamp, where would these scurry to?

name: Lurking Skirge
text: They never miss a funeral.

name: No Mercy
text:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

name: Ostracize
text: Kerrick was to find that some borders can never be crossed.

name: Phyrexian Broodlings
text: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

name: Phyrexian Debaser
text:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Devout Harpist
text: The notes themselves are irrelevant. The music's effect, however, is worth ten armies.

name: Phyrexian Defiler
text:
"The third stage of the illness: muscle aches and persistent cough."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Denouncer
text:
"The first stage of the illness: rash and nausea."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Plaguelord
text:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Phyrexian Reclamation
text: Death is no excuse to stop working.

name: Plague Beetle
text: It is the harbinger of disease, not the carrier.

name: Rank and File
text: "Left, right, left, right . . . hmm. Okay—left, left, left, left, . . ."

name: Sick and Tired
text: The Phyrexians' only interest in organic life is discerning its weakness.

name: Subversion
text: Kerrick's corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.

name: Erase
text: Perception is more pleasing than truth.

name: Tethered Skirge
text: It bites the hand that leads it.

name: Treacherous Link
text:
"You cannot possibly know the toll your alliances will exact from you."
—Barrin, to Urza

name: About Face
text: The overconfident are the most vulnerable.

name: Defender of Chaos
text: Some knights will not follow orders—only disorder.

name: Ghitu Fire-Eater
text:
"They are called 'Mi'uto,' which means 'one use.'"
—Jhoira, artificer

name: Ghitu Slinger
text: If you survive a slinger attack, the slinger wished you to live.

name: Ghitu War Cry
text: The war cry is not simply a shout but a sacrament.

name: Goblin Medics
text:
"First, do some harm."
—Oath of Goblins

name: Expendable Troops
text: No doubt in their minds, no fear in their hearts.

name: Goblin Welder
text: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

name: Granite Grip
text: There's beauty in the desert—but it's best to view it from afar.

name: Impending Disaster
text:
"The goblins are in charge of maintenance? Why not just set it on fire now and call it a day?"
—Whip Tongue, viashino technician

name: Last-Ditch Effort
text:
"If you're gonna lose, at least make sure they don't win as much."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Lava Axe
text: "Catch!"

name: Molten Hydra
text:
Keep off the glass.
—Hydra warning sign

name: Parch
text:
"Your porous flesh betrays you."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

name: Pygmy Pyrosaur
text:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

name: Pyromancy
text:
Who harnesses fire controls the world.
—Ghitu proverb

name: Rack and Ruin
text:
"My people are bound by masters centuries dead. Each artifact we destroy is another link broken in that chain."
—Barb Tail, viashino heretic

name: Hope and Glory
text:
"Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Rivalry
text: The goblins revered it; the viashino defended it. Only Urza understood it.

name: Shivan Phoenix
text: To strike down the phoenix is to slash at the flame.

name: Sluggishness
text: Vark decided to lie down and think of a good excuse to quit working.

name: Viashino Bey
text:
When the bey runs, match his stride.
—Viashino saying

name: Viashino Cutthroat
text:
"You guys go on ahead. I'll catch up with ya."
—Vark, goblin scout, last words

name: Viashino Heretic
text: "The past is buried for good reason."

name: Crop Rotation
text: "Hmm . . . maybe lotuses this year."

name: All Is Dust
text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Angelic Renewal
text: Angels watch over mortals with heavy hearts, knowing what fate awaits them in the end.

name: Grave Strength
text: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

name: Gurmag Angler
text: If everything in the Gurmag Swamp hungers for human flesh, what bait could be more effective?

name: Last Gasp
text: Takedowns in Valor's Reach are never meant to be lethal, but that doesn't mean they won't be incredibly painful.

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it."
—Sorin Markov

name: Moan of the Unhallowed
text: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

name: Olivia's Dragoon
text: Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.

name: Containment Priest
text: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

name: Reanimate
text:
"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

name: Sanitarium Skeleton
text: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

name: Slum Reaper
text: It's sent into unguilded districts by the Orzhov to collect the souls of those no one will miss.

name: Songs of the Damned
text: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

name: Twins of Maurer Estate
text:
"Children, where are your parents?"
—Reig, wandering monk, last words

name: Unburial Rites
text: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

name: Conviction
text: "There is no greater coward than one who believes in nothing."

name: Unholy Hunger
text: Liliana viewed the attention of the angels as a testament to her power. Even so, they were an annoyance.

name: Akroan Crusader
text: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

name: Anger
text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Arena Athlete
text: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

name: Balefire Dragon
text: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

name: Brazen Scourge
text: Driven by an insatiable hunger, gremlins never cease feeding. They can destroy a lifetime of work in just a few moments.

name: Faithless Looting
text: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

name: Fiery Temper
text: "Let the flames ignore the sinless."

name: Firewing Phoenix
text:
"When a phoenix nests in a volcano, we rejoice, for it means a hundred years of war."
—Golmak, Keldon warlord

name: Furnace Celebration
text: Nothing impresses goblins more than something that's bound to kill them.

name: Gamble
text:
"STUFF AND SUNDRIES AND MUNITIONS!"
—Breeches, gunner of the *Belligerent*

name: Generator Servant
text: Infinite potential given finite form.

name: Hissing Iguanar
text: It's pretty cute—from a distance.

name: Ingot Chewer
text: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

name: Lava Spike
text: It's not the most subtle incantation, but it gets the point across.

name: Mad Prophet
text: "I have seen it. Seen the end, seen the beginning, the beginning of the end. Not death, no, no. Transcendence!"

name: Magmaw
text:
"The purpose of existence is simple: everything is fuel for the magmaw."
—Jaji, magmaw worshipper

name: Daybreak Coronet
text:
"Let the deception of the gods yield to the pure light of day."
—Brimaz, king of Oreskos

name: Molten Birth
text:
"Few can coax the creatures within the magma to be cooled and take form."
—Koth of the Hammer

name: Nightbird's Clutches
text: Shiny polished silver can ward off many creatures, but it attracts others.

name: Raid Bombardment
text: Goblins in the first wave of a fire raid always bemoan the aim of everyone else.

name: Reckless Wurm
text: Bred for battle in the Grand Coliseum, these wurms annihilated whole ecosystems when released into the wild.

name: Rolling Temblor
text: When demons open a path to your front door, it's time to move.

name: Seismic Assault
text:
"In a war for survival, Dominaria itself became a weapon. The malice is gone, but the danger remains."
—Jhoira

name: Soul's Fire
text: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

name: Emancipation Angel
text: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
text:
"If Yawgmoth meant Squee's immortality as a curse, no one ever told Squee."
—Karn

name: Thermo-Alchemist
text: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

name: Vexing Devil
text: It's not any fun until someone loses an eye.

name: Young Pyromancer
text: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

name: Boar Umbra
text: "From in here, everything looks like dinner."

name: Boneyard Wurm
