text: The only thing it likes more than discovering a pit of bones is adding to it.

name: Brawn
text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

name: Devoted Druid
text: "Mana lurks in all things, even in the depths of one's own heart."

name: Eternal Witness
text: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

name: Fauna Shaman
text: She wears the talismans of every creature she can evoke.

name: Fecundity
text: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

name: Groundskeeper
text: "While the church thinks in terms of legacies, others think in terms of eternities."

name: Hero of Leina Tower
text: "You cannot achieve greatness if its seed has not already been planted in your heart."

name: Hooting Mandrills
text: Interlopers in Sultai territory usually end up as crocodile chow or baboon bait.

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Miming Slime
text:
"We paid the Simic very well for this capability, but we should quickly recoup our expenses in saved wages."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

name: Noble Hierarch
text: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

name: Penumbra Wurm
text: Its ferocity cannot be contained in one lifetime.

name: Prey Upon
text:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

name: Pulse of Murasa
text: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

name: Gods Willing
text: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Shed Weakness
text: To prepare for the Trial of Strength, nagas shed their old skin—and with it their scars, their doubts, and their fears.

name: Staunch-Hearted Warrior
text: As soon as she faces a monster, she begins composing its epitaph.

name: Stingerfling Spider
text: The juiciest prey is that which grows lazy, thinking itself beyond the reach of danger.

name: Tarmogoyf
text: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

name: Travel Preparations
text: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

name: Vengevine
text: Leave but a shred of root and it will return, bursting with vigor.

name: Heliod's Pilgrim
text: The blessings of Heliod are apparent for all to see.

name: Wickerbough Elder
text: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

name: Wild Hunger
text: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions. The snake was filled only with Otto.

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Angel of Despair
text:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia, Boros archangel

name: Blast of Genius
text: Ral Zarek's brainstorms bring actual thunder and lightning.

name: Countersquall
text: Each of the twenty-three winds of Esper is named and chronicled, and every possible interaction with the flow of magic is exhaustively detailed.

name: Gaddock Teeg
text: So great are his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

name: Hero of Iroas
text: "My left has felled a cyclops. My right has slain a giant. I bring both to every fight."

name: Golgari Charm
text:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
text: "I'm sure we can come to an arrangement."

name: Lord of Extinction
text: The forlorn cries of the dead combine to make its laugh.

name: Maelstrom Pulse
text: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

name: Sigarda, Host of Herons
text: Great devotion yields great reward.

name: Urban Evolution
text: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

name: Warleader's Helix
text:
"There is no time to remedy our enemies' ignorance. Blast it out of them."
—Aurelia

name: Beckon Apparition
text: The foyer is littered with the coins it demands but can no longer hold.

name: Canker Abomination
text: Once the hideous disease takes hold, it spreads through both bark and mind.

name: Double Cleave
text: If at first you don't succeed, hit them again.

name: Fulminator Mage
text: "Burn, suffer, and trouble me no more."

name: Kitchen Finks
text: Accept one favor from an ouphe, and you're doomed to accept another.

name: Plumeveil
text:
"It was vast, a great sheet of soaring wings, and equally silent. It caught us unawares and blocked our view of the kithkin stronghold."
—Grensch, merrow cutthroat

name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
text: "If there were such a thing as a soul, I think it would be behind the gallbladder but above the kidneys."

name: Icatian Crier
text: A thousand years removed from her home, her news of war had lost its context, but not its relevance.

name: Safehold Elite
text: Not even death will keep her from her mission.

name: Slippery Bogle
text: Ogle the bogle, or goggle the boggle? Doesn't matter. You weren't going to catch it anyway.

name: Turn to Mist
text:
"Did you expect me to dodge? How quaint."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Heap Doll
text:
"I know one night it won't come back. Then I'll know it's truly done its job."
—Braenna, cobblesmith

name: Lotus-Eye Mystics
text: Every action has a foreseen purpose.

name: Myr Servitor
text: The Krark Clan enjoys pulling them apart just to watch them reassemble one another.

name: Patchwork Gnomes
text: One wizard's trash is another wizard's roving gang of abominations.

name: Phyrexian Altar
text:
"Unskin these impure bodies, Great Yawgmoth, that the flesh may welcome your blessings."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Platinum Emperion
text: It ignores such insignificant forces as time, entropy, and death.

name: Prismatic Lens
text: A capable mage can tune its focus, refracting mana through each disk in turn to cast any spell they desire.

name: Ancient Tomb
text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

name: Desolate Lighthouse
text: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

name: Flagstones of Trokair
text: Dust-spiked winds eroded the stones, but the ground where they had stood still holds power.

name: Phyrexian Tower
text:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn

name: Martyr of Sands
text: "Only in our vulnerability is there true power, and that power is life itself."

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Thespian's Stage
text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Miraculous Recovery
text: "I am the rock of the polis. Death only strengthens me."

name: Phalanx Leader
text: His soldiers etch his words on the insides of their shields, their inspiration always in sight during battle.

name: Rally the Peasants
text:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

name: Repel the Darkness
text: A boon to those who cannot see in the dark. A bane to those who live in it.

name: Eldrazi Conscription
text: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

name: Resurrection
text:
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more."
—War blessing of Serra

name: Reya Dawnbringer
text: "You have not died until I consent."

name: Ronom Unicorn
text: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

name: Sigil of the New Dawn
text: The sigil represents an honor that endures beyond death.

name: Skyspear Cavalry
text: Pray her spear reaches you first. Her griffin is less kind.

name: Spirit Cairn
text: The most beautiful souls shine even in death.

name: Tethmos High Priest
text: "Death is tyranny. Like all tyranny, it must be opposed."

name: Wall of Reverence
text: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

name: Wandering Champion
text: "Learn from your enemies, but do not tolerate them."

name: Wingsteed Rider
text: Trust is the only bridle a pegasus will accept.

name: Archaeomancer
text: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

name: Back to Basics
text:
"A ruler wears a crown while the rest of us wear hats, but which would you rather have when it's raining?"
—Barrin, *Principia*

name: Defy Gravity
text: On every plane in the Multiverse, there is magic, and someone is using it to fly.

name: Deranged Assistant
text: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

name: Dreamscape Artist
text: He's mastered the art of sleight of land.

name: Flight of Fancy
text: The view from above is an inspiration to the newly winged.

name: Foil
text: Among wizards, poor timing is the most consistent mistake.

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Just the Wind
text: "There's nothing to worry about."

name: Laboratory Maniac
text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Magus of the Bazaar
text: "Some trade in goods, some in secrets. My soul has walked the futures, and I offer the rare coin of possibility."

name: Mahamoti Djinn
text: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

name: Marang River Prowler
text: The currents of the Marang wash away both tracks and blood.

name: Rise from the Tides
text:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Rune Snag
text:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Skywing Aven
text: "I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

name: Sleight of Hand
text:
"Gambling with mages never is."
—Remin, venerable monk

name: Stitched Drake
text:
"The best skaabs are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

name: Stitcher's Apprentice
text: "Oglor create life, Oglor take it away. Oglor god! ... until Master return."

name: Stream of Consciousness
text:
"All things return to their beginnings. The waters that spill across the Kamitaki Falls flow to sea, only to be returned to her as the rain that joins the mighty river."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Sultai Skullkeeper
text: A skullkeeper is the first to arrive after the palace archers strike down intruders, probing their brains for choice bits of knowledge.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
text: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Temporal Manipulation
text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

name: Think Twice
text: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

name: Treasure Cruise
text: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

name: Ulamog's Crusher
text:
"Ulamog is dead, and his brood is dying. Some of them just don't know it yet."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

name: Visions of Beyond
text:
"The past is the foundation for all that exists in the present. We merely reconstruct what our ancestors have already discovered."
—Sachimir, Sage of Memories

name: Whirlwind Adept
text: The Flowing Staff technique does not differentiate between offense and defense.

name: Appetite for Brains
text: Just as with a peach, the first bite is always the juiciest.

name: Apprentice Necromancer
text: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

name: Bitterblossom
text: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

name: Bloodflow Connoisseur
text:
"Death not for survival but for vanity and pleasure? This is the decadence I sought to curb."
—Sorin Markov

name: Buried Alive
text: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

name: Ancestor's Chosen
text: "The will of all, by my hand done."

name: Death Denied
text: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

name: Demonic Tutor
text: Beware the generosity of demons.

name: Entomb
text:
"I'll return once you've ripened."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Fume Spitter
text:
"Our archers made sport of it as it fumbled its way up the slag ridge. As it collapsed we thought ourselves safe, but the foul thing carried more than necrogen."
—Adaran, Tangle hunter

name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
text: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

name: Ghoulsteed
text: It once served a cathar roadwatcher, patrolling the crossways between villages. Its hooves still carry it along the same path.

name: Look at Me, I'm the DCI
text: Few understand the DCI's rigorous decision-making process.

name: Chicken à la King
text: During the Chicken Revolution, the king managed to keep his head while the others—well, just ran around.

name: Johnny, Combo Player
text: "Just wait till I get my Krark-Clan Ironworks, Genesis Chamber, and Grinding Station. Oh yeah, and a second Myr Retriever."

name: Time Out
text: Anyone other than a goblin would've gotten only a hand caught in the cookie jar.

name: Topsy Turvy
text: "Here on going is heck the what?"

name: Booster Tutor
text: "You saved that *Urza's Saga* pack all these years for *this*?"

name: Inhumaniac
text: For the mind-minded mastermind.

name: Poultrygeist
text: Farmer Brown never ate eggs again.

name: Painiac
text: "You're about to be struck by a brilliant idea!"

name: Elvish Impersonators
text: "Uh-hunh."

name: Growth Spurt
text: MORE TO LOVE: Friendly, nature-loving, Bunyonesque SEM seeks SEF looking for a huge commitment. . . . seeks atog prince

name: Old Fogey
text: "These kids today with their collector numbers and their newfangled tap symbol. Twenty Black Lotuses and twenty Plague Rats. Now that's *real* Magic."

name: Timmy, Power Gamer
text: "Just wait till I get my Gigantosaurus...."

name: Paper Tiger
text: The tiger is always quick to fold.

name: Rock Lobster
text: Many take the lobster for granite.

name: Scissors Lizard
text: Nothing beats the lizard's shear power.

name: Circuits Act
text: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

name: Eelectrocute
text: The midway's games aren't so much rigged as they are insulated and grounded.

name: "Name Sticker" Goblin
text: The Astrotorium has never been a place for self-restraint.

name: Non-Human Cannonball
text: Designed for maximum impact, comedic and otherwise.

name: One-Clown Band
text: Programmed to play more than seventy instruments and only one song.

name: Priority Boarding
text: The Astrotorium's express lane is practically its own ride.

name: Rad Rascal
text: "Rent a scooter and be just like Devil K. Nevil! Just don't go faster than the speed limit. Or jump over anything. Or catch on fire. Or break every bone in your body multiple times. Other than that, just like him!"

name: Slight Malfunction
text:
"Attention, valued patrons. The Tilt-o-Squirrel is now closed."
—Astrotorium public address system

name: Atomwheel Acrobats
text:
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves."
—Myra the Magnificent

name: Blorbian Buddy
text: When Captain Nebula tragically destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident, Myra compensated the survivors with lifetime passes.

name: Coming Attraction
text: The Astrotorium adds new attractions almost as fast as Captain Nebula can crash them into asteroids.

name: Embiggen
text: "Flea circus? No, flee circus!"

name: Pair o' Dice Lost
text: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

name: Petting Zookeeper
text: Calling it a "petting zoo" really saved on the cages.

name: Resolute Veggiesaur
text: This dinosaur doesn't know what will kill him, but he's determined it won't be heart disease.

name: Squirrel Squatters
text: Such plush accommodations.

name: Vegetation Abomination
text: The animal and vegetable categories kind of merged over time.

name: Monoxa, Midway Manager
text: "Can we get this ghost 11% spookier?"

name: The Space Family Goblinson
text: The goblin word for "vacation" translates roughly to "a battered landscape of noise and violence."

name: Spinnerette, Arachnobat
text: High-wire injuries are down 95%. Spider-related injuries are up 3000%.

name: Clown Car
text: It runs on laughing gas.

name: Draconian Gate-Bot
text: "YOU MUST BE THIS TALL TO RIDE. YOU HAVE TEN SECONDS TO COMPLY."

name: Strength-Testing Hammer
text: "I don't know you, but that hammer rings a bell."

name: Ticket Turbotubes
text: "WE ARE FILLED WITH TICKETS. WE ARE FILLED WITH PURPOSE."

name: Balloon Stand
text: Buy enough balloons and it turns into a ride.

name: Balloon Stand
text: "INPUT ACCEPTED: SHIVAN DRAGON. INITIATING . . . ERROR! GIRAFFE. GIRAFFE. GIRAFFE."

name: Balloon Stand
text: There is a very real danger that the squeaking will rally nearby squirrels to battle.

name: Balloon Stand
text: "MY PRIMARY FUNCTION IS TO FOLD INFLATABLE TUBES INTO JOY."

name: Bounce Chamber
text: The Astrotorium bouncing record is three days, though setting it wasn't strictly intentional.

name: Bounce Chamber
text: It recreates the peaceful feeling of floating freely in space, just without all that boring peacefulness.

name: Bounce Chamber
text: Anti-gravity. Pro-fun.

name: Bounce Chamber
text: It's a raucous, ricochet-ridden romp, loosely based on the molecular movement inside exploding stars.

name: Bumper Cars
text:
"These bumping cars remind me of the time your amusement park smashed into my planet."
—Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop

name: Bumper Cars
text: Vehicular mischief's appeal is universal.

name: Bumper Cars
text: The cars are serviced every ten thousand bumps or every four hours, whichever comes first.

name: Bumper Cars
text: For those needing instructions how to drive the bumper cars, there's a crash course.

name: Bumper Cars
text: The engineers figured out a way to make the crashes power the ride itself. The energy surplus alone is enough to run the deep fryer.

name: Bumper Cars
text:
"Pulled a Captain Nebula"
—Crew expression meaning "an out-of-control car has caused great damage to the surrounding area"

name: Clown Extruder
text: The sound it makes is indescribable and unsettling, but it does make a great clown.

name: Clown Extruder
text: One day, it will produce a clown that can itself produce a clown. Until that day, it will not rest.

name: Clown Extruder
text: Pietra's Mirthing Pod boasts an output that's hilarious and impressive—a real laugh a minute.

name: Clown Extruder
text: "CONGRATULATIONS. IT IS A CLOWN."

name: Concession Stand
text: Eating here is always a concession.

name: Concession Stand
text:
"Days since last atomic ketchup explosion: 1."
—Kitchen safety notice

name: Concession Stand
text: Now serving Basri Kettle Corn, Taco Bolas, Karn Dogs, Koth of the Hamburger, Dovin Baan Mi, Oko Cola, Frozen Tamiyogurt, and more!

name: Concession Stand
text: The Astrotorium offers fine dining at establishments such as Time Wok and Grilliana's.

name: Drop Tower
text: "I can see the next star system from here!"

name: Drop Tower
text: In space, no one can hear you repeatedly beg to get off the ride.

name: Drop Tower
text: Sixty stories above the Astrotorium, attendees often wonder if they've made a mistake. They have another two hundred stories to decide.

name: Drop Tower
text: What goes up might come down.

name: Drop Tower
text: The hardest working seat belts in the park.

name: Drop Tower
text: "Um, technically you can't 'drop' in space. What you—AIIIIEEEEEEE!"

name: Ferris Wheel
text: After a certain point, it becomes more of a prison than a ride.

name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
text: Nothing is safe in the hands of an eight-year-old.

name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
text:
"As a safety measure, our foam is made from the softest metals available."
—Randa, day care blacksmith

name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
text:
"I'm sorry, ma'am. Sometimes a real sword just sneaks its way in there."
—Randa, day care blacksmith

name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
text: Not suitable for children . . . who aren't ready to have a lot of fun!

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: YOU WILL REGRET SPENDING YOUR MONEY ON THIS FORTUNE.

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: TO AVOID CERTAIN DOOM, MAKE SURE TO . . . INSERT ADDITIONAL TOKENS TO CONTINUE.

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: YOU WILL HAVE A CHANCE ENCOUNTER WITH A HANDSOME ROBOT.

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: THE REST OF YOUR LIFE WILL BE FULL OF FUN AND HAPPINESS—ALL SIX HOURS OF IT.

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: AVOID CHANDRA'S INCENDIARY EXPERIENCE AROUND 11:37.

name: Fortune Teller
text: TODAY'S FORTUNE: ON YOUR DEATHBED, YOU WILL REGRET NOT EATING MORE PIZZA. (This fortune brought to you by our sponsor Saheeli Pie Pizzeria, located on the boardwalk next to Teferi's Time Twister. Bring this fortune to get 15% off any purchase.)

name: Hall of Mirrors
text: For a smaller fee, you can pop in quickly to try on a pair of jeans.

name: Hall of Mirrors
text:
"Finally! Something that can capture all my good angles."
—Captain Rex Nebula

name: Haunted House
text: To build Sorin's Haunted Mansion, every detail of Markov Manor was painstakingly recreated, from the floating laser ghosts to the robot space gargoyles.

name: Haunted House
text: Putting the "oo" in "spooky" and the "fun" in "no refunds!"

name: Information Booth
text: "Sir, this may be the information booth, but I cannot answer ontological questions. It would be arrogant to assume I could describe the true nature of reality. Also there's a line."

name: Information Booth
text: Since the majority of the park's business model is based around aimless wandering, this is not where Myra stations her best people.

name: Information Booth
text:
"When I arrived, I was looking for the costume shop. But when I left, I'd learned what I was really looking for: myself. Five stars."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

name: Information Booth
text: The information booth can answer over thirty-seven billion questions. Half the guests ask where the bathroom is.

name: Kiddie Coaster
text: The only ride that's never failed a safety inspection.

name: Kiddie Coaster
text: The only ride not explicitly mentioned in the Astrotorium waiver.

name: Kiddie Coaster
text: There's something truly thrilling about moving so slowly.

name: Kiddie Coaster
text:
"The calming motion of this grubling's ride reminds me of my world's beauty before this mobile astropark obliterated it."
—Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop

name: Kiddie Coaster
text:
"The coaster was so gentle, I was able to write my review while I was still on it."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

name: Kiddie Coaster
text:
"The ride is clearly inspired by the Kolaghan clan's reign on Tarkir which makes the use of Ojutai's scale pattern on the seats very disappointing."
—Vorthos, Steward of Myth

name: Merry-Go-Round
text: Ensconced in a slow time bubble that makes a five-minute ride take nine hours, the carousel is a very popular childcare option.

name: Merry-Go-Round
text: After the first rotation, the dressage phase begins.

name: Roller Coaster
text: Every rider leaves The Fluctuator happy—most because they're thrilled to still be alive.

name: Roller Coaster
text: They say you leave a piece of yourself behind on Garruk's Wake. The janitorial bots can tell you that's absolutely true.

name: Roller Coaster
text: The Time Spiral goes so fast it causes a paradox. Myra uses this opportunity to sell guests their souvenir photos while they're still waiting to board.

name: Roller Coaster
text: The Howling Mine moves faster than the speed of sound. The screams you hear are the group ahead of you.

name: Spinny Ride
text:
"The ship spinning out of control was spot-on, but no one shouting, 'Nebula! You fell asleep again!' or openly weeping? Too unrealistic."
—Captain Rex Nebula

name: Spinny Ride
text:
"Expect to be out of commission for about a week. It's awesome."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

name: Spinny Ride
text: Located on the opposite side of the park from the food court, for obvious reasons.

name: Spinny Ride
text: There's no such thing as upside down in space. Put another way, there are infinite upside downs in space.

name: Spinny Ride
text:
"If a species will pay to be moved in a circle, I will find a way to let it."
—Myra the Magnificent

name: Spinny Ride
text: The maximum recommended speed warning system snapped off years ago, but they hadn't encountered problems yet.

name: Storybook Ride
text: The ride is whimsical and fun, except when it's broken.

name: Storybook Ride
text: You leave the ride either entertained or an elk. Usually the latter.

name: Swinging Ship
text:
"I feel just like Kari Zev! Ragavan, set a course for Lathnu!"
—Vorthos, Steward of Myth

name: Swinging Ship
text:
"A good ride should always feel like something has gone terribly wrong."
—*Salzon's Ride Review*

name: Trash Bin
text: "I had to wrestle a squirrel for it, but I won!"

name: Trash Bin
text: Yet another trash uncommon.

name: Trash Bin
text: To be honest, it's not much dirtier than the ball pit.

name: Trash Bin
text: Standing knee-deep in unsorted Astrotorium garbage, Gurnt couldn't help but feel his trip was finally starting to turn around.

name: Ride Guide
text: "When riding Erebos's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."

name: Clowning Around
text: The Astrotorium's Clown-Bots are programmed to delight attendees by any means necessary.

name: Complaints Clerk
text: The longest lines in the park.

name: Ride Guide
text: "When riding Erebo's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."

name: Bamboozling Beeble
text: Myra bought beebles because they were cheaper than rubber ducks. Now the infestation is her largest expense.

name: Boing!
text: Sometimes the Astrotorium's stunts look dangerous because they absolutely are.

name: Exchange of Words
text: Before criticizing, walk a mile *(about 1.6 kilometers)* in their head. That way, when you do, you're a mile away and you have their head.

name: Monitor Monitor
text: Nine fires, a hull breach, and a Quafloovian meganibbler escaped from the petting zoo. Things were suspiciously quiet.

name: Seasoned Buttoneer
text: Everyone comments on the buttons, but few appreciate the pedals.

name: Attempted Murder
text: Squawks was quick to establish the social pecking order.

name: Black Hole
text:
"Code Dark Donut! Code Dark Donut! All available fun specialists, please report to the Roil Coaster immediately!"
—Truss, chief engineer

name: Deadbeat Attendant
text: Some people will hire anyone with a pulse. Myra isn't that picky.

name: Discourtesy Clerk
text: Myra doesn't pay the vampires to smile—but only because guests found it off-putting.

name: Dissatisfied Customer
text: The mirrors weren't fun for everyone.

name: Down for Repairs
text: Safety twelfth.

name: Line Cutter
text: Waiting is for chumps with flimsy spacesuits.

name: Night Shift of the Living Dead
text: At the Astrotorium, even the dead make a living wage.

name: Bamboozling Beeble
text: Myra bought beebles because they were cheaper than rubber ducks. Now the infestation is her largest expense.

name: Quick Fixer
text: Myra doesn't believe in stopping rides for minor inconveniences like "they need to be repaired."

name: Saw in Half
text: The audience always loves it, but volunteers are divided.

name: Soul Swindler
text: "Three tries to decide your fate! Fabulous prizes! Probably no untold torment!"

name: Step Right Up
text:
"Ah, the midway, beating heart of the—well, maybe the big top is the heart. If there were two hearts then the midway—or the lungs. Lungs or stomach!"
—Captain Rex Nebula

name: Xenosquirrels
text:
"Hey Glaxxar, did you remember to seal the vents on the seat belt control module?"
—Truss, chief engineer

name: Circuits Act
text: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

name: Eelectrocute
text: The midway's games aren't so much rigged as they are insulated and grounded.

name: Boing!
text: Sometimes the Astrotorium's stunts look dangerous because they absolutely are.

name: Non-Human Cannonball
text: Designed for maximum impact, comedic and otherwise.

name: One-Clown Band
text: Programmed to play more than seventy instruments and only one song.

name: Priority Boarding
text: The Astrotorium's express lane is practically its own ride.

name: Rad Rascal
text: "Rent a scooter and be just like Devil K. Nevil! Just don't go faster than the speed limit. Or jump over anything. Or catch on fire. Or break every bone in your body multiple times. Other than that, just like him!"

name: Slight Malfunction
text:
"Attention, valued patrons. The Tilt-o-Squirrel is now closed."
—Astrotorium public address system

name: Atomwheel Acrobats
text:
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves."
—Myra the Magnificent

name: Blorbian Buddy
text: When Captain Nebula tragically destroyed the planet Blorb-12 in a parking accident, Myra compensated the survivors with lifetime passes.

name: Coming Attraction
text: The Astrotorium adds new attractions almost as fast as Captain Nebula can crash them into asteroids.

name: Embiggen
text: "Flea circus? No, flee circus!"

name: Pair o' Dice Lost
text: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

name: Petting Zookeeper
text: Calling it a "petting zoo" really saved on the cages.

name: Resolute Veggiesaur
text: This dinosaur doesn't know what will kill him, but he's determined it won't be heart disease.

name: Squirrel Squatters
text: Such plush accommodations.

name: Vegetation Abomination
text: The animal and vegetable categories kind of merged over time.

name: Exchange of Words
text: Before criticizing, walk a mile *(about 1.6 kilometers)* in their head. That way, when you do, you're a mile away and you have their head.

name: Monoxa, Midway Manager
text: "Can we get this ghost 11% spookier?"

name: The Space Family Goblinson
text: The goblin word for "vacation" translates roughly to "a battered landscape of noise and violence."

name: Spinnerette, Arachnobat
text: High-wire injuries are down 95%. Spider-related injuries are up 3000%.

name: Clown Car
text: It runs on laughing gas.

name: Draconian Gate-Bot
text: "YOU MUST BE THIS TALL TO RIDE. YOU HAVE TEN SECONDS TO COMPLY."

name: Strength-Testing Hammer
text: "I don't know you, but that hammer rings a bell."

name: Ticket Turbotubes
text: "WE ARE FILLED WITH TICKETS. WE ARE FILLED WITH PURPOSE."

name: Monitor Monitor
text: Nine fires, a hull breach, and a Quafloovian meganibbler escaped from the petting zoo. Things were suspiciously quiet.

name: Seasoned Buttoneer
text: Everyone comments on the buttons, but few appreciate the pedals.

name: Clowning Around
text: The Astrotorium's Clown-Bots are programmed to delight attendees by any means necessary.

name: Attempted Murder
text: Squawks was quick to establish the social pecking order.

name: Black Hole
text:
"Code Dark Donut! Code Dark Donut! All available fun specialists, please report to the Roil Coaster immediately!"
—Truss, chief engineer

name: Deadbeat Attendant
text: Some people will hire anyone with a pulse. Myra isn't that picky.

name: Complaints Clerk
text: The longest lines in the park.

name: Discourtesy Clerk
text: Myra doesn't pay the vampires to smile—but only because guests found it off-putting.

name: Dissatisfied Customer
text: The mirrors weren't fun for everyone.

name: Down for Repairs
text: Safety twelfth.

name: Line Cutter
text: Waiting is for chumps with flimsy spacesuits.

name: Night Shift of the Living Dead
text: At the Astrotorium, even the dead make a living wage.

name: Quick Fixer
text: Myra doesn't believe in stopping rides for minor inconveniences like "they need to be repaired."

name: Saw in Half
text: The audience always loves it, but volunteers are divided.

name: Soul Swindler
text: "Three tries to decide your fate! Fabulous prizes! Probably no untold torment!"

name: Step Right Up
text:
"Ah, the midway, beating heart of the—well, maybe the big top is the heart. If there were two hearts, then the midway—or the lungs. Lungs or stomach!"
—Captain Rex Nebula

name: Xenosquirrels
text:
"Hey Glaxxar, did you remember to seal the vents on the seat belt control module?"
—Truss, chief engineer

name: Old Fogey
text: "These kids today with their collector numbers and their newfangled tap symbol. Twenty Black Lotuses and twenty Plague Rats. Now that's *real* Magic."

name: Shoe Tree
text: It grows several feet a year.

name: Uktabi Kong
text: "I desire the acquisition of a potassium-rich fruit comestible of *substantial* magnitude."

name: Ass Whuppin'
text: Asses to ashes, Donkeys to dust.

name: Mana Screw
text: There was no darker or more evil creation in all the multiverse than that of the mana screw.

name: Johnny, Combo Player
text: "Just wait till I get my Krark-Clan Ironworks, Genesis Chamber, and Grinding Station. Oh yeah, and a second Myr Retriever."

name: Mise
text: mise 'mīz v [alter. of might as well] (1997) 1: to win when you don't deserve to 2: to top-deck the "tings" you need 3: to be rewarded by an opponent's bad luck 4: to coin a phrase that spreads through the tournament scene like wildfire 5: to fling a monkey 6: to split firewood using a sharp instrument 7: To burn

name: Topsy Turvy
text: "Here on going is heck the what?"

name: Booster Tutor
text: Real men use *Arabian Nights* boosters.

name: Face to Face
text: Befuddled by this new game, Argg longed for the days of Rock, Rock, Rock.

name: Goblin Secret Agent
text:
SECRET AGENT
PD042198
LICENSE TO BE KILLED

name: Phyrexian Ornithopter
text: Regardless of the century, plane, species, interplanar threat, or if it's just a special card for MagicCon Philadelphia, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

name: The Rebellious Intelligence
text: FEWER

name: The Keeper of Dark Pacts
text: WITH

name: The Disciple of Vess
text: PERSON

name: The Spike Cactus
text: TARGET

name: The Bear Force Pilot
text: WHO

name: The Roaring Toeclaws
text: SIGNED

name: The Crimson Avenger
text: HAS

name: The Crafter
text: THE

name: The Value Knight
text: NAME

name: The Crab Queen
text: DIFFERENCE

name: Colossal Dreadmaw and Storm Crow
text:
CM 3/24 Why is it legendary if neither of the creatures were legendary?
GV 3/29 This is the most legendary team-up of them all! I'll fix it in the flavor text

name: The Scholar of Seas
text: A

name: The Duke of Midrange
text: LETTER

name: Absolute Grace
text: In pursuit of Urza, the Phyrexians sent countless foul legions into Serra's realm. Though beaten back, they left it tainted with uncleansable evil.

name: Disciple of Grace
text: Beauty is beyond law.

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Sunder
text: The flow of time was disrupted; like a flooding river it rose from its banks. Tolaria was drowned in an instant that stretched toward infinity.

name: Telepathy
text:
"The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are."
—Teferi, fourth-level student

name: Tolarian Winds
text: Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.

name: Turnabout
text: The best cure for a big ego is a little failure.

name: Veil of Birds
text: When wind marries sky, even the bride's veil sings her praises.

name: Veiled Crocodile
text: Some roads are paved with bad intentions.

name: Disciple of Law
text: A religious order for religious order.

name: Windfall
text:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Wizard Mentor
text: Although some of the students quickly grasped the concept, the others could summon only blackboards.

name: Zephid
text: Once you've seen one, you'll understand why spells won't go near them.

name: Zephid's Embrace
text: Spells will shun you, as will everyone else.

name: Abyssal Horror
text: It has no face of its own—it wears that of its latest victim.

name: Befoul
text:
"The land putrefied at its touch, turned into an oily bile in seconds."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Bereavement
text:
"Grief is as useless as love."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Blood Vassal
text:
"They are bred to suffer and born to die. Much like humans."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Bog Raiders
text:
"Let weak feed on weak, that we may divine the nature of strength."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Disenchant
text:
"Let Phyrexia breed evil in the darkness; my holy light will reveal its taint."
—Serra

name: Cackling Fiend
text: Its windpipe is only the first to amplify its maddening laughter.

name: Carrion Beetles
text: It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye.

name: Corrupt
text: Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed.

name: Crazed Skirge
text: They are Phyrexia's couriers; the messages they carry are inscribed on their slick hides.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Darkest Hour
text:
"Yawgmoth spent eons wrapping Phyrexians in human skin. They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere."
—Xantcha, to Urza

name: Elite Archers
text: Arrows fletched with the feathers of angels seldom miss their mark.

name: Duress
text:
"We decide who is worthy of our works."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Eastern Paladin
text:
"Their fragile world. Their futile lives. They obstruct the Grand Evolution. In Yawgmoth's name, we shall excise them."
—Oath of the East

name: Exhume
text:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Flesh Reaver
text: Though the reaver is horrifyingly effective, its dorsal vents spit a highly corrosive cloud of filth.

name: Hollow Dogs
text: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

name: Ill-Gotten Gains
text: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

name: Looming Shade
text: The shade tracks victims by reverberations of the pipes, as a spider senses prey tangled in its trembling web.

name: Faith Healer
text: The power of faith is quiet. It is the leaf unmoved by the hurricane.

name: Lurking Evil
text:
"Ash is our air, darkness our flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: No Rest for the Wicked
text:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

name: Oppression
text:
"Do not presume to speak for yourself."
—Gix, to Xantcha

name: Parasitic Bond
text:
"All bonds are parasitic. Only rulership is pure."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Persecute
text:
"My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians. I pray that Lady Selenia died honorably."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Phyrexian Ghoul
text: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

name: Planar Void
text:
"Planeswalking isn't about walking. It's about falling and screaming."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

name: Glorious Anthem
text: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

name: Priest of Gix
text:
"Gix doesn't want a people to rule but puppets to entertain his madness."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

name: Rain of Filth
text:
"When I say it rained, it was not small drops, but a thick, greasy drool pouring from the heavens."
—Urza, journal

name: Ravenous Skirge
text: Hunger is a kind of madness—and here, all madness flourishes.

name: Reclusive Wight
text: There are places so horrible that even the dead hide their faces.

name: Reprocess
text: Everything will find its use in Phyrexia. Eventually.

name: Sanguine Guard
text:
"Father of Machines! Your filigree gaze carves us, and the scars dance upon our grateful flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Sicken
text: Urza dared to attack Phyrexia. Slowly, it retaliated.

name: Skirge Familiar
text: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

name: Skittering Skirge
text: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

name: Healing Salve
text:
"Xantcha is recovering. The medicine is slow, but my magic would have killed her."
—Serra, to Urza

name: Spined Fluke
text: Its spines are prized as writing quills by the priests of Gix.

name: Tainted Aether
text: Gix despised the sylvan morass. The gouge that the portal had torn in the forest was the only pleasing sight.

name: Unnerve
text:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

name: Unworthy Dead
text:
"Great Yawgmoth moves across the seas of shard and bone and rust. We exalt him in life, in death, and in between."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

name: Victimize
text: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground. "It is defective. We must scrap it."

name: Western Paladin
text:
"Their weak laws. Their flawed systems. They inhibit the Grand Evolution. In Yawgmoth's name, we shall erase them."
—Oath of the West

name: Yawgmoth's Edict
text:
"Phyrexia's purity permits no other."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

name: Acidic Soil
text: Phyrexia had tried to take Urza's soul. He was relieved that Shiv tried to claim only his soles.

name: Arc Lightning
text: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

name: Bedlam
text: Sometimes quantity, in the absence of quality, is good enough.

name: Brand
text:
"By this glyph I affirm your role."
—Urza, to Karn

name: Bravado
text:
"We drive the dragons from our home. Why should we fear you?"
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

name: Bulwark
text:
"It will be the goblin's first bath, and its last."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

name: Humble
text:
"It is not your place to rule, Radiant. It may not even be mine."
—Serra

name: Destructive Urge
text: Red sky at night, dragon's delight.

name: Disorder
text:
"Then, just when the other guys were winnin', the sky threw up."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Dromosaur
text: They say dromosaurs are frightened of dogs, even little ones. There are no dogs in Shiv. Not even little ones.

name: Electryte
text: Shivan inhabitants are hardened to fire, so their predators have developed alternative weaponry.

name: Falter
text: Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.

name: Fault Line
text:
We live on the serpent's back.
—Viashino saying

name: Fire Ants
text: Visitors to Shiv fear the dragons, the goblins, or the viashino. Natives fear the ants.

name: Gamble
text: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

name: Goblin Cadets
text: "If you kids don't stop that racket, I'm turning this expedition around *right now!*"

name: Intrepid Hero
text: "We each have our own strengths, Radiant," Serra said with a sly smile. "If all of my people were like this one, who would carry your scrolls?"

name: Goblin Lackey
text: All bark, someone else's bite.

name: Goblin Matron
text: There's always room for one more.

name: Goblin Offensive
text: They certainly are.

name: Goblin Patrol
text:
"Take the sharp metal stick and make a lotta holes."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Goblin Raider
text: He was proud to wear the lizard skin around his waist, just for the fun of annoying the enemy.

name: Goblin Spelunkers
text:
"It only short jump. You go first."
"AIIIEEEE!"
"Hmm . . . we go different way now."

name: Guma
text: When the giant returned for the night, he found a dead merfolk on his pillow. Although he praised the little guma, he inwardly wondered where she had hid the head.

name: Headlong Rush
text: A landslide of goblins poured toward the defenders—tumbling, rolling, and bouncing their way down the steep hillside.

name: Heat Ray
text: It's not known whether the Thran built the device to forge their wonders or to defend them.

name: Absolute Law
text: The strength of law is unwavering. It is an iron bar in a world of water.

name: Monk Idealist
text: "Belief is the strongest mortar."

name: Jagged Lightning
text: The pungent smell of roasting flesh made both mages realize they'd rather break for dinner than fight.

name: Meltdown
text: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

name: Outmaneuver
text:
"Push one goblin into sight, an' run a lot. That's tactics."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Rain of Salt
text: Here, rain does not wash the land; it desiccates it.

name: Raze
text: The viashino believe that the oldest mountains hate everyone equally.

name: Reflexes
text:
"Here's how ya win. Don't let the other guy hit back first."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Retromancer
text: "If one harm us, strike them in return. So sayeth the bey."

name: Monk Realist
text: "We plant the seeds of doubt to harvest the crop of wisdom."

name: Scald
text:
"Shiv may be surrounded by water, but the mountains go far deeper."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

name: Scoria Wurm
text: Late at night, ululations echo from deep under Shiv, as the wurms sing of times older than humanity.

name: Shivan Hellkite
text: A dragon's scale can be carved into a mighty shield, provided you can procure a dragontooth to cut it.

name: Shiv's Embrace
text: "Wear the foe's form to best it in battle. So sayeth the bey."

name: Shower of Sparks
text: The viashino had learned how to operate the rig through trial and error—mostly error.

name: Sneak Attack
text: "Nothin' beat surprise—'cept rock."

name: Steam Blast
text: The viashino knew of the cracked pipes but deliberately left them unmended to bolster the rig's defenses.

name: Sulfuric Vapors
text: It was the dragons who first learned to chase their prey into the vapors before igniting them.

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Viashino Outrider
text: "Give thy ration to thy mount, if the road be long. So sayeth the bey."

name: Viashino Runner
text:
"It moved this way, an' that way, an' then before I could stick it, it jumped over my head an' was gone."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Viashino Sandswimmer
text: Few swim in a place of such thirst.

name: Viashino Weaponsmith
text: Within the rig settlement, those who have mastered the making of weapons earn highest honor.

name: Wildfire
text:
"Shiv hatched from a shell of stone around a yolk of flame."
—Viashino myth

name: Acridian
text: The elves of Argoth were trained to ride these creatures, even when their mounts traveled upside-down.

name: Anaconda
text: If you're smaller than the anaconda, it considers you food. If you're larger than the anaconda, it considers you a lot of food.

name: Argothian Elder
text:
Sharpen your ears
—Elvish expression meaning "grow wiser"

name: Argothian Swine
text: In Argoth, the shortest path between two points is the one the swine make.

name: Blanchwood Armor
text:
"Braid her branches, life fulfilling Goddess loving, Goddess killing."
—Citanul chant

name: Blanchwood Treefolk
text: The massive Argivian attack on their rooted kindred was a declaration of war to the treefolk.

name: Bull Hippo
text:
"How could you not hear it approach? It's a hippo!"
—Argivian commander

name: Cave Tiger
text: The druids found a haven in the cool limestone tunnels beneath Argoth. The invaders found only tigers.

name: Citanul Hierophants
text: From deep in the caves beneath the forest, the hierophants planned the druids' raids against the enemy.

name: Cradle Guard
text:
Mother, sleep / Dream our lives
Our roots your soul / Our leaves your bed.

name: Crosswinds
text: Harbin's ornithopter had been trapped for two days within the currents of the storm. When the skies cleared, all he could see was a horizon of trees.

name: Elvish Herder
text: Before Urza and Mishra came to Argoth, the herders prevented their creatures from stampeding. During the war, they encouraged it.

name: Elvish Lyrist
Endless Wurm
text: Ages ago, a party of elves took cover to let one pass. They're still waiting.

name: Exploration
text: The first explorers found Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth—towering forests grown over rich veins of ore.

name: Fecundity
text: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

name: Fertile Ground
text: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

name: Gaea's Bounty
text: The forest grew back so quickly that lumbering machines were suspended in the treetops.

name: Gaea's Embrace
text: The forest rose to the battle, not to save the people but to save itself.

name: Gorilla Warrior
text: The gorilla beat its chest and threw great handfuls of leaves into the air. It howled challenge and showed its teeth. The mechanical soldier, not understanding, simply killed it.

name: Greater Good
text:
"We have more sprouts than they have hands."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Hawkeater Moth
text: Each day at dusk the birds above the canopy grow silent.

name: Hidden Ancients
text: The only alert the invaders had was the rustling of leaves on a day without wind.

name: Hidden Spider
text: It wants only to dress you in silk.

name: Pouncing Jaguar
text: One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.

name: Pacifism
text:
"Fight? I cannot. I do not care if I live or die, so long as I can rest."
—Urza, to Serra

name: Priest of Titania
text: Titania rewards all those who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

name: Retaliation
text: A foul, metallic stench clogged Urza's senses. It was then he knew his brother was no more.

name: Symbiosis
text: Although the elves of Argoth always considered them a nuisance, the pixies made fine allies during the war against the machines.

name: Titania's Boon
text: When the winds rock the trees, listen for voices in the creaking of the trunks. If you hear your name, you are one of the Goddess's chosen.

name: Titania's Chosen
text:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

name: Treefolk Seedlings
text: The year that the brothers landed on Argoth, the trees produced five times as many seeds as normal.

name: Treetop Rangers
text:
"If you can't catch them, cut the trees down from beneath them. Force them to fight on our terms."
—Mishra

name: Pariah
text: "It is *not* sad," Radiant chided the lesser angel. "It is right. Every society must have its outcasts."

name: Venomous Fangs
text: All the pain of the shattered forest contained in a single drop.

name: Vernal Bloom
text: Many cultures have legends of a lush, hidden paradise. The elves of Argoth had no need of such stories.

name: Whirlwind
text: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

name: Winding Wurm
text: Entire trees were stripped of their bark and branches by the wurm's writhing path.

name: Cathodion
text: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

name: Chimeric Staff
text: A snake in the grasp.

name: Path of Peace
text:
"When the sword becomes a burden, let the warrior lay it aside that another with a truer heart might take it up."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Claws of Gix
text: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand. They enshrined it, hoping that one day it would point the way to Phyrexia.

name: Copper Gnomes
text: Start with eleven gnomes and a room of parts, and come morning you'll have ten and a monster the likes of which you've never seen.

name: Crystal Chimes
text: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

name: Dragon Blood
text: Fire in the blood, fire in the belly.

name: Fluctuator
text: Fiko summoned only atogs for three straight sessions. The tutor couldn't decide whether to punish his failure or praise his consistency.

name: Grafted Skullcap
text:
"Let go your mind. Mine is fitter."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

name: Hopping Automaton
text: Designed to carry equipment across rivers, the hopping automaton was soon pressed into service in the infantry.

name: Angelic Chorus
text: The very young and the very old know best the song the angels sing.

name: Pegasus Charger
text:
"The clouds came alive and dove to the earth! Hooves flashed among the dark army, who fled before the spectacle of fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 211

name: Mishra's Helix
text: The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

name: Pit Trap
text: Yotian soldiers were designed to fight, not watch their feet.

name: Planar Birth
text:
"From womb of nothingness sprang this place of beauty, purity, and hope realized."
—*Song of All*, canto 3

name: Thran Turbine
text: When Urza asked the viashino what it did, they answered: "It hums."

name: Umbilicus
text: It was the explorers' only tether to reality.

name: Urza's Armor
text:
"Tawnos's blueprints were critical to the creation of my armor. As he once sealed himself in steel, I sealed myself in a walking crypt."
—Urza

name: Voltaic Key
text: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

name: Wall of Junk
text: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

name: Whetstone
text:
To hone swords and dull minds.
—Whetstone inscription

name: Wirecat
text: Its purr is the sound of iron filings sliding down satin.

name: Presence of the Master
text:
Peace to all. Peace be all.
—Great Hall floor inscription

name: Gaea's Cradle
text:
"Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

name: Phyrexian Tower
text: Living metal encasing dying flesh.

name: Serra's Sanctum
text: A fragile cocoon of dreaming will.

name: Shivan Gorge
text: Both forge and pyre.

name: Redeem
text:
"That they are saved from death is immaterial. What is important is that they know the source of their benefaction."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Tolarian Academy
text: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.

name: Angelic Page
text: If only every message were as perfect as its bearers.

name: Sanctum Custodian
text: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

name: Sanctum Guardian
text: "Protect our mother in her womb."

name: Seasoned Marshal
text: There are only two rules of tactics: never be without a plan, and never rely on it.

name: Serra Zealot
text:
"The humans are useful in their way, but they must be commanded as the builder commands the stone. Be soft with them, and they will become soft."
—Radiant, archangel

name: Serra's Embrace
text:
"Lifted beyond herself, for that battle Brindri was an angel of light and fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 524

name: Silent Attendant
text: "The answer to life should never be death; it should always be more life, wrapped tight around us like precious silks."

name: Songstitcher
text: The true names of birds are songs woven into their souls.

name: Soul Sculptor
text: Does the stone mimic life, or did it once live?

name: Voice of Grace
text:
"Opposite Law is Grace, and Grace must be preserved. If the strands of Grace are unraveled, its design will be lost, and the people with it."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

name: Voice of Law
text:
"Life's balance is as a star: on one point is Law, and Law must be upheld. If the knots of order are loosened, chaos will spill through."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

name: Waylay
text: "You reek of corruption," spat the knight. "Why are you even here?"

name: Worship
text:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

name: Annul
text: The most effective way to destroy a spell is to ensure it was never cast in the first place.

name: Catastrophe
text: Radiant's eyes flashed. "Go, then," the angel spat at Serra, "and leave this world to those who truly care."

name: Arcane Laboratory
text: It soon became obvious that some experiments were best overseen by fireproof teachers.

name: Attunement
text:
"The solution can hide for only so long."
—Urza

name: Back to Basics
text:
"A ruler wears a crown while the rest of us wear hats, but which would you rather have when it's raining?"
—Barrin, *Principia*

name: Barrin, Master Wizard
text:
"Knowledge is no more expensive than ignorance, and at least as satisfying."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Catalog
text:
"Without order comes errors, and errors kill on Tolaria."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Cloak of Mists
text:
"All we could lose, we did. All we could keep, we do. And both are shrouded by mists."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Confiscate
text:
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit."
—Barrin, progress report

name: Coral Merfolk
text: It is not unusual for a single family of coral merfolk to spend centuries carefully guiding the growth of the reefs where they make their home.

name: Curfew
text: ". . . But I'm not tired!"

name: Disruptive Student
text:
"Teferi is a problem student. Always late for class. No appreciation for constructive use of time."
—Barrin, progress report

name: Douse
text: The academy's libraries were protected by fire-prevention spells. Even after the disaster, the books were intact—though forever sealed in time.

name: Exhaustion
text: The mage felt as though he'd been in the stasis suit for days. Upon his return, he found it was months.

name: Gilded Drake
text: Buyer beware.

name: Great Whale
text:
"As a great whale dies, it flips onto its back. And so an island is born."
—Mariners' legend

name: Hermetic Study
text:
"Books can be replaced; a prize student cannot. Be patient."
—Urza, to Barrin

name: Hibernation
text: On its way to the cave, the armadillo brushed by a sapling. It awoke to find a full-grown tree blocking its path.

name: Congregate
text:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

name: Horseshoe Crab
text: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

name: Imaginary Pet
text: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

name: Lingering Mirage
text: Birds frozen in flight. Sea turned to glass. Tolaria hidden in a mirror.

name: Pendrell Drake
text: The mages of Tolaria found strange ways to spend their free time. Occasionally they had contests to see whose kite was eaten last.

name: Pendrell Flux
text: Devoured by the mists, Tolaria was stuck in time, trapped between two eternal heartbeats.

name: Peregrine Drake
text: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

name: Defensive Formation
text:
"Your enemies will pound upon the door of your defenses, but only you shall have the key, and it is the key of life."
—*Song of All*, canto 873

name: Rewind
text:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

name: Sandbar Merfolk
text: You are not prey until a predator knows of your existence.

name: Sandbar Serpent
text: Treacherous and unpredictable currents around Tolaria earned the nickname "serpent wakes."

name: Show and Tell
text: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

name: Stern Proctor
text:
"I preferred the harsh tutors—they made mischief all the more fun."
—Teferi, third-level student

name: Work a Double
text: Ig and Burf discovered the technique by accident when Burf reached for his hammer and missed.

name: Wrench-Rigger
text: Goblin innovator, goblin corpse. Tomayto, tomahto.

name: Beast in Show
text: "A stunning example of the breed! Flawless plating, ruthlessly efficient death stroke, and an excellent drool shimmer."

name: Beast in Show
text: "We've not seen one of these on the podium for many seasons. Such magnificent posture and the perfect amount of telltale odor."

name: Beast in Show
text: "Something really special in the baloth category this season, in terms of spike density and quality. We'd like to get a word with the handler, but are unable to locate her at this time."

name: Beast in Show
text: "Not a surprise to see her on the podium. This paragon of tusk curvature is just the latest addition to the long championship lineage of Wildspeaker Ranch."

name: Chittering Doom
text: One fateful night, bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, they rose.

name: First Pick
text: Picking hammers is dangerous, but it's still safer than harvesting saw bushes.

name: Jackknight
text: "My sword is at your service, as are my scissors, corkscrew, and bottle opener."

name: Ground Pounder
text: People came from miles away just to see the head of the hammer.

name: Hydradoodle
text: Less housebroken than housebreaking.

name: Joyride Rigger
text: chitty-chitty-BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG!

name: Steamflogger Service Rep
text: It's more like a hard day of lunch with a work break between shifts.

name: Clock of DOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
text:
"Perhaps you believe, even in these final moments, that you will be saved. But doom has no snooze button, you fools!"
—Baron Von Count

name: Cogmentor
text:
"Cogs on cats / Cogs on dogs / Cogs on hats / And cogs on cogs."
—*Song of the Cogmentor*

name: Contraption Cannon
text: Common side effects include headaches, ringing in ears, and excessive smithereens. In some cases, a small hole in space-time may develop.

name: Curious Killbot
text: "whirrrr . . . beep . . . click . . . click?"

name: Delighted Killbot
text: "click . . . click . . . whirrrr . . . beep."

name: Despondent Killbot
text: "click . . . click . . . beep . . . whirrrr . . ."

name: Enraged Killbot
text: "click . . . whirrrr . . . beep . . . click!"

name: Lobe Lobber
text:
"Time for you to meet the brains of this operation!"
—The Big Idea

name: Mad Science Fair Project
text: "When it comes down to it, science is more art than science."

name: Steel Squirrel
text:
Q: Where does a mechanical squirrel hide its nuts?
A: In a bolt hole.

name: Riveting Rigger
text: "Turn a blender into an arc welder with a portable fusion reactor and a frozen yogurt dispenser? We can do it!"

name: Crow Storm
text:
Storm crow lonely, boon for a birder.
Storm crows together, likely a murder.

name: Incite Insight
text: After a hundred failed patent applications, Cornelian was stunned to find that no one had ever created a steam-powered autonomous ice cream delivery system. He immediately designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

name: Amateur Auteur
text:
And thus at Maze's End
the runners end their strife.
Our saving grace, that hooded kid,
is now Guildpact for life.
—*RAVNICA! The Musical*

name: Amateur Auteur
text:
So Griselbrand was bound,
his rage brought to a halt.
'Til Lili Vess came 'round
asking, "Hey, what's in the vault?"
—*INNISTRAD! The Musical*

name: Amateur Auteur
text:
Elspeth, blessed by Heliod,
stepped up where the hydra trod.
Soon afterward, a lesson learned:
attack the Champion, get burned!
—*THEROS! The Musical*

name: Amateur Auteur
text:
The two Eldrazi titans fell
and set the ground a-rumbling!
"How come no one ever listens?"
old Ugin flew off grumbling.
—*ZENDIKAR! The Musical*

name: Novellamental
text: "My grandmother had sold the rest of her jewelry long ago, but she left a particular necklace in my care: a golden chain, bearing a raven-shaped charm."

name: Novellamental
text: "This pendant was my grandmother's legacy. I sought solitude among the trees as moonlight danced on their branches, her gift safe in my hand."

name: Novellamental
text: "The chain fit my neck perfectly, but my heart fluttered with chills as the cool metal came to rest against my chest. I closed the clasp and waited, silent."

name: Novellamental
text: "My heart filled with warmth, and I felt my feet lift from the ground. Suddenly, I was free—free to soar, the homes beneath me shrinking to specks on a map."

name: Spell Suck
text: S-U-C-K

name: Suspicious Nanny
text: "Afternoon, folks. Lovely day for a stroll with my authentic human baby."

name: Time Out
text: Anyone other than a goblin would've gotten only a hand caught in the cookie jar.

name: Finders, Keepers
text: The S.N.E.A.K. Code clearly permits looting corpses for parts. That just meant Agent 47.3 had to make sure her target was dead first.

name: Inhumaniac
text: For the mind-minded mastermind.

name: Overt Operative
text: Saw her coming. Didn't matter.

name: Sly Spy
text: The Agents of S.N.E.A.K.—Subpar, Notoriously Evil Agent Killers.

name: Steady-Handed Mook
text: A mook's life span is just long enough to get just good enough to get careless.

name: Box of Free-Range Goblins
text: Skrab tried to warn his fellow goblins that the hammer was bait for a trap, but they stopped listening at "hammer."

name: Hammer Helper
text: "Need a hammer? Gotta get your fix? I know a guy."

name: Painiac
text: "You're about to be struck by a brilliant idea!"

name: Steamflogger Boss
text:
"Don't quit now, we're almost done.
Then we'll build another one!"

name: Steamflogger of the Month
text: The perks aren't great.

name: Steamflogger Temp
text: When you're dumber than a hammer, every problem looks like one of those things you hit with a hammer.

name: Steamfloggery
text: Goblins only have two speeds: hard loaf and full-on hammer freak-out.

name: Target Minotaur
text: "Not again!"

name: Target Minotaur
text: "Not again!"

name: Target Minotaur
text: "Not again!"

name: Target Minotaur
text: "Not again!"

name: Serendib Efreet
text: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

name: Skullclamp
text: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

name: Strip Mine
text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war.

name: Tinker
text: "What separates us from mere beasts is the capacity for self-improvement."

name: Trinisphere
text: Designed to restrain petty thoughts, but used to repress entire empires.

name: Channel
text: To some mages, the meaning of life is less important than how much is left.

name: Goblin Lackey
text: At the first sign of enemy scouts, Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.

name: Kird Ape
text: Apes can be gentle, contemplative beasts—but context is everything.

name: Lotus Petal
text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

name: Mystical Tutor
text: The student searches the world for meaning. The master finds worlds of meaning in the search.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Zuran Orb
text:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Jester's Cap
text:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

name: Mirari
text:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Rafiq of the Many
text: Many sigils, one purpose.

name: Sharuum the Hegemon
text: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
text: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

name: Visara the Dreadful
text: "My eyes are my strongest feature."

name: Captain Sisay
text: Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.

name: Doran, the Siege Tower
text: "Each year that passes rings you inwardly with memory and might. Wield your heart, and the world will tremble."

name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
text: Each of his twenty-two braids is bound with bone and leather from a foe.

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
text: It gathers against the coming storm.

name: Progenitus
text: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Ancient Tomb
text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

name: Shivan Gorge
text: Both forge and pyre.

name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
text:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

name: Vesuva
text: It is everywhere you've ever been.

name: Grove of the Burnwillows
text: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

name: High Market
text: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Akroma's Vengeance
text: "Many must die for the one who should not have perished."

name: Gilded Lotus
text: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

name: Char
text: Izzet mages often acquire their magic reagents from dubious sources, so the potency of their spells is never predictable.

name: Venser, Shaper Savant
text: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

name: Cruel Ultimatum
text: There is always a greater power.

name: Green Sun's Zenith
text: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Kessig Wolf Run
text: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

name: Impulse
text: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

name: Wall of Blossoms
text: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

name: Thran Dynamo
text: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

name: Armageddon
text: A bloody dawn broke over a scabbed and tortured world.

name: Upheaval
text: The calm comes after the storm.

name: Virtue's Ruin
text: All must fall, and those who stand highest fall hardest.

name: Wrath of God
text: Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.

name: Cataclysm
text:
"Keep with you only this much: your mount, your blade, and your wits. The rest you can find, build, or take."
—Horse clans' wisdom

name: Child of Alara
text: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.

name: Fracturing Gust
text: Elvish dawnhands test a relic's worthiness before collecting it for the safehold. If it can't stand up to a stiff breeze, it's left behind.

name: Martial Coup
text: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

name: Iridescent Angel
text: She enraptures all, encompasses all, endures all.

name: Jenara, Asura of War
text: Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.

name: Lightning Angel
text: Sudden vengeance, echoing fury.

name: Platinum Angel
text: She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.

name: Serra Angel
text: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
text:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching

name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."

name: Aurelia, the Warleader
text: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
text: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

name: Baneslayer Angel
text: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.

name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
text: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

name: Beseech the Queen
text: Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.

name: Near-Death Experience
text: Lands ravaged, cities in ruins, so many lives sacrificed, and yet there was no other word for it but victory.

name: Obliterate
text: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

name: Cabal Ritual
text: The Patriarch is long dead, but his name still stains the lips of cultists.

name: Conflux
text:
"It's self-indulgent, I admit, but I do like to watch my own symphony play itself out."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Glissa, the Traitor
text: Once Mirrodin's brightest hope. Now Phyrexia's cruel champion.

name: Memnarch
text: "An imperfection in the perfect world? We can't allow that."

name: Gisela, the Broken Blade
text: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy
text: "People's thoughts just come to me. Sometimes I don't know if it's them or me thinking."

name: Arguel's Blood Fast
text: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

name: Bruna, the Fading Light
text: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade
text: Those who grasp its hilt soon hear the demon's call.

name: Archangel
text:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Jamuraan Lion
text:
The lion blinked
—Femeref expression meaning "situation avoided"

name: Viashino Sandstalker
text:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

name: Bull Elephant
text:
Four gray trees and a long, coiling snake. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

name: City of Solitude
text:
"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Creeping Mold
text:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

name: Elephant Grass
text:
"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?"
—Kasib ibn Naji, Letters

name: Elven Cache
text:
"The elves can hide better than most can look."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

name: Feral Instinct
text:
"If a rhino's head is lower than its shoulders, trust me—it is *not* praying."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

name: Giant Caterpillar
text:
"'I've seen hornworms big as a man's fist,' the traveler said, and nodded soberly when our jaws went slack at his ignorance."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Katabatic Winds
text: Wind will win, whatever we wish.

name: King Cheetah
text:
If you find yourself and a friend being chased by a King Cheetah, you have but one chance: Trip your friend.
—Suq'Ata wisdom

name: Mortal Wound
text:
"Their tears spill over Jamuraa. Mixed with blood, they wash everything red."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Natural Order
text: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

name: Panther Warriors
text:
"When you run you're graceful and swift, sleek as a powerful panther."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Quirion Druid
text:
"The land has been gracious enough to let you tread upon her for years. That privilege is about to end."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

name: Quirion Ranger
text:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

name: River Boa
text:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Rowen
text:
"I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Longbow Archer
text:
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Ruya, Zhalfirin archer

name: Stampeding Wildebeests
text: Prayers for rain are answered with the thunder of hooves.

name: Summer Bloom
text:
"Our love is like the river in the summer season of long rains. / For a little while it spilled its banks, flooding the crops in the fields."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Uktabi Orangutan
text:
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Warthog
text:
"Too much work—it takes a long time to break them in, and more than a few recruits."
—Grebog, goblin swine-rider

name: Wind Shear
text:
"As the winds abated, there was a shower of dragonscales, then nothing more."
—Azeworai, "The Unruly Wind"

name: Army Ants
text:
"Do not underestimate the power of many against one."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Breathstealer's Crypt
text:
"Far too many soldiers have died in their beds."
—Telim'Tor

name: Femeref Enchantress
text:
"Then she spread a fine dust over the land, like a butterfly shaking its wing."
—"The Enchantress," Femeref tale

name: Miraculous Recovery
text:
"You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

name: Firestorm Hellkite
text:
"If it can scar the sky with fire, do not share its destination."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

name: Guiding Spirit
text:
"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

name: Mundungu
text:
"Our buried kings silently await the revolt of dead peasants."
—Tuwile, mundungu of Aku

name: Righteous War
text:
"This is a war without neutrality."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Scalebane's Elite
text:
"With Rashida's blades, my guiding vision and the luck of the blessed, today we will free Mangara!"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Simoon
text:
"The black-and-white sacred monkey holds her children to her, and waits."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Squandered Resources
text:
"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Suleiman's Legacy
text: With Suleiman's ascension to power, the djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah learned humility.

name: Tempest Drake
text:
