"Its speed will be equaled only by the swiftness of my enemy's fall."
—Kaervek

name: Parapet
text: There is no wall that can't be improved by making it taller.

name: Viashivan Dragon
text: The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.

name: Diamond Kaleidoscope
text:
"A pretty toy. Now show me its tactical applications."
—Telim'Tor

name: Dragon Mask
text:
"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Helm of Awakening
text:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

name: Juju Bubble
text:
"If my heart had a lid, I would lift it and show you my joy."
—From Suq'Ata wedding ceremony

name: Magma Mine
text: BOOM!

name: Peace Talks
text:
"By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie."
—Ahmahz il Kin, Suq'Ata diplomat

name: Matopi Golem
text: Some potmakers claim to use the mud of such creatures to make their finest bowls—and that the bowls scream when fired.

name: Phyrexian Walker
text:
"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."
—Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters

name: Sands of Time
text:
"But once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Day stood still."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Sisay's Ring
text:
"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Snake Basket
text:
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Triangle of War
text: The Zhalfirin war triangle represents a trinity of might, faith, and guile.

name: Wand of Denial
text: You'll never miss what you never had.

name: Relic Ward
text: Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .

name: Griffin Canyon
text:
"Where are falling feathers deadlier than falling rock?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

name: Undiscovered Paradise
text: Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.

name: Remedy
text:
"These things will protect you while I'm gone, remind you of my love for you."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

name: Resistance Fighter
text:
"My soldiers fought without hesitation, died without doubt."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Retribution of the Meek
text:
"Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Daraja Griffin
text:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

name: Righteous Aura
text:
"Good is not a 'thing.' You can neither touch nor own it. No, Good is a vision we all share and strive to make real."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Sun Clasp
text:
"And darkness shall be cast from me
For my soul resides in the Sun."
—Femeref dirge

name: Teferi's Honor Guard
text:
"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

name: Warrior's Honor
text:
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

name: Zhalfirin Crusader
text:
"War is the crucible of leadership."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Betrayal
text:
"Sometimes a burden can be borne only on the shoulders of a willing enemy."
—Suq'Ata aphorism

name: Breezekeeper
text:
"He blows a gust across the cliff to vanish in a breath of wind."
—"Song of the Wind Being"

name: Chronatog
text: For the chronatog, there is no meal like the present.

name: Cloud Elemental
text:
"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Desertion
text: First the insult, then the injury.

name: Flooded Shoreline
text:
"Some say the sea is jealous of the land and wishes to climb its heights to meet the sky."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Impulse
text:
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."
—Teferi

name: Inspiration
text:
"Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Knight of the Mists
text: Fear the mists, for they are armed.

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Mystic Veil
text:
"Magic is my thread, my will the needle. I weave over you as if you never were."
—Poetics of Hanan

name: Prosperity
text:
"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

name: Rainbow Efreet
text:
"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations."
—Teferi

name: Shimmering Efreet
text:
Life or death: which is the illusion?"
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Shrieking Drake
text:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

name: Teferi's Realm
text:
"Fire is dead. Water has killed him."
—From *The Stories of Nature*

name: Time and Tide
text:
"Time may heal all wounds, but what heals time?"
—Teferi

name: Undo
text:
"Oft have I wished to undo past deeds, but never did I imagine they would be undone for me."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Vanishing
text:
"Careless, like a child with fire, so was I with time."
—Teferi

name: Freewind Falcon
text:
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

name: Waterspout Djinn
text:
"Fly us higher, out of its storm."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Aku Djinn
text:
"Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"
—Mangara

name: Blanket of Night
text:
"Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

name: Brood of Cockroaches
text:
"It's like waking on a bed of a thousand olives during an earthquake of subtle force."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Coercion
text:
A rhino's bargain
—Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"

name: Crypt Rats
text:
"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea."
—Mundungu chant

name: Dark Privilege
text:
"As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."
—Purraj of Urborg

name: Death Watch
text:
"Watch death wait / Wait, death, watch / Steal breath swiftly / but steal life slowly."
—Suq'Ata dirge

name: Desolation
text:
"Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."
—Kaervek

name: Fallen Askari
text: In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

name: Gossamer Chains
text:
"Harah swung his sword mightily, but still the air held him fast."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

name: Infernal Harvest
text:
"I offered you eternal life; I just didn't say *where*."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Kaervek's Spite
text:
"The end justifies the means. What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living? The dead ask fewer questions."
—Kaervek

name: Necrosavant
text:
"Ah, I remember my first death."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

name: Nekrataal
text:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

name: Pillar Tombs of Aku
text:
"Aku, City of Hidden Graves / Aku, City of Lost Kings / Aku, welcome me."
—Pillar tomb inscription

name: Python
text:
"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?"
—Hakim, Loreweaver

name: Tar Pit Warrior
text:
"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep."
—Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"

name: Urborg Mindsucker
text:
"My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine."
—Kaervek

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Wake of Vultures
text:
"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'"
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

name: Wicked Reward
text:
"The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."
—Kaervek

name: Dwarven Vigilantes
text: Some dwarves can only be pushed so far.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Goblin Recruiter
text: "Next!"

name: Goblin Swine-Rider
text:
"May you get the mount you deserve."
—Suq'Ata curse

name: Hulking Cyclops
text:
"Some say a great cyclops turns the world in its hands, looking down upon it with its one bright eye."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Keeper of Kookus
text: Wanted: Thick-skinned goblin for guarding mean ol' Kookus. Must like fires. Must heal quickly.

name: Lightning Cloud
text:
The mightiest clouds sit upon spires of fire.
—Femeref adage

name: Mob Mentality
text:
"Why is loud stupidity so infectious?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

name: Ogre Enforcer
text:
"Ate up all of his siblings in the first week. A good beginning for one destined to command."
—Suka, ogre matron

name: Infantry Veteran
text:
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

name: Raging Gorilla
text:
"Every temper tantrum makes another angry gorilla."
—Femeref children's myth

name: Relentless Assault
text:
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

name: Rock Slide
text:
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

name: Solfatara
text:
"A burst of hot air tossed the moon into the air, and the moon liked it up there so much it never needed the ground again."
—Azeworai, "Glitter Moon"

name: Song of Blood
text: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.

name: Spitting Drake
text: It prefers its meals cooked.

name: Suq'Ata Lancer
text:
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor

name: Talruum Champion
text: In the Talruum language, there is no word for "surprised."

name: Talruum Piper
text: When the Talruum began to play, the dragons fell from the sky to squash the obnoxious noise.

name: Tremor
text:
"Where do you run when the earth becomes your enemy?"
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Upheaval
text: The calm comes after the storm.

name: Waterfront Bouncer
text: Closing time comes earlier to some than to others.

name: Addle
text:
"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge."
—Urborg witch

name: Baleful Force
text:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

name: Cabal Ritual
text:
"Each syllable chills your veins. Each word rattles your mind."
—Cabal Patriarch

name: Carnophage
text: Eating is all it knows.

name: Choking Sands
text:
"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

name: Akroma's Blessing
text: The clerics saw her as a divine gift. She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

name: Dark Ritual
text:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

name: Dauthi Mercenary
text:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Death's-Head Buzzard
text: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

name: Fallen Askari
text: In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

name: Armageddon
text: War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.

name: Famine
text:
"Better to starve to death than be bored to death."
—Liliana Vess

name: Fledgling Djinn
text:
"The young can be quite dangerous. Trust me, I should know."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Hymn to Tourach
text: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

name: Laquatus's Champion
text: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

name: Lurking Evil
text:
"Ash is our air, darkness our flesh."
—Phyrexian Scriptures

name: Nature's Ruin
text: One chill blast—the exhalation of the grave.

name: Astral Slide
text:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

name: Nightscape Familiar
text: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

name: Phyrexian Defiler
text:
"The third stage of the illness: muscle aches and persistent cough."
—Phyrexian progress notes

name: Reanimate
text:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

name: Recurring Nightmare
text:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax

name: Skirge Familiar
text: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

name: Spinal Graft
text:
"This one has not screamed enough to show effective implantation. Kill it."
—Volrath

name: Urborg Uprising
text: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

name: Vampiric Tutor
text:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

name: Visara the Dreadful
text: "My eyes are my strongest feature."

name: Yawgmoth's Bargain
text: He craves only one commodity.

name: Aftershock
text:
"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Beetleback Chief
text: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

name: Burning Wish
text: She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.

name: Clickslither
text: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

name: Falter
text: Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.

name: Fireblast
text: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

name: Benalish Trapper
text: "I'm up here. You're down there. Now who's the lower life form?"

name: Flametongue Kavu
text:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*

name: Flowstone Hellion
text: Volrath leaves no stone untrained.

name: Gamble
text: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

name: Giant Strength
text: "Crovax seems filled only with shadows," thought Orim. "Where does his strength come from?"

name: Goblin Commando
text: With a commando around, somebody's gonna get hurt.

name: Goblin General
text: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

name: Goblin Goon
text: Giant-sized body. Goblin-sized brain.

name: Goblin Lackey
text: At the first sign of enemy scouts, Jula grinned and strapped on his diplomacy helmet.

name: Goblin Matron
text: There's always room for one more.

name: Goblin Patrol
text:
"Take the sharp metal stick and make a lotta holes."
—Jula, goblin raider

name: Benevolent Bodyguard
text: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

name: Goblin Settler
text: Be it ever so crumbled, there's no place like home.

name: Goblin Warchief
text: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

name: Hulking Goblin
text: The bigger they are, the harder they avoid work.

name: Kaervek's Torch
text:
The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown

name: Kindle
text: Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.

name: Lightning Rift
text: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

name: Orcish Lumberjack
text:
"Wood is wasted in the dirt."
—Orcish proverb

name: Breath of Life
text:
"Nothing can stop the power of life—not even death."
—Onean cleric

name: Rorix Bladewing
text: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land. The rest seek any opportunity to restore the broken pride of their race.

name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
text: "I order you to volunteer."

name: Skirk Prospector
text:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

name: Spark Spray
text: It's the only kind of shower goblins will tolerate.

name: Starstorm
text: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

name: Wall of Diffusion
text:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

name: Arrogant Wurm
text: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite-size.

name: Brindle Shoat
text: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

name: Council's Judgment
text: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

name: Claws of Wirewood
text: They say the forest has eyes. They never mention its claws.

name: Desert Twister
text: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

name: Dreampod Druid
text: "Don't mistake my creations for mere vegetation. They are my children, loyal and fierce."

name: Elephant Guide
text: Nature's strength outlives the strong.

name: Erhnam Djinn
text: He provides a safe path to nowhere.

name: Fyndhorn Elves
text: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

name: Gaea's Embrace
text: The forest rose to the battle, not to save the people, but to save itself.

name: Genesis
text:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—Scroll of Beginnings

name: Giant Mantis
text:
"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

name: Hermit Druid
text: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

name: Jungle Wurm
text: Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

name: Nature's Lore
text: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

name: Nostalgic Dreams
text: Seton dreams of life renewed.

name: Provoke
text: Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
text: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

name: Simian Grunts
text: These monkeys mean business.

name: Sudden Strength
text: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

name: Symbiotic Wurm
text: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

name: Tangle
text: Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

name: Tribute to the Wild
text:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

name: Wild Mongrel
text: It teaches *you* to play dead.

name: Devout Witness
text: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

name: Armadillo Cloak
text: "Don't laugh. It works."

name: Baleful Strix
text: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
text: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

name: Brago, King Eternal
text: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Death Grasp
text: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Deathreap Ritual
text:
"All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."
—Marchesa, the Black Rose

name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
text: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

name: Fires of Yavimaya
text: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

name: Goblin Trenches
text: The ground rose and formed into thousands of tiny warriors. This fight was far from over.

name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
text: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

name: Ankh of Mishra
text: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle: the strange structures did not house Mishra's malevolent creations but were themselves among his creations.

name: Chimeric Idol
text: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

name: Flowstone Sculpture
text: The sculptor, weary of his work, created art that would finish itself.

name: Ivory Tower
text: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

name: Lion's Eye Diamond
text:
Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

name: Null Rod
text:
Gerrard: "But it doesn't do anything!"
Hanna: "No—it does nothing."

name: Predator, Flagship
text:
"The scourge of Skyshroud is airborne once more."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Gerrard's Battle Cry
text: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword. "This won't be a fair fight," he called to his crew. "They should have brought a second ship!"

name: Ring of Gix
text: Not every cage is made of bars.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Sphere of Resistance
text: A sphere pushes equally in all directions.

name: Su-Chi
text: Flawed copies of relics from the Thran Empire, the su-chi were inherently unstable but provided useful knowledge for Tocasia's students.

name: Triangle of War
text: The Zhalfirin war triangle represents a trinity of might, faith, and guile.

name: Ancient Tomb
text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

name: Gilded Light
text: Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second.

name: Gustcloak Harrier
text: Banking steeply, the aven streaked toward the ground—and vanished.

name: Mishra's Workshop
text: Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia, Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose. Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.

name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
text: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

name: Strip Mine
text: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominaria itself a casualty of war.

name: Tolarian Academy
text: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.

name: Yavimaya Hollow
text: For all its traps and defenses, Yavimaya has its havens, too.

name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
text: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

name: Mystic Zealot
text: Nomad youths aspire to one of two roles in the tribe: priest or warrior. Their secret dream is to become both.

name: Pianna, Nomad Captain
text: Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

name: Seal of Cleansing
text:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

name: Shelter
text: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

name: Sidar Jabari
text:
"Prophecy is whatever one makes of it, but destiny cannot be changed."
—Sidar Jabari

name: Soltari Emissary
text: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation. He realized immediately that he was not alone.

name: Soltari Trooper
text:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari Tales of Life

name: Spirit Cairn
text: It marks the border between here and hereafter.

name: Stoic Champion
text: His outer calm belies his inner fury.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

name: Teroh's Faithful
text: The light of reason follows them even into battle.

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Zhalfirin Crusader
text:
"War is the crucible of leadership."
—Rashida Scalebane

name: Aquamoeba
text: Some tides need no moon.

name: Cloud Djinn
text:
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

name: Control Magic
text:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

name: Counterspell
text: The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.

name: Deep Analysis
text: "The specimen seems to be broken."

name: Ephemeron
text: From nothing came teeth.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Frantic Search
text: Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.

name: Gush
text: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

name: High Tide
text: "There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."

name: Keeneye Aven
text: "I have no need of a map. The continent itself guides my way."

name: Killer Whale
text: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

name: Krovikan Sorcerer
text:
"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

name: Man-o'-War
text:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

name: Obsessive Search
text: The question strained his sanity. The answer snapped it in half.

name: Repel
text:
"I have a hunch we'll be seeing that one again soon."
—Ambassador Laquatus

name: Scrivener
text: A good memory is no match for a good scribe.

name: Serendib Efreet
text: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

name: Skywing Aven
text: "I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

name: Stroke of Genius
text: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

name: Thalakos Drifters
text: They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.

name: Tradewind Rider
text: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

name: Windborn Muse
text:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Flood of Tears
text:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling

name: Imprisoned in the Moon
text: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

name: Kami of the Crescent Moon
text:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

name: Breath of the Sleepless
text: Worse than the obscuring mists are the ghastly faces that appear in the glow of spectral lanterns.

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Shacklegeist
text: The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

name: Sire of the Storm
text: This storm blows gales through the dreams of mortals.

name: Spectral Sailor
text:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

name: Supreme Phantom
text: A king's knowledge does not vanish when the heart stops beating.

name: Verity Circle
text:
"Here, there is only truth."
—Barvisa, Azorius emissary

name: Ancient Craving
text: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
text: "So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar."

name: Blood Artist
text: "Great art can never be created without great suffering."

name: Bloodline Necromancer
text: "The veil of death hides little from our kind."

name: Bloodtracker
text: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Champion of Dusk
text: "Drench these golden streets in the blood of our enemies."

name: Cordial Vampire
text: "Please, come in! Hors d'oeuvres are on the table."

name: Damnable Pact
text:
"Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps."
—Siara, the Dragon's Mouth

name: Dark Impostor
text: "Ah, this is a nice life. I can see why you were so desperate to keep it."

name: Falkenrath Noble
text: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Indulgent Aristocrat
text: "If you're not surrounded by decadence, my question to you is—why not?"

name: Necropolis Regent
text: "Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot."

name: Night's Whisper
text:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

name: Nirkana Revenant
text: Hate is an everlasting wellspring from which she is eternally sustained.

name: Sanctum Seeker
text: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

name: Stromkirk Condemned
text:
"Blood from the vein is the finest vintage to accompany a feast of the mind."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Underworld Connections
text: If you're looking for it, it's available. The question is how much you're willing to pay.

name: Occult Epiphany
text: In a single unending moment, a hundred lifetimes of knowledge coursed through his unraveling mind.

name: Vampire Nighthawk
text: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

name: Blasphemous Act
text:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

name: Bloodsworn Steward
text: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

name: Crimson Honor Guard
text: The finest soldiers aren't worth a whit without a set of hands to lead them and a set of eyes to guide them.

name: Rakish Heir
text: "If you're not having fun, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Vandalblast
text: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

name: Drogskol Captain
text: Dead or alive, true leaders can inspire an entire army.

name: Stromkirk Captain
text:
"No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Azorius Locket
text:
"Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency."
—Dovin Baan

name: Azorius Signet
text: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

name: Charcoal Diamond
text: The essence of night to harden the soul.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Fire Diamond
text: The essence of flame to stoke the spirit.

name: Marble Diamond
text: The essence of sunlight to brighten the way.

name: Rakdos Signet
text: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

name: Sky Diamond
text: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Swiftfoot Boots
text:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

name: Crossway Troublemakers
text: "Lady Anje said no violence at the wedding. She never said anything about the journey there!"

name: Unstable Obelisk
text: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Port Town
text: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

name: Prairie Stream
text: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: Legend says a mighty angel appears to pilgrims in need who reach this lofty height.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Olivia's Wrath
text:
"These worthless cattle think they can sneak unnoticed into my wedding? Dispose of them."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Imposing Grandeur
text: The wedding's lavish decorations paled in comparison to the opulence of its elite guests.

name: Midnight Arsonist
text: Killing the slayers was self-preservation. The fire was just for fun.

name: Donal, Herald of Wings
text: He sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.

name: Sinister Waltz
text: For one evening, the dueling bloodlines channeled their feuds into elaborate footwork.

name: Hollowhenge Overlord
text: The ruins of the town were a notable upgrade from the wolves' forest den.

name: Haunted Library
text: The library of Moormanor had been open to all before the Travails, and it continues to attract curious visitors.

name: Priest of the Blessed Graf
text: The honored dead who lie in blessed grafs are not easily stirred, but the threat of eternal night called many from their rest.

name: Angel of Flight Alabaster
text: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if they have seen her.

name: Crush Contraband
text: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

name: Darksteel Mutation
text: Infinitely powerless.

name: Fell the Mighty
text:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

name: Ghostly Prison
text: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

name: Storm of Souls
text: Devotion does not end with death.

name: Mentor of the Meek
text: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

name: Mirror Entity
text: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

name: Oyobi, Who Split the Heavens
text: Her angry call split the sky. From that rift descended her champions.

name: Promise of Bunrei
text: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

name: Remorseful Cleric
text: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

name: Spectral Shepherd
text: The restless geists of common folk often continue their lifelong labors.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Adamant Will
text: "I refuse to die before I see the sun rise again."

name: Drogskol Infantry
text: He swore to protect the Moorlands. A little thing like death was no excuse to break his oath.

name: Concealing Curtains
text: Specifics were kept secret, but word quickly spread that the show was a must-see.

name: Courier Bat
text: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

name: Demonic Bargain
text:
"Do not try to negotiate with me, human. You want power? This is the price."
—Ormendahl

name: Desperate Farmer
text: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.

name: Diregraf Scavenger
text: It can barely feel the sword anymore.

name: Doomed Dissenter
text: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

name: Dreadfeast Demon
text: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.

name: Dying to Serve
text:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Estwald Shieldbasher
text: The door to her home survived the fires of the Malignus. Now it's her greatest weapon.

name: Edgar's Awakening
text: "Here you go. Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day."

name: Gift of Fangs
text:
"You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?"
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Grisly Ritual
text:
"You can always tell who's new from the screaming."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist

name: Headless Rider
text: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

name: Hero's Downfall
text: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.

name: Innocent Traveler
text: "Aren't you going to invite me in?"

name: Mindleech Ghoul
text:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

name: Parasitic Grasp
text: Some wicked souls linger only to consume the warmth of life.

name: Path of Peril
text: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

name: Persistent Specimen
text:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, sticher's assistant

name: Pointed Discussion
text: Small talk is a dying art.

name: Ragged Recluse
text: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
text: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

name: Fierce Retribution
text: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."

name: Skulking Killer
text: Olivia set a few villagers loose in the hedge maze as part of the evening's "entertainment."

name: Undying Malice
text: Few take kindly to being put in their place, especially if their place is the grave.

name: Unhallowed Phalanx
text:
"In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore."
—Kerren of the Mausoleum Guards

name: Vampire's Kiss
text: Young vampires gorge themselves at every meal, but their elders have learned to savor the smallest bite.

name: Wedding Security
text: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.

name: Abrade
text: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

name: Alluring Suitor
text: "May I have this dance?"

name: Ancestral Anger
text: "One vampire for every family member I've lost."

name: Ballista Watcher
text: "Careful, this thing's dangerous. Wouldn't want anyone getting hurt."

name: Blood Hypnotist
text: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

name: Gryff Rider
text:
"Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight. She'll do the rest."
—Anders, cathar drillmaster

name: Change of Fortune
text:
"We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking."
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

name: Daybreak Combatants
text: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

name: Dominating Vampire
text: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

name: End the Festivities
text: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

name: Fearful Villager
text: When Harold ran from the wolves, the others called him a coward.

name: Flame-Blessed Bolt
text:
"I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own."
—Higa, slayer-captain of Gatstaf

name: Frenzied Devils
text:
"Devils need no reason to stir up chaos. The chaos itself is their reward."
—Rem Karolus, Fiendslayer

name: Honeymoon Hearse
text: A carriage crafted from the finest materials. Horses bred from the finest stock. Skulls taken from the finest foes.

name: Hungry Ridgewolf
text: Even vampires know to travel faster when they hear howling in the Geier Reach passes.

name: Into the Night
text:
"When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

name: Kessig Flamebreather
text: "Hunter's fire" was meant for slaying monsters in the Ulvenwald, but that never stopped Ralen from showing it off.

name: Kessig Wolfrider
text: "It's a perfect partnership. My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch."

name: Lightning Wolf
text: These thick-furred wolves have adapted to Stensia's storms, channeling their energy into bursts of supernatural speed.

name: Pyre Spawn
text: Memories of the Harvesttide tragedy festered until they grew into an incarnate rage that set the world ablaze.

name: Reckless Impulse
text: A stitcher looks at their creation and sees the result of years of study and hours of toil. A devil sees a new plaything.

name: Rending Flame
text:
"It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

name: Runebound Wolf
text: The wolf's captor hid his fear, but he knew someday the runes would fail, the collar would break, and the wolf would remember his face.

name: Stensia Uprising
text: "Vampires have done nothing but take from us. Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!"

name: Sure Strike
text: Before the officiant even had a chance to ask if anyone objected to the Voldaren-Markov union, Arlinn made her opinion known.

name: Vampires' Vengeance
text: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

name: Voldaren Epicure
text: "If you're not refining your tastes, what's the point of living forever?"

name: Voltaic Visionary
text: She spent many years trying to harness chaos.

name: Weary Prisoner
text: "Your guard attacked me. He got what was coming to him."

name: Apprentice Sharpshooter
text: Innistrad's best archers are trained by the Quiver of Kessig, an order of cathars who specialize in ranged combat.

name: Cartographer's Survey
text: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves."
—Wrenn

name: Dawnhart Disciple
text: "Our coven finds strength in nature and purpose in serving our communities."

name: Dig Up
text: Things buried on Innistrad rarely seem to stay that way.

name: Dormant Grove
text: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

name: Flourishing Hunter
text:
"I would welcome her into my pack with honor."
—Arlinn Kord

name: Angelic Quartermaster
text: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."

name: Hookhand Mariner
text: The local gossips swore Nesmith lost his hands in a fight with a werewolf.

name: Infestation Expert
text: There's only so many times she can take being asked . . .

name: Laid to Rest
text:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch

name: Massive Might
text:
"Run! It's coming for us! Eventually!"
—Yaster, Havengul shopkeeper

name: Moldgraf Millipede
text: Between stitchers, cultists, and scavengers, corpses are in high demand.

name: Mulch
text:
"Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing."
—Halana, to Alena

name: Oakshade Stalker
text: He blends seamlessly into the forest, waiting silently for his prey.

name: Packsong Pup
text: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

name: Reclusive Taxidermist
text: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.

name: Retrieve
text: The roots preserved the armor for a hundred years, safeguarding it for a traveler in need.

name: Rural Recruit
text: The Dawnhart survivors welcome recruits of all shapes and sizes.

name: Sheltering Boughs
text:
"We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?"
—Marel, Dawnhart witch

name: Snarling Wolf
text:
"Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo—"
—Bruno, Ulvenwald guide, last words

name: Kindly Ancestor
text: "You look cold, dearie."

name: Splendid Reclamation
text:
"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn

name: Spore Crawler
text:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

name: Sporeback Wolf
text: The mushrooms growing in the wolves' fur possess curative properties incredible enough to tempt many alchemists into risking their lives to track one down.

name: Toxic Scorpion
text:
"You want that venom? Collect it yourself! I'm not losing another pair of dragonhide gloves."
—Old Rutstein

name: Ulvenwald Oddity
text:
"Obviously it's dangerous, but I've never seen anything like it. This could be an entirely new species! I say we follow it."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Weaver of Blossoms
text: Living in harmony with nature . . .

name: Witch's Web
text: Ever since the ritual, Ryla didn't have an appetite at the dinner table, but her long walks in the forest always seemed to satiate her hunger.

name: Wolf Strike
text: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.

name: Wolfkin Outcast
text: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

name: Ancient Lumberknot
text: The soft creak of trees in the wind is not always cause for comfort.

name: Child of the Pack
text: Her face shines with youthful innocence.

name: Dorothea, Vengeful Victim
text: "Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest."

name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
text: "Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly."

name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
text: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

name: Militia Rallier
text: "We can wait like helpless children for a hero, or we can gather our courage and *be* the heroes. Who's with me?"

name: Markov Purifier
text: The ceremonial "incense" was a concoction of Edgar's own design, a precise blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.

name: Markov Waltzer
text: "I'll lead."

name: Olivia, Crimson Bride
text: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

name: Nebelgast Beguiler
text: A moment of distraction, an hour off course.

name: Blood Servitor
text:
"Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Boarded Window
text:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

name: Foreboding Statue
text: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.

name: Honored Heirloom
text: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

name: Wedding Invitation
text: RSVP at your own risk.

name: Deathcap Glade
text: Deadly mushrooms litter these woods, each waiting for an errant footstep to release its noxious spores.

name: Dreamroot Cascade
text: Soothing whispers invite travelers to step closer, closer, closer . . . until they vanish soundlessly beneath the surface.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

name: Shattered Sanctum
text: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

name: Stormcarved Coast
text: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

name: Sundown Pass
text: Riders chase the fading light recklessly through the mountains, desperate for one last glimpse of day.

name: Ollenbock Escort
text: "Stay in the light. I don't know what lurks in those shadows, and I'd like to keep it that way."

name: Panicked Bystander
text: "Help! There's been a horrible murder!"

name: Parish-Blade Trainee
text: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.

name: Arm the Cathars
text: Faith is a cathar's greatest weapon, but a sword of blessed silver is a close second.

name: Piercing Light
text:
"Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Resistance Squad
text:
"It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed."
—Olivia Voldaren

name: Sanctify
text:
"Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Our dear Madam Mina is once more our teacher. Her eyes have been where we were blinded. Now we are on the track once again, and this time we may succeed."

name: Thirst for Discovery
text: I knew he had left the castle now, and thought to use the opportunity to explore more than I had dared to do as yet.

name: Innocent Traveler
text: I looked at her throat just now as she lay asleep, and the tiny wounds seem not to have healed.

name: Vampires' Vengeance
text: She was ghastly, chalkily pale; the red seemed to have gone even from her lips and gums, and the bones of her face stood out prominently; her breathing was painful to see or hear.

name: Reclusive Taxidermist
text: We want no proofs; we ask none to believe us! This boy will some day know what a brave and gallant woman his mother is.

name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
text: "It is in the hold, perhaps in one of those boxes. I'll unscrew them one by one and see. You work the helm."

name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
text: "The blood is the life! The blood is the life!"

name: Torens, Fist of the Angels
text: He seems absolutely imperturbable. I can fancy what a wonderful power he must have over his patients.

name: Sigarda's Summons
text: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben belongs to the living. I will not rest until it is cleansed."

name: Traveling Minister
text: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

name: Twinblade Geist
text: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

name: Sigarda's Summons
text: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

name: Geistlight Snare
text: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

name: Dominating Vampire
text: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

name: Unholy Officiant
text:
"Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?"
—Sorin Markov

name: Vampire Slayer
text: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed. When she brought one down herself, she realized she had found her calling.

name: Welcoming Vampire
text: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

name: Alchemist's Retrieval
text: To most, a terrifying apparition. To a necro-alchemist, a potent fuel source.

name: Biolume Egg
text: Serpents leave their eggs in the cold and inky depths...

name: By Invitation Only
text: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

name: Chill of the Grave
text: Frozen is frozen, whether it's with cold, terror, or both.

name: Cobbled Lancer
text:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager

name: Consuming Tide
text: Nephalia's tides obey an unforgiving moon.

name: Cruel Witness
text:
"I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?"
—Gregel, militia leader

name: Diver Skaab
text: It doesn't need to breathe, but the suit does help keep the parts together.

name: Geistlight Snare
text: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

name: Geralf, Visionary Stitcher
text: "Do you like it, Sister? Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own."

name: Gutter Skulker
text: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.

name: Inspired Idea
text: Stitching is an ever-evolving field, with each new advancement reaching a new height of horror.

name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector
text: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."

name: Lantern Bearer
text: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .

name: Mischievous Catgeist
text:
"I never get any knitting done, but I don't entirely mind."
—Lorn, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Necroduality
text:
"Geralf's prowess continues to grow. He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy."
—Ludevic's laboratory notes

name: Repository Skaab
text: Created to capture the spark of genius for later use.

name: Scattered Thoughts
text: Stitchers delegate the most important tasks to assistants with a good eye for detail.

name: Selhoff Entomber
text: It knows one fundamental truth: bodies belong in graves.

name: Serpentine Ambush
text: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

name: Skywarp Skaab
text:
"If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher."
—Barton, stitcher

name: Dawnhart Geist
text: "Our bodies may lie slain, but perhaps we can still complete the ritual. I'd rather not spend my afterlife in this wretched eternal night."

name: Steelclad Spirit
text: Some geists imitate the lives they left behind. Others follow the dreams they never realized.

name: Stormchaser Drake
text:
"Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

name: Syncopate
text: "Fool! Can't you see the tide has turned against you?"

name: Syphon Essence
text: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with *viscus vitae*, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.

name: Thirst for Discovery
text:
"This is your only warning, alchemist. The secrets of the sea are not yours to behold. Lord Krothuss will not be so merciful next time."
—Runo Stromkirk

name: Wanderlight Spirit
text: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.

name: Wash Away
text:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

name: Whispering Wizard
text: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.

name: Winged Portent
text:
"No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think."
—York, Kessig tracker

name: Distracting Geist
text: "I never did enjoy studying."

name: Wretched Throng
text:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

name: Aim for the Head
text:
"Works every time."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

name: Bleed Dry
text:
"Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized."
—Anje Falkenrath

name: Catapult Fodder
text: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.

name: Walking Corpse
text:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

name: Borderland Marauder
text: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Incremental Growth
text:
"Tie a mouse under a bridge, and your cabbages will triple in size."
—Kithkin superstition

name: Oakenform
text:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Marked by Honor
text: Stand your post for duty. Stand your ground for honor.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Air Servant
text: Wind is forceful, yet ephemeral. It can knock a dragon out of the sky, yet pass through the smallest crack unhindered.

name: Disperse
text: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

name: Sphinx of Magosi
text: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

name: Mind Rot
text:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Divine Verdict
text: "Guilty."

name: Inspiration
text:
"Day 31: I finally succeeded in my time reversal experiment!
"Day 30: I might have a problem here."
—Journal of the Prime Izmagnus

name: Sphinx of Magosi
text: "A riddle is nothing more than a trap for small minds, baited with the promise of understanding."

name: Stealer of Secrets
text: The Dimir would hire her, if only they knew where she lived. The Azorius would condemn her, if only they knew her name.

name: Tricks of the Trade
text: "Pathetic. You might as well have protected your treasures with a paper box and some string."

name: Bloodhunter Bat
text: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

name: Certain Death
text: Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.

name: Nightmare
text: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

name: Raise Dead
text: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

name: Sengir Vampire
text: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

name: Glory Seeker
text: "There's no contract to sign, no oath to swear. The enlistment procedure is to unsheathe your sword and point it at the enemy."

name: Untamed Hunger
text:
"Mindlessness is not weakness. When we are lost to hunger we are unstoppable."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

name: Falkenrath Reaver
text:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

name: Shivan Dragon
text: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

name: Thundering Giant
text: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

name: Oakenform
text:
"When the beast cloaks itself in the mighty oak, what good is a bow? When the oak wraps itself around the snarling beast, what good is a hatchet?"
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

name: Rabid Bite
text:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

name: Rootwalla
text: They make terrible pets ... unless you don't like your other pets.

name: Stalking Tiger
text: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

name: Stampeding Rhino
text: The quickest way to get through the jungle is to agitate a rhino and run in its wake.

name: Serra Angel
text: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

name: Wing Snare
text:
"We are the hands of the great trees, reaching out to ensnare what threatens their branches."
—Elvish hunter

name: Standing Troops
text:
"Bant sentries were called the Angel Line. They never faltered, and they were ready to die defending their position."
—Elspeth Tirel

name: Stormfront Pegasus
text: Its hooves touch the earth only when a hero must rise.

name: Air Elemental
text: Pray that it doesn't seek the safety of your lungs.

name: Coral Merfolk
text: Merfolk are best known for their subtle magic. But those who try to fight them in their own territory quickly realize that merfolk are hardly defenseless on the field of battle.

name: Drag Under
text: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

name: Divine Arrow
text: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

name: Ob Nixilis's Cruelty
text: Trapped on Ravnica with no affection for either side, Ob Nixilis sought gratification in random acts of torment.

name: Price of Betrayal
text: The moment Liliana defied Nicol Bolas, her contract was broken, and her life was forfeit. But she was free to choose her fate, and she decided it was worth the price.

name: Shriekdiver
text:
"It's faster than we are. Draw its attention while the Ledev take aim!"
—Shauntal, Boros legionnaire

name: Sorin's Thirst
text:
"I see you're out of the wall."
—Nahiri

name: Spark Harvest
text: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.

name: Spark Reaper
text:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

name: Tithebearer Giant
text:
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them."
—Teysa

name: Unlikely Aid
text:
"No one will ever ride me again, Gideon. Expect no further favors."
—Rakdos

name: Enforcer Griffin
text:
"A company of infantry is trapped behind the lines. We need to strike hard and fast to free them, or the casualties will be horrific. Send the griffins."
—Tajic

name: Vampire Opportunist
text: "I think I cracked a fang."

name: Vizier of the Scorpion
text: His blessing is a curse.

name: Vraska's Finisher
text: "You might have pleaded your case with my queen earlier. Now I am here, and it is far too late."

name: Ahn-Crop Invader
text:
"Give me a crew like this one and I'd rule any sea I sailed."
—Angrath

name: Blindblast
text:
"Peril is in the eye of the beholder. At least, if your aim is good."
—Jaya Ballard

name: Bolt Bend
text:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

name: Bond of Passion
text: "Why don't we fight for what's right and let bureaucrats argue over details?"

name: Burning Prophet
text: "This day will end in death, but not the one you hoped for. This day will end in victory, but not the one you expected."

name: Chainwhip Cyclops
text:
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind."
—Urgdar, cyclops philosopher

name: Finale of Glory
text: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.

name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
text:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan

name: Chandra's Triumph
text: Her triumph came not from achieving her ideal self, but from rejecting the idea of perfection.

name: Cyclops Electromancer
text: Every storm has an eye.

name: Demolish
text:
"For every inch of land they take from us, we take it back or we burn it. Give them nothing."
—Aurelia

name: Devouring Hellion
text: There's no crisis a hellion can't make worse.

name: Goblin Assailant
text: What he lacks in patience, intelligence, empathy, lucidity, hygiene, ability to follow orders, self-regard, and discernible skills, he makes up for in sheer chaotic violence.

name: Goblin Assault Team
text: Under the veneer of the various guilds, each goblin has the same basic need: to run screaming at the enemy and hit a bunch of stuff.

name: Grim Initiate
text: Beneath each gleaming mineral shell rots a once-proud warrior of Amonkhet.

name: Heartfire
text: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

name: Honor the God-Pharaoh
text: In life, they revered a diverse pantheon of gods. Now they revere only the God-Pharaoh.

name: Invading Manticore
text:
"Fall back! You are no match for this."
—Samut

name: Jaya's Greeting
text: "We have visitors? Well, it'd be rude not to give them a traditional Keral Keep welcome."

name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
text: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

name: Nahiri's Stoneblades
text: The ancient Planeswalkers Sorin and Nahiri battled across Ravnica, their blows cutting as deep as their grudge.

name: Gideon's Sacrifice
text: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

name: Raging Kronch
text:
"Seeing so much easy prey makes her crazy. See how she snorts and drools?"
—Dhuuz, kronch wrangler

name: Samut's Sprint
text: Samut's war was intensely personal. Every hour she faced enemies she once loved as friends and horrors she once revered as gods.

name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
text: "You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."

name: Spellgorger Weird
text: Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.

name: Tibalt's Rager
text:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

name: Turret Ogre
text: Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.

name: Arboreal Grazer
text:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

name: Gideon's Triumph
text: His triumph came not from victory over his enemies, but from the salvation of those who survived.

name: Arlinn's Wolf
text:
"If you don't speak wolf, allow me to translate: 'One step closer and I'll rip out your throat.'"
—Arlinn Kord

name: Awakening of Vitu-Ghazi
text: The Eternal armies advanced on Vitu-Ghazi. At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.

name: Band Together
text: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

name: Bloom Hulk
text:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

name: Bond of Flourishing
text: "We agree that life should flourish. We disagree on the optimal number of limbs."

name: Centaur Nurturer
text: "I call upon the vigor of the grasses, the hopes of the flowers, and the dreams of the trees."

name: Challenger Troll
text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

name: Courage in Crisis
text: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Finale of Devastation
text: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.

name: Forced Landing
text: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.

name: Giant Growth
text:
"Sometimes Mowu is content to gnaw on a bone. Sometimes he wants the whole skeleton."
—Jiang Yanggu

name: Kraul Stinger
text: He listens to the sounds of battle filtering down from above, waiting for silence, waiting for his time to claim the streets.

name: Kronch Wrangler
text: Looking over two city blocks of destruction, he could only cackle with pride.

name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
text: Wherever Yanggu goes, Mowu follows—sometimes at his side, sometimes obscuring him from view entirely.

name: Nissa's Triumph
text: Her triumph came not from destroying the unnatural, but from fostering life.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Primordial Wurm
text: Elite training, single-minded devotion, and lazotep coating help only so much for invaders who are fundamentally bite-sized.

name: Return to Nature
text:
"Yes, nature is stronger. You don't see little buildings sprouting on trees."
—Emmara

name: Snarespinner
text:
"Let's lure the drakes to the webs over the Samok Stand. Keep the spiders content."
—Aurelia

name: Steady Aim
text: The archer's heart broke seeing her compatriots die far below, but she held position until the enemy was in range.

name: Storm the Citadel
text:
"If we die, we die. But we cannot let him win."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Thundering Ceratok
text:
"I thought this was a civilized plane. How are there so many feral beasts?"
—Dovin Baan

name: Ignite the Beacon
text:
"If you can't save yourself, you fight to give someone else a chance."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Wardscale Crocodile
text:
"The Eternals had to endure Amonkhet's five trials. Let's see if they can pass the Trial of Ravnica."
—Jace Beleren

name: Angrath's Rampage
text: "Grand city? No. This is nothing but another squalid cage."

name: Cruel Celebrant
text: "Whichever side wins, I'm sure the banquet will be superb."

name: Deathsprout
text:
"They say nothing lasts forever. I say everything lasts forever, just not in the form you may be accustomed to."
—Vraska

name: Ironclad Krovod
text:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Despark
text: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left. "You are the gods. He is the usurper. You know what to do."

name: Domri's Ambush
text: "When civilization teeters on the brink, I'll be there to kick it the rest of the way."

name: Dovin's Veto
text: "I see you've learned nothing, Chandra. You'd still put a match to something rather than understand it."

name: Elite Guardmage
text:
"Be careful. You'll have more than Dovin to contend with if you hope to breach New Prahv."
—Lavinia, to Chandra Nalaar

name: Heartwarming Redemption
text: Kytheon had known war every day of his life. Now he finally knew peace.

name: Law-Rune Enforcer
text:
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity."
—Dovin Baan

name: Huatli's Raptor
text: The essence of Ixalan was never far from Huatli's heart.

name: Invade the City
text: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.

name: Leyline Prowler
text: It feeds on the dark energies that course through the deep world—and on any other creature lured by the leyline's pull.

name: Living Twister
text:
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!"
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Mayhem Devil
text: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

name: Oath of Kaya
text: "So everyone gets what they truly deserve, I will keep watch."

name: Loxodon Sergeant
text: His voice is both war horn and rallying cry, a trumpeting call that stirs even the faintest heart.

name: Pledge of Unity
text:
"No one hero will save this day. Today we must all be heroes."
—Gideon Jura

name: Ral's Outburst
text:
"Time to find the melting point of lazotep."
—Ral Zarek

name: Role Reversal
text: Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.

name: Rubblebelt Rioters
text:
"If the system is broken, break the system."
—Domri Rade

name: Solar Blaze
text:
"The primary weapon is nothing more than light. It shows them what they are, and they burn of their own accord."
—Aurelia

name: Soul Diviner
text: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

name: Storrev, Devkarin Lich
text: In times of war, only death flourishes.

name: Makeshift Battalion
text: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

name: Tenth District Legionnaire
text:
"The Tenth is under heavy attack, but it's being handled. I sent Mileva."
—Tajic

name: Time Wipe
text:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

name: Tyrant's Scorn
text:
"The hero with the magic sword slays the dragon? Not this time."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Martyr for the Cause
text: "If I am to die in service, there is no more worthy fight than this."

name: Firemind Vessel
text: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
text: A dictator's infuriating smirk, an affront to everything Ravnica stood for.

name: Guild Globe
text:
"Hopefully Ravnica will prove harder to break."
—Karn

name: Iron Bully
text:
"Why would someone have built ... wait, never mind. Send it to the front lines!"
—Commander Grozdan

name: Mana Geode
text:
"I don't care if it's an all-powerful relic or a street vendor's lucky charm. If it brings you courage, wear it."
—Saheeli Rai

name: Prismite
text: It didn't budge when the portal opened, nor when the ancient gods emerged. It came to life only when all ten guilds came together to face a common threat.

name: Saheeli's Silverwing
text: "Track the source of those thopters," Saheeli told her creation. "And feel free to snack on as many as you want."

name: Emergence Zone
text: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.

name: Gateway Plaza
text: Guild leaders focused their magic on the portal scar. Where the Chamber perished, a parun could be reborn.

name: Karn's Bastion
text:
"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn

name: Mobilized District
text: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

name: Pouncing Lynx
text: "I don't understand. He's normally so well behaved!"

name: Prison Realm
text: After millennia to craft victory, Bolas had eternity to contemplate defeat.

name: Desperate Lunge
text: Ravnica held its breath as the hero of the resistance—their last hope—flew through the sky, his dark sword ready to strike a god.

name: Gideon's Battle Cry
text: "Break their formation! Thin their ranks! I'm right behind you!"

name: Gideon's Company
text: "For the Legion! For Ravnica!"

name: Orzhov Guildgate
text:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

name: Rally of Wings
text: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

name: Guildpact Informant
text: "Of course you're being followed!"

name: Jace's Projection
text: "Pardon me if I seem distracted. Part of me is reconnoitering the Tenth District."

name: Jace's Ruse
text: "The Eternals can recognize faces. They just think I look like a blue minotaur."

name: Simic Guildgate
text:
"Mystery is beauty. Within the unknown we plumb revelation."
—Vannifar

name: Ravnica at War
text: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.

name: Rising Populace
text: Grief is a crucible where resolve is tempered.

name: Single Combat
text: Not even a threat to the entire Multiverse could persuade them to put aside their feud.

name: Sunblade Angel
text: At Feather's command, squadrons of battle angels swarmed out of the *Parhelion II*, unsheathing blades made of molten dawn.

name: Teyo's Lightshield
text: Teyo gifted his shields to as many allies as possible, knowing he could not always be there to protect them himself.

name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
text: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

name: Topple the Statue
text: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.

name: Trusted Pegasus
text: "Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.

name: Wanderer's Strike
text:
"Precise, clean cuts. No one saw anything. Again. Tag the report with my code and file it."
—Lavinia

name: War Screecher
text: Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.

name: Ajani's Pridemate
text: Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.

name: Ashiok's Skulker
text:
"Fear writhes and whispers in the shadows of your mind. It is the enemy you always knew would come."
—Ashiok

name: Augur of Bolas
text: "There is no future save the one my master wills."

name: Aven Eternal
text:
"I've never seen the firemane angels so anxious."
—Tajic

name: Bond of Insight
text: "Together we can unlock secrets no one has even dreamed of. I might even let you remember some of them."

name: Callous Dismissal
text:
"They make it clear we are nothing to them."
—Lavinia

name: Commence the Endgame
text:
"Even gods shall kneel."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Contentious Plan
text: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.

name: Crush Dissent
text:
"All I ask is complete obedience."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Erratic Visionary
text: An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"

name: Battlefield Promotion
text: "Welcome to the Legion. You saved a district—now let's go save the world."

name: Finale of Revelation
text: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

name: Flux Channeler
text: "Inform our allies in the Tenth and throw the circuit. It's about to get weird."

name: Jace's Triumph
text: His triumph was not in outsmarting Bolas's plan, but in understanding why ultimate power is self-defeating.

name: Kasmina's Transmutation
text:
"Hop away now, little Eternal. Go eat some flies."
—Kasmina

name: Kiora's Dambreaker
text:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

name: Bond of Discipline
text: "We agree that order benefits everyone, but not until you enforce it."

name: Naga Eternal
text:
"I recognize that headdress. This one was feared even by her fellow initiates."
—Samut

name: Narset's Reversal
text:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset

name: No Escape
text: Jace surmised that they were walking into Bolas's trap. He felt no joy in being right.

name: Relentless Advance
text: They approach in formation, every movement efficient and sure. They halt, listen, and then press on in silent unison.

name: Rescuer Sphinx
text: "Now, little fighter, show me you deserved this second chance."

name: Sky Theater Strix
text: Courier owls joined the fray, attacking the Dreadhorde with a viciousness usually reserved for mail thieves.

name: Spellkeeper Weird
text: They worked well as a team, but they knew it couldn't last forever.

name: Bulwark Giant
text:
"Where did she come from? More importantly, are there more like her?"
—Gideon Jura

name: Stealth Mission
text:
"What they don't know will definitely hurt them."
—Lazav

name: Tamiyo's Epiphany
text: Tamiyo wished only to observe the war, but she soon realized neutrality was not an option.

name: Teferi's Time Twist
text: "The safest place for you is not now."

name: Thunder Drake
text: The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.

name: Totally Lost
text: At least this was better than that week at the Juri Revue.

name: Wall of Runes
text:
"It's strangely satisfying seeing an undead killing machine from another world standing befuddled in front of a wall of text."
—Lavinia

name: Aid the Fallen
text: "I never liked you. Now get up—we have a fight to finish."

name: Banehound
text:
"I wish I could train a pack of them for hunting in the undercity. But I'd never dare turn my back, and I hate to think what I'd have to feed them."
—Zhosmir, urban huntmaster

name: Charmed Stray
text:
"There's something peculiar about the cats today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

name: Bond of Revival
text: "Today we throw off the yoke of death. Either this is an affirmation of the eternal cyclical nature of life, or it's just hilarious—depends on which of us you ask."

name: Charity Extractor
text: "War or no war, your donations are due, as always."

name: Command the Dreadhorde
