text: Liliana seized the reins of Bolas's vast army, gritting her teeth behind the Chain Veil.

name: Davriel's Shadowfugue
text: Shadows coiled around the witness's mind. Then the moment vanished, leaving only the sting of its loss.

name: Dreadmalkin
text: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

name: Duskmantle Operative
text: Gideon eyed the Dimir emissary warily. "Could your agents slip inside Bolas's citadel?" The figure met his gaze with icy resolve. "We already have."

name: The Elderspell
text: The path to power is often paved with atrocities.

name: Defiant Strike
text: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

name: Eternal Taskmaster
text:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

name: Finale of Eternity
text: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.

name: Herald of the Dreadhorde
text: Amonkhet's dead flowed into a new world in service to their God-Pharaoh.

name: Kaya's Ghostform
text: The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.

name: Lazotep Behemoth
text:
"I know I should be more concerned. But a big, blue zombie-potamus from beyond the stars? This is what they're invading us with?"
—Mileva, Boros legionnaire

name: Lazotep Reaver
text: Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.

name: Liliana's Triumph
text: Her triumph came not from escaping her death, but in claiming her independence.

name: Displaced Dinosaurs
text:
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen."
—The Third Doctor

name: The Eighth Doctor
text: "Physician, heal thyself."

name: The Face of Boe
text: "You are not alone."

name: The Fifth Doctor

name: Haunted Ridge
text:
"No, no, come on, Doc. This is where you jump in with a rational explanation. I mean, ghosts don't exist, right?"
—Graham O'Brien

name: Horizon Canopy
text:
"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect."
—The Seventh Doctor

name: Irrigated Farmland
text:
"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected."
—Captain Adelaide Brooke

name: Mystic Monastery
text:
"The woman twice dead, and her final message. He was drawn to this place of peace and solitude that he might divine her meaning."
—The Abbott

name: Overgrown Farmland
text:
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

name: Path of Ancestry
text:
"It's the TARDIS. It's my home! Or, at least it has been for a considerable number of years."
—The Second Doctor

name: Port Town
text:
"Venezia. La Serenissima. Impossible city. Preposterous city."
—The Eleventh Doctor

name: Prairie Stream
text:
"Strictly speaking, it's the fifteenth New York since the original, so that makes it New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New York."
—The Tenth Doctor

name: Reliquary Tower
text:
"The sky's a burnt orange, with the Citadel enclosed in a mighty glass dome, shining under the twin suns."
—The Tenth Doctor

name: River of Tears
text:
"We will drain the oceans and put the humans in chains."
—The Fisher King

name: Rockfall Vale
text:
"The first one to get to the site marked as the Ghost Monument will be crowned the winner and transported off this planet."
—Ilin

name: Rogue's Passage
text:
"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum."
—The Eleventh Doctor

name: Rootbound Crag
text:
"All we have to do is open the doors and read the very first words in recorded history..."
—The Eleventh Doctor

name: Scattered Groves
text:
"We'll be safe over there. Safe from the Cheetahs, and the Master."
—The Seventh Doctor

name: Seaside Citadel
text:
"Watch for the omens! I declare a new golden age of prosperity for all."
—The Captain

name: Shadowblood Ridge
text:
"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

name: Sheltered Thicket
text:
"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly."
—Robin Hood

name: Shipwreck Marsh
text:
"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die."
—River Song

name: Skycloud Expanse
text: "How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.

name: Smoldering Marsh
text:
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Stormcarved Coast
text:
"Solar tsunami. Came directly from your sun. A tidal wave of radiation. Big, big, big."
—The Eleventh Doctor

name: Sunbaked Canyon
text:
"Look at all those diamonds. Poisoned by the sun. No one can ever touch them."
—Claude

name: Sundown Pass
text:
"This is the day the Sun expands. Welcome to the end of the world."
—The Ninth Doctor

name: Sungrass Prairie
text:
"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something."
—Bill Potts

name: Sunken Hollow
text:
"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?"
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Temple of Abandon
text:
"It's my party, and all of me is invited."
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Temple of Deceit
text:
"No one's called it Satellite Five in ages. It's the Game Station now."
—Lynda

name: Temple of Epiphany
text:
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri

name: Temple of Malice
text: "Mothership will maintain Earth geostationary orbit. All systems fully operational. Attack Squad Delta, prepare to enter transmat."

name: Temple of Plenty
text: "Doctor, look at this extraordinary city down here!" exclaimed Ian. "The Aztecs. They knew how to build." replied the Doctor.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"The Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten. It's a holy site for the Sun Singers of Akhat."
—The Eleventh Doctor

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text:
"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss."
—Ida Scott

name: Thespian's Stage
text: "All the world's a stage," said the Doctor. "Hmm. I might use that." pondered Shakespeare.

name: Thriving Grove
text:
"There are no predatory animals on Deva Loka. No diseases, no adverse environmental factors."
—Todd

name: Thriving Heath
text:
"Vortis is ours. We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it."
—Vrestin

name: Thriving Isle
text:
"Whoa, far out! Are you quite sure this is the planet you aimed for?"
—Peri Brown

name: Thriving Moor
text:
"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

name: Return the Past
text:
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back."
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Vineglimmer Snarl
text:
"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind."
—The Third Doctor

name: War Room
text:
"We stand at a crossroads, Doctor, quite alone, with our backs to the wall."
—Winston Churchill

name: Waterlogged Grove
text:
"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis

name: Barbara Wright
text: "There will be no sacrifice this afternoon, Doctor. Or ever again."

name: Crisis of Conscience
text: "Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

name: Everybody Lives!
text:
"Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!"
—The Ninth Doctor

name: Everything Comes to Dust
text: "I can see every single atom of your existence, and I divide them."

name: Four Knocks
text: "Wilfred, it's my honor. Better be quick. Three, two, one."

name: Peri Brown
text: "I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"

name: Tegan Jovanka
text: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

name: Cyber Conversion
text: "Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."

name: Danny Pink
text: "I don't want to see more things. I want to see the things in front of me more clearly."

name: Flatline
text:
"We've found the missing people- they're in the walls!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Nanogene Conversion
text: "Are you my mummy?"

name: Reverse the Polarity
text: "You see, before you reactivated it, I reversed the polarity of the neutron flow."

name: Traverse Eternity
text:
"Know thine enemy. Admirable advice."
—The Fourth Doctor

name: Dalek Drone
text: "Elevate."

name: This Is How It Ends
text: "There's a gravestone here for someone with the same name as me."

name: Vashta Nerada
text: "Hey, who turned out the lights?"

name: Dan Lewis
text: "What's your plan? Some clever sciencey-spacey thing I won't understand?"

name: Delete
text: "You will be deleted."

name: Ecstatic Beauty
text: "Try to see what I see. We are so lucky we are still alive to see this beautiful world."

name: Return the Past
text:
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back."
—The Twelfth Doctor

name: Ace, Fearless Rebel
text: "Wicked!"

name: Yasmin Khan
text: "We're going to find her and we're going to rescue her. She's done it for us enough times—now it's our turn."

name: Ace, Fearless Rebel
text: "Wicked!"

name: Graham O'Brien
text: "Now, I always come prepared."

name: Jamie McCrimmon
text: "Creag an tuire!"

name: Leela, Sevateem Warrior
text: "Look, Doctor, good marksmanship is not a matter of luck."

name: Vengevine
text: Leave but a shred of root and it will return, bursting with vigor.

name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
text: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

name: Abrupt Decay
text: The worst part isn't the pain, or the smell, or even the fear of death. It's hearing the clatter of bone on stone and knowing the bones are yours.

name: Tegwyll, Duke of Splendor
text: He weaves glamours as easily as breathing, his otherworldly beauty entrancing fae and mortal alike.

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Opt
text:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

name: Perplexing Test
text: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

name: Reconnaissance Mission
text:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

name: Reflections of Littjara
text: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

name: Repulse
text: "You aren't invited."

name: Run Away Together
text:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

name: Snap
text: Good riddance.

name: Sower of Temptation
text: One glamer leads him far from home. The next washes away his memory that home was ever anywhere but at her side.

name: Theoretical Duplication
text:
"You made it asymmetrical just to annoy me, didn't you?"
—Imbraham, Quandrix dean

name: Kindred Dominance
text: In the end, the lights fade, the land withers, and only the dead and vile remain.

name: Reckless Spite
text: "The end is justified in being mean. Or something like that."

name: Thrilling Encore
text: "Welcome to the winning team."

name: Ancestral Mask
text: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

name: Aura Gnarlid
text: Kill a gnarlid with your first blow, or it'll cheerfully show you how it's done.

name: Eidolon of Blossoms
text: The emotional echoes of dryad gatherings attract lost souls.

name: Enchantress's Presence
text: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

name: Fertile Ground
text: Pretty, valuable, and delicious—a boggart thief's trifecta.

name: Paradise Druid
text: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

name: Rishkar's Expertise
text: "Control the Great Conduit? You might as well try to divert a river with your hands."

name: Sanctum Weaver
text: The arrival of spring's first flowers is a sacred occasion to Karametra's acolytes, who fill the Setessan woods with song in celebration.

name: Setessan Champion
text: "A blessing is not a gift. It is a duty."

name: Sylvan Ranger
text: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

name: Glen Elendra Liege
text: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

name: Jukai Naturalist
text: He had heard rumors of the cities—the constant noise, the stagnant air, the tainted water—and he had no wish to learn if they were true.

name: Nymris, Oona's Trickster
text: Mischief is its own reward.

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Fellwar Stone
text:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Wayfarer's Bauble
text: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

name: Canopy Vista
text: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

name: Castle Ardenvale
text: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Darkwater Catacombs
text: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

name: Exotic Orchard
text:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

name: Tegwyll's Scouring
text: "Your season has ended. We are eternal."

name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
text: The stronghold of Theros's light.

name: Secluded Glen
text: Protected by glamers and guile, Glen Elendra harbors the elusive Oona, queen of the fae.

name: Sungrass Prairie
text: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

name: Sunken Hollow
text: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

name: Temple of the False God
text:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
text: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

name: Loamcrafter Faun
text: "Give me just a moment. I need to grow us a new bridge."

name: Ajani's Chosen
text: "United, our roar will level mountains."

name: Ox Drover
text: "Ho, Shaggyfoot! Lumpton, pick up those hooves! Edgewall by sundown or I'll sell the lot of you to a witch!"

name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
text: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely. I will face despair and fight on. As a Capashen, I can do no less."

name: Daybreak Coronet
text:
"Let the deception of the gods yield to the pure light of day."
—Brimaz, king of Oreskos

name: Ethereal Armor
text: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

name: Generous Gift
text: The best presents are impossible to regift.

name: Kor Spiritdancer
text: She reaches beyond the physical realm, touching the ideals from which all creatures draw their power.

name: Retether
text: The rifts reach into infinite time streams, bringing the divergent products of alternate pasts into the present.

name: Starfield Mystic
text: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Swords to Plowshares
text: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

name: Timely Ward
text: Behind every general who leads from the front is a nervous mage with a spell at the ready.

name: Unfinished Business
text: "My story ends when I say so."

name: Transcendent Envoy
text:
"The first griffins were made by the gods to capture falling stars; they were given the keenest eyes and the swiftest wings, and sent to keep watch above the clouds."
—*The Cosmogony*

name: Umbra Mystic
text: "I have found the courage to face death—twice, if I must."

name: Winds of Rath
text:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

name: Consider
text: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

name: Distant Melody
text: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

name: Archmage of Echoes
text:
"The High Fae are capable of magics that would make even the great Gadwick himself seem little more than a clumsy apprentice."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Faerie Formation
text: The throng flitted from castle to castle, leaving a trail of star-crossed love, damaging rumors, and missing heirlooms in their wake.

name: Faerie Seer
text: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

name: Frantic Search
text: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

name: Keep Watch
text: "I see their moral dilemmas. I see their raw courage. I see their self-sacrifice. I see our victory."

name: Archon of the Wild Rose
text: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

name: Mintstrosity
text: If the sugary abominations of Sweettooth Village were ever under someone's control, that time is long past.

name: Rankle's Prank
text: The louder they scream, the harder he laughs.

name: Rat Out
text:
"Hold this for me."
—Totentanz, swarm piper

name: Scream Puff
text: Too much sugar is bad for your health.

name: Spiteful Hexmage
text: "Who'll never amount to anything now, Father?"

name: Dutiful Griffin
text: She stayed by her master's side, leaving only to hunt. She would guard him until he woke, however long it took.

name: Sugar Rush
text:
"I smell frosting. Ready your weapons!"
—Greta, Scourge of Sweettooth

name: Sweettooth Witch
text: "Try some pie! Your brother helped make it, and he really poured his heart into it."

name: Taken by Nightmares
text: Dying in your sleep is never peaceful when Ashiok is involved.

name: Tangled Colony
text: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

name: Voracious Vermin
text: Lord Skitter promised the starving rats of Edgewall that they would never go hungry again.

name: Warehouse Tabby
text: For every rat she kills, ten more take its place.

name: Wicked Visitor
text: Amalgamations of many childhood nightmares stalked the realm of dreams, feeding on the collective terror of all those trapped in the Wicked Slumber.

name: Eerie Interference
text: Ranks of sleeping Ardenvale knights filled Eriette's throne room, ready to defend their witch-queen with unthinking devotion.

name: Bellowing Bruiser
text: You can't give an ogre the runaround.

name: Boundary Lands Ranger
text: "You only find out who was hunting who when one of you is dead."

name: Edgewall Pack
text: The mayor sent hounds to root out Lord Skitter, but their loyalty was easily bought with a handful of bones.

name: Flick a Coin
text: "From here, hit the antique gong, ricochet off the suit of armor, and get Gunrudd on the nose? Is that all?"

name: Food Fight
text: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

name: Expel the Interlopers
text: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

name: Frantic Firebolt
text: Johann's conjecture about draconic fire dispelling rainwater elementals proved to be correct. Now he just needed a way to dispel draconic fire.

name: Gnawing Crescendo
text: Totentanz's song had no lyrics, but the rats understood it nonetheless. "You own this land," it said. "You deserve to feast."

name: Grand Ball Guest
text: It takes a lot to pull a master blacksmith from their work, but Maurice couldn't pass up an invitation to a lavish Delverhaugh feast.

name: Harried Spearguard
text: "Why're you vermin so daft? This is a warehouse full of bricks. BRICKS! You can't eat bricks."

name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
text: "The realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king."

name: Kindled Heroism
text: Even in the grip of Hylda's unnatural cold, something in Kellan felt bright as spring, something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light.

name: Frostbridge Guard
text: The sentry watched impassively, its spear unmoving. One by one, the would-be adventurers stumbled and fell, frostbitten, to the ground.

name: Minecart Daredevil
text: Mines that once rang with the strikes of pickaxes now echo with shouts of reckless glee.

name: Monstrous Rage
text:
"My, what big paws y—"
—Thomas the woodsman, last words

name: Ratcatcher Trainee
text: "Where do they keep coming from?!"

name: Redcap Thief
text: "Shiny is best. Then sharp. Sharp is good. Anything else is basically trash."

name: Skewer Slinger
text: One way or another, dwarven meals end up in someone's stomach.

name: Gallant Pie-Wielder
text: "Time for your just desserts, redcap scum!"

name: Song of Totentanz
text: Townsfolk tapped their feet and hummed along, unwittingly amplifying the tune that would summon their doom.

name: Tattered Ratter
text: "What's that, Snappers? Yes, you're right! It *was* very rude of the innkeeper to throw us out!"

name: Two-Headed Hunter
text: "I point, you club!"

name: Unruly Catapult
text: An autonomous, self-loading catapult had seemed like such a good idea.

name: Witchstalker Frenzy
text: The witchstalkers circled the armored figure, drawn to the corrupting stink of dark magic. Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.

name: Glass Casket
text: While Neva's mind wandered the realm of dreams, her body lay protected as mages worked frantically to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

name: Beanstalk Wurm
text: When Beluna's pets escape Stormkeld, villages fall and new Everstalks rise.

name: Bestial Bloodline
text: "There is a fierce joy in losing yourself to savagery, and a bitter pain in regaining your senses afterward. You could never understand."

name: Commune with Nature
text: Agatha befriended the beasts of the wilds, and under her influence they grew bolder ... and more savage. Some herbivores developed a taste for flesh.

name: Ferocious Werefox
text: Each night, the elves of Redtooth Keep transform into feral, monstrous beasts.

name: Graceful Takedown
text: The fauns of the Tanglespan are adept at using the precarious environment against larger opponents.

name: Howling Galefang
text:
"I have to hand it to you, Yorvo. Since your pet showed up, not a single smallfolk has even made it to the door of my vault."
—Beluna Grandsquall

name: Leaping Ambush
text: Witchstalkers have extremely powerful legs—all the better to reach you with.

name: Redtooth Genealogist
text: Some family trees are thornier than others.

name: Kellan's Lightblades
text: Kellan struck out on pure instinct, and his conjured blades cleaved through the icy guardians as though they were nothing but air.

name: Redtooth Vanguard
text: "I'm just as deadly during the day."

name: Rootrider Faun
text: "Human feet aren't inferior to hooves for climbing. It's their plodding, mistrustful personalities that hold them back."

name: Royal Treatment
text: "Stay your blades, peasants."

name: Skybeast Tracker
text: Cloud eaters, heaven tillers, beanstalk wurms—he favors prey worthy of a giant's appetite.

name: Spider Food
text: To the giant spiders of Dunbarrow, there's little difference between fly and faerie.

name: Stormkeld Vanguard
text: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

name: Tanglespan Lookout
text: "The trolls have your scent, traveler. Hurry on, and let me take care of them."

name: Knight of Doves
text: So many birds, yet the air was still and empty of song. Part of Syr Damon knew something wasn't right, but it was a far-off worry, unimportant and soon forgotten.

name: Titanic Growth
text: "Looks like you need a bigger net, mister fae-catcher."

name: Toadstool Admirer
text: Where an ouphe makes its home, the land blooms with color and joy.

name: Troublemaker Ouphe
text: Heavy is the head that wears the vase.

name: Up the Beanstalk
text:
"It's not so bad. All you have to do is keep from looking down."
—Troyan, to Kellan and Ruby

name: Verdant Outrider
text: Some knights who survived the invasion have forsaken what remains of their courts. The newly formed Verdant Order has sworn to defend the last untouched parts of the wilds.

name: Archon's Glory
text: A winged dawn dispels the terrors of night.

name: Moment of Valor
text: Hardened by the Phyrexian invasion, Will's knights starved the nightmares of the thing they craved most: fear.

name: Ash, Party Crasher
text: "Get up and dance! Let your feet thunder like forgehammers!"

name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
text: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

name: Johann, Apprentice Sorcerer
text: "Okay. First I'll calm the elementals. Then I'll put out the fire. Then I'll unflood the basement. Then I'll do the chores *myself*."

name: Moonshaker Cavalry
text: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.

name: Obyra, Dreaming Duelist
text: Obyra sleepwalks through the wilds, hunting for worthy opponents.

name: Rowan, Scion of War
text: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

name: Ruby, Daring Tracker
text: Neither the sharpest thorns nor the foulest beasts would stop her from finding her brother.

name: Totentanz, Swarm Piper
text: Among the rats, he found the acceptance the human world never gave him.

name: Troyan, Gutsy Explorer
text: "The streets of Ravnica were stifling. Eldraine is an endless adventure paved in gold."

name: Will, Scion of Peace
text: "It's easy to cry 'For glory!' and charge those who disagree with you. But it takes finesse to turn enemies into allies rather than corpses."

name: Yenna, Redtooth Regent
text: "My people are both bloom and thorn."

name: Plunge into Winter
text: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill. Others weren't so lucky.

name: Heartflame Duelist
text: "The fire of Embereth will never be doused!"

name: Pollen-Shield Hare
text: She can drive off any threat, from owl to hunter to Phyrexian monster.

name: Threadbind Clique
text: Giggles of delight may be the last thing you hear.

name: Twining Twins
text: "We spin and spin to keep us busy, but somehow you're the one who's dizzy."

name: Woodland Acolyte
text: He left knighthood behind to heal the scars of the invasion.

name: Candy Trail
text:
"Look! Another one! Who cares what Mother said? We'll be home before she gets back."
—Daniela, Edgewall youth

name: Collector's Vault
text: Beluna makes a habit of "liberating" valuables from the world below, from priceless artifacts to historic buildings.

name: Gingerbrute
text: Sometimes, "as fast as you can" isn't quite fast enough.

name: Hylda's Crown of Winter
text: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.

name: Prophetic Prism
text:
"Most dreams reveal but fragments of what you could be. Only nightmares can show you who you truly are."
—Ashiok

name: Regal Bunnicorn
text:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

name: Scarecrow Guide
text:
"You're doing a splendid job, my noble stitched friend. Not a single bird has attacked us!"
—Troyan

name: Crystal Grotto
text: What little light filters down through frost and fathoms is refracted into a million rainbow shards.

name: Evolving Wilds
text:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

name: Rimefur Reindeer
text: Attracted by the quiet of Hylda's realm, reindeer herds moved in and made themselves at home near the palace of ice.

name: Savior of the Sleeping
text: Even lost in slumber, the citizens of Ardenvale dream of a tireless protector standing guard over their homes.

name: Slumbering Keepguard
text: Dreams of a realm united gave him strength even in sleep.

name: Armory Mice
text: They help ensure that the forges of the dwarves are always squeaky clean.

name: Food Coma
text:
"Busy as a bumblesheep"
—Faerie expression meaning "asleep"

name: Pests of Honor
text: They dash—then dine.

name: Rowdy Research
text:
"Stolen treasures can be reclaimed, but stolen knowledge is yours forever."
—Alela

name: Storyteller Pixie
text: After the royal nanny had finished his dull, droning recital of the prince and princess's bedtime story, their secret friend emerged and the real story began.

name: Malevolent Witchkite
text:
"Was there a fearsome witch around here? Or was it a cruel dragon? The tales were confu—oh no."
—Osval, adventurer

name: Charging Hooligan
text: "Soon the rats are gonna run this town, so I'm gonna run with them!"

name: Stockpiling Celebrant
text: "What? I'm saving it for later."

name: Wildwood Mentor
text: "Not bad. If only you had branches."

name: Stroke of Midnight
text: The assembled partygoers fell silent and stared. As the helmet came to a clattering stop, the only sound was Ash's distant footsteps.

name: A Tale for the Ages
text: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger. But the core story stayed the same, and people remembered what happens to those who prey on the weak.

name: Tuinvale Guide
text: "Weary traveler, follow me. The night is a cage, and my light is the key."

name: Unassuming Sage
text: "The archmage Valya? Why yes, I do believe I've heard of her."

name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
text: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

name: Besotted Knight
text: "You are no monster to me, my love."

name: Archive Dragon
text: "Fascinating. It says here that dragons cannot read."

name: Beluna's Gatekeeper
text: "And what makes you think Lady Grandsquall wants to see *you*, little one?"

name: Chancellor of Tales
text: "...so the knight stabbed the troll, the troll threw the knight off the bridge, and they both forgot about the sword."

name: Disdainful Stroke
text: In retrospect, using storm magic against a storm giant was not the wisest strategy.

name: Break the Spell
text: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

name: Freeze in Place
text:
"I'm getting the sense we shouldn't expect a warm welcome."
—Kellan

name: Ice Out
text: Hylda built an ice statuary from all those who couldn't understand "go away."

name: Into the Fae Court
text: Kellan stepped from his village into a strange world where trees bore jeweled fruit. A regal, inhuman voice rang in his ears: "Tell me, brave hero, are you true of heart?"

name: Johann's Stopgap
text: "Just ... stay in there ... for one ... second!"

name: Merfolk Coralsmith
text: "Wooden swords rot. Steel axes rust. But coral only grows."

name: Misleading Motes
text: Yarvis was almost certain he'd seen the same tree an hour ago, but then again, didn't all trees look alike? He shelved his doubts and followed the friendly, twinkling motes deeper into the forest.

name: Mocking Sprite
text: "Look at me, everyone! I'm a High Fae! Watch me do important High Fae things!"

name: Obyra's Attendants
text: Obyra's devoted servants shrieked as their sleeping mistress slashed at them, unseeing.

name: Picklock Prankster
text: You can't cage mischief.

name: Quick Study
text: At first, Johann was annoyed that the library had decided to reorganize itself. But he had to admit that storing the cookbooks in the cauldron made a certain kind of sense.

name: Sleight of Hand
text: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.

name: Spell Stutter
text: "You are but learning to walk in a world where I fly, mortal."

name: Cheeky House-Mouse
text: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

name: Stormkeld Prowler
text: To the giants, it was one little gem among thousands. But to Kylene, it was a haul that would feed her family for years.

name: Succumb to the Cold
text:
"I've never known cold like it. It burned like fire and bit like an adder's fangs. Call me a coward if you wish, but I won't go back there."
—Syr Lydel, knight of Vantress

name: Talion's Messenger
text: "The Kindly Lord does not issue invitations to their court lightly. I suggest you accept."

name: Tenacious Tomeseeker
text: "An intact volume of *Tales of the Fae*? The king will be pleased."

name: Vantress Transmuter
text: "My orders were to capture you alive. They didn't specify in what form."

name: Water Wings
text: Luckily for the plummeting Johann, the hydroloft spell was one he had actually mastered.

name: Ashiok's Reaper
text: Neva's dreams were haunted by memories of the invasion—oil-black tendrils grasping at her through the mist. Or . . . was this something new?

name: Cooped Up
text:
"Cold iron's all you need to hold a faerie. The charms are mostly decorative."
—Eulyn, Edgewall peddler

name: Barrow Naughty
text: "The difference between mischief and malice? Numbers."

name: Candy Grapple
text: "Don't you mean 'poisonous'? There's no such thing as a venomous—AGGHHH!"

name: Conceited Witch
text: She wasn't much for self-reflection.

name: Dream Spoilers
text: The Wicked Slumber saved Eldraine from Phyrexia's grasp, but instead of fading when the invasion ended, it continued to spread.

name: Ego Drain
text: "You've wasted your life. Let's see if I can do any better with it."

name: Cursed Courtier
text: It was the first and last time anyone attempted to levy a tax on the witches of Dunbarrow.

name: Faerie Fencing
text: Even in the grip of the Wicked Slumber, the High Fae princess Obyra is a blademaster of unrivaled skill.

name: Feed the Cauldron
text: Kellan heard Agatha howl when he slammed into her, heard her scream as she fell into the cauldron, but couldn't afford to think about the implications just yet.

name: Lich-Knights' Conquest
text: In their rotting minds, they still quest for virtue and glory.

name: Blind Obedience
text:
"Oaths are naught but empty air. Take what measures you must to ensure absolute loyalty."
—*The Witch's Way*

name: Leyline of Sanctity
text:
"An enchanted glade revealed itself, offering safety in its warm embrace. Still she walked on."
—*The Nameless Knight of Summer*

name: Phyrexian Unlife
text:
"While the realm's great minds quarreled over the strange eclipse, Locthwain fell to the invaders."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

name: Rest in Peace
text:
"The king ordered those lost in sleep be placed in glass caskets, protected and watched in case they might one day wake."
—*The Wicked Slumber*

name: Smothering Tithe
text:
"They laughed with glee as the pixie spun gold from straw. They smiled and shrugged when their curtains and clothes were next on the wheel. Then he grabbed their hair."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

name: Compulsion
text:
"O my love, would that you could understand!
Adventure beckons; I must take its hand."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"

name: Copy Enchantment
text:
"'I don't need anyone else', muttered Hylda. 'You don't need anyone else,' her reflection agreed."
—Witch of Winter

name: Curiosity
text:
"Valtry gasped. The strange new coral was not coral at all, but a fallen drywalker! But how did it get to the bottom of Loch Larent?"
—*The Merfolk Who Walked*

name: Forced Fruition
text:
"'My kingdom for a feast!' quoth the king. A faerie appeared before him, and spoke through a wicked grin: 'As you wish.'"
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Fraying Sanity
text:
"I saw my mind stretch like cloth on a loom,
Warping, twisting toward a deathless doom."
—*A Traveler's Trials*

name: Dawn of Hope
text:
"She was the rising sun, her courage banishing the terrors of the night."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

name: Hatching Plans
text:
"The thief fled with her ill-gotten prize, her mind awhirl with visions of wealth and glory. In her pack, unnoticed, the egg began to stir and crack."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Intruder Alarm
text:
"The dark forest lit up with a thousand eyes, and for the first time, Jurald considered that the High Fae might be more than myth."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Kindred Discovery
text:
"The towers were like a song on the night breeze, faint and lovely, calling her home."
—*A Quickling's Journey*

name: Leyline of Anticipation
text:
"A glowing spring appeared before her, promising untold wisdom. Still she walked on."
—*The Nameless Knight of Summer*

name: Omniscience
text:
"They are led by Talion, the Kindly Lord,
First and Greatest of the High Fae,
Sovereign of the Court, the Liege of Laughter,
Finder of the First Yew, and the One True Lord of Eldraine."
—*On the High Fae*

name: Rhystic Study
text:
"Despite her father's warnings, Valtry's fascination with the surface only grew. She collected things that fell to the bottom, daydreaming of life on land."
—*The Merfolk Who Walked*

name: Spreading Seas
text:
"Hasty efforts to defend Castle Vantress left it more moat than castle."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

name: Bitterblossom
text:
"Tarry not in Tuinvale,
Ignore the flowers' heady scents.
Take no thing, stay to the trail,
Lest the fae seek recompense."
—*To Walk the Wilds*

name: Dark Tutelage
text:
"Ours is a path of the outcast, of pain given and pain received. But for the strong, it is a path that leads to power untethered from fae riddles."
—*The Witch's Way*

name: Grave Pact
text:
"'Fools,' sneered the witch. 'I never intended to leave here alive. And thanks to your dogged insistence on following me, neither will you.'"
—*Hexes of Dunbarrow*

name: Grasp of Fate
text:
"The witch wrapped her heart in briar vines, hid it away in the ancient keep in the depths of the forest. If none could find it, the prophecy could never come to pass."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

name: Leyline of the Void
text:
"Malevolent lights pulsed around her, whispering of riches in the dark. Still she walked on."
—*The Nameless Knight of Summer*

name: Oppression
text:
"'The human world will fall,' whispered the monstrous rat. 'You have but one choice to make: Will you fall with it?'"
—*Song of the Vermin*

name: Oversold Cemetery
text:
"'Get out! Get out!' the dead screamed.
'We've not room for one more! Get out!'"
—*Hexes of Dunbarrow*

name: Polluted Bonds
text:
"'Twas the cruelest of ironies: the realm, in desperate need of rest, gripped by endless sleep that offered no comfort."
—*The Wicked Slumber*

name: Sanguine Bond
text:
"The witch smiled, savoring every stolen year. Every love the knight would never court, every meal he'd never taste, every honor he'd never win, was sweet as honey on her tongue."
—*Hexes of Dunbarrow*

name: Stab Wound
text:
"What first seemed like a ridiculous and vaguely demeaning task quickly turned into a vicious struggle for survival."
—*Welcome to Sweettooth*

name: Vampiric Rites
text:
"Should prying eyes observe the ritual, seize them for the cauldron, and soak the altar with the blood of the witness."
—The Witch's Way

name: Aggravated Assault
text:
"The knights of Embereth fought with the fire of the Irencrag in their hearts. Though many fell, not a single one retreated."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

name: Greater Auramancy
text:
"The hunter drew her dagger and found she grasped a flower. She reached for an arrow, but her quiver held only leaves."
—*Tales of the Fae*

name: Blood Moon
text:
"The wyrm's dread eye upon the land
was turned.
And all its people bent the knee—
or burned."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"

name: Dragon Mantle
text:
"With reckless courage, Cade embraced the flame.
He vowed they wouldn't dare forget his name."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"

name: Fiery Emancipation
text:
"Mighty Torbran struck the invading phalanx like a bolt from the heavens. When the light faded, only ash remained around him."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

name: Goblin Bombardment
text:
"What redcaps lack in strategic acumen they more than make up for with brazen audacity."
—*The Kenriths' Royal Bestiary*

name: Impact Tremors
text:
"With tears in his smoke-scorched eyes, he watched the living flames consume the only home he'd ever known."
—*The Apprentice's Folly*

name: Mana Flare
text:
"I give my heart to the mountain, my memories to the wind. Let my last moment be burned into history."
—*Daughters of Flame*

name: Raid Bombardment
text:
"For slaying dozens of redcaps using only fruit and cakes, the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers."
—*Assault on Delverhaugh*

name: Repercussion
text:
"Tugrunn threw blow after blow, howling with pain as his fist met solid rock. The creature merely stared quizzically at him, unsure when the fight would start."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

name: Shared Animosity
text:
"The feud between dwarves and redcaps had raged for so long that no one could quite recall how it started. Few would believe it was sparked by a long-ago dispute over a spoon."
—*Assault on Delverhaugh*

name: Griffin Aerie
text:
"Davin's heart swelled with a heady mix of excitement and fear. If the young griffin accepted him, he would begin his path to knighthood."
—*Skies of Ardenvale*

name: Sneak Attack
text:
"Korlag carefully prepared to try the new 'am bush' strategy he'd heard about."
—*The Ogre's Revenge*

name: Defense of the Heart
text:
"And as the rose began to bloom, the curse of Redtooth Keep began, at last, to wither."
—*Curse of the Werefox*

name: Ground Seal
text:
"They laid her to rest in the wilds, in a sacred place beyond the reach of nightmares or machines."
—*The Nameless Knight of Summer*

name: Hardened Scales
text:
"Before me writhed the guardian of my prize,
A serpent with stone skin and cunning eyes!"
—*A Traveler's Trials*

name: Nature's Will
text:
"The troll took the fauns' hesitation as fear and roared in triumph. In truth, they'd seen the ledge begin to crack beneath his weight."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

name: Parallel Lives
text:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—*Curse of the Werefox*

name: Intangible Virtue
text:
"Find glory not in blood, nor dragons felled.
But in kindness given, oaths upheld."
—"The Scholar & the Knight"

name: Prismatic Omen
text:
"There would be time later to mourn the lost, to weep for their fallen homes and lost treasures. But for now, they breathed in the untainted air and allowed themselves to hope again."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

name: Unnatural Growth
text:
"Should you hear witchstalkers howl,
Best to hide or run away.
They hunt witches vile and foul.
Fear both predator and prey."
—*To Walk the Wilds*

name: Karmic Justice
text:
"I have wronged your family on a fool's errand. All I can offer is myself, that you might take your revenge."
—*The Folly of Syr Perrin*

name: Land Tax
text:
"'That town is rudely blocking my view!' said the witch. The giant bowed and smiled."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

name: Abeyance
text:
"I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Benalish Missionary
text:
"These horn-haters say no gods but theirs exist. I say let him find out for himself—right now!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Firestorm
text:
"Glok loved storms! He'd sit an' watch an' laugh through the whole thing. I miss him."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Fit of Rage
text:
"Anger is fleeting; remorse is eternal."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Goblin Grenadiers
text: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

name: Heat Stroke
text:
"Stroke of heat or stroke of blade. Choose your fate, traitor."
—Maraxus of Keld, to Starke

name: Hurloon Shaman
text:
"I believe it when they say they're connected to the land—looks like somebody plowed her face."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Lava Hounds
text:
What cats bury, dogs eat.
—Urborg aphorism

name: Debt of Loyalty
text: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

name: Lava Storm
text: They say lava conquers all.

name: Maraxus of Keld
text:
"I have no master. I am chaos."
—Maraxus of Keld

name: Orcish Settlers
text: They wouldn't know their house from a charred hole in the ground.

name: Sawtooth Ogre
text: "You will sharpen your teeth on my enemies' bones," Maraxus promised them, and his ogres cheered.

name: Thunderbolt
text:
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Thundermare
text: Its hooves strike lightning and the thunder follows quickly after.

name: Aboroth
text: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider. "My bet's on the dirt," Gerrard said flatly.

name: Arctic Wolves
text:
"No matter where we cat warriors go in the world, those stupid slobberers find us."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Duskrider Falcon
text:
"Seaborne ships have their dolphins to dance in their wakes; I have my duskriders."
—Sisay, journal

name: Blossoming Wreath
text:
"I place this wreath for you, my kin. Even in death, you give me strength to avenge you."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Briar Shield
text: In all its forms, the forest is the elves' best protector.

name: Call of the Wild
text: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

name: Dense Foliage
text:
"Big plants not only good for hidin', but full o' tasty bugs, too."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

name: Fallow Wurm
text:
The wurm's wake
—Elvish expression meaning "ruined crops"

name: Familiar Ground
text:
"I'd rather fight on foreign soil. That way, if I lose I can blame it on the terrain."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Fungus Elemental
text:
I rot growth and grow rot. What am I?
—Elvish riddle

name: Empyrial Armor
text:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

name: Harvest Wurm
text:
The wurm's weave
—Elvish expression meaning "plowed fields"

name: Llanowar Behemoth
text:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Llanowar Druid
text:
"This forest means more to the druids than their own kin. The loss of a tree is like the loss of a child."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Llanowar Sentinel
text:
"The forest has as many eyes as leaves."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Mwonvuli Ooze
text: "Ewww!"

name: Nature's Kiss
text:
I cradle my rage even as the earth cradles my dead kin.
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Nature's Resurgence
text:
Spring follows winter
—Elvish expression meaning "all things pass"

name: Redwood Treefolk
text:
"In the heart of Llanowar the magic is so strong that trees cannot stay rooted."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Rogue Elephant
text:
"When are trees like grass?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

name: Foriysian Brigade
text:
"A double-edged sword lets you cut down your enemies with the backswing as well."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Striped Bears
text:
"The bear is never cautious—which is why it wasn't born a human."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Tranquil Grove
text:
"Even the fiercest storm has a peaceful eye."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Uktabi Efreet
text:
"The Uktabi efreet and I have something in common: both of our mothers wanted to give us back."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Vitalize
text:
"After waking to the magic of Llanowar, no dreams can compare."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Bubble Matrix
text:
"This device was commisioned by a king who desired peace. Unfortunately, the royal artificer was also the king's jester."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Dingus Staff
text:
"A sharp conscience is the weapon of the soul."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Gerrard's Wisdom
text:
"Fighting without an army is called a duel, and you'll lose a duel if your enemy comes expecting a war."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Jangling Automaton
text:
"We always look upon our first creations as masterpieces, no matter how awful they are."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Null Rod
text:
Gerrard: "But it doesn't *do* anything!"
Hanna: "No—it *does* nothing."

name: Serrated Biskelion
text:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Steel Golem
text:
"Although I would give my life to protect Gerrard, my conscience will not let me take another's. There are many who would not hesitate."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Straw Golem
text:
"Don't look at me. *I* didn't build it."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Thran Forge
text: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

name: Guided Strike
text:
"If you can kill your enemy with the first stroke, you save yourself the labor of the second."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Thran Tome
text: Every line holds a tale, and between lie a thousand more.

name: Touchstone
text:
"One touch to the stone and the sidar's son turned me from stalwart to statue."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Xanthic Statue
text:
"Until you have lived as a statue, do not talk to me of pigeons."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Lotus Vale
text: At what price beauty?

name: Heavy Ballista
text:
"Archers, ballistae—you can't even get near the island of Avenant."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Inner Sanctum
text: "Save me from Maraxus," Starke pleaded, "or condemn me to his wrath. Either way, do not ignore me!"

name: Master of Arms
text:
"Being the best usually means proving it to everyone."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Peacekeeper
text:
"I have always imagined my mother as such a woman, strong and wise."
—Sisay, journal

name: Revered Unicorn
text:
"I felt unworthy even to dream of it."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Serenity
text:
"Just think of me as the storm before the calm."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Serra's Blessing
text:
"I have seen your strength imbued in angels' wings, and I have felt your sorrow rain down on the ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Soul Shepherd
text:
"The sidar who raised me had a saying: 'The first step into death is the hardest.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Southern Paladin
text:
"Look to the south; there you will find peace and serenity."
—*The Book of Tal*

name: Volunteer Reserves
text:
"I'm always a little leery of anyone who offers to kill other people for free."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Alms
text:
"Helping people is mostly a matter of teaching them to help themselves."
—Sisay, journal

name: Abjure
text: Mirri's hackles rose as Ertai continued expounding his virtues. "If that arrogant brat doesn't shut up soon," she growled to herself, "I'm going to have to kill him."

name: Argivian Restoration
text:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

name: Avizoa
text: "Maybe we can trap them with bait," thought Tahngarth, eyeing Squee.

name: Cloud Djinn
text:
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

name: Disrupt
text: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

name: Flux
text:
"Every spell has the potential to be worthless."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Fog Elemental
text:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Mana Chains
text:
"The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."
—Sisay, journal

name: Merfolk Traders
text:
"As much as I hate water, I *do* love fish . . . ."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Paradigm Shift
text:
"Barrin always said that reality is relative. 'The world,' he cautioned, 'is but pieces of one's perception.'"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Pendrell Mists
text: As insubstantial—and as insistent—as appetite.

name: Phantom Warrior
text:
"Fishtails infest the water, and mists walk the land. Give me simple solid rock any day."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Phantom Wings
text: "But you *said* 'when goats fly!'" Squee whined.

name: Ardent Militia
text:
"While the rest of us got paid to serve the Benalish army, the militia didn't. I used to say they stood for freedom—free *and* dumb."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Psychic Vortex
text:
"Tolaria floats upon a wheel of fortune."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Relearn
text:
"Barrin taught me that the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Sage Owl
text: The owl asks but never answers.

name: Teferi's Veil
text:
"I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Timid Drake
text:
"I sneezed, and it bolted."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Tolarian Drake
text: Many have been lost just in staring at its wings. What's seen differs from account to account, but madness is always part of the story.

name: Tolarian Entrancer
text:
"Why should I boast? The bards will do it for me—and with music."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Tolarian Serpent
text:
"When the fishtails' threats of magic didn't move me, they set their pet on us."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Vodalian Illusionist
text:
"Torahn gore these shifty fishtails! You can't even get close to one."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

name: Abyssal Gatekeeper
text:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Argivian Find
text:
"We often bury our pasts, and then someone comes along and digs them up."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Agonizing Memories
text:
"An innocent man died because of my anger. That knowledge will haunt me for all eternity."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Barrow Ghoul
text:
"They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."
—Crovax

name: Buried Alive
text:
"Is it worse to walk while dead, or to be buried alive? I have witnessed both."
—Crovax

name: Coils of the Medusa
text: Serpentine locks shape ornate rocks.

name: Fatal Blow
text:
"What is crueler? To let a wound of the heart fester, or to simply cut it out?"
—Crovax

name: Fledgling Djinn
text:
"The young can be quite dangerous. Trust me, I should know."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Gallowbraid
text:
"If its skin looks like stone, it is only to match its heart."
—Crovax

name: Haunting Misery
text:
"I am condemned without end."
—Crovax

name: Hidden Horror
text: Lifespans are measured by its dreadful length.

name: Infernal Tribute
text:
"I would not barter my soul for any of the filth that they called power. So they took it from me and damned me to solitude."
—Crovax

name: Mischievous Poltergeist
text:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Morinfen
text:
"I looked into its eyes, and its soul was so empty I saw no reflection, no light there."
—Crovax

name: Necratog
text: The necratog can always dig up a meal.

name: Odylic Wraith
text: By the time you've seen it, you won't remember that you did.

name: Razortooth Rats
text:
"Men and rats both hunger: we for our playthings; they, for us."
—Crovax

name: Shadow Rider
text: In its world of complete darkness, it has no shadows to fear.

name: Benalish Infantry
text:
"My favorite part of getting into the infantry was getting out again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Shattered Crypt
text:
"You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."
—Crovax

name: Strands of Night
text:
"I have seen the night torn into thin darkling strips and woven into shapes too bleak for dreams."
—Crovax

name: Tendrils of Despair
text:
"Because I am incapable of tears does not mean I have no need to shed them."
—Karn, silver golem

name: Urborg Justice
text:
"It is a narrow line between justice and vengeance."
—Crovax

name: Urborg Stalker
text:
"May you be a stalker's dream."
—Urborg curse

name: Wave of Terror
text: The sea of fear has endless depths.

name: Zombie Scavengers
text:
"Pick a shell upon my shore and put it to your ear. That sound isn't the sea, but the whispers of the fallen."
—Crovax

name: Aether Flash
text:
"You can't get there from here. Well, you *can*—it just won't be fun."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Benalish Knight
text:
"We called them 'armored lightning.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

name: Bloodrock Cyclops
text:
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

name: Bogardan Firefiend
text:
"The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

name: Boiling Blood
text:
Your father has no horns!
Your mother wears a bell!
You drink the milk of goats!
—Talruum taunts

name: Cinder Giant
text:
"The giant wept tears of embers for the deaths of his allies."
—Azeworai, "The Lonely Giant"

name: Cinder Wall
text:
"Easy. All ya gotta do is push somebody into it."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

name: Cone of Flame
text:
"Mine is not the warmth of compassion."
—Ertai, wizard adept

name: Dwarven Berserker
text: "I may be small, but I can kick *your* butt."

name: Fervor
text:
"If your blood doesn't run hot, I will make it run in the sands!"
—Maraxus of Keld

name: Kitesail Apprentice
text: Carving lines through the sky, kite sailors map trails for the pilgrims below to follow.

name: Feral Contest
text: The instinct for survival makes enemies of all.

name: Grappler Spider
text: Creatures of the air wisely avoid the darkest regions of Guul Draz—which is why grappler spiders inhabit the few places touched by the sun's rays.

name: Graypelt Hunter
text: He'll cleave wood and bone alike to carve a path for his allies.

name: Groundswell
text: "This world will not be tamed."

name: Harabaz Druid
text: "I care nothing for treasure. The land beckons me, and I cannot rest until my feet have touched every inch of it."

name: Leatherback Baloth
text: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

name: Nature's Claim
text:
"On this plane, the use of magic can provoke a ferocious reprisal from nature. Whoever the Eldrazi were, their relics left Zendikar forever enraged."
—Jace Beleren

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
text: It gathers against the coming storm.

name: Kor Firewalker
text: "A river of lava is just another river to cross."

name: Slingbow Trap
text: The Tajuru elves devised ways to let the forest defend itself.

name: Snapping Creeper
text: Its vast network of roots and vines keeps it aware of distant dangers.

name: Summit Apes
text:
"If you climb Skyfang Peak, avoid the pass. Generations of apes made that trail, and they don't tolerate trespassers."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Vastwood Animist
text: He calls on the forests for counsel and summons the earth to his cause.

name: Novablast Wurm
text:
"The sun was born within its coils, but it fled to the sky. The wurm hungers for its child, and the world will bear its loss."
—Screed of the Mul Daya

name: Amulet of Vigor
text:
"After years of study, I've learned an important lesson: the relics we watch may be watching us back."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Basilisk Collar
text: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

name: Hammer of Ruin
text: By hammer forged, and by hammer undone.

name: Hedron Rover
text:
"Now that it has woken up and wandered off, we should go see what it was guarding."
—Gotzen, Bulwark explorer

name: Kitesail
text: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

name: Lodestone Golem
text:
"Somehow it warps the Æther. It brings a strange weight, a blockade in the flow of spellcraft."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Pilgrim's Eye
text: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

name: Razor Boomerang
text: Few can catch it without losing a finger.

name: Loam Lion
text: In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Walking Atlas
text: Crafted by lullmages and bound to the land, it alters itself to match the tumultuous terrain.

name: Dread Statuary
text: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

name: Eye of Ugin
text: An eye closes. A race awakens.

name: Marsh Threader
text: "Give me a sturdy rope over the advice of any so-called expert. I can thread the dark wilds better than anyone."

name: Quicksand
text: Not all deaths are etched with mythic meaning and iconic glory.

name: Tectonic Edge
text:
"We move because the earth does."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Perimeter Captain
text: "We stand between the jaws of chaos and the mantle of order."

name: Rest for the Weary
text: Zendikar is a brutal taskmaster, but sometimes it offers unexpected solace.

name: Ruin Ghost
text: The Forsaken Ones haunt the ruins that flicker in and out of the spirit realm. Such sites are hard to find and even harder to loot.

name: Talus Paladin
text: "Why fill pockets with gold when you can fill hearts with conviction?"

name: Terra Eternal
text:
"If this world could make a wish, it would be to survive the parasites who loot its treasures and threaten its life force."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Veteran's Reflexes
text: "Assume everything wants to kill you. At the very least, assume everything wants what's in your pack."

name: Aether Tradewinds
text:
"The wind smells of misfortune. Check your knots."
—Anitan, Ondu cleric

name: Dispel
text: The Jwari winds undo reality as easily as they scatter a pile of leaves.

name: Goliath Sphinx
text: He makes his home on the tallest mountain in Sejiri, where the vista is as endless as his patience.

name: Archon of Redemption
text: Until Emeria is freed, he raises his sword in her name.

name: Horizon Drake
text: Using thermal updrafts and gravity currents, drakes eat and sleep in the air. Some never touch the ground from birth until death.

name: Jwari Shapeshifter
text: "The best expedition would be an entire team of me."

name: Mysteries of the Deep
text:
"The Roil is destructive, but not random. It's Zendikar's way of revealing secrets."
—Ilori, merfolk falconer

name: Selective Memory
text:
"I of all people know that memory is not a safe place to hide valuables."
—Jace Beleren

name: Surrakar Banisher
text: Surrakar grab things they *don't* want.

name: Battle Hurda
text:
"Murasan hurdas were too aggressive to tolerate a harness, so we put them on guard duty. Now the bandits can't get within spitting distance of us."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Tideforce Elemental
text: Ebb and flow, high tide and low, quick as sand and just as slow.

name: Treasure Hunt
text:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

name: Twitch
text:
"The flow is diverted. Your path is clear. What are you waiting for—the cave to bid you welcome?"
—Maizah Shere, Tazeem lullmage

name: Abyssal Persecutor
text: His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.

name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
text: "So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar."

name: Fledgling Griffin
text:
"We're making progress, but its desire to explore still far exceeds its ability."
—Amadi, Halimar griffin-master

name: Bojuka Brigand
text: "I don't do tactics. I don't do guard duty. I do damage. Take it or leave it."

name: Brink of Disaster
text:
"You always have a choice. That doesn't mean you always have a good choice."
—Alubri, Guul Draz gatekeeper

name: Butcher of Malakir
text: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

name: Caustic Crawler
text: Novice explorers can mistake the acid-carved stone lairs for ancient ruins. They rarely survive to learn better.

name: Dead Reckoning
text: Many venture out to hunt for treasures. Others lie in wait to hunt the hunters.

name: Death's Shadow
text: The shadow of the candle looms tall even as its light grows dim.

name: Jagwasp Swarm
text:
"You know how to tell a sapling explorer from an old hardhead? See which one mistakes a swarm of jagwasps for the setting sun."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Kalastria Highborn
text: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

name: Mire's Toll
text: As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.

name: Pulse Tracker
text: Pulse trackers terrorize adventurers, driving them through the jungle toward certain death at the gates of Malakir.

name: Ruthless Cullblade
text: She wields a blade as bloodthirsty and elegant as herself.

name: Shoreline Salvager
text:
"They search for treasures that wash up from the depths. Tracking one could lead you to riches. Or in circles."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Smother
text:
"Before I hire new recruits, I test how long they can hold their breath. You'd be surprised how often it comes up."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Hada Freeblade
text: "I toiled in Kazuul's mines when I was eight. I think I'm tough enough for a little hiking."

name: Bazaar Trader
text: "No need for a hurda? How about these maps to recently discovered tombs? Or these vials of invisible potion? Very fancy . . ."

name: Bull Rush
text: "It's gone mad! Loose the chains and save what you can!"

name: Chain Reaction
text:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

name: Claws of Valakut
text: "Swords may sunder. Shields may fail. My will is stronger than steel, and my flesh and bone far more deadly."

name: Cosi's Ravager
text:
"Cosi has many followers. Even the volcano finds a way to do his bidding."
—Zakken, Enclave cleric

name: Cunning Sparkmage
text: "I see the weaknesses you hide even from yourself."

name: Iona's Judgment
text: Beneath the gaze of angels, only the righteous may stand without fear.

name: Dragonmaster Outcast
text: "Cast out by my tribe, I am a pariah trapped in this mammal's carcass. Only my true kin hear my cries."

name: Goblin Roughrider
text: Astride the bucking creature, Gribble hurtled down the mountainside while his Grotag brethren cheered. It was at that moment that legend of the Skrill Tamer was born.

name: Grotag Thrasher
text: The goblin fancied himself a rider. The lizard was happy with its new flail.

name: Kazuul, Tyrant of the Cliffs
text: Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

name: Quest for the Goblin Lord
text: A shrine to unchecked desire.

name: Ricochet Trap
text: In his last seconds, Remhas regretted using his most powerful spell.

name: Roiling Terrain
text:
"The trembling lands ruptured, leaving an open door for things from below to emerge."
—Screed of the Mul Daya

name: Rumbling Aftershocks
text:
"I like it here. You always get a little more for your mana."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Join the Ranks
text: Expeditionary houses are notorious for their rivalries. But when adventurers meet in the wilderness, the instinct for mutual survival outweighs petty grudges.

name: Slavering Nulls
text: Having lost their minds, they now want yours.

name: Arbor Elf
text: The Mul Daya elves reject their Tajuru kin, calling them arrogant tree-binders who think the roots serve the canopy.

name: Bestial Menace
text:
"My battle cry reaches ears far keener than yours."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

name: Explore
text: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

name: Deathless Ancient
text: "Ancient one, we have reached the promised shore. The Immortal Sun is near. Drink and awake."

name: Desperate Castaways
text: A pirate crew without a ship is a crew that will do anything to get one.

name: Dire Fleet Hoarder
text: Among the pirates of the Brazen Coalition, the only thing more dangerous than failure is success.

name: Dire Fleet Ravager
text: His fists fume with the decay of death, each strike a plague on the hearts of his enemies.

name: Duress
text: Solitude and starvation are brutal punishments, but even worse is all that time to think.

name: Fathom Fleet Captain
text: "Join me, and take the world for yourself!"

name: Fathom Fleet Cutthroat
text: "It was a bad evening for you, mate. Now it's chow time for the sharks."

name: Grim Captain's Call
text: When the battle is over, the bitterest foes at last find common ground.

name: Encampment Keeper
text: Paladins of the Sanctum Seeker order are an adventurous lot, venturing into the wilds with monstrous mastiffs at their side.

name: Lurking Chupacabra
text:
"Shadow birthed it. The moon gave it eyes, and the jungle gave it teeth. But it was Death that taught it cruelty."
—Huatli

name: Mark of the Vampire
text:
"Through your sacrifice of self, you become holy. Through your strength, all will be saved."
—From the Rite of Redemption

name: Queen's Bay Soldier
text: The soldiers of the Legion of Dusk have come to the colonies at Queen's Bay in search of glory and riches. They are veterans of centuries of warfare, and they thirst for conquest.

name: Raiders' Wake
text: One was spared to tell the gruesome tale.

name: Ruthless Knave
text: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

name: Glorifier of Dusk
text: "The blood of the enemy is a sacrament. The strength it gives is proof that our cause is just."

name: Sanctum Seeker
text: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

name: Seekers' Squire
text: Dusk follows the light.

name: Skittering Heartstopper
text: It flows like water over the forest floor, as deadly as the swiftest current.

name: Skulduggery
text: "They're so much more willing to parley once they're hanging from a boom by the ankle!"

name: Skymarch Bloodletter
text: From the perpetual shadowsmoke that hung above the ship, a silent form emerged, lips curled with malice and anticipation.

name: Spreading Rot
text:
"What is this foul presence that defies the sun's cleansing rays?"
—Itzama the Crested

name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
text: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

name: Vanquish the Weak
text: The clerics known as condemners punish those who do not recognize the righteous authority of the church.

name: Vicious Conquistador
text:
"He is ambitious. Tireless. And utterly ruthless. Ideal for the frontier."
—Viceroy Elia Sotonores, report to the queen

name: Vraska's Contempt
text: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

name: Goring Ceratops
text:
"Follow her footsteps and she will show you the way."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Walk the Plank
text: When Captain Thorn adds a new ship to his fleet, he gives the crew a simple choice: follow me, or fall in the sea.

name: Wanted Scoundrels
text: "Trust me. The reward's not worth it."

name: Angrath's Marauders
text: Captain Angrath cares less about treasure than mayhem. If he can't leave Ixalan, he'll burn the plane down.

name: Bonded Horncrest
text:
"You don't tame a horncrest. You convince it that it's easier to destroy something else."
—Amautl, knight of Atzocan

name: Burning Sun's Avatar
text:
"Tilonalli's searing rays carry the spark of life's eventual destruction as all light fades."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Captivating Crew
text: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

name: Charging Monstrosaur
text: "I knew I should have stayed with the boat. Always stay with the boat!"

name: Demolish
text: What took months for human hands to carve took just seconds for the dinosaur's tail to ruin.

name: Imperial Aerosaur
text: Its assistance is unnervingly similar to its hunting technique.

name: Dinosaur Stampede
text: If you're in the way of a ceratops charge and you're made of mere flesh and bone, then you're not really in the way.

name: Dual Shot
text: "Through me the rage of Tilonalli burns twice as bright."

name: Fathom Fleet Firebrand
text: As she charges into battle, her arcane tattoos stir and crawl like fiery serpents.

name: Fiery Cannonade
text: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

name: Fire Shrine Keeper
text: Though grimed with the dust of centuries, the ancient shrine was not unguarded.

name: Firecannon Blast
text: Goblins' fearlessness and diminutive size make them the perfect cannoneers.

name: Frenzied Raptor
text: Sun Empire warriors are taught to emulate the fearless raptors that fling themselves against towers of horn and muscle a hundred times their size.

name: Headstrong Brute
text:
"Watch your backs, keep your blades at hand, and let the orc go first!"
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Hijack
text: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas. No matter how many ships he captures, he cannot break free.

name: Lightning Strike
text:
"Storm on the horizon, cap'n!"
—Grick Doobin, last words

name: Imperial Lancer
text: "Together my mount and I are stronger than either of us apart."

name: Lightning-Rig Crew
text: A pirate ship in battle is a storm of activity.

name: Makeshift Munitions
text: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

name: Nest Robber
text:
"These sailors on our shores are like the dinosaurs that plunder eggs from nests. They live on the labors of others."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Otepec Huntmaster
text: "Forward! Let the Burning Sun's light guide you to deserving prey!"

name: Rampaging Ferocidon
text: All raptors are aggressive, but ferocidons seem to enjoy their prey's pain.

name: Raptor Hatchling
text:
"Every little hatchling has a parent's claws to guard it."
—Sun Empire saying

name: Rigging Runner
text: The hook makes him feel brave, and the hat makes him feel fancy.

name: Rile
text: The enormous can still be at the mercy of the small.

name: Inspiring Cleric
text: "The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath."

name: Rummaging Goblin
text: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

name: Star of Extinction
text:
"The visions haunt me. I see the end of the world, brought on by the search for the Immortal Sun."
—Shaper Pashona

name: Storm Fleet Arsonist
text: "Go ahead, build another. I'll burn that down as well."

name: Sun-Crowned Hunters
text: One alone is dangerous, and they are never alone.

name: Sure Strike
text: "Everyone has a weak spot."

name: Swashbuckling
text: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition are the descendants of those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, and they are eager for vengeance.

name: Thrash of Raptors
text: They glide through the undergrowth, drawn to sounds of disturbance. They attack in unison and all share in the kill. And then they move on.

name: Tilonalli's Knight
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Tilonalli is the Burning Sun, associated with ferocity, fire, and passion.

name: Ixalan's Binding
text: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

name: Tilonalli's Skinshifter
text: "I am the ferocity of the Burning Sun. I am hide and feather, fang and claw."

name: Unfriendly Fire
text: Disputes within the Brazen Coalition can escalate from insult to broadside in the blink of an eye.

name: Vance's Blasting Cannons
text: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

name: Wily Goblin
text: Goblins climb and swing with ease, whether through a pirate ship's rigging or a tree's branches.

name: Ancient Brontodon
text: It is taller than all but the tallest trees, and older than all but the oldest.

name: Atzocan Archer
text: His arrows are fletched with feathers from the greatest of the winged dinosaurs.

name: Blinding Fog
text: "I see you, shiny soldiers, but you won't see me."

name: Blossom Dryad
text: The only force on Ixalan not interested in finding the golden city is Ixalan itself.

name: Carnage Tyrant
text: Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.

name: Kinjalli's Caller
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Kinjalli is the Wakening Sun, who created humans from clay and baked them in the sun's warmth.

name: Colossal Dreadmaw
text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

name: Crash the Ramparts
text: The Legion's conquistadors could endure Ixalan's sun. Their forts could withstand a charging ceratops. But nothing can stop a ceratops strengthened by the sun.

name: Crushing Canopy
text:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

name: Deeproot Champion
text: "No good will come from what you seek. Turn back now or suffer an ignoble death far from your home."

name: Deeproot Warrior
text:
"We breathe from our soul and bones to give strength to the jungle. The jungle breathes from its roots and rivers to give strength to us."
—Shaper Falani

name: Drover of the Mighty
text: "I do not lead. They do not follow. We walk together."

name: Emergent Growth
text: "By accepting my smallness I am vast."

name: Kinjalli's Sunwing
text:
"There are moments when I feel I could fly like the sunwing. Far away I would soar, but always a golden gale pushes me back."
—Huatli

name: Grazing Whiptail
text: Often found browsing on the upper canopies of Ixalan's jungles, whiptails are known to absently bat away anything foolish enough to interrupt their meal.

name: Ixalli's Keeper
text: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects. Ixalli is the Verdant Sun, who fosters growth in all things.

name: Jade Guardian
text: The River Heralds believe that jade gives weight to their magic.

name: Jungle Delver
text: "There is no power too great to be used in the defense of our ancestral lands."

name: Kumena's Speaker
