text: "The same power that drives the river ever onward flows through the roots and branches—to me."

name: Old-Growth Dryads
text: "The jungle was here before any city. It will be here after the last city falls."

name: Ashes of the Abhorrent
text: "Let no trace of the vampires' foulness remain."

name: Legion Conquistador
text: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

name: Pounce
text: The drive to hunt and feed is raw instinct for dinosaurs. The trick is simply to channel it in the right direction.

name: Ranging Raptors
text: They cover their territory like a tide of teeth and claws.

name: Ravenous Daggertooth
text: A daggertooth's triumphant roar makes all the sounds of jungle life fall silent.

name: Ripjaw Raptor
text: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

name: River Heralds' Boon
text: "We are kin to the trees, and their strength is our own."

name: Shapers' Sanctuary
text: Protection is woven into every vine and branch.

name: Slice in Twain
text: The magic of the River Heralds is so great that even a single shaman can fend off a pirate landing party.

name: Snapping Sailback
text: Lurking beneath the murky waters of Ixalan's rivers, sailbacks can rip a meal off the shore in the blink of an eye.

name: Spike-Tailed Ceratops
text: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

name: Legion's Judgment
text: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

name: Thundering Spineback
text:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Tishana's Wayfinder
text: "There is always another way."

name: Verdant Rebirth
text: The dryads of the forest have no stake in Ixalan's conflict, but they hate to see any living being suffer.

name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
text:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Vineshaper Mystic
text: She has never touched a loom, yet the tapestries she weaves are vast and beautiful.

name: Waker of the Wilds
text: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."

name: Wildgrowth Walker
text:
"Hear me, stone, root, branch: be the fist of this land. Turn back those who trample upon your domain."
—Song of the Shaper

name: Admiral Beckett Brass
text: "You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet."

name: Belligerent Brontodon
text: Predators try to separate the young, old, or injured from the rest of the herd. The alternative is crushing defeat.

name: Call to the Feast
text: By the law of church and crown, vampires feed only on the blood of the guilty—those declared heretics, rebels, or enemies of war.

name: Legion's Landing
text:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

name: Deadeye Plunderers
text: "Keep your friends close and your enemies within range."

name: Dire Fleet Captain
text: Orcs are happiest under captains who steer toward battle. Orcs of the Dire Fleet are downright jovial.

name: Marauding Looter
text: "I'll be taking that."

name: Raging Swordtooth
text: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

name: Regisaur Alpha
text:
"Seeing a pack of these monsters hunt together, I'm at a loss to imagine the size of their prey."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

name: Shapers of Nature
text: Shapers adapt nature to fit their needs and then return it to the way it was, leaving no trace of their passing.

name: Sky Terror
text:
"Wherever the Threefold Sun shines, great wings may go."
—Emperor Apatzec Intli III

name: Looming Altisaur
text: Nature can't be tamed, but the Sun Empire believes that humans are made stronger when they test themselves against the wild strength of the dinosaurs.

name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
text: "For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me."

name: Cobbled Wings
text: Flotsam held together by optimism.

name: Dusk Legion Dreadnought
text: It loomed up over the horizon, silent and dark as a grave.

name: Gilded Sentinel
text: The River Heralds fight to keep all others from reaching the golden city. The city has its own defenses.

name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
text: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

name: Hierophant's Chalice
text: In the Rite of Redemption, nobles take the same vows as Elenda, the first vampire, and make the same eternal sacrifice.

name: Sleek Schooner
text: The pirates had left the open sea behind, but they were still in their element: reckless adventure.

name: Thaumatic Compass
text:
"Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of . . ."
—Jace Beleren

name: Paladin of the Bloodstained
text: Closely linked to the Church of Dusk, the paladins of the Bloodstained order are devout to the point of fanaticism.

name: Dragonskull Summit
text: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

name: Drowned Catacomb
text: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

name: Glacial Fortress
text: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

name: Rootbound Crag
text: Cliffs echo and branches quake at the roar of life.

name: Sunpetal Grove
text: To the Sun Empire, any place where daylight brightens the jungle floor is sacred ground.

name: Unknown Shores
text:
"Just imagine what's waiting around the bend. Adventure. Discovery. Riches for the taking. This is why I sail."
—Captain Lannery Storm

name: Pious Interdiction
text: "Ours is the true and righteous path. You will bow before our might."

name: Pterodon Knight
text: "To rise like the sun—there is no greater feeling."

name: Jace's Sentinel
text: "We drove the Sun Empire out of the forest long ago, and we will not let them return."

name: Woodland Stream
text: Countless streams flow into the nine rivers, and the nine rivers flow into the Great River. The River Heralds guard them all.

name: Huatli's Snubhorn
text: Don't make the mistake of thinking blunt horns can't kill.

name: Huatli's Spurring
text: "Run like the wind, fierce one. The hunt has begun."

name: Sun-Blessed Mount
text: When Huatli chooses a mount, its eyes glow with the flames of the sun.

name: Stone Quarry
text: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

name: Queen's Commission
text:
"Let the blood of the impure flow through you. Only the blessings of the golden city will purge its acrid taste from your mouth."
—High Marshal Arguel

name: Axis of Mortality
text: The Church of Dusk teaches there is no gain without loss, no triumph without sacrifice, no drink of exquisite crimson without a dying gasp.

name: Rallying Roar
text:
"The sun's strength sings in our hearts! I have never been more proud of my home and my people."
—Huatli

name: Raptor Companion
text: A raptor will follow any order as long as that order is "hunt," "kill," or "go for the guts."

name: Ritual of Rejuvenation
text: "Nothing is more sacred than the gift of blood. Blessed are the vein that empties and the heart that is renewed."

name: Sanguine Sacrament
text: "As the sun sets to make way for dawn, so we turn to darkness to bring about the coming salvation."

name: Sheltering Light
text: Those who wield the power of the sun protect the Empire from darkness.

name: Shining Aerosaur
text:
"The invaders cloak themselves in the shadows of dusk. Aerosaurs hide in the brilliance of the noonday sun."
—Caparocti Sunborn

name: Skyblade of the Legion
text: Vampires call the gift of flight "exultation." For their enemies, it brings only sorrow.

name: Slash of Talons
text:
"The amber sun smokes with fury, gazing on foes that gather like ants invading our home. We are ready! Blade and claw strike as one."
—Huatli

name: Steadfast Armasaur
text:
"Like the mighty armasaur, we will defend against all who invade our shores."
—Itzama the Crested

name: Bellowing Aegisaur
text: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.

name: Territorial Hammerskull
text: From the eyes up, it's solid bone and stubbornness.

name: Tocatli Honor Guard
text: The glorious city of Pachatupa is the center of the Sun Empire, and Tocatli, the emperor's palace, is its glowing heart.

name: Vampire's Zeal
text: The Feast of Blood sends new life essence flowing through the vampire who partakes, manifesting as even greater strength and speed.

name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
text:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

name: Air Elemental
text: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

name: Cancel
text:
"Hold your fire, obviously."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

name: Chart a Course
text: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

name: Daring Saboteur
text: "They'll never see me coming."

name: Bishop of Rebirth
text: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

name: Deadeye Quartermaster
text: "Welcome aboard, mate! You're going to need this."

name: Deeproot Waters
text: A visit to the Deeproot Tree and its ancient spring replenishes a merfolk's connection to nature.

name: Depths of Desire
text: Pockets full of gold, lungs full of brine.

name: Dive Down
text: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

name: Entrancing Melody
text: The stronger the will, the more bewitching the song.

name: Favorable Winds
text:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

name: Fleet Swallower
text: "Captain, I think that island is following us."

name: Headwater Sentries
text: "The elders say that if the intruders discovered the secret of the golden city, it would mean an end to our people."

name: Herald of Secret Streams
text: "You might as well try to stop the waterfall."

name: Bishop's Soldier
text: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
text: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

name: Lookout's Dispersal
text: Her song plucks the strings of the storm, shifting wind and storm into a harmony that will carry her ship to safety.

name: Navigator's Ruin
text: "You won't be needing this. Or this. Or these . . ."

name: One With the Wind
text:
"River and sea, jungle and sky. Water flows freely between the two halves of the world. We are creatures of the water."
—Shaper Tuvasa

name: Opt
text: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

name: Overflowing Insight
text: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

name: Perilous Voyage
text: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.

name: Pirate's Prize
text: Nothing warms the heart like plunder.

name: Prosperous Pirates
text: The floating city of High and Dry hasn't yet sunk under the weight of gold, but it's not for want of trying.

name: Bright Reprisal
text: Vampires know blood and the systems that carry it. And they know exactly where to strike to set it free.

name: River Sneak
text: No ripples, no splashes, no warning.

name: River's Rebuke
text: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

name: Run Aground
text:
"That's the first time I've seen the ground do the running."
—Captain Brinely Rage

name: Sailor of Means
text: In the Brazen Coalition, the wheels of business are greased with plunder.

name: Search for Azcanta
text: The Sunken Ruin houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

name: Shaper Apprentice
text: The River Heralds would wreck a thousand ships to keep intruders from finding the golden city.

name: Shipwreck Looter
text: One pirate's wreck is another's reward.

name: Shore Keeper
text: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

name: Siren Stormtamer
text: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

name: Demystify
text: "The River Heralds carve spells into jade, hoping to steer us from our course. But what right do they have to keep us from that which once was ours?"

name: Siren's Ruse
text: Deception and misdirection are the heart of the pirate's arsenal.

name: Spell Pierce
text:
"A fool's fire is quickly quenched."
—Shaper Kumena

name: Storm Fleet Aerialist
text: "Only one thing beats the freedom of the sea: the freedom of the sky."

name: Storm Fleet Spy
text: "They're searching in the same direction we are. And for the same thing, I'll wager."

name: Storm Sculptor
text: In his hands, the wind can become a weapon or a means of escape.

name: Tempest Caller
text: "I *am* the storm."

name: Watertrap Weaver
text: The river is a powerful friend.

name: Wind Strider
text: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

name: Anointed Deacon
text: Inspiration is red as rubies, flowing like honeyed wine.

name: Duskborne Skymarcher
text: "The hour of Dusk is come."

name: Arguel's Blood Fast
text: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

name: Bishop of the Bloodstained
text: "They shall give us all they have as penance for their resistance. Their ships. Their goods. Their rebellious blood."

name: Blight Keeper
text: It withers fruit and flesh alike.

name: Bloodcrazed Paladin
text: When a paladin undertaking the Blood Fast finally gives in to hunger, the violence is sudden, explosive, and complete.

name: Contract Killing
text: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

name: Costly Plunder
text: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

name: Dark Nourishment
text: Demons lurk in the shadows of ancient ruins, spreading plague and corruption across the land.

name: Deadeye Tormentor
text: Despite their noble heritage, the pirates of the Deadeye Fleet are known for underhanded tactics and despicable trickery.

name: Armament Master
text: "We prepare for the known with daggers, rations, rope, and pitons. But we also prepare for the unknown with billycat tails, pikku roots, hedron chips . . ."

name: Devout Lightcaster
text:
"Goddess, grant us light to banish the world's shadows."
—Prayer to Kamsa

name: Mind Sludge
text:
"Guard your thoughts. You never know who might wish to take them from you."
—Kalitas, Bloodchief of Ghet

name: Mindless Null
text: Only a bloodchief can create vampires. The rest sire nulls, who become mindless beasts in their former bodies.

name: Mire Blight
text:
"Is there anything in Guul Draz that *doesn't* suck the life out of you?"
—Tarsa, Sea Gate sell-sword

name: Needlebite Trap
text: The traps around the vampire city of Malakir hint at the thirst of its inhabitants.

name: Nimana Sell-Sword
text:
"He asked if I had work for him. No wasn't the right answer."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
text: His spark lost, he plots revenge upon the plane whose corrupting mana fractured his soul.

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Vampire Hexmage
text: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

name: Vampire Lacerator
text: The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.

name: Bladetusk Boar
text: Those who dare stand in its path are either brave or mindless. Or in the case of goblins, both.

name: Felidar Sovereign
text:
"If survival is a game, I've seen the winner."
—Hazir, Sejiri cartographer

name: Demolish
text:
"This is why I hate settlements. They lull you into a false sense of security."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Electropotence
text: Where life and force collide.

name: Geyser Glider
text:
"Quit pontificating, mage. The last thing we want to do is give it more hot air."
—Tala Vertan, Makindi shieldmate

name: Goblin Guide
text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Goblin Shortcutter
text:
"Goblins are cheap, but be careful. It's a lot easier to steal from a corpse than a customer."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Goblin War Paint
text: War paint made from kolya fruit heightens senses and lessens fear. Unfortunately, fear is usually what keeps you alive.

name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
text: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

name: Hellfire Mongrel
text: There is no fondness between the hound and its master. There is only a common appreciation of the hunt.

name: Highland Berserker
text: He gets paid by the axe.

name: Inferno Trap
text: "Do you smell something burning?"

name: Kazuul Warlord
text: On expeditions, minotaurs are worth their weight in gold. Fortunately for their paymasters, most minotaurs don't know how much they weigh.

name: Magma Rift
text:
"Lighting a fire needs kindling and heat. You be the kindling. I'll bring the heat."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Mark of Mutiny
text: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

name: Molten Ravager
text:
"Only the foolhardy would venture into the Akoum Mountains without a lullmage to tame the raging rocks and living fires."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Murasa Pyromancer
text: "Fire is my accomplice. For enough coin, it can be yours as well."

name: Plated Geopede
text:
"Kor armorers buy the scales and claws. Elf oracles buy the rest."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Ruinous Minotaur
text: Not every intelligent being is interested in treasure and lost knowledge . . . or even the basics of speech.

name: Seismic Shudder
text:
"The land here seems to go out of its way to kill you."
—Chandra Nalaar

name: Shatterskull Giant
text:
"Now I know why they call it Shatterskull Pass. Rocks fell all night like hammers smashing an anvil. It's no wonder the giants are angry all the time."
—Mitra, Bala Ged missionary

name: Slaughter Cry
text:
"Since when did 'AIIIEEEE!' become a negotiation tactic?"
—Nikou, Joraga bard

name: Spire Barrage
text: Goblin lessons include the 2,071 tips for survival. Frek only remembered 2,070.

name: Torch Slinger
text: Once thrown, twice burned.

name: Tuktuk Grunts
text: Goblins are more aggressive with a crowd to cheer them on.

name: Unstable Footing
text: A long way down is shorter than you think.

name: Warren Instigator
text: "Danger! Danger! Come out of the safety of your holes!"

name: Baloth Woodcrasher
text: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

name: Beast Hunt
text:
"Surely we could tame something besides hurdas and pillarfield oxen!"
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

name: Kazandu Blademaster
text: "If you hire a sell-sword, you'd better watch your back. Hire me, and I'll watch it for you."

name: Frontier Guide
text: "The elders say Zendikar has no safe, peaceful places. How would they know? They've never looked."

name: Grazing Gladehart
text:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Greenweaver Druid
text: The other tribes call them fanatics, but none deny that the Mul Daya elves have an iron-strong bond to some force greater than themselves.

name: Harrow
text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

name: Joraga Bard
text: Adventuring bards recite *Chanter's Epics*, never-ending tales that keep their comrades' minds alert to danger.

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its scales contain the essence of thousands of lotus blooms.

name: Mold Shambler
text: When civilization encroaches on nature, Zendikar encroaches back.

name: Nissa's Chosen
text: "Nissa will save the elves, but only the ones who have proved their worth."

name: Oran-Rief Survivalist
text: "I'm strong enough to survive alone. I'm smart enough to want companions at my side."

name: Primal Bellow
text:
"A might spell can be handy against baloths, giants, kraken, the Roil—or if you lose your bearings in the woods."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Relic Crush
text: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: River Boa
text:
"Sheath your swords! Cudgels only. I see a new pair of waterproof trek boots slithering away."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

name: Savage Silhouette
text: Some elves believe that their survival instincts are born of many cycles of reincarnation.

name: Scute Mob
text:
"Survival rule 781: There are always more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Scythe Tiger
text: Instead of adapting to its environment, it adapts its environment to itself.

name: Tanglesap
text:
"The blood of the forest is beholden to no one."
—Nissa Revane

name: Terra Stomper
text: Sometimes violent earthquakes, hurtling boulders, and unseasonable dust storms are wrongly attributed to the Roil.

name: Territorial Baloth
text: Its territory is defined by wherever it is at the moment.

name: Timbermaw Larva
text:
"You can't trust your eyes. A tree might look healthy, but its insides tell a different tale."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Kor Duelist
text: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

name: Turntimber Ranger
text: The lone wolf dies alone.

name: Vastwood Gorger
text:
"I've known true ferocity and power. Those brazen 'planar-walkers' have no idea what wild really means."
—Chadir the Navigator

name: Zendikar Farguide
text: Expeditions follow the paths it leaves in its wake.

name: Adventuring Gear
text: An explorer's essentials in a wild world.

name: Carnage Altar
text:
"In these bloodstains I will find the fingerprints of our oppressors."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Eldrazi Monument
text:
"Gods don't die. They merely slumber."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Kor Hookmaster
text: "For us, a rope represents the ties that bind the kor. For you, it's more literal."

name: Expedition Map
text:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Grappling Hook
text: Part tool, part weapon, part of the kor.

name: Hedron Scrabbler
text:
"I don't care when the hedrons awoke. *Why* is the question that really matters."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

name: Khalni Gem
text: A fragment of ancient power lost in the heart of Ora Ondar.

name: Stonework Puma
text:
"We suffer uneasy ground, unstable alliances, and unpredictable magic. Something you can truly trust is worth more than a chest of gold."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

name: Trailblazer's Boots
text: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

name: Trusty Machete
text:
"Until this expedition is done, that blade is your guardian, your liberator, and your best friend all rolled into one."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

name: Kor Outfitter
text: "We take only what we need to survive. Believe me, you will need this."

name: Kor Sanctifiers
text: "Why keep such trinkets? They only add weight to your travels."

name: Kor Skyfisher
text: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

name: Landbind Ritual
text:
"Honor this place, for our children's children will stand here and speak these same words again."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

name: Makindi Shieldmate
text: The more who rely on him, the more resolute he becomes.

name: Narrow Escape
text:
"A good explorer has to be as slippery as a gomazoa, as tough as a scute bug, and luckier than a ten-fingered trapfinder."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

name: Nimbus Wings
text: Explorers may find ways into the Sky Ruin, but they find its secrets well protected by shifting hedrons and Roil winds.

name: Noble Vestige
text: Most spirits are chained to this world by their despair, but he remains tethered by his hope for better days.

name: Ondu Cleric
text: A cleric's true balm is the confidence he inspires in his compatriots.

name: Pillarfield Ox
text: These stubborn and unpredictable oxen inspire the plains nomads' most colorful curses.

name: Pitfall Trap
text: Each spike is poisoned—the trapmaker's idea of mercy.

name: Shepherd of the Lost
text:
"Should you fall in the wilds, lift your voice to the Sky Realm. The one who answers will be your salvation."
—Emeria's Creed

name: Shieldmate's Blessing
text:
"Even land dwellers may call for Emeria's grace in times of need."
—Emeria's Creed

name: Steppe Lynx
text: Nothing quickens the predator's blood like the unfamiliar scents of new hunting grounds and the mewling cries of new prey.

name: Windborne Charge
text: The merfolk call the sky goddess Emeria. The kor call her Kamsa. The two races agree on little except that she offers many blessings to the faithful.

name: World Queller
text:
"Why fight the world when you know who will win?"
—Nissa Revane

name: Brave the Elements
text:
"Trust me, your lost fingers and toes are nothing compared to the lost treasures of Sejiri."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Caller of Gales
text: "Some merfolk choose to rest their fins in the water. I believe wisdom exists not only where we were born but where we were told not to go."

name: Cancel
text: Zendikar's volatile mana is the basis for many spectacular spells—and some equally astonishing failures.

name: Cosi's Trickster
text: She watches the chaos created by the Roil, seeking strength in the patterns of anarchy.

name: Gomazoa
text: To explorers, "point man" is a polite way of saying "gomazoa fodder."

name: Hedron Crab
text: Hedrons perplex minds both great and small.

name: Into the Roil
text: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

name: Caravan Hurda
text:
"Not too bright, but good enough for the job required—carrying and walking in a straight line."
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Kraken Hatchling
text: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

name: Lethargy Trap
text: Suddenly, Zurdi didn't care about treasure, glory, food . . . or the drakes circling above.

name: Living Tsunami
text: At low tide it slumbers. At high tide it devours.

name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
text: When Lorthos emerges from his deepwater realm, the tides bow to his will and the coastline cowers in his presence.

name: Lullmage Mentor
text: "Many voices are needed to quiet this land."

name: Merfolk Seastalkers
text:
"Do they seek knowledge or wealth? Are they bandits or benefactors? It depends on who is chanting the tale."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

name: Mindbreak Trap
text:
"Life is a maze. This is one of its dead ends."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Paralyzing Grasp
text: The Halimar Sea Caves are both the breeding ground of giant squids and the dumping ground of hardened criminals.

name: Celestial Mantle
text: Upon such armor, even a mountain would break.

name: Reckless Scholar
text: "Any good prospector must sift the gold from the sand."

name: Roil Elemental
text: A vortex that devours everything—even the souls of the living.

name: Sea Gate Loremaster
text:
"He's a living library. He remembers everything our band of explorers has seen, and we can use that to our advantage."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Seascape Aerialist
text: "The sky is like another sea. It teems with currents, life, and endless possibility."

name: Shoal Serpent
text:
"It's like a reef that runs aground on ships."
—Jaby, Silundi Sea nomad

name: Sky Ruin Drake
text:
"Hold up your spears. And try not to look like food."
—Tarsa, Sea Gate sell-sword

name: Spell Pierce
text:
"There's a hole in your plan."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

name: Sphinx of Jwar Isle
text:
"Even if the sphinxes do know the location of every relic, getting one to talk is harder than just searching yourself."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Cliff Threader
text: "The crossing demands singular focus. Your life consists of these ropes, these hooks, and these rocky crags. Your past is miles below."

name: Spreading Seas
text: Most inhabitants of Zendikar have given up on the idea of an accurate map.

name: Summoner's Bane
text:
"I don't need to have the perfect plan. My foe just has to have an imperfect one."
—Jace Beleren

name: Trapfinder's Trick
text:
"At some point, every trapfinder will lose a hunk of flesh. It's just a question of how much—and whether it'll grow back."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

name: Trapmaker's Snare
text: "Trapmaking is an art. The trap is a corporeal riddle, a battle of wits between its creator and whatever it lures inside."

name: Umara Raptor
text: Messenger, weapon, friend.

name: Welkin Tern
text:
"The sky hedrons are covered with tern nests. It's as though the birds have given up on the land altogether."
—Ilori, merfolk falconer

name: Windrider Eel
text:
"The best spot to hook one is right behind the gills."
—Rana Cloudwake, kor skyfisher

name: Blood Seeker
text: A drop now is all he needs to find you later.

name: Bog Tatters
text: A wraith is a tale of brutal slaying told anew whenever it finds a victim.

name: Crypt Ripper
text: The tender light of the living quickens the pulse of the dead.

name: Desecrated Earth
text:
"The land is swollen with mana, cursed relics, and secrets. If you puncture it, you never know what will burst out."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

name: Disfigure
text: "Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."

name: Feast of Blood
text:
"The vampires of this world don't know the pleasures of hunger. They gorge themselves without savoring the kill."
—Sorin Markov

name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
text: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

name: Day of Judgment
text:
"I have seen planes leveled and all life rendered to dust. It brought no pleasure, even to a heart as dark as mine."
—Sorin Markov

name: Giant Scorpion
text: Its sting hurts, but death is strangely painless.

name: Grim Discovery
text: Few among the living understand just how much of their world is shaped by the ruins of the dead.

name: Guul Draz Vampire
text: "A creature's bloodscent is a beacon that cannot be disguised."

name: Hagra Crocodile
text: The creatures of Zendikar are opportunists, eating whatever is available to them. Like goblins. Or boats.

name: Hagra Diabolist
text: "When exploring the darkest regions, wickedness can be the best accomplice of all."

name: Halo Hunter
text: Hanging on the walls of his lair, the fallen halos cast his depravity in everlasting light.

name: Hideous End
text:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

name: Soul Manipulation
text:
"Birth and death are both reversible."
—Nicol Bolas

name: Sygg, River Cutthroat
text: "It's not a matter of deserving. It's a matter of strength. The power to hold versus the power to take."

name: Arcane Signet
text: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

name: Blackblade Reforged
text: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

name: Commander's Sphere
text: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

name: Banishing Light
text:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

name: Dimir Keyrune
text: A key that slips through every lock.

name: Dimir Locket
text:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

name: Dimir Signet
text: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

name: Mind Stone
text:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

name: Scaretiller
text: Fields of battle turn to fields of grain.

name: Seer's Sundial
text: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

name: Condemn
text:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

name: Sol Ring
text: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

name: Boros Guildgate
text: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

name: Command Tower
text: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

name: Cryptic Caves
text: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

name: Dimir Guildgate
text: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

name: Evolving Wilds
text: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

name: Crush Contraband
text: The Izzet mage knew she would neither get her thermoinverter back nor have the satisfaction of exploding it herself.

name: Gruul Guildgate
text: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

name: Jungle Shrine
text: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

name: Naya Panorama
text: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

name: Rogue's Passage
text: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

name: Selesnya Guildgate
text: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

name: Submerged Boneyard
text:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

name: Terramorphic Expanse
text: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

name: Emeria Angel
text: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

name: Hour of Revelation
text: In the first moments, the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh.

name: Kor Cartographer
text: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

name: Sun Titan
text: A blazing sun that never sets.

name: Aetherize
text: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

name: Distant Melody
text: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

name: Fact or Fiction
text: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

name: Faerie Vandal
text: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

name: Invisible Stalker
text: "All that concerns me is the vampires' sense of smell and those freezing Nephalian nights."

name: Marang River Prowler
text: The currents of the Marang wash away both tracks and blood.

name: Master Thief
text: Possession is ten-tenths of the law.

name: Military Intelligence
text: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

name: Nightveil Sprite
text:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

name: Open into Wonder
text: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

name: Slither Blade
text: Some naga initiates move as silently as the suns' reflections on the water.

name: Triton Shorestalker
text: "Who will miss you, drywalker? A wife? A child? Perhaps they will blame the sea for your fate, and teach future generations to stay far away from it."

name: Changeling Outcast
text: A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.

name: Frogtosser Banneret
text: The Frogtossers thread feathers, bones, and trophies from past raids into their standards, believing they fuel the warren with the anger of its victims.

name: In Garruk's Wake
text: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

name: Murder
text:
"By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end."
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

name: Necromantic Selection
text: It shambled from the cloud of ash and bone dust, undeterred by its own extinction.

name: Ogre Slumlord
text:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

name: Rise from the Grave
text:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

name: Zulaport Cutthroat
text: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

name: Acidic Slime
text: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

name: Geode Rager
text: Its crystalline core refracts light into chaos.

name: Armorcraft Judge
text: Were she not a judge, she'd win the division herself.

name: Circuitous Route
text:
"The shortest path between two points is not always the safest."
—Tamina, district guide

name: Evolution Sage
text: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

name: Harmonize
text:
"Animals commune with their environment without the need for language. Theirs is a fundamental connection that surpasses flimsy words."
—Vivien Reid

name: Harrow
text: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

name: Inspiring Call
text: "Now is the hour. Ours is the duty. For victory and family—charge!"

name: Keeper of Fables
text:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

name: Kodama's Reach
text:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

name: Nissa's Renewal
text: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

name: Rampaging Baloths
text:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

name: Return of the Wildspeaker
text: "The curse is broken."

name: Rites of Flourishing
text: "Dance, and bring forth the coil! It is an umbilical to Gaea herself, fattening us with the earth's rich bounty."

name: Satyr Wayfinder
text: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

name: Sporemound
text:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

name: Springbloom Druid
text: "New growth applies a healing poultice to wounds long scabbed over."

name: Sylvan Advocate
text: "The land gives of itself. Its abundance provides, even in times of chaos."

name: Tuskguard Captain
text: One quiet word sets off the stampede.

name: Waker of the Wilds
text: "Our foes are many and mighty, but not as many as the trees or as mighty as the sea."

name: Zendikar's Roil
text:
"I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain."
—Nissa Revane

name: Abzan Falconer
text: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

name: Extract from Darkness
text: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

name: Ground Assault
text:
"Taking down a dragon is easy. All you need is enough space to get in a good swing."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

name: Living Twister
text:
"The ancient places of Ravnica awaken, stirred by the hoofbeats of Ilharg!"
—Nikya of the Old Ways

name: Mina and Denn, Wildborn
text: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

name: Allied Assault
text: A common foe is the death of old hatreds.

name: Disenchant
text: "From legend it was forged, and to legend it returns."

name: Dreadwurm
text: Its silent slithering belies its bulk.

name: Expedition Skulker
text: Rogues bring an array of useful skills to the work of an adventuring party: stealth, agility, the ability to locate and disarm traps, and a subtle, deadly fighting style.

name: Feed the Swarm
text:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

name: Ghastly Gloomhunter
text: Stinking, silent death.

name: Guul Draz Mucklord
text: Death comes in many forms on Guul Draz, most of them slow, subtle, and agonizing. At least a monstrous crocodile offers a swift death.

name: Hagra Mauling
text:
"Din, turn around! Now!"
—Doros, expedition guide

name: Highborn Vampire
text: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

name: Lithoform Blight
text: Heedless of Nissa's warnings, Nahiri repeated history.

name: Emeria Captain
text: "The gifts of the past must find their way into deserving hands."

name: Malakir Blood-Priest
text: "From your veins to mine."

name: Malakir Rebirth
text:
"Those who fail to escape Malakir become part of the city's defense."
—Doros, expedition guide

name: Marauding Blight-Priest
text: "The vampires never had gods. We followed our bloodchiefs. Now they are gone. What is left? Destruction and death, my friends. That is enough."

name: Mind Drain
text: "The meal was exquisite. The conversation, less so."

name: Nighthawk Scavenger
text: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

name: Nimana Skitter-Sneak
text: "When navigating dangerous terrain, one hundred legs are better than two."

name: Nimana Skydancer
text: The Free City of Nimana is a great place to recruit adventurers with shady skill sets.

name: Oblivion's Hunger
text:
"Indulge the void. Become the void. Consume all you touch."
—Drana, the last bloodchief

name: Emeria's Call
text:
"Iona no longer guards this place. We do."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd

name: Pelakka Predation
text:
"I knew we shouldn't have come this way."
—Sneeflebrix, expedition rogue

name: Scion of the Swarm
text: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

name: Shadows' Verdict
text: The shadows of death fall over everyone in the end.

name: Skyclave Shadowcat
text:
"Perhaps its distant ancestors were radiant felidars, but no hint of their nobility remains."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Soul Shatter
text: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

name: Subtle Strike
text: Silence is an underrated hunting strategy.

name: Expedition Healer
text: In any adventuring party, the cleric is the heart: healing wounds, inspiring courage, and raising morale.

name: Vanquish the Weak
text: Open conflict between expeditionary houses—or even individual adventuring parties—is discouraged, but "accidents" happen.

name: Zof Consumption
text:
"Annihilation surrounds us. Our call is to embrace its ceaseless hunger."
—Voshk, oblivion priest

name: Akoum Hellhound
text: Hellhound packs roam the Spikefields, basking in the harsh sunlight and lighting the night with their flames.

name: Akoum Warrior
text:
"I'm not cruel, but I have no patience for your mistakes."
—Tyrux, expedition warrior

name: Ardent Electromancer
text: "Trust me, we won't need torches."

name: Cinderclasm
text: Every inferno begins with a spark.

name: Cleansing Wildfire
text: Every rebirth looks like a death.

name: Expedition Champion
text: Warriors are combat specialists who bring their deadly skills to bear against the many foes that adventurers face in the course of their journeys.

name: Fireblade Charger
text: "Down in flames" isn't a destination, but a journey.

name: Farsight Adept
text: "I've walked every one of the Teetering Peaks and never set a foot wrong. I can get you to safety."

name: Fissure Wizard
text: He might call up a burst of lava or a raging hellion from Akoum's volcanic depths. Or he might just fall in.

name: Goma Fada Vanguard
text:
"Her weapon's impressive, sure. But you should see her wield it."
—Gred, expedition warrior

name: Grotag Bug-Catcher
text: "Everybody grab a leg!"

name: Grotag Night-Runner
text: Naturally inquisitive and adaptable, goblins can turn their small stature to their advantage as rogues.

name: Inordinate Rage
text:
"In my years wandering this land I've seen a veritable menagerie of fantastic creatures, but one that has eluded me thus far is the fabled 'easygoing minotaur.'"
—Ko, expedition wizard

name: Kazuul's Fury
text:
"The toll is steep, but the cliffs are steeper."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Molten Blast
text: Life among the sudden tremors and violent eruptions of Akoum demands a healthy fear of both.

name: Fearless Fledgling
text: Griffins nest in precarious places, so fledglings often find themselves taking their first flights at surprising moments.

name: Nahiri's Lithoforming
text: "Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace."

name: Pyroclastic Hellion
text:
"The difference between a hellion and a volcano is that volcanoes don't get hungry."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Relic Robber
text: "Here, you take it!"

name: Rockslide Sorcerer
text: "You can cower from the crushing shards or embrace the danger of Akoum. I've made my choice."

name: Roil Eruption
text:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Scorch Rider
text: "Lava flows where it pleases. I'm just happy to be along for the ride!"

name: Shatterskull Minotaur
text:
"We just pay him and point him at problems."
—Aro, Sea Gate adventurer

name: Sizzling Barrage
text:
"A thousand sparks can burn through your defenses just as quickly as one massive blaze."
—Attikar, Akoum elementalist

name: Skyclave Geopede
text: Wrenched from the ground like a dirt-caked rock, the ancient Skyclave wriggled with life.

name: Sneaking Guide
text: "I swear, it's a shortcut."

name: Song-Mad Treachery
text:
"I'm not proud of the things I did. But all I could think about at the time was how to make the noise stop."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Spikefield Hazard
text:
"Stop screaming! You'll only bring down more spikes."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Spitfire Lagac
text:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Synchronized Spellcraft
text: "Ready? One... two..."

name: Teeterpeak Ambusher
text: Goblins from the Makindi Trenches of Ondu make surprisingly skilled climbing guides due to their habit of scaling the cliffs to drop onto unsuspecting foes.

name: Thundering Rebuke
text:
"Fire is too imprecise for my tastes. I'd rather rely on a single, well-placed bolt of lightning."
—Lyrus, Sea Gate wizard

name: Thundering Sparkmage
text: "Stay away from my friends!"

name: Tormenting Voice
text: Kargan tribal lands rarely have issues with goblin raids. Coincidentally, they also rarely have issues keeping their dragons fed.

name: Tuktuk Rubblefort
text: As with everything else, goblins believe fortifications benefit from as many spiky bits as possible.

name: Valakut Awakening
text:
"My ancestors reshaped the world to their vision. I have a few ideas of my own."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

name: Wayward Guide-Beast
text: Goblin cavalry tactics consist of pointing a beast in a direction and hanging on for as long as possible.

name: Adventure Awaits
text: "Good, we're all here. Let's get started!"

name: Ancient Greenwarden
text: When the ruins awakened, so did their defenses.

name: Kabira Outrider
text: Ondu moas make wildly uncomfortable mounts, but for determined warriors, their speed is enough to make up for it.

name: Bala Ged Recovery
text:
"Always have a backup plan."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

name: Broken Wings
text: Getting airborne with a kitesail is easy. It's everything afterward that takes focus, skill, and luck.

name: Canopy Baloth
text:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

name: Dauntless Survivor
text: "I've got a little surprise for you, beasties! Come and get it!"

name: Gnarlid Colony
text: Where mana flows, the gnarlids follow.

name: Iridescent Hornbeetle
text: The hatchlings will fill the jungles of Murasa in a glittering tide.

name: Joraga Visionary
text: "If you only follow where the paths lead, you merely go where others have gone before you."

name: Kazandu Mammoth
text:
"It doesn't obey me. It cooperates with me."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller

name: Kabira Takedown
text:
"Down below's where things go to die."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

name: Kazandu Nectarpot
text:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

name: Kazandu Stomper
text: Elves revere cycles of renewal, but they prefer cycles that don't involve their homes getting smashed.

name: Khalni Ambush
text:
"The difference between life and death in Ora Ondar is about three seconds of startled screaming."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

name: Lotus Cobra
text: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

name: Might of Murasa
text: The continent of Murasa is defined by irrepressible growth, both natural and otherwise.

name: Murasa Brute
text: Some adventuring parties are made up of old friends, their common bonds bolstering them in the face of peril. Other parties simply hire the biggest, meanest muscle they can find.

name: Murasa Sproutling
text: The seeds of memory grow eternal.

name: Rabid Bite
text: A healthy felidar is voracious yet regal. A rabid felidar is nothing more than appetite lashed to frothing jaws.

name: Kitesail Cleric
text: Too flashy to ignore. Too fast to catch.

name: Roiling Regrowth
text:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

name: Scale the Heights
text: "Ever onward, ever skyward."

name: Scute Swarm
text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

name: Skyclave Pick-Axe
text: For use on cliffs and other faces.

name: Springmantle Cleric
text: Hope and courage bloom in her wake.

name: Strength of Solidarity
text: "This expedition doesn't succeed unless we all succeed!"

name: Tajuru Blightblade
text: Ora Ondar, the Khalni Garden, is a lush tangle of growth in the harsh lands of Akoum. Its plant growth is marvelously diverse: a brilliant spectrum of vibrant life . . . and speedy death.

name: Kor Blademaster
text: Every kor blade is imbued with the skill of a thousand generations.

name: Tajuru Snarecaster
text: Elves of the Tajuru Nation spend their lives in the ancient jaddi trees' expansive canopy, some living and dying without ever touching the ground.

name: Tangled Florahedron
text:
"As Bala Ged regrows, new forms of life blossom with unfettered wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

name: Taunting Arbormage
text: "Eyes on me!"

name: Territorial Scythecat
text: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

name: Turntimber Ascetic
text: "For so long, this land cried out in pain. Now, as the flow returns to its balance point, a new harmony echoes in the trees."

name: Vastwood Fortification
text:
"When you understand nature's ways, you're never unarmed."
—Eyza, Joraga guide

name: Veteran Adventurer
text: "How can I be of assistance?"

name: Vine Gecko
text:
"It's cute now, but those things tend to get a lot bigger when you're not looking."
—Fahar, expedition wizard

name: Kor Celebrant
text: "The landbind ritual connects us to our sacred sites. More importantly, it binds us with every other kor who has visited here, through countless generations."

name: Akiri, Fearless Voyager
text: "No angel bars our ascent. Emeria waits above!"

name: Cleric of Life's Bond
text: "No gods. Only each other."

name: Kargan Warleader
text: From rebellion against the Akoum Skyclave to fighting the Eldrazi titans, the dragon-riding Kargan tribes have never missed an opportunity to defy the odds.

name: Kaza, Roil Chaser
text: "What sort of life is that, huddling in the familiar and safe? No thanks. Put me right in the center of the action."

name: Lullmage's Familiar
text:
"They store energy in special gastric organs ... but I guess you'd probably rather have me clear the path than ramble about guts."
—Fahar, expedition wizard

name: Murasa Rootgrazer
text: Few other creatures so closely embody Murasa's rapid cycles of growth.

name: Legion Angel
text: "We are many, and righteous."

name: Orah, Skyclave Hierophant
text: "The Skyclaves are our inheritance."

name: Spoils of Adventure
text: Survival itself is no small reward.

name: Umara Mystic
text: "We tolerate the North Hada thieves' den, but cutthroats who wander downriver earn a skymanta ride out to sea."

name: Luminarch Aspirant
text: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
text: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

name: Cliffhaven Kitesail
text: Made from canvas, wood, and hope.

name: Forsaken Monument
text:
"We shall forever roam."
—Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims

name: Relic Amulet
text: Old power finds new purpose.

name: Relic Axe
text: "It's light as a feather, but it hits with the force of a boulder. A very sharp boulder."

name: Makindi Ox
text:
"May bloodflies empty your veins and turn you into a dried leather sack, cow!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Sea Gate Colossus
text:
"When you are battered and exhausted, look up and be inspired by its resolve."
—Tazri

name: Skyclave Relic
text: Skyclaves held the key to reshaping the world.

name: Spare Supplies
text:
"It's better to carry a little extra weight than to find yourself halfway down a baloth's throat with no knife."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

name: Stonework Packbeast
text: It will happily carry home your treasure or drag you back to civilization, as circumstances demand.

name: Utility Knife
text: "Hold on a second, I have just the thing."

name: Base Camp
text: A new dawn, a new adventure.

name: Branchloft Pathway
text:
"Not for the bumble-footed nor wobble-stomached."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

name: Brightclimb Pathway
text:
"Why risk life and limb exploring the wilds? For this."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Makindi Stampede
text:
"They say the wind carved out these canyon walls. But the floor was hammered flat by hooves."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

name: Clearwater Pathway
text:
"Just when the river seems most peaceful, suddenly you round a bend and hurtle down a waterfall."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

name: Cragcrown Pathway
text:
"The greatest danger on the path is a failure of nerve."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Crawling Barrens
text: Zendikar is restless.

name: Needleverge Pathway
text:
"Once you really trust the rope, you'll learn to sleep standing up."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

name: Riverglide Pathway
text:
"The wind knows the way. Just let it carry you there."
—Amandi, kitesail expert

name: Mesa Lynx
text: Its ferocity is tempered by patience, knowing it must wait for just the right moment to strike a killing blow.

name: Nahiri's Binding
text: "This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones."

name: Angelheart Protector
text: "We shall persevere."

name: Ondu Inversion
text:
"At first rumble you'd best hold on tight and pray to any gods you still hold dear."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Paired Tactician
text: "If we fight as one, nothing can stand in our way!"

name: Practiced Tactics
text: Each individual has their own crucial role to play.

name: Pressure Point
text: Poke a drake in the right place and it becomes as docile as a pet. Poke it in the wrong place and goodbye, hand.

name: Prowling Felidar
text: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.

name: Resolute Strike
text:
"If you practice something often enough, it becomes part of you. That's why we train, and that's why we survive."
—Tasha, Graypelt veteran

name: Sea Gate Banneret
text: The Sea Gate Expeditionary House was founded after the discovery of the Skyclave over Tazeem. Now its banners fly over every corner of Zendikar.

name: Sejiri Shelter
text:
"It blocks the windswept salt and frigid air, but the loneliness of Sejiri remains."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

name: Shepherd of Heroes
text: "Rest, friends. I will protect you."

name: Orah, Skyclave Hierophant
text: "The Skyclaves are our inheritance."

name: Charix, the Raging Isle
text: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.

name: Into the Roil
text: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

name: Bloodchief's Thirst
text: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."

name: Roil Eruption
text:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

name: Roiling Regrowth
text:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

name: Kargan Warleader
text: From rebellion against the Akoum Skyclave to fighting the Eldrazi titans, the dragon-riding Kargan tribes have never missed an opportunity to defy the odds.

name: Archon of Emeria
text:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

name: Skyclave Cleric
text:
"Well, she can jump farther than I can."
—Aelah, expedition cleric

name: Smite the Monstrous
text:
"Darkness always flees from the light, and I am the breaking dawn."
—Kordain, luminarch of Kabira

name: Tazeem Raptor
text:
"It's good to see the eagles circling the Lighthouse once again."
—Tazri

name: Anticognition
text:
"I think not."
—Flekon the Mindcensor

name: Beyeen Veil
text:
"All you minnows in the murk, come to my light."
—Jejenar, Silundi lullmage

name: Cascade Seer
text: "Perhaps you can't see the path, but that doesn't mean it isn't there."

name: Charix, the Raging Isle
text: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.

name: Chilling Trap
text:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Cleric of Chill Depths
text: "Before my people turned to false gods, we built a glittering city beneath the northern sea ice. The magic of ancient Benthidrix lives in me!"

name: Concerted Defense
text: "You mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!"

name: Cunning Geysermage
text: "Come on, Skitch, we'll lose them in the geyserfield."

name: Deliberate
text: "I can't see all that the future holds, but I can keep us one step ahead of death."

name: Expedition Diviner
text: Wizards' spells twist the fabric of reality to channel elemental energies, peer into the future, and even calm the Roil.

name: Field Research
text: "In the field, speed-reading is a survival skill."

name: Attended Healer
text: "My cats have taught me more about the sacred than anything in some old ruin."

name: Glasspool Mimic
text:
"When I touched the Glasspool, I tasted infinite possibility."
—Ashen Wal, Akoum Expeditionary House

name: Into the Roil
text: In theory, the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

name: Jwari Disruption
text:
"You worry too much."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder

name: Living Tempest
text:
"If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes and it'll change ... probably for the worse."
—Amandi, kitesail expert

name: Lullmage's Domination
text: "One spell to quiet the Roil, one to quash the will. The principle is the same."

name: Maddening Cacophony
text: Jace traced Nahiri to the Singing City, but the magic of the ancient ruins threatened to overwhelm his mind.

name: Merfolk Falconer
text: "For generations, we have bred and trained falcons for expeditions into Emeria. Now more sky ruins open themselves to those with the means to reach the heights!"

name: Canyon Jerboa
text:
"Move, you wretched thing! You're scaring the hurdas!"
—Bruse Tarl, Goma Fada nomad

name: Negate
text: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."

name: Risen Riptide
text:
"Most days the sea is my friend. But only most days."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Ruin Crab
text: To an explorer, a priceless treasure. To the crab, a rock to call home.

name: Sea Gate Restoration
text:
"We have much to remember ... and much we can never forget."
—Tazri

name: Seafloor Stalker
text: "Sunken ruins? My specialty."

name: Cliffhaven Sell-Sword
text: "I swing a sword. It's a simple life. A lot of adventurers just see me as some cheap muscle, but if my steel lets them return home with their lives and limbs intact, then I've done my job."

name: Silundi Vision
text:
"Feel the current? Rough waters lie ahead."
—Jori En, expedition leader

name: Skyclave Squid
text: An ancient sea monster dragged the Murasa Skyclave under the waves, then smaller sea monsters moved in.

name: Sure-Footed Infiltrator
text: "I've yet to discover the ruin that can keep me out."

name: Tazeem Roilmage
text: "The Roil can be directed. Observe."

name: Umara Wizard
text:
"You see a waterfall. I see a way up."
—Ko Dari, expedition wizard

name: Windrider Wizard
text: "It's an ideal method for exploring sky ruins. The drakes sniff me briefly but then lose interest."

name: Agadeem's Awakening
text:
"Now is the death-hour, just before dawn. Wake, sleepers, and haunt the living!"
—Vivias, Witch Vessel

name: Blackbloom Rogue
text:
"If you ever want to get back up, do what I say."
—Exena, expedition rogue

name: Blood Price
text: Blood is the oldest currency.

name: Bloodchief's Thirst
text: "We are free. It is our duty to live well."

name: Deadly Alliance
text: "He could handle any one of us, but he's no match for all of us!"

name: Demon's Disciple
text: Taborax's cultists are the latest in a long history of beings who have desired to see Zendikar torn to pieces.

name: Drana's Silencer
text: "Hush."
